product_title: Kidco Auto Close ConfigureGate Pet Gate Black 84" x 31"
review_body:
I really love this gate. We have an odd configuration to our house so even though much of the living space is an open area, when you're in one area you can't see much in the other areas. This creates problems when the family is in one area and my two year old wanders into another, or when we are cooking, there is no way to keep her out from underfoot unless she is locked in her room, which to me isn't really a solution at all. Normal baby gates are too small for the open passageways leading from the family room to the kitchen, so I purchased this gate.
It was very easy to install and I was super happy that I could angle the gate as needed to ensure that I was screwing the gate into wall studs and not just drywall. I also like that once you have it in the spot you want, angled the way you want, you can "lock" it in position. And hey, it doesn't look too bad either. It's not heavy duty wrought-iron or anything, but it's so much better than the bulky plastic or wood and plastic gates, and plenty sturdy enough.

It took me a few minutes to figure out how to actually open the gate. I moved the thumb latch (which is definitely too much for a toddler to handle) but the gate wouldn't open...then I figured out that you have to move the thumb latch, then pull up on the gate, and then you can swing it open. I like that the gate will swing in either direction when you open it.

The only caveats- I have found that I need to step somewhere on the gate (I usually step on the hinges right next to the gate door) before pulling upward on the gate door. Even though it's not difficult to pull it up enough to swing it open, enough pulling force is required that I feel more comfortable providing some downward pressure so the portions of the gate that are connected to the wall don't get pulled up and out of their fittings (you screw a piece into the wall and then the gate snaps downward onto that. It’s very sturdy...unless you're pulling UP on it repeatedly).

Also, you will need to make sure that your toddler or other kids don't stand at the bars and shake them (during a tantrum or something). The gate has stayed put so far but I could see the possibility of it coming loose if treated very roughly. It hasn't happened yet but I would rather not take chances.

But as I said before, I really love this gate. Now when we're hanging out in the family room, I can relax on the couch without either having to pop up every five seconds to bring the toddler back in the room where I can see her, or having to follow her all over the house to make sure she won't break anything or hurt herself. And if I'm cooking in the kitchen and can't have her underfoot, I can put her in the family room with her toys and shut the gate. From where I stand while cooking, she can still see me (which is good or bad depending on her mood haha) and vice versa, but I don't have to worry about tripping over her with a hot pan or anything. And I'm glad it's just vertical bars- my toddler scales the diamond-patterned baby gates by sticking her toes in them and just climbing up and right over! She can't do that with these (no toe-holds) and the bars are close enough together she can't squeeze through. I would have to double-check but I am pretty sure the bars have same or similar spacing to crib slats- close enough so a baby won't get his or her head stuck in between the bars.

My older kids have no trouble either opening the gate or just stepping over. I am able to step over it as well, even though I'm only 5 feet tall, so that means we don't have to open the gate as much.

review_headline: Battery died sometime in the night after a full charge
review_body:
I really liked this monitor at first, but the second night of use I decided to unplug and bring the receiver over to my nightstand. The night before I left it plugged in across the room on my dresser. With our old Angelcare, the battery always lasted through the night (8 hours or less) but the VTech monitor was off when I woke up. WTH? Turned it back on and saw the low battery. Nice. Good thing my child is a sound-sleeping toddler who rarely wakes, and not an infant in need of several feedings in the night. I will go back to my Angelcare.

We tried it the next day during nap time, and the battery started to die (after a full charge) in under 3 hours.

Original Review:

We were using an Angelcare basic sound monitor, nothing special, before getting this. The Angelcare's audio is still working after 2 years, but the display is no longer functioning. We switched to this a few nights ago and I like it better.

*The sound quality is good. We use a noise machine in our son's room and the Angelcare always sounded very echo-ey. With this VTech, the noise machine sounds like it's sitting on our dresser. I can clearly hear my son if he makes any noise in the room.

*The video display is good for this price point, but still mediocre. The angle is not wide enough and takes some careful positioning. I have nothing to compare it to, but I would imagine if you spent more on it you'd get better video. You can definitely tell what you're looking at, but it reminds me a bit of looking at an ultrasound picture when the room is dark. You can make out his head and see him moving. I don't know what I expected. In any case, this is not a feature I require, so any video is nice to have. I'm not sure how useful this would be with an infant. My son is 2. It is nice to see if he's in there standing up if he makes a sound, or if maybe he's just dreaming.

*Very easy to hook up. I made no adjustments to it and just turned it on. It was dead out of the box and needed a charge, but we have not lost reception anywhere in our 1900 sq, foot house. Our Angelcare had a cradle charger, and I do miss that, but the simple A/C plug works fine, too.

*Talk back feature is nice. Haven't used it yet, but I like having the option. Especially for when my son jumps to his big boy bed. Again, not sure if this would be useful for an infant.

I have this sitting on a dresser, so I have not tried a wall or ceiling mount, but I would imagine you'd get better visuals if you did that. As it is, I can see my son through the crib bars, but it's not the best line of sight.

product_title: Munchkin Click Lock 9oz Straw Cup 2 Pack
review_headline: Finally, we can claim "it's not you, son, it's those other sippy cups"
review_body:
Our young'un could not get the hang of regular sippy cups (the kind with the no-leak valves). We just kept buying different brands and offering them to him as if that would make a difference. My wife and I tried sucking on them to make sure nothing was stuck or that they weren't too hard to suck on, but that wasn't the problem: they were pretty easy to get liquid out of if you have a moderate ability to suck. But, for some reason, our son couldn't get the liquid out. We realize that part of the issue may be that our little one isn't adept at tilting while sipping, and maybe that's what you have to do with a regular sippy cup (but don't quote me on that).

In any case, while exchanging dad war stories at work one day (his involved something cool; mine involved sippy cup woes), a coworker nonchalantly said \\"you need a straw sippy,\\" as if it was the most obvious thing. When I got home, I read that straw sippies often work better for the young'uns because the straw resembles a nipple. Well, wouldn't you know, when we ordered these straw sippies, our son chewed on the straw instead of sucking on it. This persisted for a couple of days until it finally just clicked. He now sips his young'un beverages all by himself! It's a miracle (for us, at least). What I've now learned is that it's maybe not an actual miracle but the fact that these straw sippies have a different mechanism to prevent spills--a lock mechanism instead of a no-leak valve. For us, that has made all the difference. Also, with the straw sippy, he doesn't have to tilt the cup; he can hold it below him just like you would with any straw-containing beverage and the liquid comes out fine.

One caveat: do make sure that you twist the straw sippy lid on perfectly (even if you hear it click), or else the cup is prone to leaking.

So, to sum it up, if your child is deficient at the whole regular sippy cup thing, don't throw in the towel just yet! And if you order these strawsippies and they don't work out right away, give it a little time. For us, it took a couple of days until our young'un finally \\"got it.\\"

review_headline: ... this because of the negative reviews I am very glad I took the leap
review_body:
After being very skeptical and hessitant to buy this because of the negative reviews I am very glad I took the leap. One of the reasons, and as mentioned by most people on here I did not want to buy this was because I was afraid my baby would keep spitting out the nipple or wouldn't give enough suction to the nipple to drink his milk. This is because he doesn't take a pacifier and every time I tried to give him one he would immediately spit it out. I was wrong, because as long as there was something coming out of it he held on to it. I had no problems with him spitting out the nipple or not being able to drink out of it. Of course there were a few times when the bottle tipped over or he pushed it out accidentially with his hands but I just put it right back in. This is great for if you need to do something quick around the home, or if you're traveling in the car or pushing around a stroller. I know many people on here are talking about using this as a bad parenting fopa. However, this is just to make your life a little easier especially if you have more than one child. Secondly, its not for use 24/7, its for those occasional times when you have little time to spare, or can't stop in the middle of the street for a feeding. The best part is you can purchase the parts seperately to attach with any regular 8 oz. bottle with a standard neck, and change the nipple to your liking. I can also see why the makers claim it helps prevent colic. The nipple that comes with it is a natural flow/slow flow nipple so your baby is not gulping down more than they can handle and it makes them fuller quicker so they are not taking more than they need. My baby is a big feeder and I was always worried I was giving him too much formula, so this helps that. Plus, it will NOT leak while he's drinking it, and he burps immediately afterwards which is a great sign so fingers crossed.

For all those who had a problem with assembly, I can personally say it took me less than 30 seconds to put together and take apart with the instructions provided, One larger sized ring attaches to the top with the 6 inch pipe and the smaller ring attaches to the other with the shorter pipe. As far as cleaning goes, its pretty quick surprisingly and you really don't need to clean it out with the pipe cleaner every single feeding unless you see that it needs to. sterilizing it in hot water for a few minutes cleans it out so that it stays clean for a couple of feedings, plus its worth it. I would definitely recommend this for anyone.

product_title: Munchkin Arm and Hammer Diaper Pail with Refill Bags
review_body: This diaper pail is fabulous! Yes, the special clamp-closure diaper bags are more expensive than other brands, but if you don't want your nursery to smell like eau de pupu, this is a must have! The bags click in place and stay in place, no sliding into the pail and spilling out. They are easy to unclick and then pull through the door in the front. When you close the lid, it twists the bag closed at the top to block out the smell then untwists when you open it again. It is easy to put the diapers in, though when it starts getting full it can be hard to close the lid-just wrap the diapers as tightly as you can to fit more in and smoosh them down as much as possible to allow the lid to close when it gets full. Just be sure you wrap up wipes inside the diaper as putting them in by themselves can get the opening wet/dirty. Supposedly it sprinkles baking soda from the dispenser on top when you close the lid. It's a super tiny hole and I don't think I've actually SEEN baking soda come out of it, but it does help absorb the smell. Between the twist-closure and the absorbing baking soda, our nursery NEVER smells like dirty diapers, even when standing right next to the pail. The only time you can smell it is when the lid is up, so it does a great job at sealing in the smell! Then, when you're done, the bags snap tightly closed so they continue to seal in the smell.

product_title: Dreambaby Safety Harness
review_body:
This product worked as advertised, and for a cheap fix, it was great. My first issue was that the "handle" was so short, our son had to be glued to my side (I was hoping he could be a few steps ahead of me) and I'm only 5' tall, so I imagine a taller person would struggle with this. He would not hold my hand because he wanted a little more room, so this did not work in that sense. Also, the harness clips to the "handle" on the sides, underneath the armpit area. Our 2 year old easily unclipped this, so we had to place duct tape over the clips (the harness itself clips in the back) so that he didn't just free himself. It would be much better (and more comfortable, I'd think) if the handle clipped near the center of the back as opposed to the sides. It would also lengthen the handle.

All that being said, the harness seemed to be durable (we only needed it for about 5 months while I was recovering from knee surgery and unable to chase after him) and held his weight when he would pull against me. For a cheap, short term fix, I would buy this again.

product_title: Fisher-Price Space Saver High Chair
review_body:
At first I was unsure of this high chair I really wanted a standing one, but after having it for several months and now going onto over year I am really glad that this is the one that I have.

Pros:
- Fits on any dining chair and has straps around the back and bottom to keep it tight
- Travels easily, we have taken this chair on trips with us and doesn't take up much space
- Easy to clean up
- Multiple positions. You can recline the back and then change it to a booster seat as they get older
- Washable fabric
- Unescapable; my mother in law has a standing high chair and my little one is able to climb out of it; with this one she is unable to escape from the high chair.
- Removable buckles

Cons:
- The tray washes very easily; but I found that if you are eating pasta and have a red sauce it stains the tray. It takes several washings for it to come completely out. At first I worried that I would have a stained tray but eventually it would go back to the white.
- Don't always realize that food gets into the buckle holes and when you go to wash it (I am always throwing it into the wash) that there is food stuck to the bottom.

Overall this is a wonderful high chair, it is easy to move around and my little one loves sitting in it. Even though the pasta sauce does stain it, it eventually comes out and I can overlook that aspect of it. If you are looking for a high chair that doesn't take up a lot of space this would be a very good option for you.

product_title: Evenflo Maestro Booster Car Seat
review_headline: We Have Had This Seat For Almost a Year and it's Great!
review_body:
I bought this seat for my two year old about a year ago. We absolutely love it even after a year. It's crash test ratings are very high which is my I chose this seat to begin with, as it also has good side impact ratings as well. The cushioning is pretty soft and comfortable for my two year old. The seat is very durable and relatively comfortable. The cup holders have been great to have, as my son puts his sippy and even toys in them.

I do have a few complaints, but this seat has by far been the best we've ever purchased. The latch system for hooking the seat into the vehicle is tough to unhook but it can still be done. It's just difficult. Also when my son falls asleep, his head occasionally falls forward but this used to happen in the old seat also. Finally, there was a recall for the buckle on this model for certain dates. Our model had the recalled buckle. Amazon did a great job emailing me about the recall, and upon entering some simple information into the Evenflo website Evenflo sent us a replacement buckle within 2 weeks completely free of charge. The new buckle is fabulous so now that's not an issue anymore.

Overall for the price, quality, and safety of this seat it cannot be beat!

product_title: VTech Communications Safe andSound Digital Audio Monitor
review_headline: This monitor has been very useful.
review_body:
This monitor has been very useful. The first monitor we used was an old Fisher Price, FP, analogue monitor that someone had given us. It worked well enough, but it had a lot of feedback. One of the things that I liked most about the FP monitor was that it came with one base and two parent monitors. This was nice because we have a two story house and could leave a monitor on each floor.

Eventually when the FP monitor stopped working I researched several different kinds of monitors based on type and price. The VTech digital monitor was appealing because of the customer reviews and that it had two parent monitors.

After purchasing the VTech monitor I have been very satisfied. Typically the battery for the parent monitors will stay charged for about three days, then it takes about 8 hours or so to fully charge again using the AC adapter.

The base unit has a night-light that is a nice feature. I also like that there is a "talk" feature on the parent units. It is nice to be able to communicate with my daughter, especially if it is bedtime and she just needs some encouragement to go to sleep.

Occasionally there will be a problem with the monitor not being "linked" to the base unit, but usually it is because the battery is low. We have wireless internet, but this hasn't seemed to interfere with the monitor system.

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_body:
My son just turned one year old, so I was ultimately (and excitedly) looking for a monitor that was reliable enough to keep an eye on him as we enter toddlerhood and he becomes mobile.

Firstly, I have to say that this is the worst experience we've ever had with a monitoring system. DO NOT BUY if you are looking for something that will not interfere with anything wireless in your home. It will interfere with EVERYTHING and it's absolutely ridiculous. We've tried everything to resolve this issue and nothing worked. Sitting at your computer using wifi? This monitor will cut out and sound LOUD alarms for not having the proper signal it needs for display.

Secondly, the sound is awful. It DOES NOT pick up any sound unless your kid is basically screaming. Other than that, you will not hear anything coming from the monitor. You can't hear coos, sneezes, or COUGHING and as a child with severe reflux, we needed something that would be loud enough if we heard our son coughing in his sleep. I could literally hear my son in his room from my bedroom and this monitor DID NOT pick up any sound whatsoever! Why do we even have this thing set up?

There is no zoom, no two way, no dual cameras or duel parent monitoring. The picture itself is mediocre at best and nightvision is just okay.

This is the worst monitor ever, and we plan on returning the entire system and going back to our old audio monitors. I'd rather be able to actually hear my son during the night and put up with the buzzing and interference of our old audio monitors instead of dealing with this awful video monitor that doesn't even do it's job. Don't waste your money!

review_headline: Compact and super easy to use!
review_body:
First of all, you need no tools at all to put this stroller together! ((cheers)) The pieces pop together easily and quickly.

Secondly, it's very compact! We have a Jeep jogging stroller that we loved, but it was so huge we couldn't put it in our vehicle unless we left children at home. :P This one fits wonderfully! Our other stroller took up a large chunk of our living room, even folded up. It wouldn't fit in the closets. This one does! It collapses easily, and it only takes a pull of a strap on the seat to fold back up. (There's a little button that snaps to secure the stroller from collapsing when you don't want it to.)

Another benefit of this stroller in comparison to our Jeep jogging stroller is the leg room for our children. My 2 oldest children's legs had to bunch up a good bit to fit in the Jeep, but there is plenty of leg room with this one. It's a great option for older children.

The only slight negative is the rougher riding. The wheels on this stroller are solid, so it doesn't ride as smoothly as the Jeep.

Overall, though, we are thrilled with this stroller!

Personally, when I was transitioning to getting used to nursing with my first baby, I LOVED using this stuff, I just applied it frequently to combat the easy off part, there is a TON in the tube so frequent application was not an issue.

review_body: We own 2 of these.  They adjust underneath to fit snugly to the toilet. I feel safe having my toddlers climbing on and off them to go to the bathroom. Easy to clean. Slip resistant underneath.

product_title: Infantino Sash Mei Tai Carrier, Black/Gray
review_body:
I'm using the Mei Tai with baby number 5 from age one year forward. I received it on her first birthday. There is a 9 year gap between #4 and #5 and so with the first 4 I mostly used the 'over the shoulder' sling type for everyday and framed backpack for extended periods (hikes, festivals, etc.).

Being a bit older (44), comfort and ease of use is more important this time around. I found it easy to figure out and by the second or third time was able to get her in and unload her without help. It's lightweight so bringing it in the diaper bag is not an issue. It feels very secure once the straps are adjusted and she seems to like being in it. Often she falls asleep and I just snap the hood on if we are out or lie her down without waking her.

If I were starting over this would be the only carrier I would use along with a framed backpack for longer use. Simply put...I love it so far!!

product_title: Car Charger for Hygeia Breast Pumps
review_body: Sometimes, when baby is asleep in the car, Mommy needs to pump to relieve pressure and to keep up the milk supply.  Hook this charger into a power outlet and pump away.  The long cord allows the pump to be connected to a rear port if necessary and still be handy to reach.

product_title: Kidco Angle Mount Safeway Pet Gate
review_body: The gate is great. It swing open no problem. Easy to adjust. It was a pain to install. I tried to install with out the banister installation kit and it was a no go. My 8 month old could fit under it on her hands and knees. Once I ordered the kit it was better. You will be better off using your own screws as the ones provided stripped easily and one broke off in the kit. The kit is basically a piece of wood and two clamps to hold it onto the banister. If you are handy you could put it together yourself. All in all we like the gate. Easy to open, strong enough to hold up against my LO pulling on it large enough to fit boxes through the opening.

product_title: Dream On Me Mattress
review_body: Would be better if it were not so noisy.  I would have paid more for a better quieter mattress.  Cloth rather than plastic cover would have been better.

product_title: Freddie and Sebbie Bath Toys, Non Toxic Luxury 36 Piece Set Bath Letters and Numbers with Toy Organizer
review_body:
Our daughter absolutely loves it!!
The colours are brilliant.
It is holding up well even with her biting into each one.

product_title: O Ball Twist O Round Toy
review_body: I bought two of these for two 7-month olds in my family. They LOVED it because of the noise, the colors and the ease of handling. Hightly recommend for babies.

product_title: Carter's Toddler Safety Harness, Animal Cat, Pink
review_body: I haven't used it yet but it looks like it meets my expectations. the leash part doesn't look very long but I guess you don't want it too long. my grandaughter wants to play with it so I don't think it will be a problem for her to wear it.

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Walk Thru Gate, White, Fits Spaces between 29" and 39" Wide
review_body: Works great we went though two of the wooden one and had to climb over them or take them down. We love this gate I would tell anyone looking for one to get it.

product_title: Kushies "On The Go" 2-Pack Wet Bag, Large
review_body: Love these.  Always take them with me for dirty clothes or anything that gets wet when I am out.  I bought several so I always have a clean one ready.  I also use after swimming for wet suits and it keeps everything else dry.

product_title: Baby Doll Modern Hotel Style Window Valance
review_body: There are some imperfections in the stitching of the strip - very noticeable when ironing or when direct sun comes from behind. Serves my purposes though.

product_title: NUK Gerber Graduates 100% Silicone Platemat
review_body: This placemat is an excellent price for the quality! It sticks to the table well so my toddler can't move it and spill, which is very nice. Plus its easy to keep clean and can even go in the dishwasher if it needs it.

product_title: OXO Tot Perfect Pull Wipes Dispenser
review_headline: Handy attractive and does the job
review_body: We don't have a baby but we use these for personal wipes in the bathroom.  It surely beats holding onto an old plastic dispenser.  I love the idea of the weight that holds down the wipes instead of some spring loaded thing that can ultimately break.  I liked the first one so much I ordered another.

product_title: Training Pants
review_body: Helped to make our potty training experience go smoothly. Easy for my son to pull these on and off. Thanks!

product_title: Tommee Tippee 2-Pack Closer to Nature Soft Shield Pacifier - 6-12m (Blue)
review_body: Very child has it own preference. My son just happens to be a picky one. He loves the tommee tippee bottles as well

product_title: Nuby Non-Drip Bottle
review_headline: Only one my daughter will use, tough to clean though.
review_body: My search for a sippy cup my daughter will use is over - but I find it hard to clean all the little nooks and crannys of the nipples and top so that its sanitary for the next use. My daughter has formula from this one on occasion and if left for any amount of time it gums up a bit. Not too big a problem for me that I regret the purchase, but I do make sure to clean it ASAP so that this doesn't happen.

product_title: Earlyears Chicken ‘N Egg Stackers – 8 Piece Nesting and Stacking Playset
review_body: Very cute.  My daughter loves to build her chicken tower and knock it down.  She's 16 months old and does have some trouble getting the eggs together, but with practice she's getting better.  They don't stay together when knocked around, but it gives her another opportunity to try to put them together.

product_title: Evenflo Chase DLX Booster Car Seat
review_body:
Haven't had a chance to use this seat yet, but am quite excited and have good expectations. The shipping however was EXCELLENT! Received it very fast and there was not a single dent in the box!

Another exciting thing for me, as people know when purchasing car seats online you take a risk with the manufacture/expiration date, but to my extreme surprise and delight the car seat had been manufactured just 2 months (3/2014) before my purchase date, giving me complete use of my money!

This seat will be getting used on an 8 hour car trip within the next few days, will update with how well my kiddo fit and how much he liked the seat!

product_title: Baby Playpen Kids 8 Panel Safety Play Center Yard Home Indoor Outdoor New Pen
review_body: I bought this for my Grandson and my daughter oved it. Just what she hoped to find for him. Large enough that he was able to roll around and easy to mainpulate to fit any space.

product_title: Summer Infant Contoured Changing Pad
review_body:
I registered for a changing pad but I saw this one and it was on crazy sale, so I bought this one instead (and removed the other from my brick-and-mortar store registry). You really can't go wrong with some of the prices Amazon offers.

This worked great on the dresser we used as a changing table.

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_body: If you are a mom who needs to pump and multi-task, this is the best hands free bra. I have tried another brand and had trouble keeping the bottles supported- I had to use my hands very often. This bra really supports the bras which means no spilled milk. The range of sizing is great, the adjustable back really helps with personalizing it for your best fit. It comes with straps but I haven't used those. It is too bulky to wear under clothes but it is easy to get on and in position if time is an issue. I wish I had gotten it sooner!

product_title: Thirsties Fab Wipes
review_body: Lovely and soft but I agree with other reviewers about the two sides of the fabric sliding against each other making it hard to grip. Not a deal breaker for me though - I like them overall.

product_title: Medela TheraShells Breast Shells
review_body: These have been really helpful for me! I had seriously sore nipples and the feeling of clothes rubbing them hurt so bad. Wearing these keeps clothing from rubbing, and allows healing. They do look awkward under clothes, but totally worth it!

product_title: Mumi&Bubi Solids Starter Kit, Baby Food Freezer Storage Trays
review_body: These arent that great. I would stick to the individual storage containers. If you have a little too much in any of the trays it doesn't close properly. Ive also noticed that this gets freezer burn easily. If you are going to be using this for one specific food, its ok.

product_title: Orbit Baby Toddler Car Seat G2 - Mocha
review_headline: Can't go wrong with an Orbit!
review_body: My daughter and son-in-law won the entire baby car carrier and base with the stroller at a baby convention. when she outgrew the carrier we definitely new we had to buy the toddler car seat. this was our purchase for her birthday.  You cannot go wrong.  she also got the stroller seat for her baby shower,  she just began using it also. So convenient it was great on our trip to Disneyland. While we were there we saw the double attachment and she said I'm getting that for when the next one arrives.  what is great you can attach a lot of things.  Like I said you can't go wrong with this company, you pay for what you get.  i wish this company would of been around when I had my kids.

product_title: UPPAbaby 2013 G-Lite Stroller, Jake Black (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Love the handling on the stroller. I can push my daughter and walk the dog without any issues. It truly is light weight and easy to transport. It was worth the purchase especially since the weight capacity is higher than other umbrella strollers.

product_title: Booginhead PaciGrip Pacifier Holder
review_body: I agree with item. The item is accord with my spectates. Thank you for all. I glad with it. The item size is correct.

product_title: The Organic Woombie Baby Cocoon Swaddle (Big Baby (14-19 lbs), Au'Naturale)
review_body: As my baby got older and stronger, she could break out of anything. I still swaddle her at 10.5 months and love this thing. Otherwise she wakes up in the middle of the night and wants to play and/or run around. I fear her crawling out of my bed and falling out ... and when she's in her crib she'll stand up. She's much safer and sleeps better in this.

product_title: Baby Elephant Ears Head Support Pillow for Car Seat, Stroller, Swing, Bouncer, Changing Table
review_body: My son has torticollis and this was great for the car seat! Would highly recommend. Also easy to machine wash.

product_title: Infantino Grow-with-me Activity Gym and Ball Pit
review_body:
The very reason why I bought this is because it can be converted into a mini playpen, which I havent seen it in any other gym mats thus far. It is extremely easy to assemble, I dont even have to refer to the manual. The size is just nice for my 3 months old. Things to improve: The opening on the turtle's head could be much wider as it only fits one hand and I can only take out one ball at a time. Imagine there are 40 balls to be removed from there..I also hope that it could be folded and kept away neatly.

Something which pissed me off later was I realized that I bought it at USD$90 from an external merchant on Amazon. Few weeks later, Amazon got its stock and sold it only at USD$46. I felt like I had been ripped off! A difference of $44! The merchant is : Toysonline. I will never buy from them again.

product_title: bumGenius One-Size Hook & Loop Closure Cloth Diaper 4.0
review_body: I am very impressed with the bumGenius diapers. They really do make it super easy and convenient to switch to cloth diapers. It's not nearly as difficult as I imagined. They also clean well and really do keep leaks in and prevent diaper rash. I would recommend these in a heartbeat! Worth the price in the end...

product_title: Stork Craft Tuscany Custom Glider and Ottoman with Free Lumbar Pillow, Oak/Chocolate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: So far so good. My baby hasn't arrived yet so I haven't used it much. I will update after a bit of use. It looks nice :)

product_title: Slap-Art Vinyl Wall Decals
review_body: This was very easy to apply to the wall.  At first I had some trouble peeling the first layer but after I laid it down flat on the table and peeled it back keeping the peeling away part low and close to the design, I had no trouble at all removing it.  I think I was pulling it back with a slight "up" angle in my pulling.  Hopefully that makes sense :).  Very happy with the results and exactly what I wanted.  Received promptly.

product_title: Gund Winky Lamb Baby Rattle Stuffed Animal
review_body: my lil guy loves this lil lamb, I picked it out because I liked it so much, but he likes it a lot now. it's washable, fluffs right up in the dryer.

product_title: myBaby Hand Sanitizer with Touch-Free Operation (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great but wish it dispense less
review_body: Really love the dispenser. I bought one to use for soap and one to use for hand sanitizer.  Works well except it dispenses too much even on the lowest setting for kids.  I wish the lowest setting dispense less and that way anyone that needs more can swipe twice instead of my kids walking around with wet hands for a while before it dries.

product_title: Belly Banter Baby Stickers
review_body: Love these stickers, they are super cute and after I used them for pictures, I put them back on the paper for future use in my daughters baby book!

product_title: Aden By aden + anais Muslin Swaddle Blanket 4 Pack
review_body: These blankets were an excellent size and were extremely useful for swaddling as the little one as he continues to grow bigger and bigger. They are a great weight and very breathable, so the little ones don't get too hot when swaddled up.

product_title: Organic Training Pant - Dark Navy Stripe 2-4 Years Underpant
review_body: I'm so happy with this product. It's more than I expected when ordered. The fabric is soft and there is something about boys and stripes. My son demands to wear these over the others. They also have extra padding in case of accident, which I didn't expect. I love these

product_title: Philips Avent BPA Free Soothie Pacifier, 0-3 Months, 2 Pack, Packaging May Vary
review_body: My daughter used it loves it. I have them in muti places for here great product. A must to have !!!

product_title: Babies Sparkle Back Seat Mirror - Keep Your Baby In View At All Times. The Babies Sparkle back seat mirror rotates 360 degrees and can pivot in any direction. With a large convex splinter proof surface, it allows you to see your baby at any angle, perfect for rear facing carseats. Never guess why your baby may be fussing, now you will know with a glance in your mirror, avoiding distraction, result
review_body: Very happy with this mirror. Easy to assemble, stays put on the headrest, and gives the comfort of seeing the baby's face.  He seems much happier too cause he can see his mommy. Thanks for a great product.

product_title: Munchkin Warm Glow Wipe Warmer
review_body: I know not everyone is a fan, but I would think I would rather have my butt wiped by a warm wipe than a cold/room temperature wipe!  If the wipes seem to be getting a bit dried out, I just pour some water over them.  But in almost 2 years, I have only had to add water twice.  Easy to put new wipes in.  Can get a bit annoying when the new section starts and you have to dig your fingers in, but that didn't stop me from getting another one when I had another baby.

product_title: Bumkins Reusable Flannel Wipes
review_body:
These are okay. They've been washed multiple times now and are still not very absorbent. I guess they'd work okay for pee, not so much for bigger messes - you'd go through 3 or more. Also, they are always bunching up in my washer and so they aren't flat anymore. They work well to clean out baby's eyes or as a washcloth when bathing. They already seem to be wearing thin, or maybe just start that way?
I wouldn't buy more - I'm a fan of the two sided wipes from GMD.

product_title: timi & leslie Annette 7-Piece Diaper Bag Set, Dusk Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: When I read other reviews that said the fabric tore I thought they might have been hard on the bag. I really liked the design, so I bought it.  I am not hard on my bags at all, yet the material on the handles has cracked where the handle tubing ends inside.  Super disappointed!

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review_body: We have two of these- one for grandmas and one for home. It folds up nicely for on the go, is easy to clean up with no cushions for food to stick to, and is so simple.

product_title: Spasilk Cotton Hooded Terry Bathrobe with Booties, 0-9 Months
review_body:
was very cute hadn't washed it yet but feels a little rough for a babies skin
should be ok after wash and fabric softner

product_title: Evenflo Tribute 5 Convertible Car Seat
review_body: Good sturdy car seat. Packaging was also great. Good value of money. Nice shopping experience. Go for it. I have no issues so far.

product_title: Award Winning Kidsme Food Feeder
review_headline: It might work on other babies but not mine.
review_body:
My baby hated it and I think it's because of the texture that silicon pouch with multiple holes give to her tongue.
To be little fair, she hates most silicon nipples as well and only latches to one kind.

product_title: JOOVY Too Qool Silver Double Tandem Stroller
review_body:
I bought this from BuyBuyBaby and I loved the soft insert and the quality of fabric. I also loved the overall quality of this stroller, but there are few things that I would like to see changed: I wish the 2nd seat would be placed on the front wheels (like City Select), not on the back wheels, that way both children could see around and both seats could fully recline. Also, the space inside the basket is lost due to the placement of the 2nd seat.Also, it seems that the skating board will only work with one of the seats on and won't work with both, as there will be not enough space due to the placement of the 2nd seat.

I wish there would be an option to buy one seat and later add the 2nd seat.
Peekaboo window should be larger, and the stroller fabric should have SPF 50 (I'm not sure if it does).

I really loved the quality and color of fabric and I think the stroller would be great for just one child, but will not be that great for two kids because of the placement of the 2nd seat.

product_title: FridaBaby NoseFrida The SnotSucker Nasal Aspirator
review_body: This really is easier to use than the bulb. I think it's way more sanitary too - you can take apart and wash. The bulb is impossible to clean inside and mothers have posted on Facebook and other places the mold they've found inside their bulbs when they cut them open. NO you don't get boogers in your mouth - obviously not. As others have explained, there's a filter to prevent that. Good price and use it all the time.

product_title: 8 oz Clear Glass Nurser 3 Pack
review_body: I wanted glass bottles for my infant and these work great. The nipples that came with them were flimsy and leaked. I purchased new nipples and the problem was solved.

product_title: KEET Roundy Rocking Chair Gingham
review_headline: Very pleased with this rocking chair
review_body:
I got this for my grandaughter for her first birthday, hoping that with just being a year old she would be able to sit in it comfortably. It worked! Its built at a good height so she can get up in to it, but also appears that she will be sitting in this chair for several years as she grows. I also like that the chair will only rock back and forth when most of her weight in sitting is at the edge of the chair. When she sits back into the chair it stays still with a slight recline. The chair is of good construction, nicely padded and the upholstered material is of good quality. Love the Gingham Navy! Looks nice in our den. AND....no assembly required! Shipped in great condition and all we had to do was pull it out of the box and take it out of a plastic bag!
I order quite alot with Amazon, and as always, most pleased with the quick process and shipping.

product_title: Hudson Baby Organic Receiving Blanket
review_body: These are the greatest blankets ever!!! We got two at our shower and purchased a third because they are perfect for swaddling! Very soft and stretchy! I would buy one or recommend to any friend of mine expecting a baby!

product_title: C.R. Gibson Loose-Leaf Memory Book
review_headline: Get a blank one and make your own
review_body: I felt obligated to keep a memory book for the babies but was too lazy to create my own. I'm just not the scrap booker type.  However, this did not suit my needs at all. There are several issues. The preformed questions aren't things that are important to me or of any consequence to my life or memories.  An example of this would be a section where you put the price of gas, bread, etc on the day they are born.  There is also an entire page devoted to listing the people who attended your baby shower and the gifts they gave.  Things that matter to me are moments but this book seems to focus on things. Also, I'm realizing that all our photos are now digital and the likelihood I will print them, cut them to fit into their prescribed shapes and sizes, and then past them into the book, is unlikely.  I would not recommend buying this sight unseen.

product_title: The First Years  Deluxe Fold and Go Diapering Kit
review_body:
Overall I am pleased with this product. I like that the mat is easy to wipe off after use or if there is a mess. I also like that I can just grab this and go into a bathroom and change my kid.

One thing that I found is to leave the wipe container at home. I have chosen to use the go wipes in the disposable packs instead. I take one with about half left and place it into the mesh pockets.

To use this product I take in my wipes a few diapers and a shirt. It all rolls up into the mat without the plastic wipe container. I did forget a shirt once and my. Baby had a blow out and we had a problem:) she just went to the car in only her diaper.

Overall worth the money and very useful! I will be giving This as a shower gift from now on!

product_title: Philips AVENT Natural Glass Bottles
review_body: Buy glass instead of plastic bottles, even it costs a few dollars more. First, the glass heats up more quickly when you have milk/formula in it from the fridge and you're running the bottle under hot water. Second, oily and greasy liquids wash out of a glass bottle much more easily than plastic. Lastly, with glass you can be sure there are no harmful chemicals getting into the baby. I haven't tried a brand of glass bottle other than Avent, but I'm very pleased with it.

product_title: Baby Kid Toddler Crawling Practice Game Play Mat Family Picnic Yoga Foam Blanket
review_body:
Really nice colorful and learning apps.
Just could be a little more cushion.. As to my 10 month is moving more and the thickness could help with unexpected falls..overall it good just place a blanket under..

product_title: Door Monkey Door Lock and Pinch Guard
review_body: This little gadget is worth every penny. I can adjust the height on the door frame so that a shorter or taller person can open the door. It keeps the cats and dogs, as well as older brothers, out of baby's room and yet lets me peek in when baby is sleeping. It works on standard door frames of interior doors. I repainted all the walls and doors and was a little fearful that the lock would scratch the new paint, but it doesn't. As baby gets a little older, I expect I'll buy a few more of these for other doors.

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Walk Thru Gate, White, Fits Spaces between 29" and 39" Wide
review_body: I purchased this gate to keep a great dane from going up the stairs, and so far so good. Assembly was very easy and quick. I put all my weight on the gate and it wouldn't budge. I wish it was a little taller, but the sturdiness at least provides a good barrier.

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_body: I like this blanket so much. I got two for my daughter for the entire winter, and after four months, they still look nice.

product_title: Luvable Friends Bright Colored Animal Face Baby Bibs, Blue, 5-Count (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Pretty colors and design but has noisy plastic backing
review_body: These are adorable to look at but I don't care for the plastic type back which makes a loud crinkle noise and isn't comfortable for the baby to wear because of the drooling/excess spit up. But colors are beautiful and the animal stitching is really cute.

product_title: PRIMO Folding Potty with Handles, White granite
review_headline: A must have in the diaper bag
review_body: It is small when folded and can be fit well in the diaper bag. We always have it with us when use a public restroom. Well made.

product_title: VTech Communications Safe andSound Digital Audio Monitor
review_body: I was really impressed by this monitor. No interference in my large house and has a very long range. The only problem (very tiny issue) is it beeps when you turn volume up or down, and it disturbs my husband if he's sleeping.

product_title: Graco TableFit Highchair
review_body: Not only does this look so nice, it is fantastic quality as you would expect with a Graco product. It has a couple trays to switch out. Easy to clean. It is on rollers which is very nice to have! You can put the stoppers on just like you would a stroller.

product_title: Starting Small Puppy Novelty Hamper - Tan (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I bought this for a baby shower and bought the baby to be all these cute little things and then just put in the hamper. It was
just great for what I wanted it for.

product_title: My Pool Pal Reusable Swim Diaper
review_body: Fits as expected and provides great protection. I bought a size 3 for my 2 year old though because he's a big baby and I want him to be able to use it till he turns 3 (hopefully).

product_title: The Safe Sippy 2 2-in-1 Sippy to Straw Bottle
review_body: IT LEAKS BADLY! Even when the cap is on! Very disappointed in this buy! Wish I could return it still!

product_title: Boppy Simply Stylish Slipcover
review_body: This is a nice fleecy soft boppy cover. The only thing I don't super like about it is that the zipper is straight across one side of the boppy where the baby lays while eating.  My other cover has the zipper around the edge and out of the way.  Overall, not a deal breaker as this is very soft and not expensive. And I did buy a second one in the bright green color.

product_title: Jeep Cherokee Sport Stroller, Cobalt (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Light and easy to move à round. Perfect for taller people. I'm 5'7" my husband ils 6' and we are both confortable.

product_title: RLR Laundry Treatment and Cloth Diaper Stripper
review_body: It worked great for helping my strip my cloth diapers. Came fast in the mail and worked just like I thought it would

product_title: Sweet Jojo Designs Pink, Gray and White Elizabeth Bed Skirt for Toddler Bedding Sets
review_body: Does not work on a crib unless you put a short side on the wall...returned it. It would work when bed converts to a toddler bed

product_title: Munchkin Xtraguard Dual Action Multi Use Latches, 2 Count (Pack of 2)
review_body: Skip the other brands and go straight to these. They are the only thing that holds up, and I like that you can remove either side depending upon how you want to use the product.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Peek-a-Boo Soother, Waterfall
review_body:
My 1 year old son loves this new crib toy. To me, the light seems super bright, but it doesn't seem to bother him so it's ok.
The features in the product details are all accurate. I love the different settings of sound and light because my baby has a heartbeat teddy bear that plays music, so I didn't need this toy to play music and we only use it for the lights and the animal's motions. He figured out how to turn it off and on by himself so now at bedtime he can play with it for awhile before going to sleep and in the mornings he has something to keep him occupied for a few minutes as well.
This really helped with the transition of him falling asleep in my arms while feeding, to laying him down in his crib while he was still awake so he could learn to sleep on his own. Very happy with this purchase, and we've had it for about 4 1/2 months now and have not had to change the batteries yet.

product_title: C.R. Gibson Keepsake Chest
review_body: I bought 2 of these memory boxes. I was surprised when I received it that it was larger than I expected (which was great!). It can fit a large memory book and has a divided drawer and storage under the lid. I loved that you can personalize with a picture on the front. This product is definitely worth the price! I couldn't have asked for anything better.

product_title: Nursery Fresh Refill for Diaper Genie
review_headline: Works, but is a little taller than Diaper Genie brand, so lid does not close properly.
review_body: We've only used one of these so far.  It does seem to work ok.  The bag material is a little more thin.  The issue I found is that the ring itself is slightly taller than the D.G. brand, which does not allow the lid to fully close.  I haven't really noticed a smell yet, but I imagine that if you had a really funky diaper, it could be an issue.

product_title: Dekor Diaper Plus Diaper Disposal System
review_body: I use this pail with 2 reusable liners for my cloth diapers and have found it to be superior to using a simple wet bag on a hook.  When I have a wet diaper in one hand and a baby in the other, it's super convenient to be able to step down and drop rather than trying to unzip, dump and rezip a wet bag. I found that while using zippered wetbags, I was often leaving the bag unzipped - either because my hands were full or I was frazzled and simply forgot to close it.  These frequent mistakes lead to an unpleasant smelling nursery. While the smell issue was preventable with some additional care, the Dekor pail made keeping my nursery fresh SO much easier.  I recommend the Plus size (thought I have not seen the 'regular') as it is relatively compact but not so low that I need to bend down to dump the diapers (I'm 5'6"). I think the standard sized pail would have been too short. Capacity wise, the Plus is more than I need for 1 day's worth of diapers.

review_body: I've been using this for about 4 months now and it works great.  I have a 2000 square foot house and it works anywhere. It keeps the screen off to save the battery until a configurable sound threshold is reached.  Without it in the mode, the battery will only last a couple hours.  Even in "VOX" mode, now that the battery is older, it only lasts about 10 hours.  Compared to other baby monitors, it has very good quality video on a nice, large screen.  Compared to modern video standards, the quality is terrible.  I really wish baby monitors had HD video.  Overall this seemed like the best baby monitor out there, and I'm pretty happy with it.

product_title: Baby's Journey Babysitter High Chair Pad
review_body:
We have used this product now for a couple of months and we are very pleased. I recommend this to everyone I know, and I get people in public asking me about it constantly.

Pros:
Easy to carry to a restaurant, small and compact.
Has a carrying case
Allows baby to sit more comfortably
Keeps baby more contained than typical restaurant high-chairs. When you have a very, very active baby like us, this is a must!
SANITARY! Restaurants do not clean their high chairs. They are always sticky, grubby, gross and this is washable.
Working buckles - restaurant high chairs SO OFTEN have broken buckles, and that does not work for my active baby.
Baby is not at table height. This can often be a con, but can also be a pro! Baby is away from all the tempting plates and objects on the table. However, if you want to feed him from the table, it can be a little more challenging, but not impossible.

Cons:
Not all restaurant chairs are created equal. This product will work with nearly every chair, but some have lower backs or open-style backs that are not very good with this product. When the restaurant chair back is low, the baby tends to slide down. We typically plan our eating out around spots that have "good chairs." LOL.

Takes a little practice to get the straps right. Not a big deal, but it is good to practice on your dining room chair at home before getting to the restaurant with wiggly baby.

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_body:
We love co-sleeping. But there comes a time when baby gets uncomfortable and needs their own sleeping space. However I had to figure out how to keep baby warm at night because they wouldn't have my body heat and I don't want to use blankets as I don't want my infant to suffocate (I know someone whose 9-month-old got tangled in a blanket and died). My son was waking up and so so cold, even while wearing his footed, fleece sleepers. One night I put clothes on under his fleece sleeper and it occurred to me that I should look into these sleepsacks I've heard about. These HALO sleepsacks are absolutely amazing. They keep him warm and safe. My baby is 11-months and can still wake me at night because of teething or whatever but for the most part he stays asleep because he is warm. I got two pairs, one to use while the other is washing, but I'd recommend having 3-4. The reason being that if baby sleeps through the night and gets a pretty full diaper these do absorb that funky ammonia smell more than other fabrics so they do need to be washed after every use. If your baby still wakes and gets changed in the middle of the night it's not as big an issue. Better to have too many than too few.

We got size MEDIUM when my son was 9-10 months old. He is now 11-months-old and they still fit with some room to grow. He's of average size for his age. Hope that helps!

product_title: Safety 1st Magnetic Locking System
review_body:
The installation of these locks needs to be fairly precise and it took me about 10 - 12 minutes per drawer/cupboard but it was totally worth it. I love that there's no risk of fingers getting pinched in slightly open doors and that I'll never have to uninstall them because of the disable switch.

Just inspect the locks and your cupboards for a while before getting started to REALLY understand the way they install and operate. I noticed that the printing on the template for the latch was a little off so I managed to adjust where I was marking the cupboard to drill the holes. Also, don't try to mark the locations for holes with a pencil as they suggest. Use an awl, or if you don't have one, a big nail or screw should do the trick. Also, always check where you've marked by holding up the lock or latch to make sure the marks align with the holes. I have one place where I need to fill a hole and try again because I marked it badly.

Sometimes they'd work fine with no beeping, and and all of a sudden they'd start coming unlinked and begin beeping again. Waking up in the middle of the night to that noise is really obnoxious. We dealt with that issue for months as best we could, but then recently the monitors started to lose pixels on their screens. They were getting harder to read, and the beeping was not going away. I called VTech today and they said they would send us new units and we should send the old ones back to them. I'm looking forward to getting the new ones and I hope they work better. product_title: Baby Jogger Vue Stroller
review_body:
The Baby Jogger Vue's most unique aspect is the ability to move its seat position from backward to forward-facing. This is achieved with little hassle, without sacrificing safety or style.

This is a well built stroller. Both the seat and five-point harness are comfortable for baby (includes infant head support). The handles are seriously padded (nice and high for me at 5ft.5in., though non-adjusting) and fixed slightly inwards for a more natural feel.

I love the solid lever used to raise and lower the seat for both sides/directions. You can also strip the ENTIRE fabric seat/sides from the frame and throw it in the wash!

The canopy is huge and sturdy. It easily adjusts without having to be removed in order to switch positions (it was difficult to initially lock the canopy into place-best way is from the FRONT for leverage).

The wheels are smooth, lightweight hard rubber, but the ride is generally quiet with little vibration. I can easily maneuver around tight corners with only one hand (having front wheels UNlocked). With front wheels locked, I am able to run fast on a straightaway without any wobbles. Also, back wheel brakes lock at the same time instead of independently (limits accidental rolling).

The Baby Jogger Vue is extremely easy to set up once you flip open the the side lock (it automatically locks when you fold the stroller down) and step on the back middle lever. Folding down the stroller is just as easy if you ALWAYS do this: 1.Step on the small side lever once. 2. Step on the big middle lever. 3. Step on that first small side lever again.

Though this doesn't fold as compact as your typical umbrella stroller (this seems about 35 degrees), a bolted strap makes this very easy to carry. I like not having to remove the canopy to fold down the stroller, and that you have the option of easily removing the front wheels. A detachable cup holder is also included.

The basket is small (zippers and snaps are used to try make it accessible). I'd have trouble fitting the typical diaper bag, but it will accommodate my necessities.

As a serious traveler, I am disappointed that the carry bag and weather shield are not included with this stroller (necessary accessories for me). However, I see they'll both be available on Amazon in mid-June. product_title: bumGenius Freetime All-In-One One-Size Snap Closure Cloth Diaper
review_body:
We use both BG Freetimes and BG 4.0 to diaper our daughter. I am so happy that we only bought six Freetimes before committing to an entire supply of these diapers. My wife and I always refer to these diapers as the "not so Freetimes" because of the amount of time it takes for these diapers to dry. Our BG 4.0's typically dry in a few short hours, the Freetimes can take over a day to be completely dry. This is because the liners are sewn into the diaper; whereas, the 4.0 liners can be dried in the dryer while the shells hang dry. Also, the sewn in liners on this diaper are not nearly as absorbent as the BG 4.0's. My daughter is currently 16 months old. As she grew older, and her "big girl pee" became more and more abundant, we have had to be extremely careful to change her out of her Freetime diaper sooner than a 4.0. Otherwise we are sure to have a leakage problem. She always goes to bed wearing a 4.0.

There are a few pros to this diaper. On the contrary to other reviews I have read, I find bowel movements easier to manage with the sewn in liners. I don't use a diaper sprayer. But I am able to hold the diaper on both ends while discarding the poop into the toilet. Any residual poop is easily scrapped off the diaper simply by using one side of the diaper to scrape while holding the other side steady with my other hand. The Freetime is a great diaper for when you are out and about. It's easy to throw into a plastic bag without having to worry about removing the inner liner. Although, now that my daughter is older, I make sure she never leaves the house wearing a Freetime. Her big girl pee is sure to leak out the sides and spoil the car seat.

review_headline: Solid product would recommend, for large openings, but will need some modification
review_body:
Bought this to go in a large opening between our kitchen and living room. It works very well. Gate is easy to open, but not so easy your child could open it.

Pros
- Easy to open gate (some baby gates are so difficult that they are practically adult gates too)
- Gate has a spring to auto shut, but also will "lock" open if opened all the way.
- Easy to mount to a wall
- We only used 4 sections for our opening and it is very easy to unhook the gate in the middle and fold the sections to the side for parties.
- The base slides around a little on our hardwood, but it has not yet scratched anything.

Cons
- Can not be adjusted in small increments. This is the reason for 4 stars. You can shorten the gate by removing entire sections. We removed two, but it was then about 6 inches too short. We chose to add some wood to one end which was hidden by some furniture.
So carefully measure your opening, if its a lot bigger then each section you might have some issues

review_body:
I bought this seat to carry grandkids because they find it comfortable. I wanted to have one of my own to avoid having to plan ahead to borrow one.

My only disappointment with this product is that it wasn't explained when I bought it that Evenflo only recommends this be used for 6 years after the date of manufacturer. They print the manufacturer date in big type on the box (year month day). This seat advertised as NEW was manufactured in 2010 and delivered for use in 2014 with 60% of its usable life already gone. Had my husband not already assembled it, I would have returned it and purchased one in a store where I could see the date.

Future buyers should be aware that there is assembly required. No tools, but the one time assembly instructions describe the process saying \\"...may require additional force to install properly.\\" They show how to line up the headrest and tell you to push until it snaps in.

It's been used by a 43lb 6-yr-old who likes it. Says it's comfortable. We haven't used the built in lights, but I liked the feature so the kids could read at night without handling a flashlight. The light is automatically directed down where it can't disturb the driver and the kids can't accidentally shine it in their eyes.

product_title: Born Free Bliss Nursing Pillow Slip Cover
review_body:
This \\"Born Free Bliss Nursing Pillow Slip Cover, Fun Dot\\" is a very thin 100% cotton pillowcase-type sheet that's in a fun graphic/color palette (the blues seem more greenish than photo-a good choice for both boy/girl). The cover is easy to put on and fits the unconventional shape/features of the main pieces of the Bliss Feeding Pillow very well.

I really like the colors and the pattern. This pillow is visually interesting without being an eyesore (easily matches my nursery items). The main piece will transition into a great toddler pillow, so I'm happy that the cute pattern is on that part. The velcro works well, but isn't a pain.

I only wish that this cover provided better protection for the pillow. It has about the same protection as a basic pillowcase. Having no waterproofing layer, this slip cover cannot protect the pillow from milk leakage, spit-ups, blow-outs...Any of these will immediately leak straight through.

*I discovered a cheap solution-tall kitchen garbage bags (the white ones with draw strings). The slip covers are just the right size to accommodate using a bag for each piece. Kitchen bags are the perfect size to COMPLETELY cover (you punch a small hole on totally sealed side). The other end you draw together and tie around loop or velcro tab.

You can't tell the bags are on the pillow-it still looks and feels great. No more worries...I can simply remove the covers and wash once dirty, then air dry.

Note: This cover is different than their QUILTED version. Also, only two slip cover pieces are included, but the pillow is made up of 3 parts. I think there's an assumption that one would just wash the entire smaller piece (fortunately, it matches the slip cover). Still, it would be nice to include a third piece in order to cover all three parts of the pillow.

review_body:
The biggest advantages to this tub are that it is foldable to be portable, and when folded, it is easy to store. Even though it can be folded for storage or travel, it is very stable when placed on a flat surface, and seems relatively durable.

Admittedly, the need for a flat surface can be a bit of a pain. We have used baby tubs in the past in conjunction with the kitchen sink. Forget about that with this tub.

The inflatable bottom of the tub replaces the sling of other baby bathtubs. While the inflatable portion is slippery when wet (duh), babies seem to like it - or at least, they are comfortable with it, perhaps more so than with the sling configuration. I do have a vague concern about puncturing the plastic, though this tub does come with a repair kit. I should note that the plastic seems fairly thick, so it would require something relatively sharp or heavy to puncture the plastic. The major downside to the inflatable part is blowing it up, which means it takes a bit of time for setup.

I should also point out that this tub is colorful and pretty. I have no idea what babies think while they are lying in it, but they generally seem happy. I should also point out that this tub adapts to a growing baby, so you may use it until your child is toddler age, and perhaps a bit more.

This tub does one thing really well. It folds for storage and for road trips. After that, it seems like a nice, sturdy tub. It may cost a bit more than comparable tubs, but you get the advantage of being compact, which can be great for apartments and going to grandma's house. It is pretty, and easy to clean, though setup can take a bit of time. Overall, I think this one ends up with a lot of advantages and relatively few disadvantages.

Enjoy!

product_title: Skip Hop Soho Herringbone Cross-Body Diaper Clutch
review_body:
Wow, what a brilliant idea. I took this little bag shopping today - wanted to give it a real spin before I reviewed it - and I am in love. I am currently carrying 4 size 2 diapers, wipes, my wallet, keys, my phone in the outside pocket, and an extra onesie rolled up just in case. I carry a big wallet too, more like a small clutch. You might be able to get more diapers in with a smaller wallet (actually, you almost certainly could). A few observations:

I agree with another poster that the wipes case leaves something to be desired. I purchased a small thin plastic container that holds ten or so wipes (Buti pods, I think) and that opens up more space although I am not yet sure how much I like them. Any thin travel case for wipes would easily slide into the designated spot though. The changing pad is not cushy however it's nicely made, easy to fold up, and plenty large to put a layer between your baby and any nasty changing tables. Think about it...for trips to the store or out to eat (not that I do much of that with a 2 month old) you really don't need tons of diapers. You certainly don't need a giant bag. I breastfeed...it seems like a bottle would cost you valuable diaper space but - doable. I honestly wasn't a big fan of the color scheme but it's grown on me, and this is the only bag that fits in with what I was searching for so it's a minor issue. I gather these are fairly new, I hope SkipHop eventually adds more color options. And the price point is amazing. Overall a well made and well thought out bag. I feel so liberated from the big diaper bag and will only use it for day trips because of this bag. One other nice feature, the bag looks like it will easily wipe clean.

product_title: Brica By-My-Side Safety Harness Backpack
review_headline: My daughter feels like Dora and I feel better about crowded outings
review_body:
I hesitated for some time before deciding to get a "leash" for my little girl- now 23 months old.

She loves to explore our neighborhood with me, but doesn't always like to hold hands. I haven't used the lead/tether yet but I feel better knowing I have something to grab onto if she makes a mad dash toward danger.

It also helps when we go to our local farmer's market. She hated being in the stroller because she couldn't see anything and I was nervous because the stroller keeps her at eye level to the dogs that a lot of people bring to the market as well. I don't hate dogs I just know that some people have illusions about the temperament of their pets, especially in sensory overload situations. I would just prefer to carry her in dense crowds and this product allows me the confidence to allow her some walking time but the ability to scoop her up if the need arises.

We even use this for our trips to the park, it doesn't' limit her ability to play at all. We put a sippy cup, a fruit pouch, sunglasses, and a pacifier in her backpack and off we go!

I was unsure if she would be willing to wear a backpack, but once she saw it, she was all about it. "Mah backpa!" Said exclaimed when I put it on her for the first time.

I decided on this product over a conventional backpack because it has the chest strap. It is also not too bulky.

We have been using this product for about 2 months now. I am a fan and would recommend it or something like it to a caregiver who wants the flexibility that I had outlined above.

product_title: Joovy Spoon Walker
review_headline: Good quality, poor adaptability as child grows
review_body:
The Joovy is a "top of the line" walker as far as quality goes, in my opinion - the mechanism is fluid and easy to propel and turn for a budding-toddler, the tray is nice and large, and overall it seems imminently safe from finger-pinches and toe-injuries… Just one problem. My son looks like he is crouching when he walks - The distance between the seat-bottom and the floor is not nearly adjustable enough to adapt to the needs of my growing little-guy. What worked great a few months ago, is no longer suitable for him now that his legs have gained some length, and to use the walker he has to bend quite a bit at the knees… It's not a great posture for a kid who is supposedly learning to maneuver independently.

I'd recommend this walker if: 1. You have a smaller-size baby (not too tall), who is unlikely to have a growth spurt in the next few months, 2. You have a kiddo with a longer-torso but shorter legs, or 3. You don't mind spending the money on the walker as a temporary device, knowing that your son or daughter may outgrow it long before they are able to walk on their own.

product_title: Tommee Tippee Explora Easiflow Insulated Girl Cup with Dura Straw BPA Free 9 Oz 2 Pack 12m Colors May Vary
review_body: They are truly leak proof if assembled correctly. No liquid comes up the straw unless baby is actively sucking, and once baby lets the suction go, the liquid is sucked back down the straw instead of remaining in the straw waiting to drip out or fling onto someone when the lid is flipped open. I've tried Zoli, BabyThink, and Thermos. The explora cups are trickier to reassemble after cleaning but after you know how to do it properly, it's actually faster and easier to clean these cups than the Zoli or the ThinkBaby, not to mention no special straw cleaners are needed to get these thoroughly clean (any straw cleaning brush will work, even though it's not really necessary). The Tommee Tippee explora straw cups also have much better flow which results in my baby drinking more. The Thermos has so much flow (and isn't spill proof if you turn it upside down) that my baby chokes from taking too big a gulp of liquid.

product_title: Bumbleride Flyer Reversible Handle Stroller with 7" Wheels, Ruby (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Almost Perfect! This great stroller deserves more good reviews!!
review_body:
Bought this stroller for my baby when he was 7 months old and he is now 14 months. I did numerous research online and visited every local baby stores to test drive pretty much all of them with my baby in it. My baby did not like any of the Stokke's (mommy's dream strollers..so pretty…but all TOO HEAVY) or the City Mini (the easiest to fold/unfold, effortless to maneuver), loved the Bumbleride Indie (but we don't need a jogger), that's how I learned about Bumbleride. I highly recommend taking the baby to test the strollers if you can wait. I ended up getting this online without seeing/driving it in person and so glad I did! I have been using it mostly at the mall or walking around the neighborhood. I had taken it to the beach (got stuck on dry/loose sand, ok on wet/packed sand) and paved trails as well.

Pros:
-Reversible handle bar
I LOVE this feature. Being able to face the baby is a must for me, but I really DISLIKE all the other ones which require switching the seat. I like to switch the baby to face me whenever it gets too windy while we are outside, this can be done within seconds. (I saw Baby jogger's Vue when I was looking for an umbrella stroller at the baby store last week, the Vue is a reversible umbrella stroller. I might have considered that one if it was out at the time, but then you still need to take the baby out before switching and the Flyer is so much more chic!)

-Easily adjustable height of the handle bar

-Lays flat
He gets neck rashes easily so I wanted to find one that can air out his chubby neck when napping since sleeping in the carseat with the snap n go was horrible as he got older. It can be adjusted easily with just one hand after the baby falls asleep without waking him. I also use it to change diapers sometimes if you are paranoid about public changing stations like me…

-Sits up straight
My baby is small and he loves to look at everything around him. City Mini's seat is way too deep for him to see anything but straight ahead.

-Adjustable calf/foot rest
Makes a big difference for little babies' comfort when they are still little, my baby didn't like the aforementioned brands and some other popular ones because his legs/feet were dangling.

-Big canopy with mesh peekaboo window
I still use a muslin blanket when he is napping. The canopy can also be unzipped partially or completely during hot summer days for better circulation.

-Very sturdy AND stylish!! Not bulky, and beautiful color (I have the aqua).

-Comes with accessories (bumper bar, infant seat adapter, cup holder and rain cover, although I only use the bumper bar)

-Relatively light weight for a full-sized stroller which can have a carseat attached to as well, although I have not tried that option since I have a snap n go.

-Easy two hand fold
Although you need to switch the handle bar to the facing out position, it is still easier than having to take the seat out when folding it to put in the car. This stroller takes up about half of the trunk in '08 Accord and '14 Q5. I can't imagine having an even bigger stroller…

-Adequate storage space
It can fit the inglesina fast table chair (folded) and my diaper backpack (Gregory Maya 18, if it is not really full) at the same time. I also like to keep his blanket or my light weight jacket on the inside of the canopy if it is not expanded completely since it has multiple panels so it creates a "pocket" on the inside.

-Does not tip over even when I hang two filled 24oz water bottles in the Skip Hop organizer, my big purse, a lunch bag, and sometimes shopping bags on the side of the handle bar without the baby in it.

Cons:
-Maneuverability isn't the best. Especially when he is facing me, but this isn't as important as being able to have him face me easily so I don't mind it too much. Now that he is older, he is usually facing out and I can tell that it pushes much better than the other way. However, I assume due to the "smaller" wheels, that is why it does not drive as well as the other bigger strollers. I really don't think it is that bad and the extra weight of those bigger strollers is just way too heavy for me (I am a 5'1" petite mom).

-No automatic lock when closing. A bit annoying at times but not a deal breaker.

-Bumbleride liner does not fit well, somehow the straps are not long enough with it anymore after I adjusted it to the higher slot, or maybe I just couldn't figure it out.

-Something is rubbing against the canopy when closed so it arrived with some scuff mark on both sides of the canopy and now it is more apparent and a bit torn. But since the fabric is very thick and double layer, it does not cut through all the way.

Even though it is not perfect I am still really glad that I got this stroller, so I hope you will find the one that fits you best after reading all reviews out there! Good luck!!

It's very well built (translation=can be considered heavy) and the fabric doesn't get too hot in our Arizona heat. It was a breeze to install (I've read install was difficult) in our Chrysler town and country. It was as simple to install as the nextfit was.

The way you tighten the harness straps is different than other seats but we have found it just as easy to get a good fit and actually prefer the ratchet style system of tightening that this seat has.

It is very narrow and will fit 3 across in just about any setting. You can use with an angle adjuster to get a better front to back fit in smaller cars once the baby has head control.

Love love love! Thanks Diono!
