review_body: These diapers really wick away moisture from the skin. They're very absorbent and though I haven't needed to stuff it with an insert yet, I like having that option. I really like these diapers for how easy they are to get on my wiggly baby and the simplicity overall. It's truly a no-fuss diaper! Out of all the diapers I have (Swaddlebees Simplex, Peachy Green, Bumware, Softbums, Sprout Change, prefolds with Thirsties covers), these are still the ones I grab first. My biggest problems with these diapers are the bulk, the drying time, the tabs not laying flat, sometimes leaks in the front, and the smell that just won't come out. The other problems I could deal with, but unfortunately smells seem to get trapped in this diaper much more than the others and that's why I have to give it such a low rating.

review_body:

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_body:
Purchased this bc I have the beco Gemini which doesn't work for my slightly early baby who is currently around 8 lb, mid 7s when I got the wrap. Someone recommended a wrap for babies that wouldn't sleep and I thought for the price I would test it out. It was intimidating for me at first but then again every baby item is, watched videos, practiced, and after a few uses feel totally comfy, at first I wasn't sure if it was too tight but it wasn't. If it's too loose the baby slips down. Also I'm 5'9\\" and a bit and I put the bottom wrap up a bit versus the instruction and that really helped.

The best thing is I have a baby that sucks at falling asleep during the day, but I can put this on (now that I know what I'm doing) and he will give a few cries (which scared me at first but now I know) and then fall asleep! Sanity!! Then I wear him for 30 min and then I can put him down without waking him and he sleeps. This is why you should buy the wrap. In a couple lbs I will test out the beco but for this purpose of getting him to sleep after 2 hours of being awake it's amazing!!

review_body: We needed a long gate for our stairs.  This was the only one we found that was long enough.  The problem we had when installing is the adjustment between the "notches."  There is a big difference from one level to the next and we were just a tiny fraction short on one level but the next level caused huge gaps in the sides.  In the end, we took off the nut and cut down the screw a little so we could make up for the fraction of the inch we were short.  After that, it was great.  It is very easy to open and close.  We were worried about that since my son has fine motor problems but even he has no trouble opening and closing it.  It is tall and works great after our "adjustment" for size.

review_headline: Sounded a lot more useful than it really was
review_body: I liked the idea of being able to use this bib multiple times and the easiness of putting the bib on without snaps.  However, realistically I did not feel it was so convenient for me.  The magnets need to be lined up to stay on and I felt it ended up being just the same as snapping a standard bib on.  Also we didn't really feel the need to stick the bib on the fridge because it was out of the way to do that rather than just leaving it near the high chair.  After one use, I didn't feel compelled to just reverse it and reuse it because I thought it was gross to leave the food on there and let it dry and then use it again.  So I ended up throwing it in the laundry anyway after just one use.  And after just one wash, the material would warp quite a bit and get wrinkled, so it was harder to line up the magnets.  Overall, I felt this was a great idea in theory but just did not translate for me in real life.  It's not very practical and considering the price I would probably not purchase it again.

review_body:

product_title: Thirsties One Size Pocket Diaper Snap
review_body:
When I first got this diaper I LOVED IT! Until I washed it... I washed it and dried it with my other pocket diapers (I unsnapped the small insert from the large one to make sure they would dry faster). Put everything in the dryer for 20 minutes on hot. All of my diapers and the small insert were dry, but the large (cotton-like insert) was still damp. I thought that air-drying overnight would be enough, but NO! It took a total of 20 minutes on hot in the dryer and over 24 hours air drying for the large insert to be completely dry.

EDIT: so far these have been the only diapers that don't leak when put correctly, so it's worth the extra time for the insert to dry. In fact, I already purchased several more (although from the Thirsties Outlet because they're much cheaper there and with no flaws)

review_headline: This seat made my child sick

It lasted for a month and turned into bronchiolitis. She had to have chest x rays twice and a nebulizer and an antibiotic. THe Dr. kept wondering why it wasn't going away. One day I was washing the cover, as I do routinely and I noticed a large amount of mold on the base of this seat. The part you can't remove to wash. I looked up the phone number to call fisher price and when I was searching, I came accross a recall on this product. THere have been 600 cases of these develping mold and 16 other reports of babies getting sick. BEWARE! I washed and cleaned mine regularly and it developed mold! My Dr. said it most likely was the cause of her illness and the reason it wouldn't go away

product_title: Fresh Baby So Easy Baby Food and Breast Milk Trays
review_body:
My son is almost two and I am happy to say that he has never had a jar of baby food in his life. These trays make everything THAT easy. I'm a full time working mother and a grad student. If I can make homemade baby food, anyone can. You just need the right tools! A good blender and THESE TRAYS!
When he was younger, I made a couple of batches of different foods per week and my freezer had always been stocked. I would grab 2 blocks of proteins, 2 blocks of veggies, and a starch. Dinner is ready! What a wonderful way to get a variety of balanced foods! Now that he is older I freeze blocks of pureed fruits to blend with yogurt for smoothies.
I buy (or, at least recommend) these trays to all new mothers. They will change the way you feed your little one!
Some people complain about the lids, but they have never given me any trouble at all. I love the lids and being able to stack these in your freezer are great. Also, the lids help out when you can't get around to bagging your frozen treats for a day or two. Nothing gets freezer burned and you won't have any spills! Stay away from dollar store trays that might tip and spill all over your freezer. A loss of sanity isn't worth the few bucks you'll save.

product_title: Infantino Infant and Toddler Activity Gym and Foam Mat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: baby loves this gym and matt
review_body: Our daughter loves this gym, and we love that it comes with the foam mat.  We have hard floors and it cushions her head well.  She loves to kick the soft bars and watch the toys move around.  At 4 months she managed to kick the whole gym over with her bundled inside, but we never leave her along while playing so it didn't bother her, and it doesn't bother us.  She loves the 2 crinkly flaps on the bottom of the mat, the elephant ear and the bird's wing.  It also comes with some cute toys.  She doesn't care for the mirror much, but loves the dog.  We attached a few extra rings and she adores it.

product_title: Britax B-Agile Stroller Child Tray (Prior Model)
review_body: my kid like this add on, I like the tray as it prevents the kid from sliding out of the seat.

product_title: Luvable Friends Woven Crib Sheet
review_body: The visual appeal is great, it fits the crib mattress perfectly. The fabric is a little rough, but didn't seem to bother baby. I'm probably just used to all the soft fabric anything baby related comes as these days. But she's happy with it so I am too.

product_title: Single Bumgenius Elemental Organic Cloth Diaper All in One ALBERT PRINT
review_headline: Love, love, love the genius Bumgenius on my genius's bum!
review_body:
First of all: I am a first time mom. And I decided to cloth diaper my DD.
I am not one of those moms that really go above and beyond wit their laundry, household, cooking, baking.. I am just, well.. too tired, and I honestly didn't even try to fool myself. I am a perfectionist, but I skipped perfection in this case, because I anticipated I would be so stressed out, sleep-deprived, nipple-sore, hungry, showerless.. you name it, once the baby is born. And I was so darn smart right.
I knew I wanted organic, but I also knew I wanted something easy. No stuffing, no folding, no 'snappies' for this tired momma. My friends were so nice to buy me 12 counts of the bumgenius elemental (in random colors) and some pocket diapers to try.
I used a mix of disposables and newborn pocket diapers until DD grew out of them (5 weeks). Then I switched to the bumgenius. She had around 8lbs when we started the AIOs and I never had a single leak. They just fit her perfectly.

So I decided to get some more. Since my husband is a scientist and we both have PhDs (and are super nerdy) I instantly was hooked when I saw the "Albert" print. I thought this print might only available in the "Freetime" version. As soon as I saw it as the "Elemental", I got it.
The print is very cute and it looks geniusly adorable on her bum. Need to figure out where to buy nerd glass frames for babies, so we can take a cute picture (to show at her graduation).
Why they cost $2 more than the normal prints I don't know. But anyway.. for us with our background it's absolutely worth it.

product_title: OXO Tot Baby Blocks Freezer Storage Containers 2-Ounce
review_headline: Easy to open and close, easy to store, easy to clean. Just fantastic.
review_body: Nothing else to say - buying these (or getting a set, rather) motivated me to make my own baby food. Otherwise, I would have never even bothered.

product_title: Evenflo Exersaucer Activity Saucer, Beach Baby
review_headline: liked the first one so much I purchased a second!
review_body:
I purchased this exersaucer for my nephew after I saw how much my daughter enjoyed playing in hers. My daughter absolutely loves loves this! I am hearing that my nephew does as well!

I wish that this model lit up or made noises like the one that I have for my daughter does but overall the children love it and based on that it is well worth the money. I am giving this 4 stars because of what I mentioned about the noise and lights but also because of the fact that Evenflo makes the toys and attachments so that they are interchangeable but finding new ones is very difficult.

Overall - both kids really enjoy the exersaucers. It is very easy to put together and the bouncing is great exercise for them. I'd recommend it to a friend, and more importantly, to family.

product_title: NTM-910YLW - Sony Baby Call Nursery Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
We bought this for when our son was born 4 years ago and it came with one base and two receivers. We used it in our two story house and it worked great. Since these don't need to be plugged to the wall 24/7 I could clip it to my clothes and walk around the house and do chores while our son slept. We recently had a second child and they still work perfectly after 4 years. We ordered this to continue to listen to our son and used the old one for our new baby.
I love how i can hop in the shower and even if i can't hear the noise i can see if the baby is crying based on the LED noise indicator. Sony always makes good products and we haven't had any problems with these monitors.

product_title: Today's Mom Cozy Comfort Pregnancy Pillow
review_body: I looked all over, and i mean all over inside baby and oregnancy stores for a nice pillow. All they had were the tiny candy cane ones. I found this one online and so glad i waited and ordered it. It is so big and comfy and really helps

product_title: Carter's Musical Mobile
review_body: I absolutely adore this precious mobile! My daughter loves it as well. The colors are right on as pictures and the poms fluff out easily. Well packaged and shipped quickly!

product_title: Diono Radian Angle Adjuster
review_body: It really is just a thick piece of heavy duty foam, but I'm glad that I bought it. We have 2 Diono Radian RXTs in the back of my 2013 Honda Accord, one rear facing and the other forward facing. My husband and I are both of average height (we're both about 5'6") and the rear facing car seat is behind the driver's seat. The car seat did fit fine without the angle adjuster, my husband couldn't lean the driver's seat back at all, and was uncomfortable (which isn't a huge deal since it's my car, and he rarely drives it). However, with the angle adapter, it gives about another 3 inches, so my husband can adjust the seat to fit him comfortably.

product_title: Sponge Bob Square Pants Night Light (b)
review_body: my grandson was so happy to see his sponge bob light that first night, I was one pleased grandmother.Very happy with the light. THANKS

product_title: SwaddleDesigns Cotton Flannel Fitted Crib Sheet
review_body: The sheet feels and looks good, but it shrunk after the first wash.  So it doesn't fit the crib now.  For such an expensive crib sheet, I am very disappointed.

product_title: Philips Avent BPA Free Classic Bottle to First Cup Trainer
review_body: very good!Very practical! I loved it!For the baby, it is very important to a good bottle! Children seem to like to use!

product_title: Graco Contempo Highchair, Rittenhouse (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Good high chair for small spaces
review_body:
We have been using this high chair for my daughter for over a year and it's served us really well. It folds up really flat, which is great for our NYC apartment. The tray snaps on and off easily and has a top layer that is smaller and flatter, which helps with cleaning. The harness goes over the shoulders as well as around the waist, which was great when she was a smaller baby. I have noticed that now as a 21 month old active toddler she always stands up in it and leans forward when I remove the tray. Although this drives me nuts and I have to stay close by to keep her from hurting herself, I have noticed the high chair doesn't budge or tip.
My only complaint is that there is a lot of surface area for her to get messy on the cover, and I have to wash it all the time. Liquidy foods set right in and as there is no plasticity to the cover, they don't really wipe off. They just set in. All in all this is a great chair though.

product_title: Graco Pack N Play Playard with Bassinet
review_body:
This was a Christmas present for my grandson, the best present I could have gotten, he loves it.
Mom is happy to as she gets work done now.

product_title: FridaBaby NoseFrida The SnotSucker Nasal Aspirator
review_body:
I have a 21/2 year old and a 10 month old and I use this all the time. It is the only product to really get the snot out when my kids have bad colds. It definately works but my kids do not like it. That said, I feel better knowing they can breath after using this even if they do not like snot removal process.
Everyone with a baby / small child should have one of these on hand.

product_title: Zee Double Stroller Color: Blue Opal
review_body:
It is everything I need it to be! It is a perfect stroller! I love it!
From a mother of five

product_title: Carter's Diaper Bag Set - Pink
review_body: excellent product for the price

product_title: Gyro Bowl
review_headline: I loved it, but not for all kids!
review_body: Ok, I bought this bowl for my son over 3 years ago, it worked awesome, I loved it! I would \\"Only put dry food or snacks in the bowl\\" and only fill half or less. Like I said I loved it because it did exactly what it was supposed to do, but when I had my daughter and tried to use it with her....yeah....Nothing, it did not work because my daughter didn't like the bowl moving around and the little genius would hold it and turn it over and spill everything. She would not allow the bowl to do It's job! But like I said, the bowl is great, it just depends on the child.

product_title: Bebe Au Lait Bebe Au Lait Nursing Cover
review_body: I'm a first time mom and breastfeeding in public was my biggest fear. The coverage and comfort of this nursing cover is so great and it totally made beast feeding in public for the first time an easy transition. Doesn't even show side boob which is a bonus!

product_title: Lansinoh mOmma Feeding Bottle, 8.4 Ounce (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: A great item. Highly suggest, has a good flow and my little one loves it. Will definitely be ordering more.

product_title: Sassy Baby's First Rattle and Teether Gift Set
review_headline: Cut the inside of baby's mouth
review_body: The round rattle with the ball cut the inside of my daughter's mouth. The plastic separated at the seam and was not readily noticeable.  Not a safe product.

product_title: Fisher-Price Discover 'n Grow Kick and Play Piano Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We got this activity mat as a gift before our son was born so he has been playing with it since he came home from the hospital.  He loves it!.  He cried a lot when he was a newborn and had to be held almost constantly, but with this we got some hands-free time.  He is 6 months old now and still loves laying down and playing with the toys but he is also sitting up at the piano and loves to play on it.  He also really likes the pictures/how colorful the mat itself is.

product_title: Skip Hop Duo - Canvas
review_body:
I bought this bag at Babies R Us almost 2 years ago.
Pros: it's small. I don't like the gigantic duffle bag types. I like the straps that clip onto the stroller.

Cons: TOO NARROW it falls over all the time unless packed exactly right (wipes on bottom, bottle in side pouch, etc). It's also so narrow that its impossible to find anything quickly. I have to dig and undo all my organizing that keeps it upright to find the one thing I needed. The top doesn't zip close, it's a small magnet closure so everything falls out when it falls over...every time.

product_title: Disney Baby, Dory Chime
review_body: I HAVE 2 NEW GRANDSONS AND I HAVE "FINDING NEMO" THEME AT MY HOUSE. GREAT TOY!! THEY LOVE GRABBING AT IT!! YES, I RECOMMEND THIS TOY.

product_title: BIG OSHI Baby Fuzzy Plush Blanket - BLP-77
review_body:
I've had a big oshi since my oldest was born. The big oshi has been spat upon, vomited upon, toilet-trained upon (I'll leave it up to your very vivid imaginations to figure out what that means). My oldest came home from the hospital swaddled in a big oshi. The big oshi is sitll in service all these years later.

The big oshis are soft, warm, washable blankets.

Let me reiterate: WASHABLE.

Do you know what that one word means? It means that no matter what your baby does to the blanket you can stick it into the washing machine with some Tide (no special soaking or prewashing needed!), throw it into the dryer, and an hour later you have the soft oshi ready to go.

This is important. Do you know why?

When your baby decides that the only thing he will sleep with/walk around with/calm down with is his baby blankie it's important to know that your baby blankie will stand up to the job. That the baby blankie will always be available - even after said toilet training accident/bout of stomach virus/nose bleed - so long as there's a washer-dryer handy.

And for this price? It's practically a steal.

product_title: Summer Infant 2-Drawer Combo Changer
review_body:
Why I purchased this product - I had been searching for a changing table to match my PBK Kendall crib in Tuscan at an affordable price and found it! The mocha color and lines compliments and matches the simple/clean design of the crib nicely. It is well made and easy to assemble. It took me a couple of hours taking breaks in between to watch my 2 month old! It is also great for small spaces. The open compartments provides additional storage space and easy access for wipes and/or baby creams.

I would recommend this product to parents looking for a changing table to match their PBK Kendall crib in tuscan at a reasonable price. I am very happy with my purchase and overall product quality for the price!

The only CON I found… As I previously mentioned the open compartment is great to keep wipes; however, if you use a wiper warmer it would be nice for the rear panel to have an opening to hide the cord.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Flip-Down Child Mirror
review_body: I love this mirror!!  I'm am going to order it again.  It is hard to install that is why I did not give it 5 stars but if it is installed properly it works great.  I got the mirror back in 2008 and had it in my van for a good 4 years without ever having to mess with it.  I got into a wreck and had to have my car detailed and the people knocked off the mirror while cleaning it and threw it away.  Of course I did not realize it until the next day.  I have since purchased 3 other mirrors because I could not find this one in the store.  They were all terrible!!  I bought the suction cup kind that just falls off the window randomly and scares the crap out of you while driving.  I have bought the one that has double sided tape and also falls off randomly and then the stickiness is all gone.  I have bought the one that clips onto the visor and it is impossible to get in the right position to be able to see the kids.

product_title: Mountain Buggy Plus One Storm Cover
review_body: I gave this a five star rating because this has come in VERY handy for blocking out extreme weather conditions, whether they be rain or bitter cold wind. The first time I used it was on vacation at Disney World when it was POURING down rain. It was fast and easy to put together and my kids stayed dry. It's very intuitive to put onto the stroller and holds up to wear and tear. I guess if I did have a complaint it's that I'm not very good at getting it folded back down, but that's more user error than a defect. ;) It's made of quality material, has a latch in bottom front to hold it in place, and velcro to connect the whole unit to the back of the stroller. It's kept my kids dry and warm and functions very well! I'm SO glad I got this!

product_title: Dr. Brown's 2 Pack Natural Flow Preemie Standard Nipple
review_body: We went through 5 or 6 brands of "slow-flow" nipples before we found Dr. Brown's. My newborn would chug the milk so quickly that she would choke and spit up / vomit. The Dr. Brown's preemie nipples have been a life-saver! Not sure about Dr. Brown's claims that the bottles themselves are easier on a baby's tummy (because of how they vent)... baby still has gas, spits up occasionally, and does all the normal things babies do. No bottle is magic. :-)

product_title: Thermos Foogo Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Soft Spout Sippy Cup with Handles
review_body: Like the cup very much; especially that it is a true thermos and keeps things cold for several hours.  I also like that it separates into a few pieces for easy cleaning.  If you prefer just a cup and a lid, then this isn't the cup for you...  It has the spout, the lid and the insert which goes inside the spout.  The handles are also removable depending upon what your child prefers.  I gave it 4 stars because liquid does spill out of it occasionally - not as bad as some of the other cups I've tried, but spillage nonetheless.

product_title: Lily's Home Starry Night Projector and Sound Shooter. With 6 Lullabies and 4 Nature Sounds. Large LCD Alarm Clock
review_body: the sounds are not real like other nature sound products I have purchased.  Also cheaply made. Would not buy again.

product_title: Evenflo Exersaucer Triple Fun Stationary Jumper
review_body: This is very nice to have but not essential.  It does buy me some time around the house though keeping my LO entertained for a good bit.

product_title: Playtex Drop-Ins System - Breast Milk Storage Kit
review_body: Awesome to be able to pump right into the drop-ins!  Reduces waste and time spent cleaning bottles!  Only down side is that they don't always screw shut well and can leak if you aren't careful.  Still worth it!

product_title: 4Moms 2014 MamaRoo
review_body: This is the only baby item our daughter likes.  It doesn't always work when she is fussing, but it does sometimes and that is good enough for me.  We had the Fisher Price swing and it would power out when we put her in it.  We have not had that issue with this.  I also love the size and how it doesn't take up the whole living room!

product_title: Cocalo Couture Delilah Musical Mobile
review_body: I wanted so much to have a sweet, little mobile for my daughter.  I found this one and thought it was perfect!  The entire thing broke immediately.  Extremely shoddy.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick and Play Gym
review_body: This is a great little gym! Super easy to put together and plenty of things to keep my little niece happy and entertained. Whether using it for tummy time or on her back, this has been a much loved (and used) addition to my sisters baby toy collection. Her little one is definitely a 'kicker', so this has been perfect for her!

product_title: graze organic Organic Cloth Lunch Tote
review_body: Cute, soft, organic so that I know it's safe for my little guy. Thick enough so that minor leaks don't soak thru badly. Made in USA! Love it.

product_title: Sweet Jojo Designs Changing Pad Cover - Go Fish Ocean Fishing Baby
review_body: We did our son's nursery with the Jojo Go Fish collection, along with some whale accents from a different collection. I absolutely love all the pieces! The changing pad cover has held up well so far (my son is almost 5 months) and it's been through frequent washing without showing any signs of wear. It's a perfect fit for the Summer Infant changing pad.

product_title: Fisher-Price Grow with Me High Chair, Bunny
review_body: My son is 4 months old and is still a supported sitter but was ready to start solids.  I need a safe chair for him and this chair is awesome.  I can easliy feed him and the harness holds him up without him falling forward or to the side.  Excellent!

product_title: Prince Lionheart 3-in-1 Universal Organizer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Takes up too much space for what it stores
review_body: I really wanted to like this but I ended up returning it.  It takes up a lot of valuable counter space for what it stores.  It also seems like it would crack easily and it isn't sturdy.  The carousel kinds store a lot more in the same amount of counter space plus you cannot put the plastic Gerber containers on this either.  We ended up just stacking our baby's food neatly on a shelf.

product_title: Boutique Curly Korker Hair Bow 4 Inch
review_body: So adorable, perfect for my daughter's ballet class outfits. It's large for a 1-2year old but perfect for. 3+ year old. Quick shipping too.

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_body: This is great for pumping. Easy to adjust and use once you adjust it to a comfortable size you can than take it on and off with the zipper. . It makes pumping much easier and hands free so at work I can continue to use a computer or read while pumping.

product_title: Disney Jake and the Neverland Pirates 4 Piece Toddler Bedding Set
review_body: My son is 1 yrs old and loves this set!! He uses the blanket every night and his face lights up when he see's it!!

product_title: Maison Chic Boy Frog with Animal Front Plush Blanket, Green
review_body: wish I didnt spend the money on this.  It looks cuter on the screen then in person. wont buy again

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_headline: Zipper splits while baby is sleeping.
review_body:
I really like halo products and I have been putting my son in them since birth. I was very disappointed that the zipper on this one keeps opening. My son has only used it 3 times. I won't be putting it on him again.
Thank you halo for exchanging the sleep sack. The new one works wonderfully. I still love your product and now I also love your customer service.

product_title: Infantino Wonder Whale Kicks and Giggles Gym
review_body: MY GRANDSON LOVES THIS LITTLE WHALE!  HE'S A KICKER AND EACH TIME HE KIDS HE'S ENTERTAINED BY THE TOYS ON TOP.  SIMPLE TO PACK UP AND FOLDS SMALL ENOUGH FOR EASY TRANSPORT.

product_title: Kawaii Baby Fun Prints One Size Cloth Diaper Double- Layered with 2 Inserts
review_body:
I love this diaper! It is soft on the inside for baby's bum and the snaps allow the perfect size adjustments. The liners are nice and big and still fluffy after several washes.
No leaks. No problems. And it is cute. Why pay twice the price when this one is afforable, reliable, and adorable? Yup, recommend.

product_title: Princess and the Frog Twin/Full Washable Light-Up Comforter
review_body: It was perfect! My gf loved it and sleeps with it every night. I would recommend this blanket for anyone! All the lights worked on mine! Yayy!

product_title: Boon Winter Grass Countertop Drying Rack
review_body: This isn't particularly big, but it's oh so handy for drying bottles and other small odds and ends that parents wash so much of. These thick plastic strands let you stand lots of things upside down and vertical you wouldn't otherwise be able to. The plastic "needles" are quite thick and rigid, but give enough to shove things with openings firmly in them while still gripping them. I have been pleasantly surprised how much we have used it for other odd shaped items we simply want to set and forget to dry.

product_title: Tiny Love Musical Nature Stroll Toy Bar
review_body: this is easy to attach with the claw ends that screw on and the items react with little touch.  My grandson is 8 months old and is able to work easily.

product_title: KerrBear Kids - Rainbow Leg Warmers
review_body: I bought these to wear with a my little pony rainbow dash costume.  My 8 year old looked cute.  They arrived on time and as described.

product_title: Lamaze Baby Bling Take Along Toy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This product had great reviews but I was a little disappointed when it arrived.  My grandson is beginning to play with it.

product_title: Storksak Caroline Diaper Bag
review_headline: Great bag for the mom who doesn't want a diaper bag
review_body:
This was a gift from my MIL and I am completely thrilled with it. But one disclaimer, my baby isn't due until May so I haven't actually used it for its intended purpose yet. HOWEVER, it has all of the details I view now as "must-have":
1. The bag must be lightweight prior to being loaded up with baby/mom stuff.
2. The bag must be 'incongnito' and gender neutral enough that my husband won't be offended if he has to carry it.
3. LOTS of pockets and organization.
4. Cross body and over the shoulder options.
5. Strong hardware and feet to help keep grossness off the bottom of the bag, wherever I may need to sit it down.
6. Lightly colored interior so things don't disappear....we all know what a black hole bags can be.
7. Potential for use after baby (and prior...it will hold my 15 inch laptop in a sleeve comfortably along with all the other carry on items I'll need for an upcoming trans-Atlantic trip)
8. Easy to clean....self explanatory.

Overall I could not be happier with the bag. I will update once I've used it for its intended purpose.

product_title: Fresh Baby So Easy Baby Food and Breast Milk Trays
review_headline: Exactly what I was looking for
review_body:
My review will be to address some of the complaints of the other reviews since that was the hardest part of my decision in buying these:

I had ZERO problem with the lids fitting perfectly. I could see if you washed the lids in the dishwasher that they may warp and not fit snugly, but if you just run it under warm/hot water and snap it onto the bottom it will re-form again.

I tested the 1oz issue... if you fill each cube w/ liquid until it bubbles up, but doesn't spill over it is as close to 1 oz as you can get.

Tip: The plastic bottom is VERY rigid, so you can't really twist it to release whatever you have frozen, so you will need to set it upside down for a few minutes until everything loosens or turn upside down and run under hot water for 5-10 seconds and then "knock" it against the counter for your cubes to fall out. Not a big deal at all, and kind of nice because it is a very sturdy product.

Use: I have used these for breast milk and for pureed foods and it worked great for both

product_title: Delta Universal 6 Drawer Dresser
review_body: I ordered this dresser to match the crib but find that the dresser is smaller then I'd expected, and looks kind if cheap.

product_title: Jeep Perfect Pockets BackPack Diaper Bag
review_body: Recently had another child (now 2). I wanted something that I could carry both of their items in one bag. The pockets are ergonomically and numerous. Very happy with this bag, a little stiff when I first got it, I'm certain it will loosen up. Easy to have 2 kids' stuff on board and right where I can find everything, Full or empty, it seems to stand up on the solid base every time.

product_title: BOB Revolution SE Duallie Stroller
review_body: Two kids now.....the first had his very own personal bob but now we have a second. We take this bob wherever we go, the mall, the beach, the park. Its built for long term use and we hope to get years of trouble-free use like our first single seat bob. We have tried another double seat stroller but you just cant get the versatility of this one. its is a bit large but understandably its a double stroller. We kept the single bob as well for those trips we have only one of our kids. You'll never regret buying these bob strollers.

product_title: Safety 1st Swing Shut Toilet Lock
review_body:
I loved this toilet latch-while it lasted.

It was inexpensive. The shipping was done quickly and the latch arrived in great shape. It was easy to install and done quickly, within minutes of being delivered. It was easy enough for my 6 year old daughter and her friends to use...until one of them didn't ask how to use it. I could do it with one hand, and my toddler could not wash his hands in the toilet when no one was looking. It was perfect, and then...

A 5 year old just popped the arm off of the anchor. No way to fix it, and the adhesive works SO WELL that I am now stuck (no pun intended) with the latch and the anchor on the lid. The arm is gone, and I haven't been able to remove the disks left behind.

If you can make sure that everyone gets instructions before they get access to it, to prevent them from just breaking off the arm, I would totally recommend this product. For now, I am just back to locking the door and listening to the wailing while I shower, brush my teeth, etc.

product_title: NurSit Nursing Pillow with Removable Blue Slipcover
review_body: We put  the baby in the pillow even when you want him to lie on the floor or sit him up

product_title: Evenflo Amp Lx No Back Booster Car Seat
review_body:
I got one of these for my son's dad to be able to have a carseat in his car but not have to keep one "installed" and ready to use all the time (my son normally rides in my car, which is where his big carseat lives). It is small enough to just chuck it in the trunk when you're not using it, without taking up your entire trunk space (like with the big carseat!), and SO much easier to transfer back and forth.

I ended up coming back to order another one because the first one worked out so well :) Also small enough to be unnoticeable and out of the way in the bottom of the coat closet by the front door so he can grab-and-go with his other relatives that don't keep a seat installed for him all the time but want to take him somewhere once in a while ;)

product_title: Stork Craft Venetian 4-in-1 Fixed Side Convertible Crib
review_headline: Stork Craft Venetian 4-in-1 Fixed Side Convertible Crib, Cognac: defective from manufacturer
review_body:
This came with huge chunk of wood missing out of it. There was no damage to the box so this was obviously a manufacturer defect. I don't see how they can send an item out to be sold without inspecting it first. We did not assemble it so I can't say if there was any other issues with it. We are having a replacement shipped so we will see if it is junk as well. If I wasn't getting a promotional credit for $50 for spending over $250 on baby items with Amazon I wouldn't even attempt to get a replacement from them.
***Update received a new crib with numerous defects and chips in it. Obviously they don't inspect the product before they send it out. Sending it back and will never buy another one from this company again. Amazon was great about the issue. I have never heard anything from the manufacturer.

product_title: Philips AVENT Natural Glass Bottles
review_headline: The goods arrived in good order.i like them very much.
review_body: I'm sure this is a great bottle if you start using it soon after baby is born. The shape is closer to that of a real nipple, and the venting system worked VERY well on the rare occasion that DS would take it.

product_title: Bright Starts License to Drool Teether
review_body: I bought one for my niece and the only bad thing I noticed is that the ring that holds the keys, is a hard plastic. So we just have to watch her when she plays with it.

product_title: Celebration Candles 1-21 Year Numbered Birthday Candle
review_body: It's really cute.  My daughters love to take it out every year.  I have the pink and the white one. They both are pretty girly.

product_title: Baby Head Rest (Green)
review_body: I chose to buy this product because my 3 month old has flathead syndrome and I wanted to prevent it from getting worse. product_title: Ameda Purely Yours Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I received the Ameda Purely Yours pump through a medical supply company (paid for by insurance premimums). The pump is relatively no frills, but easy to set up and use. I began using the pump soon after the birth of my child. Initially one of the white adapter caps that connects the tubing to the flanges was faulty and wouldn't hold a seal. I replaced the cap and the pump functioned just fine. I used the pump once daily for the first 8 weeks and never had a problem. However once I went back to work, I was using the pump 3 times a day, 5 days a week plus another 1-2 pumping session on the weekends. I was pretty vigilant about replacing the white valves every couple of weeks. Within 2 months of this schedule, I began to have issues with the pump losing suction on one side. This progressed to the point where I would have to pop off the white adapter cap every 3-4 cycles to reestablish suction. I tried replacing everything south of the pump motor to no avail. Frustrated with my malfunctioning pump, I called Ameda. To their credit, they diagnosed a motor problem over the phone and overnight shipped me a new pump. But the "new" pump they sent me is worse than my broken one and barely has any suction at all. I couldn't waste anymore time waiting for a working pump so I had to go out and buy a Medela pump.

Clearly Ameda has a problem with their pump motors. Reading the other reviews, the problems I had are quite common. I guess the fact that the customer service person could diagnose the faulty pump motor over the phone should have been a bad sign. So the pump motors are either faulty from the start or wear out quickly with multiple daily uses. Don't risk your milk supply on this pump if you are a working mother or exclusive pumper.

product_title: PooPoose Wiggle Free Diaper Changing Pad/ Changing Table Pad, White, 16" X 32" X 3.5"
review_headline: Works great for our newborn--highly recommended
review_body:
My wife and I are first-time parents, so I don't have much basis for comparison, but we did order this changing pad after a lot of research and comparison to other pads. This one appealed to us because reviews of other cheaper pads described that they were difficult to clean and/or too small and/or incapable of securing a wiggly baby, whereas the reviews and descriptions here are quite the opposite.

Once we got it, diapering our son immediately got MUCH easier. He's a wiggly little critter (we had had lots of drive-by-peeing incidents because he would always wiggle off whatever we put over him for cover) but the soft, wide cloth strap keeps him comfortable, secured with Velcro, and about as still as you could hope for. He still gets cranky during some diaper changes, but not as cranky or as often as before, and he's actually fallen asleep while strapped to the changing pad a couple of times (we obviously took pictures that we plan on busting out when he brings home his first date!).

The pad is VERY easy to clean--the cover itself is smooth, wipes completely clean, and dries quickly. The cloth strap is removable, so we've been able to put it through the wash a couple of times when it's gotten dirtied. It's a little funky to remove and reinsert, but the little plastic sleeves that get in the way serve to keep the foam from soaking in any poop/pee--those and the cover will keep this thing clean as new for a long time.

Our guy is still pretty little, but the pad leaves him with a lot of room to grow. We have the pad on the floor (no room for a proper changing table in our apartment) but there are two little strips you can use to secure it to any table/dresser/desk top for a more permanent/secure changing table setup.

All in all, it seems like they've thought of everything! I could really ask for more, except for some sort of auto-diaper changer or a beer tap. It ain't cheap, but for what you get, it's definitely worth it!

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_headline: HARNESS BUCKLE EXTREMELY DIFFICULT TO UNBUCKLE AFTER A FEW MONTHS.
review_body:
I have had major problems unbuckling the harness. I'm switching my son, who will not be 4 until a couple of months from now, to the booster seat mode (it's too early, I know, but I feel this seat is much safer in the booster seat mode). I am so fearful that I will not be able to get the buckle undone in an emergency.

Usually what happens with ours is that one of the dual buckles will partially unbuckle, but the other doesn't. I have to then push the partially unbuckled one back in, press as hard and evenly as I can on the button, and then it SOMETIMES will release on the next try, but not always. In hindsight, I should have spent more money to buy a different one.

All that being said, I LOVE this car seat as a booster. Super comfy in this mode, and I don't have some of the problems that I have had with the Graco high back booster we moved our other son into. I am actually considering purchasing this car seat again for for my older son (who originally used this seat), to replace the Graco high back booster that I hate, just because I think this seat is great as a booster. I would give it four stars as a booster and 1 star as a car seat because of the harness. The only reason I would give 4 instead of 5 stars for the booster is because it does not have a left hand cup holder for my lefty son. If anyone knows if they have a lefty version or knows of a way to switch the armrests to put the cup holder on the left, please respond to this.

product_title: Swaddlebees Newborn Simplex All In One Diapers
review_body: We love these diapers.  We made the decision to do newborn sizes starting out. We primarily did this because I like the trimmer fit and knew I was more likely to keep up with cloth diapers if I liked the way they fit... I secondarily decided on these because I figured I'd have less of a chance of needing to replace snaps and elastic in my diapers if I used them for less time.  Our daughter is about 2 months old and these have held up great.  We use these with a combination of prefolds and covers. These AIO's are easy for people who aren't necessarily on board with cloth diapering but if you're doing the prefold and cover route and are interested in getting newborn sizes, I strongly recommend the Sweet Pea newborn covers.  They're pretty inexpensive and we haven't had any problems with them.  With both of these diapering systems we have yet to have any "Blow Outs".  The diapers are disgusting on the inside of course but we haven't had any serious messes on the outside.

product_title: SaddleBaby Shoulder Carrier-Original Model
review_headline: Clearly constructed for men, not women - very uncomfortable
review_body:
I probably should have been suspicious after looking at all the pictures with happy dads and their kids on the homepage of this company. And if I would have payed attention, I would have seen that the carrier goes across the chest in a spot that is bound to be uncomfortable for women. And so it is, I have to close this thing directly over my breasts which makes it quite uncomfortable. I assume that for women with a bigger bust (or even worse, nursing moms!) this would be even more of a problem, so be aware of this.
Also, I find the saddle hurts my neck, and I cannot tighten the connection straps so much that it does not slip backwards when my daughter is sitting on it. That makes it feel very unsafe for me.
Last but not least, my daughter is not happy with the cuffs around her legs. She gets panicky when I close them. I am hoping that she will get used to this with time, though.
In conclusion, I will be trying to use this without the saddle. I got this on zulily so it is not such a big waste of money as if I had bought it for the regular price but even for half the price I think there are better carrier options out there. Nice idea, bad execution.

product_title: Britax Marathon 70-G3 Convertible Car Seat
review_headline: Best Choice - Low Hassle - Easy Set-up - Durable
review_body:
I decided to go with this model because I saw that it rated highest in consumer reports for safety tests that were performed. I bought when my daughter was a year and a half and she still uses it. The base is attached and does not detach and it has the option to tilt the car seat upright or leaned back. The straps NEVER get twisted which is something I cannot say for any other car seat I have seen my friends/family use. The straps always fit tight and after years of use, still tighten and loosen the same way as when we first bought. The seat always seemed comfortable for my daughter.

Also, the Cowmooflage cover seems to be very ideal for concealing any stains/messes because the car seat cover that we have still does not look dingy or very much used.

Owned for 3 years
Price new at that time was $215.

product_title: My Brest Friend 3 in 1 Body Pillow, White
review_headline: Not high/fluffy enough for my sciatica
review_body:
I am 22 weeks pregnant and I have developed bad sciatic pain in my butt and hips, where when I lay on my side, my butt facing down falls asleep after a while. The only way I can remedy this is to sleep on my side with the top leg bent at a 90 degree angle on top of a very high pillow, and to use this pillow, I have to fold it in half to double the height of it since it's not very full or fluffy.

I don't like the head portion and prefer to use my regular pillow, so at the beginning, I was just pushing the head portion forward and hugging the rest of it. My belly isn't heavy or big enough to like the belly padding/wedge portion of it yet - right now that part just feels too hard/high for my belly, so really, this pillow is fairly useless to me and ends up on the floor most nights. Maybe better for someone who doesn't have the hip/butt pain issues.

review_body: My 7 month old daughter loves this toy! The jumper and toys are bright and colorful (she loves the lion teether the most), the music is also fun and can be turned up higher or lower. It was a great purchase and my daughter loves jumping up and down like a kangaroo on a sugar high! I highly recommend.

product_title: myBaby Soundspa Lullaby Sound Machine and Projector, MYB-S300
review_body:
I've had this sound machine for 1 month:
The "SOUND" portion of this is fine. Does the job, my baby sleeps 10x better with the white noise on. I prefer the "rain" sound above all other options on this sound machine.
However, the projector is LAME! It doesn't spin or turn. So it lights up, and shines the image on the wall. But just a tiny portion shows up. Its a round disc of images...looks as thoughit should rotate through all the images for baby to see. But mine NEVER worked. NEVER rotated. Just 1 stark image on the wall. I'm very disapointed with that flaw. The projector feature was the only reason I chose to buy this machine over the other sound machines, and it doesn't even work right. Annoyed.

(like I said, sound portion of this works fine)

review_body:

Positives: Only three parts to clean, sturdy BPA-free plastic, no leaking.
Negatives: The valve can be a little tricky to install at first, not a huge fan of the spout- but it's better for teeth than traditional sippy cups(still can't find a straw sippy cup that doesn't leak), it's a little wide for my 1 year old to get her hand around.

product_title: RECARO Performance SPORT Combination Harness to Booster, Sapphire
review_headline: Forced to return it because of a poorly design Latch system
review_body: Let me first say I was extremely sorry to had to return this back to Amazon. I loved this car seat. It looks like a racing seat and solidly built.  However,  there were two problems that is caused by one design adoption that we could not live with. I won't get into the pros of this car seat as many reviewers have described in detail that I mostly agree  Rather, I will focus on the two flaws that may apply to you and should be heavily considered before making this purchase.    Flaw #1 - This does not apply to everyone, but the latch system of this car seat is a poor fit for our 2013 BMW X3.  The Recaro ProSport's latch system is designed similar to how a lap belt secures a person.  The latch belt travels around the car seat back,  between  the car seat fabric and seat back.  Problem is, our car's latch connector spots for the middle seat was located wide apart.  The consequence of this meant our car seat can slide side to side.  I measured our car seat sled about  3  ~ 4 inches side-to-side despite the fact the latch was as tight as it  can be.  In a side collision, those 3 inches could be pronounced and may cause serious harm to your child.    Flaw #2 - Also a consequence of designing the latch to secure the car seat by hugging the car seat like a lap belt, the belt protrudes out from the  seat back.  What you don't see from the car seat pictures is how the latch belt is located right behind the car seat fabric.  When the latch belt is tightened, the belt extends outward about an inch from the seat back.  So when our child sits, the belt pokes at our child's back.  See this video review on youtube describing the problem.  The problem is described at about a min in. [...]    If Recaro can redesign the latch system that addresses these two problems,  I would not hesitate buying Recaro ProSport again. However, for now, this one design flaw is too great to live with, which is a terrible shame.

product_title: Lansinoh Affinity Pro Double Electric Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Love Lansinoh Products but Can't Recommend Pump
review_body:
This review is for affinity pro, that I got though insurance. I have supply issues, and am going back to work after two months, so a powerful, reliable pump was very important. This is not it. I began using it a week after my baby was born and was pretty happy with it & impressed with its effectiveness (2-3oz in 20 minutes). Then it began intermittently losing suction after about two weeks, & at week 3 it completely died. Lansinoh customer service was great and overnighted me a new one, but it had died over a holiday weekend so I had to wait three days to reach someone and couldn't go that long without a pump so had to buy a pump (got madela harmony, which I'd recommend if you're looking for a manual pump).

This pump is a bit noisy, but not too bad. It's easy to use, assemble, take apart and clean. The parts tend to come out of alignment which is annoying. I find myself constantly tightening parts as I pump. The new one also periodically loses suction and I have to take apart and reassemble the whole thing to get it working. This is what happened with the first one & I'm just waiting for this one to die too. I only use this pump maybe 2-4 times a WEEK so there is no way this would be reliable enough for a working mom or exclusive pumper. It's small, light, portable and I like the timer and different suction settings.

I've also soured on its effectiveness. I realize this is comparing apples to oranges, but because of my supply issues, I rented a hospital pump to see if I got more output. I pump 4-5 oz in 15 minutes with the hospital pump (which equates to two more bottles of breast milk and two less of formula per day).

Overall, I can't even recommend this pump to the rare/occasional pumper with a full milk supply because, while it's probably powerful enough for that purpose, it's just too unreliable. And if you have insufficient milk supply, rent a hospital pump or try another brand.

review_body: My wife and I did a lot of research on all kinds of baby products before making any purchases before our daughter was born. Everything we found seemed to point to Britax as one of the leaders in safety. Their products are a little on the pricey end, slightly more expensive than similar products from Graco/Chico, yet lower than some of the premium brands. In the end we decided it was worth the extra investment and have been very happy with our decision. The seat as easy to install and the chest pads make it easy to get the positioning correct. Also the adjustable head side protection is very easy to manage and makes it easy to adjust as your child grows. One quibble I would have is that the strap release button is a bit hard to get to when the seat is rear facing. The opening is a bit snug for me to get my finger in, but with some finagling I was able to make it more accessible. The only safety feature we haven't been able to use is the whiplash tether. When the seat is rear facing the instructions show you using a floor anchor/front seat anchor to attach the tether to. However, in both our cars we do not have anywhere to attach this to so we aren't able to use it. This will vary by vehicle, but if it's a reason you're looking at Britax be sure to see if you have somewhere to attach it.  Once we're ready to move her to forward facing this won't be an issue as we can attach it to the LATCH anchors behind the rear seats. Overall we've been very happy and our daughter, now 10 months, seems to love it as well.

product_title: Playtex Baby First Lil' Gripper Twist 'n Click Straw Trainer Cup
review_body:
If you're working on getting your baby to go from bottle to cup, this is a great starter. Keep in mind that it's just the starter though, and I think that may be the cause of some of the negative reviews. The leaking that happens when the cup contents get to room temperature is just physics and can't be faulted, as someone else noted. The cup leaking all over the house because the "seal" is broken is just wrong (whether that is due to faulty advertising or misunderstanding on the part of the user, I can't say). The cup does leak, but there is no seal on this cup as there are in many other cups. That's what makes it a starter--the cup is designed to be easy to drink from for your little one. (On the packaging it lists the age starting at 4 months.) Babies don't have the mouth strength to drink from a traditional sippy cup. Those cups have rubber seals to prevent leaks, which means toddlers have to suck quite hard to get the drink out. This cup doesn't have that and so if your baby/toddler tips the cup over or carries it around with the cover open, it will leak. Perhaps your baby is ready for the next graduated level of sippy cups--congratulations!

So as a transitional cup--not meant to replace traditional sippy cups--this is a great tool for parents. We started using it with our baby around 5-6 months, and he loves it. I like that you can squeeze the cup to make water come up the straw and into the baby's mouth. Initially, my son blew into the cup rather than draw water out of it. With a little squeeze to the cup, I could help teach him that the water comes up through the straw for him to drink. Now he drinks out of it on his own.

I too find that Target, Wal-Mart, and Babies R Us are consistently out of stock of this product. After going to three Target stores in person and my local Wal-Mart, I've just checked online and only 1 Target store within 50 miles of me lists one in stock. None of the Wal-Marts in 25 miles have it. I'm willing to pay a few extra bucks for it on Amazon to know I'll have it in two days.

As far as the bottle getting warmed up in 4 minutes, they mean 4 minutes exactly, take it out a second earlier and it's ice, take it out a second later and it's molten lava. Makes it difficult if you're attending to your actual child and not fussing over a bottle warmer all day, since there is no timer. product_title: Safe To Sleep Sleep and Breathing Baby Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
First let me thank Ryan the creator of this wonderful product and then I'll get to our story. RYAN, THANK YOU, THANK YOU, THANK YOU!!! Your product us amazing and the fact that you personally field customer service calls with your team is awesome. Who better to answer questions then the man who created it! Okay on to our story...

We're new parents of a beautiful and healthy baby boy, Aidan. Unfortunately like many newborns our son suffers from acid reflux and as a result, he naturally and occasionally would hold his breath while sleeping to alleviate the discomfort of his reflux. We being new parents were unaware of this and scared SH*TLESS of SIDS, so when our 2 week old son stopped breathing for several seconds while asleep in my wife's arms, we freaked!!! How can you prepare yourself for your wife to tell you, "the babies not breathing"? You cant!

Long story short, the wife performed CPR, the baby woke up none the worse for ware and both his Peds Doctor and our many Register Nurse family members all assured us he was fine and to stay up with him overnight and monitor his breathing. BTW, both our Peds Doc and RN f'members told us a trip to the ER wasn't warranted unless it happened again (for more than 45 seconds) as it would result in the same treatment, us staying awake, watching him breath all night. Only difference we would be sitting in the ER rather than home, oh yeah and the expensive hospital bill.

So while sitting with our son, we took to the internet and found this, 'Safe To Sleep, Sleep and Breathing Baby Monitor', the reviews were excellent, our Ped's Doc and RN f'members (tired of our repeated phone calls about this and that) all agreed it does the same as the respiratory monitor at the hospital and it would allow us piece of mind and maybe some sleep. Target, Babies r' Us, Etc., all carried them 'ON-LINE' only and it was 1-2 week delivery. We weren't going to be able to stay awake that long, working and takingturns watching the baby and voila(pronounced, vwä-ˈlä) we found a solution!

Amazon.com had them! Better still is was cheaper than everywhere else!! Better yet, with our Amazon Prime account it would be here in two days!!! Better than that even, we could up the delivery service and be back in business of sleeping in no time flat!!!! Yeah sleep!!!!!

It arrives, we open it, read the book, add the batteries and placed the baby on it. Oh HAPPY, HAPPY, JOY, JOY, this thing is awesome! It has a handy remote monitor, some cool features (you can read about on your own) and we can sync it to our smart phones for even cooler monitoring graphics!

I would recommend this to every parent of a newborn!

Downside...but Ryan assured me he has a solution in the works(bigger monitoring mat for larger beds/cribs)!

Safe to Sleep is designed for a bassinet sized sleep area, we have an full size Arms Reach co-sleeper next to our bed and a full size forever crib and they both have large sleeping areas. Much larger than the Safe to Sleep designed for a bassinet sized sleeping area. When Aidan moved off the mat, (which he tended to do often 'cause I think he secretly wants to torture me with sleep deprivation) we would be awakened by the monitor alarm to a respiration distress signal only to find him asleep off the side of the mat and the mat couldn't monitor his breaths. It's better to be awoken 'cause I have a restless sleeper for a kid rather than a dead one!

Again, I can't stress enough how awesome this product is, it is worth its weight in gold for piece of mind or sleep(which ever is more valuable to you). We will be buying another(larger version) when they become available for our next baby.

Ryan you have 12 months!

review_body:
We received this as a baby shower gift and have loved it from the beginning.

About a year in the projector seemed to stop working but I discovered later that the latch on the disc insert was not shutting properly. Make sure that you have the disc right side up. Each disc has a tiny UP on it if the disc is down the latch won't shut properly. The latch can also get jammed a bit so fiddle with it till it closes. Once I got it loose I have had no trouble since.

We have used the noise every night munchkin prefers the ocean but there are several sounds. We have probably only used the projector 45 nights or so in the three years we've had it so I can not speak to the bulb life but ours is still working fine.

We loved it so much and could' take it away from munchkin that when we had another baby last year we bought a second one.

product_title: Black Large Tuxedo Bib, Frenchie Mini Couture
review_headline: Looks real on my son and it's very durable, large is a good size to go with

I put a long sleeve black t-shirt on underneath it and simple black cotton pants on him. Everyone at first glance thought it was a real tuxedo and we got so many compliments. The little bowtie is actually 3D so the middle is sewed on but the rest of the tie is free so it looks pretty real.

SIZE: It was just the right size for my son who tends to be about 20% to 30% on the growth charts, so not a big boy. Any smaller and it wouldn't have fit so I would definitely recommend the large. If you have a large baby who has a thicker neck this may not fit but, if you sew or know someone who does it wouldn't be too hard to make it fit by adding some Velcro or fabric to the clasp area.

CON: The only con I ran into was that EVERYTHING shows up on the bib since it's black so anytime my son did a little spit up, had a runny nose, etc. it was very obvious. Not a problem with the product, just something to keep in mind. I tried not to put my son in it until the last possible second and by the end of the wedding, who cares!

PRO: Easy to clean. I've had to wash it three times now and it comes out of the dryer looking great and not faded.

product_title: Summer Infant 5-Piece Essentials Diaper Changing Kits
review_body:
I'm not sure what magical entity the makers of this pad used to enchant it, but I'm a believer. So often my newborn son does this thing that drives me crazy...he cries. I repeatedly ask him "What's wrong?" but because he is simply 2 months old, he can't answer me. After determining that nothing is actually wrong with him, I begin the baby shuffle, where I try EVERYTHING to calm him. Swaddling, shushing, lights on, lights off, singing, running the vacuum, giving him a pacifier, jiggling the rattle, changing his clothes, playing his favorite song, looking out the window, promising him a pony, begging, pleading, crying... Most of these things will work but only for a few precious seconds, just long enough for me to be tricked into feeling victorious. But no longer do I have to go through this rigamarole. I've discovered the amazing, perhaps esoteric properties of this changing pad. For some unknown reason, my son will stop crying when placed on this pad. I do not question the voodoo that is present here, I just relish in his smiles and coos. I am thankful for whatever properties this pad possesses that literally turn his frown upside-down. While I initially thought that perhaps only my pad contained this special power, I was shocked to find out that a friend's did as well. For under $20.00 you can purchase this amazing vortex to what I have termed Happy-Baby Land. What a steal!
Bonus points for the awesome leg workout you can get while doing squats next to the changing table. If you are not into standing you can move this pad to other places, such as the dining room table or the floor (I'm not here to judge). Just remember, NEVER leave your baby unattended. There may be some special magic here, but only when used properly.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Harness Buddy, Monkey
review_body:
We love this harness to keep our toddler from running off! The only change I would recommend to Eddie Bauer is to move the 'tail' strap to the neck. I understand the aesthetic, but have the strap attach at the base of the monkey is problematic when the toddler trips...the instinct is to lift up which raises the toddlers bottom forcing them to go head first.

We alleviated this by wrapping the strap around the monkey's neck. It worked great yesterday when our toddler tripped and was about to go head first into the concrete when daddy pulled up on the strap and saved us from a potentially messy face scuffing.

Again, this is great and we love it with the one modification to the strap attachment. We plan on moving it permanently by sewing the clasp from the monkey bottom to the back of the neck. A soft cover for the top buckle would also be nice as that is the first thing to grab at our toddlers neck when we pull up on the strap. We will sew something for that as well.

product_title: Aqua Scale 3-in-1 Baby Bath Tub, Scale and Water Thermometer, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Good for watching weight, great for bathing, but costly
review_body:
I would give this a 4 star if it were cheaper. Overall, the design is good to keep small infants at a safe water level. The temperature gauge and weight calibration are not exact, but they are much, much better than guessing. The use and care are easy. The size is a slight drawback unless you have multiple bathrooms or a closet to store it when not in use.

I ordered this mainly because my baby boy had colic and reflux, which made weight tracking and comfort management a big issue. Our home scale only went to half pounds (rounding), and when you are tracking ounces of growth for reflux babies over the course of weeks, more accuracy is required. This unit was not actual weight as would be measured at our pediatrician's office, but it was consistently within an ounce or two on the measurement from week to week. We could tell if he had gained or lost, which was the important thing.

A slightly more accurate scale or a lower cost would make this a solid 4. Add both of those elements and it's a 5. :)

product_title: Safety 1st Splash Infant Bath Cushion, Blue
review_headline: Fantastic soft surface for baby bath tubs.
review_body:
Baby got used to baby-tub-baths with this sponge. The hard plastic tubs are no fun when baby is placed in there, but with the sponge, he stopped squirming and fighting at bath time. A side note - babies don't like when the water is running, if you put warm water in the bath or a bucket on the side all ready to go, you can pour it in slowly as you bathe baby (I recommend Burt's Bees bar soap - his skin stayed soft and didn't get flaky like with Aveeno and he smells so sweet and clean) with the Skip Hop Dunks Stacking Bath Toy scoops.

Machine wash the sponge once in awhile. The only thing I didn't care for was squeezing out the water at the end - it's good to have a place to lay it out or put it in an open window against the screen to air it out. The nub on the bottom doesn't fit over the nub in the Safety 1st bath tub - it kind of just sits on there without form-fitting it. Just so ya know! Overall, a good way to introduce baths to baby without him feeling freaked out on a hard surface. At 2 months, I chucked the sponge and he was good to go with just a towel on the baby-tub floor.

Another note: thermometers for the baby-bath water are a waste of money, the few I tried give the wrong temperature and I found that if I can put my whole underside of my arm under the running water for a few moments and feel comfortable, it's fine. Always remember the true statement that "mama knows best". Trust your instincts is my best advice for new moms.
