product_title: The First Years Take & Toss Spill-Proof Straw Cups - 10Oz, 4 Pack
review_headline: Toddlers love to pull the straw out!
review_body: These are cheap in cost, and as expected, cheaply made. I guess you can't expect much. I do not like these because they do not have a lip on the straw to keep it inside of the cup. My LO just pulls the straw right out and then dumps the water out. I have a few adult sized plastic cups that have the lip on the straw so that it will not come out. Why can't you do this on a kid's cup?

product_title: The First Years Disney Feeding Set
review_body: This dish set comes with a spoon & fork and small bowl and a plate. The plate has 3 compartments. Cute pictures of our toddler's favorite-Minnie Mouse,along with Mickey. Break resistant. Fun to see the picture when they eat and the plate or bowl is cleared.

product_title: Joovy Room Portable Playard
review_headline: Great Product!  If you have the room, buy this instead of a smaller play yard
review_body: We bought this playpen when our daughter learned how to climb out of the other square play pen we had.  Our daughter is 19 months old and at least 32 inches tall and she still doesn't climb out of this.  Part of the reason, I think, is that there is so much room for her to play.  If I could do it over again, I'd rethink the pack n play and just get this product.  I wish the playpen was even a little bit deeper, but its about the deepest one out on the market.  Ours lives in the kitchen most of the time, but we took it with us on our Thanksgiving travels as a bed for her and set it up 3 times without complaint.  It is a little bit heavier than a pack n play, and a little bit larger but folds up the same way.  We all really love this product.

product_title: Infantino, Squeeze Station, Create Your Own Baby Food Pouches
review_body: This thing made making my own baby food so much easier! I loved using it, and was able to make giant batches of baby food at a time. It is dishwasher safe and very easy to clean. While you're filling the pouches, things can get a little messy...but that wasn't a big deal to me. Having two kids, I'm used to having a mess.

product_title: aden + anais Issie Security Blankets - Luke - 2 Pack
review_body: Always love their stuff! It's cute and I don't have to worry about little one putting it on his face cause its thin enough.

product_title: sustainablebabyish sloomb snapless-multi fitted cloth diaper
review_body: Due to our son being a side sleeper, our pocket diapers did not work well for nighttime.  I purchased these fitteds as I read they would be best as they are absorbent all over.  I am so glad I did.  These are a one size type of fitted.  For smaller babies, you can just fold down the flaps to fit your baby.  They come with 2 bamboo inserts.  Our son is a heavy wetter and still may eat at night so I also had a hemp insert.  These fit him well and keep his bed dry.  They work especially well when added with a wool cover.  As these are a fitted diaper, the entire diaper is absorbent and a cover is needed.  We also will use flip covers on occasion which also work ok with these.  They come with a diaper pin so that you can pin these on your baby.  We use a snappi.  These do take a while to dry after washing due to how absorbent they are.

product_title: 6 Ounce Portable Reusable Resealable and Refillable Food Pouch for Baby Food (6-Pack) By Precious Tummies. Great for Applesauce, Juices, Smoothies, Yogurt, Puree, and More. Perfect Accessory For Meals on the Go and Lunch Box Snacks. Double Reinforced Top Zipper Leak Guard To Prevent Leaks.
review_headline: These pouches are affordable and work great!
review_body:
These have been working out great for my 3.5yr old and 1yr old!
The opening for filling is small, but I just use a baby spoon to spoon in the purée and it doesn't take long and is pretty mess-free.
The zip-top holds well- I haven't experienced any leaks.
They clean up well in the dishwasher. They would be difficult to hand wash though because the opening is too small to fit a standard bottle brush into. I worried that they wouldn't dry completely on the inside since they still are wet inside when they come out of the dishwasher, and they are difficult to prop open for air drying- but so far I haven't had any problems.
So, yes, I highly recommend these. Your kids can have healthy purees for WAY cheaper than the disposable pouches. And, they definitely aren't just for babies.

product_title: Snuza Hero Baby Movement Monitor
review_headline: Wonderful!!! Don't leave your baby sleeping without one.
review_body: Wonderful!!! Don't leave your baby sleeping without one. It provides safety and peace of mind! The perfect gift/item for all new parents.

product_title: Gerber Graduates Bunch-a-Bowls
review_body: I'll keep this review to the point.  Here is my story-  my baby started eating solids and I wanted something that would serve as both a food bowl as well as a storage bowl for leftover food (and bonus if they were stackable for space saving.)  He was probably 5ish months old at the time.  He's now just over 2.  I am finally ordering these bowls again because I've lost all the tops and we have used them so much that they have obvious wear and tear.  They are probably the most used bowls we have and have been microwaved, dishwashed, and abused for a year and a half so it's understandable that they no longer look new.  You cannot go wrong with them.  The price is simply a bonus.  I would definitely pay more now that I know how much use you get out of them.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, Luv U Zoo (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Looks nice and conveniently swings back and forth and side to side.  It's easy to change the direction of the swing, you can even do it with the baby in it.  It is a little hard to get a baby in and out of it because of the mobile and big mirror dome.  It's pretty close to the swing and I almost always hit my baby's head on one of the animals in the mobile getting him in and out. But they are just little plastic pieces and it didn't seem to hurt him so besides that I really like the swing.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: I swear, this toy is like crack for babies! Not only did my son love it from BIRTH, but every baby/toddler fights over this during playdates. It might be because they think it's theirs! Every baby I know has this toy. It's not annoying, lights up, plays classical music, and has rings to chew on. It links easily to car seats, strollers, high chairs etc.! Such a simple toy, but so popular. Buy this!

product_title: Graco Sweet Slumber Sound Machine, White
review_body: The sound machine is OK at best. It feels cheap but I would actually be fine with it if it were loud enough to drown out any sound. I like the light. I don't like the fact that the bottom spins off for the mp3 player. we don't use that function and the spinning bottom is actually pretty annoying because it always opens up. it would be better if that could be locked shut when not in use. all in all, i wish we'd gotten a louder machine with less bells and whistles since the noise is all that we really need.

product_title: Cotton Tale Designs Paradise 4 Piece Crib Bedding Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This set is so vivid in colors. The mixed textures are great!. Can't wait for little one to get here and test out his new set.
Also the quality is amazing. Not cheap at all. Currently washing on gentle cycle.

product_title: Medela Breast Shields, Connectors, Valves and Membranes (27mm Shields)
review_body: Exactly how they were descripted. Fast shipping and great customer service! We have used them a couple times so far, but we will be using them way more once my wife starts working again.

product_title: Woolino Baby Sleeping Sack - 4 Season - Merino Wool - 2 Month - 2 Year
review_body:
I had this in my cart for like a year. Well at 14months old i decided to buy it because even in the summer we had her in the summer infant sleep sacks etc and were ready to buy a bigger size and were layering with thinner ones for the winter.

We love this. It is super soft and I appreciate that it will fit from infant to 2 year old. The colors are nice and classic. I got a grey and white striped one for my girl and i will pass it to my next baby whether boy or girl.

The snaps at the top are much better than having to fiddle with a zipper in the dark and i love that the bottom unzips to check diapers. The slot for car seat buckle is an extra special added bonus, not to mention the little thermometer gauge and guide to how to dress baby depending on the temp. I have washed 3 times now (i only wash every few weeks unless there is stain from diaper or something ) and it feels like newI definitely recommend this, especially if your baby is a sack wearer not a pull a blanket over me type. JUST GO FOR IT

product_title: Evenflo Summit Pressure Mounted Metal Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Pro: I LOVE this gate. It's good for dogs and babies. My favorite thing about it is the ability to open and close it so that I don't have to step over.

Con: It's hard on your wrist if you do it a lot. I don't recommend it for someone with arthritis. My dad has a very hard time opening it.

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_body: From the reviews I read, I expected this car seat to be wonderful. But after using it for several months, it has not lived up to my high expectations. The straps are constantly twisted compared to the cheap $39 car seat we got at Kmart. We ended up getting a cheap seat because this one was so heavy, we could not stand moving it from car to car when grandparents wanted to take our child for a day trip. My son loves the cup holder and feels very important when he can get his drink "all by himself". Although it does seem very sturdy and safe, plan on this being a car seat that stays in your car and not one to take in and out.

product_title: OXO Tot Bottle and Accessories Drying Rack
review_headline: The most useful item I've bought online recently
review_body: This thing is great! We use it every day and its permanent location on my counter is not an eyesore because it's so cute. It's easy to clean and easy to use. It's worth the cost for any exclusive pumper who is washing bottles and pump parts constantly.

product_title: Ultimate Car Seat Travel Bag
review_body: tore after one flight :( great idea and nice size but sadly it didnt make it.  for the cost I would expect a few more uses.

product_title: Motorola Digital Audio Baby Monitor with Room Temperature Monitoring and LCD Display
review_headline: Worked O.K. Range not great, still happy with the purchase.
review_body: Worked fine for me. The range is a little short, the thermometer was really useful. They died on me after a year and a half of almost never unplugging them, I feel like they lasted enough for the price but could be better. An O.K. product for me that could use some improvements.

product_title: BreathableBaby Breathable Mesh Crib Liner - Blue
review_headline: Works at keeping the hands and legs in the crib
review_body: The directions are not clear, but once you figure out how the item gets installed, and in particular wraps around the corners of the crib, it work fairly well at keep in the arms and legs from protruding through the crib slats. The ties used to keep the upper edge secured to the crib slats need refinement, as this isn't a perfectly secured connection. Overall it has done a good job at allevating our anxiety over the kids getting their limbs stuck.

product_title: Angelcare Movement and Sound Monitor Kitchen
review_body: We bought this monitor when our first child was 1 month old, almost 7 years ago. It has lasted through 3 kids and we've had no problems at all. It works in a pack-n-play and regular crib, when set up properly. This is a must have for all parents!

product_title: Neat Solutions
review_body: Very thin but get the job done. Thin fabric layer with plastic under side so clothes don't get wet. I'd buy again.

product_title: green sprouts 2 Pack Best Long Sleeve Waterproof Bib, Green, 2T-4T (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These do the job. The reason I am giving it a 3 star is because my son is a big kid and the sleeves are very snug. So getting him in and out of it is a chore.

product_title: Stokke Xplory Stroller, Purple
review_body: The best of the century stroller . The purple color is amazing. Good Quality. comfortable , Sometimes difficult to close. Very, very beautiful.

product_title: Kolcraft Pure Sleep Therapeutic 150 Infant/Toddler Crib Mattress -150 Extra Firm Coils, Hypoallergenic, Durable Waterproof Cover, Crib Fit Tested, 52"x28"
review_headline: Too soft and it cracks open quickly
review_body: We absolutely disapprove of this mattress! It was way too soft and after only ONE week the mattress was sinking in where my daughter slept! At first we thought it may not be enough support from the bed itself, but even on the floor, the mattress itself was too soft. Not only that, but the plastic outer covering cracks quickly, probably due to it's softness and it flexing too much, exposing the inside parts of the mattress.

product_title: Green Sprouts Warming Plate
review_body: I bought this for my 6 mo. old grandson to use when he visits...my daughter liked it so much I ordered one for them to have at home. It does a good job keeping the baby's food warm.

product_title: Disney 4 Piece Toddler Bedding Set, Taking The Race (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I BOUGHT THIS FOR OUR Grandsons' 3rd BIRTHDAY. He was so excited! It came in a very small package but was a good deal for the price.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Breastcare Essentials Set
review_headline: Nice to have but not a necessity
review_body: It's a good deal, I wouldn't call it a must have but it definitely helped me out once or twice.  I really liked the bag and still use it to carry all my nursing needs and some other essentials.  I have a 4 year old as well as a newborn so if I put things I needed in this bag (like disposable nursing pads, small washcloth, pacifier, nipple cream etc...) and started nursing without it or needed it while otherwise occupied I could just ask my daughter to get my purple bag and she would go a running.  The bag is my favorite part but overall I am happy with the purchase.

product_title: Safety 1st Heavenly Dreams Stars a Plenty Baby Mattress
review_body: Excellent mattress! Fits in our standard crib and no problem with crib sheets fitting. Firm enough for safety yet seems comfortable.

product_title: UPPAbaby VISTA PiggyBack (PRE-2014 models only)
review_body:
The board itself is great and my son loves to ride it. The major problem we have with it is the flimsy, cheap little snap button that is used to put the board up when not in use. That snap comes undone at the slightest bump and the board comes slamming down on your foot, toe, kid, whatever is underneath. My husband and I both have suffered some pretty serious bruises and abrasions from it falling on the tops of our feet. It hurts! A lot! Trying not to swear my face off in front of my kid while jumping around on one foot is not my idea of a good time. Any little bump will do it - even the smallest little bump on the sidewalk will sometimes cause it to fall. It's unpredictable because sometimes you can take it up and down curbs without a problem and other times a little acorn on the pavement will knock it free.

And keeping the board down is not really an option, as it does significantly impact your ability to push the stroller and walk behind. I'm pretty short (5'5\\") and my husband is tall (6\\"4\\") and we both find we are kicking the board when it's down. We have to sort of lean forward and extend our arms to keep from stepping on it. While I accept that discomfort as an inevitable part of adding a toddler between me and the stroller, I'm deeply disappointed with the fact that I feel I'm courting disaster (via a broken toe) whenever I'm pushing the stroller with the board up.

While I love our stroller, I must admit the Uppababy accessories have generally been a big disappointment. The cup holder, board and the Babyganoosh muff have all been disappointing for various reasons. The pieces are all well made just poorly designed.

product_title: Maymom Breast Pump Reducing Flanges for Ameda Purely Yours Breast Pump, BPA Free, 22 mm - 4 Pack
review_headline: Not effective or efficient for pumping
review_body: These flanges are much smaller length wise than the actual flange so when you use them the seal isn't good causing reduced milk and inefficient pumping. The tube size (22mm) is perfect but the product itself just isn't effective for producing milk. If I had realized these weren't full size I would have never bought them and wasted my money.

product_title: Dena Diaper Stacker, Happi Tree (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Does not work for be part of the decoration in my baby girl bedroom.
review_body:
The decor in my baby's bedroom is all Happi Tree.

I was really excited to completed the decor with this diaper stacker but, I'm very disappointed with this Stacker.

In the photo, you can see the hook out, but if you want it to be so, you have to make the hole yourself., only have a hanger inside, which falls, when you hang it, because the fabric is in the middle of the nail and the hanger. If you make the hole yourself, the fabric may tear because the weight of the diapers and honestly I do not want to do this job, if I'm paying $28.

When you hang this,the top part wrinkled and you can't see the owl very well, does not work for be part of the decoration in my baby girl bedroom, plus this Diaper stacker is too small for her diapers (she's size 4.)

product_title: U.S. Toy Childrens Costume Headwear and Hats
review_headline: Who's head is it supposed to fit?
review_body: Although it is a cute funny hat, it doesn't stay on anybody's head. It fits my children's heads but it slips off easily. I bought it for their "Crazy Hat Day" at school but no one wore it. Don't waste your money on this one. They need to add a back to it to cover the back of the head so it actually stays on.

product_title: HALO Early Walker SleepSack Wearable Blanket Micro Fleece
review_body: I got a 6-12 month size for my 8 month old twins who are 70th percentile for heigh tand weight and they are very big but they are working as a sack for them which is fine.

product_title: Baby Food Maker - Immersion Hand Blender and Food Processor - Puree & Blend By Sage Spoonfuls
review_body: This blender was sent to me broken.  I never even got the chance to try it out.  I returned it and bougnt a similar Cuisinart product instead that also had a PBA free chopping bowl.

product_title: Dream On Me Umbrella Stroller with Child Tray, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a very nicely built umbrella stroller.  was looking one for my one year old and purchased two from amazon. Eventually returned this and kept the Contour one, which was much lighter. But this one is more compact and can also fit in smaller cars.

product_title: Boppy Pillow with Slipcover, Sports Star (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: This does what it is supposed to do.
review_body: This is our second Boppy and we couldn't live without it. One lives in our bedroom and the other in the "Mom cave." It does what it's supposed to do and the alternatives (pillows or just her arms) destroy my wife's lower back. She is a skinny gal so I can't argue with folks saying that they found the product too small.

product_title: BOB Revolution SE Duallie Stroller
review_headline: Too heavy and don't forget that pump!
review_body: It's heavy AND big.  I personally would not want this unless I had a truck.  Go shopping, no room in the trunk to put packages.  Take a pump with you, the tires will need it.

product_title: Safety 1st Go Hybrid Convertible Booster, Waterloo
review_body: Just took this on our trip to California.  Actually was able to fit into my large checked baggage, making it easy to transport.  Daughter loves it, and although I was hesitant about the color..she loves it!  Probably not the best for long trips, as there is no support if your child falls asleep...but car trips around town, and short distances, it's perfect.  I had no problem getting the seat to tighten, and be completely secure.  Not sure why others are having this problem.  It's all straight forward.  Just tighten the straps!

product_title: Summer Infant Duomat
review_headline: Good Product at a good price
review_body: Exactly as advertised. Material seems of solid construction. We have a ford fusion so I do wish they were just a bit taller since we are putting them behind car seats. They don't quite go all the way behind the car seat. The width was perfect. Any wider and it would be hard to get seat belts buckled.

product_title: Baby Deedee Sleep Nest  Baby Sleeping Bag
review_body: We brought this a few weeks back, been using it almost every night.  I thought that this sleep nest will be nice and warm for my little one, but it's not to my expectation in term of warmth.  However we still like it, and we will be using it for a while since there's room to grow.

product_title: Munchkin Arm & Hammer Diaper Pail Refill Bags
review_body: They are perfectly designed for the diaper pail, I find the pack quite expensive for what it is, but they are useful!

product_title: Graco Pack 'n Play Playard with Cuddle Cove Rocking Seat
review_body: Beautiful, practical, lightweight, easy to assemble. Almost born my baby girl and I can not wait to put her down there.

product_title: Full Coverage All-In-One Nursing and Hands Free Pumping Tank
review_body:
I tried a few nursing tanks from target ranging from 20-35 and they were terribly uncomfortable and didn't really have the ability to pump hands free.

This tank is awesome. At first I was bummed because the suction didn't happen with my pump, but I only had to hold it for three sucks and then it was stuck and I could let go to pump....hands free!!!! Those who have never pumped hands free will be amazed at how fast it goes when you can actually DO SOMETHING while you pump!!!! Right now I just pump for a break so I can leave bottles with dad, but soon I will go back to work (teaching) full-time. This tank is going to make my life a whole lot easier. I can just wear it under my clothes and pump pretty discreetly. Bonus the tops clip down fully for no-hassle breastfeeding in public.

On some nursing bras the top doesn't fold down well or is so stiff it keeps popping back up in my baby's face. Not the case with this tank, they fold down fully and easily and the clips are easy to manage with one hand as well.

The only downside to this tank for me (I did not have trouble centering the pump on my nipples as one reviewer did) is that I have hard nips all the time and this tank isn't thick enough to hold them down...ok with a thicker shirt over it but I do have tic tacs if you know what i mean when wearing a buttery soft thin cotton or silk/cashmere sweater over it.

I ordered a size down as suggested for those who like a snug fit/or are 3 months post partum (only two months but didn't get that big, just flabby and soft). It was a perfect fit.

Totally worth the money!!!! And make sure to scroll down on the add if buying on amazon, there is a code for 20% off if you buy two or more. I bought full coverage for work and classic coverage for home.

product_title: Boon Winter Grass Countertop Drying Rack
review_body: Love this! It is perfect for putting bottles, nipples, pumping accessories in one place so that all those small parts aren't mixed up with your other dishes in the dish dryer.

product_title: Brica Deluxe Snack Pod Stroller Drink and Snack Holder
review_body: This was to replace one purchased at a retailer for use on a rolling walker for my Mother in Law. After 3 years of stress and  use caused a crack in the gripping arm. She would not know what to do with out her cup holder. It fits on her walker and has stopped all the spills. I know this was not the intended use for the Pod but necessity is the mother of invention and the aunt of repurposing. I love the improvements over the old product better grippers and the removable cup tray is a real plus.

product_title: Munchkin Light My Way Nightlight
review_headline: Perfect for little ones scared of the dark!
review_body: My son has recently become afraid of the dark, and we were having a hard time finding anything that would comfort him and keep him asleep through the night. The TV was the only thing, and that was not helping him sleep well. I saw this adorable nightlight here on Amazon and when I saw the reviews I thought I'd give it a shot. It is a lifesaver! My son loves his nightlight and even claims that his owl "scares all the monsters away" in his room. The amount of light given off is perfect and the automatic shut off is a great feature. If my son wakes up at night he just finds the kid friendly button on the bottom and goes right back to bed. The little handle is a wonderful addition as well, since my son can take his owl with him in the house while its still dark. This is totally worth the investment and great for the price! I've even recommended it to family members and friends who have toddlers going through the same thing.​

product_title: green sprouts 10 Pack Sprout Ware Infant Spoon
review_body: These are ok.  They last for a long time.  I like that they are made from corn starch.  I wish they held a little more food.

product_title: Supergate Deluxe Decor Gate
review_body: The gate was easy to install and very easy access. Easy to detach if necessary and excellent for an extra wide doorway. Would suggest it to anyone.

product_title: Leachco Body Bumper Contoured Body Pillow System, Khaki
review_body: I bought this pillow when I was about 24 weeks along and I am now 31 weeks and have gained about 25 lbs which seems to only be in my huge belly :) .  I wanted to use it for awhile before reviewing.  I love all the different ways it can be used and flipped.  I did have to "grow into" it at first because when I lay on my left side, the small wedge is under my belly and I still had a lot of room between me and the wedge at first.  I still have room but not as much so its more comfortable.  It doesn't lose its shape or become flat.  It is huge however.  My fiance is military and has been gone for training, so room in my queen bed wasn't an issue until he came home.  Now room is limited but its not too crowded.  I think buying a pillow designed for pregnancy was a smart choice.  A lot of people said dont spend the money and just buy a body pillow but this pillow is much better designed than a simple body pillow.  I also did not want to spend the money, so I tried cushioning myself with regular pillows before I splurged and still did not work.  This was a good investment.  It keeps me from tossing and turning as well.

product_title: Munchkin Arm and Hammer Diaper Bag Refills, 72 Count
review_headline: Loved it. Realy takes the smel of the room. And it fits a lot of diapers when used on a basket
review_body: Loved it. Realy takes the smel of the room. And it fits a lot of diapers, around 8 to 10, depending on the size, and the way you fold then, of you use it on a basket.

product_title: Joovy Caboose Stand On Tandem Stroller
review_headline: Do not buy any other brand!!
review_body: Fantastic, practical stroller. I love that it feels like I am pushing a single stroller and not a tandem! I wasted money buying another brand. I wish I would have seen this one sooner. My older daughter is very tall for her age  - 3yrs and 42.5" and she fits on the sitting part perfectly.

product_title: Fisher Price Fastfinder Deluxe Diaper Bag
review_body: This is a nice gender neutral diaper bag (which is great because my husband does not mind carrying it).  It is adjustable so that you can wear it across your chest or just on your arm.  It has convenient pockets on the outside for bottles and toys as well as several internal compartments inside.  The wipes dispenser is a little tricky and the wipes dry out faster than I would like, but it is worth it to have the wipes so close at hand.  Overall, it is a great deal for the price.

product_title: Vulli Sophie the Giraffe Teether Set of 2
review_headline: Wonderful and perfect for my twins
review_body:
Excellent product!!! These came packaged individually but arrived in the same box - not that it mattered since I was going to use both, but that might be useful if you buy this as a gift. The twins LOVE their Sophies for so many reasons:
1) They are easy to grab and hold for small hands - in particular they like holding the legs.
2) The twins took a little time to get used to the texture of Sophie, but now they LOVE chewing on every part they can shove in their mouths - ears, legs, feet in particular - Sophie provides a variety of wonderful textures and hardnesses for the kids to explore.
3) They love the sound of the squeak, even though they have not yet figured out how to make it themselves.
4) They can fit the legs far into their mouths to explore with the back of their gums and tongue.
5) Sophie is soft enough that if (when) the kids whack themselves in the face with her, they don't get hurt.

The twins haven't started teething yet, but they will soon, and I am sure Sophie will be wonderful to soothe their sore gums when the time comes. I would definitely recommend this product and am planning to buy another as a baby shower gift.

product_title: Safety 1st Grip N Twist Door Knob Covers
review_headline: Using these all over our house
review_body: We have used these door covers all over our house. They are loose on the door, so they rattle a little when baby tries to reach them. The holes are wide enough apart, which makes it hard (but not impossible) for those little ones tall enough to grasp the knob to turn it. It also requires enough coordination to grasp the knob through the holes while turning, something that often stops our adult guests in their tracks, which is also very amusing. :-)

product_title: Baby Einstein Wiggle Wagon Gift Basket
review_body: Gift was EXTREMELY small and lacking. It was nothing that was described online!! Very disappointed with this purchase and do not recommend it to anyone.

product_title: SheetWorld Fitted Pack N Play (Graco) Sheet - Silver Grey Jersey Knit - Made In USA
review_body: I bought this for my pack and play that my grandson sleeps n at our hose.  I love it t is so soft and keeps its shape after every washing.  Shipping was fast and reasonable.  Would recommend this seller.

product_title: Pumpin' Pal Breast Pump Flanges
review_headline: Wish I had bought these sooner
review_body: I had so many problems when I tried to pump. After much frustration and buying of different sized flanges, I decided to give these a shot. Well, they are great. I prefer the medium size ones, but it is nice to have the other options. I would highly recommend to anyone having pumping problems!

product_title: Brica Baby In-Sight Mirror, Gray
review_body: This is great for looking back at my daughter to make sure she is alright. She can also look and see me, which calms her sometimes.

product_title: Medela PersonalFit Breast Shield, 36 mm
review_headline: Should have skipped these and bought Pumpin Pals
review_body: These were huge but I really needed them for one side that was bigger than the other- these were a lot more comfortable.  These still have an angle on the flange that caused me grief though. product_title: Lamaze Freddie The Firefly Musical Mobile (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
First off, I must say that my 7 week old LOVES Freddie the Firefly. When he is fussy, I can often just put him in his crib, turn on Freddie, and my baby will calm right down. Right now I have the wings on the high-contrast black and white side. Freddie and his buddies are face down so that my baby looks right at them. Most mobiles have the animals or objects facing out, which I don't completely understand since the baby looks up from his or her crib. Freddie's wings flap, and there are color changing lights on his tail. There are 4 tunes, which are short but pretty nice.

I gave Freddie the Firefly 4 stars instead of 5 for 2 reasons. First, I wish that this mobile could rotate. As is, Freddie will keep my 7 week old entertained for a good 10 minutes. It keeps his attention longer if I manually spin it (today he contently stared and cooed at it for 20 minutes while I folded laundry). Second, I wish there was a setting to turn off the music. Other than that, Freddie is awesome and a great purchase. I'm so glad I didn't get the mobile that matched nursery, I don't think my baby would love it as much as this mobile!

product_title: Jeep Cherokee Sport Stroller, React (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: It has it's ups and downs.
review_body:
This is a handy little stroller. It's not super luxurious, nor is it particularly rugged, but it is a step above an umbrella stroller. It's great for short trips with your (older) little one, and it handles walks outside fairly well. The basket on the bottom is roomy enough for my diaper bag, and the pouches on the size are handy for holding things like a small first aid kit.

I do have a few complaints, though. For one, it's a little on the short side, even for we of average height. I am practically pushing this thing with my fingers. The cupholders are also too skinny for sippy cups- a skinny water bottle can fit just fine, but who is going to let their toddler make that kind of mess? My final qualm- and this may be just my particular stroller- is that something seems to be off in terms of the frame. When I stand centered on the handle, the wheels are off to the left of my center. This suggests that something is bent. While it doesn't seem to affect handling or turning, it is annoying to have to stand off to the side just so that I can walk without catching my foot on the wheel.

In all, this is a good stroller for shopping trips or short walks, but don't expect it to jog well with you or go off-roading. It's light and folds small, and that alone was enough to warrant four stars, because who doesn't like for their baby items to be convenient?

product_title: Evenflo ExerSaucer Triple Fun - Jungle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Not great for younger babies - not enough to do.  3 n'1 Feature is very clever!!

I purchased this for my 6M old who is starting to jump a lot!
This is a traditional exersaucer in that its huge and hard to move around. I wish it was more portable as we like to move it into different rooms where we are, oh well!

I like the 3n1 play features that it transforms from a traditional saucer to back play toy and then sit n' play toy when he gets bigger. nothing better than getting multiple uses for one product.

As an activity center it's self if unsturdy. When my baby stands up and jumps I get very worried it's going to tip over.. it hasn't yet so no worries! For the activity center activities I think most of them are useless for a 6m+ old. Three big characters that don't do much? why? Why not make some sensory play here for babies? They're just a waste of plastic as they sit there like statues.
Then there the Lizard. It has the worst LED glow... The lizard is made of translucent plastic and the LED are SO bright. For a baby looking to be stimulated with things to touch and move, this is not a good addition, I actually removed it from the center so i could add my own toys he can pick up and move around himself.

So is this a good product? It's ok... I wouldn't purchase it again, I would get a version with more for a smaller baby to use, it doesn't seem to make sense that I take this huge Excersaucer and just add my own toys, this becomes one large expensive "hold baby in one place" product. Instead of stimulating experience product.

product_title: bumGenius One-Size Hook & Loop Closure Cloth Diaper 4.0
review_body:
We are in love with our bumGenius diapers. They are everything you need from a cloth diaper--they withstand multiple washings, they are sturdy, they keep contained what you need to keep contained--even really big loads! I've been particularly impressed with their fit. We started using these as soon as our little girl's umbilical stump came off (disposables were shorter and didn't press on the cord stump, hence the wait). Despite her being fairly petite (25% percentile on weight), we are able to get a good fit with these. The only "leak" we've had was during a hike when she was being held horizontally while nursing, and we mostly blame this on our not tightening the diaper as much as we normally do. We've had some *really* dirty diapers, but no blowouts! We've also been impressed with how well these clean up with a good laundry process--very very minimal staining on the inserts, and none on the interior liner of the diaper at all.

We also have some of these with the snap closures, and there are benefits to having a mix of the two closure options. The hook and loop is easier for bleary-eyed night time changes. The snaps, interestingly enough, actually allow for a more precise fit, I think, and are not that difficult to do and undo.

In short--these fit our daughter beautifully, have held up very well, and we've had no problems with blow-outs.

product_title: Britax Head and Body Support Pillow, Iron/Gray
review_body: waste of money! It didn't work for my and I was trying to use it with a Britax car seat. A receiving blanket worked better than this.

product_title: Safety 1st 10 Emery Boards & Travel Case
review_body: I was hoping that this would be better on my daughters nails but it was not so great. They torn her nails very easily.

product_title: Summer Infant Multi-Use Deco Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, Bronze
review_body: The gate came in wonderful condition and is a blessing to have with a one year old & a three year old.  It is very sturdy and child proof.  I would highly recommend this product.

product_title: HALO Early Walker SleepSack Wearable Blanket Micro Fleece
review_body: This is a great product for toddlers.  My son is 14 months and this is a good way to keep him warm and not have to worry about the blanket getting bunched up or falling off him.  I like that his feet are out so that he can walk around in it before bed.

product_title: Evenflo Soft N Wide Gate
review_body: Easy to install, remove and adjust. Intuitive, good looking, strong. I have extra wide halls and doorways and this fit the bill perfectly. Can easily be removed and stored for the next time my grandkids visit. Wish this had been around when my kids were little. Great product!

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Walk Thru Gate, White, Fits Spaces between 29" and 39" Wide
review_body:
I bought this item to help keep a puppy in my office with me while I work. The build quality is good for the $$.

The lock might get a little old if you are constantly going in/out.

The door only swings one direction, I was a little surprised by this one. To be fair, I didn't do tons of reading reviews before I bought it. I only need it for about 6 months, and wasn't as concerned as I would be if it was containing my child instead of a puppy.

Good buy for the $$ in my opinion.

product_title: Baby Trend Flex Loc Infant Car Seat
review_body: I really enjoyed the product it really met the expectations and was what j was expecting when I ordered it

product_title: JL Childress 6 Bottle Cooler
review_body: Perfect for day care! I send bottles of breastmilk in this, and a change of clothes in the top compartment! Love it.

product_title: Medela Breastmilk Bottle Spare Parts WITH Three Medium-Flow Wide Base Nipples
review_headline: Nipples collapse after a few minutes of use
review_body: The nipples collapse after a few minutes of use and my son does not like the nipples. I had to switch to another brand.

product_title: Sassy Fishing Boat
review_body: My son enjoys the parts more than the boat. I didn't realize the top does not even snap onto the bottom so it comes off very easily. The bottom works well for scooping water, but I didn't realize that it just doesn't float around as a boat very well. The packaging was a bit overboard as well (no pun intended). Takes some work unraveling the ties.

product_title: DadGear Courier Diaper Bag
review_body:
I was looking all over the place for a baby stuff bag that is not too girly. This one is incredible! It holds bottles, formulas, diapers, rags, extra clothing, wipes, toys, and other stuff that you need on an outing. We hang it on the stroller handle and got quite a few compliments.

It is well constructed and can take an abuse (dropped it on the ground and off the roof of the car)......Still kicking and without any marks.

product_title: Born Free Classic Bottle - 5 oz - 3 ct
review_body: My baby takes only these bottles, so i'd definitely recommend it. It was hard to find in stores, so i was happy to find it in amazon.com.

product_title: Britax Marathon 70-G3 Convertible Car Seat
review_body: Purchased this to replace my 16 month granddaughter 's seat that she grew out of. Wish I had just purchased this one. I installed it in the middle back seat in my Subaru wagon in less than 10 minutes.The seat fits perfectly in the rear facing position. Strap adjustments couldn't be any easier. It's obvious that a lot of thought went into the design and safety features of this seat.

product_title: Mother's Minder Breast Feeding Bracelet
review_body: I bought the black and white for a friend having twins.  She assigned a color to each and didn't have to worry about trying to remember who at last and what time or even from what side!  She only had to figure out how to get the energy to do it all.  I recommend it for all new moms...and even those with some experience.

product_title: Munchkin Sea Squirts
review_body: Sea Squirts are the perfect size for my granddaughter's small hands to grasp 5pk Sea Squirtsand squeeze. They help develop fine motor skills while providing endless bath time fun. You simply fill  their bodies with water and then squirt away! She  finds it amusing when grandma squirts water at her. She hasn't quite got the hang of making them squirt herself. My only concern with them is  that they will eventually get moldy due to the hole in them.  Parents may want to boil the toys or  run them through the  dishwasher to clean them. Always inspect the toys after boiling to ensure they were not damaged in any way that could pose a threat to baby.

product_title: KAIR Air Cushioned Bath Visor / Shower Visor /Shampoo Visor / Shampoo Shield / Baby Shower Cap
review_body: Chose this product to use with great-grandson who does not like water running down on his face.  He loves this and I do also.

product_title: Leachco BumpZZZ Travel Bed, Brown/Green Forest Frolics
review_headline: Great napping bed for my 20 month old grandson
review_body: It has worked out perfectly. I needed a place for my 20 month old grandson to nap when he visits me every Saturday.  The sides keep him for rolling off the base and I think makes him feel secure.  He also will sit in the "napping bed" and play with his toys and look through his books.  When the bed is not in use, I just fold it over and store it away.  I am happy with purchase!

product_title: VideoSecu Baby Monitor IP Wireless Video Audio Day Night Vision Security Camera with Pan Tilt Wi-Fi for iPhone, iPad, Android Phone or PC Remote View AF2
review_body: I got everything I wanted from this product.the wires are on the short side to the cameras and would be a lot better if they came about 6 feet longer.Clear picyure on the monitor and pretty good reception

product_title: Britax Roundabout 55 Convertible Car Seat, Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body: We bought this for our grandson and this is a great buy!  Received it very quickly and was easy to install.  Britax is very highly rated car seat.

product_title: Britax Convertible Child Cup Holder, Cool Gray
review_headline: Installed easy enough, but doesn't feel like it's the sturdiest of design.
review_body:
Installed easy enough, but doesn't feel like it's the sturdiest of design.
Concerned as to how it will hold up with the swivel connection of the cup to the bracket being the only component holding the piece together. I love my britax marathon carseat, just wish they'd built in cup holders.

product_title: The Art of Cure Original Premium Certified Baltic Amber Teething Necklace for Baby (yellow) - 12.5 Inches
review_body: My daughter is still in a lot of pain from teething. The only difference is that she doesn't drool AS much. I am still having to do everything under the sun to relieve the pain. I'm not saying this is a useless produce. I think she just has a low pain tolerance. It does look really cute on her....

product_title: Graco SnugRider Elite Stroller and Car Seat Carrier, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Light, smooth rolling and moves easy!
review_body: LOVE, LOVE, LOVE my new stroller.  So light, and incredibly smooth rolling.  VERY easy to manuever.  All of our children want to push the baby, and even the 4 year old twins can easily push him!

product_title: Vitamin Barrier Cream, 1.94 oz
review_body:
we like the consistency and how it goes on my baby :)
it's hard to get it off if you try to wash your hand with water so we wipe any excess on the diaper we are putting on him
we have tried the aveeno rash cream as well and we like this alot more. alittle goes a long way.

product_title: Evenflo Tribute 5 Convertible Car Seat
review_headline: I would buy again for an extra.
review_body: I bought 3 of these for grandparents/daddys car. The price was right. Not alot to them, and they dont look to comfortable.  But for quick trips they are perfect. Other reviews said the clips broke. We havent had that problem. I would buy again.

product_title: Baby Simba Lion Bottle Nipple Brushes. BPA Free Holder w/ Sterling Silver base. Set of 2
review_body: I like these brushes enough, but with reservations: the bristles are soft and they're great for cleaning pump parts because it gets in the little hard-to-reach crevices, but I noticed that they damage the bottle nipples a bit. The insides of the nipples are scratched from brushing, probably from the wire at the tip. Maybe I scrub too hard (I don't think I do), or maybe it's the particular brush I bought and it's not actually a common problem. But now I just use them to clean pump parts and use a different brush for the bottle nipples.

product_title: Lifefactory Multi-Sensory Latex & BPA-Free Silicone Teething Ring, Sky/Spring Green, Set of 2
review_headline: Great teether for older babies and infants
review_body: These are good tethers, but may be better suited for children with good grasping skills.  My daughter starting using this at four months when she began teething, and this was not her favorite teether.  She had difficulty grasping it to chew on it well, and seemed to prefer chewing on her sleeves instead.  This is, however, great for when they get a few months older.  The multiple surfaces provide various tactile textures for infants to feel and chew.  Putting it in the freezer only keeps it cold for less than 5 minutes after it is taken out of the freezer, especially when a child is holding and chewing it.

product_title: green sprouts 3 Count Favorite Food Absorbent Bib
review_body: BEST bibs ever!  They are big, soft, cute and easy to put on.  You cannot go wrong should you purchase these!

product_title: Receiving Blanket ABC & Playmates Soft Fleece 30 X 40 Inches Pink
review_body: Searched everywhere for this blanket after it was discovered that this was the only blanket that soothed a little one I take care of! If it got left at home on accident...baaaaad day. Thankfully I appear to have found the last one available. woo hoo! It's super silky and makes that little one happy! They ought to make more!

product_title: Carter's Keep Me Dry Waterproof Fitted Quilted Crib Pad, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Very nice quality and the material washes up well.  I would definitely recommend buying this for your nursery.  Must have!

product_title: Trend Lab CribWrap Fleece Rail Cover for Long Rail
review_headline: Great rail cover for the crib!
review_body: We got this crib rail cover after my infant started chewing on the wooden rail.  It fit our standard size crib perfectly and matched well with the crib wood color.  It was easy to install--you just wrap it around the rail and tie the ties in front in either a bow or a knot (we used a tight bow so that we could easily remove and wash it if need be).  She has never bothered with pulling on the ties (so far).  Overall, a great product.

product_title: BRICA goPad Diaper Changer
review_body: My son LOVES this.  He used to refuse the changing station, but with this, he stays down and doesn't squirm.  The head part is soft enough for the hard changing table, and I'm guessing that's why he loves it.  The holder for the plastic bags are nice too.  It is a bit big, but it fits nicely under the stroller.

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_body: I just love it when I find a good buy. I was so resistant to buy a video monitor because typically they range between $200-$300 or more, and to me that is just too much. When I found this monitor and read all the positive reviews, I was floored. And let me tell you, they are right. The video quality is crystal sharp, even in a dark room. Ditto the sound quality. It was super easy to set up and use which is a must when you're a sleep-deprived new parent. I would buy this again in a heartbeat!

product_title: Wall Letters Purple Flower Letter Stickers Alphabet Initial Vinyl Sticker Kids Decals Childrens Room Decor Baby Nursery Girls Bedroom Decorations Childs Names Personalized Decal Graphics Daisy Flowers
review_headline: Just what we were looking for
review_body: Easy to apply to the wall and just the right size. We love the way they look on the wall.

product_title: Munchkin 4pc Straw Cup
review_body: My two boys are really not happy that I got pick and purple cups for them.  The desciption says blue orange and green, but thats not what I got.  Very disappointed.

product_title: Sesame Street Elmo Adventure Potty Training Chair with Toilet Seat Adapter and Elmo's Motivating Phrases and Flush Sounds
review_body: In my opinion, this is not a good potty seat for boys.  My son has really started wanting to sit on the potty which makes me incredibly happy.  But EVERY TIME he pees it goes everywhere!  The shield just isn't high or wide enough to catch the pee of a 2 1/2 year old boy.  We show him how he needs to sit, but if he moves just a fraction of an inch it's a lost cause.  I guess we'll be on the hunt for a new potty that is more boy friendly!

product_title: Kiinde Kozii Bottle Warmer and Breast Milk Warmer
review_body:
I was having trouble getting my baby to take a bottle. The kozii definitely helped to get her there. The kozii is fairly small, and really simple to use. You can also put the pouches directly in there, without having to transfer to a bottle! As someone who is using the pouches to store, I still do this.

Thanks for making such a great product!

product_title: Munchkin Squirtin Bath Toy
review_body: Kids love them- great for bath time! Keeps them entertained and they are enjoying bath time more than ever. Big enough theat they can't be eaten, but not oversized that they are in the way.

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Extra Tall Walk Thru Gate, White
review_body: installs very easily.  have had it for a few months now and works very well.  would recommend to a friend.

product_title: Comfort Potty Seat
review_headline: Highly recommend, especially for little boys!
review_body: Wonderful potty seat, fits our toilet perfectly. The handles are nice and give kiddos a secure place to hold onto. The pee-guard is a lifesaver when potty training little boys, it definitely minimizes the sprinkles on the seat.

product_title: Boon Pod Bath Toy Scoop
review_body: The Boon Bug Pod is a complete scam. I ordered the Boon Bug because I thought it was so cute, but when I finally got it, the only way to attach it to my tub was to drill into the wall. So I had to make another purchase of the suction cup bracket so make it work. What a rip off.

product_title: Girls Thankgiving Outfits Mud Pie Turkey Applique Baby Girls Legging Set 2T
review_body: This outfit is great! Very well made, great quality and I got it in two days! I can't wait for my daughter to wear it on Thanksgiving!!

product_title: BOB Weather Shield
review_body: Easy installation and works well for my baby and toddler. Durable material, just make sure the ventilation flaps are properly working so there is good airflow inside the cover.

product_title: BOB Revolution SE Single Stroller
review_body: amazing - I can't believe I was using our regular stroller for so long. this thing is amazing. Easy to navigate, and our daughter loves it.

product_title: Sweet Jojo Designs Contemporary Pink and Brown Modern Polka Dot Baby Girl Bedding 9pc Crib Set
review_body: I love these items.  They came as promised and was perfect.  My baby girl room is so chic and ready for her.  This was an awesome buy to add flavor to her room.  I love them.

product_title: Maven Gifts: Kalencom Toilet Training Bundle - Mr. Petey Potette Potty Training Kit with 30-Pack Potette Plus Liners - Ages 15 Months and Up
review_body:
I've had this thing since my first child whose now age 6 and still uses this while on the go. This is a \\"MUST\\" for my potty trained 3 year old. Especially, when driving longer than an hour (this means traffic as well). It has saved hours of pulling off on the side of the road, long bathroom lines, and countless outings. Not to mention a miracle for those number 2 moments in the middle of nowhere while hiking, camping, ATVing. My husband accuses me of being a \\"tech\\" mom and buying too many gadgets for too many things. My track record is good and it's thanks to products such as these.

My only regret- is that they don't make these for adults. However, there were 2 really, really, really big emergencies (during my 2nd pregnancy while we were out in the middle of nowhere and I was desperate) and it saved my rear (literally).

If you have a baby that will soon become a toddler...you NEED to buy this. Like I stated earlier, my 6 year old will use it and I have admitted to using it as well.

product_title: Booster Seat – Svan Lyft High Chair Booster Seat - Adjusts Easily to Most Chairs - (18 Mo to 5 Yrs)
review_body: It's a great little seat.  Very sturdy and easy to travel with.  Plus, it's very secure and safe... no other seat can restrain my 2yr old boy.

product_title: One Step Ahead Juice Pal Insulated Juice Box Holder
review_body: KEEPS JUICE COOL AS WELL AS HELPING TOTS LEARN TO DRINK FROM A STRAW.  CAREFUL WHEN WALKING AROUND UNTIL THEY LEARN NOT TO PLAY WITH THE STRAW  HAHA

product_title: Munchkin Arm and Hammer Diaper Pail with Refill Bags
review_headline: Great for dog waste and cat litter
review_body: Great for disposing dog poop! We have two- one for cat box and one for dog poop. Little to no odor! I collect the waste with the A&H poop bags and then put the bag in the diaper pail until trash day, when I take the large bag to the trash. Only time I smell the stink is when I'm removing the large bag for trash night. If you seal it correctly before removing it, you won't smell anything

product_title: Munchkin Formula Dispenser Combo Pack
review_body: I love this thing, it's handy to me because it's pre-measured, so just dump it in the bottle, add water and feed baby. Takes up very little space in the diaper bag, we use it pretty regularly.

product_title: S. S. Noah Plush Monkeys - Momo & Mimi
review_body: These were purchased as one of 12 presents for our daughter's one-year birthday. They are attached by 4 plastic tags, which can be removed to separate the two monkeys (I've left them on for now). At first, I thought they were rather small coming out of the package (measurements given are for when the arms and legs are fully extended), but they were actually the perfect size for our daughter at her age. She likes to carry them around occasionally and lean her head against them for cuddles, so I guess she must find them nice and soft. They are made in China using Polyester Fibers and are relatively well-made, i.e., no loose stitching. I've machine-washed them once on gentle cycle as per instructions and they have held up well.

product_title: Graco TableFit Highchair
review_body: Its a bit large and has hard to clean places. Also the cover is a pain to remove for washing.  Otherwise its a very nice highchair and is stain resistant

product_title: aden + anais Organic Burpy Bib
review_body: This is so soft. The design of modern yet sweet. It's held up in the wash. And can double as a bib.

product_title: The First Years Ignite Stroller, City Chic (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We've loved it so far, especially for the price. It doesn't seem quite as sturdy and nice as some higher-end umbrella strollers that I've seen around, but for our needs this stroller has worked great. I would recommend it to a friend.

product_title: Gaorui Cotton Baby Carrier Infant Comfort Backpack Buckle Sling Wrap Fashion Full Pad Adjustable Red -S
review_body: Can somebody please tell me does it really look as described? I'm a hypochondriac first Time mommy and I wanna know if it's worth my buck!

product_title: Munchkin Nursery Projector and Sound System, White
review_body: I read the reviews of this product and saw that there was some inconsistency with how well it worked but I never thought it would only last 10 hours! We plugged it in and it worked great, my son was sleeping (sort of) but then around 4 am the speakers made a weird crackling noise and the thing died! It woke up my baby and now it's the morning and it's definitely broken. The projection still works, just not the speaker. Thumbs down to the munchkin brand of products. Now I need to find a good and long lasting white noise machine.

product_title: SoHo Diaper bag with Changing Pad 8 pieces set
review_body: I got this yesterday and returned it today. The fabric is awful, the color is off and its so small! There would be no way for me to put cloth diapers and a wet bag in there....let alone anything else I needed. Save your money, it's not worth it.

product_title: Baby Jogger Foot Muff City Select
review_headline: Keeps your baby warm even in Finnish winter.
review_body: Good product, keeps the baby warm and cozy, zippers need a slight redesign to be perfect. Material is soft and the insulation quite thick.

product_title: Britax Back Seat Mirror
review_headline: Great mirror for vieweing baby in the back seat
review_body:
This mirror has two fabric bands with clasps that attach around and over the headrest of the backseat. It then has a pivot point where the mirror attaches to the base so you can adjust it as needed so you can see your child in your rearview mirror for those quick checks. The attachment stays secure and doesn't cause the mirror to droop and I have no concerns about it falling off and landing in my baby's carseat.

It makes long car rides much easier because you can make faces at your baby to help soothe them, or just so that they know you are there. It is also a distraction though, at least for me, because my son is so cute and entertaining and I would much rather watch him than drive in traffic.

product_title: Safety 1st Stove Knob Covers, 5 Count
review_body: It fit my stove, but it is really big and bulky. However, it does fit and will prevent my son from playing with the knobs perfectly.

product_title: FISHER-PRICE REUSABLE 3 SECTION DIVIDED PLATE WITH LID
review_body: Its a divided bowl with a lid. Makes mealtimes easier with my 2 year old. That's all i have to say...

product_title: Gerber Birdseye Count Flatfold Cloth Diapers, White
review_body: Cheap!  Flimsy!  Not made in United States.  Don't hold shape.  Will NEVER buy again.  Gerber…this product is very, very disappointing.

product_title: My First Rosary -20.5" Large Bead Wood
review_body: The piece itself was nice, but it was threaded with  wire. I have another one at home that my son received as a baptism gift, and its threaded with nice silky string. The wire makes the whole thing seem cheesy. I wish it said that on the product description, because I would have spent more money for a nicer option. The wood cross and beads were very nice quality, well painted.

product_title: Summer Infant Lil' Loo Potty
review_body: Simple design. Easy to clean. No cracks and crevices for anything yucky to get stuck in. She seems to find it comfortable and likes using it!

product_title: NUK Mash and Serve Bowl
review_body:
As a first-time father, I've had the opportunity to try out a range of different products. There are the ones I love. Then there are the ones I don't use. Unfortunately, the Freshfoods Mash & Serve Bowl falls into the latter category.

While the concept is great, the materials are simply lacking. Unless you're mashing up already super-soft or hard veggies steamed to mush, this masher doesn't get you very far. And if the food you want to mash is already that soft, like soft pairs or bananas, there's no real need to mash it anyway. Any potato masher can do the same trick, and would likely be more durable, too.

product_title: Fisher-Price Infant To Toddler Rocker, Bug Friends (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have about 3 different swing/chair/bouncer things and this is by far the best one! Especially for the price. Our son loved it as a newborn and at 15mos old, he is still using it as his chair. We ended up buying 3: one for our house, and one for each grandparents' house. Great product.

product_title: The First Years Ignite Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I'm 5'10" and constantly have had issues with strollers being too short for me to push comfortably...spending a few more dollars for this one made all the difference in the world!  Love this stroller, and so does my son!  And it really will accommodate a child of up to 50 lbs.  Collapsed down it's taller and a little wider than your average umbrella stroller, but not so much that you couldn't take it with you on a bus or something.

product_title: American Baby Company Newly Improved 2 Piece 100% Cotton Flannel Fitted Crib Sheet, White
review_body: Fits crib mattress well. Nice, thick sheet that is perfect for winter! I've washed and dried it in the dryer several times so far and has not shrunk.

product_title: Munchkin Warm Glow Wipe Warmer
review_body: My baby girl hates cold wipes so we got this basic warmer to see if it helped soothe her during changes. It works like a charm! Plus it worked with my pampers AND huggies wipes. A definite win for anyone with a picky baby :)

product_title: Dream On Me Ashton 5 in 1 Convertible Crib, Cherry
review_headline: Bad publicity is not certain product characteristics
review_body:
It would have been nice if they had marked the pieces.
My main complaint, the cot bed was advertised as a 4 in 1 cot. Technically this is true. However, I have to buy additional hardware to make it the full size (which is evident in the description) and also I have to buy the rail and hardware to make a separate toddler bed (his description not say this)

product_title: Safety 1st Expandable Table Edge Bumper
review_body: Fits perfectly on our round coffee table.  Isn't very attractive, but it does the job.  Baby pulls up and bumper stays on.

product_title: Dabbawalla Bags Insulated Lunch Bag
review_body: It's not quite big enough to fit todays lunch in.  Unless you use ziplock baggies and let's be honest, that's so 1990.....

review_body: These are cute and fun but I wished I could choose which one I got for my child. My only complaint is that I washed my a couple of times, and yes my little one sticks this in her mouth along with everything else, and the bells are starting to rust from the inside. But otherwise this is a nice toy/instrument.

product_title: 6 Ounce Portable Reusable Resealable and Refillable Food Pouch for Baby Food (6-Pack) By Precious Tummies. Great for Applesauce, Juices, Smoothies, Yogurt, Puree, and More. Perfect Accessory For Meals on the Go and Lunch Box Snacks. Double Reinforced Top Zipper Leak Guard To Prevent Leaks.
review_headline: Too much work. I decided to get re-usable straw cup.
review_body: The product works, but by now, my toddlers are too big for 6 oz. It's too much work to just get 6oz of use out of them. I switched to reusable straw cups, so I can make a 16 oz glass "smoothie" and they drink it through the straw.

product_title: Large WallStickerUSA Flower Lollipop Wall Sticker Decal
review_body: They look good but are nowhere near as big is the picture shows.  They are just above average size stickers.

product_title: Planet Wise Wet Diaper Tote Bag
review_body:
I purchased this wet bag to store cloth diapers in the nursery. It has a loop for hanging and I hang it on the side of the changing table. I can fit quite a lot of diapers (up to 20) in this bag easily. I have not had any leak issues or smell issues.
The only Con I have is that it takes quite a while to dry as it is supposed to be hung dry. This is the reason for 4/5 Stars.

product_title: Medela Quick Clean Micro-Steam Bags, 5 Count
review_body: Love these bags for sterilizing pump parts!  Great for use at work or when just a few things need to be sterilized. Item arrived exactly as described.

product_title: Dr. Brown's PreVent Classic Pacifier
review_body: Dr. Brown makes the best pacifiers.  My son loves the size and shape of the nipple.  He sleeps with then everynight.

product_title: Stork Craft Tuscany 4-in-1 Convertible Crib
review_body: Bought this crib and assembled it yesterday.  The crib seems sturdy and well built, and assembly was easy and straightforward.  It took my husband and I about 1hour to assemble- would recommend two people to assemble just because the large pieces need holding up while one person screws it in place.  One small negative comment: the package was missing 4 screws; so suggest to check that you have all the bits and pieces before starting.  Package arrived intact and no scratches were found upon inspection.  Also, I don't notice any strong smell that others have noticed (even with my 7-month-pregnant heightened sense of smell).  Overall, I'm very pleased with the look of crib ! And the price is definitely right -- agree with other comments that it looks and feels better than $400-$500 cribs I'm seeing in the stores.

product_title: Gaorui Leather Schoolbag Animal Cartoon Backpack for Children Toddler-14 Patterns
review_body: I bought this for my son because he loves to walk around wearing his older sisters  back pack (it's pink)  so we got this as it was a little more manly but still cute :).  It's nice but smelled a little plastic-chemically after first opening it but that soon has decreased.  It is a nice small size, good for our little guy who will be 2 in February...a lot of backpacks seem to be as big as his body but this fits nicely.

product_title: Skip Hop Tubby Bath Toy Organizer, Orange
review_body: I have a couple of these and they stay new and fresh looking even after being in the shower awhile. Good size for toys. The stay mounted well for me.

product_title: Boon Catch Plate with Spill Catcher
review_headline: Great idea but terrible follow thru...
review_body: I heard all kinds of great things about the "potential" of the plate BUT, it was a disaster as it would not stick to the high chair tray, or table, or kitchen counter.  it just ended up on the floor!

product_title: Munchkin Backseat Organizer, Black

product_title: Cardinal Gates Stairway Special Gate, Black
review_headline: Great gate if you install it right
review_body:
I first installed the gate and was going to give it 3 stars because it was difficult to open - the latch on the gate kept getting caught on release hinge/hole. Turns out, the side that the gate hooks on to was installed upside down. At first glance, it looks like both sides are identical, but if you look carefully, one side is thinner around the slot/hole which makes it release easily. Having said that, it installs easily. Here are some suggestions:

1. Recommended tools: Electric screwdriver, stud finder ($10 or less on Amazon), and laser level
2. Make sure you pay attention to the parts and not make the same mistake I did by installing one part upside-down.
3. You HAVE to screw the gate on to a stud. Even with the drywall plastic anchors, it will pull right out. The entire weight of the gate will be resting only on one side.

The nice thing about this gate:

- Perfect for crown moldings along the base-board, especially thick ones.
- Opens and closes easily and smoothly, with one had operation.
- Can be installed at an angle to accommodate where the stud is located.
- Paint and finish is great and feels extremely strong and sturdy.

In conclusion, I highly recommend this gate. It's pricey but for us, we really had no choice because of crown molding along the floor. We returned some much cheaper ones but these are great and they actually look pretty decent.

product_title: Munchkin Extending Metal Safety Gate
review_body:
We own (4) of these Munchkin extendable gates and (3) of the matching extra tall and wide gates. Yup, we have a total of (7) gates in our house. It allows us to herd and corral four kids and two dogs in just about any location. The first one was a bit hard to install only because anything new can be confusing. But once I had that under my belt, the others were simple.

The first one was installed two years ago, so we have a proven track record of using them over the long-haul. We installed more over time as we learned how useful they are. These gates have held up well, but we have learned some things to pass along to other people considering these gates:

Although anyone can install one of these gates, it helps to be handy. I recommend using better quality screws. They need to be long enough to go all the way through the drywall and into the wood behind. These gates should never be installed with those cheesy plastic inserts that are supposed to work in drywall.

One of our openings was a couple inches wider than the gate is designed to fill. I ordered it anyway because I figured I could rig something to work. I used a 4-foot section of 2X4 on each wall to fill the gap. I used good quality kiln-dried wood, sanded it smooth, then painted it to match our interior paint scheme. It looks like it was designed for the gate and the gate fits the opening perfectly. I did that for one of the extra wide gates, so I posted pictures on the Amazon page for that product.

Some have complained about the difficulty of opening these gates. Although it \\"can\\" be an issue, it does not have to be. It all comes down to careful adjustment. Once the fit is properly adjusted, the gates open very easily with one hand. Since we walk through the gates all the time carrying an infant or toddler, ease of one-hand opening is a must for us. We also have an 8-year old who has to be able to get around the house easily and be willing to close the gates behind him. It's not a problem for him.

Mounting height is an important consideration. Although it's important to get the gates as high as possible, a little too high and a toddler or a small dog can wiggle under the gate. I would err on the side of a bit too low. Due to the fact that there are no horizontal bars on these gates, it's very hard for even the best climbing child to get over them.

One of our main reasons for ordering these gates is that they have no bar or track mounted to the floor. We are as happy today as we were two years ago when we installed the first gate.

I was originally concerned about the fact that the hinges are plastic. Fortunately, they are tougher than they look. Our 2-year old has ridden on one of the gates while it swung open. Considering that she is 30-lbs and was hanging on the far end of the gate, the torque on the hinges was significant. It survived without any problem.

I recommend these gates without hesitation. 5-stars.im. It's not a problem for him.

It made her feel better knowing we could see her and talk to her while she was in there. The fact that I could talk to my daughter while she was in her room has been my favorite feature! But if you read the box, you know what you're getting and I won't count it out for things it never claimed to do.

product_title: Munchkin Extending Metal Extra Tall and Wide Baby Gate, White
review_headline: OK - but may need modification to install safely
review_body:
Assembly wasn't too terrible - took about an hour. However, the anchors included in the packaging were not strong enough to hold the gate in the wall. We initially screwed the bottom pieces into the trim, but that actually caused the trim to crack - within minutes of hanging it. We ripped off the trim, then anchored the gate into the wall, but that also didn't work. Within the two days we used this gate, the anchors completely ripped out of the wall at the pivot point. This is probably because of the weight of the gate and the weakness of the wall at the corner. If you're lucky enough to have a stud exactly where you want to hang it, you may not run into this problem. I wouldn't risk hanging this gate with the included anchors when the weight of the gate alone can't be held by them. Imagine if it's a child pulling/leaning too?

It would have been helpful to have the dimensions of the space between the bars before purchase. (Sorry - I wasn't smart enough to measure this before we returned it!) Our dog learned to squeeze through the bars the first day we had it. Since it also wouldn't physically stay attached to the wall without modification, we ended up returning the gate. Kind of wish I hadn't ripped that trim off now!

review_headline: 1. Cute 2. Easy to Use 3. Comfortable 4. Secure (most Important)
review_body:
As a new mom, moving around on my own with baby, baby bag and sometimes umbrella with car keys and cell phone readily accessible proved to be a bit challenging. On my best day I looked a bit clumsy especially when baby was very small and needed to be cradled with two hands due to lack of head control.
I wanted a wrap that would look cute and feminine (i.e. to say not one of those active sporty carrier/backpack types) but will also allow me to move around easily and with elegance.
I initially purchased ANOTHER wrap and while I won't call it out by name, I will just say that it was literally a wrap - large piece of cloth that wrapped both me and baby. Learning to use that wrap was a science all in itself! And moments after successfully securing the baby in the wrap I found myself taking it off because LO and I were HOT!
That wrap was not ideal for my tropical climate at all despite how cute or secure it was!

Then I found the Maya wrap. It had the look - cute and elegant - check!
As for ease of use - well I was able to put it on and put baby in it - straight out of the box! So check! (Now of course I read the instructions but really and truly the wrap was intuitive to use to me at least).
And now how did it fare in the tropics - well the fabric is very breathable and with the appropriate amount of clothing on me and baby, we were both very comfortable. I can see this working for colder climates too - just garb baby and yourself appropriately, and remember that body heat also factors in.
As for security - oh yeah - check! Not only does it feel secure but the instructions give you a little test to do to verify that baby is secure (involves bending over a bed - baby should not move or hang down)
LO loves being snuggled close to mommy and now when I walk into the pediatrician's office I stride with confidence. Baby in wrap, bag on opposite shoulder, car keys and cell phone readily accessible in wrap's zippered pocket to the front of me and head held high! No "first time mommy" label stuck on my forehead!
