product_title: Playtex Drop-Ins System - Breast Milk Storage Kit
review_headline: Using for my second baby and still loving them!
review_body:
When I was pregnant with our first baby, I researched all of the bottles then on the market to find what was best for going between breast and bottle. [[ASIN:B002HDM1A0 Playtex Nursers]] were an affordable choice and so we also registered for two sets of these Playtex milk storage kits (at the time, each kit came with only one pump adapter). When our baby was born, we introduced occasional bottles at 4 weeks and I returned to work full time at 10 weeks. I pumped at work using a [[ASIN:B0013O9RX8 Medela Freestyle Breast Pump]] until she was a year old and I pump weaned (my freezer stash was sufficient to send breastmilk to daycare for another 2 months). She never had any difficulties switching between breast and bottle and continued nursing until she was 2. Three years later our second daughter was born, we introduced the bottle at 4 weeks, and I returned to work at 12 weeks. I am again using Playtex Nursers, the Playtex milk storage system, and my trusty Medela Freestyle.

I follow the recommendation of IBCLCs to send 1-1.5 oz of pumped milk per hour we are apart. Our daycare requires that parents send in prepared bottles (regardless of whether they contain pumped milk or formula). I prefer to feed refrigerated milk as much as possible, and the volume I pump exceeds the baby's demand so I am able to freeze milk for emergencies and donation.

My pumping/storage/feeding system is pretty seamless. Every workday I set up three 4 oz Nursers, each with with a Drop In and either a Nurser nipple/ring/cap or a sealing disk from the milk storage kit. The three prepared Nursers and one Medela collection bottle go into my pump's insulated cooler bag. I use the pump adapter and pump directly into a prepared Nurser on one side and into the Medela collection bottle on the other. After my pumping session, if necessary I pour milk from the collection bottle into the Nurser to make a full feed and I cap the Nurser, then pour the rest of the milk from the collection bottle into a [[ASIN:B005G4VUPO Honeysuckle Breast Milk Storage Bag]]. I repeat this process at each pumping session (usually 3 per workday) and then when I get home I have three already-prepared bottles and any excess milk in a single milk storage bag.

Monday through Thursday I cap each Nurser with nipple/ring/cap so that they're ready to go into the fridge and then directly to daycare the next day. On Fridays I cap the Nursers with milk storage caps and they go into the freezer. On Sunday night we pull out those three Nursers, remove the storage caps, attach a nipple/ring/cap to each, and the milk thaws overnight in the fridge for daycare the next day. Every evening the extra milk in the Honeysuckle bag goes directly to the freezer.

We also use the Playtex milk storage system for frozen backup milk at daycare. I freeze milk in Drop Ins with the sealing ring and cap. Then if/when extra milk is needed, the caregivers can just pull it out of the freezer, attach to one of her empty Nursers with the sealing ring, remove the cap, and attach the Nurser's nipple and ring. After a few minutes in warm water the milk is thawed and ready to feed. This eliminates any need for the caregivers to pour (less chance for spillage) and reduces wasted milk since I freeze only 1-2 oz in each Drop In.

The combination of Playtex Nursers and this milk storage kit are a great value. They streamline bottle preparation and reduce time spent washing pump parts and bottles, and do so at a very affordable price. It has excellent durability; I am using the storage kit parts for our 2nd baby and I have no doubt they will hold up for a 3rd someday in the future. As a busy two-income family, time with our children is precious and I'm happy to have found this system!

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Extra Tall Walk Thru Gate, White
review_headline: It works, it's sturdy, & it's hard to break. Dog owners, this is a must!
review_body:
Great product! Works as advertised! Bought for my Aussie puppy. I am positive it'll hold once he's fully-grown too. Dimensions are precise. I messed up installing it the 1st time (wrong side) and it was a pain to remove it (tight space), which tells me my dog will never take it down: that's what I bought it for!

Installation was super easy. Make sure you read how the mechanism works though; you might think you figured it out by looking at the 4 spindle rods, but it's more elaborated than that, as these rods do NOT screw into the gate frame! Height is exactly what reported: 41\\"! So if you have 41.5\\" height available, this gate will work. I have base moldings in each side of the wall and it fit no problem. Use the wall cups! It's sturdier this way. You can always fill in the holes once you remove it and add a touch of fresh paint. Make sure you place it the correct way. There's a little \\"stopper\\" at the bottom of the door that stops the door from opening if your dob/baby puts his/her weight on. If you did this wrong, the door can still be closed but the bottom part of the door kind of opens and with a heavy push the hinges could break.

4 stars because the screws could be longer, heavier duty, and because the adjustable wheel spindles are cheap plastic. Yes, they work, but a heavier duty spindle would have made this gate even sturdier.

Overall, it works and it's much cheaper than the $100 wood frame gate I bought at Petco!

review_body:

We have tried adjusting the sensitivity and also the volume, but it hasn't helped. My husband was standing over the bassinet, right next to the monitor, talking to the baby (who was cooing back at him) and I couldn't hear them!

I'd like to be able to hear the baby fussing so I can go to him before he escalates to crying, but with this it just isn't going to happen. I don't feel that I can confidently use this monitor to supervise my baby how I'd like, so I just don't use it. At this point, it has become a very expensive room thermometer (I do really like that feature and the display is easy to read!). Unfortunately, I will be looking for another monitor as soon as I have time!

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_headline: Great for newborns and small babies
review_body: I bought this wrap so I could carry my second around and have my hands free to deal with my first. This wrap was perfect for my 8lbs 3oz newborn. He loved being in it and he would be snuggled against me sleeping while I took my son to story time. Perfect. When I flew with my newborn it was a breeze. I didn't even have to take him out of the sling to go through security. TSA just wiped something on my hands and I was good to go. (I did have to take him out to fly. Darn!)  As my son grew he just became to heavy to put in a sling. Which was a bummer because I liked using it so much. Even using the various positions he still made my back ache. So I only used my wrap for a short time, which was sad considering the price.  My other compliant was that this wrap is giant pain in cold weather. My son would get super toasty if I dressed him warmly and put him in the sling. So I would dress him lightly for fear that otherwise he would overheat. The only problem was he would freeze in his carseat. So I would put him in his snowsuit and load him into the carseat. Then upon our arrival I would jump out put on the wrap (freezing myself since I had to take off my coat to do it) Then I would strip my son down as quick as possible and dump him in the wrap and sprint into the building.  What a pain! If you live in a cold climate or will be having your baby in the winter don't bother getting the wrap you'll never use it. If you live in California then I'm jealous but it works well for a year round warm climate.

product_title: Ameda Purely Yours Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I originally did well with this pump, but it lost suction about five months into it. I got it via insurance. Customer service told me to change valves, I did, no improvement. They sent me a new base. I replaced the top. New pump essentially. A little better, but still weak. Maybe the quality of the parts are going down? I rented a hospital pump to get me through the issues and just had to return it- so sad. I now feel trapped with this pump because I did not budget for a Medela, but I may have to bite the bullet. Someone gave me a Medela hand pump and I just used it after pumping with the Purely Yours. I got an extra half ounce, which is a lot for me. Judging from the number of very recent negative reviews, I am really wondering if the quality dipped in order to get the insurance business. My supply has totally dropped due to this pump malfunctioning. And yes, it is way too noisy. My son wakes up if he hears it. I am not sure what is going on because it DID work. Tonight, it hissed at me and sounded like a car dying. If this is what a Obamacare does- lowers the quality of products for mass distribution- we are going down the road of a Soviet Russia, which was famous for having cheaply made stuff for mass distro. It sounded great...free pumps for moms...but now, I have a substandard pump. 2 stars because it was great for five months.

review_body: I use this pump to pump mostly at home, every once in a while at work (in a single, private bathroom). I use it mostly once a day, sometimes two times. I have really like it, and haven't had a single problem with it. It does not seem too loud to me - you can hear it, but it never seems distracting. I find the pieces easy to clean - we wash them with the dishes with hot soapy water. It pumps plenty of breastmilk - very efficient, doesn't hurt (once you are used to it), comfortable to use, etc. I do only one side at a time because it was too much to manage holding both at the same time, so I can't speak to how to how it works for two breasts at once. I also breastfeed and use this to provide him milk when I am away, so I can't speak to how good this pump is if you are providing milk exclusively by pumping. In short, for daily, but not intense use, this has worked really well for us for the two years I used it. I would recommend it to someone in a similar situation.

product_title: Boba 3G Baby Carrier - Lila
review_headline: Made me quit the stroller and convert to babywearing
review_body:
...Not 100% quit the stroller, but you get what I mean.

This was my first soft-structured carrier that I purchased. I \\"traded\\" my Bjorn and got this instead. I instantly fell in love with this!!! After doing heavy research on finding the best fit carrier for my body type and needs (I'm 5'2\\"), the babywearing experts I spoke with recommended me the Boba 3G carrier. The back is a little longer than that of the Ergobaby's, which makes this very accommodating for space with a fast-growing baby. This fits well into the toddler years and even has detachable foot rests too. This carrier even has secure straps for holding a purse or diaper bag while carrying baby.

I loved this so much I quit relying on my stroller as my main means of baby transport. Boy did I feel guilty! My stroller was very pricey and great, but I just preferred this carrier over pulling a large stroller out of a trunk all the time. This is one item that inspires me so much that I now want to do more activities outside with baby than with a carseat in a stroller.

5++++++ stars hands down.

review_body: Like the other reviews said, it took about an hour. My husband had to punch all the holes and it definitely takes two people. My only issue is my 14 month old quickly learned she can make a huge racket by smacking the sheeting. It does get a lot of glare but she's not going to fall through the slats anymore (she could slid her head and hips right through before we added the film). OVerall, I'm pretty happy but I wish there was less noisy option.

product_title: aden + anais Classic Muslin Swaddle Blanket 4 Pack
review_headline: I am not quite sure why everyone is so in love with these
review_body:
I ordered these after buying what I thought were the "originals" that everyone on here raves about. I had found them in a local store and thought I was getting a deal. When I realized they were different, I ordered these to see if I could differentiate between the two and thought that I may as well have more baby blankets than not if they turned out to be as amazing as everyone says.

When they arrived and I compared them to what I already have, I couldn't tell the difference at all. The feel of the fabric was 100% identical to what I bought (for less money). Amazon also sells the ones I bought and at the same price--I would have gotten them on here if I hadn't thought I was getting a deal elsewhere; they're the ones that are around $35 and two inches or so smaller on each side than these.

I wound up returning these since they weren't amazing enough for me to spend so much money on and have so many blankets in the house. They are definitely huge--but the smaller size are large as well and I think they'll be just fine for me and for our new baby girl. In fact, I was surprised that these blankets weren't softer from the way everyone raves about this brand and the way the reviews all refer specifically to making sure new parents order the "originals" instead of the others which are still brand name.

If I had to do it again, I'd stick with my decision to keep the less expensive, slightly smaller version rather than spending a lot more for a couple more inches on each side.

product_title: HALO 100% Cotton Sleepsack Swaddle
review_body:
I liked it at the outset. We bought it (and another) when my youngest was 2 months old.

Problems:
The velcro gets very wonky pretty much right away when you wash it (but to be expected, rally).
As you use it frequently the parts that tuck the arms around being taxed and soon I'm finding little hands poking through the bottom
For the last two months the zipper has been sticking. The part that sticks up that you pull down keeps getting caught at a strange angle that makes it impossible to pull down until its fixed. Trying to manage that with a wiggly or upset baby is difficult.
On another HALO sack that I have, the zipper is outright coming undone from the fabric.
The zipper part on this one in particular is now ruined. It can't unzip all the way. We still attempt to use it, but I am disappointed these things fell apart and my baby is only 8 months old.

We did nothing crazy with these. Washed them according to instruction, used them as laid out.

Things I like:
It is very easy to use. Zip baby up, fold arms over and velcro.
Good for babies who don't like to be overswaddled as there are several swaddling options
Available in different fabrics. This one worked well in both spring and summer.

review_body: Nice soft feeding spoons (good for an adult to feed a baby, they are a bit long for a small baby to use by himself or herself, though maybe a toddler could use them independently), and the color change feature is helpful.  The white part of the spoons will become permanently stained the first time you use it for carrots, sweet potatoes, etc. The spoon's bowl or basin is narrow enough for a baby, though slightly deep so a little food always seems to stay in it.  The issue we've had with these is that after a month or two of use, they start shedding thin threads of white plastic, near where the spoon's bowl meets the handle, so we recently had to start plucking these threads off to avoid having the baby ingest them inadvertently. We're tossing these spoons and will not get them again, for this reason.  We have not put these spoons through the dishwasher or exposed them to any unusual handling.

product_title: Manito Elegance Plus Stroller Weather Shield/Rain Cover
review_body:
I considered the BOB Weather shield, as well as the cheap plastic rain covers you drape over the stroller. But it didn't seem as if there was good ventilation for any of those covers, as some of the reviewers mentioned they wouldn't use it when the weather was warm. I also wanted a cover that i could use on both of my strollers.

We have used it on our UB G-Luxe umbrella stroller and fits very well. I would advise you to fit the cover over the stroller before putting your baby in the stroller. There are two hooks on the bottom so that the cover is secured and protected from wind. There are air vents on the side and a bit window that allows your kid to see out. I love that you can zip open the window! That means i can open it up when it stops raining or when we get onto the train instead of having this mass of plastic sitting on top. Your kid's feet may press against the front, but you can adjust the seat and have their legs hang over to make more room.

The cover is big enough to easily make adjustments, and to fit on larger, longer strollers. You can also keep the cover on as is when folding up the stroller, making daycare drop-offs easy.

I used a hospital rented Medela and a Medela double electric breast pump and I have to say that this Avent pump is FAR better than either Medela pump I used. I am AMAZED at how quiet the pump is and how much stronger the suction is and I haven't even come close to using the full suction strength of the pump. What also really stands out to me with this pump is that I can so easily adjust the suction strength and then hit the memory button and it memorizes and mimics the pressure and speed I was using to pump. I also have to say that the soft silicone massage cushions that fit inside the pump are SO much more comfortable than the hard plastic on the Medela pumps. My nipples got so sore with the Medela and I find that with the massage cushions on the Avent I am far less sore and chafed which has really helped and made pumping a lot more comfortable.

product_title: KEET Roundy Chair with Microsuede Ottoman
review_body: I'm so happy that I  bought this chair and ottoman.  My grand daughter loves it! It is very sturdy. I highly recommend it.

product_title: Joovy Ergo Caboose Tandem Stroller Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have a 2 year old that weighs 34lbs and a newborn. My 2 year old loves the stoller and I love having my little one up close to me. We have gone for many long walks with this stroller without any issues. It would be nice if you had the option to recline the front seat a little more but I think most sit n stand type strollers have this problem although this is the most roomy sit n stand I tested and my Chicco keyfit 30 fits perfectly in the carseat adapter. All the double strollers I have looked at are heavy and toting around a 34 lb toddler and an infant and infant seat makes the weight of it a non issue for me.

product_title: Castle Activity Track (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son received this for his 1st birthday but, even his 6 yr. old big sister loves it.  Which is great since he does not know how to do the lever just yet.  This has kept both of them entertained for a solid 20 min. every time they have played with it.  It's sturdy and the bell sounds is soft, so no matter how many times they do it, it never get's annoying.  Even the sound of the ball rolling on the track sounds nice.  As with most wooden toys, I expect that this will stand the test of time.  (but, only time will tell).  I am planing on getting him a pounding ball toy as well and I know those balls will be the same size, so then he can add more balls on the track.  I'm SO glad I found this on Amazon because in my research, I discovered this has actually been discontinued by Wondertoys.  So, get it while you still have a chance.

product_title: Little Toader Teething Toys - Meat
review_body: Totally looks like a chicken wing. Great quality. A conversation starter. My 8 month old daughter has not used it as much as other teethers but it's still a riot.

product_title: babyletto Modo 3-Drawer Changer Dresser
review_headline: Stunning dresser and changing table in one.
review_body: I purchased this changing table/dresser with Babyletto Modo crib. It was simple to put together, but it did take about 2-3 hours to assembly. it was all worth it at the end as the dresser is beautiful! Very nice and rich espresso color. My favorite part is that the tray on the top of the dresser is removable, so that once your baby grows up, you simply remove the tray and the piece of furniture becomes a dresser.

product_title: Zutano Elephants Velour Changing Pad Cover (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this changing pad cover. The colors are vibrant (much brighter than the crib sheets) and it is very soft.

product_title: The Mommy Hook
review_body: I purchased this to go on my stroller as I needed a place to hang bags when dropping my kids off at daycare.  I have 3 kids each with nap sacks and lunch boxes that need to be transported to and from the car every day.  The Mommy hook has allowed me to free up my hands of things I was carrying.  I can place up to 4-5 heavy bags on it without an issue.  The only thing potentially wrong with it is the name!  My husband was using it the other day and was joking that it should be called the "Parent" hook rather than the "Mommy" hook.

product_title: Brica Cover Guard Car Seat Travel Tote, Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I liked the car seat cover because it has the straps to carry it. The only downfall is they are a little thin. Other than that it has worked great for us.

product_title: Fisher-Price Royal Stepstool Potty
review_body: We got such a good deal on this potty!  I was looking at prices for training potties and thought, you must be kidding me...  This potty is a trusted name-brand, and it was very reasonable in cost.  Fingers crossed for potty training success!

product_title: Aden By aden + anais Muslin Swaddle Blanket 4 Pack
review_body: Great gift! Love how soft they are. Perfect for swaddling. Price was right. These are popular for a reason - they are a must have!

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_body: For security purposes I needed a way to see my front gate without being seen, and I wondered if this unit could handle the job.  It's perfect; now I can see who is out there without having to open the blind.  Everything works as advertised with no interference from my internet wi-fi, cordless phone or satellite TV.  There are two adapters; one looks a bit different but the company says they are interchangeable.  I placed the camera in the window overlooking the gate and it gives an excellent clear, wide-angle picture in daylight.  Since it did not work through the dark reflective coating, I removed a small area of the film for the camera to see through. The low-light infrared function is great and the monitor can increase or decrease the light level.  The sound function is a bonus, and the portability is a great feature in case I need to watch from different rooms.  Still another application for this system is to view TV.  I can't get satellite programs on my bedroom TV, but I can put the camera in front of the TV that does get them, turn up the sound louder, and watch the little monitor in bed.  The quality of course is not great, but it can be done.  I'm sure I'll think of more applications as it is so versatile.  The technology of this digital video monitor is fabulous.  The designers have thought of everything, and last but not least, the affordable price is very much appreciated.  Customer service is excellent; a human answers the phone promptly. The DXR-5 has solved a longstanding problem for me with no unwanted complications.  It should be listed under Home Security as well if you ask me.

product_title: Leachco Snoogle Pillow Cover Ivory
review_body: formerly preggo wife probably would have ripped my head off if not for this thing. three months post partum now and she no longer uses it. tried the small end to help prop up the baby for feeding, but the pillow is so long that it makes it difficult to move while holding the little dude

product_title: BABYBJORN BabySitter Balance, Brown/Beige (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Our baby is happy sitting, kicking, and bouncing in the BABYBJORN BabySitter.  This seat allows baby to watch older siblings playing or caregivers doing chores. If there is more than one child needing attention this gives a safe seat to the other. The seat cover is indeed easy to remove and wash as we found out the first time we used it. It is very easy to put baby into and get him out when the seat is on the floor.

product_title: Nuby Look At Me Mirror Toy
review_body: Our little girl LOVEd this.  Unfortunately, so did our dog.  The mirror and the different textures kept our little girl intrigued.

product_title: Xlear Spry Tooth Gel with Xylitol, Strawberry Banana Flavor, 2 oz Tube
review_headline: Great non-flouride toothpaste for little ones
review_body:
This stuff is the only way I get my 20 month old to brush his teeth.
Great for training for the real stuff. Easy to use. He likes the flavor and the tube lasts quite a long time.

product_title: Prince Lionheart bebePOD Flex Plus Baby Seat
review_body: After reading reviews, we purchased this chair instead of the better known Bumbo chair when our daughter was about 5 months old.  Her chubby little legs fit just fine and the pommel makes it easy to get her in and out.  We love the option to strap this chair to a full sized chair so our little one can join us at the dinner table.  It has met our expectations and baby loves sitting up and watching the world go by!

product_title: Sticky Bellies Baby Onesie Monthly Milestone Stickers (Oh Sew Adorable 13-24)
review_body: These are so adorable and a must have if you have used the 1-12 month stickers. My daughter loves to play with the stickers and now it is always a game for each month :)

product_title: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review_body: I love the ocean sound but the rest of the sounds don't seem to get loud enough. There also isn't any music on here- I guess I read incorrectly.

review_body: My 3 year old son wants to wear this all day, every day.  Collecting all the Avenger costumes now :-)

review_body: finally I've found a water bottle we love! especially b/c the straw is long enough to get pretty much all the liquid out! ordering more

product_title: Pikibu 180-Degree View High Definition Clarity Baby Car Mirror, Black
review_headline: Takes some getting used to, but AWESOME!
review_body:
I bought this when my baby graduated from the rear-facing car seat to the front-facing car seat. I was so used to peeking at him through the mirror that we placed on the seat in front of him. It became difficult to see him through my rearview mirror without moving my head and body, thus putting us at risk for an accident.

Once this clipped on, I could see my little bambino's face so easily. It took some time to get used to when using it as a regular rearview mirror when driving. You do get a little dizzy and need to adjust that objects in the mirror are now A LOT larger than they appear. So, don't be quick to return it if you feel the same at first. You'll get used to it after a short while.

product_title: Kids Basics 18x36x2 Replacement Foam Pad
review_body: Great firm mattres, it fits my dream on me cradle like a glove. I'm going to use the padding that came with the cradle underneath for more support, we'll see how it's going to work out once the baby comes, but so far I'm very happy with it.

product_title: Kel-Gar Snug Tub
review_headline: Cute, but leaked air with 1st use
review_body:
This tub is great for an infant who has outgrown the Kitchen sink tub. My six month old son loved sitting in this and splashing the water, but I noticed the bottom compartment was already deflated. I thought maybe I didn't close the valve enough (there are two compartments you fill-the sides and also the bottom)
The 2nd use is when I saw air bubbles coming from the floor, realizing there was a leak in the tub. Very disappointing to receive a tub that was defective right away. But for $14, I guess I couldn't expect much. I am returning it and hoping another brand will arrive in better condition.
Too bad, because other than the leak, I really liked the tub!

product_title: Sigma Beauty Travel Kit - Make Me Classy
review_body: Girls, i strongly recommend you to buy this kit. The delivery was exactly on time. It is the most comfortable kit if you are traveling a lot and still want to look amazing everyday, also i think all the brushes are very suitable for those who just started to do make up.

product_title: Safety 1st OnBoard 35 Adjustable Infant Car Seat Base, Black
review_body:
Bought this exclusively to make transfer of the baby from vehicle to vehicle simple. This allows unlock of the seat section and allows the base to be left in two separate vehicles. Essential in a family with two cars so that the baby is always secure and safely locked in. Otherwise ( with any car seat) the entire seat must be transferred and strapped down.

Makes a lot of sense...

product_title: Dream On Me Classic 2 in 1 Convertible Stationary Side Crib
review_body:
I am sooo pleased with this crib. I had to replace the one I had that was being used as a toddler bed. (It was recalled and couldn't be fixed) Wanted Cheap in price but not in Quality! This crib fit the bill!

Easy to put together. Very Pretty! Sturdy! Have recommended it to anyone that says they need a crib!
The Light wood it just pretty!

product_title: Baby Infant Hooded Towel, Blue Boy Dog, 100% cotton woven terry, 40" x 30", Frenchie Mini Couture
review_body:
While the towel material is very absorbent and really soft, the thread pulls out easily. On the first use a loop on the towel pulled out--so EASILY that it was as if it were never woven in the towel.

I do like the size of the towel given that my 4-month old baby already outgrew all his other ones. However, I would not buy this particular brand again given how easily the towel frayed.

product_title: Hello Kitty Shoulder Tote Handbag Satchel Shopper Purse
review_body: It's a cute bag for a kid, but not for an adult. It's made of cheap material. It's not nearly as nice as the picture. Don't waste your money.

product_title: Sashas Wrap Around Sun, Wind and Insect Cover for Double Side by Side/Twin Stroller
review_body: I got this for my daughter and she says it works just fine. Since it is a universal cover, it doesn't fit exactly, so that's why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5. That is a minor quibble, though, so I do recommend it as being a good purchase.

product_title: Britax Frontier 90 Booster Car Seat, Congo  (Prior Model)
review_body:
Installation was a BREEZE with the seat belt! My 2 year old, who is 33lbs & 36 inches tall, fits perfectly & can climb into it himself which is a huge plus for us. When he falls asleep his head never tilts forward or looks uncomfortable (we have it reclined to the highest possible recline position which isn't much but does the trick). Completely satisfied with my purchase thus far!

The only negative i can find is the fact the release button to loosen the straps is placed & hidden so far back my little fingers can barely reach it. Thankfully we have the straps adjusted to fit my son & don't release it often enough for me to consider the placement of the button a deal breaker.

product_title: Sesame Street Table Topper Disposable Stick-on Placemats with Reusable Pop-up Travel Case, 50-Count
review_body:
Going to restaurants with my baby has been much much easier with theses mats.
Just stick it. then give her food there. Does the job. Great price for the amount of mats u get

product_title: bumGenius Freetime All-In-One One-Size Snap Closure Cloth Diaper
review_headline: So in love with these diapers!
review_body: These are the best nighttime diapers! We reserve these for nighttime use as they are more bulky. They are super absorbent and never leak. Plus the material is moisture wicking so our guy doesn't end up with a soggy bottom from wearing these overnight. Love them!

product_title: Munchkin 4pc Straw Cup
review_headline: Milk gets out thru straw every time.
review_body: Every time we screw the cap in place milk rushes out thru the straw. I have to remind myself to take the straw out evertime.

product_title: Nuby Teethe-eez Soft Silicone Teether with Bristles
review_headline: Flexible and soft on baby gums
review_body: The teether is very nice.. Very flexible like rubber and is not hard on gums.. Son loves to hold it with easy grip and nibble on any part of the teether.. Most other teethers are too cumbersome to hold and are harsh on gums.. this works perfectly

product_title: Cotton Tale Designs Heaven Sent Girl Standard Lamp
review_body: The bottom part of the lampshade is not a perfect circle, there is noticeable difference on one side that makes it lopsided.  I did, however, get this from the amazon outlet for about $15 so I wasn't expecting too much.  Also, not sure if its supposed to be part of the look but the base of the lamp has what almost looks like razor marks going around it...maybe its supposed to be that way.  It is a cute lamp though, and perfect for what I needed.

product_title: Sealy Baby Posturepedic Crown Jewel Infant/Toddler Crib Mattress -220 PostureTech Sensory Coils, Orthopedically Designed Coils,  Hospital-Grade Waterproof Cover, EverEdge System, 52"x28"
review_headline: My Grandson LOVES his new Mattress
review_body: My grandson just fell down and smiled with excitement with the new mattress.  He slept so good that night and every night since.  It is a GREAT mattress.  I would recommend this mattress to any parent for their little one.  My grandson is 22 months old and was using his older brothers mattress that had been through his sister already so it was well worn.  So he was really excited to get a new mattress to sleep on that was soft yet firm.

product_title: Skip Hop Zoo Toddler Kids Insulated Backpack Chase Cat Girl, 12-inches, Orange
review_body: My daughter was determined to have an orange Kitty back pack, she adores it. Unfortunately it isn't quite big enough for school, but works great for grandmas and play time :)

product_title: MAM 2 Pack Original Silicone Pacifier, 6+ Months, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son loves these! and I do too! We have about 20 of them in every part of the house !

product_title: Nosefrida Hygiene Filters
review_body: These filters work well- and the nose frida itself is AWESOME.  So much better than the bulb to suction out my little guy's nose.  I recommend the nose frida to all my mommy friends!!

product_title: Badger Basket Envee Baby High Chair with Playtable Conversion
review_headline: Very cute, easy to use with one exception.
review_body:
Really cute high chair.
I'm very happy with this product.
It was very easy to assemble , and it's very easy to use, with one exception.
Sliding the high chair tray on and off is a bit difficult, it's kind of stiff and you have to use your whole body to hold the chair still while you move the tray one way or the other.
That's the only concern I have with the chair.

product_title: OsoCozy Better Fit Unbleached Prefolds
review_body: I purchased these prefolds for use on my two daycare babies. Both are toddlers and boys. I also have flats, pockets and regular prefolds. These are BY FAR my favorite prefolds! Tri-folding and using a Thirsties of Blueberries cover is pretty much leak proof. Also, using the jelly roll fold with boingos really holds for my smaller little guy. I just ordered the toddler size for as they grow. I have been looking for a perfect Cloth Diapering system for my daycare (I do not supply disposables), and I think I have found it!

product_title: Baby Girl Memory Book Hardcover Record Babys First Five Years Diary Precious Moments Milestone Storage Box Keepsake Scrapbook Journal Photo Album Pink Monkey Animals Art
review_body: This product is pretty cool because it provides a place for keepsakes and memories. It's small enough to be portable and durable to hold up through the years.

product_title: Britax Stroller Organizer, Black
review_body: The bag is a bit expensive in my opinion for what you get. I would say that the bag is only the size of a small purse. It holds drinks, but the middle pocket seems almost useless. It cannot hold much. The pocket is probably the size of a large orange, to give you an idea of how big it is. I do like the mesh pockets in the front of it, which are perfect for a cell phone or two. Overall I just wish that the bag was bigger... But maybe for this price range it's ok.

product_title: BABYBJORN Cradle - White
review_body:
Bought this cradle as a gift for my daughter's first child. It is light enough to easily move around the house, yet it is sturdy and stable so you have peace of mind that it won't tip over. It moves with the gentlest of motions (literally, a little finger can move it a great deal) so it is easy to soothe the baby. The mesh exterior makes it easy to see the baby, so you can observe the baby to your heart's content without disturbing him; and I like the fact that the air doesn't 'stagnate' within the interior as it could with solid-sided cradles/bassinets. Very happy with this purchase.
1/12/2014 update: my 4-month-old grandson has moved on to his big-boy crib. This bassinet is being packed away to save for the next grandbaby. So pleased I made the investment in this quality product.

product_title: Graco Pack N Play Changing Pad Cover
review_body: I was amazed at how well these changing pad covers washed.  And my granddaughter always had a smile when she was placed on one to have her nappies changed. I would recommend to anyone.

product_title: Discovery Kids - Music Trio - Trumpet Piano & Guitar
review_headline: No option but to hear the little tunes
review_body: I thought my baby would be able to play the little piano or blow the little horn yet these toys come with different tunes that play with pressing the buttons so not actually inspiring music exploration but playing things unrelated to the instrument they seem to represent.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Melodies and Lights Deluxe Gym
review_body: My baby started using this at 2 months and absolutely loves it.  He entertains himself for several minutes on his back playing with it.  I like that the animals are all removable and you can put them on the blanket for tummy time, or I take them with us when going out for the carseat.  Nicely built.

product_title: Philips AVENT Microwave Steam Sterilizer
review_body: Gave to my niece after my daughter-in-law raved about hers. Wonderful gift for a first time mother or any new mother.

product_title: Badger Basket Company Sleigh Style Changing Table with Hamper/3 Baskets
review_body: When we first opened the box, we were a little over-whelmed by all of the pieces that went into assembling this piece of furniture, however, once we got started it was actually pretty easy! It took us about an hour to assemble, which in my opinion, isn't bad at all. I was nervous that it wasn't going to be very sturdy, because of several reviewers claiming it seemed flimsy, however after we finished putting it together I am pleased to say that it is in fact, quite sturdy. I think it is absolutely lovely, and provides a lot of extra storage. So far we really love it!

product_title: Moby Wrap UV SPF 50+ 100% Cotton Baby Carrier, Turquoise
review_body: Speedy delivery and great service. I do not use this as much as I anticipated I would. But it is great to have on hand for when I want to run the vacuum or do dishes

product_title: Sail Away 4 Piece Baby Crib Bedding Set with Bumper Plus FREE Sheet Saver by Bedtime Originals
review_body: I wanted a nautical themed room for my son, and once I saw this on Amazon I fell in love. As soon as we received it in the mail I could not contain my self to put everything together right at that moment, and his room came out great!!

product_title: Alpine Tunnel Slide
review_headline: Great for the toddlers who like to climb
review_body: This is a very well made and robust play center for a toddler. It has a tunnel, slide, 2 steps (one with a mirror, but not very clear.) It also has two red \\"wings\\" that provide some cushion should the child fall off the top of the tunnel. Overall a good investment, however we bought this on another site for a lot less money than what Amazon shows here. You can find it cheaper if you shop around.

product_title: Levana Jena Digital Baby Video Monitor with 8 Hour Rechargeable Battery and Talk to Baby Intercom
review_body: Alright, this is my 4th child, and my 4th or 5th monitor. It is by-far the very best I've had!  The camera quality is excellent, I love the screen feature that turns it off when there is nothing to view (and turns it on if there is noise). The music feature is cool, the nightlight is great, and I LOVE how lightweight the monitor is (so I can pin it to my pants without them falling down...hahaa!  My old video monitor was HEAVY!). The ONLY feature I would add is making the camera capable of swiveling from left to right, as well. But hey--it's still great--and I will live comfortably with it just going up and down!  Got this on a great sale on Amazon--watch the prices--they fluctuate often!!

product_title: Wood Dog Print Decor Pet Gate Black
review_body: Very sturdy gate for the price. Easy to step over or move one section. Came assembled and right on time.

product_title: Britax B-Agile Stroller, Peacock (Prior Model)
review_body: Love Love love! So lightweight n easy to stroll around! The best thing is how easy it is to close!

product_title: green sprouts Infinity Teether Rattle
review_body: pretty pastel colors and so soothing - brings the hands together and of course anything to teethe on is good

product_title: Natursutten BPA Free Natural Rubber Pacifier, Butterfly Shield, Orthodontic nipple
review_headline: Only pacifier we use in the crib
review_body: My 7-month old loves this pacifier for his bedtime.  It's the only we use in his crib.  We've used it successfully to calm him back down on nights when he wakes up before it's time for him to eat again rather than having to nurse him back to sleep.  And because of its size and color, it's easy for us to find in the dark.  Definitely worth the price!

product_title: Prince Lionheart Jumbo Toy Hammock
review_body: Great product. All my son's plush toys are all in this toy hammock. He is also happy to see his toys just hanging around.

product_title: Tommee Tippee Deco Starter Set
review_body: After three months on maternity leave only breastfeeding my daughter, it was very difficult finding a bottle that she'd take. After a suggestion from my sister-in-law I decided to give these a try. My daughter has no issues with these and doesn't seem to have any confusion with returning to the breast.

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Extra Tall Walk Thru Gate, White
review_body: We love this product.  We've been using it for our pets.  It allows us to keep them out when we need to.

product_title: Stompeez One Eyed Monster - S (5-11)
review_body: I would reccommend these for any kids.  They make great gifts for any occasion. Kids love them. Two thumbs up!!

product_title: Regalo Swing Down Bedrail, White
review_body: Although it was a little difficult to install, because you have to run two straps under the mattress, it works very well.  I do, however, wish I could have found one that has rails you can slip under the mattress.

product_title: Baby Vision Grow With Me Set 6Pc
review_body: THIS IS JUST WHAT I WANTED. I LIKE THE FACT THAT IT PROGRESS FROM 0-3 TO 3-6 TO6-9 MNTHS OLD ALL IN ONE PACLK!

product_title: Bumkins Booster Cloth Diaper, 12 Count, Natural (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These work wonderfully for us. I use them inside a Pooters Contour diaper, on my 4 month old son. He goes for a 4-6 hour stretch of sleep at night, and we never have a leak.

product_title: Britax EZ-Buckle Belly Pad
review_body: I dont know about you, but we lost the little circle belly pad that came with our seat a long time ago. This one is great, since its bigger and covers the strap as well. I wish I had thought to get this a lot sooner!

product_title: Baby Boom Monster Trucks Nap Mat, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My three year old loves this so much that he doesn't want to leave it at preschool!  The blanket is a soft "minky" material that washes well.  It seems pretty well made, although we have only had it for a couple of months.  The colors are nice and bright, and best of all the little guy actually naps on it!

product_title: Leachco Bath 'N Bumper - Cushioned Bath Tub - Blue Fish
review_body: The sides aren't as high as they look in the picture. I bought this hoping for a transitional tub since my baby is way to big for the infant tub he has used since birth (he is 10 months now & 27 lbs., like I said he is BIG). He can't quite sit up on his own for long periods, so I wanted something that would prevent him from falling onto the side of the tub while I bathed him...No luck here. It will be helpful once he sits up sturdy on his own, however. For now I am going to continue using the infant tub & hope he gets the hang of sitting up on his own SOON!!!!

product_title: Munchkin Baby Bath Ball
review_body: I was very excited because I received the pink version which would have cost more because that specific color was the luck of the draw and our original one at home in the UK was the other color.  This one is for Gma's house in the States. Thanks!

product_title: Kids Line Jungle 123 Valance, Brown (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Decor fits theme of baby's room
review_body: Since we do not know the sex of our baby, we wanted it to be neutral and having a jungle seemed to be a fit for us. The products in this line are adorable and we're glad that we picked this!

product_title: Bugaboo Cup Holder (previous version)
review_body: Love this product so necessary with a stroller!! It's convenient and looks nice on the stroller. It can be moved son it's easy to adjust to your needs!

product_title: Natural HE Powder Laundry Detergent for Hard Water by Rockin' Green, Perfect for Cloth Diapers, Hard Rock Formula for Hard Water, Up to 90 Loads Per Bag, 45 oz.
review_body: This is the second bag I bought, the first being Funk Rock. After I bought it, I found out we had hard water so I sucked it up and finished the bag. I decided that since it didn't work well the first time, I would try the hard rock next time and see if it works any better. Nope, I'm so mad I wasted my money as the diapers don't seem to be clean. In fact, they still seem dingy and smells raw. I will stick to Charlie's from now on because this is a waste of time and money.

product_title: Trend Lab Cotton CribWrap Wide Rail Cover for Crib Front or Back
review_body: Goes perfectly with my daughters decor.  And it protects the crib just as I expected.  It will stay on the crib for a long time.

product_title: Pearhead Wood Bank
review_headline: My boys have the whole set.
review_body: Between all my boys they have the set (except the girl colored one). Great craftsmanship and they're just unique... And non-breakable which is how we roll in my house.

product_title: NUK Gerber Graduates 4 Count Fun Grips Hard Spout Sippy Cups
review_body: Best cup we have ever purchased! This is the most durable cup after 2 years of searching for the right one!

product_title: Piyo Piyo 2+1 Milk Powder Dispenser
review_body:
We've been using baby's one organic formula and it does not come in a ready to drink version. Up to now I've been making a 16 ounces at a time using a mason jar and a kitchen scale, and it has worked fine for when I am in the house all day. But I wanted something for making formula on the go or when traveling generally.

The top two compartments are supposedly for the formula and the larger third compartment is supposedly for storage of things like nipples. I found the larger container too small for the Born Free nipples.

I ordered two of these and have basically created one unit with 4 compartments and am not using the larger bottom compartments at this time.

I place one container on the kitchen scale, zero it out, add 17 grams of formula (2 scoops for 4 ounces) and repeat. I did not realize how convenient it would be to keep the powder pre-measured so I did not have to worry about refrigerating the formula once made. All I need is a bottle of water to fill the bottles, my Piyo and I am good to go to whip up a 4 ounce bottle in no time.

I would not put this in the dishwasher. I have only used it for 3 days, but I already feel liberated. The benefit of "weighing" the formula in the little cups is that I can take some back out if I add too much, whereas if I dumped that into the bottle/jar with water in it right from the scoop, I can't retrieve any "over pours". Thus, this lets me make a much more consistent bottle.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat
review_headline: Great Value, beware of mildew on straps!
review_body:

I spot-treated them as necessary and they appeared to clean up okay. Fast forward 2 years... I attached this seat to one of my patio chairs on our porch this summer so that we could have family meals outside. Within 1 month in the summer heat, visible mildew grew on all of the straps...I suppose it was living off of 2 years of food residue. I cut the straps that went around my son's waist so that he wouldn't be exposed to them, and continued to use it strapless.

My brother had the same seat and put his in a storage locker for a period of time. They had the same issue - black mildew grew on the straps, and they tossed theirs as a result.

I suppose any highchair with nylon straps would have the same issue if exposed to heat. Fisher price is now using a high tech rubber on some of their chair straps, but they cost upward of $100, and you could buy 4 of these for that price. This chair is a cheap alternative. Just don't store it in warm places, or use outside in the heat.

product_title: Belly Armor Belly Blanket Chic
review_headline: Misleading Claim - Does NOT Protect as Implied
review_body:
(This is a copy of my review from the \\"Belly Blanket Chic: Metro\\" version of this product which we purchased and returned. I'm copying this here to warn others of our findings):

Written claims on product packaging:

\\"99.9% Shielding Effectiveness for radiation from: cell phones, laptops/computers, other electronic devices.\\"

Desperately trying to find a way to protect our unborn child after recently learning that WiFi and cell signals are MICROWAVES, my wife and I found some comfort finding this product and reading that claim. I believe Belly Armor's 99.9% shielding effectiveness claim will give any regular person the impression that it blocks 99.9% of typical microwave (cellular and WiFi) signals. I myself am an electrical engineer, and although not specialized in RF, I fell for this claim as well. Having learned the hard way not to trust doctors, scientists, or anyone from the government without verifying things myself, I quickly went about trying to verify Belly Armor's claims and then try my own real-world tests.

Cell phone test: As detailed on a little card included with the package, I wrapped my old iPhone 3GS (AT&T GSM microwave network) within the belly blanket for 30 seconds, and quickly took it out to see the bars. Yes, the signal had reduced. But does that mean it blocks 99.9% of the microwave radiation? I went one step further to really find out:

I first connected my iPhone to my wife's iPhone (both AT&T GSM network), put mine on speakerphone, then fully wrapped it in the belly blanket, being sure to fold over (overlap) all the edges so no signal could escape out any \\"cracks\\". Instead of the call being dropped immediately, or even after a few seconds, I was able to maintain a reasonably clear speakerphone conversation with my wife right through this blanket (reasonably clear not because the signal was reduced, but because of the muffled sound of trying to speak via speakerphone through a decently thick blanket. Now I ask you, how is it possible to have this kind of conversation for 2 minutes (after which we gave up testing) if it \\"shields\\" 99.9% of the signal?

I went one more step. I next performed a speed test (data throughput test) on my iPhone via our home WiFi (old Netgear N-300 wireless router), then DOUBLE-wrapped this router within the belly blanket. I re-ran the test (cell data option turned off so that it could not be coming from the 3G network) and was able to get nearly exactly 50% data throughput at 10 feet distance. Now how could this be possible if this product is shielding these microwave signals 99.9%?

Now without having done these tests myself, we would have been using our microwave generators (iPhones) with a false sense of confidence and security, thinking we were fully shielding (99.9% is basically fully shielded wouldn't one think?) our unborn baby from these extremely dangerous pulsed scalar microwaves. CLEARLY THIS IS NOT THE CASE.

One comment another individual made on another review was that they used their fancy testing device and verified that there was a \\"massive reduction\\" in the signal. No details or specifics were given. Well here are real-world tests each and everyone of you can try yourselves with your own WiFi networks and phones to see if this product really delivers what you're expecting and needing.

To try to understand what the heck is happening, I first wrote to Belly Armor via their website, explaining what I had done and asking them to come clean and explain how and why this could happen. I did threaten to post my findings here on Amazon, and gave them 5 days to at least confirm receipt of my e-mail. No response. Okay, that's fine, we're returning this ineffective product touting extremely misleading claims for a refund. But there's no way we were not going to warn others of our findings and explain what they might try to verify this themselves.

Next, I carefully readthe testing report from Belly Armor's website, and all of their claims. The light mesh silver shielding material used in the product is shown in a picture in the Independent product safety report available from their web site. It clearly shows a wide mesh with huge gaps in between the tiny threads of silver. In other words, if this was a screen door, you would basically see 1/4\\" gaps between the mesh, allowing quite a bit of whatever you're trying to shield through it. As with protective clothing made with silver nylon thread, if you get the cheaper 50% silver nylon mesh, you get a 50 db reduction, similar to what is supposedly achieved with this product. However, for more effective shielding that's more like \\"blocking\\" as what we want, you've got to go with the 2x more expensive 100% silver nylon design, which basically leaves no gaps through which the signal can pass. That is basically the way it made sense to me and how I understand it.

With any safety device of any kind, and most especially for our children that rely on us to know best, we think it's always best to verify claims, and do your own research and testing, if possible.the testing report from Belly Armor's website, and all of their claims. product_title: Dreambaby Chelsea Swing Close Gate Combo Pack
review_headline: Sturdy but a bear to install
review_body:
I did not purchase this gate (w/ 2 extensions) from Amazon as I found is online from a big box retailer for $15 less but wanted to review here. I have been wanting this gate for a while as the reviews were all positive. We ordered 2 of these gates. One for the bottom of our stairs and then another in our 2nd floor hallway. Every though the gate is very solid and won't budge much when installed, we were hesitant about placing the 2nd gate at the top of our stairs just in case our toddler gets rough on the gate and it just happen to fall. We felt safer putting is in our hall instead.

The first gate (bottom of stairs) installed very easily. We didn't want to screw the wall mounts into the wall so just stuck with pressure for both. The stair install went very easily. Instructions advise to mount on the lower most step but because of our base molding, it would not fit so we installed on the floor right in front of the stairs. Going up the stairs is fairly simple and the height is decent. Coming down the stairs, however, we have to reach down and bend over to open the gate. Not a big deal but the xtra tall gate may be better for stair bottoms. This would not have worked for us as the stair rail would be in the way to install the top of the gate.

The gate in the hallway was more of a challenge. Width b/w walls is right around 35\\" so we needed to use both extensions. Because we have molding on the bottom and also on our loft wall, installing here was very challenging. With both extensions attached and the pressure mounts that created a total width of right at (or more) than 35'. I really had press hard to push this into place. if I had used one 3.5\\" extension then it would have been too narrow to install. if there was a 2.5\\" extension available it would have worked perfectly. I finally got this in place but it was a lot of work.

Overall, we really like this gate and so glad we held out for this exact one. It is solid as a rock, doesn't budgewhen we open & close the gate, and very well made! My one recommendation would be to be sure of your measurements before installing. Even though it said it will fit openings 29\\"-38\\", you have to consider the gate has no flex because of how solid the metal is. if you opening is over 34\\" or in between using an extension and not using the extension then you may require extra muscle to install.

review_body:
I love my Moby wrap but why does it have to be so darn expensive?? It's fabric for goodness sakes!

product_title: Graco Snugride Infant Car Seat Base

review_body:

review_body: These were much needed parts with The Safe Sippy 2 cup.  I like having our son use a straw at 18 months to help with his speech development and these parts helped to step up the cup.  Love this cup because the stainless steal keeps his milk cold much longer!

product_title: Dream On Me Classic 2 in 1 Convertible Stationary Side Crib
review_body: Received in 2 days. The crib comes without a lot of bells and whistles, but it is a beautiful piece of furniture.  It took one person 30 minutes to put it together, and all the tools came with it.  I recommend this crib to anyone/everyone.

product_title: Safety 1st Spring n' Release Latches
review_body: These cupboard locks take a little while to install but are totally worth it! They may be "dad" proof unless you train them how to use them!

product_title: The Safe Sippy Cup
review_body: I wasn't sure how these would fair for my 12 month old, considering we're transitioning. But they turned out great. The idea of clean stainless steal and a good spout working together is genius.  My son drinks so much more water with these. And they're cute.

review_body: Fast shipping, did come in package, individually wrapped.  However, it looks nothing like the photo. The photo shows a more realistic skin tone, very funny, of course a gag gift...instead, I received a fire red pair, very cheap and looks nothing like the photo. Very disappointed!

product_title: Skip Hop Zoo Toddler Kids Insulated Backpack Marshall Monkey Boy, 12-inches, Brown
review_body: This is a great product!  It is the perfect size for my little one - it holds his lunch bag (the coordinating skip hop monkey) plus other items.  The side pocket is perfect for a sippy cup or water bottle. The front pocket has plenty of room for snacks or toys.  We love this bag.  It is very well made.  We love our Skip Hop products!

review_body: Babies love sleeping on this. They love it. They sleep well. Good naps. Naps fun. Baby zzzz. Review needs many words.

product_title: Summer Infant 2 Count Swaddleme Blanket
review_body: I love these swaddlers! Great price for a very user-friendly product. These make swaddling a breeze and even allow me to leave one of my baby's arms out while still allowing him to feel snuggled. The fabrics are different materials, but both are still quality and soft.

product_title: North States Plastic Colorplay Superyard Extension Kit
review_body: I ordered this extension kit for my sons play yard and it makes all of the difference! It was easy to add on to the existing play yard and gives him more room to play.

product_title: Hudson Baby 2 Count Muslin Swaddle Blanket
review_body: We usually buy the Aiden & Anais dream blankets and muslin blankets but have most of those prints now so we tried these and they are lovely!!! I would say just as nice as the A&A's we have and they have held up to tons of washings without getting as waffley as the A&A's do.
