product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review_body: It is a good quality build that folds up for easy storage and transportation.  It is also very easy to keep clean.

product_title: Leveret Footed Cotton Sleeper, Red & Navy Blue Stripes
review_body: I gave the pajamas as a gift... So hip and cute!! They loved it!! So comfy and cute! It is so colorful and fun!

product_title: Tag A Long Tag A Long - Lime
review_body: With three kids, I needed extra hands for when I had the newborn in a stroller and the 3 and 5 year old in tow.  They attach nicely to the stroller and allow us to walk through a parking lot with safely!

product_title: Bright Starts Pretty In Pink Bouncer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The Bouncer is very sturdy my 5 month old child love it. The only thing is that the electronic part had a couple of scratches but I figure it was not worth sending it back for that, Other then the very minor scratch it is very well built.

product_title: American Baby Company Heavenly Soft Chenille Fitted Contoured Changing Pad Cover
review_body: Works fine, fits fine. Has not shrunken in the wash and is soft enough. Not all that thick and therefore not 5 stars.

product_title: Skip Hop Versa Diaper Bag
review_body: Love this bag. Thought that it may look tacky, may be too big/small, and other worries...and I looked forever for a bag. I actually saw the bag at BRU, and thought not that bad. But, it's when I started using it that it was wonderful. If you use your "purse" the way I do, this is perfect. I have 2 kids - newborn and nearly 3 yr old and this is perfect. easy to clean and plenty of pockets... You will love it...I do...

product_title: Prince Lionheart Playmat Plus
review_body: It is not as soft and cushiony as I expected for my infant, the pics are not high resolution either! We may order another brand, however my baby can use this one when he is 2-3 years old.

product_title: Dandelion Organic Toy Crinkle Bear
review_body: This is a cute little toy, I love that it's organic and soft, but it's really not very crinkly. My niece wasn't interested at all in this toy.

product_title: 3 Sprouts Storage Caddy
review_headline: A perfect caddy for baby's things.
review_body: We keep this by the nursing rocking chair with everything we need . It is adorable and very well made.

product_title: Nursing Necessities Petite Electric Breast Pump
review_body: I have a medla freestyle which is amazing then got this so I could stop toting mine to and from work. This Playtex pump is horrible. Unless I am using it wrong, I only get about 1/4 the milk in the time it takes me to pump a full bottle with my medela. This is definitly not a good pump. If you can get something else, by all means, do!!!

product_title: Podee Hands-Free Baby Bottle Feeding System (Twin Pack)
review_body: This product makes my life a lot easier. My LO can feed himself now and I can feed him on the go.

product_title: Planet Wise Reusable Diaper Pail Liner
review_headline: Really nice if you are using a dry pail - but buy 2!
review_body:
If you are going the dry pail method this pail liner is great, my only problem is I bought one and you can not dry in dryer so it takes a while to air dry. So I recommend buying a second one to switch out when washing. But it works great to just throw in with your cloth diapers to wash. Nice product, made well

Also- seems like it might make an awesome laundry hamper liner : )

product_title: Kiinde Kozii Bottle Warmer and Breast Milk Warmer
review_body:
We bought this specifically because it is designed not to overheat breastmilk. It's no easy task keeping up with pumping and all the washing, etc. that goes along with it - so I hate the thought of losing any of the benefits of that precious milk.

We've used the Kozii for about two months now, three days a week. It's been very convenient, and we don't think it takes too long to heat- but then again, our little girl is not a good eater and usually only takes three oz at each feeding. No problems thus far with any sort of malfunctions.

I might have given the Kozii four stars just to be conservative, but I was very pleasantly surprised by their customer service. I sent in a technical question via the website, and one of the inventors answered my question before the next business day. When I asked a follow up question, the other inventor responded on the same day! Their answers made me feel that they are very committed to making a quality product.

product_title: Philips Avent Digital Video Baby Monitor with Night Vision
review_headline: Got only two stars in my comparison test
review_body:
This review is from: Philips Avent Digital Video Baby Monitor with Night Vision (Baby Product)
Customer review from the Amazon Vine Program (What's this?)
I have used the Foscam baby monitor and I think it's a lot better (and it happens to be much cheaper): Foscam FI8910W Pan & Tilt IP/Network Camera with Two-Way Audio and Night Vision (Black).

I like my Foscam much more because:

1) Better security - that's essential
2) I can pan and tilt it, another essential when using video baby monitors. This Philips Avent unit must be laser-like targeted to consistently keep baby viewable.
3) Works with my iPhone - unlike this Philips Avent unit.
4) Doubles as a security cam - again unlike the Philips Avent unit, because to be also a security cam it must work on an iPhone and also on Andriod, Blackberry and PC.

This Philips Avent just doesn't compare well because it's so darn limited.

product_title: BRICA Corner Bath Basket Toy Organizer
review_headline: Exactly what I've been looking for!
review_body: I've been looking around in stores for a smart way to store bath toys in the tub. This is perfect! The suction cups attach well, so it can hold a lot of toys.

product_title: Muslin Wrap (Set of 2)
review_body: These blankets were light and airy and perfect for the summer months. Though most muslin is not naturally soft, these were not too scratchy and were very comfortable for my baby. The material is not conducive to swaddling older babies who are more mobile, as the material does stretch quite a bit. My baby was about 6 months when I used them and he often wiggled out and would get a bit tangled up in them. However, I think newborns would do just fine. Overall, very satisfied.

product_title: Safety 1st Expandable Table Edge Bumper
review_body: I purchased this product to put on my glass top coffee table.  It is an average size table.  I was hoping to find a product to have when my granddaughter comes to visit and could remove it easily when not needed.  The information about sizing is not accurate and very hard to understand.  I tried to judge from other reviews but unfortunately it did not fit.  I will be returning it and don't know if I want to order a larger size.

product_title: Luvable Friends Flannel Receiving Blankets
review_body: Purchased these for my grandbaby - very pretty design but the fabric was not as soft as I remember for my children.  Nice size and wash well.

product_title: Leachco Cuddle-U Basic Nursing Pillow and More, Sage Pin Dot
review_body: I opted for this nursing pillow because it has good reviews and is significantly more reasonably priced than the Boppy. I really like the support this pillow gives. However, I dislike the velcro on the opposite side of the pillow. It's very scratchy on a bare leg or against skin in general. I haven't used the strap to prop my baby up, because it seems to have too much fabric to really support him. He sits in it just as well without the strap. I'd say go for this pillow if you're looking for a nice supportive nursing pillow that's reasonably priced. Of course, since it doesn't have a removable washable cover, just throw a light blanket over it so you can easily wash whatever the baby decides to spit up and you're good to go.

product_title: Graco SnugRide Classic Connect Infant Car Seat - Pasadena - One Size
review_body: I didn't really care for this carseat. The cover at the foot area kept coming off and wouldn't stay in place. I invested in a more expensive brand and carseat because safety is important.

product_title: Pack of 3 SUPER ABSORBENT bandana dribble bibs   aqua blue, grey, tomato red, 3 Months by Zippy Suit.
review_body: I bought these drooling bibs for my 6 month old.  I had another brand but they were thinner than these and my son could drool right through them.  Well I was really upset when one of the snaps fell off when I first put it on and a few of the snaps don't work with one of bibs that I got.  They are super cute and he gets so many compliments, but if they don't work properly they don't deserve a high rating.  The bib it self works great, but a higher quality snap would be better.  I literally have the metal piece to the snap sitting on my counter.

product_title: Diono Pop up Trash Bin, Black
review_body: This collapsible canister is a little bigger around than a 2 liter soda bottle and about that ht. It has a nylon top with a drawstring closer, (it doesn't show up on the photo) that increases the volume of litter you can manage. There is also optional velcro anchor to apply at the bottom if you want to stick it down. I found that I can hang it from my console shifter and let it rest in the passenger footwell in easy reach of the driver.  If it begins to overflow I can close the drawstring top a bit until I can empty it. If I want to move it to make room for company, can easily close it up with the drawstring and drop in into the back seat.  Recommend.

product_title: FunBites Squares - Cuts kids' food into fun-shaped bite-sized pieces . . . Great for picky eaters and bento!
review_body:
Once I got it in the mail, I quickly opened it up and my kids were interested at what the colorful products were. My daughter went right for the heart one. My son went for the green one. They were curious as to what they were for. When I made them peanut butter and jelly sandwiches, I started to show them how to use the FUNBITES product and then let them use it. It was fun and they were excited to see the pieces of the pb&j.

After the pieces were sorted out on their napkin, they were showing me the square and heart pieces and popping them into their mouths one by one. I've never seen them scarf a peanut butter and jelly sandwich that quickly before!

FUNBITES seem like a great way to get your kids to eat their food. They're in fun shapes and even bite-sized for toddlers (like my 17 month old) to use as finger foods, so instead of giving him a piece of bread to get crumbs all over the floor, I used the green square shape, and put the pieces on a small kid-friendly plate and he didn't make a mess. I really like this product and so do my children! They made remarks of how cute the little food pieces were, as was I.

It's fun, easy, portable (so you can take it anywhere) and just popping it in the dishwasher, cleanup is a breeze! I would totally recommend this to any mother in search of a fun way of doing breakfast or lunch for their children.

product_title: Leachco Cuddle-U Nursing Pillow Replacement Cover Green Bears
review_body: I haven't had to use it yet but will when I need to. It is great to have a washable cover.

product_title: Graco Nautilus Elite 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_headline: Good all around - instructions need to be clearer about how to use it with a seatbelt
review_body:
We bought this after returning a Britax Frontier 90 (because it doesn't have a "backless booster" mode, and the head protection is WAAAY too deep for comfort), and we kept it and like it. It's well designed and pretty easy to use and looks nice, and my tall near-4yo likes it. My only gripe is that I spent a bunch of time trying to figure out why I couldn't get the seatbelt attachment to hold it stable - until I finally found the one note on one page of the instructions that says you're only supposed to clamp one side of the seatbelt, not both. (My instinct was to clamp both, based on the design and the diagrams.)

I'm very good at reading instructions - I'd sat down at the kitchen table and read through them front-to-back before I even attempted to start putting this in. So it's pretty easy to miss this one note - and if I hadn't kept going back at it, sure that something was wrong, I'd be driving around with a very loose car seat today. So, I took off one star for that.

product_title: Baby Buddy 2 Pack Secure-A-Toy
review_body: Great quality item and price for something that helps immensely with keeping the snack cups on the stroller and car seat. Just snaps on and we are ready to go! No more snack cups falling on the ground.

product_title: Nuk Clear Silicone Replacement Soft Spouts
review_body: wonderful I had three cups that all spouts were worn out so this is a true blessing to have three in a pack

product_title: ChooMee Sipn Food Pouch Toppers | 100% Silicone | Prevent spills and Cushion mouth | 2CT - Orange Aqua
review_body: Received these a few days ago and they're really well made.  The silicone reminds me of Soothie pacifiers.  The colors and texture was well received by the little ones.  The valve is the big feature and so far has worked as advertised.  I don't get how such thick substances can be sucked thru a straw with a valve, but I tried it on an applesauce and sure enough it comes through really easy.  I then threw it on the floor and nothing came out.  Not sure how many uses and washes these can handle, but a few washes haven't had any effect on the product, and I expect by the quality of material they'll last awhile.  The strap is very handy for taking it on the go.  Highly recommended.

product_title: Fisher-Price Luv U Zoo Jumperoo
review_headline: Like it but has some weird features
review_body:
I will start out by saying that I do like this jumperoo and it does work just fine. We have the rain forest jumperoo (also made by Fisher-Price) so I tend to compare this one to that one. So first off my son is 6 months old and we got this when he was six months old.... but on the lowest setting his feet do not touch the ground!!!! He is in the 75% for hight so he is even taller then most boys his age and his feet still don't touch the ground. We rigged zip ties to make it low enough. Now the rain forest jumperoo we have been using since he was 3 months old and his feet touch just fine.
The second thing that is werid is the leg holes are small! He does have chunky thighs but again the other jumperoo we own his legs fit great in it. I honestly don't know how much longer his legs will fit in there.
Third, the toys are only so so. They work, but are just kinda blah.
So I would say for the price, it works. Be ready to rig it or use a book under your babys feet, but it totally works. If you are willing to spend a little more money, get the rain forest jumperoo.

product_title: Naturepedic 2 in 1 Organic Cotton Ultra/Quilted Mattress
review_body:
I'm glad I paid the extra money for a quality organic mattress. With everything they put into mattresses these days it was important for me to find an organic mattress at a price I could handle. This was really the top of our budget but the mattress has definitely delivered.

There was no strange smell when we opened it and it is quite comfortable as I have slept with my toddler on it. I love that it has a water resistant side that is food grade for when he is out of diapers and potty training. He seems to really enjoy his sleep and I can rest knowing it is high quality with no chemical off gassing. My husband agreed that it seemed very sturdy and will stand the test of time.

It is quite firm, but as it should be for a child I suspect. In the future you can always add a topper. It came beautifully packaged way ahead of schedule. Amazon's prices, service, and selection really can't be beat. I will be investing in another one of these, if they are still sold by amazon once my 2nd child is out of the crib (still inutero haha).

product_title: Munchkin Silly Sandwich Cutter Set, 3 count
review_body: Just received through Amazon Prime (gotta love that immediate gratification).  Was happily surprised to get all three.  Based on the reviews, I was a little worried.  These cutters are well made, heavy plastic that look like they will stand up to years of use and dishwashing.  Shapes make eating lunch definitely more fun.

product_title: Aottop Strollers & Accessories
review_headline: Permanent addition to our UppaBaby Vista
review_body:
I inexplicably owned the Vista for two years before buying this and I regret waiting for so long. It fits, it folds, it keeps drinks upright and it hides my keys & phone from my toddler. Awesome. I also like the inner zipped pouch to stash parking structure tickets.

I read that there was some concern that the actual cup holders are soft and don't provide enough support, but I've found that those cardboard sleeves from any coffee shop hold the cup holder up (and open) quite nicely.

One thing to know if you're using this with the Vista, if you don't extend the handle then the Diono Buddy will get in the way when you recline the seat (when the seat is in the forward facing direction). Since my husband and I are both tall, we extend the handle so it's never been an issue for us.

product_title: Taggies Tag N Go Cart Cover
review_body: Great seat cover- fits restaurant high chairs and grocery carts. Built in seat buckles come in handy. Material is plush and easily washable.

product_title: Little Bamboo - Baby Muslin Swaddle Blankets, 3 Pack
review_body: I use these for everything from blankets, swaddle wrap to burp cloth and bips.  easy to clean and soft fabric on my baby's skin.

product_title: Jp Lizzy Black Licorice Day Tote
review_headline: Cute, but not perfect for my needs
review_body: I love the look of this diaper bag!  Super cute and easy to clean.  However, the top does not zip closed so I felt quite nervous when I'd bend down to pick up baby or get into the stroller that my stuff was going to fall out of the bag.  Also, the size is a little small for my needs I have 3 children all really young in age and I just can't fit very much into this bag.  If this is your first child and you are not an over-packer like I am then that may not be a problem.  Overall, cute but not quite as functional as I'd hoped.

product_title: Regalo Extra WideSpan Walk Through Safety Gate
review_body: Just what I wanted in a wide opening gate.  Easy to use for adults yet secure for children and the dog

product_title: Skip Hop Duo Essential Diaper Bag, Teal (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Very durable material. It will last through several babies! Plenty of room, unless you pack the kitchen sink ;)
I would definitely recommend this bag.

product_title: Maclaren Quest Sport Stroller, Charcoal/Mocha Bisque (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Lightweight
Various inclinations: baby can sleep
Easy to fold, to hold and to use
High quality material
Big basket under
Raincover is included compared to other brands (has to be bought separately)

product_title: Hiccapop Safe Sleeper Convertible Crib Bed Rail for Toddler with Reinforced Anchor Safety
review_body:
My wife bought this because I had read so many good reviews about it. We love Amazon Prime, and the 2 day shipping is always great. When putting it together, the instructions are helpful, but it's actually easy enough that I stopped using them less than halfway through.

Installation onto the crib was another story. It's not hard to figure out how it works. It is nearly impossible to actually fasten the clamps on the bed frame. I have minor arthritis in one hand, so it took me more than 30 minutes just to do that. And my hands are really hurting. L

Also, now that it's finally installed, it seems a bit wobbly. The first time we put our daughter in her bed, she grabbed it and started moving it back and forth. If this product is supposed to be a safety rail, why is it so easy to move it like that?

In summary:
a) Easy to put together
b) Hard to install on crib
c) Slightly unstable

I would probably look elsewhere if I needed another toddler bed safety rail.

product_title: Baby Buddy Size-It Children/Baby Hanging Closet Organizer Dividers
review_body:
I bought some in pink and in blue. I think the concept of these are great and it just depends on the size of you closet pole if it will actually work the way you would want it to. Sometimes the poles are thicker or thinner and if you have the thicker ones this will either work or just wont. So keep that in mind if you are looking at these. If your pole is thinner you might have a problem with them being all over the place and not staying were they are intended or flipping.

This is ideal for any mom or moms to be and really helps dads out there that have no idea what size there kids are in. Especially if you are one of those parents who tend to purchase or receive clothing items in a variety of sizes. This helps keep them organized better and easy to tell apart from the small or bigger ones.

product_title: Mossworld Enterprises New Stainless Steel Snack Trap, Brushed Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This item is a must-have for the family like me who is trying to get away from plastics. Some reviewers have mentioned that the triangular parts of the lid where the child puts their hand is a bit pointy and sharp. At first, one of my kids mentioned this, unprompted, but it hasn't seemed to deter any of my 3 younger kids from using it, so either it wasn't that bad, or they got used to it. In any case, for me this wasn't a deal-breaker. I still love the cup and envision my kids using it for snacks without the lid even when they get older (my younger ones are currently 1, 2&1/2, and 5). My 11-yr-old still uses snack cups (without lids). Great product!

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_body:
Although this product is said to be a one stop shop for keeping track of all baby details, I wish I wouldn't have purchased the item. The instructions on the item aren't that clear and the item is limited.

I decided to purchase an app from the Google Play store that was cheaper than this and provides more features than this. The app could also be synced between multiple users, so my husband is able to check his phone while he's at work to see how our son is doing. The app I purchased also helps me keep track of pumping for breast feeding.

My suggestion: save yourself about $15 and purchase a phone app for $5 that provides more information and is more convenient.

product_title: C.R. Gibson My First Piggy Bank
review_body: cute little piggy bank, some rougher spots, but generally ok. the color is a light blue but looks faded in certain light

product_title: Dream On Me 3" Playard Mattress, White
review_body: Perfect fit for our Baby Trend pack n play. I look forward to using this as our bed side infant sleeping arrangement. Much softer than the hard cardboard mat that came with the pack n play and leaves no wiggle room between side and mattress.

product_title: ERGObaby Original Baby Carrier
review_body:
works great, strap is easy to use, unsnaps for easy open. I have not had it unsnap when I didn't want it too, which I was worried about at first.

The tag says only for babies over 7lbs, which for most people should not be an issue. After trying it with a slightly smaller baby I would definitely stick to the recommended size limit.

Only thing I don't like is I could not find it in matching colors for every baby carrier.

product_title: Cotton Tale Designs Hottsie Dottsie Mobile
review_body: Very well made and beautiful with the bedding set! On off music switch is nice too.  I am one happy mommy :)

product_title: HALO SleepSack SwaddleChange Diaper Pad Covers
review_body: I like the idea of the swaddle changer, but it really hasn't worked out for me in practice.  My little one was 6 lbs. 6 oz and 18 inches when we brought her home, but she wasn't long enough to have her arms swaddled and leave enough of her exposed to change her diaper as they show in the picture.  Hopefully when she gets a little larger she will fit better.  As this is the only covers that we have I will say that they are soft and they fit my larger contour changing pad with no problem.  Right now the swaddle part gets in the way and I have to keep tucking it around the sides of the changing pad.

product_title: Go Booster Inflatable & Portable Car Booster Seat for Children Age 4+ Weighing 40-80 Pounds
review_body:
This seat had the promise of being awesome for a round the world trip we took with our 6 year old. Light and compact, it's a great idea. However, it sprung a leak in the first week (in Brazil)(not a hole) near the valve, so we had to reinflate it every couple of hours. If we forgot, then I would look in the back seat and see our daughter all crumpled up in the back seat.

Without the leak, I would have given it 5 stars. I give it two, because you might get lucky and not get a lemon.

product_title: Delta Children City Street Side by Side Stroller, Black
review_body: I am 5'7 and the handles on this stroller are so short, my arms have to be completely straight down to touch them.

product_title: Baby Jogger Car Seat Adaptor, City Select/City Versa
review_body: Ok, so I bought my Baby Jogger dual stroller months ago in anticipation of having two under the age of 2 to cart around. This car seat adapter is so easy to use and install. I love it!!

product_title: BABYBJORN Potty Chair
review_body: This  helped potty train my granddaughter.  BabyBJorn has never disappointed.  The pink looks exactly as portrayed.  The product easy to clean.

product_title: Carter's Diaper Bag Set - Pink
review_body: Good quality, fast shipping, it is exactly like the picture. I recommend! The bag is really big, it has space for everything.

review_headline: Really Cute, and in great shape
review_body:
Some people have complained that the crib came with scratches - ours looked great! Haven't used it yet so I will come back to edit when the time comes. A couple of pointers that other people may find useful:

1) Doesn't rock with the wheels on. The wheels just pop in and out pretty easily with a good tug, so it's not terrible, but either you're mobile OR rocking.

2)The mattress height is adjustable but you do have to use the little allen wrench they give you. Pretty straightforward but not a click in/out thing like some cribs

3)Something to consider -- go ahead and order a new mattress when you order the crib. The one inch foam pad that came wiht it will be our dog's new bed :) But keep in mind the taller the mattress, the "shorter" the crib rails get. I got a 3" rather than 5" deep mattress for that reason.

product_title: Kalencom 2-in-1 Potette Plus
review_body:
I purchased the Potette Plus a few months ago to have something in the car for emergency potty situations. I used it for the first time today with my toddler - I don't normally write reviews but I can already tell I'm going to love having this in the car!
First of all - the fact that it is so compact and folds up into the bag is wonderful. I store it under the seat no problem. I put the bag on and was pleased to see the bag covers the seat so that there are no parts to clean up when done. It was sturdy enough for my almost three-year old to sit on, no problem and the absorbent material in the bag did the trick to keep everything in place... all I had to do was remove the bag, tie it up and throw it away!! :) I suppose it would be easy to make your own bags - but these are very convenient and fit the potty perfectly. My only issue with the potty is that the legs are a bit difficult to snap into/out of place. I pulled one of them off when trying to fold it back up (and if you don't snap them in when you're setting it up as a stand-alone potty you may get a tip-over!) All in all, I feel like the potty is amazing and the snapping issue is a small thing to deal with considering all the pros!! I will be using this a lot over the next couple years with my two little ones! Wish I had it when my oldest was training.

product_title: Graco FastAction Fold Classic Connect LX Stroller, Orlando (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This is our second stroller, I was looking for rugged and robust medium size stroller that can handle some strolling abuse as my wife was taking it to India where the side roads are not that great everywhere. I bought this after reviewing several strollers and returning some of them. This was for a toddler. The fold is really easy though not as easy as they advertised, cup holder, recliner, five point safety is all good. It will last for years as the frame etc seems to be well made.This was gate checked on the flight during our trip to India. Installation took ~20 mins, not hard

The cons that I found with it are -
1. Weight - It weight ~21 pounds, larger than many strollers in its category.
2. Compactness - After folding it is not very compact like umbrella strollers, fits the trunk of most car easily but again it takes more space than umbrella type fold strollers
3. Maneuverability - My wife says its not very maneuver especially during turns. In my view we have to get used to it as other stroller is more maneuverable

If you have big toddler and you want a compact stroller, I will recommend it to buy it over the cheaper ones.

The silicone is stained by the mangos, which is frustrating bc it looks dirty even when clean...but not a big deal. I think both should have a closed handle so a toy buddy can attach to high chair to avoid throw overs...but both minor and don't really affect the product.

These are great for a 6 month old +

product_title: Marvels One Size Diaper Cover
review_headline: love the double gussets in the leg

review_body:

review_body:

review_body: I really like this product overall! It's cute, it's easy to store, and you can use it for a long time!

product_title: WubbaNub Infant Pacifier - Giraffe
review_body: With my first child, we lost pacifiers like crazy.  I bought this for our daughter and it is the only pacifier we use.  It falls out of her mouth less and she likes to hold onto the beanie baby.

review_body: waste of money, did not work  at all. would not advise to buy this. threw it away. and had to wait so long to get item

product_title: South Shore Savannah Collection Changing Table
review_headline: Good quality and sturdy for the price!
review_body: My wife and I received this yesterday and we were very excited to put it together, especially  after reading all the reviews on the nightmares of construction, directions, and number of pieces. However, it does operate smooth and quietly. Im just concerned about the life limit of the drawers but only time will tell. Overall its sturdy and nicely painted, We went to a store and picked up some nicer knobs for the drawers. We are extremely happy with this item and even happier with the price!

product_title: Mud Pie Baby-girls Infant Puff Headband
review_body: This headband is soooo stinkin' cute! It fits my 10 month old baby girls head perfectly! It looks great with turquoise mud-pie bloomers!

product_title: Sassy Crib and Floor Mirror
review_body: Excellent developmental toy for babies.  Love the colors.  Mirror is clear and not distorted.  Great for tummy and floor time.

product_title: Bugaboo Organizer, Dark Grey
review_body:

product_title: eGear Mosquito Head Net

product_title: Twooth Timer Twooth Timer
review_body: My kids love the twooth timer and think it is fun.  They brush their teeth the whole time and that's great.  My kids are 13, 6, 3, and 3.

review_body: I accidentally ordered the wrong size, so pay attention to the sizing.  However, the style shied is perfect because it gives the baby's nose room to breath and be on the breast. review_body: Yes, it does tend to randomly spurt out liquid when you least expect it.  BUT, if your goal is to teach your kid to suck out of a straw, this is the cup for you. review_body: I cannot say enough good things about this baby monitor.  We purchased this monitor because the Sony monitor we received as a gift just wasn't cutting it. The monitors range is fantastic and you don't get all the interference noises and static.  I have recommended this monitor to friends and family and am getting it as a gift for my friend who is expecting! GREAT Monitor for a Great price!

product_title: Pacifier - Wubbanub Infant Plush Pacifier - Turtle
review_body: This is the perfect size.  It is not too big and not to small. Does fall out of crawling baby mouth but she just picks or back up

product_title: Skip Hop Zoo Toddler Kids Insulated Backpack Jules Giraffe, 12-inches, Multicolored
review_headline: Great preschool and lower age backpack
review_body: Good quality bag of decent size. It's bigger than the PB Kids preschool backpack which was too small in my opinion. It's nice to bring along filled with things my daughter needs for a day out (22 mo) and then I can just carry my regular purse.

product_title: Infantino Plenty Feature Packed Cart and Highchair Cover, Mosaic Stripe (Discontinued by Manufacturer)

product_title: green sprouts Water Bottle Cap Adapter Set, Clear (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is so hand to attached to a water bottle and it keeps the drink from being all over my grandson's clothes.  It is such a neat and handy idea.

product_title: Planet Wise Wet Diaper Tote Bag
review_body: I really like this wet bag. I use it for my diaper bag to store my sons cloth diapers. I've never had trouble with leaks & it does keep odor from escaping. It was smaller than I expected. The specs say it holds 2-3 cloth diapers but I use pocket diapers and there is no way it holds 3... Two if I squeeze. product_title: bestbottom Cloth Snap Diaper Shell
review_body: I bought this and 3 inserts at Once upon a Child (new) and I'm writing this review because I often rely on amazon reviews for everything. First of all, I want to point out I started cloth diapering because EVERY disposable leaked EBF poo out the back (top) of the diapers. I have used other cloth (no name ALVA-pocket, Charlie Banana-pocket, and real nappies- prefolds)and not run into this problem once, even on the first try. This diaper, I am sad to report, leaks exactly like the disposables. I have not had a urine leak but it just cannot handle EBF baby poop. My next complaint is the size. I paid nearly $30 for a diaper that won't do its job AND won't last as long as advertised. I have a normal sized 5 month old (about 18lbs or so) and I'll be lucky if these guys last a month longer. He's been on the last snap since day one and they leave pretty harsh lines on his thighs. Keep in mind I use Charlie Bananas which people often complain about running small so you can imagine. Overall, great for newborns and young infants, beyond that, don't waste your time or money. If you exclusively breast-feed, this most likely isn't your diaper either.

review_body: We have iphones and ipads etc and wanted a video monitor that was compatible. It was incredibly easy to install and sync to our devices, there is maybe a 2 second delay but that's it and we have had great luck with uninterrupted signals.  The regular babyping app is free. product_title: VTech Communications Safe andSound Digital Audio Monitor
review_body:
The monitor did an excellent job picking up the sounds from our baby's room for the 1 week it worked.

Battery Issues
Plugged this in the day after our baby was born and charged the parent unit for around 8 hours. A couple of days later we set up the unit while our newborn took a nap and the battery was almost dead. Not sure how that happened as we did not use the at all in the 2 days between the charge and first use. After charging for a few hours I removed it from the cable and it did report a full charge. Used this 2 times after for a total of 3 hours and the parent unit reported a depleted battery each time. The battery appears to drain when not in use. This would be fine if it was over the course of a few days but it drains over night.

Link Issues
On the 3rd use the unit would not link. We turned off both units and left them off for ~5 minutes and when we turned them back on they started working again. After 30 minutes the parent unit started beeping reporting that it had lost the link. We reset both sides and they connected again. On the 4th use it would not connect at all with the reset not helping.

Overall very disappointed. This unit gets good reviews at the price but it seems its hit or miss on quality.

review_body: Purchased for our new grandson and his parents who are runners just LOVE it-pushes well.  Lays flat for smaller baby and seat can be adjusted as child grows.  Excellent stroller for mom, dad, and baby.

product_title: Summer Infant Deluxe Comfort Booster

product_title: My Brest Friend Original Pillow
review_body:
When I got pregnant I was told I had to get a My Brestfriend, I registered for it but never received it. Since a cousin gave me her boppy I thought I would be fine. I was wrong. I found the boppy to move around too much, and not fit my medium sized frame as there was often a large gap between my body and the front of the pillow leaving a big gap where my baby needed to lay. I also began to have back pain after the long hours of nursing and rocking her to sleep in my bed.
I finally thought I needed a new solution for breastfeeding in bed. I looked at different back support pillows and finally decided I should invest in the My Brestfriend. I soon realized I made the right choice.
The My My Brestfriend is amazing. All the issues with Boppy are resolved by the My Brestfriend. I was able to adjust the My Brestfriend to come up against my stomach which gave my baby a surface to lay on! No gap!! No constant readjusting. The adjustable strap also made sure that I could nurse comfortably for 40 minutes at a time without having to readjust. In the early days of life with a baby this was a life-saver. The adjustable strap also allows you to keep the My Brestfriend on if you stand up or move to another room.
I also appreciated the pouch. In the beginning I was often thirsty with chapped lips. The pouch was just big enough for me to keep a water bottle and chapstick. Before the My Brestfriend I would be stuck under a baby with chapped lips, with the My Brestfriend I was always able to have my chapstick with me, no matter what room I was in in the house.
You can also take the cover off and wash it when your baby spits up on it, which will happen!
All in all, the My Brestfriend is the best thing on the market. The only regret I have about the My Bresfriend is not getting it earlier.

product_title: Motorola Remote Wireless Video Baby Monitor withColor LCD Screen
review_body:
This is the third monitor I have bought, and I can finally say I am finished with my monitor search. I originally thought I would not buy a baby monitor with video, but once we moved my daughter into her own room... I wanted the video. :-)

We tried the Drop Cam, which was very easy to set up, and had a wifi connection. Unfortunately the delay on the feed could be up to a minute or more. Plus there was only two way sound which meant when you hear your baby she/he hears you too...

So after a ton of research, I decided to go up in price and get the Motorla MBP36. We are so happy with this monitor.

Here is the overview:
The camera - Has clear a picture and the monitor is a perfect size. One thing I like is you can turn the camera portion on and off on the monitor, which is good for sleeping. The camera has a day mode, which is color and a night vision mode. The night vision mode is great! I can see clearly enough to watch my daughter breath, and I can hear her breathe too. Which brings me to the sound features.

Sound Features: You can set the volume on the sound to whatever level you like, and I can hear everything that is happening in and around my daughters room (I love that I can hear my daughter breathe), so the mic is powerful & picks up a lot! Also - you can press a button to talk through the monitor and soothe you little one as well. There are a bunch of lullabies, which we never use but they are there and you can trigger them to play from the monitor.

Pan/Tilt: We love that we can remotely operate the camera to focus in on wherever my daughter is in her crib. I love this feature and see it being very useful as my daughter becomes a toddler and is playing in her room. Totally worth the extra $50

The monitor in general is very easy to use and to control everything. It displays the temperature in my daughter's room, which I love. Some other reviews said it would be nice if it had a clock and I agree with that.

Overall the monitor is awesome and we are so happy we got it!gree with that.

Overall the monitor is awesome and we are so happy we got it!

product_title: Spectra 9 Advanced Double Electric Breast Pump with Tote! 2 Phase Cycling! Rechargeable Battery!
review_body:
Honestly, I don't really review my amazon purchases much, but felt the need to review this product. My only prior experience with pumps have been with the Medela pump in style (second hand) and an evenflo manual breast pump. The Medela worked well for me initially when pumping for my first daughter, but after 1-2 months, felt that I was not expressing as much as I could. Looking back, it probably was the motor losing its steam. It had served my cousin with her two boys before coming to me. I am sure a brand new Medela would have been just as efficient as the Spectra 9.

I just have to say I have been more than pleased with my Spectra 9 for the past 3-4 months. Not as little as I thought it would be....about 5.5"x2.5", but very light in comparison to the medela pump in style I used to have. I love that I can charge it at the beginning of the week, and the charge will last me for more than a week (pumping on avg 1-3 times a day about 15-20min per session). Tote that comes with the bag is great to use...with pump, flanges, bottles, and cooler bag there is still plenty of room in there for me to use this as my complete work bag. As far as noise, to me it is the same as the medela and my husband doesn't seem to wake up if I use it next to him in the middle of the night. However, it seems louder when I am at work, but it is probably because I get a little self conscious.....

Another plus is that I can use my old medela bottes with the pump. The do not line up to screw into the flange portion completely, but can be screwed on enough that you can pump without worrying it will fall off if you accidentally bump it. I also have been using the microwaveable medela sterilizing bags for the bottles and nipples and have not had an issue.

Con: the silicone massager inserts for the flanges did not fit, so have not been able to use them. Not that I am terribly upset by this at all.

Overall, for the price and accessories that come with it, it is a great pump for my needs. I cannot speak about their customer service since it has been working well, and I hope to not have to!

product_title: Motorola Blink1 Wi-Fi Video Camera for Remote Viewing with iPhone and Android Smartphones and Tablets
review_headline: Good for in-home viewing, poor color
review_body:
I was wondering how the Motorola Blink1 would stack up to my Panasonic PTZ cameras. I was especially interested in this camera for the low-light viewing. It was originally described as a 'baby monitor' camera; I have noticed that they have changed the positioning/marketing for this camera for remote viewing with an iPhone or iPad or Android versus a dedicated baby monitor.

Well, when you're in the house and on the same wi-fi network, it works fine. The free app is easy to use. No worries. The video quality is fair...not earth-shattering. I had no issues with set-up...it took just a couple of minutes. The sound capture is good (along with alerts); I have always had issues with the Panasonic cameras via Apple devices; I could never get the sound to work on anything but a Windows device.

Where this camera falters is the remote access and the color quality. I couldn't get it to work, and the documentation is completely useless in troubleshooting. So, if you are in the house and want to view another room (ala baby monitor), it's fine. Otherwise, it's useless.

The color quality leaves a lot to be desired. There is a red tint to everything, similar to an old polaroid picture that has faded. The image quality is nowhere near as good as my Panasonic BL-C210. With the cost of this camera, I'd go with a Foscam for less money and similar features. This camera is pricey and not very good.

***UPDATE October 2013***
Since the latest firmware update on the camera, I was able to get remote access working on my mobile device (iPad, iPhone) using the Monitor Everywhere software and my Verizon Wireless cellular data.

The sound is a bit distorted, but I can clearly tell if my son is chatting, crying, has hit his head, thrown his paci on the floor, etc.  The video is great!  I'm not expecting HD or retina display, but whether my son's room is pitch black or the lights are on, I'm able to see him clearly.  Tonight he fell asleep on his tummy, which he rarely does, and I can clearly see that his head is turned and that nothing is obstructing his face.  I read some of the negative reviews and I am confused... we have WiFi internet and we have zero issues.  Also the monitor is simple to use and settings are simple to adjust.  We don't use the sleep mode; we just keep the brightness on the lowest setting and keep it facing the wall.  The low level of white noise we hear from keeping the monitor on is negligible.  We have had the monitor for 8 months now and it has worked perfectly for us, even though I've knocked it off my tiny night stand in my sleepy clumsiness many times.  I'm so glad we didn't spend more money on a fancy monitor with loads of features we didn't need.

product_title: Britax B-Ready Bassinet
review_body:
Just like other reviews had mentioned the particle board used in this bassinet has a strong smell probably due to types of glues used to create the board.

So we made sure to purchase it before our baby was born take it apart to expose the board and set it outside in the direct sun to let it air out and to use the heat to accelerate off-gassing.

The bassinet fits into B-agile stroller with no problem and uses the same click-lock connection as the car seat would. It is a bit finicky to remove the existing B-agile seat and you'll have to remove and reattach the strap that is used to pull the stroller into folded configuration. Britax could have easily used a ring on the ends to allow this to be done easily but for whatever reason they decided to officially restrict the bassinet option to the other stroller and thus apparently had no reason to make the seat super easy to remove.

The material quality is top-notch (apart from the board), but some design choices are questionable such as the bassinet cover that requires you to press a button on each side to fold. (apparently the engineers thought that everyone has a third hand that would be used for this purpose). However the covers provide a very good protection against elements and can be folded and removed if not needed.

The mattress is nice quality with reasonable thickness and pretty much had no smell, however it is made of a porous foam and thus it is not waterproof. On the other hand it can be washed if desired.

product_title: Samsung SEW-3037W SafeVIEW Baby Monitoring System IR Night Vision PTZ 3.5 Inch.
review_headline: Goes Out of Range, Stopped Working after a month
review_body:
Summary : I rarely write amazon reviews, and I buy from there almost daily, so this carries some weight.

1 star for the product, 5 stars from Amazon Customer Service !

Too many hassles for the price.
-Went out of range very often in a medium size apartment
- In one instance, it went out of range, but the picture was frozen which could be a dangerous situation.
-Volume (Sound) stopped working first. Then, the tilt and swivel stopped responding.
-Finally, the camera got delinked, and now I cannot pair it back. Its a piece of junk now.

** UPDATE ** Amazon contacted me and offered a full refund for the product. 5 Stars to amazon ! I have since bought a dropcam from amazon, and it works really well.

Pros :
- Good infrared camera for night vision.

Cons :
- Goes out of range easily. We are talking about 50ft or less.
- Erratic behavior (see above)
- Poor picture and color quality.
- Starting jingle is annoying especially when you have spent the past 1 hr putting the baby to sleep.
- Menu options are not the greatest.
- Ok button also turns the light on
- Volume stopped working.
Given the high quality of webcams available, Samsung has designed a really poor baby monitor. Ive been a big fan of samsung products, so highly disappointed.

product_title: Take-Out Time-Out The Portable Time Out Mat
review_body: First off I have to laugh after reading several of the other reviews. It is not hazardous to begin with as one reviewer stated. I mean yea any object on the floor has the possibility of being tripped over. I also read reviews where the rated it poorly because the child was getting off it or moving it... what I have to say to this is that isn't that mat it's the parenting. You need to take your child put them on time out and in the process teach them to sit properly on time out. The mat isn't magic. It doesn't boast an invisible force-field that will stop a child from moving. It is simply a mat that is meant to help with time outs. Giving time out a special place and providing more consistency for a child. This mat works quite well. The bottom holds it from slipping around which is great. I love that I can take it where-ever we go. My daughter is 3 and we also got time tracker tags with this and we simply are able to say "Grab your timer and sit on time out" and she does just that. Paired with a timer this is an amazing product. My husband was very inconsistent with time outs simply because he didn't know what to do. I would recommend this for any parent, daycare or classroom. In fact I have recommended it to my friend who runs a day care as well as my kids' teachers. Like I said though this takes you being involved in the time out to work. You have to set the child on time out and you have to teach them to stay there. If you aren't involved in the discipline and education no teaching/parenting aids are going to work.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: I always wanted one of these ever since I saw it on 3 men and a baby but they were expensive. I finally bit the bullet when my 6mo old started getting two teeth at once. The packaging is really cute and would make for a great baby gift. My baby loves to chew on it. The squeakier inside that drives my dog crazy. We have found it in the dog bed a few times and just ran it through the dish washer.

product_title: Bamboobies Ultra Soft and Thin Washable Nursing Pads, Wrinkle Free, Reusable
review_body: I LOVE LOVE LOVE my bamboobies! I have 3 different brands of washable breast pads and these are the only ones that are actually leak proof. The cotton ones I have do not have a liquid block layer so it is no different than me wearing a padded bra. The bamboobies do not leak unless they are too full. This is how a pad should be! You wouldn't put a prefold diaper on a baby without a cover right? I also love how soft they are and how cute the heart shape is. They even get softer after the first few washes. The pink color does not allow them to show through a bra also so they do not show when you are wearing a light colored shirt or dress. I highly recommend these to all nursing mothers!

product_title: Philips Avent Natural Polypropylene Bottle, 4 Ounce
review_body: These are the main bottles we use. The original avent bottles leaked so bad that i was skeptical about the natural bottles but I fell in love with these. These worked well with Switching between bottle and breastfeeding. They're easy for my 7 month old to hold himself too.

product_title: Zoli Baby Bot XL Straw Sippy Cup 9 oz - 2 Pack, Pink/Pink
review_body: I love the flip-lid design and weight straw. The former helped contain spills and keep the straw sanitary, and the latter helped my baby girl drink until she learned to hold the cup down instead of tipping back like her earlier sippy cups. My only issue is that as the liquid inside warms to room temperature, the increased pressure inside causes capillary action, which for all you non-science types means the liquid crawls up the straw and starts dripping out. Not an issue if the lid is flipped closed, but you can get quite a mess if you forget to do so. Also, the silicon straws are very flexible but didn't stand up well to my child chewing on them while teething, but that might be asking a bit much of a straw.

I love how crinkly it is. This book is lightweight and would be easy to add to a diaper bag. I like the flaps on each page. It's colorful and the animals are drawn in a away that would keep an adult interested.

product_title: líllébaby® COMPLETE Baby Carrier Original - Black/Black
review_body: I've waited a few months to write this review, so I could give an accurate take on it.  I did a lot of research before buying a carrier and had it narrowed down to this one and the Beco Gemini.  I wanted the option to face out and these were the two that offered that.  I'm really glad I went with this one, mainly because of all the little features that make it so comfortable.  Everything is padded, including the back/chest strap.  The back/chest strap can also be moved up and down the shoulder straps, so you can easily reach it when it's behind you.  That is a huge plus for me.  All of the leftover hanging straps can be rolled up, so you don't have straps hanging all over the place.  It also washes well (I have the black original).  I also love the extra hood that can be attached to block the sun.  That was especially handy when my son was little and slept so much.  When I first got it, I could go hours wearing it and not feel anything.  Once my son got a little bigger (4 or 5 months), I started noticing more pressure on my shoulders.  Fortunately, I figured out I needed to tighten the waist belt to take some of that weight off.  I think it takes some getting used to, so you can figure out what makes it more comfortable for you and your baby.  It can get hot, but I think most of these buckle carriers are like that.  My main complaint is the lack of a pocket in the front.  That would make it almost perfect.  I keep looking for an attachment to hold my cell phone, keys, etc, but can't find one.  Another negative was when I first got this, the black color would rub off.  But, if it transferred to my clothes it wasn't much and it would come off in the wash.  I emailed the company and received prompt, friendly, and helpful replies, which says a lot in my opinion.  The person I emailed offered to exchange the carrier for another model, which I didn't want to do.  She also suggested washing it with a cup of vinegar to set the color.  I haven't done that, but it's an idea for anyone else having that problem.  I would still (and have) recommend this to anyone looking for a good buckle carrier.  It's comfortable and versatile!

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_headline: Manufacturing of New Version is Cheap
review_body: I had this exact gym with my daughter who is now four and a half. She loved it and I loved it - it was one of my favorite baby products. After lending it out to various friends and family, some of the toys were lost and the music/lights component stopped working. Now pregnant with my second child, I decided to order a new one since the old one was so great. This new gym arrived today and the first thing I noticed was that the stitching on the giraffe was coming undone and the stuffing was showing. I also noticed strings hanging off of several of the toys, which didn't look quite like I remembered them. Then I logged on to Amazon and read similar reviews from consumers who confirmed that the company had indeed changed and cheapened the product. The old version I used in 2008 was a five star product. This new 2013 version is cheaply made and should be avoided. I will return the defective product I received and purchase another brand. What a shame.

product_title: Clek Foonf 2013 Convertible Child Seat, Drift (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
(We bought this seat at Buy Buy Baby using a 20% off coupon from Bed Bath and Beyond)

After reading positive and negative reviews on several popular car seats, we decided on impulse to buy this one. The seat is impressively heavy and sturdy, and looks like it belongs in a NASCAR vehicle. After using it for 4 months (we are now buying a second seat for our other car and shopping around once again) I can say that although the seat's safety features are impressive, it falls short in the details:

The good:
-If you're reading reviews on this seat then you already know about the steel magnesium frame, and the ability to rear face your child much longer than most other seats. Definite plus, and for me, the selling features.
-Clek's customer service is great at answering any question you have in a timely manner.

The not-so-good:
-The seat really falls short in the details: strap covers are tiny and slide around a lot, the groin strap is short and too close to the back of the seat, and the seat lacks any type of padding. Now, sure, you can go out and purchase strap covers at Target for $9.99 but you shouldn't have to when you're buying the most expensive car seat on the market. You wouldn't expect to buy a Lexus only to go to Best Buy and have to buy a CD player for it because it only came with a cassette player.

Groin strap: I'm surprised a lot of reviews aren't mentioning this, but the strap is both short and too close to the back of the seat. There is a second slot which we are using (our toddler is 18 months old, 31 inches tall, and weighs 24 pounds), but I can't imagine using the seat when she gets much bigger because the clip sits really low and the strap buckles press into her thighs. I contacted Clek about buying a longer strap, and as of July 2013 they don't have one available (but did say they will have one available for purchase sometime in the future). There is a cloth/foamy cover which is supposed to insulate the child's legs from the buckles -you can see it in the picture- but it moves around and is an annoyance to adjust. Again, it's a slight ding against the seat's overall rating.
Padding: We often travel from Los Angeles to Las Vegas, and I honestly can't imagine our child sitting in this seat for more than an hour or two because it doesn't have any padding. I know lots of other seats don't either, but several do, so if you're looking to use this seat on longer drives I would advise you to go and look at it in person and compare the foam padding to other seats.
Head hang: After sitting in the back seat with our toddler I noticed that her head falls forward when she's asleep. The seat is reclined as far as it can, but one of the features of the seat is that it sits up higher so the head hang is inevitable. Clek has a link on their Facebook page addressing this -it's a post written by a doctor who reassures us that babies are flexible so heads hanging in a weird way is really not unusual and not harmful at all. Fine, if you're driving on a smooth road. But where I drive there is lots of bopping up and down (occasional pothole, speed bump, driveway, etc) so her head REALLY bobbles around which worries me because then it's outside of the protective side wings and just looks unsafe.
Strap covers: The seat came with strap covers which are removable, but they are small and slide easily so you have to adjust them, tighten the straps, then adjust again, and then adjust once more. I think the strap covers are made of a rare platinum-diamond-gold material which costs $100,000 per square inch because they reeeeeallly tried hard to use as little fabric as possible to create a thing they can call \\"strap covers.\\" I guess adding another inch of fabric would have put them out of business..
Mnual: This is a common complaint, the manual is terrible. I think they spent all their money sewing up those tiny strap covers so when it was time to write the manual they went to their disgruntled intern who invested all of 30 minutes typing it up in word, printing out the pages, then mixing them up just for fun.

Summary: The seat's sturdiness and heft is impressive, but it's not padded, the groin strap is thong-like, and a sleeping toddler turns into a bobblehead. See the seat in person before you buy it, or make sure you can return it because you probably won't like all the details I pointed out.

******EDIT 7/11/2014
After using the seat for a year or so, I still stand by my so-so recommendation. Clek now has an option on their website to purchase a longer crotch strap, so that addresses one of my complaints. However, a new issue came up: We needed to adjust the shoulder straps and move them into a higher slot, and we needed to move the headrest up. The straps were very easy to adjust, so that's great. The problem we encountered was, when moving the headrest up it needs to \\"click\\" into a new position, sort of like the headrest in your car. The problem with our seat is that only one side clicks in, while the second side slides up and down. I have contacted Clek about this on their Facebook page and noticed that several other posters had the same issue. So heads up when buying a seat, check that the headrest locks in place firmly. I will update this review once the issue is resolved.
Oh, and to add - we have the seat installed rear-facing in a Nissan Versa hatchback and it fits very well into the middle seat, and still leaves room for two smallish passengers to sit in the back, and doesn't impede the front part of the car nor the rear window in any way. review_body:
Okay folks. We have put a man on the moon, created vaccinations to horrible diseases, and nearly perfected time travel. How come nearly every brand of door knob covers are from the dark ages?
These things are horrible for the following reasons:
1. If your child can reach it on the door knob (which is why you bought this in the first place) then they can pull it apart. The way the cover snaps together is so jenky, that with little effort my 2-year-old can bat at it once and it pops apart.
2) If your hands are lotioned up or wet, good luck being able to turn your door knob. You have to get your thumb and index finger (that pointing one) and squeeze between two small holes, and sometimes getting a grip is impossible. I have had temper tantrums trying to open the door with a slippery hand. Not my proudest moment(s).
In summation, these things are a necessary evil, but if you find a product that has rubbery grips that you squeeze and those rubbery pads grip the actual handle and turn it instead of your hand... Yes, buy those. Parents Magazine make some, but they don't sell them on Amazon. Good luck!

review_headline: So Good That I Bought a Second Set of 8
review_body:
My wife and I have a 4-year-old boy and 2-year-old twin girls. Can you say prescription for pinched fingers?!? Yes, the doors are swinging and slamming constantly in our house, and yes, there have been finger pinches. When it became about hopeless to control the chaos and anxiety caused by doors constantly opening and closing in the faces of the kids, I went shopping at my favorite store--Amazon, of course.

Eight of these for a dirt cheap price seemed to fit the \\"too good to be true\\" principle, but I was willing to give them a try, given the great reviews I read. After using them on our doors at home, I was so pleased that I didn't waste any time ordering a second set of 8.

There is only one bit of advice I would give to anybody who buys these. Do NOT think that one of them is sufficient on a door. As in the pictures with the product listing on Amazon, this product provides the best protection when you use 2-3 of them spaced a few inches apart on the edge of your door. This way, you are not relying on just one of them, which could give way under sufficient pressure, leading to pinches. By using 2-3 spaced apart on our doors, we have not had a single product failure yet. Remember, our doors are swinging constantly!

One of the complaints I read about these from some reviewers has to do with the fact that there is nowhere to put them when they are not on the edge of the door. I agree with this minor concern, but I have taken it upon myself to find a solution. A simple loop of string secured to a door with tape or other adhesive material will work as a lasso, even without having the loop tight. Just hang the door stoppers through the loop, and they will stay fine. I made the loop big enough to easily hold 3 door stoppers together with some extra room to make hanging them easy.misplacing these door stoppers or allowing them to become chew toys for your kids or pets.

product_title: Safety 1st Go Hybrid Convertible Booster, Waterloo
review_body:
This is an ideal carseat for travel. We live in NYC and don't own a car so portability is a top priority. We use public transit but need carseats for cabs, zipcar, and when we travel. We've had ours for a while and have taken two longer road trips, cab rides, zipcar, visits to family with it. It is perfectly suited for all of these!

Pros:
-5 point harness - this was essential since we got this when my daughter was 3 since I didn't want to travel with two convertible seats, but wouldn't have been comfortable without a 5 point harness. It seems very secure.
-Small! It's very lightweight and easy to fold up and carry in provided bag.
-Comfortable - no complaints from my daughter!
-Quick install - VERY important for taxis. We have used both the LATCH and seatbelts with this seat without an issue. Attaching the tether is usually very easy.

Cons:
-Requires top tether, so might be an issue for older cars or international travel. Some cars we've been in have difficult to access top tethers that require a bit of work to find or get installed (sometimes they are on the floor behind the seat). Not really a fault of the seat but it can be annoying when we need to dig around in the back to get it put in. That said, we have yet to find a car that actually doesn't have a tether anchor.
-It's a booster so no recline means it's not great with a sleeping kid. My daughter's head tends to go forward if she falls asleep.
-Since it's low the view isn't great for a younger kid (3-4) but I think by 5 it won't be an issue

Overall I'm VERY happy with this seat. Since we don't drive much the cons aren't a major issue and the convenience and safety outweigh them. We're also travelling with a convertible seat for my younger child and this is so much easier to deal with. We will be buying him one when he's a little older. Travelling will be so much easier!

review_headline: Support is lacking for bassinet portion
review_body: This Pack N Play was delivered as promised.  It is compact and stores easily.  Set up is a breeze.  I ordered the fitted sheets with it which are awesome. However when my grandson is put on his side in the bassinet, the bottom sags in the middle portion, and his spine is not kept straight.  He did not seem comfortable when placed in this to sleep.  I ordered this as our daughter ended up having to have a C-section, and was not to bend clear over to get baby out of his crib.  Did not end up using the bassinet for this reason.  I am hoping the playpen part (bassinet portion would be at the bottom of Playard, not suspended up higher in the bassinet position) will be sturdier to be used when he is a few months older.

product_title: The UMMY: BPA-free 100% Natural Rubber Pacifier with Round Nipple, 3-6 Months
review_headline: Yes! Finally a pacifier she likes! Great product!
review_body: Compared to other pacifiers this one looks HUGE! But an ideal breast nipple should fill the babies whole mouth when nursing and it is nowhere near that size. Anyway--my baby has a small cleft in her soft palate and would not take any pacifier. I had tried everything--organic,simple, hospital, soothie, nuk...the list is long. The nipples on her bottle are large because they are for cleft palates and I think she didn't know what to do with a smaller pacifier--the UMMY is still a little smaller but she loves it! I was about to give up on finding a pacifier but she will comfort nurse on a bottle (not eating just softly nursing) for hours and its hard to hold a bottle for hours or all night. She took to the UMMY right away and can now nap of sleep for longer periods of time which is nice for both of us. Like another reviewer said--each baby is different and you have to find the right pacifier for him or her or not at all if you want. BUT I would definitely recommend trying the UMMY.

product_title: Graco Blossom 4-In-1 Seating System
review_body: Excellent seating, didn't realize one chair could change into so many different uses. This product will definitely get used a lot as soon as the baby arrives

product_title: Spectra Baby USA Dew 350 Advanced Double Electric Hospital Grade Breast Pump With Tote!
review_body:
I seriously love this Pump! I've struggled with pumping since my daughter was born, she was born 3 months early so I've been exclusively pumping from the beginning. I started off using the Medela Symphony but I never really felt like it emptied me. I was always able to hand express quite a bit after 45 minutes to an hour of pumping. After 3 months of this I was on the verge of quitting. After researching Spectra pumps I decided to contact them as this was my last resort, I felt that if their pumps didn't work for me then I would have no other choice but to quit. I contacted the amazing Spectra customer service and they recommended the Dew 350. I had to use it 3 times before I really got the full benefits of it but now there is no looking back! This pump empties me in 30 minutes or less and I know I'm empty because I cannot hand express anymore milk. I know that I can continue to pump and provide my sweet angel the milk she needs for months to come!
The Dew 350 has a strong, smooth pulling action that really works for me. It's a basic pump with a dial you turn from min to max. I typically start off on min for a couple of minutes and then work my way to max. My supply is slowing starting to increase as well, I couldn't be happier with this pump and I highly recommend this pump to anyone who needs the strength of a hospital grade pump. I do have to say that it is very strong which is what I need because I usually have a hard time getting a letdown but if you are sensitive you may want to look at the Spectra S2 which is also a great pump.
Tips:
I do not use the collection kit and shields that come with the pump. I pump into my regular bottles and I use the connectors and valves that I was using with the symphony along with my pumpin pals. To me that wasn't a big deal because the strength of the pump was all that I cared about. :)

product_title: Fisher-Price Rock n' Play Sleeper, Yellow
review_body: My daughter is four months old and still sleeps in this. It helps with reflux, and for the most part she has slept through the night since I started putting her in it I love this and will recommend it to all new momma's!

product_title: Table Edge Bumper Guard - By Thudguard - Protect Your Child's Head
review_headline: Extra thick padding - adjustable but double check table size
review_body:
I needed a non-stick bumper for my brand new Ethan Allen coffee table that was 64 inches square. I originally looked at the Safety 1st Table Edge Protector bumper ([[ASIN:B005XMCBDY B005XMCBDY]] but knew that my table was in between the small and medium size. I decided to try both the Thudguard Table Edge Bumper Guard and the Safety 1st Table Edge Protector to decide which one fit better, or to use both. I wound up double wrapping the table with both products and it works great! I first put on the Safety 1st medium protector and then wrapped the Table Edge Bumper Guard by Thudguard around the Safety 1st one. Together, they provide a lot of great padding and protection from my 1 year old who loves to pull himself up by grabbing onto the bumpers on the side of the table. I have NO worries anymore about him running into the corners of the sharp square table.

If your table is an off-size like mine, I'd recommend purchasing both bumpers and either using both, like I did, or trying each of them to see which fits best.

review_body: Expensive bottles don't mean better! My baby doesn't have any more spit up or colicky symptoms with these bottles than the more expensive (and harder to clean) bottles. As long as your baby will drink from the nipple, that's all that matters! And the price is right :)

He loves puzzles and I had been taking some in my purse in plastic Ziploc bags but was looking for something different for safety reasons.  These fit the bill perfectly.  Great for crayons too. review_body: The attached wheels, and their placement, was a very good idea and makes this a far better option than our previous car seat \\"tote\\" which was essentially an oversized bag. review_body: My baby loved a tight swaddle - something I could never do with a blanket.  This made it so easy, especially after middle of the night diaper changes.  It's very soft and easy to wash.  Makes so much sense!

review_body: Bought this for my 2 yr old son who loves Jake and the Neverland Pirates. However, the blanket is really great - not too heavy and not too thin.  The set washes really well though and comes out without any winkles, which is a definite plus. review_body:
We've got a number of prefold cloth diapers that we've used as burp cloths and general wipe up - they're way better than real burp cloths, and more absorbent. Picked up a pack of these Gerber brand tonight at Babies R Us - and they'll be going right back soon. They're horrible - thin as gauze, non absorbent, just terrible.

Were I using these as diapers, I'd be deathly afraid my child would leak everywhere. They can't hold anything, since they barely exist! Ugh.
