review_body: My baby can drop them, kick them without leak. Very usefully for our car trips. Our son has 1.3 years old and he knows now how to drink milk or water using this bottles.

product_title: Fisher-Price Newborn Rock 'n Play Sleeper, Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son is almost 4 months old and we have been using this rocker since the second night we were home from the hospital.  He has minor issues with reflux and the reclined position seems to help a lot.  I wish I would've known about this product with my two older daughters!  I also want to respond about the flat spots people are talking about.  My son, like I stated before, has used this rocker every single night since he was 3 days old and his head is as round as can be.  I've actually had numerous people comment on how \\"perfect\\" his head is shaped.  We ONLY use this for nighttime sleep, never at all during the day.  I don't know if that really makes a difference or not, but it gives an idea of how often he's in this rocker.  We'll soon be transitioning into his crib, as he is a big baby and will be outgrowing this soon, and I'm so sad about it!  I highly recommend this product!

product_title: Bumbo Toilet Trainer Potty Training Seat
review_body: We are potty training our 5 year old daughter who has severe cerebral palsy. She cannot sit up on her own so we have to provide support while using this seat. But it is more supportive than any other potty seat we've tried and our backs are thankful! We only need to have one hand on her torso vs. using both hands under her armpits, supporting all of her weight on a regular potty seat. We have a full support adaptive toilet seat at home, but this potty seat is good for on the go, or at friends' houses. I just hope she doesn't outgrow it too quickly! I'm not sure what we'll do when that time comes!

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Bath Center (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this for my niece and her parents love it and it is being put to good use. So far it has held up fine and is more than adequate for her. I am very pleased with this purchase and would buy it again for another baby shower.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, My Little Snugabunny (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
My daughter refused to sleep anywhere but this swing when she turned 4 months old. This swing was a life saver for us! She still naps in there and is always happy when she wakes up in the swing!

I love that this swing has a power adapter and that you can change the direction of the swinging (front to back, side to side, or diagonally).

The only thing I wish it did was play the \\"white noise\\" continuously. Other than that, it is a great swing!

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_headline: why didn't i buy this sooner?!
review_body: I bought this light for my 3 year old, autistic daughter. She already has a small seahorse that glows and plays music, but I was looking for more calming light for her at bedtime and this fits the bill! It's super cute to begin with, and she can turn it on, off, and decide which color (green, blue or orange) she wants and it throws a great star pattern on her ceiling. The orange is kind of a bust, it's not very bright at all, but in the dark it's enough. Her favorite is the blue. We were having some issues putting her to bed at night because she kept deciding she wasn't ready, but with this, she can go to bed and look at the stars and fall asleep. In the morning, she turns it on and babbles to herself while looking at them till we open her door to let her out. Definitely a great product, and my 4.5 year old wants one now too. I would definitely buy this again!

product_title: Britax Boulevard 65 TSIP Convertible Car Seat, Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body: I am totally sold and only buy Britax from now on. They are so solid and the safety ratings great. My son was comfortable in this for two years and i have just passed it along to my daughter, who is tiny at 10 months but looks so sturdy and comfortable in it as well. The fabric has held up to two years of snacks and toddler mess. All i did was vaccuum it and it still looks good as new. The rear facing installation is a bit awkward but once it's in its rock solid! not a seat for moving from car to car i think. I just bought the Frontier 85 for my three year old, just as comfy and solid. We've had many safe roadtrips with a sleeping toddler out of this seat !

product_title: Kinderglo Portable Fun and Safe Rechargeable Night Light, Elephant
review_body: We purchased this night light when my toddler was having a round of night frights.  Someone suggested a night light in his room, and we wanted one that he could hold on to, could chew on and it wouldn't hurt him, etc.  This was the perfect fit.  We got a lot of use out of it every night, and it helped immediately with the night frights and nightmares.  The downside is the light didn't last but about 10 months before the LED light inside started flickering, and certain colors quit working.  It now only turns red and green and goes dark when it's the other colors turns.  For the price I paid for it (it was an expensive night light), it should have lasted a lot longer than 10 months.  My 2 year old is not happy that it doesn't work right anymore, and is unhappy with the replacements from other brands.  But I'm leery to buy another one for that price if it's not going to last.

product_title: Puj Snug - Ultra Soft Spout Cover
review_body: This does the trick and my little one won't bump her head on it.  But I thought it was going to be a firmer material, maybe like rubber or something.  It isn't, it is a really flexible soft material, kinda of like the foam you use in crafts, very light weight.  But I guess it doesn't get moved at all so I am assuming it should hold up just fine.  It is cute though, so 4 stars.

product_title: Baby Buddy Bear Pacifier Holder
review_body: Other holders are tough to fasten onto kids or have a velcro fastening that is easily open. This one is great. Stays on place, keeps pacifier safe and lasts hundreds of  washes.

product_title: Lollacup - Good Green
review_body: Very lightweight and somewhat awkward with handles attached.  My grandson managed to leak milk with every use. When milk was in the straw it dripped out each time the cup was tipped. Not our favorite.

product_title: BABYBJORN BabySitter Balance
review_body: Greatest invention for young babies and their parents!  A safe place to put little ones when mom or dad needs to have hands free.  I bought this for oldest daughter's family since middle daughter's family was not done using theirs.  It is so portable and folds flat for greater ease.  Baby is able to make it move and bounce when he/she gets older

product_title: Britax Pavilion 70-G3 Convertible Car Seat Seat, Sophia (Prior Model)
review_body: This car seat is top of the line and the Sophia print is so pretty. I looked at a youtube video on how to install the seat and with the help of the video I had no trouble installing it quickly by myself. This chair is great and will last ages!

product_title: Bright Starts Baby's Play Place Deluxe
review_body:
My baby LOVED this play mat from the age of 4 weeks. He loves the mirror and krinkle elephant.
The added tummy pillow is good for a small baby, such as mine (who was only 5 lbs 5 oz at birth).
Added bonus, is that all the toys, including the mirror can be taken off and used in the car seat or stroller.
Well worth the money!

product_title: Protect-a-Bub Deluxe 3-in-1 Sunshade - Single - Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a great product. We use it almost daily on our walks and runs. It is great in the summer to keep the sun and bugs off of your baby and great in the winter to keep your little one a little sheltered from the cold wind. I guess my only negative about this product is when the shade is down, the baby can't really see out, but my little one doesn't seem to mind. I just put it down when she needs to be out of the sun, wind, etc and then lift it back up. You can affix this product in a couple of ways to your stroller, which is nice. We have an InStep Jogging Stroller and have not had an issue with the shade fitting on the stroller. We have been very happy with this product thus far.

product_title: Jeep Deluxe Changing Pad
review_body: Apparently Jeep has never changed a diaper.  You need to open/close these things with one hand.  Instead of velcro, they use a clip that you need two hands to open.  And there is no place for the A&D ointment.  The wipes holder is a little hard to deal with when the kid is on a changer in a public bathroom.  You tend to have the kid directly in front of you, so the supplies should be connected to the long side of the pad, not the short end.  It hangs off the side of the wall-mount changer thingy, not the front edge.  And it is pretty stiff, won't "swell" to hold a lot of diapers and wipes.  3 diapers max.

product_title: Evenflo Tribute LX Convertible Car Seat
review_body: We compared many convertible car seats for our second daughter who was too big for the first stage car seat.  This one looked to be a good option considering price and comfort and size. It fits well in the middle of the seat and seems to be cushioned plenty.  Sure you can spend much more to have one that looks bulky but plush but this one is well worth the cost.

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_body: As it is, this seat works very well, but please ignore the picture and/or aesthetics. Even though the color blocking is correct (it is pink and grey), there are large safety tags permanently emblazoned on the headrest, shoulder straps, and base. I called Graco directly and was told this was standard on all new car seats within the last 2 years due to a law congress past. I called them after buying 2 of these seats, then exchanging them for 2 more. All 4 I received in this manner were covered by these markings. Either it's d/t the obnoxius law, as I was told, or Amazon got a bad batch. Be aware of this before purchasing.

product_title: Graco Silhouette Pack 'N Play Playard with Bassinet and Changer, Rittenhouse (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I bought this mainly because of the pattern and because I have had good experiences with Graco in the past. This did not disappoint. The pattern is so beautiful in person, however the overly cream colored metal on this drives me crazy (I think because it looks so much more darker than the cream/off white in the fabric).
This is huge, but doesn't take up much more space than smaller ones. I love the bassinet, it is attached firmly and is pretty sturdy. We never used the changing table part, but in the first month or so we kept it on there because the only way to use the caddy is to have the bassinet attached. I never had this issue with my older Gracos. The vibration is a nice touch on this one.

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon Soft Natural Rubber Teether - Comes In Gift Boxes
review_headline: Fits in his hands and mouth well
review_body: Pretty cool teether, it has a good hold and the mushroom shape of the head guides the tipple in baby's mouth. Mine also loves to chew on the feet.

product_title: KidCo GoPod Portable Baby Activity Station
review_headline: Sharp edges, broken plastic covers.  no thanks!
review_body:
We ordered this thinking it would be a great seat for our boy camping and around the house (you know so you could sneak in a shower). It came and 3 of the 4 plastic sheaths on the legs were cracked and worse both cup holders/ place for toys had razor sharp edges. Crazy this passed any sort of inspection. would not recommend to anyone.

the other complaint most people seem to have is the seat sits very deep and this is true as well so for smaller torsoed babies may not really be an option anyway.

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_body:
We were looking for a video monitor to replace our old summer infant video monitor that doesn't support multi camera viewing. We have 3 kids now and we really want to keep an eye on all of them, primarily our 1 year old little boy. We use this mostly at night when we sleep having our monitor screen downstairs and the camera upstairs where they sleep. We really like how good the night vision is on this unit. We got everything around $260 and I don't think we can get anything better at this price range.

The volume falls a bit on the short side but we found that you can help boost the volume by placing this on a metal tray (we found one from our kitchen) and force the sound to be amplified by this home-made apparatus... it works and you can give it a try!

product_title: Infantino Activity Triangle
review_headline: Not the same as in pictures!
review_body:
This triangle is such a great idea! If only the \\"activities\\" were more varied and interesting. First of all it is not the same as in the pictures! The picture shows two tracks with beads on one end...but there is only one and it is angled badly, so the beads just slide to the center all the time. My baby has never touched these beads. Also, the puppy on the spinner on the opposite end is just a sticker, which has started peeling off. The beads in the rain sticks in the corners do not spiral down easily...they are all hung up with static. Also the large beads are assembled wrong with all the round beads together and all the other shapes together instead of mixed like in the pics. So the round beads are tight and have no space to move! Lastly, one of the spinning knobs is great, possible for a baby to spin, but the other one is difficult to move, requiring a kind of dexterity that a young baby just doesn't have (its a little difficult for me!). My baby is semi-interested in the thing as a whole. She likes to turn it around and to spin the green and pink flippers, and likes to shake it (although it is a bit big for her to pick up). But most of the activities either don't work properly or seem boring. I love the idea...but the execution leaves something to be desired.

Update: With reluctance I have to up my rating to 4 stars... (wish i could give 3.5). For some reason my baby actually likes this toy...the older she gets the more she plays with it! And her favourite side is the one with the spinning knobs...which I originally thought was too advanced for her. She is still pretty uninterested in the beads, but overall she likes it (although I still feel more or less ambivalent toward it!) But its her toy...so I guess if she likes it that's all that matters! :)

product_title: Britax B-Nimble Stroller
review_body: I got this stroller a month ago and I find it great!!! it is very comfortable, the perfect size for a light weight stroller!  My 2 year old sleeps in it very comfortable.  it is easy to fold and unfold, and it has a nice padded seat that can be removed for cleaning!  Also the great thing is that it has the possibility to put a Maxi Cosi Infant car seat!  I love the stroller, I have had three light weight strollers and this one by far is the best one!

product_title: Tiny Love Soothe 'n Groove Mobile
review_headline: Great variety, entertaining but missing one important option
review_body: This mobile is mostly excellent - great quality speakers and the animals are fun for my baby to watch.  The light is bright enough to see what's going on but not too bright to turn on at night.  The selection of music is fun and varied and the heartbeat sound is so soothing to my baby.  Why not 5 stars, you ask?  There's one major problem.  While you can choose a category (such as classical or white noise) of music to play for 40 minutes, the sound changes within that category.  For example, the hearbeat sound puts my baby right to sleep but I can't just play the heartbeat.  After a minute or two it changes to the stream and then the animals sounds or whatever other white noise sounds there are.  As soon as it switches from hearbeat to stream my little guy wakes up.  I'm so bummed because I LOVE everything else about this amazing mobile.  What a shame.

product_title: organicKidz Wide Mouth Stainless Steel Bottels
review_body: I love the concept of this bottle - stainless steel is easier & safer than glass, as it won't shatter no matter what you do to it. But this bottle is our least favorite stainless steel bottle. Why? Honestly, it's the paint issue. It doesn't seem like that big of a deal, but for me, it was. I have the "dark blue solid" bottles and after a use or two (hand washing only), the blue paint started rubbing off. Not scratching off, rubbing off. Like when I was feeding my baby - with dry hands - by the end of the feeding, my hands would be covered in blue. And then once my baby was a month or two older and started grabbing at the bottle herself, *her* hands would be coated with the blue "paint". Shortly after I noticed that, I took these bottles out of the rotation. My favorites? Pura stainless steel bottles. They are simple, work well, and have no paint to rub off during a feeding. Also, they are 100% stainless steel, whereas organickidz bottles have plastic at the top where the nipples sit.

product_title: Dutailier Foam/Round Back Cushion Design Sleigh Glider Multiposition, Recline and Ottoman Combo
review_body: I wanted a glider that would recline and came with an ottoman.  Surprisingly, it is hard to find gliders that recline!  I read that Dutailier was a reputable brand.  I visited a local baby boutique and sat in several different styles of Dutailier reclining gliders; however, they were all over $1,000.  Not wanting to spend quite so much on a glider/ottoman, I looked on Amazon and ordered this one.  It was easy for my husband to put together.  The fabric is soft and easy to clean.  And the glider rocks nicely without making any noise or feeling unsturdy.  I would recommend this glider/ottoman set to anyone.  The recline feature is really nice, especially late at night when we're trying to get the baby to sleep!

product_title: Graco Stanton Convertible Crib, Classic White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: WELL MADE, AND JUST AS NICE AS THE MORE EXPENSIVE CRIBS!!
review_body: I am currently  7 1/2 months pregnant and recently purchased this crib in the classic white for our daughter.  It arrived within a week, and I was pretty impressed with how quickly we got it put together.  Once together, it is very sturdy, and looks really elegant.  I havent even used it yet, but I'm already very happy with my purchase!  There is really no need to spend more on a crib, when you can get everything you need with this one!

product_title: Bandette Cup and Bottle Labels
review_body: These arrived on time and as expected.  They are great to keep our kids cups labeled anywhere we find ourselves.  Worked as described.  We wrote their names with ink pen and put in dishwasher.  They still have the names on them after many uses.

product_title: Green Eats 8 Pack Feeding Spoons, Yellow
review_body:
So they are Eco friendly , dishwasher safe, and Made in the USA? Awesome. I highly recommend them. They are a great alternative to the mainstream brands silverware made in China. We all know that there are problems especially with metal and plastics coming from overseas.

They are big enough for mom's hands yet small enough for toddlers hands too.

product_title: Snappi Cloth Diaper Fasteners - Pack of 5 (2 Mint Green, 2 White, 1 Blue) New
review_body: Once you get cloth diapering down. These snappis are so easy to use you can put em on with one hand. (:  These are a little stiff at first but once you start wearing them in they get a bit more flexible. I have had 2 of these break however. But I ordered more because I THOUGHT I had lost them so I had plenty. A pack of 5 is a good number to start with.

product_title: Aquaus Toilet Bidet Handle / Diaper Sprayer with ** BONUS ** Rockin' Green Laundry Detergent and Tooth Tissue sample
review_body:
This is an excellent product made of excellent materials, every single part of it is fitting very smoothly.
highly recommended.

product_title: Bunnies By The Bay Bye Bye Buddy Blanket
review_body: Got three of these for my son who is in love with the big version.  He loved these just as much and we now have a skipit family.  I like these because he can walk around in public with them without dragging them all over the floor.

product_title: 2 Pack Vulli Chan Pie Gnon Teether
review_body: I was so glad to find these teethers cheaper than at Babies-r-us.  My baby loves this toy, the squeaking noise makes him giggle like crazy.  And of course he just loves to chew on it.

product_title: HALO and The Happiest Baby Safe and Sound Sleep Gift Set, Cream, Newborn (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This halo swaddler did not work for my baby. It was too big and bunched up around her mouth and nose. Of course she might just need to grow into it, however the zipper scratched her face so I will discontinue using it.

product_title: Evenflo Amp Lx No Back Booster Car Seat
review_body: No back support but for older toddlers it's perfect and they can buckle themselves in.  Seems sturdy and safe.  I think it will work out fine with this booster seat.

product_title: Ergobaby Organic Baby Carrier, Green River Rock (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have only compared this with the bjorn and I agree that this is a lot more comfortable for the parent, and possibly safer for the development of the baby (though that's according the company).  I carried a 30 lb 3 year old for 20 minutes one time in a pinch and had no trouble.  One of my shoulders just starting to feel it right as I was turning in my driveway.  I was able to carry my 5 month old for two hours (she slept most of the time) and walk for a solid hour without any trouble.  This particular carrier I bought for my sister who just had twins and she says this is a godsend as one of them wants to be carried all of the time.  I do not know, however, how this compares to the boba or any of those that are similar

product_title: Klean Kanteen 12 oz Stainless Steel Water Bottle (Sports Cap 2.0 in Black) - Orange Sunset
review_body:
While this appears sturdy as I would expect from Kleen Kanteen, there are some issues. First, the finish is chipping off all over the exterior. This has been used for less than a year, and spends most of it's time in a lunch box with plastic dishes or on a counter top. It is never hauled around outside. This doesn't bother with functionality, but still disappointing.

The other thing we've found that it leaks if my little guy lays his lunch box on its side. It is closed securely at the spout, but drips out of there.

product_title: Boba Organic Baby Carrier 2G
review_body: We have tried multiple types of carriers between our two daughters and the Boba Carrier is by far my favorite! This is the one I use on an almost-daily basis and the only one I grab anymore. I borrowed an Infantino SlingRider from my sister-in-law and didn't like it so I believe I only used it once. We were given a hand-me-down classic Baby Bjorn from a friend and used that when our girls were little. I've heard some people complain that when their babies got a little bigger that this carrier hurt their backs. I can't really say that ever happened to me but I didn't like that this couldn't be worn on the back and it concerned me a little with all of their weight right on their delicate parts. We also have a Chicco Smart Support Backpack (http://www.amazon.com/Chicco-Smart-Support-Backpack-Red/dp/B0007NC7K6) and while this is nice because it's worn on the back and has a higher weight limit than the Baby Bjorn, I find the frame structure to be a bit cumbersome for everyday use. The water-resistant canopy sticks up kind of high and I always seemed to be knocking into things with this backpack. And finally I got the Boba. I saw a lady at our nearby Arboretum wearing one of these and asked her a ton of questions about it. Then I came on Amazon and read all of the reviews. The woman I saw had the newest 3G model and while I do think the strap snaps are cool, I found that for the small price difference, the 2G Organic was the way to go. The Walnut color is a nice neutral dark brown and I like how it's all the same color, the straps and the carrier part are all dark brown instead of two tones on some of the other models. I love being able to hold my baby very close to me in the front but then also have her on my back for those times when I'm cooking or something and need her to be a bit more out of harms way. I will admit that I do have a hard time putting her on my back when I'm by myself. My daughter is 9 months so she doesn't hold on like an older child will do during apiggy-back ride. I usually need someone to help hold her on my back while I put the straps on. That being said, for the most part I'm wearing her on my front while she's still small enough. I can't get enough of kissing the top of her head anyway so that works out well for the both of us.

product_title: Munchkin Teething Blanket with Pacifier Attachment (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: There's a nice smooth cool side for hot days and a soft fleece side for warmer days. Nicely sized for hugging (not to cover baby) and teething corners make this blankey a recommend!

product_title: Graco My Ride 65 Convertible Car Seat, Cuddle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Awesome car seat! Baby girl seems to like it. Looks very comfortable and safe. Easily installed. Is wider than most seats.

product_title: Motorola Remote Wireless Video Baby Monitor withColor LCD Screen
review_body: This was the perfect gift and it came in fast.  Very satisfied.  My sister was able to get it up and running in a matter of minutes for use.  Thanks so much.

product_title: Motorola Remote Wireless Video Baby Monitor withColor LCD Screen
review_headline: Best monitor out there, some flaws I can live with.
review_body:
Update #3:
Customer service mailed me a new one with a bonus camera. We really like this monitor compared to the model down (no pan/zoom). Quality and Range is amazing, and we have 3000ft house. Can even get outside quite a ways. Highly recommend! If you can buy it somewhere with an extended warranty, do it.

UPDATE #2!! Customer service issues... just like everyone else.

Phone call #1 was promising - I can scan/email them the receipt, and within 48 hours they will process my email and send me a new camera with a postage-paid box to return the broken one.
Sounded too good to be true, and alas, it was...
No email confirmation, so I was a little worried but let it slide. One week later, no camera, no contact.
Phone call #2 said yes, my email was processed but they were out of stock. Expecting more cameras in that day and I should have it in 5-7 business days.
Phone call #3: One week later, still no camera. Total over 3 weeks later, no camera and Customer service says still out of stock. I asked them to send ANY model in the meantime, and they offered to send me the \\"upgraded model\\" which is the same thing but with 2nd camera. Supposedly they will overnight it to me and I will have it tomorrow. I'm not holding my breath.

UPDATE #1!!! Broken At 6 months!!!
Display screen is solid white, and we followed troubleshooting instructions to no avail. Audio still works, except that I can't adjust the volume because you need the screen for that. Don't know why it stopped working, but i don't have high hopes for customer service based on other people's posting... I will probably buy a different monitor now because I can't be without one.

Original review (4 stars) :
Video:
pro - Big screen, great color, great night vision, pans, tilts, zooms. Picture is so clear at night I can see my baby breathing. I never thought i would need the pan/tilt/zoom functions, but i use them ALL the time. Display turnsitself off after a few minutes to save battery.
con - None!

Audio:
pro - audio is very sensitive. i can even hear the \\"sleep sheep,\\" which is actually kinda nice.
con - audio is either on or off, whereas some very cheap monitors have voice activation. My baby makes a TON of noise and he is only 2 months old. Yes, I will hear him start to cry, but i also hear him grunting and snorting and farting, etc. I am learning to sleep through this, thanks to the sleep sheep...
con #2 - no mute button - this means when the baby cries, and it is my turn to get up, I have to either run with the monitor out of the room, throw it out of the room, or fumble to turn the power off quickly in the dark so I don't wake up my husband. I have mastered the quick-power-turn-off technique.

Buttons:
pro - large, easy to use, and I am smart enough to remember which button is which in the dark.
con - the buttons are not backlit. the display button, which allows me to see the baby, is right next to the one which allows me to talk to the baby. I can imagine someone could press it by accident and wake the baby up. I have not done this yet.
con #2 - you can't hit a mute button (see above), instead you have to use the power on/off button. not a huge deal, except the power button is small and flush to the unit. designer didn't realize you would ever want to use it.

Battery:
Terrible!!! The battery won't last the full night. It starts beeping by morning if I forget to plug it back in. HOWEVER, Since I keep it plugged in on my nightstand, this is not usually a big deal. I wish it came with a 2nd power jack so I could just plug it in downstairs too. I might just search for one now.

Distance/Reception:
Amazing!! I have a 3000 sq. foot home with really thick walls, on 1/3rd acre. I have no problem doing laundry in the basement while the baby is in a 2nd floor bedroom. We tested it all around our yard, and even out to the street corner. Sure there was a little interference while walking, but as soon as I stopped moving, the picture and audio came right back crystal clear. Highly recommended for this feature alone.

Other features:
Displays the room temperature (i dont know how accurate this is, but it is definitely close).
Allows you to play lullaby music on the other end. The music is terrible and we never use it.

product_title: Aden and Anais - Bamboo Swaddles - Tranquility
review_body: I am completely in love with these swaddles.  I already have 3 and I recently ordered 3 more.  I also intend to give these as gifts from now on, every mom should own them.  They are super soft and get softer with washing.  They are extremely functional, I can use them to wipe my baby's messy face, swaddle her, or just simply cover her and keep her warm.  I live in SoCal where it can be really hot or really cold so I love that the material is so thin that I can use it to keep the breeze off of her or fold it and keep her really warm.  If you have to guard the sun from the carseat or stroller, these are breathable ways to do it without over heating the baby.  I ALWAYS have one on or near my baby.  Make sure you get the bamboo swaddles because all of the others are a bit more tough.

product_title: Summer Infant Multi-Use Deco Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, Bronze
review_body:
I was able to install this gate in a large doorway very quickly. Simple instructions included and it looks rather nice compared to some of the cheaper products out there.

I originally thought we'd only be using this for a few years until our kid figures out how to open it but now I can see how having one of these for years to use with the dogs. Instead of locking them in a bedroom or outside, they can still be a part of the party but kept helpfully out of the way.

The one negative I have is the squeaky gate. For the price, it should have come with a well greased hinge.

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_headline: In love with my baby monitor
review_body: I only had this for a week but I already fell in love with it. This is the best baby monitor for value and everything works perfectly. product_title: Beaba Bib Secondes Quick Baby Bottle Food Warmer
review_body:
I purchased this from Amazon after doing major research and spending 10 minutes warming a bottle in a pan of hot water. Sure it's a bit pricey for something as simple as a bottle warmer but this warmer is great! As a newborn, my son was a colicky baby. A warm bottle helped soothe him to bed at night. This warmer (we used Dr. Brown's bottles - the standard size, not wider series) warms a cold bottle in 3 minutes flat. A room temp bottle, 2 minutes. It's not burning hot (as long as you set it to the correct setting) and when you have a screaming baby on your hands, a couple of minutes is a blessing.

PROS:
1) doesn't take up much counter space in the kitchen
2) uses just a small amount of water in the basin to steam
3) uses steam to heat, no chemicals
4) warms bottles very quickly
5) beeps when done

CONS:
1) A bit pricey
2) If you leave the bottle in the warmer after it beeps done, it will get super hot, quickly, so you have to remove the top cover right away.

product_title: Tiny Love Musical Nature Stroll Toy Bar
review_headline: Great for use on the Rock and Play
review_body:
Anyone who knows me knows I won't shut up about the Fisher Price Rock and Play. I consider it to be an absolutely essential item to have in the house from Day 1 of a newborn's life. It really helps babies to feel comfortable (which translates into more sleep for everyone.) They think it has to do with the fact that most babies have at least a little bit of reflux so sleeping in the Rock and Play really helps.

This toy bar was given to me as a gift and I figured out that it screws right on to the rock and play so for daytime use it was so great. My baby loved to sit in the rock and play and just bat at this for a long time. It was great. It kept his attention for ages. You can hang other things off of it, like other stroller toys, so the baby's got a variety of toys at different lengths.

I now buy this toy bar plus the rock and play for all of the expecting mothers in my life. Baby loved it!

product_title: WubbaNub Infant Pacifier - Giraffe
review_headline: If baby doesn't like at first DO NOT GIVE UP!
review_body:
My friend's baby didn't like her Wubbanub (giraffe) so she gave it to me. My baby didn't like it much at first, either. Then, we re-introduced it around 5 months and he LOVED it and stopped using any of his other pacifiers. I think maybe the fact that he was more mobile- able to roll over and almost crawling and so it was easier for him to find it in the crib. I truly believe that this item was what got him to start sleeping through the night because SO many of the night wakes were just that he lost his pacifier.

What a previous reviewer had complained about (how the whole thing has to go in the wash) I think is one of the best features. When it's dirty, you just throw the whole thing in the wash and it dries (I just hang it up rather than put in the dryer) within a couple hours.

I do suggest having three in rotation. Our daycare already lost one. If we didn't have a back-up, it could have been bad. Oh- and don't pay more than $15. Occasionally, these items (the different animals) will be out of stock and other sellers through Amazon will have some for sale for $30+. Don't worry about it because a) they get back into stock pretty quickly and b) if a baby will take one, chances are he/she'll take whichever other one (duck, giraffe, bull, etc.) We've switched out regularly and there's never been a preference.

product_title: Baby Chef Ultimate Baby Food Maker (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I rarely write reviews, but I had read some bad ones and felt that I would give my opinion. I am a mother who makes all her food and so I rely on this contraption EVERY DAY. I wish I would have taken this out of the package when for the first 2-3 mos of my baby's life, as I didn't realize it was a bottle warmer too. I've read other reviews and they've said it doesn't work well, I find it works very well. It doesn't over heat the milk, all I have to do is line up the water next to the marker on the inside, press the button then leave. In a minute or so the milk is warm and my baby is happy. The steamer part works very well, and there is NO GUESS WORK in how much water to put in as it has a clear marker inside to show you how far the water should go. That mark has never failed me and the food has always came out perfectly. As far as the blending, it does so very well. Not sure why people are having a hard time blending, perhaps it's because they haven't put enough water in it, as any blender there must be liquid to blend. But I find that it puree's really well. One of the things I love most about the Baby Chef is that it is so easy to clean, none of the food touches the main part of the machine so you can throw all the bits into the dishwasher or have it soak in the sink. I do recommend after steaming to clean the hot plate before putting water into it for bottle warming, just taking a simple paper towel and wiping it is suffice.

My only complaint is since we use this so much, the little plastic bit that locks in the blending cup has broken, I couldn't find a replacement so we ended up rigging it in a way where it's always locked in and all I have to do is press Go. I would highly recommend this product, it has made this working mother's life so much easier.

product_title: Changing Lifestyles Safe-er-Grip Foot Rest
review_headline: Problem-Solver for my Little Shower World
review_body:
I've been using this for 6 months or so and it works pretty well. It took me a few tries to get the thing to stick in our standard fiberglass-type of shower which is very small, but that was my own fault. I found that the surface has to be completely air-dried to apply it and you do have to make sure you completely lock it down with the little lever underneath as indicated on the instructions. I do believe the surface will have to be completely smooth for this product to work which ours is. This has been the best solution so far for our problem of having too small of a shower for a woman's needs.

It works great for resting your foot while shaving your legs and while you can put a fair amount of weight on it, don't overdo it. I did put too much weight on it once and I felt it snap or something - I thought maybe I had broke it. When I continued to try to put weight on it again, it slowly slid down the wall (and it would not refasten to the wall) and it was rendered useless for time being. I had to wait til the shower air-dried completely before refastening it and try it again. Wouldn't you know, once again, it's working like a charm and all is well again in my little shower world.

UPDATE (6/10/2015): Photo included. I still have this product, but find it comes off the shower wall a little more than I like now and sometimes feels in my way. However, I now use an 11" gripper handle for showers attached horizontally at a comfortable height for my foot. It has 2 of the these strong suction cups on the ends and so far has been sturdy, a little sturdier than this product, though you still cannot put all of your weight on either of them, of course. It doesn't stick out as far from the wall this way which is good and bad. Good it doesn't feel in your way as much, but bad that the foot space isn't deeper. Still, it is working great. Pros and cons to each of these methods.

I purchased a little ceramic top plant stand that sits just outsidemy shower around the corner that I leave empty (so it's handy) and will grab that and set it right outside my shower to place my foot on. This method works the best, but I do have to watch how the water runs off my body so it doesn't flood the floor outside the shower. lol It's handy though to have a little extra space to set my shave cream though. I actually prefer this method over the other two, but sometimes I use the others when I don't have time to dink with moving the stand around. At least this method is reliable - the other two, if the device should happen to move while the shower is wet, the are rendered useless until they can be reapplied to a dry shower wall. Guess it's always good to have a Plan B. ;)

Who knew this poorly designed shower stall with no place to rest a foot would entail such endeavors to remedy the problems it creates?!

review_body: I was excited about making my baby homemade baby food. I thought this would be a cool appliances to have. You also have to guess how much water you need to steam food. After while you do get better at figuring out how much you need. I never used it to warm food or bottles since my bottle warmer did that and is always out. It's a neat gadget to have if you don't already have all the other appliances I mentioned. I worked great when I wanted to make my babies food right before she ate but more of a hassle to make more than one portion to freeze. Mine is sitting in my cabinet because I went back to using my steamer, food processor and in some cases a masher.  I did get mine new in the box off eBay for $35 free shipping. Thankfully I shopped around before I bought it from Macy's for $99 on sale. Shop around if your going to buy one. I bought the Freshfood mash and serve bowl. It's perfect for mashing up food you are about to serve. I even take it with me on trips. It works better than a fork to mash up bananas or other such foods.. Plus,you can then use the bowl to serve your baby.making it portable. I just throw it in my bag and go.

product_title: Diono RadianRXT Convertible Car Seat, Plum
review_body:
I got this car seat for my daughter when she needed to transition from her Chicco Keyfit Cortina Travel System with the bases and infant carrier. I was looking for a car seat that we could purchase at that time (she was almost 12 mos. old then, almost 17 mos. now)but that we would not have to replace AGAIN in another year. However I also wanted something with very good safety ratings and that she would be comfortable in. The only thing that I disliked about making the switch from the infant carrier seats is that if your child rides in more than one car with any frequency it is no longer as simple as just buying one more base to put in the other car. You have to get an entire seat for each car. Although the literature for the Diono Radian RXT says it is easy to move from car to car and I did find it extremely easy to install correctly, so I suppose you could do that if you needed to, we just got two car seats instead. This one is for my car as she rides in it the most.
The head rest can be raised and lowered so that the side supports are level with the child's head (this was a bit tricky, but I managed it after about 15 minutes, a stronger person (Dad?) may have an easier job of it. There are several layers of padding that can be taken in and out as the child's size changes or the weather gets cooler or warmer. The harness is very easy to adjust. Delia seems extremely comfy in it. We still have her rear facing and will keep her there until 2 at the least and longer if possible but she is a long toddler so she may not make it much past 2 1/2. That is just my family's preference, as long as you follow the law do what you feel is best for your own toddler.
I am excited about turning her around when the time comes though! I am actually pretty excited about each different stage of this car seat. It has a cup holder, arm rests, etc. for later. Right now it has a special base that snaps on for the rear-facing position. The literature and instructions are extremely well written and they give you step to step instructions on each phase of the seat. It is very well made and so far appears to be a good investment. It also cleans up easily, which with a 16 month old is important. I wanted to give my review because I know to many families spending this much money on one car seat seems excessive, but since this one seat will last until she no longer requires any child safety seat at all the 300 dollars actually seems like a good deal. It is a well made product that will likely last longer than almost any other child gear you purchase, so if you look at it from that perspective and do the math it actually isn't as expensive as buying cheaper seats every year or two for the next 7 to 9 years.well written and they give you step to step instructions on each phase of the seat. product_title: Britax Chaperone Infant Car Seat, Red (Prior Model)
review_headline: Great purchase for 1st and future kids!
review_body:
Before our first child was born 2 yrs ago, we decided to spend the extra money on the \\"Cadillac\\" of carseats, the Britax line. We picked the Chaperone car seat, but were really hesistant to spend the money on the B Ready. We tried both the B Agile and a Snap and Go in the store with the Chaperone seat, and my husband was shocked at how easy they seem to flip up with just a little pressure on the handle. We shelled out for the B Ready, wanting the sturdiness/stability, the one-handed maneuvering, and expecting to use it if/when we had another baby.

Fast forward 2 yrs, and baby #2 is on the way. I was so pleased with the Chaperone for my son, and am happy to use it again for the new baby. It is a bit heavy, but SO safe - really great for a first-time mom :) It is a bit longer than other carseats, but we wanted our son in an \\"infant\\" seat as long as possible. He is 50th % for height and weight, and was in that car seat until 14 months old.

As far as the shopping cart request, I used a carrier (Moby wrap) when he was little, and then the cart itself when he could sit up. The Chaperone does not sit well on carts, but I don't think they are supposed to - never felt very secure to me personally.

We have a 2009 Ford Escape, and the Chaperone fits fine in our back seat. I'm 5'3\\" and my husband is 6\\", so it was behind my seat (driver's side). In the middle, you have to push both seats forward, and being short it's hard to lug it into that position anyway. We always used the base as well.

Also, we brought the Chaperone along for a flight when our son was 9 months old. Fit fine in the window seat, with a bit of room for the person in front to recline. As another parent told me, never hurts to treat that person to food/beverages if they can't recline fully :)

product_title: Levana 32000 Lila 2.4-Inch Digital Video Baby Monitor with Talk to Baby Intercom (White)
review_body:
This is my first exposure to baby monitors. However, I have wireless internet security cameras, so I used that as a starting basis for my evaluation. The product came in eco-packaging. There was a camera, receiver, battery for the receiver, and two wall-wart power supplies. The camera does not come with a battery and needs to be installed within a few feet of a power receptacle. The receiver unit can be plugged in or used with the battery. There is a clip on the unit to allow you to carry it with you (such as on your belt). However I found the clip to be a bit questionable. It is mounted low on the receiver and the clip is not spring-loaded. The clip is much better suited as the flip-out easel stand.

The receiver video screen is in color. The color tends to be a little on the magenta side, but the resolution is excellent for the size. The camera optical quality also seems to be quite good. I was very surprised by the high quality of the images. The camera also uses infrared leds so it illuminates a dark room when viewed with the receiver, and yet no visible light is seen from the camera itself. The brightness of the screen can be adjusted with the controls on the receiver, so it can be used in sunny rooms or even outdoors, or inside rooms with no lighting. Speaking of outdoors, the camera is not suitable for outdoor weather, but it looks like it can be used outdoors on nice days if protected from moisture and extreme temperatures.

The camera also transmits audio back to the receiver. It does this surprisingly well and it also has intercom capabilities. There is a row of green and red leds along the top that light up according to the sound that is picked up. A crying baby would cause the red leds to light, but ordinary sounds only cause 1 or 2 green leds to light up.

There is a foldable antenna on the reciever, but I could use the camera anywhere in a 3500 sq-ft single-level house without needing the antenna to be extended. It may be needed in a multilevel house.

The system did not come with a manual, and no manual is on the website as of this date. It took several minutes to figure out the functions and settings of the buttons on the receiver. It isn't that hard to figure out, but really there should be at least a one-page document to explain the controls inside the box.

I plan to actually use this device in my outer office. When the receptionist is away, I can see people come into the outer office and actually speak to them if needed using the intercom capabilities of the camera. It doesn't take the place of a security camera because it has no recording capability, but it will be nice to see who comes and goes while I'm in another room. The receiver can link to several more cameras, but I have no ability to test this feature, and I don't know if it cycles through each camera automatically or if you have to press buttons to manually cycle.

I'm really impressed with this camera system!

product_title: NUK Disney Winnie the Pooh 5 Ounces Learner Cup Silicone Spout, 6+ Months
review_body:
We had a hard time transitioning our son to a sippy cup. We had been trying for a few months but he disliked any sippy we got him. He uses Nuk bottles so we figured we would try this (its identical to a small bottle except the sippy instead of a nipple and they add a handle). He loves it, finally a sippy he likes!!!!! Thanks NUK.

Oh I was worried about some of the reviews say the sippy top wears out easily but he's had it a few weeks now using it several times through out the day and it hasn't warn out yet, still looks brand new - and yes he teeths on it.

product_title: Kids Line Luxury Contour Changing Pad Cover, Lime (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Very soft. Great color. Slightly overpriced.
review_body:
The fabric is very soft, and this fits my contoured changing pad nicely. The color isn't quite what I'd call lime -- it's a softer version of that shade. Still, it works nicely for our nursery.

However, I found a polka-dotted changing pad cover in a similar color at Target for less than half the price. I'll admit I prefer this one, but I don't think it's work the price difference.

product_title: Nuk Nipples Orthodontic Size 1 Slow Flow 2-Pack -
review_body: My granddaughter would only take a latex Nuk nipple and they are about impossible to buy in town.  This was wonderful to find them online and I have ordered the next size.  Thanks so much!!

product_title: Brica Cover Guard Car Seat Travel Tote, Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
It was really handy to have a car seat cover guard, that you can carry as a backpack.The wheels were pretty useful as well. After you have loaded the carseat, it has some more space to add a few additional items that you can check-in with the car seat.

The downside was its a little difficult to get the car seat in the cover, takes anywhere between 5-15 mins. Also it wore out a bit after a couple of uses.

Overall good to have for travel and worth the price.

product_title: phil&teds Lobster Highchair
review_body: I have the original one and got this one for baby #3.  I love that this one is easier to transport and I love the tray attachment. I do wish however that the tray somehow stayed in place so that my toddler couldn't move it around.  I also wish that it worked on tables with \\"lips\\".

product_title: Recaro ProBooster High Back Booster Car Seat, Midnight (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Let me tell my horrific experience. Yes, the car seat tilts when making sharp turns sometimes.
But when it came to real life emergency the car seat saved my kid's life.
We had a head on collision with a drunk driver and both of us were severely damaged and hurt. But the kid in the car seat was amazingly safe.
Only way I can explain is that what Recaro claims that it can absorb the shock from the accident, it must have done due research. It did the job. Otherwise, it could be fatal!
I hope this review helps concerned parents.

product_title: Sassy Baby Food Nurser
review_body: Every mom needs these! They are great for the infants who are too small to spoon feed and need a little more food! We started using these for my son at one month and he did great with them! We have done yogurt, baby food, soups, watered down grits! He is doing great...these really helped with reflux babies too! Thicker food stayed down more!

product_title: Sealy Baby Firm Rest Infant/Toddler Crib Mattress -204 Premium Coils, Anti-Sag System, Hospital-Grade Waterproof Cover, Hypoallergenic Cushioning, High Coil Firmness, 52"x28"
review_headline: Just what I was looking for
review_body: We wanted to give this as a housewarming gift for our grandchild.  Her parents are very happy with it.  It is just right for a 1 yr old transitioning from a very firm mattress.

product_title: WallStickerUSA Medium "Welcome to our home" Quote Saying Wall Sticker Decal Transfer Film 17x25
review_headline: I paid for letters and spray adhesive!?
review_body:
I got letters and another sheet of paper that had adhesive. So the stickers were not \\"stickers\\" they were simply vinyl letters that I had to put the \\"sticy\\" on! After trying to do that - it all got bunched together because of static - that is was a total fail. I do not recommend this - I purchased 3 more decals that same exact day...all the other were CHEAPER and already came with the \\"sticky\\" and I just had to put it on my wall (like it should be)...

Mad. - Wasted ALL my money and time for this.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Backseat Organizer
review_body: This fit our 2012 Sonata very well.  It gives my little guy something else to kick while on long rides but now the seat is protected.  Good space to store toys, etc...

product_title: GEENNY Boutique Crib Bedding Set, Beautiful Amazon Jungle Animals, 13 Piece
review_body: Bedding is beautiful. Looks and feels great. We chose this one for the jungle theme and the price. The price cannot be beat. Baby is due soon and we can't wait for the little guy to see his room.

product_title: KF Baby Finger Pinch Guard [Set of 5], with kilofly Refrigerator Magnet
review_body: These items smell horrible!  I got a headache just smelling them and did not want my baby touching them or worse- putting them in her mouth!  I threw them away just like the other reviewer. Not worth my time to return.  I will look into the clear ones that are sold.

product_title: Dr. Brown's 2 Pack Natural Flow Level 1 Wide Neck Nipple
review_headline: These are good but just a warning...
review_body: The milk comes out of these things pretty fast and furious. It was making my 6 month old baby gag because she wasn't used to the crazy fast flow. I would only suggest these if your baby is used to drinking from sippy cups or regular cups first because that's how fast the liquid comes out. We put the ones I bought back in the box and are saving them until she is older.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Designed To Nourish Snack-A-Pillar Dipping Cups (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These stackable bowls are awesome for daycare.  They save space when packing them up in the diaper bag so they are all in one space rather than 4 or 5 bowls taking up the entire bag, or even worse in a separate bag.  As if there isn't enough to carry!  I fill them with stage 1 - 2 baby foods, some mixed with oatmeal, and they do not leak.  I will be buying more of these.  Love them.

product_title: Ubbi Diaper Pail
review_body: This pail is a replacement for my year old stinky plastic diaper pail. Even with frequent emptyings and lots of febreeze, you could barely walk in my daughter's room because after a year, the smell had gotten into the plastic.  Enter my search for a better diaper pail.  And this is it!  The steel doesn't retain odor, and the air tight seal keeps in all the gross smells.  My daughter hasn't even figured out the lock yet.  You can also use regular trash bags as liners (bonus).  The finish on the steel makes for easy clean up with clorax wipes if it ever gets dirty.  My biggest (very minor) complaint is that the opening is small, so if you let the pail get too full, it's hard to get the bag out without ripping it on the lid hinge as you lift it out.  If you put your hand near the hinge between the bag and the pail as you lift it out, you can get around it.  Wish I had found this a year ago - not smelling the diaper pail is worth every penny!

product_title: Tommee Tippee Bottle
review_body: Our breast fed baby refused to take a bottle. We decided to try the Tommee Tippee ones after hearing from others that their babies who refused bottles liked these ones. Our baby did take this one more willingly than others we had tried. I really liked the nipple shape and appreciate that it's really close to the real thing. But there were two major problems that made it so this bottle simply wouldn't work. First even the slowest flow nipple was too fast for our breast fed baby. When held upside down it would literally stream out, not just drip. This would cause our baby to gag, which in turn would lead to her refusing the bottle. I also didn't like the shape of this bottle. Like others have pointed out, it's really hard to get the last ounce of milk into the nipple. Usually when we've wanted to give our baby a bottle it was for convenience when traveling or shopping or something, and it's frustrating that if your baby isn't completely reclined, like in a car seat, nearly half the bottle is wasted. I felt for a more expensive bottle it should function a bit better.

product_title: Nickelodeon Dora Hiking Bean Bag (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Our granddaughter opened her birthday gift and was not sure what to do with it.  She was excited it was Dora.  Now she sits in the chair several times a day.  It seems sturdy and she seems very happy with it. She is 2 and it is perfect for her to sit in. It is very colorful and she says, \\"comfy\\"! I would purchase this again.

product_title: Delta Richmond 4-in-1 Convertible Crib in White
review_headline: We had one for our first baby, we are buying another one for the second
review_body: This crib is excellent. The built quality is amazing with great design and low price. I strong recommend this product.

product_title: Bright Starts Around We Go 2-in-1 Activity Center
review_body: This was a fantastic purchase. My son absolutely loves it and he finds each of the toys very interesting. He also loves it when I stack other toys in his snack tray.  I've read some complaints about the quality of the plastic...none here...we've been using it four months and no issues.

product_title: The First Years Fast Heating Travel Warmer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)

product_title: Evenflo Zoo Friends 3 Count Standard Nipple Bottle
review_body: If you want a simple, no bells and whistles, practical baby bottle (which is all you really need), this is it.  That was my husband's request to me, so we found this bottle.  The bottles are cute, gender neutral, and they do not leak.  Just be aware that they come with a newborn flow nipple (0-3 mo), which seems a bit odd to me given that the size of the bottle is really for an older child.  If you want these for an older child, you will have to buy those nipples separately.

product_title: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Activity Center
review_body: So worth the money!  My son is six months old and absolutely LOVES everything on this activity center.  We had a bright stars one and he never wanted to be in there for more than a few minutes.  We tried my sisters neptune activity saucer and he loved it.  Bought him one the same week and he plays in it, loves to spin the seat and can play with the dogs as well.  Great buy!

product_title: Additional Side Rail for the Hide-Away Extra Long Bed Rail

I basically threw away my money.  This product was bought through Amazon, but came from a Third Party.  I was very disappointed.

product_title: Boon Frog Pod Suction Cup Bracket (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Must have for the frog pod
review_body: I purchased this upon the recommendation of another reviewer.  So far, it works great!  Not real sure why this does't come as an option for the darned thing to begin with..... Had I not seen the review, I would not have purchased it and would have attempted to hang it by one of the other methods.  My husband and I both prefer this option - nothing is screwed into the wall and no adhesives had to be used.  The suction cups really do a great job of holding up the base, the scoop, 2 bottles of shampoo, and toys.  It has been up for more than 48 hrs without falling down or loosing suction.  I am quite pleased.

product_title: The First Years Learning Curve First Keys Teether
review_body: great, now i dont loose my own keys.  My son is happy to play with these as an alternative to ours.

Satisfied!

product_title: Evenflo Classic Glass Bottle, 8-Ounce
review_body: I've been breastfeeding for almost two years now and have started the bottle feeding more.  These are great for a sleepy toddler that needs to slam some serious milk. We had the four ounce version of these & have loved them.  These are really sturdy for being glass...we've never broke one. It feels safer, clean, better to use glass.

product_title: Piyo Piyo Baby Nail Scissors
review_body: My sons nails grow fast and being able to use these scissors instead of clippers have helped tremendously. These scissors help to remove the fear of cutting an infants nails.

review_body: I love this. It is small but just the right size for mashing a meal. Its is easy to travel with, easy to clean and easily mashes the food. Everyone who sees it asks where I got it from because it look sot cute and is so functional too.

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_body: I spent hours looking at the reviews to decide which monitor to get. This was the best selling baby monitor but this is primarily because of the low price, and this doesn't reflect on the quality. I was most worried about the beeping problem that many reviewers pointed out, and I'm glad the unit I received does not have this silly software glitch. Overall I think this unit is the best for 'worth'. If you are planning to spend $200 on a monitor, I would recommend the infant optics monitor with another remote camera (and another $20 to spare) rather than a better monitor with music, bigger screen... but with one less remote camera. The battery is short so plan to keep it plugged into the charger as much as you can to prevent it going out at night. We live in a 3000ft home and we get signal everywhere without interfering our wi fi.

product_title: Set of 3 PaciGrip - Universal Pacifier Holder with Clip, Delicate Dot Pink
review_body: I've bought several clips and these are by far the best. They're sturdy and stay on my daughters clothes. I'm impressed with the price too.

product_title: Baby Buddy 2 Pack Secure-A-Toy
review_body: These are great to hold toys onto a buggy or stroller.  I would even hook them to my own arm while I held my son in church or anywhere and if he dropped his toy I wasn't constantly bending over to get it..

product_title: Honeysuckle Breast Milk Storage Bags, 50 Bags (2 Packs of 25)
review_body: I am very happy with these.  I have frozen a lot of milk and they have performed exactly as they should.  They double seal which is great.  I have not had any that leaked.  I did rip the side of one while I was taking off the perforated part on the top in order to fill it but I think I was in a hurry and ripped it with a bit to much force, so I had to throw that one away.  I just purchased the one package to see how they were but I will repurchase more of these when I run out.

product_title: BABYBJORN Original Organic Baby Carrier with Bib (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: It's very easy to sit ,walk n do the work very comfortably by looking my baby is safe or not........

product_title: Kiinde Kozii Bottle Warmer and Breast Milk Warmer
review_body: I agree it looks great, and I really really wanted to love it....but...nobody with a baby has this much time to wait on a bottle.  15 minutes is ridiculous.  I can put hot water in a cup, put frozen breast milk (in a bag) in it and that works 3 times faster than this horribly slow machine.

product_title: MAM Training Toothbrush, 6 Months
review_body: My 1 year old loves brushing her teeth with this toothbrush. Whenever she sees it, she gives a big smile, grabs it from me and proceeds to munch on the brush. I like that it's very long, the bristles are soft and it's easy for little ones to hold.

product_title: Bright Starts Grab
review_body: My niece 7 mo old niece loves them. They rattle like paper and the others have bells that rattle.  She plays with them for hours.

product_title: Baby's 1st Christmas 2012 Metal Snowflake Ornament
review_body: Very pretty, will be durable for years to come, and a lovely reminder of her Nana who gave it to her

product_title: Lila 3-in-1 Convertible Crib with Complete Toddler Mattress with Hypoallergenic Waterproof Cover
review_headline: LOVE THIS CRIB. Fits Colgate Eco-Classica mattresses.
review_body: I wanted the white, but the cherry was the only one that would ship free to me, and I'm so glad it was because I absolutely love it. It's petite, very sturdy and looks really good in a nursery. Adds a vintage feel. I didn't add the wheels, and it's very sturdy. Also love the fact that it's solid wood and baby safe and friendly. Not a very strong paint smell. And so reasonably priced... the colgate classica mattresses are a very snug and perfect fit (I like snug so there's no gaps for accidents.)

product_title: Badger Basket Two Bin Storage Cubby
review_body: I purchased this over the summer, but I didn't assemble it until a few weeks ago. The materials seem to be of a good quality and it went together rather easily. The instructional materials are extremely limited. The mechanically inclined should have no problems with this, but others may struggle a bit. This is especially true if your components are mislabeled, as mine were. Fortunately, I was an Assembly Technician in my younger days and had this together in about 20 minutes. Pay close attention to the parts list and the quantities you're supposed to have.

product_title: Lamaze Play & Grow Take Along Toy, Firefly
review_body: We have three of these toys and this one is kind of in the middle between moose and peacock. My daughter 4,5 month is interested in it when she sees it for a few minutes. However, wings are not really comfortable for her to pull into her mouth and she loses her interest pretty quick.

product_title: Baby Boom - Nap Mat Set - Includes Pillow and Fleece Blanket – Great for Boys Napping at Daycare, Preschool, or Kindergarten - Fits Sleeping Toddlers and Young Children - Kid Friendly Design
review_body: My little one uses this at preschool.  She loves it.  It is super soft and washes well.  I just hope it last through all the washes for at least a year.  I bought this after reviewing other comments.  So far, so good.

product_title: UPPAbaby Vista RumbleSeat, Black, 2014 and earlier
review_headline: Nice add-on for the Uppababy Vista
review_body: I love my Vista, so I want to get as much use out of it as possible. I purchased the rumble seat knowing full well that my 27-month-old would not be napping in it or sitting in it for very long periods of time. I keep my newborn in the infant carrier with the adapter. My son actually likes sitting in the rumble seat - he plays it out like he's in a hiding spot. He is tall though - 36 inches - and his head is just grazing the canopy of the rumble seat. So next year, we may just have to buy a double. But for now, this is a great solution for short trips. In addition, it is so easy to put in and take out and I don't find my storage space compromised at all when my son is sitting in it. I highly recommend this seat! Just keep in mind this is NOT for napping. Have realistic expectations and you will not be disappointed.

product_title: Diaper Dekor Plus Pail with 2 BOXES of Biodegradable Refills
review_body: I use the Diaper Dekor Plus Pail for my husbands Depends.  It has helped SO much with odor problems.  I can't tell you what a wonderful difference the Dekor Pail and the biodegradable refills have made in our home.

product_title: Combi Flare 2010 Lightweight Stroller, Kiwi (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We purchased this stroller from buy buy baby when our daughter was 10 month old.She has always been on the higher percentile for her weight and height.Right now she is almost 3 and we still use it.Its safe because of the belt on front.The cup holder is always handy,the foot support is also good. My husband is 5'8\\" and he never had any problem pushing the stroller.It has survived two international trip.Its still in a very good condition.I will highly recommend this stroller.

product_title: ZoLi BUZZ B Electric Nail Trimmer
review_body:
Per the reviews, I bought this. I had read nail clippers will not work for a new newborn as their nails and skin are fused thus the nail clippers will draw blood. Instead, a nail file is recommended. I thought this powered nail file would do the trick well. I found it was very underpowered and takes forever. I used it once and, after spending many minutes doing it, my infant did indeed have filed-down nails. By 2 months, I started using nail clippers, which I used while my son slept. This went really well. I sometimes don't have enough light when doing this so I would recommend clippers with a light on the end.

Overall: This may be a decent solution for that very, very first nail clipping but it is ultimately not worth the money. I do not recommend giving this as a gift either.

product_title: Luvable Friends 12 Pack Washcloths, Pink
review_headline: overall decent, but discription needs work...
review_body:
I got this for my friend who will be having a baby soon. I wasn't sure what to get her, but I thought this would be more useful to use since I hear baby vomits a lot and are going to be messy in many ways.

Good:
-size doesn't say from the product feature description from the seller and I thought the cloths would have been bigger from photo, but its (I Think) decent size for new born babies. probably better and easier to use since its small. ( actual size is 9x9 inches by the way.)
-for the price its alight.
-nice colors.

Bad:
-product feature description from seller is wrong. From seller it says 80%cot and 20%poly, but on the item I got, the back says 65%cot and 35%poly.
-of course since its 65% cot, the feel isn't soft as I would have liked.... but still alright to the touch.

Between:
-the cloth are thinner than I thought ( not paper thin, but hmmm thinner than a normal cloth...?), but when I think about it, it would be easier to clean when they are thinner, but then again it will get on your hand because its thin...

product_title: Medela Valves & Membranes
review_body: I couldn't be happier with my purchase.  As promised I received my order in a matter of 3 days.  Baby is due in 4 weeks and these will surely be put to good use when I start using my Medela breast pump.

product_title: Aquaus Toilet Bidet Handle / Diaper Sprayer with ** BONUS ** Rockin' Green Laundry Detergent and Tooth Tissue sample
review_body: It is a great product. It was easy to install and even easier to use. Wished I had bought it sooner.

product_title: Tommee Tippee Closer to Nature Single Electric Breast Pump System
review_body:
I should have listened to the negative reviews before purchasing this pump. I was in a bind and so I just wasn't thinking and went for the cheaper pump. Not smart!

The good - this pump is very comfortable. Although for me it means that I don't get any milk out. Well I do but it takes FOREVER.

The sterilization box is fun. But not worth the $100 plus dollars you pay.

The Bad - It takes forever to pump anything. Then when your milk lets down it ends up in the air tubing. I had to stop my session 3x to flick condensation out of the tube. In reading other reviews this is a big problem!

The suction is not strong enough. There is no way in my opinion a women could keep up a strong milk supply by using this pump.

I would only reccommend this pump for a mom who pumps occasionally, has extra sensative boobs, and can take an hour of her time to pump 2oz. If that's you then the Tommee Tippee is for you!

product_title: Fun Express Baby Shower Mint Party Favors - 48 Pieces
review_body: These were a big hit at our vintage baby shower! Would definitely recommend! They are well made, have darling wording and tasty mints!

product_title: Jolly Jumper Deluxe Sani Shopper
review_body: I like this! The print is so cute too. It fits over any cart I've put it on nicely, the bag in front is helpful and I couldn't be happier, I needed this when my toddler wanted to chew on the metal parts of the cart, I feel much better taking my toddler shopping now that I have this. You fold it into the bag when your done and it has a draw string to close it, very convenient to carry with you.

product_title: JJ Cole Collections Hooded Towel Green Bird
review_headline: Adorable... sad it's not high quality!
review_body: LOVE the bird design! Sadly- The brown trim bled all over just from pre-washing it in preparation for my baby's arrival :-( Washed it on gentle with some other new items and it bled on itself as well as other things!  Don't risk the disappointment!

product_title: Goldbug Animal 2 in 1 Harness
review_body: This Frog harness is a great buy. I have used this harness over and over and it washes well. Most of all can let my grandbaby walk and I know that he won't get away from me.

product_title: Disney 4 Piece Toddler Bedding Set, Taking The Race (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this bedding set, as does my son!  The sheets are super soft and the comforter is just the right thickness.  I love that the top sheet is fitted around the bottom...much easier for making the bed.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Wheely Bug

I've kinda gotten used to it or I use a hair tie to bunch up some of the material and make it shorter. I previously purchased a moby wrap but after using it found it was too cumbersome and time consuming and i wanted something easier and chose this. I also had purchased a seven sling but it was not secure enough for a newborn, but once she had good head control I use that when i have to go outside with the baby real quick or through in the stroller for \\"just in case\\" moments when she might want to be carried. product_title: BabyKicks 3 Pack Joey Bunz
review_body: Follow instructions for pre-washing (1/4-1/2 det recommended, all nat), dry on medium.  Ready after 1 wash, keep getting more absorbent through first few washes too.  By wash 5, I can put 1 of these + a microfiber square in my daughter's pocket dipe (she is 18 lb. at 17 mo) and go 3-4 hours between changes.  Adding one more at night has gotten me through 13 hours at night and she is nursing 3-4 times a night right now!  2 makes for a bulky diaper, but trim considering it holds all night like that (and she's sleeping anyway).  One insert is bulkier than some microfiber inserts, but it is so absorbent it is worth it, and it is not too bulky for my very active runner/climber to be bothered by.  Very soft if you are not using a pocket diaper also.  Just take the time and read blogs/reviews/advice about hemp and washing.  Also, try not to wash Hemp (new) w/ microfiber.  Natural oils in the hemp (when brand-new) can get on your microfiber and reduce its absorbency.  Unfortunately I have not found anything comparable cheaper so don't be scared off by the price.  Hour glass shape is awesome too for trimness through thighs.

review_headline: Super easy to take baby out and about
review_body:
I have been using this carrier since my baby was about 3 months old. She is currently 10 months and this is a great product that has allowed me and my husband to easily take my daughter around town. Many moms have commented on how comfortable and snug my baby looks in the carrier and I always highly recommend this product.
------
PROS:
- easy to adjust straps to different people. I am 5'1\\" and husband is 5'10\\" and wider. We easily switch off on carrying the baby b/c of the straps.
- carrier grows with the baby. We started using the Pognae when baby was 3 months old, with the infant insert. She is now tall enough to sit in it alone, with the head rest attached. As she gets bigger and too heavy to hold in the front, I will start carrying her on my back.

CONS:
- nobody has heard of the brand Pognae in the U.S. so people who ask me about it often look perplexed. I bought the Pognae on a whim because I read about it on a mommy blog and found out that the brand is Korean. Since I am Korean too and know how seriously Koreans take to wearing babies, I figured this product was worth a try.
- I got the carrier before it came with the head shade :(

product_title: The First Years True Fit Recline Convertible Car Seat, Black/Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Don't waste your money - Difficult to install, difficult to secure baby, and expensive
review_body:
I bought this car seat after reading reviews and seeing the high NHTSA ratings for ease of installation & securing the child, since these are the feature we would use most often (getting him in & out, and switching vehicles).

It is incredibly difficult to install. You have to unsnap & remove the lower portion of the carseat cover to secure the belt to the carseat. But once you have the belts tightened and secure, the carseat it crammed so tight against the backseat, it's impossible to get the cover back on, or to see the level indicator. This also poses a problem when trying to loosen the straps to easily get the baby in & out. The latch that loosens the straps is very low and you cannot reach it once the carseat is installed. You also cannot pull the straps tighter for the very same reason.

After fighting with this car seat for 2 weeks, we went to Walmart and bought the $40 Cosco seat for our second vehicle. We had it installed in about 10 minutes and you can easily reach the button to adjust the straps. We already threw the packaging away for the First Years True Fit, otherwise I would have returned it. And I've spent too much money on it to throw it away.

This car seat would fit rear-facing in our Dodge Ram Quad-Cab with the headrest on, but the same cannot be said for our Hyundai Sonata.
