product_title: Evenflo Maestro Car Seat Booster, Keller
review_headline: Great product at a great price!
review_body: We purchased this seat for the second car to make sure that both my spouse and I are able to drive the kid around as needed. However due to how much better it is than our primary seat we decided to make it the primary. The key things that set it apart for us are extra space and integrated dual cup holders! The extra space for a snack is very useful!

product_title: Tupperware Ideal Little Bowl Set of 3 New (Electric Orange)
review_body: I love these things for no paticular reason. You can't see in them so don't hide stuff but they are great on a picnic or on a trip if you need ketchup or anything that should be sealed.

product_title: Artist Backpack Harness
review_body: This backpack is roomy enough to hold a sippy cup, several diapers and a travel wipes container, yet small enough that a toddler can wear it without a problem. I have used this with two daughters and loved them. The leash is the best thing. It allows me to keep my kids close but give them freedom to walk.

product_title: The Pull On Diaper Cover, Lime, Small 7-10 lbs
review_body: works great over our little fancy pants fitteds, and gmd workhorses. i have tried wool, fleece, 5-8 different types of covers and these are by far the easiest to get on my wild toddler, the diaper change enough was too much work for me lol!

product_title: Dappi Waterproof 100% Vinyl Diaper Pants, White
review_body: These are not as stiff as other pants, are a better value than others and are just as leak proof.  They do run large so I would order one size smaller, I am glad I did since there is still lots of room -- I can imagine how huge the recommended size would have been.

product_title: Planet Wise Wet Diaper Tote Bag
review_body: I absolutely love these bags.  I cloth diaper, so a couple small wetbags for the diaper bag were a must.  I can easily get 2 cloth diapers into a small bag - 3 if I really stuff it.  That makes the small size perfect for short outings with the baby.  I also bought a medium bag too for longer trips, but I use it more for wet swim suits.  These bags are easy to wash.  They don't fade, colors don't bleed, they don't shrink and you can put them in the dryer.  When I put our sopping wet swim suits in the bag it does leak through after a few hours, but even then it's only a little damp, not soaked.  The only other problem is they are a bit expensive, but I find them well worth it over using plastic bags.

product_title: Infant 2.4ghz Digital Video/Audio Baby Monitor System with 2.4" LCD Display Optics, 8 IR LEDs for upto 15ft Night Vision, FHSS Radio Transmission, Rechargeable Lithium Ion Battery for Monitor, Voice Activated Power Saving Mode (PINK)
review_body: the product is very good and gives no interference however could be better if it had an option to stay in fucionamento without going into standby

product_title: Trend Lab Prep School Blue 3 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review_body: Initially, I loved the design, but was a little leery to order, based upon some of the reviews. My concerns were 1)- a few people had a bad experience when laundering. 2)- at least one person found the quilt to be too thin. With the laundry nightmares I'd read of, I took extra care to wash the quilt alone, on the most delicate cycle, in the coldest of water, and tumbled dry on the lowest setting. No problems at all. My little one's bedding is still just lovely. The thickness of the quilt was exactly what I had in mind- When I think of a 'quilt,' decadent & fluffy are not what come to mind. I'm reminded of actual quilts, made by loving hands- they may not be fluffy & thick, but they are well put together, warm, and padded enough to get the job done. I'd say this blanket is about an inch in thickness, and exceeded our expectations.

product_title: Learning Curve Bristle Buddy Teether
review_body: My 6 month old LOVES this! I think this one stands apart from other teethers we have tried because he can hold it in his hands.

product_title: Sugarbooger Deep Dish Bowl, Matryoshka Doll (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought a few items from this design, & am very pleased with the quality. It arrived quickly to Canada.

product_title: H:oter Baby Dentelles Baby Flower Headband/Headwear for Infant, Baby, Toddler. Chiffon Flower - White
review_body: I received it right away, in about 1 day only, but I was disappointed that the flower was flat :(. I understand that it was squished flat in the packaging but i've been trying to unflatten it with no luck. My baby will still wear it but it won't be as nice as the picture :/

product_title: Jeep 2 in 1 Harness Backpack, Lion, Brown, White, Child Leash, Baby Walking Safety Harness, Kid Backpack with Tether, Toddler Travel, Wrist Leash
review_body: We bought this harness for my 17 month old son prior to our cruise vacation this summer.  I was just so nervous about him walking around on deck (and possibly falling overboard), that I wanted to keep him safely by my side.  As it turns out, my son LOVED it.  He treated it like any of his other stuffed animals when he wasn't wearing it (hugging it, carrying it around, etc), and would gladly put it on when asked to do so.  It was a win-win.

product_title: Sposie Booster Pads Diaper Doubler, 90 Count, 3 Packs of 30 Pads
review_body: My 20 month old is a big boy at 35 lbs.  He is solid and tall - basically the size of a three year old.  I have used the Huggies Overnights, but he was wetting through the Size 6, which is the largest size I have been able to find.  With potty training months (years?) away, especially overnight potty training, I was not looking forward to washing/changing bedding every morning.  These diaper liners are fantastic.  My son has not wet through since we started using them.  I highly recommend them!  I started with the 30 pack and just bought the 90 pack so I don't have to order as often.

product_title: Dr. Seuss Star Pattern by Trend Lab Velour CribWrap Rail Covers for Crib Sides (Set of 2), Blue, Wide for Crib Rails Measuring up to 18" Around!
review_body: I thought it would match the main center piece but it is a little lighter on color and has a different texture. It will serve its purpose though.

product_title: Sassy Baby Food Nurser
review_headline: Easier for younger babies just starting to eat baby cereals.
review_body: I had a simular feeder for my babies and loved it. I bought this for my grand baby as she is just starting to eat baby cereal.

product_title: Sassy Water-Filled Teethers 2 Pack
review_body: These are great teathing toys.  Many teethers are too thick to actually get into a baby's mouth.  These are just right.

product_title: Bandana Wonder Bib 3-pack Teal/lime/navy
review_body: these are so cute to throw on with an outfit rather than a traditional bib...waterproof and durable.  I wish they were a little cheaper, but since they are made well and not white I will get a lot of use out of them.

product_title: Munchkin Stay Put Suction Bowl, 3 Count
review_body: I like that the suction helps plates stay in place for those babies who have to grab them.  I put veggies in it and she is able to grab them without tipping it all over.

product_title: Angel Dear Blankie
review_body:
I own 4 of these all identical...the blue bear. It's comical the way I methodically monitor their usage and wash them to keep them all in even wear so he doesn't notice that Mom has backups.

My son fell in love with this around 6 mos, and now that he's about 20 mos, he's only become more attached to it. I'm home with him, and when he's out of sorts, nothing comforts him more than being able to fiddle with the blankie's tabs between his fingers or clamp his teething gums on the bear's face. And the nastier it gets, the more he likes the texture of the tabs.

My only issue is that I wish the tabs were reinforced better on the seams. All of them have a spot near one of the tabs that has come undone with repeated washing. Nothing Mom can't fix though.

BTW, my son would give this 10 stars if he could. And of course, I would recommend this product to others.

product_title: Nickelodeon Bean Bag, Team Umizoomi
review_body: I search all over online for this item and ordered as soon as I found it because my son loves Team Umizoomi.  The processing / shipping took 3 and a half weeks but understandable during the holidays. What I couldn't understand was the tiny size if the bean bag. Definitely not average as compaired to other normal bean bags.  What was more upsetting was the packing slip on the box stating a much lower price (almost half) than what I was charged on the invoice. For the price ($38) would not recommend to a friend.

product_title: KidKraft See Thru Bins Espresso
review_body: very nice thank you.. smaller than expected but very nice and easy to build... extremly elegant, fast shipping... sturdy. have nothing bad to say... only would have been nice if it was bigger..

product_title: KidCo Outlet Plug Cover
review_body: The little tab thing broke off.  I only opened and closed it about 7 times and I don't think I was too rough on it.  It's too bad because otherwise the product was pretty good

product_title: Mamas and papas Tour
review_headline: Expected it to be High End
review_body: Mamas and Papas is a high end brand. This umbrella stroller does not really live upto that standard. I have an iCOO stroller which I like a little more than this stroller. The biggest dislikes are that the incline function on this stroller is ridiculous... its a strap that you move up and down and it wont stay in place. There are no real incline positions. The next not great thing is that the under carriage is soo small. You can barely fit a regular hand bag in there. And you cannot access the carriage unless the child gets off. The best features of this stroller are the color and the strap to carry it when closed.

product_title: Britax Car Seat Travel Bag, Black
review_body: We have used this for one domestic trip so far. Mostly used it as a backpack, rather than dragging it on the floor. So far so good.

product_title: Angelcare 4 Piece Baby Video Sound and Movement Baby Monitor System Ac1100, Gray/White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love the video and motion along with the temp alarm. The audio part of the monitor is a little frustrating. All in all i am still happy with the monitor. The motion part works great and makes it a little easier to sleep at night.

product_title: Medela Disposable Nursing Bra Pads, 60 Count
review_body: The pads absorbed and were hard to notice under the bra. I wish the tape stayed better in place. But worked well and absorbed better than other brands

product_title: Set of 12 Baby Girl Rubber Duckys
review_body: Everyone at the baby shower I hosted thought they were cute.  My 2 year old still likes to play with them.  I plan to use them again, next time I host a baby shower.

product_title: Boppy Nursing Pillow and Positioner, Sweet Pea
review_body: I love the boppy! My son likes sleeping cradled in it, in fact he will rarely get to sleep anywhere else. We had to wedge it into his basinet to get him to sleep at night! It is also great support for my arms while nursing.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Jumbo Toy Hammock
review_body: The Prince Lionheart Jumbo Toy Hammock is such a great way to keep those stuffed animals off the floor. My son loves the fact that all of them all snuggled together and our dog can't get to them. I recommend this to everyone.

product_title: Wake Up Alarm Clock for Kids- Zazoo Photo Clock- Includes Alarm Clock, Video and Music Player
review_body: This definitely did the trick, getting our daughter to stay in bed until it was time to get up. She is now back to sleeping until her wake-up time, so the bonus is that we not only get the extra sleep ourselves because our daughter stays in bed, but since she is now trained to sleep past 6am again, we have a better-rested child to boot! My only concern is that the first one we ordered randomly stopped working - just out of the blue - after about a month or two. We had no problems returning it and getting a new one through Amazon - they were so accommodating and helpful! But I am hoping that we will not have any problems with this one...so far so good!

product_title: Lamaze Captain Calamari
review_body: Great little toy! The legs are different textures, and there's a little mirror on the inside of the calamari. Our daughter loves this little toy. She's only 3 months, so all she does is smile, laugh, and squeal at it, but I see it being something she enjoys for a long time!

product_title: Klean Kanteen Complete Sippy Set (with Sippy Spout, Sippy Adapter and Sport Cap 2.0) 12 oz
review_headline: Works well if you don't have a thrower
review_body: This little sippy cup (doesn't leak) is great if your child (unlike mine) doesn't have a habit of throwing things. My daughter hucked this sippy at the floor and cracked our tile. The canteen escaped nearly unscathed - just a minor dent but because we have a small dog who is usually hovering around our daughters feet, we decided this wasn't a viable option for us.

product_title: Aottop Strollers & Accessories
review_headline: Great for price compared to others
review_body:
I use this for my Baby Jogger City Mini Double stroller. It takes up one half of the handle bars. This product was MUCH cheaper than any of the comparable aftermarket products. I was honestly worried about the quality but it is very well made. The cupholders have held everything from a soda can to a 32 oz fountain drink. It fits securely on my stroller, and I can leave it on while folding it. Would buy again
UPDATE DECEMBER 2014:
I have used this stroller cupholder caddy for well over two years now. I have used it on four different stroller (umbrella, jogger, double, etc). I originally purchased it as a \\"budget item\\", but I have since tried several other more expensive competitors to this product (including the skip hop one), and I can honestly say this is the one I ALWAYS go back to. It has fit on every stroller I have tried. I even occasionally use it while grocery shopping so my drink doesn't spill! It's very easy to take off and reattach. I also have one that I attached to the top bunk of my boys' bunk bed. It works perfectly and he now has a place to put his water bottle, some tissues, a flashlight, etc. I always strongly recommend this cupholder to family, friends, and inquiring strangers. It is well made for the price. And since it is so economical it's affordable to replace it if it happens to get ruined. My favorite part is probably the wire around the opening. It allows me to easily place drinks inside, and I can usually do it one handed. That can't be said for the Skip Hop competitor to this product. While I appreciate the little zip off pouch and cute prints that company offers, this cupholder is just more functional. It may be basic, but sometimes the basics are best!

product_title: GEENNY Musical Mobile, Boutique Classic Sports
review_body: Purchased this along with other matching items to complee our youngest son's nursery.  With a fresh coat of paint and these items, the room turned out perfect.

product_title: PRIMO Folding Potty with Handles, White granite
review_body:
We only used the seat a few times because my son was to afraid to go on the big potty without a seat. There are a few flaws in the seat though.

1) It doesn't fit every style of toilet, so it can shift and slide around

2) The whole sanitary issue is hard to deal with.

I found after I would use it I would spend an additional 5 minutes in the public bathroom wiping down the underside with clorox wipes I carried with me before re-folding it and placing it in a carrying bag.

I suppose it would be good for parents who travel a lot. It just wasn't a great product for us.

product_title: Baby K'tan Baby Carrier
review_body: I bought the ktan for my newborn who was 7-9 @ birth. She really snuggled up & slept well in the kangaroo position until about one month, then she started wanting to stretch her legs out. I haven't tried the hug position yet because I'm not sure how it will work since she doesn't have head & neck control yet. I will update again later.

product_title: The First Years Sole Expressions Single Electric Breast Pump
review_body: Love this pump! Its so easy to move around and not alot to clean up, plus its really quiet and it doesn't pull at the breast. NO complaints what so ever.

product_title: Combi Kobuk Air-Thru, Licorice
review_body: Just love this new booster seat I get for my son. I feel like he is so strapped in as if it wew a 5 harness so I feel very safe. The seat is just the best... great buy for awesome price...

product_title: Skip Hop Alphabet Zoo, Multi
review_body: Good book, but little expensive. I buy it for my nephew and hope he may like it. I may recommend it to my friends.

product_title: Delta Universal 6 Drawer Dresser
review_body: We got this dresser for my 10month daughter and we couodnt be any happier very sturdy and has a elegant look and feel to the dresser may require two ppl to carry its about 120 pounds

product_title: Chicco Cortina KeyFit 30 Travel System, Adventure (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Safe and big enough for long term use, but it's VERY very heavy and the stroller is bulky.

I love the car seat, but it's pretty bulky. My husband has to carry it in and out of the house if our baby is in it. It's lasted a long time though. My son who is 9 months is still using it although he's about to outgrow the height restrictions. I bet we'll get another two months out of it. It's super easy to get in and out of the car though, it just clicks right into the base with no effort! The base is easy to move between cars,but we bought two anyways. I'm not a huge fan of the stroller it's pretty bulky as well. It steers nicely though and has a lot of room for a diaper bag at the bottom. We don't use it very often because it stresses me out to have such a huge stroller in crowded places, but it's great at the mall or on walks. If I could do it again though I wouldn't have gotten the stroller.

product_title: Cosco Juvenile APR 40RF Convertible Car Seat, Abbey Lane  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My one-year old daughter is ok in the seat. It just not as "foamy" as other seats we tried. Too hard to be comfortable. If you want to make sure your kid is comfy, buy another one.

product_title: Kids Wood Highchair / Restaurant Baby Wooden High Chair Stackable, Unassembled
review_body: We purchased this because my finicky daughter hated a regular high chair but seemed to love the restaraunt ones. This solved that problem with flying colors. She now happily eats in her high chair and it cleans up very easily. It isn't tacky or covered with some ugly print that clashes with kitchen decor, it blends in seamlessly in most areas.

product_title: Kids Konserve Stainless Steel Bottle
review_body: These items leak.  Bought two and both leaked and made a big mess in my kids lunch knap sack.  Don't buy a complete waste of money.

product_title: Munchkin Mozart Magic Cube
review_body: Bought this for my son when he was just 3 months old and although he wasn't strong enough to push the buttons, he loved the flashing lights and the music. Now that he's 8 months, he plays it and dances to the music. It's good music that isn't horrible to get stuck in your head although I think it's a little too loud. It's fun - even for adults - to combine the instruments. Excellent toy!

product_title: American Baby Company Percale 3 Piece Toddler Sheet Set
review_body: The only thing that would make this sheet set better is if it were a higher thread count. It's a little harsh for soft toddler skin.

product_title: Safety 1st Baby and Pet Gate, Brown
review_body: I have an elderly cat and a 17-months old pit bull. The gate is very sturdy so that even a nosy dog won't be able to push it over easily. Granted, a dog may jump over it, but mine does not like to jump in first place.

product_title: Baby Buddy 2 Pack Secure-A-Toy
review_body: My baby has decided that her favorite game is to throw her toys on the ground repeatedly.  These have saved me from a lot of cleaning.  I use them on her carrier, and they are just short enough that I do not have to worry about them going across her neck.

product_title: Lamaze Play & Grow, Moose
review_body: This toy is a MUST have! My 7 week old loves crinkling Mortimer's feet and holding his legs. When he gets older I'm sure he will enjoy him even more! I would highly recommend this toy!

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Extra Tall Walk Thru Gate, White
review_body: Keeps my St. Bernard out of the living room.  Thats how durable it is.  Well made. Easy opening and closing. Locks easily

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_body: Using it at my desk with the Madla Pump In Style. works great. The fabric is firm, but soft and hold the shields very well. Would recommend as a must with any double pump.

product_title: Ameda Noshow Premium Disposable Nursing Pads, 60-Count
review_body: I've tried 3 different nursing pads- and these are the best so far.  They still show a little bit (not sure if you can find any that don't show at all).  I will continue to purchase these until I find something that is better.  I tied the Lansinoh brand- adhesive sticks to you if it shifts and they fold in half frequently.

product_title: BABYBJORN Baby Carrier Original
review_headline: I can get more stuff done!
review_body: I have other baby carriers and not one can compare to this one.  It's easy to use.  I do not have to have any help to put on or put baby into,  Baby is very cozy in this. My baby usually falls asleep within minutes.  I like this product also because I can get stuff done...while toting him around!  And the best part.... i can open it up and lay him down, without waking him!!!  Super easy and a comfort for mom to wear too!  Would hghly recommend

product_title: Graco My Ride 65 Convertible Car Seat, Cuddle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Last month my one year old moved out of her infant carrier. I bought the Graco MY RIDE 65. I couldnt make my mind up for months between Graco and evenflo triumph. They were both highly rated.
I went with Graco because of the color options.
I was concerened about the location of the strap tightener because I want to keep my daughter rear facing until age 3. But I decided to give Graco a try anyway.
A month later here I am online to order the evenflo!!
I HATE THE STRAP THING!!!!!!!
I cant keep it because I get so fustrated with it. Baby is in the seat every single day twice a day except sunday. I drive an hour one way. If I keep it any longer I will not bother fighting with it to get her in properly. The strap sometimes works like \\"ratchet\\" motion other times its a straight pull motion. Drives me nuts. A few times I have had a bad day at work and I have lost my cool over a stupid carseat in the parking lot of daycare! Not cool!! I am so happy theres a light at the end of the tunnel with the new seat ordered!!!

product_title: Mountain Buggy Bassinet Stand
review_body: Seems sturdy and does it's job.  Only problem is my smallest dog seems to think that the basket underneath is a special hiding place for her.

review_body: purchased this style (removeable bottom) for my daughter's first baby and they were a hit.  now, as my granddaughter is growing, we are moving up to the larger ounce and we expect these to be just as good as the smaller version.  great value for the money.

product_title: Maryjane Subtle Baby Socks 6 Pairs 0-12 Months
review_body: Love these beautiful mary jane socks! They are what I expected and more, great quality for the money. I would recommend this brand to others :)

review_body:
I have had this for 2 1/2 yesrs since my son was born. Now my daughter is using it. SHe loves it as much as he did!!

I wish the music would play longer.

product_title: 8-Pack Colorful Printed Baby Bibs
review_headline: OK for the price, and for drooling teething babies
review_body: My daughter is at the stage where she's been drooling quite a bit while she's teething. These bibs are great at saving her clothing. They wash well, and are fairly effective for that purpose. I wouldn't count on these to contain any big messes with feeding, but for the drooling that goes along with teething it's a whole lot easier to change a bib than to change her clothing, and they keep her pretty dry. For the price, these are good for serving that purpose.

product_title: Celebration Candles 1-21 Year Numbered Birthday Candle
review_body: I bought this for my daughter's 1st birthday party on 10-14-12 and was so diappointed in the quality and over all look (the inlays on the candle that identify the year/age and the cheesy looking decals), I am going to return the item for a refund. I would not recommend this product...

product_title: Safety 1st Multi-Purpose Appliance Latch

product_title: Chewy Tubes Super Tubes Red Teether
review_body: Both my kids love these for teething. The handle is great for little hands and/or linking.  You can freeze them also.

product_title: Graco Ultra Clear Analog Baby Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have a camera monitor, but we wanted to get one that we could put in our room when our daughter was sleeping on our bed. It works great but has a few glitches that can be worked through. First off, the listening part of the device needs to be at most one foot from the face of the child to hear well when they wake. Secondly, the speaker part of the device will have a lot of buzzing when near other electronics and may need to be moved around to be clear and quiet. My only real gripe is that it is plug in only and will not take batteries. Hope this helps your decision to purchase or not.

product_title: NUK Active Silicone Spout Learning Cup, 10-Ounce
review_body: this bottle is great for water not so much for milk or formula because you cant see the fluid level

product_title: Serta Deluxe Waterproof Mattress Cover (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I've purchased a few mattress covers by other manufacturers and the Serta mattress cover is my favorite!  The cover is soft and cushion-y so it adds another layer of softness for my little one to sleep.  It also fits the crib mattress perfectly; no tugging or bunching when you put it on.  It keeps wetness from soaking through to the mattress, and it washes well too.  Thanks, Serta!  Your cover definitely checks all the boxes.  :)

review_body: I love this lady bug. My 4 month old will coo & babble away laying in her crib looking up at the stars. She falls asleep pretty quick w/ it. I love that it automatically shuts off & doesn't heat up. Definately worth it!!!!!!

review_body: My son is 18 months, and 32 inches tall. It's was WAY to big for him. We just got a smaller size.

product_title: Safety 1st Rubber TempGuard, Ducky

review_body: I am a dumb male and my pain tolerance is pretty high. I may have boiled my kiddo if I didnt have this to keep me in check. If you have a male in your life, I recommend this as a must have.

product_title: Gerber Graduates BPA Free 2 Pack Divide N' Dine Plate, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I wish these were a little deeper, but they are plates and not bowls I guess.  They work great and the no-slip helps the little ones who are learning how to use their fork and spoon

product_title: JL Childress 6 Bottle Cooler
review_headline: Great bag for my night feedings.
review_body: This bag fits 4 Dr Browns 8 oz standard bottles perfect for me! I use a large blue Medela ice pack on the bottom of the bag and 4 J.L.Childress ice packs - one on each side. So without these ice packs you can fit 6 bottles. Keeps the formula chilled all night. Good quality bag. And I like the long strap on the bag, comes in handy when I have my hands full.

product_title: OsoCozy Flannel Baby Wipes - 15 pack
review_body: On my third baby and needed to replace some now-missing cloth wipes. These are priced reasonably, unlike many other brands, and shrink to the perfect size, density, and softness after washing.  Have been using for 3 weeks so far and am more than appy with my purchase, which, BTW, was due to the recommendation of my sister, who bought these about 9 months ago for her baby.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: When compare this to my nephew's one, his one was bought from the baby shop. I found the color is different, the main different is, the smell!!! The real one has a very very good smell. but this one has an awful plastic smell!!!  So sad that I have bought a fake one.....

product_title: Safety 1st Soothing Mist Ultrasonic Humidifier
review_body: I enjoy the absence of the whirring sound that my old humidifier had and the lack of a filter to get moldy is great.  The first two nights I had issues with the area on the table and floor underneath and around the humifier getting completely soaked with water and thought I would have to return it until I realized that the directional nozzle that fits on the top of the tank had fallen on the floor when I opened it.  I decided to try it one more time with the nozzle on the top and that resolved the soaking issue.  If I run it at full blast it doesn't last the whole night but it works just fine at about 60% output.  You can't refill it at a typical bathroom sink because of the height of the tank but I keep a water bottle handy and it does the trick. No real complaints.  Its not fabulous but suits my needs and is offered at a good price.

product_title: Mountain Buggy Plus One Buggy with Cocoon and Second Seat, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Good stroller but not right for us
review_body:
I bought this stroller with the intention that it would be our only one-would convert to a double, could use as a bassinet and could jog with it. I have since bought a snap and go, an Uppababy Vista(LOVE IT, I should have bought this in the first place!!), and a used dedicated jogging stroller that lives in our garage with a fixed front wheel and is only 16 lbs.
Here are the pluses:
-Good sunshade
-Great handle material and height adjustment
-Well built
-Great customer service-The brake got stuck and they sent me a new frame
Here is why it is not for us:
NOTE: I have used this for about 4-6 miles of walking or running daily for 7 months so I have had some time to think
-It is heavy both in use as a single-I think it has to do with the weight distribution over the front wheel once the baby sits in the seat, I didn't have this problem when she was in the bassinet. We have a lot of hills and pushing this up steep hills is brutal in comparison with other singles.
-It is tippy going up and down curbs-also think this is an issue just as a single
-The front wheel is very squirrely-even when fixed I am constantly adjusting it when walking. Maybe mine pulls but unless you are on flat paved trails you CONSTANTLY are adjusting it
-It is NOT a jogging stroller-This is my fault entirely that I thought I could use it for light running. It is all over the place. Plus it is tippy and heavy. They do not advertise it as so and this is entirely my mistake.
-The sunshade is good but does have a gap. They sell and additional sunshade but for $600+ you would think it wouldn't be necessary.
-It is too bulky and heavy to take places in my opinion. Yes I use the Vista which is about 25 pounds but I find it much easier to maneuver in and out of the car.
For our lifestyle I should have bought the vista and a dedicated jogger. I love the Mountain buggy company and their service but this stroller wasn't right for us.
Thebottom line-it does everything ok but nothing spectacularly well. Not for us but unfortunately I cannot imagine I will be able to sell it locally.
If I could give it 3 1/2 stars I would. In retrospect I should have bought the Terrain because I love the company.

product_title: Ameda Purely Yours Breast Pump - Carry All
review_headline: Medela Pump in Style Advanced vs. Ameda Purely Yours
review_body:
I received both this pump and the Medela Pump in Style Advanced as registry gifts. I was going back and forth about which one to get, and would have likely ended up with the Ameda had it not been for a generous friend. Overall, I would highly recommend this pump. I hope this review is helpful to the women in the same boat as I was...

Medela pump:
1. It's very efficient. The let down \\"warm up\\" is nice so your nipples get a chance to get used to the pumping a bit and avoid a harsh start.
2. It's very quiet. I appreciate this as I'm using it three times a day at work. The efficiency is nice at work too as I'm not having to spend 30 minutes pumping to get a single meal for my child.
3. Pump parts are relatively easy to clean.
4. I do experience some leaking from the bottom of the flanges sometimes, but I have this experience with the Ameda as well.
5. The bag is quite large. I don't carry it every day, though. I leave the pump and bag at work, and just take the pump parts home with me to wash each night. (I also wash the parts between pumps at work, but our bathroom sink isn't very good).

Ameda pump:
1. It's not nearly as efficient. It takes me much longer to get a similar volume to the Medela, and I feel that it's just not getting as much. The suction is weaker than the Medela. For reference, I go up to about half way on the Medela intensity knob. On the max setting for the Ameda, it feels like it's suction is much weaker than the level I use on Medela.
2. It has a harsher start - there's no \\"warm up\\" so you have to adjust the speed and suction on your own if you'd like to have this ramp up.
3. It's MUCH louder. I would feel more self-conscious at work with this one, but it's not super loud.
4. It's much more compact if you're carrying the pump to and fro.
5. I like the bottle holders on the pump itself. It's nice to put the bottles somewhere secure where you can't knock them over when you're putting yourself back together at work.

Overall, I say if you can afford the Medela, I highly recommend it. I read rave reviews for both, so I had figured I might as well get the one that's half the price. Having used both, I would get the Medela, hands down.

review_headline: ALL foam mats are toxic for your baby
review_body: CAUTION!! All EVA foam (foam) play mats are toxic for your baby.  There are no standards here in the US to regulate levels of formamide in EVA foam.  The testing that is done in China and other parts of Asia are substandard.  If the level of formamide doesn't reach a certain number then they are free to call it \\"formamide free\\" but it still contains levels of formamide that Europe has determined to be bad since US doesn't regulate that and hasn't conducted any tests.  And the companies either hide their test results from the general public or the data sheet contains very general information, such as pass or fail on formamide but never telling you the actual amounts of formamide.  All foam playmats have been banned in Europe as of 2011.  It is illegal to sell these in Europe now.  [...]

product_title: HALO SleepSack SwaddleChange Diaper Pad Covers
review_headline: A Swaddled Baby is a Happy Baby During Diaper Change Time!
review_body: I love having a new baby in the house, and even though it has only been four years since our last baby, it is truly like starting over again. It seems that every time I go shopping for baby and that I am preparing for a new baby, there are new things out there and there is new info that I am learning about baby. I personally love finding the new products on the market, then telling others about it. Like when I have guests over or when we are out and about with Wyatt, and people ask, what is that, or how did you find that, I can tell them! Recently I was sent a product that I wish that I had with my other two, and is from a company that I adore! I was sent the new Halo SwaddleChange to review! You may be thinking to yourself now, what is a Halo SwaddleChange? Well that is what I am going to tell you about. The Halo SwaddleChange has me now convinced that this is a must have for anyone with a baby. When you have a baby, you have diapers, and with a baby, they dont exactly stay still during all diaper changes. They get fussy, and antsy and they do not really enjoy being uncovered. Now when I had Robert, I just knew that having a changing table was a must have, because I did not have one with Estrella, and with Wyatt, I just know that having a Halo SwaddleChange is the must have accessory for your changing table. I love that when I go to change Wyatt, no matter how wiggly he can get, I can easily set him up in the soft and comfortable SwaddleChange that is part of his changing table, and we can both have a easier diaper change! Wyatt loves to be swaddled, and I love not having to worry about his hands getting messy when he is squirming around while I change his diaper. To put the Halo SwaddleChange on your changing table, all you have to do is put it on the changing pad like you would for any changing pad cover, then you swaddle baby with the swaddle wrap, which soothes baby and keeps them from squirming around during a diaper change. I love that there are also slots onthe sides that allow the safety belt from the changing pad to come out. I also love how soft the fabric is, so I know that not only is Wyatt being swaddled and comforted during a diaper change, but he is also laying on a soft cover, which in all makes the diaper changing so much easier for both of us!!! Another huge plus about the Halo SwaddleChange, that makes me feel better about any products I use with my kids is the fact that the SwaddleChange has been awarded the PTPA (Parent Tested Parent Approved) Seal of Approval.

review_headline: Great!  But needs more options on motor.
review_body:
We got this after searching online for a new baby gym for our third baby. The one we had for my older two finally bit the dust, and we wanted a brand new gym for our one month old daughter. I was immediately attracted to the space theme (my 5 year old son is obsessed with astronomy, so we thought getting a space themed gym for the baby would help him bond with his baby sister), especially since it's so much cooler than most of the other themes of baby products. This gym also had the highest reviews of the gyms we were most interested in.

I love the swaying arms, very cool. At first when I saw this product, I thought it might be too simple (especially with the price!), but the other review with the video of the swaying arms convinced me that this was the gym for us. Simple and not overly complex, but not TOO simple.

What I don't like (or rather, what I'm disappointed with): With the rather high cost of this item, I'd expect there would be more options on the motor... there are two songs available (one that is like a lullaby, and another that is more upbeat), but there's no volume control. I also really wish there was a timer or something. I find that the songs are too short (about 5 minutes at most) and it just turns off after the song is over. It's a bit annoying to have to keep turning it back on every few minutes. We often use this gym as something to occupy the baby while we eat dinner (we set it right next to my chair), but when the music and swaying stops after only a few minutes, our daughter starts getting fussy. After about the third time it turns off on it's own, the baby has gotten frustrated with it and I have to hold her while trying to eat (and this was the main reason we got a new gym to begin with... as it's difficult to eat while holding a baby, ha). Considering how pricey this gym is, more options on the motor would be expected... hence the reduced star.

product_title: Contours Lite Stroller, Tangerine (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Was looking for a light weight single stroller that we could travel with. I have a Maclaren umbrella stroller, but it was lacking. I compared and shopped the following brands: Maclaren, Uppababy, Chico, Graco, the First Years, and this Contours stroller.

I chose this stroller for the following features:
- Fully reclining or nearly full recline seat
- Usable large basket
- Reasonable sunshade
- Easy to push
- Lightweight
- Compact Fold
- Parent cup holder
- Child tray

I bought this without seeing the stroller in person. I did try all the other brands in the store and wasn't impressed with any of them. So I took a chance on this based on the reviews and I am SOOOO HAPPY with my purchase. We just took this stroller with us for 8 days in Hawaii with my 18 month old. We used this stroller every day around the hotel grounds and getting in and out of the car each day. Also took the stroller thru the airport and gate checked it.

The things I want to rave about are:
1. Seriously great under stroller basket. It was huge and very easy to actually put cargo in and to remove the cargo. We have a city mini double stroller at home, a First Years Urban Wave, and a Maclaren umbrella stroller and always found the baskets too small, too difficult to use, and just plan useless. The Contours stroller basket can be assessed from behind the stroller or from the front. Amazing. Finally a useable, sizable basket.
2. So easy to push. It's super light and a very smooth ride. I was worried when it first came, because the wheels are not the nice rubber or air filled tires. They appear to be just plastic. But that caused no issue. I could push this one hand. My sister in law was with us and had a Maclaren and two kids. She had a very difficult time holding one child while trying to push the other in her stroller. The design of the Maclaren handles required two hands to push easily. My 4 yr oldnephew sat in our stroller and with the extra weight it was definitely more difficult to push, but with my 23 lbs son, it was very easy to maneuver.
3. Child Tray - None of my other strollers came with a child tray. Never knew how much I'd love it. Being able to walk around and put some snacks and a straw cup of water within reach of my son was awesome. He loved it and it created a whole lot less mess.
4. Nearly full recline - Was so happy that the comfortable seat also reclined almost flat. My niece napped in our stroller as the Maclaren only reclined to about 45 degrees. You need two hands to put the seat back up, but you could do a one handed recline.
5. VERY LIGHT and easy to fold- It was so easy for me to put this stroller in and pull it out of an SUV.

If I have anything to complain about:
1. The crotch strap is just a strap with no padding, so might be uncomfortable, if your child doesn't have a diaper on.
2. The side adjusters on the 5 point harness are difficult to adjust. Maybe a good thing, but was almost so difficult it made it parent proof, not just child proof.
3. The parent cup is not attached very tightly, so we actually lost ours when we gate checked it. I should have just pulled it off and taken it on board with me. It's attached fine for use, but not for transport.
4. Doesn't fold as compactly as some other light strollers (compared to the Chicco or First Years lighter stroller is about the same size, but much lighter. Not as compact as the folded Maclaren, but it was lighter. And the Maclaren folds into a narrower, but longer shape, so maybe it's as compact, but just shaped different). But it never created a huge issue for us so far.

All in all, I was so happy with my purchase, especially since it was so reasonably priced. My husband also agreed that this was a great purchase. I was worried that it might be too short for my husband to comfortably push, but he never complained.He's also just 5'9\\" - 5'10\\", so not excessively tall. We're both average height and had no complaints.

review_body: My baby has always been in the 5-10 percentile for weight, so I had to try lots of different swim diapers to fit her skinny legs. This brand worked great! It was even snug on her, which I think these things are intended to be so they hold in whatever solids come out of your baby. I've seen so many reviews of swim diapers where people complain about the diaper not holding pee. They're not meant to absorb water, people! Otherwise your child will sink from the weight of the diaper...or the diaper will slide off from being so heavy! They're meant to hold in poop for health purposes!! With that in mind, don't put these on your baby until right before they get in the water and be prepared to change them into a real diaper when they get out. Or else prepare yourself to get peed on.

It's just not as substantial feeling as a large swing. If you have needs like ours, I'd definitely recommend giving it a try.

product_title: Baby Jogger City Elite Single Stroller, Green Sport (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I live in Colorado and pretty much every mom I know purchased the more expensive and less easily managed BOB. I went with the City Elite for several reasons:

1. The wheels allow me to take this on tougher trails (as does a BOB). It works great on gravely or ripped up paths.

2. The ability to pull a single cord and close the entire stroller is AWESOME. The only stroller that matched this simplicity was a Britax one, but the Britax didn't have the capability of off-roading. This was an important feature in my shoppping and it has come in handy. On the other hand, I will say having had the stroller for almost a year now that I rarely find the need to shut it one-handed. I do still like how easily I can pull it closed and put it away.

3. The adjustable handle bar is perfect for me (5'7\\") and my husband (6'2\\"). Both of us can adjust the bar to where it's comfortable for us.

4. Easily adjustable back seat for the baby. I also like that you can adjust the baby's back rest with one hand. This, unlike the #2 point above, really has come in handy. I frequently find myself wanting to both lower the back rest and keep my daughter occupied -- and I can do both since the adjuster is so very easy to use. There may be other strollers with this ease of adjustibility on the back rest but most of the ones that I recall required both hands and were a little more involved.

5. Snap-and-go with a Mico car seat. Probably the most important factor for our use of this stroller is that we wanted the ability to have an infant car seat that would simply snap and go with it, without the need for extra bars and straps. The Mico car seat has that capacity. You can buy a City Elite adaptor set (which does come with extra bars, etc., for use with car seats that don't have the snap-and-go feature), set up the adaptor on the sides and simply snap the car seat directly into the adaptor and go. This was so easy for us and exactly what we wanted. When the baby was smaller, we only used the car seat and plugged it into the stroller, into the car, etc. It was critical to have one that worked well with the City Elite and made life easier for us. BOB had no car seats with a snap-and-go feature. The Britax (B-Agile I think) did have that snap-and-go ability if you bought that stroller and car seat, but there were other features it didn't have (like #1) that were important to us.

6. It has a simply awesome hood for cover from rain, sun, etc. There are also little see-through plastic windows so that I can see into it and watch baby while strolling. I think the BOB has these features as well.

Some things I'd change:

1. The storage on the bottom isn't quite as big as I'd like and it's hard to reach. I think this is a problem with many strollers

2. The nylon \\"cup holder\\" pockets around the handlebars. While these pockets provide for some storage for keys, they aren't nearly as useful as a real hard cup holder would be. They dangle and move and items can (and have) fallen out. You can buy additional add-ons but for the price I think real cupholder and storage at the handlebar area should be a given.

One final thought: The green that is shown in this picture is much darker or greener than the actual green of the stroller. The real stroller has a softer green that works with both boys and girls. You can see better pictures of it in google searches. We weren't sure when we bought this whether the color would be this grass green or the more aqua green; it's aqua green.

product_title: Safety 1st Toilet Roll Guard
review_body:
This contraption does its job adequately; Baby can only pick off small shreds of toilet paper, so no more unraveling! Yes, I still find bits of TP around from Baby pick-pick-picking at the roll, but the guard doesn't promise total TP defense, only an end to unraveling, which it has achieved.

The household's adult users have had to adjust and get used to two-handing the TP, but it's fairly second-nature at this point.

Construction has held up thus far (about a month) but does feel a bit cheap -- hope the thing stays together! If it doesn't, I'll be back to update this review.

EDIT Sept 18, 2013: Indeed, this contraption has held up for just over a year; my concerns about flimsy-ness did not foretell its destruction. However, the Child did eventually work out its defeat a few months ago, but I left it on because it at least reduces the quantity he can easily unravel. Imagine NO PROTECTION -- he would yank once, watch a stream of TP come forth, and that would be so gratifying he would yank and yank until it was all unraveled. Yes, he can now hold the guard down with one hand and pull with the other, but it's not quite as simple as yank, yank, yank, and I can live with that.

product_title: Nursery 101 Sidney Convertible Crib, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Relieved...it is exactly what I expected
review_body:
I didn't want to spend a bunch of money on a crib. I know that most models are these convertible beds but really, I don't think I care. I didn't want to spend so much money on a crib so that I was stuck with it til she was a teenager. When she's old enough for a regular twin bed, I may want a new bed set for her so this was a perfect price. I really do like it too. It was quick and simple to put together. It's very sturdy and fit the mattress well (Kolcraft Pure Sleep Therapeutic 150 Crib Mattress-love it!!) . In the corners there is a little gap but my daughter isn't crawling yet so I don't know what hazard this may be but I can't imagine any mattress could fit any better. It is so snug everywhere else, but the corners, I can barely tuck the fitted sheet. I just put stuffed animals in the corners so she doesn't investigate the small areas where she can see through.

I am really happy with the whole set up that I bought and I got it all here on Amazon. I have wanted the sheet set, Skip Hop Treetop Friends, since I was pregnant. In fact I was pretty determined to get it but I didn't want to spend so much money. After agonizing over choices for...well, my daughter is over 8mo now, so it's been a while. I went ahead and bought Banafish Migi Little Tree. It's $180ish for the 4 piece set. The problem with this set, i found, was that all the accessories were discontinued. So that means, no extra fitted sheets available. I went ahead and bought the fitted sheet for the Skip Hop Treetop Friends collection. It matches great!

My dear husband made the mistake of submerging the toys to give them a \\"good cleaning\\".  We thought they had \\"lost their voices\\" forever. review_headline: Strong signal and easy to use
review_body: Baby monitors can be very complicated, and many come complete with thick user's manuals that look more like car manuals.  This monitor does have a comprehensive manual, but we didn't need to read it to figure out how to set up and use this monitor.  The video picture quality is good, even in very low light.  Also, the range of the monitor is quite impressive.  We carry the monitor all over a big house and have never had a lost signal or any interference with the sound or the video feed.  After trying several high-end (and expensive) video monitors, this one is our favorite.

product_title: Munchkin 2 Count Door Knob Cover
review_body:
We ordered these to put on our doors to ensure that our 23-month old can't get into them. He can reach the handles, but hasn't quite figured out how to turn them yet. So far, these work wonderfully. They were a bit of a pain to get apart and snapped back on to the door, but at least I know that my son won't be able to just pop them off! The holes are large enough to allow the adults to open the door, but small enough so that little hands would have trouble getting a grip.

I do not think these will be a solution for very long, however. Small children are very clever at getting into things they shouldn't, and these do not look like they will present much of a problem for very long. I'm fairly certain once he decides he wants in, these won't stop him.

For the price, the peace of mind it will give me for a few months is more than worth it. I will enjoy it while it lasts!

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body:
I was hesitant to purchase this item because at the time it was nearly $25 dollars. HOWEVER, my father in law came to visit and purchased this for our son as a gift. Had I only known how much my son (and pretty much every baby we see) would love this- I would have purchased it MUCH earlier than 4 months.

Not only is Sophie made of all natural rubber and painted with natural non toxic paints, the design seems to be incredibly enticing to kids just as a regular play toy. My son is 6 months old now, and LOVES his Sophie. She comes in the car, we play with her during activity times, and chew on it extra hard when teething! If we bring Sophie with us on play dates, all the other babies want to play with her!

I never DREAMED of spending that much a teething toy, but I HIGHLY recommend purchasing one! Completely worth the price!

product_title: Snappi Cloth Diaper Fasteners - Pack of 3 (1 Mint Green / 2 White)
review_body: I heard you can't cloth diaper without a snappi, and after CDing for 7 months, I'm a believer.  Pins are more secure but such a pain in the neck to manipulate, and boingos just don't hold my prefold in place where I want them to.  These are my go to fastener.  Only thing I would recommend is staying away from white.  It stains and is harder too see against diaper whites.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Bouncer
review_body:
It's been 5.5 months now and this seat has been one of the most utilized pieces of baby gear we have. My little one has just about grown out of it but I wanted to pass along the recommendation since we've loved it so much. From the beginning, when we needed to put the baby down while we eat dinner or take a shower, this chair would be the perfect distraction. The vibrating option was very soothing for him. We hardly use that anymore since now he's easily able to swing at the monkey characters and set off the music and lights on his own. In the beginning we'd set the music and lights to loop, then when he was more active we changed it to light up when he triggered it.

We would bring this chair with us to friends' houses for when we needed to set him down to eat dinner since we knew he'd be entertained. It has been great for that! We opted to go with this chair over a swing due to the limited amount of space we have and I think it's worked really well for us. I would definitely recommend this item.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: I bought this for my cousins son who was born about a month and a half ago. She said she wanted something that lights up and makes noise... this is perfect. It's not obnoxious, has volume control, and is easy for him to grasp.

review_body: It is so modern and has lots of padding so my baby will be comfortable. I haven't had my baby so I can't say much yet.

review_body: Great product! Zero complaints, bought this as well as the additional camera.  Easy to set up both, no problem! Would recommend.

review_headline: Fantastic at removing breast milk build up!

product_title: Dr. Brown's 3 Pack BPA Free Polypropylene Bottles 8 ounce
review_headline: Purchased after glass bottles chipped - Superior to Avent
review_body: We used Dr. Brown's glass bottles until our baby was 5 months old.  They were great at first, but my child is strong and began to knock the bottle out of my hand during feeding which was scary because the bottles are so heavy.  At that point, I also discovered the inside of the opening of the bottles was starting to chip causing me to panic and call the pediatrician.  We hand wash our bottles, we're not sure how it happened.  Possibly from mixing formula?  We thought we were doing the right thing getting glass bottles, but, after doing some research, I discovered glass bottles chipping is not uncommon.  Regardless, the baby is fine, and I purchased the plastic bottles and also an Avent bottle to compare.  The Dr. Brown's plastic bottles are great, just like the glass bottles, only lighter.  I use Palmolive Baby dish soap and haven't noticed any residual smell issues as discussed in other reviews.  The Avent bottle made mixing formula easier because of the wider opening, but I noticed significantly more milk leaked out of the baby's mouth, and there was a suction problem with the nipple, the venting system failed, and the baby could never finish the last two ounces of formula.  We have never had this problem with Dr. Brown's bottles.  They are absolutely great.

product_title: Hygeia EnJoye LBI Breast Pump, Black Bag, QTY: 1
review_body:
I bought this pump based on reviews here, even though it appeared that the Medela Pump in Style was more popular. I have to say, I've been very pleased witht the Hygenia. One of the main reasons I bought this pump is because of its closed system, making it more green.
The feature that I've most appreciated with the Hygenia is the internal battery. I pump 5 days a week at work, and only need to charge this pump about once a week! It's so nice to not have to find an outlet in order to pump. If I have to pump at home, I can sit wherever I want! This feature always came in very handy when we went on a camping trip. My friend's pump had to have 8 AA batteries, which she complained that rarely lasted very long. The Hygenia was a bit louder than her pump, but not terribly noticeable.
The wide mouth bottles that come with the pump are really easy to clean, although the volume measurements are starting to wear off.
I concur with the complaints about the CARE button. If they decide that is a \\"must have\\" feature, perhaps they should add a volume button - it's quite loud.
All in all, I'm very pleased with this pump. I imagine it will last for a long time to come.

product_title: Moby Wrap Original 100% Cotton Baby Carrier, Slate
review_body:
It takes time to practice putting on but once you get the hang of it it is so comfortable and easy. I also have a Baby Bjorn which I still like but the Moby is much more comfortable on my back and shoulders for long wearing.

UPDATE -- 6 months later

I have had this carrier for 6 months now and still love it. I also own a few others so I thought I would put togethere my thoughts on all of the carriers that I own.

Infantino Sash Mei Tai --- It is very easy to put on and off and my 6 month old son is very happy in it. I love how easy it is to adjust the straps and when they get loose you can tie it again. I plan on using this one this summer at the playground when I'm chasing my 3 year old. Of all my carriers this is the easiest to nurse in because of how quickly you can adjust the shoulder straps to get the baby down low enough. The privacy hood is also great for nursing (and naps). I also like that I'll be able to wear my son on my back and hip as he gets bigger.

Ergo --- This is my favorite for long term wearing. The waist belt and great padding on the shoulder straps makes it very comfortable when you need to wear it for a long period of time. Since there are not any knots in the back (I tie my Mei Tai in the back) it's comfortable when you are sitting. It is very easy to nurse in the Ergo and the privacy hood is great for that and naps. This one can also be worn as a back pack and on the hip. The Ergo is very comfortable for my 6 month old and will last for a long time (I previously carried my daughter in it when she was close to 1 year old).

Moby Wrap --- This was my favorite when my son was first born. It takes some getting used to but once you are comfortable with how to tie it (go on Youtube - there are lots of people showing how to use it) it's is wonderful. The baby is curled up on your chest and is comfortable for both of you. The wrap is very large and you can tuck the baby in and go. I would continue to use this but with summer coming there is allot of fabric and it will be too hot for both of us. It was very easy to nurse hands free in the moby - again check out Youtube for tips.

Ring sling --- I have an older hand-me-down ring sling (it's probably 6 or 7 years old). I think it's hard to adjust and the material gets stuck in the ring when I'm trying to tighten it. It's made from a woven type of fabric (not a soft, stretchy one) so that could be part of it. A newer one made with different fabric might be better but I don't like mine.

Baby Bjorn --- I got this when my now 3 year old daughter was born. Back then this was the carrier everyone had. I have used it with my 6 month old son to carry him forward facing (i can't do that with my Ergo or Mei Tai). He likes that allot but I don't like that the baby is not in a natural seated position in the Bjorn (the natural seated position is best for when you wear your baby). I also don't like that there is not much flexibility for where the baby sits against your chest in the Bjorn. After both my daughter and son were around 4 months old their head was already at my chin level and you can't make many adjustments to lower them (it is not an option to nurse in this carrier). This carrier is quick and easy to put on and I liked that allot when both kids were very young.

review_body: This is a great toilet lock.  We have an American Standard Champion toilet (very basic), and the lock does not prevent the seat from staying open itself. product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_headline: Where Was This For My First Baby?!!!!!
review_body:
This item is one of those that I wished I had with my other two children. With my past two children I had the hard plastic tubs that have the hammock attachments and I had one of the sling/seat type and I hated both of them. The Leachco safer bather is awesome and convenient. I love that it is so soft for my little one and I don't have to worry about him sliding off of it or it being uncomfortable for him. It is soft and \\"cushiony\\"!

Our son suffered a traumatic brain injury at birth and was in the NICU for 32 days. When I was able to care for him at home this bather made bath time a lot easier for both of us. He is 14 months old now and I still use it because he is unable to sit independently.

I definitely would recommend this bather. If I had known about this with my first child I would have used it for all of my kids.

Just be sure to hang it dry after every use so it does not become mildewed.

review_body:

In addition, the Baby Bjorn is made of solid and sturdy material that I'm sure is going to last for multiple kids! I absolutely recommend this product over other baby carriers.

product_title: UPPAbaby Vista Stroller, Cole/Slate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I had to write this review because I've never encountered such fantastic customer service.  We have two strollers, the Vista and the G-Luxe.  Now that my daughter is a little older (14 months) we use the g-luxe 90% of the time just because it's smaller (we have a small car) and easier to push around through tight spaces, although I will still use the Vista for a long walk or if need to use the big basket underneath.  We did use the Vista exclusively prior to my daughter getting big enough for the umbrella stroller (around 8 months) and I really liked it.  Anyway, I went to use my Vista the other day and I found that one of the joints on the seat had cracked.  Now this was probably totally my fault - the seat was stored in our laundry room, under the frame and under our infant car seat.  I'm sure something got shoved on top of it and cracked the joint.  Anyway, I emailed customer service through the form on the website to see if we could make a claim for the seat (stroller is 1.5 years old) and they responded within an hour with a friendly email requesting my mailing address so they could ship it out.  No questions asked.  I just received the tracking information for the package - less than 24 hours after making the request on the website!  I would have no hesitation buying from this company again or recommending the brand (whether it be the g-luxe or the Vista) to anyone looking for a great stroller with an excellent customer service department.

product_title: Dreambaby Extra Wide Car Window Shade, Black, 2 Pack
review_body: So, I made a mistake of getting the extra wide shade when my car isn't extra wide. It covers all half of the back of the car. It's too wide for windows in the back. Also, it's dark when you look from the inside but white (or beige) when seen from the outside with a fairly big logo plastered on it. Don't care for the placement of the logo and the design.

product_title: Munchkin Traveling Flash Cards
review_headline: Great learning tool kids will love
review_body: My daughter LOVES these flashcards. The letters are large and pictures are simple which makes learning easy and I love that it includes numbers, shapes and colors as well. My only real complaint is that I was expecting the cards to be more durable but they are like a laminated card stock (I was expecting board book style) and a few pages are already looking worn and it's not a toy I would just leave out for her to play with until she is older and knows to be more gentle. Other than that I love it and even then it's not a huge deal, just not what I was expecting.

product_title: Magnifying Desk Lamp Gooseneck Magnifier Light 5X
review_body: first, it is not 5x magnification, maybe 2x. second, 15x lens is useless, you can't see anything through it.  there are no \\"crystal clear glass\\" only uneven plastic, it can't even use as toy. this company know people will return it if they don't charge you high shipping. I don't want pay shipping again, I just trash it. this is the worst thing I got from Amazon. Amazon shouldn't allow this kind of company cheating people here.

product_title: Motorola Additional Camera for Motorola MBP33 and MBP36 Baby Monitor,Brown with White
review_body: I was a little bit worried about buying a used camera as an extra camera for the Motorola MBP36 that we purchased, but we went ahead. Whenever the video unit of the MBP36 was working, this camera did exactly as it was supposed to and worked just as well as the new camera that came with the baby video monitor.  It's easy to pair with the video unit.  The only downside is that if you are scanning a fairly long room, the image is transmitted somewhat at an angle - sidewise on the one end, and the other orientation of sideways on the other end.

product_title: Boppy Organic Cotton Slipcover, Forest (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This Boppy cover is nice, if you never plan on cleaning it before letting your child use it. Even though we followed the washing instructions on 2 seperate covers, each one bled and makes the boppy cover look horrible. For the money, you'd think they'd be better quality.

product_title: Safety 1st Alpha Omega Elite Convertible Car Seat
review_headline: Good seat, but big and won't work on a plan
review_body: Love this seat for my 1yo, but although it is airplane safety approved, the non-removable armrests make it too wide for an airplane seat. Also, it is very tall and takes up a lot of room rear-facing. Would not do well rear-facing in a small car, though it fits fine in my minivan

product_title: phil&teds Lobster Highchair
review_body: We bought the Lobster highchair when we first started taking our older baby out to eat and found the highchairs at restaurants dirty and with broken buckles.  We absolutely LOVE this highchair! It is convenient, small enough that it isn't a pain to carry around or throw into the stroller, extremely durable, and our favorite part is the tray! We have also been using the highchair on picnic tables at parks since our active toddler refuses to stop playing to eat (the only way is to strap him in!).  Would recommend this to anyone looking for a good quality, portable highchair!

product_title: The First Years Ignite Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I have the First Years Ignite stroller in Black Stripe. My goal was to find a reasonably inexpensive, lightweight umbrella stroller that didn't sacrifice safety and comfortability, had a weight limit of at least up to 50lbs, and had some sort of recline. When I say inexpensive, I mean that I wanted to spend less than $75. I had bought the Lamaze LS 50 Lightweight stroller, which seems to be very similar to First Years Jet stroller model. But when I had my \\"almost\\" 3yr old toddler, weighing in at 31.5lbs and height of 35\\", sit in the stroller.. it was just no good! There's no back support frame on the Lamaze LS 50 or Jet. He was totally slouching and looked cramped in the seat, little to no room width-wise. My son is barely 3ft and his head was way above the top of the seat. There was no way I could keep it, he'd grow out of it in less than a month. I returned it the next day. I saw pictures from reviewers that compared the Jet and Ignite... I saw the back support frame for the seat, that it measured wider and taller... and I decided to order it! I am SO glad I did.

PROs
- Easy to assemble, snap on wheels and canopy
- Reasonably lightweight at 14lbs. I previously owned a 2009 Uppbaby G-Luxe umbrella stroller which was light at 11lbs.
- Wheels look sturdy, easy on/off brakes, easy front wheel locks
- Easy to recline
- Easy to fold/unfold
- TALLER, WIDER seat with BACK SUPPORT frame!!!
- Convenient parent console

CONs
- I've read other reviews about mesh side pockets, mine did not come with these.
- No handle or strap for carrying the stroller when folded. However, you can easily lift/carry the stroller using the back frame.
- No extended canopy but for the price, not really a problem. You want all these things, you need to pay more for it.
- Canopy doesn't adjust like the Jet

HOPE THIS HELPS YOUR STROLLER SEARCH :)

product_title: Munchkin Easy-Close Metal Gate, White
review_body: I have to say is a very good quality gate. Sturdy, neat looking & easy to install. I use it for the dogs & it does the work.

product_title: Boon Flair Pedestal Highchair with Pneumatic Lift
review_body:
Ever since I saw this chair being used at my daughter's daycare I did not want any other chair.

After buying it from a local store I still stand by the chair as it is such a visually pleasing, space-saving, use-anywhere chair. However the workmanship on this chair leaves a lot to be desired:

--We had to return our first chair because the brake simply did not work. After calling the customer service the rep immediately knew what the problem was (most likely a known issue) and offered to send me a brake latch which was on backorder for a month at the time.

--Not wanting to wait another month we exchanged the chair at our local store. The brake on the new chair worked better (after some tinkering from my engineer husband), however the new chair wobbled a lot more than the last one, probably due to a poor fit of the pole to the base.

Note on returning: if you don't want to take the chair apart and put the pieces back in the box it would be nearly impossible to fit BOTH the assembled chair AND the box into a regular sized SUV. Luckily our local store was nice enough to ask us to leave the box at home.

--We decided to keep the second chair because as much as it wobbles it does not seem that it would topple just yet. We also noticed that some of the same chairs at the daycare also wobble, or the braking or pneumatic system don't work perfectly. We did not want to go through the hassle of exchanging it again for a possibly imperfect item.

product_title: Disney Rapunzel 4 Piece Toddler Set, Purple (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased for my granddaughter and the sheets are very soft and the set is of a higher quality than some others out there. Having a fitted top sheet would have been nicer. Yes I would recommend this.

product_title: Playtex 3 Pack BPA Free VentAire Wide Bottles
review_body:
The design of this bottle is unusual. The air vents from the bottom of the bottle, which would lead you to think the bottle would leak from the bottom, but it hasn't so far. The VentAire system is interesting, and I am surprised at how well it works - when it works.

This bottle is very picky, when it works it works great, but there are a couple of situations where this bottle has issues. The bottom of the screw cap and the latex vent disk must be 100% dry for the bottle to work. If the vent disk or screw cap are the slightest bit wet, it will create a suction and the air will not vent properly. This will cause air to come in from the nipple, defeating the purpose of this bottle. Also, if you are using a bottle warmer these bottles won't work. I have [[ASIN:B00005BXKM The First Years Babypro Quick Serve Bottle Warmer]], which uses steam to warm the bottle, and it does not work with this type of bottle. The steam gets the vent disk wet, which renders the system useless.

While these bottles work great under ideal circumstances, I can't recommend them. For me, sometimes I need to warm a bottle and sometimes I haven't had time to wash ahead of time. I don't want a bottle that won't work if I'm trying to wash it right before I need to use it. Sometimes you get busy with a baby and with everything else you have to worry about as a new parent, who wants to add making sure you wash the bottles early enough to make sure they are completely dry?
