product_title: Graco Lauren Dressing Table, Espresso (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Love this changing table, the price is unbelievable compared to other tables and this one is actually higher priced on other sites....so happy with this purchase and it arrived fast!

product_title: Green Floral Nursing Cover
review_body: I love this nursing cover but wish it was a little easier to manuver on my small frame.  Overall I would recommend it for comfort and privacy.

product_title: oogaa Silicone Placemat
review_headline: Great Placemat for School - Perfect Toddler Size
review_body:
My 2-year-old is supposed to take a placemat to school every day, and I ordered 5 trying to decide which one was best. In the end, I decided on this one for a few reasons...

1. It's easy to clean.
2. It's foldable, so it fits in whatever lunchbox she is carrying.
3. It's really cute, so it won't get confused with the others'.
4. It's small enough to fit in her toddler size lunchboxes.
5. It seems durable - though we've only used it for a few weeks now.

It does not \\"stick\\" to the table like some placemats, so it's not for kids who are throwing their food/trays everywhere. But it's great for a toddler who is just learning the difference between her plate and everyone else's.

product_title: Graco Pack N Play Playard with Bassinet
review_headline: Don't wait too long to set it up!
review_body: I love this pack and play. My twins play under the arch and love it. My only regret is that we thought it was for older babies and waited until they were 6 months to put it together. Two of them barely fit in it side by side, and I think after another month, we'll take the bassinet down. I wish that we had put it together sooner. I can see it working out really well as a bed to put in the parents room during nights when the babies are particularly fussy or need extra attention or feedings (our babies sleep through the night since 3 months so don't need to be in our room). Easy to assemble. Anyhow, highly recommend!

product_title: Bearington Baby Lil' Waggles Puppy Dog Plush Ring Rattle (Blue) 5.5"
review_headline: It matches the rest of the collection...
review_body:
I got this rattle as a gift to go with the rest of the Waggles- lovee, snuggler, towel, and bib.
The hole was too small to fit around even a newborn's wrist, but to big for him to grasp. The rattle made an unpleasant sound. This is my least favorite item of this collection.

product_title: Withings Smart Baby Monitor, White
review_headline: Piece of Junk for the Money!
review_body: When you read all of the features this thing has one can only get excited about it.  Buyer beware, this thing is constantly failing.  The video always freezes and half the time the whole connection fails so I can't even hear my daughter.  I even spent the time and money moving my router around in the house so I could hardwire the monitor directly to the Internet.  The connection has gotten a little better but still fails.  I understand that sometimes connections get interrupted the worst part for me is the app has never successfully reconnected on its own.  I can't tell you how many times I have woken up only to find the monitor not actually working.  If the connection is lost the app shouldn't stop until it reconnects and if it goes 5 minutes without being able to reconnect it should alert me saying \\"I am a piece of junk, i lost the connection and can't get it back.  Please quit the app and reconnect.\\"

product_title: YOUR BABY CAN SWIM! (TM) Inflatable Learner Swim Float/Swimming Float Neck Collar
review_body: Why are you people buying this for your babies I don't think this is safe. You should not strap your child into this by their neck and let them float around. Your all HORRIBLE parents.

product_title: Joovy Caboose Stand On Tandem Stroller
review_body: This is an awesome stroller. One of the sturdiest ones I've had! Smooth riding and turns on a dime! The only complaint I have is the net underneath to hold the diaper bag is pretty small. I had to shove and I do mean SHOVE  my diaper bag down in it, and NOTHING else will fit under there.  I also think it should have come with a parent tray or something similar to hang on the handle. Other than that this is a really nice very sturdy  stroller. Plenty of room for the kiddos. :-) The Appletree color is very nice as well.

product_title: Nuby 4-Pack Diaper Pins, Colors May Vary
review_headline: These pins are fine but not as sturdy as I'd hoped
review_body: These are ok pins, but the metal isn't as thick and sturdy as other pins I've seen.  I use a snappi now instead of diaper pins and they work fine.  I do use these pins though to pin a Gerber cloth diaper around my baby's neck to use as a big.  Works great!

product_title: Duktig 14-piece Vegetables Set
review_body: This is a quiet toy that held my baby's attention from a young age. As soon as she learned to grasp things, she was interested in these bright colored veggies. The lettuce leaves velcro off, which will be good to play with when she gets older.

product_title: Carter's Diaper Bag Set - Black/Sage
review_body: I BECAME THE GREATEST GOD DAD IN THE WORLD WITH THIS PURCHASE!!! LOTS OF ROOM AND IT LOOKS GREAT :)

product_title: Clevamama Splash and Wrap Baby Bath Towel
review_headline: Perfect for Washing Newborns and Very Young Toddlers
review_body: My grandnephew is very, very squirmy, especially when he's taken out of the bath. We would kid my niece and nephew about the fact that they get more water on themselves than on my grandnephew. The beauty of this towel is that the bather stays dry while the baby gets his bath, and the towel is so designed that one can keep a firm grip on the child as he's lifted out of the bath. Ny niece fell so much in love with this towel that she went out and bought about seven more. She calls it the perfect towel when dealing with my grandnephew.

product_title: FridaBaby NoseFrida The SnotSucker Nasal Aspirator
review_body:
I've used the bulb, a battery powered aspirator, and the nose frida. This is the only one that has gotten the job done.

As far as getting sick, I've used the Nose Frida through 5 colds. Not once did I catch what he had. And even if I would have, I figure it's just part of being a mom. My chances of catching what he has with using the frida, are just the same if I didn't. Because when he's sick I spend even more time with him giving him extra kisses and snuggles. It's kind of one of the downsides to being a parent. They come first, you do what you gotta do to get the job done, and this get's the job done.

The cuts on the nose. Again, not one scratch, cut or bloody nose from the nose frida.

It's just like with any other product. There are going to be people out there that don't know how to use it or are using it wrong. There are videos out there how to use this properly. Google is your friend.

Now he does hate when I use it; he hates anything up his nose; so it wouldn't matter what it was. So he does wiggle and arch his back and try everything to get away from it, but I haven't had an issue with restraining him by myself and using it by myself.

product_title: BabyKicks 3 Pack Joey Bunz
review_body: These absorb so much! More and more as you wash. I use these as inserts in my AIOs for nighttime and my baby boy sleeps like a...baby for about 8 hours before I need to change him!

product_title: Alex Toys Talk Of The Tub
review_body: Wanted a toy for the bath that made noises which is why I choose to purchase this simple toy.  Battery died after only a few weeks of use. Waterproofing is compromised once the back is opened to replace. Would not recommend purchasing.  Was just on ok item.

product_title: Sassy Crib and Floor Mirror
review_body: This mirror scratches easily.  IF she hits it with a toy it's scratched. We've had it maybe 3 weeks and it's really scratched up. It has only sit on the floor on her toy pad to play with. I have not tried on the crib yet.  However it does not sit on floor well either.  It won't stay open therefore upright. I don't think I'd get this again but since we have it it'll do. Yes she does love to look at herself, but any mirror would do.  Try the Dollar store instead. It doesn't have to be fancy. They don't care about the toys just them self :)

product_title: Safety 1St Smart Rewards Potty
review_body:
I recently purchased this potty for my 3 1/2 year-old grandson. Because of his PDD (mild autism)he has been very uninterested in potty training & resisted even trying to use the other potty chairs his parents tried - and absolutely hated sitting on the padded potty seat that sits on the big toilet!
After he was introduced to his new \\"Smart Rewards Potty\\" - suddenly all the \\"dry runs\\" turned into actual success!
It was so good to see him make the connection with the music & \\"You Did It\\" !!! Letting him help dump the removable reservoir, hear the music, pretend to flush and place the sticker on the chart - finally is working! While he is still not totally trained yet - we can see the light at the end of the tunnel.
This is a good choice for any child - especially those with a developmental delay who haven't caught on to other methods!

product_title: KidCo G22 White Safeway Angle Mount
review_headline: Hard to intall, but definitely worth the effort
review_body:
This gate is perfect for an angle-mount situation at the top of the stairs. The adjustable stop-pin on the latching side allows for flexibility with setting the gate correctly. It is extremely sturdy and can be easily opened/closed with a single hand.

The only down-side is the intallation. For one who is not technically inclined, the gate was difficult to install. The instructions were challenging to follow, and we ended up assembling somewhat by \\"guess and test\\" following the illustrations.

On the whole, once installation was complete, I was highly satisfied with this gate. Aside from installation, I would highly recommend this gate and purchase it again for myself.

product_title: Sugar Booger Sippy Cup
review_headline: Super cute, not for a baby learing to drink from a cup
review_body: I got two of these because they are so cute. My 8 month old is really interested in drinking from a cup, and likes to hold it (and bang it around). I let him at this one, and immediately he flipped it over (half of the water all over the floor as there's no valve) and then got hold of the top and easily pulled it off (the rest of the water all over me and him and the floor). I'll put them away until he's older, as they are really really cute, but not for a baby learning to take a cup.

product_title: Sun Moon Stars Die Cut Purple Wallpaper Border
review_body: We ordered this boarder for our nursery and it is everything we wanted. The boarder itself is beautiful and even though the instructions were a little confusing, it was incredibly easy to apply. The instructions could have been more detailed because it took several tries to get it up but once we figured it out, it was SO simple! Also love that it peels right off so when it comes time to move to a new home, we don't have to worry about a messy removal. Absolutely recommend this product.

product_title: Carter's Butterfly Flowers Basket with Liner, Pink/Choc, 5.5 X 12" (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The basket came with a liner with Carters tag on it. Looks good, was well packed and is just as described!

product_title: Munchkin Sesame Street Re-Usable Twist Tight Spill-Proof Cups, 10 Ounce, Colors May Vary
review_body: The twist top is great for avoiding spills, and my grandson loves his Elmo cups.  He uses one for milk, one for juice, and one for water.

product_title: Edu-Tiles
review_body: This mat should be avoided if you have a baby that puts everything in their mouth.  It has way too many small pieces.  I don't feel comfortable letting my 7 month old on it anymore since she has figured out how to get them out and likes to chew on them.  I'm pretty sure the same company makes solid tiles and ones with bigger one piece puzzles like numbers or letters.  I would highly recommend those because they do provide a great surface for your baby to sit and play on and they are easy to clean, especially for all those spit-ups that tend to happen.  This specific one just isn't practical for babies because of all the small pieces.

product_title: Vicks SpeedRead Thermometer V912F-24 1 Each
review_body:
This product is very fast (a few seconds) and appears to be accurate with temperatures, and has a large and very easy to read screen with color coded lights for normal / abnormal temperatures which allows near-instant feedback. However, today I found that the battery is dead after ~5 months of purchase. This is really disappointing since I'm currently ill and need to take my temp. Fortunately I have a backup thermometer, but I'd sure like to be using this one because my backup takes 2 minutes to produce the temp. -4 Stars for absurd battery life issue. If I can't count on this device to take my temperature WHEN I NEED TO TAKE IT, it's worthless.

If you are going to order this device, I'd recommend ordering a 5 pack of Energizer CR1225 3V Lithium batteries (which are about 5 bucks) to go with it, because you will lose your battery life at around 6 months.

Another note, I literally only used this thermometer ONCE before the battery died. There's no excuse for that kind of disappointing situation. My cheapo LCD backup thermometer has been chugging right along for the 7 years I've owned it on the original battery with no signs of giving out.

...In fact, if you're going to order this thermometer you might just want to order a second thermometer of a different brand as a backup...

product_title: Carter's Forest Friends Valance, Tan/Choc, 60 X 14"
review_body: This valance is very well made with big sewn on animal prints and heavy material.  Looks good with the matching crib blanket and wall stickers.

product_title: Blueberry One Size Deluxe Hook/loop, Gi
review_body: I needed more velcro diapers for my son that my mom could use and husband and these are great. the velcro is great and strong much better then other diapers. I will definitely be buying more of these.

product_title: Safety 1st Side By Side Cabinet Lock, 2-Count
review_body: [[VIDEOID:mo2MYVBEQJ3CS49]]I installed these on our bathroom cabinet doors, and like other reviewers, I found them a bit challenging to unlock in the intended way, but that's the point right?  Then my kid just yanked on the doors really hard and it popped right open.  I made sure the locks were totally engaged and got the camera rolling.  You can see the results--useless.

product_title: Baby Bottle Holder for Hands Free Bottle Feeding by Bebe Bottle Sling, LLC
review_headline: One of the best baby items
review_body: I wish I would have had one of these for my oldest daughter.  This item is great and very helpful.  I am able to feed my baby while doing other activities such as making breakfast for my other child.  It is cute and durable.  Whenever I go out and people see it they always say that they wished they had one.  This item is a definite top 10 baby shower registry items.  Buy it and you won't be disappointed.

product_title: YummiTummi Organic Baby Choco Butter, with Calendula, 3.3oz
review_body: I have been using Sweetsation Therapy products for my children for several years now.  I also use their Choco Smooch lip and face balm, Sun'n'Fun sunscreen and Sun'n'Berry sunscreen.  My children and I love all of them. My daughters love the smell.  All the products I have tried are easily to apply and are packaged well.  I love this company, hope they start shipping on Amazon Prime or Subscribe and Save.

product_title: Summer Infant Playsafe Playard
review_body:
Since all of the puppy play pens appeared to be too low, flimsy, or chewable, I went with a children's babygate instead. Ridiculously easy to set up, open, close, carry with the strap, remove panels, etc. I used mine to make a safe area for my 4 lb dog, who is a jumper and a chewer, and he cannot even come close to jumping out, tipping it over, or chewing through it. And he likes it because he can easily see us through the holes, unlike some solid panel dog playpens.

Note - When using only 5 or 4 panels, it is more wobbly than 3 or all 6, hence the 4 stars instead of 5. Place something on the inside corner, like a doggy crate, or outside corner (place in the corner of a room so the walls are against two sides) to brace it.

product_title: Bright Starts Bounce-a-Bout Activity Center (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Hard for four month old to stand in.
review_body:
Our son is four months old, he is 24'' long but even on the shortest setting his feet don't touch the pad on the bottom, I think this is due to the leg holes in the seat being too far out in front, they're not straight down, so baby is sitting too much. I don't think this will be a problem when he is a little older and a little taller.

The height setting is in the seat, two buckle straps on the bottom, which is alright now but I'm worried the seat won't be deep enough when it's on the highest setting when he is taller.

The pad doesn't have much bounce to it, it has some but it's not enough to really call this a bouncer.

Overall, It's okay. I wouldn't buy it again or recommend it to a friend but it will work and hopefully he will enjoy it more when he's a little older.

product_title: Nuby Replacement Nets for the Nibbler
review_body: These are a great option for renewing the life of the Nibbler. My son loves to feed himself fresh fruits and soft veggies in the Nibbler, but things like bananas and pears stain the nets after use.  I soak them in water and clean them well, but they remain a brownish tint. I saw some people saying to soak the nets in clorox or oxyclean, but I can't do that in good conscious when my son is then going to suck on these...too many chemicals!! These replacements are a great option instead; I just toss the old ones after a handful of uses and start fresh!

product_title: Cloud b On The Go Travel Sound Machine Soother
review_headline: Great for car seat BUT NO continuous play!
review_body:
I would give this 5 stars except that it doesn't have a continuous play option! Why on earth would they make a sound machine to get babies to sleep and then turn it off after 23 or 45 minutes? Are they trying to make parents of newborns go crazy? The goal is to get our baby to sleep, not wake them up and once the sheep turns off!,,

It's great otherwise and love that it is small and on the go. I like the rain the best but wish they had a white noise sound as well.

product_title: JJ Cole Paisley Feeding & Nursing Pillow
review_body: I really have enjoyed using the Paisley Nursing/Feeding Pillow.  It's nice and firm.  It also sits up higher than my other nursing pillow (Boppy) - which is a super nice feature to have.  I feel the Boppy pillow isn't firm enough and leaves me slouching.  My only complaint is that I have to sit upright while using the Paisley, it won't let me recline back comfortably and still reach it.

product_title: Medela Disposable Nursing Bra Pads, 60 Count
review_body: I received a sample of these nursing pads. They were reasonably absorbent, but felt terrible! They sounded and felt like I had a piece of wrapping paper in my bra. I'm glad it was just a sample and I hadn't spent any money on a whole box.

product_title: Boppy Prenatal Total Body Pillow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
If you are pregnant and thinking about getting a body pillow like this, just do it. You need it and it really helps to make you comfortable sleeping and resting.

This model can be used in bed or on the couch to prop up your head or your feet after a days work.

The only downside is the pillow cushioning in the middle is not very substantial. There isn't much support for your belly here; but still provides some support. I'd suggest going out to a store to take a real life look at these pillows before ordering on online.

Oh, another downside...it takes up more bedspace and is a little awkward when you have to turn over and take the pillow with you. I've smacked my husband in the face with it-although thankfully he doesn't wake up. However, whomever you share the bed with will slowly be pushed further and further off. This could be a good or bad thing...

Overall, I give this pillow 3 stars. Great support for hips, legs, and to feet. Not so great to support your growing belly when side sleeping.

product_title: Hendelman & Co. Designs Baby Walker - Learn how to walk assistant Gift, Baby, NewBorn, Child
review_body: My daughter loved the product. is great to train the way you walk, you can not back pain and the child is not with his hands up. she is in the correct position for walking

product_title: OXO Tot Fork and Spoon Set
review_body:
Perfect size.
Handle: The handle is big enough for my little boy to hold onto and learn control. Others I've seen have had smaller handles that wouldn't work for his little learning hands.
Fork: Some reviews say that the prongs on the fork aren't sharp enough to stab things but this wasn't true for our purposes. They worked fine for his pancakes, fruit and noodles. That's the type of stuff he uses the fork for. But not so sharp that they poke his eye out if they come near it or something.
Spoon: I also like the size of the spoon because he can feel it in his mouth and when he needs to stop because it's getting too close to his throat. I can only assume this is what is happening because he used to choke himself on the other spoon he had but we haven't had any problems with this one at all.

product_title: Ju-Ju-Be BeNeat Bib
review_body: I haven't used this yet bc I'm still pregnant but I love the pattern and it seems very sturdy and well made.

product_title: Toddler Bed Sheet Set 100% Cotton 3 Piece Set Color: White
review_body: These sheets are great, and I love how the top sheet has elastic at the bottom to keep it tucked in.  I do, however, wish that the top sheet was wider. My 2-year-old rolls around a lot, so he'll roll one way and pull the sheet a little and then when he rolls back again the sheet is no longer covering him.  But, at least he's old enough to fix it himself, so it hasn't been too big of an issue.  The pillow case works great with the toddler pillow we got, too.

product_title: Boppy Prenatal Sleep Wedge (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I ordered the boppy prenatal sleep wedge after reading all of the great reviews, and I must say I agree. It's small and light weight and but gives my belly the support it needs. I am so thankful I ordered this and while I am considering graduating to a full body pillow, I still intend on using the wedge throughout the rest of my pregnancy.

product_title: Obersee Kid's All-in-One Pre-School Backpacks with Integrated Cooler
review_body: I purchased this backpack for my son (he is 4 1/2) and it is perfect!  I wanted to get him a backpack that would be smaller than a normal sized backpack but big enough for him to be able to use for a while.  This is the perfect size!  I highly recommend this product!

product_title: Kidkusion Kid Safe Banister Guard
review_body: I got this to help protect my toddler in our new house that has banisters on the 2nd story hall.  It works fine, but definitely doesn't blend in like I had hoped.  It was difficult to put up neatly/ straight and the plastic is sharp where we needed to cut it.  Still, if it keeps the baby from falling two stories, any cosmetic issues of it being a bit off is worth it.  I like my house clean and my toddler tends to \\"Slimmer\\" the plastic.  I likely would have gotten mesh just to not see that, although it does wipe somewhat clean.

product_title: OXO Tot Perch Foldable Booster Seat for Big Kids
review_headline: great for children, good for cleaning, good for travel - good product
review_body:
This booster seat is made of plastic that folds down (in half) for easy storage and to make it convenient to carry the booster seat with you when traveling (visiting restaurants, grandparents, etc).

I have the lime green seat, and the green part itself is soft but not too squeeshy.

The seat provides a nice back support, and has little non-slider pads at the bottom to ensure that the booster seat doesn't slide on the chair. It works on wooden chairs, plastic chairs, and suede chairs.

The material on both the cushion and the plastic are easily washable, thus making it great for spillage.

product_title: Chicco Polly Highchair Double-Pad Fabric Bella - Chicco 00063803490070
review_body: I love this high chair.  We bought a wooden high chair for my daughter before she was born.  She continually was able to get out of it and it was extremely difficult to clean.  The trays make cleaning a breeze.  Storing is also super simple.  Assembly was easy enough for my six year old to do.  Overall this has been the best high chair I have ever used.

product_title: Levana LV-TW502 Safe N' See Advanced 3.5-Inch Digital Video Wireless Baby Monitor with Talk to Baby Intercom and Remote Controlled Lullabies (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Works well but not for long!
review_body:
I bought this monitor less than 2 months ago and was very pleased with it up until a couple of nights ago when i woke up and noticed it was no longer on! The battery doesn't last very long so we have to keep it plugged up while we sleep. We had it plugged up as always and it still managed to die. After recharging it we noticed that there is a short where the charger plugs in at! I found out about the 1 year warranty through the Levana site so I am going to try and get it replaced.

Other than that, the camera works better than I imagined, the sound is great and there is no outside static or no problems with picking up cell phone conversations like I've heard about some of the competitors. Another thing is the temperature. The temperature feature only works when the camera is not charging. When the camera is on the charger the temperature reads 80 degrees the whole time. The batteries in the camera didn't last long either so we keep it plugged up as well.

One of my favorite features is the alert system. If the camera is not plugged up and dies, the monitor will beep until you turn it off so you know that the camera is no longer on! The voice activation and motion censor works well also.

Overall, I would still recommend this product, but we will see what I say once I get the second monitor. Hopefully this wont happen every time.

It has now been a while since i recieved my replacement and so far so good! I have since bought an additional camera which works well. The only problem i now have is the auto-switch feature between the cameras shuts off on its own. I'm not sure if that is the plan or a glitch though. I do not want to go through reordering another though so i manage. also shipping was a lot faster than anticipated through the Levana website, and great customer service too!

product_title: Kids Line Cascade Bow Diaper Bag
review_headline: Beautiful bag! I get lots of comments!
review_body: All of my mama friends love my bag! It's super chic and doesn't look like a traditional diaper bag. It's BIG enough to carry my personal items as well as my toddlers. I love this bag so much I just purchased it for a friend who has two children. It has more than enough space for everything. I love the blush color, so classy!

product_title: Motorola Digital Video Baby Monitor with Room Temperature Thermometer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: the monitor died on us just now. I started using this in November 2011. 7 months later the monitor no longer works. Motorola's website product support page does not even list this model when queried.

product_title: Graco Duoglider LX Stroller, Wilshire (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Put it together with the help of my toddler. It is big, yes, but what double stroller isn't? Folds and unfolds easily but I don't like that when folded, it rests on the front food tray instead of something more fitting of the job. It rolls smoother than my single stroller because it has real tires instead of plastic ones. If you are using a carseat in the back, don't plan on using the basket underneath because you can't get to it while the back seat is fully reclined. Also, we have a Snugride 35 and it overhangs just a little into the front seat's head room so if my oldest leans back, he hits his head on the carseat behind him. Overall though, small issues, I think. I like the stroller and would recommend.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Classic Polypropylene Bottle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These bottles are simple to use. They have few parts compared to most other bottles. They do not leak if you use them correctly. Put the ring directly in the bottle, then screw on the nipple and cap. Simple, and few parts to wash. My baby adjusted to bottles very easily with these.

product_title: The First Years Expandable Swing Gate
review_headline: Ok for the price but technical flaws
review_body: Ok for the Price but major technical flaws, the top of the gate has three white Plastic pieces which slides one over the other when the gate is pulled out or folded in when open, these plastic pieces get stuck on each other and makes it very hard to pull out the gate to close or fold in when open. I had to finally cut those plastic pieces and throw them away to make it usable

product_title: Evenflo Amp Lx No Back Booster Car Seat
review_body: Only complaint is my child's leg often goes to sleep on long rides. It could use some addition padding. I sure would to ride in it for more that a couple of hours.

product_title: Jeep Liberty Limited All Terrain 3 Wheel Stroller - Galaxy
review_body:
I bought this b/c it worked with any type of car seat. I got the teal to match the graco infant car seat I got in grey and teal. It looks like it was a travel system bought together. Loved using it with the car seat. So easy to place it in and buckle with the strap provided. The cover was great and with the car seat shade, provides complete protection for your infant from the weather. I have never had an issue with the tires except needing to put more air in them. It has lots of storage space both in front and behind the seat. I love the space for adult drinks, and the speaker function for walks (I actually disconnected it from the stroller and use it inside my daughters room for her lullabies).

This stroller travels well on all surfaces. Obviously becomes harder to push on sand but is not extremely difficult and moves nicely through grass, rocks, brush, uneven pavement, etc . . .)

My only 2 issues with it are that the straps did not adjust small enough for my 30th% weight girl. They would slip off her even tightened as much as possible but I didn't want to make her ride in the car seat just for walks after she was around 6-7 months old. She wanted to look at everything. My solution was to get something on the back to pull the straps and clip them together at the point of entry to the other side once my daughter buckled in so they would stay tight. It worked well.

Issue # 2, the belly bar is a little high and far away from my 14month daughter even when the seat is adjusted all the way up. She has to grab on and pull herself forward to get her snacks. I'm sure this won't be a problem too much longer though as she gets bigger.

All in all I love this stroller and plan to use it as my daughter or other children get older.

product_title: Evenflo TruVent 3 Pack Angled Bottle
review_body: These are one of the few bottles our daughter would drink from after breast feeding for 6 months. I bought a lot of different ones but she couldn't figure out where to place her tongue. I bought these and she did a little better, however, the breast flow by the first year was her favorite. After about a couple weeks of use with warming up her bottles in a nice bottle warmer these would crack. Thought it was a fluke thing but after about  four I was tired of dealing with wasting my breastmilk. Not only did they crack with the bottle warmer but even under warm water from the sink.

product_title: Graco Jump N Jive Doorway Jumper with Interactive Musical Mat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son is five months old and roughly 22 lbs and he LOVES this jumper. he has numerous stationary jumpers but this one takes the cake. the reason i deducted a star was because its on the highest setting and he still hangs low. not meant for really chunky babies.

product_title: The First Years Ignite Stroller, City Chic (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
We live in a 5th floor walk-up so we had to ditch out our old (very heavy) Graco stroller. I wanted a lightweight stroller that didn't leave me broke. My husband put this together in like 3 mins. My son fits in just fine (he's 28lbs and 31\\" tall) the handles are very comfortable for me (I'm 5'1\\")and for hubby(he's 6'1\\"). The issues I have with it are these: I wish it would recline a little more and the pull tab on the back not be so hard to set. Also the criss-cross frame in back makes it hard to access storage on bottom, so I have to stuff everything in through the side. I carry the diaper bag over the handles because it's easier.
Still, I really do like this stroller very much. The price was excellent and it does the job it was meant for.

product_title: Brica Deluxe Snack Pod Stroller Drink and Snack Holder
review_body: We liked the idea of this snack pod, but in practice it just isn't great for a toddler (under 2) who wants to control his environment and pull the pod off the stroller. We may use it when he is older with his car seat if he is ever allowed to eat while we drive.

product_title: Fisher-Price Luv U Zoo Jumperoo
review_body: Love the jumper! My baby is 7 months old and I purchased it when she was 4 months old. She couldn't touch the ground until recently so we would put up something cushy for her to jump on. The doctor advised that we not put her in there longer than 10 minutes at a time until she was able to pull herself up on her own since up to that time babies use the tips of their feet to push and are not flat footed. I would definately buy this again, although I really don't understand why there is a snack tray on it. Who would put snacks on something that jumps around? All in all 5 stars.

product_title: CoCaLo 8 Piece Crib Set, Snickerdoodle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Absolutly love the bedding! It's exactly what I was looking for.

However, there seriously needs to be more info in the description. I had no idea what 8 pieces I was getting!

product_title: Symphony 65 E3 Convertible Car Seat
review_body:
I use this seat for my 17 month old rear facing.
pros:
-The latch system connectors are the easiest to use of any car seat I've ever installed
-seat is roomy and comfortable, my son likes it
- the harness slides up and down at the shoulders so you don't have to rethread the harness as the child growns and the fit can always be perfect for your child (right at shoulders i mean)
-the head rest and protection slides up and down to where your child's head is
- seat fit fairly easily in our 2010 toyota corolla

cons
- my son gets motion sickness and this seat is near impossible to clean. the smell lingers and there are a ton of hard to clean crevices
- the foam pieces on the sides of child's legs are a joke. if you take the cover off, they are not attached, and one of the ones on mine broke in two pieces.
We are looking into replacing it with something better, but it's not a bad seat- not right for us though.

product_title: FridaBaby NoseFrida The SnotSucker Nasal Aspirator
review_headline: Baby hates it, but mommy loves it!
review_body: This product is a million times better and safer than any bulb syringe. I just spray a little saline up baby's nose, wait a few seconds, then suck out the offending boogers/snot. I was AMAZED what came out of my 3 month old's nose the first time I did this...he can breathe again, and therefore he can nurse again! And although it seems like a gross idea, it's actually not. The boogers/snot never traveled very far up the tube at all. I've used it dozens of times and never had to replace the filter yet. I see this product as a must-have for all new parents. I have 2 baby showers to go to this month, and guess what they're both getting???

product_title: Bright Starts Petals and Friends Activity Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I ordered this item because it was one of the cheaper mats that had decent reviews.  My 8 week old daughter loves it.  It's the only thing that can keep her attention.  My only complaint is that the mirror is distorted and not an actual mirror for her to see herself.  We will probably invest in a nicer one for when she gets older but for now this does the trick.

product_title: Safety 1st 36 Pack Secure Press Plug Protectors
review_body:
They worked when baby wasn't interested what's in the electrical outlets. 17 months old started to bring me these the first day he \\"found\\" them.

I also use Mommy's Helper Outlet Plugs:
http://www.amazon.com/Mommys-Helper-Outlet-Plugs-Pack/dp/B00081J3N6/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1339033291&sr=8-1

and they were tight from the start and it takes a bit to push them in and out for adult. They are much better and I can highly recommend them. Until the kids are better in using tool, but than they hopefully will understand the safety issues.

product_title: Munchkin Multi Bowl
review_headline: just what I was looking for
review_body: I used these in a package that included snacks (popcorn)as a gift for college bound students.  These bowls are colorful and will not break easily.  They are just what I wanted.

product_title: J.I.P. Photo Print Bib
review_body: The ballet shoes bib is accurately shown in the online pictures and is exactly what I expected. It is large and will cover a lot of area and it's perfect for the little girl I purchased it for. It was delivered in good time. I'd order more if I needed them.

product_title: HALO SleepSack Micro-Fleece Swaddle
review_body: This is great for soothing newborns. It definitely prevents them from scratching their cute little face. This one is better for winter time. Our daughter gets a tad hot in the fleece, so we undress her before putting her into this sleep sack at night. Very cute pattern!

product_title: Protect-a-Bub Deluxe 3-in-1 Sunshade - Single - Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great full shade for umbrella strollers
review_body: I bought this for our Disney vacation to use on our lightweight Chicco umbrella stroller, and I couldn't have imagined our trip without it!  I love that there are three coverage options -- we mainly used the partial shade, because it covered my 13 month old to her ankles and still allowed her to see most of the sights.  She wasn't as happy with the full mosquito netting shade, so I didn't use it often.  But, the partial shade was a lifesaver in getting her to settle for a nap without being too distracted by all of the people and the noise.  I frequently reapplied sunscreen, but that coupled with the shade allowed me to not worry about too much sun exposure even through 10 hours a day in the hot Florida sun.  It attached to the Chicco very well, as long as we pulled the shade taught and tied the strings tight.  So many people in the parks commented on how they wish they had thought to buy one before their vacation!  I gave four stars because the black really can get steamy underneath -- it would be nice to have a more reflective surface to keep some of the heat out.  But, we also used a small stroller fan, which kept the inside cool.  I read so many reviews of other stroller shades before purchasing this one, and I'm really happy with it!

product_title: BSF Baby Austin Convertible Crib 'n Changer Combo, Espresso
review_body:
I like this crib, it looks very good in my son's room. The color is a nice dark espresso, as pictured.

It arrived quickly and with all the necessary pieces. Should be able to use this for many years to come.

product_title: Evenflo Zoo Friends Bottle - 8 oz - 3 pk
review_body: We tried all of them - Dr. Brown, Tommy Tipee, Avent.  And then I discovered these bottles.  The unique nipple design prevents leaks and the twins drink really quickly from these bottles.  They come to about $1.50 at Target.  I strongly recommend them.  Love the cartoons on them too.

product_title: Pkolino Little One's Table and Chairs
review_body: Now don't get me wrong, we love our little table and chairs. Love the look of them and she can carry the lightweight chairs from room to room. I was a little disappointed on quality because when I was putting the screws in, it didn't take hardly any force to crack the wood on the table. There were already micro-stresses in these areas and I was by no means putting any force in tightening. You had to be extremely careful not to split the wood. Once I got it together I haven't had any trouble. Had it for a few months now. You also may want to be aware if your toddler is rough and likes to beat toys on the tabletop, it will dent. Mine liked to make her plastic animals walk (roughly) and just that put little dents everywhere. But, it is still a good table given the choices. We didn't want an ugly plastic one and I do think this one will last till she outgrows it. She loves to sit in the chairs and read her books.

product_title: Crib Clouds Cuddle Fleece Dots and Satin Baby Security Blanket, Sage Green
review_body: I am happy with this blanket.  I love that it has satin on one full side.  I hope my new little niece/nephew likes it too!  :)

product_title: Sassy Disposable Scented Diaper Sacks
review_headline: No diaper pail needed.  Dependable, good smelling, perfect size
review_body: Looking around alot online, I was trying to decide whether or not to invest in a diaper pail. Previously, I ordered the Sassy brand disposable changing pads and was pleased. So when I saw these bags by the same company I decided to try them out. Once again, these bags have met my expectations.  They are durable and have little handles on them much like plastic grocery bags.  They fit 2 toddler diapers and up to 4 smaller size diapers.  With the way these bags are working for me, I will not be ordering a diaper pail after all.  This is saving me money as I would have to buy replacement bags for any diaper pail. They also smell like baby powder, which I happen to love.  Will be ordering these in the future to keep my stock up.

product_title: Dandelion Plush Toy
review_body: I like that this toy is safe enough for my baby to gnaw on and sleep with.  She's had it since she was 5 months old...she's 16-months now.  It doesn't really look like a lion, and she's not crazy about it, but it's joined her crib as one of the buddies she likes in there when she goes to bed.  I like that it's easy to clean (I just toss it in the wash with her clothes, and into the dryer).  It's held up pretty well.  It just doesn't look like a lion, that's all.

product_title: Prince Lionheart weePOD Basix
review_headline: Wish I had this when my son was potty training
review_body: This potty seat is awesome!  It doesn't shift around while my daughter is on it and it is easy to remove.  I was a little nervous about how it would fit our oval-ish toilet but that wasn't an issue once it arrived:)  I'm very happy with my purchase.  Would highly recommend this weePOD!

product_title: BRICA Seat Belt Adjuster, Gray
review_headline: Great for shorter people, but use it correctly!
review_body: I am a short adult woman, and the Brica adapter keeps the seatbelt from falling across my neck instead of my shoulder.  I've seen some of the critical reviews, and I understand the safety concerns when a seatbelt isn't lined up properly.  However, I think it's possible for it to work properly with this product if you understand that seatbelts are supposed to tighten against the larger bones in your frame during an accident, not against soft tissue.  Make sure that the upper part of the belt is against your shoulder, that you pull it tight through the Brica- this is possible, though sometimes a little tough- and that the ends of the bottom half are resting on your hip bones instead of up over your belly and internal organs.  If you're a round person as well as a short person, this can take some wrangling, but I believe it's much safer than taking the force of a restraint against your neck in a crash.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Wipes Warmer
review_body: Fast shipping and affordable item. Great product and it fits in my purse. I carry along whenever I am out with my baby. It has a car charger as well. Love it.

product_title: Safety 1st Easy-Fit Security Gate
review_body: Not worth your money at all. It is not sturdy, made of cheap bulky plastic, and it is very hard to open and close.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Wheely Bug
review_body: It was as presented. Cute and sturdy enough for a first birthday gift. A little smaller than I expected ,and while it was seemingly enjoyed, I would advise the larger size for a child to get more use out of going forward.

product_title: Aottop Strollers & Accessories
review_body: This fan is more of a toy than an actual fan.  It doesn't blow any air at all.  Complete waste of money!

product_title: Nuby Paci Cradle Pacifier Box
review_body: For those who don't want to spend $20 on something that isn't a necessity, then this is what you should get. The price is right for this product. Yes it is cheap quality, but it does the job. Holds 2 pacifiers securely. The case is a nice size and clips easily to the diaper bag or car seat handle. I love having the convenience of a dedicated place to store the pacifiers when outside. I made the mistake of putting it in a microwave sterilizer and now it is extremely hard to close. I may end up getting another one.

product_title: Baby Jogger Glider Board, Black
review_body: The glider board is the best investment I have made for this stroller.  My daughter loves it and people always ask me where I bought it.  Would highly recommend!

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ Deluxe
review_body:
I inherited a Diaper Dekor Plus from my sister. After 19 months of use the flaps gave out on the old pail and it needed to be replaced. I am so much happier with the Baby Trend Diaper Champ Deluxe for many reasons:

1. It really keeps the smell level down. I find keeping the lid in the closed position is best for keeping smells to a minimum.

2. My son used to knock over the other pail (Diaper Dekor) and play with the lid and flaps. This could put him in contact with used diapers and wipes if I wasn't right there to prevent him from doing so. He now opens and closes the lever of the Diaper Champ with delight, but does not come in contact with any dirty wipes or wipes, as they have already been dispensed into a sealed compartment. Since he can no longer play with the contents of the trashcan he is less motivated to play with the diaper pail in general.

3. This pail takes any trash bag. No more buying expensive proprietary bags for nearly $20 a package (which was ridiculous)!! I now buy generic inexpensive tall trash bags in bulk for nearly all my trash cans. This saves me so much time and money.

4. The pail is super easy to use. Just one lever to open and close and one button to push to change the liner. I also like how securely any standard trash bag fits snugly and securely to the blue bag holder. Just push the button and tuck the bag underneath the blue holder and click it shut. Easy peasy!

My only complaint if I had any is that the receptacle could be a little taller to accommodate more diapers. That said, I usually change the diaper pail when I can smell its contents, not necessarily when it is completely full. A bigger taller recepticle isn't going to be best choice if keeping the smell-factor down is your top priority.

product_title: Sugar Booger Covered Suction Bowl Gift Set
review_body: This set is just soooo cute and highly functional. I was worried about the flat shape of the spoon but this was perfect for my daughter. She got it when she was 3 and still uses it today at 5. The lid covers the bowl perfectly and doesn't slide off easily. The spoon and fork are durable. I never used the silicone non-skid ring below the bowl so I cant comment on that, but everything else is durable and functional. You can close your eyes and buy this. My daughter has been taking the fork to school for over a year and it is still in good condition. Warning - don't overheat the bowl in the microwave - it can chip the pattern.

product_title: Baby Jogger City Elite Single Stroller
review_body: I wish there would have been a store nearby that carried all of the baby jogger strollers so I could test them out in person but there is not, so I, like most parents rely on reviews. This stroller is very cumbersome and heavy, when folded it takes up a lot of space in the trunk of my Odyssey van. With that said it makes for a very sturdy and plush stroller. The ride is smooth and very easy to maneuver. It specifically says not to hang bags across the handle bar but I find that I have to because the basket underneath is inaccessible. There is a bar across under the seat of the stroller making the basket impossible to get to. I bought the green and have had many compliments on the stroller (it is very attractive). Initially I wanted the City Mini GT model but came across this one for less because it was last years model. It has a few more features than the GT but even though I've not seen the GT in person I might would have paid the extra to get the 2012 GT model. It has the updated curved bar at the basket and would have been less cumbersome. Overall this is a great stroller if you are looking for an \\"Elite\\" stroller and if size is not an issue. review_body: This is a beautiful moses basket, and it was a hit with the mommy-to-be...I would definitely order a Hoohobberr basket again. Gorgeous material- soft and very well made. AWESOME shipping and quick customer service!!! Love Amazon!!!!

product_title: Eddie Bauer 2 in 1 Head Support, Tan (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this for my newborn son.  He was very small at birth (6 pounds) so his neck would always bend down at a funny angle and he looked very uncomfortable even with the head support that was included with his car seat. The fabric is very soft and well made.  I would definitely recommend this head support to other moms.

product_title: JJ Cole Bib
review_body: I bought this bib to replace another similar JJCole bib I have been using daily (4 times a day) for more than a year, and it looks even more durable than the first one!!! It has a reliable snap clip that is much better than velcro and my daughter has not been able to open it no matter how much she tugs and pulls. review_body:

product_title: American Baby Company Heavenly Soft Chenille Fitted Contoured Changing Pad Cover

review_body: This is a nice product, but how practical is it that a changing pad cover requires  ring washed on the gentle cycle and cannot be tossed in the dryer? We ended up taking it off until our newborn is past the 'messy' stage.

product_title: Baby ComfyNose Nasal Aspirator
review_headline: Wonderful -- and totally superior to the Nosefrieda
review_body:
This is so helpful! I purchased this to help with my 2.5-year-old's colds, and it's great. Not as good as a full nose blow would be, but until he learns to do that, this is much better than any other nose-clearing method I've found. If you have little ones with stuffed-up noses, something like this is definitely worth a try. It's made life much better around here to have a way to clear my son's nose.

We first purchased the [[ASIN:B00171WXII Nosefrida The Snotsucker Nasal Aspirator]], which is great, but he Baby Comfy is undoubtedly the superior product. The expense of the filters, [[ASIN:B002GPVER0 Nosefrida Hygiene Filters]], is silly when the Baby Comfy exists as an alternative. The tissue filtration system is terrific, and so much more practical than the filters. I saw some Nosefrida reviews from folks who changed filters once per cold, which is what I planned to do, but that filter gets boogery after just one use. In addition, the Baby Comfy has a better design. The soft tip has a texture and shape that is much more comfortable and effective for my son. I think it's the tip that allows it to get more boogers than the Nosefrida. (Sorry to be gross!) When you're done, just pop out the tissue and replace with a new one. We also run our Baby Comfy through the dishwasher every night when there's a cold in the house. It cleans perfectly.

Since my son turned two and started spending more time with other toddlers, it's been one cold after another. The colds used to make us all miserable, in large part because of the discomfort and frustration my son experienced with a stuffed-up nose. The Baby Comfy (and Nosefrida) make these colds much, much more bearable for all of us. My son sleeps better and even seems to heal faster when we use this regularly. I definitely recommend a product like this for parents of young kids, and I think the Baby Comfy is superior in every way to the Nosefrida. I think I'll be back soon to purchase a second Baby Comfy to use just for my daughter.

product_title: Evenflo Comfort Select Performance Dual Electric Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is the only pump I've found with an adjustable suction. I am very sensitive, like most women after child birth. The adjustable suction lets you decide how soft or hard the suction is. It can be a bit on the noisey side, but I think that's the only bad thing about this product. If I were gonna have any more kids this would definitely be the pump(s) I would want to have!!!

review_headline: Wish I had bought it earlier
review_body: This seat is very easy to put on and take off of your chair.  Also, with the quick and easy removable back, it is very easy to clean.  My only wish is that I had bought this product much earlier!!!

product_title: Medela Pump In Style Advanced Breast Pump
review_headline: some drawbacks but a nice pump
review_body:
The medela pump works ok, I can get a reasonable amount of milk in a reasonable amount of time. I don't take it much of anywhere so I can't comment on how it travels. The pump has so many minor annoyances that it ends up being not so great to use.

- You can't just buy the pump. You also have to buy the bag, the cooler bag, the ice pack, the bottles, the battery pack, and the storage caps - all items that, as a stay at home mom, I never need and sit unused in the closet.

- The bag that you have to buy if you want the pump isn't very good quality and it's not exactly stylish. If you want the stylish bag you have to pay a lot more. You might think well, I don't need the bag or I have other bags and I'll just use those instead. Nope. The pump is designed to live in the bag. The pump motor has a yellow facade but all the other sides are bare metal. There is an area in the bag to protect it that works well but it means you can't really sit the motor on a table or put it in a different bag since the holes in the metal will let dust and whatever else get into the motor and destroy it then you have to buy another complete set to replace it. If it's out on a table, which I tried, kids want to stick their fingers in the holes, it looks awful, and it scratches up wood furniture. The bag is made in china, which in-and-of-itself doesn't bother me but it has that smell that made in china textile products have. No big deal until you learn that you can't wash it. You can wipe it down but expect everything in and around the bag to smell funky for weeks.

- The flanges, the round part with the hole in the middle, are size medium. If you're one of the women for whom this size doesn't fit you're stuck buying them and putting them in the closet with the rest of the unused parts. The replacement 'personal fit' flanges are only about $13 but come in just four sizes, there is a fifth size but it's over $100 and made of glass. With these flanges as the size of the hole goes down so does the size of the outside part. Have small breasts and large nipples? You're out of luck. Have large breasts and small nipples? Yup, also out of luck. There's no way of knowing if any of the flanges made will fit you until you try it and once you try it you're stuck with it. Medela themselves say this is a personal hygiene item and cannot be returned. They will replace it if it's defective but if you can't find a flange size to fit you're out the $300. Something that does help the hard flanges become slightly more comfortable are the soft petal inserts that come with the avent brand pumps but that company doesn't sell them separately and they only fit the medela medium flanges. Medela makes a soft flange that is supposed to be comfortable but it only comes in one size so like with all their other accessories you're stuck with being uncomfortable or being out the money if you don't fit into one of medela's five predetermined sizes/shapes that they fell all women must be. These fit issues also apply to shape, if you're breasts are wide and flat they won't fit, if your breasts are 'pointed' they won't fit either.

- The suction starts off really strong. I'm not sure why it can't start from nothing and go up from there but the lowest setting is too strong and is uncomfortable. I've never needed to pump on a higher setting and I really wish it could go lower. Both breasts must use the same suction level, I know it's asking for a lot but if they could be controlled independently that would be wonderful.

Overall, I like this pump primarily because it's easy to use and especially because replacement parts are not a problem to get. product_title: Cloud b On The Go Travel Sound Machine Soother
review_body:
We had been told that the sleep sheep was the way to go, and were worried that the sounds wouldn't be as soothing for baby with the giraffe as they are with the sheep, but this little guy is so soft and the sounds are so gentle and calming, while matching his safari themed room! Our son does pretty well with sleeping, but when he started teething, nights got long and we found ourselves in a tight spot occassionaly. Now, I hold my son, he holds the giraffe and as soon as his eyes close, it's safe to lay the 2 of them in the crib while he falls fast asleep. I come back ~30 mins later to move the giraffe away from him again and he's set for the night!

We've also used the giraffe on the \\"play\\" sound while we finish having dinner or washing bottles or whatever if our son is getting fussy playing on his blanket. This is a great product and too cute, to boot!

product_title: Munchkin Arm & Hammer Diaper Pail
review_body: This is a great product. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is that it is a little small, but overall it is awesome.  I tried the Diaper Champ and it STINKS TERRIBLE, this one has absolutely no odor!  The lid is sometimes a bit hard to close when the bag gets full, but even when I leave the lid up (which is a lot) there is absolutely no odor.  I would highly recommend this diaper pail.

review_body: My 6 week old is difficult to put to sleep, as he constantly fights his sleep. The day we got this, we placed him in their for one of his many nap times and he fell right to sleep and slept for 3 solid hours! It definitely allowed this mommy to get some adequate nap time, too!

product_title: BRICA By-My-Side Safety Harness Backpack, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I use this product daily when I take my two year old out and I'm completely satisfied with it. My daughter enjoys wearing the backpack, and I feel confident that I can keep her safely by my side in public places. Good quality, good price, and priceless in giving me peace of mind.

product_title: Jinx Official Licensed Minecraft Creeper Inside Boys T-shirt
review_body: I ordered this shirt for a birthday gift. It arrived on time and was a perfect fit. :) It's more than I would normaly pay for a child's shirt however, it was a special ocasion.

product_title: OXO Tot Baby Blocks Freezer Storage Containers
review_body: Definitely useful to store baby food and very convenient. Very little ice crystals while freezing. The tops do get a little difficult to pop open and it is not always easy to get the washer out to clean.

product_title: Leachco Podster Sling-Style Infant Seat Lounger
review_body: This is the greatest thing for twins. When my grandsons, now 6 months old, were hungry at the same time, and only one person  available, we would sit on the floor facing the twins in their side by side podsters, and feed them their bottles together. They were elevated and had good eye contact for talking to them during the feeding. I have a photo of my daughter using a handsfree lactation pump while feeding the babies their bottles in their podsters. This kind of multi-tasking was a lifesaver over and over, both physically and mentally. As mentioned elsewhere, when they are small you can use a folded up baby blanket in the center of the mesh to keep them from sinking too much. All including the babies stays in place. The fabric washes well, but we usually had a baby blanket draped over the podsters. When you take the fabric off for washing, you can appreciate how well the podster is constructed. For the first 3-4 months, the podsters were placed side by side in the crib, necessitating only one crib. Now that we are done with the podsters, this is the best baby gift that I could think of.

product_title: Matthew Porter Art Wall Decor Art Print, Animal Alphabet Poster
review_body: This is a beautiful poster! An abc of adorable animals. The red panda is my favorite but my kids love the hedgehog and unicorn the most.

review_body: This item was easy to put together and has lots of activities for a baby. Wish it had a musical component. May be better for 6+ month baby as the seat is deep so it is difficult for shorter babies to reach toys and for their feet to touch the ground.

product_title: American Baby Company Waterproof fitted Quilted Portable/Mini Crib Mattress Pad Cover
review_body: This item is of good quality and washes well. Fits our mattress perfectly without having to fight to put it on. Nice snug fit too. and has been put too and passed the \\"Waterproof\\" test! Very good product.

review_body: this is a great product.  the ties make it so baby can not tear it off.  protects the crib, washable.  i wish i bought this one before the plastic cover that clips on and the cover that holds on with velcro straps.  Both of those my baby could take off.

product_title: JJ Cole Car Seat Canopy, Pink Blossom (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love how this canopy keeps the sun off my newborn, but it can get hot in there.  Also I have plans to put a button on the bottom front velcro because it hardly ever stays closed for me if I don't velco it entirely up.

product_title: Inglesina 2013 Fast Table Chair
review_body: We have used this chair with my son from 5 until about 12 months of age.  Perfect at restaurants when they are a little too small for the high chair or booster seat.  We also sent it over to his grandparents when they watched him, since they didn't have a high chair.  It's great for dining out because you can use it in a booth or with a table (just be careful of tables with a middle pedestal when the baby gets bigger - possible tipping danger).  Super comfortable for baby and easy to clean.  I've never gotten more compliments or questions about a baby product when we were out and about - from waitresses to other moms everyone thinks this seat is total genius.  Very light and portable, too.  A must have for parents who still want to enjoy a meal out once in awhile!

product_title: Tommee Tippee Explora Truly Spill Proof Insulated Straw Cup - 2 Pack/9oz (Colors May Vary) (Pack of 2)
review_body: I bought these at Target, $8.oo for 2. I bought them because I wanted insulated straw cups for my almost 11 month old... they are easier than tipping a cup and we are going on a long trip soon, so I was in the market for them. I liked these because the design and colors were very appealing to me. I ALMOST THOUGHT I COMPLETELY wasted my money, because after washing them and attempting the use of them, my son (nor I) could not get any of his water out of them! I came on here and saw the review saying make sure the small clear rubber peice goes THROUGH the white plastic peice!! VERY simple process, but I COULD NOT figure it out, and I had thrown out the instructions! So I did as instructed, and they work beautifully! My son holds these cups well and likes them. The only reason I gave this 4 stars is because I wish the button to open the straw was easy...closing is super easy, so that is GREAT...but I do not anticipate my son being able to open these on his own anytime soon, just because it requires you to push down very hard.. not sure if this was done for a purpose or not. Otherwise, they are great cups! Buy them from Target, on sale ;-)

product_title: Graco Highback TurboBooster Car Seat, Spitfire
review_body: I'm not too sure what some of the low star reviews are talking about.  Some mention that the seatbelt slips out of the holder that is supposed to keep it from choking the child.  Really?  What's your seatbelt made out of?  Yarn?  I had no problem with this whatsoever.  Assembly was a breeze, putting it in the car and getting it out was a snap, and getting the child into and out of the seat is just as easy.  For this price, the quality is excellent.  The seat is comfortable, with plenty of padding, and my son (5 years old, just under 4 feet tall) liked it quite a bit.  He also liked the cupholders, which was nice to put his drinks in while we were going to the zoo this past weekend.  All in all, I'd recommend this car seat to anyone who needs the high back booster seat and doesn't want to spend $100 or more on one that probably only works as well as this one does.  I have no complaints about this product at all.

product_title: Lamaze Cloth Book
review_body:
This soft book ALWAYS gets my daughter to laugh, whether read once or five times in a row. She especially likes the bear and beaver pages (maybe due to their brighter color scheme). The owl head on the cover is puffy and makes crinkly noises when you touch it, which she loves as well. Great starter book!

We also checked out the Sir Prance-A-Lot soft book... not nearly as engaging for my baby at this stage (perhaps when she's older?). It doesn't have the surprise factor from the peek-a-boo flaps, nor the crinkly sound with every page.

product_title: Kidsme Food Feeder Essential Set
review_body: My 6 month baby loves this! The silicone is much better then the mesh bags on other feeders. I've bought 2 more so I can always have one with me for feeding time. I would recommend this to everyone who is starting there baby on solids.

product_title: Boppy Prenatal Cuddle Pillow, Neutral (Discontinued by Manufacturer)

product_title: Baby Banana Toothbrush

review_body: Easy to install and click into place. Looks great and it's safe and all that.... But the rain/sun shield must just be decoration, because it doesn't extend far enough over baby to keep the sun off her or the rain off her. What's the point? I also got the stroller frame for the car seat which would be great for going on walks, etc. However, with no way to keep the sun or rain (mostly rain since I live in Seattle) off the baby, it makes it all a waste.

The instructions say \\"Using a standard ballpoint pen, write the name and/or desired information on the name plate area\\". Well... I tried... and tried... to write a name on the name plate area and the material just refused to allow itself to be written on. I went over and over each letter with five different ballpoint pens but the ink just would not penetrate or even remain on the surface. Put it into boiling water and.... no joy, there was no readable lettering.

Useful only if you are willing to rely on color coding of the toothbrushes, which I am not. Am returning this annoying item.

product_title: Double Blessings - Extra Changeable Pillow & Privacy Cover - fits San Diego Bebe Twin and EZ-2-Nurse Twins Nursing Pillows (Covers only - pillow inserts are not included)
review_headline: Finally A Nursing Pillow That Puts Moms & Babies First!
review_body:
Until I heard about the San Diego Bebe Eco-Nursing Pillow, the thought of a nursing pillow being dangerously toxic never crossed my mind. I naively trusted that any company offering a product that came into contact with infants and nursing mothers would make safety a top priority. Sadly, I couldn't have been more wrong. My only regret after using the San Diego Bebe Eco Nursing Pillow is not buying one sooner- I can't believe I was using a nursing pillow that had been sprayed with dangerously TOXIC chemicals with my other 3 babies, I sure wish I had known about the San Diego Bebe then!

Aside from being the first and only SAFE, eco-friendly nursing pillow, the San Diego Bebe is also far more comfortable than Boppy, My Breast Friend or any other nursing pillow I've used. The included back support cushion is wonderful, and the nursing pillow positions your baby perfectly to help you get a good latch every time. I also LOVE the built in privacy cover, which makes nursing in public, or at home when company is over a breeze. Thank you San Diego Bebe for creating a nursing pillow that is safe, comfortable, and truly puts nursing mothers & babies first!

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_headline: I am either completely out of luck, or the overall manufacturing quality is too poor
review_body:
The first item I ordered for my son last week came with one of three lights not working right out of the box. I had to return the item (which basically made my son quite upset) and to order a same new item with 1-day shipping for extra charge. The second item arrived today and it has a pretty visible scratch on the top of the turtle's shell. It's quite obvious this is not the result of damage in transit, but rather very low quality control at the manufacturer.
If it was an item for myself, I would have returned it right away again, because it's simply insane - tho hits and both with pretty obvious issues. I simply don't want to make my kid upset again, so I'd better live with the scratch, but frankly I don't expect this light to last long. I would be very careful ordering anything from Cloud b in future as it seems that they don't care at all about the quality of what goes from them.

Other than that, the whole concept of this light is wonderful. My son liked it really much and that's the reason of giving this 3 stars out of 5. From the pure quality point of view it does not deserve even one star, IMHO.

product_title: Britax Boulevard 70 Convertible Car Seat, Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body:
After being involved in a rollover when my son was six weeks old, I have become a carseat safety fanatic. When it was time to move him from his Britax Chaperone (new after the accident) at about nine months old, we opted to stick with what we knew was a high quality, easy to use (and install), comfortable brand. My son is 18 months now and still rear-facing, and the carseat has worked beautifully for us. It is sturdy and well-built, plus it has straps that rarely twist and never tangle, making putting a squirrely toddler in there as easy as you could hope it to be. Also, I like that it has a base--not removable, but gives it a more stable feel. Latch hookups are simple, as is seatbelt installation. My only problem is that the Chaperone and Boulevard will not fit in my car with the Boulevard rearfacing, unless I want to kiss my steering wheel st all times. Baby #2 is on the way, so we will have to figure that out. It fits just fine in the center of the back seat alone, though (I have a Lincoln MKZ).
Long story short: love the Boulevard.

product_title: Britax B-Agile Stroller, Black (Prior Model)
review_body:
I have purchased five strollers for my baby girl and the Britax B-Agile is my favorite by far. Here are some of the reasons I love it.

1. Easy to maneuver in tight spaces. I can easily stroll with just one hand. This is the main reason I purchased this stroller.
2. Large canopy is perfect for sunny days. It comes down far enough to cover baby, but not so far that it blocks her view.
3. The mesh window looks so much nicer than the vinyl on other strollers and I like that I can see and hear my baby more easily through it.
4. Easy to fold with one hand, stands on its own, easy to lift into my SUV, and takes up the least amount of space of any of my strollers (Even less than the Graco Snap and Go)
5. Unfolds easily by releasing one latch
6. Easy to adjust the seat recline
7. Easy to adjust the harness height without having to rethread the straps
8. The zippered pocket on the back is handy when carrying small toys and blankets
9. The braking system is nice and I have no problems using it, even when wearing flip flops.
10. Smooth ride even on rough terrain. The large wheels and suspension make it easy to push in grass or over gravel.
11. Decent sized basket even if it is hard to access from the back. I have found that I can put my large Vera Bradley diaper bag into the basket if I unbutton one of the basket buttons and put the bag in from the side.
12. The five point harness is easy to buckle. I like that it is more difficult to unbuckle as I hope this will help prevent my daughter from escaping.
13. I have never kicked the bar on the back between the wheels.

I added the Diono Buggy Buddy to the stroller for use as a parent tray/ adult cup holder. It was definitely worth the $10 I paid for it and is way better than the accessories Britax makes for the B-Agile. If this type of console had come with the B-Agile and if the basket was a little larger and easier to access, this would be my perfect stroller. Neither of these were a deal breaker for me and I still absolutely love this stroller and would recommend it to others.

product_title: Orbit Baby Toddler Convertible Car Seat G2, Ruby (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I never write reviews, but I felt compelled to do so in the case of the Orbit baby Toddler Car Seat G2 Ruby. I also must add that we love Orbit, and have every single product they have made. We joined the Orbit revolution when they released G2.

We have two Mocha Orbit Baby Toddler seats, and this review strictly refers to the Ruby colored ones. Due to our familiarity to the products, and their compatibility we decided to buy a third car seat to into our third car. But we had also decided to go with the Ruby color instead of the Mocha. The Ruby seat is 140 dollars more than the Mocha on Amazon. But still in spite of the fact that one could buy another low end carseat for the difference we decided to splurge.

So when the box arrived, we knew what to expect, but we were excited still about the splash of color. Opening the box he first surprise was that this car seat does not come with the sun shade like the original colors do. Since we live in FL it was a huge turn off. But we thought it was just a mistake in packaging. Further inspection revealed that the harness could not be loosened and therefore raised, because the clasps from the base of the seat do not come out. At this point we repackaged the seat, and returned it to Amazon.

They sent a replacement immediately. That's when we learned that the lack of sunshade is the standard, and if one wanted sunshades needed to go online and order it separately. For 380 it is disappointing. But we were already splurging so that wouldn't have been the final straw. It came when we again tried to fit the straps to accommodate our child, and this time the headrest came lose. It is secured with velcro, but these were not attached to the seat, and therefore the headrest was unsecured. So the chair was returned.

We would still highly recommend the Orbit toddler seat. Our child is 2 1/4 years old, and is still sitting rear facing, and we use the seat with the swivel base. It is fantastic! Just do not get the ruby color! Buy the Mocha for 140 less and it will come with a matching sun shade too.
