product_title: Chicco KeyFit Infant Car Seat - Limonata
review_headline: Highly recommended, with a few caveats...
review_body:
We purchased the Chicco Keyfit 30 in the Limonata style. In the Amazon pictures it looks yellow and gray, but in person it's actually more of a Mountain Dew yellow-green color. The fabrics are durable and nice. My daughter's been using this seat for almost six months, and it still fits her great. While I am pleased with this product overall, there are a few things I wish I'd known before taking the plunge:

- I thought all car seats had a slit to safely sit on a shopping cart, but this one does not. This makes shopping a pain because setting the seat on the back part or the seat part of the shopping cart results in a too-reclined position for baby, plus it doesn't feel safe. The car seat is large enough that putting it in the cart takes up 85% of the space, so unless you're just shopping for a few things, this is difficult. I imagine when my baby is bigger and can sit on her own I'll use the cart child seat, but that's not an option for the first seven months or so. Because of the inconvenience, I generally have to go with my husband and one of us pushes the stroller.
- I know it's been said before, but Chicco sunshades are inadequate. The only way this wimpy shade will keep the sun out of baby's eyes is if the sun is directly behind the seat. If it's even a bit to the side, the sun will be in baby's face. I wish they'd fix this.
- We ended up buying two of the bases ([[ASIN:B000UUBRYI Chicco KeyFit & KeyFit30 Infant Car Seat Base - Anthracite]]) so we could each have one in our cars, but I think it's unnecessary to have two. It is easy to strap in the car seat by itself and only takes an extra minute. The base is a slight convenience, but not one worth $85. I like the base fine, but make sure you wiggle the car seat handle and hear both of the clicks--sometimes I'd take off driving and hear the second \\"click\\" when I stopped at a light.
- Chicco is, to my knowledge, one of the only brands that does NOT fit in \\"universal\\" strollers. Despite this, my husband and I bought the [[ASIN:B000BMKEVC Baby Trend Single Snap N' Go Stroller]], and even though the car seat doesn't \\"snap\\" into the stroller, it fits snugly and has worked fine for us. We opted for the Baby Trend brand because the Chicco equivalent was nearly double the price. I highly recommend buying one of these--it makes your life so much easier because
- This seat is heavy! I don't think it's that much different from other brands, but carrying this around with your little peanut in it is quite a workout, especially since it's so bulky. You should definitely buy a Snap n' Go stroller unless you're a body builder.

My favorite features:
- The bottom of the seat is curved, enabling you to rock your baby when the seat isn't strapped into the car. This feature helped me on many occasions early on to put my baby to sleep.
- The infant inserts were sufficient enough that I didn't need to put rolled up receiving blankets around my baby's head.
- All of the materials feel sturdy and durable. Everything about this seat seems high-quality.
- The strap length is easy to adjust over and over again.
- The padding is plush and comfortable.

I like this seat and recommend it as long as the information above doesn't drive you crazy. It's worked great for us.

EDITED TO ADD: Turns out it's not safe to put your car seat on the front of a shopping cart. Maybe that's common knowledge, but I thought it must be fine since I see people do it all the time and every other baby seat has that slot in the back (what else could that be for?). So while I stand by my statement that it's inconvenient to put the seat in the cart because it takes up the whole thing, at least it's safe(r). I like to leave my baby in her seat while shopping, but you could wear your baby to preserve cart space if that's your style.

product_title: BubbleBum Inflatable Booster Seat
review_body:
We love these boosters, got 3 of them which fit generously in the back of our CRv and Impreza Hatchback. We have 3 under 6 yo and so will have to heed the booster seat law (just moved to 8 in GA) for a while longer. I was glad to see that someone out there understands that you don't have to have a mini van with 3 kids.

We not only love that these fit with tons of room to reach the buckles in between but, we also love the fact that they make the seatbelt fit so much better. Rather than the gap you typically have on either side with a traditional backless booster where there would always be space where your child could shift in a crash- these make it so the seat belt fits right at the kids hips and the shoulder piece is easy to adjust and fits perfectly as well. One of these would have solved our fit issue with the 2 existing boosters we just bought but the fit on the kids is so much better that we bought them for everyone.

My kids are happy in these, we live far from everything so the grocery store is 45 minutes one way and everyone is comfortable with no complaints. Anyone who says it tips in the car- maybe its your car's seat shape but there has been no issue with that for us.

My kids are SMALL these are So much better of a fit for small kids, my 5 1/2 yo old still hasn't quite broken 40 lbs but is very tall and my 3 yo's are right at 30 and almost 30 lbs- all 3 long and lean, these have been great to transition to to get a great fit on the seatbelt while getting rid of the 5 point which is hard to get them in with thier long legs and they are all uncomfortable with. Some may not agree with that choice but for those of you looking to fit skinny kids- I know how hard it is and this one is for us.

If your kid is on the heafty side- you will probably think this is too small to last long in which case I say- there are many other great choices but personally I like that my kids finally have a booster that is too small for me to sit in as that hasn't been the case yet. review_body:
IT FITS!!!!!
After several carseats tried and returned for my large 20 pound 6 month old (including Sunshine-Radian/Cosco/Graco) this is the one that fits in my car! product_title: Comotomo Natural Feel Baby Bottle Single Pack
review_body:
We ordered a couple of the pink 150ml slow flow bottles and planned to put breast milk in them when The Source was unavailable or too tired to feed. I was unusually pumped about this purchase--boob-shaped bottles!--such that my wife made fun of me incessantly. Much to my dismay, these bottles did not work for us. The baby just was not getting anything out of them. After 30 mins, there was no noticeable change in volume.

The slow flow nipples are way too slow for our girl. I was not expecting such a major disappointment given the nearly unanimously positive reviews. Perhaps the flow is sufficient for formula-fed babies. Or perhaps my girl needs to work on her suction game a little. Whatever it is, these rather expensive bottles were not getting it done.

Not wanting to give up, we purchased 3-6 month medium flow nipples as replacements for the slow flow nipples that came with the bottle. Bear in mind that my daughter is 3 weeks old. These nipples work much better and she is now able to complete a feeding in about 30-45 minutes. But I now have to ask myself whether the added cost of new nipples and the inconvenience of getting them makes it worth it. Probably not. Bummer.

review_headline: To Bad I Can't Rate it 10 Stars
review_body: The best experience I have had on Amazon to date with customer service, bar none.  Wall Art Corner (The Seller) went above and beyond to make sure I was completely satisfied with the product, which by the way, is fantastic, very, very, very, very (you get the idea) high quality materials, easy application, reusable, and doesn't rip the paint off your walls!  Once again, fantastic item, fantastic seller.  The negative feedback you might see on this item is too bad, as if they would have just contacted Wall Art Corner, all their problems would have been solved.  Will most definitely suggest this item to my friends and family (I've already had many comments on the 'cuteness' factor of the tree, animals, and flowers)

product_title: Disney Friendship Pooh Wall Art-3D (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great product but not as described.
review_body: The current description for this item is inaccurate.  It is not a three piece set consisting of two canvas Pooh wall decorations and one wood 3-D Pooh decoration.  You only receive the one 3-D Friendship Pooh Wall Decoration.  The piece that you do receive is adorable and well made.  It is made of solid wood.  It's size is 11.5 x 10in.  I'm still trying to find the two canvas prints of Tigger and Pooh shown in the background of the complete nursery set photo that I thought I was ordering here.  All in all I do love what I received, but am disappointed that it wasn't the complete set as described.  I will continue to search for the other two prints so that I can complete my nursery look.

product_title: Playtex 3 Pack Baby Drop Ins Nurser
review_headline: Sterile, lined baby bottles for parents on the go.
review_body:
Sometimes it's just not feasible to sterilize the baby's bottles when visiting relatives and friends. These Playtex Baby Nursers with Drop-In liners makes it much simpler and more convenient.

Likes:
>Easy to use pre-sterilized drop-in liners reduces risks of baby getting colic and gas.
>Save time vs. conventional bottles that require repeated washings and heat sterilizations after each use.
>Well designed nipple: Silicone(included) or Latex to duplicate baby' s natural suckling rate and preference.
>PBA free bottles with pastel color coded tops and baby friendly decorations.
>Affordable [[ASIN:B001F0RAB6 Playtex Standard BPA Free Disposable Nurser Liners 4 oz - 100 Count]] for only $6.66.

Dislikes:
>The look and feel of the non-flexible plastic bottles and caps are cheap; durability, heat and breakage-resistance are sub-par.
>Volume measurements printed on sides of bottles are not completely accurate.

Bottom Line:
Time saving and effective alternative to sterilizing baby bottles for busy, on the go parents. We still prefer to use unlined [[ASIN:B00005BTNA Playtex 3 Pack BPA Free VentAire Wide Bottles, 9 Ounce]] at home.

product_title: NTM-910YLW - Sony Baby Call Nursery Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Perfect item for grandparents when their grandchildren sleep over.  Easy to operate and works much better than the previous unit I had.  The price point was good. Would recommend to anyone.

product_title: Sassy Baby Changing Pads 36 Count Box, White
review_body: Love it. Saves me washing covers and cloth pads on the changing table and dealing with the mess. I rip it up in half as this is sufficient for my 3-month old baby to get more use out of it.

product_title: Green Eats 2 Pack Bowls
review_body: I got these bowls in yellow and orange for my kids who have outgrown some of the smaller toddler bowls, and I love the size of these. They are smaller than a regular adult cereal type bowl, but larger than a lot of the toddler bowls I have. Works great for soups, cereals, pasta, etc. So far nothing has stained them, they do great in the dishwasher, and they aren't scratched up by typical use of forks and spoons. These are just what I needed.

product_title: Dr. Sears Nibble Tray, Yellow/Green, 12 Months (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: So far I have only used the pineapple body and not the fronds.  My son is 20 months and I use it to pack his lunch for daycare.  It has space for a good variety, but the compartments are small and I fear it will be too small soon.

product_title: B Kids Watch Over Me Dream Station (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: How I wish there had been a sleep product like this on the market when my kids were babies! So amazing that Watch Over Me is able to sense movement and sound to not only help soothe babies to sleep, but to also comfort them when they wake up during the night. I love that it has white noise along with the all of the different songs to choose from. It is compact too, and the soft colors go with any nursery decor. It is evident that a lot of thought and care went into creating this quality product.

product_title: Philips Avent 9 ounce BPA Free Bottle
review_body: As I knew, I bought this bottle for a present and I know she loved it. I recommend it very much.

product_title: Baby Banana Toothbrush
review_body: Got this for our 4 month old. He loves chewing on it and letting us brush his gums. The size is perfect and the loops help stop him from choking on it while also giving him a place to hold. This is much better than the finger toothbrush since he can hold it himself. Highly reccomend!

product_title: Carter's Easy Printed Embroidered Boa Blanket
review_body: This blanket is very soft and a great size for little kids. The problem is that once you wash this blanket the amount of lint generated is ridiculous! It was so bad that it was like having a pet and the hair getting all over the place. It lined my clothing and caused my allergies to flair up after inhaling it many times. It took about 10 washes and drying this blanket only with others of similar fabric in order for the lint to get down to a manageable level. I'm still hesitant to use this blanket.

product_title: BreathableBaby Breathable Deluxe Mesh Crib Liner
review_body:
WOnderful idea, however the bumpers don't fit the crib. We have standard Anastasia by DaVinci crib. THe back bumper fits as it should, but the front one is way too long. I actually read the instructions (seriously? Instructions for the crib bumper?) and did as it said, and still the front bumper didn't fit. It should have been at least 1/4 of the length shorter. I tried to wrap it around in some creative way, but then it looked very ungly and didn't stay on.
Also the way you secure the back bumper on the sides is weird - the pattern is on one side of the bumper only, so when you secure the bumper you can see the solid side of the bumper over the pattern and it's not pretty.
We kept it because the idea is good and it is protecting almost 3/4 of the crib.

product_title: Fisher-Price Home & Away 3-in-1 High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great concept but seat seems uncomfortable
review_body: I bought it from the local BabiesRUs store since the 3-in-1 design looked really useful (just the colors are different). However, after setting the chair up I noticed that the seat was not very comfortable. The seating space itself seems to be smaller than other standard highchairs. The main problem seemed to be with the plastic projection between the legs, it's designed too close to the back of the seat (could have moved it 2 inches in front) and ends up being uncomfortable around the crotch area. Compared to \\"Fisher-Price Precious Planet Sky Blue High Chair\\", which we compared with side to side, this highchair had 2 inches less seating space due to that. I called Fisher-Price and gave them this feedback, hopefully they will find a solution to this if other people are complaining about the same thing. since it did not work for our nine month old child, I couldn't see how it would continue to be useful as he grew older. My suggestion would be to go to a local store and do a side-by-side comparison of this high chair with another, and decide.

product_title: Newco International Grand Glider
review_headline: Item is great... delivery not so great.
review_body: I just received this glider on Friday night.  I purchased it in the beige for our nursery.  The glider is beautiful.  It's a little stiff right now, but I'm sure it will loosen up once we sit in it a few times.  It looks great in the nursery.  I've actually never left a review for items, but since I am a soon-to-be mommy I've realized the importance of leaving reviews on items for others.  The only frustration that I had was with the delivery.  Home direct delivered the item.  They called me a total of approximately 15 times in a week.  They would call to change the delivery day and time and then 30 minutes later someone would call me back to confirm the old time.  It was the craziest experience.  Then on the night before the scheduled delivery they changed the time again so my plans had to be changed once AGAIN.  They were to deliver the chair between 12:30-4:30.  I received a call at 11 am asking if my chair had been delivered the night before.  At that point I almost lost it with these people (keep in mind I'm a VERY patient person). They called me again at 3 to tell me that they would deliver it by 5:30.  Finally, at 8:00 on Friday night they showed up.  It was very frustrating.  I completely understand that sometimes the unexpected happens, but this was just ridiculous.  So overall, the chair is good just beware that the delivery might be difficult.

product_title: Philips Avent BPA Free Soothie Pacifier, 0-3 Months, 2 Pack, Packaging May Vary
review_body: Got this is the hospital and have bought many more. Unexpectedly stand up nicely to new teeth. Wish they had one that glowed in the dark so my son could find them at night in his crib or car seat.

product_title: KidCo Bath Toy Organizer Storage Basket, White
review_body: As our son got older he collected more bath toys. This storage basket was perfect. We used the divider so we have a small section to store shampoo, soap, etc. The second larger section holds all his toys. He's able to see the toys and take out what he wants and at the end he can put everything away. It's perfect.

product_title: Summer Infant 3 Piece Dr. Mom Oral Care Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Trying to get my infant to brush teeth is hard. I love the over-finger piece for a quick wipe at young ages. As she got older I had her chew on the teether piece to get her mouth open while I brushed with the toothbrush.

product_title: Kent 18" Boys Action Zone Bike
review_headline: 5 year old loves it, no kickstand
review_body: Put together easily and didn't use the training wheels.  My son was motivated enough to ride this one without the training wheels.  A nice size between 16 and 20 but don't expect to ride it forever.  He is starting to look cramped at age 6 and should be ready for a 20 inch by 7 at the latest.  Does not come with a kickstand but so far I have found a way to sleep at night.

review_body: My daughter has been using this stuff since she was born.  Suddenly she developed a rash that the dr deemed eczema.  We reduced the frequency of her baths to help not dry out the skin and the rash got mostly better.  Anytime we increased the frequency of her baths, the rash got worse.  Finally I realized our \\"safe\\" product had actually changed ingredients without a warning on the front of the bottle.  No more CB for us.  I wish I could give this product zero stars.

product_title: The First Years American Red Cross Soft Tip Nasal Aspirator (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: It's not an expensive item, but save your money and purchase a better aspirator for your baby.  This one simply does not do the job.

product_title: Munchkin Powdered Formula Dispenser, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This one is perfect!

- Easy to dispense formula to bottle
- Easy to clean
- Easy to turn
- Easy to open

I have a different model of munchkin formula dispenser [[ASIN:B004LWZZ08 Munchkin Formula Dispenser, Colors May Vary]], and that one is hard to turn to the next section, and harder to pour the formula. I mean, you have to keep shaking until all formula is poured.

This one is highly recommended!

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Nighttime Infant Pacifier, 0-6 Months, 2-Count
review_body: My baby prefers this model of pacifier it doesn't curve to his face.  The flat plate keeps him cooler.  The glow in the dark handle is a nice feature for me.

product_title: BABYBJORN Potty Chair
review_body: I just bought this potty and the first time my 20 month daughter saw it she said \\"potty\\" and promptly urinated in it! Can't beat that! Looks very comfy too.

product_title: Baby Vac Nasal Aspirator
review_body:
I have a 4 month old and a 2 year old. They both got a cold at the same time.
***
Sounds crazy using a vacuum cleaner attachment to clean out your baby's nose - and it will freak out your mother-in-law at first glance, but it is fantastic and it does not suck out brains as you might think. Somehow the power of the vacuum is diffused into the right amount of suction. Believe me, I tried it on myself first. Amazing! What a great invention. Wish I'd invented it! My 2 year old isn't exactly a fan of having anything up his nose, but I bribed him into putting this in his own nose. We make a game out of it now. When he is sick, I leave the vacuum plugged into an outlet in the corner of the kitchen and it is much nicer visiting the vacuum \\"station\\" once an hour, than going through a box of tissues each day. No more chapped nose! My 4 month old isn't a fan either, but the key to little babies is to make sure their mouth is open. Operation is easy. My vacuum has an attachment that fits one end of the vacuum tube, and gets narrow for edge cleaning on the other. I invert that attachment so the edger part goes inside the vacuum tube. The aspirator tube then fits on the exposed end. Onto that aspirator tube, you attach one of the 2 different nose hole attachments. I've only used the smallest so far and it works on both me and my kids. I find it works best if you move it around a little when vacuuming the nose out.
***
This is much better than a bulb because:
(1) You can see what you are getting
(2) I can get out more goobers than a bulb since you have unlimited suction
(3) Easy to clean - enables me to see that it is clean with no germs left lurking around
(4) For wiggly kids - if you miss the first nose attempt, the air is still being drawn so keep trying until you land on the nose hole.
(5) You can't stab your kid way up inside their nose. This fits right inside the nose hole and can't accidentally go up too far.
***
Final answer:
(1) For travel, since I don't walk around with a vacuum cleaner in my pocket , I recommend: Baby Nasal Aspirator Vacuum Suction Pigeon: http://www.amazon.com/Nasal-Aspirator-Vacuum-Suction-Pigeon/dp/B0015TM0M6/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1334092810&sr=8-1
(2) For home use, this is the best by far. It is well worth it. So glad I gave it a try!
(3) Looking for a creative baby shower gift that nobody else will think of AND you want her to remember what you gave her...here ya go!

product_title: aden + anais Rayon From Bamboo Swaddle Blanket 3 Pack
review_body: I love Aden + Anais! I have used the regular muslin swaddlers they have for both of my children. My 3 year old still sleeps with his. This was the first time I purchased the organic kind, and there is a HUGE difference! They are instantly soft out of the package with out having to be washed 10+ times to make them feel this way. These have always been my staple baby shower gift, and now I am only buying the organic swaddlers from now on!

product_title: Infantino Jittery Pal Toy
review_body:
I ordered this for my to be coming baby girl and it is very lovely and red In color
The height is also good so that kids can ctch the toy easily

product_title: Ameda White Adapter Cap
review_headline: The cap does the job, but...
review_body: The cap does what it should, but it took a very long time to get here.  I'm a little spoiled by Prime, but it took well over a week.

product_title: Evenflo Bounce and Learn Bee Exersaucer (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased this for my third child. Having so many children, I know a thing or two about baby products. This is by far my favorite stationary entertainer. I've tried all the cheapie ones... Not worth it!

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_body: I'm so glad I saw this online and read the reviews and decided to buy it. I've gone back to work and am pumping 3x/day while I'm here. After just 4 days of having to sit in a conference room holding the pump up to myself, I knew I was going to go insane from doing this so often and was worried about getting burned out. I got this special bra and wish I'd gotten it even sooner. It's truly a lifesaver! I am right on the edge as far as sizing, and I debated on which to get. I went ahead and got the smaller one as that seemed to be what most people in the reviews suggested, and of course I HOPE that I will be losing more of this baby weight soon anyway. :) I'm glad I got it because it fits fine and I'm sure the bigger one would have been too big. Of course you want it snug and form-fitting to be sure it holds the pump securely to your body. I can now eat, drink, play with my phone, look at a magazine, whatever while pumping whereas before I had to basically just sit there. Definitely worth the money.

product_title: DEX Products Sound Sleeper SS-01
review_body: It's been said by many other reviewers, but this sound machine was way too wimpy for our liking in the sound department. If volume isn't your concern, it should suit you just fine. The ability to combine sounds was novel, although I doubt my daughter knew the difference.

product_title: TL Care 100% Organic Cotton Nursing Pads
review_body: These are very soft and comfortable, especially during the few couple of weeks when my nipples were sore. I find them to be more comfortable than the disposable kind, and like the idea of reusable. However, if you leak a lot they aren't as good at protecting your clothes as the disposable kind that have a plastic-y backing. I only have this problem at night and actually use both a disposable and one of these for extra absorbancy. Also, they are very visible if you wear them with just a nursing tank versus a nursing bra. Overall, love them!

product_title: Ergobaby Organic Baby Carrier, Green River Rock (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I'm already a HUGE fan of the original Ergo which someone had given me, and I'm absolutely ecstatic about the Organic Green River Rock version. The khaki version I was gifted was great functionality-wise but very boring colorwise and I've just fallen in love with the design and colors. The Ergo quality just can't be beat and my 11 month old loves it. She feels secure and snug in it and it's great to have a place to have her nap easily on the go. It's super easy to nurse discreetly in public and on the go too. Especially recommend this for anyone with back problems too; the design really distributes the weight well and is super comfortable (coming from someone who has had chronic back pain and shoulder surgery)!

product_title: Sweet Jojo Designs Pink and Green Flower Accent Floor Rug
review_body: I really like the way this rug looks in my daughters bathroom, but was a little disappointed that it can NOT be washed and only spot cleaned.  Other than that I love it!

product_title: The Shrunks Toddler Travel Bed Portable Inflatable Air Mattress Bed for Toddlers for Travel or Home Use
review_headline: Shipped with a hole...made it useless
review_body: We ordered the inflatable toddler bed for a trip to see the grandparents.  Shipping was fast and fortunately I set it up 2 days before we were scheduled to leave.  I inflated the bed and to my surprise, I heard the \\"hiss of death\\".  Yes, it had a hole in it and we were leaving in 2 days.  Kind of makes the product useless.  Called Amazon and hopefully they can ship a new one before we leave.  Crossing my fingers.

product_title: Britax Roundabout 55 Convertible Car Seat, Onyx (Prior Model)
review_headline: A dream come true for a small car!
review_body: This car seat just came today and I could not be more excited!  My car is a Ford Escape and I have the very safe, but very large Safety First Air 65 in it.  I love the seat, but it does not come close to fitting my husband's Scion Tc, which is about the size of a clown car.  With our infant seat in the back, the front seat had to be pushed and tilted forward and no one could sit there.  I ordered the Britax Roundabout seat b/c some reviews said that it fit in smaller cars.  And it fit!  It is rear facing, reclined all the way and it fits!  I can sit comfortably in the front seat of the clown car again!  It's like a miracle.  And my daughter seems extremely comfortable and happy in it.  This car seat is a MUST if you have a tiny car, but also want a really safe and nice seat.  The price was good for the quality and it was also easy to install with the LATCH system.  I love, love, love this seat!

product_title: Replacement Tubing for Medela Pump in Style BPA Free,  2-Count (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Do not work well with Medela
review_body: This tube doesn't work with Medela Advanced Breast Pump. It does not connect well to Medela. The tube is so thick,and improperly cut.

product_title: Sassy Ladybug Teethers Developmental Toy, 2 Pack
review_headline: NOT supposed to go in the freezer!
review_body:
I am writing this review because a couple of the reviews had mentioned putting them in the freezer. However, upon arrival, the package says refrigerator only (so freeze at your own risk!). Having said that, these teethers are cute. I was surprised that they were softer than some of our others. I initially thought it might come apart when I gave it to little one, but so far both teethers have held up well. I was disappointed with not being able to freeze them, but baby girl likes them because there is lots of teething room and she likes to chew on the antenna, so I guess they are a hit after all.

Update:
Had to change from 4 to 5 stars. We lost a ladybug and had to re-order so little one would have more than one!

product_title: JL Childress Gate Check Bag for Car Seats, Red
review_body: This car seat bag ripped the very first time I used it.  I checked it at the gate as directed and it still did not hold up.  I would definitely not recommend this product.

product_title: Circo® Toddler Blast Off Bedding Set
review_body: This bedding set is so adorable and my son loves it!!  I know it is overpriced, but it is still worth it.  The seller was great, too.  I ordered this late last week (Thurs. or Fri.) and received it Moday with standard shipping.  Very pleased!

product_title: One Step Ahead Kids or Toddlers Hypoallergenic, Mite-proof, BPA Free Antimicrobial Pillow, 18 x 12
review_body: After trying out a few pillows from home that we already owned, I decided to purchase a pillow especially for my 20 month old. Our other pillows were too large or too full. I found that a lumbar pillow was just about the right size for her; however, it was hardly hypoallergenic and it was still a little too full. This is the perfect size for her, and she loves it. I find that when I check on her after a few hours of sleep, her head is still nestled on it, and she sleeps peacefully. It's not too full or too long. Very happy with it.

product_title: JL Childress Gate Check Bag for Umbrella Strollers, Red
review_body: i got this because i am traveling & i needed this bag to put my stroller in so it wouldnt get dirty & damaged when they put it under the plane,,..

product_title: Munchkin Warm Glow Wipe Warmer
review_headline: Hmm, warmer dries wiles a little and wastes elec....is it necessary?
review_body: Got this after friend said had to get a wipes warmer but didn't use the warmer function much.  Felt like it was wasting electricity and drying out wipes. So we mostly use it unplugged (detaches from most of cord/plug). It is a very nice case for wipes otherwise and works as advertised.  It's heavy so it stays nicely in place when you're trying to pull a wipe out one handed.  Pull out wipe first and hold in hand a little to warm up as getting ready for diaper change helps.  We also live in warm climate so that helps.  If you live in colder climate/house, a warmer might be more useful.

product_title: Kiddyloo Toilet Seat Reducer (Purple/ Lilac) - Toddler Potty Training Seat
review_headline: GREAT Potty Seat for Independant Learners
review_body:
We are starting to potty train our twins at just over 2 1/2 years old. We have two very independant kids and have found they are much more receptive to the subject of toilet training with this product.
They are around quite a lot of older kids, so have shown very little interest in sitting on the little potty seats. Neither were too good with using a stool and the regular toilet seat reducer. They both WANT to sit on the toliet with this combined reducer and step stool. Hopefully it will lead to a quick transition to being potty trained and out of diapers. But, just the fact they actually LIKE this, is a huge step in the right direction for us.
For the record, our son is big for his age. He weighs about 34 pounds, and has no issue with this shifting or not holding his weight at all. He even takes it off the toilet when he gets down (I always put it on the toilet so I can make sure it is sturdy and even).
So far, so good. Money well spent already :)

product_title: Supergate Extra Wide Gate
review_body: The only good thing about this gate is the fact that it's long and works in a big opening.  The latch on the gate is extremely difficult to use that when we first got it I would climb over it. The whole thing is plastic, even the latch. It can also be difficult to slide back when you want it open and its pretty heavy, we had to put extra holes in it and the wall to securely attach it. I would not recommend this gate to anyone.

product_title: SwaddleDesigns Baby Lovie, Plush Dots Security Blanket with Color Trim
review_body: This has been wonderful. My 10 month old son LOVES his blanket like this but it is just too hot to be toting along a blanket so we bought one of these...PERFECT! We have actually bought a second one already!

product_title: EZ-Freeze Cereal on the Go
review_body: I'm disappointed, the cap where the cereal goes doesn't screw on. I tried to lift it by the cap one time and all my cereal spilt in my car. Ok user error for that one. But the milk leaks out of the bottom portion at the part with the rubber band, bummer.

product_title: Fisher-Price Newborn Rock 'n Play Sleeper, Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My friend has twins and they sleep in these all day long. He particularly likes them because he can sit back and watch television or read and just uses his feet to gently rock them. He's very happy that he's able to comfort two babies without even using his hands.

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_body: I bought this item just for my husband. He's a first time dad, but I am on my second child. I honestly didn't think I needed anything to tell me when to feed my child and how long its been since I fed him. However, I wasn't able to breastfeed so I had to make sure I pumped every two hours. The itzbeen saved us so much trouble! I programmed the special button for my pumping and was able to use the feeding timer in the beginning to see when he was eating so I could make sure I had enough pumped. Later, he developed thrush on top and bottom so we made the bottom two buttons for his mouth medicine and butt medicine. Honestly looking back, I'm so very glad that this item was purchased. Its very cheap and easy to use and portable so we can take it to grandparents house when they babysit and know exactly how long it's been since he ate when we get him back. I would definitely recommend this to first time moms, but I'm proof that second time moms can benefit as well!!

product_title: Munchkin Active Animals Insulated Straw Cup, 9 Ounce, Colors May Vary
review_body:
I make my daughter a green smoothie every morning and she uses this cup for it every day and it has held up very well. For that use it is perfect. For water though, especially for my younger daughter it is not great. The water spills out the top, so it is not spill proof.

I use this daily and do love it for smoothies and for my older daughter so I would recommend it highly and have recommended it to several friends and on a FB group. But not for water.

product_title: Non-Toxic 24" X 24" X~9/16" Extra Thick Baby Non-Recycled Quality Rainbow Waterproof Playmats (Set of 4)
review_body: We have hardwood floor and needed something to cushion our little one's when attempting to stand up and failing... These playmats are really comfy and he likes to play on them. I would highly recommend them! Besides, they are washable, you can clean them with a damp cloth.

product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_body: It hangs up in the shower so it doesn't take up any room. You can use it in the sink when they're newborn. Baby doesn't slide off and they can go on their belly too with their arms hanging off so they can play with toys when they're older. Other tubs are hard and always scared me because when a baby starts to hold their head up they drop it really fast and can get hurt. This is perfect for softening the blow. Love it!

product_title: Aottop Strollers & Accessories
review_body: I bought this just from reading the reviews from the BJ Parent console and comparing to this Diono Buggy. I have the BJ City Mini GT. Transitioning from a snap & go with cup holder to nothing blows! So I bought the Diono Buggy and do not regret it. Can hold more than enough for me right now (have a 3 month old) bottle, wristlet, bottle water and the blackberry with room to spare...good to go! Best $10 spent.

product_title: Chicco Ct0.6 Capri Lightweight Stroller, Topazio (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: With our son now more mobile and grown up, we were looking for a stroller that we could bring around without the car seat/bucket attached!  We were looking for one with the shoulder straps as we've seen other kids pulling forward and didn't want to fear him tipping over. This stroller is super convenient and folds up and opens in a breeze!

product_title: Kid Safe Driveway Guard
review_body:
I bought this for my three year old. He's a runner. Down our driveway. Down the sidewalk. Down our neighbors driveway. Etc. The fence is a great \\"visual\\" barrier for him and we have not had an incident since we installed.

Rating goes to a 4 (not a 5) because there is slack in the fence at the top. And although he COULD crawl over it (the fence does not \\"lock\\" so it pushes down if he leans on it), he has not. YET.

product_title: Motorola Remote Wireless Video Baby Monitor withColor LCD Screen
review_body:
Muy buen producto... La calidad de la imagen es muy buena, vale la pena pagar un poco mas y tener la pantalla lcd de 3.5 inch...

product_title: Auto Close Metal Baby Gate
review_body: When I was shopping on Amazon for a baby/dog gate I read lots of reviews, and I remember two things made me hesitate.  One was a series of comments about inadequate shipment packaging that basically pulverized some key parts like hinges, and the other was conflicting information about whether this product would install successfully in a 29\\" opening; one indication held that the minimum was 29.5\\".  I'm writing to say that the product arrived in a sturdy cardboard box, with evidently adequate internal bracing because it arrived in perfect condition.  So, if you're hesitating about packaging, they've solved that problem.  The other issue I can speak to is that it absolutely does install correctly in a 29.0\\" opening, although I think anything shy of that wouldn't work.  There is just enough play in the framework of the gate that you will be able to turn the adjustment knobs and get it to fit, tension properly, and have the magnetic latch assembly work correctly.  Which, by the way, it does quite nicely.  And if you plan to use this to keep a dog on one side of it, as is the case at my house, I can also advise that the latch assembly is designed so you have to do two things simultaneously (lift up and pull back on a spring-lever) and while there are no doubt dogs out there who could master this they will be in the very small minority.  Also, the self-closing feature works reliably and smoothly, which is nice when your hands are full, and the button that allows you to override the self-closer works smoothly too.  The overall design of the product is sturdy, there are no rough edges, the plastic parts are better quality, and the look of it is nice, not cheap.  One final note:  the distance between the upright spindles is too narrow for the average housecat to pass through.  My cats are working on figuring out the trajectory for jumping over it and they'll probably have that mastered in the next day or two.  All in all:  good product, happy customer.

The quality is lacking there too. I was informed it's normal for the adapters on my B agile to be wobbly & it is very difficult to push with both hands, unlike the city mini, when you have over 25lbs on it bc of the baby & carseat. If your going to waste so much money, make sure the quality is there from the beginning & will actually last through the toddler years. I will be shopping for a new stroller after my unpleasant experience.

product_title: Baby Jogger City Select Single Stroller
review_body:
My wife and I are expecting our second child and by the time it's born our first will be about to turn 2. Since both of our kids are going to be in the stroller together for awhile it was really important to my wife and I to get a decent double stroller. We looked the hardest between the City Select, the B-Ready and the Orbit Baby Helix, even though the double part of the latter isn't out yet. We also knew that we wanted a tandem stroller and not a side by side which is just too wide to navigate through clothes racks, etc.

For a single stroller my daughter had a Bugaboo Bee which we absolutely loved. My wife is very petite and is only 5'-1\\" so stroller weight and ease of use are what primarily drove our decision to buy the Bee. I must say, the Bee performed exactly how we hoped it would, extremely easy to fold and automatically lock and very light so that my wife could put it in the trunk of our car on her own. Moving to a double stroller we knew that we were never going to be able to find a stroller that weighed what the Bee does so we focused on finding a stroller that was easy to fold, still relatively light weight and didn't stick kid #1 below and behind kid #2. The City Jogger hit all of these marks very well. The multiple configurations is what sells this stroller, our daughter hates being confined and we knew she wouldn't be happy staring at the back of baby #2's seat like she would be in the B-Ready and most of the other tandem double strollers. The Orbit Baby truly looks like a great concept but ultimately it weighs more than the City Jogger and there are too many steps to fold it, not to mention the price difference.

My wife and I tested the City Jogger locally and although it seemed huge at first compared to the Bee it was still pretty small considering that it holds two full size seats; it is fairly wide at the rear though. We love the brake location on the City Jogger and the huge basket underneath, the canopy also comesdown farther than the Bee's, the tires are a good improvement for rougher terrain, and although the City Jogger moves very easily I must say it just doesn't glide the same way the Bee does but that's to be expected given the weight. The City Jogger also has an excellent tray that can be purchased separately and the Bee does not.

Now for the fold, again, considering the size of the City Jogger, it is very easy, and it's a huge benefit to be able to fold it even with two full size seats attached (although I believe they both have to be facing forward), it does take up more space than the Bee and it is definitely heavier, thus making it more difficult for my wife to get in the trunk on her own, but she can still do it. The only part I don't like is that it does not lock automatically like the Bee, so you have to close a clasp each time you fold it. I think this is a great product and my daughter seems very comfortable in it. If I could change anything I would add automatic folding lock, rear suspension and try to make the rear a little less wide but none of these are deal breakers and given that the City Select does everything else we wanted it to do better than the competition, I'm very pleased with our choice.

product_title: Diaper Sprayer for Toilet - Diaper Washer Hand Held Bidet Sprayer for Cloth Diapers
review_body:
I've been using this diaper sprayer for about 2 months now, and I love it! It was priced really fairly when I compared it to similar products. I also like that it is white, not metallic - so it isn't the first thing you see when you walk in the bathroom.
My husband had no problems at all installing it. The only reason I give it 4 stars instead of 5 is that when I use the sprayer, water sprays all over the toilet seat, not just into the toilet bowl - so it makes a bit of a mess that I have to clean up.

product_title: 100 Wonder Playball Non-Toxic Crush Proof Quality Invisiball /w Mesh Tote, Red/Orange/Yellow/Green/Teal/Blue/Sky Blue/Purple/Pink/White
review_body:
We purchased these play balls to fill a ball pit for my 15 month old son. The balls came in a very nice mesh tote. I don't anticipate storing the balls in this, but it would be great for storing other toys!

The balls themselves are very sturdy. To test them we sat on them, crunched them, stood on them and they always popped right back. The colors are vibrant and the finish is glossy...not dull like some other balls that I have seen. My son had a great time jumping around in the balls and then collecting them to put them back in the ball pit.

These are a little more expensive, but they are durable and look great. Additionally, I feel better knowing they are phthalate free, as these do end up in little ones' mouths.

review_headline: i wish it was love at first sight...

product_title: WubbaNub Lamb Infant Pacifier
review_body:
This arrived in the mail yesterday - My daughter is due in 5 weeks and I've read so many great reviews on these little things that I just had to buy one for her. When it came I was surprised at how SMALL it really is!

When you look at photos of other people's photos of their babies holding these they look pretty decent in size, like this would be something that baby could use as a stuffed animal in a year or so, once they are off a pacifier. We ordered the lamb one, and with the pacifier off of it (It'll just take a few scissor snips to take it off), it looks like it could be a toy for a dog!

It's so darn cute and tiny though... My 8lb poodle saw it come out of the bag an immediately sat in front of me, thinking it was a new toy for her. We've put it in the nursery and now she sits at the door waiting to go in so she can try and find it. (haha!) I will update this after baby arrives and we have a chance to use it, but I am hopeful that it will be a big success!

UPDATE 9/14/12

My daughter is 7 weeks now and she loves this thing. We recently took it on a trip to CA, and I make sure it's always in her diaper bag when we leave the house. We also have the blue bear one of these that stays at home as well. It's been great to keep it in her mouth when sleeping (she's a tummy sleeper), and when in the baby carrier, I don't have to worry about her dropping it and losing it in the carrier!

Also - Our cousin has about 9 of these ones for his son, and they love them as well!

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Jumperoo (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: FISHER PRICE OCEAN WONDERS Jumperoo A++ from my kid!
review_body: WOW... squeals in delight! My 4.5 month old son ABSOLUTELY loves this thing... even if he's cranky he instantly will perk right up. He loves seeing the world from this view too, unassisted. He has good control of his neck and torso but the bouncer has strengthened these muscles and just in a week of use. It's also strengthening his legs and gives him a sense of self control. Also, on a warm day, this keeps him cool, not lying on his back or side. I agree with the other reviews; music is cute, not annoying with two volume settings. There is a repeat music setting and a respond to bouncing setting. Love seeing my son bounce harder to hear the sounds - positive feedback essentially. The seat cover is durable and after a nice spit-up (do get a good after feeding burp before placing baby in!) it washed right out in cold water, and a line dry. I'd say the seat is even a little more flexible after that washing. Easy on and off, the slots are well made and keep the seat secure even when the seat is pull up when removing baby's legs. The base of the jumper is wide and definitely secure. I put the whole thing together by myself in about 10 minutes. Toys are durable, fun, and colorful. The clam shell with lite-up pearl is his favorite thing to play with currently. The height adjustments are quite easy to use, as the bar the loop attaches to (under the bouncer seat frame swings out a bit for easy on/off. The spring is just perfect - not too much or too little. Glad we'll get lots of use with the 3 height settings - my lil' guy is quite tall. VERY well made product and I am glad I bought it from Amazon (and on sale!) saved about $12 over BRU and BBB. There is also a jungle themed bouncer Fisher Price makes. Super happy with this bouncer and can't get over how giggly and smiley my baby is! A++

product_title: Playtex 3 Pack Baby Drop Ins Nurser
review_body:
This review was from 2012... See bottom for new design.
Even when I bring a bottle brush in the diaper bag I cant always get to a sink. Thats where these come in. They really help make cleaning bottles easier and convienent. Although it is an added expense with the liners, they are pretty inexpensive in bulk and if you dont use them all day everyday. Would reccomend to a mom who doesnt have much time to clean bottles or who wants an inexpensive easily replacable (they sell these pratically everywhere,even gas stations) quality product.

Why does it seem like every company that makes something "new and improved" it almost always means "new and terrible" I had these nursers from 2012 with my oldest. They were sleek and had the short caps and never leaked. They were so easy to use and the rings came off without getting arthritis. These new angles nursers actually are a good idea for upright feeding. Alot of reviewers complain that they are getting suds trapped in the hinges but I hand wash and the bottle brush always seems to get the suds out fine. I actually prefer the look of these to the old ones and they are more accurate (although still not always perfect). It seems like Playtex missed the mark on these "locking rings" I may have received defective ones but I am not the only reviewer who seems to have this problem of struggling to get the lid on and off correctly without pulling my fingers off. If they had just realized tired parents don't want to go prying things off and on at 3am they would have made the perfect new design. Disliking the design is not really a reason to give this bottle a terrible rating. It's the function that I care about the most. And the function is awful. Thought having less to scrub would be easier but actually should have just thrown my money in the trash. If there is some trick I am missing to these please someone help me. Otherwise I hate these!

review_body: This product great for a travel product.  Few things. The seat when inflated is much lower than your typical booster seat.  It is more difficult to deflate than I would have expected. I think this is because the valve is set to sort of self inflate if left over a period of time so any slight release puts air back in.  The shoulder rest strap doesn't work very well. That is unless you have a small vehicle and space is a premium or need to use seats side by side in your vehicle.

product_title: Milkies Milk Trays
review_headline: Great idea, pain in the neck to use
review_body:
I purchased this because I liked the idea of not using a disposable product both for financial and environmental reasons. I saw a sample at the lactation clinic and read the reviews (which I should have heeded). The idea is great, but there are too many steps and too many hassles to make this product worthwhile.

First, I find the measurements to be inaccurate. I would put 3 sticks in a bottle to thaw, and come back to 2.5 liquid ounces. I fill to the little line on top of the tray to allow for expansion, but it is inexact. Also, more than 3 sticks are difficult to fit into a bottle--I have to break them in half and still it is hard to smash them all in there (into an 8 oz. bottle!). When freezing the milk, the tray lids are not a snug fit and as someone already wrote, they leak when you transfer them back into the freezer, no matter how careful you are. Add on top of that the hassle of taking them out of the tray (not easy) and putting them into bags and washing them (not in the dishwasher--the lid warped badly) and it is not worth it. So 20 bucks down the drain. I ordered some bags instead.

I really wanted to like them, but they are not practical in any sense.

product_title: FridaBaby NoseFrida The SnotSucker Nasal Aspirator
review_body:
Ok, so I shop on amazon ALL the time and I have never left a review before this! But I love the Nosefrida so much I just had to share my opinion! My son is 6 weeks old and we both have been getting over a cold for the past 10 days! But he still has a ton of congestion and it even causes him to have this scary \\"rattling\\" noise in his chest! (Doctor assured me it's nothing but loose mucus and is normal) But it bothers him all day and especially when he sleeps!! Now, I know everyone raves about the hospital bulb syringes but I, unfortunately, forgot mine in the hospital when I left and have since purchased every bulb syringe I could find and have had NO success!! I have never been able to get more than just a tiny bit of snot out of his nose at a time! Not nearly enough to make him comfortable! I have even tried using the saline drops first....NADA!! And in the mean time my son has, of course, learned to hate anything near his nose!! So I'm not going to sit here and lie and say that the Nosefrida doesn't make him cry! He is 6 weeks old.....of course he is going to cry! (And let me add that he is a very happy baby most of the time) He is not crying because it is painful, he is crying because he just doesn't like it! Sometimes he doesn't like it when I change his diaper or give him a bath but i'm still gonna do it! But I don't understand parents who gave this a bad review because their baby cried.....it's not about them liking it, it's about them being able to breathe!! Which in my opinion is way more important! I respect people's opinions but a baby turning red and screaming does not mean a product doesn't work. My kid did that with every bulb syringe, even with the all mighty hospital syringe. Anyway, I used the Nosefrida for the first time today and it worked like magic!! I put a few drops of saline in his nose, waited a few seconds and sucked! Poof, long white boogers came right out of his nose! (Gross, I know) But, I have never been so happy about boogers in my life!! While my husband, sister-in-law, and I danced around the room in celebration, my son was crying for a bit because I'm sure he couldn't see the joy in the situation. He stopped crying after a few min and that was that!! No psychological damage done. Totally worth it.

Also, a few people mentioned it being \\"too gross\\"...umm....I don't know how other people's kids are, but I have to deal with FAR worse thing's than boogers near my mouth! LOL! My son has incredible aim every time I change his diapers. He also has perfect timing when it comes to spitting up on mommy's clean shirt..or in my hair...so the Nosefrida is the least of my problems. Now, I've only used it once so I don't know about people's concerns about catching their baby's colds....but again I feel like that is just as likely to happen from just being around each other so much. And I also didn't have any problems with bleeding or cutting my baby's nose with the Nosefrida either....it's meant to be over sized so that you can't push it too far into their little nostrils and hurt them.....Just place it far enough to plug up the nostril so that you can get enough suction from the tube and that's it. And I didn't feel that you need very much lung capacity either. Again, I think it's all about getting the technique right! It might take a few tries;)

This is a great product! It almost makes me wonder why I didn't think of it myself! LOL! Just remember to read the instructions, be patient, keep trying and don't expect your little baby to keep still during the process! Nobody likes to hear their baby cry but when it comes to my son either crying like crazy for 5 min or breathing well at night then my choice will always be the latter! Good luck!!
