Both baskets shipped really fast and got to me before the other items I ordered at the same time.

product_title: American Baby Company 100% Cotton Percale Dust Ruffle
review_body: Bought this for our nursery and it's perfect. Fits great and looks to be made well. Simple white, slightly sheer but it's a true white and feel I didn't want anything to bulky on the bottom.

product_title: Kidswitch Light Switch Extender- 3 Pack
review_body: Work just as specified! Have one in our son's bedroom and in his playroom. It's so nice for him to be able to turn the light on and off without standing on a stool!

product_title: Graco Snugride 35 Infant Car Seat
review_headline: I searched and searched for the "BEST" car seat
review_body: So I searched and read reviews after reviews for my unborn baby, thinking this was the perfect car seat for my little guy.. I was wrong. The size is larger than standard car seats, you can't fit them into highchairs, baby carriers and booths at restaurants. It's so heavy and we dred putting him into it! Also the cover easily slides off and will not stay in place. My next baby car seat will not be a Graco. I hear Britax is the best on the market right now!

product_title: Prince Lionheart Premium Wipe Warmer
review_body:
The warmer has worked for a month and died. I disassembled the warmer to see what went wrong and if it was possible to repair the unit.
The device circuit is very simple and consists of four elements (heater, thermal fuse, the LED and current limiting resistor for the LED). Heater is made of the flat aluminum wire on the plastic former with two (tin??) contacts. Contacts are clamped and spot welded at the each end of the wire to form solderable pads. THESE CONTACTS ARE VERY POORLY MADE AND ARE BOUND TO FAIL. The usage of the heater which is guaranteed to fail (within weeks most likely) makes this model a lemon. I strongly recommend against purchasing this unit.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Classic Polypropylene Bottle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Good bottles - never had a leak when assembled properly!
review_body:
Well the title says it all - these have not leaked unless I forgot the ring or did not assemble the parts correctly. I use these with the variable flow nipples. My baby had AWFUL reflux and these bottles were a lifesaver for that because they allowed me to feed baby rice cereal in her formula. I did have issues with the nipples collapsing BUT I found out I was the cause of that, too: the top (part nipple is attached to) did not need as much tightening as I was giving it. In fact, the less I tightened the top, the better. And still, NO LEAKS!

Before these I tried Dr. Brown's and those were a complete joke. I returned those. As a new parent and mom to 2 babies under the age of one, I did not have time to clean all those parts!!! Dr. Brown's bottles have so many parts it is absolutely insane! They do not work any better than Avent, either, they are just more time consuming.

So, I would recommend these bottles, especially with the variable flow nipple if your baby has reflux. Our baby was on medication and we did not like the side-effects, so we went with the rice in the formula and have never looked back.

The reason I gave these 4 stars is because after 4 months of use these clear bottles are now tinted orange/red. They are washed well, scrubbed, etc. so I have no clue what the stain is from. They are only used for formula.

Aside from that, no issues with cracks, leaking, or anything else - great product!

product_title: Honeysuckle Breast Milk Storage Bags, 300 Bag Bulk Pack
review_body: I have been using these bags since I came back to work full-time. They are durable and do the job well. I also love that they are more environmentally friendly. Somebody had mentioned not having space to write out the amount, but I just put that in the space above where I write out my daughter's name and the date as there is plenty of room.

product_title: Planet Wise Wet Diaper Tote Bag
review_body: We really like this bag. It has plenty of room, and the zipper closer works really well at keeping smells in. Haven't had any leaking issues either. One nice thing is the strap has a snap closure, so you can hook it around things to hang.

product_title: Edushape Educolor Building Blocks
review_body: I had a set of these when I was a kid, so I knew I wanted to get some for my daughter.  In the bath they are so much fun because the water makes them stick together slightly just from the surface tension, so it's fun to make rafts and stick the blocks on the side of the tub or the tile.  Endless possibilities.  We got the set of 30, and I think if we had any more, I'd be annoyed that there were so many. 30 is a good number.

product_title: Summer Infant Tub Time Bubble Maker
review_headline: Great potential, result = waste of money
review_body:
First of all, I've had it for probably 9 months now and doesn't seem to be anywhere near breaking.
Unfortunately, when you turn it on, that's it; it's on.
There's no flow or time button. For instance, if the bubbles came out at a slower pace, and then would run for about 10 seconds and then waited a minute, then started again, that would be AWESOME! However, it doesn't. It's on/off and at a moderate pace which is just too much.
Overall, waste of money. If redesigned, then I would spend more money.

product_title: Carters Velour Playard Fitted Sheet, Chocolate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This sheet is very soft and comfy. My daughter sleeps in her pack n play so this came in handy. I have washed it and it still fits perfectly. I read reviews on other products before I purchased this sheet and most people were complaining about the way the sheets fit after a wash. When I wash my sheet, I lay it out to air dry, so try that instead of drying.

product_title: Baby Deedee Sleep Nest  Baby Sleeping Bag
review_headline: Light-weight but maintains warmth - great product
review_body: very light, but warm. Upside-down zipper and buttons on shoulder strap are great features. Will most likely buy another one.

product_title: HABA Motley Pacifier Chain, Multicolor
review_body: This chain is actual wood and very durable.  I washed it when first got it and it did not soften like some wood products do.  Also I have gotten so many compliment on it and it always catches my baby's eye.  I just wish it was a little longer so I wouldn't have to attach it so close to his face.  The attachment is also very durable.

product_title: Pourty Easy-to-Pour Potty
review_body: A friend recommended this potty to me, and I decided to try it as my just-turned-three year old son was now so enthusiastic about his potty training he was often making a big mess trying to pour out the Bjorn potty we were using.  In addition the Bjorn was leaving a ring on his bottom.  The Pourty fixed both these issues.  It is GREAT to have a simple design that is easy to pour out/rinse or wipe clean.  The wide spacing makes sitting far less of a chore, and he can keep his independence.  Sometimes simple is better - what a great design and price to match.

product_title: Sassy Crib and Floor Mirror
review_body: What a great product, my six month old grandson loves it.  All the research says babies love to study themselves and they were right.  The only thing I would change is I wish the bee and the ladybug would come off.  They are not removeable.  Still overall a winner

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_headline: Itzbeen timers are my new best friend!
review_body: This little device helps in a big way! It can keep track of feedings, diaper changes, naps, you name it! 4 total timers. So helpful and easy to use.

product_title: Boon Stem Grass and Lawn Drying Rack Accessory
review_body: These accessories are the best idea! You can fit so much more on the lawns now. Looks so great in the kitchen, too, unlike some of the boring and cheap looking bottle racks on the market, which are almost the same price!

product_title: Chicco Smart Support Backpack, Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Comfortable for child, painful for us
review_body:
We bought it from ToysRUs using a price match from Diapers.com for the same price as Amazon. Our 2 year-old son weighing under 30 lbs was happy and comfortable, but I can't say the same for us. Both my wife and I felt the same way: As soon as we put it on, we felt tugging and strain on our shoulders, chest, and upper back. We adjusted the straps to make the pack as close to our backs as possible, but it was still quite painful. We are both 5'7\\" - 5'8\\".

We bought the Kelty TC 2.1 from CraigsList, and right away, it felt so much better.

I'll definitely be returning the Chicco to ToysRUs.

product_title: Chicco 360 Degree Rotating Hook On Chair
review_headline: Love it for use on kitchen island!
review_body:
Before ordering this chair I searched everywhere for the length of the arms/minimum clearance needed to hook up, since I was going to use the chair on my kitchen island (bar/counter). I could not find any information on this so I called Chicco. I was told by Chicco that the minimum amount of space to hook it up would be 12\\", but most important was that the part of the arms that are covered by the rubber are completely on top of the counter. The amount of clearance on our countertop was 12\\" so I had to order and test it... WE PASSED!!!
* First thing: So easy to assemble! Wow!
* Turning the chair is so much fun and easy!
* My baby is super comfortable in it!
* The chair IS made out of fabric... it got dirty on first use, but just a little. I can see that I am going to have to throw this seat in the washer about every 2 weeks or so. It's not that hard to get the seat off... putting it in is a bit of a pain, but hopefully I will get the hang of it and get easier every time.
* Love the tray! Keeps my granite clean, easy to wash, dishwasher safe and it ACTUALLY fits in the dishwasher!
* We took it to the bowling alley today. (We have an older child that loves to bowl!) The chair was a little bulky to be an \\"on-the-go\\" chair. However, it hooks on and off in a matter of seconds! I did not buy it as a travel chair (we have a high chair cover) so the steps to get it to fit in the bag did not upset me, but it's not like it was impossible! Definitely great to have when going to places that don't usually have high chairs (like a bowling alley!)

*****NEW ADDITION TO THE REVIEW*******

My toddler is now 22 months and we have stopped using the chair. Not because we were not happy with it, but because she wants to sit on a big chair like big sister!

We used the chair for a year and I loved it! So easy, functional and I received so many compliments on it! Also a huge space saver! I never got better at putting the seat backin after washing. That was a huge pain in the butt! But what I started doing instead was taking the whole chair off my counter, taking it to my yard and hosing it off. So much easier and was clean every time! Also my kid never, ever, ever got her fingers stuck in it, I had read that before I purchased. I guess they can get their fingers stuck anywhere if you are not careful! Anyway. Used it for a year and I loved it! Worth every penny!

product_title: Britax Second Seat for B-Ready Stroller
review_body: I got the second seat for a baby that's on the way, but i got to test it out when i baby sat for a friend. It was so easy to put on and it never got in the way of my feet. The kids loved it too! Best stroller i ever bought!

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Healthy Care High Chair
review_body: I purchased this chair for my 3 month old daughter who loves to play with toys. There are so many \\"pretty\\" high chairs out there now days but none of them have anything to entertain and are almost all ridiculously priced! As a parent I would chose functionality for my child over whether or not it matches my decor any day and I am OCD when it comes to matching lol. The colors are bright and the pattern is very childish but it's very cute and I don't think it takes away from the charm of my country style kitchen at all! Originally I registered for the one of the wooden chairs that would match my decor but was so thankful I did not get it after reading reviews during my search for the perfect chair. I had a similar FisherPrice chair for my 7 yo, it was aquarium theme and had an awesome little toy that had music and a little show and snapped in and out, I loved that high hair and was disappointed to find it is no longer available until I found this one! I received it yesterday and assembled it myself in no time. The complaints about the \\"extra force\\" needed for some of the construction can be easily aliviated by using a power drill. I had no trouble at all thanks to mine. This chair is just like my old one and it was still in great condition after being well used for 2-3 years so I have no doubt this one will be just as sturdy. I can't wait to try it out today and see my daughters reaction to the toy. As a mother of 3 who would pay way more then I did for this chair if it was worth it, trust me, save the extra $80-100, swallow your pride in decor and buy the one that will last and entertain while you are cooking/cleaning up meals. You won't regret the decision.

product_title: Itzy Ritzy Snack Happens Reusable Snack and Everything Bag
review_body: This is cute and a little bigger than the ones you find that close with velcro.  I haven't put anything wet in it yet, but I like it for dry goods and it's been great rolling around on the bottom of my purse.

product_title: Combi Kobuk Air-Thru, Licorice
review_headline: Nice looking but did not work out for me
review_body: I really like how this booster looks. It's got a great design and looks super cool in the car.  However, when we raised the shoulder guide to the proper height, it did not hold my sons head in-between the side wings. I wanted this seat so that it would catch his head when he fell asleep and it was not able to do that. Maybe my kid has too short of a neck, but it's something that you want to try out with your own kid for fit.  It is a little bit challenging to get the seatbelt under the armrest, but not something that an adult would have much problem with.  The padding is nice and the air vents seem useful.  I wish it did fit my kid's build, because otherwise I would've liked it.

product_title: Boon Bug Pod Suction Cup Bracket (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I followed every step of the instructions included with the bracket to install in our shower.  Yet just a few hours after sticking it to our shower wall (no grout or tile...just a smooth shower surface) it fell to the ground with just the weight of itself alone.  I hadn't even attached the boon bug pod yet.  Returned to Amazon for a full refund and they paid the shipping costs since it was defective.  I'm disappointed with the item but satisfied with Amazon.com's customer service regarding the return.

product_title: Joovy Caboose Stand On Tandem Stroller
review_body:
I didn't originally think we'd need a double stroller (2.5 year old and new baby). Then my toddler hit the terrible twos and I realized sure, he can walk, but I have to have a way to restrain him in a store or public place while he's throwing a tantrum... harder to do when you have 2 kids to keep safe. This stroller does not work for that. I have to wrestle him in, and the belt for the rear seat doesn't really keep him adequately restrained. It's fairly easy for him to attack whoever is pushing. Plus on day-trips he really does need to rest his legs.

Other points:

1. It's very heavy and hard to push (even unloaded). It's tiring, and a terrible stroller for the zoo or a longer-than-average outing. Don't try to push it up a hill unless you've been in training for a while. It doesn't steer all that well, and the handle bar doesn't adjust which my average height husband says is a little uncomfortable.

2. I don't really have a problem with the basket. Sure, when the rear seat is occupied, you can't access it from the back, but you can access it from the sides.

3. It doesn't really recline enough for anybody to sleep in it. It fits the Chicco Keyfit, which is why we chose Joovy, but the front seat has to be reclined as far as it will go, which intrudes on the back occupants space considerably. My son doesn't complain, but it seems like it would be more comfortable if he didn't have to lean forward so much.

We've solved these problems by buying the Phil and Teds Explorer. I got it (with doubles kit) for about $350. I bought the stroller used off eBay, and the doubles kit on Amazon. It handles brilliantly, solves the tantruming toddler issue (5 point harness, woohoo!), is fairly light weight, takes the car seat, and leaves lots more room in the back of my car. I stopped taking the kids on walks when I had to use the Joovy, but now we're free to roam again!

product_title: Sassy Stay-Clean Silly Squirts Water Toy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Fun but not so easy to use.
review_body: My daughter loves these bath toys. The fact that she cant squirt them doesnt bother her. We do it for her sometimes, but mostly she just likes playing with the toys.

product_title: Nuby Fun Feeding Spoons & Forks 2-Pack
review_body: We have tried a few different brands of forks and spoons and these by far are the most kid friendly. Our almost 2 year old loves the bright colors! The spoon is nice and deep, making it easier to scoop more food. The fork is easy to work with and also double as a spoon when needed. Great product!

product_title: Winnie the Pooh Crib Bedding Set Playful Day With Extras!
review_body: I gave the Winnie the Pooh Crib Bedding to my niece for her nursery.  She loved the 4-piece set, Playful Day.

product_title: FAO Schwarz Baby And Toddler Scale, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Product feels cheaply made. It does its job. It weighs and holds the number for you.  There's a tare button so you can clear the held number.  Not bad if you need a cheap scale to track weight.

product_title: Playtex Baby Spill-Proof Cup Replacement Lids: Flat Top 3-Pack Bright Green
review_body: Order one or two to have on hand.  We lost lids when travel and to yukky milk in cup under the bed.  They also come with the plastic valve.  Which is great for the husband who some how gets them in the garbage disposal.  I'd get a few of just the replacement valves too[[ASIN:B000GSJ2PU Playtex Spill-Proof Cup Replacement Valves - 2 ea]] especially if you have twins & another toddler in the house.

product_title: Montalban Trailer 3 with Jogger Conversion - Folds Flat for Storage
review_body:
I bought this yesterday at Costco, and was really excited about it and the price. My problems are the same as everyOne else. The jogging wheel doesn't move, and the straps for the kids are unreal! Can't imagine trying to get two in and out with those straps. The crotch strap is too tight as well. Disappointed at this trailer. It would maybe work for one child, if they were patient.
I took it on a bike ride with one kid last night, and it did work well. So I would say if you have one child, and only want to use it as a trailer, and are creative about making the straps work, then $200 is a good price.

product_title: Pipila Portable Pacifier Sterilizer
review_body: I gave this product a 4-star rating because we didn't have it long enough to figure out how it worked. I got this for my grandchild. She is very finicky and for some reason likes to spit her pacifier out of her mouth. I honestly thinks that she likes to see up jump for it. At any rate, once she does this, we rinse the pacifier and put in the sterilizer, however, after having it for only a few days it was destroyed. My granddaughter wanted to play another game of catch the \\"binky\\" and when she spit it out, her mother's knee-jerk reaction was to try to catch the pacifier before it went to the floor, however, in the process, she knocked over the sterilizer and the plastic shattered to pieces. So, I think it would be unfair to ding a product for something that was caused by human error. From what I could tell, the product did what it was designed for, but I cannot be 100% certain. Sorry guys.

product_title: Born Free Classic Bottle Gift Set
review_body: I was looking for the born free glass bottles. It was not specified anywhere here in the description. I took a risk in ordering them and unfortunately they were not glass. Good product but the material should have been noted somewhere, thus the one star rating.

product_title: Peg Perego Convertible Premium Infant to Toddler Car Seat
review_body: I used the peg-perego primo viaggio for my daughter and this convertible car seat is as well build as its baby version. Very happy with it

product_title: Medela Calma Breastmilk Feeding Nipple
review_body: I love this bottle.  My son had many issues nursing efficiently and was not putting on weight.  In an effort to boost his weight I began pumping and feeding with a bottle.  We tried a regular bottle, but he was messy when he was eating and spit up after every feeding.  We then switched to the Calma nipple and have been very pleased.  It did take him a few times of being introduced to it to utilize it correctly.  (in my reading of the negative reviews, I wonder if some people didnt give their babies enough time to adjust to the change.)  My son does very well using the Calma.  He is able to control the flow and rarely spits up after finishing a feeding.  Additionally, he has no trouble going back to regular breast feeding; I actually believe that the bottle helped to improve his nursing efficiency.

product_title: Modo 3-in-1 Convertible Crib with Pure Core Non-Toxic Crib Mattress with Dry Waterproof Cover
review_body:
I did extensive research into a modern-looking and sturdy crib that won't cost me an arm and a leg. This Babyletto Modo 3 in 1 crib fits the bill. Setup was easy and the whole thing definitely feels solid. Much better than some of those flimsy looking entry lines - including the $200 Ikea cribs.

I did also consider the Babyletto Mercer 3 in 1, but ultimately went with the Modo because there is enough clearance under the Modo 3 in 1 for my Roomba to move in and out. With the Mercer, just be aware that the bottom of the drawer almost touches the ground, so you won't be able to either vacuum or sweep the area underneath the crib - and that area ends up becoming a dust landfill.

product_title: Carter's Conversion Kit, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Sturdy.
Easy to install.
My kid is so restless I don't know that having this makes a differance- but it looks nice.
Warning: My son did get his leg stuck in the bars at night, so I had to go in and get him unstuck just once.

product_title: Sassy Baby Food Nurser
review_body: if you are the type of parent, grandparent or care taker that wants things as easy as possible without caring if it harms your child then so be it. use them... infant feeders cause serious ear and inner ear problems.. the pressure from having to suck thick product from a bottle basically causes serious ear damage.. enough said.....

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, My Little Snugabunny (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
My friend gave me this swing, claiming that it was essential -- one of the few things that would soothe his daughter when she was an infant. All in all, the swing is nice. Plays 3 different sounds/songs for the baby at different volumes. Can adjust the seat to face forward or either side. Can increase/decrease the incline of the seat. Unfortunately, the base is very wide, so it takes up a lot of room and is hard to move from room to room.

While I appreciate the swing and think it's a good product, my baby never really took to it. She would sit in it for a few minutes at a time and then start crying. I would generally rotate between the bassinet, swing, and my arms. Given how little time my daughter spent in the swing, how much space it takes up, and how much it costs, I would caution people to test one out before purchasing it. Each baby is different and your baby may love or hate it.

product_title: BreathableBaby Breathable Mesh Liner for Portable and Cradle Cribs
review_body: WOULD NOT RECOMMEND TIS PRODUCT ONLY HAS TO TIES, DOESN'T FIT PORTA CRIB OR MINIATURE CRIB.  HAS VELCRO WHICH I DID LIKE BUT NO WAY TO SECURE TO THE RAILS FRM THE INSIDE AND IF YOU WERE TO PUT IT ON THE OUTSIDE OF CRIB IT WOULD DEFEATTHE PURPOSE OF THE PRODUCT BECAUSE YOU'RE TRYING TO KEEP THE BABY FROM BEING ABLE TO GET ARMS AND LEGS STUCK INBETWEEN THE RAILING

product_title: Pura Stainless Kiki Infant Bottle Stainless Steel
review_body: I bought this to use as a stainless steel sippy cup.  My child never quite understood how to use the sippy by tipping it back enough so we put a straw into the sippy nipple.  The stainless steel bottle is fine however the silicone sippy spout can easily be pushed into the bottle by the child,making a mess.  I have since gotten the Safe Sippy 2 and like it better since it has a straw included and holds more liquid.  If you are looking for a stainless steel bottle to feed your baby, go with the Kleen Kanteen.  I am really happy with the bottle and the nipple that goes with it.  Also, for first time parents there is no point in getting a small bottle since the baby outgrows that amount of liquid, just go with the larger 9 oz and save yourself some money!

product_title: Delta Shelby Classic Crib And Changer, Espresso Cherry (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
The Crib was a little bit of work to put together as would be any large assembly job. I was done in about 2hrs (Installation Professional) There were a few parts that went around but basically you try to plan a couple of steps ahead inorder to not be attaching and then detaching on realizing a mistake.

The quality of the wood and the crib itself is definitely above average. I would definitely recommend the product to anyone. Its always good to have someone to help during the installation but other than that it should be easy. Im writing this review after using it for almost 7 months and its fine so far. We have also moved the mattress to a lower position (fairly simple) because our little man, is too much of a jumper!

product_title: Britax Boulevard 70 Convertible Car Seat (Previous Version), Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body:
I bought this car seat based on the excellent reviews, and I will share my positive experience as well.

My wife and daughter were in an accident where a full sized pickup rear-ended our fully stopped car at over 40 mph. The force pushed our SUV into the full-sized pickup in front of her and that truck into the SUV in front of it. Our SUV looks like an accordion, and was totaled.

My wife was fortunately only bruised and scraped, but our daughter was COMPLETELY untouched.

I have replaced her car seat with another Britax Boulevard, with absolutely no hesitation whatsoever.

product_title: C.R. Gibson Iota Pacifier Clip
review_body: I love this pacifier clip because its long. It also does slide off. I attach it to her bibs and her clothes and it is perfectly fine. She also like the bright colors and playing with it when her pacifier is not in her mouth. The material is nice, better than it looks in the picture. And you can easily wash it. I would recommend this pacifier clip to any parent.

product_title: Evenflo Tribute LX Convertible Car Seat
review_body: Really love this product, my baby feels very safe and I am very pleased. I definetely recommend it to anybody that has only one child or 2, because it is a little bulky and takes a lot of space in the car

product_title: Baby Banz earBanZ Kids Hearing Protection
review_body: We bought these to protect our three month old baby from loud sirens at a 4th of July parade this year. What an amazing purchase. We had babies crying and stressed out parents all around us. Our little one was giggling and watching the parade. I was concerned they would be too big for her but they were a perfect fit on her tiny head. She loves them and doesn't fuss about having them on. We always have them in her stroller. You never know what will pop up. Most recently there was a practice air show session in Chicago that was loud and we didn't know about. Thank goodness we had them. It was loud. Great for outdoor concerts too!!

product_title: Evenflo Triumph 65 LX Seat, Cocoa Fizz (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a great car seat, nicely priced and works just great.  Someone hit my car yesterday and my daughter did not even feel it.  This seat has worked great for us for the last 17 months and we plan to replace it with the same version after the accident.  I have to say the only annoying part is the headrest, I can't get it to stay in one place, always have to adjust the cushion.

product_title: Baby Buddy Deluxe Security Harness
review_headline: Not made in USA - Not well designed either
review_body: At the time of purchase the product description and origin both indicated it is made in the USA. It is made in China. The instructions are poor and from what we could tell attachment of the leash to the harness is accomplished by looping around the harness instead of having a clip-on point. Returned it.

product_title: Chewbeads Greenwich Teething Necklace, 100% Safe Silicone
review_headline: My baby and I both LOVE these!
review_body: I am very happy with my chew beads! I wish I didn't wait so long to buy them. I still think they are a little pricy, but glad I made the purchase. They look great, easy to wear and clean. My baby seems to enjoy them. I use a baby sling a lot, and when I wear the necklace the combination keeps her very happy. Makes it great to go out to places with her. Only downfall is the necklace sometimes pulls at the hair at the base of my hair line.

product_title: Safety 1st ProGrade Soft Solution Roller Shade
review_body: I like how this shade actually stays put on the window, and I also appreciate the fact that the top part is not metal. I had another set of safety 1st shades, and the top part was metal which is not very safe in case the shades might fall off during driving. This one is safe and does its job of keeping the sun away!

product_title: Moby Wrap UV SPF 50+ 100% Cotton Baby Carrier, Coral
review_body: I bought this for my second child. After reading the booklet and experimenting a few times I find it really easy to use. I put it on before I leave the house and then put her into it when we get where we are going. It is no hotter than any other carrier, it is the baby that makes you hot!

product_title: Gummi Crib Rail
review_body: This item is saving my baby and her crib from a bunch of trouble. She was chewing and splintering the side rails of her crib (i had already put something on the front rail). It was very easy to half to fit both sides. She chews on it all the time. I chose the extra wide and it worked in our favor bc it fit the top of the rail perfectly, but it ended up 1/4\\" too long on one side rendering the adhesive strip useless. I agree with other reviews that the adhesive should be on more than just the bottom edge, but we rigged it up anyway. Some may gawk at the idea, but we ziptied the cover on. Our sweet little baby girl is super curious and into everything. Now she's safe at least during sleeping hours of ingesting paint and splinters. I would recommend this product to others.

product_title: Munchkin Extending Metal Extra Tall and Wide Baby Gate, White
review_body: We live in a log home and have uneven surfaces. The ability to adjust this gate to line up and be plumb was much easier than expected. We especially like the feature that this gate swings in and out. We also liked the fact that it did not have a bottom stabilizer bar since we have a disabled Doxie that would not be able to get over it. We have ordered a smaller one to install at the top of the stairs where there are even more challenges with Logs and Railings. More on that later.

product_title: Spasilk Washcloth, 10 Count
review_body: We are using cloth diapers. We learned that our daughter gets a rash from disposable wipes and also wanted to eliminate the waste of the throw-away product. As many reviewers mention, these cloths are thin, but that makes them work perfectly as washable wipes. We wet them under the tap with water or use a spray we make at home using cubes (lanolin, aloe, lavender) we get from The Bundle diaper shop. They get washed with the cloth diapers. We couldn't be happier with these cloths or the solution as a whole.

product_title: Tupperware Ideal Little Kids Bowl Set 3 Fruit New Color
review_body: I bought this for food portion control. It is 3 (8oz) containers. I like the size. The lids fit tight. Good value. Nice colors. This brand lasts forever.

product_title: Edushape Sensory Ball Mega Pack, 4 Piece
review_body: I purchased these for my granddaughter when she was 6 months old and she still plays with them at almost 3 years old. I also gave a set to my grandsons who play with them often. Both sets of sensory balls have held up very well. They make a great gift.

product_title: Munchkin Bottle and Nipple Brush
review_headline: sponge tears, neck snaps and rusts
review_body: This brush was not effective for us at all!  The wire neck quickly bent and rusted then snapped off.  Immediately the sponge ends tore off going into a Dr. Brown's bottle.  The nipple brush kept falling out.  The whole thing lasted less than a week before it was useless.

product_title: Munchkin Folding Step Stool
review_body: I was hoping this would have been easier to fold up to save space. Maybe it's not for a safety feature, I don't know. I keep it out, but I was hoping my child would be able to fold it up and put it away when she wasn't using it in the bathroom.

product_title: Mommys Helper 70456 Portable Shower Arm Mount, Suction Cup
review_headline: Solves the Tall Shower/Short Kid Dilemma
review_body:
I first ordered one of these about 3 years ago. Our shower head is VERY high up on the wall, so when my son would try to shower it was tough for him to get in the path of the water. This makes it very easy for him to get wet all over.

It's also very handy to use when I'm bathing the dog, as I can just attach it anywhere, even very low down or to the side of the tub.

This is actually the second one I've ordered, the first one did finally crack after a couple years when it fell off the wall. This is the best one I've found for holding a hand-held shower head at a variable level.

Edited 9/11/2013: I'm editing this review to give it the 5 stars it deserves. We've used this daily, and it hasn't fallen off the wall yet. Really a very useful and helpful product - even though my son is much taller now, he still uses it to get the shower head at just the right height.

product_title: Delta Children Nursery Closet Organizer, Beige, 24 Piece
review_body: I love this item, I have a baby girl and a baby boy sharing the same the room and this item made their closest look much more neat and organized

product_title: Keekaroo Height Right High Chair with Tray
review_body:
I was debating between this chair and the Stokke, and went with this one because the tray was included in the price. And I saw a friend's and was convinced it would be worth it. It looks like furniture, not a big plastic monstrosity. I love how it will now be my daughter's chair for years to come, though I'm not sure how someone weighing 250 would fit on the chair to sit on it. My daughter likes not being so confined compared to the graco seat my parents have. We also have the fisher price booster seat for travel/back up when friends have a kid over.

We didn't start solids till 7 months (I wasn't going to begin solids while on vacation, we waited purely for connivence), so she was sitting pretty well at that time. We have the infant insert because she's a petite (15th percentile) kid and it looks comfy. The chair cleans up pretty easily. Cheerios always find their way into the infant seat's strap openings, so I take that off once a week for a \\"deep clean\\". Which is really my only complaint. The tray is a bit fussy but I think that is standard procedure for high chair trays!

product_title: Infantino Activity Triangle
review_body: Overall I really like this toy. There are a lot of different parts that move and spin and fun for babies to use. I will say its definitely aimed more for older babies, as it is a little heavy. All in all, a good toy. :)

product_title: Sugar Booger Kiddie Play Back Pack, Prehistoric Pals (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got this from my toddlers, its very well made, very easy to clean, waterproof and very adorable. This bag is not big enough to carry folders and school stuff, but my husband said we can still use it for lunch bags when my daughter starts school, it can easily fit into a bigger back pack.

product_title: OsoCozy Better Fit Unbleached Prefolds
review_body: I have been cloth diapering for almost 2 months now. I've tried several different brands and styles of diapers and I am in love with these OsoCozy Prefolds. I don't use the full Best Bottom system but I use prefolds in these covers which pair up and make a great combo. I wanted to cloth diaper to be green and save money. I am loving my OsoCozy prefolds and Best Bottom Diaper covers. They have not leaked at all and I have a super soaker for a son. He has had leaks in just about every other cloth diaper we have tried. I recommend purchasing about 5/6 covers and a couple dozen prefolds if you're on a tight budget and they should get you by for a long time. These prefolds run kind of small. My baby was 7lb 13oz at birth and these prefolds were a great fit then with a snappy. Now that he is almost 2 months and 15 lbs, I can no longer use the snappy. I simply fold the prefold into thirds and lay the prefold on the cover. This technique still holds very well and I am still very happy with my purchase. I might need to get a bigger size soon since these are made to go up to 16 lbs and my LO is almost there... He is growing quick but I think these prefolds will still be great to use in a pocket diaper if my kiddo outgrows them soon. They are very absorbent and I love that I don't have to worry about leaks.

product_title: Graco Secure Coverage Digital Baby Monitor
review_headline: Ended up just using the batteries
review_body:
Bought these to replace our older model of the same monitors, which have worked fine, but had batteries that were dying. We couldn't find replacement batteries, and there were no better alternative monitors on the market.

We bought these thinking to replace the older monitors. However, when they came we didn't like them as much as the older ones because there were no charging stands for the parent units. Our old ones each had a charging stand that was/is very convenient. With these you have to plug the power cord into the parent unit every time you want to charge rather than just plunking the parent unit into the stand.

SO, I ended up pulling the batteries out of the new units and putting them in the old units. We're happy.

I can't say anything about the performance of the new units because we never used them. BUT if they're anything like the old units, they are great. Our old units go anywhere in our split-level or garage without losing signal. We've also never had any interference problems.

product_title: all-in-one Rumina Hands-Free Pumping Bra & Nursing Tank - White Small
review_body: I am happy with product, but it does run small, especially the white small tank.  So seriously consider going one size up.  Otherwise, it's a great product.

product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_headline: Wish I had this with my first child!
review_body: This is the best baby bath I've ever had.  I hate the plastic tubs and feel that my baby is uncomfortable in them, and I also worry about him slipping off the side.  This bather was recommended to me by a friend and it is THE BEST.  I wish I had known about this with my first!  My son LOVES his bath and is so relaxed and comfortable.  My favorite part about it is that I can flip him over on his stomach and really clean his back and bottom easy, as well as under his neck as he lifts his head up in cobra position.  BEST BATH EVER.  I will never go to a plastic tub again!

product_title: Munchkin Stroller Insulated Cup Holder, Black
review_headline: Works ok but taller items do lean....threads strip over time
review_body:
We installed this on the horizontal bar between the handles of our quinny zapp stroller. The cup holder attaches fine but when I put my Starbucks venti iced coffee (daily coffee indulgence) in it (and the cup is full) then the cup holder will swing and tip so it's not vertical anymore. Due to the cap on the cup there are no spills but it is a bit annoying. Even though I tighten it as much as possible it will still swing when the cup is full. So I usually just drink a little bit right away so it's not so top heavy and then the cup holder will stay vertical.

Other than that, it's the best one for the price that I found.

---------
EDIT: After a while the tightening threads have started to strip. That means the the drinks will tip very easily. We ended up getting rid of the cupholder and purchasing the [[ASIN:B000NSBBIY Bugaboo Cup Holder]] which is far superior and worth the higher price.

product_title: Britax Car Seat Travel Cart, Black
review_body:
I used the Britax Car Seat for my trip to Puerto Rico with my son. It was my first time flying with my toddler and the travel cart made it a breeze zipping through the airport. Most importantly, my toddler enjoyed being in his car seat as we were walking through the busiest parts of the airport.

I have to recommend the seller of this product. Fast and prompt delivery. I will definitely buy from this seller again.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Healthy Care Booster Seat
review_body: I purchased this and the other offered Booster seat by Fisher-price to be sent down to Florida so we had seating for my twins.  They loved the toys! The seat folded up nicely and was great for preoccuping while I was getting dinner ready.  I had a bit of rough time getting the center strap out to clean it but no biggy. I wouldn't suggest feeding your kids with the toys on, once the stickers get when they look pretty grimey.  Otherwise I was extremely pleased!

product_title: Skip Hop Zoo Toddler Kids Insulated Backpack Livie Ladybug Girl, 12-inches, Pink
review_body:
I ordered this item and not only did I get it within 2 days, but my daughter loves it!!!
I used it as a diaper bag in the beginning but now that my daughter is older I use it for her toys and her snacks. Its very spacious and sturdy

product_title: Little Giraffe Chenille Duo Blanket, Celadon/Mocha (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I love Little Giraffe blankets! My nephews had always had them, and my sister constantly talked about them, so when I had my baby, I made sure to buy one. They are so super soft. My baby is 3 now, and he still packs his around. He loves to touch the satin edges with his fingers. I bought this one for my sister in law as she is having a baby in a month!
Just make sure you wash them on the delicate cycle, in COLD water, and put them in the dryer on a low setting for about 10-15 minutes, and air dry the rest. Otherwise the blanket will be ruined.

product_title: Bright Starts Around We Go 2-in-1 Activity Center
review_body:
This is the one non-essential we bought off our Baby Registry for our unborn child. We heard we would need an exersaucer and, after reading so many positive reviews, thought this was the perfect gift. Plus, it's expensive so it must be good, right? Wrong.
Not only is it a pain to put together (really? 10+ tiny screws you have to screw in yourself with a baby nearby?) but it's a pain to pull apart (say, if you need to move or return the item), and it's way too tall for a 4 month old (our baby was 4.5 months and was still 2 inchess from the bottom)! Also, it takes up about 4 times a regular exersaucer because of the rotation.
I have no affiliation with EvenFlo but we just got this (http://www.amazon.com/Evenflo-6161948-Splash-Mega-Exersaucer/dp/B002VUCBC2) and it is such a stark difference to the Bright Starts. Easy to put together (it took me 10 minutes as opposed to the 45 the Bright Starts took) and look ma, no screws!

product_title: OXO Tot Feeding Spoon Set with Soft Silicone
review_body: These are great for me to feed my 8 month old with as the handle is easy to grip.  It also is large enough for my daughter to easily grip when she tries to \\"help\\" feed herself.  The plastic handle is sturdy, as I let her chew on it for a couple of meals before we started trying solids to get used to the spoon.  Those oxo folks sure know what they are doing.  I haven't been disappointed yet

product_title: GEENNY Musical Mobile, Boutique New Froggy
review_body: This product is nice for as simple as it is. I like how this is fabric covering the plastic pole that it sits on.

product_title: South Shore Savannah Collection Changing Table, Espresso
review_body: I love this changing table! It did take some time, but I put this together by myself at 8-1\2 months pregnant (and then took a nice long nap!).  There are a lot of parts, and the instructions could be clearer, but it's not rocket science and it's worth the time and effort to get the quality. I do wish there was a little more to the backing as after pushing items to the back of the little cubby holes several times I did manage to push the little nails out of the backing, but it can be easily reattached.  The table is sturdy and looks beautiful.  We have a [[ASIN:B002A9IZ0Q Stork Craft Tuscany 4-in-1 Stages Crib, Espresso]] and the color matches just fine. The drawers are sturdy and glide nicely.  I would definitely recommend!

product_title: Britax Marathon 70-G3 Convertible Car Seat
review_body: I love this car seat. I have a pink one for my daughter and bought this for my son. It'a comfortable and very sturdy. The only complaint is that is takes up a lot of room! My car is big enough (SUV), but we bought other car seats for my husband's car. They travel most often in my car, so the nicer car seats are there. I love the fun Cowmooflage pattern!

product_title: Carter's Just One You Baby's Jungle Dots First Record Book/Baby Book, Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This has no pockets for first haircut, tooth, hospital bracelet and etc.

After looking all around it seems 1 company had a great one but is now 200 (yes) on amazon, the newer/updated version is a binder version that everyone seems to hate.

I just do not understand why it is so hard to find a proper baby book. They were around when I was a kid so it is nothing new, why have we back stepped?

product_title: Ergobaby Original Baby Carrier
review_headline: Counterfeit from Cynthia G Wise / Cardinal
review_body: This Ergo was an obvious counterfeit. No I get to deal with the hassle of returning it. So disappointed. I bought it through Prime thinking it was legit. It was the cheapest, so the one that was automatically ordered. I think Amazon should verify the sellers before making them the default sellers for a product.

product_title: Graco Backless TurboBooster Car Seat, World of Cars (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This booster seat is very easy to install.  Our four-year old boy loves it, and we like that it's light enough to transfer from vehicle to vehicle.  It installs securely and quickly, and has an adjustment strap for the shoulder belt.

product_title: Sassy Baby's First Books
review_body: I am very pleased with this order.The order came fast and the book is very durable. My son enjoys it a lot!

product_title: Badger Basket Six Compartment Cubby Storage Unit, Espresso/Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This unit was available at such a better price than through other sites.  I put it together myself and it looks great!  (I probably should have let my husband do some of it because I wasn't able to get the top as tight as I would like.)  It holds a lot more than I expected.  This was an excellent value and looks great in the nursery.

product_title: Expandable Wooden Pet Gate
review_body: Just received this item this afternoon.  I am very disappointed in the quality of this item.  It was missing parts and several of the wooden dowels were not even connected to the frame. I would not recommend this item to anyone.  The way the price is advertised you are led to believe you are getting a good deal when in fact you are paying too much.

product_title: Kolo Noci 4x6 Photo Album
review_body: I'm very please with this small album. It's very well done and perfect for a little gift. My mother is not a fan of new technology so she's happy to have a few picture of her grand children in her bag.

product_title: Valco Baby Universal 3 Wheel Sun Shade
review_body: This is a great product. I live in AZ so if the sun still gets threw the mesh which I expected but i just put a flap down and my son can still see out either side and he has to beable to see or he freaks. It works great on my baby trend fixed wheel jogger and my safety 1st three wheel stroller. My friend has a graco stroller and it fits on that as well. I am very happy with this product and definitely recommend it.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_headline: An over-rated and over priced rubber toy.
review_body: Being a first time parent, I really had no idea what toy or product to buy for my child, and so I based my decision to buy Vulli Sophie the Giraffe on the product reviews and ratings on Amazon.  I thought I couldn't go wrong with investing money on a teether with over 1000+ 5-star rating, even though it's on the pricey side.  I was wrong.  My son (at about age 10 month at the time) did not show any interest in it at all. Even when the few times he did try to put it in his mouth, I feel uneasy feeling like the paint used on Sophie will get swallowed.  It ended up sitting in the toy chest until my son was about 16 months, when he plays it as a squeaky toy once in a blue moon. For $20, I think it can buy many other better designed teethers and educational toys.

product_title: Fisher-Price Discover 'n Grow Kick and Play Piano Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We got this for our 6-week old.  I was pretty sure that he wouldn't be ready for it yet, but he instantly figured out the relationship between kicking and playing the keyboard, and was just thrilled as can be! The mirror was also a big hit.  Over the last month, he has gone from batting at the hanging toys to grabbing them (they have a good variety in terms of how hard they are to grasp), and still loves the keyboard.  So far this has been by far his favorite toy.

product_title: Dreambaby Blind Cord Wraps
review_body: Always have a hard time finding these anywhere else but amazon. These are great safety cord holders to keep the blind cords away from little hands.

product_title: Similac Simply SmartNipple, 2-Count
review_body: My son is on Enfamil A.R. and these were the only nipples/bottles available at our local store that were for \\"thick formula\\".  He is just now 2 months old we have purchased a different brand because all of the nipples have torn.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, Luv U Zoo (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great visual stimulation and soothing movement
review_body: I purchased this from Amazon for my 2-month-old grandson. It was super simple to put together, taking less than 15 minutes including the 5 minutes it took to preread the directions. It seems very well built. It is easy to switch both the motion (from rocking side-to-side or swinging back and forth) and the position of the seat (upright or reclining). It runs very quietly with none of the annoying clicking I've experienced with other swings.  The first time we placed the baby in the swing he immediately focused on the cute moving mobile and was tracking the little danglies around. The music is a good volume too.  It is very stable when it swings and all the feet stay firmly on the ground.  The legs move in to collapse it somewhat making it easier to move around from room to room and they still lock firmly into place when it is set up. Just make sure that the legs are in the position described in the manual for best stability. We've only had this swing for about 5 days so I will update later as to how the swing is holding up over time. So far, it's a hit.

product_title: Baby Girl Jumbo size Blanket ~ Butterfly
review_body: I love these blankets. They are soft and hold up really nice no matter how many times you have to wash them. And they are super warm. My son and daughter have one.

product_title: Piyo Piyo Baby Nail Scissors
review_headline: Good but baby still has talons
review_body: These are easy to use and quite cute. The only issue I have is that my baby still has sharp talons (especially the corners) even if I de-claw her every few days, but perhaps she is just a wild beast.

product_title: Sassy Real Life Remote Developmental Toy
review_body: Our 4 mo old really enjoys this toy. It's getting easier for her to handle and she can push most of the buttons on her own. The sounds are cute but not annoying :)

product_title: Graco Deluxe Nail Clipper
review_body: Either I can't figure out how to use it or it's poorly made. The light keeps blinking, doesn't stay on. Waste of money.

product_title: green sprouts Organic Velour Finger Puppet 3pc Set-Farm Girls (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We recently purchased these finger puppets, and so far I'm pleased with them.  I love that they are organic cotton, they easily fit over an adult's finger, and the faces are really cute!  They are long enough that my 5 month old can grasp and chew on them, but they are small enough that you wouldn't want to leave your child unattended with them.

product_title: Kokopax Organic Koko/Pax Protector, Cream (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The quality of materials is very nice, and this is a good add on but not really needed.  The monkey is so sweet though.  Baby likes it, but we havent used the cloth but a couple times.

product_title: Safety 1st Wide Doorways Fabric Gate
review_body: I bought this gate to keep my 14 month old out of the foyer/mudroom area.  The opening to that room is 59\\" wide.  This gate works and fits perfectly!  It is extremely easy to set up and take down, and it looks nice.  It's pressure mounted, so you don't have to drill into your wall, yet it is sturdy enough that my toddler can't knock it down.  Also, I'm 5'5\\" and 34 weeks pregnant, and I can step over it easily.  We usually take it down at night so our cats can go through, and then I put it back up every morning while I'm home with my toddler.  It only takes about 1 minute to put it up or take it down -- very convenient!  So far, I am loving this gate!

product_title: Infantino Activity Triangle
review_headline: My baby doesn't seem to be interested in it yet...
review_body: We bought this before a trip to Europe because of all the reviews that say it will keep your baby busy...I am sure it does the trick for some babies, but it did not work with mine. I actually did not use it because during a couple of months she did not play with it once. Kept pushing it on her, but nothing, she is just not into it. Hopefully one day otherwise I bought it for nothing. The product itself is well built, it has different things that spin on three sides, a mirror that also spins and some little cubes on one side to be moved on some curved wires. I think its a nice toy and I would reccommend it as every baby is different :).

product_title: Evenflo Secure Step Top of Stair Gate
review_headline: These are easy to use and install
review_body: We use only these gates because I can open and close them easily even with wrist problems. We installed these gates 8 months ago to create pet free and baby safe areas. They are still working great. Although I did screw in a small block of wood above the lower hinge so that if  someone opens the gate while pulling up the entire gate no longer comes off in your hand. That was the only drawback but was easily solved with a small piece of wood or even shim to keep that from happening. I still can't find anyother gate I can open and close easily bc of hand and wrist problems. This was definetly worth the bit of extra effort to make sure gate stays in place.

product_title: Regalo Extra WideSpan Walk Through Safety Gate
review_headline: My problem is atypical, but still...
review_body:
So this gate is great. Mostly.

It looks nice, it's not too incredibly difficult to assemble, though I did run into one problem. This is advertised as coming with a 12\\", 6\\", and 4\\" extension. But that's wrong. It comes with the 12\\", 8\\", and 6\\". With the 6\\" extension added, it's too wide to fit into my doorway before the tension presses it back, making the 6\\" extension completely useless. Oh, but because of how wide my doorway is, I have to tighten the gate almost all the way down the rod, leaving huge gaps by the wall.

I assembled this yesterday, noticed the gaps, tried to add the other extension on, realized I couldn't, and just left it. I congratulated myself on picking a nice looking gate to keep my rabbit properly contained, and went to bed. This morning I walked out of my bedroom and noticed my rabbit sitting OUTSIDE the gate, just chilling. Yes, those gaps by the wall are big enough for her to escape. Of course, this won't be a problem with a child or a large dog, but if you have a smaller animal that is a practiced escape artist, this can be an issue.

And as far as I can tell, there's no way to buy just the 4\\" extension alone on Amazon (even though I should have gotten it with this order!), so I have to spend another $20 on the Regalo site just to get the extension that I should have received originally.

I'm less than pleased with that part. But as far as the construction of the gate goes, it's pretty nice. The pressure mounting is pretty stable with appropriate tightening and I do like it enough not to just send it back in frustration.

It's definitely an attractive addition to your home if you're looking for a gate for a child or larger animal. But as-is, I just installed a new door for my house rabbit.

product_title: Orbit Baby Green Edition Footmuff
review_headline: Excellent Quality non-toxic; well-tailored cover for car-seat
review_body: So I bought this foot-muff to go over my Chicco Key-fit infant seat because I don't like the idea of putting my infant on the original Chicco seat cover made of synthetic (therefore highly flammable) fabrics treated with chemical flame retardants -- which are highly toxic to baby. My baby is due in four months, so I have not used the muff yet. The Orbit foot-muff in size \\"Small\\" fit perfectly over my Chicco KeyFit 30 infant car seat: the harness fit perfectly though the provided slots in the muff.  The muff fits snugly into the bucket, without any slack. But muff has no \\"shower cap\\"-like edge to pull over the edges of the seat bucket.  The muff holds is shape well though, without slouching or sliding around much inside the bucket.  I will be using this in place of the original seat cover when my baby comes.  Overall, the muff is well made, with significant padding and soft cotton lining inside to touch the baby's delicate skin.  I wish it had snaps instead of the buttons to adjust how far you can open the top flap.  Also, it would be nice to fully un-zip and remove the top flap for use in the summer.

product_title: ImseVimse – Premium Baby Washcloths Wipes – in Soft Thin Reusable Natural Organic Cotton for Sensitive Skin – Perfect for baby care, bath, face cleansing for newborns, toddlers, adults (set t
review_headline: Cleans very well only using water
review_body: Loved this cloth wipes. Cleans very well. I don't usually have to pre-wash before I throw it into my washer. I have told other mommy friends to order this wipe instead.

product_title: Regalo Extra Tall Guardian Expandable Gate, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I am a fan of this gate!! Even though I am 5' 3' I can get over it on tiptoes-I have long legs.
My son is 17 mos and loves that he can look out his room door and I love that I dont have to chase him down the hall when he plays.
Pros:
Sturdy material
Works well
Stays in place
Hasn't pulled paint from wall/siding

Only one con:
The gate is better suited for doorways. If you need a gate to accomodate floor trim, buy the same gate in the shorter model and will love it too!!

product_title: Kids Line Disney Nap Mat
review_body: This may was just okay for the price. The blanket was very soft, however there was almost no padding in the mat, I wouldnt even say it was a half inch thick. I spent more than the mat cost buying extra quilt batting and material to make it thicker.

product_title: Contours Lite Stroller, Tangerine (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I'll have a Tangelo Smoothie please
review_body:
My wife & I were looking for something smaller to tote our daughter (8mos.) in lieu of our current large, bulky travel stroller. After some diligent research, and a Consumer Reports best buy rating, we settled on the Contours-Lite Stroller Tangelo (I'll have a Tangelo smoothie please). Several reviews on the web address particular cons they found with the stroller the primary ones we found were:
No parent tray - We try not to carry unnecessary crap or clutter, there is a cup holder for the parents, and ample storage below the seating area (holds our well stocked diaper bag, my wife's purse, and other small items). Actually no top tray, is no problem for us.
Seat adjustment - The seat can be positioned from almost a 90 degree sitting, to flat out - allowing a baby or toddler to lay down. The seat is adjusted using a strap that's very easy to use and adjust. As easy or easier that the click positions on our Chicco travel stroller.
Child Tray - Some parents complained the tray is too high for their kids. AS mentioned earlier, our daughter is 8 mos., and the tray is a little high for her, but we bought this stroller expecting her to grow into it, and using it for a while, versus one of the smaller cheapy travel strollers.
The Sun Shade - the sun shade provides fairly ample coverage.
Wal-Mart had the cheapest price (at the time we ordered), and shipping was pretty good. The stroller assembly was straight forward and I had it assembled in 15-20 mins. It is light, easy to open, and close. This stroller is by no means as small, or as light as the umbrella strollers, but that's not what we were looking for (though much lighter and smaller than our travel stroller). If you are looking for a light, easy to assemble, easy open & close stroller, with ample storage, easy roll, stroller, that will fit your baby, infant or toddler as they grow buy this one.

product_title: UPPAbaby G-Lite Stroller, Denny/Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This is the only light weight stroller I evaluated after recommendations from friends who had done a ton of research.

What I like:
- The biggest JOY - We can ride the subways again :)
- its really light
- Easy to fold and open
- It stands when folded
- The shoulder strap to carry it, when folded

What could have been better:
- It doesnot fold if there is anything (sippy cup) in the basket

product_title: BABYBJORN Travel Crib Light 2, Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have a pack and play, but ended up buying this for a 3-week trip through spain.  Great decision - it was perfect for our 11 month old, way lighter and more compact than the pack and play. product_title: Evenflo Triumph 65 LX Convertible Car Seat, Easton (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This carseat is amazing! The shoulder straps slide up and down so you don't have to re-thread them. There's a dial on each side so you can tighten the straps easily. Plus, you can use it from newborn to toddler, rear facing to front facing. It's not that expensive, compaired to other carseats and it's from a brand I trust. product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_headline: Love Love Love the Moby Wrap.
review_body: I recently gave birth to my second child, and Ive been looking for something to carry my son in that will leave me hands free, but also feel sturdy and safe. I had a baby bjorn when my daughter was a baby but I didnt like it. It was to stiff and it killed my back. After some research I decided to give the Moby Wrap a try, and Im SO glad I did. The material is very soft, and the booklet that comes with give step by step instructions for all the ways it can be worn. I personally like the Kangaroo hold the best, because its the easiest one for me to get into without help from anyone else. The wrap is very long and can seem kind of overwhelming when you first open it up, but just take a deep breath and try all the different wrap styles to find the one that easiest for you and most comfy for your baby :)

product_title: Blueberry Training Pants
review_body:
These are great trainers, they hold just enough not to soak the child's clothes for every accident but will not soak it all in. That may seem like a con but the idea is not to transition child to a slim diaper but to let them feel when they're wet & teach them how much better it is to go in the potty. I love how they are just as soft as underwear & cloth diapers and they don't bind or pinch. They're probably a little more bulky then disposables but fit trimmer then cloth diapers. The designs are really cute but I wish they came out with a few more for variety. My only compliant is sizing, it seems off because my 19mth son is tall & lean but the small is kinda tight so I'm getting some mediums for comparison. They're not so tight as to be uncomfortable or restrictive but there's no way he can even attempt to pull them up or down himself (which is the point!).

Note about washing: DO NOT wash these with your regular detergent, even \\"free & clear\\" doesn't always mean free or clear they still have brighteners/ additives/ stain fighters that can build up & reduce the effectiveness of the cloth. I use Charlie's Soap (can be gotten online or any natural/ health store) but you can also use Ruby Moon, Rockin' Green, Mountain Green, Allens, Arm & Hammer Essentials Free, Country Save, Dropps Baby Free, Ecos Free & Clear liquid, LifeKind, Maggies Soap, Nature Clean, Nellies, Trader Joes.

product_title: Britax B-Agile Stroller Travel Bag
review_headline: Fits the Baby Jogger City Micro
review_body:
The B-Agile travel bag gets 3 stars from me. Thumbs up for the fit. Thumbs down for the lack of padding and the cheap strap.

I bought the B-Agile travel bag in hopes that it would fit my Baby Jogger City Micro [[ASIN:B002AMVELU Baby Jogger City Micro Single Stroller - Slate]] so I can gate check this stroller at the airport when we travel.

Having seen the Britax B-Agile stroller and how similar it is to the Baby Jogger City Mini, I believed that my stroller would fit in this bag. I also compared folded dimensions of both strollers and they were pretty close, so I went ahead and ordered the bag through Amazon.

I am thrilled that my stroller fits in the bag perfectly. The custom fit of the bag is the reason I ordered this bag instead of the [[ASIN:B000262HMQ JL Childress Standard and Dual Stroller Travel Bag, Black]]. I decided it was worth spending the extra $12 for the better fit of the B-Agile travel bag. The bag is exactly the right size for the stroller and I don't have to remove the [[ASIN:B005PK1G76 Diono Buggy Buddy Stroller Organizer, Black]] from the stroller handle and can leave the rain cover in the stroller basket without running out of room in the bag. Could probably fit a couple of small accessories in there but I won't for expediency.

I think the current price $36.xx is in the ballpark but have seen this bag retail for $45 - $50 and I don't think the quality justifies the higher price point. The bag has no padding at all, and even though my stroller fits in the bag without removing the wheels, I am considering removing the wheels at the gate to protect them from being banged and destroyed or broken off by baggage handling and cargo shifting. Fortunately, removing the wheels of the City Micro is very quick and easy.

The bag itself seems to be made from a decent quality nylon and I think it will serve its purpose of keeping the stroller clean for gate check and providing a barrier to the elements, but that is all it does and I definitely would not check my stroller at regular baggage check using this bag.

I also agree with another reviewer that the bag could use a short briefcase type handle because the long removable strap doesn't seem particularly sturdy and has no padding at all.

As an aside, it looks as though this bag would also fit the City Mini.

product_title: The First Years Smartwarmer
review_body:
Purchased this when LO was starting to take more than 2 oz or 60cc of breast milk by bottle. When used as directed, I did not have a problem with standard bottles, such as the Dr B we used, up to 4 oz. The wide bottles sometimes felt cooler, so you may have to adjust the size or starting temperature.

When she began to take volumes larger than 4 oz, I used the taller DrB or the Tommie Tip (which do not fit well in this unit). I do not know if it was the larger bottle or the larger volume of water needed to steam the bottle; the reservoir becomes buoyant at lower water levels. Water bubbled out of the side and puddled on the counter. By this time I used a method faster than the 5 minutes the FY Warmer took. A denser plastic may be needed to keep it from floating when the water level gets low.

As for food, jars did not have a problem working with this unit. Most food now comes in pouches so you have to use your own jar to warm food up. The baby bullets will fit. My LO doesn't mind cooler food, so it is not a big issue.

review_body: This product is not powerful at all and will not empty your breast. I returned the first one I got as I thought it was just an issue with that particular pump however I have the same issues with the replacement I was sent. I wish I would have spent the extra money for the Medela pump.

review_body: This crib is so beautiful.  My baby lies it especially for nap time and for night night.  Love it.great quality for the price

It is also easy to take with us when we need a high chair away from our home.  My only complaint is that there is a lot of space between the back of the chair and the tray.  We have remedied this by putting a towel behind baby's back so he is closer to his food.  All in all, we really like the chair.  We are thrilled we didn't have to get one of the huge, plastic, garish chairs that are so common.

review_body: I was finally able to locate this exact blanket here on Amazon! My 2 and 1/2 year old grandson has had the blue and an ecrue blanket from birth that he attached himself to. review_body: This Batman Sofa Is more like an over sized Chair then a couch. product_title: Dandelion Organic Toy Crinkle Bear
review_body: My baby LOVES this toy. The head crinkles, so he is really into that. The body is just stuffed and does not make any noise. The outside feels velvety and soft. It's a good size, too. Overall, a very nice toy.

product_title: Sassy Pop n' Push Car
review_body: my grandson is just a year, he is mobile by crawling and can stand but not walk yet.  this is a great car for him, as it will move by itself when the wheels are pushed back but it does not take off across the room.  a feature he will probably want later on.  the plastic balls pop as it moves and that too interests him greatly!  would recommend for 12 to 18 months.  definitely try amazon first too, i have seen this car at other places and it was higher.

product_title: Munchkin Mighty Grip Flip Straw Cups 2-Pack, 10- Ounce

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet 2-in-1 Projection Mobile

review_body:

I was planning to give 4 stars due to an issue (kind of very loud gear noise when toys are moving) that requested a replacement of the product but I'll keep 5 stars due to an outstanding customer support. product_title: Ameda Purely Yours Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I can't say anything really, really great about this pump but it technically works, so I guess three stars it is. A few of the things that are good:

-Price isn't bad for a double-electric.
-Threads are compatible with some other bottles.
-Nothing too difficult to clean or assemble.
-Came with an extra set of diaphragms and rubber nozzle-y bits.
-I like the dials that let you set suction and speed separately.

I do have some not-so-good things to say about it and they are as follows:

-I'm on my second one of the same model in two years, the first one just up and stopped working and I never did figure out what happened to it, so I don't think these are a good choice if you're looking to use it for a few babies.
-I had to purchase a separate set of flanges because the one they came with were way too small for me (TMI alert: I have very large breasts and nipples so if you do also, you can pretty much count on having to buy the extra flanges, I think they were around thirty bucks or so).
-I feel like it randomly loses suction, but this could have been related to whatever made the first one break because I haven't noticed since I got the new one.
-It is uncomfortable to use, bordering on painful. I have a Lansinoh hand pump that has a soft silicone flange cover and I really wish that these did, too.

Overall, this pump is completely average. It is adequate and nothing more. The only reason I own this particular one is that my insurance covered it (twice) and the negatives are not enough to make me want to spend several hundred on a different one. However, I only pump once a day usually. If I pumped for a full-time job or exclusively I would skip over this pump and get a better one.

product_title: Safety 1st Stove Knob Covers, 5 Count
review_body: We have teenagers and never put these on when when they were younger. However, recently with more entertaining and having a busier kitchen, the knobs on the stove were bumped a couple times and the gas turned on without us knowing it this last time. By the time we figured out why the house was smelling (not like gas but an electrical type of smell) we realized it was the stove and nearly evacuated the house. We opened every door and window (35 degrees outside) and broke out every fan to clear the house. After that, the next morning ordered these safeguard knobs. They are a bit bulky and when we are using the stove and flip the safety knob open, they get in the way of opening and closing the oven door. We cook a lot so it is a pain to constantly open and close these to get to the stove knob but not enough for me to sacifice our safety. We may end up replaceing the knobs for the stove and to see if they are harder to turn the stove knobs on. Overall the knobs do the trick (right price too)but are inconvenient to use when you're not use to them being on there.

product_title: Beaba Bib Secondes Quick Baby Bottle Food Warmer
review_body: We ordered this bottle warmer after having trouble with an inexpensive warmer. I wanted something that would consistently warm the bottle to the same temperature every time, and this one does just that. The dial allows you to be precise with the warming. We have had to turn it a bit above the actual amount that is in the bottle (level 6 for 5 oz), but that is most likely because we are using a thicker formula with added rice starch. With regular formula or breast milk, it would probably be just right.

product_title: Graco Pack N Play Playard with Bassinet
review_headline: YES! Great for traveling. Light weight and crib comfy.
review_body: I have a really nice and big pack in play but it is very heavy and a pain to break down. You definitely aren't going to be able to travel with it. review_body: I wish the table could be removed with one hand versus using both but overall good item for its price and very pretty !

product_title: Delta Shelby Classic Crib And Changer, Espresso Cherry (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Good looking crib; bad craftsmenship and replacement policy
review_body:
We ordered this crib because we liked the style and color and we still do. The real headache began when my husband put the crib together. There were definitely several things that are not right with it. First, the manual was missing so we had to go the the Delta website and print a 20+ page manual so that we could put the whole thing together. The next being that the back and front of the crib either were missing fitting for the bolts or the fittings were misaligned so the bolts were unable to go into the slots. The changer railing is cracked as well. To to finish off this disaster the \\"hamper\\" can't even be put together because the holes are not aligned properly. So naturally, I went to the company for help, because as their warranty states, their product is warranted to be free from defects for a period of 1 year from date of purchase under normal use. However, the response I get back is that they can only replace ONE large part under the warranty (though I don't know where in the warranty this is written because I have the document in front of me and can find no reference to that) and they told me to return it to the purchase place. This crib hasn't even been used yet and it really upsets me that despite paying this much for it, they expect me to pay more to return a product that has been defective since it left the factory!
Update: After a few more emails to the company, they did replace the parts. Even though, one still arrived scratched, it wasn't a big deal. I still hold that they make it difficult to get the replacement parts should you need them

product_title: Tomme Tippee Explora Truly Spill-proof Sippy Cup 9m BPA Free (Blue/Green)
review_body:

Also, the prices on Amazon are ridiculous. Target & Babies r Us have the same items from Tomme Tippee for about 1/2 the cot (when I wrote this, the double pack of the sippy cup is listed for $15.50 and I paid $7.99 + tax at Target).

product_title: Neat Solutions 24 Piece Washcloth Set, Multi

product_title: Blueberry Training Pants, Elephant, Medium (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Love these. They are so soft and apparently very comfortable. We are potty training and my 2 tear old hates her pull-ups. She loves these.

product_title: green sprouts Natural Wood Cage Rattle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Nice but a lot smaller than I thought
review_body: Quality wood toy, just a lot smaller than I thought it would be.  No baby yet to try it out so I can't comment on it's functionality.

product_title: Baby Diego Bathinette Posh
review_headline: Like it but some design flaws
review_body:
I've used this bathinette daily since my son was born (he's now 8 weeks). I leave it set up in our bathroom so it's always ready to use though it can also be collapsed for storage. Overall I like it a lot and am glad I got it.

What I like:
- Good height for both changing and bathing
- Convenient storage though I could always use even more storage space
- Sturdy construction
