- Looks nice (I have the red top and beige base)
- I like the drain function in the tub a lot and use it every time. It does take a while to drain, but I just throw the drain into my bathtub, lower the changing top, and dry/dress my baby on the changing top while the tub drains.

What i don't:
- The changing surface is plastic. It's cold in the winter and doesn't feel good for my baby although it makes it easy to clean. I made a simple terry cover for it or sometimes just lay a towel down first.
- The drain hook does not hang securely anywhere. It hangs loosely can can be knocked off easily. There should be a place to snap the drain hook onto the body of the tub.
- There's a stopper for the drain but I lost it. Without the stopper, you have to hang the hook on a spot higher than the water level or the water will overflow. Not a huge deal but I wish the stopper were attached to the drain so it's harder to lose.
- There is always a small amount of water left over that will not drain. It is easily wiped up with a towel but the tub should be designed to channel water out completely.

Tip:
- I got the Summer Infant Comfy Bath Sponge to line the tub for my newborn, and it works perfectly to prevent my baby from slipping in the water.

product_title: Graco Pack N Play Playard with Bassinet
review_headline: Easy to use and handy to have around
review_body: Love this pack 'n play!  My little one isn't quite mobile yet, so I can put him in there with some toys while I'm working in the kitchen or taking a shower and he's happy and safe.  It's so easy to transport and set up and take down--definitely a worthwhile purchase!  The more complicated models are fine for infants, but this one is just perfect for a baby who is getting a little older and just needs it for the occasional nap and for somewhere to play--it doesn't have all of the extras (i.e. bassinet, changing table) that can be kind of a pain to carry around and store.  The only thing that I'm still struggling with is that I'm having a hard time getting rid of that horrible plastic smell that these types of things invariably come with--but I just make sure that I put a flat sheet on the pad and I'm hoping the smell will fade in time.

product_title: Graco RoomFor2 Stand and Ride Classic Connect Stroller, Metropolis (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Excellent stroller for families with two young children
review_body:
This is a very nice stroller with room for two young kids. The build is solid and the stroller runs reasonably quietly.

The assembly is trivial. It takes 5 minutes and no extra tools.

The front seat is for the younger one. It is quite comfortable, even for a full-day trip. The rear seat is more cramped and a two-year-old probably will get cranky sitting there for more than 2-3 hours. Standing in the seat is an option, but toddlers tend not be able to stand for long either.

Overall, a two-seat stroller is much more convenient for the parent than two one-seaters. The rear seat is not for extended period, but it is nonetheless a fair trade-off.

product_title: Motorola Digital Video Baby Monitor with 1.5 Inch Color LCD Screen (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this monitor! The night and daytime settings create a perfect video feed any time of day. The sound only turns on when a certain decibel is reached which creates a much quieter night for parents. Among it's other cool features is the microphone, temperature reader, and all the setting options it has.

product_title: Similac SimplySmart Bottle - 8 oz
review_body: My wife and I found this bottle to be by far the best of the ones we tried (the others were the Nuk orthodontic bottles, Breastflow, and Evenflo).  It has several great features:  *The nipple seems comfortable for my daughter (who has gone back and forth between breast and bottle); she's 2 months old and the slow flow nipple has been perfect for her.  *When you're twisting the cap on, there is a guide to make it easy to not screw it too tight or loose.  It snaps nicely into place and I haven't experienced any leaking.  *The dangly rubber thing helps reduce the foaming effect when preparing powdered formula.  That's great for when your baby is screaming for grub and you don't have time to wait for all the bubbles to dissipate!  *Similac makes a travel cap for this bottle--you can put water in the bottle, the right amount of powdered formula in the cap, and then mix it up when you need it.  It's a separate purchase, but not expensive.  Overall, it feels well-constructed (durable, no leaks as I said above), and I like the general size and shape--it's wide enough that it's easy to pour stuff into without spilling, and easy to clean with a soapy sponge (no bottle brush necessary, though I would still use a nipple brush for cleaning the inside of the nipple).  I can't really think of cons for this bottle, outside of the fact that, obviously, it's not the cheapest bottle available.  Also, even though it's BPA free, I could understand some might still feel more comfortable with glass instead of plastic.

product_title: Summer Infant Naturally Yours Receiving Blankets 3-Pack
review_body: I wanted some blankets that would not be girl/boy colors because we're not finding out this time around. Anyways, we opened up the package and my first thought was \\"Wow\\" because not only ar the colors much more vibrant than the computer screen shows but the quality of the blanket is very nice. I don't even have sheets on my own bed that match this quality! Soft and thick, I can tell these blankets are going to last a long time. I never write reviews but had to on this one. Thanks for the great deal, Amazon.

product_title: Baby Brezza Baby Food Maker Machine  - One Step Steamer and Blender - Puree Baby Food For Pouches - Mixes Organic Food for Infants and Toddlers
review_body: There is a brown liquid that is leaking from the bottom of the food container (comes from the gadget in the middle), I think it might be oil?  I cant tell if it is getting into the food but it can drip into the food when you pour out the contents. I'm not sure if I would buy this product again.

product_title: Snappi Cloth Diaper Fasteners - 3 Pack
review_headline: Works ok but not a fan
review_body: Used snappies when I was new to cloth diapering. I used these with prefolds when LO was 2 weeks old. Since the snappi has sharp edges, I had to use diaper covers (which the product instructs to use anyway). After some fiddling, I figured it was much easier to use prefolds with just the diaper cover and no pins/snappis. Nothing against this product - does what it claims to do - is easy to use - but not needed at all if you have some good diaper covers [[ASIN:B003AJXY1U Thirsties Duo Wrap Snap, Meadow, Size One (6-18 lbs)]]

product_title: MAM Training Toothbrush, 6 Months
review_body: Love the toothbrush, but took a gamble that I might get the pink for my son and lost.  Still it is a great toothbrush!  The brush head is the perfect size and it has rubber up around it to protect your children's gums.  Also, the handle is long and flexible.  I would order it again even though we got the pink.  I wish you could pick the color.

product_title: Britax Advocate 70 CS Click and Safe Convertible Car Seat
review_body: After spending hours reading reviews on carseats I finally decided to go with the Britax Advocate 70cs.  I have been so happy with this carseat that I bought two (one for each car).  The safety of carseat cannot be surpassed.  The only bad comments I could find was the bulkiness of the seat.  Yes, there are definitely smaller carseats out there... however, when it comes to my son's safety I would rather have a hearty seat with extra safety features.  Although it is larger than some, it still fits rear facing in my husband's Chevy 2500 extended cab truck without a problem.  My son is 13 months old and seems very comfortable in the seat.  I love that it will be able to grow with him for quite awhile!  I would definitely recommend this carseat!

product_title: Britax Chaperone Infant Carrier
review_headline: Straps are too short. Seat is too narrow
review_body: We have the marathon for our oldest child and have been nothing but pleased. However, this car seat is awful. it is significantly heavier than other infant car seats on the market which I though was a fair trade off considering it claim to go up to 30 lbs. and is very safe. While carrying this thing with my now 13lbs. baby is more than a notion what I find infuriating is that because of the way it is made, I will likely need to get a new car seat well before my child grows out of it lbs. wise. There is so much extra padding that it is a very tight fit especially if you add any kind of infant blanket (a necessity if you live in a cold climate). As bad as that is what is worse is that the headrest does not go high enough to accommodate a longer baby and the straps do not have enough slack to accommodate a bigger baby. We have adjusted everything that can be adjusted to the highest setting and our 5 month old may not make it through the winter in this seat. This is particularly annoying given that I purchased the matching stroller. Now, in addition to having to purchase another car seat and base I will also now have to purchase the second seat for the stroller in order to use it in doubles mode. I am thoroughly disappointed. The only reason I am giving this 2 stars is because it has a high safety rating otherwise this would easily be a one star review.

product_title: Goldbug Clean Cushion Car Seat Cover Style #53991
review_body: I received a hand me down Britax roundabout and needless to say with all baby hand me downs, it showed apparent signs of wear and tear.  I had looked into buying a britax brand cover, but they cost $50+!  So I opted for something cheaper, and this product did its job.  No complaints!

product_title: SpongeBob Toddler Sheet Set -2 Piece
review_body: You get what it says. My son loves the sheets that we got for his new bed, And not that bad of a price

product_title: Star Wars Jedi Forces Full Comforter
review_body: This comforter is really nice and the graphics are clear and colorful.  This is the second one I've purchased.  I wanted one as a backup should the original one ever wear out.  I have washed my original one numerous times and it still looks as good as when I got it. It has gotten a little softer with washings, but I think that is a plus. I have the full size and it covers my sons full size bed nicely.  I think this comforter is a super buy.  It arrived in the time promised.

product_title: Comotomo Natural Feel Baby Bottle Single Pack
review_body: The previous reviews are true ladies and gentlemen... My little one REFUSED to take a bottle, any bottle, but he latched right on to this one. I wouldn't say he was thrilled about it, but he will eat out of it, which is a HUGE improvement. Very simple, very effective design. If baby isn't getting it, you can just give the bottle a little squeeze (the whole thing is soft) and squirt a little milk into baby's mouth. Absolutely worth the price tag.

product_title: JJ Cole Mode Diaper Tote Bag
review_body: I bought this to compare to another diaper bag. I'm so glad I did! This bag is definately made with a higher quality fabric and is easier to clean than the other and it has more pockets inside to hold lots of stuff. I bought this bag to be able to carry stuff for a 2 year old and a new baby- it definately doesn't disappoint. There are large zip pockets on the front and snap pockets on front and back (the back one holds the diaper changing pad). I like the clip inside to hold keys- not sure how often I'll use it but it may come in handy. The inside of the bag is spacious and able to hold everything I've put in it so far.

product_title: Floppy Seat® Shopping Cart and High Chair Cover, EZ Carry Bag™ Style -Blue ABC
review_body: I got this seat cover and its nice and good quality. The one problem i have it seems to not cover the sides of some carts. Also when I put it on the cart the holes don't fit correctly. I have to pull it down just to get my son in there. These carts are sam's club or costco either. They are normal shopping carts. Over all I'm pretty satisfied just have to make sure I keep pulling the cart cover over so it cover the card completely.

product_title: Britax Frontier 85 Booster Seat
review_body: Make no mistake, I am sold on this being the safest booster seat out there given the consistently high IIHS rankings for Britax products.  Prior to this purchase, we had a Britax Boulevard which served us well and was both sturdy and comfy.  I would have been happy for my soon to be 6 y/o daughter to continue using the Boulevard but at 45\\" she is now too tall for it although she weighs only 43 lbs...enter the Frontier.  I love that this will grow with her and that it has cupholders.  My daughter loves the bright pink color.  It was a bit of a pain to thread the seatbelt through the well but given my strong desire to continue using the harness, feel it was worth it.  The latch installation was substantially easier.  I would have given this five stars if the armrests were movable such that they could be tucked away to make it easier for her to get in and out of the seat AND would have appreciated an easier push button method to adjust the harness AND would have liked a more secure belly pad (along with our previous Britax Blvd, the belly pad slips off fairly easily and is awkward to pull out from under her crotch.) Other than that, I feel you purchase Britax products as a type of insurance policy.  You hope you never have to rely on it but should the time come you'll be thankful that you had it.  One of the pricier booster seats on the market, it is a small price to pay for the peace of mind, comfort of your child, and consistently high safety rankings.  Not the coolest selection of colors or prints but still pretty fashionable. And, while not the most streamlined, has the safety test rankings I needed to see to feel good about us out and about on the highways and byways.  Biggest plus for my daughter is that she feels like a big girl now that the \\"baby\\" seat is gone.

product_title: Munchkin Soft-Tip Infant Spoon, 6 Count
review_body: My baby loves these spoons!  They are the perfect size for his little mouth and the baby food actually stays in the spoon instead of falling out like with other spoons.  He loves the bright colors, too.  They are so soft that he usually gets one to play with and bang on his tray while I am feeding him with the other.

product_title: Disney so Sweet Pooh Musical Mobile
review_headline: quality item of so sweet pooh
review_body: This item was just as I anticipated and shipped fast. So sweet pooh was an item being discontinued so was hard to find reasonable, but found it here at amazon.com

product_title: C.R. Gibson First Year Timeline Photo Frame, White
review_body: We were looking for a frame to display our son's first year photos and this does the job nicely. All photos are displayed vertically - the month by month window fits photos 1.5\\" by 2\\", the larger photo is just under 3.5\\" by 5\\". Frame is nicely constructed and doesn't feel cheap like the other frames we looked at. We are satisfied with our purchase.

product_title: GO-GO BABYZ TRAVELMATE Car Seat Travel Stroller for Toddler Car Seats
review_headline: Amazing for those who fly a lot with babies/toddlers
review_body: This is our second one after I mistakenly ran over our first one with the car just before taking off with the 2 kids (both under 3) on a transatlantic flight.  I never missed my GoGo Babyz travelmate more than on that first leg of the journey where one child had to walk, the baby in a stroller and me needing to carry the car seat for the littlest one for the plane ride.  Did I mention I was travelling alone???  Had I had the Travelmate in action, the day would have gone so much smoother and with a lot less stress.  I ordered another one to be waiting for us when we arrived in Florida, the return journey was so much nicer.  I tell you this is a godsend product and once you use it you wonder what you did before.  Not having to check a stroller, having your little one secure on a plane in their car seat, and then not needing to rent a car seat on the other end, and all because of this product!?!  Incredible!  We travel a lot so it's definitely been well used and the number of comments I get on it in the airport have I'm sure increased sales because I can't stop praising it.  I highly recommend this product, enough said.  :-)

product_title: The First Years Sounds For Silence Nursery Sound Machine (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This was SUCH a bad purchase. The volume intensity wears out quickly (one month) with repeated use for frequent infant napping. We had two, both died COMPLETELY in less than a year.

I'm trying the Graco next.

product_title: The First Years Jet Stroller, Retro Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this lightweight stroller.  It is super easy to use easy to maneuver.  I love the 5 point harness, my little one is a wiggler and this keeps her nice and secure.  The \\"basket\\" underneath is on the small side but for a stroller like this you can't expect much more.  The recline on the seat is minimal but shouldn't be a reason not to buy this stroller.  I have the 'Retro Red' color and it is nice and bright while still being gender neutral.  The handles are at a good height for both me and my husband.  I highly recommend this stroller if you are looking for something lightweight for a baby who still needs a 5 point harness.  It is much easier to cart around then the big travel system strollers and more sturdy and secure then your average umbrella stroller.

product_title: Regalo My Cot
review_body: I ordered this cot for my in home daycare. I had previously used vinyl mats and they ripped too quickly and easily. One of my daycare kids is a wild sleeper so she always ended up sleeping on the bare floor, OFF of her mat. Having her on this cot keeps her in place and it's cheaper than buying the regular daycare cots. I love these little cots, how they fold up so nice and snug and I can tuck them away anywhere.

product_title: Kidswitch Light Switch Extender- 3 Pack
review_body: I bought this product to help my daughter turn the lights off and on in \\"her\\" rooms.  She is 2 1/2 and can not reach them to be useful yet, oh well.  My only viable complaint is that they don't slide easily.  They are very east to install but do not come with screws that are long enough for the light switch to be used properly.  If I loosen them up enough to work, they are too loose and fall out.  They are specific to the product.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: We purchased this for our daughter when she was just 4 months old and she has loved it from the minute she saw it. She is 8 months old now and continues to love playing with it. It's usually the toy she grabs with her to take when we go somewhere. The music on it is very soothing and it has two volume options, which is BIG plus for every parent! I will be buying this for my two friends who are currently expecting! It's a definite MUST HAVE!

product_title: Britax Chaperone Infant Carrier
review_headline: Infuriates me every time I use it
review_body: This seat has some major design flaws.  While it's incredibly bulky and heavy, there is actually very little room for a child in there.  I have to wonder if whoever designed this seat has ever actually put a kid in there to test it out.  We have an average size 8 month old boy, and he has barely fit into this seat for the past 2 months.  Exacerbating the issue is that the straps are far too short.  Even extended all the way out, and with the rear strap buckle in the upper position, there is barely enough room to squeeze our kid's arms through the straps.  It really is an incredibly irritating hassle each and every time we have to fight this thing to get the kid in there.  If you live in a cold climate, be particularly wary.  If your child is in a winter coat, forget it.  You'll never get him/her strapped in. Today I had to remove my kid's coat to get him to fit in.  I really can't express how disappointed I have been with this seat.  I can't speak about the safety performance, but from a day-to-day ease of use perspective, I can tell you unequivocally that this is a major pain.  We have not had any issues like this with the 3 other baby seats we've owned.  I will be replacing this seat shortly.  I just can't stand it anymore.

product_title: Medela Pump In Style Advanced Breast Pump
review_body: I have to start by mentioning that Medela is the only brand I have tried (it is what the hospital where I delivered had) so I cannot compare it to other brands and don't have any pros or cons. Also important to mention that I only use the pump a couple of times every day since I am a stay at home mom for now. This brand came very highly recommended by friends and when I found it 20% off its regular price at a major retailer I decided that its definitely worth a shot. I've been using it for 10 weeks now and I don't have any complaints. The pump is solid, doing very well what it's meant to. 4 stars instead of 5 because of it's price, I have to admit I was hesitant to pay the extra money but I gave in when all I heard was good things from people I actually know and trust.

product_title: Graco Duo 2-in-1 Swing and Bouncer - Sweet Pea from the Sprout 'n Grow Collection
review_body: Our son has loved his graco swing from day one (ok, maybe day 5). He loves to swing, and listen to the music and sounds. He also takes naps in the swing which he has done since he came home from the hospital. The soft green color matches our family room perfectly and would be just fine for a little girl as well. Great for parents who don't want to have to buy another swing if they had a girl the second time around!!!! It was easy to put together and doesn't take up too much space. It's light enough that it's also easy to move when needed.

product_title: Dreambaby Deluxe Bath Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I do not recommend this item!
review_body: The latches for the t-bar are very hard to operate and it broke the second time we used it.  A poor quality item at best.  I would not recommend this bath seat!

product_title: YOUR BABY CAN SWIM! (TM) Inflatable Learner Swim Float/Swimming Float Neck Collar
review_headline: think person above me is overly negative
review_body: We have been using this item with our just under 3 month son in the bathtub. It would definitely work better in a deeper tub or pool, but he has fun kicking around in the tub. He was a little scared at first about having it around his neck so start for 5 minutes and increase the time as he gets used to it. There are no sharp edges that can hurt his neck and it attaches very securely. We hope to try it in the Y or college pool soon. Just remember, start slow and let him build up confidence. Plus I cant believe my first review on amazon is for a baby toy. All i can say is it works great for our son.

product_title: Graco Contempo Highchair, Rittenhouse (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
We couldn't have lucked out any better with the choice of this chair. I remember doing lots of research on high chairs before we decided on this one and now, four years later, I was looking it up to show it to a friend that I'm passing it on to and felt the need to write a short review.

My son was first in this chair when he was 4 months old and he's a very tall almost 4 year old now. We've used it in the last few months when we couldn't handle the constant ants in the pants that a 3 year old not restrained at the dinner table routine anymore and while he looks goofy in it (he's 45\\" tall) it still contained him perfectly. It does fold up and stow away nicely and my favorite feature by far has always been the 2nd tray. It's easy to dismantle and clean, the rollers on the legs have never failed and no one has ever had fingers or other appendages pinched in any part of the chair.

product_title: Bunnies by the Bay Silly Buddy, Styles May Vary
review_body: Bao Bao was supposed to be 12.5 inches.  Maybe if stretched in a \\"rack\\".  The item is tiny.  I measured the longest size to be 9.5 inches.  Might be worth a dollar or at most two.  I think the photo advertising this item was \\"puffed\\" to look bigger than it is.  I should have taken the hint that it only weighs 1.6 ounces!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

product_title: Safety 1st Nature Next Booster Seat, Lime
review_headline: For The Price-It's A 5 Star Item
review_body: If you're looking for a booster that is easy to clean, easy to assemble, and is easy on the pocket book, this is your booster.  It serves the purpose and is a nice neutral color.  More of a lime-y sherbet color though, than the sage color shown in the picture.  I expected this based on the color description (Lime) and the reviews that were posted about the seat.  For us, it's perfect.

product_title: Dream On Me, Liberty, 4 in 1 Convertible Crib
review_body: The crib looks like the picture.  The color is exactly what I had wanted and the assembly was fairly easy.  It took my husband and I about a hour to put the crib together.  There was a scratch on one part but nothing that would be noticed once the mattress place in the crib. It arrived to my house in less than a week.  It was a great purchase, and I'm very happy with it. :)

product_title: Britax E9LC21Q Frontier 85 Combination Harness-2-Booster Seat in Cowmooflage with a car seat Travel Bag
review_body: My son has had this car seat about 2 years and we love it.  He's now 4 1/2 yrs old and about 46lbs.  It's very easy for him to climb in and out and he even buckles himself in. My only small complaint is that sometimes when he falls asleep his head bobs forward a bit since it doesn't recline too much, but otherwise the seat is excellent quality, very well padded and I feel happy knowing that he's as safe as possible.  Note: we have a Britax Marathon seat for our younger son and love that too!

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Bouncer
review_headline: Good for a Short Amount of Time
review_body:
It's always nice to have various options for baby - a swing, time on the floor, a bouncer, etc. This seat gets my nephew excited and helps wear him out. I appreciate the various levels for the music and jungle sounds.

As others have mentioned, the top bar clicks. I also wish there was a setting to turn on the lights and waterfall movement only. If we're close to nap time I'd like to switch to a calming mode and just let him fall asleep.

But - it's a nice bouncer for babies under 20 lbs. I think larger babies would bottom-out. :)

product_title: Jeep Liberty Renegade Walker, Storm (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: this walker has three setting so that you can adjust it according to your child's height. My son had so much fun in it. he would try to walk and run around everywhere in our living room. Easy to assemble and quailty is good. I was suprised with the quality. it has withstand my 5 year old as well.

product_title: Columbia Baby Backpack With Ripstop Trim
review_headline: It's ok, for seven months then a seam rippped, hole in the bottom.
review_body: Bought this bag 7 months ago when my daughter started pre-school. Took her to school by bus,used the bag everyday. Stuffed it with her lunch,and clothes. The seams on bottom of the bag have ripped and seams on the top of the bag have frayed. For the price I expected a much longer life expectancy. Disappointed with the product.

product_title: Medela Pump in Style Advanced Ac Adapter 9207041
review_body: this was just what i needed after my battery pack died, a little on the heavy side but gives me the power i need in my pump

product_title: Trend Lab Dr Seuss ABC Toddler Bedding Set
review_headline: A lot nicer than I expected
review_body: I must say that I was pleasantly surprised by the great quality this set is. I was expecting a kinda cheesy toddler bedding set, but the design was cool so I went for it. I am glad I did! It looks wonderful in my toddlers rooms ( I had to buy two sets, for both toddler boys). For the price, you can't go wrong.

product_title: Sugar Booger Feeding Collection Silverware Set
review_body: This is a our second set of this flatware.  It's perfect for my preschooler and travels very well.  I highly recommend it.

product_title: Lansinoh Signature Pro Double Electric Breast Pump With LCD Screen, Hygienic Closed System Design, Adjustable Suction Levels And Customizable Pumping Styles For Maximum Milk Production
review_headline: Pump broke after only a few months of regular use
review_body: I bought this pump back in 2009 after I went back to work from my maternity leave.  I pumped every day for about 2-3 months before my milk finally dried up (my daughter was refusing to breastfeed).  Aside from a few minor issues with the pump, I liked it a lot.  The pump went into storage after that and I took it out 6 months ago after I had my second child.  I was at home for most of the past 6 months and used the pump rarely-usually no more than once a day, sometimes once every few days.  I went back to work a month ago and that's when the problems started.  First, I noticed a different sound when pumping, and then after 2 weeks of using the pump twice a day every day the pump broke.  After my husband took it apart, he discovered that a rubber band inside broke.  He replaced it with a hair band, which worked well for about a week and then that broke too.  We tried asking the company (warranty is only for a year) to at least sell us the tiny rubber band part so that I could keep using the pump but instead they replied we have to buy a new pump.  Needless to say, I am very upset.  I'm not sure what to do-should I buy this crappy pump again (it's been redesigned anyway) or should I stick it out with a manual. I really don't want to over spend for only a few more months of pumping.  I wanted to write this review to warn people-do not buy from this company or Ameda Purely Yours (esentially the same as old lansinoh version) if you're in the same situation as me and you'll need this pump to work for more than a few months-not worth it-go with a more expensive medela. If I could go back in time that's what I would have done.

product_title: Booginhead PaciGrip Pacifier Holder
review_body: My little man doesn't like to keep the pacifier in his mouth.  He'll suck on it a little bit then spit it out then screams for it to be put back.  Many times the pacifier falls on the floor which is okay at home since we can wash it, but difficult out in public.  I wasn't sure if the Booginhead would work with a Soothie pacifier, but I'm happy to report that it does!  The clamp has teeth, but it doesn't make holes in the clothes.  Now when my baby spits out his pacifier, it just dangles from his top.

product_title: Bright Starts Comfort and Harmony Deluxe Cozy Cart Cover (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: At first I had an Ifantino cover that someone had given me as a gift and it was horrible!  I was happy to find this one...it comes with a carrying bag, which is nice for when we go into a restaurant, and it has a support pillow.  We didn't that for the cart, but we do use it in restaurant high chairs.  I haven't had a cart that it doesn't fit on.  This is a good one.

product_title: Chicco Cortina Keyfit 30 Travel System, Miro (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We purchased the Chicco Cortina Keyfit 30 Travel System in 2008 in anticipation of our first child.  It has served us well through 2 kids and is still usable and in great shape.  One of the plastic pieces that inserts into another plastic piece for the seat belt broke and I wrote to Chicco and they sent me a replacement for free. Great customer service!  The seat can get warm for the little one as other reviewers have said, but we just remembered not to dress them too warmly and put a blanket on top (if necessary) that you could take off.  We lived in a desert so the summers got quite hot, but the kids were fine.  The stroller is a bit bulky and will take up the majority of trunk space, but the sturdiness is great for strolls around the neighborhood.  A smoother ride in it than an umbrella stroller.  Also great that if the baby falls asleep you can just take the whole seat and put in into the stroller and the baby never wakes up.  The newborn inserts it come with are great also.  A lot of other car seats don't come with them and you have to buy them separately.  Overall, very happy with our purchase and rested assured that our kids were safe.

product_title: Munchkin 24 Pack Arm and Hammer Nursery Wipes, White (Packaging may vary) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: THESE WORK GREAT AND ARE SAFE!
review_body: These wipes are great for wiping down surfaces on occasion. I love them. They are so handy and get the job done without any harsh chemicals and don't leave residue behind, so I can go directly from the diaper changing table to the crib. They don't hurt the wood at all. I'm glad they have these. Thanks Munchkin!

product_title: The Shrunks Toddler Travel Bed Portable Inflatable Air Mattress Bed for Toddlers for Travel or Home Use
review_body: This travel bed is perfect for what we needed. Our daughter moves around a lot while sleeping and we couldn't go anywhere without having something to keep her in bed. It's a perfect size for her and I love that you can tuck the sheet or blanket underneath the inside section. I found though that for our daughter, we couldn't blow up the center portion (there are two sections to blow up) to 100% or it's still easy for her to roll off. If we blow the center portion up to about 70%, then it works perfectly for her! I love this and would highly recommend it!

product_title: Prince Lionheart Corner Guards
review_body: Have been in need of this item for some time now. Constantly was bumping the corners on our kitchen counters leaving marks, bruises, and sometimes cuts. Now our son is right at the height of hitting his face on the corners and to prevent injury put these corner bumpers up. They work perfectly!!!

product_title: Tommee Tippee Explora Easi-Roll Bibs
review_headline: Great for people sick of washing bibs
review_body:
I am not quite sure why people are so down on this product. We have a set of 21 month old twins and were excited to find these bibs when when the boys were around 6 months. We stopped using cloth bibs and were pleased not to have dirty,dried up bibs waiting for us to wash at the end of each day. I love these bibs. They are so easy to use and I wash them out in my dish water after each meal and let them hang over the kitchen faucet. They travel well too. We spent a month in Europe when our twins were 13 mo. and we had 4 bibs with us. Super easy to clean up in a train station bathroom.

As for rolling these up.... never had a problem to toss them in my purse. Seems to be kind of a needless feature. They really don't take up space....and I always have to carry two with me so I don't see this as a negative.

As for gaps between the neck. Yes, if your child is under 1 you may have a slight gap. I felt comfortable with putting this on my 6 month olds, because they were very alert and active eaters. I can see though where other mothers may want to wait until their child is a bit older, depending on their relationship with food.

As a side note, the neck is adjustable and this has been great as my boys have grown. In addition, these bibs have worn like iron. They are washed at least 4-5 times a day, and I've even run them through the washing machine a few times. They still don't show any sign of wear...... pretty amazing.

product_title: JJ Cole Outdoor Blanket,Blue Orbit, 5' x 5'
review_body: This product is a great example of why you have to pay attention when ordering on the internet. I had originally added it to my wish list imagining it to be a \\"blanket\\" but when I got around to reading the reviews I realized it was more like a mat than a blanket. Fortunately, when I actually bought it I understood what I was getting, and I couldn't be happier with it, but J.J. Cole should really rethink the name.  This is a fairly stiff and thick mat made out of a waterproof material, the striped material is a lightweight and soft fabric, some kind of nylon I think. It's nice enough to sit on, but it's not a snuggly blanket in any way. We've used it on the beach and at the park as a picnic blanket, and it also makes a great waterproof mat for our baby to play on when he's airing out a diaper rash.  It folds up into a nice portable package that makes it easy to carry, and as a mom juggling a baby, a diaper bag and who knows what else, I really appreciate the strap, which is long enough to wear over the shoulder. If you're in the market for an outdoor playmat/picnic blanket, this is just right. Like most J.J. Cole products, the fabrics/colors are nicely modern and stylish.

product_title: Delta Children City Street Side by Side Stroller, Black
review_headline: great little piece of baby gear
review_body: I love this stroller for my 2 grand-babies. It maneuvers easily and easy to push. I had to look for the shoulder harness as the one baby tries to get out of everything, so this one had that feature. The only downside is that the hoods don't cover much, so not recommended for a rainy day. Also no protection from any wind. Would be great for sunny days and mall-walking. It folds up quick and fits nicely in the trunk of my Jag.  I would recommend this stroller.

product_title: Skip Hop Moby Bath Spout Cover Universal Fit, Blue
review_headline: Looks neat and does the job...
review_body: This spout fits my bath faucet perfectly. Heavy grade plastic is easily adjustable and should last for a long time.

product_title: Koala Baby I Love My Daddy Jacquard Blanket
review_body: Someone bought this for me as a baby shower gift. My son is almost 2 now and it is litterally his BEST FRIEND! He takes it EVERYWHERE! That being said I have had to patch it up quite a bit. It's falling apart faster then I can sew it together. And forget washing it, it just makes it worse. I looked around to find a new one and was astonished that it's $50! It's definatly not WORTH $50. (The girl who gave it to me works for the store she got it at and got a discount) So, I'm only giving it 3 stars, because although my son loves it, I'm not thrilled with its poor quality.

product_title: DK Leigh Crib Nursery Bedding Set, Distinctive Cupcake Baby, 10 Piece (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
After long WEEKS of searching for something \\"purple, but without butterflies and not too much pink\\" for my daughter's nursery, I found this bedding set. Not only is it DIFFERENT and UNIQUE, but once it arrived (and earlier than I would have thought, since I live overseas) it was absolutely stunning.

This bedding set is just gorgeous and exactly what I'd been searching for. Beautifully done and even more gorgeous in person. The \\"pink\\" in the set is more of an orange-coral color, and it accents the lavender/purple perfectly.

Could not be happier with this purchase. Great quality at a great price.

product_title: Joovy Room Portable Playard
review_body: After lots of research we chose this and we are delighted with our choice! The red is a fun colour, the pricing is just right and our little boy is enjoying himself with the space and comfort this play pen has to offer.  Easy to keep clean, comfortable base and folds up nice and small. The wheels are a nice feature too so we can move it quietly & quickly around the room. We brought this product back to Europe as we could not find anything comparable on the market and we are not disappointed! Good buy.

product_title: Nuby Easy Clean Bottle Brush with Suction Base, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This was the second bottle brush cleaner i have used. Much better than the Luv's product that i was given at a baby shower.  The various bristle types are great and the sponge in the middle seems to already be loose.  It works great with smaller or large bottle. Overall a great cleaning product.

product_title: Tommee Tippee Explora Truly Spill-proof Straw Cup Drinking Cup 2 Pack - Insulated - Boy Colors - Colors May Vary 12m
review_body: I bought this for my grandson because he wouldn't use a sippee cup, wanted to have a straw. He also was prone to toss his cup on the floor when he finished, even if it still had drink in it. This was perfect, it truly doesn't leak nor spill even when held upside down.

product_title: Munchkin Auto-Close Metal Gate, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Horrible assembly!  For the amount of money paid for this gate it shouldn't be difficult to put together!  I plan on returning this piece of junk!

product_title: Munchkin Stroller Links, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought the stroller links to connect 2 Maclaren strollers on our family trip to Disney World, one was Maclaren Volo and the other was Maclaren Triumph. It worked great and only one person was needed to push the 2 strollers. We liked it so much that we used them in the malls as well. I would definetely recommend this product!

product_title: Prince Lionheart Complete Dishwasher Basket System
review_body: I don't use the round thing (I guess it's for sippy cups), but I use the other two for Dr Brown bottles and Medela pumping supplies.  No complaints so far, it just does what it should!

product_title: Bright Starts Bloom and Rattle, Pretty in Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter enjoys this rattle. It is soft and makes fun crinkly sounds. The handle is a little fat for her to grasp so far (5.5 months) but she enjoys it none the less. The little face is pleasant to look at. It also fits inside my purse easily. The fleece covering the handle is a little.. unesthetically pleasing and doesn't seem to go with the rest of the flower design though.

product_title: Baby Trend 4 Position High Chair, Nambia (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I was looking for a unisex chair that had wheels.  So I chose this one. It's very nicely padded.  Tray comes on and off easily.  Also hangs off the back (very convenient when your home is cluttered with so much baby stuff!).  The design is pretty.  It looks like an expensive chair but we got it at a bargain.  It moves around the house very smoothly. The height seems a little low (even at its highest) for a highchair, but it's a good height if you're sitting down and feeding baby.  the height adjustment and recline all work very smoothly and easily (not jerky and difficult like some other baby products).  Baby is 4 months old so the tray is way too high for her.  I removed it since she will be eating from my hand anyway.  I think once she's bigger it will be okay (maybe only slightly high).  Sometimes I just let her sit in it or recline. She's comfortable enough to fall asleep!  I'm very very pleased overall.

product_title: Disney Winnie the Pooh Face Security Blanket Lovey 15" Square
review_headline: Pretty, lovable, but easily worn lovey.
review_body: My son has had his Winnie-the-Pooh face lovey since he was a few months old, and sleeps with it every night (he is now two-and-a-half). He loves his lovey. I have a couple of quibbles however. The body is off-white and easily dirtied. Also, one side is satin and prone to snags. But as I said, my son adores it. It is a very cute lovey and washes well.

product_title: Britax Marathon 70 Convertible Car Seat (Previous Version), Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body: After a bit of research we decided to purchase the Britax marathon 70.  We needed 2 seats and I was a little concerned about it fitting in our Toyota Matrix. When it is rear facing it will fit in the middle position in the matrix.  It is too big to fit behind the passenger seat.  We like having the seat in the center so this isn't an inconvenience for us.  We also have a Jeep and this had no problems fitting behind the passenger seat.  The Latch makes it really easy to install.  I feel very safe with my little one in this seat.  It's very easy to adjust the height of the straps which has been great as he's grown.  I have no complaints with this seat so far.

product_title: Summer Infant Swaddleme Blanket Organic Cotton
review_body: This was a great product!  I needed to put my son in the larger swaddle before the weight posted on the package.  Just make sure to secure the velcro to the blanket before the wash so it doesn't collect friends!  ;)

product_title: Weil Baby Tritan Training Cup with Airwave Venting System, 5 Ounce, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Love this cup, my daughter was off the bottle at 8 months!!
review_body: I LOVE this cup, I gave it to my daughter at 7 during the day and by 8 months she was off the bottle and drinking from this cup 24/7. She is a VERY picky little girl and would only take certain bottles and pacifiers. I went through like 5 other cups and she refused all of them. She took to this one like a charm, maybe because its similar to the breastflow bottle that she used. But I tell everyone I know with kids about this cup!!

product_title: Baby Einstein Count and Compose Piano (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: OH no! it gets better!... get this
review_body:
This is an amazing series for a kiddo who loves word world. we have all dvds and
it took us time to collect them, this is great opportunity to save time and money.
The best way to encourage a child to learn is to buy the words world animals just
like the ones in dvd. I highly recommend the famous Word World pull apart plush plush soft animals to go with it.
The babies and kids love them so much. You can't get them anymore at stores
but if you are lucky you can come across the set on e bay.
It is worth all the money as it helps a child to learn so fast so early so much.
It is also amazing how much they sell for even used ones so it is good investment.
Well worth the price.

product_title: Kids Line Lamp Base And Shade - Cambridge
review_body: This matches the rest of the nursery we're very happy.  I adapted a dimmer/timer into it and it works and looks great.

product_title: Snuza Hero Baby Movement Monitor
review_body: My husband and I (new parents) LOVE this monitor. For the first few weeks after our baby was born, we would worry if we couldn't see her breathing at night-- with the monitor, we no longer have to worry about her when we're sleeping in another room. We used to joke about buying one of those tiny dentist's mirrors on sticks to hold under her nose to see if it fogged-- now we won't have to! We've used this every night for two months and the battery is still going strong.

product_title: Tommee Tippee Closer to Nature Anti-Colic Bottle
review_body: I have been having to supplement my newborn and originally was using the Breast-flow bottle. My son was having difficulty latching on to me and I felt like I needed a new nipple. (not to mention a bunch of other problems with the Breast-flow). From numerous positive reviews I decided to purchase the Tommee Sensitive Bottle. Right away I notice a difference in his latch. He took to the bottle immediately and we have fewer problems with the Breast-Bottle transition. The problem with this bottle lies with all the PARTS. Too many parts to wash. I bought this thinking the inserts would be optional. But, they are absolutely necessary for functionality of the nipple. All in all this has been a great purchase.

product_title: Lamaze Cloth Book
review_body: nice book, good textures and colors.  love the handle.  couple of pages use very dark material.. dont like dark colors so i may brighten them a bit somehow. {like on another book i hand sewed in some white cord to brighten a very dark page, plus give more texture for feel}. but as i have bought about 10 of this type book now, it seems the best page is the front page and those in the middle are not as bright. but overall , good quality.

product_title: CoCaLo Soft and Cozy Blanket, Daniella (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This blanket is beautiful and SO SO soft and warm! Much more beautiful in person. Washed well, did not thin out like some blankets do when you wash them. Highly recommend!

product_title: Bright Starts Bounce Baby Activity Zone, Neutral (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased the bright starts bounce baby activity zone for our 4 month old baby due to the fact that he's in the \\"I want to stand and kick my legs all day stage\\"  Before crawling.  I figure since it had toys and a rotating chair with trampoline type at the bottom.  He hated it he would only be stay in there for no more than five minutes.  This product don't have bounce, its just still.  I ended up returning the product.  I invested on the Baby Einstein Musical Motion Activity Jumper.  He loves it, I am able to pick up around the house and he is busy bouncing up and down while watching tv or playing with the toys.  If you have an infant like i do that's eager to see whats around and likes being held up along with jumping the bright starts bounce baby activity zone is NOT it spend the extra and buy a jumperoo.......

product_title: Itzy Ritzy Travel Happens Large Sealed Wet Bag
review_body: I just love the Wet Happened zippered bags from Itzy Ritzy.  I have several in my house, and keep finding more uses for them.  As a new mom, I always have one in my diaper bag to collect dirty diapers, burp clothes bibs and more but I have been finding many other uses for them.  I decided to get one to keep my breast-pump parts in when traveling or going back to work. It is also great for my sweaty workout clothes or swimsuit after working out at the gym.  I can't get enough!

product_title: The Gro Company Gro-Egg Room Thermometer
review_body: We have a house with varying temperatures in every room. This product helps us know the temp in my son's room.  We have found it to be very accurate.  And the color system makes it very easy to read.  Although it recommends being in green, we leave the temperature on the yellow color and my son is comfortable.

product_title: Twilight Turtle AND Sea-Turtle Constellation Nightlight GIFT PACK (2 Items) from Cloud B
review_body: I bought these two turtles for my two boys, who are afraid of the dark, and it was a great idea!! They're happy with them and the turtles are gorgeous!!

product_title: Belly Armor Belly Blanket Chic
review_body: I bought the blanket and a t-shirt from Belly Armor.  I tired the cellphone test many times and they all FAILED.  I think this product is a total scam trying to making money off expectant moms who will pay for the protection for their baby.  It is a very evil thing to do!  Don't waste your money on that!  An expectant mom.

product_title: Beco Butterfly II Baby Carrier - Tyler
review_headline: Yay I finally found the perfect carrier!!!
review_body: I just have to say I LOVE my new Beco Butterfly II.  I sold my Ergo because my baby was too big for it.  The back would barely go below his shoulder.  My shoulders were killing me.  We were both very uncomfortable.  After researching for a perfect carrier that would accommodate a 4'11 mom and a 25lbs 10 month old baby, I finally found one!  I can't even feel I'm carrying him.  I highly recommend it!

product_title: Disney Handy Manny 4-Piece Toddler Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This set is so cute. It washes up well and the top sheet is fitted around the bottom. Which is great because there is no remaking the bed if it comes out from under neither.

product_title: Kids' Sling Bookshelf with Storage Bins - Natural Natural
review_headline: Well designed bookshelf - GREAT for toddlers on up!!!
review_body: My parents bought this for my daughter for Christmas on my request.  My husband put it together and said it was very easy.  It was pretty heavy in the box and feels very sturdy.  My daughter loves books and we buy new ones for her all the time.  I was a bit concerned reading the reviews on all the different sling bookshelves that we would run out of room for the books, but I just reorganized them today and counted 42 board books of all shapes and sizes.  They not only all fit, but there's room for at least a dozen more!!!  I'm talking board books, not regular books.  I'm betting you could get around 70 standard (like Dr. Seuss) books in this thing.  The real selling point on this bookshelf for me was the 2 storage bins, and this is the only one on the market that I could find.  There are always uses for storage bins when it comes to a toddler's toys and kudos to the manufacturer for knowing this.  I was very happy that all but one of her puzzles fit - in only ONE of the bins, and there's room for a few more. (The only one that doesn't fit is a big 12\\"x15\\" Melissa & Doug Latch puzzle)  I still have an empty bin!  I'm probably going to use it for her growing collection of stuffed animals.  Also, I was surprised that the front sling is only 4\\" deep, but we have several 3x3, 4x4, etc books that would just get lost in the deeper pockets, so I'm happy for the shorter one.  To me, this was a very well thought out design.  I know this will last her for years.  It's small enough for a toddler to use, but big enough that it would easily work for a 7-8 yr old.  My only regret is that this doesn't come in anything other than beige.  Other than that, I'm very happy with this bookshelf and highly recommend it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Newborn Rock 'n Play Sleeper, Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have two bassinets that rock and an arms reach sleeper. This is the one that I wouldnt give back. We use this every night and during the day. My son loves to be put in it when he gets tired. He is now 15 lbs and getting a little big for it :( I'm going to be sad not having him right next to me and be able to just rock him to sleep when he wakes up. Its been a life saver after his feeds since he has reflux and has to be slightly elevated for a few minutes after he eats. I would recomend this before spending tons of money on all the other baby sleeper gear

product_title: Munchkin Star Fountain
review_body: I bought this for my twin girls and was really excited to use it at bath time, it worked for about five minutes and hasnt worked since.

product_title: Tots In Mind Cozy Crib Tent II 1, White
review_body: when my 18 month old figured out how to climb out of the crib I wasn't concerned about his saftey - he can get in and out successfully and silently at will.  I was concerned about our sleep since he appeared in our room again and again all night long and would not rest long enough to fall asleep for naps or bedtime.    The first couple of fall asleeps in the tent were resisted and we would have to leave the zipper half undone.  My big complaint:  the Zipper is really LOUD.  I've tried everything I can think of to muffle the sound so that I can re-cover my son in the several times over the night.  It's loud and he is a fairly light sleeper.  We bought this for $110 (Canadian) since we were too desperate to wait for shipping.  Too bad it's such a cheap and loud zipper.

product_title: Sesame 2 Count  Sheet Set
review_body: I ordered this bedding set expecting to have the sheets be a bit stiff based on the reviews. What I received said microfiber right on the package and the whole set was really soft even before I put it in the wash. I especially love the top sheet with fitted ends. The colors are very vibrant! My son loves it as well.

product_title: Mini Crib Mattress
review_headline: seems good, but sheets are tough to find
review_body: we have the davinci emily mini crib, and this mattress fits absolutely perfectly with no gaps at all. it seems comfy (baby isn't here yet), and we got the American Baby Company Waterproof Fitted Mattress Pad Cover to go with it. it fits, but it's a tight fit around the mattress. however i wasn't as concerned with that as i was with finding sheets.   THE KOALA SHEETS PEOPLE ARE RECOMMENDING ON HERE DO NOT FIT. we got them, placed them on and they BARELY fit. a similar fit that the mattress pad had, but then i washed them and WOW did they shrink a TON!!! after that, they don't fit at ALL, so don't bother with them. we finally got some from sheetworld.com after debating on the price (they are expensive...) but they are WONDERFUL. get the 5\\" custom high ones. they completely fit (with room to spare even after washing) and they are SO SOFT. they are jersey knit, and whenever i feel them, i know my baby will be super comfy on them.   but overall, i really like the mattress, and i think it will be great for baby. i just gave it 4 stars because finding sheets was a pain (and an added expense).

product_title: Hoohobbers Doll Moses Basket
review_body: This is an awesome basket. Looks very expensive and is much nicer than one's you'd find on a toy store. My daughter's Bitty Baby fits in it perfectly with room to spare.  The colors/fabric is very nice and I was able to find matching bed sheets for by daughter's bed in the poka dot pattern.  Fast service and good packaging from the seller.  This is a great buy at a great price!

product_title: Malden Metal Picture Frame
review_body:
This is a nice frame. It's heavy and definitely suggests quality. The lines and edges are smooth. It's detailed and has a lot going on, so it definitely will be eye catching even amongst other frames, and also looks good just on its own.

The finish is definitely more pewter and not at all silver. That's fine with me - but just wanted to clarify for anyone wondering.

product_title: The First Years Night Cravings Bottle Warmer & Cooler
review_body: I've only had this warmer a couple days, and I LOVE IT! I bought this for grandma's house, but decided to keep it myself after testing it out. I was using the Munchkin warmer but this warmer warms in half the time. Very nice design and works well so far.

product_title: Sassy Ring O' Links Rattle Developmental Toy
review_body: My little one loved these when he was 6 months. We went to restaurants and gave him the rings to keep him occupied.  Also great when teething.

product_title: Cosco Umbrella Stroller, Dino Camo  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Don't expect it to last long for the price
review_body: This is a good product if you consider the purpose and price. My nephew is quite big and it lasted him only about 6 months. Once he got a little chubbier, he looked squished in the stroller and didn't care for it. The other thing to consider is that the child ends up quite low to the ground, so if you're taking them to the zoo or aquarium, they have a hard time seeing everything. This is good for short walks and portability, but I would recommend spending the money on a Maclaren Volo. It lasts forever and is very light weight and easy to carry.

product_title: Clay Hand & Footprint Photo Keepsake Desktop Frame
review_headline: Great! A bit difficult to use on babies
review_body: The product is a great keepsake, or gift for grandparents.  I recently had a baby and wanted to give her grandparents a nice keepsake.  She was almost 6 weeks old when we did the molds.  I was a bit difficult to get a deep enough impression to notice from a distance.  Close up the prints looked great, but then looking from a distance, the prints were not as visible.  We had to redo the impressions a few times (because baby didn't like being forced to keep her hand opened or didn't like the pressure we put on her foot).  It was easy to redo the impressions...just re-mold the clay.

product_title: Infantino Swift Classic Carrier, Black
review_body: I love this carrier!  I have this one and a Baby Hawk and I feel better and more secure using this one.  Not to mention the price is super!  I use this carrier at home while doing chores and my daughter is very comfortable.  So comfortable that she falls asleep more often than not.  It's also great for when she has her \\"crabby time\\".  Highly recommended!

product_title: Boppy Water Resistant Protective Cover
review_body:
Good product. Here is why:
- Fits the boppy snuggly
- Water resistant
- Soft fabric
- Love the flap over the zipper

I have owned this cover for about 3 months and so far, I don't have any complaints.

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_body: It's simple: the SleepSacks help prevent SIDS, keep baby warm, and provide a signal to your baby at night (or for each nap) that it is time to go to bed. For those concerned that it is too constricting... such is not the case. My oldest (20 months) can walk around in her crib in her sleep sack! My little one (5 months) rolls around with no problem. As for the pilling others have mentioned, try washing it inside out. I have found that it helps considerably.

product_title: Stork Craft Tuscany 4-in-1 Convertible Crib
review_headline: Bad smell (chemical odor), good design, easy to build and affordable!
review_body:
I must say that I read the complaints about the strong smell (chemical odor) coming from the crib before I bought it. Yes, it is true and unfortunately despite the great design and that it is affordable, the smell seems to be persistent even after a week of use. They've got to take care of this or change the paint chemical they are using for the crib.

I am leaving the crib outside to let it subside the odor, but it is very slow. So, if you are concerned about the odor, do not order this crib!

But, again, the design and build is great and I love it.

Hope this helps!

product_title: Rockin Green Shake It Up Pail Freshener
review_body: This smells really nice and actually does help...it just doesn't help as much as I had hoped. It mutes the odors some but in my opinion not enough to warrant the buy. It could be my expectations were too high, however.

product_title: Kissaluvs Cotton Fleece Hybrid One Size Contour Diaper
review_body: I use these as backup.  They come in the mail sooo nice and soft looking!  Then they are washed and they get ugly.  Has a terry towel feel.  Also have some difficulty getting the snappis to fit on it because the pilling of the fabric is excessive.  Very bulky under the covers.  My son is a year old and 23 lbs and its still bulky on him.  Plus I don't like using snappis on a squirmy kid for diaper changing-prefer something with snaps or Velcro.  (I recommend workhorses by green mountain diapers.)  One thing positive about kissaluvs contour diaper is the absorbency-good for nap time.

product_title: green sprouts Organic Blankie Cool Soothing Teether
review_headline: blankie part is an effective teether
review_body: Our baby loves the fabric part of this teether -- the knots are good for sore gums. She hasn't been too into the plastic part, but I imagine that other babies would be. You're basically getting two teethers in one.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: After reading the many reviews about this product, I decided to give it a try as must teethers are too big for my daughter's mouth. While Sophie is adorable (love the name too), she is nothing more than a squeaky toy for my baby.

product_title: Nurtria BPA Free Nipple Shields, 2 Pack, Silicone (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Bough as a back up but did not like
review_body: I bought theses nipple sields because they were so cheap and I though they might be a good back up to have if I misplaced or damaged the madela shield we were using. They are very think and stiff. Also, the holes do not let much milk through. I did not like them.

product_title: BABYBJORN Bib for Comfort Carrier, White
review_body: While pregnant with my first child I thought I needed a bunch of stuff that I clearly don't. =) One of those items was this bib. Yes, my baby chews on the baby-carrier and it gets wet and this bib prevents that, but so would  a regular bib around his neck.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: I was able to try out before wrapping.  This is a great musical toy.  My neice loved it.  She played with it for the two hours during their visit.  It shipped quickly and was received in great shape.  Thanks.

product_title: WubbaNub (tm) DRAGON Pacifier!
review_body:
I bought this as a little treat for my daughter, who is due in June, I'm sure she will love it. This item is just as cute in person as on the web. At first I thought it was smaller than anticipated, but that has more to do with me skipping over the measurement description than any real issue.
My husband is excited too, who doesn't love dragons???

product_title: phil&teds Slim Shadee Traveller UV Sun Mesh
review_body: This shadee came without the zipper to attach it to the Traveller crib.  I bought two from this seller and both came without the zip.  I thought it was a problem with my crib so contacted Phil & Ted directly who assured me it wasn't.  I got hold of a shadee directly from them which had the zipper to attach to the Traveller.  No idea where these were manufactured, but as two were incorrect, I am not convinced they are genuine.

product_title: JJ Cole Broadway Stroller, Black/Gray Drops
review_body: I absolutely love this stroller. It is a very smooth ride, it's a good size- very easy to move in between isles of clothes in stores, has a large super cute canopy (I got the blue one- it's adorable), and super comfortable seat. My only complaint is that the seat is very small. It's not an average stroller seat. I purchased it when my son was 6 months old- his head was almost reaching the canopy! It seems like he is going to outgrow it really fast. This is probably not the stroller that I will be able to use through the toddler years.

product_title: Disney Baby Music and Lights Walker, Happily Ever After  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter LOVED her walker while she fit into it! Man, she was able to get around in that thing! I loved it too, because then it was easier to take her outside with us.    While it's very cute, you should know there ARE NOT any princesses on it at all.  It's just decorations and such.  I was sad to see that, but otherwise it is a good walker

product_title: Maxi-Cosi  Pria 70 with Tiny Fit Convertible Car Seat, Total Black
review_body: We LOVE this car seat.  We have a toddler and an infant and we like the fact that this seat can be easily used for either of them.  We have a 2 year old who is still rear facing and this car seat can still rear face up to 40 inches and 40 pounds.  We would recommend this seat highly to anyone looking for a convertible car seat that they can use for years with their kids.

product_title: Sassy Teething Feeder
review_headline: HAZARD if I could take AWAY stars I would.
review_body: This is only my 2nd Amazon review, EVER, and I shop enough to get the Prime. But with this product I HAD to review it.... I struggled with the ANNOYING childproof lock that makes it virtually impossible to take it apart and it hurts to open it. I have to soak it EVERY time to get the food out so I can open it, but I would deal with it. But that is NOT why I am writing. I just discovered that this product will fit perfectly over his mouth and nose, like a match made in heaven. Which is pretty bad because it could easily suffocate him. These lids are going in the trash. I will continue to use them WITHOUT the lids (lest someone else let him play with them. However, given the hassle that it is to open it I think we may just go with the Munchkin ones. Very upset about this.

product_title: Maison Chic Boy Owl Rattle, Boy Owl, 4.5"
review_body: This is very cute. Small just perfect size for a baby !  Nice colors . Shipping was fast and it match perfect with my owl decorations.

product_title: Assorted Printed Wine Corks, 1 POUND (Approximately 100 pieces), Only Real Corks, No Synthetics - For Crafts Projects!
review_body: This product is sold as a set of 100 used and factory seconds. Of the corks I received every single one of them is a factory second, which is okay because there is a nice selection and the corks are in great condition but I was really hoping for some used ones with staining on them like displayed in the picture. This can be done yourself but with a lot of extra time and work. DO NOT expect to receive something like in the picture.

product_title: 300 MiniBalls Non-Toxic Crush Proof Play Balls w/ Polka Dot Hamper: 10 Colors 5.5 cm
review_body: I bought this product for the ball pit and I'm so pleased about the quality, because it's better than the balls included with the ball pit

product_title: Contours Lite Stroller, Tangerine (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A Great value for the price
review_body: Its a great stroller for the price.  Sturdy and light weight.  Would be better if it folded up completely.  Can be a bit cumbersome in the trunk but other than that, I love it!

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_body:
I have two of these, and one is perfect... but the other has a sticky zipper that is hard to catch. But, I was in a pinch and couldn't return it, because I needed it.

But, the baby loves them. And they do help her to sleep better overall, so I do recommend them.

product_title: Kissa's One Size Antibacterial Wet Diaper Bag
review_body: This wet bag is a really useful thing.  While I imagined such a product frivolous, it is such an improvement over plastic bags.  The diapers do not get icky and moldy in this wetbag even after two days, it keeps my diaper bag from being smelly and it looks stylish and no one knows that you are carrying gross wet diapers. And now I remember to empty it out, instead of letting the wet diapers get old in some forgotten plastic bag. With the plastic bag method I would throw the used plastic bag away and then I was caught with nothing to place a wet diaper so many times.  With this reusable wetbag, I always put it back into my diaper bag and am not caught off guard.  I think the cute, stylish pattern helps with that.  Ive had it two months and not needed to wash it yet. Definitely worth the money.

product_title: Ju-Ju-Be Be Hip Bag, Marvelous Mums
review_body: Love this bag.  A bit pricey,however my husband can use it without feeling as though he's holding my pocket book.

product_title: Madison Mills #23 3' Accordian Porch Gate
review_body: I just wanted a simple gate to keep my little dachshunds out of the room we turned into a library.  I did not want to close the door as it interferes with the circulation of the heated air from our furnace.  So, this was perfect for our small old dogs.  A barrier.  But if you want something sturdy that a crawling baby would grab onto and shake, or a small dog wanted to get through because you left the room without him/her, then I would get something else.  This is light weight, and like I said a good barrier, but not a complete stop if a child or dog wanted to get through it.

product_title: Britax Car Seat Travel Bag, Black
review_body:
We used it to travel to the Caribbean with a 6 month old.
My husband carried it as a backpack and we brought it in the plane as we got an extra seat for the baby- everybody was impressed by our organization- even the pilot...We also used a bag for our stroller and checked it at the gate.
Do not try to roll it in the plane - it does not fit in the aisle.

PROS: So easy to go through the customs and walking to the gate when you have your hands free.
I live the versatility: Backpack- rolling on wheels
seems to be good quality (but we did not check it with the luggage)

CONS: It can be a little bit tough to close (we have the BRITAX Marathon car seat)and bulky- be careful not to knock people down when you carry it as backpack

product_title: Mommy's Helper Nursery Essentials
review_body: No se si solo me paso a mi pero no he usado todos los productos, generalmente los medicamentos traen su dispensador, los peines si son muy buenos, el corta uñas lo he usado por 1 año y medio y ya hay que cambiarlo, lo que no pude usar nunca porque cuando lo necesite no servia fue el gel para congelar, ya estaba como vencido y no tenia consistencia de gel

product_title: Safety 1st Nature Next Booster Seat, Lime
review_body: I bought this for my 18 month old and it was tight getting her under our table.  I should of listened to the other reviewer about the wooden skirt on the table, because that was part of our problem as well.  This was made well and really high, so if your baby is shorter and you have a high table this would be great.

product_title: HALO Big Kids SleepSack Lightweight Knit Wearable Blanket
review_body: I bought this item to discourage my 2yo from taking off his pajamas at night. Yes...he's a little nudist. Most nights  he easily gets out of it because it is HUGE. The neck hole is very wide and he can easily slip out the top if he wants to. I would say this size (2T-3T) is more like a 5T or bigger. Also - the zipper goes from top to bottom, which is good - but I do wish there was a way to prevent him from unzipping it. I think if the size was a normal size 2t or 3t, I'd be much happier...it's crazy how big this thing is....not just the blanket part - but the size of the neck hole is ridiculously big.

product_title: Sassy First Solid Feeding Bowl with Spoon
review_body: I love this set! As most people said, the best thing about this is the spoon. I almost ordered the set of spoons but they are a bit expensive and we needed some extra bowls. I love that the bowl has 2 slots so the foods don't mix. I love that the lid  likeseals off each section, and I love how soft the spoon is on baby's gums. The only thing I don't like about this set is that the lid is so hard to get on securely and a bit hard to get off (although I would rather it be hard to get off so that the food doesn't spill). By far my favorite food item for baby!

product_title: Munchkin Arm & Hammer Diaper Pail System
review_body: I bought this when it was 15bucks and I wasn't sure at first, but I swear by it now. There is absolutely NO SMELL that comes from it as when it closes, it twists and locks the bag in. I had my baby two months ago and am still living off the the three pack refills I bought. Long-lasting, great quality, just don't stuff it too full, or else the top won't close. I definitely recommend this to anyone wanting a diaper pail!

product_title: Lillebaby Eurotote 5-in-1 Baby Carrier by Scandivian Child - Red/Cream
review_body: I bought this in lieu of getting my newest little one an infant car seat.  Instead I got the First years Truefit Convertible car seat and this to carry him around.  The material is very plush and the build quality is good.  I've been using it for 3 weeks now and he even sleeps in it at home instead of his bassinet, which he didn't take to as well.  I get lots of inquiries from other moms as we go to our newborn appointments and such and have referred this product to others.

product_title: Kidco Peapod Travel Bed in Lime
review_body: We looked around at various portable cribs for when we travel and decided on this one after reading many reviews.  The portability is really great - we have even taken it on the airplane easily in it's bag to have it handy, although it will fit in luggage. The only downside I see is that the mattress slides into a compartment in the bottom and the surface for  the baby is very slippery. We began using this when our baby was 5 months and wanted something soft for her to sleep on, so decided to put the mattress inside and put a mattress sheet around it and it worked great. We've also used it on the beach and works well too.  Good value for the price - we have seen it used with even kids much older, so are hoping to be using it for at least a few more years with our little one.

product_title: Angel Dear Blankie
review_body: We received two of these for my son as baby shower gifts.  I tucked them away not really knowing if they were washclothes, blankets etc.  They come rolled up.  On a whim I took one out one day when my son was about 2 1/2 months old.  He put it right to his cheek and snuggled right in.  He absolutely loves this puppy!  We've nicknamed him \\"Woofy\\" and we now own 5 of them to keep everywhere.  My son is now 11 months old and this is still his favorite \\"toy\\" out of everything we own.  It calms him if he's upset and just makes him very happy.  LOVE this!!!

product_title: Kiddopotamus Tinydiner Placemat, Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I purchased this in Mar 2012, to relpace the 'same' mat I had originally purchased sometime in 2010. I used to love this product, and was just interested in replacing the original mat because of expected wear and tear. The mat I just received in was SMALLER, constructed of NOT AS DURABLE plastic, and the catch-trough was ALREADY WEAK, immediately spilling anything my child dropped into his lap.
I have reccommended this product to countless friends, but will STOP doing so, as it has become an inferior and basically useless product. I would have continued to include it in all baby-shower gifts I gave, but NOT anymore. I would return it, but with return shipping costs/my time, it is not worth it.
Buyer Beware-- The favorable reviews you have read are probably based on the earlier product.

product_title: Graco My Ride 65 Convertible Car Seat, Cuddle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I got this car seat to reaplace one that got stolen with my car. I loved the first one that I got for my oldest so I wanted the same one again. It's a good car seat for those on a smaller budget while still meeting the higher saftey standards. It was recommended to me by my brother-in-law who worked as a manager at babies r us. They put them through baby safety training and he sets high standards for everything so his recommendation was important to me.

I love this car seat! I have not had a problem adjusting the straps on any of the 3 I have gotten (I got 2 when I had to replace the first because I had twins when it was stolen.) I used the infant insert till my oldest was 2 and now use them with my twins. I agree with the woman who said her child looks comfortable while sleeping in it. My mother has a saftey first and when my oldest would fall asleep in it, his head slumped forward. In the MyRide, it reasted nicely to the side. I also love the 2 cup holders that make it so he has easy access to his sippy and snacks, makes my life so much easier and he loves them

The only cautions I have with the car seat are that it doesn't fit well next to other car seats (in the case of my twins they have to be on the captains chairs of the minivan.) It's also snug to fit other people on the seat next to it unless you have a big car, then it isn't really a problem. The other caution would be that a \\"pumpkin seat\\" is recommended until the child is grown out of it. They are made to be safer for small infants, so I would use the removable \\"pumpkin seats' until your baby is too big for it. (Another fact my Bro-in-law taught me.)

I would (and have) recommend this car seat to anyone. As I said, I'm on my second and third and my family loves them!

product_title: Happi Tummi Natural Colic Relief Waistband
review_body: My third baby was SO gassy. With my first two, we used Mylicon Drops. This time it seemed we needed something more. I read all the reviews on line and the Happi Tummi Removable Waistband - Blue as well as the Hyland colic drops came high recommended.
