I was excited when they came in the mail and we were able to try them out. The Happi Tummi was easy to use and smelled good, too. I put it on over my baby's onesie and then swaddled him. The Hyland's Colic Tablets seemed to work well in combination with the Happi Tummi. Several nights it's been the only way I can get my baby to sleep. It reminded me of the heat pads they used at the hospital with my first baby (they had special ones that wouldn't burn the baby). I highly recommend these! Just remember to take them out on time! If you burn it even once you'll need to get a new one! We learned that the hard way! my only recommendation would be that they include a spare pack :).

product_title: Bumkins Waterproof Junior Bib
review_body: I'm giving Bumkin bibs one star because their \\"proprietary\\" material just isn't what it should be. I have used seven of these bibs in rotation over the past year, and really wanted to like them. But all have eventually become embedded with black mold, despite nightly soaking in soapy water, scrubbing and hang drying, machine washing, and bleach soaks.  My daughter eats at her grandmother's house wearing a Bumkin bib for four meals a week-- that Bumkin bib didn't mold, perhaps because it was used less frequently-- but because it was dried in front of a sunny window, all the plastic coating peeled off in tiny bits, getting plastic bits all over my daughter (and potentially into her food).  Why can't they make a soft plastic bib with thicker plastic that is truly impermeable, period? Why have fabric edges and tags that retain water?  For the price, these bibs should stay clean longer than a few months.

product_title: medibag 117 Piece Kid Friendly First Aid Kit for the Whole Family
review_body: It does the trick I suppose, but be warned there are a lot of stickers included in the piece count. too many really. I loved (sarcasm) how the instructions on opening the box were INSIDE the box. Took me forever to figure it out (and its really quite simple). there are not enough sanitizing/antibacterial things included, I would have prefered more of those and no stickers. Along with q-tips. I won't be purchasing it again,  but at least I have a nice case to refill with bandages, etc.

product_title: Graco ComfortSport Convertible Car Seat
review_headline: Looks nice, but watch out for safety issues
review_body:
We purchased the Graco ComfortSport at Target in Sept of 2010 as an emergency replacement for our previous carseat after an accident. (We actually got the Creighton model.) I have 3 major concerns about the safety of this seat:

1) The shoulder straps do not tighten evenly. After looking at the back of the seat I realized this is due to the design of the set yoke; most seats have two individual hooks for the shoulder belts, tightened by a single pull strap. The ComfortSport overlaps the two shoulder straps under a single hook and one strap will always be a little looser than the other. This also crates the potential for the overlapping strap to slip out of the hook, as it is barely held in place by the hook.

2) The chest plate is easy to unbuckle, even for young children. I looked up advice on how to solve this issue on Graco's website- apparently many parents were having the same issues and Graco's response was that parents should just explain to their children why they need to keep the belt on. After pulling over 10+ times on a two-hour trip because my 2 year old didn't understand my explaining on why this belt was intended to keep him safe, I settled on buying self-adhesive Ace wrap to wrap around the buckle so he couldn't mess with it.

3) The tightening plate on our model broke after only 11 months of use. I was tightening the strap, as usuall, and the single screw the holds the plate in place pulled out and flew somewhere in the car. If this had happened during an accident, the shoulder straps would have been loosened about 2 inches and greatly reduced the protection of the seat.

I had contaceted Graco regauding my concerns about the seat, and asking for a refund. They sent me a letter stating that if I had problems with their product, I should ship it to them at MY expense and they would replace the seat with another one of the same model- no refund. Needless to say I just went out and bought a different, better ratedseat for my son.

product_title: Cosco Juvenile Scenera Convertible Car Seat, Medallion  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this car seat for my girly girl toddler who loves everything pink. It is a bit sad that it can't fit properly in my New Beetle. It hangs partially off the seat especially when it is in the upright position; which any parent would know is preferred by their child because they can see outside better. The problem is that the base has a front and back elevation (with open space in between). I never once considered the size and shape of the base of a car seat up until now. I never had a problem fitting previous car seats in my car. So if you own a bug or any smaller car, this may not be the seat for you. Also, the padding is sparse. I thought other reviewers were exaggerating about the padding issue, but they were right. For long rides I put a towel to serve for some cushioning for the buttocks. I can only imagine how uncomfortable it may get sitting basically on plain plastic for long durations. But it sure is pretty! Don't let that and a decent price cloud your judgement. This seat spends a lot of time in the living room serving as a princess throne as it can not fit in my bug and we use a better one in the other vehicle.

product_title: Britax Roundabout 55 Convertible Car Seat
review_body:
When my daughter outgrew her infant car seat at 7 months old, I did extensive research to find the best convertible car seat. This was almost three years ago, and I found the Roundabout 40. It was PERFECT.

When my second daughter hit 7 months, I went back to Amazon to purchase another one (as my 2 year old was still using hers) and was extremely disappointed to find that they did not sell it anymore. There were newer versions available, but I was hesitant as newer does not always mean better. I started my research from scratch,to ensure that I found the safest and absolute best product.

I researched consumer reports and loads of online reviews. Conclusion? The Britax Roundabout 55 was the best in regards to comfort, fit and safety! I ordered it and I am VERY happy. Sometimes newer does mean better!!!

Pros:

1. VERY comfortable. My toddler is MUCH happier in this seat than her infant seat.
2. The adjustable straps are VERY user friendly. This is essential when you have a wiggling toddler and have to adjust the length of the straps often for jackets, sweaters and t-shirts. It is VERY easy!!!
3. Easy to install with the LATCH system. All car seats are a little annoying to install and switch from car to car, but this is relatively stress-free.
4. It will grow with your child for years to come. It may seem expensive, but think of how long it will last!
5. SAFE, SAFE, SAFE. This car seat is consistently reported as one of the safest out there!

product_title: Kushies 5 Pack Reusable Ultra Diapers Trial Pack
review_body: These are the same size as what I already had.  I was hoping to get 'newborn' size.  The description said \\"infant\\" so it was my fault for not knowing that was what I had for my last two children already, but I can't seem to find any Kushies on any site that actaully sells a smaller size than Infant.  I find Kushies run a little big, so the baby will be more like three months old before I can even attempt to use these.  Just a bummer because I do like the all in one Kushies and was excited that I *thought* I found the smaller size.

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_body: This is one of the best infant video camera units that I have seen for the price and ease of use. The setup takes less than a couple of minutes and the video quality is outstanding. The infrared quality in darkness is great. A must have for those first time parents that constantly worry.

product_title: Infantino Hoodie Universal All Season Carrier Cover, Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Not the best fit for the Ergo Carrier, makes you look big as a house.
review_body:
I bought this to use with the Ergo Baby carrier. It fits around the carrier and my 7 month old baby with plenty of room to spare. In fact, the way the cover gathers at the sides (there is an elastic pull cord for adjusting/tightening) the cover gaps and will leave plenty of space for drafty wind. It covers the legs well, which is nice because I feel like baby's legs/toes get so cold on cold days . It does not over her arms well, but her arms are usually tucked into my chest to be kept warm.

Certainly, when i'm out carrying the baby I'm not that concerned about being a fashion plate or anything, but the way this big baggy carrier drapes over you it makes you look as big as a house. Maybe is something about looking like a giant grey Champion sweatshirt...Its not the most flattering thing.

Overall, it's not bad for the price, but I'm not sure I'm keeping it.

product_title: Trend Lab Cotton CribWrap Wide Rail Covers for Crib Sides (Set of 2)
review_body: When you spend hundreds of dollars on a crib, the last thing you want is your little beaver destroying it - those teeth are sharp! We have the front ([[ASIN:B00511SCGC Trend Lab Wide Cribwrap Rail Cover for Crib Front/Back, Yellow Fleece]]) and side rail covers. The padding and waterproof layer have kept our crib safe. The covers wash well. We have a Pali Trieste crib and the wide rail covers fit perfectly and look great.

product_title: Skip Hop Duo Deluxe Diaper Bag Limited Edition, Edgewood (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I own 3 Skip Hop bags and I use this one for everyday. I love how lightweight this bag is. It is great for one change of clothes, diapers, wipes, small wallet, cell phone and water bottle. I also love that they removed Velcro and now use magnets for main compartment and front pocket closures. The Versa bag is way more roomy, so if you like to lug around a lot of stuff get that one. I'm a minimalist so this one is good for everyday.

product_title: SheetWorld Fitted Pack N Play (Graco Square Playard) Sheet - White Quilted - Made In USA
review_body: This fitted sheet was perfect for the Pack N Play I purchased. It gives just enough cushion to make the playpen a comfy sleeping area.

product_title: Graco Direct Connect Digital Baby Monitor with 2 Parent Units
review_body: I'm not sure what's up with all the negative reviews. This works quite well for us, and has good battery life and range.

product_title: Graco Pack 'N Play Playard with Twin Bassinet, Kensington
review_headline: Works fine, but wouldn't buy it again
review_body: We had twins last year and purchased this to have a second place to lay the babies down in the second level of our home.  We never once used the bassinet function.  Now that we're using the actual pac n play, I wish we'd just spent less on a smaller, more manageable size one.  Oh well.  I would say if you have a large home (we don't) and it would be more convenient to a close-by location for napping, or you travel a lot with the babies, then it's likely worth it.  With a small house, it was just easier to bring the babies to their crib in their room instead.  With all that said, we haven't had a single problem with it, it just wasn't the best choice of a product for our needs, which is our own fault.

product_title: Bestever Baby Mat
review_body: Seller: Amazon  I got this as a gift for my year-old niece. Since she lives in another state, I can't really speak to the quality or how much she loves this, but I do know from her mom & dad that she loves it!

product_title: Graco SnugRide Baby Infant Car Seat - On the Run
review_body: I love this Car Seat it's very light, perfect for me because I'm only 5\\" tall. Very comfortable my baby loves it, he can sleep in there for hours. I love the canopy because I can adjust it however I want.

product_title: Lamaze Totem Pole Stackers Developmental Toy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this stacker for my 10 months old baby, I think it's so cute! Unfortunately he doesn't play with it as much as had thought. But I have to admit the loves chewing on the tails.

product_title: The First Years 4 Pack Take And Toss Spill Proof Cups, 10 Ounce, Colors May Vary
review_body: Yes, they can open if dropped just right or you have a savy toddler. My 19m old has only ever opened one once and I think it was sheer luck. I like these cups because they are dishwasher friendly (top rack only though) and I dont hurt the bank too much if one is left behind some place. I will note that after awhile it seems like the holes stretch and more liquid can pour out. But hey who can complain with a price like this! : ).. I love love the bright colors and the girl colors these come in too.

product_title: Dex Products Safe Sleeper Bed Rail Ultra (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This railing was helpful for us, and I would buy another because the price is good, but in less than a year, it started bending outward--my daughter likes to sit up in bed and push against it-- so there is a big space between the bottom and the bed that I don't feel is very safe.

product_title: Sun'n'Fun Broad Spectrum Natural Mineral Sunscreen for Kids SPF 30, with Antioxidants, Marshmallow and Chocolate, 3.3oz, BEST SUNSCREEN FOR THE FAMILY. 20% Zinc. Exp. 5/18.
review_headline: It Works and Smells So Good
review_body: I really loved the whole scent of the sunscreen I mean who don't want to smell almost like a smore. It does not spray which is really all I ever use so it has been a long time since I have used a lotion type sunscreen on my kids. I actually rubbed in with no problem which I really liked. There has not been any burns and this actually goes a long way. My kids also didn't break out which I have had happen with certain brands so I was happy to see no skin issues on my little ones.  Another great thing since I am rubbing this into my kids skin and no spray I was very impressed with no stickiness afterwards on them or my hands which is one thing I can't stand from a lot of sunscreens. This has worked so well and I will have to get another bottle real soon!

product_title: CuteyBaby 6 Pack Biodegradable Diaper Liners
review_body:
This is the second brand of diaper liner that we have used--the first being the large Bummis Bio-Soft. We had to fold the Bummis length-wise to get them to fit our BumGenius 3.0 and 4.0s on my 9-month-old. The CuteyBaby fit width-wise, are softer, and tear so much more easily from the roll than the Bummis. I haven't had a problem with them clogging the toilet. I like that they come in a 6-pack because we use one at every change.

With a 4-year-old in the house, I'm not brave enough to install a diaper sprayer in our bathroom.

product_title: Sashas Sun, Wind and Insect Cover for Baby Jogger City Select Stroller Model
review_headline: Fantastic fits like a glove great Product
review_body: Fantastic product exactly what was needed to finish off a Fantastic Stroller. We use this frequently to stop wind and ensure our little man has an uninterrupted sleep.

product_title: X Wide Wire Mesh Gate, Fits Spaces between 29.5" to 50" wide and 32" high
review_headline: I hope it was just a lemon
review_body: This gate is exactly what we were looking for to place on our deck while the kids are outside playing.  I wanted something taller than the standard gates you find in stores.  However, we used it one time and the metal piece on the bottom of it snapped off, the wood actually split off to be more specific. I am returning it and have already ordered a replacement in hopes that it was just a defectives one we received. However, after reading some of the other 1 star reviews, it may just be a poorly constructed gate. I've had ones that cost half as much that have lasted me for years. So we shall see I guess.  I recommend you save the box just in case.

product_title: Lil Joey 2 Pack All-In-One Cloth Diaper
review_body: I bought these diapers since they are supposed to fit a 4 pound baby.  There is still a gap between the diaper and my son's legs and he is now almost 6 pounds.  I've tried the diaper over and over, but it leaks pee every time.  It does however contain the poop.

product_title: Galt Activity Dino, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This Dino is adorable.  We bought it for out 6 month old and she loves it.  All the little scales on the back of the dino make different noises or have different textures and it helps her from falling completely over when she gets excited.  She really loves this and will keep herself entertained for a while laying with it.  Our 2 1/2 year old will come over and play with her in it as well.  Really worth every penny!!

product_title: The Gro Company Gro-Egg Room Thermometer
review_body: Love this item. It's so nice to be-able to glance at it and know if its too hot or cold in the room by the color of the light. It's also nice that it doubles as a night light.

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Bouncer
review_body: We loved this product and so did our little boy.  we did return it b/c our boy was too long for it at 6 months (we got it as a gift).  Although he loved the music and lights as watching us cook while playing!  Great product, wished we has had it from the very beginning!

product_title: North States Industries Supergate Easy Close Metal Gate
review_headline: WONDERFUL GATE SO I CAN "NOT" HAVE A DOOR, BECAUSE I HAVE HEART ISSUES AND CAN CONTROL MY DOG COMINGS AND GOINGS!! GREAT ITEM!!

product_title: Safety 1st OnSide Air Protect Convertible Car Seat, Bedrock Black
review_body: I was nervous to buy this with so few reviews and not seeing it in person first but I'm glad I chose this one. The padding is nice, just the right amount in my opinion, there are a lot of adjustment levels so we were able to get a perfect fit. My son is 10 months old now but I can see this seat lasting us at least until he's 3. Easy to install, no noodle or rolled up towel required for us. Yes the cup holder falls off easily, not a big deal to me.

product_title: Baby Mod Olivia 3 in 1 Convertible Crib in Espresso and White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We ordered all three pieces of this set an will give 5 stars to all. It was not difficult to assemble and it looks fantastic. The crib was the easiest of the three to get together. It has a beautiful modern look but will complement any nursery. We love it! In addition the dresser and changers have TONS of storage space. I've fit 6 baskets on the shelves under the changer....I haven't even figured out what to put in most of them! Wonderful set. Highly recommend.

product_title: Britax B-Ready Bassinet
review_headline: Perfect fit but it smells terrible
review_body: I was really excited to receive the Britax Bassinet and find that it indeed clicks on to my B-Agile stroller. (I have posted a photo in the customer images section.) However, the internal base of the bassinet is made of particle board which off gasses a terrible smell that gave me a headache. I did some research and found that particle board can contain toxic chemicals such as Formaldehyde.  Needless to say I'm packing this up and sending it back to Amazon. I'm sad because absent the particle board this product is very well made and I was looking forward to using it.

product_title: South Shore Furniture, Cotton Candy Collection, Changing Table with 2 Pull-Out Shelves, Pure White
review_body: It did take about 5 hours to put together, and we had to supply one screw from our own supply, but otherwise it's a great dresser.  I agree with others in that the sides of the changing table are a bit blunt, and would be better rounded.  That's easily remedied by laying a blanket over the end.  We also own http://www.amazon.com/Stork-Craft-Aspen-Combo-Dresser/dp/B000F1QVKM/ref=sr_1_9?ie=UTF8&qid=1327705415&sr=8-9 and this South Shore one is just as sturdy, if a bit more!  But don't lean on the changing table sides, that's attached a little flimsy-ish.  Very happy with the purchase.

product_title: BOB Revolution SE Single Stroller, Orange
review_headline: You get what you pay for!
review_body: This stroller is amazing.  Before we purchased our BOB, we had purchased a cheaper jogging stroller.  It was awful!  This BOB was easy to assemble and pushes like a dream.  The only gripes I have are 1) The most upright setting of the recline is a little too far back but my daughter doesn't seem to mind. 2) The little cargo basket underneath is large enough for my diaper bag but the space between it and the seat isn't big enough to fit my bag through.  It takes quite a bit of coaxing to get it in there.  Other than those two things, I can't sing the praises of this stroller enough.  The sun canopy is wonderful.  We also purchased the parent console for the top and it is adequate.  We have not purchased the snack tray for our daughter because it just doesn't seem necessary.  I like that the foot rest area is enclosed so when my daughter drops her sippy cup, it doesn't fall on the ground.  Yes, this stroller is expensive but you definitely get what you pay for.  It is worth it.

product_title: Dream On Me / Mia Moda Sportivo Stroller, Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Wife wanted the pink one, but me and my macho stance said NO!! So we decided on the red instead..
The likes.. It's a good size bigger than the cheapy 15.00 strollers you see everywhere.Build and quality is very good, I am 5.11 and is at a good arms reach, I don't have to slouch over, it reclines ( in a strange way but works) nice little basket at the bottom for small things, (Bottle water, diapers, small purse, minor things),folds really easy, setting up takes a little practice, fits really well in the trunk of my car,5 point harness, umbrella is small not much help.

Don't like: No bottle/coffee cup holder, setting up is weird and takes practice, some what heavy..

Over all my wife and I are satisfied with the product.

product_title: Snuza Hero Baby Movement Monitor
review_body: It kept coming off in the middle of the night. Nearly gave us a heart attack--a few times! Our baby is very squirmy and there's no way that thing was staying on. It's good in theory though. We got it because she sleeps everywhere but her crib and this is mobile.

product_title: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Blue Pup Pals, Large (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Cotton sleep sack great for spring and summer
review_body: This cotton sleep sack has been perfect during nights when it is too warm for our fleece sleep sack. Part of our routine at night is a bath and then putting on pj's and a sleep sack so I was glad to find this lighter one so we could continue our routine. My son is 10 months and around 20 pounds and the large size is nice and comfy for him. He has lots of room but doesn't get tangled in it and can stand when he wakes up (which he always does when he wakes up and calls out for me). The light blue color and cute dog pattern is adorable also. I would recommend this sleep sack as a great alternative to blankets (which we never use because of SIDS and the fact that he moves around so much I don't think a blanket would stay put anyways!).

product_title: Comotomo Baby Bottle, Green/Pink, 5 Ounce, 2-Count
review_body:
My baby was born almost 4 weeks early so she's had a few problems latching on when it comes to breastfeeding and although I would love to totally breastfeed for as long as I can it not possible since I have to go back to work. I decided to find a bottle that would help with her transition and not wean her off the breast totally. This bottle has been a life saver. Not only did she take to this bottle immediately but the fit of the bottle makes it look like she's breastfeeding from plastic since it rests against her chin and nose the way its supposed to be when breastfeeding. The flow is also slow so she's not gulping in a lot at a time which reduces the air intake and nipple flow is perfect. It flows slowly just the way it supposed to be so she doesn't get lazy when breastfeeding since a faster flow could possibly wean her from the breast which I'm not trying to do at this present time. We're both in love with these bottles and I can't recommend them enough.

We've had no problems cleaning them and they stand up on their own as well. I was a little concerned about the shape of the bottles and thought that might be a problem but so far everything has worked out. Color is also not a problem since I have a little girl but i can understand why moms of baby boys may want a bit more neutral color since the colors included is pink and green. Other than that these are great bottles for the breastfeeding mom.

product_title: Regalo Extra WideSpan Walk Through Safety Gate
review_body: Dont buy this! Crappiest gate ever! I bought this gate with the attachments and my God what a piece of junk I got in the box. Horrible product! The attachment, of course, need to be added on to the gate but they don't attach firmly or securely to it so all you get is a wobbly honk of metal. I returned it asap.

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_body: I have had this hands free bra for 1 month now, and I really enjoy it! It allows me to use my time wisely(eat, read, make phone calls, and even blow dry my hair and do my makeup) and not be wasted on holding the pumps. The bra is made of very soft material and I like how it can be adjust to fit you perfectly! I will definitely recommend this bra to all my friends!

product_title: Graco Vie4 Stroller, Olivia
review_body:
Let me preface this with: my baby isn't here yet... so I have zero idea how it performs with a baby in it. I do have experience with kids and strollers tho, so I feel I can still give a decent review.

I was very picky in researching strollers before I purchased this one. My criteria?

-safe
-lightweight
-easy to fold/unfold
-easy on the pocketbook!
-works with my infant seat like a travel system... minus the bulk
-girly, but subtle

This one fit all my requirements to a \\"T\\". (thank goodness, my husband was about to go nuts from all the \\"babe, do you like this one?!\\")

It was SO easy to assemble. I did it myself in about 20 minutes, besides attaching the wheels. (I had my hubs do that because I was worried I wouldn't get them on right, or tight enough.)

I've pushed several other travel-system strollers in the past (family member's kids, babysitting etc.) and they were all heavy, hard to handle, and just, well, a hassle even when empty. This one is so light weight, and a breeze to push around. Just to see what it was like with some weight in it, I put my 13 lb Shih-tzu in it and pushed it around.(she thought I was nuts, but hey, it worked) It still pushed smoothly and easily. (one-handed) It's very easy to manuever, and takes tight turns with ease. It's currently sitting in my nursery, and our hallway is small, but I had no trouble getting it to turn the tight corner.

After figuring out how to use the button to collapse it, the stroller was easy to set up and collapse. (READ the manual. It HELPS!) It's also really nice that the tray swings out of the way. (and that's easy to do too) Granted, I have never put it to use, but I thought the basket was still easy to access even with the seat back down. After the infant seat is in, you can raise the back up again to get it out of the way. Also, after you put the infant seat in, the locks hold it in securely. I didn't feel like it wobbled or moved at all. I have NO worries about having my baby in this. (SUPER easy to put the seat in/take it out... just don't forget to move the locking clips out of the way. It took me 10 minutes, and some help from my hubs who laughed at me, to realize I couldn't get the infant seat locked in because I had the clips in the way.)

I love the colors and designs. It's a beautiful pink and chocolate color, but not too bright pink. (I'm more of a fan of the muted pinks vs. the hot/bright pinks.) I love that the frame is brown. I think this will hide a lot of dirt.

It's a great buy, and I recommend it to anyone! Oh, and way cheaper on Amazon than anywhere else I could find it.put the seat in/take it out... just don't forget to move the locking clips out of the way. It took me 10 minutes, and some help from my hubs who laughed at me, to realize I couldn't get the infant seat locked in because I had the clips in the way.) I love the colors and designs. It's a beautiful pink and chocolate color, but not too bright pink. (I'm more of a fan of the muted pinks vs. the hot/bright pinks.) I love that the frame is brown. I think this will hide a lot of dirt. It's a great buy, and I recommend it to anyone! Oh, and way cheaper on Amazon than anywhere else I could find it.

product_title: BABYBJORN Travel Crib Light 2
review_headline: Baby Bjorn vs Phil and Teds travel cribs - which is better?
review_body:
I have two Baby Bjorn travel cribs for my baby twins and a Phil & Ted travel crib for my older child. Which one is better for air travel? Which one for car travel? There is a difference.

BABY BJORN

The BabyBjorn travel crib can't be beat for use at home and for car travel, as it can be set up and disassembled in about 30 seconds. We use [[ASIN:B000O7SR18 American Baby Company Value Jersey Knit Porta-Crib Sheet, Celery]], and it fits the mattress perfectly, at a fraction of the price of the Baby Bjorn crib sheet. My son sleeps in the travel crib almost every night and seems comfortable, as the mattress is fairly thick and has no bars underneath like a pack n play would. However, at 33\\", I think he'll outgrow it in a few months as there is not a lot more room lengthwise (the mattress is 24\\" x \\" 41\\", the dimensions given in the description are for the outside). *** Please note that the mattress is on the soft side and may not be suitable for newborns or babies that cannot roll over on their own ***

The material of the crib is also worth noting. It's soft and cottony and has stayed like new after daily use.

Why not five stars? The Baby Bjorn travelcrib is also lot larger folded up than the Phil & Ted's. I wouldn't use it for air travel if you want to minimize the amount of luggage - it's bigger than a carry-on and may have to be checked - call ahead to check carry on dimensions allowed and if you can gate check it (new restrictions may apply). I also doubt the fine zippered bag it comes in will hold up to baggage handling. It's also way too expensive - it costs almost as much as my son's Bonavita hardwood crib!

PHIL & TED'S

The [[ASIN:B004H7RT3S phil&teds Traveller Crib, Black]] on the other hand is a great travel crib for air travel as it folds up very small, is super lightweight, and fits into any suitcase or duffle - I think you could even fit two cribs in without any problems in terms of size or weight. However, it does take about 15 minutes to set up and to disassemble and fit into the small bag it comes in. So plan ahead, practice at home, have your child sleep in it a night or two so they get used to it if possible, and bring along the manual, just in case. Set it up as soon as you get to your destination - you don't want to do this later on with a tired crying child.

The self-inflating mattress on the P&T is long and narrow, similar to those used for camping. We put the mattress inside and used regular crib sheets on it and tucked them well underneath (the newest model has a vinyl sleeve to put the mattress into). It will probably work for kids up to age 3, as any older, they may not like being confined in a smallish space. My two-year old child slept well in it on long trips and it still looks new after much use, with a material that is easy to clean.

Although harder to set up and dismantle, I found the Phil & Ted to be great quality, super compact and much less expensive than the Baby Bjorn travel crib. It's also likely that I'll be using it longer than the BB, as it's more compact and can be used outdoors as well.

In a nutshell, both are good but with some disadvantages - the Phil & Ted crib is better for air travel and indoor/outdoor use, while the BabyBjorn one is better for home and car travel. Regardless of which you go with, it may be a good idea to put your kids in their stroller or bouncy seat while you assemble either one of these (like the [[ASIN:B00477ND0Q KidCo GoPod Portable Activity Seat - Pistachio]]. You don't want little fingers in the way.

If you are considering the Kidco Peapod - beware. The sides are made of non-breathable material and it's easily malleable. A 5 month old child tragically suffocated in a PeaPod last December (see March 27, 2012 review from Christine Whelan, the mother, for the [[ASIN:B000LL1624 Kidco PeaPod Plus Indoor/Outdoor Travel Bed - Red]] - see links under comments).

Finally, once your kids outgrow these travel cribs, consider getting the excellent [[ASIN:B00006IV33 AeroBed Sleep Tight Inflatable Bed for Kids]]. It works well for kids three and over, with built in side and end rails, sheets, detachable electric pump and storage bag with shoulder strap. It's very comfortable, easy to clean, can be used at home for sleep-overs and is great for trips./>

It's very comfortable, easy to clean, can be used at home for sleep-overs and is great for trips.

product_title: Kiinde Kozii Bottle Warmer and Breast Milk Warmer
review_headline: Great product, unlike any other on the market
review_body: I'm a breastfeeding mom and I love that I don't have to worry that the bottle warmer will kill off antibodies and/or proteins in my breastmilk.  Plus, it's so easy to use - and a water carafe vs. measuring water every time can't be beat. Also - don't have to worry about milk overheating - so no rushing to grab the bottle as soon as the timer goes off .  Only downside is that it takes longer to warm than some of the other bottle warmers and is more expensive.  Worth it, though!

product_title: Munchkin Auto-Close Metal Gate, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We got a Great Dane puppy, and wanted to restrict the available areas of the house while housebreaking her. We bought this exact same gate under a different name (Petmate) at the pet store and were well pleased with it. When we got a new puppy, we wanted another to replace a removable gate with something easier to open & close. The gate we originally bought was no longer sold, and the options turned out to be way inferior. We found this gate on Amazon, and it turned out to be the exact same gate, marketed as a child gate.  We love the fact the gate opens in either direction, and easily opens one handed. It's very solid in the doorway - a 40-inch opening. (I bought an extender kit.) The other new gate we bought (only similar item available locally) had a smaller walk-through, opened only one way, and could not easily be opened one handed. Our little Dane has proven to be an escape artist, but so far this gate keeps her exactly where she belongs. Even better, the auto closing feature means the kids don't leave it open and let her run through the house.  I have to believe it would work equally well for small children, though as some have noted if you let the gate swing shut on it's own, there will be a moderately loud \\"clang\\" as it locks shut. That is easily ameliorated by simply closing the gate by hand rather walking away and letting it close on it's own.

product_title: Arm's Reach Original Co-Sleeper Fitted Sheets - Organic Cotton - Toffee
review_body: I was very happy with these sheets. They are very soft and made really well. The seams are nice and thick and they seem to keep the sheets in place well.

product_title: The Woombie Convertible Swaddle Blanket, Banana Cream/Yellow, 0-3 Months (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Helped our girl move to her crib!
review_body: We love the woombie! This convertible woombie was perfect for our 2 month old daughter. She has been against having her arms swaddled since birth. I know swaddling helps them sleep better and not startle, but she just screamed when her arms were contained. This woombie was perfect for us because it allows her arms to be out. We were able to move her to her crib because this gave her just enough security. She can still move her legs but has gentle cuddling from the material. The convertible is a must have for when they start to roll over as well. The quality of the material and the zipper isn't the best, but it has held up for us so far. I wish the price was less, but it is worth buying.

product_title: Peg-Perego 2010 Pliko P3 Stroller, Java (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Excellent service. It was sent in the proposed time. The Peg-Perego Package was not strong enough, but the product survived. The stroller itself seems to be \\"very plastic\\". One plastic piece was not correctly assembled at the arrival, interfering the closing process. After checking and re-assembling it, everything worked properly.  In general terms, the stroller is a light, practical and nice option. Recommended.

product_title: Boutique Brand New GEENNY Brown Pink Star & Moon 13-PCS CRIB BEDDING SET
review_body: After my husband I spent a great deal of time looking at different bedding sets we finally agreed on this one.  We did not want too much pink, and we loved the moon and stars.  The bedding came fast and in good condition.  I washed it on the gentle cycle and it looks and feels just as soft and nice as when I opened it.  It looks perfect in her room.  I did not care for the wall hangings.  I think that they are rather chintzy, but since I did not plan on using them any way that was not a big deal in my opinion.  The bumper is really thick and nice, but now they recommend that you do not use one because of SID's.  It looks like it cost more than we spent, which is always nice.

product_title: Zutano Owls Fitted Crib Sheet (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Perfect Compliment to Zutano Crib Bumpers
review_body:
This crib sheet is a nice quality, and the print is so bright and gorgeous. Sure to be a visual pleaser for a small infant.

In addition, they will match perfectly with the other Zutano Owl items we ordered for the baby. 100% pleased. RECOMMENDED

product_title: Safety 1st Heavenly Dreams Stars a Plenty Baby Mattress
review_body: I was really apprehensive about ordering this product because of the price, however I was more than pleased once this item came in. The shipping was FAST and CHEAP! I think this mattress will be perfect for the crib, it is firm yet soft!!!!!! Extremely light as well.

product_title: Nap Nanny Chill (Minky Sage)
review_body: I got the nap nanny for my 2 month old who wouldn't nap for more than half hour at a time. After trying the pack n play, bouncy seat and swing, we got the nap nanny and he loved it! We put him in here when almost asleep and he wouldn't fuss, just fall asleep and nap for 1-2 hours. What a dream! We also used this as a place to set baby down while we played together and read books. He was in this until 4 months old and then he was able to wiggle out of it by himself. I understand the people with safety concerns with this item, but use common sense and it's fine. I recommend this for parents who want a cozy, comfy place to put their younger baby during naps or need something to put baby in while playing with them.

product_title: Fisher Price Infant-to-Toddler Rocker
review_body: I picked up this item and leave at Grandamas house for when we go to visit. My 6mo old loves it. The seat keeps him entertained and he likes playing the music on the middle toy. It keeps him entertained! The seat has various positions but U try to avoid the rocking one because my baby hunches his body forward too much on this position and while I don't think he'll tip the bouncer over, I'd prefer him to be in the seat sitting back. Overall, simple chair but it distracts the baby.

product_title: Itzy Ritzy Washable Nursing Pads Set
review_body: I ordered these because they looked comparable to Bamboobies, but we're less expensive.  I was very disappointed.  These may be OK if you barely leak at all, but it seems even a little milk soaks right through  and it does not protect your clothing well.  If I wear these, I have to double them up.  I would recommend Bamboobies instead- they are more absorbent and the outer layer offers mush more protection to your clothing.

product_title: Medium Quilted Peace Sign Duffle Bag - Choice of Colors
review_body: This bag is cute and functional, but it was a bit smaller than I expected. My daughter uses it as a gym bag, sleep over bag, junk bag. It fits a change of clothes, tennis shoes, toiletries and cell phone, ipod, etc. She loves it, so I have no complaints. If you'd like to use it to carry more things, I would go for the large bag instead of the medium.

product_title: Razbaby RaZberry Teether
review_body: I got one for my son over a year ago, he is almost 2 and he still chews on it. It is a bit big for a early teether but once he was about 8 months he had it with him all the time. I just ordered a pink one for a friend. I read some reviews about it falling apart, the pink and blue \\"clear\\" ones are one piece so i would suggest getting one of those of you are worried about a choking hazard. There is no wear at all on my sons and he is well know for destroying other teethers. I highly recommend these.

product_title: Momo Baby 8oz 1-Pack Glass Baby Bottles
review_body: Tried using this bottle coz of glass make. Nipples too skinny. My baby did not like it at all. Wasted!

product_title: Nursery-To-Go Mr. and Mrs. Pond 10 Piece Bedding Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Mr. and Mrs. Pond Bedding Set
review_body: We bought this set for baby boy's nursery.  It looks great, and seems to be of good quality.  He's 9 months old and it has held up well, so far.

product_title: RECARO ProRIDE Convertible Car Seat - Recalled - Envy
review_headline: Perfect carseat with only one complaint!!!!
review_body: We bought this carseat for our 8 month old.  He was growing out of his infant carseat and we needed something safe and sturdy.  After reviewing all of the convertible carseats, we chose this one.  It has the most safety features for the price!!!!  We love our recaro!!!  We only have one negative comment... It sits high.  We drive a Toyota highlander and we have to be very careful not to bump his head on the ceiling when putting him in the seat. review_body: I bought a crib with a changing table attached to it.  I didn't think it would come with a pad so I purchased this to compensate.  It is MUCH bigger than I was expecting!!! product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Wide-Neck Replacemnet Travel Caps, 2-Pack
review_body: Our bottles came with a couple of these, but we needed more for traveling. They arrived quickly in great condition.

product_title: Stork Craft Tuscany 4-in-1 Convertible Crib
review_body: We looked for a long time for a crib for our baby boy.  I found this one and thought it looked pretty sturdy and we liked the color. product_title: Graco SimpleSwitch Highchair and Booster
review_body: Does not take up a lot of space and very easy to use and clean. Tray removes easily and washes clean.

product_title: Safety 1st Finger Pinch Guard
review_body: I actually use this for my cats, so they don't get accidentally stuck in a room where the door closes itself (they rough-house a lot and knock into walls & doors).  I was so happy to find this product.

product_title: Wean Green Glass Baby Food Containers (Set of 4)
review_headline: I only have good things to say
review_body: If you take your time and cook your own baby food, you want the food to stay fresh and safe.  Unlike plastic that stains and absorb odor, this one keeps the food just like how you made it. I even tried silicon which is more natural and safer option compared to plastic, but I also had a problem with odor that clings.    The glass container itself is extremely strong. product_title: Soft Booster Seat
review_body: My toddler readily gave up the high chair for this comfortable, colorful booster seat. Easy to clean and stays in place on our cloth covered dining room chair.

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_body: I have a 15 month old son.  he loves the night light. Everytime its time to go to bed.  He presses the button to turn on his night light and points to the stars.  Not only does he point to the stars but he learned to say to word stars (the word stars in not that clear yet but we get the point).

product_title: LA Baby Waterproof 4 Sided Cocoon Style Changing Pad, 30" - Easy to Clean Quilted Cover W Non-Skid Bottom, Safety Strap, Fits All Standard Changing Tables/Dresser Tops for Best Infant Diaper Change
review_body: I like it that it has all 4 sides raised. My baby loves to nap in it, and I feel it's safer than those raised only 2 sides (before she was mobile).

product_title: Sashas Rain and Wind Cover for Kolcraft Contours Options/Optima Tandem Stroller
review_body: We get comments all the time when we are out with this cover.  It fits perfectly so long as the sun guard in the front seat is up.  If you don't have it up, the cover tends to fall down on the kiddo in the front seat.  Not really much you can do about that though. That means it takes up valuable basket space when you take it off to stow it once you are indoors.  Other than that, the thing is awesome!

product_title: Baby-Safe Inkless Footprint Kit with Color Papers
review_body: This product worked OK, but it definitly should have came with at least 2 ink wipes so I could get several prints from hands and feet.  The seller told me that one wipe was enough, but it was not.  It was enough for 1 set of dark foot prints and one set of light, and one set of dark hand prints.  I got this product because we had a home birth and I wanted by sons hand and foot prints.

product_title: The First Years Wave Stroller, Urban Life (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We selected The Wave based on tons of research and a desire to stay in a more budget friendly price point.  Getting the stroller in and out of the back of a taxi was also a big deal for us.  My husband and I have both been very happy with our purchase and found the stroller to be as functional as it is good-looking.  We love the bassinet/seat conversion option and have used it extensively.  It drives like a dream - even over the bumpy sidewalks where we live.  We constantly use the swivel seat function - often for letting our son \\"sit\\" with us at table in restaurants before he was big enough to sit in a high chair.  It's also useful for walks on sunny days, when the sun is low in the sky, you can just change the direction of the seat.  When my son was small we really liked the option of having him inward facing, but it's great to be able to turn him around now that he's more alert and interested in what's going on around him.  We've found the basket to be functional, and the canopy to be absolutely great.  I ended up attaching my own velcro to hold back the flap covering the viewing window - wish the First Years would have added that themselves.  The ability to swivel the chair with the wheels still in the same position, as well as the telescoping handle, may be our favorite features.  My husband is almost a foot taller than me (he's 6'1\\") and both of us can use the stroller comfortably thanks to being able to easily raise and lower the handle.  The frame is a little wider than I'd expected, but in small markets and doorways of my urban life, I've never had an issue.  The stroller maneuvers beautifully.  Getting the stroller in and out of a taxi is a little complicated, as the seat must be removed from the frame in order for it to fold.  However, once the seat is off, the frame can be folded very easily.  My main concern was the stroller actually fitting (we live in Beijing, where the taxi trunk space is often very small), and we've never had an issue.  It folds down really nicely and surprisingly compact for what a substantial stroller it is.  When my son was smaller we usually used the frame with a car seat, so it wasn't any issue at all, because I would have needed to remove the car seat regardless.  The Wave does not come with accessories, but we've found the Sunshine Kids Buggy Buddy, the Jolly Jumper Weather Shield, and the Think King Mighty Buggy Hook to be quite useful and work well with the stroller.  For airplane travel, the stroller fits well (when the wheels are removed, which is easy) in the JL Childress Standard and Dual Stroller Travel Bag.  One thing I didn't consider was my purchase of a diaper bag - a diaper bag that hangs from the stroller handle is pretty useless in this case, as it has to be taken off whenever you swivel the seat - a feature we use much more than I could have imagined.  As a result, my diaper bag is always in the basket below.  One other NEGATIVE factor that I wish I had read in a review or the product description prior to purchasing the stroller - is in regards to the FIRST YEARS VIA CAR SEAT.  I chose the Via because it had great safety ratings and clicks into THE WAVE without the use of a car seat adaptor (which comes with the stroller if you'd like to use another brand of car seat - they have a list of the compatible ones on their website).  HOWEVER, IT MUST BE USED WITH A BASE - rendering it completely useless for city living.  I can't carry a base around with me to throw into the back of a taxi.  This frustrated my husband and I beyond belief.  Where we live a car seat isn't even required by law, but we would have liked to be able to buckle ours into a car/taxi anyway.  We have had some quality issues with the Wave - it has had a number of parts break when we've traveled, but we're harder on the stroller than most people would be.  We've had parts break during airplane travel (even though we had it in a stroller bag).  However, under normal wear and tear we've never had an issue.  MYFAVORITE PART ABOUT THE WAVE, though, has to be the EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE of The First Years.  When we've emailed about our issues, they've been incredibly quick to respond and get us replacement parts without any hassle at all.  I would definitely buy other products from the company based on their customer service alone...something that's often hard to come by these days!  Overall, we've been very happy with our purchase and highly recommend both The First Years as a company and The Wave, specifically.

product_title: InGenuity Cradle and Sway Swing, Bella Vista (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I absolutely love this swing! With my first daughter, we decided not to find out the gender....I love that this swing can be used for either gender. The colors are very soft and pretty. review_body: I purchased this as a Christmas gift for my 1 year old nephew.  I have gotten a TON of great pictures of him enjoying it and have been told its his favorite toy.  Money well spent!

product_title: Dream On Me / Mia Moda Facile Twin Stroller, Flame (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Comfy and great steering but tricky to fold
review_body: I have used this stroller since my triplets were about 9 months old (we use a double and one single).  The seatbelts are fairly easy to adjust and the strollers handles wonderfully.  The brakes are easy to set and the turning radius is great.  I don't mind that the sunshades don't adjust individually but I could see maybe where others might.  I agree with the other posts that the stroller is not easy to fold.  I, too, thought it would get easy as the stroller got used more, but that has not been the case.  I've definitely had a few moments standing outside my car, totally panicked that I wouldn't be able to fold it at all! Once folded, the stroller is very light and compact.    There is some storage underneath, but not enough for a diaper bag or more than one or two bags of clothes you buy at the mall.  That doesn't bother me since the stroller is mostly used to take walks. Also there is no storage at body level where the handles are for your phone, keys, tissues, etc. so I would highly recommend purchasing an attachment organizer.  That's really made life a lot easier for us.  It really is a great stroller, despite the folding issue.  After having the stroller for over a year, we've had no mechanical issues with it all.  I shopped around a lot before buying this and the price is really great for what you get.

product_title: Jolly Jumper Deluxe Sleep Rite Infant Sleep Positioner
review_body: While I thought this worked just fine, I found out that these positioners were recalled and I shouldn't have been able to buy this.  I am not sure why they can still be sold.

product_title: Jeep Backpack Harness, Puppy/Pink

product_title: Diono RadianR120 Convertible Car Seat, Storm (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Stop looking. Safe, comfortable, and worth it.
review_body: My 7-month old 20 lb. twins were busting out of their infant carriers and I wanted my next car seat purchase to be my last. My biggest concerns were safety and comfort (an uncomfortable baby is a screaming baby)! After much reading I learned that the most important safety features were 1) have the baby rear-facing for as long as possible and 2) have them in a 5-point harness for as long as possible. So, I looked for car seats with the highest weight/height limits for these two things. This car seat allows rear facing up to 45 lbs (which is clearly stated in the instruction booklet yet on the side of the seat says 25 lbs? Not sure what's up with that, but I'm going with the instruction booklet!) and once the child has to switch to front-facing they can still be in the 5-point harness till 80 lbs. You're not going to find better. I looked at MANY MANY car seats. Plus the narrow design works great for multiples, yet is still roomy for each baby. I was a little worried about that, but I have little porkers and these seats are roomy yet space saving. Thank you engineers, not sure how you did that! I've used these new seats now for two weeks and not once have my boys complained when I put them in (which was opposite of my last seats!) As far as the installment, the LATCH system is awesome AND we also used the optional harness attachment to the base of the front seats. So, I feel like the seats are very secure. Not easily removable, which I'm sure would be a con for some families, but we are fine with leaving the seats in the vehicle (2001 Ford Escape). I won't know till some time down the road if this will truly be my last car seat purchase, but I'm certainly optimistic, and I have NO regrets, I LOVE LOVE these seats. Thank you Diono!

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_headline: Could have done without the leaf it came with
review_body:
Let me start off by saying I love HALO sleep sacks have used them for a year now with my son. I have nothing against this actual product but more so with how it arrived.

I find it difficult to believe that this product was new. The plastic wrapping was broken in places with tape keeping it closed. product_title: BABYBJORN Babysitter Balance Air - Black Mesh (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Quality.  You get what you pay for.
review_body: This chair is great.  High quality construction, it folds flat, no assembly required.  3 positions to choose from, and the Air-mesh design is great for a humid climate.  The chair is solid, no wobbling in any position, non slip grip on the bottom, (works very good) and the chair looks nice.  Another word about the mesh, you can put your baby in the chair (diaper only) and face their back to the sun and safely give them natural sunlight through the mesh.  You can also put a fan (safe distance of course) behind the chair and keep your baby cool because of the mesh design.  It's strong mesh, don't worry about it tearing or ripping.  After using a FP baby chair then moving up to this it was worth every penny.  The difference in quality is night and day.  I hope this helps anyone that may be on the fence about spending the money.

product_title: Skip Hop Studio Diaper Tote Bag
review_headline: Loved this bag so much until it completely disappointed me
review_body: I purchased my second Skip Hop Studio Diaper Tote a little over a year ago. product_title: Jacana High Chair Cover

review_body: I ordered the Fall Colored Camillia hair flowers and brooch, and was initially impressed by their speed in arriving as well as quality of workmanship.  I love the size of the flowers. review_body: I really take the amazon reviews seriously so when I saw the rating, and number of reviewers I bought two gates. review_body: We have an identical version from 2008 and the battery does not hold a charge.  Also, it shuts off if the power flickers so then it continuously beeps (to let you know it is out of range).  It gets a lot of static and the volume level is pretty low.  We bought the one that can monitor two different rooms (to have one ear one each child's room) and while that feature does work well, the sound level being so low and the battery life does not make up for it.

product_title: Sleepy Wrap Baby Carrier
review_body:
OMG this thing is amazing! Seriously a gamechanger. When I put my daughter in it (4 weeks old) she yawns and closes her eyes immediately! Then my hands are free to do what I need to do around the house. I'm not sitting there feeding her every 30 minutes trying to get her to nap!

My husband and I got into a \\"debate\\" in Babies R Us about whether or not to buy a carrier or a wrap. We ended up getting the Infantino Swift carrier & this wrap. The carrier works OK but as soon as my wrap came my husband now wears mine instead! He just won't wear it out of the house because he thinks it looks too funny on him.

The Sleepy Wrap doesn't put strain on your back & shoulders like other baby carriers do - it's VERY comfortable. It doesn't leave her feet dangling or marks on her face like my hubsand's carrier does. If you are trying to decide between the Moby & this wrap go with this one. I heard the Moby is looser and you have to keep readjusting the fabric.

review_body: This toy's various fabrics are not exactly like the picture, they're better. Actually, the pictures don't do this product justice. The colors are much more vivid. BUT that's absolutely the only thing I don't like. My daughter doesn't care and that's what matters! We gave this to our daughter at 4 months old. product_title: Samsung Wireless Video Security Monitoring System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Best monitor!  Must have for parents!
review_body: This monitor is the best purchase we have made for our child....every parent should have one of these!  The fact that we can add additional monitors in a playroom when she gets older was a big plus!  The volume controls are great, the added lullaby feature is a plus, the light on top is good in the middle of the night.  The infrared picture at night is extremely clear (and let's face it, most of the time, you won't need a color picture because your child will be sleeping in a dark room and the infrared B&W picture is what you will be using.   It has a feature to mute out background noise, but we prefer to hear all noises so we don't wake to a loud noise or alarm (which you can set it to do so). It is off by about 10 degrees, but I knew this going in....the good news is, you will get to know what the normal 'wrong temp display' is for the room and be able to determine if it is too hot or cold by that.  Also, the screen is a lit lcd screen....it does put off light, but they all do.  I looked at 6 monitors, and this by far was the best bet....the only better one was the next step up Samsung (only if you had a reason to want to use an SD card to record).
