product_title: Baby ComfyNose Nasal Aspirator
review_body:
I rarely write product review, but I have to do one for this. I bought both Nosefrida and this one because they are both rated high on Amazon. However, after using both of them, I must say that Nosefrida is a far more superior product: much more sturdy in the hand, easier to clean, and in every way just works much better than this one. The middle bit of this product, used to put the tissue in, sometimes crack open while we are busy sucking on baby's nose, and that is really annoying. In summary, it is just a much inferior product compared to the Nosefrida.

Now the troubling bit: I signed up for a free/giveaway BabyComfyNose Aspirator on Facebook. I did not get the free aspirator and had not bought the product then. However, I got a private email from them saying that if I am to rate the product as a five star on Diapers.com, I will get a free aspirator. They even give me a list of the main advantages of a BabyComfyNose Aspirator:

Quote
-------------
1) You don't have to buy plastic foam rubber filters because the BabyComfyNose is specifically designed to use tissue as a filter. Tissue is a better filter material, always available and...free. Nose Frida requires that you buy their filters.
2) The nylon mesh storage pouch that comes with the BabyComfyNose allows hygienic drying, whereas the hard plastic Nose Frida case prevents drying after washing. This is unsanitary and potentially harmful.
3) The BabyComfyNose has a soft medical grade nose tip and mouth piece, the Nose Frida is all hard plastic. Ouch - for you and your baby.
4) BabyComfyNose is available in two colors - ideal for siblings and multiples.
5) BabyComfyNose is made in the USA. Nose Frida is made in Sweden - does that mean NF is a better product? We don't think so.
-------------
UNQUOTE

I don't know if BabyComfyNose Aspirator has contacted other Amazon reviewers in the past, but I for sure have seen the above 5-superiorpoints in various reviews before. This product may have worked for others, but I feel that I should let others aware that this is how the company does business! So buyers - just beware!

product_title: Medela Harmony Manual Breast Pump
review_body: I can barely get this thing to work at all. I bought it for the diaper bag to use when I'm out and about to prevent engorgement. It doesn't work well enough for even that. I just take me electric pump and adapter and go pump in the car. This was a waste of money.

product_title: Squidsoap Hand Soap with Ink Marker 1 Pc with free squishy squid
review_body: This soap leaves a 'squid' ink mark on the hand that takes several minutes of washing to remove. It's great for teaching small children how long to wash their hands to be effective. My grandson, who is always in a hurry, loves it.

product_title: Brica Day and Night Light Musical Mirror, Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My order came on time and was what I expected. I really like how big the mirror part is so I can easily see my baby.  Also like the remote so I can control light and sounds without having to try and reach back.  Would recommend!

product_title: Kids Line Bunny Meadow Valance (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a cute valance!  Soft colors.  I had to purchase a second one because I have two windows and the matching crib bedding set only comes with one.

product_title: Joovy Zoom 360 Swivel Wheel Jogging Stroller
review_headline: Hip displasia surgery on a toddler and need wheels?
review_body: Absolutely love our stroller.  We've had it for a little over a year, and we use it pretty much every time we go out.  My ds is special needs, and we actually got the 360 as an 'inbetween' from a travel system and baby seat, to our special needs chair.  The large tires make it roll right over ice and snow, the giant canopy protects from the elements, the pockets and parent organizer are great (our organizer fell apart - got another from 'another company' at BabiesRus).  Folds easy, wide seat and long in leg room for plenty of growth.  Made for up to a 75lb kiddo, and the back is quite supportive - not all floppy and flimsy like an umbrella stroller or Mac.  Best piece of equipment I ever bought.  We also have their 'room2' playpen.  Another great piece of equipment.  I'm sure I'll cry when we outgrow them.    ps - someone stated in their review that you shouldn't use this out and about as a regular stroller, for shopping, etc...  We do.  EVERY TIME.  It turns on a dime, I can push and steer with one hand.  If I need to, I can pull a shopping cart behind me with the other hand.  We use this stroller EVERYWHERE.  It's big, yes - but it's totally worth it, and it's magnificent.  I seriously love this stroller, and without it, we'd already be using a wheelchair.    *** sept 2014    I just wanted to come back and add - we 'kind of' out grew it before we hit that 75lbs mark.  I think we were at 43 or so?  Maybe 46....  But height wise - was a biggie. He wasnt able to lie his head back, he'd grown over the support, and the canopy HAD to be over him in sun protection mode - and then he couldnt see what was going on, the canopy blocked it all from his view.  BUT - he comes from a long line of GIANTS.      So while we did outgrow it a scoonch, I couldn't bear to part with it - it's just too awesome.  Then we were hit with a bi lateral hip surgery, and got the cast from sternum to lower leg.  The hospital didn't have anything to offer us except an adult, Xtra large wheelchairto use - at home, and while out and about.      Home was fine, get A LOT of pillows!  But to go out, the chair was too heavy for me to lift on my own - and I'm a single parent - no help.      I remembered our JOOVY ZOOM - it has a quite shallow seating bit - I REMOVED the canopy, I got a piece of cork board, aprx half inch thick, white on one side, cork on other - easy to cut with exacto knife - got it to fit into the back of the ZOOM.  Put a pillow over it, nd kiddo JUST fit.  With his hips splayed open in the cast, he only had a very tiny bit of bum to sit with - and I was able to put a folded pillow under each leg to help as well.  The seatbelt was adjustable to still go around him, barely - but believe me - I would have tied him in there regardless, as long as he wasnt in pain.      This was the only way we were able to get to our follow up appts, to the store, or ANYTHING.  for walks down the street, we could use the large chair from the hospital - but to go in the vehicle, we could only do it with the ZOOM.      After all of that, once we were cast free, our ZOOM was finally ready for that big stroll in the sky - or so I thought....  Since I had dismantled a bit of it, cut some of the netting, - I didn't want to give it to someone, I was afraid they'd not see the beauty of it like we did - so I put it on the curb, to wait for the recycling truck.      I looked out a bit later, and dear ZOOM was long gone, but the other recycling remained.  I guess someone saw it's beauty after all, and drafted him into further service.  Made me glad.  I hope they get a lot of use out of it, like we did.

product_title: Pacimals: The Huggable Pacifier, Leslie the Lamb
review_body: I am super happy that I bought one of these, my son loves his and it taught him to grab and hold on to things very quickly. At almost 3mo he can manage the pacifier in and out of his mouth when ever he wants. I love it because we can switch out the pacifier and it is easy to wash. I will be buying another!

product_title: Classic So-Soft Baby Doll
review_headline: The only doll a girl needs!
review_body: Truly a durable, lovable doll.  This review is from my 12-year-old daughter:  I got my first one of these when I was just born, and as my love for them grew, I got more and more... A grand total of six!  I still remember when I cried ALL DAY because I couldn't find one.  I am now in middle school, and all of my \\"dollies\\"  still go to sleep with me.  Great fun for anyone, and also VERY durable.  (They are still in good shape!)  When my friends came over in preschool, I would always hide my dollies in the closet, so nobody would touch them.  (You would think that they have names, but the name Dolly stuck; for all of them!)

product_title: NUK Silicone Orthodontic Nipples, Slow Flow, Size 1, 2 Pack
review_headline: Best designed nipple in the market. Fits on Medela bottles and Evenflow glass bottles
review_body: I give this nipple 5 star rating because of its unique design. Less air is sucked by baby when drinking through this nipple. The slow flow nipple also allows less milk to release, which is great for my 2 month old because she had issues of swallowing too much milk from other brand nipples and then the milk would sometimes go to esophagus creating her to sneeze a lot and breath hard. Another thing I like about this nipple is that it fits well on Medela pump bottles and Evenflow glass bottles.

product_title: Dream On Me Sassy Stroller, Orange/Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a great lightweight stroller. It has everything you could ask for, a canopy, parent cup holders, a cup holder for the child, and an easy to access storage basket. I went through three strollers before I found this winner. I also love the colors, great for a boy or a girl. It folds and unfolds easily, I've already tested it through airport security for ease or use.

product_title: Graco Newborn Napper Pack n Play - Kinsey
review_body: We are due in December, but a friend has this same one and could not stop talking about it. After seeing how convenient it was and she brought it on vacation, it was a must buy.

product_title: Nuk ® 3 Packs of Latex Colored Replacement Spout
review_body: These lids work, even though they are less stable than the clear plastic ones. When my child sucks on them they give in like they are going to leak but they never actually have. The weakness of the lid are in the sides of the nipple. My child does not mind that its a different softer texture than the clear lids. They do work and do the job.

product_title: Sesame Street Table Topper Disposable Stick-on Placemats with Reusable Pop-up Travel Case, 50-Count
review_body: Saw family members using these and decided to try them with my daughter. She loves the bright colors, pointing out things, and can keep her food on her space, free from germs on the table and keep the table clean. I leave some in both of my cars and diaper bags, and even use them at family member's houses for easy clean up!

product_title: StrollAway Over the Door Stroller Storage Hanger, White
review_body: I used it right away, installing it on my front door in a NYC apartment.  It held the pupa baby vista, maclerran triumph, as well as the grace snap and go. This item is the best space saver and I never had a concern it wouldn't hold or fit my stroller.

product_title: Safety 1st ProGrade Rotate and Remove Outlet Solution, 12 Pack
review_body: These are just as easy as the other types of outlet covers to remove. So what if these \\"twist\\". I was hoping that these would be harder to remove than the more simple type of plug 'fillers', but they are not.

product_title: Baby Einstein Touch and Explore Discovery Book (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The bright colors, textures, lights & sounds are a big hit with our 6 month old little boy! The Baby Einstein book encourages our little one to begin learning & understanding what each object is. VTech also has a similar book, with quite a bit more music & lights, which is obviously what catches a young infant's eye... He absolutely loves that one as well... Both are perfect for young infants :)

product_title: Bright Starts Hop Along Carrier Toy Bar - Neutral (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We got this for our first road trip, and she loves to play with the frog, and it fit great on our Chicco Keyfit.  We could slide it down on the handle so her face was visible through her mirror.  She loved playing with it when she would wake from a nap and or just got in the car seat, but after a while  9 hours there, and 6 hours back  she got over the novelty, and just wanted out of her seat.  She was amazed when she discovered how to play the song, but then to our slight annoyance she just kept playing it over and over.  and the beads in the turtle constantly rattled, but not enough to wake the baby.  Maybe it was being stuck in the car for so long made us realize it, but she really didn't fuss most of the trip till about the last hour or so on each end, and we would have to say it had a lot to do with this toy bar being introduced.

product_title: Maclaren Volo Stroller, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Are you taller than 5'10"? You'll like this stroller. Just don't break it.
review_body:
I reluctantly bought this stroller for an airplane trip with my 3-year-old, as I refuse to enter an airport with her without a stroller.

The Maclaren customer service is notoriously bad. Replacement parts? Mwaa ha ha, you must deal with one of our authorized dealers. But I am 5'10\\" and my husband is 6'6\\", and just about all of the strollers out there are just too short. I didn't enjoy shelling out this much money for a stroller for a child that doesn't really need one anymore, but our previous Mclaren stroller had lost a wheel on our last plane trip. (That was when I encountered the repair provider problems.)

If you are looking for a company that will provide great support, try Graco. Our first stroller/infant car seat/tank combo came with a broken front wheel. After a single phone call and no paperwork, a brand new wheel showed up at my door in under a week.

This is a good stroller. There is a storage bin underneath, and I bought a snap on stroller storage bag for the handles. The hood is adaquate for AZ sun but not WA rains. Our very tall 3-year-old fits in it well and it can handle her 42 lbs. I love how light it is - you can fold it up and sling it over your shoulder with the attached strap. Just be careful and don't break it, ok?

product_title: The First Years Newborn Pacifiers - 2 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son loves these.  One of my \\"cannot live without\\" baby items for sure.  They are round, like a real nipple, instead of flat, and you can put your finger inside the nipple, so they really feel like they are sucking on something.

product_title: Flensted Mobiles Nursery Mobiles, Stella Nova
review_body: Found this mobile at the British Museum in London & loved it.  Altho we live in a humid climate with a long rainy season, I hung it outside under the eaves.  It's held up beautifully for 2 years but now 2 of the small balls have popped off so I'm going to replace it.  It just dances beautifully in a soft breeze.  And yes the materials are not what you'd think would withstand the elements but the finish on my wind chimes are peeling off after only 1 year so there you go!  Who knows!  These mobiles are a joy to me.

product_title: American Baby Company Heavenly Soft Chenille Crib Sheet
review_body: I really have nothing bad to say about this crib sheet.  It fits perfectly over my crib mattress, the color is bright and hasn't faded with washing.  I haven't ever dried it in the dryer, I always just air dry and it has stayed AMAZINGLY soft.  I love putting my baby down on this crib sheet.  Love, love, love it!

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body:
Our daughter likes a lot of musical toys, and seems to have a real knack for music. (She loves her piano and xylophone.) However, she has hated this toy from the get-go. When I first presented this toy to her, she immediately pushed the button once, and immediately tossed it as far as she could. Apparently, that wasn't far enough, because she then proceeded to crawl to the toy, pick it back up, just to throw it further away. This is only one of few toys that she has done this with. It's puzzling to me because I really think the music this thing plays is quite descent, not nearly as annoying as some other toys, and the song selection is good. But it's her reaction that counts.

P.s. I've presented this toy to her multiple times and have gotten the same reaction every, single, time. If i put it in her play pen, she would immediately find it, and toss it out of her pen. It's almost comical!

product_title: BabyBjorn Soft Bib
review_headline: BEST bib I have EVER bought!
review_body: This is by far the best bib I have ever bought! Originally I only added to my order so I could get free shipping, but it turned out to be the best bib purchase I have ever made! Before this bib we were using plastic/fabric bibs and over time they get smelly and dingy, this bib is SO much easier to clean, never gets an odor to it, and it catches everything because they pouch always stays open unlike fabric bibs! You will not be disappointed! It is also harder for children to rip off during meal time unlike the ones with velcro. My son is now 2.5 years old and has just started learning how to take it off. He could take off the velcro bibs around a year old! So this is definitely an improvement! I cannot say enough good things about this bib, I recommend it to every one I know.

product_title: Boutique Animal Kingdom 13PCS CRIB BEDDING SET
review_body: I purchased this bedding after researching lots of others and though this one would be the most bang for my buck. You always get what you pay for. The zebra stripes are almost a greenish brown. The rest of the colors are just okay. I was so excited to get this only to open it and be disappointed. The fitted sheet is so thin It looks like it might fall apart when I wash it. Im looking into returning it after the holiday.

product_title: Safety 1st Easy Grip Brush And Comb
review_body: I was looking for months to find the right brush for my son.  He absolutely loves this one.  He brings it to me on a regular basis so that Mommy can brush his hair.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat
review_headline: Great seat for home or on the go
review_body: This is a great booster seat. We purchased it to send it to our son's day-care, since he has some allergies and need to be physically separated from the other kids. We now own two, one for our home as well. No more bulky high-chair, we can use this in our of the regular chairs and he is oh-so-happy to be sitting like the rest of us! The lid is great for taking it with us on trips, I just wish it had a place to keep it during everyday use. We usually put it away in our cabinets, but I would rather keep it attached to the booster. I guess you can't have everything!

product_title: Nuby Bottle Brush With Net Scrub, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have always had a hard time cleaning camelbak bottles, but have found that this does a good job in getting in to all the hard spots. Good price, and decent cleaning, this is better than the others I have used from oxo, and cheap store brands. Worth every penny

product_title: Boba Vest, Grey, Medium (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I haven't used other wraps, but I find that this one is excellent!  It holds well, and I don't find it too difficult to put on.  I can put it on in just a minute or two, and I'm told that there are lots of wrap videos on the internet that make different styles very easy to try.  Fortunately, my baby also enjoys the wrap.  She gets in it and goes right to sleep.  This has been great for around the house, as well as the grocery store.  Yes, it gets hot, but I think that's to be expected.  As other people have said, you are wrapping another human being to your body, and since it's your baby, you want a fabric that will hold.  I'll take the heat for a sleeping baby that can be with me as I get other things done.

product_title: The First Years True Choice A100 Digital Monitor, One Parent Unit
review_headline: Don't waste your time or money
review_body: This baby monitor is digital and has an automatic frequency selection. Because of this feature, the sound is continually skipping and cutting out. As the monitor is searching for the best frequency, it loses the connection with the other transmitter, making the monitor unreliable.  During our testing we heard a loud beeping sound, perhaps another result of the auto frequency finder. In the middle of the night  we would rather be awoken by a crying baby than a high-pitched beep. This baby monitor also tends to transmit subtle sounds but then not baby sounds, which seems to negate the point of having the monitor in the first place.  After 1 night of testing, we done.  Don't waste your time or money

product_title: Snappi Cloth Diaper Fasteners - Pack of 2 (Mint Green / Pink)
review_body: I bought the wrong type of prefold to use these. I'm hanging on to them until I buys ome clotheez though. They seem to be made from some semi durable materials and there is an extra piece of plastic or whatever just to wrap around the sharp part for safety when it's not in use. looking forward to using.

product_title: Bumkins Waterproof  SuperBib
review_body: We got this for our child (6 months  before a recent trip so i wouldn't have to take several terry bibs with us.  We love this better than other waterproof bibs we have, because its smaller, and a lighter weight, and fits our child better, and yet generous enough to cover their lap.  And i can just rinse it off in the sink and hang it to dry between feedings, but we love how it is smaller, and so it doesn't swallow her up and leave gaps around the neck. We would buy more, but as its waterproof, i just need one bib :) and i find myself grabbing this over my dozens of terry bibs now, and i don't have to throw this in the washer after each use.

product_title: Baby Jogger Car Seat Adapter for City Mini / City Elite (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have a Graco Safe Seat car seat and I bought the Baby Jogger used on craigslist. This adaptor holds our carseat onto the stroller securely. Easy to install & easy to pop the car seat onto it.

product_title: Bright Starts Around We Go 2-in-1 Activity Center
review_body: It's a very nice, colorful, good quality \\"activity station\\". My Baby likes it. You need a little time to put it together, but it's not so difficult.

product_title: Jeep Liberty Renegade Walker, Bloom Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this for my granddaughter and she has been using this for a month now. She loves it so much.I love the colors and the total look of this walker. Beautiful !

product_title: Bummis Reusable Fleece Liners
review_body: I switched to cloth diapers a few months ago due to my daughter suffering from frequent rashes. We were trying to rid her of a nasty yeast rash while using cloth. So, I decided to try these liners to 1. Keep her skin dry and 2. protect cloth from barrier cream! I am happy to report these liners keep her VERY dry in terms of a barrier between prefold diapers that are absorbent, but wet feeling. This is the perfect solution! I am very thankful for this product and will continue to use them. Not to mention, they do a great job protecting cloth from poo :) They catch the poo and keep the cloth diaper cleaner. Great product!

product_title: Munchkin Baby Laundry Bag
review_body: While the appearance may not be as flashy as competing bags, the Munchkin Baby Laundry Bag is incredibly functional and easy to clean when messes get out of hand. For the price you simply can't complain.

product_title: Munchkin Mozart Magic Cube
review_body: There are a number of stiff plastic wires connecting the toy to its packaging that are extremely difficult to remove.  I'd recommend against buying this for that reason alone.  Not suitable for use by a child until they've been carefully pried out.

product_title: One-tier Eyelet Skirt, Hood Cover, and Sheet
review_body: I had an old basinet that I wanted a new cover for since the other one was over 25 years old. This one fit perfectly, and the hood cover was detatchable which was perfect since my basinet did not have a hood.  It also came with a matress sheet, which was a nice addition.  I think it looks very nice and classic perfect for a boy or a girl.  It will definately last for several years and several babies.

product_title: Lamaze LS 50 Lightweight Stroller - Black/Red
review_body: I needed a stroller that would fit a 45lb five-year-old as well as my 30lb three-year-old for a trip to Disney World. This was the only model I could find that would handle up to 50lbs. The stroller itself is only about 11 lbs and is very easy to maneuver. I found it for $49.99 at Babies R Us!

product_title: GEENNY Boutique Crib Bedding Set, Animal Scholar, 13 Piece
review_body: I just received my crib bedding set today, and I am thrilled!  The stitching looks great, and the colors really work well together.  The wall hangings look better and bigger than expected.    My favorite part has got to be the different types of fabric that were used.  The monkey fur is a soft fluffy material, and other fabrics feel much like microfiber or something similar.  There are a few different textures.  All the images are stitched on as appliqués, not printed directly onto the fabric.    The bedding was on sale when I purchased it for $99, and I feel like I got such a bargain!  Definitely worth every penny, and I would recommend this to anyone.

product_title: Boppy Prenatal Total Body Pillow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Around 20 weeks, I was DESPERATE for some kind of relief from the nightly back pain caused by my belly pulling.  I tried every arrangement of pillows and body pillows then splurged on this when nothing was working.  It did nothing for me.  If anything, I woke up more sore in the morning.  I don't think it can really do anything special that you couldn't arrange with an assortment of pillows from around the house.  If you just want something soft and squishy to surround your body, then this might be for you.  If your problem is needing belly support though, I would definitely recommend the [[ASIN:B00474CUTO Boppy Prenatal Sleep Wedge]] instead.  It's way cheaper and provides much better support.  It was amazing from night 1!  This body pillow doesn't seem to provide much belly support or distribute the weight well at all.  I returned it the very next day.  SO glad I found the wedge instead!

product_title: Carters Keep Me Dry Flannel Crib Pad
review_headline: a MUST for acid reflux babies!
review_body: I love this item.  Just came back to order a replacement for the one I left out of town on our Thanksgiving trip.  I have two, both of the frog design which happens to match our frog themed nursery.  I like having two so that one can be in the wash and I can still have one on the crib mattress ready for the next nap.  My son has acid reflux, so he spits up a LOT.  These pads allow me to easily change and wash the top layer without the hassle of changing the crib sheets.  They are soft, so they are comfortable for my son to sleep on.  An added bonus is that I can grab his crib pad whenever he'll be sleeping somewhere else in a pack n play, use it in the friends' pack n play which prevents his spit up from messing up their crib, and it also brings the familiar sent of home so he always sleeps great in different environments!  It is the right width for a pack n play mattress, and it is easy to tuck the few extra inches around the ends.  It is not as long as our regular crib mattress, but is the same width.  It works great in both places!

product_title: The First Years Home and Away Computer Connect (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I was pleasantly surprised at this camera. I am a disabled mother with an autistic son and a newborn. I CAN NOT be in 2 places at once, but this camera allows for the next best thing! I must keep an eye on my autistic son at all times and now I can.

Pros....
This camera was amazingly easy to set up
I was amazed at how it did so well in near pitch black rooms!
Being able to hit a button and talk to my child in the other room is a great feature.
I love being able to take snapshots and videos to show my husband what craziness or adorable moments he missed during the day!
Ability to wall mount is great
LOVE the ability to add 4 cameras!!! I can see anywhere my son goes without having to follow him around the house.
----this makes him feel much more independent (very important) while I am still secure that he is safe! (even more important) :)
Cons....
The clarity of pic is a little lacking but it more than does its job!!!
The mic picks up everything... (can be a pro or con) It often has white noise (not terrible just a little annoying)
The blue activated light continuously flashes which often distracts my son when trying to sleep.
The blue button lights and active light are rather bright.

I NEVER give 5 stars because things can always be better... but this is as close to a five star (especially for the cost) that I can give!

:) Great buy!

product_title: Itzy Ritzy Snack Happens Reusable Snack and Everything Bag
review_body: This is a great product and I love the design.  I used them from everything from snacks to keeping toys and pacifiers in them.  These are a must for any on the go mom and plus they are environmentally friendly!

product_title: Thirsties Fab Wipes
review_body: These wipes are soft and luxurious.  I use them for diaper changes, bath time, and wiping off my baby's face and they are wonderful.  The only downside in my opinion is a) they are a bit pricey and b) the colors tend to fade with washing (This is not a big deal in my book.  They still feel just as soft).  I used these wipes as a go-by for making my own re-usable wipes to supplement my stash, as I go through many wipes on a daily basis.  I purchased microfleece and flannel and was able to produce a much more economical approximation.  They aren't quite as good, but cost a lot less!

product_title: Levana Safe N'See Digital Video Baby Monitor with Talk-to-Baby Intercom and Lullaby Control (LV-TW501) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great Amazon product - my daughter used and loved The Levana monitor for past 9 months
review_body: I purchased the Levana for my daughter who had our first granddaughter in April 2011.  She has used it continually for the past 9 months and loves it.  The sound is loud - wakes her up on queue.  The picture is great - it is set so that the picture rests and becomes active  when there is movement in the crib.  It usually sits on her bedside table in the power cradle but it is so portable she can easily take it to the kitchen, bath or living room to keep an eye and ear on her babe.  No mechanical problems so far!  It has everything we expected and thought was necessary and I am especially pleased with the price for value.  Grandma, Helen.

product_title: C.R. Gibson Loose-Leaf Memory Book
review_body: I love that this is a three ring binder, I can add or remove pages according to our lifestyle. Has really good pages, about mom and dad and also firsts, as well as a page for each month up to the first bday. Then has years up to 5. Really good deal, but well worth full price if that's what you end up paying! Love the little owl!

product_title: Sassy Look Photo Book
review_headline: Cute 1st photo album for your baby
review_body: I love this little photo book, my phone loves looking at all of the photos I put in there of his family. The pages do stick if they slobber on them but I have not had any problems with the photos running or him getting to the photos.

product_title: Baby Einstein Around The World Discovery Center (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We owned another Little Einsteins Discovery Center when our eldest child was born.  It had a number of parts recalled so I bought our next child his own discovery center.  The product has deteriorated even further - it is difficult to put together, scratched, cheap and not particularly stimulating.  Furthermore it seems that this model also has a number of recalled parts - our brand new toy came with an \\"addendum\\" showing parts that were removed and replacement parts.  It was a mess.  I would recommend using another brand's exersaucer.  For the price we paid, the toy should be better.

product_title: NiNi Paci Bungee
review_body: works with any pacifier, my son can grab it easily and stick it back into his own mouth. If he chews on it, it doesn't get all soggy like cloth ones.

product_title: Today's Mom Cozy Comfort Pregnancy Pillow
review_body: This pillow is extremely comfortable and is definitely helping me to sleep better, but be aware that it's also big.  I have a King sized bed, so it's not a huge deal, but it definitely takes up the majority of my side, if not all of my side.  It's also a little bit of a pain to try to \\"climb over\\" to get in and out of bed, but the fact that it is so comfortable makes up for that hinderance in my opinion.  I'm so glad I went ahead and broke down and ordered this as I have slept so much better the last couple of nights.

product_title: Beaba Bib’Expresso 3 in 1 Baby Bottle & Food Warmer
review_body:
Like other reviewers, I got this thinking it would both heat the water and mix formula. It does not mix the formula; you still have to shake the bottle. Also the microwave sterilizer on the back seems to have nothing to do with the rest of the product (if I wanted a sterilizer, I could buy a nice one for relatively cheap separately, there is no reason to have it stuck on the back of this thing). If you're making larger bottles, it doesn't heat the water as fast as advertised in my experience... more like 2-3 minutes rather than 90 seconds.

The one-handed operation and even heating (compared to bottle warmer) is convenient, but overall not worth the price or space this takes on the counter. Buy an electric kettle (Baby Brezza kettle) instead, and just shake the bottles.

product_title: Britax Child Bike Seat (Prior Model)
review_body: This easy to use, secure bike seat also has the great feature of washable material. The padding is comfortable, but not over stuffed or too hot for the child on summer days. Though it fastens securely, it also has a quick release in case you need to remove it as fast as possible for any reason. I also found it a breeze to install. Although it says you can place children up to forty pounds, I would caution against putting a child too big in it simply due to the 'wobble' it might create on your bike while you ride. Keep your own balance factor in mind and judge carefully how sturdy the bike you'll be placing the child seat on really is. Being able to simply remove the padding and toss it in the wash is fantastic. However, I haven't done this enough to judge how many washes it can withstand before it starts to wear down. While riding, the seat stays steady (if secured properly initially to the bike), this is important if the child wiggles around. If you trust your own balance, this is a great way to get some exercise and fresh air for your child. I also recommend fastening a flag to the back of the bike if you ride on the road to help motorists spot you. If the buyer follows all the instructions and warnings, I'm convinced they'll be very satisfied with this purchase.

product_title: Lorex LW241 LIVE sense Wireless Video Home Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Well prodoct is good but the range is too small and I got the open packge first time Amazon got dispontied levana 501 is the best

product_title: Paradise Galleries Realistic Newborn Great to Reborn Baby Doll Twins, Teddy Bear Twin - Abigail, Girl Doll Crafted in Soft Vinyl and Weighted Body, 16 inch
review_body: I purchased this baby doll for my granddaughter, her name is Abigail. I tried to cancel it after looking at it more carefully and I was unable to as it was ready for shipping. It came today and what a disappointment, I think the doll is ugly not a cute baby face, her lips are too fake looking and quite heavily painted, her eye lashes where really long and I think a little over the top for a new baby. Her smile is not near as cute as the picture so altogether I say it certainly is not worth the money even for a collector.  I cannot send it back{I wish I could} but I tore the box then I really wanted to inspect it, to my surprise it said it was not for  a child under14 years because of small pieces, I could not find any small pieces, so I think I will just have to mark this up to experience, to be really careful about buying dolls sight unseen. This one is making me think this way, I really cannot believe I spent so much on such a unlikeable item. I always thought all dolls were pretty cute but after this one I am sorry to say that is not the case. I will not be able to give this doll to my granddaughter for a couple of weeks, I just hope she likes it, perhaps she will I hope so. The clothes on the doll are nice, cannot say anything else...... Sorry CABailey

product_title: Munchkin Deluxe Auto Bottle Warmer, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Takes way to long to warm the bottle
review_body: Sadly i wasted my money on two of these. My daughter will not take a bottle unless it is body temp or warmer so i thought a car bottle warmer would be a great idea. I ended up having to leave the bottle in the warmer for about 40 min and it still was just lukewarm and she wouldn't take it. They take way to long to warm the bottle up. I do not recommend this product at all.

product_title: Tots In Mind Crib Tent for Convertible Cribs, White
review_body: This product has worked for us on two different cribs. My son is 21 months and we aren't ready to have him in a big bed yet - this has saved us a lot of sleep! We put a strand of blue LED Christmas lights on top so he thought it was his cool little fort and didn't complain at all.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing
review_body: My daughter loves this swing. She stares at herself in the mobile and takes amazingly long naps in it. I love that it plugs in so it isn't constantly eating batteries. Also it is a very nice shade of pink that is soft enough to not be obnoxious. I also love the music options and volume control so the sounds aren't driving me crazy. It comes as a 5 point harness which I thought was excessive so I took off the top 2 straps to make it a 3 point.

product_title: Baby Trend Deluxe Nursery Center, Chickadee (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Versatile, grows with you baby, cute design
review_body: We got this as a shower gift and originally thought we would use it as a playpen, but we ended up using it as a bassinet upon arrival from the hospital. We like that it has pockets and room behind the bassinete part (we have 2 small baskets there: 1 for dirty diapers, 1 for dirty clothes). Since she sleeps with us we like having room for diapers, wipes, changing terry-cloth mats and, next to the 2 baskets, we have burping clothes and clean onesies. In a way we have her whole room in one place and right next to our bed. We had her very comfortably in the bassinete from birth to 3 months and now have graduated her to the \\"2nd\\" level, which is a lot larger.  The reason why I didn't give it 5 stars is that on this second level the \\"mattress\\" seems awfully hard. When I'm changing my daughter and she kicks away, I can her the thumping sound it makes against the hard mat. I assume it's due to safety, not sure, but the bassinete didn't seem as hard. My husband put it together and said it was ok. So far we have not used the folding changing table.  In summary:  PROS:  Tons of pockets  (and if using bassinete, storage space behind)  Versatile - bassinete+ playpen+ crib+ changing table  Grows with your baby  Cute  Takes work to assemble, but not too hard  Mesh sides - very breathable   Wheels on one side makes it easy to move  CONS:  The only one so far is the hardness of the mat when in stage 2  I do recommend it

product_title: Playtex Drop-Ins System - Breast Milk Storage Kit
review_headline: Great for every day use - get 2
review_body: I exclusively pump & originally purchased one set of these...but 2 is ideal so you have 4 of the pump converters & then you have a lot more lids to store them.  I have had no leaking issues, except for when I screwed the lid too tight & bent the tops of the drop-ins.  I store them on the lids as instructed & have only used Playtex brand drop-ins so far.  I enjoy being able to heat them up easily & then just dropping them into a bottle.  I have not tried to use them in the freezer.

product_title: Graco Duoglider LX Stroller, Wilshire (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
So far this stroller is awesome, especially for the price! I love how big the basket is underneath. The canopies are big and definitely keep sun out of my little one's eyes. I have 6 month old twins and although the straps are still a little big for them, they both fit and will have a lot of room to grow into it. It's also cuter than it looks in the pictures. I like that there's a drink holder for mom, and I like that the back seat has a tray. It also rides really nice and doesn't feel too bulky. When it folds up, it's really not too big. It's big, because it's a double stroller, but I'm 5'2'' and I can handle it. I have a small SUV and it fits in the back easily. I'm not sure how it'll fit in a sedan though. Likewise, I was pleasantly surprised by how light it is all folded up!

The cons:
-Only the front seat's tray has a drink holder for baby. I wish the back tray also had a drink holder.
-I wish the basket had a \\"fold-down\\" feature to make it easier to get things in and out.
-I wish the stroller had \\"pacifier holders\\" in each seat with detachable strings, but that is REALLY wishful thinking and probably a safety hazard. lol.
-The backseat folds down to flat for sleeping babies, which is nice, but it only has two positions: up and down. I wish there was an inbetween option.
-The instructions to put it together are a little hard to figure out. They were confusing, so I just went on instinct and put it together correctly. The instruction packet sucks though.

Overall, I really like this stroller and I don't see how the more expensive ones could be any better. I'd totally suggest buying this product!

product_title: The First Years Take & Toss Toddler Flatware Travel Set
review_headline: It's great when they are young
review_body: We used this on a trip with our 11 month old daughter when we went overseas and it was exceptionally useful. The container is great and keeps things clean when you're traveling. We used these for a while even after our trip was over. At first Amazon or the company that sold it to us--by mistake sent us disposable spoons by accident but after notifying them of the mistake, either amazon or the company that sold the spoons sent us the correct product. Easy as pie and great service. Now that our daughter is 15ish month old she can't really use them anymore since it isn't deep enough to spoon a lot of food, but its ok...we still found these great when she was the appropriate age to use it.

product_title: Innobaby Stainless Bus Divided Platter
review_body: I'm ordering two more of these right now so I don't have to fool with washing them after each  meal. This is extremely high quality, each section is sufficiently deep, and it's so stinking cute I can't stand it! The dynamic duo already dragged them around the house, banged them into the tile floor, and used them for lunch...no damage! If you are looking for an alternative to plastic dishware for toddlers, this is it.

product_title: FuzziBunz One Size Cloth Diaper
review_headline: Poorly constructed and too small to be one-size
review_body:
We have a stash of 9 Fuzzi Bunz and just got replacements for three of them through Fuzzi Bunz customer service because several snaps had fallen off. The top stitching has come unstitched in several places on most of our Fuzzi Bunz, but the company does not replace diapers with this problem; they say that's \\"normal wear and tear.\\" Very disappointing! My friend showed me her baby's Bum Genius one-size diapers and they look like a tank could run over them and they'd keep on going. Our Fuzzi Bunz, by contrast, seem very fragile.

A bigger complaint is that these diapers are not going to fit my 18-month older much longer and he's not yet ready to potty train. I feel very misled by Fuzzi Bunz's claim that these one-size diapers will fit from birth to potty training. Our son is 18 months, very tall (32-34\\" or so, not exactly sure) and weighs 30 lbs. He is big for his age and is often taken to be 2.5 or so. However, his hips are very small and narrow and he is thin--no big butt on this kid. The Fuzzi Bunz don't have much rise. They aren't going to fit him much longer, I'm afraid.

Also, as many other reviewers have said, these diapers are narrow inside and hard to stuff. Sometimes I get so frustrated with this, I get a little rant going in my head about how \\"Fuzzi Bunz are anti-father!\\" I realize that's a bit over the top, as I'm sure this was just poor design with lack of foresight on their part, but come on, folks. COME ON. We mamas want our husbands to help stuff the darn things. But my husband has a hard time fitting his big bear paws in these dainty little drawers.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Soft Spout Training Cup, 6 Ounce
review_body: I was so excited when i read the reviews of this cup immediately ordered it as the price was also very reasonable and was very eager to get rid of bottles.  I receieved the product from day 1 i cleaned the cup reinstalled it filled a little milk in it so i could train my baby but even i couldnt suck out the milk from then i washed it again filled it with warm water sucked it it worked tried on baby but she in 5 sips got tired of sucking hard on it and back to bottle very irritating for the eager mom who want their babies to quit bottles. i thought my baby doesnt have teeth so she cant but even i couldnt do it.

product_title: Regalo Maxi 59-Inch Super Wide Walk Thru Gate, White
review_body: I purchased a smaller version of this gate and was very pleased with the ease of putting it up and how it opened, etc. so decided to purchase additional gates for other areas of the house.  I purchased this super wide gate and was not pleased with it as I was with the smaller gate.   I don't like that the door does not swing both ways to open; the wall mounts/screws did not come with screw holders that go into the wall to hold the screws in the wall - which was a real pain when putting it up.  The gate is wide and the screws that were provided are very small and they pulled right out of the wall as soon as the gate was put on the wall mounts.  We had to go out and buy the screw holders (I am sre this is not what thye are called, but the little plastic things that go into the wall to have a stronger hold for the screw), also there isn't much room to work with for baseboards.  Also, the handle to open and close the door is not the best, it's harder to use than the smaller gate, you almost cannot do it one handed.  After we played around with different screws and holders and stuff we got the gate up securely.  3 stars because it does the job, would have given more if it was easier to put up, had screw holders and the handle worked better.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Designed To Nourish Puree and Simple Blender (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A MUST HAVE for baby food makers!
review_body: This little machine is a must have for folks who make baby food.  It is so easy to clean and store.  The only reason I purchased this was because we are temporarily living with my folks while our new home is being built and I packed away my blender.  Good thing I did or else I would have never found this!  Way better than a blender and much more compact!

product_title: Infantino Bonk Bonk Buddies
review_body: Annoying pig toy, was a Christmas present, that the giver didn't realize what it did.  She apologized post opening.  Its not even a favorite of the baby, it might fall into the bag for charity :)  Don't waste your money!

product_title: Summer Infant Multi-Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate
review_body: This gate is difficult for one person to install.  And no matter what I do. I can't get it to close automatically.  Not a problem for me - I have gotten into the habit of latching it when I go through it, but my wife can't seem to develop the habit, and so, it is left open half the time.  We use it to keep our dog in one room, so it's not a safety issue.  But whenever my wife goes out of the room, the dog gets out because she leaves it open.  On the plus side, it opens in both directions.  I just wish I could find a gate that really closes automatically AND opens in both directions.

product_title: Infantino Activity Stacker (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this toy for my 5 month old son's first Christmas. He excitedly reached for it the moment he saw it. It's been one of his favorites since. This really is a great toy. Not only is it a stacker, but the base when shaken, or smacked like a drum as my son likes to do, makes a fun little chirping sound. Each ring is a toy in and of itself. It's interesting and thoroughly enjoyable. Don' waste your money on hard plastic stackers, this is the best.

product_title: Skip Hop Graphic Accent Pillow, Mod Dot (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This was a great product very durable and very pretty we resally love it and it came to us in a very fast time

product_title: OXO Tot Whale Pail
review_body: This is a great item for the bath.  It is cute and functional.  Big kids can play with it in the tub and it works great as a bath toy pail.  I did not give this item a 5 because the suction does not work in our bathroom (I did not try adhesive tabs-they might work).  However, the pail is great just lying on the side of the tub.

product_title: Munchkin 3 Pack Mini Ducks Girl, Colors May Vary
review_headline: Not what they stated it was
review_body: I ordered this for my daughter for Christmas and was expecting mini ducks.  Instead I got the big regular sized ducks.  I mean it's a good deal for the larger ducks but it's not what I ordered.

product_title: NoJo My Little MVP Musical Mobile
review_body: I purchased this for my new nephew to match his bedding/crib set.  It was fast shipping, great price, and a great item.  Very happy. :)

product_title: Safety 1st Adjustable Multi-Purpose Strap
review_body: I really needed these straps for our desk because my daughter would open the drawers and take everything out. I'm happy that they have adhesive and are adjustable. I am very happy with this product! I highly recommend this for baby proofing your house.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat
review_body: I have used this for grandchildren from 6 months to 3 years. Best ever for serving food or providing a secure play tray for modeling clay or paints. You don't need a high chair to clutter the dining room. This fills the bill.

product_title: BabyHawk by Moby Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Meh Dai (Mei Tei) Carrier Baby Wrap Baby Carrier Baby Sling
review_body: I literally use this thing every day! My daughter hates the stroller, but loves the Mei Tai. I love that she is facing me and is in a perfect position for me to kiss her little forehead any time that I want. I also love that this prevents strangers from coming up and putting their hands or faces near my little one like they tend to do with a stroller. This is seriously the best baby product that I have ever purchased!

product_title: Secure Transitions Inflatable Baby Tub
review_headline: Baby hated it, but I liked it!
review_body: We love this tub.  We specifically sought this tub out to transition our 9 month old from the infant tub and knew it had every feature that would make it perfect.  My daughter hated it.  Screamed, wailed, thought she was dying.  After the first traumatic use, we went back to her old tub.  She would start crying again at bathtime each night, but it got better about 5 days later.  We waited for her to be normal and happy again before trying this tub again.  The outcome?  Rinse and repeat.  It was if someone dropped a 50 pound anvil on top of her head.  She would not stop screaming at all.  My best guess is that she felt unsteady as a result of the inflated padding along the bottom.  The infant tubs are hard plastic, and she just could not make the transition.  We have purchased another large plastic tub and our daughter loves it (Eurobath).  No problems at all.  I have not seen any review describing an experience like our own, but I wanted to share in case you experience a similar problem.

product_title: Lansinoh Manual Breast Pump
review_body: For the first couple of months I rented a hospital grade pump and it was great. However, when I returned it I found that I needed a pump because I had a few medical procedures that required me to pump and dump for 24 hours. I decided on a manual pump to save money. I first bought a medela--but the suction was shot within a days worth of use. Then I tried lansinoh and what a difference. Yes, as other users have mentioned you may have issues with suction at times--but after going through two different brands and finding this to be an issue--i think its just part of what you get with a manual pump. The medela was beyond fixable where this lansinoh pump was still working even with the slight downgrade in suction. The lansinoh can be taken apart and dried easily because the problem is that breastmilk can get into the mechanism--thus eliminating the problem where the medela couldn't be fixed because the design is just flawed. I don't find cleaning the breast pump to be a pain because its the sanitary thing to do anyway.  Another plus is that the flanges on the lansinoh model are designed better and I think this helps too.

product_title: American Baby Company Organic Waterproof Natural Quilted Fitted Portable/Mini Crib pad cover
review_body: Awesome, worth the money. Impenetrable! My newborn spit up several times on the sheet and the quilt and it has held its own in the wash. There was no shrinkage and it is as soft as the first day I bought it. Good quality product.

product_title: Carter's Butterfly Flowers 4 Piece Receiving Blanket, Pink/Choc, 30 X 40" (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These are incredibly soft, durable, wash well and are the perfect size for swaddling your baby. After coming home from the hospital, I was so disappointed to find out that the receiving blankets I had were smaller, thinner, and not as high quality as the ones used in the hospital. I was on a search to find comparable quality blankets, and these fit the bill. They are a little thin, but when swaddled, your baby is cozy and not bulky. They also serve so many other purposes such as covering the carseat from the sun, covering up for breastfeeding, and many other things. I recommend buying two packages!

product_title: Baby Deedee Sleep Nest  Baby Sleeping Bag
review_headline: Hands down, the BEST, Large size=great for tall babies
review_body: Not to be flip, but I don't care about price when it comes to my son's comfort. I've bought the Woolino, the Grobag, etc. The Baby DeeDee bag is by far a superior product to all of them! It is soft, easy to use, and made of a nice, duvet-like material. I suggest you buy two, so that you have a back up in case of accidents, spills, etc. This blanket is amazing--I live in Wyoming, so I need something substantial, but not overwhelming. I also bought the Woolino--I don't dislike it, but I only use it for day naps. My son is literally above the 99th% for height, and the large size blanket works out great for him. I would NOT bother with getting a small size for any regular sized baby--get a medium (I did at 3 months, and it was sufficient until two months ago) or a large. My son is 26 lbs and about 33 inches-so he is in a large now. (He is 10 months)

product_title: Luvable Friends Dot Print Coral Fleece Blanket
review_body: Very soft and very cute! It's the perfect gender neutral blanket and was exactly what I was looking for for my new addition to the family. And the pattern is adorable. Not disappointed.

product_title: Bumbleride 2011 Flite Lightweight Compact Travel Stroller, Seagrass (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love my Bumbleride Flite! To address some of the complaints some reviewers had:  1. Most reviewers say it's a two handed fold and unfold but I can do it with one hand while holding my baby in the other. You basically just release one lever first, then the second instead of doing them both at the same time.  2. The sunshade is not bad compared to the Maclaren. You can click it forward one extra notch so it is almost in front of the baby instead of just above.  3. You can push it with one hand if you need to for a short while.  My only issues:  - the basket is quite small and not a huge fan of the front loading idea.  - the buckle on the five point harness is easy to unclick meaning my kid might be able to escape once he figures it out. I wish I could replace this with something a little more sophisticated. Maybe someday in the future, Bumbleride might offer a better locking system so only adults can unclick it?  I decided to go with this stroller over the Maclaren Quest, which is at the same price point, because it looked better and the fabric seemed like it would be easier to clean. No need to buy an extra seat liner, like with Maclarens.  Everyone seems to have a Maclaren, so when I walk with my stroller everyone asks me what make is it? They love the way it looks. I love the way it handles.

product_title: Mam Bite & Brush Teether With Soft Bristles 3+ Months
review_body: I purchased this but was a little skeptical as it had mixed review but my little one loves it.  He is 9 months and teething pretty bad.  I gave him this teether just before bed and he fell asleep chewing on it.  I'm not sure how well it works for brushing but it is still better then nothing (he won't let me brush his teeth).  I only wish it wasn't pinkish purple but that is minor.

product_title: Carter's Easy Fit Printed Crib Fitted Sheet, Ecru/Brown Circles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These are good neutral gender sheets.  The fit on our baby crib mattress well with a mattress pad protector under it.  I've wash them sheets a few time, and they appear to keep their color well.  In the photo we tought there were pink circles on the sheet but they are really brown so it makes them a more neutral gender sheet.

product_title: Nuby No-Spill Flip-It Cup with Kwik-Flo Valve, 14 Ounce, Colors May Vary
review_headline: The best toddler-to-4 sippy cup for boys
review_body: I say \\"for boys\\" because that's what I have. Probably just as good for girls but, full disclosure, I don't have girls.  We've tried at least eight models of sippy cup.  This one is the ones that my kids prefer, and I also prefer it because:  * it takes a beating, and the kids have never broken one  * it's large capacity at 14oz  * it's easy to clean, since the spillproof mechanism can be disassembled  * it does not vapor lock like all the rest seem to  * it only allows the kid to drink if it's held mostly upright, which teaches good manners  The only problems are that the drinking \\"straw\\" can be chewed off (which is true of almost any model) and it's easy to lose one of the three parts of the spillproof mechanism if you disassemble it when you clean it, but just remember to keep the parts in a cup while they dry and you'll be fine.  I'm ordering six more right now.  Yes, six.

product_title: The First Years Compass B540 Booster Seat, Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I really like this product.  It is very easy to use and had high ratings through consumer reports so as a mother I really feel like I can trust it to keep my child safe.  My son is able to get in and out of it with ease.  I love how it folds and doesn't take up much room in storage.  I have a smaller car and for those times when he isn't with me and I need the space it really comes in handy.  I strongly recommend this product to any parent.

product_title: Mimijumi Not So Hungry Baby Bottle 4 oz/120 mL
review_body: I purchased the bottle for my EBF baby due to the fact I was going to participate in a 8k. She had never been given a bottle so hopes were high for this one. I found the bottle to be easy to use and similar in shape to a breast. My daughter at first just began to chew on it but later fed off of it 1 oz. In short this bottle worked to keep my baby fed while I was gone for 4 hours. I would definitely recommend the bottle. My only issue is the cap will not stay on!

product_title: Medela Pump In Style Advanced Breast Pump
review_headline: Great pump, very easy to use backpack
review_body:
I bought this backpack version of the Madela pump after already owning & using the tote-style bag with identical pump. I don't need two because both are very easy to transport (all you have to do is unplug the AC adapter, I just have a bad habit of forgetting to transport between home & work. Without going on about the pump, which is wonderful & easy to use - all of the necessary accessories are included in the bag.

My two cents is that if you're torn between the tote & the bookbag, get the bookbag - it may look silly, but you can actually wear the bookbag & pump at the same time, which is wonderful if you're at home by yourself - I can use this & pump while at the same time take care of errands around the house without having to be \\"tied down\\" to a chair. To wear it, you obviously need to use the DC battery pack vs. the AC adapter - I saw another post where the user complained that the pump lost its strength after one session with the DC pack; however, I am currently on my 6th pumping session with the DC pack and haven't had any loss of suction yet. The trick is just to use good batteries - the only downside is that the pack requires 8 AA batteries. Also, to fully take advantage of the moving-around-the-house backpack feature, you'll need a pumping bra to allow you to be hands-free, I use the [[ASIN:B003Y01MQY Simple Wishes Hands Free Pumping Bustier for Medela Breast Pump L/XL/XXL]], which works great for that purpose. (I only wear it to pump, not for \\"normal\\" bra purposes -- it fits like a halter-top and is very adjustable and also comes with straps that you can attach so that it fits like a normal bra.)

The last bit of feedback is on the storage system - while it did come with one nipple so that the storage bottles can be used to feed the baby as well, I recommend to simply just use them as storage and use Dr. Browns bottles for feeding baby (the Dr. Brown's 4-oz bottles are also compatible with the Madela pump). I've found that the Dr. Brown's do a great job cutting down on gas. (note, the compatibility is one-way, the Dr. Browns inserts do not fit inside the Madela storage bottles).r. Brown's do a great job cutting down on gas. (note, the compatibility is one-way, the Dr. Browns inserts do not fit inside the Madela storage bottles).

product_title: LilyPadz Reusable Silicone Nursing Pads Starter Kit Single Pair Regular Size
review_body: Things I love about Lily Padz:  1. Reusable.  2. Easy to use.  3. Tackiness lasted about three weeks.  4. They did stop leaks until the tackiness faded.  Things I don't love:  1. Even when you use the wipes and cleaning solution, the silicon lost its tackiness.  2. When they failed, I ended up with a completely drenched shirt because of the amount of milk that was able to build between the pad and my breast.  3. The wipes are a total ripoff. I was better off buying alcohol prep pads and using them.  4. If you have small creatures (other than your nursling), it can be difficult to see the Lily Padz if they are moved (since they are clear). Not a huge problem, but can be annoying.  I would order them again and I would recommend them for any woman who is nursing but they weren't everything I hoped they would be.

product_title: Safety 1st Soothing Mist Ultrasonic Humidifier
review_headline: works great, but hard to clean
review_body: I got this as a shower gift so thankfully I did not buy it myself.  The humidifier itself works great but trying to clean all the little groves is almost imposible.  I keep trying to scrub the little groves with a nipple brush becase that is the only thing that comes close to getting in them. Cleaning the interior of the tank is also a challenge.  I will definitely do my research first next time. The sad part is this humidier is the only one in the baby section at a lot of stores.

product_title: Skip Hop Baby Treetop Friends Activity, Multi
review_body:
Purchased this Activity Gym as it was a requested item by new parents to be on their baby-registry. It arrived today, and I must say it is terrific.

The quality looks excellent. The mat is thickly padded and all of Treetop Friends items are very very cute, colorful and so well made. The sound effects are awesome and I can just imagine the hours and hours of entertainment the infant will have for that 1st year.

The item is package in a plastic half-moon shaped package, and we keep wondering how in the world are we going to wrap this and make it look pretty and yet professional, but I'm sure we will figure it out.

I know the new parents to be will be happy with this gift. RECOMMENDED!

product_title: Cardinal Gates Patio Door Guardian, White
review_body: After reading the directions for this item, I thought I was going to have a hard time installing it because the directions didn't make much sense to me. I wound up totally bypassing the instructions and using common sense to predrill holes for where the screws go, both on the door and up on the track. Besides that the product has been excellent.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Healthy Care High Chair
review_body: Very good high chair.  The snap-in toy and removable tray are especially nice.  The wheel locks tend to get snapped into place by accident pretty easily which is somewhat annoying.  We used this highchair for several years with two kids and it is still in great shape.

product_title: HALO 100% Cotton Sleepsack Swaddle
review_body: I love this sleep sack. The swaddle option is detachable, which is really helpful when Breastfeeding or bed-sharing. The adaptability is greatly appreciated.

product_title: Santamedical 2 In 1 Professional Clinical Large Lcd Non-Contact Infrared Thermometer (Forehead And Surface)
review_body: Service was great on this forehead thermometer.  I bought two for my grandchildren.  You cannot expect 100% accuracy from any of these thermometers.  This one is one of the best on the market.

product_title: Graco Somerset Convertible Crib
review_body: We love this crib, it is gorgeous and looks expensive. It is easy to assemble with two people. I would definitely recommend it to others. My only complaint is the same as other reviewers, the paint comes off easily when teething babies take to chewing on it! One five minute chewing session (that we weren't aware of until we walked into the room) and there was quite a bit of missing paint from the front top rail. I quickly learned that teething covers would be necessary. You could also probably do a non-toxic poly finish to further protect the surface. For the price, it is definitely something I can deal with!

product_title: Itzy Ritzy Snack Happens Reusable Snack and Everything Bag
review_body: Love my new Itzy Ritzy snack bag! Perfect size, fun pattern, and I love that it's washable and reusable! I know I'm going to get a lot of use and save a lot of $ using these bags instead of throw away bags.  I highly recommend!

product_title: Similac SimplySmart Bottle - 8 oz
review_body:
My husband and I did a lot of research on baby bottles before our boy was born. We initially purchased the Dr Brown bottles and returned them because I was fortunate enough to get a free bottle from Similac. Plus, Dr. Brown's seemed to be such a hassle to clean!
Anyways...The one! Main! Extremely important! thing I like about this bottle is the stirrer. I don't have to shake the bottle so vigorously for the formula to break. I simply have to swirl the bottle and the formula dissolves and there's not as much bubbles! FYI, this is the result with room temp and cold water.
The one thing I didn't like about this bottle is that it leaks. ONLY when you have the vent (triangular dip on the nipple) facing downwards. If you face it upwards, you'll have absolutely no problem. I'm sure leaking is one con all bottles share.
Also, some people do complain about the bottle not closing correctly but I haven't had any problem with this and I have several of these bottles.

I will be purchasing more and FYI! Purchasing them at target, walmart, babies r us, and even Similac's site is cheaper than buying on Amazon.

product_title: Disney 4 Piece Minnie's Fluttery Friends Toddler Bedding Set, Lavender
review_body: My 2 year old daughter loves this toddler bed size set.Even after many washes the comforter still looks great and is prety warm too

product_title: UPPAbaby Vista Cup Holder (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I don't understand the other reviews..
review_body: I absolutely love this cup holder.  I bought 2 more because they discontinued it due to all of the horrible reviews.  Yes, it is made of flimsy plastic, but it folds up out of the way if you are going through a tight aisle or a doorway.  It also twists and folds forward, so that you can leave it attached when you fold the stroller.  None of those things would be possible if it wasn't designed the way that it is with the chains and thin plastic.  I have owned mine for a year now and it has never broken.  It fits my water bottle, venti chai latte, can of diet coke, and my son's sippy cup.  Now that I have the extra ones, I attach two, since there are clips on both the left and right side of the stroller.  This way, daddy can have a place for his beverage too.  I have seen the newer model, and I would have to say not to waste your money.  That big hunk of plastic might not break if you hurl it, but you will have to detach it every time you need to fit through a tight squeeze.  The designers had it right the first time. Love this!

product_title: Safety 1st Acella Sport Travel System
review_body: I bought this stroller for my 5th child over 3 years ago from a second hand shop. It is by far the best stroller I have owned and I have been through several. The wheels are sturdy enough to make it through rough terrain. We've used it on many a hike and I take it nearly every day walking my others to school and back. We bounce up and down stairs with it, maneuvered through airports and been abroad with it. It collapses very easily. It's true that it doesn't lay down all the way, however, when the babies were little, I just put them in the carseat that attaches to the stroller. As they get older, it's basically the same position they are in when they are in a carseat and they fall asleep. Never a problem for us.

product_title: Safety 1st Railnet
review_body: The item does what it supposed to...keeps my kids safe. It was a little hard to put together but I figured it out eventually.

product_title: The UMMY: BPA-free 100% Natural Rubber Pacifier with Elongated Nipple, 6 months & up
review_headline: smells terrible and my son hates it
review_body: We got this paci when our son was about 5 months old.  It has a very strong odor and my 9 month old son hates it and never wants to use it.  We decided to store it hoping he will like it better when he's older.

product_title: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_headline: A Video Review of the Cloud B Lady Big Night Light
review_body:
[[VIDEOID:moQ45W2K96ZV8Y]]The Cloud B Twilight Night Light is the perfect addition to a child's room. It provides a gentle light that can help soothing transition into a perfect sleeping routine. The light projects a series of stars (and 1 moon) onto the ceiling in either purple/blue, green, or red. 5 Stars

product_title: Summer Infant Baby Bather with Toybar, Pretty as a Princess
review_body: I havent used it because im still pregnant, but i find it a little big; it doesnt fit all bathtubs,  colors are nice, and the toys too; but I thought it would be a better quality.

product_title: Diono Radian RXT All-In-One Convertible Car Seat, Shadow
review_headline: Best in Safety, Easy to Install and Use
review_body:
We got this car seat as a replacement for our Britax Boulevard for two reasons: first, to lure our 3-year old daughter into sitting rear facing (given the new recommendations to keep them rear facing to at least too and as long as possible, and the compelling evidence from the NTSB regarding how much safer it is for children to be rear facing when sitting backwards), and second, because I was tired of fighting with the straps of our Britax, but couldn't justify a new car seat that wasn't convertible to a booster, given that our kiddo is already 3.

On the first point, we decided on the Diono Radian RXT because, based on our research, it is even safer that the Britax model we own. The steel frame and higher crash test safety standards for the Diono car seat were definitely compelling factors. Side impact panels and side impact testing are a must, and the Radian had that too. The thing about the Radian RXT, though that sold our daughter, was the adorable flower print. We played up that she was getting big girl car seat that was super special because she could sit backward in it! Woo hoo! She was hooked, and the minute the box arrived, she couldn't wait to open it. It took us a few days to install it in our car (a snap! clear directions, LATCH-easy), and during that time our daughter enjoyed sitting in the seat in our living room and showing it off to our visitors. Too adorable! She is really excited about the print, and so am I because it isn't as pink and garish as many prints that are out there for car seats; the neutral brown, blue, green flowers will work with many car interior, fun, but not too over the top \\"kid\\" print (a personal pet peeve of mine). And, she loves sitting backwards...its fun for her! Took some getting used to since I have been enjoying talking and looking at things with her out the window together, but an easy adjustment for her and I got a mirror like I had when she was an infant so I can see her just fine to continue our conversations. She kind of folds up her legs and is happy as a clam.

On the second point, I was slightly wary because the tightening mechanism of the Diono Radian RXT is similar to the Britax we have been fighting with (the strap you pull to tighten the harness). So, upon opening the box, this was one of the first things we tested...and lo and behold, it was a much smoother mechanism than what we currently have. We'd been struggling with ours for so long but held off on getting a new seat because we knew we'd be getting a booster sooner than later. That's why we decided on the Diono Radian RXT--we could justify getting a new seat given that it will convert to a booster seat when she's ready. Love that.

Lots of other little things we love about this seat: you can fold it for easy storage or travel; there's an emergency information card right where you release the harness...smart!; a cup holder option; back carry strap options for airport travel; instruction manual that is attached like others but in a location that is more accessible, at the top of the headrest (I always hated hunching over to read the other books which were under the seat).

All in all, we are all really, really happy with our decision to get this. I feel better knowing that my daughter is safer riding backward and we will keep it up as long as we can!conversations. She kind of folds up her legs and is happy as a clam.

product_title: Boppy 2 Sided Cotton Blend Slipcover, Zoom

product_title: Fresh Baby So Easy Baby Food and Breast Milk Trays
review_body: These were exactly what I wanted for freezing my babies homemade baby food.  They worked great.  I have only hand washed these because other reviews and the manufacturer state that the high temperature in a dishwasher could warp the lids, so they don't fit properly.  And I haven't had any issues with the lids not fitting.

review_body: I am so glad to have found these. The Medela caps leak on the Dr Brown's bottles, and for transporting pumped breastmilk these are way simpler than the nipple+cap+disk thing. And they were cheap!

review_body: Didnt really serve the purpose . I had to keep checking on it every time my baby was on it.

product_title: Kidco Peapod Travel Bed in Lime
review_body:

She loves the noise it makes, she is safe inside. Its comfortable. She feels all tucked away inside. We go to the beach with it, grandma's, and she even enjoy to play in it. The only down side, is that there is no way to really put sheets inside. So I am always using a towel or baby blanket. But we get through it, too many ups not to recommend.

You will love it!

review_body: I have only had this item for a week but i love it. my baby just finished 5 months old. she is tried of swing, bumbo seat. she wants me to hold her standing up and she askes me to jump her. I did that however it is really hard to jump a baby constantly. I had my eye on this item for a long time. I finally ordered it. same day that it arrived i got really sick and my husband wasnt feeling as well. my baby was having a blast and we survived our sickness through this wonderfull thing. otherwise she was going to sit and cry out of boredom. it took her day to fully understand she can control her jumps. once she did she was sooooooo happy. she loves to be on it even when shes not jumping to be in standing position. she goes crazy and I dont get scared if she is secure because design is very nice and smart. my husband as a harsh critic loved it. the other reviewers were saying that it is hard to put baby in and out and i undestand why. the instructions given are the most secure way however not the easiest. I simply slide the baby in very slowly than i make her sit on my lap while i velcro sides evenly and buckle up. practice makes perfect. My husband is cluless how to get her in still other than instructed way:)ohh another thing i hate eye sore baby products and only two cons it has that it is not easy to tuck away, not convient at all and it looks like a little torture chamber on the side of the living room:) (especially when baby is not in it)  but i put up with the way it looks since it makes my life alot easier:)

review_body: I bought this swing because my swing from my 1st son didn't work after being stored. I love the look of this swing. The pictures on it are really cute.
