product_title: PHIL & TEDS Explorer Baby Stroller w/Double Kit - Black
review_body: We are about to have our second child, our first is 3.  We were looking for a more versatile stroller than the bugaboo frog, which I hated to give up, I love it.  However, my 3 year old still loves to ride and I wanted a storller that would accommodate both children without being a wide load.  I read many, many reviews.  What I could gather from most of the negative reviews was what happens in a lot of cases, user error.  We received the stroller and extra seat and my husband, with the help of our three year old put it together.  My husband described the directions like and Ikea diagram...all pictures, so if you need written instructions perhaps this stroller isn't for you.  Positives include:  1. Countless ways to con figure the stroller for two children, but still not taking up any more width than a single wide.  2. Great manueverability, love the three wheels!  3.  Great 5 point harness, much better than the bugaboo and chicco we have.  4. Easy to fold  Negatives include:  1) It is heavy, but so far I haven't found a standard stroller that's not.  It is an investment, however I am planning to use it at least 4 years.  I used our bugaboo for 3, which worked out to about $175 per year, about $15 per month.  This one, given I purchased the base stroller and the doubles kit for the price of the base, will work about about the same...I use my stroller at least 4-5 times a week and on many days more than once.

product_title: Playtex Baby VentAire ADVANCED Standard Bottle 6 OZ - 3 Pack Girl Colors
review_body:
Please note i did not buy our VentAire bottles from the seller listed above, so i have no comments there about transaction. Ours came from Target.

Anyhoo, on to comments re: the bottles.

9 out of 10 days you're gonna be happy enough with these things. they clean well, they hold enough, many babies like the nipple feel, supposedly they reduce tummy upset via less air circulating in the milk out through the nipple into the baby... We were recommended to use them by the NICU since the nipples felt similar to ones our twins were 'orally progressed on' during their time in the hospital before discharge.

putting together one of these bottles requires 5 pieces: 1) the colored vented plastic base, 2) a silicone-ish clear piece that sits in the base which should prevent fluid leaks but allow air to escape past under the clear silicone/plastic 'ring' out the bottom of the bottle (or the top of it once the bottle is in use / tipped) then, 3) the body of the bottle, 4) the nipple, and 5) colored nipple ring.

i do not have a lot of experience with other brands. so, i can not say that this is the only one with a glaring flaw. but let me share my thoughts:

after just having had a leaking episode an hour ago i logged on here to encourage any moms considering these to pause, research, then choose 'the lesser of the evils' whichever bottle that may be.

now, picture yourself having 'one of those days' - that come maybe once a month, where everything is going wrong... your baby is crying even more than usual, your house is even messier than usual, you've lost your keys more than once, etc, etc, and then comes time to prepare a bottle for your wailing unthankful, unsympathetic baby. With your free hand (yes, this is one of those days where baby is glued to your hip to attempt to take the crying down a few notches) So you place the silicone vent/ring into the base and screw that on to the body and then proceed to fill itwith milk/formula.

and then, perhaps you lift the bottle- to place it in the microwave because your baby is one of those who has strict temperature preferences - and at that moment out quickly drips milk, onto yourself, the counter, down the cabinet doors, on the stovetop (since its under the microwave) and then more milk proceeds to drip on the floor as you fly over to the sink as fast as you can to contain the spill.... Milk has been lost, so you'll have to refill the bottle...

if you aren't a swearing person, you might become one for a moment.

i myself would love a letter / press release / phone call from Playtex apologizing for being 'the straw the broke the camels back' now and again. Sheesh.

and of course the problem comes about because it's not that easy to tell if the pieces aren't perfectly tight, so preventing such leaks is bound to be impossible to do everyday.

having read all of the above, i guess the question i would be asking is - are other bottles prone to similar downfalls? are the pluses of this brand/type enough to over-ride this multi-piece leak prone set-up? I really have no clue if they lessened my daughters fussiness at all, i think switching formulas was what brought some improvement...

keep in mind, when properly assembled these haven't spontaneously leaked. so, i/baby don't have problems on a regular basis. nothing drips down her chin as she drinks.

on to other thoughts:

i wish they made these bottles in a 4oz size, i felt like my kid was only twice the size of the 6oz bottle for a few months (OK MAYBE 4 TIMES THE SIZE) ha ha.

currently she's at 17mo (13 actual she was a micro-preemie twin) and doesn't need the 9oz though we had already bought a half dozen of those. Six oz per meal seems to be her max, and she's a good eater, maybe just wants to eat less more often or maybe 9oz will be needed around the corner...

i also didn't lovethat the multi-packs of bottles weren't offered with varied nipple flows. i mean, at least I've never seen them for sale. So, you may end up not using the nipples included in the 3 pack box if your child is above or below the standard level, i think the 3-packs in 6oz come with slow flow since there is no smaller size offered, so 6oz has to be the entry level and come with the slowest nipple even though a new baby on slow flow certainly doesn't drink even half 6oz. And doesn't that extra space (empty ounce-age) leave possibility for more air to circulate and work against this bottles purpose? I would think it would have too....?

i have no complaints with the nipple flow/level options. They are: slow, medium, fast - nipples have english and spanish (such as rapido) on them to avoid mix-ups though i have to stare at the clear word on the clear nipple for some time to ensure i've got the right flow since i have a times used two nipple flows at one time...

Right now i am asking myself why i didn't help myself and store each flow/speed in a different spot to avoid squinting as i prepped bottles (depending on how alert she was we'd have days where slow was good for one meal and medium for the next).... oh well, what mom gets it all down. its seriously never ending the things we parents have to think about...

I'm pretty sure there are other bottles that have more nipple 'speeds' offered, so if you're used to more options that this may frustrate you. i found slow to medium was a harder transition than medium to fast. The packages do give recommended ages for each speed and i would say they were pretty close to how/when my daughter progressed.

Oh, and for anyone who loves the scene in Father-of-the-Bride where the dad's in jail going on about how the hot dog people and the bun people got together to cheat the american public... well, the bottles are sold in 1 or 3 packs and the nipples in 2 packs. Now, I got around it by buying 2 three packs of the 6oz with slow nipples and 3 two packs of medium nipples when i needed a speed other than slow which the 3 pack came with. But, the quantities could cause a problem for some! And that irks me!

Blerg, Playtex, blerg! Thats all I can say. We need you for some things. Yet we dislike you.

Listen to the 'little' consumer and make your products better - even if you don't have to - even if we won't be able to buy anything better! It can't be that hard!?!

I wonder if mothers of babies are the hardest consumer group to please...?

- Beth Nordberg

product_title: Ameda Custom Breast Flanges with Insert
review_headline: It was not what I was expecting
review_body: I was looking for a falange for my lansinoh breastpump.  This one worked but it doesnt replace my broken falange.

product_title: JL Childress Crib Mobile Attachment Clamp, White
review_headline: Not for pack-n-play's or many newer cribs.
review_body:
We purchased this clamp primarily to hold a mobile above the pack-n-play our child slept in for naps. The clamp could not adequately clamp on the pack-n-play's rail and support the weight of the mobile. It would eventually fall over into the pack-n-play.

Then we realized the clamp would not even work on our crib as the top rail of our crib is fairly wide. We actually walked through BabiesRUs with this thing and many of the newer style cribs have a wider rail that this clamp is unable to accomodate.

product_title: Playtex Baby Ventaire Anti Colic Baby Bottle, BPA Free - Gift Set
review_body: I love these bottles. I started out with the Avent bottles, which are nice, but it was always hard to get my baby comfortable to get the last of the formula out of the bottle. The angle and the size of these nipples are great. Highly recommend these bottles. These have the larger nipples so they are more like the real thing and causes less confusion for my son.

product_title: Thirsties Duo Wrap
review_body:
I have been cloth diapering for about 2 months now, and these covers work pretty well as long as you keep your expectations realistic. Diaper covers leak, but so do dispoables, particularly on newborn babies with runny, explosive poop.

We use these during the day, and switch to disposables for nighttime for the absorbency. We started with 5 covers and I've just bought more because some are wearing out. When baby was newborn, we had numerous leaks on the sides--I think the white trim is absorbent and so it would absorb the wetness and it would leak onto her clothes. Now that she poops less frequently, it's not as much of a problem, though it can still happen on occasion. The white trim stains over time also, as does the cover itself--not sure why. I'm experimenting with ways to get the stain out just short of bleaching, but I may resort to a little spot bleaching on the trim at least to freshen these up.

Also, the velcro does seem to wear out on these, and I ALWAYS hang them to dry, I have never dried them in the drier--that would hurt the waterproofness over time. I think if you fasten the velcro strips before washing, that may help--I've tried to do this but have not always done it perfectly.

So, as long as you keep your expectations realistic, these are decent covers, some of the more affordable covers out there too, which is good, though still pricey for just a cover IMO.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Breastcare Essentials Set
review_body:
The Avent Breastfeeding Starter Kit is a great product. You get 12 daytime nursing pads, 6 nighttime nursing pads, 2 thermopads, a bra clip, and a nice case to hold all of it. The nursing pads are very comfortable and absorb excess milk really well while saving your shirt at the same time! The nighttime pads are a little thicker than the daytime ones, which is great for when I leak extra milk during the night.

The thermopads really do help sore breasts and nipples feel some relief. I also like how the pads come with a washable cover to them so you don't have to apply the heat or ice directly to the skin. The little bra clip is such a help because you tend to lose track of which side you used last as all the feedings blend together, especially those nighttime ones! The purple case is great to hold everything and is made of durable, thick material. Plus, when you're done breastfeeding you can use it as a travel case.

I highly recommend this product to any new mom. It would've been nice for them to include some nipple cream for nipple soreness also, but I'm still highly satisfied with what I got.

product_title: Graco Smart Seat All-in-One Convertible Car Seat - Rosen
review_headline: My Son LOVES His New Carseat!!! :)
review_body: Ive read so many mixed reviews about this carseat and was a little hesitant to purchase but I am absolutely HAPPY with my purchase!! Not only does my son no longer cry bloddy murder during car rides ( he hated his infant carseat ) HE LOVES GOING FOR LONG CAR RIDES!!! Ive read that the buckles are hard to get on and off and I am able to do them both with one hand :) I feel this carseat is worth every penny!! It feels so safe and sturdy!! My husband like to say its Hutners First Class Airliner Jet Seat :)  LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS PRODUCT!!! I would definetly recommend this to all my friends!!!

product_title: Fisher-Price 4-in-1 Total Clean High Chair
review_body: I am writing this review simply to reiterate what many others have noted: you have to understand that the dishwasher safe tray top is virtually useless, as most babies will grab the convenient handles and flip that onto the floor at a moments notice.  And the main tray is very difficult to clean as its a pain to keep water from running into the cracks and crevices and causing a mess inside the hollow tray.  It is NOT easy to take the tray apart to clean the inside.  I have twins, otherwise we'd throw this seat out and buy a new one.  As it is, we can't afford to buy TWO new chairs and are stuck.

product_title: Bright Starts Rattle and Shake Barbell Rattle
review_body: So I paid to have this item gift wrapped(more money) and it DID NOT happen!!!!!!!!! What a waste of money and time.. Lesson learned don't pay to have this done by this company.........

product_title: Baby Trend Snap-N-Go EX Universal Infant Car Seat Stroller
review_headline: It doesn't Snap N' Go Stroller
review_body: I bought the Baby Trend Snap N' Go stroller for my chicco keyfit 30 car seat and it does not snap in at all! I would not recommend these two products together. The only thing that holds the carseat into the stroller is a flimsy little strap and at a slight angle the car seat moves....thus no walking up any minor hills or on semi-bumpy roads without putting your baby at risk.  I really liked the idea of having a less expensive stroller option for running errands around town and being able to get in and out of my car without having to transfer a sleeping baby into a stroller. However, if you bought the chicco keyfit 30 (a great car seat), then you should buy chicco's version of the snap n' go to make sure your baby is safe and secure, even if it is double the price. The quality of the stroller is double the value as well so you are getting what you paid for.

product_title: North States Industries Superyard Playard
review_body:
I like it so much I have 2 sets.
It's easy to define layouts, you can attach toys to it and it's very resistant.
I really like it and you can pretty much put it anywhere.
The plastic is not cheap so, it stands well with your home decor.

The only think you have to watch is in case you don't have a closed area, the ends are not stable, so if your baby is trying to stand (like mine is), make sure to have it against a solid place (I have mine against the wall and the other end against a couch in a shape of \\"U\\").

Really recommend this products for parents with babies learning to crawl and walk :)

product_title: Sumersault Charlotte Rug, Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have decorated my daughter's room in the Sumersault Charlotte collection. This is a very cute rug. I have washed it at least twice and it holds up well. It appears to have increased in price. When I purchased it in the summer of 2011 - it was a steal on Amazon for $13.

product_title: North States Supergate Top-Notch Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: For the cheap price, i expected a POS to arrive, but this gate is very solid.  The latch, however, is almost too sturdy and can be tricky to unlock.  If you frequently remove the gate during the day, or have weak hand strength then this one might not be your best choice.  If you set it and forget it once or twice a day... this is the least expensive way to go, while still having a sturdy gate that won't be problematic.

product_title: Infantino Hoodie Universal All Season Carrier Cover, Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I went to Europe in the fall and used this cover everywhere. I have a mei tai style carrier and it fit great. I loved the hood and that there was a place for my hands too. In Paris my 3 month old practically lived in the carrier and we walked everywhere. This cover made it so easy and kept her snuggly and warm. I highly recommend it.

product_title: Safety 1st Heavenly Dreams Stars a Plenty Baby Mattress
review_headline: Great mattress for a great price
review_body: I was skeptical of this mattress because of the great price, but after reading the reviews we decided to go for it. It is a nice firm mattress and our little guy sleeps great on it. No regrets going with the bargain mattress!

product_title: Sassy Ring O' Links Rattle Developmental Toy
review_body: Got this Sassy Ring O'Links Rattle today. My son is 3 months old and he just grabbed it and starting to shake and chew on the pieces. He absolutely loves it! I so recommend this for your baby!

product_title: Stork Craft Hoop Glider and Ottoman Set
review_body: The glider arrived within 2 days - even during the Christmas rush! When you open the box, there is some very MINOR assembly. All it takes is an allen wrench (which comes with the glider set). Just gotta tighten 6 screws and you're done. So far everything seems very sturdy and the glide is smooth. The cushions are nice - the ones on the arms have large pockets on the outside for storage. I haven't had it very long...so we'll see how it holds up. At the moment, I love it! I'm hoping my pregnant sister, for whom it was bought, will love it too.   The only complaint I have so far: when we were putting it together, there were a few screws that did not seem to line up exactly with their pre-drilled holes. It makes me a little nervous. It was difficult to tighten the screws flush with the wood because things lined up off center.  All in all though - I'm very happy with this product.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Jumperoo (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter who is 4 months absolutely loves it. There's so many little trinkets for her to play with and keep her occupied especially while I'm cooking in the kitchen. This is a must have!!

product_title: Lamaze Soft Chime Garden
review_body: Colorful, musical, adorable. This toy has a couple different modes of play. In our favorite mode, the flowers- when played with will light up one by one and play a musical note. For the price and size, I felt that this toy was a tad pricey when just viewing it on the computer, but after we received it and had a chance to let our twoddler (not quite a baby, not quite a toddler) play with it and our baby enjoy it as well, we felt it was well worth the splurge.

product_title: Miracle Blanket Swaddling Baby Blanket - Unisex Colors
review_body: My daughter was colicky starting day 2! In the hospital!! Even the nurses couldn't figure out how to help us with her in order to calm her, and as new parents it was soooo hard. We struggled with it for about 5 weeks, one of us ALWAYS had to be awake with her because the only way she'd sleep was if we were either bouncing her or rocking her! Talk about stress. Finally, I thought to myself, hey, let's try this swaddle thing! I had received this as a gift during my pregnancy so we had it on hand. Let me tell you, the second we wrapped her, then rocked her- SHE WAS OUT like a light! And I placed her in her bouncer to see how long it would last, feeling very cynical about it all, and she was asleep for 3 hours. She's now almost 5 months old, and still sleeps with this blanket. It's the only way she'll sleep, and she sleeps about 16 hours every night! I know, isn't that crazy? Swaddling really saved our household, and then we followed that with sleep training, and we feel like we're normal again! I would recommend this for anyone with a finicky sleeper! Definitely worth having on hand with a baby... especially if you cannot swaddle with a receiving blanket- which I personally am no good at.

product_title: Tomy Lamaze Play andGrowTake Along Toy
review_body: The peacock is bright and fun, but as another reviewer said it is hard to grab. Our daughter has had the tug & play too and that engages her more. She has been enjoying both at ages 4-5 months and probably will for some time.

product_title: MAM Ba 7022-024-4-1 MAM Mini Cooler Teether with Clip Green Green
review_body: I ordered this for our early teether thinking that maybe he could put it his mouth and would help his teeth and gums.  However upon recieving ..this thing is massive what baby could get this in their mouth?  I did not open and will be returning ASAP wast of money.

product_title: Natural Touch Baby Bottle and Nipple Drying Rack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
UPDATE 10/15/17: Five + years later and I am still using this as a drying rack for my stainless steel insulated cups that are not dish-washable. It works great!

This bottle rack is great for drying my daughters sippy cups. It has a place to stash the valves and the lids. The arms on the rack snap up when not in use and it has a removable drip tray so its easy to clean. It also works well with my large water bottles and reusable coffee cups. It takes up more counter space than I had anticipated due to it having a round foot print instead of the square one like my old rack had. I would buy this again but I think this one will last forever.

product_title: Skip Hop Studio Diaper Tote Bag
review_body: I was hoping for more room with this but it does the trick. Also, not too happy about the plastic straps as this was a $90 bag. We'll see how it all holds up.

product_title: NUK Gerber Graduates Learning System Sports Learning Cup Tumbler, 9-Ounce
review_body: My son never liked regular sippy cups with the spout sticking up.  He couldn't drink very well from them and after months of trying to get him to take to it, I bought one of these. This was when he was 13 months old and he took right to it chugging his milk from it! We took out the plug because it was hard to drink with it in. He can drink from a regular cup all by himself without spilling now (he is 18 months old) but we still like to use these when we are going places.  The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because the cap is kind of hard to clean around the spout on the inside.  I have to use a q-tip to get in the little grooves, they should have just filled that area in with more plastic so liquid couldn't flow in there. But not a big deal, I would definitely recommend this!

product_title: IKEA Children's Kids Table & 2 Chairs Set Furniture
review_body: This set is really nice and easy to assemble. I get it from IKEA store for 20$ only and I am really happy with it.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_headline: Soft fabric, comfortable for mom and baby
review_body: The moby takes a little practice to put on but the photo instruction manual is very well worded and easy to follow. Once I got the hang of it I learned to put the wrap on in less than a minute. It is very comfortable to wear. The fabric is soft and breathable and it acts as back support while wearing. My daughter loves to be upright and close to me. The Moby allows both and me to have two free hands. LOVE this product. Wish i would have had it sooner. Holds up to washing machine very well and the design is very pretty.

product_title: Ameda Purely Yours Breast Pump Car Adapter
review_body: When in a traffic jam or on a long trip, this little gadget helps a TON with making pumping in the car easy. Small enough to keep in a purse or diaper bag, but still allows enough cord to pump from any outlet in the car.

product_title: Playtex Baby The First Lil' Gripper Twist 'n Click Straw Cup 7 OZ: Girl Colors
review_body: Great for learning to drink with a straw because you can squeeze the \\"cup\\" to show baby how the straw works. My daughter figured it out immediately. However, she has a hard time swallowing when using a regular width straw - a wider straw is easier for her. Also, as others noted, the straw doesn't hit the bottom, which leads to waste.

product_title: Boppy Flying Circus Play Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Looks great, the cost could be lower
review_body: The only complaint is the cost point. The arch will only be able to be used for a short period until your child can master their grab reflex. The item is visually appealing compared to the other choices out there with straight primary colors. The 4 stars is the reflection of the product cost to quality.

product_title: Lorex LW2003 LIVE snap Video Baby Monitor (White) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Worked for about 8 months then the charging bottom broke
review_body: Worked for about 8 months until the charging part to the video viewer broke. Ok product wish it had lasted longer.

product_title: Honeysuckle Breast Milk Storage Bags, 50 Bags (2 Packs of 25)
review_body: I bought these after reading the reviews & I'm so happy I did. So much better than the medela bags I was using. Highly recommend them.

product_title: Skip Hop Grab-and-Go Pacifier Pocket, Red
review_body: We used this for about 1 month...it would not stay snapped to our diaper bag so we had to store it inside the bag.  Then the zipper broke!  So now I am going to buy a different brand to replace it. Not happy with the quality. Could barely fit 2 Nuk pacifiers in it.

product_title: Tiny Love Day and Night Soother
review_headline: Strobe light not appropriate for infants
review_body:
We installed this on the crib. One day later I went in to see why our 4 month old was suddenly crying. The light was flashing like a strobe light every second or maybe more frequently. When I went to check the batteries, I saw that the \\"included C\\" batteries were actually cheap (\\"heavy duty\\") AA batteries in C spacers which can't possibly handle the drain of the mechanical parts.

I was absolutely disgusted. If you are that desperate to cut corners on price, just don't include batteries. Don't put batteries in that will cause me to expose my child to a strobe light.

product_title: Safety 1st Complete Air 65 LX Convertible Car Seat, Cadmium
review_headline: Can I take it on the plane?
review_body: Hey I am interested in this product, but I travel a lot and want to know if it will fit in a plane seat?

product_title: Mommys Helper Outlet Plug
review_body: I am quite satisfied with these outlet plugs.  They fit securely into the outlet so a toddler will definitely not be able to pull it out.  I also think they are just easy enough for me to get out to use the outlet when I need it.

product_title: Mommys Helper 70456 Portable Shower Arm Mount, Suction Cup
review_body: Read reviews prior to purchasing and was apprehensive since a few negative reviews regarding the suction of the shower arm. Rec'd the package and within 30 seconds had it stuck on the shower tile wall. Thought maybe the thing would fall off after awhile, so I had my 8 yo daughter try it out and somewhat abuse it. It's been several weeks and still stuck on the wall. No problems whatsoever. Even ended up buying another one for a different shower.

product_title: Sesame 2 Count  Sheet Set
review_body: Very cute. My twin toddlers LOVE them! The fabric is cheap (maybe 200 thread count) and feels like it would be itchy to me... but I dont think they care.

product_title: Carter's Plush Security Blanket
review_body: This security blanket was so cute. I ended up using it for the topper on a pink/animal print diaper cake. It was perfect- mom truly loved it!

product_title: bumGenius One-Size Hook & Loop Closure Cloth Diaper 4.0
review_body: We love cloth diapers at our house and my son's \\"bum\\" enjoys them as well.  During the day we use prefold and bummis covers, but they just were not holding enough in at night.  We went to our local cloth diaper store and they recommended these diapers, as well as the fuzibunz pocket diapers.  The fabric insert in these diapers are like a bath towel, as opposed to the fuzibunz which are more like a soft blanket, but the fabric that touches the skin is the same nice soft fabric.  We had a little leakage the first night with the fuzzibunz, but no leak with this brand.  My son is almost 5 months and has a pretty steady and heavy flow.  So far pretty happy.  Tip: When washing make sure to velcro the tabs together onto the inside part of the diaper, this will make the velcro last longer!!! Happy diapering and thanks for caring enough about your child and the environment to look into cloth!!!

product_title: Joovy Room Portable Playard
review_body: I purchased this play yard shortly after my second child was born. I needed something larger than a typical play yard as well as something sturdy to keep my newborn in without fear of my 15 month old climbing in or pulling over. This play yard has been the best!! A complaint I read in reviews before purchasing was the weight; however, the weight of the play yard gives me more peace of mind knowing that it's sturdy and my 15 month old can't pull it over with my newborn in it. It is super easy to set up and take down. Sturdy like a rock! Only complaint is that it did have a funky smell when you first open, but disappeared soon after. Love it! Would highly recommend.

product_title: Baby Blooms 1 Pair Pyjama Cupcakes
review_body: I ordered this item in blue ad received it in pink.  I figured mistakes happen, so I returned it for a replacement.  They sent me pink again.  I called Customer service and they told me the items were marked wrong in their warehouse, so more than likely I would receive another pink.  He told me my best bet was to accept a refund.    If that's not bad enough,  this is the second time this has happened to me in the last five orders I placed.  I will stick to the store or a more reliable site.

product_title: Playtex VentAire Standard Bottles, 3 Pack
review_headline: It does the job, but it's not miraculous
review_body: I had been hearing how my new nephew was sick with colic, and I thought I'd try to be a hero and get them some of these, cause it says it reduces colic. Only I found out they had been using these all along. So, you shouldn't get these hoping for miracles.  But, at least the design is sound. Have you ever sucked the air from a soda bottle, then felt the coke rushing into your mouth afterward? That's what a baby must feel after sucking on a regular bottle all day. This new design the air to flow out the bottom end, without spilling milk, and that results in a comfortable flow of milk for the baby. So, that's a good thing.  It's a good product, but I gotta wonder what took us so long? It seems like a obvious idea. You're going to need baby bottles, they may as well be these.

product_title: Fisher-Price SpaceSaver Bounce 'n Spin Froggy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased one of these as a Christmas present for my 5 month old granddaughter, and my daughter reported that it is a winner! I then decided to get another one to keep at my home for family visits. I saw the baby in the bouncer for the first time last week, and she was having a blast! The bouncer kept her delightfully occupied while the rest of us enjoyed an uninterrupted dinner. The space-saving size is perfect for tucking away until the next visit.

product_title: Team Purple & Gold Yellow Stripe baby leg warmers for boy or girl by juDanzy
review_body: Bought these because we are Minnesota Vikings fans and needed something for my Little One to wear on game day! :) Love the colors. Material is just ok, a little lacking compared to other leggings I have purchased. They don't stay over my baby's chubby thighs unless I have them pulled up to just under her diaper. That is a little disappointing as I don't want them that close in case of a diaper blow out.

product_title: Cars 2 Head Set - Child Std.
review_body: Cheap price for a cheaply made product, but it served it's one day purpose.  If you buy this item, be sure to press the velcro pieces together well or you'll be missing pieces, mainly the microphone. The actual head piece probably would've fit better if my son was 7 and not 2-years old.

product_title: Regalo My Cot
review_body:
The cot is perfect sized for my 6 year old step son. We are sharing a space that has limited room in it and he sleeps so well on it. It is constructed well, he is almost 50 pounds and it holds up well for him. I put a twin sheet set on it (to make it feel more like a real bed), and it's super baggy, but he doesn't seem to mind.

Will be fantastic for slumber parties, trips to my parents, trips to his grandparents house, and camping.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Designed To Nourish 6 Ounce Toddler Hard Spout Training Cup
review_body: Our 9 month old loves this little cup.  She can hold it, bang it around and its super easy to clean too!

product_title: Tiny Love Take Along Mobile, Animal Friends
review_body: This is the only mobile I found that could have attached to my son's playpen. It could have been made to move a little faster and be a little louder but,once your surroundings are not too noisy, you won't regret it! As I said it definitely does the job!

product_title: Mary Meyer Print Pizzazz 12" Plush Pillow Body
review_body: such a CUTE PILLOW...ANY LITTLE GIRL WOULD FALL IN LOVE. i SAW IT AT A BIRTHDAY PERTY...(IT WAS THE HIT OF THE GIFTS) AND HAD TO HAVE ONE FOR OUR BABY...WE GOT THE BABY OWL, BUT THEY ARE ALL CUTE!!!

product_title: Munchkin Stay Put Suction Bowl, 3 Count
review_body: The reason I bought this product is because of the suction functionality at the bottom. Although it's one of the strongest suction power cups that I've had, it's still not able to stay put. I am not a big fan of the bowl shape and diameter. the smallest bowl is a little too small to my liking. Also another cons is that the lid can be hard to close sometimes.

product_title: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_body: We bought these for Christmas for our two grandchildren.  They both love them.  They shipped on time, was received in plenty of time, and the product was all it was thought to be.

product_title: Baby Brezza Baby Food Maker Machine  - One Step Steamer and Blender - Puree Baby Food For Pouches - Mixes Organic Food for Infants and Toddlers
review_body: Just received this on Friday, have already made multiple batches of baby food with it and overall I love it. The only work required is to chop the veggies and add water, and this machine really does the rest. My only very minor complaints are 1) that the instructions are a big confusing (directions say to use 160ml of water, but the container is marked to measure 180ml, but after a few batches it was easy to eyeball how much you really needed) and 2) the blade is a bit hard to get out after it's finished to really get all of the food out (trial and error showed that you need to take the blade out while the cup is still attached to the base and then it's easy to get all of the puree out). Overall, however, the instructions are very easy to understand and the machine is easy to use and very efficient! I was able to make carrots, sweet potatoes and butternut squash purees over the course of a couple of hours while still getting other things done around the house. This will even be ideal for some single servings of adult foods like mashed potatoes. One butternut squash made multiple servings, so I think the savings do offset the cost of this machine over time.

product_title: Safety 1st Prograde Complete Family Thermometer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We were really happy with this thermometer.  We had been using the rectal probe primarily since we had a child under the age of 1.  We felt that the readings were accurate but really how do you know which thermometer is the correct one?  Anyway, we had no problems with the thermometer until the battery died.  The battery cover is attached to the back with a screw.  This is common on many items and we understand the safety concerns and the need for this.  However, this screw is so tiny and is set so far into the thermometer, we can not find a screwdriver to undo it.  We have purchased two different screwdrivers and none of them work.  Thus, the thermometer is basically useless once the batteries die.  The last thing you want to be doing is battling the thermometer when you have a sick kiddo.  I would consider looking elsewhere for a thermometer unless you have a very well stocked toolbox!

product_title: Baby Buddy Secure-A-Toy, Safety Strap Secures Toys, Teether, or Pacifiers to Strollers, Highchairs, Car Seats—Adjustable Length to Keep Toys Sanitary Clean
review_body: I bought the red/silver pair, and love it. It's so handy and keeps baby's toys in check. I think I would lose a lot of his toys even if I had a second pair of eyes without these straps. There are three snap buttons on these straps, and you get to adjust the length as you choose at each of these snaps. I think I will keep one on the car seat and the other on the high chair.

product_title: Gund Baby Spunky Plush Puppy Toy Small, Tan (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This item is great. Even has a sound chip in it that makes barking noises. Would recommend to most. Thank you very much

product_title: Yellow COMFORT SILKIE Security Blanket ~ The Original. The Best. Award Winning.
review_body: We had a sort-of emergency in losing the original blankie my son owned. I found this one after much searching, to find the closest to his other blankie that was actually 4 years old. Was afraid I'd never find anything like it again. Thank goodness this was found! I suggest ordering 2, one for home, one for travel if your babies love blankies! Your baby will love this one!  Great quality, washes up nicely, a life-saver in some situations!! Many colors and yet simple, no weird heads or rattles attached. Just simply, blankie!

product_title: Munchkin Safety Toddler Bed Rail, White/Blue
review_body: It came in a million parts and wasn't all that much fun to put together but once it is together it just works. We installed this several months ago and I have 0 complaints about it.

product_title: Lil' Diner Baby Diner-Dish Holder
review_body: My 13 months old son was able to remove the dish holder within 15 min. I attached the dish holder to his high chair and at first it seemed very sturdy. Went I went to the kitchen to get his cereal bowl and attach it, my son removed the dish holder. Thus I do not recommend this product.

product_title: Contours Options Tandem Stroller, Ruby (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I absolutely love this Stroller. It has multiple pros.   **it has LOTS of storage room underneath for lots of stuff, bags, jackets, food etc.   **it is sooooo easy to navigate over any terrain.  **anyone who's struggled with collapsing a Stroller will love it, its a snap to collapse. And to take off the seats or the car seat adapter in no time.  **sturdy.  **goes through doors easy  **the seats reclined.  **it comes with one car seat adapter and two seats for older kids. No other post mentioned this, and that concerned me after I purchased. But was so relieved it came with three options.  **u can use just one seat...   ....sooo much more pros too many to mention.  Only con I can think of, it is kinda bulky. It fit very very easily in my suv, but I gottta wiggle it to get it in my lil compact car. Which is ok, I'm a tough girl. I get it in there!! You just have to put the seats on top after u get it in.   Oh and my two year old (almost two anyway) her feet hang off, which kinda stinks, but she likes it.  I get compliments every time I use it.

product_title: Kinderglo Portable Fun and Safe Rechargeable Night Light, Moose (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My kid loves this nightlamp. It is made of durable plastic and the timer for 30 minutes is a good feature. There are multiple light setting options - multiple colors fading, or single color. On the whole its perfect for our need - keeps the light on until the child falls asleep and is rechargeable. Definitely a good buy!

product_title: Born Free Trainer Cup, Colors may vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: When we ordered this product, we saw that there were assorted colors and we were unable to chose one that we preferred.  We hoped that we would receive a gender neutral color but received a pink cup with pink lids and we have two boys.  Now we have to return the product.  We will not be ordering this item again as we do not want to potentially get another pink cup.  We rated this product with 3 stars.  We do not know specifically how this product works. We wish we would have had a color choice option.

product_title: Tadpoles ABC Floor Mats
review_body: These mat are easy to lay out and put away because they are light weight. They cover a generous area for your child to play on.

product_title: Graco Comfort Sport Convertible Car Seat, Jordan (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this seat; it's not super easy to transfer from one car to another (I have to have my husband do it). The side cup is great for snacks and a skinny sippie cup which is perfect for our little boy. Seat works great :)

product_title: Chicco Dance Baby Walker - Flower Power
review_body: I just got this yesterday and my daughter loves it already! her feet still aren't completely flat on the floor, even at the lowest height adjustment, so she won't be trying to \\"walk\\" in it just yet but she really loves the face on the music tray and all of the music. she lights up whenever the music plays & the lights flash and she sorta bounces/dances in it. it's adorable. I like that it has 6 brake pads, so she doesn't accidentally hurt herself and I like the height adjustments so she can use it longer. I also really like the colors and the seat print. another great thing about it is that the seat is the perfect size for my daughter, so it just cradles her instead of being too big for her. a good brand, very easy set-up, definitely recommended.

product_title: Petunia Pickle Bottom Touring Tote Turkish Twilight
review_body: This is a great bag for when children get a little older, it is not large enough to be a main diaper bag with an infant. Larger size diapers reach the top of the bag and when the 4 inside pockets are full, accessing the center compartment is tough. But for a toddler, this holds everything we need for daily trips. The external side pockets are large enough for an ipod or pacifiers, not much else. The changing pad provided is very small and cloth (which could get messy) so I simply took a changing pad from another bag and use it with this one. The pocket for the changing pad is quite large and any of my 3 changing pads fit right in!  Quality is fantastic, the variety of straps make switching from a hobo to a cross body bag a breeze. Overall, love this bag.

product_title: Medela Replacement Parts Kit Pump In Style Advanced ( Old model #57026, #57060 made before 8/2006) BPA Free #PISKITA-STD
review_body: Product is exactly what I needed. After an issue of getting my package out their door, my package arrived quickly when they received an email from me.

product_title: North States Industries Supergate Easy Close Metal Gate
review_body: This gate keeps my two year-old out of the bunkbed room while allowing access for my six year-old.  Opening and closing the gate is easy and can be done with one hand.  If you open the gate to the fully open position, it holds itself open which is nice.  I had another gate that flopped aroud that I got rid of... it caused too many bumps and bruises.  Installation is fairly easy.  I did not use the wall cups and the gate stays in place just fine.  Uninstalled, the gate looks warped, but that is to create a good compression fit.  Make sure you tighten everything up so that the gate locks properly.

product_title: NEW Valve × 4 & Membranes × 6 Replacement for Medela Breastpumps Part #87089
review_body: I got these hoping they could work in a pinch if I needed extra membranes. Unfortunately, they didn't work well. I used these membranes with the original yellow valves, and one side did not work at all -- the membrane wasn't flush against the valve, so there was no suction. So I used these valves with the new membranes, and they worked well enough to provide some suction, but there was a loss of suction, so I had to turn up the pump to the point where I was uncomfortable on one side. There was a \\"hissing\\" noise as some air leaked. (Note: I am using them with the Symphony breast pump, but I think the parts are the same for all Medela pumps except the Freestyle.)  Do not buy these. Buy the original Medela valves/membranes instead.

product_title: Sock Monkey Snuggle Buddy Rattle by Baby Starters
review_body: This product turned out to be even more adorable in person, than when seeing it online! It's soft and perfect for baby to hold. The family also has quite a collection of Sock Monkeys, so this fit RIGHT in!! Thank you!

product_title: Munchkin Sesame Street Toddler Bowl
review_headline: Elmo gets my son to eat
review_body: This bowl is great. My son loves to eat whatever i put in the bowl because he cannot wait to get to the bottom to see Elmo. If your child is an Elmo lover like  mine, I recommend this bowl.

product_title: Superstar Blue Toddler Bedding 4-Piece Set for Boys
review_body: When I first saw this in person, I was truly satisfied! This bedding set has bright, clear lines and goes wonderfully in my son's crib. I know that it is a toddler bed set, and it will eventually be used as such. However, right now, it is a great compliment to a shared room!

product_title: Itzy Ritzy Shopping Cart and High Chair Cover, Social Circle Blue
review_body: I just got this in the mail, and it is even cuter in person than it was on-line! I love that it is reversible and plush!  I wish they had these when I was little!  A very cute baby shower gift!

product_title: GroVia Reusable Baby Cloth Diaper Wipes, 12 Count
review_body: I have tried several types of cloth wipes and these are hands down the best.  They fit perfectly into my wipes box when folded in half.  They are super soft and baby never complains about them being scratchy (like she does with others).  We use them for face clothes, baby wipes, tissues, etc etc etc.  Since we cloth diaper they get washed right along with our diapers and come out bright white clean every time.  GROVIA rocks!

product_title: North States Supergate Clear Choice, Wood Gate
review_headline: Well made gate constructed within the U.S.A
review_body: Excellent gate.  Solid construction.  Works well.  Made in U.S.A.  Shipped quickly.  Packaged very well.  Pleased with the company and its product, as well as its service.

product_title: Dreambaby Extra Tall Swing Close Gate
review_headline: Good for kids, not as good for big dogs
review_body: I bought this gate and an additional extention for my 70 lb dog that has a habit of scratching at the door while we're out.  The doorway is ~44\\" (if I remember right) wide and with the extra 7\\" extension, the gate fits just right.  It is pretty sturdy, but not enough for a determined dog.  He is able to pull it out when he wants to, at least one side on the bottom.  If it was being used for kids, or smaller animals though, it would work great.

product_title: Tinkerbell Fairies 8 Round Wall Clock in Printed Box
review_body: this is a vey cute clock with great colors but it is very small. it arrived quickly and works well.

product_title: Keekaroo Cafe Booster
review_body: This is a great product and my kids love it! Its is very comfortable and easy to clean. It comes in fun colors.

product_title: Annabel Karmel Lunch Box
review_body:
I love this lunch box! I came looking for it after seeing the advertisement in Parenting magazing. Wanted to buy it as a lunchbox for my 3rd grader but was a little dismayed reading the size description.

However, when it came in the mail--It IS small but still easily holds a three course meal that is sizeable enough for my 8 year old. It has an area for a sandwich and/or main course and two equal sized containers for sides. A fork and spoon in the top--which ARE a bit too little for her--and a kind of plate/lid that can be used to lay out food. My daughter nor I have had any trouble removing or putting back together the pieces of this puzzle-like lunchbox. We've been using it for about six months now and haven't had any issues.

Some people have said it's flimsy--Yeah, a little bit. Not breakable flimsy though, unless you were pretty rough and tumble with it. For lunch, I pack the entire box inside my daughter's clothe lunch box--along with her canteen--and so far so good.

Pretty cool and useful little purchase, especially for how low the price is.

product_title: Owl , Squirrel Porcupine Tree Top Friends Single Toggle Switch Wall Plate Cover Switchplate
review_body: This switch plate cover is a great accent to your room. It is of great quality just like all the happi tree items. I put this in my granddaughters room as the final touch. it is great

product_title: JJ Cole Bundleme Lite, Stone, Infant (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: just got mine in the mail and this is so innovative! it seems super comfy and warm. the only thing i wished is that it zipped all the way up and had a peep/ventilation hole for the baby. other than that im glad i bought it.

product_title: The First Years Breastflow BPA Free Bottle 3-Pack
review_body: As a primarily nursing mom, I loved these bottles at first because my baby took them easily - no nipple confusion or any problems.  BUT, some of them leak.  I can't figure out whether it's a certain one of the nipples in my set or whether any of them could leak at some time.  I've emailed the company and hope they will refund me or replace them.  If not, I might pitch them all, because it's REALLY annoying to have to change out the nipple mid-feeding if milk starts pouring out under the cap.

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Jumperoo
review_body: recieved as promised. send fast. no problem at all. Baby loves it. Easy to set up. No problems yet. liked the price

product_title: Taggies Little Love Note Blanket
review_headline: Won't go to bed without it!
review_body: I received the yellow one as a gift when my daughter was born almost 3 years ago.  She became so attached to it we had to have her Grandma make replacement ones so we could wash the original.  We could not leave the house without it.  She always took it to bed with her and it comforted her in new situations.  After her brother was born early this year she just gave it up and we passed it along to him.  I am now ordering more and hoping it is the same as our original.  He did not take to Grandma's substitutes.

product_title: Wubbanub Infant Pacifier - Lion with satin mane
review_body: I bought this lion and the puppy when my son was 4 months old and he started teething. He loves it and I love it too! I have received a compliments on how cool the product is and I tell other moms to check it out at Amazon.com =)

product_title: Joovy Nook Highchair
review_headline: Finally Found a High Chair I LOVE!
review_body: After two years of looking for a highchair (and trying all of my very cool friends' chairs) and never finding one I even liked - had given up on our first child and never even bought one. For our second child the quest began again and after 5 hours of research I settled on this one and I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE it! It really does open and collapse with one hand (and some help from my foot). I brought it to my in-laws on Sunday for lunch and it was easy to fold up and bring. It is very sturdy for a portable chair! My first child now wants her own... we got the orange one and it looks great in baby pics too :0) At last a high chair that is made for kids and moms!

product_title: Bright Starts Bounce-A-Bout Activity Center, Pink, Style May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: She loves to try her legs and get up and bounce!  I have had so much fun watching her dance in this, such a joy!

product_title: Lansinoh Manual Breast Pump
review_headline: Was able to breastfeed for over a year because of this pump!
review_body: I had initially purchased the Medela Pump-In-Style. I found it to be very uncomfortable, I chaffed, and was barely able to get any milk. Even tried switching flange sizes, and it still hurt. Someone recommended this pump to me and I am so glad. Best money I ever spent. It is very comfortable, easy to take apart and clean. I used it with medela bottles. Also, the customer service from this company is the best. I needed new parts for my manual pump, and they don't sell them in Canada. After I contacted them, they offered to send me the parts... free of charge!! I am now a huge fan of this company and recommend them to anyone.

product_title: Born Free Drinking Cup
review_headline: Baby can easily stretch the spout hole
review_body: My baby had this 1 day and was able to stretch the hole in the spout to the point of liquid pouring out! This is not a good drinking cup! product_title: Moby Wrap Original 100% Cotton Baby Carrier, Navy
review_headline: Not very practical for a baby carrier.
review_body: I was so sure i would love this baby carrier because there were so many positives reviews. This is basically a massive piece of stretchy cotton fabric that you have to wrap around yourself just right so that the baby can fit in safely and comfortably. I found it very frustrating to learn how to use, and every time I wanted to take my baby out for a few minutes or nurse her I had to unwrap myself and then start the whole process over. It also made me feel very hot wearing it.  However if you do get used to the whole wrapping thing, this is alot more comfortable on your back, shoulders, and neck than the other types of carriers.

product_title: Munchkin Bath Fun Bubble Blower, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Amazon.  Please remove this product from your listings.  I have never seen such a promising toy fail this awfully.  I first thought it was my batteries, and rotated in 5 sets of batteries, until I came here to see if I was missing something.  I was.  It might be the worst product I have ever bought.

product_title: Tommee Tippee Closer to Nature Newborn Starter Set
review_body: I bought these before our son was born because 1) they were cute and 2) the nip looked as close to the real thing I could find. I have been using them for a few months now and am not very impressed. First, the name of them is suitable because they are so top heavy that they tip over all the time. The bottles are also hard to clean since there is an apprecable lip inside the bottle that collects residue that I can't seem to get with the bottle brush. I end up putting my fingers in there and cleaning it. Lastly, they are incredibly expensive. I won't be buying them again and will instead be switching back to Avent (which we used with our first baby with no problems). The great thing about Avent is you can use a little adapter available and turn them into sippy cups.

product_title: Baby Trend Snap-N-Go EX Universal Infant Car Seat Stroller
review_body: This stroller works great with my daughters Evenflo Discovery infant seat.  It's easy to push and unlike other reviewers I found the basket space to be easy to use.  My only regret is that I didn't have one when my oldest daughter was born.  I recommend it to anyone that needs a stroller for their infant carseat and doesn't want to pay high prices for the matching stroller.  Also it takes up less space than the Evenflo strollers and can easily be lifted with one hand if necessary.

product_title: IKEA Children's Kids Table & 2 Chairs Set Furniture
review_headline: You get what you pay for
review_body: The title says it all. The table is worth the purchase but the chairs are almost throw away. They're very light so when my daughter sits in them the center of gravity is way too high making the chairs want to tip over. She already has one busted lip and if un-changed I'm sure there will be more so I'm going to cut the legs down a little and hope for the best. In the nature of full disclosure I do need to admit that my daughter is 16 months old and while very active and well balanced, she does shift around a lot which magnifies the problem.

product_title: BreathableBaby Breathable Mesh Crib Liner
review_body: Just attached the bumper to our 7 month old's crib. Simple concept and design, with enough length for different size cribs. Great padding and air-holes. I am happy with it and will post any dislikes or likes if they arise! I would recommend to anyone, especially if your child(ren) like to move around and wave their feet while they sleep!

product_title: Playtex 3 Pack BPA Free VentAire Wide Bottles
review_body: I primarily breastfeed my kiddos, but I like to keep a few bottles on hand to help when I'm not around. These have been some of my favorite bottles that I've used with my son. product_title: Ginsey Bath Mat
review_body: Like it a lot!  Some people complained about the smell, but it didnt bother me and went away in a day.  It's pretty nice!

product_title: Mary Meyer Wubbanub 6" Sweet Chocolate Plush Pacifier, Pink Puppy
