product_title: Summer Infant Secure Sight Digital Color Video Baby Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This product really sucks!  Only purchased for 6mths, doesn't work anymore.  Really ousy product, DO NOT BUY!!!  Or else you will regret.

product_title: Playtex VentAire Standard Bottles, 3 Pack
review_body: I love these bottles! As a first time mom, I was very new in choosing bottles but I did know, I wanted the curving style. These were also recommended by a friend. Dishwasher safe! I do both depending on if it's a night my dishwasher needs more stuff to fill up with. My son is 3 months and have been using these since day 1 and no appearance of too much wear or anything.   I like and dislike the many pieces. Like because I know for sure all that the bottle itself gets very clean down at the bottom as well. but dislike because of the hassle of all the parts, but because of the good cleaning it gets, doesn't bother me too much.  Never had a problem with nipple collapsing or leaking as long as you have the parts screwed on correctly.  I had two bottle warmers because the first one I thought was just the brand, and ended up returning both of them because I figured out it was because of the bottoms. We have since just stuck with room-temp water and my son doesn't mind it at all.  I have no reason to turn to another brand (decided to try the evenflo curved ones and that was a fail!) so I will stick with these for my future children as well.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: Grandson 1 year and grandaughter 5 months - got one for each and they love them.  One of their favorite sources of music because they can hold them easily and it has nice variety of music.

product_title: LA Baby 2 in 1 Crib Mattress with Jacquard Cover & Organic Cotton Layers
review_body: I had to order this twice because the first time I ordered, the shipment missed the arrival date and was not moving at UPS tracking. Amazon was really good with refunding the first mattress which is still in limbo and probably never made it out of the warehouse. Anyways, when the second order arrived, I was pleasantly surprised to find it did not smell bad, it had a nice cotton covering and featured both an infant side and toddler side. You can tell which is which since the toddler side is a bit more plush. Plus, there are stickers telling you which is which in case you can't tell. I wanted an organic crib mattress but didn't want to spend $300+ so this is perfect.

product_title: Munchkin Arm and Hammer Nursery Fresheners
review_body: We have purchased the regular Arm & Hammer discs at the store and I did not read the description closely enough to realize that these are scented.  The scent was so overpowering that we threw them right in the trash.  Completely disgusting.  also, they are much smaller than the unscented discs we have purchased previously.  Overall, very disappointing.

product_title: Stork Craft Tuscany 4-in-1 Convertible Crib
review_body: Crib was very nice, but instructions were terrible, took twice as long to get together, because they were attached to the bottom of the base, and very vague. So you better be good at figuring things out by looking at otherwise your on your own.

product_title: My Little Seat Infant Seats
review_headline: Simple to pack easy for travel
review_body: I bought this when we went on our first vacation, my son was 6 months. It held him good enough for meals. He's a little short but it will work even better when he's 8 months and up! Also took it to Christmas and every time we go to friends now. We don't have to take turns with high chairs anymore! Love it!

product_title: Recaro ProSPORT High Back Booster Car Seat - Midnight
review_headline: Even better than the previous model
review_body: I own a Recaro Young Sport and I love it! So when buying a second car seat for my other child, I was concerned that this newer model would not be as good... for some reason it didn't look as cool in the picture.  Well I can safely say that this is even better! Same sturdiness, very comfortable and well built, but they have worked out the quirks in the Recaro Young Sport to produce this one, for me the perfect car seat. The only thing that's not ideal is that you can forget about switching it between your cars. Way too heavy and cumbersome. But that's the price you pay for top safety and quality I guess.  This seat still has the high-density foam for side impact protection, and the Isofix/LATCH engage/disengage system is the best (no awkward fiddling to attach or detach the straps!).  One aspect they improved is the head support / shoulder strap height adjustment. Now it's dead simple, no strap removal needed or anything. The trim piece that goes in the center clip now is not as easy to lose (like I did with the one from the Young Sport).  Finally, it looks excellent, those Recaro logos are sexy and the seat itself looks right at home in a sports-oriented SUV!  In summary you definitely can't go wrong with this one.  P.S.: In case you aren't familiar with seats, this is forward-facing only. The typical path with seats like this is to keep your child as long as possible with your rear-facing seat from your travel system (anywhere between 6 and 8 months usually), and then move them to this seat which will be good until they can sit by themselves in the car's regular seat, because this is a combination of harness and booster. You basically use the harness as long as possible before finally using the seat as a booster. The other path is to buy a convertible seat that is rear facing and then forward facing, but afterwards you'll need to buy a separate booster seat. It's a matter of taste I guess but I prefer the first path because the travel systems as a first stage allows you to keep your child in the same place both in the car and in the stroller so he/she doesn't wake up when getting into/out of the car. Ok, this was long but I hope it'll be helpful to the uninitiated.

product_title: Graco Blossom Highchair, Clairmont
review_body: I had a cloth Graco highchair for my first 2 kids. What a disaster. It would get dirty, such a pain to take off the cover to wash and it wouldn't be out of the dryer before before it was time for the next feeding. When I was expecting twins, spent a long time looking for a replacement that would be easy to clean. This has been fantastic! We own 2 of them. I started using them when the babies were just a few days old. They loved the chairs, reclined very nicely and kept the babies away from the older boys. Twins often fall asleep in the high chair and like it as much as the swing. Very easy to clean, easy to adjust, lots of options. Very stable too.

product_title: Summer Infant Temperature Tester (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a cute water thermameter. However, for the frequency this is used (every night) I would suggest getting one that gives you the actual temperature, not just good, hot or cold.

product_title: Stork Craft Vittoria 3-in-1 Fixed Side Convertible Crib
review_body: Hum...not as great as I thought it would be.  It looks great but the wood seems flemy and not strong.  The wood holding up the matress is really thin.  One jump from my baby and it probably will break.  Wished I had gotten something more sturdy.

product_title: Ergobaby Original Baby Carrier
review_body: i just love this baby carrier! it is very easy to wear, very comfortable for the baby, and the baby falls a sleep in it in just seconds... excelent item.[[ASIN:B002NGMXR2 Ergo baby Ergo Baby Carrier Galaxy Grey]]

product_title: Baby Buddy 2 Pack Secure-A-Toy
review_headline: Works as I wanted it to.
review_body: I ordered these to attach to the Babe Ease shopping cart cover.  They work great.  My daughter loves to hold on to them and they easily attach to any toy.

product_title: Tommee Tippee BPA Free First Cup - Lil Sippee - Blue
review_body: An excellent first cup for babies transitioning from bottle. Babies have to put a little pressure on the spout to pinch it open, but do not have to suck. Other sippy cups I have the baby has to suck, which defeats the purpose of a sippy cup. Some liquid will leak out if it's upside down for prolonged times, but I'm using water so it's fine. The best part is that my 7-month old can hold and manipulate the cup. He enjoys turning it upside down and all around but will get back to the opening if he wants a sip. My daycare provider says that cups without handles are the easiest for baby's to work with, so I chose this cup and am so happy with it I bought a second in a different color. The colors are fun and engaging for kids. Great material, durable and BPA-free. I highly recommend this sippy cup.

product_title: The First Years Jet Stroller, Black/Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great stroller for the price but agree the backing is a bit short
review_body: My kids are 4 and 1 and weigh 37 and 25lbs, respectively.  They each fit just fine in this stroller - the backing is tall enough for now, for my little one to take a nap or lean his head back.  My older kid usually doesn't nap so she likes to just take breaks from walking and sit sometimes when we're out and about.  I typically just have this one stroller for the both of them and it works out. The only thing worth noting, other than this is a solid, lightweight, easy to use umbrella stroller, is that the recline function is a bit of a joke.  It uses a lace which you pull or loosen to allow maybe a 2-3 inch recline.  But other than that, it's well worth the $40 we paid for it.

product_title: Guava Family GoCrib Cotton Fitted Sheet
review_body: Got it because it fit the GoCrib. However, it is thinner than I expected. It has held up in the wash so far, but we'll see if that's still the case on a longer term.

product_title: Graco Backless TurboBooster Car Seat
review_body:
The built quality is definitely there, classic Graco, solid, not over-priced. The princesses design is very cool. My daughter was like 'Wow~ thank you Daddy~' the moment she saw it.

I bought this for my 5 years old daughter to carry along during our Disney World trip. I also have a 2 years old so carrying 2 full size car seats is definitely tough! So I picked this one to stuff it inside my checked-in baggage.

The cup holders are a plus and easily hide-away. I do found the padding are a little bit too thin but I have no complaint from my girl, she just loves it.

product_title: IDM Group SB1015 Light Green Snugly Baby Tag Blanket
review_body: I bought this blanket instead of the Taggies brand because it was cheaper and larger. My little one LOVES it. The only problem is that after 1 1/2 months the tags are fraying and falling apart. We won't be able to use it much longer. Very disappointing because he has become attached to it.

product_title: Changing Lifestyles Safe-er-Grip 17" Bath & Shower Handle…
review_body: I am not 100% satisfied with this product. when trying to place them on a wall, I can't get both ends to secure properly and safely.  When I tried to secure them onto a flat surface, I could finally get both ends to secure properly. I don't recommend this product for shower safety if placed onto tub walls.  Very disappointed in the product.     Jill E.

product_title: Baby Knee Pads
review_body: These are so soft but had a slightly hard surface on the knee cap where the design is.  These are great for my 17 month old, who loves to run around, but falls often.  The knee pads protect her knees from getting scrapped up, plus they are comfortable on her.

product_title: Comfy Baby Front and Back Safety Baby Carrier (Black)
review_body: Great deal compared to similar carriers from other brands.     The reasons why I like it so much:    It's classy black & gray coloring makes you feel neat when you wear it.   It's made well & durable. I don't have it for long, but it looks like it will survive a few kids.   It's very well padded, which is really important. So many carriers I've tried give you backaches, but this one is really comfy.  It's simple to use either in the front or the back.   It take minutes to put on or off.   It comes with all the perks. The one that I like most is the headrest for a newborn. It keeps the baby right in place.     I was skeptical when I got this because it wasn't a brand I recognized like baby bjorn, but I am really satisfied.

product_title: Graco LiteRider Stroller, Zooland (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great stroller, even the dog likes it.
review_body: 6 mo old grandson loves sitting up in this stroller.  He cries everytime he is put in his car seat stroller.  And the best part is that the bottom basket is so big and airy that I can put the 14 lb Pom in it when I get tired of him peeing on every tree.  Stroller is very light. Handle is very comfortable--it is padded and is at an angle which is good for my wrists (which have been sprained and broken multiple times over the years.) The front of the seat is soft, there is no hard bar or strap that some other strollers have that I think would be very uncomfortable.  Can easily be folded with one hand.

product_title: UPPAbaby Vista Bassinet Organic Mattress Cover, Cream (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: If you have the UPPA bassinet you will definitely need 1 or 2 extra covers. Just make sure than when you dry these to air dry them.

product_title: Heavenly 4 Drawer Chest
review_headline: You get what you pay for
review_body: It took my husband and I almost two weeks to put this thing together and when it was close to done we realized that the manufacturer did not send one of the parts. It annoyed me deeply. I called south shore customer service and they assured me that if I found the brochure they would mail me the spare part for free. Now considering the fact that I have less than two weeks to go for my due date I wonder when will I receive the part and find the time to put this thing together. Plus thanks to my \\"pregnancy brains\\" and my husband's selective memory I cannot remember for the life of me as to where did I put the manual. Well I got what I asked for. A cheap product for affordable price. Well I seriously do not mind. Its a decent product which will last till my daughter grows up and replaces it with something that is shocking pink or of the kind. Till then I could not care less as to how the dresser holds up. My only gripe as mentioned is that the manufacturer needs to be a bit more responsible and send me all the parts. Because if this is what they do for cheaper products I wonder how expensive products are handled?    Anyways this is my two cents. If price is the only factor then surely go for it. Just be sure you assemble it way ahead of time and make sure throw the box only after you make sure that all of the parts are readily available. My spouse is an engineer unlike me who deals with money so putting the stuff together was not hard. But if you are clueless as far as handling and putting things together then please do not buy this dresser.

product_title: Smart Mom Teething Bling Necklace ~ Pink Cupcake
review_body: I love this product!  The only thing I can say is the pink isnt quite as pink as the pictures show it is way more muted!  But my daughter doesnt care about the color all she know is its great to bite on :)

product_title: Vital Baby Toddler Straw Cup, 10 Ounce
review_body: Great cup, like that it's see-through and has a nice \\"cap.\\"  Also I love that the straw stays put.  On cups where the straw can be pulled out, my son pulls them out and then complains that he can't get them back in.    As it arrives, the cup is VERY difficult to drink from.  I tried it.  I, like a previous reviewer, had to mess with the valves/seals to correct this.  I completely removed the air intake seal, and sliced through the straw seal from where liquid exits.  This results in a cup that will slightly leak, but at least it is usable and my son loves this cup.  The leaking is only if you turn it completely upside down and shake it, which isn't a problem with us because my son usually sets his cup upright on something (but not always).    The colors are nice too and I agree with another reviewer who said that it's not obnoxious looking like a lot of other baby cups and products.

product_title: Opair Child Leash Harness with Fanny Pack Dinosaur
review_body: I love the Hands-free ability and the Parent's fanny pack connection to my son - very convenient. The connection cord could be a little thicker. I would also like to have a way (other than just grabbing the cord)to manually stop or lock the leash extension & retraction (like what you can do via a push-button/switch with a dog's leash) The child's fanny pack is very cute & He Likes it.  I would like to see an additional harness-feature (Like a backpack-style Strap option), as all the stress as he pulls is around his waist.  Then it would be perfect.

product_title: Britax B-Agile Stroller, Black (Prior Model)
review_body: Pretty much a high end stroller that has everything you would want in a stroller. Well built and durable, the Britax B-Agile Stroller is a smooth ride, turns easy and most importantly, straps in the baby securely. There is a collapsable hood that can be placed at different stages. A mesh screen in the back that you can latch to cover the screen or unlatch to cover it. Beneath is a mesh basket to carry things. There is also a mesh \\"sun roof\\" that you can open and close. There is no cup holder, but you can purchase that as an accessory separately. When not in use, it collapses very quickly and easily into a luggage size with a carrying handle. To reopen it, just unlatch it on the side and it goes right back into position. I really like the stroller, for its light weight and smooth ride and solid build.

product_title: Tiddliwinks Dragons & Knights Twin Quilt W/ 1 Sham
review_body: This quilt was exactly what I was looking for to give to my 7 yr old son. He loves dragons and knights and it is very hard to find anything that isn't Asian styled. He loves it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, My Little Snugabunny (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Only place my daughter would sleep
review_body: My daughter had terribly bad reflux and refused to sleep in her crib or or pack and play or in anything laying down. Our pediatrician recommended that we see if she'd sleep at night in this swing. It took no time at all for her to get comfortable and sleep in it. When she was first born (8 lbs), even the first speed seemed a little fast for us first time parent s(though it never seemed to bother her), but as she gained more weight, it moved slower and less until now she is on speed three. At 3 months, she sleeps in her crib at night now, but will still take her naps in the swing.   One of the best things (other than her sleeping) is that it is battery-powered, so we don't use batteries at all. Our daughter is also a big fan of the mirror by the mobile; she stares at herself and smiles. The mobile isn't much but it entertains her. It says that there is a 25 lb weight limit but she won't get to that, because she will try to sit up in the swing now and she is getting a big long for it already. So on the one hand, the price for something that will last maybe 4 months seems excessive. On the other hand she slept in it every night for 8 weeks, and then at naps for at least the next month, so the cost is easily justifiable. My husband was able to put it together himself in maybe 30-45 minutes (and he's not super handy) so that's a bonus as well.

product_title: Carter's Butterfly Flowers Rug, Pink/Choc, 30 X 40" (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: It isn't as plush or cushy as I was hoping it would be, but it does look nice.  I'm happy we bought it, I just wish it was a bit higher quality, though I can't complain at such a low price.  You'll probably want to pick up some kind of no-slip thing to put beneath it, though - mine slides and bunches up if anyone steps on it.

product_title: KidCo GoPod Portable Baby Activity Station
review_body:
[[VIDEOID:mo1ESF2CUX9FI2L]]Before I begin, here's some background information:

My daughter has been using this chair since she was 12 weeks old. She is now almost 16 weeks old. My daughter is tall and thin (size 6-9 months). She has been standing, with support, for about 8 weeks. She isn't able to sit completely unsupported just yet (she is able to support her head on her own), so I do supervise her when she is in this chair. Now for the fun part...

I like this chair because:

I like knowing that my baby won't be overstimulated when she uses this chair.
It did not come with toys, but it does have rings so that you are able to attach your own toys.
It folds up for storage (much like a camping chair).
It is easy to fold up. You just press a small, silver button located on the bottom of one of the front \\"legs\\".
It easily goes back into the storage bag.
The storage bag has a carry strap.
The height of the chair is adjustable. However, I have not tried it yet.
The fabric is easy to clean with a wet cloth.
Your child stands on a mat, which is attached to the chair. This means that you don't have to worry about your child standing on an unclean surface.
The seat is very generous. My daughter will definitely be able to use it for a long time. For now, I fold a baby blanket in half, then half again, and wrap it around my daughter for support (and to keep her from leaning forward and putting her arms in the leg holes).
The leg holes are generously sized. For this reason, I always make sure my daughter is wearing long pants when she uses this seat. It keeps the fabric from chafing the skin on her legs.
The \\"tray\\" has two cup holders (see more on this below).
The chair is not heavy at all. I have taken it to friends' houses without any issues carrying it, taking it out of the bag, setting it up, folding it away, and putting it back in the bag.

There isn't much to complain about. The only con I've found is that when your child sits in it, the \\"tray\\" slants down. This will likely cause anything you put in the cup holders to fall towards your baby.

***Update***

My daughter is now six months old. She is now 27 inches tall (as of today).

I have learned how to fold this chair one-handed, while holding my daughter. Tip it on its side, push the button in, and push down on the chair at the same time. It's so easy!

The [[ASIN:B002M4DI5Q Hugga-Bebe Infant Support Cushion (Green)]] works great if your baby has too much wiggle room!

I have had to adjust the height a couple of times (instructions in the manual, which is available on the Kidco, Inc. website, are very clear). It is very easy as long as you push the buttons on the insides of the legs COMPLETELY inward before you twist the tops of the legs (lift the cover to see and make it easier). Otherwise, the legs will not go up and it is frustrating.

My daughter is starting to try to stand on her own. I believe that it has a lot to do with how often she uses this chair. I also believe that she stands flat-footed (not on the balls of her feet) because of this chair. The only time she stands on the tips of her feet is when she is trying to climb out (which is not even remotely possible). I have uploaded a video to show you.

I am still completely happy with my purchase, and plan on buying one for my cousin's baby shower.

Update:

DD is now 17 months old (90th percentile for her height), and it's finally time to get rid of it. DD is able to tip it over, and the fabric is starting to tear at the tops of the poles. I got way more use out of this than most of my friends got out of their exersaucers. I'm still super happy about buying this, recommend this product to everyone, and have bought one as a gift.t. product_title: Summer Infant Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 1.8" Screen - Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Owned 2 and both lasted less than 2 years
review_body: I owe 2 of these and the night vision has broken on both of these units. I didn't have static issues like others have noted but price is too much to pay for something that lasts less than 2 years.

product_title: Boppy EntertainMe Play Gym, Flying Circus (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Well I got the 1st Bobby sent to me and the lights didn't work, so I sent it back and got another one! So i finally got it and set all up! It's not what i thought it was going to be like! I mean i like the bright colors but it only plays one song and you have to hit the bobby pretty hard to get it too come on!I thought the lights would be brighter and play more than one song!! product_title: BabyKicks Natural & Organic 10 Pack Baby Wipes
review_body: These wipes work great!  I did not want to use disposible wipes and was thrilled when I found these.  They are soft and wash well.  I just rinse them out after each use and put them in the diaper pail with the dirty cloth diapers, then wash them all together.  The only design flaw is the tag.  It is rough and big so you have to be careful not to wipe Baby with it.  I eventually cut all the tags off since they were in the way.  If the tags were designed differently, I would be thrilled.  But I would recommend them to anyone as is.

product_title: Dex Products Safe Sleeper Bed Rail Ultra (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I am happy with this bed rail. It looks nice on the bed and is attached well, so I know it isn't going to fall off the bed, even with some pressure applied. The only bad aspect is that the top is a little wobbly, but that might be the case with any bed rail (this is the only one I looked at) and, as I said, the concern isn't such that it would fall off. Great price!

product_title: Dutailier Ultramotion Sleigh Glider Rocker
review_body: I absolutely love this rocker! It fits me and my husband comfortably. I'm 5'3 and he's 5'10, both on the wider side. Our baby loves being rocked to sleep in it. It has helped a lot with my back problems from breastfeeding on the couch. The color is nice, it's fairly neutral and goes with all our furniture.

product_title: North States Industries Superyard Playard
review_body: the play yard gate really comes in handy. I use it for my puppies. It cost me half the price at Amazon versus a local department store.

product_title: MAM 3 Count BPA Free Bottle
review_body: I love these bottles. I don't really like the design of the MAM bottles but my son has no issues with the nipples. I can finally feed him without him choking, swallowing too much formula,air, etc. He can calming drink at his pace and not have to struggle with feeding. I actually just bought this on a wing because I wanted to try out different nipples to see which suits him best. These did it for him. I've tried evenflo, nuk, playtex ventaire, and so far these outweigh the rest! Give these bottles a chance. Alhtough it did leak when I started him on these bottles, I've found that you have to twist real tight and boy we have been leak-free since!! Thank you mam!

product_title: Baby Einstein Around The World Play Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I bought this item because I had previously with my first child bought the baby einstein playmat with the little light up star. I loved it and my child played with it into toddlerhood until the soundbox died.
This mat I am completely disappointed with. I thought it would at least have the same light up star but the star has terrible uninteresting music and only lights up green and yellow which is totally boring. Also they made it so the toys only stretch over the very middle of the mat instead of the 4 corner type of deal that was on my last mat. product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat, Lagrange (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We purchased this for our 2 year old daughter but did not want to pay again later for a booster seat.  For me, the price couldn't be beat.

product_title: Hauck 2011 Malibu Stroller w/ Bassinet and Stand **CLOSEOUT** - Plum
review_body:
I have been wanting a stroller like this since I found out I was pregnant but after searching for hours I couldn't find ANYTHING in my price range!!! Strollers like this are on the upwards of $800, so when I found this, I HAD TO BUY IT!!! I am not disappointed at all! I disagree completely with the other reviewer who thinks the bassinet doesn't feel secured, I think it totally does! If I didn't I would have returned it the second I bought it! The only con of the stroller would be the instructions. They were absolutely terrible. If you are having difficulty with putting it together, go to the Hauck website and find the instructional manual there. For some reason, there is more information on that one.

Just the other day (after three months of use) the lever that allows the stroller to be folded down broke. I called the company I bought it from and they got the US rep for Hauck get into contact with me, they are shipping the part now. She told me if I can't figure it out or if it doesn't fix the problem to call and she will send me another stroller! WONDERFUL CUSTOMER SERVICE on their end!

I get sooo many compliments on this stroller and feel so \\"classy\\" when I'm walking around with my son :) It's truly a beautiful stroller and I really love it, I'm a proud owner and would recommend it to anyone!

[[ASIN:B004P7R7NW Hauck 2011 Malibu Stroller w/ Bassinet and Stand - Plum]]

product_title: FuzziBunz® One Size Adjustable Cloth Diapers 12 Pack Gender Neutral Colors with Dainty Baby Wet Bag Bundle, Colors May Vary
review_body: When my first daughter was born we tried cloth diapers from a diaper service and they were terrible! They leaked, they stunk, they were bulky and hard to use. So we ended up using disposables. When our second daughter was born we thought that we'd stick with disposables. That is until we noticed how much garbage we were creating (a big black garbage bag of diapers a week!)not only that but they were incredibly expensive. So we decided to try cloth again. This Time I did some research and came across these. After reading the reviews and consulting some cloth diapering parents we know, we decided to buy some.  I was really nervous the first time I used them (not wanting to relive the last cloth diaper experience), but I am overjoyed to say that these are amazing! I'm pretty sure that everything has already been said about them, but I will say this:  These are a little trickier to perfect the fit than the Bum Genius Onesize, but once you get it just right they are wonderful. I am very pleased with the design and quality, and the fact that each diaper comes with replacement elastic. Their website FAQ section is also very helpful and worth a read. I am also astonished at how well the lining fabric wick's the moisture away from my babies' bum. Sometimes it is hard to tell if she has gone because the lining will be dry, but then when I open it up the insert is soaked. Amazing! Also one last thing, my daughter had a really stubborn yeast rash for about three weeks, I tried everything to get rid of it and nothing worked. As soon as I switched to cloth the rash cleared in a day.  As for the colors we got, I am happy with them. I got some red, teal, green, yellow, orange, and a brown.  I would recommend these to anyone and everyone! They are fantastic. I actually enjoy changing diapers now. We also bought some of the BumGenius One Size and they are equally fantastic.  The idea of paying so much money at once for diapers kind of freaked me out. We bought a total of 26 diapers,a diaper pail, rockn' Green detergent, and some pail liners and pail fresheners. The total was about $500 for everything. It seemed very pricey but when you do the math it is the same as using disposables diapers for about 6 to 7 months. And when you factor in that you can use these ones right up until potty training, I think that the investment is worth it, Not only that but if you take care of them properly you could probably pass them on or sell them after you are done.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: My son LOVES Sophie!! She goes everywhere we go.  He is 3 1/2 months old and he loves chewing on her and loves making her squeak!!!  She is the perfect teether and the perfect toy!!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat
review_body: I have a high chair I originally bought for our daughter costing me $200.  Now that I have a new baby coming, that high chair is going to be used for her little brother.  After hours of research of looking at boosters, I found this one.  We have been using it for a week now and it is awesome!  So easy to clean!  It's all one smooth piece so wiping down is a breeze.  The adjustments are perfect for my growing baby girl.  No negatives from me.

product_title: Buggy Bagg Elite Shopping Cart Cover
review_headline: Comfortable for baby, lots of pocket space and stylish too!
review_body: I actually look forward to going to the supermarket with my baby now! No more wiping down the shopping cart with a sanitizer wipe and no more carrying a big diaper bag into the supermarket. This item comfortably holds my baby, has lots of storage pockets that hang behind the baby so that it doesn't get in the baby's way and has 2 stretchy areas along the inside to hold 2 baby bottles, not to mention it has a detachable pillow. I now carry my diapering items inside of the large pocket space which enables me to keep the shopping cart free of a large diaper bag and allows me to store my keys and cell phone safely while shopping. I get lots of great compliments which is just a nice added touch to the great practicality of the shopping cart cover and it's very easy to place on the shopping cart too. Oh and it has it's own seat belt tethers so I don't have to worry about my baby trying to suck on the dirty supermarket tethers. Definitely a must have for any mom or caregiver!!!!

product_title: Classic Pooh Flat Blankie Teether Toy
review_body: Durable, great for a teething baby.  Also very easy to clean - toss in the washer and dryer.   Doesn't shrink at all.

product_title: Maxi-Cosi Foray Stroller - Choco Mint
review_body: We LOVE this stroller.     Benefits:   MUCH smaller profile than a traditional travel system. The Mico carseat (which we also love) fits onto the stroller frame easily (instead of using a bassinet like the bugaboo, which infants outgrow quickly anyways).   brake is easy to use  easy to fold and unfold after a couple of tries  lightweight, especially for a stroller this size  the seat reclines to several positions and can face either way. It has a footrest, which some strollers lack. Also, the sun shade is plenty large and the rain cover zips on and off easily  cupholder!   ample storage basket  GREAT turning radius, smooth handling  retractable handle  as good looking as the bugaboo without the price tag!     drawbacks:   can't think of any.

product_title: Safety 1st Sink Snuggler Baby Bather, Green
review_body: We bought this after debating spending the extra money on a puj tub. I just couldn't bring my self to spend the extra amount, so when I saw this version at Babies R Us, I picked it up.  We introduced it about about 2 weeks of age, and it lasted until about 3 months of age, maybe less. The foam was not sturdy at all, we quit using it when he hit about 13 pounds because the sides would cave in if he moved around at all. More often than not, it would give in, and he would be wedged inside of it in the bottom of the sink.   The foam is really flimsy, and gets gouges/scratches easily. The velcro started coming unsown.  Pros: It's cheap.  Cons: It's cheap.  Invest your money in the puj tub if you want this style.

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Extra Wide Metal Walk Through Safety Gate
review_body: This is a good quality gate.  It is relatively easy to open and close with one hand.  It was also easy to install, and it is nice that it can be pressure mounted.

product_title: Britax Boulevard 70 Convertible Car Seat (Previous Version), Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body: cons : doesnt recline as much as you think it would. my 1yr old son seems sort of uncomfortable when trying to sleep since at full recline the seat is still pretty upright. cannot hook it to my stroller so if hes sleeping i have to wake him up and put him in the other car seat that i carry that sits on my stroller. its pretty heavy and certainly not meant for a small car.    pros: easy to install, heavy duty = more protection, easy to more shoulder straps while baby still in seat, roomy for my 1yr old who weighs 23 pounds.

product_title: Tomy Lamaze Wrist Rattle and Foot Finder Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Bought when my daughter was 2 months old as a starter toy for her to play with.  I found them a great toy to take out and about too in your changing bag as they're small and wrist rattles fit perfectly onto pram handle so she liked looking at them when in her pram too.  Now at 5 months, she loves the crinkly noise they make, practically eats the wrist rattles and is fascinated by them on her feet...  She has a few of the Lamaze toys, as they are all so lovely, but these were definitely a big hit with our daughter!

product_title: Especially for Baby - Color Change Ducky
review_body: Baby Eli adores his little ducky! He will not take his bath without it. It is the cutest, most adorable, durable, lasting ducky one can find and enjoy and that will last through many kids and even more baths!  Worth every penny!

product_title: Carter's Bumble Comfort n' Care Playard and Changer
review_headline: Take your chances with the SMELL!
review_body: I got one of the stinky ones, and boy does it smell horrible. I have tried washing the mattress several times according to the instructions in the manual but this smell is here to stay. It is a mix of chemicals and vomit. And it attaches to anything it comes in contact with - sheets, toys, blankets, your child. My daughter smelled so bad from laying on this mattress I had to give her a bath. Can you imagine what is in this thing that is causing such an odor? Can't be good for little babies to be around. I contacted Summer Infant and they sent me another mattress, but it had the same odor, I could smell it before I even opened the box.    You can take your chances, some apparently do not smell, but both of mine do. My suggestion would be to go to a store and open the box to smell it before you buy. Other than that I like this P&P. Yes, the changing table does tilt, but it hasn't been a huge issue. I like the caddy that comes on the side, very useful for storing stuff.

product_title: Fuzzi Bunz One Size Cloth Diapers 6 Pack Gender Neutral Colors
review_body: These diapers worked great when my daughter was a new born. Then, they started leaking like crazy overnight when she started sleeping longer (about 8 hours)! Even with two inserts stuffed in them, which are then super bulkey, which makes me worry about hip issues because she can't even close her legs properly. So, I emailed Fuzzibunz, and they sent me a totally new load- which now leak even worse, even during the day. The issue is, they changed the manufacturing of their fleece on the inside of the diaper. It doesn't wisk liquid away from the baby, the liquid sits on the diaper, and leaks out the sides/back. These are terrible. The company must not have done much testing on their new fleece. The old Fuzzibunz were ALRIGHT, but again... Still leaking issues. We were using a very gentile eco-friendly detergent and following all of their laundering suggestions. We recently went out and bought two different cloth diapers, which work MUCH better- NO LEAKS!! The one she slept in last night was Happy Hineys. She slept for 8 hours straight in this diaper and didn't leak at all! I was thrilled not to have to change all of her bedding and clothes at 3:30 in the morning for the first time in months! It was great. Then we had her in Bumgenis, which she slept in from 4-8 with no leaks... I highly recommend trying these before you decide to waste your money on leaky diapers. These are the worst!

product_title: Sesame Street Elmo Fleece Throw Blanket and Buddy Set
review_body: I bought this for my niece and she loves it! Takes the blanket with her everywhere and elmo is always near by. I will have to ask my sister for her experience on durability.

product_title: Fisher-Price Infant to Toddler Rocker, Princess Mouse (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We just got this in the mail and our daughter loves it. Everything was in the package and it was well packed!

product_title: Graco Pack 'N Play Playard with Bassinet, Kensly (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased the Graco Pack 'N Play with the Bassinet and found it to be exactly what was described. I like the neutral colors and the ease of transport. The padding was actually pretty substantial- more than I expected. I did, however, think that the bassinet's quality did not merit a $13 increase in price from the Pack 'N Play that does not include it. But overall, I am very pleased and would recommend the product. Amazon redeemed themselves this time and shipping was very fast.

product_title: Annabel Karmel Masher and Bowl (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Mashes only very soft foods - a fork works just as well.
review_body:
I was disappointed in this masher and bowl. The masher is plastic - don't expect to mash anything with skin (beans) or meats either. It works fine for bananas, avocado, etc., but I'd rather just use a fork and my own bowl (that has a lid - this one doesn't). The holes in the masher are very small and far apart, so the food just gets kind of pushed around rather than broken up. It would be much more useful if it was metal.

The non-slip bottom on the bowl is nice, but the side grip is small and further impedes your ability to really mash things up. The design is cute too. Overall, though, it just didn't work for me.

product_title: Britax Roundabout 55 Convertible Car Seat
review_body: This is by far the best car seat, and for a great price! It's so plush and soft! My 6 month old LOVES it! I highly recommend this to ANYONE looking for a car seat!

product_title: Baby Safe Feeder Replacement Bags
review_body: My grandson loves this! He is able to try different foods and I do not have to worry about him choking!

product_title: Dura-Bib Large Bad to the Bib
review_body: Bib is okay at best. Does catch food but the fasteners are cheap and will not last. It is not worth ten dollars.

product_title: Ergobaby Original Baby Carrier
review_headline: ergo sport - great for petite moms
review_body: I started with the original ergo and found it to be beautiful and well constructed... but bulky & rough. I am 5'2\\" & 115 lbs, and it was just too large and stiff looking.  I exchanged it for a sport and have been extremely pleased.  The sport is much softer, lighter, and folds up smaller.  It fits my small frame much better.  My baby is always happy in the ergo! I started using it when she was 3 months old, and she fit just fine. A good carrier is a must when you have more than one child!

product_title: Tiny Love Take Along Mobile, Animal Friends
review_body: We had one of these for our son and wore it slam out from almost non-stop use for over a year (including getting banged around on many airline flights and road trips). Bought another one for our daughter who is now 8 weeks old.     We had 3 other mobiles for our son (a sail boat one from babies r us that had to be wound up for each use and lasted about a week before breaking), the Fischer Price Rainforest mobile (which had TERRIBLE sound quality and we ended up taking back), and another one I can't even remember. The Tiny Love mobile was the only one that we were really able to use. It was an excellent value for the price, especially as compared to the money we wasted on other mobiles. Only complaint I had about the old one is that the volume was rather loud. We easily fixed this by putting a piece of tape over the speaker holes to mute the sound a bit. The old one attached very easily to the handle of a car seat.    The new one has been much improved! It now attaches to the car seat handle with an easy velcro strap, or the top of a stroller with a grip clip, or to the crib/pack and play with the arm adaptor that grips securely onto the side of a crib. With the upgraded versatility, we decided to forgo a standard mobile altogether for our daughter and just use this one for travel as well as her crib for sleeping. The speaker on this one is not as loud as the old one, so we haven't needed the tape trick. I haven't noticed any motor sounds at all. The little animals are very cute, and my daughter visibly watches the mobile spin. Has movement functions with and without sound.    The best was one afternoon when I couldn't get my baby girl to stop fussing until I put her in her car seat. The moment I turned on the mobile, she calmed right down. Doesn't work every time, but it is a regular in my bag of fussy baby tricks!    One note on use: if the mobile's path is obstructed and it cannot move forward it will click quietly. Not a big deal for a few minutes every now and then, but if it goes on for a long time it can strain the motor - I think this is what killed our first one, so really a user error issue!    I give this regularly as a new baby gift and so far everyone has loved having it.

product_title: American Baby Company Organic Waterproof Natural Quilted Fitted Portable/Mini Crib pad cover
review_headline: Very soft and easy to put on
review_body: I have used two other organic cotton crib mattress covers and this one is, by far, the best.  The material on the underside is very soft, and is waterproof without being plasticy.  Others that I have used have melted a little in the dryer (not on the hot setting), which is both a health concern, and also leaves spaces where liquids can get through.  One of the things I like the best about this cover is that it is easy to put on the mattress.  Some of them shrink so much when you wash them that you need superhuman strength to stretch them back over the mattress.  This one is easy, and the material feels high-quality.  I also like that it's softer than the others I've used.  I am going to order two more when I finish this review.

product_title: P'Kolino Little Reader Chair
review_headline: Can only be used with close supervision
review_body: My one year old wants desperately to sit in the chair, but she just can't quite get in on her own (and she is a climber - she loves to climb stairs, in and out of bed, whatever.)  It has a tall base so she has to climb up to get in by grabbing the flimsy back, which nearly tips the chair over.  Then she tries to turn around but it's really narrow and by the time she gets there she has basically slid out of it again.  The chair is constantly in danger of tipping over, and it's made of flimsy material.  I do not recommend.

product_title: Wonder Mat Non-Toxic Non-Recycled Extra Thick Rainbow Foam Playmat
review_body: This is the 2nd time I've ordered these foam mats! I love them and they always ship fast! Thank you again!

product_title: EarCheck Middle Ear Monitor
review_headline: Great Tool for babies and toddlers
review_body: This thing is great!  I have told everyone I know with kids about it.  I plan to buy it for baby gifts.  It has saved so many trips to the doctor.  When babies are teething its so hard to know if swollen gums and ears have turned into an ear infection.  With this you can watch the progress and only take them to the doctor when they need to go.  I have also used it on myself as well.  I only wish I had known about the product sooner.  Well worth the money!

product_title: LA Baby Commercial/Restaurant Wooden High Chair, Cherry
review_body: The chair was very easy to put together. It took about 10 minutes with a quick glance at the instruction. Like another reviewer said, the holes are pre-drilled, but it takes a lot of force to screw the screws in. I used a power drill and hand tightened. I can see how it will be a bit of effort if you don't have a drill.    All the pieces fit together pretty well, and there was no damage to the wood from the factory. The belt rested on the seat in the packaging and left a mark in the paint job. But it is not a big issue. Both my 3yr old and 8month old were able to fit in the chair and each sat next to the table with us.

product_title: Graco Pack 'n Play Element Playard Circa
review_body: I love my purchase of Circa: Play yard. It does everything the manufacturers said. My son has been using it since birth and is now 2 months old. One disadvantage is the changing table, it is placed in an akward position and needs to be taken on and off every time u want to change the baby.

product_title: UPPAbaby Carseat Adapter for Peg Perego, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: First of all I read the reviews on this adapter and tried to find the old model, but even sites that showed the pic of the old one always ended up coming back to me and saying they don't have it. I have the 2005 primo viaggio and it IS compatible (big plus bc the manual says it works with 2006 to recent.  I use it every morning when bringing my other child to school.    You cant just plop it on and click it in like you can when you put the carrier in its car seat base... you have to watch underneath as you set the carrier on and line up the middle groove of the carrier with the little pegs (kind of tedious but is the only/easiest way to do it without waking the baby).  Oh, and you have to click in one side at a time.      The pegs that stick up on top of the adapter actually go into the pivot point of the handle. So since there are plastic dividers under the pivot point you have to watch for that too and make sure the pegs go into the right dividers...  another reason why its kind of tedious.  All in all, if you do the little \\"tricks\\" and are very conscious of the quirks it goes in fine and baby won't wake, but its definitely not as quick and easy as just setting it on and you're done.  After doing it a few times you get to be more smooth with it.  Its surprisingly sturdy and doesn't wobble.    I think my reason for 3 stars instead of 4 is that all the negative feedback I have read about this adapter makes me paranoid about it breaking.

product_title: Baby Jogger 2011 City Mini Single Stroller, Orange/Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My husband and I agreed on this stroller as a compromise - I really wanted the UPPABaby Vista but we didn't need the bassinet (our daughter is 10 months old) and it's pretty expensive just for the upright stroller feature. This stroller is perfect for our needs. We live in the city and this thing moves effortlessly through puddles and over uneven sidewalks and potholey crosswalks. It turns easily and smoothly. The visor is fantastic - it really covers her up if we need it to and includes a viewing window so we can still see her if it's extended, but it also conveniently accordions back. The height is fine for both me and my husband (he's just shy of 6 ft.). It folds up VERY easily - the only complaint I have here is that it doesn't stand up very well in the folded position. My other complaint is access to the basket is available only on the sides, and it's a little bit cumbersome. Other than those two things, it's fabulous!

product_title: Safety 1st Cushioned Sof'Knee Protectors
review_body: My 7 month old summer crawler needed something to protect his knees from carpet burns, etc.  I thought these would work, but they are very small and don't stretch much. If your child has healthy legs, don't use these as they can cut off circulation. My baby is much smaller than the boy in the ad, too. Very disappointed.

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Walk Thru Gate, White, Fits Spaces between 29" and 39" Wide
review_body: I'm very glad we got this gate to keep our new dog in the kitchen.  It opens very easily.  It fits securely against the wall and frame without screws.  It took only a few minutes to install.  The only reason I don't give it 5 stars is that the door only opens in one direction, but that is not a problem 99% of the time.

product_title: Brica Cover Guard Car Seat Travel Tote, Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We just took a trip by plane and had to check in our son's carseat. My husband loved this tote! It was easy for him to put the carseat in, carry the carseat or roll it. I had to roll it at one point while carrying my one year old son and it was very easy for me to handle. Overall great value for the price!

product_title: Graco Lovin' Hug Swing With Plug-In, Ally (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: What is the point of a mechanical swing if it doesn't keep swinging?
review_body: I really liked this swing at first: it's compact, it has a nice pattern, plugs in to save on costly batteries, and we just loved the little elephants (we have the Capri style). But it doesn't swing! We turn it on, and the motor makes an obnoxious grinding sound. Then, we push it to get it going, and it just slows down and stops for no reason. What is the point of a mechanical swing if it doesn't keep swinging?  We try all 6 settings, and it still stops. The thing also squeaks and sounds rickety, too. Also, the mobile isn't mechanical at all and relies on physics to turn when the swing is going. And, the sounds are just awful too: the nature sounds don't sound like anything that occurs in nature, more like noisy static; the classical music is blaring and annoying; and the heartbeat sounds like soundtrack drumbeats to the most cliche Civil War battle scene you can imagine.  We're thoroughly disappointed.  We got the Fisher-Price My Little Snugabunny today and it is beautiful. I highly recommend it. But do NOT buy these Graco swings.

product_title: Nuby 2 Pack Nurtur Care Infa Feeder Set, 4 Oz Infant Feeder
review_body: I bought this because I used the Nuby with my first child on 2005. Well the gasket that is supposed to slide up as the baby sucks is so tight that it wont move. Also the small feeder that comes with it does not allow anything except liquids through it. I ended up using an upolstry needle to try and make hole larger but it didn't work as well. I decided to go and by the Sassy 4oz 2pk of feeders. These work awesome!! The foods moves through easy and they are much better quality.

product_title: Pickles Whisper Soft Baby Bib, 11X13"
review_body: Maybe I didn't read the description well enough, but I was suprised and dismayed to discover you only get ONE bib for the price! However, having said that, I L-O-V-E this bib!! It is so soft and washes up really well. Even the sweet potatoes come out!! It is also a good size for an infant up to a toddler. (It is probaby too big for a newborn.) The only downside for me was the velcro. I find that these chafe a baby's neck. I really wish it had a snap.   Although I think the price is too high for just one bib I have been able to justify buying another by telling myself that I pay more than that for a new outfit and he outgrows those in just a couple of months!!! These bibs will last for YEARS! So, I recomend this product enough to go and get another one for myself!!! :-)

product_title: Munchkin Twisty Teether Ball
review_body: This product literally stunk.  I don't know what else they stored in that warehouse but it had a very chemical smell.  Once I  was able to get the smell out( took a while) my son loves this toy.

product_title: Breathablebaby Breathable Safer Bumper, Ecru/Brown Bubbles
review_body: These bumpers work great for my 5 month old. Now I can sleep at night without worrying about her rolling into her other bumpers and not being able to breathe.

product_title: Pampers Sensitive Thickcare Wipes - 480ct Baby Wipes
review_headline: Great wipes but they are cheaper at Walmart & Target & BRU
review_body: These are by far the best wipes we have found, and believe me, I think we tried them all!      But this price is WAY too high, they are between $12.00-$13.00 at Walmart, Target and Babies R Us (in store and online).

product_title: DELUXE PET NET STUFFED ANIMAL TOY ORGANIZER HAMMOCK
review_headline: A little smaller than it looks
review_body: This is a great product and I am pleased with it especially since I couldn't find it at a store locally. However it is a little smaller than it looks in the picture.

product_title: The First Years Miswivel Feeding Chair
review_headline: I love this feeding chair and so does my baby
review_body: I actually purchased the pink butterfly design feeding chair for my daughter.  I love all the features it has, especially the easy cleaning of detaching the straps and fabric.  The recline and swivel levers are really easy to reach and maneuver (our dining chair is thin so it's easily accessible).  My daughter disliked the bumbo seat with tray (which we had purchased first) and so I did some research and came across this feeding chair.  She loves it and doesn't fuss so much during feeding time.

product_title: NoJo Froggy Friends Musical Mobile, Brown/Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Our infant (3 months old at time of purchase) has been very fickle in what things he enjoys, and he instantly loved this mobile.  The fact that three of the four hanging toys hits the base stand as they rotate past it helps because it adds additional movement.  The only negative is that the wind up power doesn't last very long, and is awkward to do if you only have one hand free.  Overall, I would definitely recommend this product.

product_title: Baby Jogger Parent Console
review_body: We have the BJ City Select for our two kids - which we LOVE LOVE LOVE! Best stroller. I eagerly awaited the release of the BJ Universal Parent Console and desperately wished it would've worked on one of their own products. But, it just didn't. Awesome features include a great silver-lined middle pocket (velcro closure) for keeping snack bags cool with an icepack. Also, the right pocket (velcro closure) is great for keys, small wallet, sunglasses, phone, MP3 player and a toy. A design improvement could've included a zipper slot on the top outside to safely assurance storage of an ID and credit card and car/house key.  But the design flaw that caused us to return it was the cup holder. Sadly, it was a disappointing feature. Nothing would stand upright and when you hit a bump, it always spilled. We tried Kleen Kanteens, sippy cups, baby bottles, soda can, coffee cup, fountain drink cup. Nothing worked because the slot just tipped too far forward toward the stroller canopy. So, we ended up returning it. bummer.

product_title: Graco LiteRider Stroller, Lively Dots (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have not found nearly as many issues with it as other have. Yes I too scraped the tray on the floor when folding etc. but the tray does come off. I do not always put the seat into the upright position and it still folds for me. Cup holder is great. Basket is big. I have do complains

product_title: FuzziBunz Elite 2013 One Size Cloth Diapers 12 Pack Gender Neutral Colors with Dainty Baby Wet Bag and Rockin Green Laundry Detergent Sample Bundle
review_body:
I think I should start this by saying that cloth diapering is not for the weak. But FuzziBunz make the experience a whole lot better.

My first encounter with FuzziBunz was as a child care provider. And now that I am having my own rugrat, I decided that getting FuzziBunz would be a fantastic idea. They work well. They hardly leak, unless you have an extreme pee-er and then there is no hope--with cloth diapers or disposables (I've seen disposables explode off kiddos...). And they are adorable. =)

I was initially worried that ordering \\"gender neutral colors\\" would land me with all the funky, pastel colors. However, I when I opened up the package I saw nothing but vibrant colors that I love.

product_title: Rockin Green Magnetic Laundry Scoop - Grey
review_body: This little thing comes in handy and I can alway find it because it is stuck to my dryer.  Great product.

product_title: JJ Cole Technique Diaper Bag
review_body: I LOVE this bag. I researched bags for months before having baby #4, and this bag is perfect. I've been using it now daily for 3 months, and it is still in perfect condition. I've read reviews that say it doesn't close, it spills everything, it doesn't fit everything, etc... It has a strap closure with a snap AND a magnet, and once closed I've never had it come open on me. I've never had it topple and spill everything either. It fits everything fine for me, and I have 4 kiddos. I actually like that the bottom is wider than the top, so things I don't use as much can stay tucked down in those bottom sides. I've gotten a ton of compliments on the look of the bag, and I LOVE the cute pattern on the interior lining. GREAT buy...Love it!

product_title: Graco Quattro Tour Duo Stroller,  Zurich (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This stroller is like 350 in stores i got it for 200$ no ship no tax...this thing is amazing!! best double stroller in the world and folds down small..5stars!

product_title: J.Lamb & Friends Waterproof Fitted Crib Pad, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I am very happy with this crib mattress pad. The cover is thick and soft, but the sides are a lighter, silky material that stretches very easily to fit the mattress.  It has washed well.  I would definitely order another one of these if I need another mattress pad.

product_title: ShadyBaby Sock Monkey Stroller Parasol, SPF 50+ Stroller Umbrella - 24" Diameter
review_body: I have a fair-skinned little guy and was sorry I opted for a smaller umbrella stroller as opposed to a big stroller that I could maneuver the canopy on. So I bought this umbrella for my Chicco Liteway stroller and I think it has been great. The fabric is adorable...many compliments. And it keeps the sun off my baby. It requires adjusting, of course, when turning corners but wouldn't anything? I think for the price, this is a great product for me. I am happy with it as it provides good air flow for the baby while blocking the summer sun.

product_title: Bumkins SuperBib 3-pk. - Pink
review_headline: THE MOTHER (OR BABY?) OF ALL BIBS
review_body: We've used Bumpkins bibs for FIVE children and some are still the originals! These go through the washer with ease and come out bright and happy. I give these as baby shower gifts and the parents always give them thumbs up as well.

product_title: thinkbaby Bento Box, Light Green
review_body:
We got these bottles after several recommendations from different sources, and were very happy with them. We had originally been using Dr Browns to reduce gas and colic, but found that the nipple flow (even for new borns) was so fast it was causing our baby to spit up all his milk. Plus, we liked the vent feature of Dr Browns to reduce air comsumpiton but there were so many parts to clean my husband hated to use them. ThinkBaby seems to solve both problems-- the new born nipple flow is almost too slow (a relief after our baby spit up so much with the other bottles) and since the air vent is built into the nipple there are no extra parts to clean.

Since these bottles have a good price point and can convert to sippy cups down the road, I think these are some of the better bottles on the market (although I haven't tried Born Free.)

product_title: Gerber First Essential 3 Pack Clear View BPA Free Plastic Nurser With Latex Nipple, 5 Ounce, Colors May Vary
review_body: Given the price of this item they are decent quality bottles. My daughter if extremely picky about which ones she'll take and I've tried four different brands/types with little success. I ordered these ones just for kicks and she LOVES them. The smaller latex nipple these bottles have are just what she needed/wanted. She has kind of a small mouth and the bigger nipples used to gag her on other bottles. The First Essentials bottles are easy to clean which is always a good thing.    The only downside I have to these bottles is that they don't have any kind of system to help the air in the bottle release so my daughter ends up swallowing a bit more air than with the Dr. Browns, Playtex or Nuk ones.     Again, for the price, it was well worthy my money and I finally have a bottle my daughter will take. Let's be honest, no matter the selling points of the bottle, if your child won't take the thing it's pointless. This met my needs and my daughter loves them. Case and point for me!

product_title: SheetWorld Fitted Crib / Toddler Sheet - Tinkerbell - Made In USA
review_body: Great crib sheets. Wanted to do tinkerbell theme and this is the only place I could find crib sheets with tinkerbell and they look great!

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_body: I bought the sea turtle for my oldest son. He's 11 and even though he doesn't need a night light he likes looking at the stars before he goes to sleep.  I have a 3 year old daughter that recently became afraid of the dark so I borrowed the sea turtle and now she won't go to sleep without it. I've also noticed that when my 3 month old is in the room and the night light is on he becomes mesmerized!!  My 11 year old got his sea turle back. I bought the lady bug for my daughter and the brown turtle for my infant.  I don't think I could live without these nightlights!!

product_title: Graco SnugRide 35/32 Infant Car Seat Base
review_body: Received the base for my granddaughters car seat quickly.  It was easy to install, and I can now take her with me when needed while I am babysitting.  It is easy to get her car seat in and out.  I only wish I had seen it was in silver instead of beige like her actual car seat.

product_title: Boppy Noggin Nest Head Support, Pink Flowers
review_headline: Doesn't help fix flat head, just prevents it.
review_body: My little one already had a flat head when I purchased this hoping it would help when she was on the back of her head.  The product has not helped improve her flat spot.  I do feel it could be useful to prevent the flat spot from occurring in the first place though, which is why I gave it 3 stars.  It was just too little too late for us.

product_title: Nuby Flip N' Sip Cup
review_headline: Hard to Drink/ Hard to Clean
review_body: It's super cute, I'll give you that. It's also convenient for bottle transition since baby still is relying on sucking. However, the \\"no spill\\" feature is pretty much a clog in the straw and they have to suck HARD to get any fluid out.  Also, the straw does not detach so you need to buy one of those sippy straw brushes to get in there to clean it as running hot water through it won't do the trick. Pop off the handles to wash it because gunk gets trapped in there and while it does not get into your child's drink, it is pretty nasty. Blech.  I won't be buying more of these.

product_title: Angel Dear Cuddle Twin Set
review_body: We have 2 of the brown owls for our now nearly 2 year old.  As soon as we saw them, we knew they would be the perfect lovey for our new baby and his woodland forest themed nursery. :)  I love having a spare when Mr. Owl needs to be washed or gets misplaced at nap/bedtime.  His grandma keeps one at her house too, so we are always prepared!  Easy to tuck in a diaper bag or suitcase, easy to cuddle with in bed.  We are expecting a baby girl now, and our only problem has been which sweet Angle Dear blanket to choose for her!  We highly recommend these super soft blankets.

product_title: American Baby Company Waterproof fitted Quilted Portable/Mini Crib Mattress Pad Cover
review_body: I am not pleased with this product at all.  You can only wash it with cold water and dry it on low heat.  Which is very strange for bedding/linens.  Unfortunately, I did not read the label and washed mine with warm water.  This in turn put holes in the vinyl layer.

product_title: Tadpoles Triple Layer Tulle Crib Skirt in White
review_body: I love this crib skirt, it is so cute and goes perfectly in the nursery!  It handled being washed before putting it on, the only negative, which is our problem, is that our cats are already clawing at it, must be a material they like.  If we can keep them away, it is exactly like the photo and was a great price.

product_title: The First Years Carry Me Near Sleep System, Cream (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Perfect, except for one fatal flaw
review_body: I love this bassinet. In fact, we had the same one for our daughter 4 years ago, and it was the one thing we couldn't live without. Great functionality, and we took it everywhere with us. Well, for our son, of course we bought another one. It is a great product, BUT, it has advertising stickers on the carry handle which will not come off. I guess we could use a chemical sticker remover, but who wants chemicals on something for a newborn. So pretty much, it is a great product that looks like garbage because some marketing person decided to put huge, permanent, stickers on it. Amazing how easy it is for them to ruin what was once a great product.

product_title: Thinkbaby BPA Free Starter Set, Orange/Natural, 0-12 Months
review_body: I really like these bottles, especially the shape of them, and how there are so few pieces (not so complicated as others) BUT i've only had these bottles for a few months and the nipples have BIG holes instead of the cross cut, so they wore out REALLY fast.

product_title: Summer Infant Plush N' Play Changing Pad with Toy Bar
review_body: excellent product .. baby magically stops crying when placed on this pad since day-1.. maybe its the distance from the eye or something ... the monkey caught her attention very early on

product_title: OXO Tot Bottle Brush
review_headline: My fav bottle brush so far!
review_body: I have gone through a new bottle brush every month as they keep falling apart. The OXO brush is so much nicer than anything I've tried! The brush and handle are so soft. It got me excited to clean bottles again! Love the aqua color. Forget Munchkin..

product_title: Evenflo Triumph 65 LX Convertible Car Seat, Oh! (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: So happy with this carseat.  I searched Britax, Sunshine kids and after all of that was very pleased with this car seat.  The cover is easy to take off and wash and the seatbelt harness does NOT need to be pushed through slots like graco, etc.  I would recommend to anyone looking for a safe, secure and smaller carseat!  Babiesrus pricing is cheaper as the other customer stated!

product_title: Kushies "On The Go" 2-Pack Wet Bag, Large
review_body: I use these for daycare. I put 2 in his baby bag. The daycare provider puts his used bottle nipples in one bag and dirty clothes and bibs in the other. It's a great system and works for us. (We use the playtex drop in liner bottles, so the only soiled item at the end of the day is the nipples and rings. THe bottles stay with her (she has 6 of them) and the liners go in the trash). Hope this helps1

product_title: Medela SoftFit Replacement Parts Kit Pump In Style Original #PISKITOSF-ST
review_body: Worked great would never know they weren't the original parts to my pump! Product came clean and tubes were in a sealed bag.

product_title: Tilty Sippy Cup, 7 Ounce, 2 Pack
review_body: This cup was helpful for my daughter, who had trouble tipping other sippy cups up enough to drink from at first.  After a couple of days using the tilty, she got the idea and was able to use all of her sippy cups.  After that, it became her least favorite cup- it has no handles, which for us would be a real help.  Also, the cups seems a little flimsy, so if we have a second child, and have the same problem, we will have to buy new tilty cups, because I doubt these will last, even though we don't use them often anymore.    So I gave it four stars, it did what I needed it to do, but no handles + only coming in sets of 2 = sort of a waste.

product_title: Chicco 360 Degree Rotating Hook On Chair
review_body: I don't often write reviews, but I wanted to write one for this chair since I read many reviews before buying it. I was a bit concerned about a few things prior to the purchase, namely the gap of the swivel part getting stuck with bits of food and how to keep the chair clean. I can say that I am really happy with the purchase. The seat is easy to install. It's not very hard to take the fabric off to wash it. I do it once a week. Yes, it gets absolutely dirty, but it's just food. I wipe my child's hands then the seat, tray and wipe on the floor, all with the same washcloth. It works great for us. I highly recommend getting this chair because it comes with the tray. We don't use the 360 degree feature too much, but it's nice to have.

product_title: American Baby Company Heavenly Soft Chenille Bassinet Sheet
review_headline: Super Soft - Mom & Baby Love It!
review_body: I love this sheet! Stays soft after washing and drying it multiple times.  It fits my bassinet perfectly (Burlington Basket Bassinet Cradle).  My baby sleeps so well on it so I will definitely be buying another.

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_headline: Useless, Use a pen and paper instead
review_body: I was so excited to use this product because of the great reviews and it just seemed like a very functional gadget.  When my daughter was born, I only used it to check the time.  I recorded everything by pen and paper - the last time she ate, slept, pooped, etc. for myself as a reminder and to report to my pediatrician her activities.  Plus, my baby told me when it was time to feed, when she pooped, when it's time to sleep again, etc...  This item is useless.

product_title: Regalo Easy Open Extra Wide Metal Walk Through Safety Gate
review_body: This gate is very flimsy poor design and was showing rust through the paint in the first week. Piece of junk not worth one tenth of it's price!

product_title: Britax B-Ready Stroller BLACK
review_body: This stroller is awesome! You can use it from infancy though toddler years. product_title: Dreambaby Stroller Fan
review_body: We bought these fans for our daughters' strollers since we live in a really hot, humid climate and we're outdoors a lot.  We bought three and one of them never even made it out of the house.  The switch would not stay in the on position, and kept popping into the off position.  The motor died on the second fan after about 5 minutes of use, and the third lasted the longest, about two hours.  The foam blades on the fan are very soft and fold easily, which may be safe for the kids, but if the blades don't line up right the fan doesn't rotate, so they stop turning frequently, until you readjust the blades.  The clip part is very heavy compared to the rest of the fan, so they tip forward from the weight a lot.  Also, we have a Maclaren, a very popular stroller, and the clip does not open wide enough to fit on our stroller frame.  These were just a total waste of time and money.  We've already retuned them to Amazon.

product_title: Kushies 5 Pack Reusable Ultra Diapers
review_headline: Kushies - best diapering solution I have used.
review_body:
Our son is now 6 months old and I have been using Kushies since he was about two months old. The ones I am using are the 10-22lb range as he was over 9lb when born, so it didn't take long for him to wear them!

I had tried both the Bummies and Thirsties and had a lot of leaks with both, meaning more changes of clothes and even more laundry. I far prefer the velcro fasteners to the snaps as it's quicker. I use disposables at night, but Kushies during the day.

1) Snug fit and comfortable, high quality.
2) Make sure the liner is in place for easy poo removal.
3) Have a plastic container with lid for soaking Kushies prior to washing - I put Oxyclean in it and about 6 inches of water. I then can wash them every 2-3 days and they don't smell at all. I tip the whole thing in the washer, drain cycle first (2mins) and then wash.
4) If you tumble dry them fold the velcro tab back onto themselves so it doesn't stick to other diapers in the machine.
5) Read the instructions about how to put the flap inside for boy vs. girl babies; it makes a difference!
6) Excellent value - I initially thought they were expensive, but they wash very well and are very tough and well made. I bought 3 packs of five, for the next size up I will buy more.
7) Dry them outside in the sun if you can.
8) Easy to use.

I like that the baby knows when they are wet and does know that it's uncomfortable. I think this may help in potty training in the future, as why bother going to the bathroom if your disposable diaper keeps you too comfy? I hope this helps and saves you the time and cost of trying other, less effective, solutions.
