product_title: Jeep Wrangler Twin Sport All Weather Stroller, Heat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Jeep Wrangler Twin Sport All-Weather Umbrella Stroller
review_body: I'll start with the seats: they have completely changed how the seats are designed. They are far more supportive and have these really nice cushion-like supports all over them. There's even extra padding for a headrest. They sit at a much higher angle than previous models. There is even a lumbar support. The recline feature has also been revamped and is much simpler. No more buckling and unbuckling. The seat does not go completely flat, but it goes flat enough, even for an infant. Because of the change of design in the footrest area - there is actually more leg room. The 5 point harness is padded where it needs to be and easily adjustable. Something I especially like is they've added a little buckle at the top where the harness fastens to seat allowing you to move it higher or lower, depending on the size of the child.   The canopies: these things are HUGE! The best I've come across. Also redesigned in the 2011 model. They are now ratcheting and seem to go even further forward. The peek-a-boo window on the top now covers the entire top of the canopy - allowing you to see the whole child. The peek-a-boo window cover rolls up and tucks into a handy pocket on top of the canopy. Another great new feature is 2 velcro straps that have been added to the canopy - these allow you to pull up the excess material when the canopy is all the way back - giving an older child more head room.   The ride: It is so smooth. It's like pushing air - seriously. And the shocks make it just as nice for the passengers to ride in as it is for the parents to push. The wheels are large and the rims are now made of a heavy duty plastic instead of bendable metal (and my husband says they look much \\"cooler\\"). Another feature I like is that they have angle the air valves so it's really easy to attach a pump to put air in if necessary. Front wheel still locks the same way, or swivels. And the back wheels easily pop off for flatter storage. The footbrake is easy to use - a simple bar - you either push down or lift up.   Transporting the stroller: The fold on the BOB is so simple and easy. One feature that they changed is the \\"leash\\". It used to be this long yellow thing that just got in the way. Now it's short, attached to the handle bar, and doubles as a snap to lock the stroller closed when folded. No more unexpected stroller openings as you are trying to load it in - a great new feature! Opening the stroller is still the same: shake it out - nice and easy! It weighs around 32/33 pounds. I don't even notice the weight really because I'm used to my tandem stroller that weighed 46 pounds. And let's face it - unless it's an umbrella stroller - all doubles have some weight to them.   Storage: the storage basket has also been redesigned. Instead of a simple square - they have added raised sides to it - allowing the basket to be deeper and packed higher. Also, with the \\"leash\\" thing no longer connected to the brake - I can easily toss my diaper bag in.   Overall: I love the new design. They've changed the fabric and it is much nicer. It also appears to repel water & moisture well. I think BOB did a good job of addressing issues with their prior models and making a great, user friendly product. My only complaint: I wish a belly bar/snack tray was included.   About me: I'm a mom of 2 kids - a 22 month old toddler and an 8 month old baby. My kids love this stroller. They look so comfortable and happy riding in it. I carefully researched my purchase before shelling out this amount of money. I compared everything from the Baby Trend Jogger, the Bumbleride Indie Twin, Mountain Buggy, Baby Jogger Citi Mini/Elite. And overall, I really felt I got the best deal for the money with the BOB. They offer a 5 year warranty on the frame of the stroller which I think says a lot about their confidence in their product. Everything else (all the other parts and fabric) and warrantied for a year. I actually purchased an earlier model BOB a little before this one. I couldn't stand it. And my husband didn't like it either. The only thing we could say was that it was easy to push. They have made such a HUGE improvement with the redesign of the 2011 model. I'm so glad I gave the a second look. I'm so happy with my purchase and feel my money has been very well spent.

product_title: Bright Starts Around We Go 2-in-1 Activity Center
review_headline: Around We Go Activity Station, Doodle Bugs
review_body: Perfect sitting-option for babies who can't sit up yet!  A great baby work-out!  They use their upper-body to reach, lower-body to move forward, resulting in the strengthening of their core musculature.     For babies 4 months and older (do not leave them unattended!),  lets baby strengthen his/her back and hold their heads up while learning to reach. For the younger babies, we fold a blanket behind baby to secure them in seat and put a pillow under their feet so their feet touch a surface. Start with 2-3 minutes and gradually add more minutes as baby grows. Ditch the blanket and pillow as baby matures, and he/she will self-propell the seat around the activity station.  This is basically a walker that is tethered to an activity station.     We could use  two of these!  We rotate it's use for my two grandsons--5 months and 7 months--as wells as my great-niece who is 9 months. It is not intended to be a babysitter.

product_title: Kalani 4-In-1 Convertible Crib with Complete Toddler Mattress with Hypoallergenic Waterproof Cover
review_headline: Solid crib at a great price--no nicks or dents yet!
review_body: I debated purchasing this crib vs a more expensive one, but have been very pleased with this one.  It arrived within 10 days and was not damaged.  My husband and father-in-law were able to put this together in about an hour.  It is a solid crib and looks great (bright white color as described), especially when compared to the more expensive cribs I saw in Babies R Us and Buy Buy Baby.  The quality is better and the crib is sturdier than those AND costs $100-$300 less.  I had a c-section and have been able to put the baby in and lift her out without any problems when the matress is on the highest setting.  My 2 month old has been sleeping in it periodically since she was born and enjoys it.  I bought the Sealy Soybean Foam-Core Crib Mattress which is a perfect fit and bought the South Shore Furniture, Peak-a-Boo Collection, Changing Table with Drawers--everything looks great together. I haven't had any paint chipping or nicks on the crib as yet and I took my fingernail and tried to dent the crib without success. But when my baby starts teething, I will investigate a teething rail.  Also, I do see a potential problem with my baby's hands or legs getting stuck between the slats (even though they are the legal distance apart), so I will get a breathable bumper in the near future.  For the price it is a great buy, but those two foreseeable issues is what causes me to give it only 4 stars.

product_title: Philips AVENT Basic Baby Monitor with DECT Technology (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: More than one year later, still working great . . .
review_body: We purchased this monitor in February of 2010 to replace another brand that had never worked well before it ultimately failed. ( I wrote quite the nasty rant about that one, surprised that Amazon published it . . . )    A year and a few months later - it's still going strong.  The reception has been very good - range extends outside our home and to the limits of our yard even through a brick wall. Sound quality is decent considering its size.  Its clean sounding, and has never ever given us static or scratchy sounding reception. Its bright blue activity lights are enough to catch our attention when the volume is turned down.    One con is that the transmission unit needs to be placed fairly close to the bed or you will just pick up major sounds.  If you're the type that likes to hear your child breathing at night, it needs to be about four feet away from the pillow and the sensitivity setting has be at max (always on).    You might also need to know that to get the advertised 24 hour battery life you'll need to use the lowest sensitivity setting - which effectively mutes the unit for soft sounds.  We use the max setting and get between 6 to 8 hours depending on the child's noise level that night.    None of the cons above are worth a star, it's the last con that makes this a 4 star review:    After little more than a year, it's time to find a replacement rechargeable battery for the parent unit.  We were getting 6 to 8 hours, now down to the 2 to 4 hour range.  I've searched everywhere for a compatible replacement, and the only place I can find it is direct from the Philips parts store. (It's part number 996510031439 for anyone that needs one.)  That site wants 16 bucks for the battery, plus 9 more for the cheapest ground shipping . . .  ouch.    If anyone knows of a compatible replacement from Amazon for this battery, I would love to hear about it.

product_title: Britax Boulevard 70 Convertible Car Seat (Previous Version), Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body: Our son was quickly outgrowing his bucket, so we knew the time was close at hand to move him up to a bigger seat. We wanted a seat that would be a safe as possible, in our price range, and with conveniences we really wanted, namely easily adjusted straps. Our son is already 21+ lbs at 7 months and we knew that \\"easily adjustable\\" was top of the list if he kept this growth pace up! The seat is very easy to use, seems comfy (our scream-every-car-ride kiddo now screams half the car rides!), and can be easily taken out and re-installed, I just took a 2 week vacation and removed and reinstalled it over 8 times in the duration, whether with LATCH or the old belt and buckle, it is an easy process. I was a little worried about the size, both of our cars are smaller, but it fits fine in the backseat of the '08 Prius and the '00 Altima. We'll definitely be buying Britax in the future.

Now, she seemlessly transitions from bottles during the day to breast at night - and her gas is GREATLY reduced.

product_title: Green Sprouts Warming Plate
review_body: I assumed by the name (my fault) that this product would be eco friendly.  Not the case at all.  I have to laugh when I see \\"pvc free\\" because as far as I know just about all plastics are now pvc free.  The plate is not biodegradable or even made from recycled materials.  I wasn't a fan of the quality either.  The suction doesn't work on our table (wood).  This plate really doesn't keep the food warm, even if you have spent the 20 min needed to warm babyfood in warm water.  I guess unless you're brave enough to use the microwave, you have to know at least 30 min ahead of time when the lil' one will be hungry.  We've tried the schedules but they just don't work for us.  He eats when he's hungry.  Unfortunately, sometimes that means he eats cold food.

product_title: RaZbaby Keep - It - Kleen Pacifier Holder - Pink
review_body: I've had no problems with this clip; in fact I love it! I have been using mine for 10 months with my daughter and it still in great shape. It attaches very well to her MAM pacifiers and I can get them on and off easily, but she can't (the rubber ring holds on great). The clip itself holds well to her clothes and her car seat strap. You squeeze to attach and lift the latch to release, which is quite simple, but I've noticed others had a hard time figuring out how to undo it before I showed them (grandma and babysitter).

product_title: Skip Hop Zoo Toddler Kids Insulated Backpack Otis Owl, 12-inches, Blue
review_body: A backpack is definitely way better than a traditional diaper bag. When the child is a toddler and not such a small infant you don't really have to carry quite as much stuff anymore like bottles, complete extra outfit, a million diapers, etc. and you can definitely use a smaller bag. My son loves to carry this cute backpack himself. That frees Mommy for carrying more stuff like the grocery bags or her own gym bag :-) However if he falls asleep in the car or whatever, this backpack adjusts very easily & quickly to sling over an adult's shoulder to carry it. Pockets very thoughtfully designed. Very good.

product_title: Safety 1st Pacifier Medicine Dispenser
review_body: Def works, but my baby won't be fooled...I was looking for yet another option for medicine dosing while teething, but I guess he is on to my tricks. I even tried to give a little apple juice in it but he was having none of that! It works, but these darn babies are smart and strong-willed (who knew?) so now I'm trying the fast melt tabs. They dissolve before he can spit it out.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, My Little Snugabunny (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: how could anyone give this swing less than 5 stars? I wish i could give it more. This is the best $130 i have ever spent! my daughter loves it! in fact she is in it right now. the seat is so comfy and soft. the music is very calm and happy. i usually use the music with nature sounds. the mobile is very cute. my daughter loves the mirror. and the birds are nice as them move up and down as well as around. the only thing i would change is that the music wouldnt shut off after 20 minutes. and a remote would be nice. the swing its self makes up for that tho. i truly love that it pluggs into the wall! i hate buying batterys all the time! this really is the best swing i have ever seen. my friends all say they are jealous and i wish it came in adult size. my daughter (3 months) wont sleep unless someone is holding her. dont ask me why she was like that from day 1. well she sleeps in this swing! amazing! from the first day i used it it already paid for its self. 5 start well deserved! thank you fisher price for making such an amazing swing!

product_title: Mobicam DL Digital Monitoring System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a great camera and we have been very happy with it.  The video quality is good and so is the sound. I like that you can turn the video off so the bright light of the screen is off and still have the sound on when you sleep.  The battery on the video screen lasts about 6 hours so be sure to plug it in when you fall asleep.  The video screen shows the time which is great in the middle of the night.  The only downside is that there is no rechargeable battery for the camera so you can't just grab it and take it in the other room, you have to unplug and replug it in.  There is a spot for a battery so it must be in development.

product_title: GroVia Booster (2 Count)
review_headline: Fantastic: my picky baby doesn't fuss if he's wet during naptime.
review_body: My boy is very fussy upon peeing or pooping.  Even in disposable diapers.  Before I used these, he was waking up crying every time he eliminated waste: both of us weren't getting much sleep.  These boosters are great because they allow more absorption within the organic cotton layer.  But most importantly, the polyester fleece outer layer doesn't hold moisture well, keeping the surface that touches the skin feeling drier.  My boy can sleep uninterrupted, thanks to these boosters.  As with any diaper, there is only so much liquid a diaper can retain.  When there is too much liquid in the diaper, he will wake but it takes him a longer time to get to this point because of the boosters.

product_title: Angel Dear Ring Rattle
review_body: this is very soft has a nice rattle sound and a cute frog. its still too wide for my 2mos old to grab so he hasn't shown any interest in it yet. but i think (hope) he does. so not 5 stars. seems good (better) than other things he could put in his mouth.i.e. plastics etc...

product_title: Infantino Twist and Fold Activity Gym
review_body: My son loves this mat. I didn't get I until he was nearly 4 months old and wish I had gotten it before he was born. He loves the toys and it's easy to attach other toys to change it up a little. The fabrics are soft and easy to wipe clean. He used to hate tummy time. After getting this mat, he started rolling over and looking at the patterns and mirror.     This would make a great shower gift. It something that might be overlooked but is a great place to lay the baby and keep them entertained from a very early age.

product_title: Little Remedies Everything Baby Needs Travel Kit
review_body: I have used every single item in this kit but the lollipops. All products work great, the nasal bulb is great since it is small so it is more delicate for newborns, and you can open it and clean it!  The nail clipper is a bit slippery because it is so small but I use it all the time. I have purchased a second kit for travel. Must have.

product_title: Lamaze Tug & Play Knot
review_body: I have this hanging over my 6 month old's playmat and she loves it!  She is always putting the pieces in her mouth and shaking them so they make noise.  It is perfect for a baby her age.

product_title: Graco Cool Mist 1.5 Gallon Humidifier
review_body: I bought this \\"humidifier\\" a few days after my son was born. He had pretty bad nasal congestation as a newborn. This product does not humidifier any. I do not mine the loudest of the product as it provides good white noise for my son. But it just not do what it is supposed too.

product_title: Buggy Buddy
review_headline: excellent product on the uppababy stroller
review_body: I have the 2010/2011 Uppababy Vista Stroller and this Buggy Buddy works GREAT on it.  i can keep a few bottles, my phone and keys on it... it's perfect.   The only thing i was slightly irritated with was that i had to pay $5 bucks for shipping and handling ....and it took a few days to get to my house.  I knew this ordering it so it was fine then..but what i was annoyed at was that a day later  AMAZON had the item available by another seller and it was available on PRIME so i could have saved the $5 bucks S & H and had it to my house in 2 short days.   not a big deal but 5 bucks is 5 bucks. especially on a $10 dollar item. overall, GREAT product.

product_title: Bright Starts Around We Go 2-in-1 Activity Center
review_body: After shopping around for this activity center, amazon.com was the cheapest.  My daughter enjoys going around the different stations and is kept entertained for a while.  For me to say she'll sit there all day would be far fetched.  No baby does that! But you have to buy different things to really keep your baby \\"busy\\".  I like it and recommend this.  I had to buy the real walker so she could be mobile, but she's almost ready to walk and will stand outside of the chair and push it around and round.  Its expensive enough that when she's done with it, i can sell it and get some of my $$ back =). thats always nice.

product_title: Oh Plah Teething Bracelet
review_body: Super cute and matches everything, plus my 8 month old always has a toy to chew.  Unfortunately, it was stolen but I loved it so much I am ordering a new one.

product_title: Carters Easy Fit Sateen Crib Fitted Sheet, Chocolate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: A perfect fit on standard crib mattress, this sheet is very soft and has such a rich color. Washes well.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Natural Flow Standard Reservoirs Replacement, 2 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These are for the *tall* bottles, and are blue like the reservoirs that come with the original bottles. Be sure to use the Dr. Brown's cleaning brush in the stem part... these and the inserts can grow loads of germy funk if you don't.  Good replacement part.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: I bought this as a gift. It came in a timely manner. It is cute and was a good price. I was happy with this buy.

product_title: Chicco Keyfit 30 Infant Car Seat and Base, Adventure (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We've been using our keyfit 30 for 6 months and love it.  It looks and feels nicer than the Graco and my baby looks comfy in it.  She does get warm and sweaty sometimes, but I found if I place a cloth wipe behind her head, it helps a lot.  It is heavy, but I appreciate that and feel that it is safe and not cheap plastic.      For those of you who complain about it not fitting in a shopping cart, it is not safe to put ANY car seat in the top of a shopping cart, and all of the manuals say so!  It becomes a tipping hazard.      If I had to start over, I would get this car seat again in a heartbeat.

product_title: BabyKicks 3 Pack Joey Bunz Premium
review_body: I bought these for doublers at night. So far they work best over Stay Dry inserts in a Flip cover. If I put them in by themselves in a pocket (Kawaii OS) they don't leak but they do bunch up and look uncomfy (although they are very trim & my LO doesn't seem to mind). I did have both bunching and leaks when used alone with a Flip cover, so I wouldn't recommend that. They do dry quickly and are very soft. I only wish they were a little stiffer so they wouldn't bunch up when used alone. I have a BabyKicks hemp insert that came with a BabyKicks diaper that I can use in the Kawaii with no bunching. That is my only complaint though. They work well at night (my LO is in his night-time diaper 6:30pm-6am) with no leaks. The large size fits perfectly in my Flip covers and my Kawaii OS both opened all the way for my almost 24lb (30.5 inches long) 12 month old. I do recommend these as doublers at night.

product_title: Safety 1st Alpha Omega Elite Convertible Car Seat
review_body: We have an older version of this seat which has been fantastic, and so we just purchased this one for our second child. The cover of the old one has been washed several times. Though the cover it is tricky to remove and re-attach, it holds up well in the washer. (We cannot say that about our Graco infant seat, the fabric of which expanded beyond useable dimensions!)    It seems that some others have had trouble with installation, but there are solutions. I have installed the seat, rear-facing, in a car as small as a Hyundai Elantra, though the fit in a Civic Coupe is just too tight to be practical. Installation in a minivan leaves plenty of room. The key is to have a rolled up towel or blanket under the front of the seat to achieve the proper angle. It is best installed in a central position in smaller cars. Also, it is necessary to place your weight into the center of the seat (with you knee) when pulling the straps tight (as is the case with every seat we have owned, including travel system bases). If the seat springs upwards a little when tightly fastened, place the child into it and see if it returns to the correct angle. Another reviewer suggested removing the base, so those with smaller cars may wish to investigate.    This is a great seat - I recommend it highly.

product_title: Evenflo Purely Comfi 9 oz. Angled Bottle- 6 Pack
review_headline: not a toy was baby bottles
review_body: these are great baby bottles not toys I am 56 and can write a review without using 20 words or more thank you very much

product_title: Munchkin Arm and Hammer Nursery Fresheners
review_headline: great scent but  don't cover up diaper smell
review_body: These little handy plastic pugs are filled with scented baking powder and smell great. But you have to shake the to refresh and even three inside my diaper champ don't cover up the smell.  Great concept, but not quite as effective as I had hoped.

product_title: Luvable Friends Fitted Knit Crib Sheet
review_headline: Cheap, color off more like lime green, but good deal, soft
review_body: i was a little dissapointed in the color, i bought porta crib sheets in same color and those are celery green, but these look more like yellow green. it'll still work, they are soft and cheap so it'll serve its purpose, but too yellow so it doesn't really match. overall id still get it maybe just a different color or expect it to be more yellow/lime than green :)

product_title: Evenflo Maestro Booster Car Seat - Akane
review_headline: Good spare, especially for short trips
review_body: We bought this seat because we needed a spare carseat for preschool carpool, and the price was right.  Our son' regular carseat is a Graco Nautilus, which we LOVE... but we weren't about to sink $140 into a \\"spare\\" carseat.  Prior to that, we had the Evenflo Triumph (rear and forward facing), and really liked it, so we were expecting decent quality.  The Maestro does what we need - provides a 5 point harness for a guy who isn't quite ready for a booster (and belt guide for later).  The size is nice and compact (we can fit two passengers alongside it in a Chevy Equinox).    Just little things that add up... the shape and padding are completely awkward and it just doesn't look very comfy.  The day we used it to drive 40 min, our son was wanting to get out and asked for his \\"good\\" carseat back.  He has no problem with the 8hr drive to his grandparents in his other seat.  The straps don't have covers, and are made of a rougher material/weave than our other seats, so they're also not as comfy.  The \\"pillow\\" part is only useful if you leave the 5-point harness at the lowest level (there is no where to secure it higher if the straps are positioned higher).  Overall, it accomplishes just what we need.  A compact, affordable seat for short trips.

product_title: Brica My Tray, Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I only gave this 4 stars because I haven't actually used it yet.  I just got it today.  We go on so many road trips; I wanted something sturdy for my daughter to be able to color and so on.  Its a little of a tight squeeze but it does fit on the car seat.  Also, I was very surprised how soft it is.  I'm glad for obvious safety reasons.  I hope it works out for us this weekend when we go on an eight hour road trip.  I will update this review when we get back =)

product_title: Hello Kitty Shopping Bag Handbag Tote Purse White
review_body: I LOVE this bag!  I get so many compliments on it and everyone wants to know WHERE did I get it!  Comes with the extra strap, I have had it for a couple months now and it still looks beautiful,  exterior wears nicely.  The only thing I wish is that the bag and pockets had a little more support for closing the magnetic exterior pockets and that it would stand up a little more by itself.  But, I am still very please with it!  If they had bright pink and black I would buy them too!

product_title: Mesh Bed Rail for Toddler Beds and Convertible Cribs
review_body: Our daughter was ready for a toddler bed and her crib converted to one but the first night she fell out and ended up in the middle of her floor.  This crib bed rail is the perfect solution.  It is super easy to install and sturdy and keeps our child safe.  I recommend it.

product_title: Britax Frontier 85 Booster Seat
review_body:
We have owned this seat for a month, and so far it looks like a great product. It is comfortable yet doesn't take a tremendous amount of space, belts don't get twisted any chance they get, fabric seems to be comfortable.

Only small problems are the armrests which don't fold up (would have been a wonderful feature), and the belt release button (not the one in the buckle but the one on the seat which allows you to loosen the belts) is a bit difficult to reach under all that fabric. Other than that - pure joy all the way.

product_title: Trend Lab White Terry Hooded Towel withTwill On Hood And Trim
review_headline: love it, and so much cheaper than others...
review_body: I love this towel.  It's not as good (soft, thick, nice, high quality) as my aden + anais one, but for about a third of the price, it's super cute, relatively soft and definitely serves its purpose.

product_title: Safety 1st Alpha Omega Elite Convertible Car Seat, Beaumont
review_body: I have one Alphia Omega Elite Convertible seats and were going to get another one for my hubbys car. Its great that this seat will grow with him and i wont need to get him another seat one for a long time. It is pretty easy to install. I still took mine to the local police department to make sure it was correct. I think everyone should.     The only thing that i wish was different is that i had more room for my passenger in front on the seat. It does not leave much room. But that is all.     Thank you saftey first for making my angel feel safe and snug in his seat.

product_title: Imse Vimse Sanitary pads 3 pcs, Organic Regular
review_body: Comfortable and absorbent, everything I look for in a pad. The waterproofing is hidden between cotton layers, and the cotton on the bottom keeps the whole pad from sliding around. The wings are small and don't go the whole length of the pad, which actually keeps the wings from getting soiled. I would recommend this brand to anyone who doesn't want to choose a pad with synthetic material.

product_title: Prince Lionheart washPOD Bathe
review_body: This pod did not work for us. When my baby was little, she slipped around far too much, and every attempt to use the pod felt like it was way too close to accidentally drowning her. The video of her first bath? It looks like I'm intentionally trying to drown her in a bucket.  I tried every couple weeks up until she was 7 months, when she could stand up and tip the thing over.  I'm glad this worked for some people, but it was pretty horrible for us. We instead used the folding baby bath by prince lionheart, and now I just put her in the tub with the water running but no stopper in while I wash her, then just take her out.  I never like to even look away while they are in the tub, and I keep my hands on her at all times to reinforce this.

product_title: Nosefrida Hygiene Filters
review_body: Works great

product_title: Babykicks 3G Pocket Diaper
review_body: Pros: This diaper is really trim.  I love the fleece at the leg gussets to keep away those nasty elastic marks that are often left by other diapers.  By nature the pocket diaper is very convenient because you can keep them stuffed and ready to use just as quickly/easily as you could a disposable.  BabyKicks 3g have hemp inserts which are super absorbent.  The bamboo (I think that is what it is) layer that sits against baby's skin is so soft and fluffy -- who wouldn't want to sit in that?    Cons: The pocket is a little harder to stuff (however, I believe that is just because the diaper is so trim and it's not problematic, just takes a couple seconds longer than some other diapers to stuff).  I don't use these for overnights because sometimes the fleece at the leg gussets wicks a little bit and pjs end up damp (great for naps or any other time though).

product_title: Cardinal Gates Auto-Lock Gate
review_body: There was a gate installed from the previous owners of the house (a KidCo Safeway Gate) but we lost one of the parts plus getting that gate open was a challenge even with two hands. The auto lock gate is sturdy metal and I'm really liking the auto lock feature. The gate swings shut into a locked position without any assistance. Opening the gate can be done one handed fairly easily, but I think it's difficult enough to prevent my baby from letting himself down the stairs. Installation was quick and simple involving drilling a few screws into the wall. I used some longer screws instead of the packaged ones that came as part of the drywall anchors I purchased separately.

product_title: JJ Cole Outdoor Blanket,Blue Orbit, 5' x 5'
review_body: I just got this blanket yesterday & I have to say I'm very pleased.  I sat on it on my living room floor and only had mild confusion when trying to fold it back up for the first time. ;)  I'd recommend this item!  It's certainly big enough for a family picnic.

product_title: Vital Baby Baby's 1st Tumbler, 4 Ounce
review_body: This cup leaks every time I give it to my daughter.  It leaks through the side of the screw top.  I bought this as her first sippy cup.  It is small, but the mouthpiece is hard.  She still cannot tip it back far enough to drink out of it. I would not buy this cup again.

product_title: American Baby Company Organic Waterproof Natural Quilted Fitted Portable/Mini Crib pad cover
review_body: Rather small in my opinion-- won't cover but half of the top of the crib mattress, and it isn't white at all.  More of a natural/ivory color. Since it's much smaller than expected, I'll be using this as a cover for our changing pad {which is flat instead of the nicer contoured ones on the market}. Overall, the construction is fabulous- and very plushy, so it's very soft even before I washed it.  Would recommend to a friend.

product_title: Evenflo Chase LX Harness Booster Seat, Winchester
review_body: I ordered this seat and returned it five minutes later due to missing storage accessories. I received a new seat and same problem.  As I have a big boy seat for my son and am graduating my daughter to the Chase, it would have been great for her to have some place to put her toys as his seat allows this to happen.  Wishing I had known before I bought this that the tray does not come with it any longer. Now I am still going to have fussing over toys because there is no room for her to keep hers.

product_title: Bright Starts Rattle and Shake Barbell Rattle
review_body: I have bought this rattle from Target. My baby still play with this. It is not heavy and it is colorful. The best one out there. I just love it. So does my baby. I would recommend this to every mom.

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: We ordered this tub months ago when we were stocking up on stuff for the baby and when it came time to finally use it were disappointed to see that the plug actually leaks! Such a bad design and very disappointing.  Otherwise I would have really liked this tub and really like the infant sling attachment.

product_title: TUPPERWARE Shape O Ball Toy
review_body: I originally purchased this Tupperware Toy Ball for all my kids decades ago and was extremely pleased to learn that it was still available when I began having Grandchildren.  It has a unique appeal, and rates well above all the similar types of toys that have come out over the years.  Kids crawl to it before they can walk; they learn their three basic colors, shapes, and coordination.  They build muscles when they learn to open it up.  They learn to stack the pieces.  Best of all, then can amuse themselves with it as well for several years!

product_title: Levana Safe N'See Digital Video Baby Monitor with Talk-to-Baby Intercom and Lullaby Control (LV-TW501) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: First the claim about the range. In US/CA maybe... where the houses are made out of wood. In Europe the thick walls cut the range to about 3/4 walls. Just to go on the terrace outside the house I had to change the location of the monitor and put a foil cover on the antena.    Battery life is not great.     Today I found that the handheld kept showing the picture even when there was no noise in the baby room. The only way to stop it was to remove the battery and put it back in. Maybe it is just a glitch.    It does the job, but with all the technology today I was expecting more.

product_title: Britax Marathon 70 Convertible Car Seat (Previous Version), Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body: We had a problem installing the seat in the rear facing position in our Outback. We read the instructions pretty thoroughly and watched videos online about the rear facing installation but the chair still never stayed stable using either the LATCH method or the lap and shoulder belt method. We didn't try a swim noodle (kind of weird that Britax wouldn't supply something for us to use) and there was no good way to anchor the top teather in our Outback or our Jetta.     The front facing position, on the other hand, is very stable and our daughter loves to ride in this seat so that makes us really happy with it. She's only 13 months old though, and with the new safety guidelines, we're going to look into something else for her to ride in for the next 11 months.

product_title: Neat Solutions Neat-Ware Potty Topper
review_body: I just love this product. I always take it with me and I also have a pack in the car just in case. I love that my daughter doesn't come in to direct contact with the toilet seat so she is germ-free.

product_title: SwaddleDesigns Organic Ultimate Receiving Blanket, Natural with Color Trim
review_body: I hesitated to register for this blanket because it's so expensive, but I am so glad I did.  It's worth the money because we get so much more use out of it than the smaller, cheaper receiving blankets.  This is our favorite blanket for cold weather or air conditioned rooms, while we usually use the Aden + Anais muslin blankets (also expensive but worth it) in warmer weather.  I also thought about getting this blanket in a different color or pattern, but I am glad I went with the off-white flannel with chocolate trim stitching.  It matches everything, and when it's in photos (which is often), it's neutral, keeping the focus on my son.  The blanket is a great size (big enough for swaddling), super soft, just the right thickness (warm but not too heavy), and washes/wears well.  The only things I would change are the tags.  There are two, and while they are silky and soft, they are still annoying.  One is kind of large and has swaddling instructions, which I think is unnecessary to permanently attach to the blanket.  The tags are sewn in with the decorative edge stitching, so cutting them off might mess up the blanket.  They are centered on one side, which makes folding the blanket in halves awkward, and we're frequently adjusting the blanket so that the tags aren't near our baby's face.  Even with that minor complaint, though, I still give this blanket five stars.

product_title: Vital Baby Toddler Straw Cup, 10 Ounce
review_body: I like things that are easy to clean. This is a typical straw cup, nothing special about it. Pain to clean, even in the dishwasher it can still come back out dirty.

product_title: Pinzon Baby By aden + anais 2 Pack Muslin Security Blanket
review_body: Much smaller than I thought.  About 20in X 20in.  I still like it a lot, very cute, but was expecting a full size blanket.

product_title: The First Years Jet Stroller, Black/Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Pros:
- Easy to assemble.
- Looks good.
- Larger wheels than most cheap umbrella strollers make it easy to push even over grass or gravel.
- Comfortable padded handles that are taller than most umbrella strollers.
- Built-in parent tray with a zippered compartment

Cons:
- The basket is much smaller than I expected from the pictures, and it's partially blocked by the frame. No way would a full diaper bag fit in there.
- It's not exactly difficult to fold, but it's not terribly easy either.
- The sunshade is fairly small. It can be removed/adjusted by simply snapping it off, but it's not ideal.

Overall, this is better than most umbrella strollers, so if you're buying it to use as a secondary stroller, it's fine. I would probably give it 4 stars if I were rating it simply as an umbrella stroller. But I expected it to be much more functional from the other reviews I read.

product_title: Pepperpot Baby Record Book, Camille (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this baby book. The inside pages are so adorable with the same pink and white detailing. There is a lot of room to write and plenty of picture space. You won't be disappointed!

product_title: Sunshine Kids Stroller Accessory Buggy Buddy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The reviews got this one right!  I LOVE this!!!  It holds my belongings and my drinks.  Has a zippered compartment as well. I use it for my Baby Jogger City Mini and it works great.  It even stays on when I fold the stroller.  I didn't want to waste $30 on the cup holders that come with my stroller, but this is truly a universal model that will work well on any stroller.  It is high-quality and not cheaply made.

product_title: Infantino Balance Baby Carrier, Spindles, 8-35 Pounds (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Deceiving example pictures but nice quality
review_body: I love the pattern and style of this carrier being that both myself and boyfriend can wear it. I feel like our baby's neck is so uncomfortable in this carrier. The pictures show a child happily in the back and the neck doesn't look crowded at all(which was the biggest factor in my decision to buy this one). My baby is 20lbs and 29\\" long in the 90th percentile, so she isn't a little pipsqueak,and it seems that it is tight around her neck. She sits comforatably in it, but i would much rather give her the option of being able to easily turn her head. We will be keeping this carrier but not be using this very often, just for when we go to fairs or on vacation where there would be too many people to push a stroller around.

product_title: Safety 1st Perfect Fit Gate
review_body: Ok, so I've had this gate for about a month and I thought it was great because it is very sturdy, and isn't very easy for a toddler to climb over. Well, I usually use it in front of my 2 year old's room door when it's his bedtime and at other times when I need to finish doing things around the house and don't want him to wander where I can't see him. Well, I put it in front of his door tonight and somehow he managed to stick his whole arm into the skinny opening (the handle part that you push down on to lock it). He was crying and it took me a while to get his arm free. I actually thought I was going to have to cut the handle part open! I am never going to use this gate again!  I've never had any problems with the few other products I've purchased from them, so I didn't expect this type of thing to occur. I just want other parents out there to know that it CAN be dangerous for some children!!!!

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_headline: Good video monitor and great customer service
review_body: We must have gotten one of the last ones for the low price of $99.98, and I'm glad we snagged it because shortly after, the price shot up to $298.98, although another seller through Amazon has it for $179.95.    This monitor has had very good reviews here, and it does what it's supposed to do as others have said. The picture quality is OK, but it's a bit wonky when you have the Auto Night Mode on which it is by default, as it sometimes tries to transition back and forth too much depending on how much light there is. Audio is loud enough, but tinny. The VOX mode conservers battery life by disabling the speaker when no noise is being made, and then having the monitor go into sleep mode when there is no noise for a few minutes. It then comes back on when there is some noise detected. Range is fine, as we can have the camera and the monitor at opposite ends of our house. I did not experience any interference with other devices. It is supposed to offer privacy encryption to prevent other people from picking up your signal and seeing your baby, but I had no way that I know of to prove or test that. As for build, it's made of very light plastic, which might feel a bit cheap as others have stated.    The support seems very good when I had questions about the battery life. With VOX active which it is by default, the battery fully charged can last around 9 hours. With VOX off and the monitor always on, the battery fully charged lasts between 3-4 hours. It is recommended to keep the monitor plugged in with the AC adapter for prolonged monitoring, like using it overnight, so that it doesn't shut off on you from low charge.    It's definitely a good deal at the $100 price point, but at the higher price points which it is now at, for it to be worth it, it would have to offer better audio and video, maybe a bigger screen, and be built of better material so that it doesn't have the \\"cheapy\\" feeling.

product_title: The First Years Babypro All In One Baby Food Maker (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got this as a first time mom who wanted to make her own babyfood in order to save money as well as giving my son the best food he could get.  My mother in law bought this product for me, at my request and I'm not sure why I'm seeing bad reviews!  It's awesome!  As for instructions, you really don't need any other than 9 oz of food takes 3 oz of water (to steam).  It's a little trial and error, but it took me less than one afternoon to figure it out for myself.    I usually can get two/three servings per each steam.  If you want to do more at a time, then get another processor.  But keep in mind that it really takes no time at all.  (I Facebook while I'm steaming, or do laundry), the unit sits right on my counter and it doesn't take up much space at all, it's easy to take apart and clean and it's simple to use!  After I put my son to bed is when I'll make his food, or on a weekend afternoon and that's all it takes to make up to two weeks of food.  As for recipes...there are tons of books out there and websites that are helpful if you really just take the time to look.    If you want something easier, then maybe you shouldn't be making baby food from scratch at all.  Sure it may take a while, it may be a little work, but isn't that the point?  It's worth the effort knowing your child is getting food that you've made for him and not just popping open a jar!  My son's favorite foods so far are cauliflower and mango!  He gets oatmeal swirled with real strawberry puree in the mornings and we're trying fish with lemongrass, starfruit and papaya this weekend!    The only reason why this isn't getting a full five stars is because I wish I could just a little more at a time.

review_body: This is a great cup! It has a soft mouthpiece, easy for drinking. We've tried ones with hard plastic mouthpieces and my son can't get enough liquid out of it. We have had no leakage problems and the cup holds up very well. It's perfect for leaving around the house (wherever he drops it) so that he can have a drink whenever he needs it.

review_body: This item has got to be one of the best finds for parents on a budget with 2 or more kids!  I was dreading the idea of taking my double stroller on a plane and this item gave me the option of taking my umbrella strollers instead.  I was bouncing the idea around of buying a double umbrella stroller, but I didn't have $60-95 dollars to spend, but I was able to afford another umbrella stroller.  My umbrella strollers are 2 different heights and not of the same brand and I was a little skeptical.  I figured for $10, why not try it out.  SO glad I did.  They stay together, you can turn them very easy with the use of one stroller.  Now that I know this works, I am going to purchase some of the accessories that go with the umbrella strollers!!  I recommend this to anyone!

review_body: Love this product!  It is a must have with any baby!  Can be used as an overnight bag for young children as well.

product_title: Jamocha Espresso 4 Drawer Dresser Chest
review_body: I was worried about this dresser when I first ordered it because no one had reviewed it. And after reading many reviews I knew I would be taking a risk. But this dresser is beautiful. My fiancé's many complaint is that it is not real wood (partical board) but it is well constructed. This dresser does come in about a million pieces and probably took about 3-4 hours to put together completely. The instructions were easy to understand and to follow. One good feature about this dresser is that the draws lock so that only one opens at a time, so that you or a small child cant easily pull the dresser over on top of themselves. Overall this dresser is great quality for the prices and looks great also for a small child or babies room.

review_body: This is a nice quality gate. It is easy to set up and take down as needed. We are using it for our grand daughter, so we didn't want to \\"install\\" a gate. This works out perfectly for us. We have it at the top of our stairs. My husband did add two blocks of wood on the bottom so our cats could get under easily, but not too high for the baby either. review_body: when you wash them, the white parts with \\"dirty\\" and \\"clean\\" and the babys face will come off. not practical. i just use the same trash bags i use for dirty diapers while oout if i have a dirty clothing item. much more practical.

review_body: bought this for my wife to replace a snoogle cover for our friend's snoogle that we are borrowing.  The product itself is as advertised and way cheaper on amazon.  Snoogle covers start to peel or have cotton dots over time and that's why we couldn't use our friend's cover.

product_title: Sugar Booger Divided Suction Plate
review_body: This is my daughters first plate and we love it. We have been using it pretty regularly for about 2 1/2 months so far. My lil miss (15 months old) likes her food separated, she just seems to eat more that way, so we definitely were looking for a divided one, and since we have a dog she likes to throw her food to him, so the suction helps keep her from dumping her whole meal to him, which was my fear with putting her food on a plate instead of the high chair tray. We think the suction works great. My method is half filling my cupped hand with water, pouring that on the high chair tray and spreading it around, then pushing the plate on and turning it about 180%. On occasion she has detached it, but 95% of the time it stays put. The design it very cute, and it has stayed in good condition through many washings already, including the dishwasher with the suction part taken off. The suction part can be a little tricky to put back on, but going into it with patience in mind helps, my husband takes twice as long as me to get it on because he gets frustrated right away. It can hold a very good amount of food, I would say about 12 oz.? She is starting to learn to use a spoon and fork herself and even the smaller sections have enough room for her to scoop up food. I would definitely recommend this to all friends and family, and I plan on giving it as a 1 year old birthday gift when given a chance.

product_title: Steribottle Ready to Use Disposable Baby Bottles
review_body: I bought these for a vacation, a four-hour car trip followed by an hour long ferry ride where we had to leave our car on the mainland, and I didn't want to be lugging nasty crusty bottles around.  They definitely work - no leaks, and a nicely shaped nipple that a baby who usually uses wide-base nipples would find comfortable.  The lid is NOT removable, as other reviewers have said; I had to carry my water separately and mix at feeding time.  The biggest problem was that the nipple is super fast, so fast that my baby got sick of being drowned and simply refused this bottle after the third one.  I have six left and he won't have anything to do with them.  Maybe I'll try again in a few months with the rest.

review_body: NOT a product for an agressive thumb sucker. The large compartment can only hold medium sized books, etc. But it couldn't be any larger or it would be too heavy for the little ones. I would think this bag is suitable for ages 2-6.

product_title: NUK Learner Cup BPA Free Silicone Spout, Single Pack
review_body: I picked this cup for my soon-to-be one year old son. I was kind of in a hurry and had heard from a friend that this was a great cup and the reviews were good, so I just ordered it without paying too much attention. I was definitely disappointed when a red and pink cup with flowers showed up. It does say colors vary, so that was my fault for not paying attnetion. I wish they'd give you the option to pick a color so you aren't just taking a gamble. :/ Anyway, I found this brand of cup in the store and I do really like it! My son seems to like it just fine too. But he doesn't seem to be too picky as long as it is this particular type of soft tip (he also likes the playtex brand cups). I think it's all a matter of preference for each child, though. My daughter HATED the same cups my son loves and vice versa, so I am judging these by sturdiness, ease of cleaning and how leak proof it really is. I give it a 4 star because it really is a very good leak proof cup and very easy to clean, but I'd really like to be able to pick the color. ;)

product_title: Summer Infant Best View Handheld Color Video Monitor, Sliver/White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: First of all, I've tried 3 different baby monitors with the screen. What I expected/wanted from the baby monitors are these:  1) Good quality of the screen so I can see my baby (even breathing: chest going up and down at night)  2) Easy of use (I just hate anything that is a pain to use)  3) Camera pan/zoom option (My baby moves around and I like having camera close to him, so this is a really good feature to have)    So, let me explain how those three monitors performed.      First one is Motorola Digital Video Baby Monitor with 3.5 Inch Color LCD Screen (At Amazon regular price: 229.99)    This one is the winner. It has a good picture quality, zoom in, is really easy to use. That's it. It satisfied all those three categories. Other feature I also liked but not necessary are,, talk back, lullaby (well, kinda useless for my baby). I wish it was made with a little better quality plastic (compared to other two I've tried) and wish it had clock on the screen, which is very helpful at night when the baby wakes up! One thing I noticed though, was that battery of parent unit goes out SO QUICK when it is not plugged in, and use rechargeable battery.        Second one is Samsung Wireless Video Security Monitoring System w/ 3.5\\" LCD (At Amazon regular price: 179)    This one,, sigh... I really wanted to love it... I always trust Samsung quality. and YES, it comes up to that quality standard (both physical material that is made out of, and some great added features) that I look for. BUT there are a few cons that I just could not live with.  First of all, this one is LOADED with FEATURES. It has the best quality screen (almost like a digital camera! which is very impressive for a baby monitor! Both day and night time, it showed consistent great quality), talk back, Date/Time, viewable from the computer, etc etc... Just a lot!    However what threw me off was that vibration/beep when the parents unit wakes up from the sleep mode. Basically this thing goes to sleep when the babydoes not make a sound or makes a sound that's not too alarming. It is trying to give parents some time to sleep unless baby cries so much. HOWEVER, I noticed that it did not pick up small cries that I also wanted to hear. And that VIOLENT vibration would just startle me every time the unit wakes itself from the sleep mode. I almost had heart attack every time it did it. I mean it is VIOLENT vibration. It is way too powerful and hear this, you can not control it, nor you can turn it off. You can either choose between vibration or loud beep, which is also annoying. I guess they did not test this out themselves. If they had a baby, they would know that just sound of a baby crying will wake parents up.    Another thing that made me return this unit: lack of zoom and pan feature. OK. I should have read before purchasing this one, but so sad it did not have this feature, while having all other useless ones?! weird.    The Last thing I wanna point out on this: freaking annoying to go around the menu and hard to use! This thing is loaded with features (a lot of not so necessary) and but failed to organize it successfully under the menu. Also, it has way too many buttons around the parents unit that I do not think are the \\"most-used\\" buttons for parents. Once again, did they really test this thing with real parents with real babies?!! It's like having a cell phone, trying to figure out where/what category the feature I want to use might be hidden under. A lot of them were where it did not make sense to me. Basically, very annoying to use.      Third one is Summer Infant Best View Handheld Color Video Monitor (At Amazon regular price: 199.99)    I had a high hope for this one, as I heard good things about Summer Infant baby monitors. I will make it short. It has the best \\"Ease of use\\" amongst all three. The parents unit had buttons (shapes and placements) that made most sense out of three I've tried. Plastic (or any other material that were used) quality was great. It does not have bells and whistles as other ones, such as talk back, lullaby, etc etc. It also has zoom in/panning feature that is very helpful.    BUT, this is why I returned this thing: the BAD, BAD, I mean BAAAAAAAAAAAD screen quality, especially at night. It made my baby look like those \\"ghost pictures\\" people take. Like those grainy pictures that people claim that they have captured the ghost in the picture... Get what I mean? It is super grainy I could not recognize my own baby's face! My baby's face filled up the whole screen (I'm saying this to say that I did not have the camera far from my baby) but still I had to guess, oh those two black blobs would be his eyes.. and another one below them is his nose?? no,, mouth??? Yes, basically, if you are looking for a baby monitor with a screen, why would you waste money on a screen that is useless? Move onto other monitors.      Finally, after using three, I realized that Motorolla had to be the winner, and I've been using it over a month and very pleased with it. Hope my review helped.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Adventurer Travel System, Stonewood  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: This thing sucks from the ground up!
review_body: I hate this stupid thing. The stroller part has wheels that rarely go in the same direction. They stick all the time and wont turn. Then once you stop using the car seat in the stroller and just use the stroller, it doesnt have any time of barrier to keep your baby from just falling out of the stroller seat. sure it has straps and of course we always use them but who in the world makes a seat for a baby that has no way for the baby to not fall out the second you put them in, before you have time to strap them in. nutz!    Then the car seat itself is a lemon! I dont know which is worse, the seat or the stroller. they both are horrible in my opinion. just constant headaches. The seat is sooo annoying to try to fasten because you have to hold the two hooks together while you simultaneously try to stick them into the bottom buckle. with a squirming baby that is often impossible. I could really go on and on for days i hate this thing soooo much. the only reason i even gave it 2 stars is because it technically functions but boy is it a big headache!

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Night Time Pacifier
review_body: I ordered these because I thought the glow-in-the-dark feature was cool. I was always loosing pacifiers in the crib at night. Unfortunetally, they don't glow for very long. About 10min. Also, only the loop glows too. I still like them though and my baby likes them. He likes to grab the loop and take it out of his mouth and try to put in back in. Funny because he is only 3 1/2 months old.

product_title: Graco My Ride 65 Convertible Car Seat, Cuddle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I don't like this seat. I bought ours 2 years ago now, and it just doesn't compare to our Britax marathon. The cover doesn't stay put, it's very hard to pull on the strap and adjust the harness when rear facing, we've had a lot of twised/uneven harness issues, and mostly, it will absolutely not last until your child is 65lb because she harness slots are too low.  Our daughter is 3.5, 38.5 inches and 29 lbs. She's very light for her weight, but 60% for height. She was rear-facing until last month, but her head was 1.5 inch from the top of the shell, we got a new car, so we just switched her forward. We had to move the harness to the top slot, and her shoulders are barely half an inch under the top slot now. I'm guessing she has a couple months left in it, but that's it. I can't imagine a child longer than 40 inches fitting in this seat... and I highly doubt they are anywhere near 65lb.

product_title: DaVinci Chloe Cradle
review_body: This cradle is a very smart buy. Excellent quality product for a great price. I definitely recommend this product to others.

product_title: Bandette Cup and Bottle Labels
review_body: I love it.  I don't have to write on my bottles anymore. I don't end up with ink all over me anymore.

review_headline: Great quality, and easy to use!
review_body: When we decided to look for a highchair, I was dissapointed in what we could find. Everything was either plastic with too many parts to keep clean, or way too expensive to consider. review_headline: Very happy I bought this pump..get the twin instead of single pump
review_body: I read a lot of reviews for both the Philips Avent electric pump and the Medela pumps before I gave birth and remembered that because there were such good reviews for BOTH, I went for Philips as it was less expensive. product_title: Playtex Twist 'N Click Spill Proof Cup Sippy
review_headline: They're great when they don't leak - and I figured out how to stop the leaking
review_body: I bought these cups for my daughter and loved them.  They didn't leak, they were easy to take apart and clean (unlike some other straw cup styles), they kept drinks cold, etc.  So, when it was time for my son to use them, I bought him the same cups and that's when the leaking problem began.  They leaked all the time.  They leaked even before he took a sip, whether they were in the refrigerator or on the counter (they tend to errupt like a volcano).      I eventually figured out the issue, which is a complete quality issue with the valves.  I initially called Playtex and they said you should barely insert the straw, which in my testing didn't have an impact.  They also said something I found quite ridiculous which was that you were always to start with completely dry parts every time you refill.  That's just not practical.  Anyway, after being quite frustrated with the issue, and it only seemed to start when I bought my son's cups (my daughter's cups were fine) I decided to figure out the problem.  It's the valve closure.  When you close the valve, peek through the straw (in some good lighting).  You could also just peek at it from the valve end before inserting the straw, but if I do, I usually double-check from both ends as it appears slightly different.  If you see holes/gaps/etc., then it will leak.  So, I played around with closing the valve and found that in some cases I had to barely close it, or could close it at an angle and the slits in the valve would remain closed (no gaps).  I noticed on an older valve (which was from my daughter's cups), I could close it all the way and the slits would stay closed.  So not all valves have the issue, but many do.  One thing I found interesting was that Playtex asked where I had bought my cups.  I had bought my daughter's cups at Toys R Us and my son's at Target.  I'm wondering if they purchase them from different sources - thus possible quality differences.  I did notice there is a difference in the lid closure between hers and his.  The same question was asked when I had called Pampers about some wet wipes that weren't of the usual quality.  I had bought those at Target too.    Anyway, Playtex is sending me a coupon for new cups (and I need to return the leaky ones), so I plan on buying the kind with the spouted lid rather than the straw.  I don't feel like wasting any more time in looking at the valve slits every time I assemble the cup.

product_title: Munchkin Arm & Hammer Diaper Pail
review_body: Our little girl is almost 2 now, and we've tried almost every single way you could think of to keep the stink from diapers from filling our house. We tried just putting it in our outdoor garbage whenever she had a \\"bad one,\\" and went through two different kinds of Diaper Genies (both of which broke in only a few months) before we went to this. The \\"smush\\" factor (having to \\"smush\\" the diaper into the pail) isn't nearly as bad as it sounds, especially when compared to the Diaper Genie. When your diaper pail isn't full, the design actually helps suction the diaper into the container. The Diaper Genie doesn't do this, and after a while, the \\"trap\\" in the Diaper Genie breaks (regardless of my over-attentiveness and reluctance to overfill the Diaper Genie). The A&H Diaper Pail, on the other hand, has withstood us transitioning into eating mostly solids and adult food, effectively keeping the smell in. I'll admit that when I do open the Diaper Pail to put a diaper in it does smell pretty terrible, but at least I know when I shut it, the smell goes away instantly. Another thing we really like is the design of the refill bags. The \\"handles\\" make it really easy to change out the refill, something I hated doing with the Diaper Genie because of it's odd cut/tear/tie bag design. On that note, the only suggestion I would have is to purchase the 3-box set of diaper refills from Amazon so that you can easily get diaper refill bags when you run out. I had the hardest time finding them, as it was hard to find a grocery store that kept them in stock.
