review_body: This sippy is easy for the little guy to hold and use. The straw-like spout is soft and almost like a bottle ~ so it's a nice transition between a bottle and a cup.   It rarely leaks, unless you put the lid on wrong. Our nipple did go bad though ~ some gunk had accumulated in a sippy that had been lost for a few weeks. I really got to scrubbing it ~ and I used a bottle brush to clean the air release hole. I think that I must have sliced the hole ~ so the fluid would leak. Other than that ~ we haven't had any problems and we really love these!

product_title: Protective Bottle Sleeve 8 oz., 2 Pack
review_body: These do a great job of protecting the glass.  They make it easy to hold onto and if you drop it  the glass won't break.  Couple tricky things to know tho - I don't think they're worth having until the baby is old enough to be holding their own bottle - they don't come off very easy (which is good as they dont slip and slide when you don't want them too) so they don't dry well if you wash the bottle and sleeve together.  The little finger holds should be adjusted so you can see the fl oz you measure to most often.

product_title: Lorex LW2003 LIVE snap Video Baby Monitor (White) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this monitor. It's small and works great. I love being able to see the baby in her crib. The power save feature is great at night when I want the sound off but the picture on. I can view baby with the click of a button. Great product.

product_title: Bestever Baby Mat
review_body: I bought this for my 10-month old daughter and she absolutely loves it! It is much softer and cushier than I expected it to be, and it's really adorable. I'm buying two more for gifts.

product_title: Summer Infant Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 1.8" Screen - Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: 5 stars;Summer Infant Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 1.8" Screen - Silver
review_body: 5 stars;Summer Infant Day and Night Handheld Color   Video Monitor with 1.8\\" Screen - Silver  ship/sold via amazon  good video and excellent audio.  audio stays on,  no automatic audio turn off in 5 minutes.  reliable.  had it over 2 years.  buy it.

product_title: Baby Delight Snuggle Nest, Green/White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: It's pricey for what it is, which is a pad.   The baby didn't take to it, so I give it two stars.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Toddler Weaning Spoons, 6+ Months (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: 5 stars if not made in China...
review_body: This is a great spoon, good size and shape with a nice feel in the hand. I was a little disappointed though when I recieved it and saw it was made in China. All the other AVENT products I have are made in England. I wish websites would think to post country of origin.

product_title: Tiddliwinks Bath Rug - Mod Pink and Brown (30x20")
review_body: I bought 2 of these and they are so cheap! I wash them on delicate and dry them on delicate and I still worry they will tear. The backing isn't rubberized at all and they slide around.

product_title: Lansinoh Manual Breast Pump
review_body: For the price, this is good to have around (i.e. occasional pump-and-dump or engorgement relief), but if I were to do frequent pumping, I personally would just bite the bullet and rent a hospital pump. No breast pump is particularly enjoyable, but this one was uncomfortable and cumbersome for me. Maybe I was spoiled from getting to use the effortless Medella Symphony hospital-grade pump around the time I had surgery for my breast abscess (the Symphony is AMAZING!), but this to me is best suited for emergencies or occasional use. It's not bad for those on a budget, however. Just don't use a snazzy hospital pump and you'll never know the difference. ;D

product_title: The First Years Ignite Stroller, City Chic (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The buckle on the five point harness broke the FIRST time I used it. Useless now and it cannot be returned! JUNK!

product_title: Britax Frontier 85 Booster Seat
review_headline: easy to adjust, easy to install, easy to clean, nice color
review_body: this chair is perfect, all the way around.  the box it came in was small, we just pulled it right out - no assembly required.  to adjust to fit our son, the directions were easy and it was easy breezy - even the pictures in the instruction manual made it easy to be sure that it was property fit.  the installation was easy, we have latches (pontiac vibe) and it just clicked right in.  it was a little tricky getting the over-the-seat latch to tighten, but that wasn't too hard.  much easier than his little boy seat that we were removing.  this seat won't be moved in and out.  this seat was heavy and sturdy, and much smaller than the previous seat that was in our car.  our son loves the cup holders, and the head rests - he said he liked the pillows (the head rests).  our son could also climb in and out of this seat easier since this seat isn't as high in the car as the old one.  he also can hook the 5-pt harness... but not undo it (which is OK with me).  the chest harness system is firmly in place, no slipping down like his old one.      i'm glad we got THIS britax seat (in blue, which is really nice fabric, easy to wipe off - also easy to remove the entire cover to wash!)

product_title: Joovy Scooter Single Stroller Black (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I'm sad to give this stroller four instead of five stars. Honestly I love this stroller. I'm a mother who spends hours and days and weeks researching every little detail before making the jump! I have only ONE complaint which you can read in the CON section of this review.     I did a TON of research and in-person deciding between the Joovy scooter, the baby jogger city, and the maclaran si. (and every other stroller you can imagine! but those were the final three). I'm VERY happy that I decided on this one over the others.     Pros:  -Folds easier than most strollers, however you do need both hands. Folds fairly compact compared to others as well.  -Huge Storage basket without being in the way when I walk (I'm 5'9)  -Very comfortable height to push  -Maneuverability! LOVE the way I can push it with ONE HAND. Seriously. I can push this thing on-handed all day long!   -I love the benefit of handlebars that I can hang things from, without having it be those annoying regular umbrella handles. These ones are very comfortable of the wrists unlike regular umbrella handles.   -Huge canopy with peek-through window  -Lays down a lot. not flat, but enough to change a diaper!   -Foot rest pops out for when the child is laying down.   -Not too heavy  -Wheels handle very well over bumpy paths or even when you are walking very fast.   -Looks good - I've gotten many comments on how it just LOOKS like a nice, durable stroller. Friends think that I paid well above the actual price.    Cons:  -The material the handles are made out of is very rough and after pushing to the park every day for about a week, the skin on the palm of my right hand (remember I said I LOVE pushing with one hand) was all red and a layer of skin was being torn off! I couldn't do dishes or anything that directly contacts my right palm for over a month!! It is still healing and whenever I push the stroller I throw a hand towel over the handles because that rough material just tears my skin up! I'm planning to try to wrap it with that tape for tennis rackets or hockey sticks. I'll update my post to let you know if it works!  -There is no snack tray. I think I may have found one from another company that will fit this stroller though, I'll update when/if I get one.

product_title: Sunshine Kids Radian Travel Bag, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Fits our Graco High Back Turbobooster just fine
review_body: This bag was designed to fit the Sunshine Kids Radian Car Seats. Knowing that, I ordered it anyway for my daughters Graco booster seat since the reviews were mostly positive and I knew I needed something!    It's a snug fit but it fits! As anyone who owns a Turbobooster knows, the high seat back easily comes apart from the seat base. I simply took it apart, nested the two pieces together and slipped it into this bag. It was a little tight getting the zipper closed but once closed, the bag didn't pull or tug anywhere.    I've taken ours on one trip - checking the bag at the curb both times. It came through with no damage to the bag or the seat. I am VERY happy with this purchase and highly recommend it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Auto Mobile Mirror (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I received this item as a shower gift, however I could not for the life of me figure out how to hook it up to my car seats. It came with no instructions in the package so I ended up not even being able to use it. We kept it in the house and my daughter would press the power button to play the music. That's the most use we got from it. Also, there is a timer dial on it that did not work well AT ALL. If you turned it to anything less than 20 (minutes I'm assuming), it wouldn't even come on. If you turn it to 20 or more, it never goes off. I did not like this product and would not recommend it.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_headline: I love it, but my baby boy doesn't
review_body: Sophie is very cute and well-made. Good Quality.  I was very excited when I got it and couldn't wait to give it to my baby boy, who is 8 months old.  Supprisely he is not interested in it at all.  He kep pushing it away.

product_title: Orbitel PS3 - 700 3 Tier Baby Shower Favor Cake Kit - Its a Boy
review_body: This was very cute once put together! It was very time consuming to put together though! Don't wait until last minute to out this together! :-)

product_title: Pink and Purple Butterfly Flower Collection Baby Girl Bedding 9pc Crib Set by Sweet Jojo Designs
review_body: I just loved the butterfly theme.  I was able to get everything to match and the price was very very reasonable.

product_title: Supergate Extra Wide Gate
review_body: Bought 2 of these gates to restrict the our dogs to certain areas of the house and they work just great. I didn't want to put holes in the walls by installing the hardware so we just open the gates wide enough to block off the door ways by leaning them against the door frame. These gates work great and are easy to use.

product_title: The First Years Wave Stroller, Black/Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I absolutely love this stroller. It is light, easy to fold, good looking and the turn around feature is great. I have only been using this product for 5 weeks,but my baby loves it and everything is working the way it should. The only think I wish would be different is the basket, it could have been bigger and easier accessible. I am using Chicco car seat with this stroller, so I could not tell you about the First Year car seat, but I have compared this stroller with the similar ones for a lot more money and don't see any difference.

product_title: Nice 'N Clean Baby Wipes Soft-Pack with Aloe - Unscented, Hypoallergenic, Pack/80 Wipes
review_body: I will preface this with the disclaimer that I do not have a baby.  I bought them for personal use, since I travel a lot, and baby wipes are very convenient for travel.  I honestly think these are the best baby wipes I have bought.  They are soft, moist, and adequately sized for convenient use.  Given the price and quality, I don't think they can be beat.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, My Little Snugabunny (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I ordered this at amazon site, the condition said was new. But it looked like a used one or returned item may be but definitely dint look new. The mobile or motor was extremely noisy, im returning it back. Im so disappointed with this purchase, i usually like amazon a lot. I hope they refund the amount i spend on this, i get very upset when we spent some solid amount of hard earned money on something you want and get a crappy product.

product_title: Nuby 2-Pack Prism Orthodontic Pacifiers
review_body: I have searched high and low (and spent a lot of money!) for a pacifier that my son would finally LIKE! low and behold, super expensive ones don't compare to this pacifier!  this is perfect for him as he gets rashes around his little cheeks with other pacifiers...not this one, this has a gum soother and fits his little mouth perfectly. This one seems to have been custom made just for him. Nuby is a great brand. We love it!

product_title: Bright Starts Petals and Friends Activity Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I received the mat from my baby shower. My 2 month old daughter enjoys the mat. My only criticism at this point is that she is too young to grasp the musical bird in the center. So, I constantly have to pull it for her. Also, the mat itself could use a little more padding.

product_title: Classic So-Soft Baby Doll
review_body: This doll was given to my Mom at my baby shower, and so I've grown up sleeping with her. Even as I've grown up, I've loved this doll. She's perfect to cuddle with, and is still with me after sixteen years! She is definitely worn out by now, and her shirt is almost worn through, but she has yet to break or rip, and I know she will last many more years. I would recommend this doll to anyone.

product_title: Bumkins Waterproof SuperBib 3 Pack (6-24 Months)
review_body: They keep baby's clothes nice and dry during meals. The great thing about it is that you can just wipe it clean if there is no sink available to wash. I also love the pockets where most of the food falls into. There has been times where she has thrown up eating and it all went into the pocket which saved me lots of cleaning. All I had to do was wash was the bib. And because of its material, her clothes were not soiled from vomiting. I would get another set when this one wears out. Don't know how long they last till, but I've been using them for months and they still hold pretty well.

product_title: SafeFit Jumbo Mirror (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Perfect for our car and truck
review_body: We have a Subaru Outback and a Dodge Ram truck.  This mirror was perfect for both of them.  In order to use it the headrest above the baby seat needs to be movable -- you have to move the headrest up, slide the strap under and over the back, and then put the headrest back down.  As long as your headrest is adjustable, it is very simple to install.  The strap is adjustable so you can set the viewing angle of the mirror.  It's large enough that we can easily see our baby.  I initially bought one just for my car but my husband loved it so much that I had to order a second one.    Yes, the image is a little distorted, but you're going to have that with any mirror that isn't made of glass.

product_title: EveryDay Willow Wool Dryer Balls Gift Set of 3, Natural
review_body: I was excited to use these right after I ordered them because i'm tired of having to use laundry sheets. Unfortunately, they don't work. My clothes were still static-y after I put all three wool dryer balls into the dryer. I think i'm stuck using dryer sheets again unless I find better dryer balls.

product_title: OsoCozy Factory Seconds Prefold diapers, Infant 4x8x4, Bleached
review_headline: Good diapers, but had major shrinkage!
review_body: I was excited to receive 12 infant prefold diapers in really good condition! I pre-washed them, dried them, and noticed they were quite a bit smaller after coming out of the dryer (which was on the delicate setting). My measuring tape confirmed that they shrunk 1 inch in width and 2 inches in length. I think they will still work fine for my infant, but I'm not sure how soon I'll need to get a larger size. They did not come with washing instructions, so I'm not sure if I was supposed to line dry them, but I may do that in future to avoid further shrinkage.

product_title: LittleLife Arc-2 Travel Cot, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is an outstanding travel crib. Compact, light, and easy to put together - only takes a few minutes to put together after the first time. Our 11-week old slept great in this for a few nights when we were away from home. The fabric of the tent is like that of a bed sheet, so it is certainly breathable and I love the fact that the mattress is not plastic-coated. This also came with 2 sheets to cover the mattress, which was a nice surprise considering the product description states that it only comes with one. We looked at many other travel tents and pack-and-plays, and while the Arc 2 is more expensive than similar products, it is definitely worth it.

product_title: Graco Alano Stroller - Ally - One Size
review_body: This stroller is practical and it matches the infant car seat carrier.When the baby was a newborn I would remove the carrier from the base and placed it in the stroller and I didnt have to wake her up. I can open it using one hand for turning the handle lock and my foot for holding the base while pushing it.I gave it four stars because now that she is older and does like to go for walks around the neighborhood before naptime, it will be nice if I was able to lay the baby flat when she does falls asleep in it.Other than that I really like this stroller.

product_title: Leachco Easy Teether XL - Crib Rail Cover For Convertible Cribs - Sage
review_body: I really like the soft sage color. It looks very nice with the brown wood crib. Our convertible crib has a wavy cut rail instead of straight and this rail cover still fit perfectly. I don't attach any toys because my son would tug too hard and possibly loosen the velcro straps that hold the cover in place. Once that happens, he would probably learn how to remove the cover. So for now, he actually chews on the toy straps. I don't mind. He chews on everything and was chewing all of the finish off of the crib rails. He is very happy with the new rail cover and doesn't mind it at all. He was initially curious but now has more or less left it alone.

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_headline: A  must for the newborn phase
review_body: When you wake up to hear the baby crying you don't know if you've been asleep for 2 hours or twenty minutes - I would use the timer to see if it's only been 20 minutes since she ate not to waste my time trying to feed her or vice versa.  For the first 6 weeks I would not have survived.  It as really nice to have the alarm setting because sometimes newborns would rather sleep so I would use it to remind me to feed her at least every 4 hours.  I recommend this to all my expecting friends.  It has survived several late night drops on the floor and still works.      One of the best  features is the spot light so you don't have to turn on the lamp or light in the nursery and really wake up the baby.  It provides enough light to change a diaper and position for feeding.      A great use of $20!

product_title: Munchkin A&H Disposable Multi-Use Pad - 20 Pack
review_body: I use these with every dirty diaper change. If there's any mess, it makes it so easy to just wrap it all up and toss it! I keep a box on his changing table for at home, and I always keep some in his diaper bag for travel, too. I don't like to use public changing tables, so I change him in the car and just use one of these on the seat underneath him. They work like a charm!

product_title: NUK/Gerber Ultra Thin Nursing Pads, 60 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These are awful, they offer hardly any protection against leaks. After only an hour or two they have to be replaced when I used some the hospital gave me for an entire day, I just wish I remembered what brand they were.

product_title: BabyPlus Prenatal Learning System plays Heartbeat Music in the Womb to Promote Bonding, and a Smart, Healthy Baby
review_headline: 8 years later, Update on this product
review_body:
If you are reading the reviews to this product, Bravo. I did as well, but few were out there 8 years ago when I was pregnant with my first child.

I purchased this item and used it faithfully with both of my pregnancies. My children are now 7.5 and 6. Both were excellent sleepers as babies, fantastic eaters, and are both identified as \\"Gifted and Talented\\" now in school. They are honestly great kids, and I've always felt very blessed. A younger friend hoping to get pregnant was asking what I did when they were babies etc., that they are so good.

I had to think and try to remember everything we did and we talked for hours before I went back and recalled using this device. It's been so long, I kind of forgot about it. Now, I have to wonder....coincidence? Perhaps. I will tell you that I followed the directions exactly for pregnancy number 1. When our daughter was born and was such a great baby, and slept well etc., I knew I'd use it again with another pregnancy. That was all of the proof I needed.

Now, I think back and wonder if this item prepared them for learning while in the uterus. I have no way of knowing for sure, but I definitely know it didn't hurt. : I'm a proud mommy of two now.

I was also able to \\"resell\\" the product on another site, as \\"used\\" and recovered 3/4 of the cost...so, I really had nothing to lose!

Another update:....now 10 years later!!

My 10 year old just scored in the top 2% of our state's mandated testing, and is continuing to make us proud daily. I just told my mother \\"I don't know how I got so lucky with these kids\\"...and she said \\"I think that belt you wore had something to do with it\\".

Who knows..but, I'm not discounting it. Both of my kids continue to shine academically and socially. They've always slept through the night and are both musically inclined. I would recommend this product to everyone if I could.

product_title: Yo Gabba Gabba Ultra Soft Toddler Blanket
review_body: I love this throw.  It is for my two year old grandaughter who is a Yo Gabba Gabba groupie. The throw is a perfect size, the colors are vibrant, and it is so very soft.  I took it down a star because it is thin...great for summer in an air conditioned house though.

product_title: NoJo 2 Pack Dot Changing Table Cover
review_body: I washed these covers before putting them on and they seemed to hold up. My changing pad is 4 sided and it just fits with a bit of stretch. The terry does seem like it may thin out quickly but getting this as a two pack is worth it. The color is not too bright which is what I was hoping. Most of the other reviews seem to be accurate.

product_title: The First Years On-The-Go Booster Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This booster seat is wonderful I bought it for my grandaughter she loves it much more comfortable than those hard ones and this one folds up nice and small for easier storage. Read the instructions because the first time it doesn't expand to full inflation but after that first time it works great.

product_title: Hanging Ladybug Red Black Shimmer Mesh Nylon Lady Bug Decorations Decorate Baby Nursery Bedroom, Girls Room Ceiling Wall Decor, Wedding, Birthday Party, Baby Shower, Bathroom, Kids Ladybugs 3D Art DIY
review_body: I ordered some lady bugs and butterfiles in different sizes from amazon and I must say I was most impressed with the ladybugs!! The butterfiles were really nice too, but the ladybugs were something else.  They are really nice! I ordered them in 4\\" and 8\\" and my family and I loved them!!!   Great quality! We used the ladybugs and butterfiles to decorate my nieces garden themed birhtday and it came out really nice! Everyone at the party was very impressed with all the bugs, expecially the ladybugs!! You won't be disappointed!

product_title: Baby Buddy 2 Pack Secure-A-Toy
review_body: I love these toy leashes and use them all the time.  I've given them as gifts many times and I've had several people approach me to ask where they could buy them.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: We did not purchase this from Amazon, but received it as a gift.  Overall, we like this teether, it smells pleasant, it's soft, looks friendly and a cute little squeak.  The only concern we have is if he could choke on the legs.  We feel that we should always supervise our 2.5 month old.

product_title: Burlington Baby Large Espresso Willow Basket Set with Liner
review_body: I am using these under the babies changing table and they work wonderful! They are the pefect size for diapers @ wipes.

product_title: Under The Nile Bear Ring
review_headline: great idea, but my babies haven't cared for it
review_body:
I saw this when I was pregnant with my first baby and just loved how eco-friendly and organic it is. We received it as a gift, and I was delighted to give it my little girl to clutch when she was about four months old. Unfortunately, she has never been interested in it as a teether or as a playtoy. (She is now two and a half.) I thought maybe it was just her, but our second baby has shown no interest in it either - ever - and he is now 13 months old. I think it's been played with for less than two minutes in all the time that we've had it, even when I have handed it to them and there have been no other toys in sight. It might be just my children, but I think babies are more interested in something that is thinner, brighter, and easier to hold. The [[ASIN:B001O1VERW Sassy Bumble Bites Teether -- 1 Toy]], for example, is not so eco-friendly, but both of my babies have loved it for teething.

As much as I want to like this little teething bear, it has been completely useless for my babies. If you're looking for a teether for your own baby or as a gift, I'd recommend finding something bright and BPA free. It will be far more useful than this item will be!

product_title: NUK Learner Cup BPA Free Silicone Spout, Single Pack
review_body: I just bought the Nuk learner cup. We have highly resistant twins who love their Avent bottle nipples and are digging in their cute little baby heels over having to transition at all to anything else. Rejections so far include: lollacup, Zoli, Nuby, and Avent sippy cups. I did learn that our twins do not like hard or almost-hard (even if the label claims it's a soft spout) so I didn't bother to try Playtex or Munchkins because both of those have harder spouts.    Turns out the babies are ok with the Nuk sipple. I wouldn't say love because the transition still requires some constant encouragement but at least they are getting somewhere other than just crying and throwing bottles without even taking a sip so progress is a success at this point.    The one thing we had to do is we started with the Avent bottles. Then we went to the Avent sippy cup. They hate the spout on that so I realized they are interchangeable so at 8 months forward the babies were using the Avent sippy cup with an Avent bottle nipple instead of the spout.    Now they are a year old and really should be graduating from the bottle nipple. What seems to be working is the Avent sippy cup but with the Nuk spout. So I bought a few Nuk bottles, took out the nipples and put them into the Avent sippy cups. I'm glad to see that Nuk has replacement nipples as well.

product_title: Graco Silhoutte Swing - Melbourne
review_body: 2 out of 5 stars because the material of the seat is not fully connected to the frame. If you have your LO strapped in tight is works fine, but any slack will allow the seat to sag. It seemed unsafe to me, like she could fall out of the back. I had the straps as tight as they would go, but I guess a 16 lb baby is too small for this swing?

product_title: Baby Einstein Count and Compose Piano (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My 6mo old daughter has been playing with this piano since she was about 2mos old and it is still one of her favorite toys.  It keeps her entertained for a while and gives me time to do a short chore.  We take this toy with us everywhere!

product_title: Sweet Jojo Designs Window Valance - Soho Pink and Brown Microsuede
review_headline: great featuer for the top of my daughters bedroom window
review_body: a great feature for the top of my daughters window along with the longer window shadses. it matches everything in her room and the brown is a chocolate brown. it looks great and helps with the sunlight in the early morningings.

product_title: The First Years Soothie Newborn (0-3 months) Pacifiers, Girl (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: The only pacifier my child will accept-
review_body: My baby would never take a pacifier, not even in the hospital when she was born, but these 'mommy' shaped nipples are perfect for 'the old switch-a-roo' at bed time.    Also, it is super cute, because you can see inside her little mouth while she is suckling!

product_title: Safety 1st Air Protect On Board 35 SE Infant Car Seat
review_body:
Although I cannot review the functionality of the product, I was very pleased with the entire purchase. I ordered the carseat while i was in the hospital with my unborn son. He was being a little impatient and was trying to make an entrance at 25 1/2 weeks. The carseat that I was looking at was not rated for a premie so I needed one fast. When I showed the nurses at the hospital this one, they said it was one of the best ones recommended. Luckly enough for me my baby is still inside so I now have a great beautiful carseat for my son. I really like the fabric and my husband likes that its not too girly for when he has to carry it. The padding is nice and thick. The most important for me is that since im not a very large person, I can easily lift it.

EDIT
Its now one year after I began using this carseat and I still LOVE it. We are expecting number two in a few weeks and I will be using this seat for the new baby. It still looks new with extensive use. It has been on 5 long road trips and my son was completely comfortable in it the entire trip.

EDIT 2
Its now two years later and my daughter uses the car seat. It still looks beautiful like brand new.

product_title: Skip Hop Moby Bath Spout Cover Universal Fit, Blue
review_body: i like the fact that it allows an area for you to still pull the shower switch up where the blow hole is.

product_title: To Daddy on Our First Father's Day - Picture Frame Gift
review_headline: To Daddy on Our First Father's Day
review_body: My son LOVED this picture frame. I was really IMPRESSED with the quality of this product because it wasn't cheap looking at all. I had also sent one to my daughter-in-law for Mother's Day but I didn't get a chance to see it. Thank you so much for making their day so SPECIAL!!!!!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet 2-in-1 Projection Mobile
review_body: My daughter is attracted by colors and animated screen. So because this mobile has a projector that i believe my daughter will like i decided to buy. Of, it did the job, it kept my daughter's attenetion for at least 10mins at a time. After 2months or so, the mobile stop working. You can hear the music but nothing is moving. For the price of the mobiel I will expect for it to go longer than 2 months. Oh, by the way i thought it was the battery, we changed it, still nothing.

product_title: Wupzey High Chair Food Catcher
review_body: As a consumer with limited disposable income and even less time to clean up the messes that my son so enjoys making, I had high hopes for this product.  I finished setting it up, put my son in the high chair and thought it might just work.  With one swift kick from my son, any of the food that was in this catcher fell onto the floor.  I fixed it and he would kick again.    This product was pointless in my view.  I wish I had known that there was going to be absolutely no room for my little one to kick.

product_title: Cara Mia Baby Nursing Cover
review_body: This cover is ok. The material is pretty, washes well, and it a nice weight. For me, I found that it was a little on the small side. I'm about a size 16, and pretty self- conscious, so I would have preferred a bigger cover.

product_title: Dream On Me Jessica Changing Table, Cognac (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Just what I was looking for.  I bought it to put in a public restroom.  Seems sturdy, safe and looks nice.  Easy to assemble.  Fast shipping.  Nice transaction.

product_title: Quinny Buzz Footmuff - Black
review_headline: Love it but does not fit Maclaren stroller
review_body: I took a chance because some of the other reviewers said it fit their umbrella stroller but this does not fit a Maclaren umbrella stroller.  This is a wonderful item so I had to give it 5 stars.  It's like a sleeping bag and if you live in a cold region, this is a wonderful way to keep baby warm without having to put on tons of layers.  These are so popular in Europe and I'm so glad the concept if finally catching on more in the US.  The holes that the waist strap goes through is so close together on the foot muff.  I extended the waist strap as far as I could on my stroller but there is no way my baby would fit.   If you have a Quinny stroller they I highly recommend this. Funny, you would think Quinny would make a universal one too because the quality is good and they would make a lot of money on it!

product_title: Cloud b On The Go Travel Sound Machine Soother
review_body: We love the giraffe, and our baby loves it, too.  We use the white noise sound the most because it sounds like a fan humming.  We turn it on every time our baby goes to sleep, whether a nap or at night.  Two things I don't like that cause me to not give it five stars.  I wish it had an option to let it run continuously.  I am sure this is to save batteries, but it would be nice to have that setting as an option because sometimes my baby wakes up when the timer is done.  Second, I wish there was an easy on/off switch.  If you want to turn it off, you have to turn the volume knob all the way down and off.  Not a huge deal, but it would be nice to not have to turn it back on with the volume knob because then you have to readjust the volume next time you use the giraffe.  It is convenient that the battery pack comes out easily so the giraffe can be washed, and this version comes with a velcro loop to attach him to a car seat or elsewhere.  One of the sounds is a jungle drum beat with giraffe sounds mixed in.  I can't say I had any idea what a giraffe sounded like before I heard this toy!

product_title: Status Series 600 Combo Storage Unit
review_body: When my wife and I started looking for a changing table for our Son's Room I was the picky one.  All the changing table in the stores where not made well.  They were not solid construction and seemed cheaply made.  We looked everywhere, from the specialty stores in Chicago, Land of Nod, Buy Buy Baby, and Babies R US.  Land of Nod and s couple of specialty store had some nice one but nothing that was great.  I decided to look on the internet, I found the Status Series 600 on a couple of baby websites.  The unit looked nice and since we wanted a Black finish it was perfect.  I loved the fact that the unit was larger them the changing pad giving us room to place diapers and other items on the top for easy access.  Now comes the hard part, I looked all over to find a review about this product.  I found nothing!  I loved the fact that the unit comes put together; I did not have to worry about it not being solid.  How well made was the unit, that was a concern.  I looked for someone to write a review but I found nothing.  After going back and forth on this piece I finally found it on Amazon and decided to order it.  I know that I could return it since it was sold directly from Amazon.  I even called Amazon to confirm this since it was such a large piece.  I have ordered tons of things from Amazon but never something this big or something that would be freight delivered.  The Changing table arrived and all I can say is this unit by far blows away my expectation.  The unit is well made, very solid and gives us tons of room.  My wife loves it because she has room on top for diapers, lotions, wipes and anything else you can image right there with in reach.  I love this piece because it is well made, solid construction and looks great.  I am sorry I did not right a review sooner, we have had this piece for 14 months now and it is great.  We are glad we got it and I always recommend this to friends who are expecting that see our Son's Room.  If you are looking for a great changing table that will serve as a great dresser later on then I suggest you look at this piece.  It is well worth the money and as my Son grows I will be purchasing other pieces from this collection to add to his room.  Don't waste your money on the changing table that you see in the store.  They might cost 1/2 the price or less but they are not well made or solid construction.  More importantly you have plenty of room on the top for more than just the changing pad which is very useful.

product_title: Baby Jogger Parent Console
review_body: I use this for my baby jogger summit series stroller. It is easy to attach and holds everything i need.

product_title: The First Years Compass Pathway B570 Adjustable Belt Path Booster, Bumble Bee (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have 3 of these seats in our car...actually, two of them are older versions and one is the 570.  We have had them for years and all of our 4 children have used them.  Yeah, now we are down to 3 car seats!     I had to write today as we were in a collision yesterday.  The seats preformed beautifully in the worst situation -- a wreck.  The 570 has a different shoulder latch system than the older versions & at first I didn't like them as they are a bit difficult to get used to.  However, after yesterday, I'm so thankful that the shoulder straps in all 3 car seats work as designed.    We purchased all 4 compass boosters from Amazon too -- the best prices at the time. product_title: Arm's Reach Co-Sleeper Bassinet Mini Sheet
review_body: I purchased three sheets to go with our co-sleeper. So far, we have washed all of them a few times, and even accidentally dried one. The one that went through the drier continues to fit just fine. They take quite a while to air dry, so I might toss them in the drier occasionally at the end to soften and finish them off in the future.     I really like that the sheets fit so tightly to the mattress. I have not had any difficulty getting them on and adjusted properly. I think three sets is perfect and hope they will last for a long time.

product_title: Medela Freestyle Breast Pump [Model - 67060]
review_body: I bought this after having borrowed a Lactina from a local baby charity and the Freestyle is almost useless in comparison.  The suction is so poor and I know it's not my milk supply because I can get more milk by hand expressing, using the avent manual pump or the Tommy Tippee electric pump.  I have tried all the tips about taking the breastshield apart, cleaning it and reassembling it and it hasn't helped.  I even bought a larger size of breastshield but it made no difference.  I think it's ridiculous that Medela expect you to buy different breastshield sizes anyway before they can use the pump.  A complete waste of money.  The only way I could use it at all was by modifying the breastshields I had been using for the Lactina but these aren't meant for long term use and break easily.  I will be contacting Medela Customer Services about this.

review_body: I looked all over for a pacifier clip that would fit on the Soothie Pacifier.  This one works wonderfully! Strongly recommended!

She only started to like it once she reached about 4 months old, but she now knows how to make the frog sing by pulling the ring and she will do it over and over and over.  We don't leave her in it for long periods of time (10-15 minutes at a time) and mostly use it when we are trying to get something done (get dressed or make the beds). review_body: The quality of the plastic isn't as good as I hoped, but the performance and price really beats it all. Its is truly plug and play, it is very easy to setup an use. It does not interfere with our wireless internet and that is a big relief with most 2.4ghz monitors available. I love the small hand held screen unit rather than the old big screen monitors that you can't carry around. The battery lasts a good few hours before needs recharging. There's a little belt clip but it feels flimsy. I hope it will last! Overall a great product if you are looking for something affordable and performs well in video/audio quality BUT do not mind the lightweight plastic. If it breaks, I happily got my 1 year warranty.

product_title: SafeFit Car Seat Grabber in Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: after getting a new car with leather seats, we were worried that the carseat would dent and eventually rip the seats.  obviously the car seat will be installed for a few years, same spot, in the heat and cold, etc...      as for the product, the material is similar to the drawer/cabinet liners you use in the kitchen and they are just slighly thicker.  i'm sure car seat experts would say never to install these mats.  after leaving the hospital with my first, they said never to have the window shades or rear-facing mirrors [find me a car that doesn't use those!].  after installing the car seat on the mat, i can say that my car seat isn't going anywhere in a crash. after installing it correctly the mat is dented in due to how tight the car seat has to be, so don't expect it to lay flat like in the picture on the box.     overall, it serves the purpose we bought it for. 4 stars because it doesn't stay up on it's own and it doesn't reach the top of the seat.

product_title: bumGenius One-Size Snap Cloth Diaper 4.0
review_body: I bought a variety of different styles and brands and realized I am not a big fan of stuffing. I prefer diaper covers with inserts or AIOs. I normally wrap the inserts with a flushable liner that can easily be removed with #2s. This is more difficult to do with pocket diapers. However I have no real complains besides the stuffing part. review_headline: Decent cup, but not as easy as a bottle and has a weird hole
review_body: I ordered this sippy cup for my little boy, so I was pleased when the blue cup with the sailboats arrived instead of the red / pink floral cup.  I like the handles and the snap-on lid that keeps it from leaking.  However, maybe some babies catch on quicker, but my little 6 month guy seems to have as much trouble with this as with any other sippy cup.  I thought the softer spout would be more like a bottle, but he doesn't seem to think so.  Plus, something really weird about this cup, there is a little hole in the side of the spout that is supposed to allow air flow or something, but it totally allows liquid to dribble out when the baby tilts the cup the wrong way, which he inevitably does.  Big design flaw in my opinion - if he was drinking something red or purple he would totally stain his shirt.  I still like the cup alright, but I wish they'd omitted the little hole.

product_title: Pink Daisy Organic Cotton Nursing Pads
review_headline: Wrinke at the edges; absorbent and soft
review_body: If you are just looking for something to wear at home (or beneath really bulky sweaters maybe) this product would be fine. I wear them at home, and I do really like them. The pads are *really* soft, and highly absorbent. The velour layer makes them less likely to stick to your breast, as well.  However, as the other reviewer said, the edges got all wrinkly the first time they went through the dryer. I have continued to use them because they are much more absorbent than the other washable nursing pads I have (Gerber; they are terrible); I just don't leave the house with them. Another thing to be careful of with these pads is that because they have a hemp inner layer and a velour outer layer, they may feel dry to the touch even though the hemp has become saturated, so if your breasts are sore due to being moist, make sure to change the pad very regularly even if it feels dry at the surface.  And one thing that I think *all* washable reviews (and product info) should say is that just like cloth diapers, you can't wash these with fabric softeners or they will become less absorbent (check your detergent as well as any extra laundry products). Also, it will take a few washings for a them to come to their full level of absorbency, because the hemp (or cotton) oils take a few washings to fully get out of the fabric.

review_body: This dresser is very easy to set up and is great for kids. I would not want to use it for adult cloths though. So far it had been a great dresser.

product_title: Summer Infant PictureMe Digital Color Video Monitor, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is our first baby monitor so we have nothing to compare it to.  This baby monitor has great night vision and picks up sound pretty nicely.  The monitor and camera has adequately long cords so that plugging in isn't a problem.    The switch on the camera is on the front part of the base which is a pain to turn the switch; wish it were on the back.

product_title: Baba Buddy by Bella Baby Designs - Pink Chenille
review_headline: Very useful product when used right
review_body: After reading the wide-range of views on this product, I wanted to express my views - I use this product every day about 3/4 times a day.  I have my third child and no babysitting.  I also have a child who tends to be a cat napper and therefore I must utilize my time as efficiently as possible.  I am never more than a few feet away from her.  It allows me to finish the dishes, make a phone call, make lunch for my boys, or sit down for dinner.  So in general I love this product.  As for bonding - I get plenty of that during the day and we have a wonderful bond so far - there are plenty of ways to tailor that.  My only caveats: that it's made only for long straight bottles.  It won't work with the shorter and wider Advent bottles.  I also cannot get it to fit a snuggly around her neck as suggested, but I am ok with that.  You have to work with it.  If it's too low for good milk flow, then you have to put a rolled towel under it too, but the point is that it holds the bottle well.  For the record, she has only started to cough in it a few times and I was always right there.  Lastly, young babies who fall asleep with this will have to still be picked up or pushed forward to burp.  A product I use a lot is a product I can recommend as long as you use your common sense.

product_title: NTM-910YLW - Sony Baby Call Nursery Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Horrible! We first used it in an 1100 sq ft house. Son's room was on one side, our room on the other, and the receiver kept beeping! Tried changing the color channels, which helped, at first... The worst part about this monitor was that any time any person walked by either the receiver or the monitor itself, it beeped and lost signal until the person got out of the way... When we moved to a 3200 sq ft house, we were on the bottom level and he was on the top. The beeping is even worse now. Try sleeping while this thing beeps... not possible. I'm throwing it in the trash only because I've had it too long to return it (bought at Target). My Fisher Price monitor worked 100 times better.

product_title: Luvable Friends 5 Count Flannel Receiving Blankets
review_headline: Thin  and small but soft and  pretty

They are great for summer and to note they are for a small baby 28 X 28 in size but they are not poor quality.  They are soft and have pretty bright colors and the picture is true to color.  And the price is right.  I do have other very expensive blankets as well but I have a spitty baby and use a lot of blankets and the price is right for these blankets :)

product_title: Budget Series Vinyl Hamper Black Silver Trim
review_body: This hamper can be displayed in even the finest home.  It has a beautiful finish for a vinyl hamper and it's easy to clean.  The silver trim looked even better in person.  My three year old son uttered the words \\"It's beautiful.\\" when I first removed it from the packaging.  It arrived clean, neat & undamaged.  Thank you AMAZON.

review_body: It's so great, and it was cheaper than buying a new pack and play! Very snug fit, especially after washing, but stretches out. Very cute design. It IS a bit overpriced considering it doesn't cover the pad, or has a matching sheet that does, but definitely better than buying a new pack and play. The only other thing I didn't like was I can't use the bassinet part on my pack and play, but I got a bassinet, so no biggy. If you have a pack and play with a bassinet, I do not recommend getting this, as to buy a bassinet and this would be the same price as buying a new pack and play with the bassinet.

product_title: BOB Duallie Snack Tray, Black
review_headline: Nice snack tray but wayyyy overpriced!
review_body: I believe a snack tray is a must for a stroller, so why it isn't included with the stroller purchase is beyond me.  This is a nice snack tray, very easy to put on and take off, and there's no need to take it off when folding down the stroller.  It is very durable and nice quality. I only gave it 4 stars for two reasons:  way overpriced, and the height of the snack tray is a little high, and not adjustable. It seems to be right in the line of sight for my 14 month old twins. (I also own the City Mini Double Stroller and its snack tray height is adjustable). I ended up taking it off until my girls are a little older/taller to see over the snack tray.  Instead I now attach their snack cups and sippy cups to the stroller using tethers.  I love my Bob stroller and think it is well worth the price, but I think they really rip you off on the accessories!
