review_body: This is just great...compact, easy to set up, and will be great for years to come....not just to help us through the potty training.  Love that it has its own bag with places to put supplies.  Very happy with this product.  I was concerned the legs would be difficult or cheap and would break easily but they are built well and are easy to quickly open and close!!

product_title: McKenzie Kids Balmoral Diaper Bag in Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I LOVE this diaper bag. I wanted a bag that didn't look like a diaper bag but still had all the storage i needed. It has that and more!  Plus, the price was unbeatable.

product_title: Motorola Remote Wireless Video Baby Monitor withColor LCD Screen
review_body: This monitor is amazing.  Over the last 3 and a half years I have bought and returned probably 5 monitors.  We ended up with a Summer monitor for the first 2.5 years, then it finally broke and replaced it with a Summer Bestview.  The only problem is that model (bought in January 2011) is discontinued and with a second baby on the way we need a second camera which is no longer available.  I have been researching for weeks now, reading every review on Amazon and other sites and decided to order the Motorola MBP36.  When I wrote this review a few weeks ago, a second monitor was not available anywhere.  Although they are not available on Amazon yet (as of 9/1/2011), they are available online at other major baby stores where you \\"buy\\" stuff for babies (hint hint).  I just ordered one today, which now makes this the perfect monitor.  PROS  - LCD Unit  First of all, the LCD screen is huge.  It is 3.5\\" diagonally.  For reference, and iPhone is also 3.5\\".  The aspect ratio is a bit more square than an iPhone, but you get the idea.  The unit is very thin, its about as thick as a typical men's wallet.  It is lightweight, has a nice kick stand that seems very sturdy and nice, grippy rubber feet on the bottom that are very unobtrusive but work great.  There is an antenna across the top back that can flip up if you need it to get better reception, but we have never needed it, even when two floors away.  There are 4 buttons on each side of the screen, 4 directional that control camera, volume, menu navigation, a menu button, an \\"ok\\" button, a video on/off button and a microphone button.  They are well placed, it is not a huge problem to have to hit the menu to get to volume, we had to do the same on the Summer Bestview and it is the first menu option (i.e. hit the menu button and it is already in the volume option, so just hit up/down from there).  As you can tell from the pictures, the unit has pretty good industrial design too, which seems to be the trend in baby monitors now.Battery life is decent, it works enough to have a daytime nap and then use it again in the evening without charging in between.  Your not going to get more than 3-4 hours out of it if you use the LCD a lot though.  There is a series of LEDs across the top that indicate how much noise your kids are making, and there is a very accurate temperature display (based on reviews, sounds like Samsung temp is off by 10 degrees, but this unit matches the thermostat outside the room so I'm assuming spot on).  - Camera  The ability to scan and pan is great, very quiet and no likely to disrupt your kid.  There is a small green LED on the front of the camera, but you can't see the infrared lights in the dark (unlike our Summer Bestview which looks like 10 little LEDs in the dark).  The zoom is not great, kind of hard to get to on the menu and it is only a digital zoom that crops the center of the picture and doubles it.  It is small and can be placed pretty much anywhere.  The picture that it sends to the handheld unit is great (as far as baby monitors go).  It isn't going to win a technical Oscar, but it is very clear. The huge LCD screen helps.  In daylight it is incredibly crisp and vibrant.  I haven't noticed any interference with WiFi, but haven't really tested either.  It operates at 2.4GHz and we mostly have 5Ghz 802.11n devices, so we are in a different bandwidth that doesn't conflict.  If you have additional cameras (up to 4), you can set the monitor to manually scan through them, it will stay on each one for 12 seconds based on what it says in the manual.  You can have up to 4 cameras, but there is no ability to see multiple ones on the the screen at once (like the Lorex).  CONS  I guess a minor quibble might be that you can't put batteries in the camera, but the old monitor had this functionality and we never used it in 2.5 years so not an issue for me.  One other possible thing worth mentioning is that the monitor unit takes a proprietary battery, very similar to whata lot of cordless phones have.  One other minor thing worth mentioning is that the infrared LEDs at night are not very bright from 10 feet away, we are just going to put a shelf near our 3 year olds bed so that it will be closer (think of the LEDs around the camera as flashlights for night vision).  I can say without reservation that this thing deserves 5 stars after a 3 full weeks with it.  My wife loves the size of the screen, the light weight monitor, the portability, ease of use etc.  Its a very cool product.  *Update 8/24/2011* minor spelling correction (sales to sails) and added clarifying point in final paragraph \\"even though it supports 4 cameras\\", which was already mentioned above but needed reiterating.  *Update 9/1/2011* Removed comments about additional cameras not being available since I bought one today.  Added a few minor updates to the review.

product_title: Graco Secure Coverage Digital Baby Monitor
review_body:
We purchased this when our daughter was born in October 2010. we keep the base and both receivers on 24/7, and have since she was born. We have one parent unit on the nightstand and one parent unit in the kitchen, both sit in their cradle charging in order to stay constantly on. We are able to take the kitchen unit outside with us when needed and the battery seems to last at least a few hours at minimum, we rarely ever get the battery low warning.

The best part about this product is ZERO static and great range. We have lots of wireless devices in the house and there is absolutely zero static coming through the receivers, crystal clear.

The units can vibrate if you want, they have a visual (LED) warning system and obviously audio. Not much to it, but it does what it is supposed to, and it does it well.

No issues here after almost a year.

UPDATE 1/2013
This has been on 24/7 for 27 months now and is still working perfectly with crystal clear audio.

product_title: Graco Pack 'N Play Playard with Bassinet, Kensly (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this pack n play for my new granddaughter and I love it.  The price was right and being a Graco product was a plus.  It sets up and takes down extremely easy and is sturdy.  The color is brown and mint green so I can use it for either boy or girl. I keep it in my car, just in case I am away and I have her visit.

product_title: Munchkin Stay-Close Harness and Handstrap (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Not impressed so far with leashing my twins.
review_body: I bought this for my 15 month old twins, who are normally pretty darn easy going, but they did NOT like having this one them at target today. I took them out of the cart with the harness and leash on, and they both tried to head off down the aisle. When they couldn't go forward, they fell backwards onto their bottoms. Then they tried again, and again. Then they cried. Then they both tried to head in separate directions, and screamed because the leash wouldn't let them run through the store, and I had to drag one screaming on the floor in order to reach the other one to put them back in the cart.     They calmed down a bit once back in the cart, and I just handed them a couple of dog toys from a nearby aisle to give them something to do for the rest of the shopping trip.    I will try these again, but our one attempt so far did NOT go well! They have been walking for only 2 weeks, but have gotten pretty good at it in that time. They are normally easy going, but they did NOT like the leash tonight!    I gave 3 stars because the product is fine, just leashing did not work for us today. It is not a problem with Munchkin's harness / leash, if you are going to get one, go ahead and get this less costly one.     This may very well work GREAT when they are older etc. But again tonight... it was a dismal failure.

product_title: Bath Toy - Stack N' Spray Bathtub Fountain - 7 Unique Pieces With Different Functions
review_body: My sister bought this for my son. She said her and her daughters were loving it, so she sent me one. We love it too. So far, it is a blast. I love the different tops and all the different ways you can play. The one that turns and squirts water (the orange one conected to the red boat) is my son's favorite. I like the yellow on that just acts like a pretty fountain. The red one squirts straight out from 6 or so holes. My son, who liked bathtime anyway, loves it even more. He sets (small) animals on the floating green part and has them live at the fountain. When he takes off all the pieces, his animals have more room and a big water fountian in the middle. He plays with it the whole time, some way or another. I think it is fun and cute, and my son definitely enjoys it.

product_title: Graco Silhouette Swing in Edgemont
review_body: I am a first time parent and I received this swing as a shower gift from my registry.  We put it together - which was no problem - however, I feel like the swing makes a lot of noise.  The mobile does not move properly while swing is on.  The legs feel wobbly, which at first I thought was because we put it together incorrectly.  We went to several stores and felt the legs of the other graco silhouette swings and they all felt a little loose.  Lastly, the vibration pack is borderline unusable on the high setting.  It is so loud, no one would use it while a baby is trying to sleep.  Overall, not pleased with swing.  I feel that for the price - the performance should be much better.

product_title: Summer Infant Sure And Secure Custom Fit Gate
review_body: OK, so the gate isn't perfect but it is pretty good.  When you have a large span to cover it is likely your best option.  The soft fabric is nice.  I would love it if you didn't have bundles of fabric at the ends, but then the gate wouldn't be adjustable.  I would love it if there wasn't a bar underneath the opening, but then it wouldn't be stable.  Again, it is a good item for large spans and likely your only/best option.

product_title: Pinzon Baby By aden + anais Muslin Swaddle Blanket 4 Pack, Wild Thing
review_body: These are my absolute favorite blankets- even softer than the other aden & anais blankets I purchased on Amazon. I just wish they had more patterns available.

product_title: THERMOS FOOGO Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel 10-Ounce Food Jar
review_headline: Good for keeping your lunch warm, a bit too small though.
review_body: After eating school lunch for 4 years, my 9-year old daughter finally grew tired it, she insisted on taking our dinner leftover to school for next day at school. But she didn't have access to a microwave at school, and I would never let her have a cold Chinese lunch. After much researching online, i.e. amazon.com, I finally came across this food jar and thought I would give it try. To my surprise, it worked. I would micromave her lunch in the morning and put it into the jar, by the time she had lunch at school, the food would be still lukewarm. The only complaint I have is its size, a little on the small side, so after some more research, I bought another one slightly larger. [[ASIN:B0017IFSIS Thermos Stainless King SK3000MB4 Food Jar, Midnight Blue]]

product_title: Sassy Seat Doorway Jumper, 3 Toys (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got this jumper second hand, and free.  I was really excited to put my baby in it, since I loved doorway jumpers when I was little.  Well, he doesn't jump hardly at all in it, which I saw another person say is because the spring isn't sensitive enough.  That seems likely.  He also can hardly seem to stay upright in it.  He gets off to one side so much that his head comes within an inch of the door frame.  If you want this as an interactive toy for your baby to keep them occupied and safe while you leave the room for a minute, I would definitely not recommend it.  I have heard the Graco one is much better and I plan on trying that next.  I don't trust this jumper without someone sitting right next to my baby, and he's 7 months old and over 17 lbs; plenty big enough for it.  The only good thing is that it has velcro on the front so that you can attach any toy you'd like.  I hear the toys it originally came with are no good, but at least that's interchangeable.  I still wouldn't recommend this jumper, even if it was free.  I'd rather spend money and get one that is more safe for my baby so I can leave him in it while doing dishes etc.

product_title: juDanzy cow print baby & toddler girls & boys leg warmers
review_body: love it , ptu it on my newborn and its soooo cute~! quality is ok for the price ,wash it twice so far and no problem yet . will buy again .

product_title: Medela Breast Pump Accessory Set
review_headline: Made going back to work much easier
review_body: I ordered this accessory set right before I returned to work so that I wouldn't have to wash bottles in the morning before leaving.  It's a great set overall, but I do think it should be noted that the breast shields come already attached to the valves, so if you needed a smaller or larger shield, it would basically be useless to you.  Other than that, however, the bottles are the same bottles that came with my breast pump, and you also get two sterilizing bags with it, which are handy for quick, microwave sterilizing.  Overall, I'm very glad I bought it.

product_title: Medela One-Piece Breastshield w/ Valve and Membrane
review_body: I really don't understand why Medela insists on including these multi-piece valves with their pumps, and was really happy to see that there was an alternative - even though it's sold separately of course.  But in tiny print on the box it says they are not compatible with the Freestyle pump!!

product_title: Regalo Easy Open Extra Wide Metal Walk Through Safety Gate
review_body: Installation was intuitive. For the money, it is of adequate quality. It does the job for my home. It is NOT top of the line gate because it costs less.

product_title: Baby Trend Navigator Double Jogger Stroller - Sonic
review_body: Not sure what the wheel issue is that other reviews have mentioned - follow the assembly instructions (which are very easy) and this is an outstanding stroller. Very maneuverable, convenient pockets, lots of cup-holders, very well thought-out.  It is on the heavy side, but it's a double so you can't really get away from that.  Highly recommended!

product_title: Satsuma Designs Baby Mittens, Natural, One Size
review_body: they were the only mittens that stayed on our newborn daughter.  i didn't always want her in mittens, but when i did, they stayed put!

product_title: green sprouts 10 Ounce Aqua Bottle, Aqua (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The last thing you want in a sippy cup is leaking. I do not know why, but I have two of these cups and they leak all over the place. Had to throw them away.

product_title: Bright Starts Bounce Baby Activity Zone, Neutral (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: It's just very good. there are some other ones that i looked into before buying this one and I'm very happy with it, so is my 6 month baby. felt tempted to go for a \\"more complete\\" one but I'm glad I didn't because the kid is't having a very good time on it....but it will out grow it in just 3 months, so why spend more?

product_title: Nuby 10 Pack Hangers
review_body: The quality's great but too small. For baby's clothes only. I didn't notice that before ordering. But anyway, Nothing to say about its quality.

product_title: Baby Starters Plush Bear Blanket
review_body: This is a wonderful soft, fabric for a blanket. Purchased for a friend of mine, who is having her babygirl. SHe really loved this blanket. Great choice.

product_title: Fresh N Freeze Reusable Baby Food Containers
review_body: These are nice to keep in the freezer but the lids dont stay on and they leak in my diaper bag. I'm so disapointed in this product!

product_title: Luvable Friends Flannel 6 Piece Receiving Blankets
review_body: I had read on some of the reviews that these blankets were small, but the item info said they were 34 x 28. When I received the blankets, they have 28 x 28 on the tag.    Other than the size, the blankets are super cute and 10 times softer than the Gerber receiving blankets that I have. They seem to wash pretty well too.

product_title: Tinkerbell Fairies 8 Round Wall Clock in Printed Box
review_body: I love it! Too cute! The perfect finishing touch to my little girls Tinkerbell room! I would definately recomend it

product_title: Summer Infant Kenneth Brown Change Pad Cover Handsome Puppy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Very soft and good fit for any changing pad. Looks nice and classy. Hasn't faded yet after so many washes.

product_title: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_headline: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_body: I purchased this Twilight Sea Turtle Night Light for my 2yr-old grandson, and I also purchased the Twilight Lady Bug Night Light for my 4yr-old granddaughter. They were both very excited when they first received them because they come with batteries included and they could turn them on immediately. I had an opportunity to view them on my recent visit with them and saw my grandkids are absolutely thrilled with them and they sleep with them on every night. My son and daughter-in-law said they appreciate them very much because they are so soothing, and everybody absolutely adores them. I'm very pleased with the product and reccommend it for anyone with small kids. There is a variety to choose from, and I'm sure you would also be pleased with any of them.  [[ASIN:B001CW7CVK Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light, Sea Turtle]]

product_title: The First Years Close And Secure Sleeper,Colors May Vary
review_headline: Wonderful for Co-Sleeping, If you have a long baby - BEWARE
review_body: This is a WONDERFUL product for co-sleeping and for travel with baby! However, if you have a long baby, this won't last long. I am going to do what I saw another reviewer did and that is cut the wedge off the end so that we can use it for a few more weeks or so before we transition her to her crib. My baby is currently TOO long for it and she throws her little legs over the side of the little bed and it scares me that she could roll out!.   Other than that - I REALLY love this product. For the first few months of your baby's life, you just can't beat the comfort and security this offers by having your baby safely next to you. I love rolling over and having her right next to me, sound asleep where I can check on her without getting up. This saves me from A LOT of sleepless nights of worry!

product_title: Sealy Baby Firm Rest Infant/Toddler Crib Mattress -204 Premium Coils, Anti-Sag System, Hospital-Grade Waterproof Cover, Hypoallergenic Cushioning, High Coil Firmness, 52"x28"
review_body: I'm very happy with my decision to purchase this crib mattress.  When I opened the package I was glad to find it is actually firm (unlike some other 'firm' mattresses that are easily bent in half).  I was also pleased to find it fits perfectly in our Graco Lauren crib.  I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a good, quality crib mattress at an affordable price.

product_title: Munchkin Powdered Formula Dispenser, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This product does the job its supposed to. Sometimes creates a little mess pouring out power until you get the hang of it (insert opening into bottle opening and shake container from side to side)

product_title: Baby Brezza Baby Food Maker Machine  - One Step Steamer and Blender - Puree Baby Food For Pouches - Mixes Organic Food for Infants and Toddlers
review_body: I just used this for the first time to make my daughter's first few batches of baby food.  Absolutely love it!  It assembles and disassembles super easily, and cleans perfectly in the dishwasher.  It is so nice to set it and forget it....once the steam cycle is complete it purees on it's own!  You can also use it just to steam veggies and fruits for older babies.  I was actually told to look into some of the other baby food processors, but so glad I decided to go with my gut and get the Baby Brezza!

product_title: Contours Lite Stroller, Tangerine (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I had a very expensive MiaModa stroller that was awful. It was heavy, the wheels constantly locked and I disliked it from the start. This stroller is everything a person could ask for. It is lightweight, strong, ridiculously easy to assemble and best of all my rather tall 2 year old daughter LOVES it! It is very easy to manouver and the recline feature is very nice. I would recommend this stroller to anyone without hesitation.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, My Little Snugabunny (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My little boy didn't really take to this swing until he was at least a month old (he preferred his bouncer), but once he did take to it the swing became a valuable asset in our house.    The swing is soft and cozy.  It's also pretty durn cute.  The pillow has bunny ears so when my son's head is on it he looks like a little bunny!  I love the 5 point harness; it makes me feel like he's nice and secure.  I really like that I can turn the swing cradle (which is super easy to do).  My son prefers to be able to see us and this allows us to just turn the cradle and not have to move the entire swing (which is pretty sizable and heavy, but also STURDY) when we do things in different parts of the living room.  The spinning birdy and mirror \\"mobile\\" doesn't seem to do much for my son, but I'm sure lots of babies out there would find it interesting (or at least more interesting than nothing or the ceiling).  The music and nature sounds are very soothing and very easy for a parent to stand.  I don't mind them at all.  It's nice to be able to adjust the volume on said sounds and music as well.  The AC adapter is fabulous (and one of the main reasons we bought this swing).      I really don't have any complaints about this swing.  I see people on here mentioning that their motor started slowing down.  I notice that the swing, even on its highest setting, doesn't swing as much as it once did, but then again, my son now weighs over 20 lbs!  I don't think they could put a powerful enough motor in something this size to compensate for growing kiddos.  Also, I do recommend that you give the swing a helping hand when you start it up.  After snapping in my son, I start swinging him myself and THEN turn on the swing.  It seems to afford less wear and tear on the motor.  Maybe that is something you should HAVE to do, but if such a little thing could help increase the life of your swing, why not?     Overall, I'd highly recommend this swing.  I know that we've found it very useful in lulling a cranky baby to sleep and just as a place to put an awake baby when you need to get something done.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Bouncer
review_headline: One of my favorite things for my babies
review_body: Received as a gift for my son 3 years ago and STILL love this for my second child! Fun sounds and music. Variety of colors and great graphic on the fabric. Sturdy for a chubby baby or tiny newborn. Toys are easy for them to grab once they are able to reach. Love that you can turn vibration on only or music on only or if you want to run both, you can do that too! Silent options are great when you want them and volume control too. Your child will stay tuned in to this so that you can have those much needed moments for yourself.

product_title: Jeep Cherokee Sport Stroller, React (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This was a great buy! The price is affordable, it uses less space in the car trunk and the toddler is very comfortable in it.

product_title: Levana Safe N'See Digital Video Baby Monitor with Talk-to-Baby Intercom and Lullaby Control (LV-TW501) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: DON'T BUY THIS!!!! Read this review!
review_body: When I first got this monitor, I really loved it, but this love only lasted for 3 months when it broke. There is a 12 months warranty on it, so I figured I would go ahead and call the company and get it replaced. I have called the company 4 times this week and nothing has happened so far. The first two times I called they told me they would send me an email with the return instructions, but that I never got. Finally, another customer service person told me that I have 2 options. I could either send it back and wait 4-6 weeks for it to get repaired or I could pay $199.99 plus $12.95 shipping and they would send me another monitor, I'm supposed to send mine to them and they would fix my monitor and when mine was fixed they would send it back to me and refund the $199.99. So, I not only would $70 more than I originally paid for this monitor, but I would also pay all together $26 in shipping. I tried to get a hold of a manager but either I was told that he couldn't do anything for me, so I wasn't connected to one and the one time that I left a message for a manager to call me back, I never was called back.   I have never wrote a product review, but I felt that I had to let people know NOT to buy this baby monitor. It is of poor quality (my husband turned of the camera and then when he turned it back on, it just didn't work anymore), the customer service is the worst I have ever experienced! I don't understand how a baby monitor company can expect you to be without a baby monitor for 4-6 weeks, without sending you a replacement. I also would have no issue sending mine back and for them to send me a new one, but I'm not willing to send them $199.99 for a faulty product.   I ended up buying a Summer baby monitor and that seems to work just fine.

product_title: Baby's My First Photo Album of Family & Friends
review_body: I like this because I can fit a lot more photos than the first one we owned (which would only hold 4). The pages do have a bit of a glare and are somewhat wrinkled, but I still like it.  My daughter enjoys the mirror at the end.  Would make a good gift!

product_title: Mommy's Bliss Baby's Bliss Gripe Water 4 oz.
review_body: The box was open and some of the gripe water had leaked out so it was also soggy.  It was too much of a hassle to return.  :  We decided to use what was left anyway, as the seal was not broken (still can't figure out how it leaked).  Honestly I didn't see any of the magic powers these other parents have seen.  Wishful thinking for a frazzled mommy who hadn't gotten any sleep for weeks.  I can't say it didn't work as our daughter eventually calmed down.  We also started her on Prilosec at about the same time, though.

product_title: Wall Deco Mural Art Sticker Morning Tree - PS58196
review_body: Looks terrific in my daughter's nursery!  Took about two hours to apply the whole thing, but it looks great!!

product_title: GroVia Newborn All in One Cloth Diaper - Owls
review_body: I wish I could recommend these...I loved everything about the IDEA of these.  Cute, organic, easy.  They fit little bodies really well when all the other cloth diapers look odd because of their bulk.  I prepped them 5+ times with recommended soap, etc. etc.  But they have leaked every time I've used them.  And looking at it, I can't see how they wouldn't since the absorbant material goes all the way the the edge.  Really, I've found the prefolds with a good cover to be the best option.

product_title: The First Years 2 Pack Breastflow Stage 1 Slow Flow Nipple
review_headline: Excellent to continue bottle feed and breast feed
review_body: These nipples help to reduce nipple confusion. When I used these while nursing, I had no issues with my daughter latching on after being bottle fed.

product_title: Simplisse Double Electric Breastfeeding Companion (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: This is a wonderful product! Highly recommended!
review_body: I have used both the Simplesse pump and the traditional electric pumps, and I have to say that there is simply no comparison! The Simplesse pump is simply the best I've seen on the market. With the traditional electric pump, I experienced a lot of discomfort, especially as a new nursing mother. I had no trouble or pain using the Simplesse pump. The pumping action is so much more natural and doesn't pull or tug on the breast. I've recommended this pump to a number of new mothers because I believe in it that much! This product is revolutionary!

product_title: American Baby Company Organic Cotton Interlock Crib Sheet
review_body: Of all the organic crib sheets I've bought or seen, I love these ones the most. Super soft, sage is a pretty gender-neutral colour, fits my Naturepedic mattress perfectly and washes well. FYI...these are also sold for the same price at BRU in the US (at least I saw it in buffalo)

product_title: Vital Baby Fragrance Free Hand and Face Wipes, 30 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These are soft and fragrance free! Just as advertised, they clean up baby's face and hands without a fuss.  I use plain baby wipes, but have gotten tired of the fragrance they leave behind, so I thought I'd try something new. I may not buy them again, but they are very nice to have around. I bought them to take on our vacation at the end of July and they really came in handy.

product_title: Booginhead SippiGrip, Delicate Dot Green
review_headline: Great for keeping the sippy cup off the floor
review_body: The SippiGrip works great.  It is perfect for keeping the sippy cup off the floor.  I have one for home and one for when we go out.  I don't have any issues with my daughter taking it off the cup.  I would definitely recommend this product!

product_title: GroVia Soaker Pad (2 Count)
review_body: Just like people say - these inserts are great for size/fit, SO easy to use, great at containing leaks since they have their own elastic, are very absorbent, and they have a waterproof backing so I rarely have to change the cover itself.  BUT they take FOREVER to dry and can be prone to mildew if left damp for too long which has not yet happened to me but did happen to a friend.  Also they feel very wet on baby's skin when they are wet and my daughter gets very fussy when that happens.  A thin fleece liner will help with that.

product_title: Evenflo Classic Glass Bottle, 8-Ounce
review_body: I had ordered it because I thought it was a good deal. I loved the design of the bottles, and the nipples and the tops. My baby however did not like the bottles, I used the bottles for milk storage instead. I used the nipples and tops on other bottles. I would recommend this product!

product_title: Combi Yurikago Swing
review_body:
This swing is just OK. We have it in the Butternut color. About 50% of the time I can get my baby to tolerate it. She is on the small side of average and barely fits in it--the harness just swallows her whole, especially the shoulder straps. The pads on the shoulder straps also be seem to made of a rather rough material, so she won't tolerate them touching her face.

Also, when you snap together the harness, the click sound it makes is insanely loud--it startles my baby or wakes her up every time we put her in there.

The music is a nice idea, but can get pretty annoying. They have some classic baby/toddler songs in there (Old McDonald), some classical, and then randomly the song \\"Memories\\" from the movie \\"The Way We Were\\". Why on earth is that on a baby swing?

Overall, I wouldn't purchase this again. I'd shell out the extra bucks for a more high quality swing with better fabrics and mechanisms.

product_title: Carter's Keepsake Memory Book of Baby's First Years
review_body: This item came real fast, before the due date, packaged well.  it's a cute book asking all the questions.  there is room on some pages to put pictures, though the pages aren't plastic protected.  this memory book is great for my needs my only hesitation is the lettering on the pages doesn't contrast well.  That's no biggie.  Good Buy

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Potty
review_body: I bought this Fisher Price Precious Froggy Potty for my daughter who I am beginning to potty train. She is only 1 year and 8 months, and when she seen it she was actually excited about sitting on it while we both went potty. Its comfortable for her and easy to clean up. It isn't bucky and it's good for the price. I have a boy on the way this coming June and I can use the Potty for him as well. So its a good investment.

product_title: Sassy Look Photo Book
review_body: This is the first image/book/toy that caught my little guy's attention when he was around 10 weeks old.  He especially loves the page with the black squares - he always smiles when he looks at that particular page for some reason.  These images really do capture his attention and he enjoys looking at them.

product_title: Medela 150 Ml Storage Bottle Case of 10
review_headline: Exactly what I was looking for
review_body: Looking for bottles I could pump into and freeze that held more than a measly 2.5 ounces. This did the trick.

product_title: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_body: Great product.  I was a lot cheaper on Amazon than it was in the department stores.  My new grandson loves it!

product_title: DaVinci Parker 2-Door Changer
review_headline: Don't be fooled by the picture of "Natural" finish
review_body: I wanted a changing table/dresser with a natural wood finish to match my natural wood crib.  I really did not want that orange-tinted wood color and it seemed like many pieces online that were considered Natural wood, had that orange tint to it.  After researching online for weeks, and from the pictures posted online, I felt that the DaVinci Parker in \\"Natural\\" was the closest match.  I was wrong.  My husband took it out of the box the other day and it has that orange-tint and looks nothing like the picture posted online.  If you want that light natural wood finish, do not get the DaVinci Parker in \\"Natural\\".  What a joke.

product_title: Sun'n'Fun Broad Spectrum Natural Mineral Sunscreen for Kids SPF 30, with Antioxidants, Marshmallow and Chocolate, 3.3oz, BEST SUNSCREEN FOR THE FAMILY. 20% Zinc. Exp. 5/18.
review_body: I had to return this product as my son developed red rashes on his face after spending an hour in the sun with this Sunscreen on.

product_title: Tots In Mind Cozy Crib Tent II 1, White
review_body:
We bought this because our son was old enough to climb out of his crib but to still young to understand that he could hurt himself. We found him wondering around the house with his shoes one day getting ready to go outside to ride his bike the next day we found him straddling the top rung of the crib and decided that we needed to take action. So after looking online for advice which ranged from locking them in their room to letting them run free through the house none of which we felt was very safe then we found the Cozy Crib Tent so we decided to give it a try.
When it arrived I was surprised at how small and light the box was but opened it and sticks to put together and a large mesh tent the instructions seemed simple enough to follow so I took his bed out of the crib and started to put it together the sticks formed the two ribs that run across the top of the crib giving it the tent appearance the rest of it slides down into the crib and is held in place using Velcro for our particular crib it was a little difficult to Velcro into place as we have a high arching back rung but I was still able to Velcro everything into place with out to much difficulty.
When our son first saw it he was a little distressed (he gets that way with new things sometimes) and cried the first time we zipped it up but we made a game of it with him and now he helps us zip it up at night when we put him to bed now.
We found the tent to be very sturdy (our son likes to hang from the top of the tent as we put him into the bed and it will hold his weight (35lb) with out bending) and well made and once zipped up and in place all the sides are taunt the mesh material seems to be durable and of good quality.
I would recommend this product to anyone needing a solution to a situation like we were in.

product_title: The First Years 4 Pack Ziploc Sippy Cup, 10 Ounce (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I''m amazed at how poorly these cups were designed and really concerned about the quality of the plastic that they used in them - the smell has a really disturbing medicinal quality even after multiple washes in the dishwasher.

product_title: The First Years Ignite Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This stroller is a cinch to set up even with a baby in your arms. Using it for my 7month old granddaughter and she's comfortable and secure. As others have said the sun shield is not very effective. I'm almost 6 ft tall and find it's height very comfortable. We appreciate the zippered pouch on the handles. Looking forward to lots of long walks!

product_title: Safety 1st Alpha Omega Elite Convertible Car Seat
review_body: This car seat is great. It reclines and all and is just great. I like the cup holder and armrest. My son loves it. But the instructions are horrible. Great product.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ Deluxe
review_body: Ours stinks so bad my husband started putting diapers on the floor instead of opening it and subjecting himself to the nastiness. I wipe the champ with an antibacterial wipe evertime I change the bag so not sure what is up with the stankiness. Odors must leak through the bags and absorb into the plastic. We use a step can downstairs in our living room and no sitnk there. I'm throwing out and getting a step can.

product_title: Leachco Play Day Blanket and Tote - Pink Frolic
review_body: Love the color, size and the way it folds up. However, I was expecting it to be more padded. The blanket flies up when the wind blows because the fabric is so thin.

product_title: Melissa & Doug Annie 12" Drink and Wet Doll Plus Time to Eat Feeding Set
review_body: I purchased this doll for my 5 year-old who loves the idea of a baby who can pee.  While she is having such fun using the potty, feeding her water and changing her, I am livid over the scent.  We washed the doll, clothes and accessories and they still emit a horrible scent.  It's some sort of chemical that is enormously strong.  I have a headache from it.  Shame on Melissa & Doug! We have many toys from them and this is our first negative experience.

product_title: Britax Marathon 70 Convertible Car Seat, Blueprint (Prior Model)
review_body: These seats were ordered for our 16-months old grandsons. After reading a lot of reviews on several seats, I ordered the Britax Marathon 70 Convertible Car Seat, Blueprint, with the belief that I was buying the safest ones for our babies. I had also learned that a baby needs to face the rear until they reach two years of age, and these seats can be installed facing rear or facing forward. Evidently, the seats are very comfortable, because the babies fall asleep within five or ten minutes after we leave home. However, within a month after receiving these seats, I read an article stating HealthyStuff.org has published a list of the best and worst picks for car seats, in terms of chemical exposures. When I went to the website [...], I learned the Britax Marathon 70 in JetSet was rated as one of the worst for chemical exposure. I do not know if the JetSet is different from the ones that I purchased, or if they are the same. If I had known about this study before I purchased the seats, I would have possibly made a different selection.

product_title: FridaBaby NoseFrida The SnotSucker Nasal Aspirator
review_headline: No better than the hospital Aspirator
review_body: I read all of the rave reviews and figured I had to have this product, since my four month old seems to always be congested.  I have found that this product works no better than the nasal aspirator they provide at the hospital.  I will say that my son seems less annoyed when I use this product, I think mostly because he is curious about the aparatus mommy is holding.  In result -- not a bad product, but not the saving grace that I was hoping for.

product_title: Green Sprouts Silicone Freezer Tray
review_headline: HORRIBLE to get out frozen items!
review_body: I'm disappointed. I purchased this because I figured it would make it easier to get out frozen items. HARDER. Hard plastic would be better because at least you could bend it and stab it with utensils (lol) without worrying about cutting or ripping it. This thing DOES NOT bend easily when you have a tray full of frozen baby food. I cut myself trying to get the stuff out. You'd be better off with a regular ice cube tray. OR get those individual baby food storage things... they're not easy to get frozen food out of either, but at least you can just take one out of the freezer and let it thaw in there (you will need multiple packs of them, though). HTH.

product_title: JL Childress Gate Check Bag for Car Seats, Red
review_body: This bag ripped during first use and has poor construction and cheap material. Yes, it's an inexpensive product, but I expected it to at least one flight.

product_title: WubbaNub Infant Pacifier - Giraffe
review_headline: the best thing we ever bought
review_body: we bought one when my son was 2 months bc he couldn't keep his bink (he calls it his \\"ning ning\\") in his mouth by himself.  this was perfect to keep it in.  now he's 21 months and if he wakes up in the middle of the night, he can find it himself in the dark.  he still has that first bink, along with two more.  He goes to bed with all of them.    the only reason i am giving it 4 starts is bc the bink does not detach from the animal, so if it has to be replaced i have to buy more, remove the old one, and sew the new one on.  It's a pain bc i have to do it about twice a month.  i know it's probably time to take the binks away from him, but he loves them so much i can't do it yet.

product_title: Chicco Cortina Stroller, Hazelwood (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A good stroller, but I ditched it after a year
review_body:
I have used this stroller for a year. It was fine at the beginning, and I mostly got it because I wanted the Keyfit 30. However, once we started using it without the infant car seat, I knew that it wasn't going to be the stroller we would probably keep till she outgrew it.

Pros: Obviously it fits nice with the Keyfit 30 (which we loved.) Nice storage basket underneath. Built well, and I bet will last for some time. Smooth ride on normal surfaces and turned well. I liked that it came with a tray/cup holder and storage compartment (but that is a standard with strollers in this category).

Cons: It was getting hard to open and close as time went by. It fills my entire trunk on my Accord without room for much anything else. I definitely could not open it/put it away while holding baby. It's bulky, and the weight was starting to get to me. The sun shade is too small, especially as we live in S. Florida. I was stuck using an extension sun shade. The brake was also a bit difficult to unlatch and ruined a pair of my favorite flipflops. (I know I shouldn't have unlatched it while wearing such a shoe!)

When I started looking for an umbrella stroller, my friends recommended that I consider selling this stroller and replacing it with something lighter all together. I looked into the BJ City Mini and the Britax B-Agile. I have since purchased the B-Agile. Had this stroller come out a year earlier, I probably would have gotten it over the travel system. In hindsight, I recommend buying the carseat that you love, and the stroller that you love. I would not do a travel system again.

product_title: Infant Optics DXR-5 Portable Video Baby Monitor
review_body: Bought a pretty expensive monitor when we had our first child and it definitely let us down, so after seeing good reviews on this one we decided we would try this one. An obvious PLUS for being at lower end of the pricing scale on the market. My son is four months old and we have finally placed him out of the crib and into his own room. It is great to be able to have this next to us so that we can see him safe and sound next door. Really easy to set up and the battery seems to be OK but I keep it pluggeed in most of the time. My part of this monitor is that it is so silent after a while without any noise. It works well all around our house. We use it mostly at night which is great with good infrared night vision. It looks a bit like a toy but it definitely has been working great.

product_title: Safety 1st Whale and Baby Spout Guard
review_body: This is a very cute and effective spout cover. The plastic is firm but not hard and it completely covers the spout. My one complaint is that it doesn't have a hole at the top to allow for pull up shower mechanisms. This means that when my husband or I need to take a shower we have to take the spout cover off. Not that that is hard to do, but it gets annoying.

product_title: Medela Swing Breast Pump
review_headline: light, easy to use and to carry
review_body: it´s light, easy to use and to carry. even though it pumps one breast at a time, the benefits i´ve mentioned make it worth because -at least in my case- the pumping it´s quite fast. the cons i find is that you either have to use it plugged or with 4 batteries. i would like the pump to have a battery inside that it is charged when you plug it for some time.

product_title: The First Years Close And Secure Sleeper,Colors May Vary
review_headline: very useful as a portable sleeper
review_body: I got this as a hand-me-down and so far it has been one of our most-used baby items. We don't have it in bed with us since it feels a little cramped in our queen-size bed with it there. However we keep it on a nightstand next to the bed at night, so I can see how my little guy is doing without needing to move a muscle. During the day it moves to my desk, or the dining table, or the coffee table -- wherever is conveniently nearby. This has been great for always having baby near me so that I don't have to keep running to the crib to check on him. It is also very compact and portable -- we always take it with us when we're vising friends or family so that baby always has a comfortable place to sleep.  Big caveat though: my baby is only 1 month old and already takes up almost the entire length of the sleeper, so I don't think we'll be able to use it for much longer. However, even for just the first month this has been so helpful to have. He makes a lot of noise at night even when he is asleep and I would have to constantly be hopping out of bed to check on him if we didn't have this cosleeper next to the bed.  I did have to sew an extra sheet for it though, since the one it comes with will inevitably get dirty. The mattress itself is a good softness and is wipeable. The velcro on the sheets is unnecessary since there is nowhere for the mattress to slide anyhow.

product_title: Evenflo Classic Johnny Jump Up, Frogs (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Save up and get the more expensive model...
review_body: This is very cute - bright colors, adorable pattern etc. However, unless you are pumping it up and down with your hand, or your child weighs 35 pounds, it won't bounce smoothly. It's very jerky. I loved the price, however the only thing it was good for was a swing. Save up and buy a more expensive model, your child will have a lot more fun!

product_title: Infantino Cloud Cart Cover, Numbers (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this cover and use it all the time. It fits most carts and highchairs. It does show dirt and stains, but washes up well. When dealing with babies, I think we all just learn to ignore the stains anyway. The downside, which I'm sure is true for other covers, is that it can be tricky to get it into place while holding the baby. The solution I found is to try to park next to a cart return place so I can get it setup (it takes less than 30 seconds when you have both hands) while my son watches me from his carseat. It's also really bulky, but if you keep it in the car, you always have it when going out. The cover serves its purpose and more. I think it's a good choice if you're looking for a cute cover that is efficient.

product_title: GroVia Reusable Baby Cloth Diaper Wipes, 12 Count
review_body: Any product that is 88% polyester should not have COTTON in the name of the product. This is misleading and people who want cotton will mistakenly order it if they don't read the details.

product_title: Summer Infant Baby Touch Digital Color Video Baby Monitor
review_body: picture quality is terribly bad. but i am not looking to take pictures and the purpose of baby monitoring is successfully solved in my kids case. another problem is interference with wireless internet. i couldn't use  internet and  baby monitor at the same time.

product_title: Chicco DJ Baby Walker, Splash (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter uses this all the time.  We got it for her at about 5 months and she uses it to follow me, or the dog, all over the house.  We have a single story home, so we do not have any stairs or drop offs to worry about.  The colors are more girly (definately pink), but since we have a girl I don't mind.  Its an awesome product and my daughter loves it!

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat
review_body: I've had this seat for a few weeks now and love it.  I'm so glad it doesn't have any material or padding because it's so easy to wipe clean as it is and nothing needs to be washed.  Very happy with this booster seat.

product_title: Pigeon Baby Nose Cleaning Tweezers Pigeon (Made in Japan)
review_body: have been using this since the baby was a month old. We love it. Now since the baby move alot and does not want us to pick his nose, we have to use it when he sleeping (with flash light). My sister got one and she loves it for her daughter as well.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Twin Electric Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: i researched online and from my friends who use breastpumps and it was a choice between medela and avent.  I end up purchasing philips avent twin electric breast pump.  it turned out that avent has a stronger pumping system than medela which is very important to me because my milk supply is minimal.  its also a plus for me that avent breast pump (twin electric) is a closed system meaning that no milk will go to the pump.  avent is also cheaper compared to the medela.   I use my avent electric breast pump for a month now around 4-5x a day and it still works great.  I am very happy with my purchase.  The product is great.    I got my breastpump from amazon exactly 5 days from the day they shipped it and its an international shipping.  It was well packed and all parts complete.  This is very important if you're an international buyer since returning the item would be a hassle and shipping costs would be expensive.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: I don't know what it is about this thing, but my baby loves it!  She has been playing with sophie everyday since she was about 8 weeks old and she is now almost 8 months.  I really do not see the appeal, but every baby seems to love this toy.

product_title: Annabel Karmel Fill and Freeze Puree Pops (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This was bought through Amazon.com as a gift for my niece to make pops for her little boy.  She told me she loves and is very happy with them. The little one is 7 months old and has no problems hold them and enjoying them.   Good buy for the money.  would recommend this product.

product_title: Munchkin Designer Diaper Change Kit
review_body: I love this diaper changing kit! My diaper bag came with a roll-up changing pad, but I traded up to the munchkin diaper changing kit. It has room for diapers (about 5 size 3 at the moment) and 15-20 wipes in the included wipes case. I like that the bag has a wrist strap - makes it much easier to carry baby and bag at the same time. Definitely worth the price.

product_title: Munchie Mug Snack Cup 16 OZ Yellow
review_body: We bought one of these for my almost 2 year old and it works really well.  In other snack traps, my son grabs a handful of snacks (cereal, teddy grahams, whatever), and they end up everywhere, especially in the car.  On this one, the fabric stays tight against the lid and prevents every single snack from ending up on the floor of the car, in his car seat and anywhere else in between. The other snack traps, he just sticks his hands in and pours the snacks out, but this one he, so far, has been unable to do that. It's a bit pricey, but I'm OK with it, since this product is about the size of 2 of his other snack traps.  I would definitely recommend it to anyone who is frustrated with the other snack traps and needs an alternative.

product_title: SheetWorld Crib / Toddler - Percale Baby Pillow Case - Light Solids - Made In USA
review_body: Exactly as advertised and arrived early. (Slit for the pillow is in the back.) The color was just as I imagined it would be.

product_title: FuzziBunz One Size Cloth Diaper
review_headline: Good diaper, but not as adjustable as claimed
review_body:
I have been using the FuzziBunz one-size diapers on my daughter for 15 months now, starting when she was 9 months old. The fit was great in the beginning, but I've had some issues with the fit for the last 6 months or so. My daughter is 50th to 75th percentile for height and weight, so not petite but not gigantic. Most children's clothing is true to size for her. She weighs approximately 30 pounds now.

About six months ago, I had to remove all of the waist elastic in my 15 or so diapers and replace them with extra leg elastic. The diaper was much too tight, and when I'd try to snap it into place, she'd cry. This adjustment has bought some extra time with these diapers, but they are currently my least favorite in my stash. Now that she's bigger, the adjustment buttons seem to dig into her more. I recently bought a different brand of one size diaper, and on the biggest setting these have a footprint as big as a large Fuzzibunz and use a comparable insert as well. The insert of the FuzziBunz one size is much smaller than the inserts for their medium or large perfect size diapers. I prefer to use these only at home as I'm liable to have a leak if we're out and I don't change her quickly enough (I'm confident that the leaking is due to the size of the insert and the width of the diaper, not my care of them, as I don't have any issues with the Medium Perfect Size FB we've used just as long).

Things I like:
*Price is better than other big name one-size pocket diapers, with great quality
*No issues with fraying or staining after 15 months of constant use
*I prefer stuffing my own diapers - separate inserts reduce drying time
*Apparently FB has repositioned the button to stay inside the fleece (Be sure to get the new model!)

Things I don't like:
*NOT adjustable to 45 pounds - started having issues around 25 pounds
*Insert is small when used with toddlers
*Button on old model digs into skin
*If the bottom snap is snapped into the loosest setting, then one of the two top snaps will dig into baby's skin

These have done well for me, but I'm wondering what to do now. I've got a two year old who is potty training and don't really want to invest in new large-size diapers. I got a couple of inexpensive Diaper Rite pockets (these adjust with the traditional fold-down snaps) which are filling a hole in my stash (also aggravated by my purchase of the FB aplix prototype which was a total fail - the aplix was worthless after only a few months and after my child carried her dirty diaper to me, I put them away).

I'm expecting number 2 soon, and am planning to use covers and prefolds until she fits into the FB OS. These will be a great diaper in the beginning, but I expect to run into the same problem when she gets above 25 pounds.o top snaps will dig into baby's skin These have done well for me, but I'm wondering what to do now.
