product_title: Kate Aspen Five Piece Pedicure Set with Matching Thank You Tag
review_body: fits in the palm of your hand. I thought it would be bigger, then again i didn't really read the description much to figure it out before-hand. Once you get used to it though, it's a nice,cute, small gift idea.

product_title: Fisher Price Fastfinder On The Go Backpack Diaper Bag - Brown
review_body: I have 3 children and have gone through many diaper bags over the years.  I have been using the JJ Cole Collections System Diaper Bag in cocoa oval for almost a year now (my son is almost 1).  I really love the bag and found it \\"almost perfect\\" as well which is why I have used it as long as I have.  For me the reason for change is that with my boy getting bigger and heavier, it is sometimes hard on my shoulder to be using a shoulder strap bag.  I decided a backpack style (that would distribute the weight on both shoulders) is better.  I don't carry the diaper bag a lot but if I have to go in and out of places with it, I figured a backpack style would be ideal.  If I'm using the stroller the JJ Cole has stroller attachments and I have always used those.  To my surprise this bag has stroller attachments as well.  It doesn't list it in the description but it does have them where the straps are on the back.  My main complaint with this bag is that for me the bottle section doesn't fit more than one bottle and for me it barely fits that.  I have been using the Born Free bottles (which I didn't think were very bulky or wide) and I couldn't zip the compartment all the way closed.  Grant it, my son is on his way to using a sippy cup but still takes the bottle right now and thankfully I don't usually need more than 1 bottle when I'm out and about but I was disappointed that it didn't fit properly.  Likewise, there really is no spot for a sippy cup, other than placing it in the main compartment which is nice and deep and has plenty of room but my concern is that if it tilts and leaks (although most sippy cups are designed not to leak, inevitably some do)it will be all over the inside.  I have not used the front 2 pockets for anything as of yet.  I like the pacifier compartment and the wipes compartment on the outside is a superb idea.  Love that.  Likewise, I love that each compartment is essentially labeled so you know what goes where.  Of course you can always customize itto your liking I suppose but the specific compartments are helpful.  I use the front zippered pocket for kleenex and other random things.  The inside has some nice pockets on both sides that you can use to your liking.  Even with every pocket on the outside and inside full you still have plenty of room in the main section of the bag.  I personally would have loved maybe a divider of some kind in the middle of the bag so I can toss my things on one side and baby things on the other but that's not a deal breaker for me.  Bottom line, I definitely recommend this bag if your looking for a backpack style bag.  Nicely organized and plenty of room.

product_title: Davinci Willow Universal Fit Natural Coconut Palm Crib Mattress (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The mattress is very-very nice! I don't like the idea that my baby would sleep in a plastic, and this one is made from real cotton. My baby loves it! I recommend it to everyone.

product_title: Dappi Waterproof 100% Vinyl Diaper Pants, White
review_headline: Bought these for to go over swim pants
review_body: I bought these because I was told that when you take small babies swimming it's better to have plastic pants and a swim diaper on, just in case. I used these the first two times I took my baby to the pool and stopped after that. The only thing they held in was water. I know some public pools require plastic pants over the swim diapers, but these didn't make a difference. My son was about 14.5 pounds and the leg-holes weren't tight enough. I imagine these might have been helpful on a road trip or something, though, as an extra barrier between my son and his car seat.

product_title: Britax Frontier 85 Combination Booster Car Seat, Rushmore (Prior Model)
review_body: I did a lot of research online before choosing the Britax Frontier 85.  It was a hard decision because of the cost, but realizing that my grandson would use it for the next 5 years made it easier.  He absolutely loves it.  Being a big baby, he had outgrown his rear-facing carseat a month ago and was starting to hate car rides.  Now he's happy to get strapped in!  The harness system is very secure but easy to adjust.  He loves the cup/bottle holder.  He routinely falls asleep but the padded wings keep his head from tipping to the side.  Most importantly, I feel good that my \\"precious cargo\\" is safe in his new Britax carseat!

product_title: Infantino Swift Classic Carrier, Black
review_body: I used it for the first time today for a short trip to the store (about 30-40 minutes). My little one is under 10 lbs but I am recovering from a c-section, so I can't carry him in a carseat or lift a stroller into or out of a car. That's why I needed an inexpensive carrier that I'd use for quick trips - and this carrier is great for this purpose. I do not plan on prolonged babywearing.  Little one was comfortable, while I was slightly worried that he still can't hold his head up. He kind of leaned it against one of the side straps and didn't care about anything.  My son fell asleep in the carrier as soon as we walked into a store.  The only thing I didn't like about the carrier is that you put it on as a sweater. I'd prefer sliding into one from aside. Other than that - I was happy.

product_title: Safety 1st Whale and Baby Spout Guard
review_body: I had trouble putting this over my faucet and it doesn't seem to fit properly so the water comes out slower. I use it the guest bathroom but guests have to take it off anytime they want to shower. I would recommend looking for one that leaves room for the shower turn on/off thingy. Otherwise, it's okay.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_body:
Babywearing a wonderful sanity saver for both moms a babies. My 6month old daught was a classic colic/high-needs baby, and I wouldn't be the calm, effective, with-it mommy I am today without babywearing!

I originally used a ring sling, but around 15lbs my baby go too heavy for me to comfortably wear for long periods of time. So, I tried out the Moby wrap. It's fantastic! The weight is so much more evenly distributed, and it doesn't hurt my back or sholders. I can wear her for hours and it's no big deal. Our baby loves being worn, and seems to also prefer the Moby to the sling. My husband actually ties her onto his back!

There are TONS of different wraps, far more than what is shown in the booklet or on the Moby website. Check out youtube for all the different holds.

I will make the comment that I have NO idea how moms breastfeed using this. Breastfeeding in a sling was really easy, but I can't figure it out in the Moby. Also, I think the ring sling was \\"easier\\" to use in the sense that you just put it on and go, so going to the grocery store was faster and easier. But, you can put your Moby on before leaving to do errands, drive, and then slide your little one (or big one!) in the Moby when you get to your destination.

product_title: Tiny Love Sweet Island Dreams Mobile
review_body: Just wanted to add this is a nice product.Initially i felt this rotates very slow.But understands that this needs to move slow as baby can concentrate otherwise.Hanging toys are very good.Bright Colorful.

product_title: BabyKicks Set of 3 Nursing Pads, Jersey
review_headline: no leaks, reasonably priced -- no complaints!
review_body: I've been using these nursing pads for about 3 weeks now and I have no complaints. I really like the material, first of all (I love Babykicks hemp/cotton blend). They have not leaked at all, although my baby is 4 months old so I don't have that crazy newborn leaking milk situation anymore. Some reviewers complain that the cloth pads show through clothing and the disposable kind don't. This is more or less true because the pads are thicker (they're actual cloth, so they have to be!). But to me, the \\"green\\" benefit of reusable pads, as well as the economic benefit of using them over and over outweighs the inconvenience of having to adjust them occasionally so they don't show through my clothing. Besides, it's only some shirts/sweaters, and only if I have a very thin bra on. Anyway, I like these pads very much and would recommend them to anyone. Cheers.

product_title: Neat Solutions Neat-Ware Table Topper
review_body: Great value!! I LOVE these and never go out without them. Plates get immediately tossed to the floor and this gives my toddler a clean surface to eat off. These stick extremely well. With some of the other brands I've had problems getting the strips off to expose the sticky side, no problems with these. Recommend!!

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_body: I bought this product for my daughter who is a young adult going to have a baby. She feel in love with it and had to have it. So I purchased it as a baby gift. She likes that it lights up the room and can be used as a soothing night light and she likes the turtle it is one of her favorite animals. Also I like that it is light weight so the baby will be able to play with it after it is old enough to hold on to. oh this is about the shipping from amazon..I love the air pockets you put in the box's now it is so much better than those messy peanuts.

product_title: Tiny Love Super Mat, Orange/ Blue
review_body: Great playmat.  Like the satiny nylon surface and the durable backing.  Washes very well too.  perfect for home or on the go.  We have a 5 month daughter and she loves the textures on the mat and it's large enough for two adults to sit on there with her.  Highligh recommend this, just wish it came with a small travel tote, but it folds pretty well so if you have a bag, it fits well.

product_title: Bumkins 3 Pack Waterproof SuperBib (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Way easy to clean and very stylish!! I love these Bibs, the only kind I will use for my little one during feeding time!!

product_title: Badger Basket Baby Changing Table with Six Baskets
review_body: I have a small apartment and this was so ideal. i love it. The draws are such a great space saver i was able to really use these. It was not hard to build and the color matches perfect with my other espresso pieces. Im very happy i chose to go with this. And you cant beat the price. Its a score!

product_title: Britax Boulevard 70 Convertible Car Seat (Previous Version), Onyx (Prior Model)
review_headline: Top of the line car seat!
review_body: Got this as a replacement for my 4 month old son, as he was in an Eddie Bauer carseat no longer big enough. As soon as we got it open it really did wow me and my wife. The safety features are amazing, and the build of this item was just as pristine. Only drawbacks is that it is pretty difficult to place in the car compared to a regular carseat and that if you plan on taking it out, thats a process as well. Also, its quite large for certain vehicles when your rear facing, and I drive an 09 Maximathat is fairly spacey. But with Boulevard 70, there won't be the ample amount of space you were used to with your previous carseat. Despite the cons, it easily brands itself a name of superiority with its easy alteration features for size and width. comfort from all sides including side impact and easy snap seatbelts, and it finishes itself off with a sleek sporty look (Onyx). All in all, safety features, build quality, comfort, durability, all at a 5 star rating, great carseat, good for along time, thanks Britax.

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_body: This thing itches like crazy and is hard to zip up.  Easy Expressions is much easier to wear... I'd recommend that one instead.

product_title: Zip-n-go Blanket | Waterproof Picnic Blanket | Outdoor Blanket | Stadium Blanket | Large Fleece Blanket
review_body: This blanket is a high-quality product.  It is a great size and also comes in very attractive patterns.  I have a similar blanket that does not come near the quality of this product.  It may seem pricey, but it is worth the money.

product_title: Nuby Replacement Nets for the Nibbler
review_body: Had to return these bags as I never could get the original bag off the feeder.  Had to return the whole feeder.

product_title: Sassy Happy Hippo Bath Shower Spray (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I wish I could give no stars!
review_body:
Where do I begin!
I was sooooo excited to get this product. I thought that it would be fantastic to rinse off my 4 and 6 year old kids' hair as well as my infant. Unfortunately, I never even got to use it. I hooked it up to my faucet as directed (WORD FOR WORD OUT OF INSTRUCTIONS) and while I was trying to adjust it so that water would not spray everywhere, my husband came running upstairs asking what the heck I was doing. APPARENTLY this thing was backing up the water out of the faucet so bad that it was LEAKING out of the pipes... which, mind you have NEVER had a problem before.

DO NOT BUY! It's a good thing the husband is a plumber or this could have really been a pickle. I promptly returned it to Amazon... UGH!

product_title: Cloud b On The Go Travel Sound Machine Soother
review_body: We LOVE this giraffe. My daughter goes right to sleep on the sleep setting and stays asleep until it turns itself off. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it's on a timer (25 or 45 min) and once it shuts itself off she wakes up moments later. We hang ours on the top of her crib and turn it all the way up. Works like a charm!

product_title: Sleepy Wrap Baby Carrier
review_body: I started out with a Baby K'tan when my son was born and quickly realized I wanted something else. A friend had a Sleepy Wrap and I tried it out and liked it immediately. The pro of the Sleepy is that it is not \\"sized\\" - so my 6'4\\" husband can wear it as easily as I can. It is also very secure, and my baby seems to love it! Once you figure out the wrap, it's actually quite easy to do, but there is a learning curve to figure out the wrapping technique and then to figure out how to get baby into the wrap relatively quickly and safely. On the con side, because the material is very stretchy, it can be hard to get the fabric wrapped tight enough that baby is high on your chest once he's in the wrap. Also, in the winter, it can be difficult to put on and take off because the ends of the fabric drag on the group (I've solved that problem by putting on the wrap before I leave home and then just popping baby in once we arrive). The only other con I can think of is that it does seem the fabric would be a bit warm for the summer, but for winter time it's been just great!

product_title: Baby Angels
review_body: Baby Angels is one of the favorites I read when substituting.  All ages love it. It is a terrific bed time story!!! :0)

product_title: Summer Infant Ultra Plush Changing Pad Cover, White
review_body: This is a great product. It fits my changing pad well, and it's very soft. I use a disposable changing pad on top of it to try and avoid washing it every day. But, my baby's head lays on the actual material of this cover and it's so soft and comfy for her.

product_title: Safety 1st Lift Lock and Swing Gate
review_body: The door is easily opened and closed with one hand, I installed with screws. My 9 month old baby boy is safe now from going to the laundry room. I need another door for top and bottom of the stairs but I am trying to avoid the use of screws on the walls. Still doing research, because I do not find this door stable for top of stairs, that is why I gave 4 stars, but if it is properly installed with screws it should work perfectly.

product_title: Motorola Digital Video Baby Monitor with Room Temperature Thermometer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this product. This is our first video monitor. We used it for a new born litter of puppies. It works excellent The only thing I would add is some sort of handle to carry the parent monitor from room to room. It is easy to slip out of your hands.... Love this product overall....

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA-Free Animal Front Teeth Teether (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is the only teether my daughter used.  She loved it!  I loved it too.  Firm and squishy at the same time.  Easy to clean.  Easy for her to hold and chew.

product_title: Chariot SideCarrier 1 Child Side Mounted Child Carrier
review_body: I have owned this carrier for 3 years and I have to say that chariot makes the highest quality carriers on the market in my opinion. The benefits to a side carrier are the ability to view you child with ease vs turning around to a trailer, the ability to use a trail-a-bike, utility or child trailer in conjunction with the side carrier. The negatives that I found are. 1, the tire wear. 2, the hitch weighs 1Lb 10oz and if you have a bike with expensive light weight components and your concerned about your bikes total weight this is problem, and it's not practical to remove the hitch when not in use. 3, if you ride on sidewalks the total width of the bike & carrier may be problem depending on you cycling skills. 4, if you use panniers on the right side of the bike it will affect your right turning ability. 5, clearance issues if you have a front fender. The unit handles very well. Other than that it's a very cool design and you surely wont run into many people using the sidecar.

product_title: MAM Hold Me Bottle with Handles, 6 Months, 9 Ounce
review_headline: Luck of the draw with colors
review_body: I bought this bottle almost exclusively for the handle of my son's anti-colic bottles. As a bonus, I actually got a blue bottle! It may have had something to do with the other three boy's bottles I ordered at the same time. Also comes with the x cut nipple and a spout for transitioning. As my son adores Mam products of all kinds, I'm sure we'll make good use of these in a few months. I definitely recommend this product!

product_title: Kissaluvs Fitted Diaper: Size 1 (13-28 lbs)
review_body: I wanted to like these but they did not work for us at all. Before my daughter was born I was so convinced I'd love these that I ordered several in sizes 0, 1, and 2. My daughter is tiny - 10th percentile for both height and weight - and the sizes 1 & 2 were both gaping at her waist but way too tight on her thighs so they didn't last for the weight limits I thought. Also, they hold in the \\"stink\\" way more than prefolds (for me resulting in having to strip the diapers, but everyone's washer is different). On the plus side they hold everything in - no blow outs!     Another reviewer mentioned these \\"keep baby dry\\" but that is misleading - your baby will still feel wet, unlike a fleece-lined pocket diaper for example.

product_title: Baby Nasal Aspirator Vacuum Suction Pigeon (Made in Japan)
review_body: I purchased this product for my daughter, knowing how much better human suction is than battery powered for nose clearing.  This product does the trick.  I know it's working because I hear it and feel it working.  I read a review that was a complaint about how you can't see the mucus through the bulb, and how it was difficult to clean. In my opinion you don't need to see the mucus, because yo are the one doing the sucking, believe me you will know it's there. Also I found that by using the nipple brush of a bottle brush I can clean the bulb just fine.  I highly recommend this product and can't wait to buy for a new mom!

product_title: JJ Cole Bundleme Shearling Baby Hat
review_body: I see quite a few reviews that say the hat is too small. My baby is 2 months old and it fits her big. You have to take in to consideration that all clothes, hats, etc are going to fit babies differently and at different times. I have clothes from the childrens place that fit her perfect in 3 months and other clothes are WAY to big for her in that same size! I give the hat 4 stars because while it might not fit a 6 month old baby...it will fit at some point between 0 and 6 months of age. Oh and its not as white as it looks, its more of a eggshell creamish color.

product_title: Baby Einstein Count and Compose Piano (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this for my 8 month old son. He was bored with it in a matter of minutes and I ended up sending to back. The keys play very softly, and there is not much on the toy to really play with. I ended up spending a little more and getting the Fisher-Price 2-in-1 Singing Band Walker. It's a little more money but has been well worth it! It plays songs, and keys are loud enough to hear them and there are multiple toys on it! And he can use it as a walker when he gets to that stage!

product_title: Booginhead PaciGrip Pacifier Holder
review_body: This is a perfect strap for ANY pacifier.  My daughter really liked the pacifier she received at the hospital and not the orthodontic ones or the AVENT or MAM ones I had received as shower gifts.  Those straps will only fit that specific pacifier, too.  The Boogin Head strap is easy to attach to any pacifier and clips to any fabric without leaving marks.  Plus, I get compliments on the cute patterns!

product_title: Dream On Me Baby Bath Seat, Pink
review_body: Cute bath seat, but the suction cups do not suction the bottom of my tub.  It's not only these suction cups, but others as well.  My baby is only 15 pounds so hopefully when she's heavier her weight will hold the seat down.  Toys aren't that great either.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat
review_body: Great product and price! I looked extensively because I'm so picky about style and color. This blends well with our decor. Sturdy too. Will highly recommend.

product_title: North States Stairway Pet Gate
review_body: I bought this gate because we just bought a new Chihuahua puppy and I wanted to be able to block off our basement stairs as well as a main floor den that is the only room in the house with carpet.  We have an older female Maltese and she has had wetting accidents on the carpet in our den so we don't allow her in that room when we are not at home anymore.  I know that the puppy will do the same thing as my mom's older male Shih Tzu did when he came for a play date which is wet on the area's where Tilly did to mark his territory.  It's just in a dogs nature to do that once one dog has gotten it started. Thank God I don't have carpet anywhere else in my house.  I bought two of these gates and may buy one more.  I love the fact that once you get the brackets up you can just take the whole gate off and store it until you need to block off an area, or just keep it up & ready at a moments notice to put into use.  And these are so easy to just put back into the brackets when you need to use the gate.  I know this is called a stairway gate but I'm using one in a regular doorway as well.  Works like a charm either way!

product_title: Boppy Organic Cotton Slipcover, Forest (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Thin fabric feels cool to the touch
review_body: This is cute very thin fabric one of those fabrics that always feel cool to the touch...i like that. It is very cute and blends well with neutral decor...i thought it had birds on it with the trees but it is teddy bears...eh dont love that but whatever its organic and you dont notice them unless you get up close.

product_title: Regalo Easy Step Walk Thru Gate, White, Fits Spaces between 29" and 39" Wide
review_headline: Confusing to build at first. Used for a small dog with modification
review_body:
We bought this gate to contain my mother-in-law's small 5 pound dog in her kitchen. The gate arrived at our house and I decided to unpack it for a trial build before takining it to her house. Out of the box, the gate looked defective. The gap at the top of the gate seemed to be about an inch too big and the door latch did not meet the fixed part of the gate. After some complainig about cheap workmanship and poor QA, and being surprised Amazon would sell such a product, I got to thinking that I would see how much pressure it would take to get the gap to close enough to latch. Then it hit me, since this is pressure mounted in the doorway, the gap will close when it is installed. Well after a half hour of fooling around with this and many words that should not be used in front of kids, I was cofident it could work as-is. I was ready to put it back in the box to take to the mother-in-laws and dumped the box to get all the packing material out. A small 3\\"x3\\" pice of paper fell out and it warned not to be concerned about the gap since it will close up during installation. I wish they would staple that piece of paper to the instrucion sheet. It would have saved a lot of agravation.

So the gate got installed at the house. The doorway opening required the adjustment screws to be almost totally out. In hind sight, we may have needed the next size bigger gate. The little dog was able to get between the gate and the wall. I added a peice of wood in that area to stop the escapes. Now the gate is doing its job.

product_title: Chicco Sleep and Play Musical Puppy Crib Toy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We got this toy as a gift and it turns out to be the biggest hit. Turn it on and the fussing stops! He plays with it all the time. The music is really clear and the songs are a good choice. He likes to pet the the soft ears too. I highly recommend this toy.

product_title: OXO Tot Mini Silicone Dishwasher Basket, Orange
review_body: This thing is so very very helpful! Keeps the concave things concave and the convex things convex. Exactly what we needed!

product_title: Summer Infant Swaddleme Microfleece, Blue, Large (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great item, can't find this size in stores
review_body: I was worried when my son grew out of his swaddle and couldn't find a larger size in any store. I was so happy when I found one on Amazon because when I put him in it, he goes right to sleep. And it also keeps him from waking up so much at night.

product_title: Kidco Basic Natural Feeding System
review_body: This product is absolutely great. You control the speed with pressure from your hands and can increase the speed even further with the turbo button. I recommend that you steam your fruits and veggies before use for an even creamier consistency.     Make sure that you wash the parts thoroughly as it is easy for foods to stick.   It also would have been better with two tiers of blades but overall it gets the job done. I have had mine over 4 months now and it is still getting the job done!

product_title: Rover Gear Westport Car Seat Travel Bag, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This bag would be a 5-star if it was just a tad taller and wider. As it is, however, it makes me curse every time I use it. Every time we go on a trip, I consider just renting car seats from the rental car agency because I hate wrestling with the $%@# car seat bags.     I pack two car seats when we travel - a Britax Marathon and a First Years True Fit - two fairly common car seats, neither an outlier for size.    The Marathon just barely fits; it is nearly too tall. You have to make sure you put the base of the car seat in first, then ease the edges of the bag up and around the top. If you care about your fingernails, outsource the job! It takes me about 2 minutes to get the Marathon into the bag and fully zipped up. Only minimal sweating here. If you're only going to put a Marathon in this bag, it might be worth it.    The True Fit takes about 5-8 minutes to squeeze, push, pray, curse, and generally manhandle into the bag. By the end, I give up trying to get the bag fully zipped. The True Fit is nearly too wide for this bag and when the headrest is attached, much too tall. You will have to remove the headrest and place it in the seat, which adds to the width (thus making it too difficult to zip entirely). Even without packing the headrest, you have to turn the whole package on its side and put your knee on the side of the car seat, effectively squeezing the \\"wings\\" of car seat body, in order to get the zipper even halfway zipped. I can't imagine this is good for the car seat's structural integrity!    The Rover bag says it fits car seats up to 31\\"Hx20\\"Wx19\\"D. Definitely check your car seat's measurements before you buy, and make sure you can get a free return if the seat doesn't fit the bag. Believe me, there is nothing more frustrating than trying to corral two small children, curbside at the airport, while you spend 10 sweaty minutes stuffing their seats into ill-fitting bags!    I will say this: They seem to be quite durable. Ours have been on several flights and are holding up just fine. The zippers have withstood my yanking and stretching, and the wheels are still rolling smoothly. If it fits your car seat, this is a good buy.

product_title: Summer Infant Elite DuoMat for Car Seat
review_headline: Good Product to save your leather car seats
review_body: We have a Britax car seat on our leather car seats for some time and even though we put a towel below the seat, it was getting impressions of the car set. So after seeing the potential damage that would be done to the car seats, we decided to buy this. This is a great product at a good price. It is easy to install. Just open the Duomat and slide it where you want it. It has a tab on the back to slide between the seat so it stays in place and then the care seat can be installed on top. We are very happy with this and recommend this to everybody who has leather seats in their cars and wants to protect them from damage from Child car seats..

product_title: Milkies Milk Saver
review_headline: A Must Have for breastfeeding moms!
review_body:
This product is one of the most simple innovative solutions for breastfeeding moms ever... I'm not gonna lie- when I first saw this in a magazine ad I laughed and had to look it up. (I thought it was something you wore at all times to catch milk at first). The point of it is that when you are feeding your child on one side you catch the milk that it let-down from the opposite side (instead of it soaking your breast pad). It is as simple as that and you have all of that extra milk (which we all know is like gold to breastfeeding moms) to save and use later or freeze.
With my first son, when I went back to work and wasn't pumping as much as he ate and had to rely on the milk I had gotten from extra pumps at home or pumping more often at work so I could get him all of his bottles while at daycare... I tried everything- Drinking TONS of water, eating oatmeal, many calls to our lactation consultants and even taking Fenugreek to boost my supply and even with all that I only lasted about 7 months until I had to use some formula If I had known about this I would not have had to stress about it. This time around using the milk saver I have a supply of 54 extra frozen bottles right now (my son is four months) so even if my supply is going down and I have to use them for daycare I don't have to worry since I continue to catch more with my milk saver when I'm home with my baby!
This really is one of my favorite baby products and I've already gotten it for two friends as baby gifts. I would recommend it to anyone! I was leery of the price at first and almost didn't buy it but I'm SO glad I did! I would pay $25 for it again in a heartbeat. All of my extra milk is worth SO much more to me than that- Especially if you have a low supply or are going back to work and your supply will decrease- Think of this as $25 you spend on being able to save your own breast milk for baby instead of supplementing with fomula.

Pros-
-Great Idea
-Easy to clean
-Easy to use
-No stressing about not making enough milk- this backs up your supply for when you go back to work, get sick, need a drink, get your period back- Anything!
-You save money on breast pads since you don't need to change them as often (for me this has already paid for itself with the pads I have not had to buy)
-It helps keep your supply up in general since it allows you to let down more than you would without it- therefore letting your body think the demand is higher and makes more.
-Great gift idea

Cons-
-I don't really see it as a con since it needs to be big to catch the milk (you can also attach a bag to it and drip right into that but I don't normally get THAT much) but it IS on the large side- I normally only use it at home anyway but if you have a nursing cover in public anyway I don't see why you couldn't conceal this as well.
-I have spilled my milk out of it by leaning over to put my baby down when he was done and I forgot it was in. You need to take it out and set it down (it is rubbery so it doesn't slip if you put it down leaning on something but it DOES come with a stand/carrying case to set it in as well)
