product_title: Breast Ease Warm/Cool Gel Pads, 2 Pack, Blue
review_body: I bought these to help with a clogged milk duct.  I wasn't very happy with the way they felt.  No matter how much I tried to wipe them down they were super wet, so I couldn't just leave them in my shirt.  My electric heat pad worked much better for the clogged duct.

product_title: Boon Frog Pod Suction Cup Bracket (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This did not work in our shower. I followed the directions for prepping the surface, and the suction cups still would not hold. The frog pod either ended up sliding down to the bottom of the shower, or falling completely off. I had this suctioned to the side of a glass shower. It ended up being returned.

product_title: Boon Odd Duck - Squish (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Paint peeling off beak but GREAT customer service
review_body:
I love the company & the fact that the plastic is safe. BUT -- My 9 month old baby has been chewing (no teeth) on the ducks beak & I just noticed that the paint is chipping off. I've emailed the company but it is a shame to have to take away a toy she loves so much.

UPDATE: I emailed Boon. They called by back with in two days. They say that they havent heard this complaint very often and were happy to send a new duck. Truly excellent customer service.

product_title: Munchkin Two White Hot Cling Shades (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Suction Cups Just Don't Stick Well
review_body: The title says it all. It's a little cold today (45 degrees). I cleaned the windows 30 minutes before applying these and followed the directions on lightly moistening the suction cups. No go, they just don't stick. I even warmed up the car for a while in my garage to see if heating the windows helps. That got them stick on, but pulling on them to lower the shade makes them fall off.     Considering how heavy these are, a baby seat next to the window could be a problem.   I will be returning these and buying static cling shades....

product_title: North States Industries Supergate Easy Close Metal Gate
review_body: Good item, great value.     Easy to install.     Con: There is no simple unlatch procedure.     Works perfectly for our 30lb dog

product_title: Sumersault Slow Pokes 4 pc Crib Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This crib set arrived and I was so excited. It is bright, colorful, and made of quality materials. For the price I was expecting something cheaper looking but it is perfect and makes the nursery so cute- full of bright fun colors and cute little creatures.

product_title: Baby Buddy 2 Pack Secure-A-Toy
review_body: I bought a couple of these to use for a multiple of things.  For a buck & change a pack why not?  Right now (since it is winter) I have been using these straps to hang toys off my 4 month old's toy bar that hangs over her pack n play, and also from her swing.  It allows me to hang it at the right height for her to be able to practice grabbing.  When she starts sitting in a high chair in a couple months I plan on using these on there as well as her stroller to keep toys from getting lost.  They are a little short, but are long enough for what I need.  I have the sippi grip that i bought for her sippy cup and snack bowls when the time comes too.

product_title: Munchkin Warm Glow Wipe Warmer
review_body: After about 4 weeks of use the warmer began to leak around the blue plastic in front.  Also, it doesn't have a convenient on/off switch.

product_title: Bassettbaby River Ridge Changing Table
review_body: The table itself is nice, it's sturdy and attractive.  It's a lot more substantial than it looks in the picture.  The assembly was straightforward, took me about 10 mins on my own (once I got all the pieces).      The problem is, like other reviewers have mentioned, there was no hardware in the package....Granted, basset was responsive and shipped the necessary parts within a few days, no complaints about the customer service.  But a table like this, from a company like Basset, you expect there to be hardware....and unpacking it and strewing the parts all over the room, only to have to wait 4 days before you have everything necessary to assemble, is unacceptable...    Only get this table if you don't mind waiting a few days after you unpack it to actually put it together.

product_title: NUK 2 Pack Classic Silicone BPA Free Pacifier, Size 1
review_body: Our son loves it!  They gave him at the hospital when he was born and its his favorite pacifier so far!

product_title: Summer Infant Sleek and Secure Multiview Handheld Color Video Monitor, Grey (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have owned an Summer infant monitor before and was very happy with the product.  We decided to get rid of it because it was analog and not digital.  We bought this one even against all the warnings from reviewers.  Believe the reviews!!!  It has horrible picture reception.  I couldn't tell the difference between my daughter and her stuffed animal in her crib.  I did end up returning and buying the sleek and slim monitor which is much better.  Summer infant really messed up with this product and should take it off the market.  Horrible horrible waste of time and money

product_title: Dream On Me Full Size 2 in 1 Folding Stationary Side Crib
review_body: This crib was fairly sturdy and looks good.  However, it took us a long time to put it together, even though  my husband is always pretty good at figuring things out.  The directions were not very detailed and the pins had to be put in upside down, which meant that we had to keep turning them and guessing where the hole was.  Other than that, it seems to be a very good product for the price.

product_title: Dreambaby Cabinet Safety Catches
review_body: We actually bought this to prevent the cats from opening the cabinets. It worked like a charm and according to my fiance it wasn't hard to install.

product_title: New Arrivals Frame
review_body: This picture frame is beautiful & well-made!  I love the colors - they were well-described, a light sage green & dusty pink on a cream background - perfect for our daughter's nursery!!!!!  AND, it will grow with her nicely!!

product_title: Clek Ozzi Booster Seat in Licorice (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: huge white warning label on the front of the seat
review_body: A note for those of you that are buying this seat for it's good design and solid color: What is not shown is the huge white warning label the covers the entire front side of the seat. It is a federal law to have these warning labels, but they should have put it on the side on a small tag like Graco does. It is a great carseat and very comfy but beware that the photo on the websites is not what it looks like. Also if you have a Land Rover it is very difficult to latch the seat belt due to the short span on the latch bars on the Land Rover. Borrow one and test it before you buy it.

product_title: Skip Hop Moby Bath Spout Cover Universal Fit, Blue
review_headline: Works for us we have twins
review_body: We have used this for a year now and it has been great. No mold problems and goes on and comes off easy. I love it and it does the job!

product_title: SnugGlider Classic Connect Infant Car Seat Swing Frame
review_body: My two issues with the swing are: first of all, the ad doesn't specify portable and while the photo shows the swing as being low to the ground, I thought I was buying a taller swing.  Secondly, the vibration and sound controls are located under the seat, when the seat is on its perch.  This means that you tilt the swing upward to select controls, either interrupting the swinging or possibly waking the baby if all you want is vibration.

product_title: 36 Pc Full Size Diaper Pins
review_body: The company is great. No issues there. The pins are awful. They melted a low temps in the dryer and they are left-handed design. They are simply not easy to use.

product_title: Graco Sweet Slumber Sound Machine, White
review_headline: Still needs to be baby tested but so far...
review_body:
I plugged the sound machine in for the first time today. I love the simpleness of use, the small compact design (I will be using this when we travel, as well as at home). I bought this as a replacement to a humidifier that my 8 month old son cant sleep without. I love the humidifier, but we have terrible water and it continues to be clogged and honestly I can't travel with it. So I am hoping the Graco sound machine will do the trick. I read some reviewers say that it was too loud--or not loud enough, I think it is a matter of opinion but in my opinion it will be just right (if not a tid bit too quiet). A clogged warm air humidifier can be pretty loud so I'm hoping this will do the trick. I love the 6 \\"white noise\\" sounds...the first two are similiar to static/humidifier so I'm going to experiment with those first. The heartbeat, rain, ocean and foresty type sounds are beautiful and I would hope my son will enjoy those in the future. I always put classical music on during nap so it is a plus that there are those settings also.

Even if my son doesn't like it, I would still highly rate this product. It has many functions, is small, and well worth the price. :-)

product_title: Graphique Home Decal, Dr. Seuss One Fish Two Fish (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: After a few months these began to peel away from the wall and end up on the floor

product_title: Kolcraft Tiny Steps 2 in 1 Walker, Circles (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have another Kolcraft walker (it has Elmo on it) that we keep at my inlaws' house.  We bought this one for our house.  We had to remove the white rubber along the bottom, otherwise it was too difficult for my son to move around.  (We keep this on the ground floor of the house and there are no stairs/ledges that he can walk off).  The one think I don't like about this walker is that the back wheels do not rotate.  The only go back and forth and it makes it difficult for my son to maneuver and sometimes he gets stuck in a corner.  The Elmo one we have, all 4 wheels rotate all directions and he moves really well in that one.  Other then that, it's a good walker.  We haven't tried using it as a stand behind walker yet but it seems sturdy.  My son loves to chew on the balloons and the icecream cone.

product_title: Sugar Booger Divided Suction Plate
review_body: I bought this plate for my 1 yr old son because his plates always end up on the floor.  The plate itself is adorable, and he likes to point and smile at the pictures. We have a marble table top and it never suctions well. I've tried getting it a little wet, but it just pops back up. I removed the suction tube part so I could put the plate in the dishwasher, but it's difficult to get the ring back on the plate now. I still use the plate, but I had to remove the suction part completely.

product_title: Ju-Ju-Be Packabe Diaper Bag
review_body: Great size (for one) and cleans up great!  I like the backpack style and my husband uses the single strap.  I have had this bag for 20 months and after a quick wash looks brand new.

product_title: Baby Buddy 2 Pack Secure-A-Toy
review_headline: Simple, inexpensive- and does its job well
review_body: nothing much more to add that above, wish it were a tad bit longer but i like them, works well to attach lots of toys and so far, baby hasn't been able to unbutton it

product_title: Graco Shelby Classic 4 in 1 Convertible Crib, Cappuccino (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Very easy to put together we had it up in less than 30min!!! Seems really sturdy and made well!!! No problems at all!!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Gentle Waves Musical Mobile (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My baby loves the ocean theme and so do I. Works well and was everything I expected. A nice addition to any crib.

product_title: Summer Infant Best View Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I was very excited to try out this monitor, as I had the old Summer Infant Day/Night monitor, and really wanted a digital one, that wouldn't get interfernce, and also absolutely loved the idea that you can remotely control the camera, especially now that we have moved our toddler to a \\"big boy bed\\", and he can get out on his own.      However... the key thing in any monitor, is the sound and volume.  This monitor, turned up to it's highest volume level, is only maybe half the volume level of the old one.  I got so used to the old one, where I could hear when my son was moving around in his bed, and it picked up every noise.  This one doesn't even compare.  I was viewing the monitor on this new one, and seeing that my son was moving around, however, I couldn't hear a thing!  This is unacceptable to me.  I have returned it.

product_title: Medela Pump in Style and New Pump in Style Advanced Breast Pump Tubing - Pack of 2
review_body: As a lactating mother who accidentally melted my last set of tubing, it was refreshing to purchase these online & have them shipped overnight, especially since Medela doesn't sell these in the local stores!

product_title: Bright Starts Lots of Links Accessory Toy
review_body: These are a perfect early toy.  They are a great size, so my little one can actually grab ahold of them (at 2 months), and I can use them with my other toys (activity gym, tummy time mat) to connect other toys, or just these.  I keep a few in each of my dipaer bags and at home.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body: My five month old son loves this activity gym.  I love that you can move the different toys around so that he can play with them weather he is on his tummy or on his back.  I love that it plays different nursery rhythms and that they are interactive.  They only play again if the right spot on the mat is hit.  My son loves the toys that crinkle, the parrot, and the elephant ear.  He also greatly enjoys the plastic toy that came with it.  It is his favorite now.  The reasons it did not get a five star rating is that the toys hang too low.  Even when the toys are at their highest point they are in my sons face. Other than that it is a great product and it stores very easily with the snaps.

product_title: Nursery-To-Go Wooden Lamp Base
review_body: Perfect lamp base size for our nursery.  We were unable to find a white lamp base of this size anywhere, so of course we were able to find one here!

product_title: Snappi Cloth Diaper Fasteners (1 pack)
review_body: I decided to buy one to try it out.  I'm really pleased with this item.  I use to use safety pins because I was unable to find a snappi in stores.  The snappi is easy to use, safe, and does not pose any danger to my child's skin.

product_title: Mud Pie Baby Little Prince Blue Twill Photo Frame, Little Man (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My mother-in-law has this with all of her boy grandchildren (3) in it and sits on a table full of grandbaby pictures. I'm getting her another photo frame as we are expecting boy #3, this will be grandson #4.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: That's what my husband said when I got this.  But, Sophie has become a beloved member of the household.  And I like knowing that she is safe for my kid to slobber all over.    The only thing I don't like is the hole in Sophie back which allows air in and out to produce the squeeking sound.  When I washed Sophie the first time, water got inside her.  Even though I squeezed it out, I'm sure there was still some moisture left and I wonder if it resulted in mold or mildew inside Sophie.  After the first time, I've been really careful to put my finger over the hole when washing.  It makes it more cumbersome, but better than mold.

product_title: Skip Hop DUO Deluxe
review_body: I found this to be an \\"ok\\" small diaper bag - we used it for a year. I could fit most of the gear I needed for a day in the bag (minus a change of clothes and blanket - I was bf-ing so didn't need room for bottles/formula/etc). Once you load it up it doesn't close, so it was always tipping over and spilling out. And as another reviewer mentioned, if you fill the pockets you can't get to the bottom of the central compartment.

product_title: Travel Potty
review_body: This is a really cool potty seat with how you can attach the bags to it and how it folds down so well, but the seat is really small and there is no shield on it for little boys making it hard for them to use! I will be returning it just because its hard for me little boy to use!

product_title: Combi Tatami Playard, Jade (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Like it, don't use it much
review_body: I like this play yard because it is easy to set up and not so heavy to carry. When it is folded it takes up a lot less room than the Graco ones. I also love the price on Amazon, it was 100 bucks cheaper than anywhere else.   The only thing is that I haven't used it much b/c we haven't had the need, but I think we will use it more as my baby gets older and needs to be kept away from the dog and sometimes his older sister!  It looks beautiful, is easy to use and it does not have any stinky plastic smell, and the mattress is nice too.

product_title: Playtex 3 Pack Baby Drop Ins Nurser
review_headline: Maybe not the best choice for formula babies?
review_body:
I really wanted to love the drop-in bottle system. I purchased eight bottles, several boxes of liners, and two breast milk storage kits prior to the birth of my son thinking it would be so convenient to just pump breast milk into the liners and freeze them. Unfortunately, mother nature didn't cooperate with my plans and I was unable to breastfeed. I figured they would still be good bottles even if my son was formula fed because you don't have to scrub them and they should cut down on gas. This was a good theory, but in practice I have found that I tend to wash these just as often and just as thoroughly as I would a traditional bottle, so it really doesn't save me any time. Plus, to me, it seems almost messier to deal with disposing of the liner (especially if there is leftover formula) than if you just poured the extra down the sink from a traditional bottle. I have found the liners to be costly and kind of a nuisance to keep up with (one more thing to remember when traveling with baby). And now that my son is taking four ounces at a time, I have found that it is just about impossible to fit four ounces of water plus formula in this bottle without making a mess. It also bugs me that I can't use these with my bottle warmer (they melt...oops!) and the nipples do not fit well in my dishwasher basket. These are small things, but when you deal with them several times a day it can get annoying.

What does my 5 week old son think of these bottles? Well, this was the first nipple he was ever introduced to, and he seemed to like it at first. But in the past two weeks he has been acting like he doesn't want to latch on to it as well. He actually preferred the narrower, \\"firmer\\" nipple on the Similac nurser bottle. With the Playtex drop-ins nursers he eats very slowly and seems to lose interest halfway through a feeding. Also, I can't tell that they really prevent gas all that much. He has a lot of trouble with spitting up. For this reason we finally decided to switch bottles. He now uses the Dr. Brown's Natural Flow bottles and is doing MUCH better....feedings are much easier and quicker and there is a lot less spit-up mess to deal with afterwards.

I know every baby is different and I can see where these bottles would be great for a breast-fed baby. Mom can pump directly into the liners and the nipples seem to be designed to mimic breastfeeding. I will be saving my bottles, and hopefully I can breast-feed my next child so they will be used. However, for my formula fed baby, they did not work as well as the Dr. Brown's.to switch bottles. He now uses the Dr. Brown's Natural Flow bottles and is doing MUCH better....feedings are much easier and quicker and there is a lot less spit-up mess to deal with afterwards. I know every baby is different and I can see where these bottles would be great for a breast-fed baby. Mom can pump directly into the liners and the nipples seem to be designed to mimic breastfeeding. I will be saving my bottles, and hopefully I can breast-feed my next child so they will be used. However, for my formula fed baby, they did not work as well as the Dr. Brown's.

product_title: Sealy Soybean Foam-Core Infant/Toddler Crib Mattress - Hypoallergenic Soy Foam, Extra Firm, Durable Waterproof Cover, Lightweight, Air Quality Certified Foam, 52"x28"
review_body: Firm, yet not a rock. Good quality mattress that fits well in the crib and both my daughter and I are happy with.

product_title: Baby Einstein Activity Keys
review_body: My baby loves this activity keys. Its just the right size for his fingers to grip and the colors catch his attention.

product_title: Flensted Mobiles Aero Hanging Nursery Mobile - 24 Inches Plastic
review_body: This looks great hanging over our baby's crib, and I love that it's not battery powered and plays music, or has lights all over - he gets enough of that during playtime, sleep time should be peaceful!  Simple design, but the way the planes rotate is fascinating and very soothing - my husband and I enjoy watching it too.  Assembly was easy, although I do wish the propellers on each plane snapped on more securely.  I'm going to have to come up with a way to attach them better so one doesn't come off and drop in the crib.

product_title: Gerber Large 3 in 1 Ribbon Bag
review_body: This is a great bag and you definately get your moneys worth. I purchased this bag for my new born baby girl and haven't had the chance to use it very much yet because she is not here yet but I have packed everything I need for her in the hospital and still have room to fit some more. This bag is very spacious and very stylish. I have fit 2 outfits, diapers, wipes, pacifiers, hats and blankets in here and I still have room for more. If you looking for a bag with lots of room I would definately choose this bag.

product_title: My Little Legs baby leg warmers (#19) Spring Stripe
review_body: I've purchased both the BL brand & these \\"My Little Legs\\" for my daughter. The quality is the same, but this brand is much cheaper.  I got 3 pairs of My Little Legs for the same price as one pair of BabyLegs.

product_title: Ergobaby Original Baby Carrier
review_body: Love this carrier. Infant insert is a must for early months, but after babe is big enough, ergo carrier is awesome in and of itself. My big boy loves being toted around in this thing, and his 22 lbs feel comfy bc of the waist strap. He loves the back hold position...all in all, great investment.

product_title: Neat Solutions Dora the Explorer Potty Topper Disposable Stick-in-Place Toilet Seat Covers, 10-Count
review_body: If your little one grabs onto the sides of the potty chair like mine does, then this seat cover DOES NOT offer enough protection.  Continue searching for the ones that actually drape over the sides of the seat.  They are worth the extra money!  I gave these Dora seat covers away to my friends who don't use any seat covers for their little ones, and they love them.  But for me (ultra cautious about public restrooms), they were not good enough.  They need to be designed to drape over the chair.

product_title: Medela Soft Fit Breastshields 24mm - Medela 67246
review_body: These are much softer than the regular issue hard plastic shields. I prefer them because I think they are more comfortable. I did not notice any significant increase in milk output, but they are a great pair to have around because of comfort. I put mine in the top rack of the dishwasher a few times, too and they distorted a little but it didn't really affect their use.

product_title: DwellStudio Stroller Blanket
review_body: The quality of this item is definitively lacking, considering the price and the designer I expected much more in terms of the heaviness of the blanket. The fabric print is very cute, and the only thing making me keep this blanket. (owl print) I had read bad reviews on the DwellStudio owl bedding set quality, and since that is $400 I decided I would buy separates for our nursery instead since its half the price that way and this was to be the blanket for the crib bedding set. However it will end up being used as an everyday blanket now and for the bugaboo since it is very light weight. It is a thin cotton, with no filling, and a soft fuzzy backing. If your looking for a true light weight cute blanket to go with your stroller, then go for it but it cannot serve as a true bedding piece for your crib. But honestly only if you are in LOVE with the print, because for half the price you can get the same quality blanket from dwellstudio for target (i have pieces from there and its the same in terms of quality and construction).

product_title: Kushies Zolo Linko
review_body: My 1-year-old daughter loves these things. She'll spend 20 minutes sticking and unsticking them, then another hour carrying them around the house and sticking them to her highchair, radiators, the fridge, etc. She's little yet, so she doesn't understand magnetism and isn't coordinated enough to build them into a tower, but that's what dad & I are for.     My only complaint about them is the price -- we received them as a gift and she loves them, but WOW I don't know if I would have paid $50. So maybe only go ahead if (a) you've got $50 to burn, or (b) you already know your kid loves magnets.

product_title: Baby Jogger 2011 City Mini Single Stroller, Orange/Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We just bought this stroller and I am so glad we did! It is very lightweight, easy to maneuver, and the folding mechanism is brilliant! I have a squirmy 8 month old and with him on one arm, it is so easy to pull the handle on the other and stow in the back of our suv. We were using a Peg Perego and after buying this jogger, I don't think we'll use that stroller again!!!

product_title: Kushies 5 Pack Reusable Ultra Diapers
review_body: I have used these diapers from months 4 through 10 (and counting) in a large rotation of other diapers (from prefolds to BumGenius Organics) and finally feel qualified to write a review.  Overall, I have been very pleased.    Like all cloth diapers, your success wth a particular brand/style may depend on your baby's build and activity level.  We have a small/avg baby and these definitely didn't fit him at 10 lbs, probably more like 12-14.  He was EBF at that point still and these didn't have a problem handling the waste.  Now at 10 months, these are DH's go to diaper for fast diaper changes on a squiggler.  The fabric stays inside the waterproof, so there's no adjusting or checking to make sure it's all tucked in, and the easy one step velcro is fast.  The only problem I am seeing is that as DS gets bigger around, the top can fold down a little bit, causing wicking.  I also don't know that they will last for another baby's worth of use, the cotton is starting to pill and the PUL is getting stiff.  But at $8/diaper opposed to the BG O at $25/diaper, defintely a fabulous value.

product_title: Dreambaby Retractable Gate - L820 - 55"
review_headline: Good dog gate, not good for baby
review_body: I would recommend this to people that are wanting to use this to keep dogs in a different room. We use it for when company comes over to keep our 10 month old dog in the kitchen and the people in the living room. The dog gets a little too excited and the gate helps her to get excited and then calm down before we open the gate. This is a soft flexible gate and it would NOT be good at the top of stairs for anyone! It would be easy for someone to push the flimsy material. It is ok for a ranch style home using between rooms. It's difficult to open with one hand which is an issue for me with two kids, I usually have one of them in my arms and need to put them down in order to open the gate. My husband is able to open it with one hand though. Many visitors have a difficult time figuring out how to work it so there is a learning curve and anyone using it needs to be shown how to use it which is a bit of a pain. The instructions for installation are easy to read.

product_title: Dreambaby Chelsea Xtra Hallway Swing Close Gate Combo Pack
review_headline: Good gate, tough to install, hard to move
review_body: This gate is high quality. However, it was very hard to install properly. Once it is installed, you won't want to move it as it is designed to stay up all the time. I don't recommend this for a space that you want to be able to open up at any point. For us, it's between the kitchen and living areas to keep the dogs out. But when we have guests over, we'll want to move it and that is going to be a huge pain.

product_title: Digital Baby Monitor Handheld 2.5" Lcd Color Video and 2.4ghz Wireless Camera - Video & Audio Infant Nursery Monitor
review_headline: if you have an infant get one of these!
review_body: i bought my Brother and sister inlaw this for christmas. Almost every month i get an email thanking me for it, and how she cant imagine not having it. It has made things so much easier for checking on the baby and for training to go down for naps without rocking.

product_title: Inglesina Club Highchair
review_body:
We purchased two of these chairs, one for each grandchild. The chairs are made in Italy. They are well constructed and assembly was a snap. Assembly took about ten minutes per chair. The Italians know how to pack and ship their merchandise so it is not damaged in shipment. Our grandchildren love these chairs. They actually run/crawl/toddle up to them when they catch a glimpse of them in the dining room. They will sit in them throughout the meal without fidgeting so I assume they are comfortable for them. They clean-up with ease. A little costly, but again, well constructed so worth the money. We would definitely purchase these again

Update:
Almost a year later and the chairs have worked out fantastic. Our grandchildren are going on two years old now and still fit well in the chairs. They appear to enjoy sitting in them at meal and play time a year after the initial novelty of having a new piece of furniture wore off. These will easily pass down to the next sets of children.

product_title: Moses Basket Sheet Cotton - Color White
review_headline: Good Quality - Couldn't Find a Better One
review_body: I added a wool sheep skin pad to the thin plastic foam pad that came with my Moses basket which the company referred to as a \\"mattress\\" and these elastic fitted sheets accommodated the extra thickness very nicely. These sheets fit very nicely and are a much better quality then the sheet which came with the Moses Basket. They were even better and fit very well after washing in hot water and drying in the dryer.

product_title: Lamaze Chime Garden (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: People are overthinking this, it's great!
review_body: This toy made it through my sister's twin boys, my daughter, and now my five month old son.  It's currently received 3 1/2 years of steady use.  Each of the four children loved it!  I would say it's most appealing from 4 months to a little over a year old. I like to place my baby in his/her Bumbo seat or high chair and place it on front of them.  They each loved to use their uncoordinated hands to sort of hit or push the flowers, causing them to play music and light up.  When the music stopped, they hit it again.  It kept them entertained for 20 minutes at a time!  As my daughter grew older we would play the longer song and sing along to it (if you're happy and you know it clap your hands, stomp your feet, etc.) I say it's well made, very entertaining and easy to wipe clean. The music seems to be at a good volume, not too loud or quiet, and the melodies are nice.  I am sensitive to loud obnoxious toys too.  The batteries have only need to be replaced twice.  I highly recommend it!

product_title: LA Baby 2 in 1 Crib Mattress with Jacquard Cover & Organic Cotton Layers
review_body: We researched like mad to find a mostly organic materials matress with great support, a resonable cost, and without chemical issues. Although we certainly would have purchased a complete organic matress, the cost was extremely too high ($300-600!). This matress is an amazing value. No smells were noted upon arrival. The company openly provides info on it's materials, and unlike most others, admits to true precentages of organic materials in layers blended with non-organics. (One main layer is 100% organic). We tried a futon, but baby (a large boy) quickly made a large concave indentation. This matress is firm with a high spring count and has remained like new after four months. Construction appears well-made. It fits perfectly in the crib (sorry can't remember brand) without any gaps. And the water-resistant surface seems virtually water-proof. For the price, this matress really can't be beat. We love it.

product_title: bumGenius Reusable Diaper 2 pack - Neutral (Snap Closure)
review_body:
These diapers are great! They wash well and do last from birth to potty! They are caregiver/daycare and daddy friendly. They are absorbent, dry quick, and don't leak!
Prefold might be cheaper, but not the solution for everyone, these are so easy!
If you are going to try and cloth diaper I would recommend these, prefold were imitating for me, these are just as easy as a disposable. Either way you will save money vs disposables. I have owned many brands, but sold them off to buy more of these. I have even got some second hand, the older versions that are still in great condition!
I am confident these will last through another child too, they are so well made!
** And snaps are much better than aplix/velcro, when your baby gets older he/she will be able to take them off, just like disposables!

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_body: I like this product but not really as a night light my children love it because its fun for us to look at the stars in there room and read books with a small light near by.We also play games with it there favorite is find the moon lol i will turn it on face it down while holding it and move it around and since theres only one moon they have to find it over and over again we mostly play with it but my 5yr old sometimes sleeps with it as a night light. I do like it

product_title: JJ Cole System Diaper Bag
review_body: Great bag for the price and no so girlie that we would need another if we have a boy next.  Bag is't super huge but it carries a ton of stuff.  Love the seperate changing pad which allows me to put a few diapers and wipes in so I do not have to use larger bag all the time.

product_title: Lamaze My Puppy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased this for a baby shower in which the mommy to be also loves dogs.  This gift went over well.  I personally like these books as they are soft and colorful for babies to play with.  My daughter really likes playing with these types of books.

product_title: American Red Cross Door Finger Guard - 2 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: broke the door off the hinge
review_body: these products are horrible.  if you have a kid that likes to swing doors, they will immediately cause the door to come off the hinges.  this product did it within 5 minutes of install.

product_title: Fisher-Price My Little Lamb Cradle 'n Swing
review_body: Just received this swing in the mail a few weeks ago and I am very disipointed in this product. I use to own the rainforest swing which pluged in and I never had any complaints, I got this swing realized it was only battery operated which really shocked me considering the retail price but put the swing together and could not believe how loud the gears are! I called fisher price and they sent me a new gear head which helped a little but the swing is still way to loud. I cannot imagine this swing being  soothing to a baby making that kind of loud grinding noise. Everything else about the swing is great, nice soft cushioned seat, pretty soft colors but none of that matters once you turn the swing on.

product_title: Room Magic Heart 5 Drawer Chest, White
review_headline: Room Magic Heart 5 Drawer Chest, White
review_body: This is a solid piece of furniture for children and beyond.  It comes already assembled (90%), heavy with rails on the sides of each drawer, and solidly crafted to last (you can change out the heart handles as the child grow older).  The only drawback was that sometimes the screws for the hearts were not the correct lengths causing them to pierce through the heart or not hold them in place (no instruction included).  A quick call to the Amazon promptly solved these problems.  I just know this is a common problem as I ordered several furniture products from this company to match the set for two daughters.

product_title: Diaper Sprayer for Toilet - Diaper Washer Hand Held Bidet Sprayer for Cloth Diapers
review_body: If you are doing cloth diapers... you NEED one of these!!  We had to switch back to disposables and my friends were fighting over who could buy it from me!!!

product_title: Chicco Cortina Together Double Stroller, Fuego (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have researched for weeks about a double stroller for my 3year old and newborn. After looking and trying out many in the stores, we decided to purchase this one on amazon after seeing it in the store. It is by far the best stroller out there. WE orginally thought the sit and stand strollers would work best, but decided to spend the extra money which has paid off!. It is very easy to fold up and put away in your trunk. I have a small car and this stroller fits perfectly. Very light/easy to steer especially when my 30lb 3yr old is in the front. love how the back seat reclines to a flat position.  I definitley reccomend this stroller to anybody with 2 small kids.

product_title: BOB Infant Car Seat Adapter For Single Strollers
review_headline: Must have to get full use of bob!
review_body: As a first time dad I did tons of research on everything baby.  I wanted a stroller that was easy to fold, durable, functional off pavement, and it had to be cool:  the bob rev is by far the best.  That being said, it also had to work from infant till 4, and does so with this kit.  For the hefty price tag of the bob the overpriced adapter should come standard but oh well.  I did make one modification in adding washers to where it bolts to the bob to make it completely snug.  We use it with the chicco keyfit30 which is not bob approved, but it installs just like the graco snugride and found it to be a much better fit with the bob after rigorus testing at babiesrus.  ( keyfit did not budge, graco was more attached but bounced loosely in comparison when violently overturned.) all in all this is a must have adapter to to get full use of bob.

product_title: Munchkin Stay-Close Harness and Handstrap (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We used this with my 17 month old when we went to take her great grandpa back to the airport.  We found a less-busy area and put this on so she could go out of the stroller and walk around, but not go out of sight.  It was great and she thought it was soo funny!

product_title: Cosco Funsport Play Yard
review_body: I bought this for my 3rd baby, bonus child, gave away the last pack and play cuz didn't thing I would be having any more children so I didn't want to spend too much on another one.  I read the reviews and purchased and to my surprised its totally worth every penny.  I paid too much for the other one I bought and should've just gone with this one....its basic and totally got me out of a pinch.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Coordinate Duffle - Black
review_body: Super practical diaper bag, that fits all my baby's and my stuff!  I don't even bother with a purse anymore.  I intend to continue using it even after my baby grows up - doesn't look like a diaper bag at all.  Very light, doesn't get dirty, great to travel, fits well on a stroller, shoulder strap is very comfortable and doesn't fall off.

product_title: Stork Craft Lauren Fixed Side Crib
review_body: I am a Grandma and purchased this bed about a month ago.  I think it will be perfect for my Grandchildren when they visit.  I just wanted something inexpensive that is also built really well and sturdy and this bed does just that.  I am happy with my purchase.

product_title: Kiddyloo Toilet Seat Reducer (Blue/Green) - Toddler Potty Training Seat
review_body: I purchased this seat in order to get my 3-year-old son to go potty on the toilet (as opposed to his stand-alone potty seat in front of the TV). It fits him just perfectly. He is comfortable on it, and the front comes up enough so that he doesn't pee all over the floor (like with other seats that I tried). I would recommend this seat. It's really cute too.

product_title: Bright Starts Comfort and Harmony Bouncer, Biscotti Baby (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great bouncer, a bit too much padding for newborns
review_body: We got this bouncer when our son had colic, and needed to sleep sitting up much of the time. We love its angle, and he seems to like the music and vibrations. However, my only gripes are these: it is hard to adjust the angle with the baby in it, and it has alot of padding along the side of the bouncer, making me worry that he will turn his face into it and have difficulty breathing. To solve this, we pinned back the sides, and now I feel much more comfortable with it. We also have the Fisher Price Infant to Toddler Rocker and the Baby Bjorn, and like this one just as much if not better for newborns, though I'm sure the other two will be preferable as he gets older.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: Fun toy, not annoying to adults. It's a good music box to turn on when she is looking at books and other images (she is 9 weeks old).

product_title: NUK 3 Pack Orthodontic Silicone BPA Free Nipple Bottle, 5 Ounce, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Speech Pathologist prefers these for her grandchild
review_body: I prefer these nipples over any other because they train my grand baby to move her tongue from front to back across the hard palate.  The slow flow makes her work a bit harder which is very good for her tongue strengthening.  Ultimately it will help with the shape of her hard palate as well as the clarity of her speech.  With other nipples, I noticed that our baby was pushing her tongue forward to slow the flow of the milk.  That was not what we wanted.  My daughter-in-law has been very happy with my suggestion.

product_title: LilyPadz® Reusable Silicone Nursing Pads Single Pair Regular Size
review_body: Thinking these pads would help my sore nipples, I bought them and was very excited. It worked great for the first few days, although I did notice a little milk pooling in the pad. A few days later, both my nipples became bright red and my skin around the areola started peeling. Turns out the pads weren't allowing the skin to breathe and I developed very painfully raw nipples. It's been 5 days since I stopped using them and I still cry each time I nurse. These pads r horrendous. They deserve minus stars not the one that I'm forced to give!!!

product_title: Bumkins Organic Cotton Burp Cloth 2-Pack
review_body: These are my favorite burp cloths!  The size is large, they're super soft and super absorbent.  My baby spit up quite a bit when younger and this would do the job without getting soaked like other thinner burp cloths.  And, I love that it's organic.  Baby is now 7 months old, and they are still in great shape!  And, I love that they're a neutral color.

product_title: The First Years: Easy Store & Thaw Milk Organizer
review_body: I agree with other reviewers that you can't store very much in these but I liked to use them to store the fresh milk while it was freezing. Then when the container got full I would move the milk into gallon storage bags organized by date. Any way you look at it milk takes up alot of freezer space, this was just a good spot for me to put my freshest milk for freezing.

product_title: Kate Aspen "About To Pop" Popcorn Favor Box - Set of 24
review_body: These are about an 1.5\\" high.  Nice to give something to everyone at a baby shower. Worked very well for me and looked nice.

product_title: Pink COMFORT SILKIE Security Blanket ~ The Original. The Best. Award Winning.
review_body: Tried different versions of this comfort blanket but my daughter refuses to sleep with a different one, durable and easy to keep clean

product_title: Jollybaby Prop 'N Play Discovery Gym and Playmat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: What a Great thing for little ones!!Grandson loves it..and it props him up safely as he tries to play with the hanging objects!!  Highly recomended!!

product_title: Fisher Price My Little Lamb Infant Seat Baby Carrier
review_body: I used this seat for both of my children and they loved it.  So why only 4 starts?  Well, I think the seat is dipping too deep that they slide down.  If I sit them in high-up position, then their legs get squished and it doesn't look too comfortable to them.  My kids didn't care for the music or the vibration either.  With that said, my children still love the chair, and they need a place to sit so that they can look at things other than the same view from their crib.  So I give it a 4 star.

product_title: Pinzon Baby By aden + anais Muslin Swaddle Blanket 4 Pack, Wild Thing
review_body: We desperately needed new swaddles when our 3 month old baby kept breaking out of his old small ones so I ordered these. They have been great. The blankets are nice and soft and our baby loves holding them, rubbing the blankets on his face and chewing them. They've also been very useful as cover ups for nursing and for covering his car seat/stroller when outside in the winter. As for swaddling the size is perfect. Our baby is 16 lbs and these cover him with no problem. They are quite delicate though as my husband tore one while attempting a super tight swaddle and the baby wore one of the blankets thin from kicking at it while swaddled. Also, the baby still broke out of these swaddles but we found that double swaddling has worked wonderfully. Now we first swaddle him in his old too-small flannel swaddle which pins his arms well and then swaddle him again in this muslin swaddle. He hasn't been able to break free from this and has slept so much better because of it. Another note though is that it is the middle of winter and this combo is very warm. Not sure how it would work in the summer.

product_title: Cloud b Baby Turtle with Quiet Rattle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We're trying to fix up my one-year-old's sleep.  She didn't have a lovey, and we needed to ditch her pacifier.  She loves, loves, loves her Twilight Turtle (\\"turtle\\" and \\"star\\" were among her first words thanks to that), so I decided to get some more \\"huggable\\" turtles to use as loveys.  I got this rattle one, a small keychain turtle, and a larger pillow turtle (all Cloud b products in the Twilight Turtle family).  Well, the pillow was too big for a lovey, the keychain turtle too small, and while this guy was a little smaller than I would have liked, it still makes a great lovey.  It's soft, she can shake it and the sound can comfort her in the dark when she can't see, and it's just big enough that it doesn't immediately fall through the crib bars.  Wish it were just a little larger, but for the price you won't hear me complain.

product_title: Levana BABYVIEW20 Interference Free Digital Wireless Video Baby Monitor with Night Light Lullaby Camera
review_body: I received this as a gift before our first baby. After 6 months, the power supply to the monitor broke. My brother also got one and in 8 months the volume to the monitor broke. When the product is working it is great, but it is hard to give a good review when you haven't seen it work for more then a year. The return service is tied up in red tape. After going through all the loops, they have found it defective and I hope they are returning it with a new one. However, I haven't received it yet.     As a side note, you get a 1 year warranty with the product. You can get a 6 month extended warranty if you post a positive review of the product or a 1 year extended warranty if you post a positive video review of the product. Therefore, I would take that in consideration when looking at the reviews.

product_title: Carters Everyday Easy Dust Ruffle
review_body: This was a perfect bed skirt for our crib. It hides all the boxes I store under the crib for now, and matches the wall color well. It needs ironing out of the wash, but holds up well.

product_title: Medela 100% Cotton Washable Bra Pads, 4 Count
review_headline: Easy to find, so-so absorption speed
review_body:
I've tried four different products. I'm working to test each product I can get a sample of. I believe most products fit one or more specific needs. I hope my research helps you make the best choice for your needs.

So far, each brand's strengths were as follows:
>Kushies (3star)absorbed moisture immediately so they were the best inner doublers,
>La Leche League (3star)appearance was best for use in B/C nursing bras,
>Medela (2star) was easy to find in stores and absorption improved with time,
>NuAngel (4star)was very affordable. \\"White/patterns\\" absorb a bit faster than \\"natural\\" so I like to put \\"natural\\" as an outer doubler and \\"white/patterns\\" as inner doubler during heavy let-downs.
If you only drip a few drops during let-down any one of these brands would be fine. Read further if moderate to heavy let-downs are common.

All products were machine washable, free samples, and pre-washed in hot or warm water and cold rinse at least once before use unless otherwise noted. No fabric softeners were applied as they can cause repelling. All samples were used at least a month before final opinions were noted.

Categories: dry shirt test, rate of absoption, appearance, leakage, light use, heavy night use, doubler. Organic?, Made in USA/Canada?, Fair Trade?, Construction Material? Seam/Dart? Cotton/ Bamboo...?

KUSHIES:
Single layer/light use 4 star
Inner doubler 5 star
Outer doubler 1 star
heavy night solo 1 star
Rate of absorption 5 star (immediately absorbs 3ml during 2 secs dispersed).
Shirt test - back of pad damp in 10 minutes (3ml), shirt not visibly damp, but slightly damp to touch
Appearance 2.5 star (deep dart gives nipple effect on C cup(2), becomes less visible with time(3))

Best speed of absorption and inner doubler. 2-second squirt of 3ml absorbed in same 2 seconds. Still fresh white color after 2 months use. 100% cotton, 4 layers, med contour and dart/seam, 6 pads/pk, ~5\\" diameter, Made in Canada.

LA LECHE LEAGUE:
Single layer/light 4 star
Inner doubler 1 star
Outer doubler 4 star
heavy night solo 2 star
Rate of absorption 2 star: (3ml in 13-40 sec, variable)3ml within ~5 seconds after couple months of use
Shirt test - shirt visibly wet in 5 minutes (3ml)
Appearance 5 star (Especially good for C/+ size in my experience)

Best appearance for 36C wearing tank top/tight clothes. Variable speed of absorption. 13-40 seconds to absorb 3ml--improved after 2 months use. Excellent outer doubler. 95% Cotton/5% Polyester, outer shell 100% cotton, seamless deep contour, 4 pads/pk.

MEDELA-baby shower gift:
Single layer/light 3 star
Inner doubler 3 star
Outer doubler 2 star
heavy night solo 1 star
Rate of absorption 2 star: (3ml in 23 sec), 3ml within 5-10 seconds after couple months of use
Shirt test - back of pad damp in 20 minutes, not visible on shirt (3ml)
Appearance 3 star

Absorbed 3ml in 23sec, absorption improved thereafter following additional months of use. 100% cotton, min contour and dart/seam, 4 pads/pk w/ mini laundry bag

NUANGEL INC:
White/White Lace/Patterns
Single layer/light 5 star
Inner doubler 3 star
Outer doubler 3 star
heavy night solo 2 star
Rate of absorption - 3ml within 3 seconds after couple months of use
Shirt test - White/Patterns: back barely damp in 30 min / White Lace back not discernibly damp @ 30 min... in both cases shirt barely felt damp but not visibly damp
Appearance 4 star (flat. smaller you are, better it probably looks)

Natural/Natural Lace
Single layer/light 5 star
Inner doubler 2 star
Outer doubler 4 star
heavy night solo 2 star
Rate of absorption - star: 3ml within 5 seconds after couple months of use
Shirt test - Natural: back damp in 30 min / Natural Lace back not discernibly damp @ 30 min... in both cases shirt barely felt damp but not visibly
Appearance 4 star (flat. smaller you are, better it probably looks)

NuAngel had the best price per unit. White & patterns absorb more quickly than natural tone (3ml in 24sec), absorption improved thereafter following additional month of use. Probably best to use white alone or as inner doubler depending on anticipated flow, and natural tone as outer or alone if only slowly dripping. May work especially well for smaller sizes like A or B. 100% cotton flannel, 4 layers (+ optional lace), 8 pads/pk (4 pair), no dart/seam, 4.5\\" shrinks to ~4\\" diameter, Made in USA.

Definitions:
Fully absorbed. liquid no longer beads/flows on surface when tilted

Heavy let-down. Can soak a Lansinoh disposable (most absorptive disposable I'd encoutered) in a single feeding and leak. Equivalent to about two & a half washable pads stacked to catch the flow. Heavy flow requires very absorptive inner doublers and low(er) absorption outer doublers so they have time to soak it all up without affecting your shirt. Hopefully a washable pad out there can improve on these statistics. I just haven't met it yet. I'm still hopeful that the other 2/3 of these brands can provide a more efficient answer. I will gladly try any brand and report on my findings.

Rate of absorption. 3ml water dispersed in 2 seconds. Dispersed/absorbed time: 2/2 = absorbed immediately. 2/20= 18 seconds after water dispersed until fully absorbed

Shirt test: After 1+ month of use, lay pad on favorite tank top, apply 3ml water, time how long until back of pad is damp to touch or shirt is visibly dampened. Check at 5, 10, 20, 30 minutes.

product_title: Dream On Me Baby Bather Bath Tub Stand, Gray
review_body: Purchased this stand along with the Dream On Me baby tub.  It's a bit wobbly and the tub doesn't actually exhibit a perfect fit but it still works.

product_title: SafeFit Kick Mats 2-Pack in Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I ordered the 2-Pack Kick Mats for our new KIA Sorento. We often have our grandchildren in our car and wanted to protect the backs of the cloth seats, especially the one in front of the 3 year old's car seat. They were easy to install; the elastic slips over the front seat to hold the bottom of the kick-mat in place. The top has velcro strips that fasten around the head rest. They work great. It may be better for some if they had pockets since they cover up the pockets on the back of the seat. We don't use the pockets but some folks may.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Warmies Reusable Cloth Wipes
review_body: These wipes are very soft and absorbent. I followed the washing directions exactly and half of them are fraying along the edge and it gets worse with each wash. I throw 1-2 away after each wash because they are no longer useable. I have only been using them about a month and wash them every 4 days or so. I will not buy any more of them:o(

product_title: Boppy Organic Changing Pad Set
review_body:
It's hard to tell from the picture just how pronounced the stars are on this cover, so I was a bit surprised when I saw it in person. That's not necessarily a bad thing, just be prepared to see stars. Other than that, it's soft and comfortable and seems pretty durable. It's been through several washings already and the color hasn't seemed to dull or fade.

The white liner it comes with, on the other hand, isn't as spectacular. I don't know if it was this size to begin with or whether it shrunk during its first washing, but the liner is so small it's pretty much worthless. This wasn't a big deal for us, though, as I don't really see the point of it anyway, but if you're looking for a liner that provides a reasonable amount of coverage this might not be a good buy for you.

product_title: Gerber Training Pant (In Vinyl Bag), 3 Pack
review_body: These are my absolute favorite! They are very soft and well made compared to the cartoon character panties we have in our collection. They also do a great job at keeping my daughter's pants dry when she has small leaks on her way to the potty. I initially bought the 18 month size when she was just 2 and about 22 pounds. Now she is about 2 1/2, weighs about 25.5 pounds and mostly wears the 2T. She can still wear the 18 month size, but the 2Ts are easier for her to pull up and down by herself without gaping at the legs. I am very happy with the quality of these pants. Wash after wash, they still look great.

product_title: Playskool Busy Balls Terrific Textures
review_headline: Great balls to help baby discover textures
review_body: My son loves these balls and I love them because they fit in the palms of his hands easily. He loves to carry one in each hand.

product_title: JJ Cole Collections Infant Bundle Me Lite - Graphite
review_headline: Must have for a new parent!!
review_body: These were so handy for us...I registered for a light one as well as a heavier one...our daughter was born in October, so the light one was good for a while, then we needed a heavier one once we got into the colder winter weather.  Very easy to use, keeps your baby comfortable and warm.  Easy to wash, too.  Highly recommend!

product_title: Haba Macy Mouse Mini Mobile (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My child loves this mobile!  It is cute and looks chic in his nursery.  Every night he points to it and says, \\"moon.\\"  It is the cutest thing!

product_title: Digital Connect Digital Baby Monitor - 1 Parent Unit
review_body: I just returned this monitor for the SECOND TIME.  The first time the parent unit just stopped working after we owned it for a month -- we tried to get it to reconnect and never could.  We assumed that we had a defective unit so we returned it for another one.  Last night (after owning the second monitor for about a month) we were staying at my parents house and I woke up at 3:00 AM because I realized that I couldn't hear the rain sounds that a noise machine we use for my daughter makes, the parent unit had again stopped working.  Thankfully we use the noise machine because the absence of the noise woke me up otherwise I feel certain that we would not have heard my daughter if she woke up as we were downstairs and our daughter was upstairs.    I was very disappointed as we loved everything else about this monitor.    I would advise you to not purchase this monitor.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: My daughter only used this a handful of times. Way too pricey for what it is. I could've bought a $2 dog toy instead.

product_title: Summer Infant Extra Camera For Day and Night Flat Screen Color Video Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My husband and I decided, after dealing with waking my daughter up to check on her  at night, that with our second child we'd get a video monitor. We liked it so much, we bought a second to put in my daughter's room. Not only can we check the well being of our kids from afar, and see if they're grousing in sleep or are genuinely awake, we can also watch the crazy pre-sleep shenanigans.

product_title: Bumbleride Flyer Reversible Handle Stroller with 7" Wheels, Seagrass (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this stroller after having been through 2 Gracos, 2 Umbrella strollers, a jogger, and borrowing friend's strollers on occasion to try out.  This is by far my favorite!  The fact that you can easily take the cloth off and wash it is my favorite part.  My other strollers got so dirty and could not be washed.  My first child ruined those strollers and there was no way they would have made it to be used for another baby. I also love being able to just flip the handle to let my 6 month old see me. He doesn't get upset on walks anymore.  The adjustable handle is wonderful too.  My 5 year old likes to push his brother and can do so when I lower the handle for him.  Raincover fits perfectly!      Now, the cons.  The only 2 complaints I have are the lack of a parent tray and snack tray for baby.  I bought the snack pack but am not sure if I will like it (haven't used yet since baby is still so little.)  I just know that I used both so often with my other strollers.  Also, the basket is quite small.  However, this hasn't been a problem since I bought a diaper bag that attaches to the handle.        Overall, I really love this stroller.  The cons are me just nitpicking.  It rides nice, has lots of recline positions, does not feel cheap in any way.  Highly recommend it!    Oh, and mine is in Lava, not Seagrass... not sure why it's saying that.  I like the dark colors since it won't show dirt as easily.

product_title: Motorola Digital Audio Baby Monitor
review_body: I've bought numerous monitors since my son was born. All the top brands. They all die too early or generate WAY too much noise. This one by Motorolla is amazing. Always works great and has lasted for a year so far without any signs of failing. And it's been  dropped, bumped, and down-right tossed around (kids! :)).    The noise-cancellation is a HUGE plus too. I don't want to listen to static, I only want to listen to my son crying or calling. The other monitor manufacturers definitely have a way to go to catch Motorolla.

product_title: Safety 1st Bath Sling, Blue
review_body: Excellent product, and worth the price many times over. I'm a first time mom and this small lightweight bath lounger made my life so much easier. I used it in the sink for almost 3 months, instead of hunching over the bathtub. It's lightweight, durable, comfortable & dries easily. When baby was a bit older, I even used it as a lounge seat on the kitchen table while we had a family dinner. I just wish it came in a bigger size, by 3 months, baby outgrew it.

product_title: Munchkin Squirtin Bath Toy
review_body: I emailed the company, as I do with all baby toys I purchase to see if they are made with BPA, PVC, or phthalates . These are made out of PVC, and are toxic. Very cute but toxic.

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie Elite Diaper Disposal Pail, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: You can use garbage bags in this!
review_body: Okay, I'm just baffled at how many people haven't figured this out yet! LOL! Simply take an empty refill ring, put a regular ol' garbage bag down into the center, then simply overlap the top of the bag over the ring and tuck it under the ring when placing it into the genie. Simple, cheap, and works just as well.

product_title: Carters Wrap Me Up Receiving Blanket, Brown/Sage Circles, 4 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Love the patterns on these simple blankets but they really wash badly.  Super linty and they faded immediately.  I keep one in my diaper bag in case I need to put baby down somewhere and want a clean spot for her and I use the other in a similar way at home when I dont want to ruin my nicer blankets.

product_title: Philips AVENT Basic Baby Monitor with DECT Technology (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Well, you've heard the reviews en mass about the low volume. I use mine to monitor my elderly mother, and we basically have to yell in order to communicate one floor apart.   I guess I've had my two units, for two different rooms, for two years. I've totally replaced one of the units for a third $92, and two batteries have needed replacement. Three days ago the second unit died and now I'm starting all over in a search for a dependable monitor. Bottom line....$275 plus the price of two batteries, and it's all crap. I haven't trusted Phillips for years - just another third-tier American brand, and throw in the made in China label and you get the total screw.   For this kind of money I'd like to go out and find a truly professional one and get quality for my money. Trouble is, I really am not sure there's one out there. Best of luck.

product_title: Munchkin Stroller Links, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I am a child care provider  and wanted to get a quad stroller to take the kids to the park but they are way out of my price range. So, I got two of the Baby Trend Sit n Stands and hooked them together with these connectors for a fraction of the cost! I tried it out for the first time today - it's big, and I have to go slowly over bumps but was ok for getting to the park and back. The kids love it. The only really tricky part is backing up - the middle wheels do get tangled unless you do it just right but I think with some practice I'll get the hang of it (I tried locking the wheels but then I couldn't corner well enough). I wouldn't take this anywhere off road, but fine for around town (as long as your sidewalks are wide enough. :) )

product_title: Nuby Flip N' Sip Cup
review_body: My daughter likes chewing on the straw but bot able to drink water from it. I guess its hard to suck with a straw. She might learn eventually.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'N Swing, My Little Snugabunny (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I absolutely love this swing. I have no complaints as it is... cute, sits in a comfy reclined position, plush texture against babies delicate skin, has multiple speeds to swing, sturdy allowing you peace of mind your little one is safe, pleasant melodies and it plugs in. I'm all for any baby product that doesn't take batteries, Duracell is getting enough of my money as it is.LOL. I have a baby due in Feb. 2011 and a 15mo old son that is into everything. Once the swing arrived I put it together and let him try it out. (I wont be putting him in this swing again nor do I recommend anyone else doing so with a baby this age, its not safe as he could fall and get hurt trying to get out.)Just the same I had to add that tidbit in here since he loved it so much he went to sleep within 5 min of being in it with a sweet peaceful look on his face. Now that is a priceless moment that proved to me this swing is worth every dime spent on it. I would highly recommend this product to anyone I know that is going to have a baby!!

product_title: Safety 1st Kirby Inflatable Tub
review_headline: ONCE YOU INFLATE IT ONCE IT IS GOOD TO GO!
review_body: I AM GIVING IT 5 STARS CAUSE ONCE YOU INFLATE IT ONCE IT WORKS GREAT - IT DID TOOK US A WHILE TO INFLATE SAME AS AN INFLATABLE AT THE BEACH - NOT AS MUCH FUN AS SPECTED!ONCE INFLATED IT WORKS GREAT CAUSE IT STOPS MY DAUGHTER FROM BANGING HER HEAD TWENTY TIMES ALL OVER THE TUB (I HAVE BEEN USING IT FOR MOTNHS FROM ABOUT 7 MONTHS TO NOW 11 MONTHS AND SHE STILL FITS COMFORTABLE) IT ALLOWS HER TO PLAY LIKE CRAZY AND I DON'T HAVE TO WORRRY CONSTANTLY! IT IS EASY TO CLEAN I ONLY INFLATED IT ONCE SO I CLEAN IT INFLATED AND ALL - IT TAKES A LOT OF BITES FROM MY DAUGHTER AND PINCHING IN HER ATTEMPS TO GET THE FROGS PAINTED AND IT HAS GOTTEN NO HOLES SO ONCE AGAIN I AM A HAPPY MOM =)   CHEAP SOLUTION, FITS PERFECT IN THE TUB, AND IT KEEPS MY LITTLE ON SAFE AND ENTERTAINED!

product_title: Skip Hop Baby Treetop Friends Activity, Multi
review_body:
i love this! unlike a lot of gyms it doesnt have obnoxious music, jangly noises, flashing lights, or any of the other things that often annoy me in baby-entertaining items.
there are nice surprises in the mat-- crinkly sounding leaves, a soft kind of velour-ish leaf, a flower that squeaks if you press on it, a mirror in the trunk of the tree (very nice for tummy time!)
the hanging toys seem pretty high quality, and are very cute! the owl makes a chiming noise and the apple is velvety to touch and has a mirror in it. my son also seems to like the pillow that comes with it, especially for tummy time.
the only thing i wish was different was the thickness-- i would like a little more cushion in it.

product_title: Munchkin Sesame Street Toddler Fork and Spoon, Elmo
review_headline: Great for small hands to hold
review_body: This set of fork and spoon is great for small hands to hold, but not easy for adults to hold if u want to feed your toddler with them.

product_title: Disney Winnie the Pooh Take & Toss Spill-proof Cups
review_body: I bought these cups to use for the young children at my 1-year-old's Winnie the Pooh-themed birthday party. They were really cute. The only thing is, the tops didn't stay on very well. At one point, I looked over, and my son was covered in water! He had figured out how to pull the top off. Now he just plays with them.

product_title: Fresh Food Feeder, 2 Pack
review_body: This is by far the worst feeder bag on the market.  It is impossible to clean, unlike the brands where the bag can be removed.  Try the Kid Co. Baby Steps.  The bags can be removed for thorough cleaning which means you can buy new ones if they start to look worn.  Feeders are a great idea to introduce new flavors to babies without the risk of choking.  You can also make cold \\"teethers\\" with frozen breastmilk.  Highly recomended, just not this brand.

product_title: Bumkins Waterproof Sleeved Bib, Robot (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My little guy loves to feed himself...and I was doing laundry after every meal. I bought two of these so I could always have one clean. I think the only thing that would work even better is to have little legs sleeves as well. Regular bibs just don't cut it.

product_title: ProSport Harness Booster Seat Color: Blue Opal
review_body: Very sporty, looks comfortable. My 18 month old seems to like it and seems to be comfortable in it. Pretty easy to install. The only thing I don't like is that you have to uninstall it to raise up the shoulder straps. I really like the way it looks and it has good safety ratings.

product_title: Bunnies by the Bay Silly Buddy, Puppy Skipit with Pacifier Holder
review_body: I'm buying a second puppy now for my 8 month old daughter, who LOVES this puppy.  He was given to her as a gift when she was about 5 months, and we quickly noticed her preference for him when it was time to go to sleep. Now, we just hand her the puppy and she smooshes him to her face and starts settling down!  It's the perfect size/scale for a baby's hands and the pacifier attachment feature is a plus.  Highly recommended!

product_title: Bright Starts Fun on Safari Cradling Bouncer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I had an expensive $50 automatic bouncer by the same company. I was out of town and was desperate for something to bounce my son in since I could not take my other bounce with me and he was super fussy. I went to the store, saw this for $20, and bought it. I have since found that I use it more than my more expensive one and my son prefers it.  The vibrations are nice, and one reason I bought it. The toy bar has to be removed to get baby out which I don't like, but not big deal.  The main reason I ding it one star is because it has very little padding. I don't think it would kill their profits to add a small pillow or contour of some kind to make sleeping in it more comfortable. But other than that it is great. It is a little flimsy though. I have noticed it kind of leaning before and had to redo the joints on it. But nothing major and this is probably just because we use it so much.  This is one of the only things that will calm my 3 month old. I sit him in it to talk to him and entertain him and I put him in it and bounce it with my foot til he falls asleep when he is fussy. I will say this is a lifesaver. Better than any of my more expensive baby products, and very good for the price. I would definitely buy it again. Just wish it had a tad more padding or something.

product_title: Battat Sound Puzzle Box
review_body: This is a great toy, my daughter loves it.  She is getting very good at putting the right shapes in the right spot.  I would definately recommend.

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'n Swing
review_body: Hi.  I bought this swing for my best friend who had a newborn girl. I also purchased a simular product in green for another best friend of mine who had a girl.    both of my friends adored the swing.  they both told me it was the best baby gift they had recieved.  they both told me that when their child became fussy, they slipped them into the swing and their babies calmed down.    the only negative is that after 6-8 months,   the baby grows out of it,  so the gift gets packed away.

product_title: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing, Starlight
review_body: This swing is super cute! It swings in 3 different directions, has lights, music and a mobile.  It has a buckle so you can buckle your baby in and a support pillow.  Although the pillow was a little big for my newborn I still had to add my Kiddopotamus head and body support pillow.  She loves sleeping in the swing more than her bassinet or crib.  My only complaint is the motor makes a frog like sound when it moves, and after about 7 weeks now it's started to squeak a little bit.

product_title: Safety 1st Crystal Clear Baby Monitor, White
review_body: I got these because I have a small house and didn't intend to use them often, but I wanted something cheap for the once in a while situation.  Even with limited use, I wish I had not cheaped out so much.  They work fine but get feedback from just about anything, so while I can hear my baby, often the feedback is so annoying I end up turning them off.  Keep shopping!

product_title: Kidz Delight Interactive Animal Cubes, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: good stuff for little minds and little hands
review_body: 0ur 16 mo old daughter got these for a Christmas gift. she's learning all of her animal names and/or the sounds they make. It didn't take her long to be able to put the cubes in on her own and she loves it when she hears the animal noises. We always get a big grin for big accomplishment.

product_title: Dolce Mia Flowers and Butterflies Nursery Wall Clock - Sew Vintage
review_headline: Very cute design, but VERY cheap mechanical components
review_body: The design, including the colors are perfect for my baby daughter's room. But when I tried to adjust time, I realized how cheaply made it was. It's a clock, meaning that the core function is to have a solid time keeping mechanism. However the hands are flimsy and the whole clock portion can turn easily without much force. I am disapppointed that I paid that much for a product of this quality. It would get a much higher rating from me if it were cheaper.

product_title: Kokopax Baby Take-Two Sun Hat, Bubbles
review_body: Pros:  Good quality, heavy duty material - will withstand for a while    Cons:  Chin strap is not tight enough, nor does the velcro withstand a toddler pulling it off (so I can't keep it on him by the tie it on him method - sigh.)          The hat is HUGE for an 18 - 24 mos old - which would be fine IF the chin strap weren't so loose and only a piddly lil' velcro to hold it.  Tying it would have been a much better bet of keeping it on.    I gave it four stars for excellent quality and took off a star for the crap velcro strap which doesn't hold up to a toddler pulling off the much need sun hat in SoCal.

product_title: Fisher-Price Newborn Rock 'n Play Sleeper, Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This piece has been ultra useful.  We've used it since the birth of our daughter, first as a bedside bassinet then as a daytime napper.  We even use it as a support seat since she's not sitting up by herself yet.  It has held up well, no problems or issues at all.  And it is very light - even grandma slings it around and carries it up and down the stairs.

product_title: Boon Fluid - No-Spill Toddler Cup
review_body: We loved these sippy cups in the beginning! They are fun, easy to clean (only two parts -- woo hoo!)and your little one can easily slip their hand through and carry it around. Now that our son is a little older though, he can pull the lid off easily with his teeth (we call him baby piranha, please take that into consideration) Worth the money for the simplicity of design! People were always asking where we got it/the brand, etc.

product_title: Joovy Caboose Ultralight Stand On Tandem Stroller, Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Fits a Small Trunk and Baby Carseat Fits in Back!!!
review_body: Awesome, awesome stroller. Just got my ultralight and am very pleased. Seems like high quality material and sturdy craftmanship compared to other strollers I've been viewing in stores. Very light and turns on a dime...fits through small doorways with ease.      Baby Carseat Placed in Back:    I have a 16 month old, and a newborn due any day. I wanted a tandem stroller in which I could put the baby carseat in the back. After reading two other reviews on here about modifying it to do just that, I took the risk and ordered the stroller. My evenflo car seat sits perfectly secure on the bars for the sit 'n stand. I don't even feel it's necessary to tie it down to the stroller, it fits so well. This is not an approved set-up for the stroller, but I feel comfortable using it this way. You do have to keep the front seat in the upright position...but my 16 month old likes sitting up straight. Also, I am excited about this modification because when my 16 month old is older, she'll use the sit 'n stand and the newborn will be sitting in the front. It's a stroller that can grow with my children and I feel like I'll really get my money's worth out of it.      Fits in a Small Car Trunk:    I was very concerned about finding a double tandem stroller that would fit in my Mazda Protege. It has a VERY small trunk, and I haven't been able to find any double stroller that would fit it. If you remove the sun shade and snack tray (or carseat holder if using) the stroller folds up much smaller in length. In fact, it fits in my trunk better then my current evenflo aura single stroller!!! And it's not hard to remove or put back on the sun shade or snack tray!!! So easy, they just snap into place (they are meant to be removed).      I am 5'11\\" and the handlebar is perfect in heigth!!!!! This is a dream stroller, especially for such a reasonable price!

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_body:
This is a must-have item for me. I use it 3 times a day at work and it is indispensable so that I can write notes, answer pages or just surf the internet while pumping.

I was able to adjust it for a comfortable fit and I like that you can wear it so that it zips from the top or the bottom (just flip it over!) I'm a B cup so I have never needed the straps. I find that it can hold up full (5 oz) bottles just fine (I have never tried it with larger bottles). I do my compressions over the bra and this works well for me.

Just a note: This bra does not work as an all day bra - I put it on just before I pump. My breasts would look very strange through my shirt with the big circles and extra fabric over the nipples - but I can't see any way to improve this.
