product_title: Infantino Shop and Play Cart Cover, Monkey Garden (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this so much, I bought another for my mother-in-law for when she has my duaghter!  They easily roll up and can be carried in and out of the store without any trouble.  They keep her entertained and keep her hands clean.

product_title: Nuby Flip N' Sip Cup
review_headline: Great for kids who can drink from a straw
review_body: I bought this cup for my one year old son. He enjoys drinking from a regular cup and straw, but can't yet keep from spilling. I like the handles on either side, which make it easy for him to hold. Previous reviews have mentioned the various parts, which I imagine would be difficult to clean. We only use it for water, so it hasn't been a huge issue for us. I can see how the straw might be difficult for some babies to use, as it does require that the child squeeze the straw between his lips and suck. My son seems to have found it intuitive, though.

product_title: C.R. Gibson 5 Year Baby Memory Book
review_body: This album is soo pretty.  The pastel colors are clear and the pages are easy to write on without smears.  I like the fact that is has monthly pages thru 1 year and then yearly pages til 5 years old.  Just what I was looking for.

product_title: Medela Pump In Style Advanced Breast Pump
review_body:
I can't say enough how much I love my PIS! It workes perfectly, Medela has awesome customer service if you have any questions, and it has so much extra storage in the bag.

I don't work so my pis stays on my desk at home all the time so I can pump and play on my computer. The bag is great because I can tuck everything away in it and no one knows what it is, and it's so small it doesn't take up a lot of space.

This is a short review, but I honestly have nothing bad to say about the pump. I wasn't a huge fan of the backpack style at first, but I think when I travel it may actually be nice.

product_title: Skip Hop DUO Deluxe
review_body: I put this on my registry based on its great reviews and a recommendation from a friend but now I wish I had seen it in person first because I've never really been happy with the design. This is a great quality diaper bag, it doesn't fray and isn't showing any signs of wear despite my son being almost a year old. I like the waterproof pocket for dirty diapers and the cup holder side pocket. But the design of this bag kind of stinks. It's tall and narrow so it falls over when I set it down and it's not nearly big enough for a few diapers, a change of clothes, and a toy or two. I can't ever find anything inside it, my wallet will sink to the bottom while I'm out shopping, never to be seen again (till I get home and dump the entire thing out). It also kind of swings awkwardly at my side. It's not flat like a messenger bag but since it's usually overstuffed and there isn't a strong closure (just a magnet) I don't feel comfortable flipping it over my back where anyone could reach inside. I will probably sell this at a consignment shop and get a different bag for my next kid. That said, I have passively been looking for a replacement and most of what I see in stores feels cheap so I continue to use (and dislike) it. Well made bag, just a dumb design. I think there are nicer ones by this maker.

product_title: Woombie The Baby Eco' Donut
review_body: I purchased the Woombie Donut for my grandson when he was 2 months old. I purchased it from the Woombie website and am very pleased with the purchase. He is just a 1 week shy of being 10 months and is still able to use it. My main concern when purchasing the Woombie Donut was to insure that when he was out and about with his parents, that he had his own personal space for which he could be laid upon, It is soft, comfortable, durable,cozy and very portable. I highly recommend this product and am a fan of woombie products.

product_title: J is for Jeep 2-in-1 Shopping Cart and High Chair Cover, Universal Size, Baby Grocery Cart Cover, Infant High Chair Cover, Machine Washable, Safety Harness, Folds into Handbag, Pocket for Essentials, Cart, Cover, Toddler
review_body: We got this cart cover because of the design and fold into a bag features. I love the design and it is convenient! But it is a little hard to get this cover to actually stay on the cart. and the buckles dont stay snapped very well. And it didnt fit very well at Target on their bigger carts. Over all, it works but its So... so...

product_title: Boon Squirt Baby Food Dispensing Spoon in Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Boon squirt é uma colher super prática, com apenas uma mão consigo alimentar meu bebê e sem fazer sujeira. Amei essa colher, podiam fabrucar tb maiores e tb com o furo maior para as crianças maiores.

product_title: OXO Tot Sippy Cup with Bonus Training Lid Set, 7 Ounce
review_body: I bought this because I was interested in the transitional lid, but I wanted the handles to make the cup easier for my 10 month old daughter to pick up.     It turns out that the transitional lid is totally useless. I am not sure what the point of it is- I had thought it was to help them learn how to drink out of a cup without dumping all the water everywhere (or at least slowing down the dumping). Let me tell you, it does not slow down the dumping one bit. I handed it to my daughter, and within one second, I had a huge puddle all over the floor. I am not sure exactly how it provides an advantage over just giving your child a cup like the [[ASIN:B0012AUR32 Doidy Cup - Blue color]]. Or just a regular cup. If you are thinking about getting this for the transitional lid, I would not.    But what about the sippy cup part? I can't speak to the valve because I took it out, but without the valve, this is a decent valve-free sippy cup for kids who never took bottles and parents who don't mind the mess. The liquid in the cup does flow out very easily, and I know that this is a feature that some people are interested in (especially grandmas, who remember when sippy cups were just cups with lids that had spouts in them, no valves or anything). It does make for some messy spills, though, which might not be attractive to others. We also bought the [[ASIN:B001F913N8 Tilty Sippy Cup, Clear, 7 Ounce, 2 Pack]] at the same time, and those are the sippy cups we use the most. The Tilty doesn't have handles, but even at 10 months, our daughter has never had problems picking it up or holding it. The Tilty also is valve-free, but the spout has 2 holes instead of 3 (this is how many the Oxo Tot has), so water doesn't come out quite as fast when our daughter turns it upside down or shakes it with glee (in which case, the Tilty will sprinkle). This is an advantage at mealtimes- it means her food doesn't get waterlogged if she turns her cup upside down, which happened the one time I gave herthe Oxo Tot cup.     The sippy cup part is not a bad product, visually it is very appealing, and the parts are easy to take apart and put together (and clean), but I just don't think it has an advantage over other products in the market.

product_title: Cosco Umbrella Stroller, Giraffe  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Love the print, typical umbrella stroller
review_body: This was a SUPER cute stroller and I was in the market for a lightweight, cheap, easily transported, smaller stroller for a couple of trips we have coming up. My son is almost a year old and he LOVES it! He loves being able to see out without having to sit so far forward like he does in our jogging stroller and he enjoys kicking his feet in it. Leave it to a 1 year old...Anyway, what I don't like about it and I'm told it is the same for virtually all umbrella strollers is the handle height. It's too low to be comfortable when walking for any amount of time. I'm 5'7\\", maybe shorter people would have an easier time. It's wheels are also too close together and I step on them while walking. It's very awkward to use in general. But again, I love the print and it will work for what I need, I didn't want to pay $100 for something that wouldn't be used super often.

product_title: Gerber 12-Pack Flatfold Birdseye Cloth Diapers - White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Used for many things but not for diapers.
review_body: These are not the diapers I remember.  In fact, you could not possibly use them as diapers - they are very very thin and even when folded would not hold in what needs to be contained.  Obviously the company has changed the material they use in this product.  I'm not sure why.      They are however great for putting on your shoulder when burping your baby.  Great for wiping up spit-up and drool.  Great for tying around a toddler if you don't have a bib handy.  And great to have in the car for spills.  They are also okay for dusting furniture.    Wish they were diapers though - since that is why I bought them.

product_title: Circo® Fleece Paradise Green Crib Changing Pad
review_body: This changing pad cover is very soft, a cute muted green color, and fits the changing pad I bought separately very well. I have washed it several times and it has held up well. I recommend this cover.

product_title: WhodaThought Mrs. Smith's Diaper Bag
review_body: This is a great bag for travel and all day outings. It is the only bag you need because you can keep all your stuff and your kids stuff, including snacks and beverages.

product_title: Fisher-Price My Little Lamb Cradle 'n Swing
review_headline: Pretty cute and thats about it...
review_body: I am big on reading reviews before making a purchase, so I thought I should let people know about this swing. First of all, what sold me was that in the pictures it looked as though the swing lit up. Now, in hindsight looking at the item on the page it does not light up. That would be the picture to the \\"starlight\\" swing mixed in with the pictures of the lamb swings pictures. Not sure if that would be amazons mistake or what! Anyway, I thought that it is still cute and I would keep it. My husband put it together and we put brand new batteries straight from the package in the swing, and what do ya know it doesnt swing. It is very disappointing considering we waited about 8 or 9 days for the swing to get here. I guess my next step is to contact Fisher Price about a possible motor problem, although the mobile and music work.... Not sure what the problem is but I can say that for the money and waiting time I am very disappointed. The swing is so cute and cozy, if only the darn thing worked!

product_title: Stork Craft Beatrice 5 Drawer Chest
review_body: We purchased this dresser to match the Graco espresso crib set and it goes perfectly.  My husband put it together with no problems in about 2-3 hours.  For the price, it's perfect and appears that it will last just as long as we would need it.  We had no problems the other reviewers had related to putting it together, mismatched drawer sizes, missing parts, and scratches.  It looks much more expensive than it actually is.  SO glad we purchased it!

product_title: Inglesina 2011 Fast Table Chair
review_body: I bought this table chair from Inglesina 2011 Fast for my 6 month old baby and I am very happy with it. I do a lot of shopping around to make sure that what I buy suits my needs and that of my baby, so i had originally bought another one and found but did not like it at all, didn't even sit him in it because it seemed too bare bones, no cushion, and it didn't seem comfortable for my very young baby.  The Inglesina has a higher back, its cushioned all around, has a nice belt, and is very sturdy when you set it up, leaving any concerns of safety and comfort behind. I'm very satisfied and so is my little one, we bring it everywhere.

product_title: Yellow Boa Plush Baby Blanket with Frogs
review_headline: I have not us any item because my baby is not due until next year in April.
review_body: I have not us any item because my baby is not due until next year in April.

product_title: OXO Tot Foldable Tub Kneeling Mat
review_headline: Fold and hangs for easy storage
review_body: This mat folds in half for compact storage and has a loop, so I can easily hang it on a hook next to the tub. I love the magnetic closure and it's a great color (although I wish there were more options). It's not super squishy, but does save my knees during bath time.  Since it is used in the bathroom, it would be a nice feature if the cover unzipped to be machine-washed, instead of just spot-cleaned. I guess since kids usually don't come in contact with it, it's not that big of a deal. Overall, I'm very satisfied.

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_headline: Must-have for pumping moms at work
review_body: This pumping bra is a must for pumping at work.  I can eat lunch, read a magazine, or check my text messages with this on. The breastshields stay put without shifting at all.  I definitely recommend to anyone that will be pumping regularly.

product_title: Starlight Support Bassinet Mattress with Rounded Corners
review_headline: No Materials Info On This Mattress
review_body: Who would buy this item when the product description does not indicate what it is made of and where the product is made?  For all I know it's made of lead and mercury in China.  It's exactly the size I need, and could be a very good choice, but I could never buy something for a baby without knowing what it's made of.

product_title: Fisher-Price Comfy Time Bouncer
review_body: I was looking for a simple bouncy seat and fell in love with this one. A great price and it is just adorable! The colors are warm and neutral and the little animals on it are adorable! Super cute! The toy bar is removable, and the seat has a vibration option and a safety strap. Too cute!

product_title: Simple Wishes Hands Free Breastpump Bra
review_body: This item is AWESOME. It has helped so much with keeping my hands free allowing me to do other things. I pump often and it is very cumbersome to hold both pumps in my hand and was tiring. I have also found that I pump longer when I have the bra on as I can continue to surf the net, talk on the phone etc. I have to admit that this product does give one a laugh when looking at it in use but the look is worth the output! I was concerned at what size to order, but I wear a medium/large top and a 38D bra and the small/medium fits me great since this is adjustable the large would be way too big. I highly recommend.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: Not only did the baby love it, her older siblings kept trying to get it away from her, but she wouldn't budge, she definately made the toy hers.  She was thrilled when she realized if she bites down on it, it makes noises.  It is soo cute, and the knowledge that they are top grade materials is an added plus. Very happy with my purchase.

product_title: DaRiMi Kidz Long Sleeve All-In-One
review_body: Fits her good and protects her from the sun. I like the neck sun guard especially. One thing..., on breezy days the suit can make her quite chilly if it is wet so make sure you dry the little ones off good.

product_title: Safety 1st Detach and Go Grooming/Healthcare Kit, Orange/White
review_body: This product was part of my baby registry. I am first time mom and had no idea what I trully will need. This product is part of my list - \\"Useless stuff\\". My baby is already 10 months and I don't think I used even one thing out of this set. My personal nail clippers are much better than the one in the set and we got a great thermometer at the hospital when my son was born. Don't waste your money!

product_title: Cosco Juvenile Scenera Convertible Car Seat, Stone  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We are grandparents who don't live close to our grandchild, so the carseat is used only twice a month. It was fairly easy to install and comfy enough for our grandchild since we only are in the car less than an hour at a time. It's perfect for our situation.

product_title: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest
review_body: It's wobbly, the drawers don't line up and the \\"wood\\" is cheap looking - the drawer bottoms are nothing but a heavy piece of paperboard - the stuff that is tacked on to the back of Ikea bookshelves to make them look finished?  Yeah, so don't plan on the drawers holding anything heavy.  Not that baby clothes are heavy, but you should know that these just will not hold up over the long run.      All in all I think it took us about 3 hours to put together and it's just plain crap.  I wish I had a more eloquent way to say it.      Other items we purchased for the nursery went together smoothly and are sturdy so I know it's not our assembly skills at fault here - this chest of drawers is just not made very well. I really wish I had spent more and gotten something that will last or at least not wobble every time I touch it!

product_title: Tiddliwinks Security Blanket- Jungle Friends
review_headline: Adorable... but grey eyes, not brown like in the picture
review_body:
My son loves his Tiddliwinks lovey! It's a great product. I was originally freaked out by the idea of a decapitated teddy bear, but my son loves it.

By two, or more of these, in case one gets lost or is in the wash.

That said, I was trying to get a spare for my little guy's BROWN eyed bear with a lion on it. That's what's in the picture, but not what I received. Mine has grey eyes, and he's smart enough to tell the difference.

product_title: Bebek Bottle Brush (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This brush works great to cleaning bottles, pumping parts, and feeding accessories. The contoured design make it easy to reach the nooks and crannies. The brush looks like a giant toothbrush.

product_title: Changing Lifestyles Safe-er-Grip 17" Bath & Shower Handle…
review_headline: Not too good on 4" tile, but Glass works great
review_body: I was kind of depressed when I got this and discovered that first of all I had to put it on an angle with my 4\\" tile and secondly it wouldn't stay on the tile for very long. But after a bunch of try's on the tile I realized that it held really well to my glass hinged door and if I put it close to the hinges it doesn't move up and down at all so it works really well. Too bad it doesn't work on the 4\\" tile, if I would of only put up the 8\\" 15 years ago... I guess that's why in the picture they are using 8\\" tile, they should mention that since the suction cups are about 4\\" in diameter there is no hope on 4\\" tile.     So if you have some glass you can mount it on, even if it moves on one axis, just mount it on the other axis and it works pretty well, much better then it does on 4\\" tile and it stays put.

product_title: Gumdrop Full-term Natural Scent Pacifier
review_body: This was the only pacifier my son would take.  And I like it because it is rubber and he just chews all over it now and I don't have to worry about hard plastic hurting his gums.

product_title: Aprica Presto Stroller, Loft Brown (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A great lightweight stroller with USABLE features
review_body: I spent so long researching strollers and went through so many choices, including Chicco, Maclaren, Cybex, and Maxi Cosi. Ultimately, for price and features, I decided on the Aprica Presto.    One of the big concerns of moms is the recent recall of many umbrella-type strollers (every Maclaren made from 1999 till 2010 for instance) due to the risk of finger amputation.  Maclaren's hinge caused 12 finger amputations!  While they are currently producing a new hinge, I was not interested in buying from a company that permitted so many children to be injured (since 2004).  I wanted a hinge mechanism that was safe for my child.  This did require some sacrifices, but my baby is worth it!    The Aprica is NOT a one-handed fold.  This is due to its design, which is safer than most one-handed folds.  The fold can be sticky and confusing, but the one review that stated it could \\"not\\" be closed is totally over the top.  In truth, I figured it out with no help while viewing it in the store in less than 5 minutes.  With roughly 5 more minutes of practice at home, I've been able to master it pretty easily.  There is a center pull-arm that you pull up on to begin the release of the stroller.  Then you fold it flat and lock it.  I wish it self-locked, but it does not.  Those are the negatives.    The positives far outweigh the negatives.  For one, unlike Maclarens, it has a really usable and LARGE sunshade.  It also has a functional USABLE bottom basket!  This is so rare in umbrella strollers!  Even with the seat reclined, the basket can be accessed from the side of the stroller pretty easily.  My large diaper bag and purse fit in the basket.  Part of the reason the basket is so easily accessible is because the child's seat sits much higher than most other strollers.  This is great for several reasons; one, it gives the child a better point of view.  My daughter is able to really see the world and other people much better. Two, it is SO much easier for me to reach in and out of thestroller to get her out!  Three, it makes it much easier to wheel her up to a table.  She's not too short when we go to dinner in her stroller, like many other umbrellas.  Finally, a taller seat means that it's a great stroller for mid-to-tall parents.  You are less likely to catch your own feet as you push this stroller.    The stroller is rated to 70 pounds!  There are three height adjustments on the 5-point harness to hold children of varying sizes.  The recline is not 100% flat, but this stroller is not meant for infants, so it has been good for my daughter so far.  It also handles like a dream.  I've been able to use it one-handed on flat and bumpy surfaces.  The front wheels lock so you can drive it (for instance, I locked the front wheels while driving it on sand).  The seat is super comfy and this was the only stroller my daughter actually smiled in when I tested it.    Overall, I am very happy with my purchase.  Do not let the ease of the folding mechanism deter you - you can do it and it is so much safer. With a taller more comfortable seat, pretty color choices, and a real usable basket and sunshade, this is the umbrella stroller you want.  Don't fall for marketing and fancy names - I love my Aprica Presto!

product_title: Skip Hop Duo Double Hold-it-All Diaper Bag, Black
review_headline: Great size, esp if you have more than one baby
review_body: I have twins and use this bag when I go out with both of them.  This bag fits just about everything, including stuff for overnight stays.  I would highly recommend this bag.

product_title: Summer Infant Deluxe Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Frustrating as hell, doesn't work half the time
review_body: We are on our second unit. The first unit was replaced with a refurbished one by the manufacturer at our expense after developing an issue where it would magically drop the connection to the camera.We would have to move it around an inch or two, jiggle the switches, etc. to get it to work again.    The replacement unit developed the same problem. It is most frustrating when in the middle of the night when it stops working -- the last thing I want to deal with is making this stupid thing work at 2 am.  There are some serious design issues with this device. I am ready to throw this out of the window, but I like my windows and it is cold outside to open them.        Save yourself the hassle and invest $80-$100 in a real security camera. I can't wait for mine to arrive.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Replacement Vent Inserts, 3-Pack
review_body: I'm really glad you are able to order parts for the Dr Brown's bottles.  These seem to not stain as much or get as much residue in them as the original parts I bought a year ago.  Well worth my money to replace the originals.

product_title: Inglesina 2011 Fast Table Chair, Basilico (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Take it to Restaurants - Love it
review_body: We bought this chair for our 8 month old son.  We have a regular high chair at home, but keep this in the car at all times.  We take it in to restaurants, or use it at Grandma's house or friends houses.  It is an essential baby and toddler item for us.  Restaurants usually have hight chairs, but they are usually the standard wooden ones and aren't set to the table height of the tables at the restaurant.  So, our toddler was often too low and hitting his head on the table or not able to reach what he wanted.  With this chair, he is always the perfect height, and pulled right up to the table.  He is secure, and loves it.  It has worked fabulously for us for that use.  I wouldn't use it for a daily high chair, but for a baby on the go, this is fantastic.  He is now 15 months and we still use it all the time.  It adjusts to any table, and is really secure.  The only slight issue we've had, is if the table isn't weighted right, the extra weight on one end can make it unstable and he could hypotethically tip the table over.  So, we check the table steadiness before we let go and are now pros at knowing where in a rectangular table to hook him.  We love it, I can't recommend it more highly.  We have people see it all the time and ask what it is because it is so handy.

product_title: Chicco Smart Support Back Pack, Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter is 1 and outgrowing the Baby Bjorn (which she still loves), so I wanted to get a backpack carrier to carry her without killing by back and shoulders. The Chicco backpack got mostly good reviews, and others seemed to say that it is comfortable, so I purchased it. I could not wear this for more than 15 minutes without my shoulders and back killing me! My husband tried it too and had the same reaction. Those who think this is comfortable must have shoulders of steel! I can't imagine going for a hike wearing this enormous contraption. Unfortunately we are returning this item, and will stick with the Bjorn for now.

product_title: Graco Snugride Infant Car Seat Base
review_body: SOOOOOO nice to just drop the carseat into the base and be done with it! Especially when trying to get a 3-yr old into a car seat also. The base in each car is sooooo convenient. Easily enough installed, especially since you only have to do it once in each car!!

product_title: Safety 1st Alpha Omega Elite Convertible Car Seat, Beaumont
review_body: Read the manual before putting it in. If you need to take the head support and/or strap padding off, you'll need to do this BEFORE putting it in the car. You'll also want to adjust the strap height and crotch belt before you cinch everything down. I've purchased this for my three-year-old, so I can't comment too much on rear-facing other than saying it would not have worked in my Prism/Corolla, but then not much did as the seat spacing on those is really tight. If you are buying this thinking, COOL, I can use the latch straps and easily recline the seat, think again. Not easy. Plan  on at least loosing the top tether. Might work better with using a seat belt instead of the tether, should certainly work as a booster. Miss having a cup holder that works on both sides. Not sure why they designed it that way, and the holder seems a bit flimsy. Arms are not as solid as I would have liked. I'll update once we've used it for a bit. On the plus side, lots of padding. The kiddo was really excited about the pillow and the side supports--both look like they would be good for napping. Installation was no worse than any other seat.

product_title: Lorex LW2003 LIVE snap Video Baby Monitor (White) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: ***if you have WIRELESS INTERNET do not get this!!!****
review_body: I'll keep this short but if you have wireless internet you will have that constant background interference noise that a lot of people complain about! For this reason we had to return the monitor and bought the Summer Infant Day and Night which has technology that does not interfere with the wireless internet.     We tried everything to get the noise out (unplugged chargers, moved the unit, etc etc).... we had no idea it was something that we couldn't unplug every time we used the monitor - our wireless internet! I found this out with a bit of research online.    DO NOT GET IF YOU HAVE WIRELESS INTERNET

product_title: PottyCover Disposable Toilet Seat Covers
review_body: I always wondered before why there wasn't something out there that protected my child's clothes from touching the nasty toilet seat. Thank you for such a wonderful invention!! We tried it out this past weekend at the movie theater's bathroom and it worked perfectly!! Didn't slip while my daughter used it.

product_title: HALO Early Walker SleepSack Wearable Blanket Micro Fleece
review_body: I was very hesitant to order this product because of all the reviews saying it was too big/long.  When I initially pulled it out of the package, I thought the same thing and that I may need to send it back.  However, when I put it on the girls (twin 1 year olds), I was pleasantly surprised.  It is long.  BUT, it is a BLANKET sleeper.  I would probably not put them in it to play because they could trip over it, but that is what footed pj's are for.  For sleeping, it is perfect.  I can rest assured that they will stay warm through the night and when they fall asleep, I like having the option to \\"tuck\\" in their feet.      I bought a large (12-18 month).  My girls measure 20 lbs and 29\\" tall, so they are BELOW the recommended size for this product.  I know I will get a lot of use out of these.

product_title: Safety 1 Clic Infant Car Seat Carrier, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this stroller. Its simple to put together, very lightweight, and goes perfectly with our AirProtect car seat.There is a sunshade I had no idea about until I got the item home and opened,helps alot to keep the sun off of him and germy strangers from touching him.

product_title: Bright Starts Fun on Safari Cradling Bouncer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Purchased for grandson's birth he's almost 4 mos old still using it and he still loves it!!! Gives mom and dad time to get some things done around the house. He's just now showing interest in the animals on play bar.  Seems to soothe him very quickly when nothing else works. Product is holding up very well, lightweight enough for travel (they bring it when they come to visit). Definitely recommend!!!

product_title: Kalani 4-In-1 Convertible Crib with Complete Toddler Mattress with Hypoallergenic Waterproof Cover
review_body: Though it took some time to put together, after we were done, the crib looks beautiful! It is really sturdy wood, and the espresso finish is great. We put the toddler rail in the closet for later, and the naturepedic mattress fit snugly inside. I highly recommend this crib!

product_title: Chicco 360 Degree Rotating Hook On Chair
review_body: We were all set to buy the Phil and Ted version (looks like aluminum vice grips - super secure!) until we started thinking about table aprons. We were ready to spill some dough, but we want to make sure this purchase will be around for guests and grandkids! This thing is great!  It's easy to set up (although lazy grandparents may refuse - it can appear intimidating, but once you show them they will be embarrassed at their refusal of attempt!) It's comfortable. It rotates a full 360 degrees so if you're spoon feeding jar food, you don't have to contort to hit that teeny-tiny pie hole with the spoon!   It folds uber-flat so it will fit alongside groceries in the trunk of your hybrid or disappear into the shadows of your suburban. It is padded and made of quality fabric - practically sail cloth - it cleans up so well. I do not recommend the blue fish one... neighbor has this one and after a little acidic tomato juice came in contact with the blue, little spots of discoloration in the same blue family (yet lighter)- (not obscenely noticeable but will definitely hamper anyone planning to resale at a favorable price.) My kiddo has had her tomato escapades and either the fabric hides it so well that it is impossible to notice, the fabric is of a higher quality, or my neighbor ought to start shopping organic!  Anyhow - this is worth every pretty penny it costs! I urge you to go with it. And I will also let you know that while we have this (in the trunk) in addition to our Boon high chair, there are times (despite my fascination with the pneumatic lift on the Boon) that I wish we'd have skipped the pricey Boon and gone with this alone. Yeah. It's that great. As far as injuries go - I haven't experienced any and I tend to believe that often times these injuries come about because the caretaker is not attentively considering that one should not rotate a high chair (or install) when fingers are in close proximity to moving parts. I hope that Chicco took this into account and did their best to prevent avoidable injury, but we must all remember - it's still our job to protect as the little ones are in our charge. Not Chicco, Fisher-Price, etc. Notice, be diligent, be responsible. If you notice a design is ridiculously unsafe, return it and state why. Bless the little ones and those who tend to them.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_headline: For big babies, this is perfect.
review_body: While my son is only 6 months old (and 27lbs, and 31\\"), I've had the hardest time bathing him after two months. At his 2 month mark, he was 15lbs, and didn't fit in the tub I had for him anymore, but since he couldn't support his neck yet, I ended up covering him in wet washcloths to keep him warm. Fast forward 3 months, and my son was 24lbs and 29\\". Needless to say, there was no way I could safely bath him anymore, so I ordered this tub and I just got it in last week. (As a side note, this got here quickly despite living at an APO address.) It's a life saver! He was a little too unbalanced on the reclining side, and while he can sit unsupported for a few minutes at a time, the other side was a bit too big for him. I came up with a simple solution: I use a bath pillow when I take a bath, he can use it too until he can sit well unsupported. It's great, he doesn't freeze, can splash without fear of slipping (like he would in the old tub) and I don't have to break my back trying to keep him from slipping and clean him at the same time.

product_title: Dreambaby Deluxe Bath Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this for my 11 month old. It was fine until the latches broke completely with normal use. If I had not had my hand on him he would have probably gotten hurt. Don't buy this.

product_title: Kids Line Bella Canvas Wall Art 2 Piece, Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought these at Babies R Us for $13.00 (on 2/2/2011).  They were on clearance and look beautiful in the baby's room.

product_title: Baby Jogger 2010 City Mini Single Stroller
review_body: Bought the 2009 Citymini and used it for our infant with a soft car seat insert in the regular stroller, not the city mini car seat attachment which is awkward and felt unstable.  Three great features of this stroller, one-hand steering and pushing are great, easy folding and a huge sun shade. Would be great if it came with a cup holder and a belly bar instead of every little piece being sold seperately.    The stroller has been in use in the city for exactly 2 years...yesterday the front wheel came apart on the sidewalk! It was squeaking for a few days, I tried to snap it all back together but no luck.  Happy Birthday baby???  Hopefully their customer service will be speedy and send us a new wheel.    Never used this as a jogging stroller.

product_title: aden + anais 3 Pack Muslin Washcloths, Splish Splash (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love these! They are so soft- way softer than a regular wash cloth. They are also a nice size, so I can use one to cover our little guy and one to wash. The color is also nice, not too crazy. They got moldy after use- even though washed everytime.

product_title: Green Sprouts Bottle Silicone
review_body:
This is the best bottle what i have trying with my baby
He is 5 months now and we have trying a lot brands (Avent, Dr Brown, Gerber and more)
Never leaks so easy to used dishwaher safe and easy to baby start to learning hold a bottle !!

product_title: Aquatopia Deluxe Safety Bath Thermometer Alarm, Green
review_body: We have used this for almost a year, and it still works perfectly. My child doesn't use it much as a toy - mostly ignores it - but it is reassuring to know the water will be warm enough without scalding her.

product_title: Summer Infant Quickchange Portable Changing Pad, Black
review_body: Bought for the diaper bag, this changing mat is perfect. A great size, it folds down to be small enough to pack in any bag. It's made of a washable material so any messes can be easily wiped up.

product_title: The First Years Pooh Pacifier Attacher (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Keeps pacifier handy. Just don't boil.
review_body: This is a nice strap to help keep your child's pacifier from getting lost. Our daughter loves the colors and the Pooh figure. She has two, each one with a \\"paci\\" (one as a primary and one as a backup).  The only issue with this (and partially our fault) is that when boiling the \\"paci\\" to disinfect it the hot water started softening the plastic on one of the clips. It's no longer a big deal since we just take the\\"paci\\" off and hand wash the strap.

product_title: Baby BeeHinds Wool Wrap Diaper Cover
review_body: This is my husband's and nanny's favorite wool cover. The velcro doesnt catch on everything, its pretty trim, we have never had leaks, or red marks. After its lanolized it never leaks. Also, because it is pre felted, there are no unfortunate shrinking accidents when the cover slips into the diaper wash. My 20lb baby is outgrowing the small even though its supposed to only go up to 15lbs. 4 stars vs 5 because its not organic and is made in china.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_headline: Most expensive teether but 6 month old baby didn't care for it at all! :-(
review_body: I bought it because of its great review however my 6 month old son doesn't care for this item at all.  He chew on everything but this giraffe. Maybe it's the size, maybe it's the rubber smell, I am  not sure. I am giving it a 3 star because it is just sitting there and not being used. Thus, I am unable to give much review about the use of it. This giraffe come in a box that is very nice, and has its birth certificate or something like that. Very good quality rubber, and squeek when you squeeze it. Yes it does look like a dog's chew toy. It is able to stand too.  I am not sure why my son doesn't like it. Perhaps he is on the smaller side, only 20th percentile on weight.  This toy is way too big for him to hold and put in his mouth. A little difficult to handle. When he first hold it (on one of the leg), he hit his head with the giraffe's head.  The second time, the giraffe's pointy ear poke his eye. It's difficult for him to aim it in his mouth, perhaps that's why he doesn't like it.  He tried the leg, but it seems like he can choke on it, so I suggest parents keep an eye on their babies while using this item. I wish one day he will use it. For now it's just an expensive made in France chew toy sitting on the floor.

product_title: Medela Quick Clean Micro-Steam Bags, 5 Count
review_body: I don't care too much for the holes and how it has to connect, but it works!  It does the job, so for the price, I keep purchasing it.

product_title: Snoogle Chic Jersey - Snoogle Replacement Cover with Zipper for Easy Use
review_body: So soft. So nice. My first pregnancy, I couldn't find a cover for my snoogle, and was kind of grossed out by it after awhile.  Now, I can wash the cover and it just gets softer and nicer all the time.  It's easy to take off and put on.  A definite must for the snoogle.

product_title: Apple Park 9" Picnic Pal Organic Plush Toy
review_headline: Cute, but OMG So Over-Priced and They Won't Even Clean My Windows
review_body: The quality of the toy is fantastic, but it is very SMALL for the pricetag. Someone is laughing all the way to the bank. :) And I'm not just talking about the cost on Amazon, but all over the place. We have them in an organic boutique out here, and they are just as expensive. Yes, they are nice, but I guarantee at least $15 of that $40-50 you spend is on the fancy apple foo-foo box.     While they are cute and well-made, they are nothing to justify being $40-50. If I want to spend that kind of money on a stuffed animal, it's going to be a collector's piece (yes, I am not only a mom, but a toy collector). But this is geared to small children, and it is overpriced--even for an organic toy. We a few organics at home--including an Apple Park finger puppet (and I still think we paid too much for it), so I can honestly say from experience that you can get other organic/high-end stuffed animals for at least half the price that are BIGGER and just as nice (check out Miyim or Habba--they have bunnies for Easter too). If you just have to have one of these, keep an eye out for a store that has them on sale.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_body: With all of those wonderful reviews, my wife bought the wrap for our cranky 7-week old baby. Unfortunately, we returned it right away. The procedure to wrap and unwrap is a bit complicated and your baby needs to be pretty comfortable just \\"hanging out\\" while you hold him/her and spin the fabric around you. Speaking of which the product is literally just a long roll of fabric, cut to the proper dimensions of course and made from really soft material, but their is no magic happening here. Unfortunately we ended up returning this product after two days of failed attempts to really get the wrap snug and the baby didn't really enjoy being in any of the positions suggested in the manual. A bit disappointed because the baby does enjoy being in \\"standard\\" carriers with buckles and clamps.

product_title: Bummis Tots Bots Easy Fit Pocket Diaper, Pomegranate, 8-35 Pounds (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Are you scared of cloth diapering? wish it was easy?  Well then buy this diaper!!!  It's amazing!  It's super easy to use, and it uses natural fibers...bamboo!  Plus it's not a giant poofball on your kid's butt like other diapers.  You never have to fish around to find the right insert since it is attached, plus it comes in super fun colors and prints.  I really want to buy more!

product_title: Summer Infant SwaddlePod
review_body: Our little one won't arrive until March 2011, so we haven't had a chance to use the SwaddlePod yet.  However, it arrived in perfect condition and feels both soft and sturdy.

product_title: Nature's Purest Hug Me Jumper with Body Suit
review_body: I love this brand and was so excited to see it for sale here. The fit is great, the material is very soft, and my baby looked super cute in this outfit.

product_title: Munchkin Soft-Tip Infant Spoon, 6 Count
review_body: My 6 month old boy loves the spoons.  They are soft so they are gentle on his gum.  Plus he loves to hold a spoon in his hand as a toy too to knock on the tray during feeding.  He loves the bright colors.

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_body:
We have a 3.5yr old and a 12mo old. The older one needed a new seat because the straps of her old one was getting twisted and also would come undone. The younger one is creeping up on 20lbs. This meant 2 new car seats at the same time. We ended up buying 2 of these hoping they will be the last ones we buy for them. My initial reaction to it is that I love it. It was easy to put together. I love how the slip covers come off, just some elastic loops hooked around plastic hooks. This means I'll be able to fix it myself if one of the elastic loops breaks. The older ones car seat slip cover started coming off and a plastic piece broke. The drink holder location is exactly what I wanted - again the old one had it on the side and having two car seats side by side (one front and one rear facing) we had to remove the drink holder. The older one said it was more comfortable. It's very easy to buckle and unbuckle and it was pretty easy to install. One note is that it's heavy! We've done a lot of traveling this year and I'm so glad we weren't lugging this thing around with us! If you are transferring the car seat make a note of the weight of it. We have this next to a rear facing Peg Perego right now and they worked fine together. The younger one sat in it after we put it together and I can tell she's going to fit well in in. Very happy with the choice we made. And the price was right!

Update after a couple of weeks: still like the car seat. The only thing I didn't like was the liner that sits inside the seat. If you have to adjust the straps to a higher notch the liner doesn't fit well and makes it hard to tighten/loosen straps. I removed the liner and problem solved. So the black part you see inside the seat comes out leaving the silver liner.

UPDATE: March 2013 We've had these for a couple years and my girls love them! They are in excellent condition, have cleaned up well from all the messes. I have since bought a 3rd one in December 2012 for my 3rd child. The newer model changed the buckles a bit. It's more difficult to unbuckle the chest one which is a good thing because my 2 older ones can undo theirs which isn't a problem since they no not to do it. My 3rd watches everything they do of course and she is not able to unbuckle it! The crotch buckle is also more difficult but once I got the hang of it, it's not a big deal. I still had to remove the liner because it would slide down Nd I couldn't adjust the straps correctly. I don't even really know why it's in there. I have a 5.5yo (42\\" & 36lb) , 3yo (36\\" & 32lb) and 18mo (33\\" & 26lb) old all in the same carseat - different adjustments and all are fine! All are able to sit cross legged in their seats, have toys in the side pocket etc. I do wish the drink holder was a little closer to the child because my 18mo can't get her cups out. My now 3yo had same problem until she grew.

product_title: Gerber Graduates BPA Free 3 Pack Kiddy Cutlery Spoons
review_body: I've purchased so so many spoons for my 27 months old son, this is the only one he actually says he likes it.  The first time I gave it to him, he held it with his little hands, then stop and look at the spoon, and told me \\"mama, I like this!\\" I think what he meant was this is the handle with the right length for the little hands, and the spoon is neither too small nor too big for the little month. It is \\"just right\\".  I will highly recommend for your toddler.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body: Our little guy loves playing on this mat.  Mat offers fun from dangling toys as well as lights and squeaks on the floor.      The sounds on ours isn't working very well - the music is playing out of tune...but that's not such a big problem.      Baby spends lots of time playing on the mat reaching, pulling, gazing into the mirror, and talking to his little animal friends.    Highly recommend!

product_title: Dream On Me 2 Position Baby Bather Bath Tub
review_body: Overall a nice tub and designed to accomodate baby during early phase and later.  Only have a couple of negative comments.  First of all, it arrived without the so-called rubber drain hose as mentioned in the description.  Secondly, we purchased the tub along with the stand but it's not very stable...a bit wobbly.  I wrote Dream On Me to tell them about the missing rubber hose and find out if they would just ship it to me.  They never responded.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review_body: This high chair does its job and is an inexpensive alternative to other high chairs with the stand. Its portable making it easy to take along when visiting friends without kids and can be attached on any dining chair (no fold-able chairs as highlighted by another reviewer). Space saver and portable its also colorful and very easy to clean.

product_title: AMP Diaper Pail Liner
review_body: I purchased two of these liners about 4 years ago to use with my oldest son (so that one is always in the trash can, while the diapers are in the wash).  Now we're using them again for my youngest son.  We've had absolutely NO problems with them leaking and to combat smell, I place some citrus disks in the bottom of the 13 gallon trash can.  I like the amount of elastic on the edge, it's just enough to easily put over rim of trash can, but not too loose to let it slide in.  We've washed these liners with diapers (just invert the liner into the washing machine) 2-3 times a week for 4 years.  Really makes cloth diapering SO much easier!    I'd highly recommend these and in fact am buying two more for my best friend and her new baby.

product_title: Born Free Teether, Gum Brush, Silicone 1 EA
review_body: My 8 month old son loved it. However, after a few months of use, I found that at least ten bristles broke off. Some of them must have been swallowed by the little one. Now, maybe it's harmless and the tiny bits of silicone have passed with his stool, but I am giving this item one star so that potential buyers are forewarned!

product_title: Milkies Milk Saver
review_body: When I got the milk saver, I was all ready to be excited about it! In fact, I used it for a week before I figured out what was really wrong with it. And now, my kid is 3 months old and I don't use it.     First, as other reviewers have said, it's huge and really not appropriate to use in public, or even while running around the house. Second, there is pretty much no way to use it at night if you nurse in bed. That was the kicker for me. I was leaking at night every time I fed, and I was pretty sure that if I had been able to collect that milk, I was looking at least an ounce leaked per feeding. During the day I was only getting .25 to .5 of an ounce per feeding. Over the course of a day I could collect enough for a feeding, but I was needing to wash the milk saver every time I fed, have two bottles going in the fridge at all time (one cold, one just pumped at room temperature) and it was a LOT of monkeying around to collect roughly 2 oz per day.      I've also stopped leaking so much, so now the milk saver wouldn't do much for me at all.    So just remember, every woman is different. If the price isn't prohibitive for you, this might allow you to save a lot of milk that would otherwise be wasted.

product_title: Maclaren Techno XLR Stroller, Black and Champagne (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Tips over, storage is horrible, annoying bar attachment
review_body: I bought this stroller because I loved the sleek look it had, it was light weight, easy to use..HOWEVER if you put a diaper bag on the handle bars or your purse it tips over! Also the storage is horrible, very hard to get to & it doesn't hold much. When I traveled with it on a plane there is a bar that you have to attach when you use the car seat adapter which does not go on easily...the bar doesn't attach to the stroller when you collapse it so I had to carry around the very awkward bar on the plane while holding my baby, my purse, & my diaper bag, extremely frustrating! All that to say, I am definitely purchasing a different stroller that is safer & more convenient for my next child.

product_title: Disney Recliner
review_body: This is such a pretty chair.  The quality of the fabric and workmanship is great. I purchased this chair for my 2 1/2 year old granddaughter.  She loves it.  Now she can put her feet up just like papa!

product_title: BOB Revolution Stroller in Mesa Orange
review_headline: A good stroller, but now worth all the hype
review_body: While this is one of the better strollers out there, I don't know if I would buy it again.    Pros:  Excellent steering and maneuverability, quality fabric, good design, and um...    Cons:  Big and bulky-I have a hard time in some stores with little aisle space. It's also very heavy to carry. Very little reclining action, very small storage -I can barely fit my medium size purse in there, thin inner tubes- I've replaced 3 inner tubes in 8 weeks, the handle bar foam is coming apart after a couple months, customer service is not as helpful as I would expect, and the WORST thing is I can hardly close and open the stroller; the joint is giving me problems. I emailed C.S. about this and they gave me a couple things to try, but really, I've only had this thing for a year and I'm having this much of a hassle!??!

product_title: Tiny Love Follow Me Activity Toy, Fred
review_body: I wasn't sure about this toy, but my mom bought it for my 9-month-old for Christmas and it turned out to be the perfect toy for him!  He loves chasing after it and grabbing its tail.  He immitates the barking noises it makes.  I like that you don't have to turn it on and off.  When baby stops paying attention to it, it stops moving.

product_title: GO-GO BABYZ TRAVELMATE Car Seat Travel Stroller for Toddler Car Seats
review_body: This travelmate is awesome!!  I used it on my toddlers car seat going to the airport and it was easy to strap on to the car seat, very durable, rolls great, the handle slides down to fit perfectly in the overhead compartment.  I could even fit it walking down the aisle of the plane.  I had SO many comments on this when I was using it.  Well worth the money!! I have NO complaints!!  this is perfect to travel with and was so much more convenient than hauling my car seat and baby and luggage.  Love it!

product_title: Key Fit 30 Car seat base
review_body: I got this as a second base for the Chicco KeyFit22 car seat that I purchased for my second baby (expected soon).  It fits the KeyFit22 perfectly.  Installs as easily as the other bases I've used, so only takes a couple of minutes.  Should work great.

product_title: Carters Velour Playard Fitted Sheet, Sage (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Fits my pack n play. . . barely
review_body:
Love the fabric! It's so soft! I was nervous about it fitting my pack n play, I have the graco pack n play with the bassinet and newborn napper feature. The pack n play matress has a hard bottom, so I don't have problems with the sheet pulling up on the corners of the mattress, but it sort of puffs up in the middle, I guess because it is slightly too small? I also have a play yard quilted waterproof mattress cover underneath the Carters sheet, so I am sure that affects the fit of the top sheet, but I don't want to risk having to deal with wet messes on the pack n play matress. Either way I am happy with the purchase. I will be careful to line/hang dry it just in case it is likely to shrink in the dryer. I will definitely be ordering a second sheet.

****Update I have since stopped using the quilted waterproof matrees cover underneath this pack and play mattress. It really does fit much better, with less bunching. Baby sleeps on it everynight. . . he's still in the pack and play in our room. At two months old, I am trying to work my nerve up to letting him sleep in his room but just not there yet. So far so good!

product_title: Summer Infant Secure Surround 8-Panel PlaySafe Playard
review_body: I use this for my puppy. It works great unfolded as well as the play yard. Well worth the money.

product_title: NoJo Alexis Garden 4 Piece Crib Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Love the colors!

Love the patterns!

Love, Love, Love!

I was looking for something that wasn't soooo pink. This was one of the few options I found and am happy with it!

product_title: Ju-Ju-Be Be Quick Wristlet
review_body: I love this little bag. It's very well made and I can see it coming in handy for lots of things and for many years, well beyond diaper years. I am using mine as a \\"nursing\\" pouch to carry all my nursing essentials. It holds 8 nursing pads, a pack of nursing wipes, a nursing cover, burp cloth, a tube of nursing cream, and my nursing strap (that attaches to any blanket), with a little room to spare- Everything ready to go in one place! I just throw it in the diaper bag or attach it to the car seat and can do a quick grab anytime I need it!

product_title: The First Years Jet Stroller, City Chic (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We bought this for our 4 year old to take to NYC, and it held up really well, was easy to put up and down (maybe less quickly than a NYC resident wanted us to, trying to get on the train behind us, but fast enough).  It fit her well, even though she's very tall.  Of course, the cup holders and bin underneath could be a bit bigger, but then it probably wouldn't fold down as small.  After seeing similar looking strollers around the city (Maclaren, all of them) that I know go for much more money, I don't think it would have given us any benefit to have paid that much more.

product_title: Leachco Natural Boost - Adjustable Nursing Pillow
review_body: Great nursing pillow...in my case, it´s the best thing for men because you really can get tired when you feed your child with the bottle so this pillow would be something unique to rest on.  For my wife is an ok product, not excellent because the pillow is a little bit higher than her breast so when she tries to breast feeding our daughter it gets uncomfortable and difficult to work with.

product_title: Skip Hop Duo Double Hold-it-All Diaper Bag, Black
review_body: I have been eyeballing this bag for a while but couldn't bring myself to spend that kind of money on a bag.  I recently snagged a used one and wish I had just bought the darn thing over a year ago!  This is a great bag if you have more than one kid and/or you do cloth diapers and/or you're planning a big day out (or many such days).  It's not so big that I feel like an idiot carrying it around (a major fear before purchasing) and it has a ton of pockets so things stay organized.  Right now I have a 7yo who for all intents and purposes is past the diaper bag stage ;-). a 3yo who is mostly trained, a 3yo who has no interest in training, and a newborn.  I have a pocket for pull-ups, a pocket for bigger disposable diapers, a pocket for smaller disposable diapers, a pocket for my cell phone, a pocket for wipes, pocket for binkies and gas drops, more pockets left over, and tons of big main pouch space for the potty insert we carry with us and for cloth diapers when I have the diapered ones in cloth.  And plenty of room still for snacks, water bottles, extra sleeper for the new baby, etc - all without the bag seeming too gigantic.      I have it in the uptown stripe and I love the colors.  It hangs nicely on the back of my double bob stroller using the shoulder strap, but I think the Bob is too wide for this to hang on it using the special clicky side straps.  Haven't tried it, but it doesn't look like it would work.  But it works fine with the shoulder strap.  Great bag, wish I had gotten it sooner rather than trying to make do with a smaller bag all this time!    I got this bag used and it is still in awesome shape so I have high hopes for its durability.

product_title: Levana Wireless Audio Baby Monitor with Sound Indicator LEDs (LV-TW100) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Ok for older infants, not sensitive enough on sounds.
review_body: I have to echo what others have.  This monitor needs to be more sensitive to babys noises.  It takes quite a bit for this to pick up the noise of your baby.  While this may be fine for older infants if you are just starting out with newborns then you will probably want to hear every little sound and this set will not do that.  This set would be fine for older infants/toddlers as you probably don't want to hear every little noise as they get older.  This would also make a good travel monitor as the battery life seems to be very good when just using the internal battery.  This set is convenient and small which is nice.  Overall this is not a bad set but those looking for a very sensitive monitor may not be happy with this set.

product_title: Infantino Movers and Shakers - Mouse (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Both my 2-year-old and my 10-month-old love this little shaker.  The two year old loves to turn it on and the 10 month old loves to chase after it.  I wish it was easier for the 10 month old to turn it on, but what toy does a 10 month old really know how to turn on?!  It's a great purchase!

product_title: BOB Revolution 12" Aluminum Wheel Stroller in Black
review_headline: Bob Revolution 12" Aluminum Wheel Stroller in Black
review_body: This was a gift and it was an excellent choice! This is now almost 2 years old and it is used all the time. It's durable easy to operate and my grandson loves it. A new baby on the way and it is in great shape to use for the second baby. The canvas makes it easy to keep clean as well. The suspension is great for gravel and off road trips too.

product_title: Badger Basket Sleigh Style Baby Changing Table
review_body: The cherry finish is more red than brown like it should be unlike some other brands.  Also, it is very sturdy. If you read reviews or saw a un-sturdy one at a local store than it was not put together properly. This changing table is easy to put together and well made for the money.

product_title: FunBath Angel Dear BLUE BEAR Blankie
review_body: My son got this as a gift when he was born, and it became his \\"lovey\\".  Now he cuddles with it before every nap and bedtime.  I bought a second copy to making washing easier.  It's soft and cuddly, and it's small, which makes it easy to schlep around.

product_title: KidCo G22 White Safeway Angle Mount
review_body: This gate is poorly designed and way too complicated to assemble. Do yourself a favor and buy the Kidco G20, very simple assembly.

product_title: Evenflo Switch A Roo
review_body: We got an Evenflo exersauser from a friend that was a little older and used. I bought this toy because my son is teething and loves sitting in his exersauser. Its perfect! The fish is nice and soft to chew on and the tale crinkles. Most of the other toys are not too great for a baby to stick in their mouth but this one is nice and tall and works perfect!

product_title: J is for Jeep 2-in-1 Shopping Cart and High Chair Cover, Universal Size, Baby Grocery Cart Cover, Infant High Chair Cover, Machine Washable, Safety Harness, Folds into Handbag, Pocket for Essentials, Cart, Cover, Toddler
review_body: I love this little thing. My son is small. So he always would slip and slide in the high chairs and carts. But now he doesn't. It does have a lot of gadgets to hook up to secure it but depending on chair or cart not all hook ups are required. The fact that it turns into a bag is a plus!

product_title: Boppy Total Body Pillow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This pillow was fantastic for the first month or two of use. After that, the stuffing in the head pillow part began to get lumpy. Mine came with a washable cover, but I found that the between the knees pillow portion started to flatten too much and the only way to get it back into a comfy shape was to throw the entire thing into the washing machine. That had the effect of plumping up the bottom portion and making the head portion lumpier. Turning over in bed is a pain with this thing, but I think that would be the case with any full-body pillow. Overall I still use it at 8+ months and put a normal pillow case over the head portion to disguise the annoying lumps.

product_title: Baby Jogger Car Seat Adaptor For Chicco, Single (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I wish I had read these reviews before I purchased this horrible adapter and spent over an hour trying to figure out why the SnugRide 35 wouldn't snap in.  This feels completely unstable and there is no way I can place my newborn in this.  I am very disappointed and a bit pissed off.  The folks at Baby Jogger should be ashamed of themselves...

product_title: Sunshine Kids Stow 'N Go Car Seatback Organizer, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Look wise, this looks great, but in reality, I had to send it back because the top strap is way too long to create a secure fit around the seat.  It will slide all over, and not serve it's purpose very well.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Bottle Warmer
review_headline: we have cooled on the bottle warmer
review_body: at first we really loved this product, but a couple of months into it, and it seems to heat bottles very inconsistently. sometimes 2 minutes and 40 seconds heats a bottle perfectly, and sometimes, it comes out cold. i thought it might have to do with the water level in the tank, but that doesn't appear to be the case. other than that it is a pretty convenient product that is easy to use

product_title: Carters Snuggle Me Elephant Boa Blanket, Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought my twin girls these blankets (green, pink) for Christmas when they were 1 year.  They abandoned all other blankets and started calling these their \\"blankies\\".  They are now 3 and these blanket have held up to 24/7 loving (no pilling, shrinking, fading).  I have to sneak and wash them b/c they will not surrender them willingly.  They put their blankies to bed in the morning before school and make bee lines straight for them after they get back home.  As the other reviewers said, any baby would love this blanket.

product_title: The First Years Breastflow BPA Free Bottle
review_body: I have a baby who doesn't really care for the bottle.  So prior to her starting daycare, I purchased this bottle with the hopes it would be more like mommy.  To me, it was one of the most 'real to breast' feeling nipples I've run across.  It just didn't work for us.  She didn't like it any more or less than the others we've tried, so I'm sure with more constant use she'd have become used to it.  I wasn't crazy about it for one main reason - if you have warm milk in the bottle and baby wants to take a break, you have to drain the milk from between the interior and exterior nipples back into the base, otherwise the milk that gets 'stuck' becomes cold.  Call me lazy, but it just seemed like an extra step that I didn't want to take every time - especially since she was indifferent to the bottle.

product_title: Graco NasalClear Nasal Aspirator, 1 Count
review_body: Our 10 week old was recently hospitalized with RSV. Upon being dicharged the nurse asked if I needed anything else, I of course tell her I want the vaccum suction to take home! She laughed and said she heard they started making a battery operated one so of course, I stop on my way home to pick one up. This works at least as well as the hospital suction! While she still doesn't enjoy having things stuck up her nose, this makes quick work of sucking out even the stickiest snot! Will definatly be my new go-to gift for baby showers!

product_title: WubbaNub (tm) DRAGON Pacifier!
review_body: Baby looks adorable using it, and it does what it's supposed to - it pacifies a baby.  Worth the buy just for the cute factor.    Now that she is grabbing, she will occasionally take hold of the stuffed-animal part and pull it out of her mouth.  That's your only look-out on this item.  You want to stay close by till the baby's asleep, so you can pop it back in her mouth if she tugs it loose.

product_title: The First Years Ignite Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I hesitated a long time before finally choosing this umbrella stroller.
I think for the price it's a good quality, the handle are definitly taller than they are on other brand of umbrella stroller, and that good because I'm 5'9:-)
There are some storage which is a good thing too, and pretty rare on umbrella stroller at this price.
The 5 points harness is a good feature too.
My only concern are maybe the wheels, they seems not really good, but we'll see.
Overall I think it's a good quality/price buy!

product_title: Kidco Peapod Plus Travel Bed
review_body: We got this for my 2 year old daughter for Christmas. She is not the best traveler. We borrowed our friends Kidco Peapod as we were traveling for Thanksgiving and she loved it. Whenever she needed some alone time she just retreated to her \\"little tent\\". We set up the dvd player in there and she even took her naps in there. We ended up purchasing the larger sized one since we would like her to use it a little longer. It travels so well and is very eady to set up and put away. We are very satisfied that our traveling experiences will be easier the next few years thanks to the Kidco Peapod.

product_title: Tinkle Bells Keep-Tys for Baby Shoes--White
review_body: I bought these for my nine month old daughter so she would quit untying her shoes and kicking them off.  They work great,  super cute, and she loves the little bells.  She is always kicking her feet and laughing.

product_title: Summer Infant Sure and Secure Double Bedrail
review_body: As other reviewers have mentioned, the actual color of these is a baby-blue, not the royal blue shown in the picture.  Other than that, I'm very happy with these bed rails.  We got them for my toddler who just transitioned to a double bed.  He has pulled on the sides (much the same way he used to rattle the bars on his crib) and they stay strong.  It's nice that they both fold down, too.  Makes for easier sheet changes.  They were easy to install too, with no tools needed.  Took my husband about 20 minutes.

product_title: Summer Infant Swaddleme Microfleece, Blue, Large (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We were very pleased with this swaddling blanket.  It replaced a more difficult to use velcro blanket and this quickly became our favorite.    It was very easy to put on and did a good job keeping our daughter swaddled.    It's being saved for use with baby #2.  We recommend it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat
review_headline: a great step-up from a high chair
review_body: I had used the FP Space Saver high chair until my daughter figured out how to rock the chair over at 17 months. I got this as a friend of mine bought it for her oldest.  I love it!  It's very easy to use and take with us on trips if need be.  I *LOVE* that it essentially has two trays (who has time to wash the tray after every meal???).  A fantastic booster and great for the price.  Would recommend to anyone with a toddler.  Super easy to clean with a messy eater!

product_title: Munchkin Stay Put Suction Bowl, 3 Count
review_body: they're great bowls w/great lids, but will not stay suctioned to tray.  my son was able to pull it off the tray instantly & toss it.

product_title: Wubbanub Infant Pacifier - Red Dog
review_body: I'm a  first time mother and was tired of holding his pacifier, this was great and not a choking hazard.

product_title: Smart Mom Teething Bling Pendant - Donut Shape
review_body: My baby is very picky about her teethers. She seems to like this one, though gets a bit frustrated that it doesn't fit on the back part of her gums. I think its very pretty too! my boyfriend was surprised at how soft it was since it looks so much like stone. I agree with another reviewer the cord could be a bit better of quality, but I'm sure that would also make it more expensive.

product_title: Kid'sleep Classic
review_body: This clock conveys time to a toddler with no confusion-and if used daily-works like a charm to at least keep your child in bed and quiet until the time you set the bunny to wake up! You have to use a time close to when they wake up though-prob won't work if you set it at 10am for you to sleep in! Lol!

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: My son loves his Sophie the Giraffe so much that I bought one for my friends who are expecting babies.

product_title: Summer Infant Contoured Changing Pad
review_body: This is exactly what I was looking for.  The sides are high enough that I don't think he could roll off (though I try not to give him opportunities!) but aren't in the way at all for changing him.  The surface is washable and easy to clean - I don't use a cover with it, just a cloth under his head for when he spits up.  My one negative is that in the five weeks we've been using it, it has already developed some snags and the beginnings of rips - not sure how, unless I'm catching it with my rings or something.  I don't feel that we've abused it at all, so I'm a little disappointed with that.  I suppose using a cover with it would negate the problem.  Overall, I'd probably buy it again, but I do wish it was a little more durable.

product_title: Boon Winter Grass Countertop Drying Rack
review_body:
This drying rack can hold any baby item you could possibly need to dry, doesn't take up a lot of counter space, and gives off the effect of a funky kitchen garden. The grass and base separate and can go in the dishwasher for easy cleaning.

Check out more baby gear recommendations at: [...]

product_title: Sassy Pull and Go Boat Bath Toy
review_body: This toy is super cute but it barely moves in the water. I had thought it would ZOOM! But this is not the case.

product_title: Stork Craft Aspen 5 Drawer Chest, Espresso (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We got this for our first baby. My boyfriend put it together and within days it was falling apart. The metal screws do not fit right and the drawers are not strudy. I am in love with the way it looks and will find away to fix it. Maybe Rhino glue. All in all, not worth the money, and stress. Not even made of wood. Scrathes very easily

product_title: FunToSee Polly Patch Flowers Girls Nursery and Bedroom Wall Decals, Flowers
review_body: I bought these to use on a dresser that I was refinishing for baby's room.  I painted the dresser white, and cut the decals so they would sit on the drawers.  It turned out way better than I imagined.  The flowers are adorable and they stick well.  I was able to reposition them while I was working to get them perfectly straight.  Great product!

product_title: Charlie Banana 2 in 1 Reusable Diaper - Baby Pink
review_body: We absolutely love our Charlie Banana diapers and will definitely be getting more. They have a great fit and we have yet to have a leak. The pocket opening is in the front which is great when you have a messy diaper. The spacing of the snaps is good and there are crossover snaps to get a customized fit. I would definitely recommend trying one of these diapers.

product_title: Baby Einstein
review_body: Baby (9 months+) likes to bang it.  She does not use it like a ball yet but she likes looking at the colors and putting it in her mouth.

product_title: Taggies Look At Me! Activity Mirror for Baby
review_body: If the mirror could be fixed or have a a protective cover so it doesn't scratch this item would be perfect!

product_title: Angelcare Baby Movement and Sound Monitor, Blue
review_headline: Peace of Mind for NICU Baby
review_body: Our baby was born premature and had respiratory problems.  When he came home we were worried about his breathing and we lost a lot of sleep.  After several days we set this monitor up and tested it.  It worked great!  Now we've been using it for several weeks and we love it.  Great product!

product_title: New Extra Long Vinyl Shower Bath Mat, Extra Long Bathtub Protector Non-Slip Bath Mat & Shower Mat
review_body: THIS EXTRA LONG BATH MAT IS GREAT!!  IT HUGS THE TUB SURFACE AND DOES NOT SLIP.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

product_title: Wallcandy Arts Smarts, Black/White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love the wall art.  It was so easy to put up; all I did is measured the total width of the design and figure out where I wanted to put it.  It went up so easily and looks really professional.  I definitely recommend it.  You can take it down and move it too (have not done that yet).  Totally awesome.

product_title: HABA Motley Pacifier Chain, Multicolor
review_body: I have a 7 month old son who loves this chain.  He has used it since he was 1.5 months old when we first gave him a pacifier - we have one other pacifier chain from a different brand and we swap the two chains out almost daily.  He chews and sucks on this chain and have not had any paint coming off or wood chipping. I get compliments on this chain all of the time.

product_title: Clek 2010 Oobr Booster Car Seat, Paul Frank Zoom Julius (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Clek Oobr is part cool & part safety.  To me, I wanted a car seat that was safe, fun, and comfortable for my son.  This seat is in my husband's car, mine is a Japanese make, Aprica, that is also phenomenon.      I like the Clek Oobr for it's easy to clean surface, a place to put my son's drink, and the ease of using the car's seatbelt.    Mostly, if you are looking for something a bit different, while you drop your kids off, run errands, etc. Clek Oobr delivers with it's European styling.      We are very happy we went ahead and order this carseat.  The runner-up would have been a Britax that is always rated as top-safety carseat.  We just felt that as a second seat, we prefer the Rigid Latch that this carseat uses, and each time we put our baby in the seat, it makes us smile.

product_title: Colgate Classica I Foam Crib Mattress
review_body:
There's firm, but then there's *FIRM*. This matress is like a rock, and my baby has not sleep well in it. Trust me, I tried. ....at least until I added quite a bit of padding. We started out with a bassinet, then moved to crib. I suppose every baby is different though.
There isn't a standard definaition of \\"extra firm\\" crib matresses. I've felt other extra firm matresses that weren't nearly this hard.
Give this matress a shot, but do *keep the box* just in case your baby doesn't like it. I want to return it but need a darn box now.

product_title: Fisher-Price Newborn Rock 'n Play Sleeper, Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We bought this for our baby in February hoping that she would sleep well. Both of our boys slept better in their carseat at first so this looked very promising. So far it has been wonderful. The back is a little hard so I placed a folded blanket under the sleeper's cover like another review suggested and that has solved that problem. She's been in it almost 2 months and so far has no flat spot or hair loss. She sleeps very well in it and it is small enough to be in any room of our little house. It's easy to move around between rooms and it's low enough for big brothers to admire her without having to hang on the sides or pull themselves up and risk pulling her over. The base is steady and not easy to tip. It was simple to put together although an extra pair of hands was helpful. It's also very neutral in color. My only complaint is that we should have bought it in pink since we ended up having a baby girl :)

product_title: Graco Snugride Infant Car Seat Base
review_body: I found the best price for these is here on Amazon. The base fit into my Dodge Ram back middle seat perfectly and the LATCH system keeps it very secure. However, my wife's car does not have LATCH and we were required to use the seat belt.
