Her car has leather seats and the front of the base slides side to side on the leather no matter how tight the seat belt is, the sliding does not happen in the Dodge Ram.

product_title: Thermos Ice Mat, 6 Cube
review_body: I use some 6-cube packs to complement some [[ASIN:B001TWI81G 9 Cube mats]] that I used for a full semester of lunches, and they are still working well. No leaks yet, and there is little visible wear on the packs. Even if they were to break, it's just clean water, and by the time your ice has melted, your lunch items will likely be long gone anyway.     The water remains isolated in the cube shapes, so the pack is flexible even when frozen. They are quick to freeze, and seem to last long enough for a late afternoon lunch even in my cheap, lightly insulated lunchbox. These mats don't take up too much space and distribute the ice over a large area.     Very functional at a very reasonable price. I recommend buying a few extra to keep in the freezer, just in case you forget to pop a used one in the freezer at the end of the day.

product_title: Kidz Delight Magic Mirror Laptop, White/Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This teaches shapes, colors, ABC, and has fun lights and music.  My baby loves looking in the mirror and following the lighted images.  It is definitely a good toy that I recommend.

product_title: DaVinci Jayden 4 in 1 Crib with Toddler Rail
review_body: We looked for months for an antique white crib that was a good quality for around $300. This one totally fits the bill. Easy to assemble, sturdy, and beautiful Antique White/Ivory color. The wood is pine which is soft and can scratch easily but it is far better than many of the cribs I've seen in baby stores in this price range.

product_title: Boon Winter Grass Countertop Drying Rack
review_body: Love this product. I use it everyday it keeps his items organized and it's very modern. I have received many compliments, plus it can hold a sufficient amt. of bottles and spoons, it doesn't get moldy, I even use it for my sons teethers. I would definitely recommend it to any parent.

product_title: Sugar Booger Feeding Collection Tabletop Splat Mat
review_body: cute designs, nice quality, contains the mess, easy to clean! i haven't put this in the washer yet but i don't know why you would honestly. hand wash it in 2 seconds! i'd buy it again.

product_title: Munchkin Five Multi Cups
review_headline: Perfect BPA free cup for toddlers
review_body: I've been looking for a nice BPA free plastic cup for my toddler and this one is perfect. Light enough to pick up easily and big enough for a 2-3 year old.

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_body: My child couldn't wait to get out of the back facing baby carrier.  This seat is neutral colors, which I like and is easy to hook up and operate.  It's also nice that I won't have to buy multiple seats, this will be it through the stages. My child likes sitting up and doesn't mind the straps, plus the straps are easy to adjust.  Later on, the cup holder will be an added bonus for a bottle or snacks.  I highly recommend this seat!!

product_title: Carter's Green Elephant Musical Mobile, Green/Choc (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The elephants get stuck on the bar.... our mobile stopped working and it's only been 5 months.... and the music doesn't play for long enough!! It's too bad because it is really cute!

product_title: Dreambaby Deluxe Bath Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The bath seat could be made a lot better. The plastic is sort of sharp in places, and there are places where it can pinch a baby. You have to be really cautious with it. Also, if you have any sort of \\"non-skid\\" surface or texture on the bottom of your tub you have to install provided stickers to the tub to give the bath seat a surface to suction cup to. I didn't want to do this because I didn't want to mess up the tub with the adhesive provided. Also, the seat isn't weighted at all, it floats up and flips if there's no weight in it or it isn't suctioned down- why not weight it down so baby can't flip out of it? Keep looking for a better bath seat!

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_body: I bought this Sunday afternoon November 21, and was so pleased to see how fast it arrived, (November 23). The Cloud b Twilight Turtle is everything I thought it would be, it is nicely made, just right for little hands, (not that it's little, because it's not) took it out of the box to test it and WOW, the light colors are great and the stars are so clear, our grand baby is going to Love it, can't wait to give it to him for Christmas. Will be purchasing one for our house as well.

product_title: Sunshine Kids Monterey Booster Car Seat, Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: After looking for a \\"Big Girl\\" carseat for my 3 1/2 year old, I settled on this one and love it! It is so comfortable, if she falls asleep, her head doesn't slink forward. She is really small for her age, just a notch under the weight and height guidelines for this seat even. I was worried this wouldn't work. I was wrong and this seat fits her perfectly. I loved it so much I bought one for my 6 1/2 year old, fits her too perfectly. You can tell she is far more comfortable in this thing than her graco one. She had trouble on trips falling asleep, her head falling forward. Not anymore! True it is heavy and slightly bulky, you could still fit 3 easily in the backseat of a midsize or fullsize car. Benefits outweigh the cons! Hightly recommend!

product_title: GYRO BOWL Spill Resistant Kids Gyroscopic Bowl with Lid
review_body: THIS ITEM WAS BOUGHT AS GIFTS FOR MY GRANDDAUGHTER AND GREAT GRANDSON.THE PARENTS TELL ME THIS IS THE BEST BOWL EVER AS THEY DO NOT HAVE TO WORRY ABOUT SPILLS THEY JUST LOVE IT.

product_title: Summer Infant Multi-Use Deco Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate, Bronze
review_body: I purchased this gate to place at the bottom of the stairs. It's easy to install and quite solid. The style works well and wall mounts are secure.   It takes 2 (little) hands to open the gate so my 2 year old hasn't yet been able to open it on her own --

product_title: Mini-Coral the Mermaid
review_body: I bought this for my baby daughter's first dolly and first christmas gift. I love that it is hand made, and super soft. I really like the yarn hair. I gave it 4 stars because it was very expensive and I'm really bothered that it has nothing on its chest. Aside from that I really love this doll and am so glad there is something that isn't dressed like a hooker or waiting for a knight in shiny armor. I will probably purchase more of these over the years.

product_title: Sunshine Kids Dry Seat Pad, Grey (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have set into our Britax Boulavard and it works great. Perfect catcher for all the crums and potty training accidents. It's great just to able to wash the seat section without taking apart the entire chair and waiting for it to dry.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat
review_body: my 14 month old son loves it . at 1rst i wasnt quite sure  because it seems ordinary. but its excellent. my son refuses to have me feed him. he understands its his eating chair and i never worry he might fall or he might be in danger. i recommend this 100%

product_title: 5 Pack GumDrop Newborn Pacifier - Lavender Natural
review_body: These pacifiers are great for breastfed babies. They are the right shape and shouldn't cause nipple confusion, as some other pacifiers might. The shape is very similar to the Soothies you get at the hospital, without the annoying outer part that smushes against the baby's face. These are contoured perfectly. If you want to use a binky holder, the holes on the sides stretch a bit to allow use of one. Overall a great purchase!

product_title: Fisher-Price Luv U Zoo Busy Baby Booster (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great seat to add to your dinner table
review_body:
Update: As expected, works great to feed our little boy in. Very easy to clean. He smiles the whole time. Love this chair.

I haven't actually started feeding my 5 month old son solids yet, but eating our family dinner in peace was impossible. I read somewhere that you should warm your child up to a seat before you start feeding them. So, I decided we'd purchase this early and start breaking it in. He LOVES this seat. He'll sit at the table through our whole meal and play with the toy bar. He no longer needs to be held or tries to grab our food. He's just content with the toys and happy to be up at eye level, like part of the family.

I'll probably update more once I start using it to feed him. But my SIL has used this chair (the healthy deluxe version) for all three of her oversized children and she swears by it. Easy to set up, even easier to clean, use at 6 months or 24, doesn't crowd out your table, and stores well once your done. I'm really glad Grandma bought us this one instead of the healthy deluxe one I had on my wishlist. The toy bar really is genius.

product_title: Status Series 200 Stages Convertible Crib
review_body: This is a beautiful crib! It is also very solid and sturdy. It looks very expensive for a great price. I would have given it 5 stars but the finish can show scratches easily.

product_title: Evenflo Embrace LX Infant Car Seat, Metro (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this car seat to use for my little boy, who got big very quickly after he was born. It was perfect when he was very little; the head pillow is crucial for newborns because it really helps keep their head from falling from side to side. At 3 months and 15 pounds, however, he is almost too tall to use this seat anymore, and I had to order a new, convertible one. As my baby isn't particularly tall, I don't think that most babies will be able to use this seat until they're 22 pounds.

product_title: Chicco Cortina Keyfit 30 Travel System, Fuego (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have yet to be able to use it, still waiting for my little one to arrive but I was very strict on Graco vs other companies but after testing out and feeling this one, I fell in LOVE with it. The pull bar to recline the seat is awesome, not to mention its extremely comfortable to stroll. Putting it together? All I had to do was a few snapping things together. I cant wait to use it when my baby boy arrives. I got this Travel System for a total of 261 so im very pleased :)

product_title: Toddler Shield Table Pad, Medium 141" - 192" Colors: Cream
review_body: Well... it's not perfect.... it's ugly actually.... kind of makes our coffee table look like a pool table.... but I'd rather the table be ugly than having my son risk hitting his noggin' or something else on the table corner!   He can't pull it off (like those stupid little stick on corner cushions).   I'm thankful that this product exists!!!!

product_title: GroVia One-Size Diaper Shell - Snaps
review_body: I have no doubt that this diaper will be great for my 0-3month when she is bigger(6mo+), but the bulk is too much with the snap in soaker. Nice design, but not quite as \\"one-size\\" as I thought it would be.

product_title: The First Years Massaging Action Teether (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: this is a good teether my niece had one just like it a few years back but we somehow lost it. Thanks to the maker of this product, because my baby niece loves it. I don't know how the other vibrating teethers work but this one is great.

product_title: Stork Craft Beatrice 4 Drawer Chest
review_body: We got this dresser to match the crib we bought elsewhere.  The dresser matches the espresso color of the crib.  The only thing was that one of the cam lock pieces was damaged and there were not any extra in the container so there is one place on the dresser that is not locked together correctly.  Other than that i am happy with it.

product_title: Graco Pack 'N Play Playard with Twin Bassinet, Kensington
review_body: This is an excellent choice for twins. It keeps them separate but together for ease of access. While accommodating both it fits in the same area as a crib.

product_title: Philips AVENT DECT Baby Monitor with Temperature Sensor and New ECO Mode (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We purchased the old model of this monitor that came in this cute yellow round shape about 3 years ago for our first born. We loved it. The range was so incredibly good, we could walk around our block and lose the link for just a few seconds. One of the bases died so we tried to buy it again, even used. Not possible. So we bought this model. Same maker. We figured, it's got to be good, right? Eeeeh. The range is terrible. Just seven steps down from the room and it loses the connection. So the unit starts beeping really loudly and you can't turn that off. Walking around the block with both old (base in our first born's room) and new (new baby) monitors, we can see how quickly the new one loses the connection with the base. Also, even though the sensitivity feature is still the best around, it's still not as good as the old model. Plus it's more expensive for only one parent unit.   We purchased a Graco set without the sensitivity feature and we had to return it right away: we couldn't sleep because we could hear the \\"noise\\" machine in our baby's room all night long. All we needed to know was if the baby was crying.    Overall, we're disappointed that Philips was unable to keep up the quality to which we had grown accustomed but with the sensitivity feature, it's still the best around.

product_title: Fisher-Price Zen Collection Cradle Swing
review_headline: My baby likes this swing but....
review_body: This swing is attractive, especially compared to others out there.    Positives:  Plugs into the wall so no need to waste batteries  Seat turns to face any direction  Seat is removable so if my baby falls asleep I can take her with me if I need to leave the room    Negatives:  Noisy!  The motor is quite loud.  Mobile does not move, although it does swing away  Large, this swing takes up a lot of space  Small tilt range, from flat to slightly less flat    I think my baby would like any swing I put her in.  I would have liked to have gotten one that plugs into the wall but is more quiet.

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie Elite Diaper Disposal Pail, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a wonderful product - easy to use and works as described.  There is no dirty diaper smell!  I have found in my experience, however, that diaper pails in general are not necessary and can become a nuisance.  I find it just as easy to throw diapers in the trash and take the trash out regularly.

product_title: The First Year's Newborn-To-Toddler Reclining Feeding Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The back of this chair does not click into place. At first I thought it was something I was doing, but when my husband couldn't do it, I knew it was manufacturers error. I've also read other reviews that say the same thing. This is my first time ever doing a review, but I am hoping to save someone time and money!

product_title: Bob Pre-2016 Single Infant Car Seat Adapter For Chicco
review_body: Awesome accessory for the BOB Revolution stroller. I had to go to the BOB website to match the car seat to the stroller, but I love the way BOB got with several manufacturers to make their product as versatile as possible. Their strollers are compatible with Graco and several others.

product_title: Tadpoles Organic Double Knit Cotton Footed Snap Front Romper
review_body: I would have given this product a five star review if the cuffs were looser. As much as we loved this outfit, it was a battle every time to get our newborn's hands through the rather tight little opening. Otherwise, the material feels lovely and we like the plastic snaps.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: This is a nice portable little toy for throwing in the diaper bag (I'm the grandma, so I hope it comes back when my grandson comes for an afternoon with me).  The music is pleasnt even for an adult, and is not too loud, yet loud enough.  The flashing lights also provide interest.  The handle is easy to hold for little hands and the buttons are easy to push too.

product_title: Polypropylene - 9oz Sippy Cups 2 Pack
review_body: I love this! My son is 7 months old and won't take a regular sippy cup. He will take this though and seems to like it. It doesn't leak for me at all, with or without the handles on. The nipple is soft for tender gums. This seems to be able to get him used to the shape of a sippy cup while still being a bottle.

product_title: Regalo Extra Tall Guardian Expandable Gate, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The gate is metal, but everything else is cheap plastic. The round piece that turns to tighten the gate cracked the 2nd time I used it.

product_title: Baby Einstein
review_body: My 6 month old loves this ball! Shes liked it since we got it two months ago when she used it to learn to grasp. The holes make it easy for little hands to learn to hold and now she shakes it like crazy. We roll it around and play hide the ball with it. And now that shes crawling, she chases it too. Easy to take along too. Glad we bought it.

product_title: Evenflo 3 Pack Classic Clear Bottle without BPA
review_body: I am a super picky momma and actually purchased Dr. Browns and Avent bottles initially for my baby. I learned very quickly that Dr. Browns were a pain to clean. Avent was actually pretty good. But then baby girl entered daycare and I needed to pump at work thus I had to purchase a lot of bottles to send her with and to use with my medela pump. These are great! They clean really well and they attach to my medela double electric pump. Plus they are super affordable so I bought 15 bottles so I didn't have to do dishes all the time.  I would have had to pay way more if I sent her in with Avent bottles. I love that they are BPA free too! I have never had a problem with leakage and I heat the breast milk inside the bottle (sitting inside a cup of hot water) These are the best.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_body: My son did not like baby carriers, I tried a few then bought this one because my health care provider recommended it. My son loves it. The best part is that I can put him in it and clean the house.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Booster Seat, Green/Blue
review_headline: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Booster Seat, Green/Blue
review_body:
I purchased the Fisher-Price Healthy Care Booster Seat, Green/Blue after using a regular highchair for a year and a half. Although I loved being able to move my son around in the regular highchair since it allowed me to wheel him over to the sink for after meal cleanups and near me while I cooked food I always dreaded how much time I ended up spending cleaning the highchair itself. This was only made more frustrating by the cloth seat cover it came with which is now threadbare from repeated washings.

The Fisher-Price Healthy Care Booster Seat is an absolute dream to clean! It takes just a minute to wipe down the entire seat and the smaller tray is a breeze to wash off in the sink or pop into the dishwasher. My son must feel like a big kid in it because it is actually tough to keep him out of this new seat, he just loves it! He seems really comfortable in it and I don't miss wheeling him around nearly as much as I thought I would. Of course he is bigger now and is happy clanging his own pots and pans while I cook these days. It fits securely onto our chair which we can then scoot under the table so we have gained so much more space. I highly recommend this booster seat and wish I had purchased one earlier. The high weight limit means we'll probably be done using it before we actually outgrow it so I think it is a great bargain.

product_title: Me4kidz Diaper Bag Buddy Natural and Organic Baby Basic Kit,  2-Pack
review_headline: Cute little kit, not really necessary
review_body: For some reason this sounded cooler when I was reading about it, than when I actually received it and opened it up.  I think they could have made it a little more practical.  I like how its organic products, but also am not really sure where the products are made or of the quality of them.  I do like the little case they come in though, I think if you add a few more things yourself it will make for a nice first aid/diaper bag kit for on the go.  I guess it was worth buying one, but I probably wouldn't buy this again, if that makes any sense.

product_title: Safety 1st Crystal Clear Baby Monitor, White
review_body: This monitor is analog, so if you're having static or something, just rotate it a little, or move it. Ours works great, and is crystal clear most of the time. Sometimes there is a little static and then I remember I paid less than $17 for it so I shut up. I would buy again any day.

product_title: Baby Buddy Bear Pacifier Holder
review_body: I don't particularly care for the plastic clip styles that have the sliding lock. They never seem to really hold unless you have a good amount of clothing/material to clip it to. I love the little metal clip on this one. it only needs a small amount of clothing/car seat strap/etc. and it holds very well. It does not clip so tight that is damages or stretches anything though. The button snap on the pacifier side is very sturdy as well. This is the least expensive yet best made clip I have seen. I use it all the time and we never drop the pacifier. :) I would buy again. Great purchase.

product_title: Kissaluvs Cotton Fleece Fitted Diaper
review_body: We love these diapers. They don't leak, are easy to use, and easy to wash. When we told family and friends that we were going to use cloth diapers people thought we were insane. We have made friends and family believers as they see the modernized version of the cloth diapers ( no pins necessary we have upgraded to snaps!) Kissaluvs products are some of the best on the market with the superior customer service (to answer any questions that you have), durability of products, and easy use.     We use these diapers during the day, the absorbency is wonderful as our daughter has had no leaks to date. Very important to put the diaper cover on, we have forgotten a few times, as that helps keep absorbency in. Very happy with this product.

product_title: IKEA KLADD PRICKAR Bib, blue, red - SET OF 2
review_body: these are great bibs!  they do a great job of keeping the clothes of a messy toddler clean during meals.  they wash well and dry very quickly.

product_title: Regalo Hide Away Double Sided Bed Rail, White
review_body: These rails are a great deal for the price. A lot of the rails I was looking at were single rails and cost almost twice as much, so this was the perfect deal since I had to buy two sets. Like other reviewers mentioned, this can be tedious to put together. Once I had the first set put together, the second set was MUCH easier. The bar that fits in horizontally across the bottom of the rail is tough to put in. It took quite a bit of manuevering to get it in position, but at least I know it's definitely not going anywhere! I really do appreciate the hide away feature, since it will make changing sheets much easier and will allow guests to sleep in the beds without feeling like a toddler :) My only complaint is that the rails that fit in between the mattress and the boxspring are very thick. We had quite a big gap between the mattress and boxspring and I was worried that it was going to damage the bed springs. We just purchased the mattresses, so maybe I'm just overreacting. We ended up putting a few thick text books under the mattress (at the foot and head) so that the pressure was more even. Since my kids are both under 4, I don't imagine they could do much damage, but we have guests over quite a bit and I know I won't always have a chance to remove the rails. In the meantime, the books seem to do the trick and make the mattress quite a bit more even (you definitely couldn't feel the uneveness, I just knew it was there).

product_title: Booginhead PaciGrip Pacifier Holder
review_headline: for Booginhead and MAM pacifier combo users, i recommend...
review_body: I bought this booginhead as my MAM pacifier straps were useless. Unfortunately the booginhead and MAM pacifier dont work comfortably (at least for my son) together so I used the plastic circular piece from the MAM strap system and attached it to the loop on the BooginHead. NOW it is a perfect strap! I recommend trying this for any other MAM users!

product_title: Baby Banana Toothbrush
review_body: LOVE this item! My infant loves brushing her gums and brand new pearly whites with this banana!  It's been a great aid to massage her gums and has helped her teeth break through. She seems to like holding it all by herself. I attached a ring to it, and a tether to that to keep it from falling to the floor.  Highly recommend!

product_title: Fisher Price Ocean Wonders Cradle 'n Swing
review_body: I can't tell you how great this swing is!!! It does not need batteries and that is the best part! Some others mentioned squeaking but I noticed that the legs weren't straight on the carpet and once I adjusted them slightly, it was quiet and just the rhythm of the motor. It was easy to adjust, I could do it one handed holding the baby and she loved the music and the mobile. I would buy this again a million times over. The no batteries feature again, AWESOME!!!!

product_title: Charlie Banana 2-in-1 6-Piece Reusable Diapers
review_body: This diaper is a great quality diaper. I have the Apple Green one-size diaper and the color is so bright and pretty. The colors and prints from Charlie Banana are awesome! The microfleece lining continues to look like new after washing and is still so soft. This diaper is similar to the Fuzzibunz, but I prefer it for a few reasons. I like the style of the pocket opening better on the Charlie Banana, and also the shape of the front tabs better. I love the wide elastic on the back and that it includes a crossover snap. I find the fit at the top of my baby's thigh to be just a tad awkward, but it's not that big of a deal. It's just because of where the elastic is sewn in. I'd prefer it if the shape of the wing were more gradually sloped, but again, it's not that big of a deal. The quality is still great and the diaper is plenty absorbent. The inserts are nice and thick without being bulky and are super easy to stuff into the diaper and fit nicely. I'm not sure how this diaper would fit on a newborn because I didn't start using it until my baby was bigger, but the adjustable elastic is in the legs is a nice feature. This is a nice diaper!

product_title: organicKidz Wide Mouth
review_body: These bottle are great! They are replacing our glass evenflo ones. The evenflo plastic rings started cracking and I was on the hunt for a bpa free and stylish alternative. These are perfect! Baby loves them and so does mommy. Easy to fill with the wide neck. The only reason for the 4 star rating was that it is a bit tricky to get the fill measurements correct. It is a bit hard to see the fill lines on the inside of the bottle. But, that is the only complaint I have. I also love the fact that they sell a sippy spout for when your child is ready to transition. Hooray for fun bottles. :)

product_title: Fisher-Price Royal Stepstool Potty, Pink Princess (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Made without the parent in mind
review_body: This seems like a great potty.  It is a chair with a removable ring for the big potty and the boy version's penis guard is actually big enough to hold your toddlers pee in the toilet.  Your child will like being rewarded by music and being able to use it as a step stool    You will NOT like cleaning this thing.  Inevitably the lid will get dirty and then you will have the joyful task of cleaning poop and pee with q-tips because the stupid little holes on the thing (which serve NO PURPOSE) are so deep.    There was no concept of the end user in mind when this thing was designed.  It has way to many crooks and crevices for something that gets peed and pooped in.  Cleaning it will be a nightmare.  Don't buy this potty, unless you are a glutton for punishment.

product_title: Maclaren Volo Stroller - Charcoal
review_headline: Great for parents on the go!
review_body: Unlike cheap strollers, this thing is so durable and very easy to swivel around with a 30lb butterball inside. Folds super easy. Built-in shoulder strap for easy transport. Little net under kiddo for storage. Even got a cup holder (Munchkin) for the handle, so momma can have her drinks too!

product_title: Gerber Graduates BPA Free 3 Pack Kiddy Cutlery Spoons
review_body: My son has difficulty picking up food on the small plastic spoons or the metal spoons with plastic coating. These spoons provide a wide mouth and good grip so he can eat more easily with less mess.

product_title: Bright Starts Around We Go 2-in-1 Activity Center
review_body:
[[ASIN:B002VBXY40 Bright Starts Around We Go Activity Station, Doodle Bugs]]

It's pretty easy to set up. My daughter has a blast once shes in there. Only problem i have is that the pieces are week so it really doesn't hold together. I was gonna send it back but instead i had to make some home adjustments now it great.

Update: This product was great until the outcome of it months later when she started walking. My daughter became pigeon toed because of this product. Don't buy it. she kept going in circles so her right foot adjusted to always going towards he left. now she has to wear a leg brace every night to correct this. DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT!!!!

product_title: Chicco Cortina Keyfit 30 Travel System, Miro (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Love it!  The colors are great for either a boy or a girl.  Stroller is great for tall people.  I am 5'11\\" and hubby is 6'4\\".  All around wonderful product by Chicco!

product_title: Uncle Goose Swedish ABC Blocks - Made in USA
review_body: I bought these blocks for my 6 month old and his interest in these grows more as his motor skills develop. I really like that they are in my second langauge, helping me pass it on to my son.

product_title: Munchkin Sesame Street Sports Bottle, 10 Ounce
review_headline: It would've been nice to get the item pictured
review_body: My son loves elmo but instead of getting the one I ordered I got a pink and purple one - for my son.

product_title: NUK Universal 1 Pack BPA Free Pacifier Clip, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Paci-clips are so simple, but worth it. I wasn't able to find any under $6 in stores. This was a fantastic find & buy!

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon and Sophie the Giraffe Set
review_body:
My son likes these toys, but I was very surprised when we got them. They are are thin rubber and have very loud squeekers. They feel and sound like cheap dog toys.
Chan Blue is great as a pacifier, with his large nipple head.

product_title: Safety 1st All-in-One Convertible Baby Car Seat 22172
review_body: Purchased this seat at a local national store for $99.50 regular price. Bought the black version as it was all they had in stock and we love it and our 12 month old loves it too. It is a bigger seat - be sure to try out fit in small vehicles. Fits in our minivan great. Good manual/easy to understand, the seat is easy to adjust, straps stay straight, great support for napping and well padded. Our daughter is a fussy car rider and when we switched to this seat we didn't hear a peep for the entire evening. She was so content, it was great! Overpriced here on Amazon - was MUCH cheaper at the big national store that starts with a W.

product_title: Levana Safe N'See Digital Video Baby Monitor with Talk-to-Baby Intercom and Lullaby Control (LV-TW501) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I received this product and was super excited about it.  The picture is really pretty amazing even at night!  I did not like that you could not turn the volume off or down very low really and the music part is nice but only works if you have the monitor on.  My point being that I didn't necessarily want to listen to the music while looking at my baby and could not turn off the volume on my end.  The option to speak to your baby sounds like a nice idea except I think it scared my son more than soothed him.  After about a week the camera portion stopped working.  It would sometimes turn on and sometimes do nothing (I think it was a loose connection or something).  The Levana company was helpful in giving me return/exchange instructions and I am awaiting my replacement.  Hopefully the second one is a little sturdier!

product_title: CircoÂ® Comforter - Flower
review_body: I bought this as a \\"tummy time\\" blanket for my little one. Right now it works fine, since she can't scoot, but I do wish it were just a tad bit bigger.

product_title: Stop Thumb Sucking, Thumbusters, Blue
review_body: My 4 yr old was hooked on his thumb, so we needed help.  I suggest buying two Thumbusters; my son only sucked his right thumb, but when we initially implemeted the Thumbuster, my son began sucking the left thumb!  Then we used the Thumbuster in conjunction with the bitter paint-on liquid.  Because I felt it a bit cruel for my son to have to taste the bitters, we used the Thumbuster as the reminder of what was underneath...yucky stuff.  It worked great!  He loved wearing the Thumbuster, even insisted wearing it to baseball practice!

product_title: Skip Hop Baby Zoo Little Kid and Toddler Insulated and Water-Resistant Lunch Bag, Multi Otis Owl
review_body: I can't say enough about this lunch bag. It's so adorable. I looked everywhere for something small and unique enough to distinguish from all the other Thomas the train or Toy Story lunch bags. The owl and dog are so cute and good quality. First use his entire juice bottle spilled in the backpack but was just like new after a quick hand wash. Love this product and plan to buy the bookends too.

product_title: Playtex Drop-Ins System - Breast Milk Storage Kit
review_body: This is a great solution for what is already a great product.  We use these with medela and pump into the Playtex Drop-ins and the wide neck ventaires.  Material feels good, and pricing is fair.

product_title: Stork Craft Madison Stages Crib with Trundle
review_body: I had the crib sent to my daughters home a few weeks ago. I visited my new grand daugher on Christmas Day and saw the crib in her room. It is quality material and was put together well, but where is the mattress?  Was there supposed to be one?  What a let down!!  All the packaging was thrown away and I dont even know who to contact.  If a mattress is not included, there should be some notice to potential buyers.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Rocking Wood Bassinet, Meridian
review_body: This purchase was a gift and I've been told it more than met the product description. Delivery was very prompt and the bassinet was easy to put together.  After 6 months the new baby  has finally moved to a regular sized crib.  Definitely a terrific purchase.

product_title: Baby Einstein Neptune Ocean Adventure Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My little guy has been using this for 2 months now (he's 4 months now) and he really enjoys it. He constantly kicks at the toy bar, which changes the music (I don't know if he realizes that yet though). I like the options for the music and all the loops to put toys on. You can change it up as often as you like, it's really easy. I can usually get 10-20 minutes of time for myself while he's under this gym. My only complaint is that the fabric is so soft and silky that it doesn't work well for tummy time. He just slides around on it. The same goes for the stuffed whale toy it comes with it. It's supposed to be used as a prop pillow but it's slippery and a weird shape to be used for this.

product_title: American Baby Company Organic Waterproof Natural Quilted Fitted Portable/Mini Crib pad cover
review_body: As a traveling nanny, I get a chance to see many infant care products but when I had my first grandchild--well, it was a whole new experience in looking at baby products. My daughter leans heavily towards organic so I begin to research products for her.  She had invested in a quality organic which means it had no \\"plastic\\" top.  I read the reviews on this product and thought it might be worth the price.  We have been very pleased with the quality and ability to protect the mattress.      I have felt confident about this product to recommend it to my clients.

product_title: Baby Buddy Smiley Pacifier Holder
review_body: I bought thinking that I can clip her pacifier to car seat or stroller so it won't fall down every time she spits her pacifier out. Ribbon is so small that I literally have to clip it to her clothes. Its not very safe as the clip to attach to stroller is of sharp metal and baby can scratch herself real bad. Don't buy thinking its cheap. Spend little more and get something which is useful.

product_title: Foogo By Thermos Leak-Proof SS 12 oz - Straw Bottle, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Unfortunately I live in the Philippines and couldn't return the item. This straw bottle doesn't look brand new. The color of the flip cover is faded and doesn't match the shade with the rest of the body.The straw sticks out a little too much. I have to push it back to cover the top. The plastic hinge has signs of over bent? Turned white like any plastic that has been stretched beyond its limit.

product_title: Graco Pack N Play Comfy Combination, Pink and Cream (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Just received this. Right out of the box, looks like it will work well enough. Trouble is, I was looking forward to two sheets and two changing pad covers given the photos of the pink/cream combo. Plus, the sparse product description doesn't indicate differently. So, this really ends up costing twice what I thought it would.

product_title: Munchkin: Fresh Food Feeder
review_body: my daughter is still a little to young to use this but it is pretty cool she tries though and its really nice because i really dont have to worry about her choking on something because she decided to put a lot in her mouth or somehting and its nice because i can give her real foods instead of the processed baby foods:)

product_title: Bloom Nano Urban High Chair, White Frame With Seat Pad Coconut White
review_body: Worst chair ever! Looks great, but does not fold as flat as should.  Legs flair out and everyone trips on them, everyday!  Hard to clean. Cloth straps absorb food.  Overly complicated.  Any chair but this one!

product_title: PeaPod Portable Kids Travel Bed
review_headline: Excellent option for travel and home!
review_body: We bought this tent for our son in preparation for a road trip to Florida when he was just six weeks old, and I consider it one of our best baby purchases! It is incredibly portable, comfortable, and multi-functional. We've used it consistently for 8 months -at the beach, on hotel beds, and at friends' houses- and we've never had to worry about the safety of rented cribs or lugging along a pack-and-play. The mattress blows up (using the included hand pump) in about a minute. My only gripe is that the blanket that comes with it is made with sleeping-bag-like material and slips around on the bottom of the pod, so we just use a receiving blanket instead.    Oh, and use your brain. Follow the directions for taking it out of the package (it WILL pop open - that's what it's designed to do) and putting it away (if you do it correctly, it folds like a dream).

product_title: Trend Lab Set of 2 Dr.Seuss Oh! The Places You'll Go Frame Set
review_body: these are beautiful and go great in our dr seuss themed nursery. i was surprised at the size as they seem much larger than i expected. also, they are fairly heavy to hang just for a heads up. wasnt a problem for us just didnt expect it. very well made!

product_title: Wildkin Crackerjack Backpack
review_body:
We have had this nap map for over 5 months now. My daughter loves this and takes it with her to day care. It has held up great after machine wash every week for 5 months.
I highly recommend it.

product_title: aden + anais Muslin Dream Blanket
review_headline: so glad i finally bought this!
review_body: I have had my eye on this blanket for quite some time and finally decided to purchase it for my son (7 months), who loves his aden + anais swaddle wraps (especially his cozy swaddle wrap with the fish). I wanted to find a blanket that my son can grow up with and use year-round. It's nice and big and has the quality I expect from this brand. It's also super-soft and thick, right out of the package, but I love that it won't over-heat my baby.     The reason this model costs more than the others you might be looking at is it actually has 6 layers of muslin, as opposed to the other dream blankets with only 4 layers. It is called \\"extra warm and cozy\\" on the packaging. This brand's \\"cozy\\" line of swaddles and dream blankets is higher quality, thicker, and softer than the classic counterparts. This information isn't clearly expressed anywhere I have looked so I hope it helps anyone looking at these products. If you're looking for the softest, thickest muslin dream blanket, look no further!

product_title: The First Years Learning Curve First Keys Teether
review_body:
My son won't leave the house without these. They are his \\"car keys\\". So he gives them thumbs up.
I give them thumbs up because they are textured plastic, light weight, easy to handle toy that I can feel safe about him chewing on. And if he ever loses his \\"car keys\\" it will only be 2$ to get him a new set.

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_body: It is so refreshing to not have to worry about letting your child put something in his/her mouth!!! With all the worries of lead paint, this product is a a great reliever! It is made in the French Alps with natural rubber and non-toxic paint which made it's selling point with me. My child loves it and the size is perfect for little hands. I recommend this product!

product_title: Summer Infant Mothe's Touch Soothing Bassinet, Pink/White, 0-4 Months
review_body: Pros: Beautiful look. Love the colors and floral pattern. Love the extra storage on bottom. I use it for storing extra blankets. Cute plush flowers and lady bug hang above for baby to watch. The sounds it plays are nice and relaxing to listen to. The size is just right for me to move about the house.    Cons: My worst complaint is the rollers on this bassinet. It does have two that lock, however it always feels like it's locked when it's not. We have hardwood floors and it's hard to roll this bassinet from room to room. It really annoys me that I spent good money on something that can't do something as simple as rolling across a flat surface. My second complaint would be that the vibration stays on all the time when turned on. It would have been nice if it would have had a built in timer for it.

product_title: Tiny Love Tiny Princess Mobile
review_body: We got the mobile this week. I put it together in minutes. The colors are perfect for our nursery. I don't think they are too bright, they are fun! I love the movement except when the flowers flip around with the little charachters they make a small clicking sound. I don't know how this is going to affect the baby, but I loved how each little character is looking down on the baby rather than out at the adults. Also I have a convertable crib by baby cashe the \\"oxford\\" version, and with the adapted piece they sent it fits fine.

product_title: Stork Craft Tuscany 4-in-1 Convertible Crib
review_body: I was a little nervous ordering this crib despite all the great reviews, because it was so cheap.  It was something like [...], with free shipping because I have free Prime through Amazon Mom.  The crib arrived in 2 days and is so much better than I dared hope.      It didn't have any dings or scratches like some people complained about, and it was reasonably easy to put together (it took my husband and I about an hour and a half - if we took it apart in the future, I'm sure we could reassemble it much more quickly, now that we know what we're doing).  Once assembled, the crib is extremely sturdy and looks gorgeous.  The wood looks and feels high-quality, and it is a rich dark chocolate color, somewhat darker than some of the pictures make it appear.    One of the best things about this crib is that it works for tall people.  My husband is 6'3 and I'm 5'9, and I didn't want a crib where I would have to bend way down to put the baby in.  This crib allows you to set the bed height at 3 different levels.  When the baby is new, you can set it quite high to make it easy to lift the baby in and out.  When he gets older and can stand up, you can set the level lower so he can't climb or fall out as easily.    I also purchased the Sealy Soybean Foam-Core Crib Mattress, and it fits the crib perfectly, nice and tight so there are no gaps on the sides.    One caveat: the crib is just a little too wide to fit through a normal bedroom door, so make sure you set it up in the room you want to keep it in.  I'm sure you could take off one of the sides without too much difficulty if you did need to move it later.

product_title: ProGradeTM Lever Handle Lock by Safety 1st
review_headline: Does not work with doors that have levers on both sides...
review_body: THis product seemed well made and is certainly less obtrusive than other lever locks, BUT it only works on doors with lever handles on one side. My doors have levers on both sides that are connected, so if the lock is activated, you cannot open from the other side. This is a major product flaw, as such I went with the KidCo Lever lock product which does not have this issue.

product_title: Door Mouse Finger Guard by Kidkusion
review_headline: OK, depending on how you use it
review_body:
OK here's the thing. This is pretty solid for a concept. I would have given it a 2 star rating, but in all fairness, it's sold as a finger guard and a close guard and not a slam guard so that would be a little unfair.

My main contention with this product is that the foam-type material it is made of, is not very durable. The first one I deployed lasted all of 1 slam before splitting in two. I learnt quickly that these can only be used for doors not intended for ANY possibility of major slamming. It begs the question what level of finger protection is this providing, but I guess if maybe you're thinking of toddlers there may be a small case. The product page also marketed among the intended usages, preventing doors from closing. If you are prone to get locked out because of auto-locks, etc. this may help (providing it doesn't slam, break the foam and then lock anyway).

The other thing I don't like about it, is that it gets dirty real easily and it's not that cleanable (after a while the pristine white, will look sorta grimy) and nobody likes that.

Would I buy any more... ahhmm... jury's still out on that one, but right now I'm leaning towards no.

product_title: Boppy Pillow with DwellStudio® Tulip Slipcover - Pink
review_body: This Boppy is great.  The pillow is just like all of the other Boppys.  The cover is adorable.  The plush side is very soft, and the other side is soft, too.  I'm not sure why the previous reviewer said that it's not.  I think the quality of materials is comparable to the fancy Boppys that are for sale at baby stores.  It's true that the zipper is situated in a different location from most of the other Boppy pillows out there.  However, it's just as easy to get the cover off and on, and it doesn't seem to bother anyone or anything.  This is super cute and looks lovely with the Dwell Studio Tulip bedding from Target.  The colors are very rich and vivid, but it's not visually overwhelming.  I actually think it's visually stimulating for the baby to look at.

product_title: P'Kolino Little Reader Chair
review_body: I bought this chair for my little girls first birthday and couldn't be more pleased!! It is super light weight and soft. It is the perfect size. She can get in and out of it with no problem or worry that she will hurt herself if she falls.  The chair seems to have some magic ability..my daughter is a big time mover and barely sits still, but she will sit in the chair and watch an entire episode of Sesame Street!! It's a miracle! I highly recommend this chair to any mom!

product_title: Lamaze Spin and Explore The Sea (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Looks like a great concept, but is a crappy product
review_body: Okay, this product stinks.  The concept is great, but the product isn't.  The spinning thing is quite hard and not comfortable to lay on for long periods.  My 4-month old is much happier laying in the same position on something that's much softer, like a boppy pillow (which we don't have, but he likes the one at his daycare).  We have 3 tummy time mats, and this one is by far the worst quality.  It constantly bunches up and is pilling even though it's barely been used.  The bunching up issue is even worse since the mat/spinner set are designed so a baby would really be grabbing onto the mat while spinning - so you'd think the mat would be a little sturdier to grab onto, but the way it is, it's really hard for the baby to grab and spin.

product_title: Mommy's Helper Bath Mat Froggie Collection, Green, 6-48 Months (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I wanted a small non slip mat so I could give my daughter (now 7 months) a bath in the kitchen sink. It fits great!  In the past I had her sit on a washcloth, but I was afraid she would hurt her foot on the drain.  This is perfect for the sink!  In my opinion, it's way too small for a tub.

product_title: Taggies Taggies Fun Shapes Flower Plush (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I bought one of these when my daughter was a month old and at six months this is still her favorite toy. She has clocked more hours chewing on her Taggies flower than anything else I can think of.

The \\"tags\\" themselves have faded, but that is probably more because I toss this thing into the washing machine every few weeks because of how gross it gets otherwise. I don't remember what the instructions say, but I've machine washed and dried (on low) quite a few times now and it has held up very well. The satin applique is starting to come off, but oh well. I'd rather it be clean. All the washing hadn't affected the rattle, either, which I'm quite impressed by. All in all this was a great purchase.

product_title: Boba Classic Baby Carrier, Twilight (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have tried many different wraps and carriers and by far the Boba Classic is THE most comfortable and secure of them all. I will never use another carrier again. The idea of \\"you get what you pay for\\" is so true with this product - it's pricey, but it is worth every penny to get a quality carrier.    This Boba carrier is designed to hold children from 15lbs to 45 lbs; my daughter is just shy of 15lbs and my son is 33lbs and I have used it with both of them. It takes well over an hour of carrying my infant daughter before my back even BEGINS to hurt, which is phenomenal in my experience. Of course, i'm also overweight and in horrible shape, so if you are someone who actually takes care of themselves, this carrier might NEVER cause you to hurt!   I must say that it's nearly impossible to carry my son in this carrier... and pretty much any carrier. I honestly don't see how it's possible to carry such a large, heavy child in ANY contraption. It's just plain not good for your body. But IF i HAD to carry him in something the Boba carrier would be my choice.   It's simply the strongest and most comfortable carrier I've ever used. When my child is secured in it i never feel like she's going to fall out or shift around. I also love the variety of ways to adjust the carrier, so it truly fits any body shape. It's easy to use and put on and it also doesn't tangle up like some other carriers. Even though the \\"Twilight\\" color would not be my first choice, it's still such a beautifully constructed carrier that it's attractive in any color. One of the best features of this carrier is the roll-up cover for baby - it's RIGHT there, you don't have to search for it, it unrolls quickly and easily - and it's just as easily put away! Genius!    Overall, this is the best carrier i've ever used and I highly recommend it!

product_title: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Jumperoo
review_body:
ATTENTION Amazon and potential buyers of this Laugh and Learn jumperoo. First off, in fairness, I do admit that this product looks like it would be a ton of fun for our little one. This is, in fact, what most of the reviews have claimed AND the main reason we purchased it. HOWEVER, when the price says \\"Buy New\\", you must not believe that you will be receiving a new product. This jumperoo just arrived today and our 6-month-old watched excitedly as I pulled out all of the colorful parts, in anticipation of getting to play with and slobber all over each and every one of them. As I began putting the base together, I noticed scuffs and cuts on all of the plastic pieces, as well as scrapes from obvious use on each of the metal support poles.

Long story, short, I attempted to find a Customer Service number for Amazon to alert them of this problem. No such luck. Skimmed through each and every page that might be related to anything customers would need help with, and found absolutely nothing. To make matters worse, I called the Customer Service number provided on the Fisher-Price registration card, only to have the pleasure of listening to rind after unanswered ring, before finally having a loud BUSY SIGNAL go off in my ear. Fisher-Price does not even have a recording to let you be a bit less frustrated with having to call back during business hours.

The option to simply return the item is not acceptable, as the people that pack these on a daily basis have a much better idea as to how everything fits in the box, and I do not feel like I can trust Amazon to ship me what I paid for, which is a new product, right out of the box, as opposed to a used product that was used then put back in the box.

If anyone has the Customer Service number for Amazon, it would be much appreciated if you would post it here.

Best of luck to you, if you decide to purchase this \\"Jip-eroo\\". You're going to need it.

product_title: Britax B-Ready Stroller BLACK
review_headline: A really, really great double stroller!
review_body:
Five and a half years ago, when we first bought a double stroller, there were limited options that allowed you to have seats positioned somewhat like the way you can put two seats on this stroller. We ended up with a Valco Runabout because at the time it was one of the few you could put a second seat on and also take it off and still use it as a single. However, when I saw this stroller I knew it was time to finally retire the Valco, especially since I'd been ready to do so for awhile.

There are lots of things I really like about this stroller. The numerous options for how the seats can be used, the fact that our infant car seat can easily attach to if we choose (we own the Britax Chaperone), and the possible accessories for it as well. I like the fact that it came with a rain cover, a cup holder, the car seat attachments, and a detachable storage bag. It steers extremely well, it folds and unfolds really easily, it has a wonderful canopy (as does the optional second seat), and it has a really great sized basket. The basket is also easily accessible even with the second seat attached and occupied because it has zippered openings on the other three sides of the stroller. And the brake is a very easy to use push pedal, and has a nice green/red indicator to tell you if it's on or not. We even discovered somewhat accidentally that it can be pulled along while folded (if you use the footrest as a handle), which is nice.

We have also flown internationally with this stroller three times so far (with the optional second seat attached), gate checking it each time, and it's held up really well. We've gotten compliments from the airline crews on the stroller each time, primarily due to how quickly I can fold it when we get to the door of the plane.

The only cons I've found in almost six months of use are the fact that the straps come apart rather easily when you're trying to buckle your child in, the basket can brush against the front wheels if your child pushes their feet forward too much (or if you were to put a lot in it weight-wise, I suspect - there is a weight limit for the basket, though), and the detachable storage bag is pretty much useless with a second seat attached, since it attaches in the same spot. The shoulder straps are designed to separate from the waist portion, which isn't necessarily a bad feature, but they do it a bit too easily, sometimes slipping out as you're trying to buckle the child in. In terms of the basket brushing against the front wheels, it does so where there's a bar sewn into it when it's been shoved too far forward by the child in the bottom seat. (So far only when there are other items in the basket for the child to push on, though.) I suspect it may eventually wear through, even if it only wears through to the sewn-in bar as opposed to wearing a hole into the basket itself, so hopefully Britax will eventually offer the option of replacing the basket, especially since it shouldn't be too hard to remove it and put on a new one. (Most of the basket, other than the front panel, can be removed from the stroller, I would assume for cleaning purposes.)

Ultimately, given the positives for the stroller, I can live with the shoulder strap issue. In terms of the basket, like I said, hopefully Britax will eventually offer it as a replacement part so that if it does wear through, we can get a new one and use this stroller for years to come. I could wish the stroller in general had cost a bit less, but given what we paid for our Valco five and a half years ago, this one didn't strike me as hideously priced. I'd most definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a really nice double stroller.their feet forward too much (or if you were to put a lot in it weight-wise, I suspect - there is a weight limit for the basket, though), and the detachable storage bag is pretty much useless with a second seat attached, since it attaches in the same spot.
