product_title: Razbaby RaZberry Teether
review_body: The berry part is very big and barely fits in my 5 month old's mouth.  I love the idea of it and it's really gummy-perfect for her while she's teething.  The thing is just too big she gets frustrated it won't fit in her mouth.

product_title: Summer Infant Extra Camera for Sleek & Secure Monitor - Silver
review_body: We got this with our second child, SO wish we would've w/ our first! It is awesome! NO complaints!!  We can see both kids in each of their rooms!

product_title: Milestone Personalized Girl Handprint Photo Frame
review_body: I was NOT pleased with this girl's photo frame kit. It comes with a PURPLE clay for your child's handprint. I would NOT have bought this item had that information been disclosed.

product_title: Born Free Twist n Pop BPA Free Straw Cup, 1-pk, Blue
review_headline: Love it for my older Toddler!
review_body: We have used these straw cups for a while now and LOVE them for the most part. It's hard to find any cup on the market quite this large! They do leak, so I wouldn't recommend them for really young children. My 2 1/2 year old loves them and never spills them.

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_body: We love this product! We have used these ever since my son stopped being swaddled at 4.5 months. Great product.

product_title: Secure Transitions Inflatable Baby Tub
review_body: Overall this is a great inflatable bathtub. My 20 month (almost 21 month) old fits in it quite nicely with room to spare. He loves to point at the cute little colorful ocean creatures that are music themed. The bottom is not inflatable, it's a textured flat surface (which may or may not be a downside for someone; I would kind of prefer it to be inflated). It also has holes for storage on one side which are nice, but they tend to fill with water. Also, if you don't remove the inflatable tub from your bathtub after use then the bottom gets slimy, but they all tend to be that way.

product_title: Evenflo Classic Johnny Jump Up, Frogs (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We bought this for my daughter when she turned 4 months old.  At first she loved it.  Once she got the hang of how to jump she started smashing her face in the doorway.  If your baby is just going to sit there and hang out it's a great product but if your baby wants to jump at all it is not a safe baby product.  I can't use it with my daughter because she gets hurt even with me sitting right there with her.

product_title: Munchkin Arm & Hammer Diaper Pail
review_body: I am in love this diaper pail because it eradicated the smell of baby/toddler poop from my son's room. The two other diaper pails I used before purchasing this one just didn't do the trick (would start to smell after 2 or more diapers). Not sure if it's the baking soda or the design (it feels like the diaper is being sucked down to some far away place) of the Munchkin diaper pail but it is certainly an odor eater.

product_title: Imse Vimse Soft Diaper Covers - Hoop and Loop - Large - White
review_body: I have tried several different covers, and this one is my favorite. I love the bit soft closure area, which closes very securely. The tabs even stay close in the wash, preventing them from getting hung up on other items. The material is a bit stretchy and have a close, slim fit, so they have a smaller overall appearance under clothes. We use them over Motherease fitted cloth diapers and it is a perfect fit. The large fits our 18 month old, who wears 24 m to 2t clothes.

product_title: Mommy's Helper Contoured Cushie Step Up, 1 Count
review_headline: Pretty Good But A Little Unstable
review_body: We got this for our 2 year old daughter and we use it every day. It's not quite as stable as we had hoped, but our little girl is able to use it herself and it folds down nicely to be fairly compact. Overall, we are happy with it and would buy it again.

product_title: Stokke Xplory Summer Kit
review_body: I only want to write this review to let people know that if you have a stroller earlier than 2009, this kit will not fit.  I tried to make it work but there have been so many changes to the new seat that it wasn't possible.    Too make this kit work without buying a whole new stroller, you can buy the 2010 seat/textile kit (for $400).  I was told by a 'Stokke' person that the new seat would fit on the old chassis.  So that's a cheaper option.    Other than Stokke making awesome strollers that last so long, that their textiles and seats become dated, so you have to spend money on redecorating, Stokke is the best stroller ever.

product_title: Electronic Crib Rocker Sleeper for Crying Baby's
review_body: I was really excited to get this and see if it helped my 16 month old finally sleep through the night. Unfortunately, it didn't even vibrate the entire rung of the crib it was attached to, much less the entire crib! I returned it....good news though, Amazon.com is wonderful about accepting returns!

product_title: ReUsies 2 Pack Snack and Sandwich Reusable Bags, Peace Out
review_body: Great product and it helps save the environment!  The 2 sizes are great and they are easy to clean.

product_title: Smart Mom Teething Bling Donut Teething Necklace
review_body: A friend of mine told me about this product.  Thank God!!  It helped my teething baby so much that I started buying them for my pregnant friends!

product_title: Wubbanub Soft Toy and Pacifier
review_body: I received the princess and the doggie as a shower gift.  When I initially saw them I thought it seemed like a great concept but it wasn't the type of pacifier I had used for my older daughter so I packed it up with the other \\"maybe's\\" I had gotten from the baby shower.    We came with our new baby girl from the hospital realizing that we only left there with ONE of the paci's that the hospital had used and as most know one paci just isn't goig to do it so I grabbed one of the paci's that I had intended on using for my daughter.  The ones I had actually registered for and to my dismay she would not even CONSIDER it (I had probably 10 of the ones I thought I would use). So I started digging around in the \\"maybe box\\" and I soon learned that these are the same kind of paci that the hospital used so I broke these out and tried them.    My daughter didn't like them very much as a newborn because they're pretty big and it was easy for her to accidentally pull out the paci and they were bulky sitting on this tiny baby (tiny meaning almost 7.5lbs).  Again, put them back on the \\"maybe\\" shelf and bought the plain pacifiers from the store.  When my daughter was around 2 1/2 months we tried these once again and YAY!!  They're wonderful!  She's learned how to hold onto it, play with it and chew on it.  This little paci/toy entertains her for HOURS!  We LOVE IT!  So my advice to anyone who might try these and their babies not like them at first... give them another try once the baby gets a bit older.  I don't think these are the best for newborns but work great once your baby starts better developing their motor skills.  Here is my final assessment:    PROS  1. Baby can hold it themselves and put the paci back in their mouth.  2. Once baby is past the initial \\"newborn\\" stage the size is perfect for little hands to hold  3. Makes for a great little teething toy and \\"security blanket\\"  4. Its easy to find in the dark or when baby spits the paci out.  It usually just lands on her chest or lap.    CONS  1. My daughter is always cross-eyed looking at it because a lot of the time she's sucking the paci while playing with the toy.    2. The paci doesn't come loose from the toy and sometimes when I hold my daughter the toy gets in the way and the paci comes out.  Hard to have her head laying on my shoulder with the paci  3. It's not the easiest to clean.  Once again, if the paci could be taken off the toy this would clear that up issue.    All in all... I would defiitely buy these for friends and family having babies.

product_title: Europa Baby Geneva Convertible Crib
review_body: We received the Europa Baby Geneva crib yesterday and we are so impressed!  I have been so stressed about purchasing the right crib, but we highly recommed this crib!  The packaging was excellent.  Each piece was individually wrapped and we found no dents or scratchs.  The instructions for putting the crib together were easy to understand and my husband and I put the crib together in less than an hour.  It is very sturdy and great quality wood! It does have alittle bit of the industrial smell that some of the reviews talked about, but I hope that will go away soon.  We loved the crib so much we ordered the changing table!

product_title: North States Superyard 3 in 1 Metal Gate
review_body: Very nice metal baby superyard.  This is a 3 in system.  It is easily put together and very nicely made.  Well worth the money!

product_title: Lambs and Ivy Luv Bugs Night Light, Plum
review_body:
I got this to go with the set and it's perfect for my baby girl's room.
The colors are exactly as shown.
It comes with the light bulb.
This picture shows only the night light cover which is for the most part, flat, and clips onto the plug-in socket assembly.
The light is manually turned on and off by a small, neutral white switch (which their picture does not show) that shows down below the bottom of the night light cover.
The butterfly is completely opaque, but the light shines through the flower and around from behind, giving a very pretty effect.

product_title: Manhattan Toy Zonks Rattle
review_body: A little heavier than I thought it would be and not quite as interesting to my baby as I thought it'd be either. Good toy for two-handed grabbing and as she gets older, she seems to be more interested than before.

product_title: Kids Line Bella Musical Mobile, Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We got the bedroom set that went with this mobile, and it's just perfect, goes with everything.  We love, & think our little princess will enjoy it when she arrives. :)

product_title: Medela Swing Single Electric Breast Pump
review_body: nao recebi o produto ainda,estou decepcionado com a amazon.com, pois foi minha primeira compra.o produto ja esta atrasado em uma semana

product_title: Sassy Rattlin Ring, Blue /Black
review_body: I bought this for my son when he was about a month old and he did not have much interest in this at all until he was almost 3 months. Now that he's 7 months old, this is his must have toy to be around. He plays with it on the change table, his swing, in the car seat, in the stroller and even on his floor mat. I don't know what it is, but he loves to chew on it and just swing it around crazily. The toy is very well made and the colors are nice. It's easy to clean, just use soapy water, rinse, air dry and it's ready for him the next day.

product_title: Luvable Friends Diaper Bag - Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great idea but not made well
review_body: After reading the reviews on this diaper bag and several other one I decided that this was the one I wanted.  I wanted a bag that I could carry all my baby's items in and have an area for me to keep my credit cards, checkbook, keys and other small personal items in so I didn't have to carry a purse anymore. When I received it I was pleasantly surprised at how much it could hold.  I had all my stuff from my old diaper bag in it and still had room to put some other things in there if I wished.  The front pockets were perfect at holding all my wallet stuff.  And the side pockets great for bottles or in my case medicines and lip gloss.      My problem with this bag came about 3 weeks after I had been carrying it around.  I was getting out of my car when I went to get the bag out of the back seat the strap came completly off the side.  It didn't rip but more or less got pulled out of the seam.  My mother stitched it up for me with some embrodary thread and it was good as new.  Well, two weeks later the same seam ripped wide open.  When that happen the lining on the inside ripped too.  I am so disappointed at the craftsmanship of this item.  I now have to find a new diaper bag that I like as much as I had liked this one at the beginning.

product_title: Woolino Baby Sleeping Sack - 4 Season - Merino Wool - 2 Month - 2 Year
review_headline: WOOLINO Merino Wool Baby Sleep Sack
review_body: This amazing 100% natural sleep sack for baby is very luxurious as described! What a great gift it is to get current/future parents. The fact that it is made from natural merino wool adds on to our cause in keeping things green around the house.

product_title: Chicco Liteway Stroller, Fuego (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We bought this stroller to replace our travel system (and a cheaper umbrella stroller). So far it is great. I love the color (all of our son's \\"gear\\" is red, so this fits in perfectly), he seems pretty comfortable in it, it folds easily and is pretty light. I would definitely recommend this stroller!

product_title: Doidy Cup - Blue color
review_body: My son would not take a bottle, so by 5 months old he was learning to drink from this cup.  He had it down quickly which really made our lives easier.  And we skipped the whole bottle and sippy cup stage.  The design is excellent and it is also BPA free (which we should all be conscious of now).  We ended up ordering a second one for convenience.  This is a must have for any kid.  Highly recommend it.

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_body: I did a lot of research prior to purchasing this carseat. Its a perfect fit for my car, not to mention very stylish. It looks a lot more expensive than what I actually payed for it. In terms of safety, I don't think anything can beat Britax, however, I definitely feel this carseat comes close! Its superior quality and has a lot of really good features. I'm very happy with my purchase and I would recommend it to my friends with without a doubt!

product_title: Angelcare Baby Movement and Sound Monitor, Blue
review_headline: Great Peace of Mind & AMAZING Sound Monitor
review_body: We bought this for the peace of mind for the sensor, but it also has proved to be an amazing monitor.  So nice to know the temperature of his room. And loved the sound quality, especially because our house is large and his room was very far from ours.  Never had an issue with static or crackling.  Great that it could be \\"off\\" until he made a noise, and you can set the sensitivity level of that too.  We did have a few alarms, but I think they were because we placed it wrong.  Once he was standing up we just used the monitor and loved it.  Fabulous and highly recommend!!!

product_title: NUK Orthodontic Latex Nipples, Slow Flow, Size 1
review_body: the brand NUK is my favorite brand for nipples they dont let my lil girl jus chug down a bottle is a few gulps helps with less burping because there isnt as much air getting in to her tummy so she isnt fussy either

product_title: Munchkin BRICA GoBoost Travel Booster Seat
review_body: The Munchkin booster is the must have if you travel with you little one! We recently hit the beach for the christmas holiday, which meant staying in a condo. It was so nice having this portable high chair with us. I would recommend to all mom's!

product_title: UPPAbaby G-Luxe Stroller, Jake (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: All of the other positive reviews are correct about the features and convenience of this stroller: lightweight, good sun protection, seat recline, stands folded, reasonable price, etc.  When planning a trip to Europe with our 13 month-old last summer, I obsessively researched umbrella strollers and this was the big winner. It worked wonderfully in some of the least child-friendly places: airports/planes, elevators/escalators, cobblestones, public transportation... you name it.  We used it in airports (sometimes running to make connecting flights) and it easily folded to go through the x-ray scanners and we had no problem \\"gate checking\\" it when we reached our flight. It's so lightweight, I was worried that it might be flimsy.  However, it stood up to the roughest terrain and we're still using it almost daily a year later with our 30-pound 2 year-old.  This is one of the few baby gear products that I am almost evangelical about.  HIGHLY recommend.

product_title: Munchkin Arm & Hammer Diaper Pail
review_body: It sure keeps the stink in, but pushing a really bloated poopy diaper through the \\"sphincter\\" could prove to be a problem.  I've had to wrap a second diaper around the first a couple times, if the mess was oozing too much.  Sometimes even the best diaper-folders can't get it all in. We like it though.

product_title: Skip Hop Saddle Bag
review_headline: great little addition to your stroller!
review_body: I love this for walks and shopping trips when I don't need the diaper bag. It holds a lot more than you'd think! I can fit a few diapers, wipes, juice box, snack bag, my wallet, cell phone, sunscreen, and keys. It attaches really securely to our stroller and is easy to get in and out of. We have to remove it before we fold our stroller (Bumbleride Indie), but it's not a big deal and super quick. I do wish there was an option to have a longer strap so it could also be used as a small diaper bag, which is hard to find. It's also nice to have the mesh pocket on the side for a sippy or bottle.

product_title: Angel Dear Blankie
review_body: This is so soft you almost can't believe it. There are many different critters and each is cutter than the last. they are very small but just right for babies and toddlers and could prove to be a favorite blankie for years to come. They are maybe a little steep at $12 but all baby stuff is priced crazy like that so just spring for it!

product_title: Sassy Baby Food Nurser
review_body: This product is great, they are easy to fill and clean. I love the no air system for my grandson.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Natural Flow Preemie Standard Nipple, 3 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These nipples are perfect for breastfed babies taking their first bottles because the flow is slower than most Level 1 nipples.  Highly recommended!

product_title: Instant Murals 18 Vibrant Butterfly and Ladybug Wall Transfer Stickers
review_body: This product was one of several wall decals we bought for our daughter's room. Most were peel and stick and look very nice. But these you have to tape to the wall, then rub to release the decal. It is very difficult to do. I have 18 to do and I can only manage to rub a couple on before I am exhausted and need to take a break. And I am not out of shape! I workout, do karate, yoga, dance and have a 4 and 6 year old! I am a very active person! Once you manage to rub the decal enough to start releasing, the paper streches with the rubbing, the decal shifts, wrinkles, cracks, and the small appendages of the critters most of the time don't transfer.The decals look nice once transfered if none of the above happens (maybe 1 in 6), but they are not worth the $ or trouble! The only thing good about this product is I can scrape them off the wall with my nails and I don't have to paint over them!

product_title: GEENNY Boutique Crib Bedding Set, Horse Western Cowboy, 13 Piece
review_body: Great price for all that is included...I love it and so does everyone who sees it...especially the price...would definitaly recommend...

product_title: Sony 900 MHz BabyCall Nursery Monitor with Receivers (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this monitor. We've used both the stay-on feature as well as the voice-activated one. We can hear clearly no matter where in our house or yard we are. No interference experienced yet but we live in a house not an apartment building like some of the other reviews. We would highly recommend.

product_title: Dekor Plus Refill
review_headline: The best diaper pail on the market
review_body:
This is by far the best diaper pail on the market. Prior to owning this make, we had a [[ASIN:B002IWYXH4 Baby Trend Diaper Champ Deluxe, Blue]] and I had a chance at our local baby store to put my hands on all the other models.

Pro:

Double seal system keeps odors in.
Foot peddle opener makes it easy to open lid.
Super easy to change bags.
Will convert to a regular trashcan when baby is out of diapers.

Cons:

Top heavy; baby can easily tip it over (although it usually remains closed).
Replacement bags are expensive. Wish I could find a cheaper alternative.

Overall, this is clearly the leader in diaper pails. Don't fall for the gimmicks the other manufacturers are trying to sell you.

product_title: Birds in Tree Repositional Wall Decal
review_body: These are so adorable in our daughter's nursery. We have a birdie theme going and these matched perfectly. They are the static cling stickers that remove easily but they do stay put just fine once you place them... we also have a semi-gloss glitter paint on her walls so maybe that's why it stays so well. We love this!

product_title: My Brest Friend Deluxe Nursing Pillow
review_body: The cushion has two raised bumps.  One of these bumps caused a dent in the baby's head after prolonged use.  We had to cut through the foam to remove reduce the bump so that we could avoid a cranio-facial specialist.  I would have given it 4 stars if it didn't have these stupid bumps.  It would also be better if it were longer.

product_title: Munchkin Stroller Cup Holder, Colors May Vary
review_body: Holds drinks well; be careful of placement though - can make the fast fold-up of the umbrella stroller tricky (the attachment that holds the holder - if you are using it for the child's benefit, as I did).

product_title: Britax Boulevard 65 CS Click & Safe Convertible Car Seat
review_body: We are so glad we went with this car seat. It is VERY easy to use. First installation only took about 15 minutes, and the instructions were easy to understand. Strapping my one year old in is a breeze. I love how easy it is to adjust the straps too. Never have to re thread the straps. The seat is very soft and my one year old falls asleep in it all the time.

product_title: Ultimate Car Seat Travel Bag
review_body: We got this for our Graco Snugride 32 carseat. The seat and base fit in it very easily. The bag was really helpful for our trip. The backpack-style shoulder straps mean the carseat is one less thing you have to carry, which is a huge help when traveling with a baby! I do wish it had a little more protective padding, but overall, this was a great purchase!!!

product_title: Bedtime Originals Baby Zoo Wallpaper Border - Chocolate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I wanted to give this product five stars just for its cuteness but I could not simply do that. The wallpaper border was easily installed and looks great. My problem was the fact that I needed more than one roll to complete the nursery border and rolls DID NOT MATCH at all. The colors are much more saturated and dark on one roll than the other.It is very noticable and disappointing. I can live with it for now but I am seriously considering ordering another roll to see which one will make the best match and replacing it with the one that doesn't match.

My suggestion, if you order more than one roll, open all rolls immediately and check the color saturation/richness to make sure they match before installing. I did not do this, and had I done this, I would have ordered more and found the best matches and returned the ones that did not match.

product_title: Badger Basket Baby Changing Table with Six Baskets
review_body: Sooooo...... we received this product with anticipation. This will be our first child and we were just excited to get the product and put it together. Halfway through we noticed that one of the main side panels was cracked almost all the way through. We sent for a new piece, which was actually set up very nicely on their website, but now thinking back in retrospect probably doesn't make them look good, like it happens all the time kind of thing. So a couple of weeks later we received the replacement and then noticed that while screwing two pieces together, the piece of wood started to crack. Not sure what they use for wood, and I know that this was only $150 (which, I think is alot of $) I would expect a little better quality.  I would not recommend this due to all the problems and the quality of wood.

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Kick and Play Piano
review_body: The piano was perfect for my son. He loved kicking the keyboard while lying on his back when he couldn't sit up yet and now at 7 months he continues to be intrigued by the blinking lights and likes playing it with his hands. It's quiet so it is perfect for a nursery, and the keys are easy to press. I do wish there was an option for the keys to just play the notes without a melody playing out after each note.   The piano attaches to the crib securely, and the strings are short enough to not cause any worry. As a bonus, it looked super cute in the crib :)

product_title: Levana Wireless Audio Baby Monitor with Sound Indicator LEDs (LV-TW100) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Very basic, analog audio baby monitor with vox. Not a great value.
review_body: After playing around with the [[ASIN:B004CLZHA6 Levana Wireless Audio Baby Monitor with Sound Indicator LEDs (LV-TW100)]] I have it's not going to be a monitor that I keep using and here's why:    The Bad  1. Analog 400Mhz so it's easy for anyone with a scanner to listen in  2. Although it has vox (voice operated switch which means that the transmitter only turns on with sounds of a certain loudness) it's not adjustable. So no listening to baby's breathing etc. Only fairly loud sounds will activate the transmitter. This may be a good thing for some folks but not for me since I want to listen in on whatever is happening.    The Good  1. Very small and portable  2. Comes with AC Adapters for transmitter and receiver but these are 120v only so may not be appropriate for travelling to some countries  3. Decent Range. Should be fine in most wood-frame North American houses    At $30 it's not a bargain by any means and you can probably get a better analog monitor like the [[ASIN:B0031M9CL2 Safety 1st Glow And Grow Baby Monitor, White]] for about $5 less.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Knot It Bag Dispenser
review_body: I bought prince lionheart's seat covers and liked the product so much that I didn't have a second thought getting the knot it bag.  The items come with an extra roll of bags.  they are big and handy.

product_title: Dreambaby Extra Tall Gate, Two Gates and Two Extensions Value Pack, White
review_body: Just installed this gate and it is sturdy, well made, tall and opens fairly easily.  Very happy with it.

product_title: Munchkin Arm and Hammer Nursery Fresheners
review_body: They don't work for very long (a few days). In addition, the packaging is such that there is only one \\"box\\" for all 5 fresheners, and so you have to use all 5 at the same time because they all stop working at the same time. All in all, the effect was hardly noticeable, so save yourself some money and save the planet some junk and pollution.

product_title: Regalo Hide Away Bed Rail
review_body: Installation instructions were easy to follow. It got a bit tricky when you had to pull the mesh along the tubes, but with a bit more effort I was able to do it successfully. My husband and I were able to attach it to our son's queen size bed. He's 2 and rolls around a lot in bed. I thought about getting the extra long bed rail but then opted for the regular size after reading a review saying that there was no need for the extra long because the regular size one works just as well and covers a good bit of the side of the bed. After having purchased the bed rail I agree with the review. The only set-back is that you do struggle a bit making it hide-away with the knobs on the side. That doesn't bother me as much though as the fact that there is a part of the bed-rail that sticks out when hiding away. I'm afraid my son or I will bump into them so we keep the bed rail up most of the time except for when I make the bed. I hope I didn't install it incorrectly on the bed, but I don't like the part that sticks out in case of injury. When it's up I don't have any worries. We are happy with it because most importantly my son has not fallen off the bed during sleep, which is exactly why we bought it.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: Sophie the giraffe is a must have baby toy! My now.. 6 month old daughter, Audrey absolutely loves Sophie. It's great for teething..babies love that rubber. The colors of Sophie mesmerize her. She grabs her easily and can pass Sophie back from hand to hand by the neck. The legs are long and easily held as well.. also great for chewing on. Audrey could easily make Sophie squeak.. but the only negative thing I have to say is the squeaker sounds like it's running out of juice... maybe it got stepped on or something. Overall, Sophie is an excellent buy!

product_title: BABY SPOON & FORK - BABY SPOON & FORK, SILVER PLATED. [Baby Product] by Creative Gifts
review_body: I bought this in conjunction with the baby cup. Makes a great affordable gift.  Very cute. Something to save.  Design is cute and items are well made.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body:
After perusing the hundreds of the 5 star reviews, we added Sophie to our baby registry. Then we read the 1 star reviews. Turns out, this TEETHING toy is a choking hazard. We promptly removed Sophie from our registry. We received Sophie as a gift anyway.

Sophie is one of her favorite teething toys, and we have not had any choking hazards (our daughter is 6 months). Even though Sophie is very cute, we remember that she is a killer. Still, we let our daughter play with the giraffe when we are right there with her

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'n Swing
review_body: This is so worth the money!!! My daughter loved the thing & its super safe & i never had to worry about her in it !!!!!!

product_title: HALO 100% Cotton Sleepsack Swaddle
review_body: I had purchased this before my baby was born based on reviews here and other websites and was happy to see that the hospital where I delivered used the same swaddle! My daughter is instantly calmed once she is swaddled in this (mind you she usually  cries like crazy while you're trying to put her in it though!) I think the reviewer who said this should be recalled didn't put it on correctly. You need to make sure that the outer part is below the inner part in the back, so that it is doesn't bunch up around the baby's mouth in the front. Last night the zipper part of the sleepsack was against her mouth and I couldn't figure out what was wrong until I saw that the back part of the outer wrap was above the inter sleep sack.Once we took it off, put baby higher and re-swaddled, it was fine. You also need to make sure the swaddle part is pulled tight (pull on the fabric as you wrap the left side over and around baby's back a little,  then pull the right side over tight and velcro closed.)     Also, my baby is wearing the premie size and it fits her great - she is 6 lbs. I think it says for baby's up to 5 lbs, but I think it's the perfect size for her right now. We have the newborn size too, but we only use it when the other one is dirty because it's big - but really just in the length so no big deal.     Buy this - you won't be disappointed (as long as you're putting it on correctly!)

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Infant to Toddler Rocker, Alpha Fun (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: there was a little problem at first getting the boys used to it but now they seem to like it they fall asleep easily and it gives me a chance to get the dishes done.

product_title: J.L. Childress Gate Check Bag For Standard and Double Strollers, Red
review_body: After 3 uses it is already starting to show signs of wear. There is a tear along the top of the bag near the pull strings.

product_title: SISI Baby Bedding - Forest Friends 15 PCS Crib Bedding Set
review_body: This is a cheerful happy crib set.  Easy to work with.  I am very pleased with this choice.

product_title: Cloud b Sound Machine Soother
review_body: We had purchased a sleep sheep a year or two ago for my son as he preferred white noise to music - we since lost the noise box and had another baby so we bought another one and they have only improved the product!  Snuggly, adorable and soft the stuffed sheep is terrific and the noise box is great.  You can have it continually play or have 2 timer options.  I love the whale noises, and the rain is very nice too.  Much easier on the ears than some other noises.  Highly recommend!

product_title: Boppy Prenatal Total Body Pillow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I should have bought this during my 4th month of pregnancy with twins not my 6th!!!! It really does support the weight of my belly. I recommend it to all preggers out there!

product_title: Dream On Me 4 In 1 Mini Convertible Crib
review_headline: baby got too big for it!
review_body: Great product and looks nice, but my grandson grew out of it too soon, he is very long, so only lasted 7 months for him, but other than that it is a good crib for small area

product_title: Podee Convert A Bottle Feeding Kit
review_body: Thought this item would be great for traveling alone with the baby, but she cannot suck hard enough to get the formula up through the straw.  Probably would be used better with a child 7 months or older.

product_title: Room Magic Toy Box
review_body: The box itself is beautiful, but the hinge already broke.  Beware!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  It broke and hit my son in the head.  Poor thing has a huge bump!

product_title: Kolcraft Universal 2 Infant Car Seat Carrier (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I don't have a car but love this
review_body: I take the bus and trolley to get around but when I think I may go someplace where someone will give me a ride home after the buses have stopped running...I use this stroller...I can accept a ride since I have his car seat with me.   He's 15 months old and I still use it for walking him in the evening..he pushes the stroller until he is tired and then I pop him in and he falls asleep almost instantly..reclining comfortably..looking at the sky and able to look at me as i sing to him..I love to be able to see him as he drifts off to sleep.  This is light and very well made...love it!  I have two other strollers I use for quick trips but this one definately has it's purpose.

product_title: WubbaNub Tabby Kitten Pacifier
review_body: I love this, even though my baby quit using pacifiers, he still hugs his Wubbanub to sleep. I can easily hand wash/hang dry the kitten. it has proven to be very durable. the pacifier is well stitched to the stuffy. I am very pleased with this product.

product_title: Munchkin Reversible Strap Covers, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: So soft, and LIME green. Perfect!
review_body: I bought these and I also bought the JJ Cole reversibles. I must say these are softer than the JJ Coles. They are also thinner widthwise, which I think is a plus. However, they are also thinner plush-wise, which some parents may think makes them safer to use as they won't add any unsafe cushion to the seatbelt.  I don't mind, and actually hoped to get, the lime green. It matches the Instep Bike Trailer I bought them for. The velcro is very sturdy (also a plus over the JJ Cole as the velcro on those is a little flimsy). The inside is a plush pile like a newborn teddy bear toy, and the other side is a silky satiny shiny short-hair fur. I love them.

product_title: Bumkins Diaper 3 Pack Cover Bundle
review_body: These diaper covers have been great for me. I line dry all my laundry, and for me the main advantage is that they dry VERY quickly. I can hand wash and line dry them in 1/2 hour on a warm day. Odors and stains wash away relatively thoroughly because the fabric is thin and lightweight--I find this design more sanitary than others I've seen.     They are completely waterproof and can be reused for multiple diaper changes because they don't get soggy, and if they get damp, they dry out fast. I could use the same diaper cover for half a day or longer if necessary.     I got by with 3 of these, but 4+ would have been better. I like the prints better than the white because they're less likely to show any light staining. Too bad they don't have any in solid colors.

product_title: Eco Baba - Stainless Steel 12oz. Baby Bottle (Black)
review_body: I love the idea of this bottle, I love the shape and the feel and the look.  Unfortunately, when my son tries to drink from it the nipple collapses. Anyway, I emailed Eco Baba and and was surprised when I didn't hear back for some time - I was disappointed and initially gave the Eco Baba a less favorable review.      As it turns out this is a family owned and run business and the owners spent considerable time locating my order and finding me after having issues accessing my information through Amazon.  So I received a lovely and very responsive and concerned call tonight.  We discussed the size of the nipple (level 2 comes standard) and transition form a vented system to a non-vented system.  She explained her own experiences as well.  So I still love the idea, shape, feel, and look of the bottle, my son has adjusted his drinking style a bit, and I am very happy with Eco Baba's customer service. product_title: Philips Avent Niplette For Breastfeeding
review_headline: Very good product if used properly
review_body: This is a very useful product for those with inverted nipples or (like me) small nipples.    They're very simple, just a couple of thimble sized cups with tubes sticking out of them.  These tubes have valves in them so that when you put them over your nipple and use the included syringe to pull the air out, your nipple is pulled up into the cups and held there by the suction.    A couple of warnings and tips for you:    1. ALWAYS use some kind of lubricant.  I use Motherlove Nipple Cream as it's natural, softer and easier to spread, but lanolin based works find too and I've even heard of people using lip balm.    2. NEVER use too much suction.  If you do, you'll end up with a clear serum looking discharge that actually scabs over on your nipple.  NOT comfortable.  Be patient, if it stings, you're using too much.  Back off and let it work.  It'll only take a few days... maybe a week at most before you're able to fill the cups.      3. BE PATIENT.  I've heard people complain that the results don't last... but they do if you use it consistently and for the 3 months they recommend.  It takes TIME for the skin of your nipple to remember it's new shape.    4. Buy the [[ASIN:B000058DPN Medela Soft Shells for Sore Nipples]]  to go along with this.  Without the shells  you'll have a heck of a time keeping the cups on.  At least at first.  Once you are filling the cups completely, they stay on really well and hide decently inside a bra.  The shells work well and are decently comfortable to use.  They even let you use the niplette at night (with your most comfy, soft bra, of course)    Good Luck!

product_title: BabyKicks 3 Pack Joey Bunz Premium
review_body: I'm quite pleased with my baby kicks.  I use them as double-stuffers in my 8-mo-old's fuzzi bunz to get her through the night.  So far, so good.  No leaks yet.    These are two hour-glass shaped pads with two layers each, sewn together at the tag.  Having them splay like this allows for much more reasonable drying times, and probably better washing too.  I boiled mine, and they absorbed just fine after that.  The hemp does shrink in the wash, but they're sized quite amply to accommodate for that.  Once wet, they smell a bit different than the microterry I was used to, but it isn't bad.  They're also thinner than microterry inserts, but seem to absorb at least as much.  I haven't done a side-by-side comparison, so this observation is anecdotal and not empirical.  Maybe I should bust out the blue liquid maxi-pad-commercial-style and see what does better.     My only suggestion is this: for my purposes, I think I'd rather have two two-layer pads totally separate than bound together.  That way, I could put in an odd number of layers if I needed to.  I might actually snip the stitches at the tag to do this for myself.
