We have another step stool, but it's too short to help my son reach the big potty, or even the sink to wash his hands.  This is just the right height for both.  It is slightly taller than the Baby Bjorn (I set them side by side in the store to test), and measures 7.5\\" tall.  The picture on Amazon makes the top of the stool look like it's a different color than the rest of the stool, but it's not...same color as the legs, it's just the non-slip texture reflecting in the flash.

product_title: Protect-a-Bub Universal Rain Cover - Twin - Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This weather shield folds up small and is a great fit. I've never seen one this high-quality! Way better than the usual thick plastic kind that you can never get to fold up again.

product_title: Baby Einstein
review_body: bought it for my 3 month old and she is still enjoying it at 5 month old.  Likes to put her fingers in, cant always figure out how to get them out.  A great toy for travel, not very big and keeps her interest.

product_title: Clek Olli Booster Seat Leopard (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: The best backless booster seat ever!
review_body: Why oh why wasn't this seat around for my first child?  It is in perfect shape after over 1.5 years, with daily use, switching between cars, and a fair number of long trips.  It fits perfectly in overhead compartments on planes.  Even a couple of taxi drivers have written down the info to get one for their own kids and/or their cabs.  Comfortable (according to my son), ultra-convenient, and durable.  No more concerns about the seat sliding when the child is getting in and out of high seats.  More expensive, but worth every penny.

product_title: J.L. Childress Maxi Cool 4 Bottle Cooler, Grey/Green
review_body: I really like the look of the cooler.  We have Dr. Brown Bottles, which are taller than typical 8oz bottles. So the bag doesn't quite zip up with 4-8oz bottles.  Four of the 4oz Dr. Brown Bottles fit nicely though.

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Forward Facing Car Seat
review_body: This is a fantastic car seat.  Our three year old has used hers for a little over a year and we just purchased another one for our one year old.  This car seat is safe, easy to use, and comfortable for our daughter.  I don't know what the previous reviewer is complaining about with the crotch straps--they are adjustable.  So, if her strap was too far back, all you have to do is adjust it.  The material isn't cheap and is extremely durable.  Our toddler has gotten her seat dirty so we've washed it a few times and it looks like new.  Installation is easy and straightforward.  We don't have latches in one of our cars and it still installs safely with no problem.  Definitely would recommend.

product_title: Imse Vimse Flushable Liner - 200 count (Baby)
review_body: i usually get the kushies liners and thought they were a little rough. i read the reviews on these and thought they sounded good. we HATE them! they are too thin, they bunch up so it doesn't really catch all of the poo. they get so beat up after using them that we never even tried to wash them in order to reuse them.  the fit is weird too. they are too wide and too short. just ordered more of the kushies. very disappointed!

product_title: Sassy Real Life Remote Developmental Toy
review_headline: It's a fav. at our house
review_body: As mentioned in a previous review, this remote can make some annoying noises but it is less offensive and fortunately much quieter than many other battery operated toys. It is designed to sound like you're switching channels and my son is very amused by the voice that predicts the weather--always optimistic: \\"It's going to be bright and sunny today!\\" By 11 months he would hit that button and then look out the window at the sky. I think this is an educational toy. Plus, at just 6 months old, he adored the ever-changing black and white hologram which he played with silently...those were the days!

product_title: Wupzey Mess-Catcher Coverall Bib
review_body: I've tried all kinds of \\"catch all\\" bibs and this is by far the best----much stronger material, wipes off easier and can be thrown in to the wash over...and over...aaaaand over again (and we have).  A great bib for eating or even toddler art.  A must have for parents.

product_title: Bright Starts Ingenuity Cradle and Sway Swing
review_body: This swing is wonderful!  It has been a life saver for me and my husband.  The 2 swing directions are great for keeping our new daughter happy.  I love that it saves energy and that the batteries last longer than other swings.  The motor is also very quiet.  I love all of these features, but I also love the way this swing looks.  The pattern and design are so pretty.  This was a great purchase!

product_title: Maclaren 2010 Volo Stroller Silver Green Stripe
review_headline: excellent stroller, green is not as bright as shown
review_body: i have the 2009 version of the green stripe. i just wanted to mention that the green is not as wild as it looks in the picture. my daughter is currently 9.5 months, 29 in, and 20lb. the stroller is suprisingly roomier than what i remember it to be in 2007 when i was shopping for volos for my son. i recommend it for its weightlessness, its roominess, ease of cleaning, and cimfty factor. i also love the carry strap. buy through ebay for discounts!

product_title: Summer Infant Mother's Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review_body: This seat worked great until out little one graduated to a bath ring around 7 months of age. Past that age and I think a baby might be a little too squirmy for it. However, this is probably the case for any lay down seat because any baby is too curious about the water by then to sit still. I loved the fact that we could fold it up and put it away so that it wasn't an eye sore for company in between uses.

product_title: Stokke Care Baby Changing Table in Natural
review_body: A must have table and easy to construct.  Price is good since it can be turned into a small desk and you can turn it into a full desk if you buy the add on.  As others have mentioned, you can face the baby straight on instead of sideways but be careful of incoming spray and splatter.  Overall, saved our back and was one of the best items we bought for the baby.

product_title: iPlay Best Bib Long Sleeve 2Pk-Boy 12-24 Months
review_body: These were really cute, but for the price of only 2 bibs plus shipping I expected it to be flawless. The first problem was that the cuffs suffocated my sons arms, so I HAD to snip them to make them loosen up on his little wrists. It did work really well until we washed it, according to the package. I noticed it was even more thinner feeling then before, then liquids would just seep right through the bib getting my son's clothing soaked. Such a disappointment of almost $20 for bibs, it was too good to be true.

product_title: Hi Bebe Heart Rate Monitor/fetal Monitor w/ 8 Ounce Lotion
review_body: We love having this heart-rate monitor. It's so comforting to know that anytime we want to hear the heartbeat, we can!  In fact, I use it a lot less than I thought I would, because just knowing that's it's here to use when we want is comforting.    For $100, this monitor has been wonderful!  We started using it around 18 weeks, and have never had a problem finding the heart beat. It take some practice, but after you get it down, it's really easy to use. It is a little more static sounding than what the doctor's office uses, but it's never stopped us from hearing the heart beat.

product_title: Snappi Cloth Diaper Fasteners - 3 Pack
review_body: This product is awesome I would not be using the cloth diapers without this product!  I will buy more for each of my children!  Great Product!

product_title: The First Years Compass B505 Adjustable Folding Booster Seat, True Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this car seat for my 4 year old son. He meets height/weight requirements for the seat.  However, the seat slides around with him in it.  I do NOT feel it's safe for him at this time.  I just took it out of my car and re-installed his 5 point harness seat.  He hates the old seat and is not happy, but I'd rather him be mad at me but safe! The booster is easy to use, using only the lap belt, but I feel I have sacrificed safety for ease of use.  I reccomend keeping your child in their 5 point harness seat for as long as it is safe for them.

product_title: The First Years True Fit Convertible Car Seat, Casino (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
We bought this seat for our 5 month old once he out grew his infant seat. We are very happy with it. Do a little research and you find great safety features. Also, it seems very comfy. So important when you have a little one who doesn't want in the seat in the first place. I love how easy it is to adjust. I haven't had to clean the cover (yet!) but I appreciate how easy it's going to be to get the cover on and off.
I had a slightly hard time getting it installed in our Excursion. The built in lock-offs gave me trouble. I'm not sure if it's the tilt in our seats or what, but to get it tight and still in the path of the lock-offs I had to struggle a bit. But, I finally got it there. It wouldn't keep me from buying this seat again though.
I like how much of the safety and fit info (when to add the headrest, turn around, move up the straps, etc) is shown right on the seat. Very helpful!

product_title: Delta Children Canton 4- in-1 Convertible Crib
review_body:
Not too heavy, lovely, looks expensive, it's sturdy, it's great, I love it.
Normally a purchase this important, I would go to a store, but I'm glad I went with this crib, don't regret it!

product_title: Safety 1st Corner Edge Cushions Taupe, 4 Piece
review_headline: Great product for more than babies.
review_body:
I have them protecting my office chair from the edge of my L shaped desk. They work great, the edge use to cut and poke holes in my chairs, got a new chair and these - no more holes ,cuts, or scrapes. I wish they came in more colors than just beige - They still look professional even though my desktop is almond color. The included double stick tape really adheres them to the edge, and they are big enough the cover the top and bottom of the 1 1/2\\" thick countertop. Glad I found these, they are not in the local office store.
>>>> UPDATE December 2013: Still working great on the corner of my office desk, Tape still holding firm, and still no holes in my office chair!

product_title: Original Maya Wrap Sling (Not Padded)-Bright Stripes
review_body: I've used this wrap for five months now and the only thing that I like about it is the tail because I can nurse while carrying my baby with ease. I don't like the fabric and when tightened it digs into my neck and my baby's legs and hurts.  It seems to be twisted 90% of the time and I know that I'm threading it correctly.  I have to readjust it too often because the fabric is always sliding and loosening up the sling.  I NEVER go hands free using this carrier.  I don't know what they're talking about but this sling isn't that secure.  Another thing about slings is they are only supported by one shoulder and your back so eventually the weight from any sized baby causes a lot of pain and discomfort.  I am looking into the Moby or Sleepy Baby wraps because they're softer, more secure and distribute weight evenly, but I'm not sure if I want to be bothered with all that wrapping.

product_title: Charm Company Carlton Cow Rocker
review_body: I bought this cow rocker for my son's first birthday.  He was having a farm themed birthday and I thought the cow would make some cute pictures.  He loved this as soon as I took it out of the box (and I loved it too becuase there was no assembly required).  He is abled to rock it himself and it's low to the ground so I'm not worried when he's on it.  It's really soft and it can moo too.  Everyone comments on how cute it is.  We love it and I'd recommend it.

product_title: Lansinoh Signature Pro Double Electric Breast Pump With LCD Screen, Hygienic Closed System Design, Adjustable Suction Levels And Customizable Pumping Styles For Maximum Milk Production
review_headline: NOT the same pump as Ameda
review_body: I bought this pump because somebody told me it was the same as the Ameda Purely Yours. It is not! The suction is horrible and I ended up with mastitis twice because of it so they sent me another one and it was just as bad! DO NOT BUY THIS PUMP if you think it's the same as the Ameda. Spend the money and get the Ameda. This one is junk!

product_title: 4Moms Mamaroo Infant Seat, Orange (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: There is no Bounce in this Bouncy seat
review_body: I have a fussy baby and I was very excited when I read all of the amazing reviews for this product.  I thought that the price was high, but if it was as effective as it appeared I would pay it in a heartbeat.  I ordered and received the mamaroo and tried it out that night.  Assembly was pretty easy, it took up less room than our Fisher Price swing and was very attractive, but when I tried out the controls for the first time I knew I was in trouble.  While all of the movement options are great - they barely move at all.   Even on the highest speed setting the movement was so gradual and slow I don't think my 7 week old daughter could tell it was moving at all.  The sound choices are nice and (oddly)  have very high volume options if needed, but the movement just didn't get the job done.  I have to walk and bounce my daughter constantly and I was really hoping for at least a bit of a break, but she wasn't having it.  I get a much better result with my 6 year old Fisher price swing that was $89 and used for three kids.  It has 8 speed settings and I never go past number 4 afraid that the movement will be too much for her still developing neck muscles.  I like this company and am excited to try out the stroller when it comes out.  I hope we have better results.

product_title: Munchkin Car Bottle Warmer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: So HOT it caught on FIRE!!!
review_body: Purchased this item and it caught on fire during its first use.  I had it plugged in for about 3 minutes when my sons bottle and product caught on fire.  I do not recommend this item.  When I called the company they requested that I spend my own money to return the item and if they found that it was a mechanical failure they would replace the item only after I paid shipping.  When I asked about my bottle they said their was nothing they could do about my loss.  (Fire had caused the bottle lid to fuse to the bottom)      This product is not worth a penny.

product_title: Fresh N Freeze Reusable Baby Food Containers
review_body: till now it has worked great. very easy to use.best price too. You can surely give a try.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Deluxe 3-in-1 Convertible Car Seat in Vanderbilt  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: THIS CAR SEAT HAS WORKED GOOD FOR ME THE PAST 4 YEARS OF USE. I HAD A MINI VAN SO THE SIZE WAS NEVER A PROBLEM. BUT NOW THAT MY SON IS READY FOR THE BOOSTER SEAT SETTING, WELL I CANT FIND THE MANUAL. THATS RIGHT I DIDNT KEEP MY MANUAL IN A SAFE DEPOSIT BOX OR IN A SEALED VOLT SO I COULD USE THE THIRD SETTING. WHO WOULD HAVE KNOWN THAT THIS SEAT WAS SO DIFICULT TO FIGURE OUT. SO I AM ASKING FOR A HUGE FAVOR.. IF YOU STILL HAVE THIS MANUAL WILL YOU E-MAIL ME A COPY OF THE BOOSTER SEAT INSTRUCTION PLEASE. ( PHOTOBRAT2003@YAHOO.COM ) THANK YOU SO MUCH.

product_title: Stop Thumb Sucking, Thumbusters, Blue
review_body: My 6 year old liked this option best and it was effective for her. However, after a few days it made her thumb sweat so she wanted to take it off. We switched to the bad tasting polish and that worked.

product_title: Solemio Cup - Green Stripes
review_body: [...] sent me one cup, not six. When I complained, they sent me a rude email stating that they have no influence over the amazon listings and they didn't sell sets of six. I don't see how that can be true, and I would never have spent five dollars on a single plastic cup.

product_title: Ju-Ju-Be Be Prepared Diaper Bag
review_body: I debated for a long time on this bag, I have a 21 month old and a baby on the way.  I wanted something big enough for the both of them and this bag is perfect!!!  I also got a be quick for quick trips to the store so I don't have to carry a bag if I don't want to.  The bag seems durable and should easily last thru 2 kids.  I love all the pockets as it really allows for organization and the inside is nice and bright so I can find what I'm looking for.  I have nothing bad to say about this bag, so far I have only used it for day trips with my DD and had room to spare.  Now I have it packed for 2 since DS will be here in 3 days.  Love it, love it, love it!!!

product_title: Skip Hop Saddle Bag
review_body: This is a nice, very well made small bag. I only give 2 starts, because of the incorrect product dimensions. The bag is smaller than described and does not match the dimensions from the manufacturers website.

product_title: Olli & Lime Billie Blanket
review_headline: Quality blanket, modern look, soft feel.
review_body: This blanket will be a part of our family for years! It is beautifully constructed with quality materials. The pattern is attractive in person and the soft backing feels very nice to the touch. This blanket works great for tummy time, as well as a stroller blanket on cold days and nights.

product_title: Boppy Nursing Pillow and Positioner - Bare Naked
review_body: So here's something I didn't know when registering for baby products:  lactation consultants hate the Boppy.  At least, mine did.  They all recommended using the My Breast Friend pillow instead.  As it turns out, my baby and I were lousy at breastfeeding (not the Boppy's fault!) so I can't comment on whether my LCs were right or wrong, but I do know that I don't regret purchasing the Boppy.  It's far more useful than you'd think it'd be.  Baby used it for tummy time, and as a sitting aid, and to lounge around in (an infant fits neatly right in the middle!)  Mom and Dad use it to rest our extremely weary heads while sitting on the living room floor playing with baby.  The cats use it to store extra fur they're not using.  All in all, a useful thing to have around.

product_title: Natural Way Organics Organic Baby Powder Lavender 2.5 Oz. (73.9ml)
review_body: I bought the natural way baby gift basket it came with this baby powder itwas just amazing it has an unblivable relaxing lavender smell I even youse it on my self its a great soft powder that feels and smells amazing.[[ASIN:B003H4GK0K Natural Way Organic Baby Gift Basket (skin care)

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Classic Bottle Sealing Discs
review_body: I bought these disks to use with my Avent bottles for storing breast milk and later homemade baby food. I've been using them for about two months now, and had to order more. I have had no problems washing my other Advent products in the dishwasher on the delicate setting, but these sealing disks warped after several washes and stained a light orange after one. I have ordered more and will have to hand wash them.

product_title: Safety 1st Stove Knob Covers, 5 Count
review_headline: Perfect for keeping little hands away,
review_body:
We love these, and we've been using them for about 3 years now. I just came back to buy a set for my friend, who has a hellion of a 2 year old who has defeated every child-proofing device out there, but he hasn't defeated my stove covers! He has pulled the whole knob off INSIDE the Safety 1st cover before, but he still can't turn the gas on, and he figured out that there was nothing too exciting underneath it anyway and gave up quickly! I don't know why anyone would want to keep their knobs in a drawer, and if your range is anything like mine, taking the knobs off would create a hazard on its own, leaving sharp little eye-poking things sticking straight out from the front of your range!

Ours are plenty heat-resistant, by the way. We have an old gas range that heats up the whole house every time we use it, and these are still going strong after 3+ years. They do get warm to the touch when the oven is on, but it's certainly not hot enough to burn anybody, and they don't melt.

product_title: Buggy Bagg - Black Toile - Shopping Cart Cover - Diaper Bag
review_body: This is the best shopping cart cover!  I bought it before my daughter was even born, knowing that I would use it one day, and last week I finally opened it up to put my daughter in it now that she is sitting up.  Without this cover, she would have slumped over in the big shopping cart seat (she's on the small side).  But because this cover comes with a pillow, the pillow helps keep my daughter propped up.  And the cover is SO plushy!  At one point, my daughter laid her head back and I immediately went to put my hand behind her because I didn't want her to hit her head on the wire back of the cart seat.  But then I realized that the cushioning of the cover was so thick that she couldn't even feel the steel of the cart!  That's when I decided that I needed to write this review. :)  It's such a great cover, and you won't be sorry for buying it.  I love that it protects her from germs (as well as my own hands since the cover goes over the shopping cart handle, too).  The cover fits large carts, like the one at Costco, which makes it even better.  Not all of them will fit those large ones.  I've been out with the cover about 4 times now, and every time I've noticed people looking at it when I walk by.  Maybe it's the nice print (that doesn't look like a kid print).  Who knows, but I love this cover and recommend it to all moms with a baby and/or young child!

product_title: Lorex LW2003 LIVE snap Video Baby Monitor (White) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is the best baby monitor I have ever had.  The setup is very easy, no cords just rechargeble batteries for both camera & monitor.  The picture is very clear and sharp.  Only downsize is I would like the monitor to be a little bigger, but it is also a camera which is really cool.  And this is a great portable system to take with you on trips.  The sound quality is very sharp, and I really like the two way audio option.  This system comes with 1 camera but you can use up to 4 for the monitor which is really great.

product_title: Boon Modware Toddler Utensils, Blue and White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
We purchased the Blue and White version. The color was a tiny bit darker than the picture shown in the preview. It's very nice looking. Both the spoon and fork are soft and bendable.

The grip is not too large for our son (1 year 1 month), and fit around his hand perfectly.

Never using any type of utensils to feed himself before, he was able to grab the spoon and swung it around a bit. After a day of \\"practice\\" and guiding his hand on what he should be doing, he was able to push the food around. Eventually, he was able to scoop cut-up food from the food tray, but not able to feed himself, yet. With additional practice, I can see him feeding himself with the spoon, and us not having to worry about him poking his eyes out.

The fork tips aren't sharp, so it's very hard to use it to poke food. I don't see him using the fork for anything but scooping food. So, we'll probably skip the fork all together, and just stick with the spoon.

As a practice tool, I think it was worth every penny. They are also pretty easy to clean, just soap and water and all the grease comes right off.

I just wish it came with 2 spoons instead, since the fork is pretty much useless.

product_title: Fisher-Price Clutch N Shake Turtle Toy, 2 pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bouth this for my baby because Amazon had a really good deal on it.  It is super cute and made of a soft plastic.  However, it is fairly heavy for a rattle so a baby would probably need to be several months old to really enjoy it.  Maybe it is because my baby was too old (5 months) when he got it, but it didn't hold his attention for very long.  It is more awkward to chew on than some of his other toys.  It is a cute item, but my baby is not in love with it.

product_title: Gift Mark Upholstered Chaise Lounge with Pull Out Drawer
review_body: Wonderful piece for a little girl's room!  My 20-month-old granddaughter loves to look at books on this couch!

product_title: Cosco Alpha Omega Elite - Hammer
review_body: First of all, I have not used this seat rearfacing ever. I purchased it once my daughter outgrew the seat that was part of a travel system. I love this carseat, and she does as well. I was recently rearended and pushed into another car (at high speed) and my daughter was ok, not a mark on her. I am going to buy her the same seat again now. The old one still looks perfecty fine (we've had it for 2 yrs) but after the wreck I am of course replacing it. The only reason I did not give it 5 stars is that the latch system hooks on this model (which are the same for the Graco Nautilus) are just very basic hooks and one of them bent soon after we got the seat and is somewhat of a hassle to remove. So, for forward facing use in only one car, where you are not inteding to switch the seat out a lot, it's a great choice in my opinion. One more note: when I first bought the seat, I thought I could use the recline for making her more comfortable on long rides to sleep but it is not to be used forward facing, unless you need to recline it to level it correctly.

product_title: Merry Muscles Jumper Exerciser Baby Bouncer
review_headline: Don't cheap out on this one! Make the investment!
review_body: This jumper is absolutely amazing. My son and I are both in love. He's 6 months old and we have tall ceilings, so I had to fold up a few blankets and put under his feet. So maybe the chain could be a few links longer, but seriously, I can't even complain about that.     After having it a week, this morning my son jumped for over 2 hours straight. That's two hours that I didn't have to sit in the floor holding his cute little bouncing behind. This evening I put him back in just to make some dinner and he bounced for about 15 minutes and then fell asleep in it. And he looked perfectly cozy.     I kind of squirmed at the price, but if you're looking for a bouncer/jumper that will last through a few kids just do it. It's such good quality on top of being really entertaining for everyone. It even keeps my 3 year old daughter occupied when it's empty. Apparently it's better than the park swings when you can give each one of your animals and dolls a ride. ;)

product_title: Dex Dura Bib Big Mouth
review_body: first i love the colorful big animals on the front. my 6 month old loves them too. i also love the pouch, it catches everything my daughter spits out. and i can just wipe it off w/ a baby wipe or throw it in the dishwasher and its ready to go again! i like that it unsnaps and the material is really flexible plastic so it is perfect for traveling. i bought extras to keep in the diaper bag as well.

product_title: Sassy Vibrating Teether Toy
review_body: The vibration will not work!  I bit it several times myself to make sure it wasn't just a pressure issue, but I cannot get the thing to vibrate.  It's also weird how some of the bubbles do not have fluid in them, just tiny balls.  Overall, my son doesn't like this toy... so save the few bucks and buy something else!

product_title: Fisher Price Luv U Zoo Diaper Stacker
review_body: I was a little hesitant to pay the price for this diaper stacker but am very glad I did!  It was very well made and is extremely useful in a tiny nursery like mine.  I put All -In-One cloth diapers in it and it works perfect.  It matches the bedding beautifully.

product_title: Steribottle Ready to Use Disposable Baby Bottles
review_headline: I don't think I will be switching from the Playtex Dropins I have been using
review_body:
I don't think I will be switching from the Playtex Dropins I have been using.

The re-sealable bags for the Steribottles are easy to use and do help keep them clean. Sterility of the bottles and the nipples is ensured by their being stacked, one on top of the other (think Dixi Cup dispenser). The bottles themselves are 8oz and graduated. The nipples are fast flow.

The procedure to unseal and reseal the bag to get out the bottles is straightforward, although probably not necessary. Once you open the bag it is no longer sterile. The need to carefully and only partially unzip the packaging for the nipples is tedious. The nipples leak very little when the bottle is inverted, but when feeding, the flow is very fast (too fast, much faster than a Playtex fast flow nipple).

The biggest surprise was that once you put the nipple on the bottle, you can't take it off. I discovered this while testing it empty and had to waste a bottle and nipple. This means you can't \\"top off\\" a bottle, or add something to an already made bottle. Forcing the nipple off the bottle breaks the sealing mechanism and renders the bottle useless. The bottle is recyclable, but not reusable. There is a lot less trash with the Dropins.

I see no reason to switch.

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Sky Blue High Chair
review_body: Very happy with the purchase. Matches all our other precious planet items and works wonderful. I love the harness seat belt and the tray goes on easily with one hand. The best part is the reclining back. It was great for our son that wasn't quite steady enough to sit straight up, it is very comfortable as well.

product_title: Graco Classic Wood Highchair with Seat Pad, Butter Pecan
review_body: I cannot say enough about how great this high chair is. When it comes down to it what you really want from a high chair is that it is attractive enough to look at, easy to use, tip resistant, and EASY TO CLEAN. This chair does all of the above. I was considering either this or the Eddie Bauer equivalent. After using this for a month I saw the used EB \\"cousin\\" at my friend's house. With EB (and every other cute wooden chair I have ever seen), food bits collect at the base of each little spindle. The Graco chair, however has the decorative spindles/slats as well, but at the bottom they have a 1 1/2 inch border which means that most food collects at the bottom of the seat along a solid piece of wood rather than in between many spindles. All it takes is one wipe along the seam. We hardly ever have to work the cloth between any spindles. Also, the safety stick that comes down between your baby's legs is not attached to the seat. It is attached to the tray instead. This means that when you are sweeping away food it doesn't collect around anything - it just sweeps right into your hand. There is about a 1/2 clearance for this.     I must add that we have never used the cloth padding. I am talking about the cleaning experience of cleaning with just the bare, beautiful wood. (This is our second chair for our second baby. They do fine with out the nuisance and mess of padding!)    The plastic tray is very handy for cleaning as well. I love the cup holder in it as well (no cup holder if you use the wooden tray directly - gives you options).    I agree with the other reviewers that the chair's height will not work at the average table as a converted toddler seat. We don't have any high tables or counters to see if it would convert to a bar stool so I'm no help there.    One reviewer stated that the safety bar between the child's legs is too far back. I am not sure about this, however our kids are on the smaller side. When I put my 30 pound 3 year old in the chair to see how shefit the seating space was a little shallow but she did fit and didn't seem to be uncomfortable. A larger 3 year old would definitely need the safety bar removed (which is how you'd convert it to a toddler seat anyway). Our younger babe is 15 months. He is a 22 pound, 31 inch little guy and he fits in there great. I hope this helps.    P.S. Did I mention that this chair is BEAUTIFUL!? The design and the richness of the wooden stain are just beautiful.

product_title: Safety 1St Comfy Cushy 3-in-1 Potty
review_headline: Safety 1st should know the cushy seat is UNSAFE
review_body: My daughter has been using this potty since she was 8 months old (now almost 3yrs). I chose it because the hole was relatively small for parents who choose to potty train earlier than US average. The soft seat also seemed more welcoming for an infant to warm up to. She used it right away and was instantly potty trained!     BUT    as time went on and little drips of urine, etc would get on the seat or under it where it rests on the plastic bowl, it would absorb it, even with daily rinsing and washing. I have soaked the seat in hot soapy water and squeezed and even jumped on it to get all the nastiness out and then jump again with it wrapped in a towel to get it dry. Later on I got a nice washing machine with silver ION disinfection and started to throw it in there every few washes of her night time cloth diapers. This is the ONLY THING that has allowed us to continue using this poorly made potty for so long.    I see that they've made a new similar potty with a different seat, which is good if its non porous this time, but truly they should not be selling the models with this unsanitary seat any longer. A recall wouldnt be that out of the way either.    No one should purchase this potty (or the pink one)

product_title: KidCo Adhesive Mount Magnet Key and Holder
review_body:
Here is my top pros and cons:

Pros
1. Very quick to set up and install.
2. Easy understandable directions
3. Extremely strong backing--these will not come off without significant effort
4. I have custom cherry cabinets with thick doors-no problem for the magnetic key.
5. No screws. But there if you need them.
6. Sturdy, solid product

Cons
1. I found (after numerous trial and error) that they do not work with narrow cabinet doors. I have several long and skinny doors that I had to remove the locks on because they did not match up after the install. I believe the angle of the narrow door prevents the latches from lining up straight and connecting.
2. A few of the locks (out of 20 used) did not work properly. It appears the magnetic latch on a few do not sit flush when shut and this prevents the latch from hooking resulting in a non-locked door.
3. No extra sticky back tabs when I have to remove the latches --I have tried 3M sticky squares cut to size and they do not adhere at all. I then used screws and they worked fine. You cannot reattach with the original sticky tabs once they have been removed.
4. Magnetic keys are a bit pricey. I have 3 and keep them close to the most used drawers.

Overall performance is excellent after I figured out I could not use them on my narrow doors and found 2 that did not latch correctly. They are great when you do not want to use screws. We use a combo of the cheapo plastic press latches that have to be screwed in and these. I have put the cheapo press ones on drawers we access all the time--like our silverware--because it is less hassle than to get the key, open the door, put key back multiple times in a day.
I would recommend this product but not for all instances.

product_title: Huggies Overnites Super Mega Pack Diapers- Size 4, 5, 6
review_headline: The Best Overnight Diaper:  Try a size up from your day diaper.
review_body: We use Huggies overnights for night/long trips and Pampers Baby Dry the rest of the time.  I've tried so many diapers (including Pampers overnights which are NOT good) and this is the #1 system for us.  My son drinks a lot during the day so he's a good tester!  About sizing- my 22 month old technically fits a size 5 but he seems more comfortable in the size 6 and they're easier to put on.  Huggies in general seem to run a bit small, IMO. (He wears a size 5 in Pampers)

product_title: Summer Infant Deluxe Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen
review_body: I thought this was a great monitor for a few weeks.  The reception is good and the picture is clear.  Then one evening, my husband took our son to his crib and I switched on the video monitor.  On the screen, was another person's child sleeping peacefully in her crib.  When I switched the monitor to Channel B, I could see two people in a toddler bed, enjoying a nighttime story.  I was horrified!  I couldn't help but wonder who could see my baby, or if anyone had seen me nursing him during the past few weeks.    When I called Summer Infant Products, they were aware of the problem.  They are sending me a digital monitor to replace the one I have.  I am glad they are replacing my monitor, but I still feel uncomfortable about the incident.

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: This is our fourth child, so we've had many different bath tubs, bath seats, etc. over the years. This is quite simply the best. The sling holds our daughter well enough that I can use my other hands to wash her, but it still keeps her down in the water so she doesn't get cold. It is definitely the best choice out there!

product_title: The First Years Jet Stroller, Princess (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This stroller is awesome, especially for the price! The only assembly required is to put the wheels and the sun bonnet on the stroller.  It is light weight, and folds up nicely.  It is sturdy and easy to maneuver.  I purchased this for $39.99, super saver shipping at $0.00, and received it 24 hours later.  I couldn't be happier with this purchase.

product_title: Simmons Kids Beautyrest Beginnings 2-Sided Vinyl Contour Pad
review_body: This is my second Simmons changing table pad and I love them.  The quality is very good and the pad truly does not slip.  I have placed one on a free standing changing table and the other on top of a dresser and both work beautifully.  The pad is soft but sturdy.  We have owned one for 3 years and even though we use it daily, it feels the same as the brand new one.

product_title: Fisher-Price Space Saver High Chair, Scatterbug
review_body: The space-saver chair does exactly as promised - saves space. We have it permanently affixed to one of the four chairs at our dinner table, and we hardly notice it's there. We live in a small space and there was no way we could accommodate a traditional high chair. My 6-month-old sits well in it and likes to bang her hands on the tray while she awaits her food. The seat wipes clean pretty easily with a damp rag, as does the tray. The bright white straps are starting to look a little dingy though. That's probably my main complaint: the straps should be easier to adjust and clean. Minor issue though. Still, it's why I'm holding back the fifth star. That said, I'm completely satisfied. It's small, it's cute, and it works.

product_title: Dreambaby 4 Pack Stove Knob Covers (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: not big enough for my stove knobs
review_body: i have a jenn air gas range. the knobs, although advertised as fitting most ranges (which could very well be true) do not fit my oven knobs. instead of hassling with returning, i will pass along to a friend.

product_title: Safety 1st Bathtime Letters and Numbers
review_body: I am extremely happy with this purchase. The letters and numbers are quite durable and are really cute. My toddler loves them. The price was great.  I have seen them locally for double the amount that I paid.

product_title: Baby Barrette Hair Clippie. Caterpillar 3.
review_body: We do not own this particular pattern, but my two girls have both worn this company's bows since birth.  They are simply fabulous--second to none!  They won't fall apart after a few uses, and can be saved well into toddler years to pin back whispies with pony tails, etc...  The craftsmanship is great and the pattern/designs creative.  My first daughter had VERY fine/hardly any hair at first and they worked for her....but then my second daughter had a lot of hair and they were still great.  You won't be disappointed!

product_title: BOB Handlebar Console Stroller
review_body: If you are an active parent who takes his/her kid out on nice days, this is a convenient add on to hold water bottles, keys and cell phone.  It fastens securely, is easy to install, and puts everything you need right up by your hands.  I recommend it for anyone who purchases a BOB.

product_title: Utterly Yours Pregnancy Pillow - Brown Swirls/ Pink
review_headline: Not good for later stages of pregnancy
review_body: I bought this pillow at 8 months pregnant b/c I was desperate for comfort and sleep!  I loved the idea that it supported both belly and back, but unfortunately it just wasn't supportive enough.  It really didn't help.  I gave it to a friend who was 6 month pregnant thinking it might help at a time when the belly wasn't so big, but she had the same conclusion.

product_title: Imse Vimse Bumpy Soft Cloth Diaper Cover - Large (20-26 lbs)
review_body: I've tried many covers and this is one of my favorites. I like the Thirsties cover too. This cover fits good and has the leg gussets for extra protection. I 've found it easy to wash. I turn it inside out and flip the inner flap over. Handwashing works good too.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_body: I received a Sleepy Wrap and a Peanut Shell Sling as shower gifts. After using both, I found I loved the Sleepy Wrap, but the fabric was too elastic, causing my daughter to sag if I didn't tie the wrap very tight. I bought a moby, and have been very pleased with the elasticity of  the fabric - just enough so that she seems comfortable and I can get her in and out, but not so much that she's sagging. It can be difficult to put on in parking lots or places where you don't want the fabric to drag on the ground, but it's comfortable enough that I just put mine on before leaving home. I have a bad back, and this is by far the most comfortable carrier. It really does just feel like an extra layer of clothing. The instruction book that comes with it has a lot of helpful tips. Overall, I am extremely satisfied with this product, and my daughter loves it, too.

product_title: Graco Kimberly Combo, Espresso
review_body: We looked ALL over for a combo unit for our son's nursery that wasn't overly priced.  We purchased our Graco Lauren crib in Espresso first and then went from there.  We found this Graco Kimberly Combo unit in Espresso at various retailers but when I went online to order it they were either out of stock or they wanted to charge an arm and a leg for shipping.  I finally ran across it here with the BEST price and the BEST shipping cost...FREE!!!  The item was ordered on 11/25 and arrived on my front porch 12/2; with the Thanksgiving holidays that was QUICK!!!!  I had read reviews after reviews about how difficult it was to put together but we had NO PROBLEM and my husband had it put together in an hour.  We LOVE it and it matches PERFECTLY to our crib, now all we need is our son to arrive in 8 weeks!

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon Natural Rubber Soft Chew Toy, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I don't know bout this little guy!
review_body: So this toy is pretty cute and is shaped well, so that my munchkin can grab his neck and get a good bite of his head. The down side is that Chan makes the WORST squeaky noise you can imagine! So very loud even if you just barely touch him. Chan is also made of the type of material that attracts every speck of dust/lint/hair that is in the air and gets really dirty easily. He also is a little flimsy, not as tough as I would have liked...so far I don't know if he was worth the the money. Sophie is on her way, lets hope she is better!!

product_title: 2 Red Hens Bib and Burp Cloth Set
review_headline: Only bib my daughter can't rip off!
review_body: I love these bibs!  My daughter can get off all of the velcro or snap bibs, but the large buttons on these are a cinch to fasten and she can't (no matter how hard she tries) get it off.  They're big enough to protect from almost any messes, cute and stylish, and wash well.  I highly recommend these to parents with \\"bib Houdinis\\" who can get anything off!

product_title: Snuggy Baby Sorbet Dot Wet Bag
review_headline: every mom needs a bag like this
review_body: Highly recommended. This is an adorable way to contain wet and messy clothes, diapers, bibs, etc. so they don't get yucky stuff all over the inside of my diaper bag. Much more eco-friendly than a plastic sack. It squishes up really tiny when you're not using it, but it can expand to fit lots of stuff. I like that it's so cute it actually looks like a purse or clutch (but has a waterproof lining). You can just throw it in the wash when it's dirty. Good construction: the zipper at the top slides easily and the seams are strong. It's a super-reasonable price for a really cute, well-made bag!

product_title: Graco TotBloc Pack 'N Play with Carry Bag
review_body: We love it! Great playpen, easy to set up and colorful which is great for my son. Fast shipping too.

product_title: Philips AVENT ISIS Manual Breast Pump, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: can this pump be swapped out with the elecric version?
review_body: I have the isis iq duo electric pump. I accidentally melted the piece which connects the bottle to the breast. I can not find a replacement part sold separately. does anyone know if this singular manual pump can be \\"swapped\\" out and used with the electric equipment.  Thanks in advance!

product_title: Maya Wrap Lightly Padded Baby Sling
review_body: This has been wonderful. My son is five months and there have been days when carrying him in this around the house was the only way he would calm down. I also use it walking around the market and shopping. He loves it and I do too! We can still use it for a long time to come.

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_body:
I bought this for my 8 month old, because at night he kept taking off his blanket and he would get cold and wake up. The first night that he used his Sleepsack, he slept through the night and woke up very happy!!
If I would've known about this product earlier, I would've bought it when he was born!!

product_title: Kid-ding Quilted Waterproof Multi-Use Pad - 27" x 36"
review_headline: Must have for moms of toddlers
review_body: I have been potty training my child and it was such a pain to wash the sheet and mattress pad each time there was an accident. I bought one of these and it is such a huge time (and laundry) saver! My only regret was that I did not buy more than one - so I ordered 2 more to cover the entire length of the twin mattress. Washes well in the laundry and a very good size (2 would cover about 90% of a twin mattress). A must have for moms potty training their kids!

product_title: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio SIP 30/30 - Moka 2009
review_body: I haven't had the chance to use this car seat yet (still pregnant), but it seems very nice and very safe. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5, is it is one of the more expensive car seats on the market, but it is the only one that would go with my stroller.

product_title: Gerber First Essential 6 Pack Silicone Nipples
review_body: My babies were 9 months and I still was using the medium flow nipples, so I decided to replace them with fast flow nipples and they're excellent, my babies can drink they bottles faster now and they didn't have any kind of problems with this change. I haven't had any kind of leakage with these nipples.

product_title: Chicco DJ Baby Walker, Splash (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My baby girl LOVES this walker! It is so stylish and fun... Only thing she is 4 months old and her feet don't reach the floor!

product_title: Bellybuds Pregnancy Bellyphones
review_body: Fun to own, work well. Great for mom and baby to listen to relaxing music together.

product_title: Graco Contempo Highchair, Rittenhouse (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this highchair.  Its very comfortable, SUCH a beautiful design for boy or girl, and easy to wash.  My only bad thing to say is that the dishwasher safe tray NEVER fits in the dishwasher..its huge and it doesn't fit right in any dishwasher so if you are looking for a highchair with a easy dishwasher safe tray, probably not the best one.  But this chair makes up for it : )

product_title: Summer Infant Metal Expansion Gate, 6 Foot Wide Walk-Thru, Neutral finish
review_body: This product has worked very well. I had to span a wide area between a kitchen peninsula and a wall that did not match up. After some modifications to the mounting surfaces, this product has performed flawlessly. Great Product. Would have given 5 stars if I could have skipped the modifications to my surfaces. This product should work better on flat surfaces that line up.

product_title: Secure Transitions Inflatable Baby Tub
review_body:
I have been a fan of inflatible bath tubs for babies since I was given a Tubby 32 years ago. When my grandson was born, I encouraged my daughter to purchase an inflatible tub; she chose the Secure Transitions Baby Tub and is quite pleased with her choice. Using an inflatible tub provides a measure of security for new parents and prevents little ones from having an extremely slippery surface on which to sit. Further, the inflated edges add a measure of protection for little heads if baby topples over while you are bathing him/her.

The Secure Transitions Baby Tub is large; it is almost as wide as the standard bathtub in which it is placed. There is only one suction cup on the back tab of the tub; but, the bathtub in which this is being used has nonslip appliques on the bottom. These add an extra measure of security to prevent the tub from slipping around. I would recommend using a nonskid bathmat under the tub if you do not already have the nonslip appliques in place as they are not easily removed. Although the floor of the tub is supposed to be nonslip, I do not think it goes far enough. I would recommend getting a nonslip shower mat and cutting it to fit inside the tub as it will provide extra security. Several of the off-price stores have a wide selection of nonstick bathmats for under $10; some of these are large enough to be cut in half so one would not have to purchase two.

I definitely recommend that you consider the Secure Transitions Baby Tub when you are looking for an infant bathtub.

product_title: BOB Revolution Duallie Weather Shield, Grey
review_body: I give this product a 4 out of 5 due to the fact that I wish it were a little bit bigger to fit completely over the sides of the stroller. It does let in a little bit of wind, but overall it has made going outside in the winter weather very comfortable for my twins! Every time I check on the kids, they are warm and toasty inside the stroller.

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_body: The sleep sack arrived in original packaging and has been a great fit for our baby. The sleep sack works great and washes easily.

product_title: Fisher-Price SpaceSaver Bounce 'n Spin Froggy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My six month old daughter is very petite - she was a preemie - and it seems she is too short for the Bounce N Spin Froggy. Her toes are still about three inches away from touching the platform even on the lowest setting, so she can't bounce or spin quite yet. I'm hoping she will grow into it, but I wish there were more height adjustment options, since I know she would love to bounce in it. There are 2 different heights that the seat snaps into the base, but they are only about 1 inch difference. She does love sitting in the seat and spinning the froggy's eyes though!     Also note that the sounds are controlled by spinning the eyes. At first I thought I had a defective product, because we put batteries in & turned on the music switch, and nothing happened! When its eyes spin, then the music & sounds are activated. That wasn't immediately obvious to me, and it didn't explain that anywhere.    I do like the fact that it does take up much less space than the other bouncers available. Plus it is so darn cute!

product_title: Munchkin Sprout Drying Rack
review_headline: excellent, inexpensive, works with glass bottles
review_body: i as skeptic about that it works with glass bottles when i read the review, i bought one to try, and it worked great! i have 2-3 8oz glass bottles  on it at any one time, plus 3-4 plastic ones, plus bottle rings, breast pump shields etc. wife was skeptic about it when i shown it to her, now she wants me to buy 1 more! 1 for home, 1 at in-law's home.

product_title: Leachco Easy Teether - Crib Rail Cover for cribs with THINNER railing (circumference of 7.5" or less) - White
review_headline: Fits the round Rail Perfectly (DaVinci Emily)
review_body: This works perfectly on the round rail for the [[ASIN:B000FT7NXS DaVinci Emily Convertible Baby Crib in Cherry]]

product_title: Kolcraft Pediatric 2500 Mattress (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: mother of three, three and under
review_body: This mattress is nice for the money.  I don't see much of a difference between this and the first mattress I bought a few years ago for more money.

product_title: Dreambaby Chelsea Swing Close Gate Combo Pack
review_body: I bought several of these gates after becoming frustrated with the gates you have to take in and out to walk through a doorway.  After I installed the first one, it was super easy to put the other ones in. Also, I like that it automatically came with gate extenders and wall protection covers. I opted to use the double-sided sticky rings rather than the screws and they are very secure.  Not only do they work well with the baby but they also work well with our dog.

product_title: Dr. Sears Flatware Set, Green/Orange, 9 Months (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: my 4 yr old and 2 yr old love these. they think they are so cute and easy to hold. perfect for dipping in yogurt and apple sauce.

product_title: NUK/Gerber Ultra Thin Nursing Pads, 60 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Of all the nursing pads these are the absolute worst. They are not absorbent and I leaked within hours of using them. I tried them because they were almost half the price of the lansinoh pads and less then half the price of dr. brown's pads. I am now stuck with a box of nursing pads that have to be layered with a more effective pad that can catch what they cannot. If you have a very full milk supply that is prone to leak before your baby demands food, these pads are not for you.

product_title: Graco Passage Travel System, Abbington
review_body: I love this system!  It was easy to put together out of the box.   The stroller moves very easy has locks on  the wheels works like a gem.  The baby carrier is awsome.  Holds the little one very snuggly and safe. It fits on the stroller very securly and make me feel comfortable in knowing its not going to come apart while on the stroller.  It came with a base that stays in the veh. when placed in the veh. the base feel very secure and when the carrier is place on the base it locks in very tight.  Seperating the base and carrier is a snap.

product_title: BABYBJORN BabySitter Balance, Brown/Beige (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Lets Mom Have Some Free Time!
review_body: We bought it when our son was 3 weeks old from a co-worker.  If I hadn't been able to buy it from a friend, I would not have hesitated to pay retail for it.  IT IS WORTH IT!!!  Buying it after the baby was several weeks old really showed us how useful it is.    We can set him in the chair while we cook dinner, take a shower if the other parent is gone (with him in the bathroom), or just let him have some quiet play time.     My son absolutely despised tummy time until he was around 4 months old, so this was a total lifesaver.  When he got tired of being flat on his back, I could set him up in this for a change of perspective and he would be perfectly content for 15-30 minutes.  Trust me when 15-30 minutes a day of occupied, calm baby is worth the steep price they charge for this sucker.  We also have the toy bar, and I will say that the baby does play with it.     I like that it's very well designed, has a relatively high weight limit, is very adjustable, and is simply designed with quality materials.  We didn't want some garish, plastic, vibrating monstrosity in the middle of our living room.      We own the bjorn carrier (which I hate, but my husband couldn't say enough good things about), travel crib and babysitter, and they are all so convenient and well thought out.      When considering the high price, also realize that quality products will have a high resale value when you're done, vs. cheap plastic crap.  So really, they potentially end up being a better buy, as you get more of your money back when you sell it.

product_title: Grobag Little Bear Baby Sleeping Bag 1.0 Tog
review_body: I purchased a sleep sack from Halo and was very disappointed. It was too thin and the neck hole was very large. I returned it and bought this Grobag and I am thrilled! The 1.0 tog has a nice, sturdy cotton cover and the lining is very soft cotton - almost like flannel. The neck hole is a perfect fit and it won't slip over my son's head. It is much longer than the Halo sleep sack: my son is 29 inches and we bought the 6-18 month size and he has at least another 7 or 8 inches before outgrowing it.

product_title: Nap Nanny Infant Sleep Aide, Blue
review_body: It reeks of chemicals. I washed and sprayed the cover and even sprayed the foam itself - didn't work at all. I then began to worry about what it was made of and whether it could be harmful, and see that another reviewer has commented that it is made of harmful chemicals. I wish I had done more research before buying this so quickly, since they have a no return policy (no wonder - as soon as you smell it you will want to return it). On top of that, my baby doesn't sleep great in it either. I am getting rid of it tomorrow.

product_title: The First Years 5 in 1 Carry Me Near Sleep System
review_body: I was curious when I ordered the ivory bassinet if the skirt would be too long, it is a bit longer than the other styles, and when you lift it off of the stand it does hang down past the bottom.  If you plan to leave it on the stand, no big deal, but if you plan to travel with it or carry it around the house more, it might be a big deal.   Despite this, it is stunning and the fabrics are a nice quality, great for a boy or girl.

product_title: Trends For Kids Mamaboard, Wood (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I ordered this board and use it on a tike tech double atx jogging stroller.  It doesn't really get tight enough to hold it in one place, but my 4-year old son, for whom i bought it, likes to swivel back and forth on it anyway.

product_title: 8-pack No-slip Baby Clippies.
review_body: These little clips stay in even on my newborn!  I started using them when my daughter was 5 days old and they really stay put!

product_title: Graco Soothe and Swaddle Bouncer
review_body: We have two of these for our twins and they have been extremely helpful!  Sometimes it is the only way to calm them down.  It is also a good way to keep them elevated when they are sick and have head congestion.  The one problem is that their feet can kick the controls and turn on the vibration or music when it is not needed and it drains the batteries (it does have automatic shut-off, but not for 25 minutes.)  The directions for putting it together were confusing.  FYI--the stuff that looks like packing on the frame is actually padding and not meant to come off, but there is nothing that specifies that.  Despite the small drawbacks, this has been a great product and would buy it again.

product_title: Gossamer Wings Porta Crib Set
review_body: I purchased this set along with a Delta mini crib and I love it. It fit perfectly and seems to be of good quality. I think it's adorable and would recommend it highly.  Also it was delivered VERY quickly.

product_title: Playtex Sipsters Stage 3 Insulated
review_headline: Not the same as they used to be
review_body: Playtex has a new \\"Twist-n'-click\\" top on these now and they are impossible to use. I really mean impossible. You're supposed to twist the cap on far enough for the little arrow to line up with an indicator for a leak proof fit. First, you can't even screw it on enough to get to that indicator and second, you can't remove the top once it is on!! My husband can't even remove it! I thought maybe it was not screwed on straight, but that is not the case. I can't believe they changed the design of the top (which isn't reflected in the picture of the product here). We have several of these cups with the old style lid and loved them. They never leak, so I don't know why they changed them to this unusable style.

product_title: See Me Smile Infant Mirror
review_body: the first thing i noticed when i received this was that the mirror was actually large enough and of high enough quality that you could see yourself.  we tried it in the car, but couldn't get it adjusted right --  so i hung it on the wall by the changing table so baby can look right into it while i change him.  i used a removable 3M wall hook (which are a miracle if there ever was one).  the monkey itself has a pleasant look and is soft.

product_title: Cocoa Wall Border By Bananafish
review_body: I could not wait to get this in and put it up in my dining room. However, when I got it in, I was disgusted with the way it looked. TO me, it looked nothing like the picture at all as far as color goes. I thought is would be brown and beige, but it was brown and blue. The cut was horrible as well. It looks cheap and tacky. It looks like the top and bottom were cut with a dull blade leaving tiny bits of paper all along the top and bottom. I hated this.

product_title: Razbaby RaZberry Teether
review_headline: Great teether, if your baby likes teethers
review_body:
I had my last two babies very close together and my first which was a boy wasnt so crazy over it as he thought it was a pacifier and would try to suck on it...he actually preferred to chew down on his pacifier, go figure. So I saved this raz-berry teether for my next baby which is a girl and she loves it! She's six mos old now and I see her first 2 bottom teeth coming through and this has been such a big help. I can sometimes see her very k'vetchy (restless) and I give her this and she just goes crazy on it, best part she can chew it all over including the leafy sides and handle, which provides different textures. I dont know if this is the best teether out there but its definately one of the very best.

product_title: Evenflo Summit Pressure Mounted Metal Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This gate was difficult to install. OK, part of the reason could be because I cut off the zip tie holding the gate closed before I had the gate completely installed. The instructions tell you not to cut it off until everything is installed...I thought I had it installed to my liking, but later decided to shift it a bit. Once you cut off the zip tie it's very difficult to install. This means if you later want to install it on a different doorway, because the zip tie has already been cut off, it'll be difficult to install - definitely a two person job.    Once we were able to get it properly installed it worked great. This gate is VERY sturdy (note: we did NOT use the extension...some gates become less sturdy once you use the extension). It's very easy to open with just one hand. Some people mentioned they had trouble opening the gate. There are two tricks: 1) make sure the tension on each of the screws is properly adjusted - the indicator dot will be completely green when the tension is adjusted correctly; 2) to open the gate, pinch the two buttons with your fingers while using the heel of your hand to push down on the end of the handle that's on the OPPOSITE side from the two buttons (don't try to push down on the handle where the buttons are - it won't work). Once you learn how to open the gate, it's easy!

product_title: Philips AVENT Basic Baby Monitor with DECT Technology (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My wife and I bought this monitor for our first child.    LIKES  -Bright LEDs. They're easy to see in the daytime albeit a little distracting at night.  -Interference free. We have wireless internet, and neighbors have wireless phone. No interference from either.  -Sensitivity adjustments. 5 levels of adjustment are great.  -\\"Talk\\" button on parent for communication back to baby monitor.  -Good battery life. We get about 24 hrs of life on a lower sensitivity setting; about 16 hrs on highest setting.  -Battery backup for baby monitor. I'm fairly certain all baby monitors have this now. Nonetheless, AA batteries can be installed on the baby monitor in the event power is lost.    DISLIKES  -Relatively low volume of parent. With volume turned all the way up on parent it is difficult to hear cry over TV. (No I don't have the TV THAT loud.) But the bright LEDs are helpful here.  -Expensive  -Only one parent. Two would be more convenient - especially at this price.      NOTES ABOUT CHANGING THE SENSITIVITY LEVEL  -First, there are 5 levels with 5 being highest and 1 being lowest. The speaker on the parent will turn off after about 30 seconds of inactivity on ANY SETTING LOWER THAN 5. This is to save power. This also means that if your baby starts to cry it won't pick up the very first cry. The parent speaker will turn on and then transmit any subsequent noise. After 30 seconds of inactivity, the speaker will turn off.    -Second, if you want the parent speaker on ALL THE TIME set the sensitivity level to 5 LEDs on (highest).      THE BOTTOM LINE  A good monitor with little noise and no interference. Expensive. Good sensitivity control.

product_title: Stork Craft Tuscany Glider and Ottoman
review_headline: Did not stand the test of time! (edited after less than a year of use & again at 18 months))
review_body:
***EDITED AGAIN 5/14/12***
And now the chair is kaput. I was rocking my now-almost-2-year-old as part of our bedtime routine and suddenly there was a crashing/cracking noise and we dropped an inch or two. I figured one of the bolts had fallen out (it's happened before) but one of the bearings had been ripped away from the chair, leaving damage to the wood. It might be fixable, but honestly, I'm sick of replacing screws and bolts when they fall out and constantly tightening and WD-40ing this thing to keep it in working order. I really wanted this chair to be a good cheaper alternative to a more expensive rocker and it just didn't work out. :( Probably going to put it out to the curb tomorrow and go buy a recliner. So disappointed to be tossing the chair I've been rocking my little one to sleep in every night for the better part of two years!

***EDITED 10/3/11****
Well, we've had the glider for the better part of a year now, and sadly, it has not held up. It is now squeaking constantly no matter how much we tighten and WD-40. We still rock our 14-month-old nightly as part of our bedtime routine, and it's now annoying and feels kind of rickety. Unfortunately, the quality has just not stood the test of time. I'm really sorry to say that, because I wanted to love this chair and it is very comfortable to sit in. Our Shermag, which also gets daily use, works as well as it did the day we got it. If anything, I think the rocking motion has gotten smoother on it over time. I mentioned in the original review that I thought the Shermag would outlast the Stork Craft, but I didn't think the SC would poop out THIS soon! The SC would be a great rocker for grandma's house, but if you plan on rocking for more than a few months, this one is a waste of money, sorry to say. You're better off investing in a good one up front.
*****

We already have a $300 Shermag rocker that we use in our nursery, and we got the Stork Craft Tuscany Glider/Ottoman whenwe wanted a 2nd chair but had less of a budget. Here are the main differences:

--- The Shermag is noticeably \\"plusher\\". The cushions are much, much softer. The Stork Craft has a pretty crunchy foam seat that needed to be broken in (not a lengthy process -- I kneeled on the cushion a few times before putting it on the seat). If, like me, you appreciate a firm cushion, you won't think this is a problem. Both chairs are attractive, and the quality of the Stork Craft fabric is nicer than I expected for the price point.

--- The Shermag is heavier and sturdier. I would be surprised if it didn't outlast the Stork Craft. (Hey, you get what you pay for!)

--- The Stork Craft was MUCH easier to assemble. Many fewer steps as the ottoman and bottom part of the chair (the glider) were fully assembled in box. My only complaint re: the assembly is that a hole was not drilled where it should have been to connect the left arm of the chair to the base. Each arm attaches in three places, and I found it to be sturdy enough without the third bolt that I didn't bother returning it. Next time my dad is over, I'll have him bring his drill and fix it for me ... no biggie. In the meantime, the arm doesn't wiggle with regular use.

--- Yes, the Stork Craft squeaks. It squeaks loudly enough to render it completely unusable. My dog actually came running in from the other room the first time I used it and started barking at the chair because she thought it was an animal, ha! The squeaking comes from the bolts on the glider part of the chair. I sprayed some WD-40 on the joints, and voila! No squeaking. If anything, I would say the gliding motion is now smoother than my Shermag.

--- The seats are different sizes. Once you have all the cushions and padding on, the Stork Craft seat is 18 inches across at the armrests and 17 inches deep, vs. the Shermag's 20 inches across and 20 inches deep. The back of the seat is longer on the Stork Craft -- 28 inches vs. 26. I am short and slightly overweight (5'4 with a long torso/short legs, size 14) and the Stork Craft fits me much better. However, I am sure the Shermag would be much more comfortable for a tall/long-legged woman, an average man, or someone more heavyset.

--- The Shermag has a lever to lock the chair in place, which I need on that chair to stand up smoothly while holding a sleeping baby since I have to scoot forward before I can touch the floor. The Stork Craft doesn't have the locking mechanism, and I thought I would miss it; but since the seat actually fits my legs, I have no problem getting in and out of the chair gracefully. (And believe me, that's a feat!)

Overall, yes, the quality is obviously nicer on a more expensive chair. But the only dealbreaker for me was the squeaking, and it was an easy, $5 fix. If you are petite and looking for a nice, inexpensive rocker, this will definitely suit your needs! If you are tall/heavyset, you will definitely need to invest in a different chair.

product_title: Westwood Design Saffron 5 Drawer Chest, White
review_body: We bought both the Saffron crib and 5 drawer chest. It took Amazon a little longer than expected to ship them. I'm used to Amazon shipping things the day after I order. This took about a week to ship. No big deal really since the baby is still in the bassinet.   This is our second crib and drawer set from Westwood studios. When my son was born in 2008 we bought a Hart Meadwodale setWestwood Design/Hart Meadowdale Convertible Crib, Brown Chestnut from BabyDepot in a local Burlington Coat Factory. I wish I had known that Amazon carried it. Burlington had to deliver it 3 times because their shipping kept destroying them. They always blamed the fact that they are made overseas as to why they were beat to he!!. The shipment from amazon came with NO shipping damage and a friendly delivery man. We loved the design and engineering of the set. I was impressed with the actual dovetail joinery on the dresser. Even on higher end furniture I'm seeing less and less care in the product design. When we moved I accidentally threw away the springboard. This is how I learned that Hart Furniture is a subsidiary of Westwood Design Studio. When I called to order a new springboard the phone was answered \\"Westwood Design\\". When I explained to the operator what I had done they told me that they had the part in their warehouse and could send it to me Fed-Ex so I could get my kid back in his bed. She then asked if there was anything else that I needed and I prepared to find out what kind of damage my mistake was about to make on my wallet. To my total shock she said there was no charge and they would just send it. 2 days later it was on the doorstep. It's amazing how a little customer service goes a long way. A $20 part and they sold themselves another $1400 crib/drawer set. Enough with my rave on the manufacturer.     The Saffron set we bought was designed well, including the dovetailed drawers. The assembly is pretty simply and comes with the tools required. It's quite heavy, have a helperready if you need to move it any distance. The hand carved detail work looks great. The only complaints we have are that (1) there was a slight knick in the dresser. This was not from shipping. It was in the board before they painted it. (2)It was painted after it was assembled and I can see the timber in one of the seams. If you aren't looking you don't know it's there though. I still give this set 5 stars and would easily purchase it again from Amazon.
