product_title: Baby Jogger Car Seat Adapter for City Mini / City Elite (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have a baby jogger city elite stroller. And we got the adaptor to use with our graco snuge ride 35. We made sure we bought a carseat to go with this adaptor, but we find that this adaptor didnt click well to the carseat... its just not tight as it should be... really didnt like it!

product_title: Infant Bath Seat
review_headline: Great for a second baby so that you can bathe two kids together!
review_body: I used a regular infant tub for my first baby, which was fine.  But not long after my second baby was born, I wanted to be able to bathe both my kids together in one bath for efficiency.  For the first few weeks I didn't use this, but I think once my newborn was around 3-4 weeks old, I started using it.  Like many other reviewers, at first I used it with a hand towel in there for comfort.  I definitely needed to keep a close eye on the baby when she was young to make sure she didn't slip in it, but importantly I didn't have to keep my hands on her at all times so I was able to wash my older daughter's hair while the baby was in the tub too.  I\\"m still using it and my baby is 9 months old!  Sometimes she tries to sit up in it when she's reaching for a toy, but mostly it still works great, and I like using it still because although she's a steady sitter, I think her older sister might knock her over fairly frequently if I had her sitting up on her own.  Great, simple, inexpensive product!

product_title: Redmon Bongo Buckets
review_body: I really liked these buckets. They are great for organizing toys. The kids love them too!

product_title: Tiny Love Spin Ball Toy
review_headline: Shiny and Noisy,  but a ball should roll
review_body: This is a colorful, noisy, ball with moving parts and a glistening inside.   But...this ball doesn't roll in a straight line, and it is hard, meaning hard on your hands, hard on woodwork it might crash into, just hard to get the hang of how to use it in a playful way. It is called a spin ball, but it doesn't spin either.  ????

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_headline: Not all it is cracked up to be
review_body: We bought this car seat online due to all the positive reviews.  Yes it's safe and that is the most important thing when it comes to car seats and a child's safety.  However, you can get a car seat that is safe and not such a pain!  It is SO Heavy!  It is huge!  It takes up 1 1/2 seats in our car and gives little room for a 3rd passenger in the backseat. It is impossible to clean.  The material does not come off the booster part of the seat.  The whole thing is very complex and not user friendly. The release button for the lower strap is VERY difficult to unlatch.  I wish we had not purchased this item.  I am very disappointed. We call it the rocket seat because it's over-the-top.  Absolutely hate this car seat. on that note, Any one want to buy it from me? ;)

product_title: Ella Grace Diaper Stacker
review_body: Not well made at all.  It matches the set so I bought it but I would not recommend it.

product_title: Graco MetroLite Stroller
review_body: I'm going to start off on the color b/c if it weren't for someone elses review I would have thought I was getting a brown and pinkish colored stroller.I don't think any description I read in regards to this stroller told the colors.   Either way, Pink is NOT the case. The fabric colors are dark brown, cream & a lighter burnt orange. The pattern on the fabric (the seat part) are giraffes. My husband and I love the color & the designs we are excited its not another pink thing to add to the other pink stuff we have for our daughter. Its unique & a bit vintage looking.   I really wanted a Graco full size stroller & would have bought one if they had one with fabric I liked and weren't all travel systems, we already had a car seat. I went back and forth between this one & some others that were actually higher priced & had better reviews & less features. I came back to Graco b/c I have had a stroller from them in the past & this stroller had everything I wanted. There is a great info video on youtube in regards to the metrolite stroller. That video was basically what made me finally decide on this stroller. I read a lot of complaints in regards to pushing/steering this stroller. My husband said it best by saying you have to push it like a lawn mower. So if that is a down fall it's the only one in my opinion.  This stroller is affordable, light weight, stylish & has all of the great features you would get with a regular sized stroller, such as cup holder, storage compartment, adjustable handles, full reclining seat for infant/newborn, large basket good for shopping bags or diaper bag & it folds up nicely (there are more features than these, this is just some of them). I think that your getting more than your paying for, I have found strollers with far less features, priced for much more money & I am so happy that I choose this one!     GRACO NEEDS TO MAKE IT SO YOU CAN GET ALL FULL SIZED STROLLERS IN ANY DESIGN OF FABRIC. HUNTING THROUGH ALL OF THEIR DIFFERENT PRODUCTS SOLDTHROUGH DIFFERENT SELLERS WAS RIDICULOUS!!!

product_title: Emily 4-in-1 Convertible Crib with Complete Toddler Mattress with Hypoallergenic Waterproof Cover
review_headline: Easy to set up, looks beautiful
review_body:
Purchased this crib for our first baby in June 2010. The baby will be here in September, so we haven't had a chance to try it out yet, however, the first impressions are very good. The crib is sturdy, took us about 30 mins to set it up and it was very easy. Does not require any special tools, and as long as you follow the directions it is very easy. The crib is a lighter color than what is portrayed in the picture (it is not much honey), but I'm okay with that. Also we bought a Sealy mattress with this and it fit perfectly within the safe guidelines. The rails also are close together, and fit the safety guidelines set by the AAP. It seems very easy to convert to a toddler bed. We didn't buy the rails for the full size bed because it seems a long time from now, however, I'm thinking that you don't have to buy the 100$ rails from DaVinci to get this working. I think that any kind of full size rail should work because you're working with a headboard and a footboard...but that's just my opinion - I haven't done any research in it. Looks like a very safe crib though...I guess time will tell how sturdy it is. :)
Will try go get an update when the baby is here.

Added Feb 2011: We've had the crib for 4 months now. It is still sturdy and works great, no problems with it. The only thing I don't like is that the crib is really deep and because I'm short I have to bend to get the baby there and sometimes he will wake up. I'm 5.3 and definitely need some height adjustment in order to get him in his crib peacefully. I'm sure this won't be a problem soon when he can sit up on his own.

product_title: Graco IPO Stroller
review_body: I bought this stroller 25 months ago to use for a newborn (who is now 2) and I love it. I went to a local baby specialty store and tried out all the fancy high priced \\"umbrella style\\" strollers and the shop owner actually recommended this one. She said the higher priced ones had a slightly smoother ride and might weigh slightly less but that this one would be the best value, and she was right. I don't tote the thing around - I move it from the car to the ground and back, and hand it to the flight attendant when traveling, so the extra 3 pounds is nothing. As for the ride, the difference was barely noticeable in the store. I've read reviews on here saying that people have smashed their fingers because the stroller started opening when they picked it up, but if you fold it properly there is a latch that prevents the stroller from opening until you release that latch. Others say the canopy doesn't stay on but I've never had a problem with mine. As for the basket size, I load that up and hang extras from the handles and I've never not had enough storage space. It steers easily with one hand and handles hard surfaces and grass easily because the front wheels can be locked so they don't swivel, so I've never had an issue with wobbling. The fabric is strong and easy to clean. I bought a UV sun shade extender to give full coverage when needed, and a little caddy that fits over the handles. This stroller needs nothing else other than a lock for those times you have to leave it unattended in public places (hello, Disneyland) because trust me, you'd be heartbroken if it got stolen. Sometimes I think people don't read the owner's manuals and they just don't know how to use their product.  Update: Baby girl is now almost 3 1/2 years old and this stroller is STILL perfect, although she's not in it as much because she loves walking like a \\"big girl.\\" The tires are still in excellent condition and the fabric is perfect (because it's easy to clean). This was a really great purchase.

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planets Umbrella Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Worth the extra money for an umbrella stroller!!!
review_body: I wanted to keep an inexpensive umbrella stroller at my house for when my granddaughter comes to visit.  I looked at all the $19.00 versions locally, and was very disappointed in the quality of the strollers.  Very flimsy material, no brakes on the wheels, and no adjustable backs.  After reading about the Fisher Price Precious Plants umbrella stroller, I decided that, for a little more money, I could get a good quality stroller that would work for my granddaughter, as well as any future grandchildren.  What a great decision!  This stroller is solidly built with brakes, an adjustable back to acommodate very small babies as well as older children,a canopy (which I wish was larger to help keep the sun out), a cupholder for grandma, and a mesh bag to hold items such as extra diapers, etc.  My granddaughter and I have taken quite a few walks with this stroller, and it has worked perfectly.  Turns on a dime and can be controlled with one hand, as one would expect an umbrella stroller to do.  Collapses for storage, which is nice, too.  Don't waste your money on the cheap $19.00 versions!  Spend a little more and get a stroller of quality which will last for many years!

product_title: Joovy Kooper Umbrella Stroller, Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I found the other reviews so helpful and I don't have much to add, but just wanted to add to the discussion.    My little guy is 4 1/2 months old.  We just started using the stroller, even though it's technically on the early side, but everything looks safe and comfortable.  I use this stroller for long walks on suburban/city sidewalks with stops for errands.    Pros:    Very compact footprint--fits anywhere  Easy to carry up/down a few stairs  Easy to get in/out of stores and fits well at a restaurant table   Great, full coverage sun/rain canopy  Nice kid pockets for toys/adult pockets for keys/cell phone  Smooth pushing with two hands  Don't kick the wheels, and there's no back bar in the way.  Great color/fabric (I got yellow, which is more of an orangey yellow.)  Sporty style--looks more expensive than it is.  Easy to use harness/quick to snap baby in.    Cons:  Have to tip it for larger sidewalk bumps so you don't trip on them--easy to do, so not a huge issue  Hard to push one-handed on bumpy sidewalks--this is only a problem if I am carrying my iced coffee because. . .  . . .pouches do not really work as cup holders.  They are as good as it gets for fabric pouches, but can't compete with a hard plastic holder.  I think I'll buy one separately.  When seat is reclined, basket is hard to get to--not a flaw, just a trade-off for having a good recline.  I can't use this for a full shopping trip, but it's fine for one or two small bags.      I was between this and the City Mini until I read the reviews (was worried about kicking the back of the mini.)  I am so happy with the decision!  I don't think this stroller could get much better without adding to the weight or the price tag.

product_title: BabyKicks 3 Pack Joey Bunz Premium
review_headline: good absorber but a bit big
review_body: I bought these to go with my fuzzibunz onesize diapers. They turned out to be a too big. I read some other reviews that said they would shrink, not even close. after I re-sewed them I decided to use them as 1 pieces, (they come sewed together as two pieces sewn together at one end so they can be dried easier). I use just one half of the set and stuff it into the diapers along with the fuzzibunz insert. they absorb really well. I should have bought the mediums. I Love the way they work and the shaped design is nice.

product_title: Bright Starts Comfort and Harmony Bouncer, Biscotti Baby (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a very good product @ a very reasonable price!  Our baby loves it so much that whenever she cries and we put her on it, she stops crying.Every part of it works magically great!  This product rocks! I can recommend it to anyone,anytime!

product_title: The First Years Jet Stroller, City Chic (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: For the price this stroller is just great! Very easy to assemble, light weight, seating area is large and it moves easily. No more bending over to push a stroller!!! Cargo area underneath is small but not a big deal. again for the price it is well worth it!!

product_title: Munchkin Snack Dispenser
review_headline: Very good snack container for adults as well
review_body: I'm tired of carrying my snacks in zip-logs and this works amazingly for me.  I use them to store nuts and chocolate in my purse.  A good container to bring on picnics as well as on planes when travel.

product_title: Bunnies by the Bay Hare and A Spare Buddy Blankets
review_body: My daughter got this lovey bunny as a gift when she was born.  She loves it so much, I bought this two-pack to have a backup bunny and one for the car.  This well-made and super cute bunny looks great after daily use for a year and multiple washes.  I expect we'll be loving on this bunny for years to come.

product_title: American Baby Company 100% Cotton Value Jersey Knit Porta-Crib Sheet
review_body: This sheet fits perfectly on the Chicco playard (which is hard to find). Sheet fits snug and is easy to get on and off. It is a little thin but a great buy for the price.

product_title: 3 Sprouts Art Smock
review_body: Got two of the cow smocks. Very nice. Fits my 3yr old with plenty room to grow. Nice wipeable surface.

product_title: Graco Bumper Jumper
review_body: I purchased this for my 5 month old.  And while it is well made, nice looking, and fun (hence the 3 stars) the hang strap is not very adjustable.  From the beginning we had it as short as it would go and if my child grows any more, her legs will not be positioned correctly to use the jumper.  Our doorways are not particularly low (I think we have 7' doorways).  My child loves this toy, and I'm kind of disappointed that she won't be able to use it for very long.

product_title: Red and White Polka Dot Ladybug Girl Toddler Bedding 5 Piece Set
review_body: When I washed the bedding (sheets separate, comforter separate, cold wash, tumble low) the sheets came out fine, but the red on the comforter & sham bled and now it's pink. I don't recommend this product.

product_title: Starting Small Novelty Hamper
review_body: We are using this in our baby's room and is a good size for baby clothes.  It isn't that stable for it is easy to rock over when throwing something in it. But overall it is very cute and goes with the room and is a great size for a child's hamper.

product_title: Evenflo Big Kid AMP No Back Booster Car Seat, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased this seat so we could more easily take our grandson in the car with us when we visit. My research showed this with a 5 star safety rating, so that was a huge factor! It's light weight, easy to get in and out of the car, and will be easy to store when we're not there :-) And he loved feeling more like a \\"grown up\\".

product_title: FridaBaby NoseFrida The SnotSucker Nasal Aspirator
review_body:
Lemme tell ya! This snotsucker is the best snotsucker EVER! My baby just turned 1 and was sick with cold twice so far, and every time he had a stuffy nose, he was so miserable he couldnt breath and he would not let me use regular nose suction bulb,screamed and cried and when babies are in such distress you dont want to use the suction bulb because it can easily injure the nostril. I was frustrated and looking for a product which will actually work safely and effectively. And I did! Nosefrida is so effective and safe and ingenious at the same time and very easy to use. I bought this item based on good reviews and recommend it to all the moms and dads. My baby still fights me when he realizes what I am about to do, but at least I am not afraid of any nose injuries and it sucks out the snots like there is no tomorrow! And when my baby feels better and breaths better when he is sick is all what makes me happy. It made a big difference in treatment of those nasty colds.Plus it is super easy to clean. And actually I also love it for one more reason...My husband absolutely can not watch me doing it and he gags so bad and leaves the room telling me You're not right woman! It makes me laugh, it so funny how he thinks that the snot actually goes up into your mouth and thinks I am gross, i tried to show him and explain that it's nothing like that, that snot goes nowhere neat your mouth , but he doesnt believe me ))) I just think it's hilarious .
Whoever has any doubts about this product , put them aside and buy this awesome snotsucker already!

product_title: Graco ComfortSport Convertible Car Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
We've had this car seat for 3 years and it's been wonderful. It's a good basic car seat and does not cost an arm and a leg.

Pros:
- affordable
- easy to use & install
- seat belt clips are easy & smooth to unlatch
- easy to clean w/removable cover

Cons:
- plastic hooks/buttons on seat cover becomes lose after first few washings. Easily lost
- harness latch is a little too easy to remove since our 3 1/2 can figure out how to unlatch herself.

I would buy this product again.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: I purhased three of these and every recipient was thrilled with theirs.  The Take Along Tunes is just the right size for those little hands, the music is not to loud or annoying like so many of the other toys out there today.  It is easy for an older child to hang on to, turn off or on and take along with them, just as it is named.  It is great for babies as well since it isn't loud or \\"mechanically sounding\\" instead the music is melodious and soothing.

product_title: Babylegs for Moby Wrap Leg Warmers
review_body: I bought these babylegs for my daughter to go with her fuscia moby wrap. They match perfectly and look great! Babylegs are great for cloth diapering, too! No need for pants to cover up your cute prints, and diaper changes are a breeze! I'll be getting more of other colors soon!

product_title: FuzziBunz Diaper Sprayer with Microban
review_body: I bought this sprayer via Amazon from Earth Mother and installed it.  All fittings on it leaked.  Not only did the two fittings which can be tightened leak, but the fittings which are built into the unit leak.  The instructions said to tighten any fittings which leak.  I tightened them all and the leaks continued.  I uninstalled the unit and noticed very cheap fittings and seals.    The documentation states that a plumber is not necessary to install.  I am  not a licensed plumber, but I know my way around plumbing.  I have installed sinks, faucets, home water filters, and baths with no problems.    I have requested a full refund.  I'll post Earth Mother's response.

product_title: Boppy Changing Pad Liners, White, 3 Count
review_headline: Love these!   Great for home & travel
review_body: We love these little pads.    On road trips I take a couple .. and put one down on the car seat when I change her ... then they are easy to wash later if they get messy.    At home, if they get messy you can pick the baby up with one hand and put a new one down.    The fitted changing covers are a two-handed process to change, so with these I rarely have to change the fitted one.

product_title: Graco Alano Travel System-Mulberry
review_body: I purchased this for my first grandchild. there are too many systems out ther to chooe from. the stroller is great, though a little heavy. has storage space for shopping, but yet is comfortable and the way the infant seat fits into it is fantastic. The infant seat is perfect for her. she is now almost 9 weeks old and can use it for quite some time. i am not crazy about how secure the base of the seat attaches in the car. you have to strap it down from multiple locations for it not to rock or tilt from the back to front of the seat..which is facing backwards in the back seat.  otherwise, we are satisfied overall.

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon and Sophie the Giraffe Set
review_body: This item is perfect for my 24 month year old. The texture of the items allows a great chewing service. It is large enough to be safe for any age. I would tell anyone to buy one of these!!!

product_title: Philips AVENT Digital Screen Baby Monitor with DECT Technology (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Bought this for my daughter who has just given birth to her fifth child.  Her oldest daughter who has a 3-month old son lives with her and uses a less sophisticated, less expensive monitor.  This Philips Avent with DECT Technology does not interfere with the cheaper monitor and that monitor does not interfere with this one.  My daughter and her babie's daddy absolutely love this monitor.  They call it the Cadilac! My daughter said they never expected to get a monitor that had so many practical and useful features that work perfectly.

product_title: PumpEase Fabulous 50's Collection hands-free pumping bra
review_headline: Great for pumping, esp. at work
review_body: I bought this item because I didn't want to be changing in and out of bras, esp. at work.  This product is ideal. It's small, simple to use, and works great.

product_title: Safety 1st Power Strip Cover
review_body: I originally purchased a [[ASIN:B000056JJF Mommy's Helper Power Strip Safety Cover]].  After not being completely satisfied, I decided to try out this Safety 1st Power Strip Cover when I needed to purchase additional covers.  This cover wins out over the Mommy's Helper cover.  The closure tabs on the Mommy's Helper don't snap very securely, but this cover has buttons on either side that must be pressed together to open the cover.  It's also more sturdy and seems like it will hold up longer.    A great feature you will get with this cover is it is expandable to be as long or as short as your power strip.  This is really nice for small power strips.  You won't have a huge cover taking up extra room.    This cover is also wide enough to fit the new plugs that are turned sideways.

product_title: The First Years 3-in-1 Kickin Coaster Seat, Green/Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got this because my 3 month old(at the time) kicks his feet NONSTOP as a means of communicating emotion. He doesn't stay in it more than 15 minutes as of now (5 months old), but that's his boredom level. Three months was a little early to get it, as he was about 2 inches too short to enjoy the coaster part, but of course he grew into it. The only thing is, the music doesn't quite keep up with him when he kicks it, so for a while he was not really sure HE was making it go. A warning, my friend came over with her son who is 25 pounds exactly (the weight limit) and I thought the mesh kicking part looked to be under obvious strain due to the weight. Overall, I would reccommend the product. It's very well constructed, but uber-easy to put together. You can adjust the sound, it has a vibrate mode and you can adjust the music to play continuously or only when the baby kicks- all cool features. My favorite feature is you can lock the coaster in place if you child doesnt care for that, or for an added safty measure.

product_title: Summer Infant Complete Coverage Color Video Monitor Set with 7" LCD Screen and 1.8" Handheld Unit (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Excellent results in both sound and pictures on both the monitor and the handheld. Will defintely reccomend

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Snow Globe and Lights Bouncer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Loved it, until the motor in the Polor Bear portion went out!
review_body: This chair is way better than most when comes to entertaining the little guy. However, after owning it for only 1 month, the motor for the polar bear portion started making scary noises (sounded like someone screaming in a loud high pitched tone). Thankfully Amazon is great and is replacing it, so hopefully the same problem doesn't happen with the new one! Again, if this problem did not occur, it is a great and entertaining chair!

product_title: Toilet Targets for Boys
review_body:
i still haven't recieved my targets but once i read the shipping email this company charged me $24.99 to ship a $2.99 product!

BE CARFUL! IF IT IS SOLD BY SOMEONE OTHER THEN AMAZON BEWARE! these targets could fit in an envelope! and they wanna charge me $24.99!

REDICULIOUS!

p.s this product doesn't even deserve one star, but it wouldn't let me give it (-) stars

product_title: Fisher-Price Fun Sounds Flip Phone (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This little phone is simple and great for travel. My son is 7 months and he loves it. Also, a big bonus is it makes sounds but they're not crazy loud! It plays little pieces of nursery songs and makes beeping sounds. The little mirror on it isn't great as far as seeing a good reflection of himself, but he still likes it.

product_title: Changing Lifestyles Safe-er-Grip 11.5" Balance Assist Bar
review_body: Have bought two of these suction handles. One for each bathroom. We find they do a more than adequate job. The suction works great on a smooth tile. If the suction cup is on a seam in the tile it will not hold as well. On our bathroom wall, one tile is in the middle of the tile and holds well. The other tile (in this case the bottom suction cup) is one a seam and does not hold as firm. The one tile that holds well is strong enough to hold the handle adequately. Good design and usual good shipping from Amazon.

product_title: Pre-2016 BOB Infant Car Seat Adapter For Duallie Strollers
review_body: I love my BOB stroller and purchased it knowing I would have to buy the infant car seat adapter if I didn't want to wait a year to use it for my newborn along with my older daughter.  However, I never looked at the price until it was time to order it and I do feel that although the quality of the product is good, there is very little to it and the price is outrageous.  I compared it to the entire frame of a Graco stroller that just holds a carseat. The quality is equal, it's just bars that hold the seat plus a couple cup holders.  But for their entire stroller it's the same price as this.  I'm disappointed in the company for charging so much.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_body: I wish I would've had this wrap when my first daughter was a baby (she's now a demanding 3-year-old), but I'm glad I got it for my second daughter!  Granted, it is a bit long and takes two people or a very long hallway to fold, it is a great baby carrier and an asset to any parents' must-have baby accessory!  I benefited from watching the \\"How To\\" video on Moby's website, which I think is a must for any person about to use this product for the first time.  I've also read reviews stating that this wrap can \\"heat up\\" a baby, which I agree with, so be careful in the summer months (you could just leave your baby in a diaper).  I plan on using this wrap in Disney World in May 2010!

product_title: Sunshine Kids Travel Pal Organizer
review_body: This is a great product to stow away toys and small books in the backseat. It fits perfectly on the middle seat of my small car. It's not super huge, and I only allow as many toys that will fit inside of it into the car, so it really cuts down on the amount of clutter in the backseat. It has a lot of small pockets that we don't use, but perhaps older kids would have smaller things to store in there.

product_title: Dreambaby Pressure Mount Hallway Gate
review_body: This gate is awesome. I love the look of it and it was very easy to set up. Well earned 5 stars.

product_title: Sweet Jojo Designs Funky Zebra Window Valance
review_body: I bought four of these plus a bed skirt.  Shipping was almost $30...I admit my fault because I did not read the fine print, but really, this fit into a medium size Priority Mail box and should have been $8.95 for shipping.  No complaints about the actual product,

product_title: Nuby 4 Pack Snack Cup and Spoon Set, Colors May Vary, (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I make my daughters' food and really found these little containers to be wonderful. I love the quality and durability of these containers. I would definately recommend them. Esp if you make your own baby food. They are super handy.

product_title: Britax Advocate 65 CS Click & Safe Convertible Car Seat
review_body: This car seat is so nice and the material is so comfortable for my daughter.  It is a very well made and solid car seat.

product_title: QuickZip Zipper Sheet
review_body: It was such a pain changing my son's crib sheet until I got these!  Now it takes less than a minute and there is no lifting involved!

product_title: Philips AVENT Basic Baby Monitor with DECT Technology (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased this monitor so my mom could sleep in her bed upstairs while my dad needed to stay downstairs on one level due to weakness and ill health. The monitor has worked well with clear volume and no static. It also has a button on the receiver so mom can respond speaking to dad to tell him she is on her way to help him. They have found this useful when she is out in the yard as well. It has been a \\"life saver\\" for mom who is 85 and was sleeping on the floor on quilts to be able to respond to dad's needs. Now she can respond but also get a fairly good nights sleep with peace of mind in her own bed.

product_title: Satsuma Designs Jersey Infant Hat - Natural
review_body: I have this hat and the velour hat and blanket.  Love them all.  This hat is super soft.

product_title: Gerber First Essentials 2 Pack Natural Flex Pacifier, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I ordered these pacifiers because they are my son's favorite, but the stores don't care them any more.  The description says colors may vary between red, green, and blue, but we got pink and green.  I'm all about boys wearing pink, but the pink paci is a little much!  We still use it though!

product_title: MAM 2 Pack Rock N' Roll Silicone Pacifier, 6 Months, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Baby is really fussy about the pacifiers.  If baby likes it...  I like it!    Rated it only 4 stars because you can't choose the pattern.    -  Baby boy with \\"Rock Princess\\" pacifier looks odd    -  Baby girl with \\"Blue Pirate\\" symbol looks pretty weird too

product_title: Chicco 360 Degree Rotating Hook On Chair
review_body: This high chair is perfect for our family.  When we sit down to dinner, I can rotate my 7 month old to face me so I can feed him his baby food.  Once he is done, I can rotate him back toward the table to sit with the family through dinner.  I'll also admit to being a normal family - the chair can rotate the other direction toward the TV as well.  :)    The chair is very easy to take on and off the table.  It does come with a portable mesh bag so you can take it with you to restaurants or to see family.  (It's collapsible.)     The tray pops on and off for easy washing, and I just toss the seat into the washing machine when it needs it.

product_title: Joovy Zoom 360 Swivel Wheel Jogging Stroller
review_body: Pros: a sun cover that covers the entire baby while jogging or walking, free additions that are extras with other strollers (i.e. rain guard tent, and tire pump), lightweight, good ability to see child from back of the stroller, good seat adjustments. Excellent traction. Smooth ride.Easy pedal brake. Amazing price (I got mine for under $200.00) for joggers within this class...     Cons: There is not a way to lock the front tire from the handle-bars. One has to stop jogging/walking, brake the jogger and then click the wheel into lock position. I've not found a way  to adjust the handle-bars. The harness works well 70% of the time, otherwise, my kiddo slides to one side.     9 reasons this is a \\"pro\\" vs. 4 reasons this jogger is a \\"con.\\"

product_title: Britax Roundabout 50 Convertible Car Seat
review_body: I love this car seat. I have my 9 mo old 23 lb. baby in it, and I plan to keep her rear facing until the 35 lb max, which is something I really liked about this seat. I researched and stressed sooo much about what to get, but I am very glad I chose this. Many people have told me Britax is \\"cream of the crop.\\" It gives me peace of mind to know I didn't skimp on this important decision. It is extremely well designed. Other reviewers have complained about the buckle being underneath the baby. It is a little awkward, I admit, but the fact that the design makes it so extremely easy to tighten and loosen the straps, it hasn't been an issue. She likes this seat and I love the pistachio design. The fabric is soft and seems easy to clean. I also think there is probably enough padding. She has never seemed uncomfortable, however she's never been in it for more than 1-2 hours. I would buy again.

product_title: SoHo Noah Ark Baby Crib Nursery Bedding 13 pcs included Diaper Bag with Changing Pad & Bottle Case
review_body: I just received this bedding and so far I'm in love. The design is EXACTLY what I was looking for. I was surprised at the lack of Noahs Ark bedding in the market these days. I thought I would be a great neutral bedding, but the only ones I found were very blue. Not this one. The polka dots make this bedding as do the details like the litle red birds. It came in a very nice zippered bag that will help keep in nice till we wash and put in on the crib. Since I haven't used it yet I can't speak to the quality but it seems well sewn and just a sturdy as other bedding on the market. I would highly recommend this bedding.

product_title: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_body: My three year old received this as a Christmas gift and even though he isn't afraid of the dark it helped him fall asleep faster. This was he favorite gift this year! I think ever child should own one! Too bad they didn't have them when I was little !

product_title: Playtex Twist 'N Click Spill Proof Cup Sippy
review_body: It's true what the other reviewers say, the cup will just be sitting there and milk starts coming up through the straw and all over the table. Seems to be some kind of reverse-vacuum that starts when the child doesn't suck all the milk out of the top end of the straw. And if you close the straw into the cup, the leaking still happens, you just get sprayed when you open the thing. Maybe this wouldn't happen with an older child who is better at using a straw. I found it hard to drink from but my kid loved it. I have tried a lot of this type of cup, with a silicone straw, and none of them are great. Finally got my 20-month-old a Tommee Tippee Explora cup with no straw - does not leak, at all, ever (Amazon does not seem to have them, got mine at Babies R Expensive).

product_title: Baby Boom Nap Mat, Princess (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This mat was even nicer than I imagined. My almost 2 year old uses it at daycare on a cot and it is perfect. I would definitely recommend this!

product_title: Dreambaby Deluxe Bath Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A GREAT help for bath time!!!
review_body: Bought this for our grandson..........it is a HUGE help when he's here for the night!  Makes bathing ssssssssssssooooooooo much easier for us!!!!!!!!!!    LOVE IT!!!!!!

product_title: J.L. Childress Standard & Dual Stroller Travel Bag
review_body: I use this bag to store my Bugaboo Frog. I didn't want to spend alot on the Bugaboo brand transport bag, since I am not using this bag for air travel.  Everything fits, including all the accessories.  If you wanted it to be even flatter, you could take the wheels off the chassis.  I probably would not use it for air travel for the Bugaboo since this bag doesn't have any padding.

product_title: Ultimate Car Seat Travel Bag
review_body: We have used this bag on several flights, and it is holding up really well.  The best thing about it is the size - it can fit our Graco MyRide 65, which is one of the biggest car seats out there.  The padding is pretty thick, and the straps make it easy to carry.  We're really happy with this bag.

product_title: We Sell Mats Anti-Fatigue Interlocking Flooring Set, 6 Counts
review_body: I bought two sets of the floor tiles and they provide the perfect amount of space for my 10 month old twins to play.  It is easy for them to crawl around on, we don't have to worry about stains and it is easy to put away and store when we have company over.  Great purchase!

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_body: I loved it! my son loved it!  It's beautiful, safe and the price is worth!

product_title: Dr. Brown's Formula Mixing Pitcher
review_body: This pitcher is so useful, I even bought one for my parents' house for when we visit. As long as you don't get overzealous with the mixing motion, you should only get a small amount of bubbles in your formula. It is easy to clean and simple to use. Great product.

product_title: Vital Baby Toddler No Spill Straw Cup, 10 Oz
review_body: Love this cup. Nothing spills out, no matter how much the cup is turned over and shaken! And, the \\"straw\\" part is very sturdy. My son has bitten off all other straws from several previous cups, but so far this one has been able to withstand his gnawing and gnashing. I also love that there are measurement marks on the side in both ounces and mL, and the flip lid stays on firmly (unlike our broken Thermos Foogo). Price is attractive, too. There are only two negatives: because nothing spills or leaks, it also takes some effort to drink juice. However, my toddler does just fine drinking from it. The cup is supposed to adjust to your child's sucking power at any age. Secondly, when we first opened this, my toddler called it a \\"baby\\" cup. Okay, so we're not thrilled with its aesthetics, but that is a minor trade off. I would buy this again and again.

product_title: American Red Cross Door Finger Guard - 2 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The day I received  those it was the day I sent them back! And here is why : this finger guard actually is well made and the plastic seems to be very durable and this can be actually the problem...My baby loves to play with doors and the minute I install this guard in the door, my baby tried to close it as he normally plays with it and the door BOUNCED OFF of that plastic guard so hard ,it hit my baby's face and knocked him off his feet...needless to say he cried so hard , broke my heart. I think this happened because the plastic is hollow ,not a solid piece and when you close the door it kind of \\"squeezes\\" the plastic,but since the plastic is strong enough not to be crashed, it just bounces off. This is what happened to us anyway.

product_title: Lamaze My Friend Emily
review_body: My 4 month old granddaughater chose Emily as her favorite Christmas gift.  She was attracted to this bright colorful doll right away.  She likes the crackling sounds and keeps grabbing the rings.  Great infant toy.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier for Newborns + Toddlers Soft Baby Sling Baby Wrap, Ideal for Baby Wearing, Breastfeeding, and Keeping Baby Close
review_body: I have owned three baby carriers before I found this one.  The others included one that was a sling style and two that were front upright type carriers that the baby could ride in facing forward or facing Mommy.  With the birth of my third child, I am so happy to have the Moby Wrap.  My baby can ride upright facing me, or sideways cradled against me, or facing outward, or even on my back when he gets older.  I can put the wrap on at home and wear my coat over it.   If he falls asleep while I am wearing him, it is very easy to get the baby out without waking him up.  It is easy to wrap the carrier tightly or loosely depending on the size of the child, so it is a one size fits all item.

product_title: Joovy Caboose Stand On Tandem Stroller
review_body: This is a great stroller at a great price.  Perfect for my 3.5 and infant sons.  However, it is a bit heavy and awkward to store.

product_title: Bassettbaby Cape Cod 4 in 1 Crib
review_body: After looking at lots of cribs in stores I decided I wanted a natural pine colored one... which was hard to find. Hence... Amazon. I ordered this and it looks awful. The wood has dark black areas where it wasn't properly stained and it looks like the wood has weathered in the rain. This is especially true on the backboard - the most visible part - and around the holes where the vertical pieces go in. It just doesn't look like the nice, country-style crib shown online. I contacted Bassettbaby to see if they could replace it or do anything about it and they said no. The crib is also very light even though it isn't designed to be a portable crib. When I lift and lower the moving side, I pick up the entire crib with one hand! It just feels cheap. Unfortunately, the box it arrived in was so damaged that I really can't re-pack it and send it back.I should have looked at one of these in a store. It really doesn't compare with the quality of cribs I was seeing at BuyBuyBaby. That said, this was under $300 and those were about $600. Maybe you get what you pay for!

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: My little girl loves her Sophie. I have tried other teethers and she wouldn't have anything to do with them. So I gave up and bought Sophie. Love all about Sophie but the price. A little pricey for such a small toy. But of course, it has been worth it.

product_title: KidCo Magnet 4 Lock Set (4 locks per package - key sold separately)
review_body: This set of locks does not come with the key to unlock/lock it. The description of this item does not explain this important detail. The key is even pictured in the description. $21.95 for only 4 locks and it doesn't even come with the key.   ________________    I feel that I should update my review after using this product and dealing with Kidco's customer service. I called their customer service to complain about the key not coming with the lock set even though it is pictured in the description and the description does not explain that it does not come with a key. The representative very politely explained that the item does not come with a key and that it is sold separately. She still offered to send me the key anyway free of charge and I received it in 2 or 3 days. I figured out the problem is that it is not described adequately on Amazon. If you look at the item on Kidco's website, it clearly states that the key is sold separately. I would say that for $22 the 4 lock set should come with a key. Even if you bought a starter set (with key) who couldn't use an extra key? Especially if you use the locks in more than one room. The product is very easy to install. Make sure to follow the clearly written directions thoroughly. Put on the cabinet end of the bracket first and make sure to remove the guide tabs after you install it. They get in the way if they are left on. I chose to use the screws because I didn't want to have to go easy on the locks and worry about them falling off. Who cares about holes on the inside of the cabinet anyway? I can putty them later if I feel like it. After the installation, the locks work very well. I am raising rating to 3 stars. They would get 5 if they didn't nickel and dime us for the key. I would have paid a little extra to have a key.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA-Free Animal Front Teeth Teether (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is just a simple ring with a knob on the end.  But it seems to do the trick.  The shape makes it easy for baby to hold on to and get into his mouth.  It's not really going to hold his attention unless he's interested in chewing it.

product_title: Evenflo Comfort Select Performance Single Electric Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this to use in situations where plugging the full size pump in was not an option.  It has worked just fine for me.  Obviously it's not as good as a $200-$300 Medela pump, but I get 4 oz in a pumping easily, even on the battery operation.    I wouldn't recommend it as a primary pump or for people who are exclusively pumping, but it's small and convenient for throwing in the diaper bag or my work bag.      I've definitely got my money's worth and more out of this already.

product_title: Jaq Jaq Bird Feeding Bib
review_body: I bought this for my 14 month old son because he just insists upon feeding himself these days. Needless to say, he always makes a mess. I am not the most efficient cleaner, so I was trying to find a bib that was thick and easy to clean. This bib not only serves that purpose, but has such a unique print. My son doesn't usually wear \\"baby-ish\\" designs. My son enjoys pointing out all of the planes (he's obsessed) on his bib. It helps make his eating experience fun. I love this bib both for style and functionality.  It's the perfect mix. The pockets are big enough to catch most everything that drips and the fabric is sooo easy to clean. Probably the most durable bib we own now.

product_title: BumbleRide Indie Stroller
review_body: LOVE this stroller. My daughter is one year and we also have a McClaren Volo that I intended to use for travelling and other trips outside the neighborhood. The Indie is so lightweight and easy to fold that we rarely opt for the McClaren. Travelling with it is a breeze, it even comes in handy as a luggage cart when needed. My daughter has used it from day one without her car seat attached (although we've tried that too)as the seat reclines. So easy to maneuver, even in 36\\" of snow this winter!

product_title: Baby Trend Snap N Go Stroller
review_body:
I used this stroller with both of my girls before they could sit up in a normal stroller. Things that I love about it:

- When running errands, you can just pop your baby's infant car seat in this. No need to undo straps or wake a sleeping baby.

- The storage underneath is so big compared to a normal stroller. It is really easy to access things underneath even when the infant carrier is on top.

- The cup holder and tray are very nice and sturdy.

- It is lightweight and compact - easy to get in and out of the trunk of my car.

The reason I didn't give it five stars is because it is not a necessity. You can definitely get by without one but if you have access to borrowing one or can find one used, it is a really nice and convenient thing to have.

product_title: Lambs and Ivy Enchanted Forest Plush Owl, Green
review_body: This was actually about twice the size we thought it would be when purchasing. We love it!

product_title: Gerber Terry Burp Cloths, 6 Pack
review_body: Very practical little burp cloths. They are blue on one side and the dot pattern on the other side. Very durable, yet soft to the touch so they don't scratch your baby's face when your wiping off that extra drool. When they were washed on high temperature the colors did not fade on the first wash, and after the tenth wash they still have the same color as the day they arrived.    The price of $9.99 was quite reasonable for the 6 towels. One can never have enough burp cloths around the house when you have a baby.

product_title: T1L-66545-V0Parent
review_body: We'd only used the munchkin bibs before, but I figured we'd try these out, and they are a great eco-friendly alternative.    The bib itself is a little smaller than the munchkin, but the coverage seems just as good due to the way these bibs attach: you stick each side of the bib to your baby's clothes (near their shoulder blade) rather than around the neck.  This makes the bib conform better, and it seemed to bother our son less.    These bibs also do have a pocket, which isn't mentioned in the description, and the corn-based backing proved to be just as waterproof.    We'll be sticking with these from now on.

product_title: Dreambaby Chelsea Xtra Hallway Swing Close Gate Combo Pack
review_body: I love my new gate. It is sturdy and beaufiful. I actually have no children, but I have 3 small dogs that make it very difficult, if not impossible, to open the front door of my house. I mounted the gate just inside the foyer which enables me to enter the foyer through the gate, close the gate behind me and open the front door to meet people without fear of my dogs getting out. It is wonderful. The gate can be either pressure mounted or hung with provided hardware. I am having no problems with the pressure method. The shipping was speedy and the product well packed. I would purchase again from this company without giving it a second thought.

product_title: Pearhead Giftable Keepsake Coffee Mug
review_body: We did eventually get a usable print out of this kit, but the material is spongy. You press the hand into it and then it springs back somewhat - like memory foam.  It also does not dry hard (which I didn't realize at the time of purchase).  I always remains somewhat flexible and my 3 yr old was able to tear a dried leftover piece in half with his bear hands.

product_title: JJ Cole Outdoor Blanket,Blue Orbit, 5' x 5'
review_body: Wish it was a little softer/thicker and maybe a tad larger...other than that this blanket/bag is great!  Folds up well, convenient and light weight.   I noticed in some of the reviews I read that there was a chemical smell and I agree - there was an odd smell when I first received it (kind of plasticy?), but it was fine once I aired it out for a day.  I would recommend this to friends as a great purchase for picnics, beach, etc.

product_title: Coolibar Girl's Swim Romper UPF 50+
review_body: I bought this for my baby and am in love with it.  It does look a little odd, but I don't have to worry about applying sunscreen or about sand bugs or mosquitos attacking my baby while she's wearing this.  It has held up very well.  I only wish there were cuter gender neutral options because it is expensive, and I would like to be able to pass it on to a future sibling, but am limited by the color.  I am sure it would hold up well as a hand me down.  It does show the same wear as a swimsuit would- pilling on the bottom from sitting on a cement pool deck, etc.  I do not hold that against this product.  I am a big fan and am ordering a new larger size for this summer.

product_title: KEET Wave Chair
review_body: Very satisfied with this chair so far - upholstery job is well done, chair feels solid and stable - can't be easily overturned by our 18-mos old daughter and fits her perfectly. Made in Mexico. Got it on \\"sale\\" - 45% off of msrp - otherwise it's quite expensive. In any case, if you go to your local toys-r-us and look at their selection @ $40-$60 - this one is leagues above in esthetics and workmansip quality.

product_title: Safety 1st Simple Step Diaper Pail
review_body: I have a newborn baby.This diaper pail is great so far for me!I never smell any odor.I love the foot pedal

product_title: The First Years Premium Single Electric Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is the best pump I have tried, it was also my first and nothing has compaired, it is fast yet gentle. I purchased a second pump the same brand that was TERRIBLE, painful and slow, I could not completely empty my breast with it either and I'm a B cup size.

product_title: Sesame Street Teether Babies
review_body: I got the Cookie Monster Teether.  It's very cute and the size is right.

product_title: Boutique Safari Jungle Animals Baby Crib Nursery Bedding Set 13 pcs included Diaper Bag with Changing Pad & Bottle Case
review_body: Overall, it's very cheap. The colors are bland and don't look very much like the pictures. It looks as if they used 3 colors to make this set. The turtles are red and look like ladybugs and the giraffes are also a ladybug red. The bib is useless. I can see thru it and it's a bit too small. The comforter is very thin. The entire package is about the size and width of a small laptop bag which confused me since I've seen bedding sets at Wal~Mart that looked nice and plump! The contents inside are just too frail. After being so excited to get the crib bedding and decorate our sons room, I was sooo dissapointed when I finally got to open the package. I felt very mislead and cheated. Please try looking for a better deal.

product_title: Medela Breast Feeding Contact Nipple Shield
review_body: Great product to get baby to latch back on after refusing.  And when you are so sore during the first couple weeks.  However, I would say to definitely get fitted by a lactation consultant before purchasing, as I needed a size small and a regular sized one.

review_body: The sheet got here so, so fast! It was very soft, washed beautifully and I can't wait to lay my new son on it! Thanks

product_title: Go-Go Babyz Infant Cruizer All Terrain for Graco Infant Seats, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this because I am gonna be moving overseas soon and have 4 children, one is just born... I wanted to be able to travel with her carseat and a stroller along with all our luggage without looking like the local bag lady... This is a great product. It is easy and small to travel with... manuevers very easily... doesn't do so well on cobblestone streets though... but is otherwise a great investment.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Bath Center (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is the perfect bath for your little one. My daughter is about 3 months old and has been using this since she was 2 weeks. The netting is very sturdy. I have not had one problem with this product. My daughter loves bath time and this product lets me be hands on with her.

product_title: Fisher Price Rainforest Melodies and Lights Deluxe Gym + Accessory Kit
review_body: My baby has loved this from the time she was about 6 six weeks and would lie underneath it and look at the toys and lights and listen to the music, to now when she is 6 months and likes to roll around under it, sit on the side and play with the giraffe and lie on her stomach and study the patterns. For me it has given me the opportunity to put her down, knowing she will be happy for around twenty minutes, and I'll have the chance to get something done. However, shop around. The price for this toy varies a lot!

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Bottle Brush
review_body: After months of splashing all over myself while washing baby bottles with a round Munchkin brush, I finally said to myself \\"there's got to be a better way to do this\\". And thanks to Amazon I found this awesome brush and my sleeves can stay dry! The angle of this brush makes cleaning the bottom of the bottle so easy and it fits perfectly through the skinny neck of my Dr. Brown bottles. It works so well I am thinking of buying another one just so I can have a spare!

product_title: Trend Lab Wall Clock
review_body: Save your money on this, all of the reviews are true and I should have listened.  Bought it for a new bathroom.  Waited 2 months to put it up so by the time I took it out of the box and noticed it didn't work it was too late to return.  Since it looks so cool though I went and bought a cheap clock and replaced the clock and hand mechanism on the face of this clock with the working ones.  At least I didn't have to throw it away.

product_title: KinderGlo Owl Portable Fun & Safe Night Light
review_body: My daughter (2.5 years old) developed a fear of the dark, so I bought this owl in the hopes that she would feel happier and safer. It has worked! She goes to sleep with him every night and we also use it in the car at night for my 5 month old daughter. Such a great little night light! Customer service is awesome when i had a question for them and they were super helpful!

product_title: The First Years  Soothie Transition Bottle - 1 Pack
review_body: Purchased for my daughter when she was 12 months. She accepted it the first time I gave it to her, and within 2 weeks she was on a sippy cup!

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Blue Sky Cradle 'n Swing (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Nice Product a Bit Noisy Though
review_body:
We really liked this Swing. Our baby seems to enjoy his time in the swing. I am using A/C Power with the Cable which came with it. It makes slight noise when the motor tries to push the Swing back and forth. This swing won't work without manually making it to swing. The motor just keeps up the swing's pace. The Max speed is about perfect for our baby. I really like the music on this swing (It has 3 choices for that) The one with rain forest sounds is really good.

We had initially thought that the toys on the top of the swing would rotate, That would have been great, But it does not. Also a little light (Probably blinking or something) would have caught baby's attention.

Overall this is a very nice product for the Price range. Our baby goes to sleep without crying much, what else do we want!!

product_title: Blue COMFORT SILKIE Security Blanket ~ The Original. The Best. Award Winning.
review_headline: Too small to be called a "blanket"
review_body: Unfortunately, I didn't realize that this item is only about 18\\" square when I put it on my baby registry. I was disappointed in the size as it's really rather useless as a blanket.

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Forward Facing Car Seat
review_body: We have been using this seat with the 5 point harness for a few weeks and so far, everything seems great.  At first, I didn't think there were enough shoulder harness slots.  Once I raised the head rest, I saw 4 sets of slots.  Our tall 2.5 year old son is on the third set from the top and I think he should be able to be harnessed for a while.  The straps are not prone to twisting like our Graco convertible seat did and the latches are easier to work with, yet still not easy for our son to undo himself.  There is extra storage space in the inside of the arms that the kids can easily access to store small toys, etc.  The seat is somewhat bulky, however, as the kid grows, the seat needs to grow so that's to be expected.  I plan to order another one for our second car soon!

product_title: KidCo Baby Steps Food Mill, 1 food mill (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: an oldie but goodie...glad it is still around for next generation
review_body: I used this grinder probably thirty years ago with my first child: now my youngest is using it with her ten month old. It works great. No annoying people in a restaurant with noise...and no reliance on bland pureed baby food...just use the healthy food the family eats. Obviously not for first introduction to solids, as it is not smooth like yogurt...but most babies like variety,and texture. She loves this grinder, just as I did. Cheap, well made, useful, basic. It isn't great for tough meat, or raw veggies...but for cooked veges, stew, soup, pasta...chicken, it works great.

product_title: Simmons Kids Plush Changing Pad Cover
review_body: very nice, very plush and soft.  it fits the pad very well and doesnt come off by accident.  I recommend.

product_title: Fisher-Price Dreamsicle Collection Swing N Glider, Tan/Orange (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I shipped one of these units to my son and daughter in-law. They were having a hard time putting their fussy newborn down for a nap. My wife suggested a swing and I immediately ordered this one and expedited the shipping. The swing arrived in 2 1/2 days. They LOVE it. It has been a god send for the past two weeks. I remember when we had one with a crank handle. This plug in model is a dream.

product_title: Graco Avaalon Glider Rocker with Ottoman, Espresso (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this glider. It is super comfortable for me, and I like the pockets on the sides of the arm rests.

product_title: THERMOS FOOGO Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel 10-Ounce Straw Bottle
review_body: I have purchased different kinds of straw cups for my 17-month-old baby and can honestly say this is the best!!!    My main concern before I bought this cup was the weight of this cup. My little was used to have cups with handles so I wasn't sure if she had a strong grip enough to handle this cup. As you see, the cup seems to be very heavy!! However, this cup is not as heavy as it looks( a bit heavier than my computer mouse.) And its insulator works like a charm!!! I think it keeps milk/juice cold for at least 6 hours. At last, it doesn't leak for most time. Only time she spills her drink out of this cup is when she holds this cup up side down and shakes it hard.    I'm very pleased with this product and own 5 of them now. My little girl loves this cup as well!!!     So here is my 5 stars!!

product_title: Lilly Gold Sit 'n' Stroll 5 in 1 Car Seat and Stroller Combination, Shoreline (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Excellent item for air travel with a child
review_body: My husband and I love this item! We bought the Go-Go kidz special when he planned to visit his parents in Colorado with our 2 year old, and although it looked simple to use- he wanted to use to sit-n-stroll. When he got back i was surprised to hear him call it a 'life saver' There's less steps involved going through security check-points. It just sits on the belt and no need of taking the wheels off to make it fit when traveling alone with a toddler. product_title: Diaper Dekor Plus Refills 2 Pack

product_title: Carters Easy Fit Velour Crib Fitted Sheet

product_title: Aimee Silky Baby Blankets
review_body: My son has been using his every day for almost 7months now. Has been washed several times now and no unraveling or any wear signs. Can't go anywhere without it! Great Blanket!

product_title: Bumbo Baby Sitter - Lilac
review_headline: Not a must-have; depends on the child.
review_body: I agree with previous reviewers that the Bumbo's usefulness depends on your child's personality. My mommy friends led me to believe that this was a \\"must-have\\" that every child would love. It's a cute product, innovative and it appears to be well-designed. I saw no reason my baby wouldn't like it! However, it turns out that my daughter was just way more interested in moving than sitting still. The first few times we tried to put her in it (3-4 months) she didn't have enough trunk control and slouched over, so we removed her. By the time she was 5-6 months, she was constantly arching her back and trying to launch herself out of the Bumbo. She was learning to crawl and valued mobility over sitting and watching the world go by. Ultimately, it wasn't the best investment for our family. I wish I had bought one used instead of paying full price for it (because I was naive and so sure it was the perfect baby product). We did use it the first couple of weeks she was eating solids, but we will probably put our next child straight in the high chair when she reaches that stage. I did keep it and I am holding out hope that our next child will appreciate the Bumbo more than our first. Maybe then we can get our money's worth!

product_title: Mommy's Helper Panda Door Pinch Guard
review_body: I bought 3 of these after seeing one in use at a friend's house.  They work so well that I am back to buy enough for every door in the house.  These pandas work so well.  They not only save my little door slammers fingers, but the wall from door handle dents as well.  They are easy to move/remove and can be placed as high on the door as you need.  I have been using these for four months now and have no complaints at this time, except for the small child who can't get it through her head that we don't slam doors!

product_title: MAM 3 Count BPA Free Bottle
review_body: These bottles are cute, the nipple shape is great. My newborn had no problems. The problem is that it leaks terribly from the bottom. I tried everything from tightening it more, making sure it was dry, etc. Still leaked. Sent them out for donation.

product_title: Baby Jogger 2010 City Select Stroller Second Seat Kit
review_headline: Best investment, best overall even with some faults
review_body: Hello everyone,  I have never been one to write a review, but after researching this stroller pretty much night and day for the last month, I feel I should since it was those reviews from others that helped me make my decision! My thanks to each one of you!    I just got my baby jogger city select yesterday and took it for a 2 hour spin. WOW! When they say it is a luxury stroller, they mean it! It handles like a dream, and anybody who has tender wrists can really appreciate this feature of smooth, one-handed steering. I do not have a second child yet, and it is true that the adapters for the second seat SHOULD be sold apart from the second seat, but I feel it is still worth it! After taking it for a spin you will understand. Great sleek design, wonderful capability to turn the seats however you want them, wheels are great to absorb impact, in my opinion all terrain.    Being honest, if there is one thing that can be said that should be better, it is the foot rest. Many, many others have commented on this feature and it is true that it is too short. But, you can either not buy the stroller and suffer with a dozen other issues with another stroller, or you could buy this wonderful stroller and find a way to make it better! I personally will put a small blanket under my sons fanny to lift him up when his legs get a little snug in the rest, or you can just lay the foot rest all the way down! I ALMOST reconsidered buying this stroller because of the footrest problem, but don't let that deter you! It's an awesome stroller and the best I have ever used!     IF you are still concerned, find a store near you that carries it and check it out! You will see!!

product_title: OXO Tot Dishwasher
review_body:
OXO's Tot Dishwasher Basket is designed for washing baby bottles and other small accessories in the dishwasher. Normally these items are not suitable for dishwashers because they can drop to the bottom where the heating element is. To solve this problem, OXO basically gives us a plastic basket with securely closable lids and a lot of reasonably large but still small enough holes. These two features work together to make sure that whatever goes into the basket does not come out. The idea is very well conceived and makes you wonder if really no one has thought of it before.

However, I must note that there is no reason to limit its use to baby items only. In fact, we had great success using this basket to wash other items that used to fall down to the bottom occasionally. Try measuring spoons and silicon rubber spatulas (especially those that comes apart into a silicon tip and a plastic handle).

product_title: American Red Cross Door Knob Cover - 3 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I should have listened to the other reviews on here for sure! I am on my second child and with my first we used the Safety 1st brand and had absolutely no problems. With these, they are practically impossible to get apart to even put on the door and then once you get them on there they are extremely hard to get open especially on a round knob. I put one on my pantry door and my husband came home and couldn't get it open! So I tried to and sure enough it does not grip it at all no matter how you try to do it. Then I tried to get it off the knob which took me another 10 minutes because of how impossible it is to break apart. I finally had to get a knife and press down on the little button while trying not to stab myself lol. It definitely will keep your child out of the room you have it on but it will also make it very hard for you to get in. I will be buying the Safety 1st brand and throwing all these away!

review_body: These cute little strap covers fit perfectly in my baby's car seat. The straps used to dig into his neck and hurt him. These soft pads alleviate this and now there is no issue with that.   My only concern is that he chews on the heads non-stop until i turned them around so that the head is in the back.

product_title: Vtech Crystal Sound DECT Digital Monitor Single
review_body: I saw this monitor at walmart for $60 including two parent units and though I was actually looking for the [[ASIN:B001COIH3A Philips Avent Basic Baby Monitor w/ DECT Technology]], I couldn't pass this one up when it was $50 less and included a second parent unit.  I purchased this one thinking surely it would be just as good since they were both DECT technology AND I would even get an extra parent unit.  How cool is that right?    I got the monitor home and set it up to test.  Our home is not huge (about 2000 sq ft), but the kids' room is on the opposite end of the house from our room.  Also our home is VERY well insulated...which is nice for the electric bill but we've had many problems with monitors in the past!  I was hoping the DECT technology would be the solution I was looking for!    After setting the unit up in the kids' room I went to the kitchen to test out the receiver and noticed that after a few minutes it would go silent.  I figured this was a battery saving feature and that it would voice activate.  I sent my husband back to test it and to my disbelief it NEVER activated in spite of him talking very loudly right next to it!  After looking through the manual I found that you can set the sensitivity to 5 (max) and the volume to 5 (max - but still not very loud for being the max setting), and that would keep the units linked continuously.  So there's one problem solved...then I moved the receiver to our bedroom (further from the kids' room than I initially tested since this is where most of our problems arise)...and I had it on continuously...I sent my husband back to test again and once again I COULD NOT hear him at all.  The unit never indicated it was out of range or that there was any connection problem.  There was no static, no beeping, no nothing...including no sound from my husband talking right next to the kids' unit.      Thankfully I had purchased this to put in my 3 and 4 year old kids' room and NOT a nursery.  However I was horrified at the thought of someone putting this unit in a nursery expecting to hear their baby crying, only to find out they can't hear them at all.  I CANNOT imagine how guilt ridden I would be.    This monitor has some serious design flaws that MUST be addressed.  Firstly, the failure of the unit to voice activate properly, and secondly, the failure of the unit to indicate it was out of range and unable to transmit.  VERY DISAPPOINTING.    I did end up purchasing the Avent monitor and it works perfectly.  Though it is $50 more, it is well worth it for a properly designed monitor that does what it is supposed to do...and does it well!  We've had no static, no interference, and we can HEAR our children...most importantly!

review_headline: I dont love, but I dont hate
review_body:
I have always used Luvs diapers and these are around the same price so I decided to try them. I have an 8 month old and a 2 1/2 yr old. My only complaint about these diapers is that I wish the elastic between the legs was tighter. I experienced no problems when my 8mth old wore them. He is a crawler and a mover but not as much as my 2 1/2 yr old. I will not put these diapers on my oldest until after he has done his \\"business\\" for the day. The few times I did, I was lucky nothing ended up on his clothes and between his legs. The fit just isn't tight enough for the movement of a spirited little boy.
I will give the positives to this diaper; they are absorbent without being bulky. The tabs are stretchy, good for my youngest boys little pop belly. Never had any problems with rashes or irritation of any kind. And the fun and new design had my oldest singing twinkle,twinkle little star every time we changed his diaper, which was always very cute. Plus they are very affordable and made in America.
I really want to say I would by these diapers again, but sadly I will not. If the company were to make changes to the fit of the elastic between legs, then I probably would buy again.

product_title: Aosom Baby Kids Wooden Playpen Room Divider 8 Panel
review_body: I purchased this product when my son was only 11 months old. He wasn't even walking yet.  I purchased this play pen because it was made of wood, advertised to be a safe place for a child to play in, and offered a lot of space. I didn't purchase this unit from Amazon, but directly from the AOSOM Company in Oregon who is the manufacturer/distributer of the unit.    It was only in use for a little over 2 months, when I noticed that it had areas where it was cracked and split on half of the panels. I noticed this because my child was playing with something in his hand; and I saw that it was a large chunk of wood.  The wood that is used in the manufacture of this unit is soft.  The wood pieces that are above and below the dowels are not whole pieces of wood, but three smaller pieces of wood glued together. The connection points between each panel are not reinforced and due to the soft wood, split, crack and break off. The entire unit is supposed to have some sort of coating to make it smooth and keep it protected.  This is definitely not the case.  I contacted the manufacturer and dealt with 2 different people.  The person who contacted me via phone stated that he would replace any broken panels and that he wanted me to send him pictures.  On the same day a different person e-mailed me and said that the company couldn't help me because I only had 2 months warranty, but he said that he wanted pictures.  I took pictures of the unit.  When I took the pictures I carefully look at every panel section and noticed that the other 4 panels had damage as well.  The first 4 had very obvious damage where pieces of wood completely broke off, the other 4 had pieces of wood that were splitting and splintering and were ready to break off.  Thus, the entire unit would need to be replaced, or I would need a refund.    I sent the pictures to the manufacturer and the person that e-mailed me back stated that he would only replace 4 of the panels ---with me paying shipping expenses for the new panels to be shipped to me.  I was floored at the response since I sent pictures showing that the unit not only was unusable and posed a choking hazard, but had obvious manufacturer defects.   For three weeks, I repeatedly asked for someone to call me, and I asked the manufacturer several times for a refund as I didn't want 4 panels replaced and 4 panels broken.  The response from the company was that they could not help me.  I asked to speak to a supervisor and the last response that I received is that their manager \\"doesn't accept phone calls\\".  I contacted the Better Business Bureau and also the Consumer Product Safety Commission.  The CPSC picked up the unit and is completing an investigation of the manufacture of the unit and the choking hazard that this unit poses to children.    In my opinion, this unit should be recalled.  As part of my due diligence to the CPSC, I looked on the internet to see if there were other individuals that had the same issues as I had with the playpen.  The lesson learned here, is that I should have looked on Amazon first to see if there were any poor reviews of the product.  There are several poor reviews out there on Amazon and other places.   Had I seen the poor reviews on this unit, I would have never purchased it in the first place.

product_title: BabySmart Cooshee Changer
review_headline: Best changer out there and great VALUE! EASY TO CLEAN!
review_body: UPDATE 8/22/11:  My baby was only 5.5lbs when we brought him home, so he looked really tiny in this changer.  He is now 13 mos and over 2ft long (or tall, I guess), and his feet stick out over the edge.  While we still use this, I'm afraid its useful life is coming to a close for us.      One concern I do have is when he is lying down on it to be changed, he puts his feet against the lip and pushes, but since he is longer than the changer, his head hits the top, and then he screams because his head is being smushed, not knowing that if he would just stop pushing with his feet, his head would be fine.  Despite this, the high lip is still a highly recommended feature because it is solid and sturdy while being soft, so when my baby rolls over and tries to crawl away, he kind of doesn't because the lip makes him feel penned in.    I'm not sure how long other parents have used changing tables for their babies...up to 2 years old?  This changer, despite its great features, will not last that long, and we got bonus time with it because we had a preemie.  I guess its the changing pad on the floor now...    Still highly recommend over traditional changing pads.  Never had to take a cover off due to mess getting on it.  We just wiped it down with bleach, dried it really well, and it was ready to go.        ORIGINAL REVIEW:  Saw this in a magazine and Amazon was the only place that carried it.  Ordered it in Chai Tan and absolutely LOVE IT!  Cushion and soft for my baby, doesn't get cold, the built-in head rest is a very nice feature, and the sides are tall enough that baby won't roll away.    Best part is that it is completely waterproof.  Urine and poop squirts that my horrible diapering skills fail to catch just wipe away.  It doesn't stain the changer at all, and there are no changer covers to buy, remove and wash.  We end up having to change baby's clothes because they get dirty as a result, but that's ok with us.    As for the Chai Tan color, some people say it looks like baby poop.  Since my baby has pooped on it several times, I can attest that though the color is similar, it is not the same.  My baby is breastfed exclusively right now, and his stools are a nuclear bright yellow.  The Chai Tan color is more of a warm harvest gold color, and since our bedroom is harvest gold, sage green, and chocolate brown, it is a perfect match, and looks gorgeous and sophisticated on top of our mahogany antique dresser, which we are using as a changing table (much less expensive, better looking, and more useful after baby grows up).  We absolutely love it and are highly recommending it to our pregnant friends.
