product_title: Mickey Mouse 2 in 1 Buddy Harness Buddy
review_body: This is a great harness for toddlers. My husband and I have a disney pass; but on days I go alone, this is the perfect solution. product_title: Boba Classic Baby Carrier - Dusk
review_headline: Great product except baby can't be turned faceout & not for newborns
review_body:
This is a pretty comfortable baby carrier, but please note that it is not designed for babies without head control. This means your baby will need to be about 3-4 months old before using this carrier. So, if you're looking for something for a newborn, you want to use a different carrier.

Pros:
* It comes with two additional features not always found on baby carriers: a sleeping/feeding hood and foot straps. These are nice little add-ons, although the hood is not likely to be used after baby is about 9 months, unless your baby just *likes* to have things on its head. The foot straps are detachable, so you can choose whether you want to use them or not.
* You can have baby facing in on the front or behind you.
* Straps are padded and feel secure.

Cons:
* There are no places for extra diapers, money, keys, etc. Some other baby carriers include this, and that's nice for when you're taking baby out hiking and don't want to be toting along a diaper bag or backpack (plus, with the baby carrier, there really is no where to carry the other items if you are solo).
* I am relatively new to the motherhood thing, but I couldn't figure out how to place the kid behind me without having a second person to help. I also needed someone to help remove the child from the back position.
* Baby can't be carried face-out in front, which is sometimes nice for the child, so they can see what's coming up. I like the facing out position best because then you can point things out.
* If you are small in stature but have a large (tall) child, I think that the forward facing position may not be possible, as it seems like the baby would be right in front of your face. I say that, although I'm 5'8\\", the positioning felt a little high up.

Overall, I found this a comfortable, easy-to-use carrier.

Regardless, the seat shows no signs of damage. With a little duct/cloth tape, I might be able to get a few more flights out of it, but for the $20 or so that it cost I'd be satisfied if I had to throw it away right now.

product_title: Naturepedic No Compromise Organic Cotton Classic Crib Mattress
review_body: I had this mattress months before my baby arrived... looked great, chemical free, organic... loved it.  Well, after only 3 months of my little guy sleeping on it, the mattress wasn't feeling or looking firm anymore. I even had to position my baby in different spots to try and find him a flat spot to sleep on. Unacceptable safety wise (and $$$ wise).  So, I emailed Naturepedic and described what was occurring, and they set up to ship me a new mattress immediately! The mattress arrived within days, and it was much more firm than my previously purchased one was when it was new! My son is now 16 months and the mattress is holding up great!  Get this mattress for the chemical-free factor, the organic factor, and the customer service!!!

product_title: Graco SnugRide LX Baby Infant Car Seat - Ally | 1763859
review_headline: cheaply made for sure, but nice!
review_body: i like it. my baby looks comfy in it and most of all, this is very affordable and works well with my tandem stroller. like the color too. the washable stuff are better than you can imagine...

product_title: Modern Basics Green Hippo Blanket 40 X 30
review_headline: Not as soft as I tought.
review_body: I tought it would be more soft, but it is kind of rough. Didn't like it.

product_title: Graco Mobile Entertainer Jungle Crew
review_body: This walker is great.  I bought it for my daughter when she was 8 months old, a little older than most people do, but she loved it.  Once she got the hang of it she was scooting across the house super fast.  Some of the other reviewers stated that it was hard for their babies to move on the carpet but she never had any problems, even going from carpet to lenoleum.  The only thing I did not really care for was the tray of toys, she never really used it, and it did not really work that great.  The stops worked great the were really sturdy and once locked in they did not move.  Also I bought it because it did not fold down, I never trusted the style that folded so this one was perfect because it locks in at 3 leaves.  I would definately recommend it to anyone.

product_title: TrendyKid becoPotty, Natural (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This BecoPotty is ideal for those practising Elimination Communication (taking baby to the potty when they need to go, rather than relying exclusively on diapers). The small size makes it easy to help even newborns use it, with mom or dad close behind to support their body fully.     Having said that my 2 and half yr boy had no problem using it, and the high splash guard is ideal for any boys who are potty training. The size also makes it ideal to take in the car on long journeys...    But forgetting all the above the main reasons why I love this potty and I will always recommend over all others is that its made from natural plant fibres making it so much more eco friendly than all the other potties on the market....In my eyes its a \\"must buy\\" for all parents starting their child's potty training between the age of 12mths -24ths.    Alex

product_title: Stroll-Air Stroller Organizer
review_body: I took a chance and ordered this even though I wasn't certain if it would fit my Bugaboo Bee. It's not perfect, but I really do love it. For an extra $5 over the price of the $25 Bugaboo Bee cup holder (the world's biggest ripoff after peeling of six and a half bills for the stroller itself), you get so much more... a cup holder, a place to put your stuff (keys, change purse, phone, iPod), and a compartment that closes with a drawstring for maybe a pacifier. I only put bottled drinks in the cup holder. I don't drink coffee, so I can't speak about how well the cup holder feature holds cups with caps on them. (I wouldn' put a cup with hot liquids that close to my baby anyway no matter WHAT brand of cup holder it was, but that's just how I am.) The instructions on how to put this organizer on the stroller consist of one ill-drawn diagram, but you'll figure it out. Also, I can't imagine why the straps are so long. It can look kind of messy, but I just kind of tucked them in around the organizer so that they don't stick out. I didn't want to cut them as another reviewer suggested, because I might want to use this organizer for a different purpose someday and maybe the long straps will come in handy. If you're trying to style and profile with your stroller accessories, then you can spend the extra money to get all the Bugaboo accessories you'd need to make up just this one. But if you want something that stays on snuggly, doesn't interfere with closing the stroller, and looks pretty decent, I think this is an excellent product for the money.

product_title: SnugZee Baby Car Seat Pillow & Head Support - Bingo
review_body: I ordered these for my son and my niece and they are great! I don't have to worry about his head leaning forward when he sleeps in car seat (during walks or in the car). I have used them since he was 4 months--as he was developing head and neck control and they work well now too. very soft and easy to wash! I hope they start selling an organic cotton line soon!

product_title: SOZO sleep Nap Sack Monkeys
review_body: This sleeper is great. Warm and it has a zipper on the side for easy changing if baby has to be changed. Love the product

product_title: Britax Boulevard 65 CS Click & Safe Convertible Car Seat
review_body: I am very happy with my purchase of this particular carseat and so is my son. I did my research and had asked questions on carseat forums.

product_title: Bumbo Baby Sitter - Blue
review_body: We bought the Bumbo for our second child when she was about 6 months old. At first she didn't like it very much, but eventually she changed her mind and didn't mind being in it at all! We took it with us often, especially when going to friends' houses that didn't have small children. A good (but not great) impromptu 'high chair' (on the floor, or with non squirmy children on a table with very close supervision!) for feeding her when there were no other options. Our best success with the Bumbo was on the Autotrain - an overnight trip from northern Virginia to Florida.  Dinner was served in the meal car which had tables with bench seats on either side. No room in the aisle for high chairs, and no boosters provided by Amtrak.  We brought the Bumbo and used it much like a booster for our 8 month old daughter.  The Bumbo is easy to clean, very portable, and a great product when used in a safe manner.  Don't forget to visit \\"Ready, Set, Bumbo\\" - the website.  The videos are hilarious and may give you some ideas of your own!

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: My son is usually fascinated by new toys for about 10 minutes.  They then get the old heave-ho and are recycled for use a few weeks later when he usually gets another 10 minutes out of them.  Not this one.  He has consistently been amused by this for hours at a time for weeks.  He'll stare at the blinking lights and press the music button over and over.  He also like to chew on the handle.  A bonus for us is that unlike most musical kid's toys, the sound emanating from the Take Along Tunes is not headache inducing.  A great product.  My only criticism would be that the sound wheel should be made of plastic instead of cardboard as it has not worn very well.

product_title: Mommy's Helper Contoured Cushie Step Up, 1 Count
review_body: I bought this product after returning another because the steps didn't reach the floor. This one is definitely made better. It appears as sturdy as something can be when its made from plastic, but the seat doesn't fit our toilet. We reversed the guides that come screwed on to give it a bit more room, so its workable. In reality, however, my son prefers to just hold himself up over the toilet rather than use this.

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor w. Sound Monitor w. Two Parents' Units
review_headline: Core functionality - five stars; Other "features" - one star
review_body: Ultimately I bought this as a breathing monitor... and it works perfectly.  We had two false alarms and both were when my son was sleeping deeply (very light breaths) after having wedged himself all the way to one end of the crib.  As the instructions (and others) have pointed out... you will need a piece of wood or something sturdy to set it on under the crib.  Ours was set at the perfect sensitivity straight out of the box, but you should run some tests with the baby out of the crib to see if the alarm goes off.  I found that if I had the ceiling fan on the highest setting, the vibration was enough to prevent the monitor for working properly.  All in all, the breathing monitor functionality (the pad and the alarm unit it connects to) is very easy to set up, and reliable.  I wouldn't change a thing.     However the other advertised features seemed to be poorly designed afterthoughts.  The tic funtion is annoying in the room... I'd love to just be able to have the parent unit lights flick instead of having to make it tic and then \\"see\\" the tics through as audio parts of the monitor.  Speaking of audio monitor, this one is very staticy and lacks the feature of others (like radio silence unless there's noise on the other end).  I already had an excellent baby monitor when I bought this so I just continued to use that.    Overall, I think $100 for just the breathing monitor functionality was totally worth it for my piece of mind (and therefore sleep).  I'd buy it again (although I'd also by my other sound only monitor as well).

product_title: Tiny Love Classic Mobile
review_body: I liked the item, the only thing is that it only attaches to the crib and current my baby is co-sleeping, therefore I returned it since I can't attach it anywhere else.  I recommend that you check out other products by tiny love, since they have ones that have attachable links.

product_title: FridaBaby NoseFrida The SnotSucker Nasal Aspirator
review_headline: Just what I was looking for...
review_body: So much easier to use than the bulb! Really gets in there and gets the job done. My husband finds it completely off putting especially the \\"noise\\" as it's suctioning up a good bit out, but hey...that just means it's working! Anything that helps our baby get a good night sleep is worth it in my book. FYI - I also use saline nasal drops before using it but will work without it if the boogs are nice and soft, e[...]

product_title: Fisher-Price Cradle 'n Swing, Scatterbug (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this swing.  I originally wanted a swing that would turn into a toddler rocking chair but the only ones I could find were at least $50 more than this swing.  I can just wait and buy a rocking chair when he is a toddler with the money I saved.  He is three weeks old and already loves the swing.  It plays neat sounds and has several speeds.  We are going slow right now.  The bugs are so cute!!  The toys are a little high but they are cute and sway with the movement of the swing.  The baby seems to like the nature sounds.

product_title: Safety 1st Fingertip Toothbrush and Case
review_body: I was expecting a product I could use to clean my dog's teeth.  I was very disappointed when I found that the finger-brush is so small that I could not get it on my finger and it therefore is unusable.  Not recommended.

product_title: Graco Alano Snugride 22 Travel System, Greer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Assembly went well except for the last step. Instructions were well written.    The parent tray (for cups, keys) that fits on the handle of the stroller did not fit. I could get the left or right side to fit but not get the \\"2nd\\" side to fit. So, I attached one side, and then  I loosened the phillips screw holding the black \\"button\\" on the other side of the tray.  I then took a THIN straight blade screw driver and pried the tray over the button. Then I tightened the screw.

product_title: Diaper Dude Original Diaper Bag - Dragon
review_body:
I had a bulky diaper bag and it wouldn't go over my shoulder and was such a pain to take around along with my purse and the baby. I use this as my purse and diaper bag and it has tons of room. This helps make life much simpler now that I can put this over my shoulder and ditch the dumb purse! Yay!

*Updated* 5/28/12 - I am still using this bag and it has not shown one bit of wear...it still looks brand new! I really love how it clips onto the stroller so it can't be lost or stolen and it is easy to carry the bag and handle a energetic toddler at the same time.

product_title: Baby Sherpa Alpha Sherpa - Black
review_headline: not enough space for baby neccessities
review_body: I researched all sorts of baby diaper backpacks and thought this one would be the winner.  It is an okay bag but now I wish I had kept the tags and paperwork to return it.  The Lap top pocket is barely big enough to hold a laptop and if you do carry a lap top, there is no room for a changing pad (you have to choose one or the other and i would rather the changing pad).  There is no diaper specific pockets or even enough inside pockets to separate your things.  Also, there are no stroller straps to attach to your stroller or shopping cart for when you'd like to put your bag down. The big built in cooler is nice, but since most people just carry a few snacks for their children and not a six pack of cans, it makes for much less storage in the main backpack and makes the backpack top heavy.  It also has no pacifier holder.  The two extra side pockets could be slightly bigger.  The material seems to be durable so far and it has served it's purpose.  All in all, I would recommend a more diaper gear friendly bag to others.  For being a diaper backpack, the Alpha Sherpa doesn't have all their bases covered.

product_title: New Arrivals The Letter L
review_body: I was envisioning something a little more substantial when I ordered my letter. It was going to be the focal point of one wall. It was much smaller than expected when it arrived. It would have been nice to see the letter used in a room before we purchased. I would not say this is worth the full listed price.  Also, it didn't come with a means to hang it.  The description says to use double sided tape?!  We drilled a hole in it to hang from a nail.

product_title: South Shore Furniture
review_body: This is a nice Changing Table for the price I paid. The only thing that I did not like is that it took a long time to put it together, the instruction are confused, otherwise for the price you paid you cannot expect for more.

product_title: Safety 1st Prograde Clearly Soft Corner Cushions - 4 Pack
review_body: This corner cushion is a soft, silicone-like outer cushion adhered to a hard plastic liner.  The hard plastic seems to allow a more secure attachment to the furniture, but it will definitely NOT \\"conform to table corners,\\" as the product description states.  The inside lines and angles of the rigid liner are perfectly straight and right - if that doesn't describe your furniture, these cushions may not fit well.  Both layers are transparent, though the rounded part of the outer layer appears lightly frosted.  Outside dimensions (from outer-tip to outer-tip) are 2-1/4\\" across the top, and 2\\" on each lower diagonal - please note: this measurement is where the cushion cuts behind the furniture corner, not along the furniture's edge.  Each cushion comes with three triangular pieces of double-sided tape.  The cushions are applied by pressing the tape to the inside, hard-plastic side, then pushing the cushion onto the corner to be protected.  It takes a bit of dexterity to prevent the tape from sticking to the corner before the cushion is all the way on - it's not too difficult, but some care must be taken to assure the most secure application possible.  This is probably important, as on one or two occasions, our 17-month old has walked up to a cushion and chewed on it.  The rubber seems pretty tough, and completely resisted the light chewing.  He hasn't tried to pull them off yet, but I don't think he would be able to - they are on very securely.  We used these on the painted-metal casings of HVAC units, and the attachment is very secure, as I think it would be for any smooth surface.  I can't speak to its effectiveness on wood, or the damage removing it may cause, but every corner/edge guard I've seen is attached with double-sided tape - I'd keep that in mind when reading some of the complaints of other reviewers.    As for protectiveness, these cushions are more dense than the typical foam cushions, and would seem to protect better against a head bump.  They are also completely rounded, whereas foam cushions still come to a point at the corner, so these may be better for eye protection.  On the down side, these are smaller, so they really only cover the corner, whereas larger foam cushions cover more of the edge.  They also taper down toward the corners, so would not be appropriate if you're looking to extend the cushion along the edge, beyond the corner.    In terms of appearance, to my eye these are far more appealing than foam cushions - they blend in better - at least on our light-colored furniture - and aren't as bulbous and bulky-looking.

product_title: Kalencom Heavenly Dots Week-Ender Bag
review_body: I have this bag and the laminated and I love them - one goes with the baby, one stays with me.  Very well made - roomy, and organizes well.  Would buy again and again

product_title: DadGear Messenger Diaper Bag - Daredevil
review_body: My husband picked this out for his Daddy Diaper Bag.  It's made from a material that will be super easy to clean, it's adjustable strap is great for putting it on the stroller, and the design is super cool.  Came with a changing pad inside and lots of pockets!

product_title: Summer Infant Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor 1.8" Screen
review_body: Although the monitor  is a bit bulky (if you have plans of clipping it to your clothes where you are out and about in your own house), it worked well the first six months. Then, all of a sudden, no more picture, just static. I have never been able to figure out what the heck happened and why. I certainly would not purchase any of their electonic products again.

product_title: BABYBJORN Diaper Backpack Active - Blue/Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got this as a gift from my mother in law because I was expecting my 2nd and knew a back pack diaper bag would be more user friendly with 2.  The compartments are not very big.  The front one is good for food and stuff for my toddler but the back one seems packed with just the diapers and bare necessities.  I would prefer deeper and wider pockets and might just look for a regular back pack on sale at back to school time.

product_title: Elmo Travel Tray
review_body: We got this for a road trip - it works great for travelling with a little one...they can eat and play there in their carseat as you go. We love it!

product_title: Safety 1st Simple Step Diaper Pail
review_body: I thought this product was larger than it really is - Note that the Amazon dimensions must be the box it ships in.  Under details it does state that this is only 16\\" high.  This is more of a disappointment to me because I plan to use it for cloth diapers, and it doesn't look like it would hold more than 8-10 at most.  The quality is what you'd expect for the price - adequate.

product_title: Boba Classic Baby Carrier, Glacier (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a good looking, functional and comfortable baby carrier. The straps are comfortable, it's easy to adjust. Also it has a little extra height to it which helps keep it very close and stable--very helpful and better for your body/back. The price is great and the foot straps are a big plus to have. The \\"Glacier\\" two-tone color combo is also very stylish.

product_title: Infant Flight Vest Travel Harness (Red)
review_body: I didn't get to use the product. the airline no longer lets families with small children on first so we had less time to get situated. Felt  rushed trying to get my two kids comfortable and ready for the long flight.

product_title: Safety 1st Exchangeable Tip 3 in 1 Thermometer
review_body: I liked the concept, but this thermometer is the slowest thermometer I have ever used. I am sure it would work great if my baby would sit still for the entire 2 minutes it takes for it to read her temperature, but what baby can sit still that long? Every time I tried to use it I felt like I was torturing her. I tried it in her armpit and rectally, both took an equal amount of time to get a reading.

product_title: Hoppop Bato Bath Tub, Lime  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Our new tub arrived yesterday and it was exactly what we were hoping for.  It is VERY lightweight and my 8 month old little girl could sit in it with ease and has lots of room to grow.  The high sides are great and, contrary to another review, we didn't find it slippery at all.

product_title: Shuttle 33 Infant Car Seat
review_headline: recommended for special needs, low weight older babies
review_body: This was the third infant carrier for my baby, who is actually turning 2 very soon.  The first one was rated 27\\", the second 29\\", now this one 33\\".  With a child who has less control, with special needs, this has been the answer.  Thank God for Combi!  I was at a loss of how to transport a little one who can't sit in a grocery cart.  Taking a convertible carseat in and out would be a hassle.  Note: it doesn't fit well in the front of grocery carts, I use a simple buckle to go through the cart and put it in the place where the seatbelt would go (if you were to use with out the base). You could use a bungee cord type buckle just make sure it is all secure.  Some of the dvd player cases have plenty of extra buckles that are long enough or can be doubled.  You definitely do not want baby sliding!    One point of importance.... I thought about the feet being cramped at 33\\" still rear facing, but the design of this carseat is better than most when in the base.  The rebound bar is annoying but even baby learns to like it.  If your little one cannot face forward because of low weight, ANY carseat will have to be backwards, so why not use a carseat that is transportable?  Easy in and out.

product_title: Kalencom Stroller Straps Brown (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These little things are fantastic!  I actually use them much more often for my purse when I go out with my umbrella stroller.  They are easy to put on and work just as intended.  It keeps your purse or diaper bag easily accessible!  I can't believe that they aren't easily available everywhere baby things are sold!

product_title: The First Years Hands Free Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
There are so many pros, so few cons to this gate. It's tall, there's no way my 2-year-old can get over it. Incredibly convenient swinging door. If you follow the instructions on how to correctly tighten it on the door frame you won't have trouble. I didn't do that the first time and I was getting frustrated. The gate was smarter than me!

My son, who is Mr. Motor Skills, cannot open it.

Would make an excellent dog gate for small dogs.

Sometimes the pedal can get sticky and you have to push on it a little harder, but that's really my only complaint.

product_title: Tiny Love Classic Mobile
review_body:
I want to give this mobile a great review because my 4 month old loves it. Its a life saver to put her down in the crib and have it entertainer her giving Mommy a break. However I am constantly replacing the batteries and C batteries are not cheap. I recently purchased rechargeable C batteries to try and save some money but in this mobile they run out of juice much faster than normal alkalines. Changing the batteries requires a screwdriver and I've gotten to the point where I just leave the back off. What a pain! I cannot recommend buying this mobile based on the issues with batteries alone. Honestly it seems like this mobile is \\"out of order\\" more than it works.

ugh!

product_title: Munchkin Formula Dispenser Combo Pack
review_body: Convenient for moms on the go.  Great for baby bags without weighing it down with big cans of powdered formula.  The single serving dispenser is a nice addition.  Colors are bright and pretty.

product_title: Graco Twin IPO Stroller, Navarro (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I am extremely happy with the purchase of this stroller!  It is compact and sturdy.  It is a little on the heavy side, but I like that it doesn't feel cheap.  The boys (2yrs - Gray, and 5 months - Jack) seem to like it just fine.  I love that the seats recline independent of each other.  Great purchase.

product_title: All Natural 100% Cotton Reversible Baby Sling Carrier with Leg Rest Cushion, Cool Green Apple Design
review_body: Very pretty and stylish.  It's a little difficult to get my baby in and out of this sling by myself, so I have to have help.  Other than that small issue, I think it's a great sling!

product_title: Wubbanub Soft Toy and Pacifier
review_body: Looks cute and its what I wanted. Shipping got messed up and took some time to get here. Will be looking at getting more in future.

product_title: Graco Pack 'N Play Playard with Newborn Napper
review_body: I love the item, it was easy to put together for the most part.  It is a very nice looking pack and play.  The thing that sold me was the newborn napper.  I got this item so I didnt have to get a bassinet.  We love the Graco pack and plays and they last a long time.  The added feature of music and vibration is really cool for newborns.  The side caddy thing isnt very great but altogether it is a great item.

product_title: Carters Easy Fit Velour Crib Fitted Sheet
review_body: I purchased one of these sheets 3 yrs ago with the birth of my first child.  I found that the softer/warmer the sheet that the baby sleeps on, the better they sleep.  I've since purchased more of the same in various colors as I've had another child and now have one more on the way.  My best friend just had a baby and I got one for her too.  Now she's a believer like me!  These sheets are the best.

product_title: HABA Miniland Fabric Ball
review_body: I accidentally ordered this product while purchasing some other toys on Amazon for my 9-month old. When I found out that I had unintentionally paid eighteen dollars for a toy that we didn't want in the first place, I was pretty annoyed. This has turned out to be a sturdy ball though. The stitching is reliable and the ball makes a nice sound. However, I feel that one would only pay this much for a fabric ball if they were buying more so for the label. This ball is relatively small so I feel that ten dollars would be a far more reasonable price. It's easy for babies to grasp though which is certainly a positive.

product_title: Graco Modern Pack 'N Play Playard with Bassinet and Changer, Zurich (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We've been using this pack and play since we brought our son home from the hospital and now he is 10 weeks old. We didn't want to buy a traditional bassinet since it would only be used for a few months and then be useless.  This was a great alternative.  Once our son exceeds the bassinet portion, we can still use the pack and play as a play yard.       Pros:  -The sound machine that attaches to the side is great--the music and nature sounds are soothing.  Our son likes the music and falls asleep easily when we use it.      -The diaper changing station that attaches to the side has been a real life-saver, making late night diaper changes easy.  The storage compartment easily holds lots of diapers and a box of wipes.       Cons:  -It does not fit through our door frames and must be broken down to move from room to room.      -While the bassinet is very secure, it does tend to bow in the center a bit.

product_title: Ellie Dust Ruffle by Cocalo
review_body: Love this collection, sad because I think it's discontinued.  The only complaint is that the colors are brighter in the pictures. They are very subdued in real life.

product_title: Chicco Ct0.6 Capri Lightweight Stroller
review_headline: Great stroller but color choices are limited...
review_body: We purchased this stroller for our trip to Hawaii with our 12 month old son.  I bought it based on the positive reviews on Amazon.  I was not too thrilled about the Topazio Blue color and would have preferred Grey, Navy or Green... but functionality is king and this stroller delivers.  It held up well on our 10 day trip across Kauai and Oahu.  Folded nicely and was easy to gate check during the flights.  Has good storage area and rolls steady.  The sunshade is adequate, it seems to detach itself fairly easy so when folding the stroller you need to keep an eye on it.  Overall for the sixty five bucks you pay I think it's a great find.

product_title: GoGo Kidz Travelmate
review_headline: Great for Travel! Would not travel without it again.
review_body: We buy our son a seat almost everytime we fly.  We like to have him sit in his carseat because it give us some rest time also.  Fits his carseat perfectly! He has a Sunshine Kids Radian XTSL which is way to heavy to lug through the airport.  It also save on the amount of stuff we have to bring on our trips.  We have also used it as a stroller.  I have traveled a lot with just my son and I and it makes it much easier for me to just stroll him through the airport to our connecting flight if we have one.  I have seen so many parents at the airport asking me where I got it and if he will ever grow out of it.  I was glad to tell them no!! So far it has been a life saver for me! Especially when my husband isn't there to help lug stuff around.

product_title: Recaro ProSPORT High Back Booster Car Seat - Midnight
review_body: This is a very nice car seat!  We ordered 2, one for both of our vehicles.  We previously had a Chicco infant car seat and couldn't find anything even close in quality at our local retailers.  If you are looking for a high quality, well built, and very safe booster car seat I promise you will not be disappointed with the Recaro ProSport!  One note on the fabric...we ordered one in Midnight and one in Blue Opal.  The Midnight one is more of a cloth/microfiber cover and the Blue Opal is more of a polyester fabric cover like our Chicco seat.  Both look like they will hold up well and clean up nicely.

product_title: HALO Big Kids SleepSack Lightweight Knit Wearable Blanket
review_body: As other reviewers have stated, these sleep sacks are generously sized.  My triplets have been wearing sleep sacks since they were born, and they love these as well.  My daugter will be able to wear this one for a long time.

product_title: My Little Seat Infant Travel High Chair
review_headline: Like a straitjacket--my child hates it!
review_body: Perhaps we started using this too late--our child was already 12 mos old when we finally tried one. I was so excited to see a solution to lugging a portable booster seat around. That said, it's hard to imagine our child ever tolerating it. My husband insisted after the first few tries that we just needed to get him to used to it. But, after 20 attempts I've finally given up. He cries, screams, twists and turns when I try to strap him in. I tried to use it on a family vacation and everyone started referring to it as his \\"straightjacket.\\" Finally, he was so hysterical when sitting in it that he started pushing back from the table and almost pushed the chair over.     One other note--reviewers mentioned that it didn't work on high-backed chairs but, as other reviewers have pointed out, a cushion or phone book fixes that problem. Would that there were the only one! I also like how stylish it is--very pretty!

product_title: Sassy Crib and Floor Mirror
review_body: I am disappointed with this.  It's ok.  It meets the minimum description of the product.  But there are a couple problems.  1) The velcro loops for hanging it in the crib are on the side of the ladybug.  This means when hung, the ladybug is upside down.  There was a picture on the box that showed the ladybug rotated, but mine is sewn down, so there is no way to make it right side up while hung on the crib rail.  2) When hung the velcro that holds the mirror \\"easel\\" closed pulls the fabric  out, so that it really doesn't hang straight.  3) The mirror does have some distortion, especially around the edges.    So yeah.  It wasn't so bad that I went to the effort to return it, but I wouldn't rec it to a friend.

product_title: Jenny Lind Crib Maple
review_headline: Nice item, but not all advertised colors are available
review_body: Rail's well designed to fit into the space, and looks sturdy, but not all colors mentioned in the Amazon listing are available.  I ordered oak but was sent white.  It took a few calls to the vendor before we got it straightened out, and I had to resort to an under-mattress rail.  (Somehow the first operator coded my return as \\"customer changed mind\\" which was ludicrous, I was begging them to find one in my color in their warehouse -- and when I learned that meant I wouldn't get free shipping back on the return, I called back again and the second operator was really on the ball.)      One caveat about the rail -- if your child moves all over the place while sleeping and presses up against the edge of the crib, you might be better off with a rail that blocks the *center* of the bed.  That's what I ended up with -- it's an under-mattress insert with a 9-inch gap at top and bottom.  Several times I've found my 3yo partly hanging over the edge at the gap, so it turned out to be for the best.

product_title: Fisher Price Brilliant Basics Block Cart Walker
review_body: My daughter said her almost one year old didn't seem to want to try and walk pushing a toy so I ordered this to have when she visited. It was a great success and my granddaughter started walking holding on to it right away. She also likes putting the blocks in and out so the toy will continue to entertain as she is able to fit them in the right shapes. I was very pleased with this toy, both as a walker type and just a toy.

product_title: Ju-Ju-Be BeConnected
review_body: although i didn't looove the diaper bag these are a must if you use a stroller and are out and about. it makes it easy to get into bag and is very accessable.if the diaper bag is full it's a bit hard to detach the bag from them before putting the stroller in car or wherever. basically u have 2 buy them and they serve their purpose, they should be included with the bag since it's so exspensive

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Whale of a Tub
review_body:
This is one of those items that most people are going to review without having used an alternate product. That's true for me as well. But I can say this: I'm one of those new moms who scoured reviews and Consumer Reports to pick what to register for. I'd picked another tub that looked more sophisticated I guess, then ending up registering for this one since it was available at a certain store where it seemed ALL of my shower guests wanted to shop. And I've been totally happy with it.

It's worked great for our baby since the time the cord fell off and he was allowed to get wet. And it seems like it will grow with him well. The green insert that he sits on is smart; it comes out to make room for a growing toddler. The little whale shaped cup that comes with it is a cute bonus. It has holes to sprinkle; that's a little annoying now if I want to use it to rinse him, but will be fun later as he learns to play with it.

Our baby feels secure and enjoys baths, I feel he's safe in it (always supervised of course!), we've had no issues with it staying clean, the holds water and then drains well, no issues with the legs being sturdy... all in all, can't think of anything I'd change.

product_title: Joovy Kooper Umbrella Stroller
review_headline: Great product but missing some basic features.
review_body: I love this stroller but it is missing some basic features like the one hand folding option and automatic lock when folded. The design is great and have received compliments from people.

product_title: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Daisies, X-Large
review_headline: A bit large, but works just fine
review_body: I bought this for my six-month old daughter, who is over 20 lbs and 27\\" long. It is certainly loose on her, but she sleeps comfortably and seems to like it. I bought a second one for her in a size large and it is only a tiny bit smaller. The material is soft and comfy.

product_title: Britax Boulevard 65 CS Click & Safe Convertible Car Seat
review_body: This is a great car seat, we bought it for the Britax brand and the reviews that the seat has gotten, a bit worried about the size and fit in a small car.  Backwards, it was a tight fit in a Mazda3, but now that we have turned the seat around it fits very well as a forward facing seat.  Our son seems very comfortable in the seat, and the installation was straightforward and pretty quick.

product_title: North States Industries Supergate Stairway Swing Gate
review_body: This gate is exactly what I needed for the extended space at half the cost of the gates available in stores, and the gates in stores do not extend as far as this gate!  Great product, great price!

product_title: The First Years Indigo Stroller, Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great stroller until it's been used for a while
review_body: We loved this stroller for the same reason as others have said - parent-facing seat, great price, good looking.  We have only used it with our chicco car seat so far - not the seat that comes with it - yet.  We have loved it and have only had a few squeaks from the front wheels which were easily taken care of with WD40.  We have been using the stroller for almost four months and are finding that the front wheels stick after you turn or back up so that they will not straighten out when you push the stroller forward.  It is a problem that has steadily gotten worse and today as I was in mid-walk going a pretty good speed (for walking) I turned to cross the street and when I tried to straighten out, the stroller tipped up on the two front wheels because they wouldn't straighten out.  I finally had to straighten them with my foot, but it scared me, if I hadn't had a good grip on the handle the stroller could have toppled over.  I have emailed the company to see what they suggest and will update my review after I hear from them.  Just wanted to let others know about this safety issue.    UPDATE: I talked with co. who said they would send me two front wheels - they never arrived so I called back and were told they were out of stock until mid Dec.  Overall I'm disppointed with the company and the hassle and not having a safe stroller to use.  Wouldn't purchase again if I had it to do over, that's the reason for two stars.

product_title: Fresh N Freeze Reusable Baby Food Containers
review_body: I am making my baby's food at home and needed something like this. I love the way the containers snap together and the fact that the tops screw on instead of snap. It really does fit in the door of my freezer. I put water in one of them and gave it a good shake an it did leak. I haven't traveled with these containers yet so I'm not sure if this will be a problem. But other than that, these containers are sturdy material and exactly what a mommy making baby food needs.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: Very soft rubber for chewing on, long legs and neck for grasping with small hands, and non-toxic coloring.  Easy to see why it's been around for so long.

product_title: Tots In Mind Cozy Crib Tent II 1, White
review_headline: AWESOME!  Puurrrrr-fect for keeping kitties out of the crib!
review_body: My husband and I had our first baby in October and purchased this for her crib.  We have several four legged furry family members and this is perfect for keeping the nosy little kitties out of her crib.  It is very well constructed and is strong enough to support them when they climb on it to keep an eye on her.  The only downside is that it is difficult to attach any musical toys or anything to the side of the crib and it is a little challenging to change her sheets.  However, overall it has been wonderful and I would highly recommend it to anyone who has kitties.

product_title: My Brest Friend Twins Plus Deluxe Nursing Pillow, Green, 0-12 Months
review_headline: a must have for twin moms
review_body: This pillow made my life so much easier.  I can nurse both twins at the same time in the football hold and still have my hands free to read a book or talk on the phone.  It cut my nursing time in half!!

product_title: Elephants Wooden Ceiling Mobile
review_body: This mobile is flimsy and unbalanced.  The threads are thin and the crossed dowels don't firmly meet, so the entire mobile hangs lopsided and doesn't move.  The elephants just heavily hang there, pushed up against one another.  The concept is cute, but the craftsmanship is poor.

product_title: Safety 1st 48483/48367 Adjustable Multi-Purpose Strap
review_body: i only got these to work on my sons changing table by actually taking a screw and screwing it into the wood. one side is sticky enough to hold the sides securely, but the other side has too many holes where there is not enough surface for it to stick. it works well on a drawer with area between the drawer and top of the cabinet where a traditional drawer latch would not.

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon Natural Rubber Soft Chew Toy, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: The only teether my son will use!
review_body: My son has never been interested in teether's or understood that you are supposed to chew on them until we got this teether. It is super soft so it squeaks really easy and he loves that so he bangs it on everything. He loves to chew on every inch of this toy especially the head because I think it reminds him of a nipple. You can't got wrong with this teether, it is worth the price to me.

product_title: Kidkusion Table Kushion
review_body:
Only bad thing is it didnt come with enough of the sticky tape...hmmmm. not sure how they expect you to use it without the tape.
Otherwise easy to install and I love that it is in black as matches the furniture! And you can cut to size.

product_title: Juvenile Solutions Thermobaby Bath Ring - Blue with Green
review_body: I don't get the pricing on this.  First of all the blue model is $56.00 vs. the pink model which is $48.98.  The only difference I can see is the color.  Secondly, this isn't worth $56.  BuyBuy Baby sells them for $25, which is much more reasonable for the product.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Bottle Brush
review_body: Love this bottle brush! It has lasted much longer than any of the other bottle brushes I've tried.  I also like that the nipple cleaner on the end is attached, and not a separate piece that you have to take in and out and gets all rusty.  Love this brush!!

product_title: Alyssa Crib Set
review_body: Made from high quality materials.  Fits our crib perfectly.  We couldn't be more pleased.

product_title: Infantino Jumbo Wheel Playspace
review_body: great item - purchased at a Target store.  Bought for my nephew who uses it for tummy time, or just to throw down some toys to play.  also good for the grass at the park, and its machine washable.  He really loves all the colors & textures - I have a feeling this item will be in our family passed down for years to come.

product_title: Gerber Brand 6 Pack Prefold Birdseye Organic Diaper, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is my first review of a product ever. I did not realize how awesome this cloth is until I used a few inserts recently. This fabric holds so much more liquid than the microterry inserts. I am so glad I made the right purchase. The fabric gets softer by everyday use, hand wash and line dry. A round in the dryer made them fluffy too. The size of the pre-fold is generous. I have had no leaks so far. And lastly, the price is also very good. I went to one of the chain fabric store and found that bird-eye non organic cloth costs $4.99 per yard! The Gerber organic prefolds are defenitely a steal!    Oops, I just realized that the current price is $30, which is way too much. I had paid $9.99 a few weeks ago and that sure was a steal.

product_title: Baby Einstein Neptune Ocean Adventure Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My 4-month-old absolutely loves it! I think his favorite toy is the octopus, we always put it at the top and he bats at it and kicks at it and cracks up.  He gets so excited when hes laying on this mat looking at the toys.  He loves having the musical aquarium too.  I don't care too much for the whale pillow although it is cute.  I had to add on a few more entertaining toys, but it is still way better than the other Infantino playmat I bought.    CONS:  The price is ridiculous most places, but thankfully I found it here on Amazon for $30 cheaper than other places.  Still not sure it is worth $50... but it entertains my son so I don't regret buying it one bit.  Now, the REASON it is not worth the price is because it seems cheaply constructed.  The loops on the mat part that hold the bars down are already ripping off after a couple of weeks.  The loops are just not sewn on strong enough to secure down the bent toy bars, because the toy bars  want to straighten out.  I may have received a defective one?  Its not even that big of deal because it can probably be sewn back together.    CONCLUSION:  No play mat is going to be all that it is advertised to be, pictures always make them look like they have more toys and so on.  However, this play mat seems to be the closest to what its drummed up to be.  I think the baby einstein playmats in general seem great.    I would recommend buying it.  Its not perfect, but its close.

product_title: MilkBank BPA Free Insulated Feeding Bottles 5 oz - 3-Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought these bottles out of no where just to try and they turned out to be a blessing. Our baby had severe colic attacks and these bottles made a difference, they did not eleminate colic but we saw that he enjoys them much more and doesn't have much colic after the feeding.  They are almost perfect, \\"almost\\" because there is one flaw; the markings dissapeared after about 2 months and we only wash by hand but no biggie coz we use a measuring cup now.

product_title: Evenflo BabyGo High Chair
review_body: Love the fact that it's portable, but I do not like that the chair sits SO LOW and the tray is WAY too small. On top of that, our Munchkin suction bowls wont properly suction to the tray (and it's not the bowl...it works everywhere else). Unfortunately though, the chair is so low that I'm unable to just let our daughter use the chair without the tray. I tried putting some padding in the seat, but then I cannot strap her in (which obviously won't work).     I would return the item if it weren't such a pain to do so. And frankly, it does work well enough for a $39.99 highchair.     We have green color, which is pretty nice.

product_title: J.L. Childress Cups 'N Cargo Stroller Organizer
review_body: I love it love it love it. I put my 3 boys sweatshirts in the mesh bag and I put a bottle in one cup holder a cup in another and my sons sprite bottle in the little pocket they showed for the cell phone only the bottom of the bottle fit in but it held it in on our walk home and we live on a hill!!! mom of 7 definitely recommend this product!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

product_title: KidCo Lever Lock for Decorative Lever Door Handles
review_body: What a piece of junk!  It installed quickly, but my two year old opened it within one minute of seeing it.  Blah.

product_title: Dream On Me Classic Sleigh Toddler Bed
review_headline: Pink Dream on Me Toddler Bed
review_body: I love it, soft shade of pink, as a 52 yr. grandmother I put it together myself on Sunday afternoon.  Easy to follow directions.    Can't wait till my grandaughter comes this next weekend to try it out!

product_title: Trend Lab Window Valance
review_body: Nursery is now complete with these. Good quality and good length, at first I was worried I may have to order 2 for one window.  But one per window is fine. Would recommend to a friend.

product_title: Jeep All Weather Umbrella Stroller, Ice Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I BOUGHT AND SENT THIS TO MY GRANDDAUGHTER FOR HER FIRST BIRTHDAY.  THEY JUST CAME TO VISIT ME AND BROUGHT THIS STROLLER WITH THEM AND I THOUGHT IT WAS EASY TO USE, PUSH HER IN AND WAS VERY FUNCTIONAL.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: My son is 7 months old and has been teething for months.  He loves to put everything in his mouth, and this is one thing I don't have to worry about.  It is the perfect size for his little hands to pick up by the legs, neck, or head.  I had been hesitant about buying it because of the cost, but now I wish I would have bought it sooner.

product_title: Snoozy Cotton Waterproof PlayYard Mattress Pad Featuring Saftety Stay on Corners, 27"x 37"
review_body: Very cozy mattress pad.  fits snug and it was even soft enough for my baby to sleep on it with no sheet (it was in the wash).

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon Cool It Soother Teether, Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The quality of this product cannot be beat.  With that being said, my so was completely disinterested in this while he was teething.  He preferred to gnaw on Sophie the Giraffe.

product_title: Safety 1st Prism Color Video Baby Monitor, Black
review_headline: Huge Disappointment -- battery life too short; not user friendly
review_body: I've never written a review in my life, but this thing is expensive and a HUGE disappointent.  Battery life is pathetic, as another reviewer mentioned.  I guess it's meant only for quick trips out of the room.  I was hoping to be able to leave the AC adaptor in the bedroom for overnight and be able to use the battery while hanging out in other rooms.  Not really possible.  Base is narrow so monitor constantly falls over.  The adaptor connection broke after some minor jostling caused by the aforementioned narrow base, but I'm glad because now I can buy something else.  There seem to be a lot of \\"features\\" with this monitor, but it's not very user friendly.

product_title: Boon Squirt Baby Food Dispensing Spoon, Orange (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great for travel once you get the hang of it
review_body: I love this spoon. I wouldn't use it everyday for regular feedings because it's a little strange. My baby (6 months) can't get all the food off in one shot and it seems the spoon is shaped a little weird (too big, hard plastic), but it is great when we're out and about. I just used it at an amusement park and it was great! I filled two up (one with a veggie, one with a fruit) and took it out at the park. No fuss, no muss!    You have to jiggle the food down to squeeze it out and sometimes it splatters out when you squeeze it. It is a great product though once you get the hang of it.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body: Bought this toy for my son when he was 3 mos and he loves it!! The only thing I didn't like about this is the lights/music? The lights weren't attractively bright enough and maybe the wiring on mines were crossed but the music coming out of the speakers sounded warped and distorted, so we took out that entire piece all together. My baby loved it regardless!

product_title: Natures Purest Organic 4 Piece Crib Set, Hug Me
review_body: My son is 14 months old and he has been using this bedding since day one.  I knew I was very happy with the quality, but didn't know just how nice it was for the price until I started shopping for new bedding for my next baby.  The quality of other brands I saw in the same price range is terrible.  All of the material is super soft, the bumper is very nicely padded, fits well and stays in place.  Other brands were thin and didn't stay up, folded over or gaped on the sides.  Everything still looks like new after 14 months.  The sheets have been washed a lot, of course, and are still soft and perfect.  I have only washed the bumper a few times, but it comes out great too.  It is a bit of an inconvenience having to air dry everything, especially the bumper, but it is still worth it.  I like the subtle design and think it is a soothing place to fall asleep as compared to many bold patterns that don't seem comforting to a baby.  This bedding had absolutely no odor out of the bag, unlike most new products.  I feel good knowing my baby is sleeping on organic cotton, especially considering how many hours are spent in the crib.  I just can't say enough good things about it.

product_title: Sunshine Kids Adjustable Stroller Umbrella Shade, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The day I received this umbrella I put it to use and it works really well. I am very happy with it and will continue recommeding it to others. I love that I can provide shade to my daughter and she can still feel the cooling breeze on a hot day.    The only reason why I did not give it 5 stars is because it works best being mounted on the opposite side of the Sun and it takes more effort then I like to move it to the other side.     I suggest buying a second mount to make it easier.

product_title: Protect-A-Bub Compact Single Sunshade With Fabric Bag In Navy - UPF 50+ - Mesh Windows for Viewing & Air Circulation - Fits All Canopied Strollers, Carriages, Joggers and Car Seats - Protects Against 98% of Sun's UVA & UVB Rays (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I really like the shade and got a lot of compliments on it.  I returned it for the full size version because the sun was still getting to my little one.      -Easy to install  -Easy to put away  -I could still keep it on when I folded my stoller although I would not recommend storing it that way.     -Because of the angle of the sun in the evening, we needed a little more protection for my baby's fair skin and light eyes.    -Pay attention to the trim color on your stoller.  I originally bought the navy one to match our green stoller, however the handles and everything else are black (duh!) and I prefer things to match.  When I purchased the full size version I opted for black.

product_title: Graco Ultra Clear II 49MHZ Baby Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Although sometimes, if my cell phone is recharging near the monitor it is static-y. This monitor is good deal & holds a charge, works better than the fisher price version which is about $[...]. We had to replace that one because it only worked being plugged in. Overall, for @5-you can't go wrong

product_title: BOB Weather Shield For Single Revolution/Stroller Strides Models in Gray
review_body: I absolutely love this thing! Now I am able to go running during the winter! My daughter stays so snug and warm with the BOB weather shield. Almost too warm I think. She refuses to wear her mittens and her hat because it gets so toasty inside. I haven't used it in the rain yet but I am sure it works just as well. The only thing I would recommend is to make sure your child doesn't get too warm inside. I am considering getting a thermometer to see just how hot it does get. I usually stop every 5 minutes or so to check on her but it's so hard to tell if she is cold because her hands are far warmer than mine at this point.

product_title: Sassy Soft Sided Toy Organizer, Pink Mod
review_body: I purchased this for my cousin's baby. Very easy to use and pretty. It was a lot bigger than I expected. It's so big, you can even fit a baby in there. I may buy the green/blue one for my baby.

product_title: Juvenile Solutions Aquababy Bath Ring - Pink/White
review_body:
This little bath chair supports our 5-month-old just fine. Yes, she wiggles a bit, since she she's still not sitting up on her own, but she hates to lie down; this does the job. I truly think it'll grow with her, as well. In fact, I think this will work better as she gets older.

The suction cups works just fine, and believe it or not, the chair fits in a standard-sized kitchen sink.

The only unfortunate thing is that you can't take this seat apart for traveling. (Well, I guess you could...with a screw driver...)

Bottom line? It's a great product.

product_title: Infantino Fold and Go Bouncer, Metro (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I went back-and-forth on this bouncer. On the one hand, it's not too expensive, it folds flat (great for storage), and offers an extra \\"seat\\" (which also provides some assistance/distraction with a baby) that's easy to take from room to room. That said, the quality is good, but not great; I've seen similar bouncers from Europe that are much better made (higher quality fabric, plastic, etc.) for about the same price or just a few dollars more.

This chair is also a bit heavy, and since it's not any easier to put a baby in than a standard car seat/rocker carrier/ stroller seat combo, I'd only use this in an extra room when I didn't want to use the regular rocker/seat.

One GIANT warning, which is also highlighted clearly with the unit- this rocker is NOT to be used on any raised surfaces, tables, etc. since the rocking can slowly move it to the edge... If you're getting this as a gift for someone and there's ANY doubt in your mind as to whether they'd be dumb enough to do this, DO NOT GET IT FOR THEM. It might sound a bit blunt, but better that than the alternative.

product_title: Bebe Au Lait Nursing Cover
review_headline: Works great and everyone comments on how great it is!
review_body: This product works great for 'on-the-go' feeding where you can see what you're doing and still provide privacy that you need.  We have had friends comment on what a great item this is.  They basically say, \\"I wish I had that when I was nursing.\\"

product_title: Skip Hop Hare Brush and Comb Set
review_body: The cutest brush and comb set!  My child loves it and quality is excellent!  So worth the cost.

product_title: Wee Gallery Art Cards for Baby
review_body: These cards are perfect for keeping the attention of your newborn. I have a little 8 week old and I've been using these cards in his crib since he was 5 weeks old. He loves to just stare at them and observe them when he's having his tummy time or if he's just laying on his back. The contrast of the colors are perfect. I love that they are reverse colors on the other side. If he gets tired of looking at one side you just flip the card over and there's the same image but in different shades. It's great! And the cards are very durable - they are not easily bendable and if they happen to get dirty they wipe off quite easily. I've gotten two other sets for him.

product_title: Sevi Mini Pull Along Toy
review_body: I bought this pull toy as a gift for a friend.  It is so cute, but much smaller than I anticipated (I should have carefully read the dimensions).  Before I left the party yesterday, the paint was already scraping off, and the string is not long enough for a toddler to pull easily.  My friend will be attaching an additional string.  However, it is all wood and very adorable.

product_title: Summer Infant Ultimate Crib Sheet
review_headline: Great product, but not very durable
review_body: My son spit up in his sleep for the first 6 months, so this product was wonderful.  However, by the time that he was 6 months old, all of my ultimate crib sheets had developed holes and cracks in the plastic backs.  The product was such a life saver that I will purchase new ones (maybe a different brand) for future children, but I really expected more than 6 months of use out of these.

product_title: Mobi MobiCam Audio Video Wireless Internet Kit
review_headline: great if you know what you are buying
review_body: I bought this thinking we could see the kids if we were out and left them with a babysitter.  What I found out was in order to do this the monitor must be connected to the pc.  We only have one laptop!  We don't have internet on our phones.  There is also a $10 month charge.  Had I known exactly how it worked and there was a monthly charge, I would not have bought it.

product_title: Steribottle Ready to Use Disposable Baby Bottles
review_headline: practical for on the go, not for daily life
review_body: These bottles are lightweight so they are perfect for travel.     Perhaps the bottles don't need to be perfectly sterile for the baby, but I'm still hesitant to approach these as completely sterilized. They bottles are sterile in the pack they come in, but once you open them, then what?     The fact that they are recyclable is a bonus, but these bottles are incredibly pricey ($1/bottle) to be used daily at every feeding.

product_title: Built NY Cushy Tushy Changing Pad
review_headline: Great Diaper Clutch! Lost mine so ordering another one!
review_body: I received this as a gift and absolutely loved it! I forgot it on a plane and miss it so much that I am buying another one. I use it everywhere, and it especially comes in handy when going out to dinner and needing to make a dash into the restroom for a quick diaper change. I love how fashionable and minimal it is, too. I usually put 3 diapers, wipes, and a onesie in the pocket, as my baby has had a few occasions where she couldn't hold it while I was changing her. The neoprene material is great, too, as it stays fairly clean and dry if you have to lay the pad on the floor or a wet countertop.

product_title: Sweet Jojo Designs Pink and White French Toile Baby Girl Bedding 9pc Crib Set
review_body: I returned this. When it arrived, it was definitely not as nice as in the picture, and the pink in the gingham and the pink in the toile and bows did not match each other at all. The gingham was more of a salmon color. Also, the fabric was not as soft as I would want for a nursery. It looked cheap. I ended up getting a pink toile set from Pottery Barn Kids, which cost a little more, but was much better quality and looks super cute in the nursery.

product_title: BABYBJORN Little Potty
review_headline: You get what you pay for
review_body: Its a basic potty that moves when my 15 month old is trying to sit. It is very light.

product_title: [2 Pack] Magic Bumpers Child Bed Safety Guard Rail 48 Inch - Travel Size: Two-Part Design
review_headline: Not fancy, but they do the job
review_body: Let me start by saying these work really well - I wish I had found them sooner. We use a platform bed and most other bed rails and guards require a box spring set up. We placed two along one side of our queen bed and one on each side of the toddler bed, to prevent falls. They are much longer than you would think so work quite well.    These are simply wedges cut from foam with \\"magicbumper\\" stickers slapped on them. I ordered the four pack, which arrived much sooner than estimated. They came unwrapped and un-packaged (no plastic, nothing) inside the mailing envelope. While I am sure they were originally white, each wedge seemed to be at a different stage of yellowing.    If you have the time and tools available, I would say go to the fabric store, buy some foam, and save yourself some money. If you have neither, buy these- functionally they're great.

product_title: Carters Super Soft Dot Changing Pad Cover
review_body: Very soft, color in photo is accurate, and fits my standard-size changing pad well.  Would definitely buy again.

product_title: Footed Cotton Knit Baby Pants
review_body: We got these for our twin girls. Both left the hospital at  little over 5 lbs, with one at 19 in and the other at 18 in. product_title: Chicco Cortina Together Double Stroller, Fuego (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I was very excited when I heard Chicco was finally coming out with a double stroller. I was initially against any double stroller; I just didn't want to mess with it. But when our daughter was 2.5 years and our son was four months we were taking a month long trip abroad, and I knew we wouldn't be able to corral both kids without one. The Cortina Together worked wonderfully for what we needed. We already had a Chicco car seat and Trevi, so we knew we liked Chicco. And I wanted both kids to be able to sit comfortably. I knew a sit and stand would be lighter, but didn't want my two-year-old to have to stand or sit on an uncomfortable, tiny seat all the time. After hauling this thing all over Europe, here is why I love this stroller:    You can easily snap the Chicco car seat into it. I love that you can place it in the front seat or back seat. When we want more control of our toddler, we place her in the back and baby in the front. But when we are just enjoying a walk she loves sitting in the front to see better, and hop in and out on her own. It is also a great feature that the rear seat fully reclines. This is nice for a napping toddler, and makes a great bassinet for a sleeping baby.    The basket underneath is very large and very accessible. Adding the zippered front is a huge help, to be able to access things even when the back seat is fully reclined. I was able to easily carry diaper bags, luggage, groceries, etc in that thing. I also like that the basket stretches in front of the rear seat. If our daughter dropped anything, it caught it, which is nice when you are running to catch a train, and not keeping track of everything!    The canopies work well. They aren't large, but the fact that they adjust so easily means you can keep your children covered from rain, or keep the sun out of their eyes, no matter what angle. I also love having the two cup holders for mom and dad, as well as the two cup holders on the front seat. A con, however, is that there are no cupholders for the back seat. And the two cup holders on the front can be switched which is nice. But, if you have them turned out, you can't fold the canopy up when the stroller is folded, and if you have them turned in, you can't fold the front seat down to accommodate the car seat. But this is super easy to adjust. The seats move very easily as well - one hand adjustment. The brakes and wheel locks are great and easy too.    Even with its large size, the stroller turns on a dime. The handle bar adjusts easily for pushers of different heights. Sometimes we found the stroller can be a little tricky to fold up - the lock only requires one hand, but you have to maneuver the stroller just right to get it to collapse on itself. When folded up, though, it's not too huge - it easily fits in our Honda CVR, no problem. It's great for on the go, easy to set up - no adjustments needed.    The stroller proved to be very durable - considering we hauled it on and off planes and trains, as well as up and down cobblestone streets and off-road. Like others have said, it is heavy, but it is a double stroller, that's what you get. It is lighter than many options, though. My close friend has a Graco double, and she is super jealous of our Chicco! One other negative is there's no handle or really great place to grab the stroller to carry it when it's folded up. The feature that allows it to still roll when folded is nice, but obviously doesn't help when you are going up stairs.    I truly love this stroller, and I would highly recommend it to anyone. Coming from one mommy who didn't especially want a double, is only five feet tall (and not very strong!), but realized she needed it, I would never use another double stroller. This is the way to go!

product_title: Baby Jogger City Elite Single Stroller
review_body:
After researching strollers, from reading Baby Bargains to reading lots of blogs, this is by far the best stroller for average neighborhood, park, and various outdoor use.

One important thing I have learned that may not be obvious: The reviews on Amazon are bundled- so every stroller/product option shown shares the same reviews. This can be very misleading.

The strollers shown here are from 2 different years. The model numbers and the weights are the key. One review mentioned the foam tires. As far as I know this is a great new improvement for 2010 models- and not on the 2009 models. The Blue, both Black, and Stone models have air tires, the Red, Lime, and Sky have the forever air tires. If color isn't a big deal- get the forever tires for the same price! The 2010 versions are usually way more expensive elsewhere- it looks like this retailer isn't aware of this great improvement and this can save you maybe 150!

The 2009 models are still great and the best- the only difference I can see from 2010 are the tires and possibly parent console. I just know how confusing all the stroller choices can be and I hope this can help. Also, you can call Baby Jogger directly with any model number and they can tell you what year it is and any details you need- they are great! If looking at 2007 or 2008 models, confirm with BJ what the upgrades have been- I think there were some major updates like child weight limits.

product_title: NUK 3 Pack Orthodontic Silicone BPA Free Nipple Bottle, 5 Ounce, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We've been using these bottles for about a month now.  They are used for expressed milk, which any pumping mother will tell you is extremely valuable to them for the trouble they go through to produce it.    We were much happier with these than some of the standard bottles, because the nipples seemed to fit better for the baby, the different options for flow speed let you change according to the current needs of the baby (so they aren't getting overwhelmed or frustrated), and you can find something that works well in different cases.  The bottles are solid, use standard parts for the different sizes (nipples/rings can be used on the larger bottles as baby grows), are easy to wash, and have cute designs on them.    We did have a few major complaints though.  As a previous posted said, it's very difficult to get all of the milk out.  It gets trapped on the ledges, so you end up losing a few cc's to every bottle.  That adds up over time.  The second was that the measurements on the sides of the bottles are highly inaccurate.  We were using a bottle with standard walls and dimensions to compare, and the NUK bottle was sometimes off by 10-15ccs on markings.  Not a deal breaker, but hard to keep track of how much the little one is eating unless you pre-measure in a different measuring tool. Finally, the slow flow nipples seem to get pinched by the baby more, so it can take a lot longer to feed when first getting started.  What we found is that you actually have to put some reverse pull on the bottle so that the baby gets maximum suction, allowing them to get a good rate of flow going without cutting it off completely.  After we learned that trick, it got much easier.    Overall, the benefits definitely outweigh the downsides, but because of the downsides we do have to spend more time preparing meals.
