I also have a Boppy and used that as well, but the Breast Friend was my preferred pillow when the babies were very young. I read the reviews about natural materials and while I agree that it is important to pay attention to the materials near our babies, once the pillow gasses off, after a few days out of the package, the organic cover is all baby will be in contact with. Wash the cover in a cold, delicate cycle and hang to dry before use. As a child development specialist and an eco-conscious mom who has done a lot of research, I have no concerns about this product.

product_title: Mam Training Cup with Handles 4 Months 8 Ounce BPA Free Assorted Colors (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I dont know why they can't give you  a color you want
review_body: got this but am gonna sell it to someone else because I didn't realize I can't pick the color I want . .  dont know why that's a problem with the sellers. .

product_title: DaVinci Emily Baby Changing Table
review_body: I have the set of DaVinci Emily furniture (crib, dresser and changing table). The crib is the highest quality piece of the set-very sturdy and well made. The dresser is not bad-we had some trouble putting it together because of confusing directions, and a couple of the drawers don't fit as snugly as they could, but overall not a bad piece for a child's room. The changing table itself it decent and seems to be sturdy enough-although my child is only 7mos. and under 20lbs. at this point. The drawer is a joke-cheap materials and craftsmanship-it was a nightmare to assembly because the screws didn't line up with the drill holes. It never really worked, and eventually after coming apart so many times we just removed it. I do miss the drawer, but it can function well enough with just the two shelves.

product_title: Ju-Ju-Be Be Quick Wristlet, Pretty Tweet
review_body: This print is so gorgeous, and it is the perfect size for my use - I am keeping my mommy items in it, and can transfer it between diaper bag and purse.  Or...so pretty it can be used on its own as a large wristlet.  Love it!

product_title: Gro Baby Shell Set
review_body: We'be been using Grobaby diapers since our daughter was 8 weeks old.  Initially, we tried several types of cloth diapers.  We decided to use only Grobaby because it the system is easy to use and the customer service (Natural Baby Company) is unbeatable.  Our decision was right for us.  We've never had a single blow-out using these diapers, nor has our daughter had a single diaper rash! We have also converted all of our diapers into snaps and love this option!   Pros:  They are easy to use; they are cute; we won't have to buy any other diapers; the biosoakers are a great alternative for traveling; the loads of diaper laundry are small; they are compact in a diaper bag.   I could go on and on...  Cons:  The up-front cost; they are pretty bulky on a tiny baby; the hook and loops stick to everything (we solved this by converting to snaps and we are so happy we did!).

product_title: Munchkin Play N Pat Water Mat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My 4 month old son is still not the biggest fan of tummy time, but this does seem to keep him there longer. I haven't had any problems with it leaking, and I like the frogs that stand up, it gives him a reason to lift up his head and look at them.

product_title: Munchkin Snail Stacker Bath Toy
review_body: My daughter liked it the first time we let her play with it in the tub. After that, she seems disinterested. So, it doesn't hold her attention. Also, not super sturdy floating in the water.

product_title: Baby Einstein Move & Go Music Mirror
review_body: The light show is very entertaining and helps my baby to enjoy the car ride. (he usually hates the car and screams and cries). The remote is hit or miss and most of the time doesn't work. It defeats the purpose of this toy because when my baby wakes up and is upset I need to be able to turn it on. Or when it stops and I would like it to continue playing I am unable to do so. If the remote worked I would give this toy a 5 star review. I get frustrated when the baby is crying and I can't get the remote to work.

product_title: JL Childress Gate Check Bag for Umbrella Strollers, Red
review_body: Don't buy this bag for your stroller,, a waste of money !! it was made with cheap material and was ripped after the first time it was gate checked at the airport which is what it was sold to be.  Upon returning home the bottom of the bag was nearly completely all ripped up... very poor construction.. DO NOT PURCHASE !!

product_title: Baby's Cozy World Microfiber & Fleece Carrier Cover - Black with Khaki Dots
review_body: Fits perfectly over my sons carseat. It's extremely windy where i live, so not having to throw a blanket over it, is a definate plus. The zippers are wonderful, so i can leave it on and still take my son in and out with ease. I would definately recomend this to everyone!

product_title: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_headline: Doesn't follow up to the hype.
review_body:
I have a nine week old who is sleeping through the night, but I wanted to have a night light for her that glowed with color and projected something for her to focus on at night in case she had sleep problems moving from the bassinet to the crib. We got this last night and I am boxing it up to return right after I write this.

The cut-outs for the stars are only on two of the top \\"shell\\" portions, so you don't get the full canopy on your ceiling like you do with the ladybug. Also, the pattern is very weird, nothing like stars falling over everything in a magical way like you imagine when you order this for your child. The sides that light up are pretty cheesy; it makes you irritated that the space was wasted when it could have been used for more star cut-outs. You can make certain animals light up on the shell, but it's dumb; doing so makes it so you can't even see the picture of the animal any more, just this bright spot on the shell.

The light projection comes in blue, green, or \\"aquamarine\\"...yeah, it's only the green and blue on at the same time but not mixing the colors as they project through the cut-outs (so you even get two moons showing on your ceiling - so it looks extra dumb).

Seriously, this is so lame. Get the ladybug instead. I got the ladybug for my 10 year old, and it was very cool. We put it in the middle of her room on the top of a tall laundry basket, and the whole ceiling and walls were covered in stars. The seaturtle is very very lame.

Oh, and the bedtime story that comes with it would FREAK OUT a small child. It's all about, \\"oh, this sweet little animal is going to die forever if you don't save it. You need to hurry and save it before it dies\\". Like I want to then kiss the forehead of a three year old and say \\"goodnight\\" after I have just told them that! Not too soothing before bed. (Really, the story is pretty hard-core for little kids - tell them animals are going to die right before bed. Nice).

Anyway, this is lame, so don't get it.get it.

product_title: Wahmies One Size Cloth Diaper
review_body: Not sure how well the diaper works because the fit was so bad on my tall skinny girl that there were huge gaps and I didn't dare leave it on her to leak all over. The buckle system makes it impossible to get tight enough on skinny babes.

product_title: Evenflo Big Kid Booster Car Seat - Flower Power (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this booster for my son, and have been quite pleased with it, so I bought the flower pattern for my daughter.  I liked the booster before, but I noticed that the newer version actually has nicer fabric/padding, and the fabric attaches more firmly to the structure, so I'm very happy to have bought this seat.

product_title: Bright Starts Around We Go 2-in-1 Activity Center
review_headline: okay toy - big size - toys are a little boring
review_body: Takes up a lot of space, which is okay, but even bigger than an exersaucer...the little piano is fun, but the rest of the toys are boring, my toddler doesnt like to play at all with it and my 8 month old gets bored after about 8 minutes....If I could do it over again I would get a stationary bouncer one!

product_title: Bright Starts Comfort and Harmony Portable Swing, Biscotti Baby (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Easy to put together.  I love the music that comes with it.  Very relaxing for the baby and also myself.  Nice color. Good for boys and girls.

product_title: Britax Blink Lightweight Stroller
review_headline: Britax Blink Sprout not for short people
review_body: I received the stroller in the mail yesterday.  It looks great!  It appears very well made and perfect for taller kids.  However, the handles are very high.  I am 5'3\\" and my husband is 5'6\\".  Neither of us felt comfortable trying to push the stroller.  It is definitely a great umbrella stroller made for parents that are on the taller side.  I wanted the stroller to work so badly and I am bummed that we aren't going to keep it.  I think the sprout design/colors are great and I so wished this stroller could have been a good fit for us.

product_title: Keekaroo Adjustable Height Right Wood High Chair - Natural
review_body: I purchased this as a gift and my son and daughter in law are very pleased.  It has such a sleek look and so much more attractive than the traditional high chair.  The fact that is can be used by adults as well makes so much more sense.

product_title: Summer Infant Naturally Yours Changing Table Cover
review_body: I love this changing pad cover.  It matches great in our neutral room and it fits our generic changing pad pretty good.  I use a Kushies diaper on top so I don't have to take off/wash as often.  I've washed multiple times now and it had held up great and fits just as good as day 1.

product_title: Baby Jogger 2010 City Select Stroller Second Seat Kit
review_headline: don't buy this stroller if you need to make it a double
review_body: Baby Jogger is completely insane. They market this as the best solution for a double stroller but fails to mention the second seat kit, which you need to make it a double, isn't available. So basically, you get a single for $500! We have been waiting for months and months to get our second seat kit and the delivery dates just keeps getting pushed back. And if you check the company's website now, it doesn't even give an expected delivery date anymore. If you want one infant carrier and one regular seat, you still need to buy the second seat kit in advance b/c that is where the brackets you need are! So even if you can get the car seat adapter, it is useless until the second seat kits come in. If I could return the stroller I would but unfortunately we used as a single until #2 was born and just never imagined the other parts would not be available. I will never buy from Baby Jogger again!!

product_title: Graco Contempo Highchair
review_body: I absolutely love this highchair! I would have given it 5 stars, but younger infants (4-6 months) get their arm/s stuck in between the seat and the leg post. You need to keep a close watch because of this.  As they get older,this is no longer a problem!     I love how practical this is! It folds down and is VERY slim for a high chair. I can put it behind the door without it taking up a lot of room!    It's a great chair...looks nice with any decor too! =)

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_headline: Sophie - dog squeak toy or teether?
review_body: Baby Evelyn, now 4 months old was curious about the giraffe at my new mom's group a few weeks ago, so as her saliva dripped down the chin, I ordered one.  Sophie is all good besides her feet, which I find to be a bit too rough around the edges to consider it a truly high class teether.  The face is excellent, body perfect for small hands, and squeak sweet rather than irritating like many baby toys.  I'd recommend, but make sure your child's mouth doesn't get abraded on the feet.

product_title: Graco Pack 'N Play Playard with Bassinet and Changer, Bancroft 2008
review_body: I thought It would be more handy, instead it is rather heavy and full of small separate parts for which i don't have any storage space.  And we can't use it for travelling because nowadays luggage is so restricted in airplanes... I don't have the energy to carry this Playard \\"anywhere\\"

product_title: Thinkbaby BPA Free Anti Colic Silicone Nipples - Fast Flow
review_body: We have had a good experience with the Think Baby Bottles.  We started using them about a week after my baby was born with the slow flow cross cut nipple.  The Think Baby customer service has been fantastic both on the phone as well as shipping my orders.    These bottles are so great bc there aren't a bunch of parts to wash and they are BPA Free!  The other good thing is that when my son is ready, they convert into sippy cups!

product_title: Stork Craft Sleigh Glider
review_body: Good quality for money.  It is wide, but could be a little wider...only for breastfeeding purposes.  I don't miss the ottoman.  Overall happy with the product.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Musical Monkey (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son LOVES the monkey that came with the rainforest activity gym, and I was looking for more of the same kind of monkey for him to have, he LOVES this toy, maybe it's the face, but he will coo and laugh for a long time at this monkey--we bought all of the rainforest stuff just because if his love for this silly monkey face!

product_title: Sealy Perfect Rest Mattress (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: this mattress was delivered in a day or two. i researched the differences in a foam mattress which i already owned vs this spring coil mattress. i thought it would be fine. this specific mattress was very soft compared to the solid foam one i had. i switched this one to my son's room, he's almost 3 and it's fine for him. way too soft for a newborn or infant.

product_title: Evenflo 3 Pack Classic Glass Bottle, 8-Ounce
review_body: I freaked out when I discovered that my super-expensive Dr. Browns could be contaminating my son's body with BPA. It was easy to throw out the plastic bottles, but I (and the hubby) wanted to fight for the venting system we paid so much money for! So, he figured out that if you use a little cutter for PVC pipes (or something more powerful than kitchen scissors) you can cut 1/2 an inch or so off the tube and VOILA! You can use the Dr. Brown's vent system, top & nipple with the Evenflo bottle and you don't have to go spend $150 on replacing your entire fleet of bottles. Make sure to tighten the top all the way and you've got a winner! Love these bottles!

product_title: Kel-Gar 52840 Snug-Tub
review_body: We have purchased 3 inflatable snug-tubs from Kelgar. The infant size tub was fine, and still works okay after 2 years. However, the slightly larger toddler size tub has a slow leak. The first one we bought had a very slow leak; after 9 months it turned into a fast leak, so we bought another one, thinking we wouldn't be unlucky enough to get another defective one twice in a row.    Wrong!!    The second one arrived with a slow leak in the same place as the previous toddler size tub. At first it was so slow, it just meant we'd have to reinflate it once in a while; then you have to reinflate it more and more often until finally it won't last through one bathing without going limp. After the second flop, I decided to just send the leaky tub back to Kel-Gar and ask for a free replacement. They never responded to my friendly letter. When I finally called (took me a while to get around to it; I kept thinking that surely a replacement would be arriving any week now!), they were totally unhelpful.    The woman who answered at \\"Customer Service\\" kept interrupting me to tell me that they do not accept returns, and any problems have to be taken up with the retailer. Way to stand behind your products, dudes!    Then when I called the retalier (Right Start) just now, they said that it's not their responsibility to handle a replacement, it's the manufacturer's-- BUT at least this customer service person was polite and said she's ask her boss and look into it more, just to see if there is anything they can do.    I'm really surprised that Kel-Gar cares so little about their image with the public and about providing pleasant and helpful service to their customers, especially repeat customers such as myself. I mean, come on, how hard is it to throw a piece of plastic that weights about 8 ounces in the mail to keep a customer happy??     However, since that is their attitude, you're better off buying an inflatable tub from a real-life (non-virtual) retailer with a decent 90-day return policy, such as Babies-R-Us or Target, so that if a leak develops you can physically take it back and get a replacement. That's what we'll be doing from here on out.    So long, Kel-Gar. The tub was \\"just ducky\\" but your service was DOA!    Update: No go on the replacment. Big surprise. Although not quite as cushy as this tub, I would highly recommend getting your baby or toddler the PRIMO EuroBath instead. We got it after having to give up on inflatables, and it is roomy, comfortable, and DURABLE, unlike Kel-Gar's products. 4.5 stars with 750 reviews on Amazon- you can't beat that! [[ASIN:B000056OV0 PRIMO EuroBath Pearl White]]

product_title: LOOM Life 904 The ZOOM Kit - Black & Tan
review_body: It sounds good in theory, but once you put all the things you need in it (which wasn't much, in my case) the magnaetic closure kept opening and all the stuff spilled onto the floor.  Try picking up those itEMs while watching your kids at the same time... Thanks, but no thanks!  The only thing that I liked that I do use is the caribiner that clips that keys and money to my old diaper bag.

product_title: Roman Savell - Resort Tote - Designer Tote Bag in Tan
review_headline: Finally a pretty tote perfect for moms!
review_body: I bought this tote for the beach because of the cooler bottom and how great it is to always keep my kids snacks chilled. But I now find I am using it all of the time. There are pockets for everything inside and out and the lining is spillproof so it can't get ruined. I have been using it as a shopper tote and always keep some things for the kids in the bottom storage. Great value for a designer bag and it shipped quick!

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Kick and Play
review_body: I actually have two playmats to change things up for my baby.I love them both equally and so does my son. He loves to look at all the colors and bat at the toys. The music is nice and I love the kickpad. Great stimulation for baby and allows for a few minutes of me time.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_headline: Super toy for baby and toddler
review_body: Sophie is a great toy - first for baby - feels good in her mouth to her sore gums - and also fun to squeak and just play with.  My niece is 23 months old and still reaches for Sophie to play with with her other toy animals!!  AAA++++++++

product_title: Fisher-Price My Little Lamb Cradle 'n Swing
review_body: I love this swing it is so soft and the music it not annoying like most other baby toys.

product_title: Kiddopotamus SwaddleMe 100% Cotton Knit - Circle Bear S
review_body: I bought this for my newborn nephew and he seems to sleep soundly with this wrapped onto him! No more sleepless nights for his mom! I recommend this for newborns. They also come in large for bigger babies. Buy this!

product_title: Alphabet Soup 4 Piece Crib Bedding Set by Cocalo
review_body: We knew we were expecting a baby girl, but we still didn't want to register for everything in pink. We wanted the bedding to work again if a little boy comes along next. This bedding has been great. The colors are very kid friendly; the bright contrasting colors are easy for them to see from early on. And the colors go with any furniture. We have receieved lots of compliments, and we love it.

product_title: Graco imonitor Vibe (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This monitor makes noise constantly: a crackling, static-type noise.  It's so persistant that I can't sleep with it on, which kind of defeats the purpose. Very disappointing for the price point and I wish I'd bought another Fisher Price monitor instead (which worked great until the baby gave it a bath).  My house is 2300 square feet and two stories.  The baby's room is upstairs and the units are usually on opposite sides of the house; not sure if distance is causing the issues or not.

product_title: The Woombie
review_body: This is the first thing we have found that our 4 month old baby can't wiggle out of. We had tried all kinds of things and he would always get his arms out and then wake him self up. This works great and is nice and light so he doesn't get too warm with extra layers.

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_body: This is the second Graco Nautilus that I have purchased and I love it! My 4-year-old uses his with the harness, and my 6-year-old uses hers with our car's seat belt. Both kids love it and I feel secure putting them in it. It's comfortable, sturdy, and safe.     I love the extra perks like a cup holder built into the armrest (fabulous idea!) and the secret compartment for cars and stuff inside the armrest.     The only con I can think of is that it's somewhat heavy, but if you don't need to move it around much, then that shouldn't stop you from purchasing this seat.

product_title: New Native Baby Carrier: Khaki Small (chest size 30-33")
review_body: When my baby is fussy, I carry him in this and he instantly falls asleep. He's currently 4 months but I've used it since he was 6 weeks and he loves it. However, I place him in it backward. (From their website: Turn your baby around, facing the opposite direction from the manner in which [page 1] indicates. This way your baby's head is not down in the fabric that goes over your shoulder.)   When he gets starts sitting up, I'll probably wear him on my hip in the toddler position. But for now, he naps for hours in this sling. Make sure you measure yourself correctly for a proper fit. If you wear your baby higher on your body, it's easier to go to the bathroom without taking him out.

product_title: Tadpoles 16 Sq Ft Playmat Set
review_body: It's really cute the colors were a lot better then I was expecting and they matched my daughters room perfectly. it doesn't stay together though. If you walk on it or the tiniest thing it comes apart. So other then that It works.

product_title: Safety 1st High-Def Digital Monitor
review_body: We purchased this monitor as our 2nd monitor for son #2. We have the Sony Baby Call Monitor for our older son. I wish I had not outsourced this purchasing decision (sorry, husband!) but I don't like this monitor at all. It is certainly functional and the sound quality is great. However, it has two huge disadvantages: 1) If it looses charge, it blinks and then just dies. If you are not watching the monitor at this time (like if you are sleeping) you won't know the monitor is off and you won't hear your child. HUGE Disadvantage. The Sony BabyCall beeps loudly to let you know the charge is fading. 2) The volume is not very loud. The sound quality is great, but if the monitor is in the kitchen and I'm in another room, I can't hear it. Yes, it has a clip, but it doesn't really stay on if I'm actively moving around the house (like doing laundry). The Sony BabyCall is very loud and I can still hear it several rooms away.

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_body: We have 5 month old twins and this gadget has been WONDERFUL!  We have used it from the day we brought our boys home from the NICU.  As new parents we didn't really know what to expect with newborns, much less twin newborns.  But we quickly found out everything is a blur, including when we last fed the babies.  Note that we did NOT get two of these even though we have 2 babies.  That really is not necessary.  Initially we always fed the babies at the same time, and we would always change their diapers then too.  So it was very easy to use the same timer to track both babies for bottles and diapers.  But nowadays we find that we don't always need to change a diaper when they get a bottle (which is about every 2.5 to 3 hours).  Also, sometimes I'll feed one baby and wait 20-30 minutes before feeding the other baby (helps with logistics).  So what we've done is \\"repurpose\\" some of the buttons.  Now we use the first two buttons to track when baby #1 and baby #2 last ate.  The last two buttons are now used to track when baby #1 and baby #2 went down for a nap (or conversely when they woke up from a nap).  This works great for us!  Now if a baby starts crying uncontrollaby we can look at the Itzbeen and determine if its because they are hungry and need to prepare a bottle, of if it may be due to another reason.  We were surprised that babies don't always make it 3 hours but can sometimes get ravenous in only 2 hours or so (darn growth spurts keep ya guessing)!  This timer is also great because my mom watches our babies during the day while we work, and we can \\"trade shifts\\" with minimal updates.  When she comes over and starts her shift we don't have to write down when baby #1 and #2 last ate, we just toss her the Itzbeen and she is ready to babysit!  We highly recommend the Itzbeen, especially if you are a new parent or parent to twins (or both!).

product_title: Lambs & Ivy Yum Yum Baby Smoothie Hooded Bath Towel Set
review_headline: SO soft and such a cute gift idea for baby
review_body: My sister-in-law brought this gift to the hospital for us upon the birth of our first child, a girl. It was such a cute thing to have sitting there in the room as I recovered from a C-section for five days. She bought it because I had gestational diabetes during my pregnancy and she thought it was funny to bring me a \\"smoothie\\" which would have been something off limits while pregnant. I'm sorry to say that we didn't open the smoothie until our daughter turned four months. We had other towels from the baby shower and I liked the packaging of the smoothie and assumed the towel would not be high quality because it was more picked for the color and packaging; boy was I wrong. The towel is one of the best we own now for baths -- it's a super soft and fluffy towel. The strawberry is a wrist rattle and is too cute. I just loved this gift and think I may buy one for my other sister-in-law when we visit them in the hospital for the birth of their second child. Highly recommend.

product_title: Britax Roundabout 40 Convertible Car Seat
review_body: This is the best carseat.  My 4year old is still in it and I just bought a new one for my 1 year old.  It's not big like the Marathon which we also have one of.  The materials are soft and you know your child is safe.  Best seat EVER!!!

product_title: Britax Roundabout Convertible Car Seat, Latte
review_body: I Have Owned And Used Two Britax Car Seats Since My Children Have Been Born They Are By Far The Easiest Car Seats To Use. My Children Love These Seats, The Velcro On The Sides Make Sure There Is No Tangling In The Straps Wonderful. The Couching Of The Seat Make It Cumffy For My Kids. The Buckle Is Further Up The Seat So I Don't Have To Big Underneath My Kid To Buckle Them In. All Around 110% Worth Every Penny And Easy To Use.

product_title: Chicco DJ Baby Walker Safari (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this thinking my son would love to be able to move around, my mistake. He hates being in it, since he can't crawl around or reach anything. He is very mobile and crawls everywhere. He uses tables and anything he can to walk arund as well so now it's just collecting dust. I'll be selling it soon. Great product though

product_title: Safety 1st High-Def Digital Video Monitor
review_headline: A Great Monitor BUT topples and brakes very easily!
review_body: I really like this monitor and think it is one of the best \\"tools\\" for baby care that I own BUT it topples VERY easily! The tall narrow shape of the monitor, along with the rounded back and location of the power cord cause it too fall over even when you just touch it to pick it up!     The second time my monitor fell over the screen quit working (but the sound still worked). We called Safety First and they said that it would not be covered under the warranty and IT WOULD BE $135 TO REPLCE the broken monitor! My sister has the same monitor and she says that hers has fallen lots of times and still works, but it's an expensive gamble.    On the positive side, I do like the small size and the functions of the monitor and really love the ability to zoom and \\"move\\" the camera around when the baby moves.     The other thing that I dislike about the monitor is that the lowest volume setting is pretty loud. I would like to be able to keep the monitor on for the few minutes that my baby needs to cry in order to go to sleep but it's still very loud on the lowest setting. Thankfully, I also have the \\"BébéSounds Angelcare Deluxe Movement Sensor with Sound Monitor\\" which is wonderful (a full 5 stars for it!) which does have a nice low setting and a cradle for the monitor to rest in to keep it secure and charged.     If Safety First just had a better waranty policy I would wholeheartedly recomend this monitor, but as it is I don't feel I can really recomend it. I hope in the future they will make some needed changes in their design of an otherwise great monitor. If you decide to get this monitor keep it as far away from the edge of your bed-side table as possible!

product_title: Bummis Super Whisper Wrap Diaper Cover
review_body: These are great basics for any cloth diaper stash.  The leg gussets are comfortable (looking, I admit, I haven't worn them myself!) and they keep the wetness inside.  It's nice to be able to use them a time or two before washing. The print is cute but in the future I'd probably save a buck or two and just go for white since I nearly never have baby in just a diaper and she doesn't care what it looks like.  Maybe for older babies it would be an issue.

product_title: NUBY BPA FREE 14 oz Easy Grip No Spill Cup with Soft Silicone Spout
review_body: These cups are about $1 - 2 each, don't buy them for $9.99!  They can spill if the child figures out that turning them upside down and pressing on it will make the fluid leak out, but usually do not spill.  My son is 13 months and has been using these for the past few months. (got them from ebay - 5 for $5.00)

product_title: Popular Kidosaurus Dinosaur Costume for Halloween Scary Fun
review_body: My Son loves this costume! once we put it on, he didn't want to take it off. unlike the discription the mouth is actually open. Which my son thinks is cool.

product_title: Delta Children Simmons Pearl Stroller
review_headline: Delta Simmons Pearl stroller: good but not amazing
review_body: Quick rundown:  lightest weight stroller I could find that has the option of facing baby toward you or away from you.  rear wheel covers popped off 7 times in first 15 minutes of use.  Instruction booklet for assembly is quite poor. Anyone who has assembled a stroller before or is adept at looking at things and seeing where they fit should be fine but if you rely on the user guide for actual help in assembling things, you are going to need a second person or a different stroller.  Very attractive and easy to use. When seat is facing the parent, stroller cannot be folded completely.  Sun shade needs improvement. It is on the narrow end of the spectrum and is not adequately adjustable.   The basket seems shallow.   There's no parent-friendly places for a water bottle or cell phone, keys, iPod, etc.  With some after-market accessories, I am going to make it a great stroller, once I get these damn wheel covers to stay put.  After about 3 months of light use, we have encountered a problem with the stroller. At random times, the wheels lock and cannot be unlocked. The first time it happened, it somehow resolved itself a week later with no action on our part. This time, I've been brought to tears because I cannot get the wheels unlocked. Am calling manufacturer today to ask for assistance.

product_title: Fisher Price Rainforest diaper bag animals of the rain forest
review_headline: Totally Adorable, and lots of pockets for storage!
review_body: I just received this diaper bag in the mail today, and I love it! It is so cute. It's a nice quality bag with nylon handle straps, and the interior is all wipe-off vinyl. While the exterior is a fabric material that seems like it would be easy to take care of. You could either wipe it clean, or throw it in the wash on gentle, and hang to dry. I also love the fact that it has so many pockets. There is a pocket in the very front (where the animal image is) that has two smaller pouches inside to hold little items such as baby nail clippers and baby spoons or hair clips. (I have girls) There are two \\"bottle\\" pockets one on each side of the bag for either bottles or Sippy cups, and a large pocket inside as well as another on the very back of the bag. The bag itself comes with a changing pad in the same green to match, and the pad is very cushy. Much better than any pads that I had found for my first two girls. The changing pad fits just inside the very back pocket. (See the images) Typically I would use a backpack as my diaper bag like I did for my first two, and still might switch once the baby goes into toddler stages and we are going to the park often. However I love this bag for use in the early stages because it's also got four more pouches sewn inside the lining in the main pocket that have elastic on the edges to hold in all your smaller items such as diapers, little socks, lotions etc. The bag overall is not so big that you feel like you are carrying around a suitcase, but it is definitely big enough to hold the necessities and then some, as it has so many pockets. I am very excited to be able to use this bag as I have all the fisher price rain forest items and my baby's crib set is going to be in monkeys. I have posted a few pictures of the interior of the bag for you to see. I hope this helps with your decision making!

product_title: Graco Nautilus 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_body: I bought this for my 15 month old son..This easy to put and is very comfortable and secure. It has some cushion features on the straps that adds some xtra comfort...Really worth my buy...I would strongly recommend this..

product_title: The Safe Sippy Blue
review_body:
I was delighted when I saw this cup - it had a sleek design and was BPA free. So, I decided to cough up the $17 PER cup and spent almost $40 for two cups (Excluding shipping!). It has been a huge disappointment. The cups leak and I have to wrap a paper towel around the lid everytime we use it.

I disagree with the other reviewer. It is not acceptable for a sippy cup to leak so much that it drips down on the child and a towel is needed. I am going to toss these out soon as I get new BPA-free ones. I rarely give reviews, and when I do, its because I really feel compelled to. Please save yourself the cash and invest in a BPA-free cup from another manufacturer that works.

product_title: Peg Perego Si Light Weight Stroller
review_body: i just got the pp si!  its a pretty good stroller and i'm happy with the features.  there are a some things that could be addressed --    when the stroller locks in the collapsed position, the left and right side arms dont lock into place even though there are clamp-like brackets.  the material used for the hood window doesn't give you a clear view of your child.  it's kind of like looking through a dirty window or screen or something.  the locking swivel wheels have to be independently locked (on my uno both wheels locked if you locked just one).  you can't fold the stroller with anything in the basket (my uno could fold with an umbrella, water bottle, rain cover and canvas bag, plus a few more items!).  but that's the sacrifice for an umbrella fold.  the included rain cover fits a little awkwardly and is a little flimsy and it doesn't come with the boot like it does in europe. so i'll keep my old rain over and bundle me and we'll be good to go.  the 3 position recline is two handed and the seat drops back to full recline due to the weight of the child, which could be a little scary.    other than those MINOR issues, i'm happy with my si and would recommend it.  it's lightweight, easy to maneuver, has 3 position adjustable handles and backrest.  the seat sits up high and the basket is unobstructed.  it folds easy in two steps and carrying seems like it will be easy and comfortable.      it has only been one day, but i think there is good things in our future.  check around for theprice.  i got my $249 instead of the $279 some places are selling it for.    enjoy!    kingston's mom

product_title: Eddie Bauer Velboa Play Yard Sheet
review_body: This is such a soft playpen sheet! It's not like the cold sheets typically used in a playpen. This \\"sheet\\" is so soft it feels more like a blanket. It fits wonderfully in our Graco Pack n' Play!

product_title: NoJo Emily 6 Piece Crib Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This bedding set is gorgeous! It is such good quality and it is made with very soft, velour like materials, even the valance and diaper stacker. The background is a rich cream color, but looks good on white furniture. I am very satisfied with this set. The colors and patterns are great for a baby or toddler and I plan to use it for a few years. It is nice to be able to incorporate so many colors (pink, blue, green, brown, cream) into the room and have a really girly nursery with out being all pink or purple. I only gave it 4/5 stars because it wrinkles very easily even with special care and I had to iron everyhting, but I am picky about little things like that! Otherwise, perfect!

product_title: Tiny Love Clip and Go Musical Mobile
review_body: My daughter and I both love this toy - she loves the music and the \\"0-3 month\\" side of the mobile \\"paddles,\\" or arms (the flat ones with stickers).  I love the music as it is all classical, and a fair representation of the actual music (only Chopin gets a little \\"tinny\\" on a few notes, but nothing I cannot live with).    Other favorite elements include:  1)it plays continuously (I hate musical toys that turn off after a preset period of time - so annoying), 2)it has a \\"mute\\" setting, for movement without sound (great for restaurants and bookstores) and 3) it comes with the \\"lobster\\" claw attachment, which is removable from this mobile, and useable to attach a multitude of other toys to just about anything (I totally disagree with the reviewer who said they could not attach this to virtually anything - I can attach it to virtually *everything*...I use this all over, with multiple toys from multiple brands.  It was most useful in attaching everything to the hood of a bassinette).      I like that one can attach the mobile via the lobster claw OR the velcro-ed elastic strap:  very versatile for a multitude of objects.  It is a perfect size for travel:  not too small, and not too large.    My daughter ADORES this mobile.  She would stare at it contentedly for parent-friendly blocks of time (from 3-5 mo. or so) in the bassinette.  She never liked the older-child, soft plush figures as much as the flat, 2D, images in black/white/red (even after she could see color, and 3D).  She loves the music even now at 8 months, so it's not a big deal, but Tiny Love (TL) could improve the color contrast or interest of the plush \\"guys.\\"  She and I also liked that the plush figures stick w/ velcro to the three rotating paddles, but can also be pulled down to dangle via the attached string below the paddles for added movement/interest (they don't come off completely).  Three different viewing modes for the price of one.      I gave it four stars due to the so-so interest on the plush toyside.        In general (not affecting my review of the mobile), TL should include this \\"lobster\\" claw attachment clip with all sold-separately accessories such as the [[ASIN:B000KTWWIO Baby's First Wind Chimes - Garden]].  I highly recommend both this mobile and the chimes as a perfect pair for months 3-5...and beyond.

product_title: Munchkin 2 Piece Snack Catcher
review_body: Ok. These aren't perfect. Although I am sure they are better than the Snack Trap brand but a 12 month old will learn to take the lid off and learn if they shake it with a finger in it will go everywhere.

product_title: New Boutique Pink Girl Minky Dot Chenille Baby Blankets FREE SHIPPING!
review_body: This blanket is very beautiful and so soft.  It was a gift for my niece and she always has it with her.

product_title: Playtex Baby Binky. Most Like Mother. One-Piece Silicone Pacifiers: Pink

review_body: I bought this because it said \\"just like mother\\". The nipple of this thing is tiny. I know it says 0-24 months, but it should be about 0-6 months. product_title: BabySmart Cooshee Booster Seat Classicwith Travel Bag
review_body: Only had it a month, but so far very pleased.  Kids find it so comfy they'll take it in and sit in it on the floor to watch tv at times.  Does not slip when placed on a wooden chair.

product_title: Britax marathon, decathlon, roundabout 50 and 55 (NOT 70) replacement Car Seat Cover
review_body: I just received my car seat cover today, and it is really beautiful.  It's a shame something so nice will probably be treashed when my daughter is done with it.  I have only a couple of issues.  Because I am a first time parent, I know next to almost nothing about car seats, let alone covers. There were no instructions for care, and I have NO idea what the accompanying pieces of material are for.  The cover was easy enough to put on, however the upper holes for the harnesses were not all opened up, and I am afraid to open them and rip a seam.  The quality checker should have noticed that3 holes were still closed.  All together, I like this cover and would purchase again from them if they improve their quality control.

product_title: Stork Craft Chelsea 4-in-1 Crib with Drawer
review_headline: Protect Your Baby: Pass Up this Toxic Crib
review_body: At [...], I knew we weren't getting the best crib out there. Frankly, I'm appalled they even allow this thing on the market.     The description says solid wood and wood products, but I couldn't find one piece that was made of anything but pressed sawdust and glue. Note, I'm not just talking your typical particle board here - this is some all-new funky material, likely developed in China, where the crib is manufactured. As everyone knows, many China-made baby and children's products have been recalled for lead, asbestos and GHB. What new and toxic shortcut could have been used in the manufacturing of this crib?     It's not just the appearance of this \\"wood product\\" that is disturbing. The smell is atrocious. I began unpacking this crib indoors, but quickly had to move it to the outdoors. It has an acrid smell, like one of those nail salons in the mall, and it quickly engulfs an entire room. Even outdoors, you don't have to be right next to the thing to be blown away by it. We tried wiping it with a vinegar solution. We tried airing it out for a day - just to give the thing the benefit of the doubt. Then we packed it up neatly and looked into Amazon's return policy: It's awesome by the way. UPS picked this piece of junk up the next day and we breathed a sigh of relief.     As an aside - the finish is ugly. It looks like someone tried airbrush a wood-like appearance onto it, but they were too cheap to get it right. It's patchy looking, kinda like a mangy dog. (How were any of these reviewers fooled by this?) In the lighter spots it's really obvious that the thing is indeed pressed sawdust, and the bars of the crib are flimsy and rubber-like.     If you think you're too poor to afford better, I'd suggest going for used. Our first daughter's crib was a used 7-year old piece that was originally in this price range. It's solid wood. It doesn't stink. It has a real honest polyurethane-style finish that wasn't airbrushed onto it. It's made in a third-world country that isNOT China.     If you can afford better, there are options in the 400+ range. One reviewer mentioned Baby's Dream - who claims their cribs are USA manufactured. While that's a fallacy - Baby's Dream cribs are manufactured in Chile - it is true that Baby's Dream uses 100% SOLID WOOD, no particle board, and their finish doesn't just say non-toxic, it smells non-toxic. And they are gorgeous, quality cribs that turn into toddler beds, then either full or twin sized beds depending on the model.     In the 600+ range you can go one better and buy an Amish crib that IS made in the USA, and is either unfinished or is finished with Tung oil, and is made of sustainable woods.     Either way, put your foot down and tell these manufacturers that you won't put your baby to sleep in their toxic crib. Our children deserve better, and until we DEMAND better, we will continue to get products that are substandard and dangerous.

product_title: BABYBJORN Baby Sitter 1-2-3 Activity Bouncer, Black Gingham (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Our baby had to adjust to it... at first he didn't really like it.  Now he can sleep in it, but we do have to rock him in it before he sleeps if he is not sleeping yet.  His body does not naturally rock it back and forth (up and down).  We are hoping that as he gets older (he is now just about 2 months) that he'll grow more used to it and rock it more.  It is not a total waste though, he does sleep in it alot, mostly in the daytime.  However, it's kind of bad because he gets so used to it he has a harder time sleeping in his bassinet.  Hopefully the money that we paid will equal out if we keep using it.  However, the bad thing is the playthings (those little teddy bears).  We took them off and haven't put them on since, and now I can't figure out how to put it back on and have it stay.  He did not like those teddy bears though.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier-Moss
review_headline: Wonderful for airplane travel, and much more....
review_body: I just used my Moby wrap for my 7 month old daughter's first airplane flight and it was so valuable, I just had to write this review.  It was better than a stroller for going through security because you didn't have to take the baby out to put a stroller through the x-ray machine. I could use the folds of the wrap for a nursing cover-up (with her out of the wrap), and during the flight, she slept comfortably in the wrap leaving my arms free.  She is 21 lbs. now and I can still carry her in the front position comfortably because the wrap is so supportive. She is also my second child and it was invaluable for shopping trips and hikes with my son. From very early in her life, it was a great way to calm her when she was fussy and still enable me to get things done around the house. I liked it better than my baby Bjorn for a newborn because her arms and legs could be contained more securely.  The only down-side to this wrap that I can think of is that it can be a little hot during the warmer months, and the wrapping takes some practice to figure out at first.  A mirror was helpful to check the straps in the back until I became more proficient.  Overall, this is one of my favorite and most-used baby items!

product_title: Medela Pump in Style and New Pump in Style Advanced Breast Pump Tubing - Pack of 2
review_body: glad i could buy this online, it was sold out evrywhere in the stores where I live

product_title: Nuby Step Up Stool, Colors May Vary
review_headline: Wonderful design - but no opportunity to pick color!
review_body: This stool is perfect design and price for my little man.  He specificly uses it for in front of the toilet and it gives him perfect height to keep accidents to a minimum.  The only problem - all the colors shown in the picture were primary colors - any of which I would have been fine with - but the one that came... was pink and purple.  My husband said to ship it back, but for a $10 stool, I would have paid more for shipping than it was worth... so WORD TO THE WISE... BE PREPARED YOU MAY NOT GET ONE OF THE COLOR COMBINATIONS PICTURED.

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: We absolutely love this bathtub! It is easy to give our newborn a bath in this tub and it is something he will be able to grow into. We definitely recommend this tub!

product_title: Chicco Little Driver Baby Walker (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This really is a great product. I read reviews of all the walkers available, and this trully is what all have stated.  Safe, adjustable, fun toys for my 6 month old son to play with, and the toy is removable for a plain shelf to put his own favorite toys.  It is a must for young babies that are trying to learn to walk, and keeps him busy!

product_title: Zanzibar - Quilt
review_body: I got this set as a gift, but it did not have the quilt, when I was able to find it on line, the color,texture and quality was right on the money.

product_title: The First Years Close And Secure Sleeper,Colors May Vary
review_body: Hubby and I bought this last minute when a hand-me-down bassinet ended up not working out for us. I had a lot of mixed feelings about baby sleeping in bed with us but the sturdy sides of this sleeper elimnated any concerns the very first night we put our little girl down to bed in it. I know it only goes to 24 inches but that really seems like it will be enough as we do plan to transfer our little one to her crib once she is sleeping solidly through the night or once she gets too big for this sleeper...  If you like the idea of co-sleeping but worry about rolling over on baby or smothering them then this is a great product- it's like baby has her own bed within your bed- and the best part of all: it makes nursing at night a snap!

product_title: Zooper Waltz Stroller Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I actually have the '07 version of the Zooper Waltz in Blue.  While I was very happy with this stroller in the beginning, I am totally disgusted right now just 10 months later.      The piece you pull up to recline the seat snapped off and the whole mechanism broke.  Also part of the 5 point harness snapped.  I called the customer service department to be told I need the receipt.  This was a gift.  Luckily my friend had the receipt (thank you Amazon.com) and I was told the stroller would be covered under warranty as it was less than a year old.  The problem is I am responsible for the cost of sending it back!  Do you know how much it costs to send it back $60-$100?  I did not break this stroller, why do I have to pay?      I wish they would stand behind their product and make things right.  I have never wrote a review before but I wish I had known their warranty was so unfair to the consumer.

product_title: Ergo Baby Carrier - Black/Retro
review_body: Easy to use and very comfortable. I started to use this after my baby outgrew his previous carrier - so I can't rate it for small (<20 pound) babies.

product_title: Sassy Rock n Stroll play pad
review_body: I bought this to go with my daughter's stroller. She loves it. The only down fall is I wish the straps were a tad longer.

product_title: Boon Benders Adaptable Utensils, Orange/Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got these for my 18 month old who was having some angular issues trying to curve his arm enough to get food directly into his mouth with regular kiddie utensils.  I figured awesome - you can bend as much or as little as you need to.  Well my problem is that 1) they bend way too easily and 2) the amount of food they can hold is pretty much the same as an infant feeding spoon.  I thought portion size changed with age a bit?  My son gets aggrevated cuz he can barely get any food on the spoon to begin with due to the small size, and on top of that it ends up bending even more while he's scooping something up.  Then it's over compensated for, and counter-productive.  The concept seems good in theory, but I don't think I would waste my money on them again.

product_title: Graco Soft Seat Potty Trainer
review_body: We've got two of these for our son and daughter (2 yrs old), and they've been a success: both of my children were pottytrained in two week, and they love their little potties. I think all the components are great: as a potty, as a stepstool, and as a seat to put on a big toilet: my kids have successfully used all of these. I didn't think they'd use it as a step stool, but they do (very handy!) and they also use it closed as a little seat to put their \\"big kid underwear\\" back on. The little grips on the base keep it nice and sturdy, but the grips tend to fall off every time we move the potties between our two bathrooms. It's also a job to clean, but I think it's worth it.

product_title: BuggyBagg Shopping Cart Cover - Single Pattern: Jungle
review_body: This product is great. Large and colorful keeps baby free of germs even in the large shopping cart. Can be used for many other areas that you want to protect baby from unwanted germs. Good storage capacity also.

product_title: DaVinci Kalani 4-in-1 Convertible Crib with Toddler Rail
review_headline: Crib looks great, sturdy, all around awesome!!!
review_body: The crib came to us very quickly.  I couldn't wait to open it and put it together.  The instructions for assembly were attached to the mattress spring.  Everything came looking great.  I was able to put it together all in a few hours.  The spring portion is very easy to be raised and lowered unlike another crib I helped my friend put together.  The finish on each piece matched perfectly.  I only needed help with one section of it and that was only to have my wife hold up a bar but everything is lightweight so it was no trouble at all for her to hold that for a few seconds.  One thing I would say is to be careful when putting it together not to cause your on scrapes buy accidentally putting in a top portion and letting the other parts scrape one another.

product_title: Sunshine Kids Stroller Accessory Buggy Buddy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This product is perfect for all of our strollers.  I would highly recommend it.  I have not had any issues with it as of yet.

product_title: Lamaze Symphony Motion Gym
review_body: My 2 month old daughter is fascinated by this play gym.  The motion is ingenious - she will watch each object sway above her and smile with delight.  The two types of music are cute.  I wish they were a little less repetitive and that there was a volume control, but those small things certainly don't take away from the other great features of this play gym.  The design is so much better than everything else I have seen - the space theme is really cute and not obnoxious like so many baby products can be.  Another great feature is that my two year old has dragged this all over the house, jumped on it, and climbed all over it, and it's completely indestructible.   We also have a Fisher Price play gym and both my daughter and I prefer this one.  I highly recommend it.

product_title: North American Bear Baby Cozy
review_body: My baby received one of these as a gift before she was born, and she adored it so much by the age of three months that I bought another \\"just in case.\\"  She's ten months now and, at least for now, has lost interest in Ellie, although she'll still light up and play with her or snuggle with her for a few moments if I bring her out and make a big deal over \\"Ellie.\\"  Great for babies, but, like all toys, outgrown within a few months.  But, I bet she'll re-attach to this toy when she hits the big insecure phase in a few more months...

product_title: Chicco Polly Double Pad Vinyl High Chair, Splash
review_body: I agree with all of the positive reviews so far.  I don't think any of the negative points should stop someone from buying this great high chair.  It looks good, functions well and is practical.    I do think the tray is a little difficult to put on the arms as it doesn't slide smoothly enough to do with one hand.  But, I love the size of the tray and the fact that you can store it on the back legs.    I'm not too worried about cleaning the straps...maybe I'm just not compulsive about that, but wiping them down with a damp cloth after each meal is fine.    I have other Chicco products which I am happy with so I bought this high chair and am glad I did.

product_title: Star Kids Snack & Play Travel Tray, Black
review_body: The Star Kids Snack and Play Travel Tray is a very useful product.  We traveled 2000 miles roundtrip on our recent vacation and our 4 year old really benefitted from the tray.  It is more flexible than I expected, but that makes sense for crash safety.  The pockets are deep and hold lots of toys.  There are no sides or legs on the tray, it drapes across your childs lap/car seat and the pockets hang over the sides.  It can be relatively easily folded and tucked away when not in use.  The tray will sit differently on various booster and car seats, some may be too wide for an ideal fit.  Our Graco Turbo Booster was perfect and Our Graco convertable infant/toddler seat was okay, but tray was on a bit of an angle.

product_title: Combi 3-in-1 Hero: High Chair, Booster, Toddler Seat
review_body: My mistake...Combe 3-in-1 high chair sucks...awlful to keep clean...to many folds in the fabric...fading fabric...and the apple plate, don't get me started...can't use other dinner ware very well...thru chair away...wouldn't give it to anyone!!!!!

product_title: Carter's Watch the Wear 4 Flannel Blankets (Blue)
review_body: I have received my order from this seller and the blankets are better then the picture. Thanks!

product_title: Discovery Exclusive Ann B. Dextrous Motor Developer
review_body: My son received this as a gift when he was 4 months old.  At 2 1/2, he still loves playing it.  The stages allow for develpment as the baby gets older.  My son has some developmental delays so we loved the option to change the settings as needed.  We just bought this as a gift for our friend's baby.  The only problem we had was with the 4 blocks on top.  In the later stages they come out and my son lost them, probably in the trash!  Other than that, its a great toy.

product_title: Combi Activity Walker Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I was really skeptical and cautious from reading bad reviews...but not any more.
review_body: After reading negative reviews of missing/broken/defective pieces/duplicate mirrors/duplicate horns/made in china etc., I was highly skeptical of purchasing this combi activity walker. But due to the unique design, functions and the positive rating I was willing to take the chance. I really wanted my grandson Byrce to have this walker as his first set of wheels. The unique black n white color really tooted my horn...very sleek not the standard infantile protocol. The color coordinates with my Sons furniture...how cute is that!!!  I had it shipped to Richmond where they live  it arrived a day early. The item was/is in perfect  condition according to the proud father. So far good so . I will be visiting them next weekend (Aug.23rd.08) I'm anxiously waiting to see my grandson in action in his new drop top convertible. For me it was love at first sight (black and white) that was the hook I couldn't take my see off of it, the features was the line, the functions was the sinker. I am prayerful for the price it will withstand the test of time if not you will be hearing from me again on a different note. I think the manufacturer should consider even more eye catching attractive colors after all that's what got my attention. Although it may be a stretch... for and extra 10 bucks throw in an am or fm radio in the dashboard or even a simple voice recorder would really blow me away. The little drivers would like it too after all they usually like what we like including the sounds of music. Not that it matters but...I made my purchase at Babyage.com,(they offered free S/H) It's always good to shop around. I hope my review is helpful.

product_title: Where's My Bone Soft Baby Activity Soft Book
review_body: My son is too young to truly enjoy this (3 months old) but he is just now learning to touch stuff, and has given it a little exploratory touch. But I am impressed by its sturdy \\"handmade\\" feel that I think I enjoy more than he does, at this point. I can imagine lots of fun games we can play where I hide the bone somewhere and he goes through the pages looking for it. He'll get there soon enough--he already knows how to turn pages with his feet!

product_title: Evenflo Triumph Advance LX Convertible Car Seat, Harbortown (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Great carseat.  However, if you just had a baby do not buy this one until they are close to 1 year old.  This is a massive carseat that when facing backwards makes it tough to put your baby into.  This seat is great for forward facing 1 year babies.  Enough said.

product_title: Playhut City Boutique
review_body: I bought this boutique tent for my (at the time) 11 month old last year. She absolutely FELL IN LOVE WITH IT! It's pretty easy to assemble and fairly easy to put away in the cute bag it comes with (once you get the hang of it). :) My daughter (now almost 2 years old) STILL LOVES it, and I do too! I will admit the first time I actually tried to put it away (just to see how \\"easy\\" it would be) I just about had a COW! LoL! It wasn't THAT easy; the metal wires bend out of shape pretty easily if you don't do EXACTLY what the picture says, but from corner to corner (like one of those old school windshield sun blockers)and if it still gets a little bent out of shape bending it the opposite way will keep it from falling over. I haven't had any more problems with it! I've had it for almost a year now, and I still am so glad I bought it. It really is a great buy for the price. :) Happy bargaining. :)

product_title: Battat Mirror Pound-A-Ball Toy, Colors May Vary
review_body: My son has CP and this is one of his favorite toys. We've had it for about a year and he never gets tired of it. He plays with it almost everyday. It's great for CP kids, teaches them to use tools (the hammer) and they can play with one or both hands.

product_title: Baby Planet Solo Sport Stroller Cobalt Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I had a Chicco Ct 0.6 stroller for my 2 year old daughter. It was great but she had a growth spurt and gained too much weight to be in it so I decided to get a new stroller (mind, she's now only 31 lbs). I got this one, not knowing what it'd be like but I listened to the reviews and I'm glad I did! This is the best stroller ever, I don't know how I managed the last two years without it and I've only had it for two days! I can't believe there would be a parent who doesn't have this stroller![[ASIN:B000NP080E Baby Planet Solo Sport Stroller Crimson]]

product_title: Badger Basket Three Basket Set
review_body: These baskets are GREAT!  I love them in my daughter's nursery because they hold a lot and they are the prettiest baskets I have ever seen anywhere. They can hold baby books by the rocker, diapers and creams or lotions, toys, etc. Very happy with this purchase.

product_title: Baby-Says Bodysuit - See ya later Alligator!
review_body: I recieved this as a gift at my baby shower and am very pleased with it. It is super soft and thick!!!I'm sure baby will be very comfy!!!

product_title: Disney Pooh Peek-A-Boo Soft Blocks (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: They came within a week and my daughter loves them. She eats the balls and loves the crinkle of the boxes. If your child loves winne the pooh and is teething this is a great toy.

product_title: Recaro Young Sport Child Car Seat - Ebony (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: We love it, our son loves it A+
review_body: We purchased one of these seats for our now 3yr old son back when he made the jump from his infant seat.  He never had any problems sitting in it and last year when we made a cross country trip he never once complained about discomfort while awake or after being asleep.  It is easy to take apart and clean and just as easy to put back together.  We now have 2 of these seats (1 in each car) and don't regret the purchases one bit!

product_title: DaVinci Alpha Baby Crib
review_body: I purchased two of these cribs for use when our (now 10 month old) twin grandsons visit once a month or so.  They were easy to assemble - took the two of us about a half hour for both using a screw driver and socket wrench AND reading the directions (there are various sized screws and you must use the right one in the right place). The finish is good - smooth and  tough. The long sides have plastic \\"teething\\" guards\\" on the tops so that the wood is not scratched if the baby bites on it. One side can be raised/lowered as needed, but the locking mechanism is not that smooth so we leave them stationary. The mattress height is adjustable so that the mattress can be lowered down as the child learns to stand up. I was able to install a heavy mobile on the headboard.   They look great with all the accessories in place and two fit nicely into our small 10X10 room, leaving space between them for a changing table.    The crib is sturdy, but if one end is pushed, there is about a half inch of \\"give\\" due to the plastic parts that allow the side to be lowered. For the price, this crib is a good deal. I would give it 5 stars if the locking mechanism worked more easily.

product_title: North States Industries Superyard Playard
review_body:
I've been searching different stores and sites for a play yard. We bought this play yard and extension kit in August for our then 10 month old. I listed the pros and cons below.

PROS:
-Sturdy for our average sized 20lb. daughter, she frequently pulls her sell up on it.

-Quick shipment time, we received the item within 4 days including the weekend.

-The sides are tall, I don't need to worry about her climbing out. (for awhile anyway)

-The color is light enough that it isn't completely hideous.

-The plastic is easy to clean.

-The gate comes assembled and the extension is easy to attach.

-Even without the extension kit our daughter has enough space to crawl around.

-Without the extension kit 2 kids could play without issues of space. Our 8 yr. old played with her in it before we added the extension. Although, I do recommend buying the extension kit, especially if you have more then 1 child using it.

-The price is good.

-It folds up compact enough to slide behind a couch, transport in the car, or store in a closet.

CONS:
-Doesn't work well on wood or tile floors do to sliding. Great on carpet though.

-The gate didn't come with the skid pads but the extension kit did. The pads in my opinion are kind of expensive for just rubber and adhesive. I glued pieces of the rubbery slip resistant cabinet liner on the bottom.

-The play yard is not the most attractive but I'd say it is comparable to others.

-The gate can be tricking to open and close until you get the hang of it. I personally just step over it if I need to get in.

-It is a slight hassle to move if you need to vacuum or clean the floors.

-Folding, unfolding, and positioning can be hard as well because the panels seem to stick a little bit. It may be how the gate is made though, so it is sturdy.

Overall, I would recommend this play yard. If you are looking for a gate that matches your home or furniture this may not be it. I personally, wouldn't expect a play yard to match anyway. It serves it's purpose and is well made. This item has worked out great for our family.d to match anyway. It serves it's purpose and is well made. This item has worked out great for our family.

product_title: WallCandy Arts Peel-and-Stick Wall Decal, Nightly News Wall Decals
review_body: These owls are great! They are color correct with the image on my MAC. Exactly what you see and more. Very happy!

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Booster Seat, Yellow and Orange (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Great product and great price!  This booster seat is easily transportable (I leave it in my car so we have it when we're out), folds down nicely, light-weight, and a great accessory if you have a child who can't sit on an adult seat and reach the table yet.  I HIGHLY recommend it.

product_title: Proudbody My Little Prints Baby-Safe Ink Pad, Black

review_body: love this and it is well made, thick material and our new son loves looking at the animals. Highly recommended.

product_title: My Brest Friend Deluxe Nursing Pillow
review_headline: Essential for the first weeks of Breast Feeding
review_body: I recieved this pillow, in addition to a Boppy pillow for my baby shower. I chose to take this one to the hospital with me and it turned out to me the best choice I could have made. I ended up with a C section, and my baby and I had a really hard time with nursing. The lactation consultant at the hospital said that this was the very best pillow for me in my situation. It helped me to feed well while sitting up in a chair as well as in bed, while keeping my baby and the pressure off of my very sore tummy. My son had to be nursed in the football position which places his body along my sides rather than across the front of me. I was able to turn the Breast Friend sideways and had great support so that I could nurse him with one hand.   Once we arrived home from the hospital, I used this exclusively for the first 4 weeks. On a couple occasions I used it to allow me to nurse at the table while I ate dinner. Now that my son is 16 lbs, we have mostly outgrown the need to use this pillow but it was very well worth having it, even if it was mostly in the first 4 weeks.    I would spend the money to purchase this pillow just for the help it gave me in the hospital. Breast Feeding was and is so important to me and having the right tools is what enabled us to get through those first challenging days.     The only con I would say is that it needs to be buckled in order to stay in place. I tried using it a couple times without buckling it and it kept slipping away from my body and my son was sinking into the crack. Not a huge deal because it only takes a moment to buckle but in the middle of the night it's just one more thing to have to focus on. Still, it was great having it!

product_title: Pink Lamb Infant Newborn Baby Costume
review_headline: SUPER CUTE! GREAT in BLUE & PINK for twins!
review_body: This is very cute and came super fast from costume craze. I highly recommend it, but we bought a 12-18 month for 8 month old daughter and it fits her perfect. She is a little big, but I would recommend one size bigger. Our son. her twin is smaller and he also fits in the 12-18 month.

product_title: Graco Quattro Tour Deluxe Travel System with SafeSeat in Imperial
review_body: I found this to be a great product, the only thing that I had a hard time with was the clip to hold the wheels, but haven't had a problem with anything else.  I love having the versatility of the car seat because I have the swing that the car seat attaches to, which saves me space, and it's extremely convenient to take my baby from the car to the stroller where I don't have to un-strap him from the car seat and re-strap him into the stroller.  The car seat was extremely easy for me to install, but my husband had a hard time. Also the car seat itself is a little on the heavy side.  Overall, I'm extremely pleased with this product.

product_title: Sorelle Tuscany Convertible Crib - Cherry
review_body: We went crib shopping at a near by store and saw this crib on the show floor.  We fell in love with it right away!  But we did not buy it right away since our baby's grandmother wanted to purchase a crib for us.  But of course, she lives in another state.  We went home and looked online and found the same crib on Amazon for $100 cheaper!  We called up the grandmother, and she had it delivered to us with 1 day delivery.  The crib box arrived with a tear on the side but amazingly enough that was the only thing wrong with packaging.  All the parts were in perfect condition.  The instructions were easy to follow and the parts were labeled for easy assembly.  After assembly, the crib is very sturdy and the wood finish is beautiful.  The nursery smelled like wood for a couple of days which is a good indication of the quality of the crib.  Our baby is not due for another month, but believe me, we cannot wait to put our baby in it.  All in all, if you are looking for a good quality crib, the buck stops here!

product_title: Sassy Baby's Mam 5 oz. Boy 3 Pack Bottle
review_body: I tried several different bottles, and spent a lot of money in the process, trying to find a bottle that my daughter liked.  She absolutely loves this bottle.  I would recommend it to anyone.

product_title: Graco Cozy Dinette Highchair
review_body: This highchair is PERFECT!! It is durable, versatile, and worth every dollar!! The chair has plenty of cushioning to support an infant.....and the extra cushion can be removed as the child grows. It seems very easy to adjust, and clean up.........and does fold up for storage. review_body: I have a 2 year old, who is like Dennis the Menace, and he finds trouble anywhere. Kidco PeaPod plus is a winner in our house!!!!!!!!!!!

product_title: Primo 4-In-1 Soft Seat Toilet Trainer and Step Stool White with Pastel Blue Seat
review_body: I love that this potty chair has everything in 1 product! It saved me money from having to buy everything separately and saved space too. It comes with cute reward stickers too. I got the free shipping and it came in about a week.

product_title: The Softest Swaddle Blankets
review_body:
My granddaughter had trouble sleeping at night so I bought one of these for my daughter to try. The next day after using it that night my daughter runs up to me and gives me the biggest hug. She said for the first time the baby slept not only more than a couple hrs. but she slept all night!
I was a little skeptical for it to work so well and so fast so I waited to hear what would happen the next night. Well there again she slept all night. It has been over 2 months and with using this swaddler my granddaughter has slept 99.9% of the time all night. There have been a couple times she was up but not anything like before. Wonderful product. Make your baby feel snuggly and safe. Easy to use. We love it.

product_title: Sassy Baby Mealtime On the Go Feeding Set, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is the greatest thing for my 19 month old's lunches.  They are the perfect size for her portions, and I love that the containers they all neatly sit neatly in the outer container.  I don't use the spoon that came with, but otherwise I am planning to buy another!
