product_title: Sunshine Kids Radian65 Convertible Car Seat - Granite (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
We were just involved in a car accident this afternoon where someone ran a stop sign and we hit them. We had the Raidian65 car seat for my 14 month old son and I am online buying another Radian65 car seat. Although all the adults are extremely sore, my 14 month old son seems perfectly fine. We had him rear-facing and he was frightened but not injured and doesn't even seem sore.

We had an Eddie Bauer car seat originally and did not like the way the seat fit in our Trailblazer. I did some research and saw that the Radian 65 was one of the top-rated car seats according to Consumer Reports, as well as more narrow than the Britax car seats. We tried it out and were very happy with the seat.

Unfortunately I have the experience to say that this seat will definitely help keep your child protected if there is ever the need. Plus, it is narrow so you have room for passengers and more car seats if necessary. I would definitely recommend this seat to anyone!

product_title: ProudBody Pregnancy Art
review_body: Takes a bit of patience to apply. You will need lots of coats for full coverage.  But the result is EXCELLENT. Does not rub off easily. I still have it on after a full nights sleep wearing a tank top over it.  Better to use a blot/twist motion with the sponge and then using the brush for details. Use just a tiny bit of water and blot with a paper towel before applying. My hubby painted a sunset on my belly for halloween, and I took 1st place in the costume contest.  I'm VERY IMPRESSED!

product_title: Baby Jogger Performance Series Stroller - Double
review_body: The Baby Jogger is by far the best jogging stroller made. I looked at them all before deciding to purchase this one. My only hang up was that Baby Jogger is a bit larger than the rest of them, and will not fit through a lot of house doors. I decided that I would rather fold it, or leave it under the patio cover rather than buy a different stroller that would fit through the doors. We are very happy with our decision. It rides like a dream. We have a 3 month old and a 2 year old, both seem to love it. We roll a towel and bend it around the head of the 3 month old to keep her head steady. It does lean back further than I thought it would though.     Very well made, drives great, and I would recommend it to anyone.

product_title: SwaddleDesigns Ultimate Receiving Blanket, Brown Mod Circles
review_body: I recieved a Swaddle Designs blanket as a baby gift and it is now my #1 gift for new babies. It is perfect for swaddling, but the large size is also great to put on the floor when the baby needs a play area, and as it is thin, it fits nicely into a diaper bag or stroller to carry with you all the time as the baby gets older. Plus they are soft and pretty! What more could you ask for?

product_title: Evenflo ExerSaucer 1-2-3 Tea for Me - Tea Party
review_body: My daughter has been enjoying this for a month. She is now 7 1/2 months old. She also started getting teeth at 4 months and has the four front right now. She has chewed off the paint on many little corners of the toys. Of course I didn't realize this until it was done. I will be calling customer service to get the replacements/substitutes. Otherwise, we really loved the entertainment and challenges it gave her. She is already a bit tall for the height and I may suggest that if you have a big baby, go for one that will adjust to higher heights.

product_title: Toddler Shield Table Edge Cushion Large Brown
review_headline: Best edge and corner protection according to childproofers
review_body: Small children can be seriously injured with table edges and corners. This shield is recommended by childproofers over stick-on edge protectors, which can be easily pulled off. It's easier to install with two adults - clear the table, have each person grab on to it, strech it around the table, and you're done. There are no adhesives so it won't damage your table's finish.     This is an all-in-one product that comes with optional corner bumpers that you slide underneath, for added protection. It won't prevent all injuries but will help minimize risk, especially if you have a glass table (avoid them if possible). Please note this product will not work on cube shaped tables. Comes in small, medium and large, and in two colors, beige and black. Measure the diameter of the table before ordering to get the best fit.    There will be a small gap where the shield ends (you can slide your fingers under). The table top covers from Improvementscatalog website can be used on top of this if you want to hide the shield. There are different colors, but the Mosaic-Look Custom Table Cover is especially realistic and will give the thicker dining room or kitchen table the look of stone and mosaic. An added plus is its durability and easy clean feature - essential with toddlers.    Tip: install the shield and table top cover when your child's not around, so they won't figure out it goes on like a shower cap.

product_title: Crown Crafts The Old Gang 4Pc. Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this bedding set, my son is nearly 2 years old now and if it were not for his feet hanging from the comforter this set is still in mint condition, after several washes and use...Im happy with my purchase!

product_title: Gerber Flannel Receiving Blanket, 5 Pack

review_body: With the arrival of our second child, we thought this would be a good idea, but we were wrong.  The monitor constantly loses the signal and beeps.  The room switch can be set for different times, but never worked right and as others have said, you have to wait to tell which room the noise is from.  Forget going to a different floor too as the signal is just too weak.  I would recommend buying two single room monitors and changing the frequencies as a better alternative than wasting money on this product.

product_title: SwaddleMe Adjustable Infant Wrap-Pink Cotton Knit
review_body: I loved this for my daughter early on. It was nice not having to figure out a blanket-this solves that problem! They will outgrow it though (by like 3-4 months old)

product_title: BABYBJORN Little Potty
review_headline: baby bjorn : little potty is great for travel or around town
review_body: a. was very reliably pottying on her big bjorn potty [[ASIN:B0009OLSZ8 BabyBjörn Potty Chair - White]] before her second birthday this summer ( thank you 'once upon a potty' [[ASIN:1554072840 Once Upon a Potty -- Girl]] ) but with autumn just around the corner, we needed something small we could take to the park and music class. it needed to fit in a bag, and under the maclaren and the baby jogger.    a. is 30-ish pounds and nearly 27 months old. this is not an everyday seat .. it's the comfortable equivalent of peeing on the grass : necessary & convenient. i prefer her not sitting on a public toilet. the little bjorn is clean, familiar and safe.    the bjorn little potty is perfect in every way. the only caveat : be sure to have some spare water in your bottle [[ASIN:B0018ZRS4W Stainless Steel Water Bottle with hiking clip (16 Oz) - Pink c/t New Wave Enviro]] so that you can rinse if you're not near a sink.

product_title: The First Year's Newborn-To-Toddler Reclining Feeding Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I BOUGHT 2 OF THESE CHAIRS FOR OUR GRANDDAUGHTER, ONE FOR OUR HOUSE AND ONE FOR HER HOUSE. SHE IS ONLY 3 1/2 MONTHS OLD BUT SHE LIKES TO SIT UP SO WE PUT HER IN THE CHAIR SO SHE CAN WATCH THE OTHER KIDS PLAY AND FOR HER TO PLAY WITH HER TOYS ON THE TRAY. review_body: We used two extra pieces on each leg to bring the co-sleeper to the perfect height for our bed.  Worked like a charm!  Expensive yes, but the right tool for the job.

product_title: Kandoo Wipes Tub Holder
review_body: I love this piece, it hangs right on your existing toilet paper holder without getting in the way of the adult toilet paper. I just bought another one for my 2nd bathroom. My 5 year old loves it and it's great when u need a wipe and don't want to go digging for one somewhere.

product_title: Summer Infant Best View Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: So glad we chose this monitor.
review_body: This monitor has been great for us. We've had it about 6 weeks, and so far, everything has been perfect. The picture is sharp and clear, the zoom/pan work well, and it stays in range all the time. It doesn't make too much noise or have too much of a hum that can be annoying with some other monitors.    The only thing i wish it had was one more degree of volume control. Even when it's on the lowest setting, it still is pretty loud. I'd like to be able to go 1 or 2 notches lower. But that's a very trivial thing.    Overall, great monitor that is easy and convenient and does the job. Would recommend and am glad we chose this one.

product_title: Safety 1st Acella Sport Travel System
review_body: We received this stroller set today and we LOVE the look of it. It's very sporty looking and looks more expensive than it was. I really can't say enough about the good looks of this stroller, it should stand out in a crowd. The wheels are nice and big and there is even \\"soft suspension\\" in the front which makes it very smooth rolling. It took my husband about 30 minutes to put everything together and then maybe 10 to 15 minutes to figure out how everything works. It folds together really easily and everything seems very smooth to operate. Our baby is due in 3 months and I'll write annother review after putting it into practical use but so far I'd highly recommend it.

product_title: Primo 4-In-1 Soft Seat Toilet Trainer and Step Stool White with Pastel Blue Seat
review_body: What else can I say?  no frills or bells and whistles.  What do you want for something that's going to end up with pee and poop all over it? Then every few days , i moved it closer to the bathroom.  Now he doesn't use it anymore except as a stool to use the grown up potty.  Hey, one less thing I have to clean, right?  WHen it first came, I was expecting it to have a \\"cushy\\" seat, that's what I think when I see \\"soft\\".  It's really just a rubber cover over a plastic seat.  it's easy enough to wipe down after each use and I really cleaned it every night after he went to bed, as well as the floor underneath, but he's a boy - not expecting everything to be contained - if his dad can't do it, why should he?:)

We've never used the tray mat, but the tray is great.  The tray has high sides and is easy to get into the sink for washing. review_body: Sheet did not fit.  Was about 1/2 the size of the Graco Pack n play.  Wrapping is gone.  Would love to return, but don't know where and too busy enjoying my grandaughter to care.  Don't buy this.

product_title: Sunshine Kids New Radian 80 Convertible Car Seat - SuperCool (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)

review_body: I installed this car seat rear-facing in the middle of the backseat of our 1999 Toyota Camry.  It is working well for my 1+ year old toddler.  I had read previous reviews that caused me to worry that it would be difficult to adjust the harness in rear-facing position, but I did not experience this problem.  The back of the carseat does brace against the back of the 2 front seats, but the fireman who inspected my installation said this is not a safety issue and is in fact better since it provides more stability for the carseat.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Complete Play Yard with Bassinet & Changing Station Bryant Collection
review_body: We bought it for our daughter and after a month the side broke. When we contacted Target they wouldn't replace it or anything. All I did was touch it. We paid alot of money that we only had for a month. This product sucks!!!!

product_title: Lamaze Play & Grow Pupsqueak
