It is very sturdy, easy to put baby in and out, tray truly moves with one hand, and top tray pops out for easy cleaning.  I am so glad we found this chair and didn't settle!

product_title: Boppy Nursing Pillow and Positioner - Bare Naked
review_body: I got this pillow as a baby shower gift, and I have used it constantly since my baby was born. I use it for nursing, to prop the baby up in a reclining position on the sofa or bed and for tummy time. My husband also uses it when holding the baby on his lap. It is one of the most useful baby shower gifts I received.

product_title: BABYBJORN Potty Chair
review_headline: Finally found a big enough potty!!!
review_body: If you are looking for a bigger potty, this is it. I don't think it's possible to find a larger one. I am so glad I bought this potty. I went to several different stores and put my son on so many potties after I had already bought 3 and took them back. They are all so tiny it is ridiculous!!! I was getting so ticked off. My son was just over 2 1/2 years old and he is skinny. I guess they make the potties like everything else in this micro mini world we live in. This fits my son well and he likes it. I love the built in pee pee guard, he can't remove it. He loves to bring the insert to me and show off his accomplishments. My son is now 31 1/2 pounds and just over 37 inches tall and he is very comfortable on this potty. Thank God and Baby Bjorn for this potty. I don't know what I would have done.

product_title: Safety 1st Soft Spout Cover
review_headline: Inexpensive and fits like a glove!
review_body: I had researched a lot of spout covers before buying this one. My bathtub faucet has a shower pull, AND a handheld shower hose attachment. I really needed something that would not obstruct either of those and protect my baby from bumping his head- and I found it for less than $3! (Sears sells this for $2.65)    Now tonight was the first night that we used it, so I will update if this thing turns out to be a flop. But so far, so good. I blew it up, it slid right on and fit really tight too. At first it didn't, but I just took it off, added more air into it and then it fit really tight on there. This is the second faucet cover I have tried. The other was the Munchkin rubber ducky cover- which was really cute, but very hard plastic and it just didn't fit over the shower pull. This cover has a removable strip of plastic along the top. All I had to do was remove it, and there was plenty of space for the shower pull. So your shower pull can be towards the front, or even the back (like mine) and it will still work.     So very soft, covers the whole faucet- even the bottom side- was super easy to put on, fits great, kind of cute (there are cuter covers out there), but for $3 I am very happy.     **UPDATE**  We've had this on the tub faucet for nearly 6 months now, and it has only lost a tiny bit of air. I have not had to add more air, or do anything at all to it. My son has bumped his head on it many times, and has not even seemed to notice. Great purchase.

product_title: Family Seat-Plastic White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Cheap Plastic not worth a penny
review_body: The tightening mechanism is weak and leaves the seat loose.  We are average weight people, 5' 10\\", 180, being the largest person in the house, myself.  I strongly discourage anybody from wasting their money on this product.  Do not by plastic if you can help it.  If I could return it, I would, but I tossed the box.  Returning a toilet seat seems wrong since it is used. Ok, enough ranting, just trust me.  P.S. I've never written one of these feedback boxes before.  I am not paid to write this, obviously :-)

product_title: Cosco Ambassador Belt Positioning Backless Booster  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Inexpensive, functional, quality booster seat.  It gets the job done, and looked great in the back of my sports car.  Daughter loves it, and not sure what else I can say.

product_title: GO-GO BABYZ TRAVELMATE Car Seat Travel Stroller for Toddler Car Seats
review_headline: A.w.e.s.o.m.e. I'm even willing to loan it out to friends!
review_body: We love the go-go kidz travelmate.  We purchased it to hual a Graco Nautilist for our 37 lb 40.5in tall 3 yo.  We were pleasantly suprised how well it handled with the 26 lb carseat and our 37 lb child.  The razor wheels are great for wheeling around.  The telescoping handle was perfect for our 5'6\\" and 6'3\\" adults.  It was super easy to attach the carseat to the travelmate.  The most difficult part about the entire assembly process once we took it out of the box was to find a screwdriver.  The screws screwed right in.    The travelmate went right through the x-ray machine at the airport still attached to the car seat.  At the smaller airport it was hand checked by the TSA guys, but that was because the carseat wouldn't fit through the smaller x-ray machine.  We got to wheel our 3 yo sitting in the seat to the airplane door.  We flew Alligent and it fit perfectly in the seat.  We did not need a seatbelt extender or anything.      We have since offered to lend out our travelmate to all of our friends.  We are so glad we bought it.  Can't imagine how we would have done it without the travelmate.

product_title: Philips Digital Baby Monitor
review_body: I purchased this item for use in Australia. Unfortunately the monitor does not have multi voltage power packs, but it was easy to replace the power packs to 240 volts AC and it was well worth it since this is such a good monitor... I've been using this item now for a few weeks and it is very good.

product_title: Graco Contempo Highchair in Kasbah
review_body: laughed as I \\"assembled\\" chair. easiest baby item to date - 8mo.  easy to figure out, stack/store and multiple adjustments. ive been using reviews to make purchases but have yet to review any...this is the first because its really worked out well.

product_title: AD Sutton & Sons Convertible Stroller Bag Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: the size is perfect!  I would rahter it comes with additional bags inside for diapers, and some other sutff bu I completed by buying and aditional kit.    I loved the fabric and the inside color.  It looks like a fashion bags rather than a diaper bag.

product_title: Graco Snugride Infant Car Seat, Tangothe Tongo
review_headline: I miss the front pull tab tightener
review_body: We had a similar model that has passed its expiration date, so replaced it with this one.  Overall we like it, but the new rear-access cinch-up straps are a bit difficult to use.  The older models had a single pull tab at the front (foot end) to tighten the straps.  Otherwise no complaints, the pattern is cute and gender-neutral.

product_title: P'kolino Silly Soft Seating
review_body: While I have to admit that my daughter is still too young (10 months) to use this seat \\"properly,\\" she will sit in it and loves to play with it in her own way.  It definately serves as a conversation piece and almost everyone comments on how cute it is.  The only negative is that we have an inside dog and the fabric seems to love pet hair.

product_title: Combi Activity Walker Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I had the most difficult time trying to find and order this product. People either said that they didn't have it in stock, it was back ordered to a date that was crazy (my son would have been walking by that point), or the company did not ship to Hawaii!!!The item shipped and is better than I thought!!! My son loves it and it is multi-functional!!! Everyone who sees it absolutely thinks its adorable.  My friends son, same age, used it and loved it. Would highly recommend product!

product_title: Evenflo X Sport Convenience Stroller
review_headline: Nice Stroller - could use some changes
review_body: We bought this stroller to go on vacation. We spent the entire time running after the front wheel that kept falling off. We called evenflo and they are going to send a new one. Was a real pain to deal with. Also if you have long legs, I am 5'7 then you will kick the back wheels. You will have to learn how to walk with less big steps. The drink holder is not for an adult beverage. It spilled over because it was not sturdy. I like the zipper compartment to hold keys ad cell phone. My daughter also liked it.

product_title: Baby Einstein Play Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I almost didn't buy this cause it was a little more than I wanted to spend but I'm glad I did cause my baby and I love this mat. He uses it eveyday and never get bored with his star (which lights up and plays music). I bought it when he was 2 months old and now 4 months later he still loves it. Worth the money.

product_title: Dreambaby Bath Seat
review_body: I love this bath chair, i was so scared of my baby slipping thru my hands in the tub so it was a 2 person job until i got this. Now i dont have to wait 4 my husband and baby loves it!

product_title: Razbaby RaZberry Teether
review_body: This is HANDS DOWN the best teether ever!! My son has been teething since he was 3 months old - and we finally came across this teether and ordered it when he was 6 months old. He's now almost 8 months old and has four teeth, and three more fighting to get through. Regardless, we use this teether on a DAILY basis! It's great because all of the surfaces are teethable and so easy for him to hold. He gets soo excited when we go to give it to him and he goes to town! Again, BEST. TEETHER. EVER!!!!

product_title: Baby Trend Snap-N-Go EX Universal Infant Car Seat Stroller
review_body: I wanted a \\"snap-n-go\\" type stroller for our Chicco Keyfit carseat.  This worked perfectly.  I found the stroller to be well-made and easy to steer.  It was easy to open one-handed (while holding a baby or carseat) and has a spacious basket that was pretty easy to access, even if baby was in the stroller.  We were very happy with this stroller and glad to find one that worked well with the Chicco Keyfit.

product_title: Rover Gear Easton Travel Playard Bag, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This bag makes all kinds of travel easier with baby.  We bring our pack n play with us everywhere.  It is easy to pack and unpack.  The straps on the inside keep it snug.  It has extra space so I also put packed our baby's bedding inside the bag, along with a few extras!  This helped us with our packing, since we are always short on luggage space.  We are VERY happy with our purchase!

product_title: Natursutten BPA-Free Chill-It Teether, Fish, 3-12 Months (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Baby likes it cold; Mom likes that it's BPA free
review_body: My 5 month old likes this fishy right after I take it out of the fridge. This week his 2 bottom teeth broke through and this has made him feel better. He takes turns between this fishy and his Sophie The Giraffe, which he can grab easily too. I would recommend both teethers highly  when you can't supervise your baby 100% (like in the car seat). When you're at home, my baby likes to teeth on a long piece of organic celery or a peeled, cold organic carrot.

product_title: Kolcraft Contours Options 4 Wheeler (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I would have given it 5 stars if the folding feature was easier.  The stroller is fairly heavy, and it doesn't unfold easily. I was so embaressed one time, where 2 people had to help me in front of the mall to unfold my stroller. It is just not easy at all. The look is great, but buy it only if you can leave it unfolded.

product_title: The First Years Car Rear Sunshade (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The sunshade is perfect for my baby.  It keeps her eyes from bright light.  THe only problem I see is that the car's rear glass is larger than this sunshade.  Some rays still go through the sides.  However, it still does the job of shading my baby well.

product_title: Lamaze Play & Grow, Moose
review_headline: The best of the Lamaze toys
review_body: I bought [[ASIN:B000I2OKEW Lamaze Patty the Panda]] and [[ASIN:B000I2MRLK Lamaze Jacques the Peacock]] in addition to [[ASIN:B000I2MRLU Lamaze Mortimer the Moose]]. My 4-month old is interested in all of her Lamaze toys, but if you are only going to buy one, I definitely recommend the moose. My baby is fascinated by the moose, he has a soft body, rubber antlers and his feet dangle, with brightly colored ends and bells.

product_title: Chicco Polly Double Pad Fabric Highchair
review_body:
The only thing I like about this high chair, is that my son can't get out of it, so it's safe to put him in it, while I'm heating up his food or chopping something up for him.

What I hate about it:
- The tray covers don't stop food from getting on the tray, so you have to wash the tray also
- The tray is HUGE. I don't know if they though triplets would be eating from one tray, but no child needs a tray this big. If you put this tray in your sink to wash it, water gets inside of it, and you can't get all of it out. Great for growing mold.
- The seat cushion/cover is very padded. I understand maybe having the padding under the butt, but why behind the back? It's not like the child is in there for 8 hours a day. And the padding makes it so you can't machine wash the cover, only wipe it down. However the folds in the corners really trap food and you have to use running water in the sink to wash it. Guess what, it gets waterlogged, because the back of the cushion isn't waterproof.
- The arms of the chair trap dirt where they connect and it's not easy to get food out.

So, yes, if food never touches this chair, then it may be fine, but if you have a kid who actually feeds himself, and you need something that you can EASILY wipe/wash get something else. I'm so frustrated that I'm going to spend more money to get something much simpler that won't store water and rotting food.

product_title: Swaddlebee EcoNappi Aplix One-size Cloth Diaper
review_body: First of all, the customer service is really good. I sent two emails and got quick replies. The shipping was VERY fast, I live overseas and have been waiting for other diapers from another company for almost 3 weeks, it took DDM less than a week! These diapers are great, very soft, trim fitted, great at keeping in messes, they dry fast compared to others, super comfy on my baby. I tried Rumparooz and they make my baby's bottom look huge! These are great, I plan to order more. TOTALLY worth the money!! Thanks DDM!

product_title: Thinksport Sports Bottle- 25 oz.
review_body: So far I have been really impressed with the Thinksport water bottle.  It keeps everything cold for hours and does not \\"sweat\\" like other sports bottles.  My only complaint is that it does not fit in all cup holders.  I wish they made a slimmer model.  Great product.

product_title: Boppy Rock In Comfort Travel Swing (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We purchased this for our newborn son and have used it everday for the last month. I like that it is compact, easy to move from room to room, low to the ground(making me feel safer about putting him in it.), and very sturdy. The colors are adorable and we bought the Boppy Playard in this print as well. We get so many compliments! The swing takes a few seconds to get going, but once it does its good to go. The timer is great! I love that I can set it for 8 min and by the time it turns off he is usually asleep, which saves batteries! We have not had to put new ones in it yet. After reading a few other reviews I worry that the motor might not last. He is 10 lbs and it does seem like its a little bit of a struggle to get moving already. We will have to see, but hopefully it holds up because we love this swing!

product_title: Sassy Car Wash Bath Toy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Not sustained fun, mildew grows in the pump
review_body:
We have had this toy for a long time. It was fun for maybe two months. Then, even though she loves cars, she lost interest.

1) The cars do not slide down the ramp
2) the squeeze car wash is difficult to pump (must wait for it to refill, hard to squeeze)
3) the net is just a wee bit too shallow to hold everything easily
4) the hook is a joke - it does not hook to anything I own, so it sits on the edge and falls over all the time
5) If you cannot get all the water out of the pump, over time expect to have a mildew problem inside (gross!) - there are lots of ways around this for smaller squeeze bath toys but none I know of are practical for this large toy.

I would pass at any price and get something like [[ASIN:B000ZL5UKY Crayola 3ct. TaDoodles Washable Tub Crayons (Dog, Pig, Elephant)]] instead (I am suggesting bath crayons - Ammie is edited them out).

product_title: Boon Squirt Baby Food Dispensing Spoon, Orange (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Wish they had invented this sooner!
review_body: I absolutely LOVE this spoon! It is so much easier to feed him! I have 2 toddlers running around besides my baby (6 mos old)and I LOVE not having a jar and spoon sitting next to me to have to keep an eye on while feeding him.   It's also MUCH cleaner! possibly because there's no food on the UNDER side, like you'd get from dipping in a jar, you can hardly tell he ate after I finish with the Squirt. He's not covered in food.   AND it's a one handed job. I'm a single-working-mom of my 3 babes and just this morning I was fixing bowls of cereal for the 3 yr old and 2 yr old and had the Squirt in one hand, going over to the baby every few min to give him another bite. ONE HANDED OPERATION!! YAAAAY!     I'm only sad that once he graduates to food with chunks, this spoon will be out :(     Wish I had had it for my first 2!

product_title: Evenflo SimpleStep Pressure Gate Taupe (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We purchased this for the bottom of our stairs.  It fits perfectly into the stairwell, and my husband had no problems installing it.  It is very sturdy, and stands up to my son rattling it constantly. It is easy to open and shut with one hand.  My only issues are that my one cat can't fit through, so we have to make sure that the gate is open when we are not home.  Also the little rubber stoppers left marks on the walls.    But I would buy this gate again.

product_title: Stork Craft Aspen 5 Drawer Chest
review_body: This dresser is not very well made. The other day I accidentally chipped the veneer finish with my fingernail. The descriptiom claims it has sturdy cam lock construction and the cam locks fall out all the time no matter how much they are tightened down, making the drawer come apart in the corner. For almost $300 I was expecting something more solid and sturdy. This piece of furniture will most likely only make it through one child. It won't be one of the pieces that can be passed down. The stain is also not the same on all of the front of the drawer panels. Some of the drawers are darker than others. On the good side, it wasn't too complicated to put together, the drawers slide easily and it is nice looking even if it's cheap. And just a warning, even though amazon says it is eligble for free shipping it is not. They consider it an oversized item, so that adds on about another $50 to the price.

product_title: Chicco Caddy Hook On Chair
review_headline: Excellement product, don't believe the bad reviews
review_body: The design and locking system is pretty simple. This chair will fit 99% of the tables. Don't believe the bad reviews, pay close attention at this pictures, the dimensions and you should figure out if it will work for you.

product_title: Summer Infant Deluxe Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this one for my brother's baby because it has worked perfect for our son since he was born.

product_title: DaVinci Rivington 4-in-1 Convertible Crib with Toddler Rail
review_headline: Oak Crib - Beautiful color and quality
review_body: I have to be honest - I was very nervous ordering a crib online that neither my husband nor I had ever seen in person.  The crib we had originally wanted had gone on back order and we needed a replacement before the baby was born. After much searching, we decided to go with this crib in the oak finish and it's beautiful!  It's a very solid, sturdy crib which didn't take my husband long to put together at all.  It matches a very old dresser that we are using as our changing table and I'm very pleased with that.  I was not excited about choosing the oak color at first (I'd much prefer the cherry or white) but since we were trying to match the old dresser, the oak finish was the best choice.  I have to say that I am very pleased with the color, quality, and construction of the crib!  I ordered the crib on a Friday and it was at our door on Wednesday with no shipping damage.

product_title: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver
review_body: I recently purchased the Prince Lionheart seat saver for my granddaughter's car seat, to protects my seats. At first, my son got angry because he though I was more interested in protecting the seats in a new car. But after installing them, which didn't take long at all, he realized that not only did the seat saver fit snug, the baby's safety really did come first.

product_title: Grobag Lollipop Baby Sleeping Bag 2.5 Tog
review_body: We absolutely love our daughter's grobag!  Is is easy to get her in and out of, unlike some other sleep sacs we have used.  The over the shoulder snaps are especially helpful.  It is also the perfect weight for slightly warmer nights.  We are buying another one!

product_title: Baby Einstein Discover and Play Activity Center (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this for my third child and really did some research (like reading reviews) and am very happy with my purchase. Fairly easy to put together and my daughter loves it.

product_title: Skip Hop Studio Diaper Tote Bag
review_body: I've had this bag for 2 weeks now and love it.  This is my second SkipHop bag, and they do not disappoint. It has plenty of pockets, lots of room, and looks great.  I like the insulated bottle/cup holders.  The stroller clips on SkipHop bags are great.

product_title: Graco imonitor Vibe 2 Parent (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Won't hold charge ; beeps constantly.  Terrible!
review_body: We bought this monitor despite some negative feedback here.  I need to ADD to the negative feedback.    As others have posted previously, this monitor does not hold a charge (YES, I followed the directions explicitly and did not use the monitor until it had been in the chargers for well over 16 hrs).    When the charge runs down, the monitor very helpfully tells you that you need to recharge by emitting an extremely annoying beep every 5 seconds or so.  Unless you plan to leave the monitors in the charger bases all the time - in which case, just buy a plug-in model, which is what we ultimately did - DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT.    Jim, New Orleans

product_title: Medela Comfort Maternity Nursing Bra - Black - Extra Large
review_headline: Does the job...with a little help
review_body: I purchased this bra in black for my last trimester, along with a bravado bra, which came in at the same time.  I have to say, while this one is more comfortable, I use the bravado's breast pads with this bra every time I wear it, which is why I took away one star.  One other thing about it is that the washing instructions are o the bra not on a tag, and it's not the easiest thing to read.  But that's peanuts.  All in all, a good bra to use for the last trimester and beyond.

product_title: Sweet Jojo Designs Window Valance - Green Camo Army Military Camouflage
review_body: These valances were ordered for my 5 year old son's room to match the army/camo theme he so desired. They look great and match the bedding we ordered from another manufacturer perfectly. They are quite thin and long but I ordered 2 to make it look fuller on his window. They are a great addition to his new room and well worth they cost!

product_title: KidCo Healthy Snack Frozen Treat Trays
review_body: These are great.  I make apple juice popsicles for my 6 month old son.  He loves it and they are healthy.  I made the popsicles and after they were frozen I ran the bottom under hot water for about 5 seconds and they popped right out.  I put them in a freezer bag and they were good to go.  Great for teething babies.

product_title: Summer Infant Extra Camera for Day & Night Handheld Color Video Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I read some of the reviews that were negative and was concerned that this wouldn't work for us.  But the extra camera works great with our original camera and monitor even though both cameras are in the same room relatively close to each other.  I called Summer before purchasing to confirm this exact model number is made to be used with my original camera and monitor because there are 2 or 3 different models and I wasn't sure they were compatible.  They indicated which model of extra camera I should get to work with my monitor and everything works as expected with no interference.

product_title: Trend Lab Cotton CribWrap Wide Rail Covers for Crib Sides (Set of 2)
review_body: works as designed.  do wish it extended over the corners of the crib.  and definitely wished i would have gotten it before he chewed 2 spots on the crib!

product_title: infantino Auto Mirror (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great Size Mirror for Little One...
review_body: This mirror is the perfect size for the car.  My little guy loves looking at himself and giggling!  It's a good quality and I like that the mirror is adjustable, on snaps so you can move it and change the position of it.  Great mirror for a good price...

product_title: Summer Infant Secure Sounds 2.4 GHz Digital Audio Monitor with 2 Parent Receivers - Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: THE WORST, AFTER DAY ONE WE WERE'NT ABLE TO WEAR THE RECEIVER ON OUR BODY, IT'S GOT TO STAY IN THE RECHARGE CRADLE & BE AS STILL AS STILL IS. RANGE IS TERRIBLE, MORE THAN ONE ROOM IS TO FAR AWAY.  STAY AWAY FROM THIS PRODUCT - I MADE A MISTAKE & TRUSTED THE FACT THAT I'D HAVE NO PROBLEMS,  DESTROYED THE BOX & PAPERWORK IT CAME WITH, THAT'S WHY I DID'NT SEND IT BACK.  NEVER AGAIN.

product_title: Chicco DJ Baby Walker, Splash (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son loves this walker!  It is easy to assemble, folds down flat for storage and the adjustable heights are exactly what we were looking for.  The brakes on the bottom also make it so he is not able to move over the thresholds into another room.  He has a grand time flying around in his walker.

product_title: Munchkin Mozart Magic Cube
review_body: My 22-month-old twins luuuuuuuuuvvv this little Mozart cube (one of them in particular -- he tries to take it everywhere he goes!). Unfortunately there is no button to lower the sound, as there is on many musical toys, but it is Mozart, so it isn't grating to adult ears. This is a terrific toy and I'm sure it's good for my little guys to be listening to world-class music. However, the toy itself is not very durable, in my opinion. We've only had it three weeks, and already the sound has stopped playing (though the lights still light up). My little nephew has one of these cubes as well, and his mom pointed out that although his still works, the plastic cover has cracked, causing them to wrap it in plastic tape so that it would not fall apart. I am buying a second one for my boys because they adore it -- but if this one dies too, that's it. No more cubes at twenty bucks a pop.

product_title: Rainforest Bouncer by Fisher-Price
review_body: La silla es preciosa, a parte se ve muy comoda y tiene cositas muy lindas para distraer al bebè. Me encantò

product_title: Proudbody Pregnancy Belly Cast Kit
review_body: This product was well put together. Was easy to use but would have been better if there was a certain amount of cream the pregnant woman had to put on. Overall great product!

product_title: DISNEY CARS Team McQueen T-Shirt (4T)
review_body: This was another CARS item for my grandson.  The shirt is good quality and fits true to size I think.  It's a fun shirt with 3 great characters on the front.  My grandson really likes the t shirt a lot.

product_title: JJ Cole Original Bundleme Khaki Infant (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The Bundle Me was great for my grandaughter!  It is extremely warm, soft, cuddly & comfortable and it fit perfectly in her car seat.  This is absolutely great for transporting your baby outside on cold winter days.  I would give it an A+ for appearance, comfort, and functionality!  I highly recommend it!

product_title: Bumkins Waterproof Superbib¿ 3-Pack - Unisex
review_body: Don't waste your time buying any other brand of bibs.  I have and wish I hadn't.  These are absolutely the best bibs out there-spend the money.  I have had some over 2 years old and not one of them has ripped or smelled like some do.

product_title: Boppy Noggin Nest Head Support
review_body: This is an ok product. It doesn't provide as much support as I thought it would. I ended up getting rid of this and just used some rolled up receiving blankets. The blankets are approved for car seat use, unlike after market products like this one. I didn't know that at the time I bought it, but after reading about car seat safety, I learned that using after market products can/will void your car seats warranty in the event of a crash.

product_title: Evenflo Summit Pressure Mounted Metal Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Very easy to use.  Installation was super simple and it is constructed very well.  you don't have to screw it into the wall which is nice but it stays in place like you had.

product_title: Chicco Trevi Twin Stroller, Adventure (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I was looking for a stroller for my 20 month old and 1 month old.  I read many reviews and the chicco trevi seemed to fit most of my needs.  It is easy to set-up (take from my husband who can't set-up our pack and plays) same weight as my single large stroller.  fits in the trunk of our honda civic nicely.  Reclines almost all the way and has the boot for my newborn. easy to move my 6 yr old can push and guide it with the 2 babies inside.  the only downside were the canopies did not provide enough shade I live in Hawaii.  Solved that problem with a shade for double strollers which works better than buying the Joovy Groove 2 (if you can find it) because I am able to adjust the shade for more or less coverage.  I would recomend testing out the strollers because everyone has differing needs.

product_title: Boppy Changing Pad Liners, White, 3 Count
review_body: These pad liners do not lay flat and also take a long time to dry.  Buy a waterproof pad instead...they come in different sizes and work well.

product_title: 3-Pack of Snoopy Creepers - Blue - 9-12 Mths
review_body: My daughter chose a Snoopy theme for her son's nursery before he was born.  In keeping with that theme, I ordered several Snoopy items.  Although my grandson has not yet grown into these, I must say that I am very pleased with the quality and the softness.  I'm sure he will be very comfortable in them.

product_title: Sophistication Round Crib Bedding
review_body: I just love this bedding. It's a stunning set. It was a pleasure dealing with aBaby.

product_title: Grobag Egg Digital Room Thermometer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We bought this to use in a whelping pen (for puppies), as the temperature must be maintained at a particular level for the first few weeks. The \\"egg's\\" readout is visible from across the room, and the color coding is helpful.

product_title: Cloud b Sound Machine Soother
review_body: I love the Sleep Sheep.  My son liked the ocean sound the best.  The only thing I think I would add to this wonderful product is a remote or a longer timer.  As a tired mom I had to get up and reset the sound if he woke up.  It is a great product and that would just make it perfect.

product_title: Safety 1st Kirby Inflatable Tub
review_body: I bought this tub to replace our hard plastic infant tub, and it is perfect.  The size is just right for our 8-month old baby, and she likes the soft sides and bottom of this tub much better than the old, hard tub.  It only take a little bit of water in the bottom of this tub to give her a bath - quick and easy.

product_title: Evenflo Aura Select Travel System, Georgia Stripe (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this travel system!! It is very cute and easy to put together. I'm 34 weeks pregnant and was able to do it in less then 20 minutes once I got it out the box. I can't wait to use it once my baby arrives. I'll leave another review once my baby is here.

product_title: Summer Infant Mother's Touch Large Comfort Bather
review_body: We love this bather! My son HATED his first baths until we started using this after his cord fell off.  Now bath time is comfortable, relaxing, and he loves lounging in the sling.  I Love that it has an adjustable incline, he doesn't slip in it, it has head support for those first few months, and it folds up to be put away (a very good thing since we live in a small studio apartment.)  It is also so easy to just fill up our tub and drain it when we are done.  Someone mentioned that it can tip over backwards. This will only begin to happen if you start to place your child in the bather way up towards the top.  Don't place your child's bottom up by the headrest and you'll be fine!  I think this is a very secure and safe bather.

product_title: Boon Flo Water Deflector and Protective Faucet Cover with Bubble Bath Dispenser
review_body: I was expecting something soft and rubbery which would help protect baby's head if he falls in the bath.  But this is hard plastic.  I couldn't figure out how it would really protect from anything.  I guess it would help if you have your kids lean back to rinse their hair, this would allow them to sit further away from the faucet because of the waterfall spout.  Also, although it's handy that the diverter is still functional, it's also a bit hazard sticking up that could hurt in a fall.  I thought the protector came up higher around the diverter so that if you hit it, the head would stop at the protector and not reach the diverter.  But that is not the case.    I think it works as they intended; it fits our faucet, and the waterfall effect is sort of neat.  Didn't try the bubble dispenser, that seems like more trouble than its worth.    Just not what I was expecting, and doesn't work for us to provide the bath safety I was looking for.

product_title: Medela Swing Breast Pump
review_body: I really thought this was a wonderful pump for stay at home mom's. I'm not sure how great it would be if you were exclusively pumping during the day while working, but for my periodic uses, I loved it.  I usually used it on electric power, since I thought it ate through batteries pretty quickly, but when I did need to use it on battery power (like in the car) it worked well too. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because I felt like it did not have quite as powerful of a suction on battery, but since I was usually plugged in, that wasn't an issue for me.  I did use it while on vacation without my child for 5 days, pumping at least 6 times per day, including two 8 hour car trips, and it worked great!

product_title: Philips AVENT iQ24 Sterilizer with 2 Bottles, 9 Ounce (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Product works as great as is advertised.  Easy to set up and simple to use.  I like the feature that allows you to leave bottles in the unit and keeps them sterile for hours.

product_title: Fisher-Price Potty On-the-Go (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this product! It goes with us everywhere and is extremely handy to use. It is very portable and the size is not too much of an inconvenience. The only problem we had with it is that our son is a little too short to sit on it without his little boy parts scraping on the pee-guard, but this will be remedied with time. We do not have any problems with the opening being too small. I would recommend this to a friend.

product_title: Evenflo Expansion Swing Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: as allways so far never a problem when ordering from amazon! super saver said 6-10 day's was here in 3day's wow! in pefrect condition cant ask for more. average price per piece save me on sale's tax@ 7% wish amazon could nock the prices down alittle since there so big then i would buy everything from them. oh my gates are used for 4 dog's none over 20lbs they work great my jack russell stop chewing everything so they will last. if you have kids !!watch!! there arm's and fingers with these gate's

product_title: Bummis Super Brite Diaper Cover
review_body: For the most part, I use AIO diapers, but occassionally a diaper cover comes in handy, especially for a few WAHM made diapers I have that do not include a waterproof layer. I love these diaper covers! I technically have the pink and the green, not the blue - but color doesn't affect the funtion.

product_title: Graco High Back TurboBooster Car Seat, Taila (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: won't work in the middle seat
review_body: The information on this seat says the safest position is in the middle of the back seat. We only have one child and want her in the middles for safety and so she can see more. We own a Toyota Camry (#1 car sold in the US for a long time...) It would not fit in the middle. It wobbled around. If you have any kind of hump or raise in the middle seat it won't work. I would have returned it, but we had friends in town with an older child and use it on the side. We keep it for a back-up or for friends, but its just not safe in the middle. We are going to buy a latch system seat that will fit in the middle. Until then, we still have her in her 5 point restraint Britax which fits for now...  Otherwise, we liked the colors and materials. My daughter loved the cup holders.

product_title: Britax Regent Youth Car Seat
review_body: The Regent is a big seat, and a little heavy when you are lifting it to install, but once you get it in your car, it is good and sturdy! The seat cover is fairly easy to remove and wash, and the whole seat is pretty simple to take apart if you have to clean it thoroughly, which is a huge plus if you have a vomiting kid or one prone to diaper blowouts! The biggest plus of all is the fact that the 5 point harness can be used all the way up to 80 lbs (!) so if you have a special needs child, like I do, that needs the harness a lot longer than usual, the Regent is for you! I think my petite daughter will be able to fit in this seat until she is 18! Also, I can fit two of these in my Toyota Prius back seat just fine, although I try not to take them out very often since they are so big and a little cumbersome to move around. I just leave them where they are and they do a terrific job! This seat is worth every penny!

product_title: Tiny Love Clip & Go Musical Mobile
review_headline: Our baby seems to love it
review_body: My infant son started to notice this mobile around 8 weeks of age.  We keep it on his car seat and every time he's in it, he stares at the mobile fascinated for a good 15 minutes or so until he falls asleep.  So far, we've only used the black & white images but I will be changing it up soon.  I haven't used the clip because the mobile hangs too low in the car seat (and is too heavy) when I do but the velcro works just fine and keeps it secure even in the car.  We also don't use the music option but we don't on any mobiles or toys as we just play music for him separately.  Overall we're very happy with this purchase!

product_title: Baby Jogger City Mini Single Stroller
review_body: I've finally used this stroller and overall I'm happy with it.  Pros: great handling, smooth ride, compact, amazing one handed folding mechanism, lightweight, good for city dwellers, huge cover that actually keeps sun out of baby's eyes, modest price.    Cons: THIS IS IMPORTANT: when baby is fully reclined this stroller is very easy to tip backwards.  Please be extra cautious when going up a step or a steep incline.  Also, keep in mind older siblings like to pull or hang from the handle bars and could easily tip the whole stroller over.  And don't hang bags from the handle bars.  While the seat does fully recline, the mechanism is a real pain.  You have to depress the spring clasp and move it along a nylon cord while keeping baby steady in the position you want her in--this means you have to put on the brake and support baby with your shoulder or knee until you can move the clasp to desired position.  Lastly, the basket is small and you can't access it when baby is reclined.        I can't really comment on how great the stroller is as I haven't used it yet--baby due in a few weeks.  I can comment on the customer service.  I purchased stroller at local store and it came all assembled in box.  There was a small snag/run in the fabric seat so I called the store.  They had me call Baby Jogger directly.  I told them the issue and they sent me out a brand new seat which arrived just a few short days later--no other questions asked.  Seems like great customer service to me.

product_title: Nuby No-Spill Flip-It Cup, 12 Ounce, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Kids love, but it is hard to assemble and flicks water
review_body: I would give this product a 3-star, but my kids seem to like it more than I do ;)    My twins love these cups in addition to \\"Munchkin Mighty Grip 10 oz Flip Straw Cup\\".  They drink a ton of water.    The one advantage this cup has over the Munchkin cup is that it is easier for the kids to suck.    Generally, this cup does not leak, unless the straw is still out and there is some pressure on the straw (to allow the liquid to come out).  Munchkin is better in this department.    When you flip the flippy-lid open or close, it will flick water on you or what is nearby.  Be sure to aim it away from you.    I like the Munchkin cups better, but my kids seem to drink maybe a little more water when they use this cup.    This cup is BPA-free...I'm not sure about Munchkin.    The straw is soft - and my kids love to chew on the straw if they aren't actively drinking.  We've only been using this for about 2 weeks, but the straw seems to hold up ok.    I'm likely to buy this cup again.    update: I wanted to note that the straw requires the child to bite down or put pressure in order to open the straw for flow.  However, I have found the my kids do this even on regular straws...and they end up biting them closed and getting frustrated.  So, I'm not a fan of this straw.  Also, if your kids like to chew, it is easy to tear the middle portion of the straw that keeps it from spilling.  Argh!

product_title: Combi Helio DX Lightweight Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My husband and I are about to be first-time parents, so I can't comment on having another stroller because I've only tried them out in stores.  The ones you see in retail stores are so bulky and incredibly heavy.  My husband wanted something lightweight while I still wanted something cute and trendy.  When this arrived last week, it was a cinch to put together.  I recommend reading the instructions just because if you don't, you won't know what all the features really are for.  I'm only 5'2\\" and not very strong.  This stroller was super easy for me to fold up and even easier to unfold.  My mother and grandmother were present when we opened it, and it was so lightweight and easy for them to use, also.  We purchased the apricot color and the matching Combi Shuttle car seat.  They look beautiful together and work flawlessly.  We haven't had the chance to put the baby in it yet, since she won't be born until July, but we're so pleased with it thus far.  I wouldn't waste my time and energy on those big bulky heavy strollers.

product_title: Travelmate
review_body: We purchased this item a year ago for a trip to South Africa.  It worked great for us since we were taking the seat on the plane.  But the big thing for us was at security having to take it off to go through the scanner was a big pain.  The other issue we had was when we had to make a connection, having to stop to put it back together before running across the airport was not ideal.  The only time my daughter sat in it was on the way home standing in line to check-in, which we ended up checking the whole thing on the way home since she never sat in the carseat on the plane either.      We did get a lot of questions about it, and my husband did feel bad for all those dads we saw carrying carseats through the airport.  But in the long run we decided it was not needed for our travels since our daughter perfers to sit in the seat.  Ended up selling it on Ebay!

product_title: Evenflo ABC SmartSteps ExerSaucer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I put my daughter in it when she turned 5 months.  She immediately started to play all of the toys.  She's at the stage where she likes to try to stand, and this exersaucer allows her to do that while not putting too much strain on her legs.

product_title: Delta Children's Products Lauren Armoire
review_body: I bought this as an entertainment center.  We left out the pole to hang clothes.  Its perfect, the drawers are perfect for DVD's and VCR tapes and cabinets quality is good, although just a bit wabbly.  I was very happy with the price I paid for real wood instead of particle board.  Can't beat this armoir I was very happy with my purchase!

product_title: Foogo By Thermos Leak-Proof SS 12 oz - Straw Bottle, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: This has a major flaw for kids!  The flip lid breaks easily!
review_body: We have had three of these.  Two of them have had their flip lids snapped and cracked when my son or daughter dropped them--and kids drop things!  The lid is just a very brittle plastic and with a hinge that makes it very vulnerable in a fall.  I've temporarily fixed them with superglue but it eventually cracks again.  While thermos makes great adult products, a heavy stainless steel can is a lot for a kid.  So otherwise its a beautiful mug, but gets very expensive as it breaks and drops.  Thermos need to modify this and avoid a design with this brittle flip lid.

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Very comfortable and useful chair. I use it for two month. It has three position for back that allowed to use it from 4 month age. Very safety. Ease to clean with wet wipes. Great toy that you can remove if necessary.

product_title: Easy-Cling Sunshade - 2pk
review_headline: Only safe type of sun shade!
review_body: These cling sun shades are the only truly safe type to use.  The roll down type will probably come off the window in a crash and be a projectile, and could seriously injure your child!  Pick one up sometime, they're heavy!  I was told that the test for using something like this in the car is \\"throw it at your husband, see if it hurts, and if it does, don't use it!\\"  *grin*  This one is the safe way to keep the sun out of your precious baby's eyes!

product_title: Batman Logo Web Belt (Black/silver)
review_body: very comfortable, fitting product.  one size fits all, or at least most.  very cool etchings of the bat symbol.

product_title: Swing Seat Ikarus
review_headline: Great swing if you bring it in in the winter
review_body: We put this on our outdoor swingset and the kids (and me) love it!  It doesn't get hot when the sun is beating down outside like the plastic seats do.  Unfortunately, it deteriorated and broke while my daugter was swinging...bring it in during the winter months and maybe it will last longer.

product_title: Fisher-Price Dance Baby Dancin Band
review_headline: great for children with dwarfism, or vision problems.
review_body: This toy is a big hit in my home!    It was purchased for my daughter that has a rare form of dwarfism and the height was perfect for her! Also it has two volume settings which helped with her hearing issues. The toy is also very bright and lights up for any vision concerns. Overall this is a great toy for a child develomentally delayed or for those right where they should be. Even my three year old played with it regularly. Also, my children stopped the monkey countless times from spinning and it still works in perfect condition.

product_title: Inflatable Bathtub Alphabet Inflatable Bathtub Liner (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Don't waste your time with this product. The design in inherently flawed. The buoyancy provided by the water in the tub provides enough force to overcome the suction cups. In addition if your toddler decides to grab it, it may give way and cause your toddler to slip and potentially hit thier head. Amazon should remove this product from their website!

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Deluxe Auto Mirror with Music
review_body: My mother-in-law purchased this on a whim while shopping together; I was just going to buy the basic mirror.  It's fun, very easy to install and offers a very nice view of the baby.  If your remember to leave the remote in the car and say, not inside the house, the music does offer a brief distraction.  Great for those moments when you're almost home and you've tried everything to soothe the \\"little screamer\\" ;)

product_title: Kelgar Baby Stroller Pinwheel Fan
review_body: Fan does not put out a ton of air, but it helps for air flow circulation.

product_title: Bebe Au Lait Nursing Cover
review_headline: I wish they had these when I was nursing my babies!
review_body: I'm the mom of 3 daughters, who are in their 20's.  There wasn't anything like this when I was breastfeeding my girls - I wish there was!      I have an 8-month old granddaughter, and this product has been just GREAT for my daughter. It has allowed her to nurse the baby anywhere without worrying about the baby getting hot from being under a blanket, or the baby tossing the blanket aside, as they do at this age!  Another great feature is that this nursing cover is made so that you can \\"see what you're doing\\", which is especially important when you're a new mom.  You can also maintain that precious eye-contact while feeding the baby.      My daughter got this as a gift from a friend who is also a nursing mom, and it's one of the most useful gifts she received!  This item is perfect for a baby shower gift!

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Melodies and Lights Deluxe Gym
review_body: I bought this for my grandson and he love's it!  He talks to all the animals and love to grab them.  This gym is very well made and worth every penny!

product_title: Levana BABYVIEW20 Interference Free Digital Wireless Video Baby Monitor with Night Light Lullaby Camera
review_body: This is by far the best purchase i have made! I bought this monitor when my baby was 6 months old, and my only regret is not buying it sooner! My husband and I could never get my son to sleep through the night because at his first peep we would have to go in his room to check on him and we would awaken him by opening his door. When I got this product I was able to check on him without going into his room. I was able to see that he was just whining with his eyes closed and would fall right back to sleep himself! Now we all get the rest we need! I highly reccomend this product for any parent!

product_title: Potty Time Potty Watch - Blue
review_body: This product is a great idea. But it really needs some work. It worked for about 10 minutes and hasnt turned on since.

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon Cool It Soother Teether, Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Safer teether and baby loves it
review_body: Vulli has some great products, and this soother teether is one of our favorites.  The liquid in the clear circle freezes so it soothes her teeth.  She likes to gnaw and it and loves to grab him and bang him against just about anything.  Every time she sees the toy, she lights up.  It got us through 6 teeth coming in in one day, so \\"Mr Frog\\" is our hero in this house.  This, unlike some of the other teethers like sofie and pie, etc., is not rubber - it's a hard (safe) plastic.  The keys by Vulli are made of the same thing.

product_title: Combi Dakota Backless Booster Seat Pewter (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Purchased this for my husbands new car after discovering that the original seat we had did not fit properly.  We had a Turbo booster (graco) that quite honestly did not fit all that great in our old car (Honda Accord) but was terrible in the new car (Infiniti).  The Combi fits perfect in the seats.  It is actually recommended by the manufacturer which we found out after the fact.  It is not as square and boxy so it fits better into a \\"bucket\\" style seat.  We don't have these issues with our mini van because the seats are more square and flat in the back.  It does work nicely in our van too, FYI.

product_title: The Nesting Pillow - Organic Nursing Pillow with Washable Slip Cover
review_body: I used the Blessed Nest organic nursing pillow when helping my brother with his new born twins.  The way the pillow adjusted to support the babies was perfect. My brother and his wife also had a Boppy but it did not have the flexibility to adjust to the babies position.  I found the Boppy very awkward and I would make sure I had the Blessed Nest to use when it was my turn to feed one of the babies.  I HIGHLY recommend this product.  (Note: it also comes in several other organic fabric options which you can find at [...].)

product_title: Gerber GentleFlow Bottles - 9oz. 3pk
review_headline: Tried alot after BPA issue came to light.. these are best
review_body: My girl is 6 months old now. We have been using Avent. Those worked best for her gas. Then her doc let me know about BPA, so i tried Drop ins. Those are a mess, a hassle and she kept puking! then i tried NUK, after a day, found they are BPA containing also! i hated switching her after so long. Then i came across these in walgreens. says like avent. gave it a shot! works like avent for her and alot cheaper! and bpa free!! YAY!! also, they are better than avent for the reason that they don't leak, my avents leaked.

product_title: Nuk Orthodontic Bottle 5 oz - boy colors
review_headline: Great bottle at a great price!
review_body: This bottle worked well for my son who is also nursing. It didn't flow to fast and was easy to clean because of the wide neck. The parts are also made of very sturdy plastic.

product_title: Strawberry Shortcake Socks Size 6
review_body: I bought these for my daughter at Target in the dollar section. Do not by these over priced socks!

product_title: Adiri BPA Free Natural Nurser Ultimate Bottle Stage 1 White, Slow Flow (0-3 months) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Worked great for my lil' boob lover.
review_body: This bottle is great.    We were using Avent originally, which my daughter was fine with, but I wanted something BPA free.  Not crazy about glass.  Adiri looked intriguing.    My daughter is breastfed, and I think she just prefers a slower flow, so we bought the clear stage 1 and at 9.5 months she still uses this one happily.      I always pump and put my milk into bags while at work so my partner warms the milk in the bag, and pours into the bottle.  I don't see this as a huge pain, it is easier & quicker to warm the milk in the bag than in the bottle itself (the plastic is thicker in avent & other bottles so it takes longer to heat the milk).      If your bottle leaks either the cap & the bottle are not tight enough, or the petal/air flow cap is not completely dry.  You just have to make sure it is dry and the caps are on tight.  Somewhat of a pain to explain to new people...like grandparents visiting from out of town who then accidentally spill a couple ounces of your liquid gold..haha.    Overall a great bottle.  And on a side note my friend's daughter refused numerous types of bottles until the adiri...    <3 Adiri

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon Soft Natural Rubber Teether - Comes In Gift Boxes
review_body: I bought this for my son who sticks everything in his mouth.  He likes it well enough, but isn't really interested in the knob on top.  It's just not long enough to really let him chew on it.  He somehow manages to chew on the underside of the head, which makes the toy squeak.  It used to drive our dog mad, but she's learned that the baby's toys are the baby's toys.  (Plus, we don't let him touch hers.)  All around it's a good teether and easy for him to hold.

product_title: Tiny Love Double-Sided First Book
review_body: Our baby girl loves this so much (especially the Zebra) we've just purchased another for friends with a newborn boy.    Highly recommended.

product_title: American Baby Company 100% Cotton Percale Fitted Portable/Mini Crib Sheet
review_body: Very dissapointed - shrunk so much that when you put it on it buckles the mattress - I had to quit using it after 1 use.

product_title: Summer Infant Sweet Dreams Full Sized Playard (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased this playard to go along with the matching set of everything else....comforter... lamps... swings.... bouncer.... high chair etc.  It so beautiful.  I would agree that this is not the traditional PINK that everything seems to be made of for little girls.  Its actually more of a mauve pink.  That was the first thing that caught my eye.  Assembly can be challenging.  It took me about 35 minutes to figure it out.  After setting it up completely...( and hearing the wood support in the bottom of the changer crack) with the changer attatched and the infant toy bar.... I noticed that there was NO room to put baby in.  Please look at the photo.  That is exactly how this will look! The chager is so big that it would actually be on TOP of baby if you attempt to put the baby in while it is attached. Since, I already have a changer for my twins... I don't need this one... So I took it off.  Its much better without the changer and much more useable.  We have twins and I used this as a bassinet for both of them when we brought them home. It works just fine.  Our babies are small, so they each have tons of room.  In my overall opinion, it is a good product, and does match an entire set!  Unlike some of the competitors... but I would like to see more quality... and more thought that goes into a product that will not only make it appealing to the eye, but useable!  Most pack and plays do come with a changer... but I noticed that their changers are slightly off to the right of the bassinet and not directly over it....Hmmm.. Now I see why!

product_title: Chicco Caddy Hook On Chair
review_body: I really like this chair. The best feature is that it can be folded down and travels very well. When we travel to visit friends and family, I can actually fit this in my suitcase and pull it out wherever we are. In my experience, this is a better choice than the other comparable products offered on amazon (and better priced). I have friends who own others that have trouble fitting on some tables. So far, I have not encountered a table this will not fit. And the fabric seat is removable and machine washable!

product_title: Arm's Reach Mini Co-Sleeper Bassinet - Natural
review_body: I love this co-sleeper because I have a one-bedroom apartment and I prefer bedsharing to a crib.  The co-sleeper is great for my daughter to sleep or rest in.  She's always close by because I can wheel it around the apartment.  and it has tons of storage, which is also a huge help.  It's extremely portable and fits into a small bag.  It's easy to assemble and take apart.  And it has excellent safety features.  I'm going to keep this stored in the closet to use with any more new babies we have.

product_title: BuggyBagg Shopping Cart Cover - Single
review_body: I researched these quite a bit and am very happy with my final decision.  The primary colors in the stripe work great for my daughter and would also be just fine for any future little boy that may come along.  Very high quality product worth the extra $$.

product_title: BuggyBagg Shopping Cart Cover - Single Pattern: Jungle
review_body: This is a fantastic product. It covers EVERYTHING - I just got it and took it with me the very next day. I used it in 2 restaurant high chairs. You don't have to worry about anything gross on the high chair or taking the time to wipe everything off. It is so easy to put on and take off - very quick. LOVE IT!!

product_title: Tripp Trapp Cushion - Art Stripes
review_headline: Tripp Trap Seat Cushion and Baby Rail
review_body: The cushion is attractive, easy to install, and WASHABLE!  Many Thanks, A happy Grandma

product_title: Trend Lab Cotton CribWrap Wide Rail Covers for Crib Sides (Set of 2)
review_body: I purchased this right before the teeth came and I am glad I did.  My 10 month old is constantly biting on these.  I purchased enough for all three sides of the crib and I suggest you do the same because she is all over the crib, not just on the front.  Solid purchase...also helpful for head banging since it is lightly padded.

product_title: Tiddliwinks Safari Fitted Crib Sheet
review_body: We received this sheet as a gift for our first baby and we like it more than the the sheets that match our room theme and so does our 20 month old son.  It doesn't really clash with many themes, it's gender neutral, very cute and kids love the animal prints.  It has been washed many times and remains in good unfaded condition and doesn't stay wrinkly like lesser quality sheets would.  It's a great alternate for a baby boy and we plan on keeping them for our girl too.

product_title: Munchkin Car Bottle Warmer
review_headline: Cannot be used with Playtex Nurser Bottles
review_body: I was very disappointed to get this product and find out that it cannot be used with Playtex Nurser bottles.

product_title: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_body: fast delivery.  My granddaughter loves it.  It is soft and she loves to see the star constellations.  Great bedtime toy and nightlight.

product_title: Mommy's Helper Tub Water Temps Temp-Sensing Bath Tub Applique (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I am on amazon right now looking for a replacement- I put these on the bathtub (following all directions) 4 days ago- they are stickers!  They peel right off when the water starts filling up.  My 9 month old made quick work of them.  I think the temperature changing duck is a good idea- but not reliable- in testing it out (without kiddo in the tub)- if the tub is warm (or hot) and it's red to indicate too hot, and you put your fingers under a cold or cool stream of water, and touch the duck, it will turn blue again.  Also, if it's too hot in the tub and you stream in cold/cool water, it takes forever to change the sensor- even if the bath has turned cool.    I'm looking for suction cup non slip frogs like a friend has.  I do not recommend this product- my $5 just went in the trash!

product_title: Nature Babycare Eco-friendly, Chlorine Free Diapers, Size 4 (22-37 Lbs), 120 Diapers
review_body: I think these diapers are fabulous! I think these are wonderful and make me feel much better about what I am doing to the earth.  I read that in a average year a child goes through half a ton of diapers and we all know that they are not going to be reabsorbed into the earth in our lifetime.  Cloth is for people way more dedicated to the cause (and less squimish) than me.  Buy them when you can they go fast especially in the bigger sizes.  Wish they made them as a pull up as well.

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis Manual Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Better than Electric for my Bottle-fed Premie
review_body: My baby boy was born 10 weeks preterm, and since he could not yet feed on his own I needed to pump, so he could get fed through a tube at first and later get fed by bottle until he was big and strong enough to breastfeed.    At first I followed all the advice from the lactation nurse, pamphlets from the hospital, and what I found online:    1.) pump with a hospital grade electric pump  2.) pump 8-12 times a day.    I was told that it shouldn't hurt and that my milk supply would be high if I followed these directions.  In my case the advice was wrong, it did hurt and I was very frustrated about getting only 20 oz after six weeks.  I used a Medela Symphony at $70/month rental until a few weeks after my son was home.  It took me more than 20 minutes just to get 2 oz out (8-9 times a day).    The pump was clunky, heavy, and uncomfortable for me.  Power cords and tubing were difficult to deal with as well.      After a couple of friends said they liked the Avent pump, I decided to give it a try.  For me it worked just as well as the electric pumps.  I experienced less discomfort, and it is easier to carry around.  It made no difference to my supply.    There are a few problems I've had with it though.  I find it rather squeeky.  The box says it is quiet, but it's not.  Plan on spilling if it is dropped.  I'm not sure why but the pump does not quite screw tightly to the bottles.  Finally, one of the pieces is a little white disk which is hard to find at stores.  It can be easily lost and I found that if I pump too hard it will get out of place and the pump is then useless. Also, since it can't be hands free you can't easily hold the baby while pumping.    If you are in a situation where you need to feed your baby by bottle exclusively for a period of time, I would recommending renting a hospital grade electric pump first since that's what is generally recommended, but if you find it's not working well, I would definitely recommend the Advent pump.     If you just need topump occasionally, I would still recommend trying this before spending $300 on an electric pump.      Good Luck.

product_title: American Baby Company 100% Cotton Value Jersey Knit Porta-Crib Sheet
review_body: This sheet fits my Graco pack n play well and feels soft and cozy against the skin.  I was initially concerned about previous reviews that these sheets would be \\"too thin\\" but I also purchased a quilted mattress pad/protector and they are great together.  It is holding up so far in the wash, so the quality seems good.  Given the choice, I would definitely purchase these over the Graco pack n play sheets which feel rougher and not as soft.  About the color, it is a little more \\"minty green\\" than sage despite the picture. Overall, I think it is a good product and would buy again.

product_title: Munchkin Mozart Magic Cube
review_headline: cool for parents, too advanced for kids
review_body: This is a totally cool product...for the parents.  By the time the small child this is designed for could possibly appreciate what the toy teaches, he/she would be at least 5-10 years old and by then, the toy still requires patience.  This is just a good idea that can't quite reach the audience it hopes too.  I still like the toy, but sadly, it's just not for babies. (And I'm a musician with a broad mind for what my little one can understand---this is just too advanced.)[[ASIN:B00004TFLB Munchkin Mozart Magic Cube]]

product_title: Lamaze Play and Grow Kerry the Fairy Take Along Toy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My wife and I bought Kerry the Fairy for our 9 week old daughter and she loves it. She is just beginning to reach for things and the doll has crinkly textures that really engage our baby. We also have \\"Celeste\\" and \\"Princess Sophie\\", however our baby seems to prefer Kerry the Fairy. I believe this is due to her colors - with red hair, it is one of the first things a baby can see very well, once they develop beyond black and white. The rings and clips on Kerry the Fairy and the other Lamaze toys seem extremely durable, and we hang the doll from the top of the stroller, on the diaper bag, on the rail of the co-sleeper, and along our bed foot board, allowing us  position Kerry the Fairy in many places. Our daughter seems to like her enough to vocalize \\"talking\\" to her and the doll keeps our baby's attention for hours!

product_title: Skip Hop Tubby Bath Toy Organizer, Blue
review_headline: We love this bath toy organizer!
review_body:
This is a great bath toy organizer. It is the first and only one I have purchased after reading several reviews. It sticks perfectly on the tub and has been up for at least 2 months with no problems. It fit all my son's toys easily with room for more. I like that it is easily washable and can be taken off the wall with the little plastic hooks. It seems very sturdy and would probably hold a lot more weight if we had heavier toys. A great buy!

***************Update- 2 years later******************

We've been using this for 2 years now. It has never fallen off the wall! We have used it in 3 different tubs. The longest we have left it on is probably 1 year. I have washed it in the washing machine a couple of times, just to make sure it is not getting gross. It held up just fine in the washer. (I did not put it in the dryer, though!)

It still holds tons of toys and it keeps things looking neat and tidy. I still think it was a great buy!

product_title: Lowercase 36 Sq. Ft. 'We Sell Mats' Alphabet and Number Floor Puzzle-Each Tile 12"x12"x3/8" Thick with Borders
review_body: My son loves this mat.  It is very colorfull and stays together pretty well.  I only give it 4 stars because I wish it was a little softer then what it is.  Other then that it is a good play mat.

product_title: Playtex VentAire Standard Bottles, 3 Pack
review_body: Used these for my first grandson and now for 2 more coming next month.  These were easy to clean and never had trouble with the baby sucking to much air.

product_title: Thermos Foogo Leak-Proof SS 7 Ounce Sippy Cup with Handles, Blue, 6 Months (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Slight leaking after a few uses
review_body: These cups are not bad, but I have noticed slight dripping.  We have used our Foogos about 5 times, so the quality is not what I had hoped for in a cup that cost $15.  My son likes these cups and took to them quite quickly, the handles really help him to use it himself.  The drip is not bad, the cup is still functional, but it is a disappointment, I thought I had found a great non-plastic cup, but I will continue searching...

product_title: Graco IPO Stroller in Soho (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this stroller. It is durable and DOESN\\"T hurt your back when pushing. I use this at stores and also for our daily walks. This strolled has been everywhere and has given us NO problems!

product_title: BOB Revolution Duallie Stroller
review_body: I have twins and this stroller is the double stroller category killer.   I have had my children in this since they were 8wks old and it goes everywhere with us.  In the end, I was so happy with my BOB that I didn't even bother to get another double stroller.  Quite a statement from a mom of twins--most of my peers have at least 2-3 strollers.     It is made to fit through most single doors (i.e. front doors of shops and homes) so I am independent when out and about.  It folds very easily and although a little heavy is well worth the extra heist for the sturdiness and maneuverability.  My only wish is that it was set up to take 2 infant car seat adapters as that would have been a nice option in the beginning with twins.      We have the handlebar console and the strap-on IronMan bag as well both of which I'd highly recommend.    Save your time and money and buy only one double stroller--this one.

product_title: BABYBJORN Potty Chair
review_body: Thanks to this potty, my son no longer looks like a gorilla sitting on a donut (husband's words)!!! I love that I don't have to keep telling him to \\"point it down\\" anymore because of the design. He sits very comfortable on it despite the fact that he's only 2, and the size of a 3 1/2 year old. The best thing is...it's super easy to clean!!!

product_title: Chicco C6 Stroller
review_headline: Chico umbrella stroller just what we wanted.
review_body: This is for my grandson and it fit his and my daughter's needs perfectly.  The tangerine was a perfect color choice for a boy.  The stroller is easy to handle and fold and so far it is very sturdy.

product_title: Insulated Bottle Bag
review_body: Haven't used this product yet, as my 2nd little boy isn't due for about 13 more weeks, but I'm hoping it works well.  Looks roomy enough for several bottles or a combo of bottles & food with some extra pockets for little stuff.  Seems well made, just hoping it's not like some of my diaper bags that have worn out in only a few months time (not this brand).

product_title: Momo Baby 8oz Glass Feeding Bottle 3-Pack Green
review_headline: Momo used as substitute for Dr. Brown glass bottle
review_body: I am only reviewing this as a substitude for the Dr. Brown bottle, not how the bottle itself works.   Purchase this because I cannot buy any Dr. Brown bottles.  It is serving that purpose but it is not ideal.  Here is what I learned.  The length of the bottle is too short for the Dr. Brown tube.  So if used as is will push up against the holder for the nipple and cause it to pop out, leaking milk from the sides.  I bypassed this by slightly tilting the tube so that it goes on an angle into the bottle, giving enough clearance so that the holder does not pop.  Still need to be careful if over tighter the holder, the thing will still pop out, but not due to the tube but becuase of the spiral groves which is slightly different between this bottle and the Dr. Brown.  As one of the previous reviewer said, the measurement ticks are off.  It looks like for 6oz of liquid, the bottle will show 6.5oz.  So it is ~ .1 oz less per tick.  Used dishwasher and rapid bottle heaters with this bottle and after 1 month of daily washing an heating, no bottle breaks.

product_title: Philips AVENT BPA Free Infant Bottle Starter Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I've used Avent before with my daughter and liked it so I ordered some for my newborn. I'm kinda disappointed with the bottles - they leak! But I liked the price I got it for.

product_title: Protect-a-Bub Compact Sunshade - Single - Brown (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This definitely is a great extension to the practically useless sunshade that comes with any umbrella stroller. We have the MaClaren Quest Sport and this is a perfect match. It provides plenty of shade for our baby. It is key to understand that if your stroller does not already have a sunshade, this product is not for you simply because it must sit on top of an existing sunshade in order to stay up.  My only complaints are (1) that it doesn't really adjust although you can kind of pull it up like a sleeve on a shirt if you wanted to see your baby more and (2) you have to tie it onto the stroller whenever you want to use it. Velcro would've been a better solution, IMO.  Overall, it's a great product and does exactly as it describes... i.e. provides more shade for your baby.

product_title: DELUXE PET NET STUFFED ANIMAL TOY ORGANIZER HAMMOCK
review_body: Works great!  Now all the stuffed animals have a place to stay so my daughter will use HER bed!!  Don't put them up too high though... you'll be in there all night getting this one and that one...

I should have listened, the insults are just mean and uncalled for.  They aren't fun.  I had to put \\"for emergency use only\\" on the package for the christmas gift. product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Kick and Play
review_body: This has been a great play mat for my daughter. She esp. loves the mirror.

review_body: I was nervous about getting this because there were only 10 reviews that seemed to be evenly split between working great and having problems. However, since it was a known brand and digital (I really didn't like the idea of unsecured images of my infant being broadcast) I thought I'd give it a shot.
