product_title: The Heavenly Stroller
review_body: We are tall parents--my husband is 6'7\\" and I am 5'8\\" and all the umbrella strollers I tried were horrible.  I had to slouch to push them and my husband couldn't push them at all.  This one solved the issue.  It is very basic, just has a little pocket, but it does the job on short outings.  It fits well in my trunk and is very lightweight.  Best of all, my husband gets to push the stroller without bending over.

product_title: Daphne Bath Seat
review_body: I wouldnt even invest in another seat. Worked amazing, no problems, no slippage. Im giving MOST of my baby stuff away, BUT Im saving this one for my next baby.

product_title: Luna Lullaby Dream Full Body Pillow
review_body: I ordered this for my new grandchild. It was perfect. The customer service and delivery were hassle free.

product_title: Cloud B Twilight Turtle
review_headline: Great toddler stay in be tool!
review_body: Very cute and functional night light.  This was a wonderful tool for transitioning our twin toddlers from their cribs to their toddler beds. After tucking them in, we'd give them each a turtle light.  They were fascinated and played with them in bed until falling asleep.  It is also nice to know that they each have a light that they can control should they need one during the night.    The only disappointment was the color of the fabric.  It is much greener than it appears in the picture.  It is not unpleasant, just different from my expectations.  Overall, this is a very nice light for your child.

product_title: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Baby Yellow, X-Large (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love these sleep sacks... its difficult to find lighter ones for summer and these are just perfect.  Fleece is too hot for the warmer weather, but you still need something for your baby to sleep comfortably and safely.  They wash and wear forever and I only replace them when my baby outgrows each size!  I would highly reccommend this item!

product_title: Fresh Baby So Easy Baby Food and Breast Milk Trays
review_body: I have 4 of these trays and have been using them for 3 months to freeze baby food. They are fantastic!     MEASURING- Each cube is 1T, which is great for measuring. For example, for lunch my baby gets 2 cubes of meat, 2 veggies, and 2 fruit. Some people complain that the cubes are too small, but if they were bigger they would take longer to defrost. I think the size is perfect.    QUALITY- Some complain about warping or poor fit. I haven't had that problem at all and I use these a lot. I wash them by hand in hot soapy water. I couldn't fit them on the top rack in the dishwasher if I wanted to...all those darn baby feeding bowls and bottles!    EASY- Put frozen cubes in labeled zipper freezer bags. If they don't want to come out of the tray, just turn the tray over and run some hot water over it for 10 seconds. I take what I need out of the freezer and put them in little bowls the night before and they're thawed for the next day. If I forget I just microwave for a minute.    GOOD FOR BABY- I love the variety my baby gets. Many parents give just 1 or 2 different foods to baby at a meal so they don't open too many jars. With all choices I have in my freezer, my baby gets 4 different foods at each meal and I know exactly what she's eating. I don't have anything against jarred food, but I feel better (and thriftier) giving her homemade.

product_title: Mommy's Helper Contoured Cushie Step Up, 1 Count
review_body: I bought this hoping for a solution to the frightening experience of falling into the toilet or falling off the toilet. My little girl is very independant and wants to do everything herself. We had hit a road block with the use of the toilet because she can't relax and sit on the seat and I have to help her up onto the toilet. She was really excited when we put it together and knew exactly what it was for. However, it isn't very sturdy at all. It is very wabbly when she is climbing up it and the seat has a tendancy to move (I do have an elongated toilet). So this frightens her still. But it does give her a little extra independance so I am not totally disappointed.

product_title: Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes Musical Toy
review_body: He is 8 months old now, I bought this 7 months ago. He really likes it.

product_title: Lamaze Play & Grow Take Along Toy, Firefly
review_body: My son is 5 months old and loves this toy.  It makes crinkling noises when he grabs it.  It also has a teether and a great quality mirror on one of its wings.  I hang this toy from his swing and car seat.  He enjoys grabbing it and chewing on it.  My only concern about this product is that I am not sure if it is BPA free.  I emailed the company and haven't heard back yet.  If the Lamaze line of toys is BPA free, I will definitely be buying more.    12/25/09: I heard back from the company. They assured me the product is BPA free.

product_title: Safety 1st Complete Care Bath Center
review_body: don't buy this one now I have to spend my money and time lookin for another one.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Bottle Newborn Feeding Set
review_body: my baby's pediatrician recommended these. Baby has less gas, rarely throws up or spits up, and seems to like them too.

product_title: Safety 1st Infant Car Seat, Black

The shoulder straps dig into her neck, and the buckle digs into her legs. It doesn't install very well, and is in general probably better for cars with the latch system- though it's supposed to work with buckles- and for toddlers. Avoid it for newborns. I have to buy a different brand now and have wasted my money on this seat.

product_title: Naturepedic No Compromise Organic Cotton Classic Crib Mattress
review_body: This is an item that is worth the price tag for my baby's health.  I'm satisfied with it's quality.  However, I think it is extremely unfortunate that this is not available at a price that every parent could afford for their child.  The one problem I've had with this mattress is that it is extremely heavy and only my husband can get it out of the crib to change the sheet & pad

product_title: Kiddopotamus Snuzzler Complete Head and Body Support, Ivory Fleece & Grey Trim (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I received this item and I couldn't be happier with it. My husband and I are expecting our first little one in December and cannot wait to use this item. When it arrived, I opened it and immediatly wanted one for my self it is very soft and seems as thought it will provide much needed support for baby's head and body.

product_title: Sassy Nasal Aspirator
review_body: I bought the whole collection of these adorable \\"functional\\" items from Sassy. But I am completely disappointed with this aspirator. The rubber is so thick, you can't squeeze it tight enough to get anything out. To put it simply... The suction sucks! Total waste of money. Like too many baby items out there, it is cute and worthless.

product_title: The First Years Via Infant Car Seat - Cappuccino (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: This car seat is lacking major features.
review_body: When I first opened the product I loved it. The seat belt height adjusted very easily from the back, the padding was great, and the handle was the best I have seen. Then I saw the stickers on the side that said it can't be used without the base and it can't be used in a shopping cart which meant it can't be secured in a stroller either. This car seat is only useful for transporting baby from car to house. I'm not sure what your supposed to do with your baby when you go shopping. You would basically have to carry your baby around all the time. I was very disappointed and could have dealt with always using the base but it had to be able to be used in a stroller or shopping cart. Also, I received my seat damaged due to a gouge in the side of the box that riped the foam on the side of the handle.

product_title: Bummis Whisper Pant: Large (over 30lbs).
review_body: It's a very good product, and I am happy with the way it washes/is very light, good waterproofing, however, the size is really Large- my son is 30 lbs, but it was way too large in the waist and around the legs- I had to stitch the openings smaller... I did not know what the medium size would be like, but did not feel comfortable ordering it, because it says it is only up to 30 lbs...Also, I was hoping to use it for overnight- no way, somehow it does not hold overnight spills for my son, even with 2 diapers in..

product_title: Bummis Super Whisper Wrap Diaper Cover
review_body: This cover worked fine at first, but after about 6 washes or so, it stopped being waterproof.  The wetness of the diaper would gradually seep through the fabric and leave my baby and me damp.  After this happened twice, I just threw the thing away.  I prefer the Thirsties covers instead.  I've washed them dozens of times and they're still going strong.

product_title: ProudBody Pregnancy Art
review_body: The paint looks great, until it dries. It chips and looks horrible. It takes forever to apply as well because the paint doesn't want to stay on the skin. I tried painting a pumpkin for halloween. After 4 hours of painting, it looked great, until it dried and began flaking...

product_title: 5-Pack Pastel Bodysuits
review_body: The quality of these onesies are not worth the price. They are cheap for a reason - the material is thin, the material around the snaps rip and twice they have gotten so tangled in the wash that the buttons broke off. I would not recommend this product to anyone!

product_title: Tadpoles Organics Set of 2 Brushed Cotton Fitted Crib Sheets
review_headline: Great for cool Midwest fall and winter
review_body: What a great deal to get two sheet per pack! The material was not as soft as other flannel sheets I have purchased, but they will do for providing warmth and comfort.

product_title: Baby Trend Serengeti High Chair
review_body: Ours is pretty sturdy, unlike others who posted.  However, the size of the chair is very odd.  Our 8 month old is swimming in it.  He sits very low and far back.  We had to \\"add\\" padding by putting towels under the cover.  Its an odd work around, but we didn't feel like taking it back.  Our friends purchased a FisherPrice - Easy Fold and that seems to be more appropriately sized.  Also, the cover says not to machine wash... obviously a stupid restriction for a baby high chair cover.

product_title: Sunshine Kids Stroller Accessory Buggy Buddy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this to fit on my Dream on Me Adjustable Handle Stroller which doesn't have any cup holders or trays.  It fits perfectly and will hold any drink - including a cold coffee drink from Starbucks or a water bottle.  It's got plenty of room and the metal frame really makes a difference in that it always stays open.  I have to attach it on a slanted portion on my stroller handle because of the way my stroller is, so to offest the slant I attached one side by twisting the velcro before putting it on and it stays level with no problem.  GREAT PRODUCT!!

product_title: BABYBJORN Toilet Trainer
review_body: This is the best potty seat by far.  I have 2 boys and I never have a wet mess after they use this seat.  I bought other seats but they always left a wet ring around the rim and I had to rinse the seat and their legs every time.  I never worry about a mess with this seat. Worth every penny.

product_title: Evenflo Triumph Advance LX Convertible Car Seat, Harbortown (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This seat is wonderful. I did lots of research and this seat is one of the best and is reasonably priced. My 1 yr old loves it. She can see out of the window and it is very comfy. Very happy with this purchase. I also received it super fast!

product_title: Baby Plus Prenatal Education System
review_body: I purchased this product based on what other people have said about the outcome of the results. I find the instrument to be too loud and I wonder if it is scaring the baby more than it is suppose to help the baby develop. Since I am 8 mos pregnant and have been using this product for 6 weeks so far, making sure I make the time 2x a day at the same time can be challenging at times. In the beginning the baby moves a little but I find that it puts her to sleep, which might not be a bad thing because I can use it when she is born to help her relax to sleep. It makes me want to sleep too. Since it is too premature to say if it does everything it claims to, I can't give it 5 stars.

product_title: Sunshine Kids New Radian 80 Convertible Car Seat - SuperCool (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love these car seats!  I bought two, one for each son.  I love knowing that they are safe.  The ONLY negative (and this is not always a negative)is that it is very tall and may not fit in all cars in the rear-facing position.  When it is front-facing, that is a positive, as it can accommodate taller children!  The push-button release on the LATCH clips is also great.  It makes installation a breeze! I wish more people knew about the amazing safety features.  I don't believe they have ever been recalled and they have a 5 point harness up to 80 pounds!

product_title: BOB Revolution Stroller in Navy
review_body: I bought this for my daughter in law.  Both she and my new granddaughter are enjoying the rides.  Mom can jog and baby can see the world.  The quality was great.  Even a grandmother feels safe with this stroller.  It manuvers really well with the pivoting front wheel.

product_title: Sassy Baby's Mam 9 oz. Boy 3 pack Bottle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son isn't very picky, so he did fine with the switch to these bottles.  I like them mainly because they are made of BPA-free plastic.  They are easily cleaned, but you MUST remember to put the bottoms on tightly or it will leak everywhere.  The rubber ring must be inserted just so, also.  I was using Playtex drop-ins, but found them to be a little annoying because it was just one more thing to remember when going out of the house--I have many times remembered the bottle, but not the drop-in.  I also like these bottles better because you can fit a larger amount of formula/milk in them.  ONE WORD OF CAUTION--I bought fast flow nipples, and they seem to be really too fast for my 8-month-old--he finishes a bottle in under 3 minutes and seems to gasp a little while drinking.  I was using fast flow in the Playtex and did not have this problem.

product_title: Joovy Groove 2 Stroller
review_headline: Great for my 6 month old and 3.5 year old!
review_body: Pro's, very manuverable, stylish, super quality fabric, lots of storage, compact when folded. The fabric they sit on is reversible for either cool fabric or warm fleece for here in Alaska.    Con's like others stated would be the little clip on the handlebars that keeps the thing folded, and the sunshade inside joint that is really hard to set or release.  Also a little hard to open the stroller.  I feel all of these complaints are very minor.  We bought this for an upcoming trip to disneyworld.  I was surprised when looking at their strollers to see that they were all really hard plastic and not soft for younger children.  I was nervous opening this stroller in the parking lot of our halloween bazaar (my test run) since it was very rocky and ice/snowy.  The stroller took it like a champ with both my kiddos loaded up.  The seats are super cushy and it's so nice to have one sat upright for my daughter (who's an in and out of the stroller kinda kid).  My son just kinda chilled looking at his sister happily for a couple hours and my back wasn't aching from my bjorn with his chunky lil butt.  For me the stroller was a great surprise in quality.  I looked up reviews on everything, and had a really hard time ordering this one because there just aren't very many reviews out there.  My main goals for this stroller was being able to fit my 28 lb 3 year old and my son at 8 months (with potential for naps), plus we needed a sunshade and some storage.  The only prob I ran into at the halloween fest was trying to get adults to pay attention so I could get out but it was nutty and way too packed.  Overall I DEFINITELY recommend!

product_title: Regalo Hide Away Double Sided Bed Rail, White
review_body: I really like this product. It works great with my 2 year old daughter, as she just recently got her big girl bed (full size bed). The rails go together pretty easily then all you have to do is put them under the mattress. The next step is to connect them together under the mattress via 2 long straps. Once you get them positioned correctly, pull the straps tight and you're done. Simple and easy, but you may need a second person. I had read other reviews (not on this site) that said it wasn't a good product and that it was difficult to put together, but it's a great product and was fairly easy to put together. When reading the instructions, you kinda have to read them first then go back and put it together without them (glancing back is ok). Anyway, this was my experience and it was a good one...

product_title: Arm's Reach Co-Sleeper Original Bassinet, Natural (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great Idea- lots of flaws with instructions
review_body: I loved the idea of having our baby close to us during the night.  I researched it well, or at least I thought I had, and bought the \\"Universal\\" model as our bed, including mattress, is 20\\" from the ground.    A few things to note:    If your bed has any kind of frame that is not flush with the sides of your mattress, for example, we have the Tate Bed from Crate and Barrel, the co-sleeper function will not work. The side frame of your bed has to be completely aligned with the mattress, as you find with a traditional boxspring/mattress set up.  If it is not, there is a huge space between the lowered side of the co-sleeper and your bed, which is an entrapment hazard.  I really wish that arms reach mentioned this somewhere on their website.    The instruction manual is probably the worst I have ever read.  It is poorly illustrated and incredibly hard to follow.  I consider myself someone that can put together just about anything and although I had read reviews of people saying this was hard to put together, you often find that for most products, so I figured it was down to the individuals.  But no, after struggling for an hour, trying to figure out how to convert from a co-sleeper to a free standing bassinet, I decided to come online and look at arms reach support to try and get clearer directions.  What did I find, but a tutorial that is utterly different from those provided with the co-sleeper, There are some clear photographs and a step by step guide, but it barely relates to the printed version.    I truly feel like this probably isn't that hard to do, just the instructions send you on a path that is very hard to follow and leaves out huge chunks of information.  The illustrations are terrible (Ok, i am hypercritical about this- it is my profession- but they are bad!) , small, almost impossible to decipher and contradict from one page to the next.    I am so frustrated with this thing that I haven't yet tried the \\"alternative\\" instructions, but will do so later.The really 'convenient' thing about the online tutorial is that it isn't available in a printable format and my co-sleeper is in another part of the house, so I am going to have to copy and paste each section and drag and drop the photographs to create my own printable tutorial, otherwise walk from room to room for each step- which at 9 months pregnant, I am not looking forward to.    Just for some perspective, this is our second child, we have had bassinets, a crib, a pack and play, a few strollers and car seats, swing, bouncer etc etc and I have put all of these together by myself, usually heavily pregnant.    I will also point out that the mattress is really hard, yes, a mattress for a baby should be firm, but this is very cardboard like and has 3 distinct 'sections\\" - this is true of all pack n plays, so we bought an alternative latex/organic cotton mattress from Pure Rest.    I am hoping that once I finally get it together, it will function as a playard/bassinet for our baby.    Unless you have a standard boxspring/mattress and have unlimited patience, I would suggest a bassinet/cradle for next to the bed and a regular pack and play for the living room and/or travel-- they are much easier to deal with.

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: before buying sophie i read tons of reviews, the majority of which raved & raved about this product. for me & my daughter, it was definitely NOT worth the price. she's interested in it for about 2 minutes tops and then she's done. it was a very very rubbery smell. and i thought the material was very thin - at least for what i was expecting. it really is a lot like a dog toy - but for infants.

review_body: Product is fine, but was not the same as pictured on the site.  Easy return however and good customer service.

product_title: Munchkin Warm Glow Wipe Warmer

I cant get the tension right so that it locks on its own when it swings shut like my old one did. Also, it has a little blocker so that it only opens one way - a safety feature. review_body: This is a solid, easy to install gate that actually fit out 45\\" wide stairs. My wife had it put up in minutes. It strong, easy to open and keeps the kids in. We ended up buying two and they're worth the purchase.

product_title: LilyPadz® Reusable Silicone Nursing Pads Single Pair Regular Size
review_body: I loved my Lily Padz so much that I purchased these for a friend. The down side is that they lose their tackiness after about a month (at least this was my experience), but they are perfect for wearing under tighter fitting shirts (even more fitted t-shirts) and with summer tank tops.

product_title: The Original Woombie Baby Cocoon Swaddle, Newborn Short, Kiwi Green
review_headline: cheap zipper and poor customer service
review_body: I purchased this for my 2 month old.  My son likes to have his arms free, but the downside to that is he wakes himself up.  So I thought the woombie would be perfect to keep him swaddled.    He did very well in it the first time I tried it, which was a nap.  He did fuss a little bit once he realized he couldn't get his hands free, but then calmed down and went to sleep.    However, my biggest complaint is the cheap zipper.  When you are fighting a 10 week old to get back into the woombie after a diaper change, good luck getting it zipped back up.  I think they need to use a stronger zipper like the ones on his sleep sacks.      All in all, sometimes my son tolerates it, sometimes he doesn't.  It seems more of a hassle to get him back in the woombie at 3:00 am after feeding and diaper changes, then to just put him down in his crib in his sleep sack.  If you are going to purchase this, use it from birth.  And if you are a seamstress, switch out the zipper.    Update - after contacting customer service about the cheap zipper,I was offered a replacement if the item was defective.  I didn't think the item was defective, it's just poorly designed.  So I gave up using the woombie.  Much later, I opened the larger one I purchased at the same time and saw that this one has the correct zipper construction and no internal tag.  I contacted customer service again and asked for an exchange b/c clearly my original was defective and was told they don't accept returns on used items.  I asked why I was offered a replacement the first time, but not now?  In response I was given the copy from the website with the 14 day return policy and told that they no longer make the woombie I purchased, the houdini.  Very disappointed with this company's service especially since they offered a replacement for a used item initailly, and now won't take it.      I would not recommend this product to anyone.  Buy the swaddler from summer, it does the same thing for less money.

review_body: Awsome bed set! Arrived fast and it's beautiful! My wife and thought it sounded to good to be true but boy we where wrong! Fit our standard size 4 in one crib perfectly! But it, it's $50 but looks much more pricey!

review_body: This is a wonder for helping a newborn to sleep in longer segments.  I give one to all my friends after my brother had such success with it and my nephew.

product_title: Evenflo Chase Booster Car Seat - Lancaster

The flip top holder they call a storage accessory looks remarkably like an an ashtray.  That accessory won't last long anyway, it keeps falling off.  We like the cup holder.    This product did not come with a users manual.  I suspect it was simply missing.  I found it on-line at the evenflo.com web site.  Look for it under replacement parts.    There are plenty of adjustments available.  The strap adjustments are easy to accomplish - even with a squirming toddler.  The seat belts into our caravan simply and sturdily.    I have used better (and worse) car seats/boosters but for the money I think perhaps my score of 3 stars may be a bit low..... lets call it 3 1/2.

product_title: Baby Nasal Aspirator Vacuum Suction Pigeon (Made in Japan)
review_headline: I'm so glad I purchased this!
review_body: The Pigeon nasal aspirator works wonderfully!  I did a search on nasal aspirators to try and find one that worked at LEAST as well as the one provided by the hospital, when I ran across this style.  After reading the reviews, it intrigued me.  With the \\"blue bulb\\" from the hospital, there were times when I would suction my son's nose and just when the bulb was back to it's normal shape, I could hear more mucous that was \\"almost\\" suctioned out - very frustrating.  I decided to go ahead and try this one and see how it worked.  The other day, my son had a little bit of a stuffy nose (he's at the tail end of a cold - of course I order this product AFTER the cold!).  I decided to give this a try to test it out.  Wow, did it work!  It requires very little sucking, and my son seemed to be fascinated - he had a little half smile on his face the whole time! It didn't go up his nose - it stays right at the \\"entrance\\" - you just wiggle it around, and the suction strength and duration was controlled by me.   I just rinsed all of the parts in hot water when I was through.  I can't say that I'm looking forward to his next cold, but I CAN say that I'm not worried about him having a stuffy nose!  Bring it on!

product_title: Baby Einstein Neptune Soother (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
We've purchased a variety of toys for our 9-month-old son and he seems to prefer things that have to do with music. As such, my wife found the Baby Einstein Great Barrier Reef Soother and we installed it at one end of his crib. He enjoyed it right from the first moment, and it wasn't very long before he discovered how to turn it on. It was then on a lot, I might add.

After about a month or so, it stopped working. It seemed to shut down feature by feature, just like described in many of the reviews. We replaced the two different sets of batteries, but never could get it properly functioning again. Dismayed, we returned it to Target where we'd purchased it. We had no receipt, but had paid for it with a credit card, and Target cheerfully replaced the soother with a new one. The replacement seems to work fine, at least so far.

It's an interesting and attractive toy. Sometimes our son seems mesmerized by the little fishies and bright colorful lights. At other times he pays no attention at all but seems to enjoy the background music, which is rather good I might add. The soothing sounds seem to have no particular effect, or at least it's not noticeable. We like being able to turn the soother on when we put him to bed and have the toy automatically turn off after a set time. He's almost always asleep by that time, I might add. It seems rather bright for a sleep aid, but the light doesn't seem to bother our son. In the morning, he commonly turns it on to start the day.

I have mixed feelings about this product. Basically, I like it in that it is an attractive distraction and the boy obviously likes it. It's a battery burner, I should add, and I have questions about the long-term durability. For the moment, ours is working well and is a nice addition to his set of playthings.

Gary Peterson

To clean I simply place a dab of dish liquid on the bag and rub with hands then rinse well.  No stains or stuck fruit.  Hot dogs can be chopped up and fed in bag too.  Kids love their franks! product_title: Graco LiteRider Stroller, Tango in the Tongo (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Bought this to go along with carseat from graco- works great for infant. put kiddo in carseat, then carseat latches seamlessly into the stroller- it's awesome. I also like how it folds down to about 25% of its size so it fits nicely in the trunk of my car.

product_title: Sumersault Rocket Baby 4 pc Crib Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I struggled with purchasing this set as I didn't really want to spend so much on bedding. product_title: First Years Premium Double Pump
review_body: I've been using this pump for 2 weeks now and am very satisfied overall. Maybe it won't hold up as long as a more expensive pump-- that remains to be seen. product_title: Nuby BPA FREE No-spill Cup 7oz 1-pack, Boy Color
review_headline: Fills a Gap in the Market
review_body: I think these cups are great for babies that reject cups with harder spouts. This was the case with my daughter. She is doing really well using this cup. I was a little concerned about the soft nipple breaking, but this has not happened. This might be a risk with children that chew on the cup more. In that case a harder spout might be better for them. The cups that I have though have two notches to align, so I don't know if the cups I have are slighly a newer version of the one described by another reviewer. Most cups on the market are not like these ones. I think they help fill a gap for babies that prefer softer spouts.

product_title: DaVinci Jenny Lind 3-in-1 Convertible Crib - Ebony
review_headline: Beautiful crib at a great price!
review_body: I looked for months for a crib that had a vintage feel without having to spend an arm and a leg. I wasn't quite sure after ready some of the reviews but after receiving it and putting it up, this crib is the cutest I have ever seen!    I read in the reviews people were complaining about the exposed brown, plastic hardware that came with the crib.  Before assembly, I just spray painted the brown hardware with a black spray paint made for plastics and you would never know it was originally a different color.    The instructions weren't great, but my husband put it together in under an hour.  The crib is also very sturdy. Love it, love it, love it!

product_title: Chicco Polly Double Pad Fabric Highchair
review_headline: Would give 6 stars if I could!  Love it!!
review_body: I was going to buy a wooden high chair for my baby, but after seeing one in person, decided on this one instead.  I am SO glad I did!  I can't rave enough about this high chair.  Here are all the things I love about the chair:    1.  Two chair covers!  One can get thrown in the wash and still have a pad on the chair.  I don't have to rush to clean it.  However, unless it's a real mess, it is easy enough to clean with a cloth. Nice cushioning, too.  My baby is comfy in it.    2.  Removable tray liners!  The high chair comes with 2 removable tray liners.  I've never had to use both, but I guess if I didn't have a chance to wash the one before needing it again, it would be handy. I like that I can remove the whole thing and walk it to the trash can and then the sink.  It's fantastic and easy to clean!    3.  The tray has holders for storage on the back legs of the chair.  I always put the tray on those holders when my baby is not in the chair.  This makes it so easy to put my baby in, strap her in, and then grab the tray to put on.  (one other reviewer didn't use this storage spot and noted it was difficult to remove the tray with the baby in her arms.)  Storing it here eliminates this problem.    4.  The leg separator is attached to the bottom of the tray instead of the seat.  I love this feature.  I don't have to worry about getting her legs around that thing while she is squirming in my arms.  Instead, once she is strapped in I can worry about it.  Plus, this means the chair will literally grow with her.  When she is big enough and doesn't need this feature, it converts to a regular chair at the table.    5.  Height adjustment is great. Without the tray on, she can sit at the table like a big girl.  She thinks that is great!  Adjustable foot rest also grows with her.    6.  There are brakes on each wheel.  So it is easy to roll everywhere and then keep it secure when baby is in it.      7.  It has multiple reclining positions which are easy to adjust.      8.  It folds up easily.      9.  This nice green color isn't like all the loud, colorful baby products you find.  It fits nicely with our decor and doesn't scream 'baby in the house'!  (though there are other color options like that if you like the colorful products).    As you can see, I absolutely love this product and without a doubt think it was worth every penny.  I'm so glad I spent the money and didn't settle for a cheaper product!

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_headline: Best invention for new moms EVER!

product_title: Boppy Bouncer in Pink (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We bought this for our new granddaughter.  My daughter says it's the perfect shape for cuddling & swaddling.  The vibration and music are indeed helpful.

product_title: Lansinoh Manual Breast Pump
review_body: I have to start out by saying that this is an absolutely fantastic pump, the only one I'll use. I have tried two different electric pumps, and one other manual pump (the Medela Harmony) and this one is by far the best for many reasons. First of all, the part that fits onto the breast is very soft and comfortable, making it easy to get a good seal. Also, the handle is very ergonomic and comfortable to use for the duration of a pumping session. My hand does not get tired at all, and suction is just perfect for me. This pump does not hurt at all and yet extracts the same amount of milk that I would with an electric pump, and all with no pain!    This might be personal preference, but I don't really get why so many women use electric pumps which are harder to control, noisy, can sometimes hurt and are so bulky. I throw this pump in my bag and take it to work to pump everyday, and it's so comfortable, discreet, quiet and easy to clean. Instead of dreading pumping, it makes it a joy to express breast milk for my daughter.    Another great thing is the extra parts as well as the cleaning brush which make this whole set an even better value for the money. Since the top disassembles, having the alternate pieces allows the top to be cleaned and dried without the pump being out of commission.    My only issue was that it did start to squeak after about a month of use. It didn't really matter when I pumped at home, but at work I was highly conscious of the noise, so I put some vaseline on the part where it was squeaking and now it is silent again.    Overall, I can say I honestly don't know what I would do without it. I don't think I would be pumping if I didn't have it, I would have given up long ago!

product_title: Boon Frog Pod Bath Toy Scoop,Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this for my 2 year old son's bath time about 2 months ago. It was installed in less than 60 seconds using the suction cup method. review_body: This really works.  I am so pleased with it.  I love the fact that it does not need an adhesive like the other ones in the market.  Fantastic design!

product_title: Dream Baby Swing Close Security Gate (shown with extensions included)
review_body: This gate is easy to install and take down. I got this for my dog. Since it is metal, my dog does not chew on it. I am quite pleased with it.  It automatically swings shut so I am careful to make sure my dog is out of the way before it closes.

product_title: Fisher-Price Puppy Dumbbell Rattle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I always like the brand \\"fisher price\\" a lot and thought this would be another good product from it, but it turned out to disappoint me a lot. It doesn't have a bright color, thus not appealing to infants. Though it is called a rattle, it doesn't produce a rattling sound when shaken - so not really attractive to a relatively older baby, but yet it is pretty long and heavy that I don't think a small baby can easily grab or hold.

product_title: Ju-Ju-Be Be Major Wallet
review_body: This is very, very disappointing. I gave it one star just because you have to give something, but it doesn't deserve even that, really.     I used to have th Ju Ju Be Be Mine - and was very happy with it for about a year. The only thing I was missing - there was no space for the phone. So when I saw this one, I thought - I have to have it, this one has it all. WRONG!    First of all - it has this stupid removable center divider. OK, so I don't need the space for pix, because I think its lame (but it's just me really), but I could use the card slots. But this thing is just too bulky! It kept sticking out, and I had to fight it to close the wristlet every time. Eventually I decided just not to use it, thinking there is still enough space for cards and not having the divider will give me some extra space for the keys.     WRONG again - the key fob, this addition to the Be Mine has to stay inside by the design with the keys on it. Well, you know what? Even a small bundle of keys won't fit in there, even after completely removing the divider. The bag just wouldn't close. You'll need to have ONE very flat key for the fob to be useful, kinda. I only have a key to apartment - one key and car keys - really, not that much. If I only had the apartment key, it may have worked. But seriously - you make products for mothers - is one key would be all a mother has?! And of course, I can leave the keys to hang out there, as with the Be Mine, but then - what is the key fob for? Just to stick in there with no purpose - well, this is a nice addition.     I find the little change pocket (the one by the mirror) completely unusable, it's too small. I'm a small person with small hands, but I can't even fit my pinky finger in there, let alone extract coins. The mirror makes the pocket not flexible, which complicates things even further. To make a pocket just to say - you have a pocket there?     And - this wristlet has sturdy walls, as opposed to the Be Mine, so for me it's a minus. I havea garage opener I used to carry in the Be Mine, and I can't put it in there - it's too tight and keeps opening the garage door accidently.     And eventually - the phone pocket. In my opinion it's a very bad use of space there. If it would open to the side, instead from top to bottom, you could use more of the space in this pocket. Because the way it is now - the upper part is just empty, covered with the lid. And it doesn't look so good with the phone inside - just not proportional.    Overall - I'm very, very disappointed, thinking about returning it. If you have the Be Mine - don't switch - it's not worth it.     Hope this helps.

product_title: JJ Cole Lite Embroidered Bundleme, Navy, Toddler (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This really keeps my baby warm in a chilly windy day. I bought this for my 7 month old. I can use this with my stroller no problem.  It may seem a bit big for him but it's more roomy.  Get the toddler one so you dont waste the money on the infant one that only can be used up to 12 months.

product_title: BABYBJORN Toilet Trainer
review_headline: Saved me from taking my potty seat EVERYWHERE
review_body: My 2-year-old is a little scared of new things.  So, you can imagine how hard it is to get him to try an adult size toilet in a public restroom.    We used the [[ASIN:B000MEU3M4 Baby Bjorn Potty Chair]] (great product, as well!) to get him started .  He figured out the routine within 3 days, but when I had to travel with him, he refused to use other potties or any toilet seat covers (padded or folded).  If I was lucky enough to get him to sit on the other seats, they would move or the pee guard didn't seem high enough, so my toddler and I would be nervous about him sitting on there for long.  I had to take the potty seat with me everywhere I went... to family members' houses, to parties, and to the grocery store.  I was sneaking my son out to my car every time he had to pee.  And when we finally decided to go without the potty seat while we were entertaining friends in downtown Chicago, my son was more comfortable peeing in his pants than any toilet in CHI-town.    Then I bought the Baby Bjorn Toilet Trainer and no more potty in the trunk.  It fits into the diaper bag and since it's adjustable, it fits all toilets securely.  When my son sits on it, he can change positions as many times as he wants and he doesn't feel like he's going to fall in.  I think it really helps that it is white like the toilet as well.  He gets such a satisfied look on his face when he pees on the BIG toilet.

product_title: Pink and Brown Modern Polka Dots Toddler Bedding 5 Piece Set
review_body: I bought this set for my daughter to transition to a toddler bed.  The set is very cute, but I'm very disappointed in the comforter.  I washed everything before putting it on her bed according to the manufacturers directions.  When the comforter came out of the wash, the inside stuffing was all mashed up in one corner.  The only thing that I think would fix this is to open up a seam and tack all the stuffing down.  What a mess!  The sheets are alright, I wish they were a little softer.

product_title: Sassy 2 Pack Baby Less Mess Toddler Spoon, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The handles are user friendly for your little one to grasp.  The spoon is deep so it holds more and the holes make it less likely for the food to spill.  Remember not to use it for cereal and milk or other foods with thin gravies.

product_title: Evenflo Titan Elite DLX Convertible Car Seat
review_body: I bought this seat about a week ago and I'm very happy with it.  It is a great seat.  It's light, easy to install:  I installed it with latch system and took me less than 20min (but I have to say that with car belts it doesn't work very good, it moves more tahn 1 inch altough I pulled the car seat belt very hard).  My baby is now 6 months old and is big for his infant carrier so I decided to get him a car seat wich he can use for a long time.  And this seat is the perfect one!. It has many advantages:  light (as I already said), beatiful, you can place it in the middle of the back seat and you still have enough space for 2 adults to sit (but you'll have to take off the bottle and snack holder).  When I started to look for a car seat for may baby I was between Evenflo Triumph car seat and this Evenflo Titan car seat.  Differences between these two car seats are little:  1. Triumph has infinite harness system wich means that harness height adjust automaticly to the baby, Titan doesn't have this system and you have to adjust it by changing the straps height yourself (not big deal!) 2.  Triumph has a knob to thighten the harness, Titan has a strap to pull and thights the harness (not big deal either).  3.  Triumph has 3 recline position in rear facing, Titan has only one, but my baby doesn't note the difference.  This seat is not very expensive and I would reccomend it to anyone that is looking for a SAFE, beautiful, comfortable and durable car seat.

product_title: JJ Cole Original Toddler Bundle Me
review_body: I love this bundle me it keeps my lil man warm I love it and fall asleep in it too. I actual bought it from Marshalls for 24.99.

product_title: The First Years Spinning Drying Rack
review_body: I'm so annoyed with this product. It's been only less than 2 mos but the top of the rack can never be positioned stable. I am so annoyed that the height is never stabled. The top is always dropping down. I use a hairband to keep up the top part. It still doesn't work. I'm on Amazon now looking for a replacement. I don't understand why there is such high marks for this cheap, flimsy product.

product_title: Gerber NaturalFlex Silicone Pacifier - Green / Blue
review_body: I gave this paci to my Daughter when she was only a couple weeks old and she really liked it.  I was breastfeeding and liked the idea that it was \\"like mother\\".  The problem with this paci is that where the soft latex and hard plastic meets there is a seam that saliva can get into.  Over time it gets funky in there and mold can grow.  Unfortunately, you can't take apart the binky in order to clean it. Even boiling them didn't work. I did end up using these until my daughter was 1.  I just watched them and threw them out when they started to get weird. So if you don't mind cycling through binkies every few months then give these a try...

product_title: Graco Blossom Highchair, Townsend
review_body: We waited for this highchair to come off the assembly line and we are glad we waited for it. It looks like it'll carry us from infant to toddler 'plus'. (highchair, youth chair, booster) It took 15 minutes to put together, which wasn't bad. It rolls around smoothly which is wonderful. We love the adjustable heights - it is so easy to go up and down depending on our needs. We like the big tray AND the small tray. I can see where both are handy. It adjusts to reclining easily too. Our child is 5 months old and is enjoying being \\"up\\" with the big people, instead of sitting on the floor in a bouncey seat. Now he can join me making dinner in the kitchen and then be rolled to the table. Now we feel like a real family having dinner together. sort of....

product_title: 2009 Buzz 3 Wheel Single Stroller - Apple
review_body: If u buy this stroller in a complete set with the bassinet it'll actually cost u more or less the same with the Bug Frog.   I was tempted to buy the Frog at first.. but after thinking and researching and testing and comparing between the new Buzz and the Frog, the Buzz won!   This stroller is very easy to steer, easy to fold! just one push and whoosh.. it goes down.. love the automatic lock that comes in the newer version of Buzz!   And its even easier to unfold, just one nudge with your finger or feet and whoosh... its ready to use.. (u dont have to  take the seat off when folding the stroller which is a plus.. at least for me..)  And the look... this stroller is sooo pretty!! Compare it with the Bug Frog.. i like my Buzz A LOT more!!

product_title: McKenzie Kids Kensington Diaper Bag in Black/Red
review_body: Pros:  1) Big and roomy for everything  2) Doesn't look like a diaper bag and looks like a stylish tote.  3) Comfortable to carry  4) Has many inside pockets: Credit card/driver license slots, zippered pocket, cell phone pocket, pen/pencil organizer, 2 insulated bottle holders, 2 inside mesh pockets, key hook.  5) Has 2 outside accessory pockets.  6) The changing pad folds in a nice way and is closed with a tab, looks stylish, you don't even know it is a changing pad!  7) Everything easy to reach in the bag.    Cons:   1) The main compartment is closed with a magnetic flap closure, easy to reach but things may fall outside since it has no zipper.  2) The changing pad is described as \\"Full size pad\\", I thought it will be bigger than the ones I saw in stores but it not very big, it is narrow, about 60 x 30 cm (24 x 12 inches), but maybe that's enough, I'm not sure since I'm still expecting my first baby! Looks very similar in shape and size to [[ASIN:B000HEG7KQ Kiddopotamus Quickchange Portable Changing Pad]]    I would recommend this bag to you if you are searching for a roomy diaper bag that looks like \\"your\\" bag not your baby's bag.. In the end, Mammy is the one who will carry it not the baby ;) It's also a good choice if you hate messenger bags and prefer hand or shoulder bags like me!

product_title: Chicco Liteway Stroller, Topazio (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We were looking for something smaller than the bulky but nice travel system we'd been using for the first year of our son's life, and yet more comfortable and sturdy than the umbrella stroller we purchased.  This was just perfect for our family.  Durable, yet lightweight, comfortable for our son, easy to push, and with lots of great features.

product_title: Graco Stylus Travel System in Moracco
review_body: The Graco stroller gets good reviews for a reason - it is a good stroller - once you have figured it out that is.  The stroller part itself came with good assembly instructions, is sturdy once put together, and generally does what a stroller is meant to do.    The car seat was a totally different story.  The instructions had so many warnings about the dangers to the infant if the seat is not installed correctly it was hard to discern what the actual installation procedures were.  Instead of having a clear set of instructions, followed by the warnings, there would be one line vaguely describing some part of the installation and then pages of warning of what might happen if done wrong.  Needless to say it made for a very frustrating process trying to figure out how to install the car seat.    In the end, we did get it installed (hopefully correctly) and it will do the job just fine.  I like that the car seat attaches to the stroller for walking around with the baby.  Seems like a well thought out system  even if the installation manual is terribly written.

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie Elite Diaper Disposal Pail, White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Better than the regular Diaper Genie 2
review_body: This product took into consideration the few criticisms of the diaper genie 2 and improved on it.  It has a little pedal you step on to open the top lid, you put your diaper in and release.  Truly one handed operation, minimal smell because of the way the internal clasp seals the bag when you step on the pedal, and you never touch the inside bag.  Occasionally, if I don't step on the pedal all the way, I get a whif of the internal contents because the clasp doesn't seal all the way...but I figure thats my fault for not doing it correctly.  It now has a handle on the front so you can carry it with one hand, and emptying is similar to genie 2.   If your a fan of the diaper genie...you'll like this product.     You do still have to buy their refills, and that is the one big drawback.  I've seen the price come down to equal that of genie 1 refills, so if your already paying for them, then its not a problem.  Our refills last 3 weeks with our toddler's diapers.

product_title: Moby Wrap Baby Carrier-Moss
review_headline: Great for getting around metro areas
review_body: I take my nine-month-old son out in this just about every day. The only drawback is that we didn't have it before he turned 2 months, as I could see it being an amazing resource with a newborn.     I feel a lot more secure having him close to my body compared to having him in a stroller, especially when we're heading down escalators, packing into crowded trains, or going out to public events or farmers markets. It is a must-have for the citymom.

product_title: Aurora Baby Talk My Fruit and Veggies 7" by Aurora
review_headline: OMG!  You HAVE to buy these!
review_body: OMG! We LOVE these little guys. I first accidentally picked up the safari animal set on vacation to a little zoo. The animals are so colorful and a perfect size for toddlers. As an educator I love the fact that the names are all embroidered into the sides of each animal. Some of the sounds are a little hoaky, but for this age group it works. It certainly provided hours of interaction between me and my child. Each set comes with its little carrying case, which also is a great size for the kids. These sets have traveled with us many places.    I have to mention the customer service of the company. What a friendly and helpful organization. My daughter wore out her favorite animal (the elephant) because she carried it EVERY WHERE! I called to see if I could buy a replacement and the company sent me one for FREE!!! WOW!    Needless to say we bought every set they have. A year and a half later they are still providing many hours of play and pretend time. My 7.5 yo will sit down and play with them as well as my husband.    Do yourself a favor and pick these up!

product_title: BABYBJORN Soft Toy
review_body: My daughter really enjoys this product. I thought it was too pricey at first, but it's well made and she spins the face and flowers on it and I use more links and add them to the bar and add other toys to them, so it is multifunctional for sure! Love it!

product_title: Sassy Soft Sided Toy Organizer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Large and cute but horrible smell!!!!!!!!
review_body: I read the reviews about the smell but since most of the reviews were positive I hoped that was an old (solved) problem. The chest arrive and was spacious and cute. My tot liked opening the lid and would not get hurt running into it. But the smell was noxious! It smells like just produced toxic plastic. I aired it out for 2 weeks (!) in another room. Then taking drastic measures (realizing that it ruins the chance of return but hoping to keep this oh so cute box) i dunked it into a cold bath. After it dried (which it did without any problems btw) it still smelled. So did the toys left in it overnight. Sadly the chest went to the curb...

product_title: Blue Silky Dragonfly Baby Crib Nursery Bedding Set 10 Pieces
review_body: This is a great bedding set.  It's a huge 10 piece set for less than the price of most 4 piece sets.

product_title: HALO SleepSack 100% Organic Cotton Wearable Blanket, Green/Blue Dots, Small
review_body: Our baby was able to bust out of a swaddle early on, even with the special velcro-ing (is that a verb?) blankets like the [[ASIN:B000TVZEVK Kiddopotamus & Co. Organic Cotton SwaddleMe - Ivory]].  With this product, he stays warm all through the night because he can't kick it off.  No 2am \\"I'm cold\\" crying, plus we don't have to worry about it ending up over his face.

product_title: Made For Mom Snack Trap, Colors and Styles May Vary
review_headline: Complete Failure to Perform as Advertised
review_body: Forget about taking the lid off - all the kid has to do is hold down one flap and turn the cup upside-down.  This can't be used for any small snacks, like Cheerios, which I'm sure most parents are using it for.  I've only had success with large crackers staying in here and, even then, if she tilts it upside-down, the small fragmented pieces fall out everywhere.  This snack trap just doesn't trap the snacks.  I'm going to try the one made by Munchkin.

product_title: Gerber Graduate BPA Free 2 Pack Fun Grips Spill Proof Cup, 7 Ounce, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have now replaced all our Avent sippy cups which have valves that get really dirty with these that are very easy to clean.  I only have the larger size.  Also noticed that there is an offer for a 3 pack that looks like you might really be getting just one cup.  Be careful when you order.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest 2-Pack Roller Shades (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have a VW Polo and this is too big for it... Ao the baby can't see the complete image...

product_title: Fisher-Price Power-Plus Plug-In Swing
review_body: My baby got this swing as a present, and we like it a lot. I love that you can plug it and you don't have to worry about changing the batteries.   The only thing I would change is the music.

product_title: Cosco Juvenile Soria Stroller Hoops  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Nice looking stroller. Awkward when folding and wheels don't work well. The trays are nice to have and the basket underneath is awesome!

product_title: Britax Advocate 65 CS Click & Safe Convertible Car Seat
review_headline: A car seat for MANY years
review_body: I ordered this for my grandson even though he's not quite big enough for it, but he will soon outgrow the Chicco Keyfit 30 he is now using, so it's nice to be ready for that day.  His daddy and I were immediately impressed by the Britax's sturdy appearance, i.e., is this a baby seat or an Air Force ejector seat!!  As with the Chicco, it has excellent harness controls and adjustments, unlike so many car seats we looked at that looked fine on first glance, but proved to have poorly designed harness gear and/or difficult adjustments.  Interestingly, the color instruction booklet is permanently attached so that one can easily recheck the instructions, if needed, or, as a matter of fact, after the seat is outgrown and  passed on, the next user will never have to guess about its proper installation.  Let's face it, this seat is NOT going to wear out anytime soon!  In addition, extremely helpful online installation videos are available.  My thought is that an interested buyer would definitely find these videos extremely helpful if for nothing else but to get a feel for the size of this unit.    And speaking of the size, that may be a problem.  It is too wide to use in a rear-facing way when placed in the center of the rear bench of my son's extra-cab pickup.  The seat's protective \\"wings\\" make the seat wider than the space between the front captain-style chairs.  In my 2003 Accord four-door sedan there is no problem in the forward-facing mode, but in the rear-facing mode, the front seat back has to be adjusted.  For the most part, this seat will be installed in my daughter-in-law's mini-van on a more or less permanent fashion.  With extra sturdiness comes extra weight, and this grandma, by myself, would be hard pressed to install and remove it frequently.    One other complaint:  Although the recommended poundage begins with a five pound baby, one would be insane to use this chair for a baby that small - unless you're prepared to somehow stuff the extra space in order to avoid potential whiplash, and it's still not a good idea.    In conclusion, this seat would rate five stars if all cars did not have the drawbacks ours do.  BUT IT IS A BEAUTY!

product_title: Evenflo X Sport Plus Convenience Stroller
review_body: We purchased this stroller (to add to our collection) because we had moved to NYC and needed an easy stroller to use when I was out with just 1 child. It is a great umbrella stroller, the under the seat storage is nice, my girls like that they can put stuff under there from the front. The \\"cup holders\\" hold no cups, just kid stuff and gum. It is a total pain to fold, it takes 2 hands (really 3 because you need to fold the stroller with 2 and mind the toddler as well), and the latch to keep the stroller folded is impossible. It is not an urban stroller because if you ever want to use the bus or subway you are forever wrestling with the latching mechanism and the folding switch. So we are biting the bullet to buy the Maclaren, to also add to our collection...

product_title: Beaba Babycook, from Williams-Sonoma WS
review_headline: I love my BabyCook and can't imagine preparing my baby's food any other way
review_body: We got the Baby cook as a shower gift, I put it in the closet and there it sat until my twins reached 6 months.  I decided to give it a try when we got the go ahead to try solids,, and i LOVE IT. I feel wonderful knowing that my babies are getting organic veggies and fruit, and no other additives, I can mix foods easily in the blender as well. I typically will do 3 batches of one type of fruit/veggie and do 3-5 ice cube trays of it.. I don't plan on ever feeding my girls from a jar, no need to with the babycook :) LOVE IT!!!

product_title: BabyBjorn Soft Bib
review_body: The Baby Bjorn bib collects so much food in the small pocket and saves on cleaning.  It is easily washed in the sink and is also dishwasher safe.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Deluxe Convertible Car Seat, Granite  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Not a great seat, get a  Britax
review_body: This is not a very well-designed seat. The angle of the back doesn't seem comfortable for our kids, and certainly not for our infant. The pillow, as others have noted, is way too far forward. It pushes their heads forward - just a bizarre design. The straps or ok, but they do tend to get twisted, and the buckle is fairly hard to release, especially with one hand. The Britax Roundabout is not all that much more money than this, and it is so much better in design and safety. I would advise against this seat.

product_title: LLLI Washable Nursing Pads #60-0726
review_headline: good to have but not to rely on
review_body: I tried these along with several kinds of disposable pads and the unique \\"continuously usable\\" ones.  These are comfortable and a nice moderate size and discreet concave shape, though they did get a bit lumpy after the initial washing.  They are not waterproof or especially absorbent, however, and soak through pretty easily.  If I were using these exclusively, I would need a few packages (at two pairs per) to get to the next laundry.

product_title: Vulli Chan Pie Gnon Soft Natural Rubber Teether - Comes In Gift Boxes
review_headline: I like it more than my daughter does
review_body: I like the non-toxic soft squeaky toy, but my duaghter is not very interested.  She likes Sofie better, but honestly she likes the old toxic plastic toys the best.  Go figure.

product_title: GEENNY Boutique 13 Piece Crib Bedding Set, Lavender Butterfly
review_headline: Not quite what we had envisioned
review_body: We are doing our daughters nursery in purple and white butterflies, so we thought we had found the perfect crib set... however, upon receiving it, we discovered that everything is outlined prominently in gold thread - not what we were expecting, or hoping for. We were quite disappointed and returned it in exchange for a simple purple and white gingham set from Pottery Barn. The seller was wonderful - the product, disappointing.

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Potty
review_headline: My son is EAGER to go potty on this ~CUTE FROG~ potty chair!!!
review_body: My son just turned 2 and we begin potty training next week. I bought this about 3 months ago and just let my son get used to sitting on his potty chair. This is absolutely adorable, and my son BEGS me to go sit on \\"fwoggy potty\\"! And he has peed a couple of times (I didn't even expect that!) I love that it has a splash guard so he does not make a huge mess. A big plus, especially with a BOY. It is super convenient to clean, the blue part lifts out. There are 2 handles on the side and one at the top of the chair. I also like that this is a wide potty, it is easy for my son to sit on and get off of.    I recommend it to everyone!! - It is a WONDERFUL buy at just $13!!

product_title: Graco Snugride Infant Car Seat Base
review_body: My grandaughter uses the Graco Snug Ride car seat.  Her day care regulations say baby comes in and leaves in her car seat.  We needed extra bases...the baby will always be with the carrier.  This was perfect.  Grandmother doesn't need the whole seat - just the base.  My son said that this base \\"seated\\" into the car seat better than the original base that came with it. srs

product_title: Gummi Crib Rail
review_body: This lasted a day on my daughter's crib.  It didn't stick at all! She pulled it right off and continued to chew on the crib!

product_title: Safety 1St Comfy Cushy 3-in-1 Potty
review_body: The biggest issue we had was that the shield was too small/low and our 2yo had a hard time being able to pee into it when seated. The ring itself is pretty small too, so if your child is on the large side I'd opt for something else.

product_title: K's Kids The Hungry Pelican (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this toy - it has lasted two kids and still in perfect condition.  The pelican's belly doubles as a pacifier holder - our daughter knows where to go looking for them when it's naptime and she puts them away there too when it's time to wake up.  I've also noticed that both our kids for some odd reason liked to snuggle underneath the pelican's fuzzy feet while they are sleeping (it just barely touches their foreheads when lying down) - at first we used to move them because it seemed uncomfortable but they just go back - they really seem to like it. It makes some crinkly and some (quiet) squeeking sounds - more subtle than many toys these days. A perfect crib toy.

product_title: JJ Cole Essentials Blanket
review_body: Finally something easy to clean and take around town with a little one in tow.  Folds up very easily.  Is a little on the heavy side which is great because it does not blow around or shift while in use.

product_title: Dex Products Universal Safe Sleeper Bed Rail
review_headline: Good Product for Lower Bunk on Bunk Ben
review_body: this was a great purchase for our bunk beds.  It works great on the lower bunk, the folding hinges in the middle works really well.  Leaves plenty of room to get in and out of the bed when it is up.  Assembly was easy, read the directions but don't follow them, common sense works better then the directions.  Very sturdy, good investment.

product_title: Nuby 6 Pack No Spill Nuby Nipples, 0-6 Months, Clear
review_headline: Milk on the floor no more!
review_body:
Well, I've bought these nipples for three different kids. Their only flaw is that they can wear out kind of quickly, but it's pretty obvious, if they leak, they need to be replaced. As the other mom said, if you push the nipple cleaning brush into them too hard you can rip the nipple itself, but I've only seen that happen when they were pretty well used to begin with.

One of the reviews said that their baby couldn't get anything out of the bottle, that just sounds silly to me.

These are the only bottle nipples I have ever found that don't leak. I particularly love them for children who are of the age of crawling and walking about, and not quite ready for a sippy cup. If you have a newborn, this probably isn't the right product for you, and it'd be kind of silly. A newborn isn't the one constantly knocking over a bottle or leaving it on it's side. I like to use bottles over sippy cups because they are easier to clean by far. Also, my kids just haven't transitioned well from a soft nipple to a hard spout. Any soft spout sippy I've hated, leaked and was difficult to clean. These nipples though solved the whole problem altogether, I keep them on the bottle a little bit longer, and don't have milk all over my house. I highly recommend them.

product_title: Majestic Anaheim Angels Newborn Girl Pink Onesie, Bib, and Booties 3-6 mos.
review_body: The product looks great. My wife was delighted to see it. We have a an unborn baby girl due in January. so this will be prefect for opening night 2010.

product_title: Aosom Baby Kids Wooden Playpen Room Divider 8 Panel
review_body: I have a very wide curved set of stairs to my 2nd level.  I was looking for a gate that would fit accross the bottom and most gates are not that wide.  This gate/playpen was more reasonable in price and you could connect it to a wall.  After putting it together, (very simple) I am totally pleased.  It is so awesome, I can also use it for around the christmas tree if needed, it is huge.    Thanks

product_title: BabyDoll Extravaganza Bassinet Liner/Skirt & Hood
review_body: The quality was as expected. The problems I encountered were 1 where the hood attaches to the bassinet did not match where the connections were on the bassinet, and two the hood did not seem to fit my expectations.

product_title: Winnie the Pooh Spin Garden Gym
review_body: This is my new baby shower gift.  My daughter had issues with \\"Tummy Time\\" and if I had had this product it might have been a little easier and more fun for her.  We had some tummy toys for her but they never kept her interest.

product_title: Sassy Baby's Mam 9 oz. Girl 3 pack Bottle
review_body: I orginally got this product after some concerns that the Playtex drop-in bottles/liners that I had were not BPA free. I did some research and found that these Mam bottles were BPA free and fairly inexpensive in comparison with other brands (such as Born Free). My husband and I love them! They have dramatically reduced the amount of gas that our daughter has had. This has lead to a happier baby with less crying and waking up at night with gas, which has made us much happier too. I also am still supplimenting with breastmilk and found that our daughter now seems better able to get milk out and not get upset that it is not flowing as fast as her other bottles used to. The bottle insert said that the shape and design of the nipples used were more similar to the mouth movements needed when breastfeeding than traditional nipples. We intend to use these right from the start with any future children. The only problems we have had were that if you do not assemble all the pieces correctly the bottle will leak and we had to buy more slow flow nipples to use with the large sized bottles as the faster flow was too fast for now. Also, I could not find the insert on how to correctly assemble the bottles in the larger sized bottles, but it came in smaller ones. We would definately reccomend this product!

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planet Potty
review_body: I really love the price, design, and simplicity of this little potty.  I bought it for my 17month old and my only complaint is in the awkwardness the froggies eyes make for my sons toddler sized legs.  The eyes are so big they prevent my son from closing his little legs together and force him to 'spread eagle'.  This makes for an uneasy sit on/ get off.  Other than that this potty is fun and really accentuates his interest in toilet training!

product_title: Maclaren Easy Traveller Stroller, Black and Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: No one mentioned this tiny little fact:
review_body: I am sure the Maclaren Easy Traveller is everything everyone says it is. I myself have a Quest for my 2 year old & couldn't be happier. That is why I purchased to Easy Traveller for my baby on the way. I thought how could I go wrong?   I read all the wonderful reviews and knew I'd love it too. Except for the fact that no one has mentioned its size. It is HUGE. I was only assuming it'd be the size of my Quest & I could use stroller adaptors to connect the two if need be. That definitely isn't happening. I am still shocked by its size. I am so sad to send it back for a refund. Its size just isn't for me. Just to descibe a little more for the people who expect it to be Quest-sized, it is about as wide as a Graco Quattro Tour & very tall.   I just figured I'd take the time to share my opinion as I really appreciated everyone else's while I was on my search.

product_title: Britax Boulevard Convertible Car Seat
review_body: My Wife, Daughter, and I All Love This New Car Seat. Even The Firefighters Who Installed It Were Impressed.

product_title: Bath Toys: The Adventures of Patch the Pirate and his Pirate Ship
review_body: These are super cute and much bigger than I thought they would be. They are made out of soft terrycloth and are absolutely adorable. The only thing stopping me from giving them 5 stars is the price. $15 for bath toys is a little much, but if you're willing to pay, you won't be disappointed.

product_title: Playtex Baby Create My Own Cup Insulated & Spill-Proof Cup: Turquoise BPA Free
review_body: You can find this cup for $5 on ebay. I can't believe someone is trying to sell this for $14.95 and $7 to ship it. What a rip off. They should be ashamed. This is a great cup. I make my own monogramed inserts for them. My son loves it!

product_title: The First Years Compass B510 Deluxe Folding Adjustable Booster Car Seat - Aspen (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Great booster seat. My son loves it. We plan on buying another one for our daughter who is very jealous after seeing this one. Easy to use. There is a lot of padding and when my son fell asleep in the car today his head did not flop forward, he seemed very comfortable. The shoulder strap fits great and it is in the right place with the guide so it can not slip off.

product_title: Medela Breast Feeding Contact Nipple Shield
review_headline: Wonderful - but sometimes hard to find in the stores
review_body: The Medela contact nipple shield is a great product.  My grandaughter won't nurse without it.  My daughter recently moved and almost panicked when she couldn't find them in the store.  Thanks to Amazon we were able to ship her several.  Medela makes a great product, from the nipple shields to the bottles to the breast pump.

product_title: Tiny Love Symphony-in-Motion Mobile- Farm Yard
review_body: I thinkthe mobile is abolutely adorable, just wish the music played for longer periods of time.

product_title: North States Industries Superyard Playard
review_body:
This is very heavy so that it cannot be lifted by any young child. My 8 year old cannot lift it. But it can slide a little if your child puts their weight on it. It will not topple over as this is impossible. I use it to block my garage so that my 2 year old doesn't run out of the garage and into the street. Once your child is too big to fit in a playpen, you can get this so that they have more room to play, but still have them contained.

It is very difficult during the first few times you open and close it. But it does loosen up and becomes easy enough to setup alone. It is actually better that the joints don't move so easily so that your child cannot change the shape of the play yard when they push against it.

product_title: BébéSounds Portable MiniFridge
review_headline: Had not had a chance to return it
review_body: It arrived the day before we were leaving on a 2-week trip, plugged it in the night before and nothing, followed the instructions to a tee and nothing.  Had to rush out (few hours before we left) and purchase another brand of mini-fridge.  I have not had the time to return it or contact Amazon, but in the fine print it says return to manufacturer and not Amazon.  It does not seem like it will be a easy process.  Fridge is cheaply made (that's Ok if it would work).

product_title: Kathe Kruse Stuffed Grabbing Toy, Giraffe (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My youngest LOVES this, he cannot go to bed without it.  It has stained a bit after lots of teething done on it's poor ears and head.  Overall though it stands up to everything!  He carries it around by the neck.  Worth the money!

product_title: BABYBJORN Safe Step
review_body: This is a great little step but it is not cheap.  Recently I found a functionaly equivalent step (non-slip top, broad stance, rubber feed) at a local hardware store that is a little bigger and taller with a weight capacity of 300 lbs for half the price.

product_title: Dreamer Design® Ditto Jogging Stroller
review_body:
I really do love this. It's VERY light and VERY easy to handle. The seats are roomy so I know I will get a few more years out of this.

The back pockets provide ample storage for diapers and wipes if you need to take them along. I don't recommend hanging a heavy diaper bag over the handles. It made the stroller tip backward. Although, I did have water bottles and a lot of my own stuff in there -- but anyway something to think about. This just goes to show you how light the stroller really is.

Also, if you plan to do a lot of shopping the basket underneath isn't all that great. It is easier to get to than most strollers I've dealt with, though.

Folding this jogger can be a bit tricky in the beginning. It tends to pop up and fold down again depending on how you're holding it. I wish there was a better mechanism for keeping it closed flat for storage or for transporting in the vehicle.

Another thing that kind of bugs me, and maybe me more than the babies, is that the shoulder straps are a pain to get in and out of. The strap release is a pain (however I can only really compare that of carseats). They also seem really uncomfortable... But it could be that the babies are only 1 and as they get older the straps will probably fit better.

At any rate, this is a GREAT stroller. It's VERY smooth. I think you'll really like it.

I had no problem getting around sidewalks in the little town of Ventura... you won't fit through any single-doors so think about that if you plan to use it as your primary stroller.

Have fun!

:)
Janie

product_title: aden + anais Classic Muslin Swaddle Blanket 4 Pack, Blue and White (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These have quickly become some of our favorite baby wraps since our son was born nearly 2 weeks ago. They are very soft, lightweight but warm, and big enough to really wrap him up like a burrito. They have a slight stretch/give to them that makes them wrap well, and they're pretty too. I bought another set just yesterday because I like them so much!! Haven't tried them as nursing covers yet, but they also are nice to use as an extra layer over the baby's lower half in the car seat, with the Bundle Me over it. I really, really recommend these and I will be buying them for others, too.

product_title: Scandinavian Child Anka Convertible High Chair in Espresso
review_body: I love the the way this chair looks (Like furniture) if that is what you are looking for it is awesome. It is very difficult to clean, food gets trapped in all of the cracks, the tray does not slide in close.. Those are really the only two downs, it has felt pads on the bottom so it slide on hardwood floors. They are small and covert into a youth chair, so that is a great feature.

product_title: Graco Snugride Infant Car Seat, Tangothe Tongo
review_body: I was bit skeptical about buying this car seat,because of the reviews i read but i decided to go with it since it looked a whole lot similar to the one my older child had used.I'm glad i went with it because it suites our needs perfectly,now that we have twins.I have no complaints.

product_title: BABYBJORN Baby Carrier Active, Black/Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Baby Bjorn was the pioneer for baby carriers 10 years ago but since then there has been an explosion in the market - slings, front carriers, pouches, etc.  The BEST, in my honest opinion, is the Ergo.  The baby sits with correct posture (The Bjorn is not so great for the baby's spine) and the parent is not in pain!  I can walk for hours with my 20 lb baby in the Ergo -- not so in the Bjorn.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Bouncer
review_body: This is such a wonderful toy for the price! Honestly the best bouncer I've seen on the market. We've used the bouncer portion since my son was born and the toy attachment since he was 2 or 3 months old. He's now 5 and a half months and still uses it daily when I need to get things done. He loves all the lights and music! We use it while my husband and I eat sometimes and you can switch from songs to rainforest so we say we eat \\"in the jungle\\"! Great buy...worth every cent!

product_title: Boon Frog Pod Bath Toy Scoop,Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
