review_body: I read the other reviews, I don't know why it hasn't stuck for some and has for others.  We used the enclosed adhesive and it works great for us!  Maybe it helps that we don't actually take our showers in that bathroom (have a shower stall closer to our room) so it never gets steamy in there.  If it does come down, I'll put it back up with silicone caulk, that stuff holds really well even in wet steamy places.  Our little girl loves to put her toys away in the basket which we can then hang up out of her reach.

product_title: The First Years Double Electric Breast Pump
review_headline: Great affordable option for a breast pump
review_body: This pump gets the job done at a great price!!  My only complaint is that I prefer the medela bottles over the bottles that come with this pump and of course the bottles aren't compatible.  Also, the breast shields that came with the pump were way too small for my breasts (I'm a 38DD) and I had to call the company for larger ones. They did send them though free of charge which definitley impressed me! Overall, I am very pleased with this purchase and saved probably at least $100.

product_title: Electronic Puzzle Bug
review_body: I bought this along with some other toys for my daughter when she was 1 yo to take on a flight to Hawaii.  It did not keep her attention.  Now that she is 2, she can figure it out quite quickly so it still does not hold her attention for long.  I'm not quite sure for what age this is appropriate.

product_title: Disney Soft Spout Sippy, 10 Ounce by The First Years/Learning Curve
review_body: This is THE BEST cup when you're switching from bottle to cup!  I've gone through TONS of them, and this one is the best in that it's super easy to clean, it has the soft nipple, AND (an important one), the nipple doesn't crack and present a gaping hole!    You have to try it!

product_title: Fisher-Price Take Along Swing- Woodlands
review_headline: Great swing without all the bells and whistles
review_body: I just bought this swing for my 3 mo. old granddaughter.  I agree with previous writers that the speed is pretty much the same on all settings.  A very slow speed would have been ideal.  So far I am happy with the purchase since my granddaughter is sound asleep in the swing and that's what I was hoping for!  I like how compact the swing is too.  I will update my review of this item down the road.

product_title: Summer Infant Rite-Temp Baby Bath Tub
review_body: I used baby bath tubs designed to fit in the kitchen sink with my 3 kids and was surprised to find them not readily available in stores anymore when my oldest had twins. This tub is similar to the ones I used and better designed. Why lean over a bathtub when you can comfortably bathe babies in the kitchen sink?

product_title: Lady Bug Crib Quilt
review_body: My daughter likes the lady bug pattern on this quilt.  It shipped fast and seems to be made well.

product_title: Graco Mobile Entertainer Jungle Crew
review_body: This Graco walker does the job.  My 6 mos old can get from point A to point B pretty easily.  The only complaint I have which I did read in the other reviews is that the toy tray it comes with isn't that entertaining for him.  But the upside to that is the toy tray is removable and I can give him his own toys to play with on the tray.  Also the back wheels don't turn as well.  Overall, I would recommend this product, what you see is what you get!

product_title: Britax Advocate 65 CS Click & Safe Convertible Car Seat
review_headline: The best safety money can buy!
review_body:
My son is eight months old and was ready to move out of his starter seat into something bigger. I wanted something that we could, of course, still use rear facing until he was at least a year old, then use forward facing until we no longer needed a car seat.

I also wanted the top notch in safety that I could buy. As I researched this purchase, I learned more and more about the deadly effects of side impact collisions and how limited most children's car seats are in terms of protection from this type of event. Fortunately, Britax has done their homework and this seat builds on the pioneering work they've already done with side impact protection on the Boulveard. This seat has two huge crash energy absorption pads on either side to limit damage and protect kids from smashing their face into glass in a side collision.

The seat also has a tether feature that I've attached to my overhead tether connectors in the back of my Infiniti FX35 and this monster is going absolutely nowhere.

Installation was a snap, took me about fifteen minutes. Just remember to put it in full recline before installing it if you're installing it rear facing.

While the safety is clearly the key rationale for spending this money, I also feel good knowing my little guy is comfy cozy in what has to be one of the plushest car seats ever made. This thing is the kid version of a Heavenly Bed.

While the side panels certainly make it larger than the Boulevard, it is easily manageable for taking on airplane trips if you're going on vacation. We took it with us to St. Croix and had no problems. However, I do feel it is big enough that it's not something you're going to want to remove from your car on a daily basis.

Feel good knowing you purchased the safest seat money can buy and your baby won't mind the fact that he's sleeping in a giant marshmallow!

product_title: Kiddopotamus Duomat 2 in 1 Car Seat Protector Mat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This mat really protects your leather seats. It is easy to clean and install. The front pocket is a plus!

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Booster Seat, Yellow and Orange (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Wonderful booster, don't even bother with a high chair!
review_body: I can't say enough good things about this booster chair.  I have two of them, one for each of my toddlers.  My only regret is that I didn't buy this booster from the get-go and avoid the high chair completely!  I spent $90 on a Graco high chair that did not work well at all for my first child.  So, with my second child, I used this booster from the get-go when she started solids (about 5-6 months of age in our case) and it worked just fine for a baby as small as her...even better than the high chair, in fact.      I love that you can put the tray very close to their body if you want to help avoid spilling down into the high chair, and you can also have the tray set back further for when they get bigger (there are three tray settings).  It's so much less bulky than a regular high chair.  It's very affordable.  And best of all...no fabric or difficult-to-clean nooks and crannies!  This chair is so easy to clean.  Both of my girls seemed plenty comfortable in it, too, despite no soft fabric on it.  In fact, they seemed much more comfy in these boosters than they did in the big padded high chair that just kind of swallowed them up when they were little.    The only reason I rated this booster chair four stars instead of five is because I wish you could boost it a little bit higher.  My youngest child is 2 years old and we have the seat at the highest setting, but it's still not quite high enough to have her sit directly up to the table with us.  Yes, she is on the short side, but not THAT short.  Now that she's 2, we'd rather have her sitting right at the table with us than still sitting a little ways back from the table and using the tray on her booster.  So, now I'm in the market for a taller booster chair.  But, I have no regrets about this purchase and the Fisher Price booster has served us very well up until now.  I will certainly be using it for my next baby, too, as soon as he or she start solid foods.

product_title: Hawaii Medial Gumdrop Pacifier - Newborn, Natural Scent
review_body: My son dosn't really like pacifiers, but he loves this one. He seems to be able to keep it in his mouth a lot easier and it just fits his face much better than the rest. He prefers the vanilla scented gumdrop the most. He is now 4 months old and still loves it!

product_title: Britax Frontier Booster Car Seat
review_body: I now own two britax car seat and have been completely satisfied with both.  The Frontier is not only stylish but durable.  The Britax company really stands behind their products with comfort as well as saftey when it comes to our children. Plus this car seat will grow with my daughter as she grows.  I just recieved it in the mail a couple a days ago and had no problems installing it...

product_title: UPPAbaby VISTA Stroller - Black
review_body: I purchased the 2009 Uppababy Vista after much research and obsession over strollers. I was looking for a versitile, durable stroller that would hold up over years of nearly daily walking. My 6 month old daughter is very happy in it. Here are some thoughts...     Pros:   1) Maneuvarability!! This stroller rides like a dream. The foam tires, suspension, lightweight alumininum frame, and responsive steering make for a remarkably smooth ride. Bumps, cracks, gravel, etc, are no problem and will not wake a sleeping baby. Also, adjustable handle bar and curved lower frame bar make this stroller comfortable for people of all heights to push. My husband (6 ft) could not push my previous stroller (Graco stroller frame) because his feet were always hitting the bottom bar. We don't have that problem with the vista.     2) Stroller can grow with baby and family. The included bassinet is great. When baby gets older, you can replace it with the seat that can face toward you initiallly, and away from you as your baby is ready to see the world. It is a sinch to switch around. The seat is also very easy to recline without waking a baby who falls asleep in the upright position.     Uppababy is also making a toddler seat (to be released in Spring 2009) that can be attached to the rear of the stroller, making it the second stroller ever to convert from a single to a double stroller. (Phil and Ted's is the first...but it is MUCH more cumbersome as a single stroller. It is more like a jogger and does not have nearly as nice a ride or as many features.) This was the selling feature for me. I figured I could justify spending the extra money on the Uppababy, since I won't have to buy a whole new stroller if I have another child.     3) Features and accessories. This stroller comes with a bug net, rain cover, and fabulous basket that is more easibly accessible in the 2009 model.     4) Easy to fold and fairly compact when folded. The only downside about folding is that the seat has to be inthe front facing position in order to fold it with seat on.     5) Style. I actually am a bit embarassed by how sweet the vista looks! You may risk looking a bit yuppy-ish, but the stroller is very classy and sleak! I have it in Red (\\"Denny\\" ), which is a really nice red.     Cons:   1) Price. As far as strollers go, this is on the pricey end. Again, if you are looking for a single stroller that can serve as a dual stroller down the line, then you should consider the 2009 model that will allow for the addition of a toddler seat. This might help justify the price. Also, comparing the Uppa to the Bugaboos, the vista is a much better value and I actually prefer the ride.     2) Fairly wide. Not wide enough to make a huge difference, but perhaps a bit wider than the average stroller.     3)Seat is still slightly reclined in the most upright position. I don't think this is a big deal, but it would have been nice to see a fourth, upright seating position.     4) No cup holder! Must be purchased separately. :~(     Hope this helps. We love it and I think it's worth every penny spent.

product_title: Superball Machine Science Kit
review_body: I bought this kit for my son for Christmas. He loves bouncy balls and I thought how perfect that he can make his own! I was sorely disappointed in the product however. The only thing good I have to say about it is the idea of a kid making their own toy is fabulous. But when it doesn't make the product as you expect it's kind of a let down. The balls are very easy to make, and they are nice and colorful. That however is the extent of all things good about the product. The ball it makes is not super bouncy like a normal bouncy ball is. They are hard right off the start and then very quickly get hard again, so hard that they will not bounce at all. Basically the kit is fun for a single day use, you can have the fun making the ball and then play with it that day, after that it's too hard to do much with. While it's not an expensive kit, for a single day worth of use it's a little pricey. Overall I would have to say I would not recommend this kit to anyone. If they could improve the product and have it make a real bouncy ball I would definitely give it a try.

product_title: Combi Cosmo DX Lightweight Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Some nice features, but not the best...
review_body: I went on a search for the perfect stroller.  I had a hands on trial of this one.  It is nice and has some great features, but the wheels aren't that great and it is a little difficult to steer.  I much, much prefer the Graco Deluxe IPO and it is less expensive.  Just my two cents.

product_title: The First Years Microwave Sterilizer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I use this item everyday.  This item was shipped in great condition and in a timely manner.   Good Product!

product_title: Safety 1st Dream Bear Swing Time Hammock
review_body: I layed my baby down in this thing and it BROKE at the end! DO NOT buy this hammock it's horrible. I tried to contact safety first and they told me too bad they can send me a replacement at a good price. Why would I ever want to fix it? I tried to get my money back. This is a horrible product please for the safety of your child don't buy this

product_title: Fisher-Price Power Plus Swing
review_body: Love it! super cute! love that it is battery and a/c adapter ready! Not many swings offer that! And anything fisher price is amazing quality! And if not, they always stand by their products! Awesome company

product_title: Keekaroo High Chair With insert and Tray
review_body: While assembling, I thought there were going to be some issues.  Some things just didn't seem \\"right\\".  Wasn't sure if I had things assembled incorrectly, but it's reallly so simple.  This was partly due to how the optional cushions (recommend) fit into the assembly.  But, after making final adjustments and using a couple times, my wife and I are very pleased with this high chair.  It's stylish, too, and that was one of our main buying points.  We needed a high chair, but didn't want some childish looking contraption stood up in our nice dining area.    It also proved quite convenient the other day when some visitors came with their children.  The little girl, 6 years old, fit right into the high chair after taking the table attachment off.  It served as a perfect booster chair solution.  Now we know this one will serve our needs for many years to come!

product_title: Summer Infant Bath Sling With Fold (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Wish I Did Not Buy This
review_body: I really just wanted to use this product while giving my nephew a sponge bath instead of bathing him in the sink. So to test this out I put it on my couch and then put my nephew on it and he kept sliding down it. Thank God I did not put him in this thing in the sink before I tested it out. I just went ahead and bought an infant tub. I dont know what I am going to do with this thing. I know it does not cost much but I think you would do better to buy an infant tub with a sling.

product_title: Britax Frontier Booster Car Seat, Red Rock (Prior Model)
review_body: We owned the previous version of a Britax booster for our older child- the one without the harness or LATCH.  So we ordered this one for our younger child, thinking it would be perfect.  It is, but BOY is it wide.  In the width and weight categories, it is much more like a standard Britax (think Marathon) than a regular \\"big kid\\" seat.  Of course it's the safest thing out there, and to judge by the way my 2 year old loves it, I think it must be more comfortable than her non-Britax as well.    Like any Britax, it's an investment compared to other seats in this class, but the flexibility it gives with the removable harness and adjustable headrest should mean it is the last seat we buy for her until she it big enough to ride without anything.  I think it will be well-worth it.

product_title: Bumbo Baby Sitter - Pink
review_body: I got this item for my baby shower a year ago. I put it in my garage thinking that it was dumb. Well it turns out I had a child that didnt like being put down nor being put in the pack and play. Unless she was a part of things she was not happy...which is hard for a baby that is 6 weeks old. This chair is heaven sent! I know it is a \\"hot\\" item now and some people are unhappy with it, but apparently their kids are either MUCH bigger or much stronger than my daughter. She is now 10 1/2 months old and we are still using it. Not as much because she grew out of the \\"always being held\\" stage, but we use it instead of a high chair! It is amazing! Having a child that isnt screaming is AMAZING...please watch them well in this seat. I put her on couter tops and things until she was big enough to squirm and now she is NEVER on raised surfaces! We now have the tray too, which made the life of this product extend quite a bit!! Highly recommended!!!

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ
review_body: We have had an older version (or design) which we have had happily used for about a year and a half until 2 years ago. Then the insulation lining wore off and we trashed it. Shortly before my daughter was born, we purchased our second Diaper Champ. That was a year ago. It was supposed to be improved in design. Unfortunately, they totally botched it.    First, we had to wrap around the velcros and all pointy corners of the diaper into a perfect ball to be able to dispose it. Otherwise, it would get caught in the two-way flipping mechanism. We either had to push the so-called \\"one hand flip handle top\\" in by hand or we had to open top to release the stuck diapers.    Second, they designed the new body to be wider at the bottom and narrower at the top. So when the trash bag filled up all diapers settled down at the bottom. As we tried to pull the bag up we struggled to pass the big belly of the trash bag filled with soiled diapers through the narrower opening of the pail.     I give two stars because if you can use this pail paying attention to the pointers above, it does not emit any odors. It keeps the bad smell in. And you don't have to pay extra for special bags.    We haven't been able to use our \\"new\\" diaper pail for a long time, because of these reasons.

product_title: NTM-910YLW - Sony Baby Call Nursery Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This baby monitor is perfect: It has many channels, and it was easy to find one that worked without interference. The sound quality is great and easily controlled. There's even a setting you can use that broadcasts only when the baby cries (you don't have to listen to all that fuzzy background stuff constantly like you do on some monitors). It's easy to set up and use, and my husband and I are very pleased with it.

product_title: Baby B'Air Flight Vest
review_headline: No complaint about product, but hardly used it on our flight.
review_body: The product is made well.  I have no complaints about the Baby B'Air Toddler Flight Vest.  I wish you could use it on take off and landing, but you are not supposed to do so.  That is an FAA limitation, not the fault of Baby B'Air.  We did hit some turbulence on our flight across the country to California, and we put it on our 11 month old then.  However, for most of the trip, our baby wanted to face us, and the way this vest is designed, the baby sits in your lap, facing away from you.  I would bring it with us again on future flights to put on her when the pilot announces that there will be turbulence, but she probably won't wear it if there is smooth flying.

product_title: The First Years Soothie Bottle Starter Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: After my daughter was born, I was unable to get her to latch on. The hospital also gave her the pacifier in the nursery and she seemed to become overly attached to it. We started using the cheap nipples that the hospital gave us and she was spitting up very frequently, choking, and coughing alot. One day I decided to buy one of these bottles from walmart to try to decrease her \\"need\\" for the pacifier. Not only did she not need it as much but her feeding issues dropped dramatically! That night, I went back to walmart and bought this set for around $14.00. The only problem is the frequent need to wash them if you only have one set. I would recommend getting the set along with extra bottles and nipples. These made my nights much, much easier. My baby girl sleeps better without the gas issues.

product_title: Graco SnugRider Infant Car Seat Stroller Frame (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: this stroller is very compact and convenient. I never really liked big stollers so this one is perfect if you dont like traveling bulky.

product_title: Sunshine Kids Radian XT Convertible Car Seat
review_body: This car seat is awesome and all the negative things that I read about it before buying it are definetly outweighed by the positive.  i own a 2008 jeep patriot and have three small children. I needed to be able to fit three car seats across the back seat.  With only 51 inches of hip room this seemed tough the radian made it easy.  Even with two other larger carseats it would fit fine.  Also i love the side wings on the XT it makes me feel like my childs head would be very protected in the event of a side impact crash.  My three year old whom is very tall for her age at 41 inches still has pleanty of growing room I expect to be able to keep her in a harness till she is atleast six years old in this seat.  Yes it is heavy but not any heavier than the britax frontier and it folds making it easy for traveling. Love it will be buying another one for my other daughter.

product_title: Sassy Baby Powdered Formula Dispenser, Colors May Vary (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I used to bring a tuberware of formula which would get everywhere and now that I use this dispenser, there are no messes and no powder everywhere.  I highly recommend it!!

product_title: Evenflo SimpleStep Pressure Gate Taupe (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These gates are wonderful. They are extremely easy to install and easy to use. They are tall enough that my German Shepherd can't get over them and the spaces are small enough that my Pommie and Jack Russell can't get through them. The taupe color makes them perfect for any color setting. I would highly recommend these gates to anyone.

product_title: Skip Hop Splash - Poppy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Fantastice product.  Easy drying for clean bottles, bottle accessories, and sippy cups and easy access for further daily use.  Easy to take apart and clean.  Everying that has been washed is not all over the place.  I would recommend for others to use.  I will buy this as a gift for new parents.

product_title: On the Go Potty in Blue
review_headline: Very small, just like a toy...
review_body: Just be aware of its size: it is very small. But on the other hand, it meets the need of easy-use and portability for private time.

product_title: Baby Einstein Lights & Melodies Discovery Center (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: it is my baby's favorite toy. she enjoys from 2 month to 8 month age and her cousin loves it when he visited our house. he is 11 months old.   she plays lie down when I change her diaper and usually she likes to play standing up.   even my puppy likes to press button for music.

product_title: Fisher-Price 4-in-1 Total Clean High Chair
review_body: Just purchased this high chair for my 8 month old son. It was super easy to put together. The colors are so pretty & go perfectly with my decor. It's easy to wipe clean & the tray comes off easily with one hand. The brown headrest is useless, but other than that, I love this chair & so does my little monkey!

product_title: Baby Trend Galaxy Flex-Loc Infant Car Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Good CR review, but don't be fooled
review_body: We bought this seat rather blindly based on it's good safety rating on Consumer Reports.  Bad idea...    Not that this seat won't do what it's intended to do, mind you.  But it is a painful ordeal to install the base in our cars, which do not have the LATCH connectors for the middle-back-seat (i.e., the only position that works well for this seat+base).  The painful problem with the base is two-fold:    1) The place where you thread the seat belt is VERY narrow and not channel-like.  Thus very hard to thread a belt through w/o rasping your knuckles.    2) The place where you thread the seat belt is VERY close to the crook of the seat, which makes it VERY hard to tighten properly unless your shorter belt-buckle-strap is shorter than our cars (2000 and 2001 sedans).    Besides the major aggravation with installing this seat there are two other issued worth mentioning.    It is also very difficult for me (partly due to my back problems) to unclasp my child from this seat while kneeling in the backseat.  This is due the two things:    3) The two latches for positioning the handle are VERY tough to dis-engage.    4) Both the upper and lower buckles are hard to dis-engage one-handed.    We also don't like how heavy the seat is, though the handle-shape clearly helps.  Lesson learned: don't trust good safety ratings alone.  Try it out first.

product_title: Graco TotBloc Pack 'N Play with Carry Bag
review_body: I did not buy this item at amazon, I bought it 8 years ago at the store and it was perfect!!!! My son was very big for his age and having a big playpen like that was grate. 8 years later I just had another boy. Just got this out of the storage, it was just like new. Love it, toys on every side keep my little one entertained. Best of all its easy to fold, or move out of the way.   simply the best, totally worth every penny.

product_title: My Creative Cookery Club
review_headline: Perfect kitchen for 2 yr old boy
review_body: My son just got this for Christmas and it is just a wonderful wooden toy. My husband followed the directions without problem and had it together in 20 minutes. The kitchen is sized perfectly for a 2 yr old and comes with play food, cooking pans, plates & utensils. It has its own sink, cabinet/fridge, stove top & oven. Plus S & P shakers that sound like they work! We love it and my son can't stop playing with it. Good, sturdy quality toy - get this one!

product_title: Baby Plus Prenatal Education System
review_headline: annoying for mom, questionable for baby
review_body: I used this item faithfully from 17 weeks. It was loud and intrusive in my opinion. The noise and the vibration really got on my nerves. I started to dread wearing it after awhile. And it was always slipping off my belly, the belt is not very adjustable. I also had problems with the functioning of the unit. Sometimes it did not last the pre-set 60 minutes and other times, it continued ticking well past an hour. When I contacted the manufacture, they advised me to change the batteries (which were new). I will not use this in my next pregnancy.

product_title: Graco TotBloc Pack 'N Play with Carry Bag
review_body: This is a great product!  It is better than a crib for visiting grandbabies because it takes up so much less space, they can't climb out of it, and setting it up and taking it down are idiot-proof.  Our granddaughter is 17 months old and she slept \\"like a baby:\\"

product_title: Cloud b Twilight Constellation Night Light
review_body: bought this for my 5 year old son -- he loves it. we appreciate that it shuts off automatically. he enjoys watching the stars project onto the wall.    2 thumbs up

product_title: Skip Hop Baby Infant & Toddler Playmat with Interlocking Foam Floor Tiles, Blue / Gold
review_body: We are very happy with this playmat.  Our 6 month old is just learning to sit up and tips over often.  This breaks her fall wonderfully!  I also love the blue/gold/brown colors.  It blends nicely with our room and doesn't stand out too much.  All of her toys are bright and colorful so that mat didn't need to be.  We are pleased with this purchase.

product_title: Aosom Baby Kids Wooden Playpen Room Divider 8 Panel
review_body: Excellent product.   No problems with the door (any more)   Works well for my 9 month old.   Better then anything else I have bought so far.

product_title: North States Superyard XT Playpen Extension Kit
review_body: I ordered this extention with the superyard as there's many reviews praised them.  However, when I got it, I had to return them.  There is no door on the superyard and the extention.  For me (5'-3\\"), it's very hard to step in and out of the superyard with baby in my arms.  I think the superyard without door is a tripping hazard.  I think this is UNSAFE. I contacted the manufacturer, they admit the superyard does not have a door.  Think twice before you order it.

product_title: Safety 1st Glow And Go Two Receiver Monitor
review_body: I would never recommend this product to anyone!  It seemed to work great at first, but as time has gone on it has gotten worse and worse.  My husband usually stays up at night with the baby and keeps a monitor with him in the living room, and I have one in the bedroom with me. He has no problems with his, but mine is always causing static and interference.  The last two nights when I've been sleeping, the monitor has gotten so loud with the interference that it wakes me up because it's scared me.  My husband usually hears the baby way before I do as well.  I'm not sure if it's because I'm so much farther away from the baby's room than he is, but this should not make a difference as our house is not that big!  Last night I decided to use the monitor in my room on the batteries because it seemed to have less static and interference when I unplugged it, but to my surprise my son came in to my room this morning to tell me that the baby was crying!  The green light was on, which made me think that everything was ok, but when I picked it up and listened I could not hear ANYTHING!  I have no idea how long my poor baby was in her bed crying for me, all because this piece of junk failed on me.  There was no indication that the batteries were dead, infact the moniter was still on and still made some quiet noises making me thing it was working fine.  This was a VERY bad choice for us.

product_title: Baby Einstein Play Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We received this as a gift, and our son loves staring at the star.  Our complaint is that it only plays four songs, that aren't very long, and get very annoying for mom and dad!! The speakers sound like they have been blown out, when we only play it on the soft volume, this happened in just a few weeks. This makes the songs even more annoying.  For some reason this doesn't seem to affect baby, so I have to use headphones when he is listening to it to keep my sanity!  Also it doesn't have much to interact besides the lighting up star.  Fischer Price has a jungle theme gym with tons more things for only $10 more.

product_title: Skip Hop Tubby Bath Toy Organizer, Orange
review_headline: An excellent product that really sticks to the wall
review_body: Holds a ton of stuff (much more than it looks like in the picture) and is very strongly attached to the wall. Does not slide down or pop off at all. A great product!!

product_title: Natursutten BPA-Free Natural Rubber Pacifier
review_headline: Nipple too big for my newborn
review_body: Even though this is 0-6 months, my newborn gags on it.  The nipple is quite large.  I am sure he will grow in to it (I can't wait for this).  I love the idea of the product and can't wait to get to use it.

product_title: Munchkin Deluxe Care Cart (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great for diapers, cloths, and other baby essentials..
review_body: Easy to assemble and the cart feels more solid than I expected. Great product and I'll buy this again. I'm giving it only 4 stars because I feel they should have included 6 base cardboards instead of only 4.

product_title: American Baby Company 100% Cotton Percale Fitted Crib Sheet Bundle, Gray and Gray Zigzag
review_headline: better, yet less expensive than most
review_body: I am a Family Childcare Provider in Massassachusetts. I have 3 children sleeping in cribs and have purchased many crib sheets. Some don't fit the crib mattress correctly and the kids are able to pull them off in no time (2 year old)... These sheets have nice wide pockets for covering the mattress completely. Easy to change and vibrant colors to boot... A very good purchase...

product_title: Dr. Brown's Natural Flow Standard Caps Replacement, 3 Pack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: It is impossible to find the caps at the store.  I was so excited to find these on Amazon.

product_title: Summer Infant Three-In-One Family Thermometer
review_body: This seemed to be a good deal, but it is junk like all of the other thermometers I have recently purchased. It's new home is in the junk drawer. I think it is very poorly made, it also doesn't correctly read temperatures. We all have a temperature of 84 degrees everytime I try to use it?? My advise would be not to waste your money. Oh, and did I mention it is made in China........

product_title: Pump In Style Advanced Breast Pump Backpack
review_headline: Backpack is not of Good Quality
review_body: I have used the backpack for 5 months and use it every day at work.  It has had normal use and I only take the small refridgerator pack home every day and the pump once a week.  Based on this use, it is coming apart at the seams in two places.  Other users have had the same issue and you cannot buy a bag replacement. (Go to the Medela website and review the threads).  Buyer beware.  You might not want the backpack for this reason.  I have another Medela model with a different bag style and that one is just fine.

product_title: Disney Winnie The Pooh Come Out and Play 4-Piece Toddler Set
review_body: My 2.5 year old loves the images and color on this bedding but I wish its made with 100% cotton rather than a poly mix.  This will do well in spring season but not summer or winter.

product_title: Chicco Cortina KeyFit 30 Travel System, Adventure (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My cousins bought this travel system for me for my first baby. It's so easy to use. The stroller was light and easy to maneuver. Of course you have to read the manual to know how to operate it, but once you know how, you can fold and unfold it with one hand. The lady who said her 2 month old baby didn't fit in it probably didn't read the manual to know that you have to take out the extra padding so that her baby can fit nicely. I was sad when my daughter got to big for it and I had to get a forward facing carseat already. I'd recommend this travel system to EVERYBODY!!

product_title: Infantino Play Time Activity Center (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased this when my daughter was 2 months old (now 5 months), and it has yet to engage her significantly.  Part of the problem I think is the angle of the sides.  Flat on her tummy without pushing up with her arms, she can't see herself in the mirror or the view the activities.  If she does lift herself up so she can see things, then her hands aren't available to manipulate the 3 activity sides!  She DOES like to push up and look at herself in the mirror, but a crib/floor mirror is half the price and would do that same job.

product_title: Summer Infant Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 1.8" Screen - Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this monitor. This is the only one we have owned with our first baby. It works great. I usually leave it plugged in and only used it at night. However, it works well as a hand held also.     The screen stays lit if you have it plugged in. If unplugged it dims to save battery power. You can also shut the screen off manually either way.     I love being able to see the baby. She is only 6 months old. But I have seen her stare towards the camera mutliple times. I think it is so cute to see her in the morning \\"looking\\" at me.     As far as picking up other signals. Yes this can happen. However, my husband says that if you have the camera and monitor on at the same time it blocks the other signals. So the only time you would be broadcasting your crib is when the handheld is off so your baby probably isn't in there anyways.

product_title: Graco Cool Mist 1.5 Gallon Humidifier
review_headline: One of the easiest humidifiers to maintain.
review_body: We have gone through about 4 humidifiers for our 13 month old. This one is easy to clean and easy to change the filter. The other humidifiers we had would get very moldy and nasty very fast. This humidifier does not get that way. The only reason I would give this 4 stars instead of 5 is the fact the the filter does need replaced about every 2 months. It cost about $7 each.

product_title: JL Childress Tall TwoCOOL 2 Bottle Cooler
review_body: This bag works well, but I just wish it were a little bigger.  I use Avent bottles so it's a pretty tight squeeze with 2 bottles and the ice pack in there.  A little more space on the inside would be great!

product_title: Maya Wrap Lightly Padded Ring Sling - Chocolate - Medium
review_body: This is a really nice wrap.  However I do reach for my biorn active more.  I found it fusterating to get used to.  It's quite simple, but it's just not very smooth(adjusting it).  I can imagine that the none padded version might be better.  Still I do use it sometimes and it's a very nice wrap(I have the brown).

product_title: Britax Regent Youth Car Seat, Sahara (Prior Model)
review_body: We read numerous reviews before purchasing this car seat and were concerned about the size of this seat. I already own the Britax Mooflage Marathon and had it in my Saturn Outlook but decided to put the Regent in my car and the Marathon in my husbands Volkswagen Jetta! The Regent is a very large seat and probably not the best for a compact vehicle. My 2 year old son loves his new seat but the only complaint I have is that now my little one can't see out of the window but when he gets bigger I am sure it will be fine. Seat is very sturdy and the material is soft! I highly recommend this seat and give it five stars!!!!!!!!!!

product_title: Baby Einstein Musical Motion Activity Jumper, Green (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter loves this thing. The frog got her attention at first but now she \\"talks\\" to the sun and hits the keys to make the music play. I would recommend this to everyone.

product_title: Safety 1st Intera Convertible 5 Point Car Seat, Moonstore
review_body:
After looking at all the car seat that are out there this one take the cake.
It has everything for my twin Boy's. All the feature and the best part no recalls.

product_title: BOB Revolution Stroller, Chocolate and Blue NEW
review_body: We actually bought this used on [...] a month ago and I love it. I've used it almost everyday. It's so awesome as the suspension is the best out there. I've tested several strollers. It actually does push with just one finger. It's so agile it's unbelievable. Yes you need the cup console $[...] especially for the easy access to your phone or water bottle. I have found that sun shade doesn't shield my son completely from the sun. The shade doesn't detach and with the sun at a lower angle now it tends to hit him right in the eyes. I wish it moved like his car seat shade does. I'm looking into getting either the sun or wind shield. I just cringe at the price. I'm so happy with this stroller. It actually gets me out there walking everyday! I don't think you'll be disappointed.

product_title: Bumbo Baby Sitter - Pink
review_body: This chair is a must-have!  I started putting my daughter in it as soon as she could hold her head up (about 2 1/2 months).  She loves it!  We also have the tray attachment and we use it in restaurants and she also plays with her toys on it.  She is six months old now, and she can almost get out of it.  We still use it on the floor and occasionally for feeding.  Highly recommended!

product_title: Kiddopotamus Rayshade UV Protective Stroller Shade for Single Strollers & Joggers, Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: i give this product 4 stars because it is great overall, but only because it is too light in the windy conditions, it tends to just flop back  a little and it does get a bit annoying. otherwise it is great. easy to put it on, easy to adjust, gives my kid all the shade, pulls all the way down to my child's legs when he is in the stroller, so we can limit sunscreen now. i like the pockets on the side, and the little extra pocket for a bottle INSIDE the right pocket. very useful.sturdy material, breathable, washable, folds into itself for extra compact storage...love it! this is a must when we go out!

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_headline: It is the best you can wish to have!!!!
review_body: To save money and time you just bay this one and you are all set from 0-24 M.

product_title: Evenflo ABC SmartSteps ExerSaucer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Keeps Baby Occupied and Strengthens Legs!
review_body: Highly recommended product!  We put our daughter in it when she turned 4 months old and she's loved it ever since!  She loves all the different kinds of toys and gets distracted with them, which is good when you need to do some chores around the house.  It's also strengthened her legs a lot as she stands really well with support.  She's now 8 months old and still seems to like it but not as distracted with the toys as she used to be.  The only complaint I have about it is it's not so easy putting her in it by yourself as her legs don't exactly \\"voluntarily\\" insert themselves into the leg holes.  Otherwise, great product!  I'd probably recommend a similar Evenflo Exersaucer item that actually can be taken apart and placed on the floor after they're able to walk or stand on their own.  This one doesn't do that, but I have a friend who has model and we wish we knew about that one.

product_title: SoHo Classic American Teddy Bear Baby Crib Nursery Bedding Set 13 pcs included Diaper Bag with Changing Pad & Bottle Case
review_body: I bought this set for my daughter who is having a girl in March. She said it is the most beautiful set that she has ever seen and words cannot describe how soft the material is. I am well pleased and would reccommend this set!

product_title: Born Free Twister Brushes (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: interesting design, but doesn't hold up
review_body: Pros:  + Twist action is interesting  + No bristles mean no scratching of bottles    Cons:   - Bottle brush is falling apart after just 4 mths for a nursing baby (e.g., not that many bottles!) and the foam section of bottle brush is so wide that it's practically unusable with other brands  - Expensive, especially when you consider how quickly they need to be replaced  - Nipple brush is poorly designed; when inserted into the nipple, the foam slides off to the side leaving just the plastic handle    Bottom line: Don't buy.    Instead: Head to your grocery store's dishwashing aisle and look for a handled scrubby designed for cleaning stemware. It'll be a little wide most likely, but for only $2 you can trim to fit your brand and it'll hold up a lot longer!

product_title: Infantino Surfboard Tummy Time Mat
review_headline: Cute Look, but Not Right For My Child
review_body: I love the cute island surf theme, but that is pretty much it. The toys come off way to easily, the mat is to thin to go directly on the floor, the pillow is an odd shape and not supportive of a child's head, and the aquarium part is hard to fill with water and becomes to cold for my child's liking.

product_title: Twilight Turtle - Constellation Night Light
review_body: This little night light is cute and have purchased another one as a gift for our 3 year old niece, who loves it. It is pretty basic but kids 2-3 years old appear to be entranced by the different colors and stars on the wall.

product_title: My Brest Friend Deluxe Slipcover
review_headline: Great to have a spare cover!
review_body: I love MBF pillow!  I highly recommend these things!  I'm no longer using it since my little man is bigger, but I am certainly looking forward to using it again with future little ones.  The covers are line dry only, and with a sloppy nurser, it was great to have a spare cover.  The deluxe covers are great.  I never really used the velcro feature, but these covers are much much softer than the original ones.

product_title: Cotton Tale Designs Tiger Tale 4 Piece Crib Bedding Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I ordered this set for my 15 months old daughters crib that we have converted into a toddler/daybed (like the photo).  I love the colors, very bright and vivid (more so than the photo here). The Rust color is almost red, and the green is almost a grass green. All of the cover material is 100% soft cotton, is very well stitched, and with no weird odors. The bumper pads are not quite as \\"over stuffed\\" as what is shown in the photo, but they are sectioned into four sections which made it an easy fit for our day bed. I also ordered the pillow pack and matching valance which are o.k.,(pillows are small and valance is flimsy), but are definitely are not necessities.

product_title: Evenflo Big Kid DLX Booster Seat - Hawkeye (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: i love this booster seat for my 2 year old. the added features for the light is awesome. she can read or watch her movies at night. i would totally recommend this to another parent.

product_title: Trend Lab Fabric Storage Bin
review_headline: cute, practical, not as sturdy as I had hoped
review_body: The bins have soft sides and removable bottom reinforcement.  Nice for a small toybox, but due to the fabric only sides (metal frame to support) it does not hold heavier or pointed objects well. I would be afraid that they would puncture the fabric. Overall, cute and functional in with the coordinating bedding and room decor.

product_title: MobiCam Audio Video Baby Monitoring System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Anyone considering purchasing this monitor should be aware that the seller (Health Checks Systems) will charge you a 10% 're-stocking fee' if you are not happy with it and make a return. I purchased an additional camera making my total $158. After the fee and the cost of sending it back, I spent $25 to find out that it does not work as advertised.    For me, it worked fine if the monitor was just outside the room where the camera was but went blank when I walked just a few feet from the door. Additionally, the camera is deceiving. As other reviews point out, from appearances it looks like the round camera can be turned to point in any direction but that is not the case. It can only be tilted up and down slightly so unless the camera is placed on the same level as your child you will not be able to get a good viewing angle.

product_title: Baby Einstein Flap Tote with Clear Front Pocket - Navy
review_body: The bag is really nice & perfect for a little boy. However, I wish they would put the size/dimensions of the bag so the buyers would know how big exactly this item is. It is just as big as the Skip Hop Via Messenger Bag, which I did not expect. It's big enough to be my other kids' school bag. Other than the size, the compartments, materials, & design are okay. Recommendable if you're looking for a big diaper bag.

product_title: JJ Cole Collections Diaper Caddy, Green Stripe (Older Version) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Great to organize everything you need for changing diaper. I removed mat from the caddy and use as ointment and lotion holder. In the drawer, I put diaper sacks(nature babycare product in a box) and dispense from the hole of drawer. It works perfect! Great for home and go.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Melodies and Lights Deluxe Gym
review_body: We tried another playmat, but she wasn't interested.  Got this one and she loved it right away.  4 months later it is still her favorite toy/activity.  We now have the Rainforest Jumperoo and bouncer too.  Excellent quality for me, fun for her.  I'm sold on Fisher-Price.

product_title: Combi Activity Walker Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter has Down's Syndrome and needed a very specific type of walker in order to help her learn to walk.  This product fit the description to a tee!  We are very happy with the durability and safety of this product.

product_title: Ultimate Car Seat Travel Bag
review_body: This bag works great for travel. It makes it easier to carry a bunch of baby stuff because you can wear it like a backpack. It may be a bit cumbersome for petit women, but it should be good for most dads (It is not a small pack). The best part is that you can stuff coats or other light, bulky items in there for transport. A great purchase to protect your car seat and base.

product_title: AngelSounds Fetal Heart Detector
review_headline: After reading review, bought this & love it!
review_body:
After reading the reviews on this page, I bought the monitor. It is less expensive than most monitors out there and arrived from Facelake in only 4 days (much earlier than the estimated delivery time.)

The monitor works great (I am 15 weeks pregnant) and in only a little bit of time I was able to find the baby's heartbeat using baby oil. You do not need ultrasound gel if you buy this. You can even use water.

product_title: Bumkins Organic Cotton Burp Cloth 2 pack
review_body: Unfortunately, these burp cloths are rough.  Instead, try Under the Nile (from Giggle and other stores) or Gerber Organic (from Babies 'R Us).  Those are very soft and in the same price range or cheaper.

product_title: Fisher-Price Precious Planets Play Yard (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This Playard is pretty darn adorable. I have mine set up in my living room.   I was hoping that one of the little animals in the mobile was the polar bear, like how it shows on some of the ads. The box even has the polar bear being one of the animals, but the instructions and some other photos show the crocodile. Even so, I love the playard. The changing table has to be taken out every time you use it. So, you have to find a place for it when baby's in the bassinet.  Also, I tried a quilted travel yard sheet by Graco, the standard size, but it created a bubble between the sheet and padding. So, then I tried a regular travel yard sheet and it worked a lot better. Too bad Precious Planet doesn't make the sheets for this.   This product was easy to put together and you'll have to remember to break it down correctly before taking it on the go.  Overall, I really love this product, the colors, the practicality and its Precious Planet :)

product_title: Kidsline Swazi Basket Liner
review_body: I got a lot of compliments on these liners. They are washable and doesn't shrink.  Perfect fit for my wicker baskets.

product_title: Kiddopotamus Elite Duomat 2 in 1 Car Seat Protector Mat
review_body: Love this for under my 4 month old's car seat! Under a rear facing infant seat you can fold the back down so it doesn't show and for a front facing it protects the entire back of the seat! I would recommend this to anyone!

product_title: Kiddopotamus SwaddleMe 100% Cotton Flannel Large
review_body: First time moms (and dads) will love this  ... so E Z to use even little mommie-helpers can swaddle baby perfectly.  Bought 3 and will be coming back for more.

product_title: Dekor Soft Touch Changing Cushion w/ 3 Inflatable Sides
review_body: This is a terrible product. Ever since I bought this, all it's done is cause me headaches. It practically melted on a dresser (while I had the A/C on) and ruined it. Also it sprung leaks several times when only being used by a 7 lb infant. Don't waste your money.

product_title: Boppy Pillow with Luxe Slipcover, Teddy Bears
review_body: This boppy is really nice.  I loved my previous boppy but it was one of the originals that didn't have a slipcover.  After multiple washings it became lumpy.  I was so suprised when this boppy came because it was super soft.  Also, I thought the script said \\"3 little bears\\", but it really says \\"my little bears\\" and has a little picture of two boy bears with a girl bear in the middle.   It was perfect for my family.  I have two boys and a girl in the middle!  I thought that was extra cute!  I can't wait to see how it washes, but so far I am happy with my purchase.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Bouncer
review_body: I purchased this rainforest bouncer for my Granddaughter and she just loves it.  She sleeps in it plays in it and is constantly amused by all the animals. Great buy for new borns and they learn to amuse themselves.

product_title: DaVinci Contour Changer
review_body: Have the Emily changing table and the included pad cracked after one week of use. Bought this to replace and fits the Davinci Emily changing table perfectly. good choice but little expensive.

product_title: Summer Infant Day & Night Flat Screen Color Video Monitor with 7" LCD Screen (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: So good I leave the baby's room to look at the monitor and see if she is asleep. The static from interference can be annoying but a move of just an inch can solve the problem (or make it worse). Much better than audio only monitors. So often a lot of noise means nothing if the baby is still sound asleep. You can tell that on this video screen..not sure if you would have that kind of detail to be able to tell if her eyes are opened or closed when the monitor screen is just an inch or two.

product_title: Star Kids Snack & Play Travel Tray, Black
review_headline: Very cheap quality.Not worth the postage to send it back
review_body: Star Kids Snack and Travel Tray.  What a terrible piece of equipment.  It is nothing like advertised.  Limp and flimsy and doesn't hold anything in front of your child.  Don't waste your money.

product_title: Badger Basket Sleigh Style Baby Changing Table
review_body: I use this everyday. It holds a ton of stuff and looks really good. I love it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing - Nature's Touch N1973 (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter is currently 4 months old and she has loved this swing since birth!  It is so cozy and comfy, we want one that's adult-sized!!  We put her in it the first week of her life and she spent many comfortable naps gently swinging with the soft music playing.  As she got older, we started turning on the leaves/birds at the top, and she really enjoys watching them.  She's 4 months now and she doesn't nap in it anymore, but she loves swinging in it and watching Mommy clean up in the living room and the kitchen.  The music options are great, the speeds are really good, and the batteries seem to last a long time.  It is also easy to clean as we learned the first time she had a leak!  I highly recommend this swing.

product_title: JJ Cole Bundleme Shearling Baby Hat
review_body: great hat!  Very happy to have found this on Amazon.  My grandson looks soooo cool wearing it!

product_title: Infantino Lil Lion's Happy Hangout Gym
review_body: My son loves this play mat.  He is 4 months old.  He bats at the toys and loves to stare at himself at the mirror.  The sounds are cute and keep him interested.  Unfortunately the music doesn't play very long. Overall we are happy with this product.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Waterfall Peek-a-Boo Soother
review_body: I love the Peek a Boo waterfall soother.  It has a wonderful time setting option from 6 minutes, 12 minutes or 18 minutes.  My son just turned a year and he still loves it.  The only problem I am having with it (and hopefully it's only me) is I am replacing the (Energizer or Duracell)batteries constantly.  He's used it now for 9 months and in that time frame I have replaced the batteries 6 times.  I think that's alittle much.  But other wise it's a great toy and 9 months later still entertaining.

product_title: Playtex Embrace Breast Pump System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
PLEASE DO NOT BUY THIS!!!!!!!
I tried to use it to breast feed twins, I could not do both at the same time so I would nurse one bottle the other and pump to empty, and swap the next feeding. So I had to have a good supply.
Well, after 24 hours of beging home my husband had to go back to the hospital and rent a pump because my milk suply was droping fast(WILL NOT EMPTY YOU/OR EVEN CLOSE TO EMPTING YOU!)So that was a $100 on top of the $300 i spent on the playtex, I used the hospital pump for 2 weeks to bring my supply back up then returned it. The moter on the playtex went out, called and got a new one. Two weeks later we had to go back and rent the hospital one again, andther $100. In the end I was dried up by 3 months. So I spent over $500 to save money with twins and I could have bought formula saved time, and a HUGE headach and EXPENCE. Please learn from my mistake and buy the ones that are proven to work, playtex does not stand behind thers,they will just keep sending you a new motor, which is not the entire problem. the tubes get crimped all the time, not a very strong suction, I could only pump one breast at a time to even get anything. DONT BUY IT!!!!

product_title: Mountain Buggy Urban Triple Storm Cover
review_body: This is great.....at first. It is easy to put on, it has the front flap which is brilliant. It has everything going for it except......this is the cheapest plastic I have ever seen. I have used it for two months and the ENTIRE front flap has cracked so badly, that it is completely unusable. It is a real shame, and I was very surprised that they would use such a poor quality plastic. I have not had a chance to find an aftermarket replacement, but I remember seeing something at BuyBuyBaby, but I have not gone there to see it. I will update this if I find anything. Please note, I have the double not the triple, but I would think the material is not different.

product_title: Leachco All Nighter - Total Body Pillow - Ivory
review_body: I just got this pillow last week.  I am in my fifth month, and I was struggling with back pain.  This pillow has changed my life!  It's amazing.  It supports your back and hugs your whole body.  It takes up a lot of room, so make sure you have a big enough bed!

product_title: Koala Baby Chambray Hamper - Light Blue
review_body: The hamper fit into a comfortable space in the room and blended well with the decor.  It was a welcome and practical gift.  The take out bag is convenient for traveling to the washing machine and is easily washable.

product_title: Graco Classic Wood Highchair with Seat Pad, Butter Pecan
review_headline: Graco Classic Wood Highchair is absolutely beautiful
review_body: If you're looking for a wooden high chair...........I would highly recommend this one!!    It has a plastic tray that is easily removed to wash off.  The seat cover is stain resistant, carrots wipe off with ease.  The cover can be thrown in the washing machine also.    Beautiful wood, sturdy construction, very solid!  I can't wait until my baby gets bigger & can use the toddler tray.  This high chair can be used for a long time, even with older children.

product_title: Mustela PhysiObebe No Rinse Cleansing, Diaper Area - Face 10.14 fl oz (300 ml)
review_body: My son had some baby acne and his face was a little dry.  They said not use soap on his face and I didn't think it ever felt as clean as I wanted it to.  So I tried this and the Mustela Bebe face lotion and the acne cleared and his face is nice an soft now.  It has a nice scent as well, not the usual baby scent that everyone knows and loves though.  But is still nice.

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor w. Sound Monitor w. Two Parents' Units
review_body: We buy this for every baby shower and everyone we give it to LOVES IT! Of course we used it. My son is nine months and all over the crib so we can't use the sensor anymore. We bought the Baby Sens- which covers the whole crib but it is so sensitive to even hard wind outside. It doesn't have a sensitivity level. I must check it everyday to make sure an alarm sounds if my son isn't on it. Angelcare is the best and would trust this with my newborn. The Baby Sens- is ok but I would never use it on a newborn. THE BEST MONITOR EVER!

product_title: BumbleRide Flyer Stroller Pattern: Pacific
review_body: I read the review below and I agree with everything that person said but 3 stars is too high.  I hate how the stroller does not navigate properly and I hate the basket.  I also wish I had spent a few extra bucks for the Bugaboo.

product_title: Miracle Blanket Swaddling Baby Blanket - Boy Colors
review_body: This turned out to be a MUST have. My baby will not sleep unless swaddled. You can use regular blankets to swaddle, but if you have an active baby they will kick out of it very easily. My baby can kick out of this, but he doesn't do it until he's ready to get up so it really isn't a problem.     It is tricky to figure out how to use at first, with a squirmy baby it can be impossible to put on. But, I wait until he's sleepy and with a little practice is can be put on quickly.    It wraps around the baby several times, so I dress him only in a diaper otherwise he sweats.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Wall Hanging Teddy Bear
review_body: These wall hangings are so cute - like the rest of the teddy bear set. The bears are all different textures and look really nice hanging together or spread out in the room. We have the quilt from the bedding set on one wall and these on the other near the crib. They are mostly in browns, but as is the bedding, there is a slight red stripe in the plaid, so it gives you another option for adding color to the room. Cute!!

product_title: Britax Roundabout Convertible Car Seat, Latte
review_body: I cannot say enough good things about this car seat.  When my daughter moved from her infant carrier car seat to her toddler car seat, we bought the Britax Roundabout and another cheaper car seat for our 2nd car.  I appreciate the Roundabout even more since I have another car seat to compare it to!  My daughter enjoys sitting in it and seems to be more comfortable since she sits up a little higher in this one.  Also simple items, such as the velcro on the sides to keep the seatbelt out of the way, are a big plus.  Might not seem like a big deal, but when you're putting a squirmy two-year old into the car seat and she keeps sitting on the belts, you'll learn to appreciate velcro!!  Looks great and cleans up pretty easily.  The seat belt also easily loosens and tightens, unlike our other car seat. Needless to say, this car seat is in Mommy's car, and Daddy got the cheap one in his car since he's the one who didn't want to spend the extra money on the extra seat!  Well worth the extra money spent!!

product_title: Graco Easy High Chair w/Print
review_headline: Graco Easy Chair High Chair - Super Safari
review_body: Well Worth it. My niece enjoyed this chair.

product_title: Graco Mosaic Stroller in Ionic (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: After two tries we finally got it right!
review_body: This is our \\"Goldilocks and the Three Bears\\" story: We started off with a full sized stroller that was part of our travel system, and after six months it was just too big. I couldn't fit in in stores and it was heavy. We then downsized to an umbrella stroller and it was too small. It didn't recline, there was no cup holder and it tipped over when the diaper bag hung on the back. So we found this and it was just right! Its is wonderful with the reclining seat, our daughter can take a nap, and is great with a quick diaper change. The basket is nice and is decent size if you utilize the space under the seat. Its lightweight enough that I only need one hand to lift in and out of the car, and its really quick and easy to open up. Folding it takes a couple tries to get right, but then its no sweat. We recently traveled with this stroller and I was amazed at how much easier it was, having previously traveled with the full size stroller. We've had it for ten months now and I've only noticed it squeaking when it has a lot of bags on the handles. It also fits with our Graco infant car seat, which will be great when we have a  second child. I have no complaints! I wish we would have found this stroller first!

product_title: Fisher Price Miracles & Milestones Touch & Cuddle Hedhehog
review_headline: Love it!  Love it!  Love it!
review_body: Around November/December of 2005 I searched everywhere for this toy.  The only place I could find it was on eBay and I didn't want to pay an arm and a leg.  Finally I found this toy on babycenter.com.  I was so happy to get it since it was named a top toy in a lot of the baby magazines.  My daughter was about 4 months old when we got it and she has loved it ever since I took it out of the box (she is now almost 9 months old).  She can hold it in both hands and chew on the nose (a favorite thing for her to do).  She also loves the bean bag bottom and the crinkle feet.  She has lots of fun with this toy and I can bring it out at any time and it is still a favorite!!

product_title: Vulli Sophie la Girafe
review_body: By far our 6mth old's favorite toy. Easy to grab, lots of different spots to chew on (head, neck, legs, etc), and very easy to clean. We've had Sophie for a month - so far so good!

product_title: Toysmith Battat House Shape Sorter Toy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Kids from ages 2-1/2 to 5 love this toy!  Each door has its own color- and shape- coded key.  The locks are too advanced for those without good small-motor skills but the block sorter can be used while the key skills are developed.  Plastic seems a bit brittle but I haven't had any cracks or breaks even after lots of play by multiple children.  Highly recommended.

product_title: 2 Handle Cup w/ TPE on Handles and Fat Flip-it Straw Top (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Helped my tube-fed child learn to drink!!
review_body: My son would not drink from his bottle.  He has been totally g-tube fed for the past 7 months.  We have tried practically every bottle and sippy cup ever made.  I introduced this cup two weeks ago (with the valve cut out of it to make sucking easier), and he is now up to 7 ounces of milk a day from this cup!!!!!  I wouldn't care how much it leaks (which it does a bit), it is the best cup ever! :)  I think the fat straw helped him a lot, as well as the straw being so soft and flexible.

product_title: Maclaren Triumph Pink Flag Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this stroller.  Its light, has a simple fold, and clips shut on its own.  The shoulder strap is helpful when traveling and I love that it can be folded/clipped one handed.  While it won't replace my P3 for full days out, this is the perfect errand stroller.

product_title: MOBI TykeLight
review_body: This is a wonderful little light to keep in your child's bedroom.  It has a very soft glow so you can see well in the dark and you won't wake your child with a bright light.  There are 3 settings; the first is dim, the second is supposed to be brighter, but it's not a whole lot brighter than the first setting, and the 3rd setting will keep the light on for 45 minutes and slowly dim the light until it shuts off.  Good night light for children that have trouble falling asleep in the dark or afraid of the dark.

product_title: Safety 1st 48483/48367 Adjustable Multi-Purpose Strap
review_body: This strap works really well for difficult cabinets.  The only reason I gave it 4, and not 5 stars, is that the one that I use to lock the trash up, the adhesive pulled off after my daughter tried to pull it numerous times.  It works \\"enough\\" and I just pop it back on.  I have not replaced it and plan on continuing to use it.

product_title: Boppy Cradle In Comfort Bouncer
review_body: I was looking for a moderately priced item like this, and decided on the Boppy - a perfect choice.

product_title: Skip Hop Duo - Canvas
review_body: My husband wanted something we could both use with comfort for carrying the odds and ends of our precious little one to be.  We both love the durability, the stylish and sporty look.  We both felt it was a little short on space, it looked bigger than it really was. Overall a great bag, but a little bit too small.

product_title: Peg Perego Pliko P3 MT Stroller - 2006 Anice
review_body: I cannot even count the total number of strollers I have owned for my three children. I have been using my P3 for over 2 years now.  It has held up well, and still rides like a dream.  I was never able to comfortably use the toddler step on the back for a second child, but I have allowed my daughter to get out and ride when she gets bored in the seat.  I have found it to be a stylish stroller, which is important to me.  I don't consider it to be a lightweight stroller.  For short trips I use my Maclaren Techno.  I also feel like the footrest is a little high for my average sized two year old.  Her knees bump into the front tray when she puts her feet on the footrest.  This is also not as much of a problem with my Maclaren.  The seat is much more comfortable in the P3, and if I think my daughter might nap in her stroller, the P3 is my first chioce by far.

product_title: Nova Kids Summer Camp, Floor Lamp White,Lgt Blue/Wht Cross Stich
review_body:
The lamp is pretty, though the lamp came broken on a critical section
needed for stability. Even when assembled - it is \\"shaky\\" since it comes in multiple long sections that do not tighten well.

product_title: Summer Infant Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 1.8" Screen - Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We love this monitor with video.  We are a little short on cash and my wife didn't want to spend the extra money on video but I talked her into it.  Now she can't live without it.  Every time our Daughter makes a sound she is hitting the video button to see if she is ok.  And she always is but its nice to see without walking into the room to look and waking our baby up.  It doesn't interfer with any of my other wireless items which is really nice.  The night vision is really nice to.  Its almost like day time but it almost look negitive.  But we can see if her eyes are open or if she is sleeping.  I think it actually helped her fall asleep.  For some reason our daughter loves to stare at lights.  There is a little green light on the camera part that she will stare at and it lookes like she is looking right into the camera.  If I could I would rate this camera a 10 out of 5 we love it so much.  I love that we can turn the video on and off to save the battery.

product_title: Fisher-Price: Deluxe Healthy High Chair
review_body: This high chair is great!  It is easy to fold and easy to adjust.  It wipes clean with no fuss.  Little ones are very comfortable in it.  I highly recommend it.

product_title: Prince Lionheart 2 Stage Seatsaver
review_body:
I bought this after my second child was born to protect our car's seats from the child seat. I have the original thin Prince Lionheart from my first child and love it. This one is so bulky with the built in lip that it got in the way of anyone having to sit next to it in the car. Also, the two part design causes so many problems as it constantly comes undone causing the top portion to slip down (thus defeating the purpose of protecting the seat).

It does catch spills, but the original thin seat saver does too and actually does a better job. I have just recently moved the original one under my younger child and discarded this one altogether. I will look for something else to put under my older child's seat.

I do not recommend this product.

product_title: Zooper Twist Teal Lightweight Umbrella Stroller - Everyday Line (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have been using a Maclaren Triumph for the past 18 months, and have been envious of all the features my friends strollers had.  What my stroller was missing? - a leg rest, window through the canopy, a greater sun shade, the ability to increase the recline thoroughly, are all found with the zooper twist, plus more.  I love the matching boot, and that the accessories are included.  I may go ahead and order a more structured cup holder cuz I dont trust the mesh one for coffee.  Also, the wheels are smaller than what you might find on a more expensive stroller, so for longer walks you may want a nicer zooper model.  Other than that, it is gorgeous, and perfect for mall walking/ shorter street walks.  My friends now have stroller envy of me for a change, and thats fun. ;-)

product_title: Bob Single Stroller Travel Bag Black
review_body: The BOB Stroller Travel Bag Black is a great purchase to protect your single BOB stroller when you travel by plane. It keeps the BOB totally compact and secure, and it is reinforced all around.  However, I would still use some sort of padding to protect the front wheel.  If you are using the carseat adaptor, everything will fit inside as well.  I absolutely recommend this item.

product_title: ProudBody Pregnancy Art
review_headline: All new mothers-to-be should have a belly cast
review_body: I rated this product a 5, but that is for the end result.  For difficulty of use, I would have given it a 3.  But what the heck - it may have been tricky, but the results were worth it!  Make one of these for a baby shower and have the guest sign it.

product_title: Safety 1st Easy Saver Diaper Pail
review_body:
I'm glad to see more people are trying out cloth diapers! I also started with disposables, then moved to Fuzzibunz! I love this diaper pail! It's be PERFECT for both! My mom had the diaper genie for my little brother ans sister but hated it. This diaper pail keeps the smell out very well!!

I also recommend people give cloth diapering a go! There are more options today then there were in the past.

product_title: Joovy Big Caboose Stand-On Tandem Triple Stroller
review_headline: Good idea, but not functional for me
review_body: I have infant twins and a two year old. I love the concept of the stroller... But;(1)not a great deal of room for my two year old with the infant seats on. (2)I have to put my whole body into turns, it also feels like it could tip with two car seats and a two-year old (3)The \\"jump seat\\" for the two-year old doesn't stay in place, it scoots back, which causes him to lean forward and eventualy I have to stop, and pull the seat back up. It needs a locking mechanism. (4)it absolutely will not fit into a bathroom stall at the mall, so take a friend and take turns watching the kids. I think that without the infant car seats, the whole thing would work better.  I returned mine though, I need the infant seats on for a while. I am looking for another solution besides a leash for the two-year old :)

product_title: Boppy Noggin Next Head Support, Denim (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Caused cone head on our infant - BEWARE!!!!!
review_body: We found out yesterday from our Pediatrician that this Noggin nest is causing a cone head on our infant.  we had noticed a ridge on his skull the exact circumference of the round opening in this product.  It must be recalled immediately.  The doctor said this was the 2nd time he had seen this in a week.

product_title: Medela
review_headline: Not just for the working mother!
review_body: I wish I had bought one when my first son was born. I had a hand pump, not cool. Even though I did not work, it would have been very helpful. Now after my second son came, I went back to work part-time and this has been a godsend. I pump on one side while I breastfeed on the other. It's a great way to always have milk in the freezer. And I don't feel so bad about going back to work knowing that he is still getting the same nutrition as being with me.

product_title: Baby Trend Side By Side Jogger (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this double jogger despite the bad reviews I had read online and was pleasantly surprised. I love the adjustable canopy, it really blocks the sun. Also the parent tray is great. I am using the stroller with a one year old and a 4 month old so each child has plenty of space and seems perfectly content in the semi-reclined seats. Maybe as they get older they will be more crowded and want to sit more upright but it seems like they will have plenty of growing room and can see everything from where they are seated... Also, my stroller does not pull to the side as I read in other reviews but there is a troubleshooting guide in the box about this particular problem so it seems like it may be a common problem since they included the troubleshooting guide but my stroller works fine. Also, it folds very easily and in my opinion is very compact. It fits easily in the back of my Ford Focus station wagon. I did not have trouble turning the stroller. I am used to pushing down on the handles to turn corners from my single stroller and I did not find this any more difficult other than it was a little heavier which is to be expected. I am running on a paved street so it may be a pain if you were on a trail that was not paved or had several tight corners but it works great for me. The hand brake doesn't seem to work on mine which is why I gave it four stars instead of five. However I think there is a troubleshooting guide for this problem also I just haven't checked it out yet. Also, since I do not jog particularly quickly and do not go down any really steep hills the hand brake not working doesn't really concern me. I have only used the stroller once, I just got it yesterday but so far I have been very impressed (and relieved) with my purchase.

product_title: Cloud b LullaBag Fleece - Baby Sleep Bag - Large Blue (6-18 months) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The order info said, \\"Cloud b LullaBag Fleece - Baby Sleep Bag - Large Blue (6-18 months)- Product # B000HGSS4M\\". The item received had the same product # on the packaging, but it was a small pink (0-4 months)... listed wrong on Amazon perhaps. Good thing my buddy just had a baby girl.

product_title: Cosco Alpha Omega Elite Convertible Car Seat  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I thought this seat would solve my delima with a tall baby. My child is long and lanky. Not Thick at all, and it rubbed his neck RAW! The pads moved out of the way and the straps are too close together. Also, his head flops fwd, like the other reviews have said.I had to return the seat, after 5mths use. The end of the line with it, was trying to put it in a friends van! It was sitting straight UP! I have it rear facing as he has Just turned 9mths old. We took a 2 hour road trip, and he was miserable, and that is when the straps hurt him. I would be afraid, VERY afraid if an accident had occured! DON'T Buy this seat!
