product_title: Summer Infant Secure Surround 8-Panel PlaySafe Playard
review_body: I highly recommend this product to any parents with babies that are on the move!  I recently purchased this surround gate for my 7 month old little boy - and it is wonderful.  It is large enough (I also bought the extention kit) that he doesn't feel confined.  I love the fact that I can fold a load of laundry, read the mail, empty the dishwasher, etc. without worrying where my little one is and what he is doing.  I also love the fact that I can easily fold it up and take it outside or on trips.  It brings great peace of mind!  This is the best $100 I've spent!  I only wish I would have bought it sooner!

product_title: Combi Travel Solutions Play Yard
review_headline: Great bassinet, great colors, disappointing play yard
review_body: I bought this in the mocha color as I loved the non-babyish look and all of the features.  However I haven't used this as nearly as much as I thought and don't think I got my $$ worth out of it.    The bassinet has overall been great.  I love that it can stand alone and you can set it so that it stands on wheels or rocks back and forth.  This fit perfectly in my bedroom (I didn't have a lot of extra space, and in fact had to roll it out of the way to open my closet, so I had to keep the wheels engaged) and it was very convenient and wonderful to have my newborn son sleep in my room the first 3 months. (When they wake up every 2 hours, every step you have to take counts!) The storage basket underneath is wonderfully large - you can fit all the baby linens, diapers, etc. you would ever need for your overnight adventure with your precious new bundle of joy.      The bassinet has been easy enough to travel with - but for short trips I didn't take the pedestal because while it is easy to assemble it is rather difficult to take apart.      My complaints about the bassinet:  you can't order any extra fitted sheets, and the bassinet pad is not a standard size.  This drove me crazy at first.  I called customer service several times about it and they were useless.  They were barely professional when they answered the phone, it was like calling someone's grandmother.  I almost ordered custom size sheets from some internet web site for like $40.  Finally I just wrapped a pillow case and pinned the corner when I needed to wash the fitted sheet it came with. I was paranoid about SIDS and how the sheets aren't supposed to have wrinkles, but they wrap blankets around the bassinet pads in the hospital and $40 is a lot for a silly bassinet sheet.    About the play yard:  way too difficult to set up.  Instructions were terrible and it took us a while to set it up the first time.  It is not intuitive to set up or take down or pack it back in the bag.  It is also too heavy really to take along for travel.  My husband has refused to carry it on any trip we go on.  He hates the darned thing.  We just shove our son in the bed with us or use whatever crib/ cot is at the place we are going to when we travel.  The result is I think I've used the play yard only a half a dozen times.  Having a second crib has been handy for when young kids/ babies have stayed over our house, but that's about it.    Although I've barely used the play yard I noticed that the extra pockets you can attach to the side (presumably for diapers, etc.) is on the opposite side that you can attach the diaper changing tray to.  To me this makes no sense.  What a stupid design flaw that should not have occurred.  Also I haven't been able to use the music box/ vibrator at all since it is permanently attached to the play yard.  It seems that you should be able to stick it on the bassinet somehow, after all those types of things are most valuable for very young babies.  Poor design!

product_title: Two Tone U Zip Backpack in Denier
review_body: We used this bag for our trip to Disney with our 2 year old.  It had enough room for extra clothes, diapers, wipes, cream, tylenol, wallet, keys, sunglasses, cups, napkins and anything else we could think of.  It worked well as a back pack.  The only thing I would change would be the adaptability of the straps.  I wanted one that would hook to the stroller, but wasn't willing to pay the extravagant price.  All in all we loved it and I now use it daily for errands.

product_title: Fisher-Price Magic Rattle and Ride Pooh
review_headline: A toy your Baby will play with for a LONG time
review_body: My daughter bought this for my 4 month old grandson and he loves watching it, My 14 month old granddaughter loves it and my brothers 27 month old son loves it.  All I can say is it is a great toy to buy!

product_title: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review_body:
I bought this wrap based on the praise it received. But I think it is way too expensive for what it is. It is also time consuming and cumbersome to put on. You do get the hang of it but it still takes time to get it just right and drags the floor in the process. Also my 18 month old didn't seem that safe in it. I felt like he was about to fall out all the time. And I wondered if the bunched material under his butt and back hurt him. It pulls up on your shirt so make sure you wear a long one! And it left black looking fuzz all over my hands and clothes every time I touched it. I washed it several times and even lint rolled it and it still didn't help. It's also made of a thick t-shirt like material and made me and my son hot. The only thing about it I liked was that it didn't hurt my back or neck like other baby carriers.
I am still on the search for the perfect baby carrier...

product_title: Avent Breast Pump Conversion Kit
review_body: This works great with the Lansinoh (same as the Ameda Purely Yours) pump.  It is so convenient to pump directly into bottles.  Great product ... also available at Babies R Us.

product_title: JJ Cole Urban Bundleme
review_body: Similar to a previous reviewer, we also recommend that people buy the toddler size cover instead of infant.  Our baby outgrew an infant cover by 8 months, so we purchased this next.  We've been very happy with it since.    It fits our Maclaren Quest stroller perfectly, haven't had a problem with it slipping off at all.  To make it more comfortable, we added a plush head support to the shoulder straps inside of the cover (Cradler® Adjustable Head Support For Newborns To Toddlers, also available on Amazon).   When going outside, we tuck the top edge of the cover under our little one's chin & the sides of the head support.  It provides turtleneck type protection & warmth without the worries of a scarf.  When the Bundleme is used this way, along with a fleece hat that has ear flaps, our baby is as snug as a bug in a rug!  And this is in the north, when it's -10C outside (or more).  Add the rain cover to the stroller to reduce any further windchill & we have no worries that junior is cold.    You won't be disappointed with this product.

product_title: Nuby No-Spill Easy Grip Cup, 10 Ounce, Colors May Vary
review_body:
3 problems:

1. The nipple tears off if he baby is teeting or chews it. The milk comes too fast because of this and also spills out.
2. If the bottle is dropped on hard floor, the lid comes off.
3. You got to turn just once to close the lid. So if it is even a bit loose and the baby plays with it a bit, there is a chance that the lid comes off.

I regularly have the above problems but I still keep using it. The manufacturer should sell the nipples seperately too.

product_title: DO NOT USE Graco SnugRide Infant Car Seat - Darius
review_body: [[ASIN:B000MXJ26I Graco Darius SnugRide Infant Car Seat]]  You can not beat the snugride!! This is top quality and the price is nice. I have 4 children and have owned several seats and Graco is really the best in my point of view!! The print is adorable....lots to choose from:) Handle is stiff at times but not a problem.

product_title: Combi Counterpart 2 Stroller Cherry (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: good double stroller with reasonable price
review_body: I have a 1 year old daughter and a 3 year old son.  My son loves sitting at the back seat which is very spacious.  But, the front seat is kind of small and the back couldn't decline much.  My girl doesn't like it very much.  The steering is good for this size of stroller.  The weight is not a problem for me.  Overall, I am happy with it.

product_title: Evenflo Exersaucer Smartsteps Jump & Go
review_headline: Hours of giggling fun for my son!!!
review_body:
We bought this for my son when he was 4 months, and he loved it from day one! He didn't start jumping in it right away, it took him a week or so to figure out how to jump in it. Maybe because he was too distracted by the super fun toy that's on the tray. He spent the first week playing with the toy, and has spent months jumping like a monkey! He loves this thing beyond belief, he jumps and laughs for as long as you'll let him most days.

I don't know why others have had such a bad time with it, my son has never hit his head or his fingers on the door molding. The biggest problem we've had with it is getting him out of it! =)

product_title: Britax Regent Youth Car Seat, Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body: We just started using this seat & love it.  It wasn't overly difficult to install, although it is a HUGE seat.  I fit in it!!  I wouldn't try to use it in a small vehicle, but in our Suburban it fits just fine.  My son says its very comfy & loves it too!

product_title: JJ Cole Urban Bundleme, Diva, Infant (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this bundle me in Nov and it did not even last 2.5 months.  The zipper broke.  It is not well made.  Stick with the other bundle mes.  The urban bundle me is cheaply made.  Not worth the price

product_title: Under The Nile Bunny Blanket Friend
review_headline: Good for very young babies too!
review_body: I bought this product to try and avoid using a pacifier for my 2 month old daughter who loves to suck.  She appeared not to use it much at first, but at 3 months she's really warmed up to it.  She snuggles with it for naps and comfort and does chew on the little ends.  I'm hopeful that it will become a teething toy for her in a few weeks.  One note--since I work outside the home too, I slept with the toy for a few nights so that it smelled like me and that seemed to make her like it even more when I was gone.

product_title: Lamaze Grip & Grab Rattle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
My son loves this rattle, even at 11 months! It is sturdy, durable and washes very well in the dishwasher. The sides are hard and I can't see it being used as a teether, but it is small and light weight enough for little hands to shake, shake, shake!

I don't know if any other reviews picked up on the colors, but on each side - you see 3 colors. If you look at Amazon's picture, there is red, yellow and orange on the side they are picturing. You can take each side and explain yellow and red make orange. The other sides are similar - blue and yellow make green. Red & blue make purple. The primary colors are grouped together as are the secondary colors. Very neat idea!

product_title: Britax Marathon Convertible Car Seat, Granite
review_body: Our daughter has been in this seat since she was 7 months old. It is FANTASTIC!!! She is now 3 1/2 and I recently invested another $50 into the seat. I replaced the harness and the HUGS and was fortunate to find a new cover on clearance in a children's shop in Seattle. It now looks like brand new! We use it in a 2001 Toyota Tacoma double cab, a 1996 Chevy Suburban, and a 2003 BMW X5. In the Toyota and the BMW to get proper fit we have to remove the head rests. NO PROBLEM! As for the wieght, I am ok with having to lug a heavy seat if it means my child is as best protected as she can be. When you get the seat into whatever car you want it in, my recommendation is to literally climb into the seat with one knee pushing as much of your weight into the seat as possible. We do this when installing ours and it doesn't move a millimeter...... Our daughter is always comfortable in the big cushy seat, doesn't slump when she falls asleep, can't escape from it, and I never deal with twisted straps! Well worth the money, the *inconvenience* of the weight and size. Crazy that people would spend the money on this knowing it is the safest seat and then just because it is heavy put your child in a piece of junk in another car. An accident is only going to happen in the car with the best seat?? Think again!! Take the time to do it right! If you have trouble installing it find a local fire department or insurance agency that will properly install it for you!!!

product_title: Fisher-Price: Pop-Onz Pop 'n Musical Big Top
review_body: My daughter received this toy for her 2nd birthday.  I usually have to get her started playing with it by making up a story that we use to \\"build\\" the circus town.  This will get her imagination going to play on her own.  We also have the starter pack with blocks and characters -- I recommend purchasing it to have more pieces to play with.

product_title: Kiddopotamus SwaddleMe Microfleece
review_body: This is a must have for new parents, my daughter had the tendency to startle herself awake but after we started using the swaddle me, she was sleeping 6 hours at a stretch at the age of 4 weeks. She is now outgrowing her newborn swaddle me so I have \\"upgraded\\" to a larger size since we can't do without it!

product_title: Philips AVENT iQ24 Sterilizer with 2 Bottles, 9 Ounce (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A point to note before buying this
review_body: I gave 5 stars, considering reviews of others who own/use it and don't want to lower the ratings in any way, considering this is definitely a good product. But, what about the cost of this? Just think, is it really worth it? All families have a microwave these days. They are the FINEST AND BEST STERILIZERS anywhere! If you can get a dedicated sterilized and clean container, microwave safe, wash and rinse all the baby bottles, nipples, etc. (the washing part anyways one has to do, irrespective of whether they use this product or not) and place them in this microwave safe container, run it in microwave for no more than 40 to 50 seconds - violla - all items are absolutely sterilized.    Those who might not be aware, microwaves kill 99.9% of all germs within 20 seconds of exposure. In fact, a very common practice is to microwave the cloth or sponge one uses to rinse/clean utensils for 20 seconds to get it sterilized. Think what 40 to 50 seconds will do to the bottles, etc.........Completely disinfect them. You save (say) $70.00 ($4.00 for the Target bought microwave safe container, with lid and big enough to hold the bottles, lying down)    [Edit, after reading comments on original review, as above]  I agree, it was my fault and mistake to miss out a critical and vital point and those who have commented on that - I thank you! The above review had a critical pt. missing - one should never, ever microwave ONLY the product in question, i.e. bottles, nipples, etc. What I really meant was what I use, i.e. I have a container, where I put all the baby stuff in, pour about 7 to 8 oz. of water and m/w for 8 min., which steams out the water and steams out everything, thus sterilizing.     The cost of the container was $3.00. Sorry - my bad. So, what I really wanted to say was is the price worth it? As for time involved, it takes just the same. Effort - also.

product_title: Boon Fluid -No-Spill Toddler Cup in Orange/Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I really, really wanted to like this cup.
review_body: It is cute, it's got a great design for toddler hands, it doesn't have a chewable cap (the main reason I got it).  But I gave it to my son and he became extremely frustrated trying to get anything out.  I thought maybe he wasn't holding it properly, but even I couldn't do it!  So I took it back to the store.  It's too bad.  I also bought the ball snack cup and I do like it so it wasn't a total loss.  But I was very disappointed.  I hope they redesign it soon, I'm going to be having two in sippies really soon.

product_title: Britax Regent Youth Car Seat, Onyx (Prior Model)
review_body: I bought this product after using a Graco booster with 5 point harness six months ago.  The Graco seat, which wasn't cheap, was difficult to use and had a bunch of extra useless padding that tore.  This Britax seat, while incredibly large, is great and my 3 year old son loves it.  He has a small build so I know this will last him a while and it is so easy to use and I feel that he is safer in it.  Staying in a 5 point harness is much safer than a normal car seat belt and he's worth it.  I plan to buy another when my baby girl is old enough.

product_title: Bumkins Waterproof Art Smock
review_body: Great smock ~ I personally think it runs a little on the small side, but overall a great product.  I would recommend, and I would purchase again.

product_title: Aquarium High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Out of all the gifts we received, this one has been the absolute best!  I started my son in it at 3 mos. old.  He loved the attachable play station, and it kept him occupied while I prepared his meal.  He's now almost 13 mos. old, and he still loves it!  We have hardwood floors, and the chair glides easily over them.  I can lock it, if I need to, and it folds up and goes with us to all our friends and relatives.  My 8 year old son uses it to move my baby from room to room, which keeps them busy for long periods of time.  I never even used a highchair with my first child.  I had no idea how wonderful one could be, until I received this one.  It cleans up great, and has an attachable tray that fits in the dishwasher.  I love, love, love this product!

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Jumperoo
review_body:
My son (7mths) and his live in cousin (6mths) love this toy. They just bounce up and down like crazy. My son will only play in it for a few minutes though because he does not like to bounce as much. As for his cousin he loves it beyond words. In fact he loves it so much that when we hold him we have to be ready to be the Jumperoo because he will start jumping. Since he does spend so much time in it his legs are much stronger and he is able to push himself more when trying to crawl verses my son.

We love:
1. The colors
2. The sounds and the fact that you can set them to where every movement made by baby sets them off.
3. The toys are fun and easy to clean.
4. It is height adjustable
5. I folds up in a snap
6. easy to put together
7. seat is pretty easy to pull out to clean

Drawbacks:
1. It is pretty large
2. Legs are not as sturdy as I would like

update 6/5/06
my son is now 9.5 mths old and he still loves this toy!! We put him in it before nap time and within a few minutes he is passed out while still jumping!!!!!!!! This toy is FANTASTIC and we still have one more size adjustment to go, so we have at least a few more months to go before he grows out of it.

product_title: Kiddopotamus Cradler Adjustable Head Support for Newborns to Toddlers, Navy Puppy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This really works! Ever since my 20month old started using his Graco Booster, his head would drop to his chest when he falls asleep in the car. The cradler manages to keep his head steady so it doesn't droop. I'd definitely recommend this.

product_title: Munchkin Deluxe Potty Seat
review_body: My son is very particular about which potty he will use.  This is the only one he will use on the big toilet.  The handles are awesome and it fits perfectly.  Very stable.    As for deflectors, we had problems with the potty chairs that sat on the floor and had a deflector.  We simply taught him to point before peeing and we have no mess.  While learning, I simply kept a thing of disinfecting wipes handy to clean up and removed the rugs from the bathroom.    Of course, I'm really looking forward to the day when I don't need one of these.  But until then, this is the one for my house.

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_body:
This is a seemingly simple but absolutely essential and useful gadget for us! Itzbeen has lessened the stress of remembering -- and that is vital if you're taking care of a baby.

Itzbeen is highly recommended. Every new or veteran parent should at least try it. If you don't like it, don't return it to Amazon, \\"gift\\" it instead to other parents. They'd appreciate it.

product_title: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review_body:
This item was a live saver for me. I put my son in his when he was 5 months old. He didn't get the hang of it until he was 6 months old, but after that... well, he LOVED it!!! He would stay in it for an hour and a half to two hours sometimes. He didn't walk until he was 14 months old and he stayed in it till then. As he got closer to walking, obviously he didn't want to be in it as much. This product allowed me to have some time to clean, cook, or read a book, all things that are harder to do once the little one arrives. I give this present, or one similiar, to pratically every new Mom-to-Be I know. We didn't have any casing that we could put this on except for in the back of the house, so my husband put up a temporary board on either side of an opening between the living room and dining room. This worked great. My son never had any pinched finger. As for some of the other comments as to the safety of this product (or similiar ones)... my son would lean back all of the time and he never hit anything or almost fell over.
All in all, this is a wonderful product and I plan to use it again if we have another child in the future.

product_title: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review_headline: Skip the Manual Pumps...This one is the Best (price and function)
review_body: After receiving the Avent Isis Back to work Manual Pump at my shower...I thought I was all set.  Until I had the baby, tried to \\"Hand Pump\\" and it did not work.  And of course, once you open these packages...you can not return or exchange.  So I bought the Easy Comfort Single pump, HOPING, that this would work for me.  AND IT DID.  I unpacked it, and was able to pump 4 oz on the first try!!  Save your money and skip the manual pumps...they may work for some people, but spend the extra few dollars for this one and be sure that you will be making a good investment!

product_title: Evenflo Titan Deluxe Convertible Car Seat - Nutmeg (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: While this is a good, save carseat, it's not very conducive to my daughter sleeping in the car.  It sits very upright so that her little head flops around and is often bent far forward, resting on her chest.  Not good for nappping...

product_title: Lambs & Ivy Rhyme Tyme Slip Covered Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this little chair to stay at my home for my granddaughter's visits.  It is light weight and easy to store, also the baby seems to enjoy sitting in it to watch TV.  It is not a good chair if you child is in the \\"climbing stages\\" as it would tip over backward.  But for a temporary chair, I recommend it.  If my child would sit in it daily, I would get a heavy chair that wouldn't tip over easily.

product_title: Mother's Touch Deluxe Baby Bather
review_body: I bought this item when my son was 1 month old. It's great! It's so much easier than using an awkward baby bath tub. You just sit it in the tub and it does a wonderful job supporting your baby. It reclines in two positions. The mesh covering allows for quick drying and it's washable. The only draw back is that there's no way to hang it up anywhere to dry. Other than that, it's a great product!

product_title: Babe Ease Original Clean Shopper
review_body: The Whimsical Clean Shopper has met all my expectations: it is easy to use, fits both shopping carts of all sizes as well as restaurant highchairs, it is large enough to cover all those germ-infested areas that my baby might touch or chew on, quickly folds when we're done with it and easy to wash. I couldn't ask for more!

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Kick and Play
review_body: Im so glad I bought this toy...now I'm just wishing I bought it earlier.  My daughter is only 9 weeks old but she loves this thing.  Right now she can really just stare at the dangling toys above her but she loves looking at them and sometimes, especially when I shake the arches so the toys move, she gets so excited she starts smiling, kicking, and cooing and she keeps herself entertained so long that she ends up just falling asleep on the mat which makes a good nap area and its pretty comfortable especially if you put a blanket under it to make it softer.  The toys that come with this are really cute especially the duck wind chime my daughter loves to hit at it so it makes sound.  You can buy additional toys by tiny love that come with their other playmats at toys\\"r\\"us which is cool because then you can switch the toys around making it even more interesting for your baby and they are only a few bucks each. She can't reach the other toys yet but when she gets older I know she'll have fun with them the tiger and the giraffe's feet rattle and the two plastic toys make great teethers.  I also bought the baby wind chimes kick toy to add and she loves it she just can't get enough of kicking it.  The only downside to this mat is you have to press pretty hard on the kick pad to get it to play music...my daughter can hardley ever kick it hard enough but she is only 9 weeks and small too only 9 pounds so I'm sure when she gets older she'll be able to kick it hard enough but for now she's content just pushing off of it and in the meantime I just put the continuous music on.  There's also two rings on the pad so you can attach toys for tummy time play.  There's also different textures on the pad to keeps your baby entertained and a little squeaker toy. This mat also works great as a changing area and is really easy to travel with.  This is definately worth the money and I suggest buying the additional toys for it I haven't seen any at babies\\"r\\"us but I know they have them at toys\\"r\\"us you can buy any of the toys that come with the other tiny love playmats individually for a few bucks each.oys\\"r\\"us you can buy any of the toys that come with the other tiny love playmats individually for a few bucks each.

product_title: Burlington Baby Large White Willow Basket Set with Liner
review_headline: Canvas Totes are the Way to Go
review_body: I received a set of these for my shower.  At first, they seemed ok, but after a short time of handling them they began to wear very easily.  The paint does chip and the wicker becomes brittle and cracks.  I have found pieces of the wicker (as do my 2 year old twins) around the house constantly.  I would highly suggest finding canvas totes that work instead.  Much safer than these baskets!

product_title: Rain or Shine Kids Woobee Plush Blanket
review_body: I received this blanket and a matching bib when my daughter was born and have given them to all my friends for shower gifts.  It is my favorite blanket ever, I have three kids and wish I had it for my other two. I would recommend it to anyone!!

product_title: Boppy Nursing Pillow and Positioner - Bare Naked
review_body: In London I use the Widgey pillow and so I thought this was similar.  I went to visit my parents in the US and sent one of these to their house.  It's not the same.  It's too soft in the middle and my baby boy was struggling while nursing.  It's not as solid and a great disappointment.  My London pillow is amazing!

product_title: Bebe Star Snuggles Moses Basket
review_body: We received this moses basket and matching hamper (separate order)and I have to say I was not that impressed with the thread count on the material used.  Not sure what the thread count is but it seems low.  The inside, where the baby rests it's head is nice and soft though. Not sure how to take the material off to wash it and have not needed to do this yet but I think it will be a challenge    Overall a good product for the price but I def would not have paid full price for it- the quality is just not there

product_title: dexbaby Dex Baby Food Processor Top Loading
review_headline: It's easy but not great for batches
review_body: It is a good processor but it's just too small to really be able to do much more than nightly food processing. It's impossible for big batches and I think most of us moms who are making our own baby food are making it in big batches. I got a large food processor for Christmas last year and I'll be making this little one's baby food from that one. It's just too small!

product_title: Boutique One-piece Swimsuit for Toddlers & Girls Lotus Flower (2, Yellow)
review_body: The product was shipped quickly and was in good condition. It is an adorable suit.

product_title: Infantino Shop & Dine Deluxe Savvy Seat
review_body: Great product, love it, love it, love it. The actualy product looks better then the picture from Amazon.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Peek-A-Boo Leaves Musical Mobile
review_headline: Had hoped it would be good
review_body: This mobile looked and sounded (from the description) like a great mobile.  Our son loves to watch things move and loves animals.  Unfortunately the music was SO soft even on the loudest setting and the mobile itself was SOOOO slow that it would not keep his attention at all.  Looks like a great mobile but just didn't live up to its description.  Also, if you have a crib that does not have straight sides (e.g. there are some curves) the mobile attaches to it but it's very temperamental when it comes to the movement - you have to move the mobile to try to get it to work.  Not the best unfortunately.

product_title: Peg Perego Aria MT Lightweight Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: I love it but the sunshade is TOO short
review_body: I bought this stroller after having a [...] peg perego hand me down. I loved the old one but it looked like it had one thousand miles on it, as a friend told me so I gave it to my mom to use. I knew it was important to get a good stroller that would last rather than buying cheap ones. I am a very price sensitive, I shop at consignment shops, etc and I still feel the money spent is worth it!    The reason I like this stroller:    1. You can guide it with one hand.  2. There is a spot for bags, etc underneath.   3. The cup holder for mommy and child. (this is an extra accessory)  4. It's lightweight and you can pop it open and closed easily.   5. The five point harness    Updated on 7/18/07  The sun-shade is bad. It does not provide any coverage. If purchasing consider checking if the sunshad is bigger!  Otherwise, still a good stroller but in reality a stroller should provide adequate shade and this one does not!

product_title: Dr. Brown's Deluxe Gift Set
review_headline: Not worth the time or the money!!!!
review_body: If I could rate this any lower then 1 star I would, when I was pregnant I did alot of research on many different bottles, I decided to go with these based on all the reviews even thow  knew they took a long time to clean, I wanted the best for my baby, but my baby is very gassy and does not burp well. I don't think there worth the time or the money.

product_title: Boppy® Bare Naked Nursing Pillow for Breast Feeding
review_body:
I registered for this because I had heard such great things about it. I am entirely disappointed. It is a hassle to deal with as far as breastfeeding is concerned. I spend a lot of my time pushing the boppy back against my body as it does not stay in place. I would recommend the \\"My Brest Friend\\" pillow before the boppy.

Don't waste your money!

product_title: Safety 1st 3 Level Booster Seat
review_body: My son, has ditched the high chair for this booster seat. He turns two years old this month and is able to get in and out of the booster seat himself. I think he loves his new found freedom. This is also perfect because now when we eat together, he feels part of the family as he is on the same level. I would highly recommend this item, absolutely no regrets. It was simple to assemble, is durable and easy to clean.  Excellent!

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body:
We originally bought this mat for my daughter when she was about six weeks old. She loved it form the moment we put her under it. There are so many different toys, textures, and sounds that she never got bored. We did add the wind chimes, which ended up being the favorite of both my babies. Emma would usually tire herself out playing on this while I did housework and I have many pictures of her sound asleep with a toy still in hand...
The fabric holds up beautifully. Emma has spilled/spit up/leaked everything imaginable on it, and it comes through the wash looking like new everytime (we wash on delicate and dry on low) Once she got too big for it, we took a couple of the toys off and put them on her shopping cart cover.
When my son was born, we pulled everything out of storage and gave it a good wash...we even threw the animals in thinking we could replace them if need be...but everything came out of the washer great. My only suggestion is to buy a couple sets of links and a make a couple of the toys low enough to grab and hold...other than that, this mat is perfect.

product_title: Fisher-Price Royal Potty (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Did not work at all!  had to return it!  We prefer the \\"Tinkle Toons\\" potty with a moisture sensor.  the motion sensor on the royal potty did not work!

product_title: Just One Year Bouncer
review_body: My baby really likes this. It's really soft, and the toys are cute and fun. I like that the toys can come off also so she can play with them.

product_title: MOBI TykeLight
review_body: This light is good at first. It then all of a sudden was really dim after a month of use. I could not longer get it back to the brighter light. I charge it all the time also. I think that is also doesn't last 10 hours.

product_title: Combi Savvy Soho DX Stroller Pattern: Electric Blue
review_body: I purchased this to replace my car seat stroller combo made by Evenflo, I thought that the stroller would accomodate my busy life (I have 5 little blessings) which the features are great, however the fabric on the basket underneath is very cheaply made like a cloth, so is some of the fabric throughout the stroller. Also is very small, I bought this for my 16 month old, and the weight limit is 45lbs so i place my soon to be normal size 3 year old son in this (he weighs about 30lbs and his head is at the very top of the head rest) This must have been made for baby dolls or something.  I plan to call the company since it shipped straight from combi. For 120.00 this should have been made better than my Evenflo, and yet it is not. The Carry bag is made better than the basket. I gave this 2 stars for the ease of use and how light it was. Do your self a favor and go with another stroller!

product_title: Eddie Bauer® 2-in-1 Harness Buddy
review_headline: loose leash not for aggressive toddler
review_body: Cons:  1. Too loose, not adjustable enough on a skinny toddler. Not tight and secure like other leashes.  2. Hot monkey on your back in the scorching summer  3. small pocket is very small and mine had velcrow/not zipper closure.  4. Buckles will hold strong fat toddler.    Pros:   So soft and cudly, My son loves to sleep with it  Cute at disneyland and mall  dirt/sweat shows up way too easy

product_title: Discontinued Item
review_body: I bought this chair after my 2 year old reffused to sit in the regular highchair, but was still not fully reaching the table to sit in a regular chair.  This chair is great, my daughter loves it and any time my older nieces and nephews come over they fight over who gets to sit there ( and their ages range from 2 - 12 :-).  Delivered quickly without problems and I am planning on getting another one soon, for my younger daughter who is almost 1yr now, so they won't fight over this one :-)

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor w. Sound Monitor w. Two Parents' Units
review_body: I purchased this item for my brother, for his new born son. (a baby that was 8 years in the waiting) The baby was doing fine but my brother was the one not sleeping, due to worry about the baby. This item is worth the money, my brother and baby are both getting a good nights rest :) Great item. I wish I would have had one when my kids were born.

product_title: Peg Perego Uno Convertible Carriage to Stroller System in Moka (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have this stroller for about a week now and it is perfect. It rides smoothly, and it has a lot of features. The color is very nice. It's good for a girl or a boy.

product_title: BABYBJORN Potty Chair
review_body: I was originally looking at buying a potty chair that had all the bells and whistles, flush noises, music, lights, the works.  Then I thought, wait a minute, the regular potty doesn't have those things.  She wants one like mommies! I got this for her after being asked repeatedly to read \\"the potty book for girls\\" She was immediately  sitting on it without any prompting. Once I finally took her pants off she went right away.  We are still working on going always on the potty, but she loves the potty itself.  It is very basic and sturdy.  My daughter had no problem sitting with the little guard on the front.  I like that it has a separate bowl and my daughter is so proud when she can take it out and flush it down the \\"big\\" potty.

product_title: Core Products 1100 Leg Spacer Sleeping Cushion
review_body: This pillow is as hard as a rock.  I don't know how they expect anyone to sleep with this thing wedged between their knees.  It felt like my knees were gripping a board. A complete waste of money.  I plan to throw it away.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body: We are very happy with the tub.  It is light, well made, made in the USA!  THANK YOU!!!  We buy a fair share of Made in China stuff, so it is nice to see a made in the USA product.  THe drain in the bottom is a great idea as well.

product_title: Fisher-Price Baby Papasan Infant Seat
review_body: I have three children and wish I would have had this with all of them. I had a very fussy new born this time and if it weren't for this amazing bouncer I would have never showered. They way it cradled her with it's soft materials enabled her to feel comfortable and secure enough to sleep which for me was incredible. It's a must have for sure!

product_title: Baby Einstein Discover and Play Entertainer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: my granddaughter, Lucy is 7 months, 22 lbs and 2'4\\" tall. carrying her is quite a workout for me. i can pop her in the baby einstein and she and i can play face to face. we especially like the music. Lucy hits the animal till there is music and waits to see what her silly nana does. i wish they had these when my girls were growing up.

product_title: Razbaby RaZberry Teether
review_body: my baby was only interested in the product for 1 days.  I think the price was a little too high for this product.

product_title: Evenflo Discovery 5 Infant Car Seat - 3 Little Bears (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: ConsumerReports says this car seat should be recalled!
review_body: It disconnected from it's base in a side impact car crash and failed to meet the federal frontal-crash standard. They believe this car seat should be recalled, and recommend only two that passed all their tests which were more rigorous than the federal tests. They recommend the Baby Trend Flex-Loc or the Graco SnugRide with EPS.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer --the only anti-microbial warmers
review_body: I used this for a few weeks but it doesn't work properly with anything other than Pamper's wipes.  The lid opens with the wipe and you wind up having to use two hands - not safe or efficient with a baby on the changing table (A Pain!!).  I took it back and got the Wipe Warmer with changing light by DEX and am very happy with it.  It has locks on the lid so you can use it with any type of wipe, a night light, a window to see how many wipes remain inside AND there's NO NEED TO BUY SPECIAL FOAM INSERTS EVERY FEW WEEKS.  You just add water directly (see instructions.)  I wish I bought this the first time!

product_title: Chicco KeyFit 22 Cortina Travel System Sahara
review_body: I can't say enough about this travel system.  It cost a bit more than the other travel systems Babies R'Us sells, but it's worth it.  I chose this system for the ease of use and relative light weight of the carseat because I have arthritis in my hands and wrists and had difficulty with some of the latches and releases of the other systems.  This thing is so easy and efficient (and the colors are nice too).  The carseat locks into place easily, the base is easy to mount and level, and the stroller is super-smooth, sturdy, and folds easily.  It also has padded harness straps so the straps don't rub and a body support for newborns.  I have only two complaints: The foot brake, at least on my stroller, can be difficult to release, and the stroller is bulky.  It may be a problem for compact car owners.  Other than that I highly recommend this system for everyone!

product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_body: My friend gave me one of these cuz she loved it so much. It is great. Our son is so comfortable in it and loves bath time. I used one of the plastic tubs once and it was so hard. He was so uncomfortable and it was so hard for me to clean him and keep him from slipping out of my hands. The safer bather is so much easier.

product_title: Baby-Says Long-Sleeve Bodysuit - Fire Trucks Fanatic in Training, 9-12 months
review_body: Soft fabric next to baby's skin and sizing is true. I didn't find that it ran big or small and seemed right on target. I'm happy with the quality and low price.

product_title: Graco SnugRide Classic Connect Infant Car Seat Base, Tan (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Slips around in the back seat.   I used some shelf liner, (rubbery kind), underneath and it did help to keep in place. Not just my car it moves around in my mom's also.

product_title: Emily 4-in-1 Convertible Crib with Complete Toddler Mattress with Hypoallergenic Waterproof Cover
review_body: the crib is pretty good, but when i was trying to put the crib together the holes in rear legs did not match.  so i had to call the company and it took them almost 3 weeks to get the parts that i needed sent to me.  to everyone out there i would not recommend buying things like furniture on the internet.  i learned my lesson.

product_title: Matte Satin Christening Gown with Ribbon and Pearl Flowers at Waist
review_body: dress was gorgeous well made and my daughter looked sooo beautiful... very happy with this purchase

product_title: The First Years HideAWay Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Horribly cheap hardware! The screws were so soft, those that didn't break, stripped out. I used a new Snap-On #2 bit to install the gate, so a worn out screwdriver was not the issue. I now have eight holes in my walls that I have to patch.
The gate operates on a ratcheting reel that is so noisy it would wake up your neighborhood and frighten the monsters right out of your kid's closet! This gate is difficult to operate with anything in your hands, nearly impossible while holding a child!Box claims \\"Easy press button to open and close\\". There are no buttons on the gate. It's a knob like the heater control in a car that is too small to get any leverage on. When you finally get it to turn, you will duck for cover as you pull the gate out in fear that someone is shooting at you! I will NEVER buy any product from this manufacturer again. Hopefully they will design better products after their \\"First Years\\".

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis iQ Duo Twin Electronic Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Too bulky and not really portable
review_body:
I am returning to work now and find that this pump is too bulky and difficult to use at work. It has too many connections and tend to be wobbly and cords tangle easily.

However as a stationary in home use pump it is excellent and very comfortable.

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 4oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I breastfeed my daughter and she has never accepted the Avent  nipple when she gets a bottle. It is very hard and she could not get a good latch. I tried the Playtex Nurser bottles and she did very well with them. They are much softer.

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_headline: We love these for our Triplets
review_body: These are great!  Our triplet girls have been wearing these sleepsacks for bedtime and naps since we brought them home from the hospital.  They were so easy for sleepy parents to use during midnight diaper changes.  We have gone through the newborn and small size and are about to buy the next size up because they work so well.  We also don't have the constant worry about SIDS issues like we would with blankets.  We highly recommend these for any new parent.

product_title: Evenflo Soft And Wide Gate Taupe & Chocolate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This gate is a pressure-mounted gate designed specifically for \\"light traffic\\" (that's what it says on the box!). It's not meant for the top of stairs. It doesn't have a latch or door that you can open and close. But it's a great gate to block off an area that has a wide opening. There are no other pressure mounted gates on the market that fit this wide of a space (up to 60 inches). The next widest pressure mounted gate covers just under 48 inches and that one was difficult to install. This one I had installed in less than 5 minutes, and it's quite secure. The gate is low enough that an average height Mom or Dad can step right over it, so the lack of a door doesn't bother me at all. (I'm 5'4\\" and have no problems swinging my leg over it). And to top it off, the price is reasonable.

If you have a narrower space and want a pressure-mounted gate with a door/latch, I recommend the Hands-Free Gate for The First Years. I've had it for over 3 years now and use it mulitple times a day without any problems. It's maximum width is 34 inches.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I also opted for the Diaper Champ because there isn't any refills. It is very easy to use, but is difficult to open. I'm afraid of ripping a fingernail completely off everytime I change the bag. My problem is with odor control. There isn't any. My newborn daughter's room smells constantly. It only takes ONE poopy diaper to smell. Yes we do change the bag regularly per other posts. We had to keep a fan on in her room during the summer just to keep the odor from a choking level. No exaggeration! If the smell wasn't a problem, I'd completely recommend this product.

product_title: Evenflo Soft And Wide Gate Taupe & Chocolate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this gate!  We are in a rental house and it has a larger door opening so we needed a larger gate that wouldn't damage the trim.  This worked great.  It really does the job!

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis On The Go Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I used my Isis for both of my children (the older one is now 6), so for well over 2 years total.  It was the best baby purchase I made.  While my girls were babies, I had every combination from full-time mom, part-time job, and full-time job.  The Isis worked well for me in all 3 situations.  I can't say enough about how fast, comfortable, quiet, small, and light this pump was for me.  (I also tried the Medela Pump N Style, but liked the ISIS better.)  I have recommended it to so many people in the past 6 years, I always joke that you'd think Avent was paying me a commission!

product_title: Kolcraft Tiny Steps 2-In-1 Walker With Mini Maestro (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son loves this walker.  He loves the music as well as the toys on the walker.  The other great thing about this walker is that once he was ready to actually walk, you can take the seat out and he can use it to walk behind.  Also, the fact that it can be folded down made it very easy for us to take with us when we visited grandma.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
The champ is great because you don't have to waste anymore money buying expensive refills like the diaper genie. This one uses regular bags (I use 32 gallon bags). I did have some problems with the odor, but I think anything you put poop in and let sit for days will have odor so that's inevitable! Here's some tricks for this Champ:

1. Put an Arm & Hammer Baking Soda box at the bottom of the pail to help eliminate orders. And the obvious, change the bag every couple days to eliminate the smell... don't expect to leave it there for a week and have it smell like roses!

2. The side straps of the diaper will get caught in the shoot so make sure you roll the diaper really tight and use the straps to hold it together, otherwise your diaper shoot will get clogged.

3. If you're like me, you probably have tons of grocery bags laying around. Keep a few handy in the nursery and use them to bag the poopy diapers. Double bagging them helps to eliminate the orders.

Hope this helps!

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor w. Sound Monitor w. Two Parents' Units
review_headline: Works well, but preset sensor is VERY sensitive
review_body:
We've used this monitor for 4 months now.
Likes:
- very sensitive. Went off only once with baby in bed (because the sensor pad had been moved to one side of the crib after changing the sheets and the baby was on the other side of the crib)
- can turn off movement sensor to just use sound monitor
- gives me some extra ease of mind even though my baby is low risk of SIDS
- has two receiving units
- long enough range that I can take the receiving unit outside
- receiving unit lights up when baby cries (nice for use while taking a shower)

Dislikes:
- only has 2 channels. Receiving units pick up static almost all the time from lights, computers, cell phone, you name it. However, we have not picked up our nextdoor neighbor's baby monitor.
- hard to turn off receiving unit without loud static noise (not good for middle of the night feedings when you want your spouse to stay asleep)
- need board over springs on crib for movement sensor pad
- very senstive - the baby's ceiling fan on high moves the mobile, which is attached to the crib, enough that the sensor picks up movement even with the baby not in the crib. Also, adults walking around the nursery causes the sensor pad to pick up movement.
- alarm goes off when you pick up the baby and forget to switch off the movement sensor

product_title: Baby Einstein Discover and Play Activity Center (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son loves this thing! It was easy to assemble (once we got out the directions) and most of the items are easy to clean. It has so many different things to look at; my son just can't get enough. He plays with all of the toys and I also believe it has helped him develop muscles crucial to sitting and standing. We recently pulled up the pegs that keep it steady. This was a little unnerving for our little guy since he started wobbling all over, so I would recommend staying very close until your baby gets use to that sensation. Mommy and 5 month old baby boy approved!

product_title: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review_body: I love this thing.  Even though it's homely, the fabric print is pretty ugly, this thing is the best thing since sliced bread.  I thought the back support sounded gimmicky, but it's one of my favorite features.  It actually makes it comfortable to nurse.  I don't end up leaning over, the back support is in just the rght place, baby loves the firm surface, and if she falls asleep nursing, I can leave it on and easily transfer her to her crib without disturbing her by moving her around too much.

product_title: Lamaze My First Fishbowl (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My 5 month old daughter will cry when I hold up any other toy she owns, but when she sees the crinkly crab, she starts kicking and smiling. She will play with it longer than any other toy. Each toy does something or feels different. It is very cute and colorful with lots of textures. It was her favorite Christmas present.

product_title: Evenflo Comfort Select Dual Auto-Cycling Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This pump was cheap but did not last. Customer service was horrible. This pump decreased my milk. It was loud, uncomfortable and poor or no suction. I contacted customer service they sent out a new pump. I still had the same issues with a brand new pump. Of course they were not aware of any issues. The problems started after only 4 weeks. I purchased a Medela pump it was the best investment. If you are unable to purchase Medela pump. Rent one from your local hospital it will make a great difference in nursing and you milk production. Medela all the way.

product_title: Munchkin Tri- Flow 2 Pack Standard Nipple System
review_body: I agree with the first mom. Tried nipple yesterday to feed son expressed breastmilk and the slow setting is way too fast.

product_title: Summer Infant Deluxe Baby Bather Blue
review_body: This is a great seat especially if you take trips to the beach or go on cruises. It folds very very flat and packs into a suitcase nicely. We've had the baby sit in it while napping in her baby beach tent, while taking a bottle, and even at the edge of the water. Then it is good for bathing in a pinch; much safer than trying to hold a slippery, soapy baby. Our baby doesn't mind not being fully submersed, but you will need more water than a standard baby tub since their bottom is a few inches off the ground. We've lent this to a handful of friends and they've all liked it very much.

product_title: The First Years Simple & Secure Stair Gate
review_body: Poorly made and I broke 4 of them in the first year

product_title: The First Years  TubtoSeat Bath Complete (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I like that the baby stays pretty well contained in the tub, but my son always slips over the seat bump that should hold him in place.  I constantly pull him up so that the bump is not on his back.  I am getting ready to use the tub as support for him to sit in our large tub, but I don't see how this will work.  It doesn't look very comfortable.  Also, the tub was difficult to assemble properly;  I couldn't get the plastic pieces to snap together as they should.  I am buying another tub now that my son is starting to sit up.

product_title: Medela Harmony Manual Breast Pump
review_body: For occasional pumping, this pump is perfect. I use this pump once or twice a day to build up a freezer stash for when my 4 month old starts solids in 2+ months. It is very easy and comfortable to use, and interchangeable with other Medela systems. It is also very easy to clean and there aren't a bunch of different parts to keep track of. This pump also comes with a detailed manual and a guide to breastfeeding (and the information is accurate).

product_title: Baby First Corporation The Baby Bath Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This product works exactly as stated. My son is very big for his age and has outgrown his baby bathtub at age 9 months. I now bathe him in the regular tub, but I was worried about my son hitting his head on the spout, even with padding he would have hurt himself. Of course, I still keep an eagle eye on him, but now I don't have to constantly grab him and move him away. I would recommend this to anyone, perhaps even to use when bathing pets!

product_title: Britax Boulevard Convertible Car Seat
review_headline: It works well, and fits my child wonderfully!
review_body: I recently had a car accident, and had to have my car seats replaced.  What a drag?  At amazon.com, it was without stress.  I just scrolled through the site and found my car seat.  In a different color of course.  Who would pick the same color that had an accident.  Sort of bad luck I suppose.  But purple is also a girls color, as much as pink is.  To those that choose this model, the head rest raises & lowers by twisting the knobs on the sides.  So as your child grows, the head rest goes up as he or she gets taller.  A#1 good purchase in my book.  Happy window shopping.

product_title: North States Auto Close Gate
review_body: This Gate is very strong and well made.  It automaticly closes which is nice. However, for older people it is a little hard to open since you have to pull up on the gate before opening. Other than that, it's a very good Gate for dogs and small children.

product_title: EvenFlo SmartSteps Exersaucer Entertainer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Perfect for our litte one.  Well worth the money.
review_body:
My husband and I looked at every single bouncer and entertainer out there before we decided on this one. We went to Toysrus and played with all of them and pushed and pulled on them and did the same thing at Walmart, Kmart, Target, etc.

We bought this one from Toysrus and we've been so happy with it. We bought this when our baby was around 3 months old and now she is 6 months old and she still loves it. We usually use this in the kitchen and it buys us time to eat breakfast, lunch or dinner. We rotate this toy with others during the day and it's good for 30 minutes at a time for us.

It's a safe toy and it's easy to clean up when there are any messes. Our little one has had some pretty big blowouts or spit-ups in this toy and it's so easy to pull the fabric out and wash it and to clean the plastic parts as well. Baby can turn around and view the different toys and pull the overhead toys as well. Baby can also bounce in this toy as my little one recently discovered and it's hardy enough that I can let her go at it and not worry that she's going to break it or fall out.

Our baby is almost 17 pounds now and she's still enjoying this toy and fits perfectly. We highly recommend this one as you definately get what you pay for in this case which is a great toy for your little one and a little peace of mind for Mom and Dad.

product_title: Evenflo Exersaucer Smartsteps Jump & Go
review_body:
We've been using this product since our son was 4 months old and we LOVE it! We set it up in the doorway between our kitchen and living room, and it keeps him happy while I do anything from folding laundry to eating dinner. It gives him plenty of exercise and he has so much fun...his jumps get higher and higher and he gets more and more excited.
Installation is super-easy and the swing can be moved to another room in a flash. The first time or two I put him in or took him out by myself, it was a little challenging, but nothing too difficult. Now it's second nature and no problem whatsoever. My son is 9 months old now and still having a blast is his jump & go. Definitely worth the money...one of our top 3 \\"baby essentials,\\" along with his swing and exersaucer!

product_title: Bungee Baby Bouncer
review_headline: Life saver for parents of 4-9 month olds!
review_body: We LOVE the bungee baby bouncer!  We give it to our closest friends who are having babies.  We used this every night from when our son was 4 months to 9 months old.  We made 'bungee mixes' on the iPod, put our son in the bouncer, and rocked!  He danced and kicked and played for about 30 minutes.  We used this to tire him out before bed time, and also during the day for great fun.  He loved the perspective of standing and moving himself rather than us doing everything for him!

product_title: Fisher-Price Aquarium Take-Along Swing (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This swing is the best. Not only is it easy for travel, you can pick it up with one hand. Which makes it easier when you are carrying a baby in the other arm. It sits down low enough that we were using the swing with my baby at two weeks old. My daughter loves to fall asleep in it.

product_title: Cloud b Lavender Lab with Scented Lavender Sleep Aid (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My 4 month old received this dog as a gift for Christmas.  It smells so lovely.  He buries his head in its face to snuggle with it.  I leave it in his crib until he falls asleep and then I remove it for the rest of the night.  It has completely baby safe features which I really appreciate.  The biggest surprise is that my 4 year old keeps sneaking it out of the baby's crib so she can sleep with it too.  It is on her list for the next holiday!

product_title: Roundabout Convertible Car Seat - Grey Wicker
review_body: both me and my baby loved this carseat. We used Graco for him before, he loved this so much better.

product_title: Boppy Luxe - Clouds
review_body: I researched which kind of nursing pillow to buy and decided on the Mothers Brest Firend pillow instead of Boppy.  When nursing with the Brest Friend pillow the baby lies flat and not on an incline.  It is very difficult to adjust the baby with the Brest Friend.  I received a couple weeks later as a gift the boppy deluxe pillow and love it!  It is comfortable for me and the baby and I can nurse the baby correctly.  He loves to nap around the pillow also.

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 4oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have a 6 week old with colic and reflux, During a doctors visit i was feeding my son and my doctor came in, He made a comment on how much air my son was sucking down from the avent bottles. You could acually see the air bubbles and hear them going down.  I was advised to switch to the doc brown bottles and this made a huge diffrence! I dont advise these bottles at all. Not to mention that one week after use 2 has already started to leak.

product_title: Basic Comfort Handy's Plus Pad
review_body: I have bought disposable bed pads in the past and they did not stay in place.  Since this is anchored under the mattress this does not move and is very absorbent.  It also is actually more economical and environmentally friendly than the disposable alternatives.  I highly recommend this product.

product_title: Baby Plus Prenatal Education System
review_body: I used this product exactly as directed from 18 weeks on in my pregnancy.  So far, my 6 month old is anything but an easy baby.  I love her dearly, but she is extremely high maintanence and fusses quite a bit.  She is finally sleeping through the night, but the claims that this product helps babies sleep through the night early on are definitely not true for all.  As far as  reaching her major milestones, she is right on target, but is by no means ahead of the pack.  I'm still hopeful that she will excel in her learning as she gets older, but I doubt I'll ever attribute it to the Baby Plus System.   Save your money and read to your child!

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body: My daughter used this from a about 5/6 months old until she was 2.  It is big enough for her to sit and enjoy her bubble bath with her toys.   I would highly recommend this product!

product_title: Playtex Baby Replacement Bottom Straws (for the Playtex QuickStraw, The Insulator Sport, Create My Own, and Baby Einstein Straw Cups): 3 Pack
review_headline: Much needed and cheaper than new cups
review_body: These came on time and brand new.  We throw away straws that have had milk curdled in them.  These save us from buying new cups!

product_title: Graco Pack 'n Play Canopy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased this item and was not as impressed as I hoped that I would be. It didn't fit my playyard as it said it would and it blows off a lot. The idea is great but you need to come up with ideas to secure the product better because the clips are a joke. More thought from the company is needed to make it more successful.

product_title: Aquarium High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This is long but I think worth reading if you're considering buying this product.

I put off getting a high chair before my daughter, Karah, was born because I thought it would be a long time till we would need one. Well, that time came very fast! After feeding her in her bouncer, car seat, exersaucer, and walker (what a mess!) we finally realized we needed to buy a real high chair. I did my research online and then I went to Toys'R'Us and tested them with my little one. I really liked the Healthy Care Aquarium High Chair and the price was very reasonable (about $65 on sale) for something I was expecting me to last a long time.

I love how close the tray can go to her chest so less food ends up in her lap. Make sure it clicks and I haven't had one problem with the tray coming off or my daughter taking it off. (I don't know how those other reviewer's kids can get the tray off. My daughter is 18 months old now and she still can't reach around the sides and undo it-her arms aren't long enough to do that. She does sometimes get her fingers pinched under the removeable tray though but not bad enough for her to cry.)

I love the 5 point harness. I do them up every time and she knows that to sit in there she has to be buckled in (she even trys to do it herself.) I love that there is a leg divider so I don't have to worry about her sliding out the bottom. Karah has always been a very active little girl and with this high chair I know she's safe. If it didn't have a 5 point harness she'd be climbing out the top. I know she's less likely to choke sitting still than getting up and down and running around the table while eating and hopefully it fosters good dinner table habits (sit and eat till done then you're excused and you eat at the table not all over the house.) You can also take the tray off and pull it up to the table if you want.

When the brakes are off this high chair is shockingly easy to move (even on carpet) and when they are on it's very difficult to move. They lock very easy if bumped (that's good and bad-good because that means Karah will accidentally lock them if she's playing around it and it will stay in place if she happens to climb in. bad-frustrating for me if I don't want them to be locked and I have to reach down and unlock each wheel (it's not hard though.))

I love how easy food washes off both trays. I love the toys hooked on the tray-they are easy to wash too. Food is not as noticeable on the cushion and it's easy to wipe off. The seat is comfortable enough for Karah to be in there for an hour playing and eating (she's a big eater-but so active that she only weighs 19lbs.) I leave the high chair out and ready for action because it's used so much! I put the big tray toy in it's storage place and it seems like Karah is always getting it and putting it on her picnic table or on the ground to play with it. When she was little the side buttons were too hard for her to push but there were plenty of other features to occupy her time.

I love how easy it goes up or down, even with her in it! I like it up high so she feels like part of the family at dinnertime but all other times I put it on the lowest setting because she loves to climb in it and I don't want her climbing in and out of it at the highest setting (even though she can!)

Lately I have been very dissappointed with products on the market, but with the Fisher Price Aquarium Healthy Care High Chair I have been nothing but happy. It's a nice, safe way to keep my little one in one place for more than a second (which is a nice, much needed, break for me!) Sorry my comments are so long but there are so many great features that couldn't be left out. (I also HIGHLY recommend the Fisher-Price Healthy care Booster Seat for any time you leave the house. There are no seams in the plastic seat to dig food out of, there's a tray, removeable tray and a cover (so you can take it back home to clean) and it folds up nicely with a carrying strap so you don't need more hands to hold it. I love it!)

product_title: J.Lamb & Friends 100% Cotton Secure Corner Crib Sheet, 2 Pack
review_body: These feel like sandpaper - seriously. Even after washing. I never used them and for me they were a total waste of money. They do look like they would fit very securely on a mattress though.

product_title: Medela Breast Feeding Contact Nipple Shield
review_body: The hospital lactation consultants really pushed this item. Know that this is detrimental to your milk supply. The baby cannot successfully compress the sinuses around the nipple if he latches on to this shield as he will suck more like he would a bottle. It took me 5 very long and frustrating weeks to wean my baby from this thing. That was time I could have spent enjoying my baby rather than fighting with him. Giving him whole, natural breast milk is extremely important to me or I would have given up and just went to formula. A friend of mine gave up on breast feeding all together when faced with the same problem. The same consultants at the same hospital pushed it on her as well.     If you have flat or inverted nipple know that you do not need an aid. Your baby knows no other nipple and will figure it out. Once the La Leche League leader in my area told me this, it gave me the strength to go for weaning my baby from it.

product_title: The First Years Carry Me Near Sleep System, Cream (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I am not sure what the other reviewer is complaining about.  I bought this bassinet and my daughter slept in it until she was 6 months old.  She slept fine in it, in fact she slept through out the night by the time she was 6 weeks old.  I never had any problems and I loved the night light, it helped me to see her if she woke at night without disturbing my husband.  I also liked the different highth positions you could use for bedside or changing table and the rocking or locking into place rolling wheels.  You could take the baby in different rooms with the top basket which was nice.  The pad that goes on top is about an 1 1/2\\" thick and the other reviewer doesn't show that.  With the pad and slight weight placed in the bassinet it evens out the slight variations.  Have you ever looked at or used a pack-n-play portable play pen.  The mattress pad that wraps around the whole unit has several segments and they are all not perfectly even.  I don't think that First Years would sell something that wasn't going to be a good product, they have been around for along time.  I would recommend this bassinet to anyone, it has so many different uses.  I would have kept my baby in it if she had not out grown it.  My daughter is a healthy 8 month old and we miss the bassinet.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Mobile with Remote Control (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: the fish stop spinning, I have owned two now and both have done the same thing. Fisher price has done nothing to help.

product_title: Safety 1st Tubside Bath Seat
review_body: OK, this bathtub does do the trick, but there are many many things that just dont work well.  The swivel is rough and dosent work while there is weight in it.  It is an akward size and shape. It is hard to get my daughter in and out of it, her legs get stuck.  I'm taking it back.....it just work for me or my 5 month old.

product_title: The Custodian. 2.5" Wireless Monitor with 1 Tilt and Pan Camera From Safe Baby. Includes Free Power Pack Valued At $24.95
review_headline: Thought video would be nice, but a little creepy...
review_body: I also bought this through Sam's club, and have to say that the video quality is excellent, but there is a lot of audio interference, buzzing and clicking. So much so that I find by morning with the thing next to my head at night I have turned the volume down, and don't even know it. I at first thought the video would be a comfort over only having audio, but instead find myself waking periodically only to note tat the baby has not moved since I laid her down, or that she seems to be too still, and since she is not crying I want to go in and poke her just to be sure. If you are going to buy video I would buy one with excellent audio, so you can hear the baby breathing, otherwise video causes me way too much anxiety, and I can hardly hear on this one over the interference anyways.

product_title: The Children's Place Boys Ski Sweater Sizes 6m - 4t
review_body: I bought this for my son and I'm glad I did. This is such a great quality sweater. The material is very flowy and not really a heavey cumbersom sweater. It's perfect for going to church or a nice outting activity. For $3.99 that I paid...not a bad deal at all.

product_title: Chocolate Brown "love" Duffle Tote
review_body: I absolutely love the look of this diaper bag. It is beautiful and the labeled organized pockets on the inside are ingenious. I also like the magnetized sections, instead of buttons or velcro. Having said that, I am going to be returning this bag. I started packing this bag shortly after my baby was born and found that after filling the labeled organized pockets I didn't have any room left. This was leaving out an extra set of clothes for baby, a blanket, and burp cloths. I found that I could shove these items in the bag but then the bag looks overstuffed, not to mention being a little awkward to carry. I am really disappointed that I need to return this bag, but I simply can't justify the impracticality for the price.

product_title: Evenflo Exersaucer Smartsteps Jump & Go
review_body: What a horrible design!  First of all my daughter hates the strap behind her head which she is constantly banging against and then the strap that goes in the bouncing mechanism is all twisted and won't stay straight.  As a result it is fraying and will break if I let her bounce in it much longer.  Luckily my daughter never smashed her hands against the door frame but as other reviewers noted this is entirely possible and likely given the design.  I was hoping to buy a fun jumper to last through all my children but this is definately not the one to buy...save your money.  Mine is going back to the manufacturer.

product_title: DaVinci Emily 3-Drawer Changer
review_body: This piece is exactly what we needed for our new baby's small room - a place to store her clothes and wipe her butt, all in one. She can continue to use it as a dresser as she gets older, so paired with a convertible crib, this piece is a good long-term investment. The quality is good, and the color is great. My favorite feature is the rails on the sides of the changing surface - they make it virtually impossible for baby to roll off. I highly recommend this product.

product_title: Chicco Travel Seat - Canarie
review_headline: Almost perfect seat for your little diner!
review_body: This seat is great for eating out with your infant/toddler. I hated the high chairs because they were a)dirty and b)often left my son barely able to reach the table. This is the solution. Light weight and easy to clean, very attractive colors and super cute hippos. We get so many compliments when we go out. I deducted one star because the design leaves a gap between baby and the table - perfect for food to fall through - which leaves a mess on the floor. If they fix that, this would be the perfect dining chair. Your baby must be able to sit up with confidence before this seat would work well.

product_title: Pump In Style Advanced Breast Pump Backpack
review_body: I won't heap on much additional praise for this excellent product. A working and nursing mom's must-have! The Dr. Brown's bottles can attach to the breastshield by simply screwing on, no additional attachments necessary. And for hands-free pumping you must purchase the Made By Moms nursing band (separate).

product_title: Chicco Polly Highchair Woodstock
review_headline: I am glad I bought this highchair
review_body: I searched and searched for the perfect highchair and I think I found it!  I bought this chair in November when our daughter was 4 months old and just starting to eat cereal.  Now she is going strong on solid foods and I love that is rolls easily, has many different heights, has different seat positions (when she falls asleep she can lay back), folds very flat, the tray stores on the back of the chair, came with 2 trays, the trays fit in the dishwasher, 5 point harness, easily wipes clean. . . and I am sure many, many more things that I love but can't list them all!

product_title: Diaper Stacker
review_body: Ive found that this item is a space saver and looks great in my daughter's nursery. Ive gotten lots of compliments.

product_title: Zooper Zydeco Stroller Brown (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: While I don't own the 2007 version, my 2005 Zooper Zydeco is fantastic!  It may be bulky for my 5ft 2inch frame, but it is the smoothest, easiest stroller I have ever pushed.  My husband and I test-drove one at a specialty store in our area before we purchased it on-line.  We were immediately impressed by its ease of maneuverablity for its size.  It's very easy to switch the seat from rear-facing to forward facing when your baby can sit up on their own.  It's very easy to collapse for storage.  We managed to adjust our Graco SnugRide infant seat onto it so that we could take our son out for walks when he was a baby.  Even now, at 21 months of age, our son loves to go for rides in his stroller.  So far, we have taken it to the beach several times.  We have had no problems pushing it through the sand.  The tires are like all-terrain bike tires so they do extremely well on and off road.  The material washes and dries well - great for when milk, juice, food, or any other \\"organic\\" material happens to fall on it... We looked at other jogger strollers and the insanely expensive, super-popular \\"Bugaboo\\" stroller.  We liked this one better.    The only down-side I could possibly write about is that it takes up all of the storage space in my car - I have a Ford Escape and this stroller leaves very little room in the storage area.  Kind of makes it difficult to go food shopping with it in the car.  Other than that, it was well worth buying.    Hope this helps anyone interested in buying one.

product_title: Kiddopotamus SwaddleMe Microfleece, Small, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I wish I had one of these for my first daughter.  Both of my children loved to be swaddled, and as a result, they both were awsome sleepers.  This is a wonderful invention (just wished it was me who invented it :) It is easy to use, and and works well. My only complaint is that my baby grew out of it after three months.  Wish they made them in sizes. Other than that, I highly recommend it!!

product_title: The First Years All Purpose Steam Sterilizer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have this and have used it for about 5 months. I have never had problems with it starting, but it drives me crazy with the dripping all over the counter and the amount of condensation. I am looking for a new sterilizer because of this. I do not recommend.

product_title: Summer Infant Ultimate Crib Sheet
review_headline: Using for 3 1/2 years- back to buy two more.
review_body: Bought these sheets before my twins were born and have been using them for 3 1/2 years.
