review_body: forget internet nanny or similar programs that your kids may get around. without this usb jump drive type devise connected (it folds into small cover with strap hook for portability, it easily fits into a shirt pocket as it is the same size as a usb jump drive), no internet connection can be made. even if you leave it laying around, they need a password (which you choose). set up is not difficult, make sure to follow directions. i tried to connect straight to internet explorer and thru my esp, either way, access was denied with key out. make sure to write down cd key # (on cd label) and your chosen password and lock in a safe place for emergency (such as a sudden case of old age and you forgot the password)

product_title: Pre-Natal and Newborn Baby Education System 5 Cd Set
review_body: In terms of pre-natal resources, this is the best I have found!  The positive results are proven.  I can not think of a reason not to buy this product.  Every expectant parent wants the most and best for their unborn child.  This system is wonderful for interacting with your child before he or she is born.  You will even notice a response from your baby!  It's very exciting!

product_title: The Floppy Seat: Deluxe Shopping Cart Seat Cover with EZ Carry Storage Bag!
review_body: After reading all the positive reviews I went out and purchased this item and was disappointed at how difficult it was to use with one hand.  Think about it....in most cases you're going to be holding a squirming infant in one arm and trying to put this thing on a shopping cart or high chair with the other.  It does come bundled up in it's own cute little sack, but it takes two hands and about 30 seconds to actually work the thing out of it's sack.  Once out, it's not super easy to get on the cart with one hand but can be done.  No biggie there...the real trouble comes when you're done shopping and you once again have your squirming infant in one arm and are trying to remove and repackage your floppy seat.  This thing is not small and trying to get it back into it's cute little sack takes some doing. And because it's so big, it's not the kind of thing you want to keep out all the time, loose from it's baggie. Too much work I say, for something that could and should be more convenient.  I exchanged mine for a Buggy Bagg. At first I balked at the price of the Buggy Bagg but later realized it is worth the extra 20 bucks.  Super easy to open, set up, remove and store all with one hand.  Plus it's got a ton of room in the diaper bag compartment so when we go out shopping or dining we don't need a diaper bag anymore.

product_title: Chicco C5 Umbrella Stroller
review_body: I purchased this stroller for my 16 month old son because I wanted a smaller lightweight stroller. I loved the look of it and the price. I put my son in it and within 10 minutes he was moaning to get out (he never cried before like this in his other stroller). There is no back support at all! It has a lightweight piece of cardboard that just buckles in. The seat barely reclines and has hardly any room. My son's arms were all scrunched up. I was so very disappointed. I returned it. Luckily Babiesrus took it back with no problem. I ended up paying double for the Maclaren Quest stroller. But it was so worth it. He is very comfortable in it. And there is much more room for him. DON'T get sucked into how nice it looks. It is a piece of crap.

product_title: Prince Lionheart bebePOD Plus, Watermelon (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: My 3 month old likes the bebe pod right now.
review_body: My daughter fits in it perfectly now at three months (13lbs). It is helping her hold her head all alone and she is starting to reach for the toy. I feel like this seat will help her develop as long as she doesnt get too big for it. I like that the set has a soft shell and I only wish the tray had some padding on the underneath. My babies legs bump the top while she stabalizes herself. I can imagine being disappionted if I had purchased this later in her development so I would suggest getting it earlier than later in the 3-14 month time frame. When I bought this product I felt a little guilty that I spent $60 on a seat but when I put her in it and saw her reaction it was worth it to me (still feel like it is alot to pay for a seat when highchairs cost the same).

product_title: Quack Along Ducks
review_headline: Great toy - but broke after 3 months use
review_body: My son absolutely loves the ducks. He will sit and pull the string to hear the tune and see them waddle along, or I can pull the ducks around the house and he will chase after them, giggling like crazy. Sadly, the sound broke on it two days ago, and now it's silent. I'm really disappointed that the toy broke so fast, as is my son. Perhaps I was unlucky, and just got a bad unit. I hope so, because its a fun and endearing toy.

product_title: Medela Pump In Style Advanced Breast Pump
review_body: I used this pump faithfully for 12 months, several times a day.  It allowed me to go back to school and finish school while knowing that my child was getting the best possible nutrition.  I never had a problem with it and it was very convenient.  I had more trouble finding time to pump.  When I was done with it I gave it to my friend who wanted to keep breastfeeding after she went back to work.  9 months later it is still going strong.

product_title: BabyBjorn Soft Bib
review_headline: Doesn't get any better than this!
review_body: I bought these for my twin boys after about two weeks of washing a mountain of \\"regular\\" bibs.  I started using them when they were about 7 months and have used nothing else since.  Now that they are ten months and self feeding, they have saved me from doing tons of extra laundry.  Their clothes rarely have any stains.  I love that I can just rinse them after each meal and either put them in the dishwasher or hand wash them at the end of the day.  They make mealtime so much easier.  One of my boys loves to rip off his bibs, but he can't budge this one!!  They also love to fish out any dropped food from the trough and try again to get it into their little mouths.  Everywhere I take the boys I get such positive feedback on them.

product_title: Kiddopotamus Dreamsie Sleeper with Sleeves Microfleece Large
review_body: I do wish these were a bit more decorative as far as just being a plain colored fabric, but they do get the job done!

product_title: Vintage Teaberry 4 Piece Crib Set
review_body: I saw this bedding online and absolutely fell in love with the whole Vintage Teaberry theme. I must say, it did look a bit cheaper and less rich-looking in the store but I figured it was a store model and bought it anyway. I set it up in our crib (dark brown wood) and it looks BEAUTIFUL! I am so glad I went ahead and purchased this set. We also bought the matching pillow and a few other items and I just love how our nursery looks. My daughter looks like a precious angel in her crib! I personally think when you consider everything it is worth 300 bucks. It is by no means luxurious but it is not cheap at all. Just in case, we have minty sage colored walls, dark brown (not cherry or mahogony) colored furniture, and a wood glider with gingham minty sage pattern and it matches beautifully with the set.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Healthy Care High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is such a great high chair.  It was a little bit more expensive than what I wanted to pay, but I definitely don't have any regrets now.  Everything about this chair is easy, from folding it up, to adjusting the height of the seat, to how easy it cleans up.  My son plays with the big tree toy on the floor but when he's sitting in the high chair, he plays with the little toy attatched to the tray.  I think this chair is very safe with the harness and the piece in the middle of the seat to block my son from falling out.  The wheels easy lock up too so the chair won't move around.  What a great buy and I would definitely recommend this to anyone.

product_title: Cosco Alpha Omega Elite 3-in-1 Car Seat
review_headline: Cosco car seats could be made better
review_body: We did not use this seat for our son as an infant. I would recommend using a carrier. But once he was over 22 pounds we purchased this car seat. It is rated well on Consumer Guide for safety. It was rated a little lower for the infant ratings. It is relatively easy to make adjustments without having to take the whole carseat apart. But the major problem I have with Cosco car seats are the chest clip. It only took a few months for the clip to become loosened (because it is not well made) and my son was able to take his tiny finger and press the button and the whole thing would come undone. According to the directions the carseat is not safe without this being clipped shut but how do you keep it shut if they make it so easy for your child to undo. They did send me a new clip free of charge but in the meantime I had to drive many a time with the clip undone. The new clip seems tight just like when I bought the car seat but I am sure in a couple of months, I will need to request another one.

product_title: Especially for Baby Steam Sterilizer
review_headline: Great Item, but NOT exclusive to Amazon
review_body:
Hi,

I bought this same unit at Target, under the label \\"First Years,\\" for about $30.00

I love it, have used it many times a day since ds was born 5 months ago. If it broke I would buy another one. I would even by this one at Amazon if I couldn't find it at Target anymore.

But I subtracted a star b/c it is dishonest of Amazon to change nothing but the label and claim an \\"exclusive.\\" Shame on Amazon.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Bouncer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Our daughter loved being in this seat from day one. HOWEVER, at 4 months, she lifted herself up and off the side, landing with her head on the floor and feet in the air. So, we don't use it anymore. It suited us very well for 3 1/2 months and I would use it again for the next child.

product_title: Medela Double Select Breast Pump
review_body:
When my lactation consultant recommended the Medela brand pumps, I was happy to find this simple to use and relatively inexpensive pump. It got me through the first week of severe engorgement and continued to work well for several months after. I did accidentally suck milk into the pump and followed the directions in the manual on how to take care of the pump after. It never seemed to pump as strong after. Then, the other day, I got milk sucked into the motor again. I was so disappointed when two days later...the suction was almost gone. I was thinking I'd have to buy another pump, and wanted to check out the other reviews on this pump before I bought another one. I was so happy to read about the lady who called Medela and was told how to clean out the motor. I followed her directions and sucked warm water in the motor, and let it all drip out...then I sucked a little alcohol into the pump to sanitize and help dry it out. The results were INCREDIBLE! Now it is pumping like it is brand new. It's like I never sucked milk into the motor at all. I was able to pump 4 ounces in one sitting where before I was lucky to get one ounce. It was such a relief to not have to purchase another pump. So like she said...don't give up. Make sure you clean out the tubes, take the sides off and dry them off after each use (moisture always seems to get in the tubes and thus the motor, no matter how careful you are), change the membranes and this pump will be your best friend!
One last note...I got sick with Shingles when my son was about 3 months, and the medicine, along with my weak immune system, affected my milk supply. This pump, along with Fenugreek, and Mother's Milk tea saved me and brought back my milk supply. It allowed me to continue breastfeeding my son, who is now 7 months old.
I don't know why so many people seemed to have problems at about 2 months. Maybe they needed to change the membranes, or clean it out. I would recommend this pump to anyone who is going to breastfead and needs to occasionally pump milk for their child.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body: Yes, because of it's size my husband refers to this as \\"the boat\\".  Despite the size we really do like this tub.  The plug leaks a bit and I could probably exchange it, but I just put an extra washcloth under the plug and that works fine.  It also won't be an issue when I start using it in the bathtub instead of on my kitchen counter.  I use it there because I feel that I have better reach and less back strain.  When he can sit up in his tub I'll move this to the bathroom.  We also use the Safer Bather with this tub for the extra stability for our son - he is a preemie and the infant side is still a little on the big side right now.  The Safer Bather works great with this tub.

product_title: Playtex 3 Pack BPA Free VentAire Wide Bottles
review_body:
When I first saw this, I was sure that it would leak, but it just seemed like such an innovative idea that I bought one anyway. The bottle is incredibly easy to clean because both ends can be removed.

I unscrewed the nipple ring and the bottom of the bottle. I was so sure that it would leak if I put anything liquid in it. I filled the bottle full of water and tossed it around on a white sheet to see if it leaked. It didn't, but I still wasn't sure. So, I washed the bottle in hot water. I've noticed that some bottles leak after being washed. Then, I tried the sheet experiment again. It didn't leak. This bottle is 9 months old and still hasn't leaked.

I also liked how these bottles were wide and took similar nipples as the disposable bottles from Playtex, which makes switching back and forth from the Playtex disposable and reusable bottles much easier and causes less nipple confusion.

product_title: The First Years  TubtoSeat Bath Complete (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Terrible product. Very uncomfortable for baby!!!!
review_body: This is probably the WORST baby product I have. It is completely unuseable! First, the bump that the baby is supposed to sit on is slippery and not big enough to give any real support to a newborn. My baby kept slipping off and would end up with the bump in his back. Then, I got it out again later to try to get some use out of it when my baby could sit. The tub didn't work this way either because the bump is sticking into his back! Also in the sitting position the baby slips down and ends up with the bar jamming into his little privates. He actually had red marks. This is terrible. I wouldn't like to sit in somehting like that so please don't buy it for your baby. Giant waste of money!!!!

product_title: BreathableBaby™ Crib Bumper - Blue Gingham
review_body: Exactly what I was looking for.  Keeps the baby's hand from being stuck and makes me feel the baby is safe because it's breathable.

product_title: ~ Mindy Harris 14 KT Diamond Child Prong Earrings
review_body:
Bought these for my granddaughter for Christmas 2008,
just had her ears pierced a few months ago, they look
so cute on her, fit her tiny ears just right!
Very Happy With My Purchase
Diane

She only wore them a few times when the back fell off,
luckily we still have the post. They were screw on backs
that didn't hold up, not happy with this fact! I'm going
to have to see if I can get new backs for them now!

product_title: Adoption Book: The Story of Your Adoption Memory Book
review_body: It's hard to find baby books that are geared toward adoption stories.  This is a nice book - great colors and patterns in it.  Many blank pages in the back for pictures and there are pockets to hold things too.  Subject topics include: \\"when we first found out about you\\", \\"what we were doing while we waited for your arrival\\", \\"your birth name\\", \\"how/why we decided on your name\\".  There are a few lines that are more geared toward international adoption, not necessarily domestic adoption (\\"received referral\\", \\"visa approval\\", \\"okay to travel\\").

product_title: Boon Benders Adaptable Silicone Utensils
review_body: The bendable features seems great, but the spoon area that's suppose to hold food needs better design. It holds very little food and it's hard to scoop up food. My 14 months old son only used this spoon a few times.  After he got the hang of feeding himself, he prefers his regular Gerber or The First Year disposable spoons that he can more easily scoop up food.

product_title: Polly High Chair - Sahara
review_headline: MOST USER FRIENDLY AND BUILD HIGHCHAIR
review_body: Well worth the investment. Its cloth is easy to clean when your child gets messy. There are 2 trays plus the tray on the bottom so you don;t have to clean after each use if you don;t have the time. The structure of this is so well built and made it will last for a bundle of children to follow. My son loves it and I think its wonderful.

product_title: Tiddliwinks Baby Travel Bumper
review_headline: Better than most on the market
review_body: This is one of the best bumpers on the market in the moderate price range. It is much higher than most, hence it provides more of soft cushioning for the child. I got this because our son started seating in the crib and he would frequently roll on the side or fall back and bump his head against the crib railings. The previous bumper was only 8\\" high and was too thin. This one is much softer, thicker and overall just looks better. Has different textures too. I'd given it 5 stars if it were not for the straps - I wish there were more straps so that it were better tied to the railings, and that the straps were hooked from the middle of the bumper not the edges, because my son easily unties the straps. Otherwise, I really like it.

product_title: DadGear Backpack Diaper Bag
review_body: Great product!  We have 3 in diapers adn just took it with us for 10 days in Disney world.  Could not have survived without it! One of the best parts is the wipes dispenser.  There are so many others- like the outside bottle/drink pockets & diaper canopy.  I love it!

product_title: Infantino Wall Mounted Mobile - Lion (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son is hilarious to watch as he stares, gives huge smiles, giggles, outright laughs, and talks to this lion.  He has been giggling at this mobile for the last 4 weeks (my son is now 3 months).  I have to say I get a kick out of watching him.  I don't have any other baby thing that prompts this kind of response.

product_title: Sesame Street Elmo 4-pc. Toddler Set
review_body:
This set is adorable and my 2 year old son loves it!!! Recent reviewers said the quilt is \\"thin\\" and yes, this is true. But my son has an entourage of 10 blankets, so it works out just fine. He gets so excited about going to sleep with ELMO, bedtime is a breeze! We introduced this set when we switched from a crib to a regular bed, and it made the transition easy.
I recommend to anyone who has a kid that likes ELMO.

product_title: Gymini Super Deluxe Gym
review_body: I love this product. My son is only 6weeks old but he loves playing on the mat. He has been playing on it since he was 2 weeks old. It is really good for tummy time because he can watch the lights and track them. I also like that the toys hang low enough for him to kick them but are not put in areas that get in his way. I could go on and on about thing I like it is a great product.

product_title: Elegant Baby Ceramic Polka Dot Piggy Bank
review_body: It's the perfect size. Appears much smaller than it is. Also comes in a really nice box. Is displayed nicely to give as a gift. I purchased it on sale and I'm waiting for another sale so I can purchase more, even though the regular price is still worth it.

product_title: BABYBJORN Travel Crib Light
review_body: I've used this crib many times now, it's very light and easy to set up.  Folding it back up takes some getting used to, but once you get the hang of how to fold it up it's easy.  The only downside has been our 3 month old sleeping so low to the ground its sometimes hard on my back to bend over to lift her out.  Overall I'm very satisfied and wouldn't trade it for anything.  The cost is well worth the convenience!

product_title: Foogo By Thermos Leak-Proof SS 12 oz - Straw Bottle, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this thermos for my son (16 months old) to replace his plastic sippy cups (since, apparently, everything plastic is the latest 'toxic' scare parents are dealing with). Good things about the Foogo - It's extremely durable. It has survived numerous drops without getting any dents or cracks. It holds plenty of water and keeps it nice and cold. The straw is soft and easy for my son to use. It's very easy to clean and re-assemble and is dishwasher safe.  Only downsides - it's a bit heavy for his little hands (but I believe you can purchase snap-on handles separately). Also, the Foogo line is not (yet?) available in Canada which means paying a bit more for shipping, but it's worth it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Constant Motion Plug-In Swing - Circus Plaid (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Power Plus Swing We love it
review_body: we bought this swing when our son was 4 weeks old. he loves swinging in it and we love that it keeps him content and it plugs in. he has slept some of each night in it since we had it. Can't imagine how many batteries we would have had to buy by now. SO the plug in is excellent!! Since this is the 1st i am sure they will make improvements. Over all I love the swing. Some things don't like: the pattern wish had differnt colors etc. to choose from, and I have had opposite of that other reviewer. My swing goes a little on the slow side. Seems slow even when on high. My son is 2 months and 14.6 lbs so it should still swing him pretty good on the high setting but seems slow. Other than that I love it! Definitely will stick with a plug in !!!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Bath Center - Aquarium (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have used this tub from the time my grandchild was first born through to her first birthday, so far.  It is absolutely excellent in growing with your child.  It took me awhile to understand what it already said in the instructions - not to put too much water in when they are little.  If you do, the baby easily slips.  But there is still enough water to play.

product_title: Mickey Mouse and Friends - Peel&Stick - 32 Wall Stickers / Wallies
review_body:
I purchased these as decorations for my son's second birthday party. Not only did they enliven the party and create a fun backdrop for the festivities, but they now hang on the wall in my son's bedroom. The wall stickers are big (about 3 feet tall for the big ones), very brightly colored, and stick easily. And they come off the wall easily. And they don't take any paint with them. And they don't leave any marks. And they stick somewhere else easily.

My son got a huge kick out of arranging them on the wall himself, and then taking them down to create another scene. We didn't let this go on indefinitely, because I'm sure the staying power of the backing adhesive doesn't measure up to my son's appetite for repetition, but I was impressed at how durable these stickers are.

If you're children are into Disney's Cars, you might want to check out the [[ASIN:B000CQ75DM Disney Cars Wall Stickers]].

product_title: Zooper Hula Stroller Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have the 2006 version of this in black, but it is basically the same.  There are some good things and some bad things about this stroller.  I did all my research before I bought it, and most of the reviews were pretty good, thats why I decided to buy it over the Maclaren Quest.    Well...Lets start with the good  1. My son loves it, he is very comfortable he is 16 months  2. It is lite, and easy to load in the car  3. It is small, and fits through aisles at the store  4. The basket is large enough for the items I need to carry, like a diaper and wipes.    As for the cons...  1. The basket drags and gets caught in the wheel, only with 1 diaper and 1 small travel pack of wipes  2. The wheels can turn any direction, although it seems that they then get stuck and don't go straight again. ( I called Zooper and they give me all these stuff to do like lubricate the wheels, and remove this and that... The stroller has only been used since April and mostly indoors!)  5. There is no way to sit all the way up, you can lie all the way down, but my son has trouble eating when he is reclined so much and keeps using the bar to pull himself up.    Thats basically all of it, For the price i paid $300.00 I wish I would have just splurged and got the Bugaboo I was looking at, but I will continue to use this stoller for my son until the next baby arrives, and then just get the Bugaboo with the ride on board or the double Maclaren.

product_title: Eddie Bauer 2 Level Wooden Booster Seat
review_body:
I bought this for my daughter as we are in between homes and without her high chair. I bought this because it is so similiar to the larger version that she has and I must say in some ways this is even better! In some ways this is better because she has more elbow room and sits higher from the tray so using a sippy cup is easier for her.

As another reviewer mentioned it is hard to secure baby while removing the tray, so I make sure the harness is super secure and I too leave the tray off the chair between feeds. The tray however does lock VERY WELL, my daughter gets a little excited sometimes and has pushed on it and it has not moved at all! The tray is also so easy to wipe down or just put in the dishwasher. I love that the cushion is a wipe down plastic, much better than cloth!

Overall it is great! I was hesitant to buy a $60 booster but I am so glad I did! I will be curious to see if we go back to the bigger high chair after two weeks with this! This will definitely be going on travels with us as well!

product_title: Graco Car Seat Travel Bag (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This bag is very thick and sturdy. It kept our car seat protected on the airplane when we had to check it.

product_title: Burt's Bees- Baby Bee Starter Kit
review_body:
I am so grateful that I received these products at my shower.
They are so gentle and natural with a lovely smell.

We only use Burt's on our beautiful Kai.

product_title: HALO Sleepsack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket
review_body: I have been using sleep sacks since my baby was 3 months old. He is now 19 months old but uses 3t cloths, do the extra large was a blessing. I could not be without it. Its very soft and the baby stays covered the whole night!! Must buy, worth every penny.

product_title: CitiTour Tandem Stroller - Tattersall
review_body: The stroller shipped with parts missing! Called today and they can't even ship the missing pieces until after the holiday! They have no system in store for express mail. I paid a lot for this stroller and I expect to be able to use it. Customer service wasn't the least bit apologetic. I'd love to say something wonderful about the stroller but it's going to be a week and a half before I get the chance to USE it!

product_title: 2 Handle Cup w/ TPE on Handles and Fat Flip-it Straw Top (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Of all the cups we have, this is the best. Because of the straw, I don't have to worry about tongue thrusting like other cups. It's easy to assemble and clean and has held up. I am buying another and throwing away my other no-leak cups.

product_title: Portable Booster Seats for Eating with Adjustable Positions | Booster Chair Travel Booster Seat | Hi-Seat by KidsKit
review_body: this booster seat works well with our kitchen table and chairs.  other booster seats raised her up too high and I couldn't slide my daughter's legs under the table lip that hung down, this one is great.

product_title: Peg Perego Ultimate Lightweight Stroller- Black/ Toffee
review_body:
I bought this stroller for my almost 2 yr old. I wanted to replace my clunky Graco with something small and light. I was planning several trips (to NYC and other places) and wanted something that would travel well. THIS WAS A LOUSEY CHOICE!! It does not steer well in airports. there is something about the shiny linoleum that makes the stroller difficult to turn with one hand (ie. you've got one hand pulling your luggage, one steering the stoller-- I'm a single mom, I travel alone). It may because my 2 year old is >30 lbs. I find it slightly easier to steer when he sits back (I often push him without the harness) but it is still way too difficult with one hand. The harness does nothing to stop my son from pulling foward (the small \\"hook\\" comes out of the small fabric slot easily). The directions have given me no solution to this problem. I often end up with just the lap buckled. Also, the basket is made of very thin fabric. I once put a heavy camera in the basket during a trip to a zoo and came home to find that a hold has worn through th fabric where the heavy camera must have made the basket drag on the ground. Also, if you are going places that have subway or railways where you may need to go through turnstyles, this is not your stroller. go with the McClaren or an umbrella stroller. they will easily fold up so you can go through narrow turnstyles. THis one will not. it folds up like the Gracos (flat and wide) and won't fit through many of the turnstyles in NYC or DC. I plan to get rid of my Aria and find myself a McClaren. I gave it one star because it is very lightweight, attractive, and cleans easily.
Happy strollin'!

product_title: Chicco Little Driver Baby Walker (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Words won't even be able to fully describe how much I (and my son) love this walker! I was very hesitant to buy it because at the time there were no reviews for it, and therefor I was worried it was a generic, unpopular product.  Well, as it turns out, even if it is, I'm glad I bought it!    I first put my son in this walker at just before 5 months, and within a week he was already cruising around the living room.  I (and my doctor) wouldn't recommend this if there are stairs nearby or uneven surfaces, but because in our house he's pretty much trapped in the living room, she said it was ok.  (We don't even use the \\"brake pads\\" that came with it, because there's a 1\\" lip going onto the tile in the next room that he can't get over, but I have tried them out, and they do stop the walker in its tracks when it starts to ride over uneven surfaces.)      Movement: We've got hardwood floors, and what I think I love most is how quietly and smoothly this walker glides around on top of it.  It's so easy for my son to propel across the room, he just has a blast in it.  Its first seat height is nice and low, so it's easy for him to reach the floor, but there are 2 more height levels beyond that.      The activity center, or \\"dashboard\\", is a riot.  I may have had as much fun as my son the first time I messed around with it.  His first time in it he went nuts hitting all the buttons, pushing the shifter and turning the steering wheel.  There's a key that when turned to one position, makes all the buttons make animal sounds, but when turned the other way, makes the buttons play songs.  That's another one of my favorite attributes of this walker--all of the songs are really cool, jazzy versions of common tunes, like the ABC's, she'll be comin' round the mountain, when the saints go marching in, and several more.  You don't get sick of it like you so easily do with other toys that play boring versions of the same song.  The steering wheel has a horn, and makes \\"traffic\\"-like soundswhen it is turned either way.  The shifter is a comfy size for his little hand, and it makes revving sounds when pushed forward and screeching brake noises when pulled back...so funny.  And then of course there are dashboard lights along top, just above the steering wheel, that light up everytime a button is pushed or a song is playing.    Storage:  The metal crossbar frame folds down so the walker lays nearly flat.  Very nice for tucking away or leaning up against the wall out of the way.      In summary, I would say its ease of motion and ability to keep my son happy for long periods of time are its best qualities.  I also really do love the fact that it plays such fun versions of all its songs.  I can hear them all day and NOT want to pull my ears off of my head.  If you want something that will genuinly entertain your baby, I would say the extra cost of this walker over others is well worth it.  Especially for how much use they'll get out of it and all the FREEDOM you'll get!!  Hopefully your child loves it as much as mine has!!

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie Twist-Away Pail System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
i just purchased a new diaper genie as a shower gift for a friend. i've had one for 6 years through 3 babies and it functioned just fine. my babies rooms never smelled and i didn't find it a challenge to operate. i never found that having 3 diapers in the first \\"sausage\\" a big deal, closing the lid kept in most of the smell. I did wish it was bigger so i could stuff in more especially when you get to size 3 and 4 diapers and the cost of refills can be prohibitive for some but then again, i'm one of those creative people who figured out how to use regular trash bags in mine.
If your bothered by the smell of dirty diapers for a few minutes when you change the bag, just think of what you are in for when the real fun of potty training starts.

product_title: Playtex 3 Pack Baby Drop Ins Nurser
review_body: I bought these bottles thinking that I was going to breastfeed my son. After I soon realized that he wanted nothing to do with it, I fed him formula from the Platex Premium Nurser bottles. Don't get me wrong, the bottles were great. However, it became a pain the continue buying the liners for the bottles and when I went to heat the bottle, you had to pour the formula into a cup because you obviously can't put the bottle in the microwave. Also, once I was able to put cereal in my son's bottle, not even the \\"fast flow\\" nipple would allow the cereal to pass. So I ended up switching to the Avent bottles. No liners, you can pop them in the microwave, and the stage 4 nipple allows the cereal mixed with the formula to pass. All babies get gassy when they drink a bottle and I found that my son did just as well with the Avent bottles as he did with the Platex Premium Nursers. It was just easier for me!!!

product_title: Sunshine Kids Travel - Bag (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The bag is big - large enough for the car seat, diapers, coats, toys, etc. I noticed a few small tears in the fabric of the bag upon return from the first and only trip we have used it on.  My only real complaint is that there is no way to lock the bag. The end of the zipper snaps into place but ther is no place for a padlock.

product_title: Baby-Says Bodysuit - My Aunt Rocks!
review_headline: wrong item sent, but problem corrected quickly...
review_body: I ordered this onesie for my sister's little one in the blue color.  I received a onesie with the correct message but in a purple/pink color.  I e-mailed the company and they sent me the correct onesie very quickly.  They were very pleasant to work with.   The quality of the onesie is very nice.....its a bit thicker and nicer than your average onesie.  I am not sure if the size holds true because my nephew hasn't tried it on yet.

product_title: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing - Nature's Touch N1973 (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This swing buys me a couple more hours of sleep in the earlymornings when my baby wants to wake up too soon.  I love the look and design and the music isn't annoying.  The mirror is great as my son loves looking at his own face a lot, great buy.

product_title: Baby Planet Solo Sport Stroller Crimson (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Buy this instead of a Maclaren!!!
review_body: I needed an umbrella stroller and I was all ready to buy a Maclaren Quest because of the good reviews. But I saw this at the store next to the Maclaren Quest and fell in love right away. Not only does it look better, the Maclaren looks downright cheap next to it. The fabric is much better on the Baby Planet, the fabric on the Maclaren looks and feels like a cheap pair of khakis. The Baby Planet feels more like a piece of good luggage, like a Tumi.    The Baby Planet has a much more comfortable looking seat because it is padded (unlike the Maclaren), and the hood is much more substantial. Also, it folded much easier. When I tried to fold the Maclaren, I could barely get it to work. I also could barely fit my foot between the rear wheels to activate the wheel locks on the Maclaren.     On the Baby Planet, you just push up on the leg rest to adjust it up. You push a round button to push it back down. On the Maclaren, you have to pull out little pieces of metal on each side to get the leg rest to be horizontal. Finally, when I saw how the seat reclined on the Baby Planet, I was sold. There are straps under the seat tied together by a plastic restraint. You simple pull on the plastic restraint, this loosens the straps, and the seat reclines to ANY angle you want!! I have never seen this before but it makes perfect sense. The Maclaren has 4 positions only, like most strollers.    When I assembled it, it was super easy (took about 5 minutes) and the pieces all feel well made. The wheels are also bigger than the wheels that come on a Maclaren, which makes for a more comforable ride. I just took it for a trip, it pushes like a dream.    The only complaint I have is that there are metal bars that criss-cross through the center of the storage basket.    Otherwise, this is the stroller I have been waiting for! Lightweight and well made!

product_title: Peter Potty Toddler Urinal (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
My almost four-year-old son has autism and I have tried so many different products and methods to potty train him. He refused and screamed no matter what approach I used. Then I ordered the Peter potty and he took immeidate interest. It took him about a week of looking at it before he actually used it. He absolutely loves the peter potty. Now we are transitioning to the regular potty, but Im positive he would still be in diapers if it weren't for this urinal.

The free standing base does adjust higher and lower, but not by much. I wish it would go higher, but my son was still able to use it even though he is extremely tall for his age (he hits closer to the top of the opening.) There is also a wall mount feature that could be used for more height control, but I didn't want to attach it to the wall. It is a nice option though.

For my son, this is the only thing that worked. Now Im free of diapers and so happy!

product_title: Mustela Bebe Dermo-Cleansing, 16.90 fl.oz
review_body: I use this for my infant and it seems to work very well.  It's very gentle cleansing and leaves skin soft.  My only complaint is that it doesn't smell like the usual baby kind of smell.  It's a little too perfumy smelling for me, but not bad enough to make me stop using it.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body: Our daughter loved this gym from day one. I think we bought it when she was only a couple weeks old and didn't expect her to react to it at all so early.   As others have said, it's great for tracking baby's development. First, all she would do is stare and stare at the eyes of the animals and wave her arms around. Now, at four months, she's grabbing and rattling and having \\"conversations\\" with them. She just discovered the mirror too. I think next will come her awareness of the crunchy butterfly and elephant ear and then finally her awareness of the peekaboo bird behind the elephant ear.  It's a great toy that'll grow with your baby. The only complaint is that the colors do fade with time and washing.

product_title: Safety 1st 900 Mhz Sight And Sound Nursery Monitor System
review_body:
We bought this monitor because we had a preemie we wanted to closely watch, but since the monitor is not very portable, we opted for this brand which came with a second portable receiver. Our reception has been decent for audio, very mediocre for video. Receiver was about 30ft away and would flicker if you sneezed. All of these we could deal with since we know Safety 1st isn't a high-end electronics company. The part that was a real stinker was the fact the video started rolling uncontrollably. This monitor has a \\"video on/off\\" switch that was apparently put in to try to preserve the life of the screen but we left our video on every night. We didn't have a receipt or anything to try to make any warranty claims so we just sucked it up and lived with having no more video. Now that little brother was here, and we already had one good camera and audio receiver, we decided to just buy a second set. Hopefully monitor 2 rooms easily. This monitor started rolling after 2 hours. There is a \\"V. Hold\\" on the back but in both cases it provided little or no help.

I'd rather have a $100 version you could hook to a cheap walmart TV, that way when the tv goes out, you can replace it. Instead, with this system, all you can do is replace one cheap video receiver with another one.

I'm returning the second unit and likely going to try one of the monitors by \\"Summer\\" instead.

product_title: Dreamer Design Manhattan Deluxe Jogger (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I just purchased the stroller today.  I put my 3 year old in it for a test run and strapped him in.  Something caught his eye and he sat forward, and completely ripped the straps of the 5 point harness clear off the back of the stroller.  My kid is not large, nor is he exceptionally strong.  All he did was lean forward, and that caused the straps to rip.  Shoddiest construction I've ever seen.  My cheap $50 stroller has held up far better over the years.  The damage is fixable... but now I have to sew the straps back on.  That's not something you should have to do to a $350+ stroller before you even get it out of the driveway.  Very disappointed.

product_title: Sumersault Fun Fairies 4 pc Crib Set
review_headline: This is so beautiful and fun!!
review_body: THis set is such beautiful quality and so precious for a little girls room. It is so much more beautiful and vivid then you see online. It has held up really well I just wish it had more than one crib sheet in the set!

product_title: Britax Regent Youth Car Seat
review_headline: Great seat, but needs a lot of room
review_body: We have 4-yr-old twins and have used Britax Roundabouts in both our vehicles for over 3 years.  We recently bought a Regent for our son, who had outgrown the old seat, since we wanted to keep him in a 5-point harness as long as possible. The Regent is an extremely comfortable, well-designed seat and is obviously big enough for years of use. Our son likes it and calls it his \\"astronaut seat\\". I would give it 5 stars, except that it's so big (compared to the Roundabout) that some cars will have trouble with it.  We have it in a Volvo V70 wagon, where it fits but definitely needs all that space.  In a small car the leg room could get tight, and the height of the seat could cause visibility problems for the driver. Measure before you buy. We have a Honda Civic also, and chose not to get a Regent for that car because of limited space.  For the Civic we got a Britax Monarch booster.  If you don't feel a strong need for the 5-point harness, the Monarch is probably more practical.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Voyager High Back Booster  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: looks pretty - try to clean it!!
review_body: Nice looking seat - had great safety ratings - and amazon reviews - we bought two - nice until one child got sick - it took 45 minutes to take the seat apart - and another half hour to reassemble - talk to the company customer service - they had nothing to say other then that is the way we design our products - we had a bowl of screws and pieces - a nightmare - just don't buy it - ours are going back.

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis iQ UNO (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This pump was a very painful experience for me and the silicone inserts which are supposed to add comfort stuck to my very sensitive breasts and peeled at the skin when I would remove the pump from my breast.  I took the pump with me on my visit to the lactation consultant who said I was doing everything properly but that the pump was just not working with my breasts.  It is also very difficult to dissasemble and clean.  I would defenitely not recommend this product.

product_title: Tiddliwinks Contoured Changing Pad - White
review_headline: If you really need it buy...
review_body: ... it. We think afterwords it was not necessary. It is bulky. You could be more happy with a portable since it is more useful.

product_title: bumGenius 3.0 One-Size Cloth Diaper
review_body: Bought one to try.  Seems to work just fine, but VERY bulky on my trim baby.   Will only be using at home!  A bit bummed as I really liked the idea of the one size (I had hoped to make these a big part of my stash).  Maybe when baby is toward the end of the size range it won't be nearly so bad.  Also bought the bumgenius AIO, which obviously fits trimmer (though not by a ton!) ok, though takes forever to dry.  My vote: OK, but not fantastic.  I don't plan to buy more of either right now, exploring other diapering products currently.  Hope this helps.

product_title: Aquarium High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This highchair is awesome. It looks a little odd, but it's really easy to use and my baby is nice & secure while he's eating. There's also a little play-thing that occupies him while I'm getting his food ready. Vinyl seat makes for a real quick & easy clean up.
Highly recommended!

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor w. Sound Monitor w. Two Parents' Units
review_body: I am currently using a medical monitor from a hospital with the wires for heartbeat and breathing.  I ordered this to replace that one when the doctor takes the hospital one away.  My wife and I connected both monitors to the baby at the same time and this monitor blinked at the same rate as the hospital monitor, just 1/2 second later.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Open Top Take-Along Swing
review_body: I purchased this swing because we wanted something to take back and forth to our parents house. Though I am VERY sorry I purchased it. When you place the baby in the swing- the seat lays almost flat/horizontal (with the foot part of the swing MUCH higher than the head position??)Very weird?? While it swings, I am afraid my daughter could end up tipping the seat backwards and land on the floor. Also, there is no head support. On the box it says that it is age appropriate from birth to 25lbs- THIS IS NOT the case. My daughter is only 4 months old and she can hold her head- but not too great yet and there is NO HEAD support with this swing. My daughter ends up leaning way over to one side of the swing- it doesn't seem to have the support that other swings have. I have another swing the head support and positioning of the way the swing sits is MUCH BETTER. To add- the mobile is horrible. It's really pitiful and hard to believe that Fisher Price put something like that on the market. The entire swing has a poor design to it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review_headline: Please be careful of tipping hazard
review_body:
I don't have a whole lot to say about this booster, but wanted to note to other buyers that there is a potential tipping hazard with the seat.

We visited with friends for lunch one day and they pulled out this booster and attached it to a folding chair and brought it to the dining room table for us to use. I sat next to my 10 month old daughter the whole time but simply did not react fast enough when she leaned forward and tipped the entire apparatus (the high chair and the adult folding chair) forward. Since the chair was facing the dining table, she ended up busting her lip right on the edge of the glass table. The booster with tray can be quite front heavy, so please be sure you only attach it to a very sturdy and preferably wide chair. And insist on it if you're visiting others (we are often too polite for our own good). My daughter is not a very active or bouncy baby, but she managed to tip it over while leaning forward. There aren't warnings to this effect on the booster seat, but I wanted to make the issue known to other parents to whom it may not have occurred.

product_title: SnugRide Infant Car Seat - Windsor
review_body:
I picked this car seat because it was relatively inexpensive and liked the snap and go. I now wish I had bought the Peg Prego car seat.

First, the button is really hard to push. It takes to two hands and you will mostly likely brake a few nails.

Second, the sun visor is cheaply made. My daughter is now 6 months old and has almost comeletly destroyed it.

Third, I dont know if all car seats have this problem but my baby sweats a lot in this car seat. We have tried putting a boppy behind her but no matter what we do her back is always wet.

Finally, this car seat is pretty heavy. I strongly recommend that when you purchase a car seat take weight into consideration.

product_title: Nursery Rhymes Coverall - Crumb Catcher Bib, Blue - Hickory Dickory Dock
review_headline: BIG bib that smells like plastic
review_body: I'm not sure I read the fine print well enough, but this bib is huge. My child is 15 months old and it's way too big for her. Maybe when she's four. Otherwise, it is a little overpowering with the new plastic smell. Another annoyance is that it's hand wash only.

product_title: Munchkin Stay Put Suction Bowl, 3 Count
review_body: My wife purchased these and what a great idea, unfortunately the suction is not that great. Licking or wetting the bottom does work but only moderately. But is there another choice, maybe a $20.00/piece set from PeopleWithoutAnyFinancialSense.com that matches their $1000.00 stroller.

product_title: The Amazing Miracle Blanket
review_body: Before the baby was born, I went shopping for receiving blankets because I felt the ones that I had were too small and too thick for a successful swaddle.  Walking down the aisle at the baby store I was completely clueless... why did they seem so small, what kind of fabric, etc.  Then I met a mom of twins who happily shared her advice... the miracle blanket.  I bought one from a specialty store and I thought, you can't go wrong - they have a satisfaction guarantee.  Well, I ended up buying two and have bought one for every baby shower since.  This is seriously the best blanket for a swaddle.  My baby loved being snug and slept so peacefully.  She used it for the first 4 months or so.  Worth every penny and much better than any blanket or the swaddle me (which was given to me as a gift).

product_title: BreathableBaby™ Bumper
review_body: I ordered this after having a \\"conventional\\" bumper that continuosly collapsed and would not stay taut.  I ordered this as a replacement and have been pleased. I have a convertible crib and the side does not go down (the kind that turns into a toddler then full size bed).   Not only is it safe but I found it easy to install and it stays up fine.  Because the material is soft, it will give if baby leans on it but it goes right  back into place.  I think it is a great safe alternative and I would recommend it to anyone - keeps babies legs/arms and pacifiers in !!!!!

product_title: BeanFramed Peek A Boo Bunny-Pink Growth Chart
review_body: This is simply adorable and my little girl just didn't want to let go of it.  I'm glad I got it for her - it's the perfect keepsake.

product_title: Kid-ding Quilted Waterproof Multi-Use Pad - 27" x 36"
review_body: I have a 9 month old daughter and we still use these multi-use pads.  We have had to sleep on the couch a few times due to her having a bad cold and I put one of the pads on the couch under a sheet, to protect the couch from accidents in the night.  I also use one of the pads on our changing station.  Hope this helps :)

product_title: Fisher-Price Aquarium Play Yard (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Awesome!  Functional, cute and practical.  My 3 month old son loved this.  I was flying to NY and had it sent ahead to Grandma's house.  Amazon shipped lightening fast.  My son loved the bright colors and even the white writing against the blue background.  It is sturdy and easy to assemble.  The mobile is a very nice touch.

product_title: Primo Freedom Trainer (Toilet Trainer) (White)
review_body: Unstable and flimsy, this piece of plastic nonsense is such a disappointment.  it's not sturdy enough to support a toddler.  I should have  known that at this cheap price that I was going to get junk.  You're better off putting a stool on the ground and a seat on the toilet.

product_title: Munchkin Dora the Explorer 6oz Insulated My First Cup
review_headline: Great cup, wish I could find more of them!
review_body: I have one of these cups in the Spongebob version.  My son loves this cup.  My son is 20 months old and needs a harder spout as his current cups have softer spouts and he is starting to chew holes through them.  I also love that the no spill valve stays in place.  My son has thrown this cup several times and  it has not cracked (another problem I have with other cups).  Unfortunately I've looked everywhere for more of these cups in my area with no luck. I haven't even found the Spongebob version being sold online.

product_title: Peg Perego Pliko P3 Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Nice but still some major drawbacks for us
review_body: I thought I'd found it all when I saw this stroller... lightweight, compact (folds like an umbrella stroller), attractive, padded comfort for the baby, multi-position reclining seat, tray, fabulous sunshade (the BEST), decent storage, narrow enough to get around in stores, adjustable handles, smooth ride, and you can easily handle it with one hand.  Just beware of 3 things: First, this stroller does NOT fold with just one hand.  The catch is hidden in each handle... you have to use both hands to release both handles together, then you can use one hand to pull up and fold.  So you can't hold your baby and fold at the same time.  This is a big drawback for people with kids who don't yet stand on their own!  Secondly, the most upright position of this stroller is still slightly reclined.  This makes looking around a little harder on wee little ones.  Combined with a tray that is pretty far out, it makes it hard for them to access the tray too.  My son keeps leaning and pulling forward, trying to sit up!   Finally, I agree that the harness is not very good.  It's not secure at all... more like a flimsier version of those leashes you can buy so you don't loose your toddler in the airport.  My 5 month old can wiggle all over the place in it, and he easily gets himself in scary positions, even when the harness is tightly adjusted.  He probably would be more content if the back would just sit more upright!  Also the harness makes it hard to use some stroller accessories since they are made for a real 5-point harness secured in a wide stance into the back of the stroller (like McClaren).  This harness just gets in the way, and it's dangerous.  I would love to either have the option to just use the lap part or else have a way to firmly secure the harness to the back.  How hard would it be to make the harness so it can clip on more securely to the back if you want that?  For $300, these are major drawbacks for us.  I am so disappointed!  I really wanted this stroller to work for us.

product_title: New Native Baby Carrier: Khaki Xlarge (chest size 40-45)
review_headline: Nice carrier but not for women with large breasts
review_body: This carrier is well made and simple to use with a newborn but if you have large breasts like I do then it can be a little challenging to wear. With larger breasts there isn't a lot of extra room for baby. Overall the carrier is comfortable and doesn't hurt my back or shoulder but the cloth can sometimes cover baby's face too much.

product_title: Baby Trend Flex Loc Infant Car Seat
review_body: We bought this car seat (and the snap 'n go) based on good reviews (not the ones listed here). It did not meet our expectations. I give it 2 stars just for the safety of it. Otherwise, I have a hard time finding positive things to say. It is way too heavy. Our baby was 7 lbs+ and from his early days, it was heavy to carry around. Now that he is almost 20 pounds at 5+ months, it is nearly impossible to carry him for any length of time. The adjustable strap often gets stuck and we really have to tug to make it work. On most grocery carts it is too big to have it face towards you as you shop. When you do clip it on to the cart, the front end is suspended in the air. I just put it sideways which is a pain. Also, the handle bar is built to be easier to carry...I don't agree. It is still awkward- I end up hooking it under my arm. Lastly, to put the handle bar up and down is very difficult. You have to squeeze the taps on both sides and really push hard to get it to release. I'm sorry that I don't have any others to recommend. I had hoped to like this and am just suffering until he doesn't need the support in the grocery cart---that is really the only reason I still use it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Jumperoo (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The Jumperoo is worth its weight in gold in that it provides so much in the way of fun and physical development for our 5 mo old grandson.  He loves everything about it: the stimulii of the toys, sounds, jumping and being able to remain in an upright position to look around.  We only regret that this apparatus wasn't available when our children were this age.  Five stars for this activity toy.

product_title: Baby-Says Bodysuit, Party tonight my crib 3 a.m., 6-9 months
review_body: Not only did I think this was hysterical, the new mother to whom I gave it to did also.

product_title: Britax Parkway Booster Car Seat, Brownstone
review_body: I usually don't write reviews on products, but this one is just too good to pass up. I have an almost 4 year old daughter who I bought this for after getting tired of watching her little head flop around in her other booster seat when she slept. This carseat has the BEST head support ever for a booster, she LOVES her new carseat and falls asleep much better in it! Her head no longer falls foward or to the side. The size of the seat is perfect in my car, not too big or wide and the material is very comfy. I would suggest this booster to anyone in the market for one, pay the extra money and you won't be disappointed! I love Britax!

product_title: EvenFlo SmartSteps Exersaucer Entertainer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son has had this toy since he was 4 months old. At first he'd cry after only a minute or two in the toy. I was later informed by my day care that it was probably due to his back muscles not being strong enough. Eventually he was able to stay in it for as long as he pleased! He's still using this toy! Being 9 months old it is perfect for jumping in. He loves to spin around, and he still enjoys the pull lights, and the electronic book (his favorite!). The 2 different noise settings are nice because he can play while my husband and I are eating dinner or cleaning. I read a few other posts, about the purple flower, and I didn't have that problem. The toy was a little interesting to put together but it is sure worth it!! It's fun because he gets so much exercise. It's durable because he is so strong now! And education? Yes! He pulls, turns, flips pages! It's so much fun watching him play.

product_title: Tuscany Valance
review_body: I had trouble finding the 7-pc set, but it's available on eBay for the same price that it was when it was in stores. When you have the whole set together it gives the room a very soft feeling. (Kind of like the old Hollywood movies with the Vaseline on the lens to make the woman look ethereal.)     Obviously the valance doesn't keep out much sun, but adding blinds (eh) or sheer panels (Yep) to the window makes it very sweet.     My favorite thing about the valance is the word \\"Love\\" printed on the green fabric.    Definatly suggest.

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis On The Go Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Put the $60 towards an electric pump!
review_body: If you are only going to be pumping once in a blue moon, then this is a great pump for you.  I found it to be an incredible nusance, so I borrowed a friend's Medela electric pump.  Never used this Back to Work pump more than twice after using hers!  Why spend a longer amount of time pumping that you have to (and yes it does take longer even though the manual says their stats say otherwise).  With our next child, I will definitely be buying electric!

product_title: Wee Gallery Art Flash Cards for Baby - Original Collection
review_body: I just bought these and my 7 week old is mesmerized by the pictures.  She loves them.  I think that she would have responded to them even earlier if I'd had them.

product_title: Lola 4 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review_body: I love this set!  The quilt material is great, but I wish the material on everything else wasn't so cottony...it fades too quick.  I just never noticed material fading on my other daughter's kidsline set.

product_title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Healthy Care High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This high chair is great.  Very easy to use and adjust.  My six month old loves the toys that come with it so much, he cries when I take them away.  The only downside is that it's plastic but that's goes for all his stuff.

product_title: Medela Freestyle Breast Pump [Model - 67060]
review_headline: pricey but top of the line
review_body: I have been using the freestyle pump for only 3 weeks but have been very happy thus far.  Motor fits easily into one hand and weighs less than 1 lb.  Everything is easy to assemble, even the bra clamps for the hands-free option (despite their initial appearance).  Love the ability to choose between AC adapter, car adapter, and rechargeable batteries as the power sources.  The soft-fit breast shields are comfortable and create a great seal.  The zip-up double-strap black/taupe bag is stylish, completely lined, of great quality, contains lots of compartments, and is an added bonus.  I was lucky and found this pump listed for a price similar to that of the other medela pump-in-style pumps and thus the decision was a no-brainer.  Would have been hesitant to pay 30-50% more as is often listed.

product_title: Graco Quattro Tour Deluxe Travel System with SafeSeat in Imperial
review_body: I am pregnant with my first baby and I wanted to make sure that I got a stroller that would fit my life, comfy for baby, sturdy but something that the baby would not outgrow in a few months and I have buy to another one. I took my time searching for the best stroller and this one is truly IT! The tags on the stroller said it was built like an SUV and I have to agree! I love that you can lock and unlock the front wheels when you need to, the extra large basket that will fit just about ANYTHING you want to put in there and the little extras of a cup holder and little holder in the middle. The best part for me is, that I don't have to buy stroller first and then search for a car seat just as good. The reviews on the safety of Graco's 5 point harness system sold me as well. It is also great, height-wise: hubby is 6'3 and I am 6'0, and the handle comes up to us just perfect! It was even easy for me to put together, without any input from hubby, in about 20 minutes. I can't wait til I can put my new baby in it! I would recommend that you buy a seperate baby head support for the first few months because the one it comes with allows for too much room for baby's head to roll around. Interestingly, I have this pattern but I did not choose it. I actually chose the Graham pattern but the factory made a mistake and labeled it Graham on the outside and put the Imperial design inside the box. I was upset because I really wanted that pattern but after putting it together and seeing it, I fell in love with it. Then after finding out for sure I was having a boy, I was even more happy with the Imperial pattern. I have read some negative reviews about it being too bulky or heavy or whatever and I almost didn't buy it. I am so glad that I didn't listen those reviews. If it seems that heavy, just keep it in the car when your not using it, simple as that. Plus, I work at DFW airport and I noticed that at least 90% of the strollers I saw were of the Graco travel system. I asked many womenwhat they thought of it and I always got rave remarks and glowing reports; so I bought it and am not sorry.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Wooden Booster Seat
review_headline: From Infant to Toddler & takes no x-tra space
review_body:
This seat works very nicely for infants when used with the tray. Once your child is older take the tray away and
your toddler eats from the table. It straps easily into your dining room seats so it saves space. The cover is machine wash/dry. Neutral fabric and wood means it doesn't look like another piece of baby gear. I began using it at 7 months and continue to use it at every meal, at 2 1/2 years. Worth the additional cost over the plastic models. The arm rests on the sides help to keep your small infant or wiggly toddler in the seat.

product_title: SnugGlider Classic Connect Infant Car Seat Swing Frame
review_headline: Great Product, but a little noisy
review_body: This is a great product. It is very light weight and portable, easy to use, and a space saver! The only drawback is that it's a bit loud. It makes a clicking sound similiar to the old school swings that you needed to wind.

product_title: Navy Eddie Bauer Weekender Diaper Bag
review_body: This is a great travel bag.  My husband actually picked it out. The style is unisex, so dad doesn't mind carrying it with him.  Many compartments, roomy, very nice bag.

product_title: Terry Contoured Changing Pad Cover - Blue
review_body: I admit that while it wasnt a necessity, Ive enjoyed having this cover. When accidents happen, it completely soaks everything up and doesnt puddle onto my changing pad (I still do clean it though). It hasnt fallen apart in my washer and Ive already washed it many, many times. Baby likes that he doesnt have to be laid on a cold pastic-y surface when its time for a diaper change.

product_title: Miracle Blanket Swaddling Baby Blanket - Unisex Colors
review_body: Love this blanket. Tried the other brands... didn't contain our guy. We also gave this as a shower gift... they love it too.    Only neg, is our babe is really long  (over 25in at 7weeks), so we swaddle him with his feet out of the pouch. Still works great!    He sleeps 6-7 hours with it, 1-2 without it.

product_title: Cosco High Back Booster Car Seat  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The top clip is not difficult for me to use but my daughter hasn't figured it out yet - which is the way I want it.  I've also used it as a booster and I was satisfied with the way the buckle looped through and stayed in place.  I also like the strap on the bottom that allows me to add a little slack or tighten it a little.  I think that's a really important feature - especially in this season when my kid may be wearing a jacket one day and none the next and also if you use the car seat for different kids that are similar but not exactly the same size.  I have another car seat without that and I find that sometimes I can't get it closed because it's too tight and sometimes there's too much slack.

product_title: Ugly Doll "Bop N' Beep" (Blue/Green) Clip-On
review_body: I love ugly dolls, and these ones are very cute because they're just one with two faces. I got one for me and a friend like a childish friendship keychain.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Car Seat Travel Bag
review_body: I recently used this bag to hold my 4 year olds Graco booster seat.  It fit perfectly with plenty of room for other things. I actually filled a garbage bag with diapers, baby food, toys, etc. and was able to fit it in the bag with the booster.  I was a little concerned about it because the material it's made of is somewhat thin, but it held up well.  It would be nice if it had back pack type straps. But other than that I would recommend it.

product_title: Jeep Weekender Tote
review_headline: Not weekender but a day tote
review_body: I ordered it because it was called a \\"weekender\\" tote but its more like a larger day tote. It won't hold enough for a whole weekend. I like the various outside pockets. Includes an innner \\"dirty duds\\" zipped bag that is so small I'm not sure what they expect you to put in it. Also comes with a changing pad that folds up. Straps are long enough for a smaller person to use as shoulder straps but not long enough for my tall husband. Well made and a good regular diaper bag. Just advertised as something it is not.

product_title: Classy Kid Green and Clean Disposable Placemats (20-Pack)
review_body: These placemats have come in handy for eating out with our 2 year old.  He can color on them, but they can't be thrown off the table or dropped.  It is also a convenient place to put his food.  We have used the plastic disposable placemats as well, but those can't be colored on, so they are not as useful.  We usually end up using the crayons that they give him in the restaurant, though.  The triangular crayons break too easy.  He was also able to pull the paper wrapper off too easily.  They seem like a good idea, but it would be better if they were jumbo size and sturdier.

product_title: DaVinci Jenny Lind Changing Table
review_headline: We had to return this table due to water damage
review_body: When we opened the box that this table came in I immediately was struck by the peculiar smell of mildew/varnish mixture. Upon examination we found that the shelves had water marks indicating some type of water damage. The smell of the varnish was also too strong to consider keeping this item in a baby's room.

product_title: The First Years Hands Free Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Even my three and a half year old nephew couldn't figure it out without guidance.  It keeps the kids where you want them!

product_title: Bumble Bags Jessica Messenger Backpack
review_body: I really like this bag. It fits everything I need for my 15 month old and room for what I will need for my newborn in a few months. I love the backpack feature. I have used it as a backpack several times and now I couldn't live withouot it. I think there is room for some improvements - better, more comfortable straps (these are stiff and sometimes chaffe), and a slightly stiffer fabric for the bag and lighter colored interior would be helpful. Other than that, I love the bag!

product_title: Tiny Steps 2-in-1 Walker-Fantasia
review_body:
This is the second walker that I purchased for my son. First of all, he is a big boy and the other walker did not adjust high enough for his height. Also, the other walker did not seem to encourage him to walk forward. All he would do in the other walker is walk backward.

It seems that this walker had toys that encouraged him to lean over a little thus pushing him forward and he realized that he could move forward!! Also, the height is great and the toys are really cute on the walker. The music is pleasant to listen to also.

I would recommend this to anyone!

product_title: EvenFlo SmartSteps Exersaucer Entertainer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I should start off by tell you all that my daughter has Cerebral Palsy and is 14 months old.  I purchased this for her about 6 months ago after much debate since she HATES walkers and swings. Before this the only thing she would sit in was her Jumperoo. She enjoys being in the Exersaucer for short periods of time.  The lights, sounds and colors are great for her since she has vision problems.  She loves the apple it makes her smile everytime she hears it giggle. The reason that I am giving it only 4 stars is that the large springs were not in the box. I had to call Evenflo about the problem and they sent the springs to me for free. So, no complaints there. It's just the fact you pay 100.00 for a item and all the parts are not there.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body:
Baby loves all the colors and toys.
Lots of \\"extras\\" built into this.
Great buy!!!

product_title: Suction Cup Mobile
review_body: I tried everything, cleaning the window, cleaning the suction cup, wetting the suction cup, etc., etc.  Good thing I ALWAYS keep my receipts - hassle free returns are great!

product_title: Baby Boom Thomas & Friends Blanket
review_headline: Super soft, but smaller than expected
review_body: I bought this blanket for a 3 year old. The blanket is super soft but it's a little smaller than expected. The kiddo loves it and always has it when he comes over to my house!

product_title: Kiddopotamus Bibbity Rinse & Roll Bib, Yellow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These bibs are too hard and difficult to store.  I found the Dex bibs softer on baby's neck and easy to store!

product_title: Child's Spindle Rocking Chair
review_body: I was a bit leary at first about ordering this chair as the description is a bit lacking and it's always problematic purchasing furniture sight unseen.  I made the leap and ordered two, one for each of my daughters.  I can not tell you how pleased we are with the product.  The construction is very sturdy -- the chairs are of quality make and a nice heavy wood.  We ordered the honey stain and it is a beautiful maple color.  Both of the chairs shipped promptly and the Seller was very responsive to my questions.

product_title: BABYBJORN Booster Seat - White (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got this for my 2-year-old who loves to sit at the bench at our kitchen table but needs some \\"boosting\\" to sit comfortably there and eat.  It's working fine, but I wish the rubber stoppers on the bottom of the seat were a little more rubbery/sticky.  We can't use the straps to attach it to a chair since we're using it on a bench.  I was hoping the rubber on the bottom would keep it from sliding around, but it doesn't really serve that purpose.  Otherwise it's a good booster seat.

product_title: Baby Jogger Liquid Holster
review_headline: Holds drinks well for us caffeine addicts
review_body: Holds drinks well.  Though coffee drinks still slosh out of the opening if full; but as expected with any holder if on the move.  Only one that is adaptable for any stroller.  Used same one for three different strollers thru the years.  Cannot be without it!

product_title: Evenflo SimpleStep Pressure Gate Taupe (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: At first look this gate seems like it would be the perfect gate for families with older and younger children.  I was looking forward to having my older children be able to walk through the gate without climbing over and at the same time keep my little one off of the stairs.  When I opened the box the gate was unusable from the beginning.  The latching mechanism did not even meet the other side of the gate.  It was 2 or 3 inches short of even latching.  I checked the box and directions to make sure I wasn't missing anything.  Nope.  Just made wrong!

product_title: Graco Angelcare Movement Sensor with Nursery Monitor
review_headline: Sleep w/ ease (excepting the false alarms!)
review_body: Our neighbor lent us his Angelcare Sensor when we brought our baby home, and let me tell you, I was such a nervous 1st time parent, I wouldn't have been able to sleep without it!  We use the No-tic motion sensor, & while our baby was in his bassinet, it was great!  We moved him to the crib, though, & have had two false alarms.  Keep watch on your baby's sleeping patterns for a little while after you move them to the crib, because ours is a \\"scooter\\", moves himself out of his no-roll brace to the head of the crib, which caused himself to move out of the sensor's range twice, setting off the alarm (SLEEPLESS  NIGHT!!!)  After we readjusted it under the mattress, all was well, and we could sleep with peace of mind once again.  This is a MUST for all parents!

product_title: Magic Moments Learning Seat
review_body:
My 4 month old son, who could barely lift his shoulders was tipped out of the seat twice because the weight distribution in the base is not balanced. If your baby can lift his/her shoulders the seat will tip forward all the way and flip over. If any weight is placed on the front of the seat at all it will flip forward. Because I also have a 16 month old daughter, who would love to get her hands on my newborn son, I had to keep him on table tops. When I had him in this particualr bouncy seat (I have two different ones) on the table and he was able to lift his head and shoulders, he tipped the seat and flipped out onto the floor fracturing his skull. It could have been worse, but he is fine and fully recovered. The second time was when I had him on the floor in it. The same thing happened.

I have another bouncy seat, which is completely safe. Even my 32 lb. toddler can't tip it over when she sits in it. It is the Ocean Wonders Aquarium seat.

I obviously do not recomend this bouncy seat and think it should be taken off the market, or revised for proper balance and weight distribution.

product_title: The First Years Close And Secure Sleeper,Colors May Vary
review_body:
Our little one was born less than 2 weeks ago and the co-sleeper has been a life saver. Prior to his birth we assumed that he would sleep in the bassinet for a while and we would use the co-sleeper occassionally to be closer to him. After his birth we found that we wanted him closer to us at night so we used the co-sleeper right off the bat. It worked out great, he sleeps like a log in it and we feel more secure that he is safe(first time parents!). It's night having him so close while you sleep as you can hear his breathing pattern and as soon as he starts to wake. He seems more comfortable in it than in the bassinet, possibly because he could feel us closer to him while he rests. We usually swaddle him at night and use a burp cloth folded up and wedged on both sides so he feels more cozy and we are assured he wont roll to his side especially when we get in and out of bed.

Great purchase, will use with our next child for sure!

product_title: JJ Cole Collections Bundle Me Baby Infant - Sage
review_body:
I highly recommend the 'Bundle Me'. We live in Chicago where it's quite cold in winter.
It is so easy to just put my baby in her car seat and zip the bundle bag up without having to fuss with a winter suit. It keeps her really warm, and it's so soft. What a great idea! It's money well spent.

product_title: Evenflo Soft And Wide Gate Taupe & Chocolate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Travels well, good for large doors, no hardware to install
