review_body:
I bought this gate for a large entryway between my kitchen and family room. I liked that it did not require the installation of special hardware, which most of the other large-space gates did. When it arrived, I found it easy to assemble, and once I got the hang of the tension rods, it was very easy to put up. I also didn't have any problem taking it down at night when the baby was asleep; there are clear markings on the knobs indicating how to expand or contract the rods; a few twists and the gate came down.

The gate is about 27.5\\" high. As some other reviewers have mentioned, you do have to climb over this gate while it is in place. It does not have the open/close gate option of some of the newer systems out there. However, my husband and I are tall enough that this isn't a problem.

I like that the gate is versatile enough to move to any room in the house; when my son was old enough to venture around the house more, we took it out of the kitchen doorway and now use it to block our office, so that I can be in here writing this review while my son plays in the living room outside, and I don't have to worry about him climbing under my desk. I also love that the gate is easy to disassemble and travel with; we flew to see family in New Jersey in July and we brought the gate along, tucked into the same bag as the playpen.

The gate expands to 5 feet, but it can only retract to about 38 inches. However, you can adjust the top and bottom tension bars to different widths, which I liked because the bottom rests against my trim and the top on the wall, so there is some variation in width there.

I have found that if you set the gate up with too much tension, it will pull the paint off of your walls, so this is the biggest problem in my opinion. However, we resolved this by buying some $2 wall guards, usually used for walls where doorknobs hit, and sticking them in the place where the gate is most often set up. Another problem was that our cat, who is somewhat skittish, was afraid to jump over it; she got the hang of it eventually.

In all, this is a good gate for temporary use in places where you want to keep kids out until they're a little older. It's not permanent, and it should not be used atop stairs. There is some minor wall damage if you set it too tight, but the ease of travel and storage makes this a good gate to have for a backup or at Grandma's house.blem was that our cat, who is somewhat skittish, was afraid to jump over it; she got the hang of it eventually.

product_title: Decathlon Convertible Car Seat - hampton
review_body: My daughter had problems with acid reflux from the time she was only a few weeks old.  She hated her infant carrier-type car seat so much that she screamed through entire trips.  We finally discovered that those carrier car seats can make acid reflux worse in some infants because of the way in \\"scrunches\\" them in the middle.  So when she about 3 1/2 months old we decided that we needed a different style car seat.  We opted for the Decathlon because we liked the inserts that surround an infant.  We were worried that she would get lost in a convertible seat since she was so young.  We also liked the fact that it has such a high weight limit that we knew she would be in the seat for a long time.  It was totally worth the investment!  We went to the store and put her in all of the seats to see how she fit in them.  She did not cry at all when she was trying the Decathlon, and we found the winner!  She was very happy in her seat and for the first time, she didn't cry so much on car trips.  We lost the portability of the carrier seat, but it was worth having a happier baby.  My daughter is now 15 months old and the Decathlon is still in great shape and she still fits perfectly in it.  We have obviously adjusted the height of the shoulder straps, and moved the crotch buckle, and turned it front-facing, but she still loves her seat!  Overall I am so glad we purchased this seat and I have no regrets about putting her in this convertible seat at such a young age.  I felt she was very safe in her decathlon.

product_title: Skipping Hippos Juniper Hot Pink Poncho
review_body: both my kids love their ponchos!  so easy to throw over their heads and out the door.  a must have for all little girls

product_title: Faux Shearling Posh Pouch Infant Car Seat Cover - Fawn
review_headline: one of my favorite baby items
review_body: This has been wonderful for a cold weather new baby, it keeps the cold out, you can fold it up to keep out rain or snow and it seems to keep strangers grimy hands off of the baby as he is nestled deep into the carrier and covered by the kiddopatamus. We get more comments on this cover, people stop us in the mall to ask where we got it.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body:
The tub came so fast and the shipping was only $5.00, I was planning to buy this same tub from Babies R Us but it was going to cost me $50.00. The tub was $24.00 and shipping was $26.00. That was craziness. This bathtub came within 2 days in great condition and it has been well used. Thanks!
As for the tub, I love that it is so deep. I can give my baby a bath without getting water all over the floor (unless she is splashing) it has two sides to it, one for infants and the other for toddlers, She'll be able to use this tub until she is two. Also there is a Safer Bather pillow that can be used on the infant side that keeps them from laying on the hard cold plastic, it is sold separately but I would say definitely buy it. I've used other bath tubs when visiting family and friends and I'm so glad I have this one. I bought one for a friend as a baby shower gift and she equally loves as much as I.

product_title: The First Years Hands Free Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This seems to be well made but I have a 4 month old toy poodle.  Weighs 3.2 pounds.  She gets over this.  Not good for any dog since they don't come too much smaller than mine

product_title: Maclaren Twin Triumph Coffee Brown Stroller (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased this product to hold my very tall 4 year old (often mistaken for 6) and my 2 year old.  This product works very well and my oldest daughter doesn't have to worry about her head rubbing on the umbrella or her knees being up in her throat.  It also folds up and requires very little room in your vehicle.  I was extremely happy to receive the additional pads for the stroller, my only wish would be for an additional umbrella.  Also if this is any indication of how great it is ....I have friends and sisters begging for it when I am done.

product_title: The First Years Night Cravings Bottle Warmer & Cooler
review_body: When I first bought this, over a year ago, I was hesitant about the price - it being so low compared to other brands. Rest assured, this is all you will need! My finicky baby had to have his warm Alimentum. This bottle warmer is sooo quick and easy, I could put the water up to the predetermined line of the measurer(that comes with) poor it in and left it alone. It was ready within a minute and after a few shakes, it was the perfect temperature. This is also helpful for warming up baby food jars (Comes with a special attachment just for that purpose) The warmer was dropped twice on the floor so it can defently take a beating! Outside is easy to clean (the water deposits on the warmer - not so much) All in all It did the job for my little boy. And for $16 GET IT! And Get one for the Grandparents! Don't spend $30 on a bigger and bulker item that will do the same thing!

product_title: Graco Quattro Tour Deluxe stroller - Milan Milan
review_body: I don't own this exact stroller.  But the only difference is that mine has a different design on the material covering it.  This stroller is a bit clunky and heavy so if you have a small house/apartment or limited space then this is not the stroller for you.  But if you do, this stroller is a really good one to buy.  It has a clock built in which, for me, is convenient seeing as I walk everywhere I go and lose track of time fairly easily.  It also has four positions to recline your little one, plenty of storage space, is easy to fold and unfold and also has a thermometer so you know what the temperature is wherever you are.  That feature isn't necessary but I like it.  The only drawback about this is that the basket is a real pain in the neck to collapse.  I can never seem to do it with mine but maybe it's just me.

product_title: Fisher-Price Flutterbye Mobile (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I absolutely love the look of this mobile and bought it for my baby.  I put it together and it did not work - no music, no movement, no lights.  I took it back to the store and got another one, I figured it was just a fluke.  But, again after I put it together it did not work!!  I was so frustrated, I tried everything to get it to work, I tried different batteries, I took it apart and put it back together, I read other reviews and tried those suggestions, I called Fisher Price (they told me to exchange it again!), but nothing worked.  I can understand one faulty mobile but to get another just proves that this particular mobile is of poor quality.  I love Fisher Price, too bad they can't get their act together with this mobile.

product_title: HALO SleepSack 100% Cotton Wearable Blanket, Cream, X-Large
review_body:
I've used these sleep sacks since my daughter was born, and she is 17 months now. I love them!! I use the cotton ones during the summer months and the microfiber ones for the winter months. They keep my baby warm without me having to use blankets (which she would never keep on anyway.) My daughter actually recognizes the sleep sack as part of her bedtime routine, and will start waving and saying \\"night night\\" to everyone as soon as I put it on her.

I've bought some sleep sacks in other brands, but they aren't as durable as the Halo ones.

product_title: 4moms Digital Bath Spout Cover with Built-in Thermometer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Excellent Intuitive Solution to the Common Bathtime Challenge!
review_body:
As father of a 15 month-old daughter, I must say these '4moms' got it right! The struggle of finding and maintaining a safe bathtime temperature, while protecting the kids from a bang of the head on the tub spout is officially over. Having sought the perfect solution to this challenge over the past year-plus (and being disappointed repeatedly), when I learned of this I was willing to pay a bit extra to see if I had found the right product. Let me be clear up front, I DID, and it is worth every penny!

Installation is easy and quick - slip it over the spout, snug the velcro strap to secure it and you're done. Convert it from Demo Mode per the included instructions, and it's ready to use. The padding is excellent, the display very readable, and the color coding is invaluable. Also, the shower diverter remains functional, unlike virtually every other spout cover.

First test of the thermometer, and we watched it go from blue to green to red, for cold to warm to hot, and all coincided with what we 'thought' we had accurately felt previously. However, we discovered that we had likely flirted with hot on more than one occasion as we settled on the temperature that we normally felt was right for our daughter. Yikes! With this product in use there is no guessing, you'll look and know if the temp is right. An added value and peace of mind for us, is that now when we're looking for comfortable rinse water toward the end of the bath, we'll know we're there.

With a second child on the way, and a bevy of visiting nieces and nephews, this is certain to get much use in the coming years. A BIG Thank You to the '4moms' for putting out a terrific solution! I look forward to others as you expand your product line.

product_title: phil&teds Metoo Highchair, Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got this hook on seat for my 5 month old and he does really well in it.  I had a different hook on seat that  I had used for my older two boys when they were small, but it was so big and bulky.  This seat is incredibly lightweight and easy to take along when we go out to eat.  I even use it at home and hook it only the island in my kitchen.  He gets to sit in it and play while I cook and clean up throughout the day.  I feel like the way it hooks to the table is a really secure way and I have no fear of him falling. Overall it's a great chair and I would for sure recommend this to others.

product_title: Safety 1st Grip 'n Go Walker
review_headline: The safest walker on the market, I think
review_body: I was a bit skeptical to buy this walker after the video review that someone had posted but I went ahead and bought it anyway after checking it out in the store.     When it arrived, we did have some trouble putting it together (the same problem area as the guy in the video).  However, my husband was able to snap it in (it took some maneuvering, some tools, and a few choice swear words) and has been fabulous ever since then.  We've put all our weight on it, pulled and pushed, carried it by the problem leg and it hasn't budged.  So it is secure once you snap it in correctly.    What I love most about this walker is how safe it is.  The base is wide enough so that it can't tip forward and the best part is that if the wheels are off kilter even a tiny bit, the walker stops dead in it's tracks and can't be moved.  Even going from the kitchen tile to the living room carpet (there is about an inch height difference), it stops and has to be physically lifted off the ground and carried into the next room. As with everything, you should always supervise your child when in a walker, but it makes me feel safe that if I turn my back to throw something out, I know he isn't going to go flying.     It doesn't roll so good on the carpet, but then again what does?  I know there is some debate about the use of walkers, but since my son can't walk yet without holding on (he cruises like a pro), this is a really great way for him to be independent of us.  I'm glad I bought it.

product_title: Mommys Helper Kid Keeper
review_headline: Great product -- I just ordered a second one
review_body: I have a big (~22#) very active 14 month old daughter who has been walking for several months.  She's very fast and usually fearless -- and she will readily zip off to explore the world on her own, leaving her parents in the dust! <smile>     We purchased the first harness about a month ago.  The first time we put it on her at home (-- a \\"test run\\" --), she didn't like it -- but that's not unusual for small children.  However, she got used to it quickly and it has become standard-operating-procedure for her to put it on before we go out to the car and go anywhere.  While she likes to explore things, she also recognizes/respects the boundaries it establishes.  I also find that the waistband makes a good handhold when giving her piggy-back rides.  Unlike another reviewer, I have not had any difficulty with the velcro not holding or the child opening the velcro -- however, that difference might be caused by the difference in the age or temperment of the children.    The two suggestions that I would offer other parents are:  (a) Allow the child to become accustomed to the harness BEFORE going out in public -- take the child for walks around the house or in the yard -- and (b) keep the shoulder straps very loose -- as the harness is much, much easier to put on and take off that way, and there is no functional reason that the straps need to be tight.    The only suggestion I would offer to the manufacturer is to include padding sleeves to put over the shoulder straps where they go along the neck.  This would prevent chaffing if the shoulder straps are kept tight.  (However, as a note to parents, if the shoulder straps are kept loose, chaffing is not an issue.)

product_title: Summer Infant Baby's Quiet Sounds Video Monitor with 5" Screen (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
My husband and I originally bought this item by mistake at Babies 'R Us. It was on the wrong shelf and we thought it was $100, but when we went through checkout, we found out it was more, but decided to just go ahead and get this one anyway. When we got home and tried it out the screen had a big fuzzy black line in the middle of it. We figured it was just a bad one and we would take it back into the store and return it. Later that week we took it to the store and returned it. Brought it back home, tried it out and this one, the screen was totally messed up! Well, we really wanted this particular monitor because of the features it had, so we were going to try once more. We took it back to the store and this time we asked them if we could try it out before we drove all the way home. They agreed and they ended up trying out about 3 before we finally realized that this product is just horrible! They said it must have been a bad shipment, but still!
One good thing, the store was very cooperative and apologetic.

product_title: Battat Mirror Pound-A-Ball Toy, Colors May Vary
review_body: This toy requires you to POUND the ball really hard.  I'm not sure I want my 1 year old to learn to hit ANYTHING with a hammer that hard.   I'm putting it away (it was a gift) for a year and then we'll see.  I'm super bummed b/c it looked like it would be so much fun.

product_title: Boppy Noggin Next Head Support, Denim (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The product worked fine per say. The problem was that we took our son to a specialist for some flatness on the back of his head (four months old). We showed the noggin nest to him and after looking at it a couple of minutes he said he felt it was good marketing but shouldn't be used. He said that any surface on which the baby's head lies, becomes firm with the weight of his own head and therefore contributes to the flatness. And with the way our son would turn his head and lay in one position in his car seat, it's true that it still ends up being just another surface. He also said that given that his flat spot was due to him favoring one position, it would be important to not cradle his head straight, rather help him move it the other direction to loosen up the muscles. Both our specialist and our physical therapist strongly recommended not using this product. Instead, just lots of tummy time has helped him already.     Along the same lines, they also said that boppy seats and exersaucers should NOT be used because they deter babies from developing proper back and neck strength.

product_title: Bumbo Baby Seat, Blue
review_body: My baby has develooped very quickly.  Yet, he can't hold himself up for more than a few.  WIth this chair I can sit him on the counter while I do dishes.  I can put him in the shower or tub with me and we can bath at the same time.  He can sit on the couch between me and my husband and not feel left out.  He can sit in the rocking chair and just look silly when we take his picture.  He can sit on his own in a restaurant.  It is so safe because the bottom widens out.  It is WATERPROOF, like the box says so you can put him in the tub, he can throw up and it's so easy to clean, you can take it to the beach.  MIRACLE ITEM.

product_title: Fisher-Price Soothing Motions Glider - Butter Bunny (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: if you want your baby to sleep BUY THIS!
review_body: We bought this when our daughter was 2 months old. and it was part of her night routine!! she fall sleep in it EVERY TIME. plus it was the perfect place to put her after feedings or if we have guest or just doing chores around the house! this is by far our fav. baby gear product. however now that she's 7 months old, she doesn't like it as much because now that she can roll and sit she feels that it's restraining her. but we had to do it all again, we will buy it at a heart beat!! it gave us 5 months of happiness!!  P.S. check other places you might find it cheaper.

product_title: Cloud b Sound Machine Soother
review_body: I am having hard time training my six-month to sleep by herself.  I am so desperate that I gave the sleep sheep a try.  The sheep is cute. But the soothing sounds did not work at all.

product_title: Dex Products Secure Sleeper
review_headline: Not for little ones, but great later!
review_body: Like other reviewers, when my daughter was really little, this did not work at all.  She would slip down the wedge to where I was concerned about her being able to breathe. We wound up using just the basic Sassy side positioners to keep her from rolling over in her swaddle. However - once she weighed enough to sort of sink into the foam, around 15 lbs, this wedge has become an essential!  It helped her breathe when she had colds by keeping her head elevated. Now she just plain likes sleeping on it!

product_title: my best friend Inflatable breast feeding pillow
review_body: I have both the Boppy and My Brest Friend.  If I had to buy only one, it would be the Boppy because my son can use it for playtime.  The Brest Friend is good for sitting in chairs but not good for sitting up in bed.  Although if in bed you could probably nurse lying down.  I don't know in I have an older verison, but the cover is really hard to take off and clean since the cover opens to a foam pad.    Nursing pillows need to be cleaned often and I was very disappointed.  That's why I can't give it 5 stars.

product_title: Disney Princess Storage Table and Chairs
review_headline: It's the nices set  in the market thats not expensive
review_body: It looks nice in my daughter room everything matches.

product_title: BABYBJORN Baby Carrier Original
review_headline: Don't buy it until/unless you really need it...
review_body:
I received this as a gift when I had my first baby...my husband used it a couple times around the house to rock him to sleep. We didn't really use it with my second son 14 months later...maybe because we had a double stroller and they went around in that all the time...NOW introduce new baby sister 3.5 years after our first baby. She was a late spring baby so we were able to use the carrier at picnics and get togethers at friends' homes when I needed to mingle around. This way I didn't have to carry the car seat around with me....but now that it is winter, we really don't need it. And once the babies become heavier than 15 pounds, it really does a number on your back.

SO if you are considering buying this...I would suggest only buy it if you are having a Spring baby so that you can use this during the summer. Or if you have 2 other rugrats that you need to hold onto when crossing parking lots...other than that, the car seats are just fine. You will only really use this a maximum of 4 months.

product_title: Safety 1st Secure Lock Bed Rail
review_body:
The product seems very sturdy. The two 'feet' that slip between the mattress and box springs have grips that hold the assembly in place. The rail itself has a bar on the top and bottom like a curtain rod holding a see-through mesh so the child can see through. It took two of us to assemble but we are quite satisfied.
AS

product_title: New Native Carrier Organic Khaki LRG
review_body: I have used this carrier for three children now. It is great. My husband can even wear it. My fourth child is only a month old. I never take his car seat out of the car. ONe of us carries the baby in the new native. I even wear it at church. It is nice for people to be able to look at him without touching. I have tried the over the shoulder, the maya and this. I love it. I am ordering another one for the summer...

product_title: Kidsline Gossamer Wings Hamper
review_body: We liked the inside net hamper that can be removed when you take the clothes to the washer machine. The hamper itself is a bit unstable but it is of good quality and looks great in the baby room!

product_title: Graco Contempo Highchair in Graham
review_body: I purchased this for my 6 month old because I think Graco is a quality brand and I really liked the folding feature. My son is a big baby and the bottom part of the seat is not long enough. I planned for him to be in this until he was ready to sit at the table, but he'll outgrow it within 6 months. I also don't like the attached tray. I don't see the point of it. This is my 4th child, so my 4th highchair and I'm just not impressed with it.

product_title: BreathableBaby™ Bumper
review_body:
We sleep better now knowing these bumpers are on our sons crib.

They are great, you would think since they are \\"breathable\\" they would be thin but they are not. They are very well padded and easier to instal verses the conventional crib bumpers.

For those who have not had to worry over crib bumpers yet, go to the store and pull out a bumper in a bedding set pack and stick your face into it and try to breath. You will not be able too. They are crazy thick. Yes they match the decor but they are not safe. Also per the pediatrics guidlines they say not to use a bumper at all because of the thickness of the conventional ones, but when you see a little arm stuck in between the posts you will see why they are even still made.

product_title: JJ Cole Essentials Blanket
review_body:
2007: I bought this blanket mostly to use under my three year old's play table--so he could paint and play with play dough on top of our new light tan carpet. It's great for protecting the carpet--anything on it cleans up easily. My only complaint is that it moves around easily--bunches up and I have to straighten it out to keep the carpet covered. I've also used it outside on a cold autumn afternoon for a picnic. Kept grass stains off me and gave us a nice bit of insulation from the cold ground. Despite the tendency to bunch up when on top of a carpet, I'm really glad I got it and would certainly recommend it.

[Update - 2014:] Six years and one more boy later I am still using this blanket. It now lives in the back of the car and comes out for soccer games, going to the park, and (especially) camping. It definitely doesn't look new - but it's held up amazingly well and has No rips or tears in it. When car camping, this is what I lay down in front of our tent door. Makes sitting down to take off shoes much nicer - also nice for the knees when kneeling down and reaching into the tent to grab something.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Complete Play Yard with Bassinet & Changing Station Bryant Collection
review_headline: cannot get it set up !  OK NOW IT WORKS !!
review_body: Is nice if you can get it set up. The railings along the top fold and have some sort of handle or clasp that is supposed to snap and lock into position.    Very difficult to get it to lock into position. We got it set up once and liked it. But when I took it down and put intot he carrying bag, then opened up I could NOT get it to lock into position. The mid-point of each rail has some sort of handle that lets you push upward to relase the rail and fold it for storage. However it does not let you snap back inot lock position.     I'm going to search the internet for instructions or else toss it in the trash tonight.      OK ! I figured it out. I found a link that mentioned the directions were in a flap on the bottom of the unit. I found out that :    1. open the unit pulling from opposite corners (without setting center floor pin )    2. Snap short edges into place    3. Snap long edges into place    4. push center floor pin ito place    I bump it to 2 * for the hassel. But if I would have know this ahead of time I think it is of 4 * quality

product_title: Sassy My Little Sunshine Mirror (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son loves this little mirror.  He enjoys when the cheeks light up and when he sees himself.  He also loves to chew on the butterfly and ladybug.  I checked on the sassy web site and I did find this product listed there.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Deluxe - Noah's Ark
review_body: We received this as a shower gift and I have to say it's our daughter's \\"favorite\\".  It's so awesome, it has won 4 awards (Parenting winner: Toy of the Year; Openheim Toy Portfolio: Best Toy Award Gold Seal; Parents' Choice Silver Honor; Openheim Toy Portfolio: Blue Chip Classic Award Winner) and I can see why.  It's lightwight, so easy to travel with and set up anywhere.  Plus, it's easy to clean.  Our baby LOVES it.  She's been playing with it since she was a few weeks old (when she could look at the objects above and hear the music) now she's only 3 months old and is now 'batting' at the mobiles and 'cooing' at herself in the mirror.  We also love it for \\"tummy time.\\"  My husband and I have taken it EVERYWHERE and our baby is always entertained, plus, it makes her feel \\"at home\\" when we're at grandma's or others.  Buy this and/or give it as a gift!!

product_title: Kolcraft Contours Options Tandem Stroller, Ruby
review_body: I bought this stroller even with the negative comments spoken about on Amazon.com and I'm so glad I did!  I love my stroller.  I only have 1 6 month old child right now but plan on having another w/in the two years so we made the investment into a double stroler.    Some complaints I heard:  1.) It's HUGE!  Yes, it's big, but so are all double strolers.  I own a Saturn Vue & it fits great in the back & I still have plenty of room to put stuff on top of the stroller & around it.  2.) It's HEAVY!  I really don't agree with this.  I guess it depends on what you think a double stroller should weigh.  I have no problem getting it in & out of my car.  3.) There's no TRAY: I'll have to admit, I was hesitant about this one, but I can snap his toys on the saftey bar so I don't have any issues yet.  Maybe when he's a little older & wants snacks.  I guess I'll have to give him them one at a time instead of dumping a pile on his tray.  4.) Seats not DEEP enough: This was the other comment I tossed & turned about. My friend's 3 year old sits in the stroller when we go out toghether & she fits perfectly.      Things I love about the stroller: I love the storage room under the seats, I love the harnesses (very easy to use & keeps him in there), I love the reclining options-it's so easy to lay him back so he can sleep, I love the removable seats & the options for which way the baby faces, I love how easy it is to manuver & you don't kick the basket when walking which is what bothered my husband with our previous Graco.    Things I don't like about the stroller: It took me some time getting used to how long it is, having only owned a single stroller, It takes two hands to get it opened & closed (not as quick & easy as a single stroller) and that's about it.    I'd highly recommend anyone with 2 small kids or a family of 1 wanting to have another child soon, to consider this stroller as opposed to buying a single stroller.  My girl friends all want this stroller & I get stopped all the time when out with my son & the stroller asking me about it.  It's definately high quality & worth the cost.

product_title: Deluxe Shopping Cart Cover - Toile
review_headline: It fits a Target cart like a glove
review_body: This is such a wonderful product.  My daughter loved it!  Suddenly going to the store with mommy became so much fun!  I researched and looked at so many sites, offering all kinds of covers, read reviews and despite some negative reviews, decided to buy this one. I am very happy with it.  Being able to put it on and off with one hand is awesome! Knowing that my sweetie is comfy and warm because of the padding is great.  I recommend this cover to anyone who does not feel like wasting money.

product_title: All Stars 6 Piece Crib Bedding Set
review_body: My husband and I both agreed on this set when we found out that I was pregnant with a boy. Every thing about it is great. Now we are having a second boy and they will be sharing a room. I am so happy with the way this product has lasted through washes and my son. It will definatley be going through another baby. I even bought another sheet so I can put it on my son's toddler bed. It was extreamly easy to find a coordinating blanket for the toddler bed also. I would strongly suggest this set to any one.

product_title: Baby Trend Snap-N-Go EX Universal Infant Car Seat Stroller
review_headline: Loved The Double had to get the Single
review_body:
When we found out we were having triplets, we like all other multiple parents bought a stroller to accommodate all the babies. The stroller is so large that we can not even fit it into a mini van. We have to purchase a large SUV or Full size van to go anywhere.

We bought the Latch Lock carriers from baby trend and we just love them. When we saw the stroller that went along with them. We decided to order the Double Snap N Go.

The stroller comes all put together, you just need to snap on the wheels. Then comes the fun part. The stroller is made for many different brands of carriers. You find the carrier you are using in the instruction manual and then you remove bars or rearrange them to fit your carrier. It is very simple and all the parts are well labeled.

The carriers just snap on to the top, just like when you snap them into the base that is in the car. There is a strap that goes over the lower half of the carrier to prevent it from rocking or coming off the stroller. It is great because you do not have to unsnap your baby from the car seat and them snap them into the stroller. No need to transfer toys and blankets from car seat to stroller. What a time saver.

It is very light weight and easy to set up. I pull it out of the trunk and just snap and lock it into place. I then just snap the carriers in place and we are off. It takes up the same amount of room that a normal single travel system would take up.
For all you shoppers out there. I took the stroller into a women's clothing store and was able to easily navigate the store. The stroller handles very well. The front wheels are adjustable. You can set them for straight ahead or let them rotate.

Because we have 3 babies, we easily become a tourist attraction. The stroller handles so well that I was able to move swiftly and accurately through spectators and display racks.

We love the Double Snap N Go so much that we have asked for the Single Snap N Go for our Baby Shower.

product_title: Babylicious Sit and Spit Cloths - Blue
review_body: I like these because they are so cute looking and nice and thick but they are just a bit on the small side

product_title: Roundabout Convertible Car Seat - Grey Wicker
review_headline: Easy setup car seat good fit and easy to use
review_body:
We have this seat and an evenflow.

The good: This one is the seat that I choose to move from car to car (grandma etc) since it's fasten system is the easiest of every car seat I have ever used, both forward and backwards. It makes it worth the price alone. My son got sick in it and I was able to take the cover off and machine wash even though it says not to and air dried it. Worked great! The Velcro for straps helps keep them out of the way when putting them into the seat and prevents twisting.

The Bad: It sits so high my son can kick the seat in front of him much to my wife's dismay. Rear facing in a small car requires it is between the seats for proper installation. Taking the cover off requires rethreading the belts as does changing sizes, but you should have to do this rarely.

Bottom line, I would buy it again.

product_title: Babylicious 4-Pc. Crib Bedding Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The crib set itself is stunning- if you like something contemporary.I ordered it from baby age and had the same thing happen- received a pink feeding pillow.They weren't very helpful or pleasant in the way they handled the transaction. They did not honour the advertised price.I ended up buying the ultra bedding set from a local boutique.

product_title: Graco Digital Deluxe iMonitor Baby Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The sound quality is very good.  That being said we have 2 problems.  1) it seems the parent units have to have almost a direct line of sight with minimal walls and doors between to get good signal.  2) if power is lost in the home the child unit does not turn back on automatically so both parent units will be beeping because they can't find the base.  HUGE problem at 3am.  For a tiny infant you can sneak in and turn the base back on, but as my son got older this was not practical.  Very disappointing.  We ended up just getting rid of the monitor.  I could not even bring myself to sell it because the problems with loss of power were so bad I did not want to put another parent though that.

product_title: Baby Smart Cooshie Booster Seat - Green
review_body: I decided to spend a little more than I wanted on this booster for my 3-year-old son. It fits perfectly on my dining room chairs and it doesn't slip unless you really are trying to move it. My son likes to use it, which is a wonder if you knew my son. I actually wish I would remember to bring this booster with me to restaurants because it's a lot wider than those little booster seats they have in those restaurants so it looks like it's more comfortable for him and a little safer because it won't tip over as easily as the ones they usually have in restaurants.

product_title: Cooshie Booster & Travel Bag - Blue
review_headline: Loved the Booster - travel bag was not shipped
review_body: My wiggly giggly girl sits in this booster.  For us it has worked much better than the hard plastic that is available in most stores.  My only frustration is that the travel bag was not shipped with the item and it was really impossible to figure out how to get one sent to me that I gave up trying to get it.

product_title: BABYBJORN Baby Carrier Active, Black/Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Fine if you just want a carrier for a newborn
review_body:
Don't be fooled into thinking that this carrier is the best by the sheer number of them out there. We were given one by our parents when our son was born and it was fine for the first few months. However, as soon as he hit 15 lbs the shoulder pain became unbearable when wearing him for more than 5 minutes. We did an incredible amount of research and switched to an Ellaroo Mei Hip (also available on Amazon) and have never looked back. They are incredibly comfortable and shift the weight to the hip instead of the soft part of the shoulder. (Our friend has the Ellaroo Mei Tai carrier for her newborn and loves that too.)

Again, this isn't a bad carrier, it just isn't that functional afte rthe first few months. Its also padded in such a way that it is difficult to fold it up small enough to carry in the diaper bag and still have room for other stuff.

product_title: Graco Pack 'N Play Playard with Bassinet, Tango in the Tongo (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have four kids and almost always buy Graco products, and we are not disappointed with this one, either!

product_title: BABYBJORN Potty Chair
review_body: Great potty. We had the BabyBjorn Little potty and loved that, but our daughter was getting a little tall for that one. This one is a good height for her (small, 21 months) and is so easy to clean. Our daughter took to it well, and puts her \\"FooFoo\\" dog on the little potty while she uses this bigger one.

product_title: Summer Infant Deluxe Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this to spy on my 15-month old. I couldn't figure out why she wasn't napping and what on earth she was doing all night. Each time I went in to check on her, it made her hysterical. I researched a lot of monitors before deciding on this one. I am so pleased with this. If your expectations are to get HD quality, or even color, this won't meet your expectations. However, I can see her in her crib both day and night and it is very clear, but mostly in black and white. My only complaint is that there is static every once in a while and if you have the volume on, it can be distracting. I have wi-fi and cordless everything and have experienced no interference. The only thing that interferes is when my cell phone is nearby and I get a call.    I live in a 3-story home and her bedroom is on the top level. I was able to go to the basement and still see her clearly. Now I can workout in the morning and watch for her to wake up. There is a clip for my belt or a kickstand to prop it up on the dresser. I love this and I'm bummed I didn't get one earlier.

product_title: Baby Einstein Discover & Play Star (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We received the Baby Einsten Star as a gift for our infant.  He LOVES it!  At 5 weeks, it was really the only toy that captured his attention for any length of time.  He loves the blinking cheeks and the music.  It can instantly change him from fussy to happy. At 7 weeks he now reaches out to touch the different sides, and the smiling face.  I like that this toy will grow with him. The sides require different actions to achieve the sound effect, i.e. one is pull, one push, two squeeze.  At first I was opposed to toys like this with flashing lights and all the \\"bells and whistles.\\"  When you are so small though, that all you can do is watch your toy while mommy shows you how it works, the lights and bells and whistles are captivating!

product_title: Itzbeen Pocket Nanny Baby Care Timer
review_body:
When I got this item as a shower gift last year, I couldn't wait to use it. Once my son was born, you had to pry this thing out of my cold dead hands. It went everywhere with us and if we happened to forget it, we were lost.

Perhaps, like some people, they think it's silly. It's a gadget this is true, but when you're a new parent and you are flying by the seat of your pants, in a haze of sleep deprivation, this is a great tool to help you remember the basics. We slept with it, we dragged it around the house with us like a security blanket. We flew cross country when my son was five weeks, and this thing was an absolute godsend. Do math? With a newborn? Haha!

True, it's a short lived need. Once your baby gets on a schedule, you won't really need to rely on it so much. By about 2.5 months, we were able to put it away. But in the time we did use it, we USED it. I see people selling these used on ebay, saying that they got it and ended up forgetting about it, which is sad.

I will echo the other people here in that I would have liked a feature that allowed you to record the amount they last ate.

Bottom line, it's great for new parents, and even a seasoned second time parent. I'm sure wrangling a toddler and a newborn, can't be easy.

product_title: SafeFit Baby In Sight (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A must have for a traveling mom
review_body:
Like some other reviewers have said, the mirror does scratch easily but for me, it's barely noticable.

I travel A LOT with my daughter at this time in our lives, so it seems impossible for me to drive without this mirror. It has been a lifesaver.

product_title: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing - Nature's Touch N1973 (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We registered for this swing, received it for a shower gift, and couldn't be happier.We've been using it almost daily for three months, and the batteries are still going strong.I feel that this swing is perfect for newborns and up because of the incline, you don't feel like your infant is going to fall out of it when it starts swinging.So, you can use it right away. The motor is very quiet.The colors of the swing, and fabric are very neutral and calming. We love the option to use the swing, or the cradle. We moved it up into our bedroom because our son sleeps the longest stretches in it at night. He is three months old now, and is now interested in the mobile, and mirror above. The music keeps him interested/or asleep. I even love the back pocket, which is useful for extra pacifiers in our case!

product_title: BABYBJORN Potty Chair
review_body: With five young children in our home, we have two of these Baby Bjorn potties. With constant use (and abuse) they still look brand new! They are easy to clean (I have even stuck the bowl portion in the dishwasher) and easy to transport. My kids LOVE the bright colors which make potty training easier :) Well worth the money!!

product_title: Graco 4 Gallon Cool Mist Humidifier
review_headline: Does the job and great price
review_body: I agree this is a very quiet unit on the low settings. Even the high isn't bad. Very easy to fill, love that and really puts out alot of moisture into the air. Best price for sure on Amazon and I too researched until I was almost sick and the reviews on many other sites say this is the one to get. Glad I did. We really like it.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body: I got it for my daughter when she grew out of the fold up tub and she loves it. She can sit there and splash around. She doesn't slide down due to the fact that there is a section in the tub that is between her legs that keeps her from sliding. I would highly recommend this to everyone. The only downfall is that it isn't very easy to store. It is very safe for all babies. I am keeping it for when I have another baby. It's easy to clean and lots of fun for her. Hope this helps.

product_title: KidCo Configure Gate 24" Extension
review_headline: Nice addition to the configure gate
review_body: I bought two extensions to add to my configure gate.  I love it!  I've had no problems at all with instability, but you have to be sure not to have the gate too straight.  You have to have some bends (angles) in it to keep it sturdy.  I have triplet daughters and have used this gate with two extensions added to it for 3 years now and have not had any trouble with it whatsoever and the gate is still as good as the day we bought it.  Highly recommend this gate to anyone, it's worth every penny!

product_title: Crib Shield System White
review_body: this item solved my problems with my baby putting his arms and leggs through the bars when hes sleeping the only problem i have is the two short pannels on either end wont stay up due to my son always pulling them down

product_title: JJ Cole Infant Original Bundleme, Pink
review_body: This is one of my favorite items! We used it for four months straight and it was wonderful. It is still in great condition. It was nice not have take extra blankets with us that just fall off. Plus it was nice for when our little one had accidents...just through it in the wash!

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Jumperoo (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: You will never regret buying this item. It is by far the best thing i've rec'd as a baby gift. My twins love it and if your debating whether to spend the money (as i was), just BUY it- it is hours of entertainment!!!!

product_title: Combi Avatar Convertible Car Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: great seat and even greater price
review_body: I love this seat.  I returned the Alpha Omega Elite for this one.  It is super cushy and comfy, comparable to a Britax.  It reclines while the baby is in it, so if he falls asleep, I just reach around and lay him back a little without disturbing him.  The Baby Bargains book gave this one an A- too.  The only thing that takes some time to get used to is the belt fastener.  You must hold the two pieces together as you insert it into the latch.  But I definately would not pay $100 more for a Britax, this seat has it all!

product_title: Wheely Car Seat Carrier
review_body: I couldn't imagine traveling with a wandering toddler alone with all the carry-ons AND the car seat. This car seat carrier sure is a life saver. It's easy to use, easy to roll and easy to fold & store. It makes a big difference having those wheels. My only concern with this product was the fabric, it was thinner than I expected. If it were to have a sturdier fabric, it would be perfect.

product_title: Miracle Blanket Swaddling Baby Blanket - Girl Colors
review_headline: Only for babies up to 14 weeks
review_body: Bought this product when my baby was 13 weeks old, as the product information said \\"one size fits all\\" with no further info.  When it arrived and after paying more for expedited shipping, I was extremely disappointed to see that the packaging said only to use it on babies up to 14 weeks! This should be clearly stated in the product description.

product_title: Regalo Easy Diner Portable High Chair with Travel Bag
review_body: this seat is great. my 1 year old loves it. she is at the table with us and it is convienient to use. easy set up and take down we use it as our every day high chair and have retired our trusty big exspensive one. the liner pulls out easy for daily washing and i just found out the whole chair can be taken apart and hung in the shower for a good washing in minuts!!!!!perfect product for a germ a phob like me!!!!!

product_title: Evenflo Comfi Angled Bottle 9oz (3Pack)
review_body: I ordered the Evenflo bottles for my niece and she received them within a few days. Amazon delivery service was excellent with this product. She absolutely loved the product and I would definitely considering ordering again from them.

product_title: Trend High Chair - Malawi
review_body:
I am so happy with this purchase. My husband and I looked for a long time for a \\"perfect\\" chair. We learned that there is no such a thing as perfection, but this chair came very close to what we had in mind. We liked that it was comfortable and had an arm chair look and feel. We liked that it came with two different types of pads (vinyl and cotton). And we loved two extra trays. But most of all we liked how safe and sturdy it seemed, how nice and snug the harness fit and how our baby enjoyed playing in it for an hour or longer in total comfort. Not too many other chairs offered all the features and extras of Malawi. Even if you don't think you'll use the recline feature get a chair with that option, you won't regret it. You might use it more often than you think.

P.S. Tiny infants will all seem even smaller when you put them in the big chair with a large tray in front of them. Their little arms could get stuck behind any tray. So make sure you pull their little arms out and place them on the tray before you push the tray towards them. I know it's a common sense advice, but you'd be surprised how many of our relatives forgot to do it when putting our baby in a chair.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a great swing--it reclines or sits up, swings back and forth as well as side to side, has multiple speed settings, plays music as well as three nature sounds, the mobile lights up and moves, and the legs close so you can slip it between a bureau and wall for storage. We do wish that the music played a bit longer, it shuts itself off rather quickly. We have not yet found that it goes through batteries too quickly. Our daughter loves it and it gives us a much needed break during the evening 'witching hours.'

product_title: Dr. Brown's 8 oz. Natural Flow Wide Neck Bottle
review_body:
I had purchased the Dr. Brown bottles after the birth of my boy/girl twins in hopes of helping my son with his gasiness. They did help ease his suffering but he was also put on soy which seemed to help the most. By this point, both babies had become attached to these bottles and wouldn't use anything else.

At first I thought I must be doing something wrong for them to continually leak, and sometimes POUR out of the rim of the bottle. (I have a total of 4 kids and have been through lots of different types of bottles, none this bad!) We tried Everthing to stop the leaks -
*using only all dry parts for each new bottle
*not heating or storing in the fridge with the valve and stem inside
*not overfilling

After an entire year of frustration with these leaking bottles I noticed that when my son would hold it by the nipple or squeeze the nipple, that milk would come pouring down the sides! Finally, the answer to the leaks!!!

Is truly a great idea and I hope they try to perfect it, but these have a MAJOR DESIGN FLAW - and babies drenched with formula in the middle of the night is no fun. These items were meant for baby use, and for the price it should help make babies' & mom's life easier.

Stick with Avent or Playtex with liners. Thank you & Good Luck!

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review_body: I have bought 5 of these so far, 2 for me when my grand children visit and 3 for others. Everyone I have bought one for loves it. I am still using it, even with my 3 yr old grandson. It is so easy to clean and stor. For the price you can't beat this chair. I bought a different one at first and threw it away, the cleaning time just wasn't worth it. This is a great chair for it's portabilty and easy cleaning. You won't regret buying this.

product_title: BOB Sun Shield For Single Sport Utility Stroller Models
review_body: The sun shield works and seems to block out the sun but it does seem to trap in heat. I take my daughter in the early morning and it's fine but when it's hot outside in the afternoon I have to leave the sides open so she can get a breeze. I would not use it in really hot temps because it just traps in too much heat.

product_title: Seat 2 Go Safari Stroller Attachment
review_headline: A fantastic accessory for those with two little ones.
review_body:
I can't say enough about how wonderful this accessory is. Your child can stand or sit or you can use it as a strangely convenient shelf when you are out and about. I live in Brooklyn and I would have to say that if you live in a city and you have two little ones this is the way to go!

People were constantly stopping us and asking us where we purchased the Safari Seat 2 Go. When the first one broke I didn't have to think twice about getting another one. We simply could not live without it.

product_title: Taggies Bear Sleepy Fleece
review_headline: My baby loves the taggy bear sleepy fleece!
review_body: My baby loves to rub the tags on the bear fleece!  It's soothing when she is cranky or sleepy.  It's well sewn - and no loose ends to fall off and get stuck in baby's mouth!

product_title: BABYBJORN Toilet Trainer
review_body: I bought this for my 8 months old daughter after she had been using the BabyBjorn potty for a month or so. I realised that it wasn't much fun cleaning the potty so decided to give this toilet seat a go and it's been working great for us. My daughter is happy seating on it, it's small enough for her and it's very easy to install, put on and take off.

product_title: The First Years Hands Free Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought two much cheaper gates before buying this one and really wish I would have just bought this one to begin with. It is well worth the money and doesn't fall down when pushed against and the floor handle works really well when my hands are full. Also, just a note I thought mine was bent when I first got it, but once my husband installed it according to the directions it was perfect.

product_title: The First Years 3 in 1 Learning Potty
review_body: The round hole is too small for boys.  The top does snap on to toilet but it slides frontwards and backwards.

product_title: Summer Infant Sweet Dreams 6 Piece Set (Comforter, Bumper, Crib Ruffle, 2 Crib Sheets And Valance) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I was a little concerned after reading the one review there was on this product, but it was soo cute I had to chance it.  And I'm so glad that I did!  This bedding is absolutely adorable, and it's even cuter in person than in the picture.  The pink is very pretty, not as coral-y as it looks online. And the coordinating colors are white, a light cocoa brown and chocolate brown.  The bear on the comforter is so soft and furry with chocolate stitching all around.  There's cute feminine flowers, fun polka-dots, darling butterflies, and sweet bears. The bears dresses are seersucker and the bows are satin.  It comes with 2 different crib sheets (one polka-dot and one flowered) for different looks.  The cotton isn't ultra soft or luxe, but the quality is very good and the bumper pad I received wasn't thin or flimsy at all. Overall, I am so happy with this set and think it was well worth the $$.  And Amazon had the best deal--and trust me-- I shopped around!

product_title: Medela
review_body: I have a week old newborn and I decided to pump after having a hard time breatfeeding. I used the heafty-duty-industrial pump that while I was at the hospital and this pump is just as durable and easy to use as the one in the hospital.  I had a hard time spending so much money on a pump, but after reading many reviews I decided to go with this one.  Now, I couldn't live without it.  It's so light and portable, I can't imagine not having this product.

product_title: Safety 1st Apex 65 Booster Car Seat
review_headline: My children love this seat and so do I.
review_body: I have a Britax Wizard and this car seat installed in my Honday Odyssey and my two children fight over who gets to sit in this Apex 65 car seat.  It is big and roomy and has just enough cushioning.  It has all of the same safety features of the britax that sits next to it.  Both have 5 point harnesses above and beyond 40 pounds and side impact protection.  The difference?  This one costs half the price, my kids like it better and so do I.  It seems easier to get them into and out of it.  I also think that they are not going to outgrow this one as fast as they will the britax - as it is much narrower and the crotch strap is shorter.

product_title: Baby's First Year Keepsake Stamp Pad Calendar in Blue
review_headline: Great calendar to record baby's first year
review_body: I like this calendar because it gives lots of space for writing events and even includes an ink pad for footprints. The ink pad is not the invisible kind though and takes  a while to get off.

product_title: Leachco Prop 'R Shopper Body Fit Shopping Cart Cover
review_headline: Not the color and pattern descibed
review_body: Didn't like the pattern and was expecting the Sage Pin Dot pattern as described, however when I received this, it is blue.  Had to pay for shipping again to return the item.

product_title: Britax Marathon Carseat - All Star Blue
review_body:
So many convertibles car seat to choose from but the Britax Marathon name kept coming up in every online review as well as every online forum.

I was very pleased that the Marathon can handle a child up to 65lbs in a five point harness. No other seat that I reviewed offered this feature. I also liked the fact that the seat was very easy to use and install with the latch and tether strap.

My son fit nicely at age 7 months and the transition from infant car seat was very pleasant for him as he did not like his Peg Perego Primo Viaggio.

The price for the Britax Marathon retails for $270.00 everywhere. However the price differed tremendously when I shopped online. I did find traveling tikes.com to have the most competitive price at $220.00. Their price included free shipping and I payed no sale tax as I lived outside California.
They offered a great selection of colors to choose from and had the color I wanted in stock.

I believe I made the best choice after very carefull review and hope that this add if published help those whom review my comments.

product_title: Cosco Alpha Omega Elite Convertible Car Seat  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great seat, great size, great price!
review_body: I purchased this seat last week after much research and debate. I have a 1 year old who I am bumping out of her infant seat. I was torn between the Graco Safe Seat Step 2 and this Alpha Omega Elite. After comparing the 2 side by side in the store, the Graco seat was HUGE and had a wierd shape to it. I wasn't sure how it would fit in my car, so I bought the Alpha. I brought it home and installed it rear facing. It fit well, was easy to install and my baby had no problems with her head flopping. This seat actually reclined more than her infant seat. And if the recline is not enough the instructions tell you how to put a rolled towel underneath. Most convertible seats do not have a recline feature at all! I then turned the seat forward-facing. It was equally easy to install. It fits great in my Jeep SUV. My little girl has no problem sleeping in it seems really comfortable and safe. I was wondering how happy this purchase would make me, I am not dissappointed at all. Plus since this seat accomodates to 100 lbs, she can use it well into her childhood. I think this is one of the most versatile, safe, inepensive seats on the market today.I would recommend it.

product_title: Parents of Invention Ultimate Baby Wrap- Black
review_body: I bought this when my son was first born.  I had a hard time with it at first, but once I got the hang of it, I won't take it off.  It puts no pressure on my back and I can carry him in it all day.  I did not find that it supported my son when he was unable to hold his very at all.  I waited untill he was about 3 months before it worked really well.  I would recommend this product over any of the other pricy ones out there.

product_title: Safety 1st Safe-Glow Nursery Monitor 2 Receiver Set
review_body: This monitor is perfect.  We have had no problems with it at all.  Yes it is very sensitive but isn't that the point of a monitor?  The main thing we care about is being able to hear our son breath.  We have had this for 4 months and it is great!! I highly recommend this monitor!  The price is right and the monitor is great!!

product_title: Malawi Chair
review_body: He got it for his 1st b-da, he loves to sit and watch TV in it.... GREAT chair!!

product_title: Caden Lane Pink Circle Dot Burpies Set
review_body: I love these burp cloths. I received a set of two burp cloths and two matching bibs as a baby shower gift, all of which were purchased from this seller - Spoil Me In Style. I have since bought numerous things from this seller. Seller is wonderful, and burp cloths and bibs are incredible. I love the design on the cotton side, and the solid pink fabric side is so incredibly soft. This is something you can use like a mini blanket to soothe your baby or as a burp cloth to absorb the things that we like to absorb! I highly recommend this item to any style-conscious mom who wants something adorable and comfortable for their child. It is perfect!

product_title: Lamaze Spin & Explore Garden Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: [[ASIN:B000I2MRHE Lamaze Spin & Explore Garden Gym]]    My daughter received this when she was 1 month-old.  A little too young, but I set her in it periodically.  She is now 4 1/2 months-old and has learned to spin herself around and will stay entertained for about 20 minutes.  I have enjoyed it.  I was not good at doing tummy time with my older daughter who did not like her tummy and needed to be entertained during tummy time.

product_title: Nursery Organizer by Basic Comfort
review_body: I purchased this product to use on the end of my Graco Travel Lite.  It works great for holding a few diapers, ointments, etc.  However, there is no storage area large enough for wipes.  Best item I could find for this use.

product_title: The Ultimate Baby Wrap in Navy
review_body:
I paid extra shipping to receive this item. I couldn't wait for it's arrival - even after reading some reviews that it was cumbersome. I didn't measure, but imagine approximately 20 feet of material that you must wrap around your body. That is what you must do to use this item. Is it \\"difficult\\"? No. But it is quite a pain. What's worse is that because it is stretchy material, it stretches the longer you wear it. I do not trust it to support my baby -- and there is definitely no head support for little ones when inward facing. The sling causes other issues. Once it's tight enough to hold baby somewhere *above* your waist, there's no room for baby to be comfortable.

This item freed up one hand -- at best. I could have managed the cumbersome \\"application,\\" but the end result isn't even satisfactory. I am very disappointed in this product -- no wonder I couldn't find it in stores.

product_title: Mini Co-Sleeper (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Here are the reasons I gave the co-sleeper four stars instead of five.  1.  My husband said it was not easy to convert from co-sleeper to bassinet (changing the railing height).  2.  I have yet to use it as a true co-sleeper.  I have just been pulling the bassinet up next to my bed; it is way less work.  3.  I am apprehensive to purchase the leg extenders, which we need to make the co-sleeper work like it is intended to, because another reviewer stated they made the product wobbly.  BUT...I love the material the co-sleeper is made off.  The product is soft and durable.  The fern color is great.  The co-sleeper is easy to move.  It is a good size.  The storage pockets on the side and underneath have proven wonderful.

product_title: Baby Einstein Hippo Towel/ Wash Mitt/ Washcloths Set
review_body: This is a cute set for a gift or your own baby.  Washcloth and Mitt are very high quality.  The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is that I don't think the towel is of equal quality.  Seems really thin for the price.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Bottle
review_body: We've had the best luck with Dr. Brown's bottles.  My 8-wk old daughter suffered from colic early on;  I tried Avent bottles and Nuk nipples but had no luck.  Once I introduced Dr. Brown bottles the colic reduced and now I only use these to feed her.  It's true that the extra parts are a pain to wash, but it's well worth it if you have a fussy baby.

product_title: BABYBJORN Toilet Trainer
review_headline: Very best potty seat for boys!!
review_body: My son is 3 and a half and we started potty training two months before he turned 3.  We had purchased the cheaper seats at Target and Walmart, but he would still have #2 accidents.  Our toilet is very elongated and all the other seats didn't fit well and were very wobbly. We just recently bought the Baby Bjorn toilet trainer and now he is excited about going #2....  It is very secure because of the adjusting dial and he can get on the potty all by himself.  No more accidents after a week with this seat!  The high front prevents #1 spillage and the contor shape holds him well.  I wish that I had known about this seat 8 months ago.  I very highly reccomend this seat!

product_title: Stokke Sleepi Crib
review_body: We use this as a second crib for downstairs. It works well for this function because it's on wheels. Somewhat expensive but worth the price.

product_title: Philips AVENT Express Microwave Sterilizer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a great sterilizer and is so easy to use.  It can also double as a place to store your bottles.  I and my baby hated the bottles that come with it though.  They leak and are awkward to hold.

product_title: The First Years SpillProof Cup 10 oz. 2 pk. - Colors Vary
review_headline: Does Not Leak, Best Sippy Cup I Have Found
review_body: I have 2 year old twins, this is the only sippy cup I have found that really is spill/leak proof. I also like the flip top cap, this feature makes it very easy to cover and take with you and you don't have to worry about loosing the cap. The twins can open/close it without help. I ordered 6 of these to try and liked them so much I tossed all the other sippy cups we had and bought more of these. The only thing you have to watch for it to make sure you screw the lids on correctly, sometimes in a rush they looked closed but if on crooked they will leak. If the lid is put on properly they do not leak.

product_title: Bluedogz Design Stool
review_headline: we use this as a table..
review_body:
my son is 7month old and this is perfect size as a little table for him.
he likes it very much and later we can use this as a step .. no regret

product_title: Koala Baby Sage Closet Organizer
review_body: This organizer made finding all my newborns needs easy. I could not believe how much it stores.I highly recommend this for any nursery or childs room.

product_title: Glass Table and Shelf Corner Cushions
review_body: These corner cushions are good for protecting against injury from bumps on the corners of tables, and cabinets (including overhead cabinets).  However, there is one problem:  the adhesive tape that comes with them, for applying them, doesn't hold very well on wood cabinets.  Perhaps they would hold better on plastic or metal surfaces which are less porous or have not been finished as wood has.

product_title: Malawi - Fitted Sheet
review_headline: does wrinkle but not if you hang dry
review_body: after reading the reviews i still went for it and got this extra crib sheet, the first time i washed it and put it in the dryer on no heat of course so it wont shrink, it came very wrinkled i had to iron it.. what i do now is wash it on extra low cycle and when i take it out the dryer i stretch it out a little then hang dry it and looks brand new and i have to wash them often with my son due to reflex problems

product_title: Dr. Merry's PottyPal Flip Toilet Seat & Training Method
review_body: This is a very quality toilet seat.  We tried 3 different kinds that attach to an existing toilet seat, including a portable seat, one with a built in step ladder and one that had a lip that held it in place between the bowl and a regular toilet seat; however, when the boys were learning to pee sitting down, urine would always get under the seats and they were wobbly. This doesn't happen with the Potty Pal.  I love the versatility, and my sons use it with ease.  Since it also has a regular toilet seat, I will get a lot of use out of it when guests (or I) need to use that bathroom as well.  I did not buy the special step stool - I just used a plastic one I purchased at Target and it works great (Circo brand I think).  I wish I would have purchased this first and saved myself some headaches.

product_title: BreathableBaby™ Bumper
review_body:
We bought this because we wanted to keep our daughter's arms and legs inside the crib. We feared that she might get them caught and hurt herself. And she liked to sleep right up against the bumpers. It does the job, but it does leave one opening at the top and bottom of the crib, our crib has a drop down side. And our daughter is an active sleeper.

I gave it 4 stars because it was good until she was about 6-7 months. Now that she can crawl and pull herself up, we had to lower the mattress, it constantly has to be adjusted and it really doesn't stay up.

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor w. Sound Monitor w. Two Parents' Units
review_body:
As far as I know, there is no other MOVEMENT monitor on the market currently. It works great for that! This one detects breathing motions, even tiny ones. We have not had any false alarms since we started using it a month ago. But, it does go off every time we forget to turn it off before taking the baby out at night for feeds, which is a lot. Pavlov's dog did better than us sleepy parents.

We used it first in the Pack and Play and put a piece of cardboard from a carseat box under the mattress for support. Plywood was not necessary for it to function properly. I also bought one for the crib. Installation took less than 10 minutes, once it was out of the clamshell packaging.


I think in the future this type of product will be recommended for all babies, but I'm not waiting for the experts to catch on!

product_title: Infantino Wall Mounted Mobile - Lion (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son loves this Lion mobile.  He smiles and coos at it and has given me the \\"Thanks for the cool toy Mom\\" look many times.  I'm going to try to set it up in the car for him for holiday traveling as he gets lonely in the back seat (screams) and he hasn't noticed the monkey mirror I bought for the car yet.  I highly recommend this product.  The strings that are the legs of the lion are shorter than pictured, yet I'd rather have strings that were short than strings that could be dangerous from being too long.

product_title: Summer Infant Sure And Secure Custom Fit Gate
review_headline: They fixed the removable velcro door panel
review_body: I just wanted to say that they put stiches on the velcro door panel so that your child cannot remove it.  I love this gate but I do agree with another reviewer that it would be nice to have the door swing 180 degrees instead of just 90.

product_title: Summer Infant Multi-Use Extra Tall Walk-Thru Gate
review_body: I ordered three of these gates because we are house-training our new, \\"teenage\\" adopted golden retriever. She is still a destructive teen and chewed through, smashed through or jumped over all our previous gates.     Not only did I get a smokin' deal on these through Amazon, but they arrived a day or two after I ordered them via \\"standard\\" shipping! Perfect timing! They are easy enough to operate that my 4-year-old can open them, yet they deter both our dogs.

product_title: Molded Scoop Baby Bib - Crumb Catcher
review_body: I've had this bib all of a month.  After my daughter eats, I clean it with warm water and dishwashing soap.  Within a week and a half, the plastic on the bottom of the pocket part began to crack apart.  Now, about a month later, the plastic has practically shredded apart.  No unusual wear or abuse, just a 14 month old wearing it a couple of times daily during meals and standard hand washing.  Additionally, the shipping costs were more than the price of the item, which is a little annoying.

product_title: The First Years Simple & Secure Stair Gate
review_body: This gate only worked for 8 months and the latch broke!  The company would not replace it because they only offer a 90 day warranty.  They will not even let you buy a replacement part.  They want you to buy a entire new gate.  What a rip off!  Don't buy this gate, it is a piece of trash!

product_title: MOBI MobiCam Ultra 900 MHz Monitoring System with SW Power (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Pretty Good Unit For It's Size
review_body: This MobiCam has a better than average quality of a picture. The only problem I have with it, is if you turn it up too loudly - it does buzz and have a lot of static.  But the night feature is great!  I had just a listening monitor type which was good but I wanted to be able to see my granddaughter during the night when she sleeps over. With the night feature it looks like daytime in her room.  I would certainly recommend it.

product_title: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review_headline: Definitely over rated and over priced
review_body:
We bought this careseat for our first child as we received the Peg Perego Venezia stroller as a gift and thought a travel system would be a good idea. Naturally, only Peg Perego fits in Peg Perego so we were sort of stuck with getting the Viaggio.

Anyway, we've concluded that the Peg Perego products we've purchased are definitely over rated. Our son HATED this carseat from the minute we put him in it coming home from hospital. The seat is way too deep and he was really squished. Very restrictive movement wise (were they trying to create a 'womb' effect here?) and heavy. Complete misery every car ride. A few weeks later, I borrowed a Graco seat from a friend and it was like night and day. Suddenly, pleasant car rides. My little guy would actually sleep in his car seat- unheard of in the Perego. Perego out, Graco in.

And a side note on travel systems: waste of money in my opinion especially with only one child. Buy a Graco and a Kolcraft snap n' go. The basket is bigger and it's compatible with just about every car seat on the market including the elusive Perego. I even used this setup for the second- much more convient then lugging around that huge stroller and the carseat.

product_title: BABYBJORN Original Carrier - City Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I call this sling a third arm because that is what it feels like. Having the baby in this sling gives me the opportunity to do so many things - type, go to the bank, do laundry, eat, etc... My son loves being close to me and get sleep for hours in it. It is especially helpful during those times that he is crying but has been fed, changed, burped, etc... As soon as I put him in it and start moving, he falls asleep. Really worth it.

I gave it 4 stars because of one thing - I feel the pressure between my shoulder blades very much and I stand slightly hunched because of it.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Diaper Depot Clear
review_body: In my last place I had the 3-way Pack 'n Play Portable Playard downstairs and the diaper deapot will attach to it very easily. So everytime I had to change her diaper I wouldn't have to go all the way upstairs to change it. In my new place I only have one floor so I though that I wasn't going to used but I found the perfect spot: It attaches to the hamper!! right next to the single bed that I used to change her diapers so I don't leave her by her own. And it keeps everything organize, the only problem is if I don't have too many dirty clothes in her hamper and the diaper deapot is full it starts going forward. But be creative and maybe you can find somewhere else to attach it too.

product_title: Safety 1st Space Saver Fold-Up Bath Tub
review_body: We got this tub as a shower gift... I didn't want a tub in the first place because I knew I was going to put her in the sink just like our parents did with us! Anyway.... we tried it and it did nothing but leak all over the place. The best place is the sink and it's so much easier to clean up. I use a towel to support her head.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini
review_body: I have been using this playmat since my son was born. It is the one toy that fascinates my baby and gives me a few moments of precious free time. He loves spending time kicking at the toys and reaching for them overhead. I attached additional colorful Sassy toys to the arch, which clip on easily. Just yesterday, my baby rolled over for the first time on the mat. I truly think the mat has improved his eye-hand coordination and his physical development. I love this toy!

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Take-Along Swing 79616
review_body: I received this swing as a gift for my daughter Katelyn who is now 6 months old.  It is very difficult to get the baby in and out of the swing with the bar overhead.  I was always afraid to bump her head.  The hanging toys would hit her in the face when it would swing.  I would have to put them over the sides.  It just does not seem safe to me.  I have stopped using it.

product_title: Crown Crafts The Original NoJo BabySling by Dr. Sears - Denim (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: At first when I bought this I couldn;t figure it out. It had an intructional video that came with it, so I gave it to my mom and she practiced and figured it out with a baby doll. Now it is soo simple to use< It took awhile of getting used to the bulkiness of the shoulder pad, but other than that its great. I wasn't really into wearing this all the time, but after continuing reading Dr. Sears book, I got more and more into it, being an active practicer to Attachement Parenting, its great.
