When ever shes fussy I put her in the sling and shes cool after that, he favorate is the Kangaroo hold, and for sleeping is the Snuggle hold. I think its wonderful and now IM a vertain wearer and I can do things easliy. I wear it in stores, and home and while visting. Great choice I recommend it HIGHLY

product_title: Malawi - 6 Piece Bedding Set.
review_body: My husband and I love this set. We don't know if we are having a boy or a girl, so we wanted something for either and that could grow with our child. The actual colors and fabrics are much prettier than on the website. We painted the walls a medium blue and two dressers, one yellow and one green to match. We purchased animal knobs at a home improvement center for the dressers. I washed the bumpers with Dreft on delicate cycle and hung to dry, they came out beautifully, it held its shape and there were no rips. I washed and dried the sheet on delicate and had no fading and very few wrinkles. I haven't washed any of the other items yet because they won't be touching the baby. (We are hanging the quilt on the wall for now.) We purchased or registered for many of the coordinating accessories, but we like that we can add almost anything animal theme to the room and it fits in nicely. Everyone tells us how gorgeous the room is and we can't wait for the baby to arrive in a couple of weeks to see how he or she likes it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Infant-To-Toddler Rocker in Blue/Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We have a bouncy seat and this rocker also.  My 4 month old son loves the rocker better than the bouncy.  There seems to be more room in the rocker than in the bouncy seats that are out there.  He is not too happy about the attachment that has the toys on it but that is ok.  I would recommend this to everyone who is having or has had a baby.  It is wonderful !!!!!!

product_title: Safety 1st On-the-Go Fold-Up Booster Seat
review_headline: Great for travel and on the go
review_body:
I have not found another seat that packs up as easily as this one. It is so easy to take on the go and set up quickly. We keep ours in the car trunk for that reason.
I did buy another one for home use. This one has a lower back support and our son is tall. Also, like others said, the tray is not adjustable and doesn't leave much room for his big belly.

product_title: The First Years Night Cravings Bottle Warmer & Cooler, Blue/White
review_body: Safety first makes a very similar product with all the same features. The warmers are almost visually identical. My Saftey First warmer does not have any of the issues others have complained about with the first years warmer (overheating, underheating, ect.....)

product_title: Philips Avent BPA Free Breast Milk Storage Starter Set, Clear, 6 Ounce, 10 Count (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have loved having these containers to freeze breastmillk in. They are easy to use. I pump a little bit at each feeding and fill up containers all day in the fridge and then at night-time, I transfer the containers from the fridge to the freezer. Also, I haven't found any leaking or problems putting the lids on properly. Just be patient and learn how to do it right the first time, and no more problems to speak of arise. My one complaint is that you can get extra containers (they are all pre-sterilized) but you can't buy just extra LIDS which I would really love. So thats my one complaint. Otherwise, I am loving these containers!

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: GET THIS SWING!!!  It has all the things that soothe a newborn and their growing stages.  The lit mobile at the top is great for \\"wide awake\\" 2 a.m. occasions.  My son absolutely loves this swing and really enjoys the side to side vs. front to back motion.  It really soothed him and just looks so comfy, cozy for them.  This is the swing for all parents.  They really thought everything out when they made this swing.

product_title: Carters Basics Blue Blanket BLUE
review_body: I just bought this as a light summer blanket. Its great and so soft. It seems to get softer after each washing. I would highly recommend it to anyone.

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 9oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: As stated in previous reviews, this bottle leaks.  Luckily I only got one as a sample,but I figured I would try it.  Even put together properly, it leaks.  I will stick to my Dr Brown's and Playtex Ventaire

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_body: My daughter is captivated by the music and colors.  Starting at about 2 weeks of age, this has been the only thing she will watch and enjoy for more than 5 minutes.  We love this product.

product_title: Swell Riviera Bedding Collection
review_body: SO THAT'S WHY IS A DUVET, IT'S SO FLAT, I WENT TO THE STORE AND SAW IT, BUT TELL ME, WHERE DO I GET THIS COVER, I BOUGHT THE OTHER STYLE AND HAS A ZIPPER WITH IT, SO I THINK I NEED TO PUT LIKE COTTON OR SOMETHING TO GET THIS THING TO BE FLUFFYL. PLEASE SOME ONE HELP ME..

product_title: Sassy Who Loves Baby? Photo Album Book with Teether Handle
review_headline: Terrific First Book for parents and babies
review_body: My 3 year old began to enjoy photographs when he was a little more than one year old.  We do not live close to our family and this book is great to put in photos of the grandparents, their cars, their houses, the horse we  saw when we visited etc.  You and your child can look at the book and your  child will learn the names of relatives and other objects.  Since we live  in the Virgin Islands, photos of snow serve as an excellent reminder of  what life is like elsewhere.  Young children love repetition and familiarty  and seeing photographs of loved ones and familiar places and themes in a  book in which they can turn the pages and drool over, is great fun for a  toddler.  Highly recommended.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Over all, we liked this product.  At least for us, it most contains the smell, and is easy to use.  However, the design is flawed in that diapers easily get stuck in the top, leading to problems changing the bag. However, it is still better than nothing.

product_title: Roundabout Convertible Car Seat - Grey Wicker
review_body: This is the best car seat!!  My husband did research on many carseats and found this one to be the best (no recent recalls that he could find).  It sits very secure in the back seat.  I don't have to worry about being to lose and moving when the car turns.  Also, in the laid back position it still its up high enough for our son to see out of his window, and he can still fall asleep comfortably.  The seat cover is easy to remove and wash.  We put it in the washer (by itself), then line dried it and it fit perfectly back on the seat with no shrinking.  This car seat is completely worth every penny.

product_title: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I use these bottles with my daughter who is two months old.  She has been using these since week one (with expressed milk) along with the breast.  She has no problem with switching back and forth which makes it great for me since I do not like to breast feed when I am out.  I also freeze the milk in the pre-sterilized liners.  I highly recommend them.

product_title: RayShade UV Protective Stroller Shade Improves Sun Protection for Strollers, Joggers and Prams Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great product, works well on my jogging stroller
review_body:
This is a great product and I'm glad I went ahead and bought it. I go jogging with my daughter nearly every day, so I needed something that would block the sun well. I had been using a light blanket and clothespins, but wouldn't you know, just as I got going at a good jogging pace, my daughter would remove a clothespin and the \\"shade\\" was no more. I was stopping to fix it more than I was actually jogging.

With this sunshade, she can't undo it...although she tries! I can pull it all the way down (as low as I can on my particular jogger) and she can still see out but is shielded from the sun. I like the side pockets - great for keys and small items - and the velcro tabs are easy to use.

The only drawback - and this is such a minor issue, probably hardly worth mentioning - is that the shade doesn't fold up all nice and compact like the instructions say. I wrestled with my shade for awhile before I finally got it folded up (it was a matter of \\"doggone it, this thing isn't going to get the best of me!\\")...and even then, it wasn't very stable. My suggestion - keep the little bag it comes in and semi-fold it and store it in that.

All in all, this is worth it. Wish I'd had one when I started jogging with my daughter last year!

product_title: Baby's Quiet Sounds Video Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
It is the one baby item I am most thankful for! It gives me tremendous peace of mind to see my son as he sleeps and naps! It also is a joy to watch him as he settles in and we no longer go running into his room if he wakes up, as he usually falls quickly back asleep. It saves a lot of steps when he naps and at night we all sleep better for it!
We do often get static-sounding feedback on the audio. We have a lot of wireless tech in the house however it may just be my area (West Chester, PA) as a review below also noted. At night we turn the sound off and leave the video on (which is bright but we got used to it) and also use a regular audio monitor which has no feedback. For us the video alone is worth the price

product_title: The First Years - Air-Flow Sleep Positioner
review_body: I have used this since my daughter was first born.  Now she is 6 months old and it is very useful.  It adjusts to fit the baby great.  When she was younger I would make it tighter so that she could not roll on to her stomach.  Now I kept it slightly bigger then she is cause she likes to go to sleep on her side but during sleeping will roll on to her back.  The sides have vents so that if the baby happens to put her face up against she is still able to breath air!  Only problem is now that she is older and can move around more she does wiggle out of it but I am sure that would be the case with any of them.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: This has been a great thing to have in the house. My son loves to sit in it and watch his movies and play while I clean or take a shower!! Worth your money to get purchase one.

product_title: Disney Sincerely Pooh
review_body: THIS HAS BEEN THE BEST INVESTMENT I HAVE EVER BOUGHT. MY DAUGHTER IS NOW OVER ONE YEAR OLD AND SHE STILL LOVES TO GO TO SLEEP WITH THIS. EVERY TIME WE PUT HER IN HER CRIB SHE WILL CRY UNTIL SHE HEARS THE MUSIC START TO PLAY. IT IS GREAT

product_title: Deluxe Shopping Cart Cover - Toile
review_headline: Why is the manufacturer and reps allowed to spam this site?
review_body: I came here to get some honest reviews about the different cart cover products and I had to log in just to say this.  After reading the reviews for the Buggy Bagg, I can say I will not be purchasing this product solely based on some of the dishonest reviews I have read.  I do not believe it is a coincidence that most of the reviews by \\"parents/buyers\\" here, sounds like a commercial or that most of the reviews use language that can be found word for word on the buggybaggs.com website.  Isn't spam illegal? The reviews in question also come from parties who have done no other reviews.  That speaks volumes to me.

product_title: Graco Ultraclear Monitor, with 2 Receivers (2001)
review_headline: Sooo glad I spent the extra money!
review_body: After reading lots of reviews when I was doing my baby registry, I decided to register for the Fisher Price Lights 'n Sounds monitor with two receivers. What a mistake! I sould have listened to the reviews that said that it was a nightmare. There was a constant hum and all I could ever hear was when my daughter was screaming. Nothing else. I finally took it back and after reading reviews here decided to give this one a shot. The minute I plugged it in, I knew it had been a good decision. Three months later, I'm still loving it! No feedback, no static, just the sounds that I need to hear. Now when my daughter's in her crib I can her breathing, sucking her thumb, kicking her feet against the sheets and even the tiniest whimper. Complete peace of mind. We have LOTS of electronics near where the monitors are placed and nothing interferes. And, it goes without saying that two receivers in a two story house is a must! Now I tell everyone who's trying to pick a monitor that this is the one to go with. Way to go Graco!!

product_title: Medela Hobbit Breast Shells
review_body: Obviously these don't work for some people but for me these shells are the only reason I'm still breastfeeding! I love them! They are a little awkward at first but so worth it. My nipples were so sore that I almost stopped breastfeeding. They wouldn't heal because the wet nursing pad kept the moisture on them and irritated them further. Now I love nursing and the only time I don't wear the shells are in the shower! Yes they make me have  pointy breasts but I still think it's worth it!

product_title: Evenflo Snugli Citysport Carrier- Khaki
review_body: This is a really awesome baby carrier. My baby goes to sleep so quickly in it that it amazes me :) I love it and he loves it too. Plus this is one of the only three way carrier I have found so far. Its also very easy to take a baby out of it by just undoing the front without disturbing the sleeping child (but u do need few trials to successfuly work with it). Overall, REALLY GREAT! Even though the back strap is sometimes hard to work with, its a very important security feature.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_headline: Buy This Tub Or You'll Be Sorry!
review_body: We purchased this tub for our newborn because of the great reviews and the large size. We do not currently have a standard bathtub in our house, so we needed something that our daughter could use for a while until we install a bathtub. We could not be happier with our purchase. The place to bathe newborns is priceless. You can just set the baby in and bathe with two hands free- baby stays put with no sliding. When our baby was 3 months old, we took a trip out of town and stayed with my sister-in-law, who has a different (and more popular) baby tub. There was no comparison. With her tub, you had to try to support baby with one hand and bathe baby with the other- a very slippery and difficult feat! Now that our daughter is 9 months old, she still loves this tub. It is plenty big for her to splash and play in, and she is well supported by the shape- she has never slipped or tipped over. This is, without a doubt, the best tub out there.

product_title: Ez Clean Bottle Brush
review_body: This brush is perfect for cleaning Avent bottles and cups, Gerber standard or New Tradions bottles, Evenflo Elite and standard bottles, and just about every sippy cup out there that I've encountered.  The brush is easy to use, and it does an excellent job.  I've tried many bottle brushes in the past year and this one wins hands down.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Musical Rocking Bassinet
review_body: I agree with some of the reviews written. The look is great; we have a 2 month old son and other bassinets looked either cheap or were ugly and too \\"frilly\\" for a boy. The good things about this bassinet: it's pretty sturdy, esp. if you have a large baby (which we do); it's portable w/the wheels; music is cheesy but most don't come w/that; storage space underneath is ample. The bad things: pretty heavy so if you have stairs and you want to bring it up and down the stairs, it's not an easy task so you end up keeping it either upstairs or downstairs; the rocking mechanism should be improved upon - the woman who said that it should be a continuous rocking motion is right - it only rocks if you move it - once you stop, it stops and it would be nice for when you're trying to put your baby back to sleep in the middle of the night. Would have been nice to include a small mobile but we attached a small rattle type toy and that keeps him occupied. Overall, it's a good product - it's too bad he's getting too long to fit in it.

product_title: The First Years Hands Free Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Best Pressure Mount Gate I've Tried
review_body: I really like this gate.  Most pressure mounted gates are not really secure even if tightened as much as possible but this one is the best I've tried.  It's really easy to install.  I needed two extentions, but even with them it only takes a few mins. to install.  It opens just like they claim it does and my three year old can not open it, no matter how hard she tries.  My only problem with it is that the foot petal can pinch bare feet if you don't put your foot on it just right.  But it only takes a few times of being pinched to remember the right way.

product_title: Fisher Price Nesting Action Vehicles
review_body: Both of my boys (1 and 2.5) love stacking and building.  They also love cars.  So this was an obvious choice for a great toy for them.  They both love these cars!  All of the cars have a little "surprise" (the ladder on the firetruck "clicks" as it raises up and down, the siren on the police car spins, etc.) & they are all numbered which is great for counting and number recognition as they get older.  They're also a great way to teach abstract concepts like smallest, bigger, biggest.

product_title: The First Years Multiuse Bathing Cushion
review_body:
We use this product to keep the bottom of the tub from being so slippery plus the cushions on the back are great in case your little one falls backwards in the tub. Saves them from a head bonking.
I gave it four stars as it does tend to float but only until you put your baby onto it. Once I put my little on it, there was no problems. They should've put more adhesive suckers on the bottom.
This product made us feel a lot safer for putting our baby in the tub.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_headline: Good Bouncer - only lasts for one childddd
review_body: We received this as a gift for our first child and loved it. After we were done (child was too old), we stored properly (taking out the batteries). Now the toy bar doesn't work for our new baby. The manufacturer won't help replace and this is the second product by this manufacturer that only worked for one child.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Bouncer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
When mom and dad need a little break, our 2 month old sits in this bouncy seat for a while. He loves the spinning starfish and watches it in wide-eyed fascination. We can either have it on to play continuously or to turn on when his feet hit either of the two toys hanging from the bar. If you forget to turn off the sound/bubbles it will turn off automatically after a few minutes. It will also turn off if the baby is still in the seat, so you'll have to turn it off and on again. I like that there are two volume settings, although since I only use the lower setting, it would have been fine with just that one. The vibrate is nice as well, although we hardly have used it.

The one option I wish it had is to play music without the bubbles always going with it. He likes the music but the bubbles are so stimualting that he never falls asleep in this chair. The bar is removeable, which is nice for travel.

product_title: Single Deluxe™ Breastpump by Medela 67272 67272
review_headline: Not the best quality, Don't waste your money
review_body: If you're looking to find a quality product you might want to try  the more expensive pump in style model, not that I know if that's any better.  I purchased this model when my baby was first born,I used it a couple times a week.  It lasted 7 weeks before the motor gave out.  I was unable to return it to the store because it is a personal hygene product.  Thinking that the Double Deluxe model must be better I purchased it.  Don't bother!  you get an extra bottle, breast sheild and a tube to connect it.  Not a quality product.  The suction quit working after 1 month.

product_title: Lamaze Grip & Grab Rattle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This gift has been great for our daughter to learn all kinds of things.  When she was a few months old, she liked watching it as someone else shook it.  Then she could hold it herself, and now she just loves to shake it around and watch the balls move.  Good toy.

product_title: Dex Safe Lift Universal Crib Wedge
review_body: I have infant twin boys (2 mo. old) who are very fussy. They woke up a lot at night screaming (gas) and with spit up dripping down thier chin. I purchased two of the crib wedges and they work wonderfully. They keep the upper part of the babies body elevated to help with the digestion of their formula and the spit ups are less frequent. My crib wedges DO NOT have a card board bottom (as the lady from Austin, TX said). The entire wedge is soft and supportive. However, some mornings I find the babies have wingled all the way down the wedge and are laying flat. As long as they are not crying, that's ok! Later, the wedge can be used as a pillow underneat the sheets to elevate an older babys head.

product_title: Lilac Luxe Blanket
review_body: We originally bought the blue blanket and our 3 month old son and LOVED it, so decided to buy another blanket to use as back up when the other is being washed.  These blankets are SO SOFT, durable, and wash VERY WELL.  I only wish they made them big enough for adults to use!  If you need a great blanket I highly suggest buying this!

product_title: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
First of all I want to say that all of you are entitled to your own opinion, and we of course can agree to disagree. Avent bottles do not cause gas, all bottles do. No matter what commercials say all bottles have air inside even the ones that use bags. Breastfeeding is the best for every baby and mother, plus it does not cause gas. So I recommend that those of you that complain about the bottles and gas, how about breastfeeding?
P.S.: when my son was six months old and I went back to work, we started using the Avent bottles for breastmilk and they are the best. My son never had gas and he is now a very healthy three year old.

product_title: Lamaze Grip & Grab Rattle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This was the 1st toy my son was interested in at about 2mos because of all the bright colors....he's 4mos now and it's STILL his FAVORITE toy to grab and chew. It's SO easy for babies to grab onto because there are so many sides and they are all just the right size for grabbing!
We LOVE this toy!

product_title: Tiny Love Symphony-in-Motion Remote Mobile
review_body: My baby loves this mobile.  I loved the colors and all the movement as well.  I spent a lot of time looking for just the right mobile before I finally decided on this one.  The other day I put my daughter in her crib and started up the mobile when nothing would soothe her and I needed a break.  Wow! The mobile really did the trick.  She was transfixed and calm  . . . until it stopped moving.  The music continued to play but all the motion stopped.  This was only the fourth time I had turned the mobile on.  From the sounds of other's reviews I would save the money and buy another mobile.

product_title: Soothing Dreams Monistor with Remote Control, Fisher-Price
review_body: We purchased this monitor thinking it would be a great way to help our 2 year old transition into his big boy room, but were quickly aware this might have not been the best choice. There is a constant clicking sound that comes through the monitor receiver, the lights are not indicitive of the baby's cries, it turns on at random times and last night static surges woke our 2 year old up at 5 a.m. What a disappointment since our son likes the light show so much...but there is just too many negatives to keep using this monitor.

product_title: Safety 1st Deluxe 4-in-1 Bath Station
review_headline: Don't buy this leaky piece of junk!
review_body: We bought this tub when we were expecting our first child.  For the first month or two, this tub worked fine.  After that, it started to leak even with the clips on the underside properly secured.  If I filled it to the top, it would still be empty within 2 minutes--not nearly long enough to bathe a baby!  We wound up throwing it away and just taking "momma and baby" baths together until our son was old enough to stand up in the shower with me.  Now that we are expecting baby #2, we plan on trying the Eurobather.  It's a little more expensive, but doesn't have any negative reviews!

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Bottle, 8 Ounce, 3-Pack
review_body: I am using these bottles on my baby who has colic and they work so well and I am also noticing less spit up.  They are worth the money.

product_title: 900mhz Attachable Monitor
review_body: As a electrical engineer and pround new father of a baby girl, I am more than disappointed with this product. It did not work out of the box.  With a 10 hour fully charged battery in the baby unit and brand new 4 AAAs in the parent unit the range was 1 foot (with or without the AC adapter plugged into it), on both A and B channels.    If you buy this brand & model and have good luck that is great but why take the chance?  For me it is back to the store to exchange this for something better, but first I will read the opinions, something I should have done in the first place.  Best fo luck to you.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We bought this product and absolutely love it.  For one, it doesn't dump all that additional plastic into landfills... It's very easy to flip the lid to deposit the diaper into the pail.  I even use it sometimes for random bits of trash (clothing tags, etc) and this is not a problem because the champ uses a regular garbage bag.  Best part is you don't have to open it everytime to put a diaper in.  It stays closed and \\"sweet smelling\\" until you need to empty it which is a snap to do...

product_title: The First Years Night Cravings Bottle Warmer & Cooler
review_headline: LOVE IT...Bought one...Had to get another for the 2nd floor
review_body: The best!!!  So convient, compact, inexpensive.  I bought one at Babies-R-Us and thought maybe I will use it.  Well, we could not live with out it now...it will travel well too because of small size.  Mother came to visit and brought me another for our 2nd floor, we love it so much.  We carry a shoulder strap cooler w/ 2 bottles upstairs at night and just pop one in the warmer and 3 minutes later...Happy Baby. You just have to always test the temp..as with any system.  Just bought one online for a friend too.

product_title: Gerber Premium Feeding System Infant Starter Gift Set
review_body: Bought Avent & Dr. Browns...nipples are just too long, my baby sucks as much air as milk...Bought the Gerber breast pump which came with two bottles and my baby latches on to these nipples like my breasts! No funny sucking noises like the other nipples! Easy to clean and no leaks! LOVE THEM,LOVE THEM,LOOOOVE THEM!

product_title: Safety 1st Railnet
review_body: My friend has this in her house and she loves it. It works great.

product_title: The First Years Nature Sensations Lullaby Player (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Eats batteries, but glad we have it.
review_body: It gets static sounding when the batteries are getting low.  We use the rain and ocean sounds the most.  I couldn't tell if the heartbeat helped when our baby was a newborn.  The music is horrible.   The turn on when baby cries feature doesn't seem to work consistently.  The top railing of our crib is to long for the player to click onto.  But it fits snuggly anyway.  We also attached it to our daughter's moses basket and have traveled with it.  I like the fact it doesn't trigger the baby monitor the way changes in a music CD will.

product_title: Triumph V Car Seat - Black Diamond Assortment
review_body:
I found this car seat to be wonderful in all but one way. My son is only three months old and already weighs 15 pounds; a big boy. He is about 24 inches in height, so he is not very long, but the seat fits him perfectly with room to grow. It's cushioned so that I'm sure he gets a great ride and not a sore bottom.
The five point harness is safe and easy to get him in and out of quickly. The quick adjusting height of the shoulder staps is great when he needs to wear a thick coat one day and just a sweater the next; no hassel.
The seat reclines in five different positions...which is great since he is still a newborn and cannot sit up.
The only drawback of this car seat (as is any other toddler car seat) is that unless you have very dark back windows, your baby is blinded by the sun since the seat does not have a sun canopy atttached. Other than that, I highly recommend this seat to any mommy (or daddy); whether you have a tiny newborn or a toddler!!

product_title: Medela Pump In Style Traveler Breast Pump
review_body: My daughter was born underweight (5lbs 10 oz) needless to say feeding was a problem. she was so weak and tired, yet HUNGRY... I had gained over 50 lbs during my pregnancy so, neeedless to say, I had PLENTY of milk. Everytime she cried I began to leak. NOT CUTE - This pump saved my life. Sure, at first your nipples get tender, but at no time at all, on full power, I could produce 4-6 ounces within 10 minutes - WHAT A DREAM!!! Especially when travelling - I could pump as my husband drove and then feed her while he drove - all the while, all 3 of us were buckled up and SAFE. It has been 6 months and I am happy to say I still have a healthy supply of milk and she now weighs 16 lbs! I have this pump to thank. EASY to use, plenty of storage space and cannisters = LOVE IT

product_title: BABYBJORN Original Carrier - City Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: All I have to say about this product is it's GREAT!!!! Both of my hands are free to do whatever I need to do and at the same time I have my baby near me at all times. My husband even use it to carry our daughter against his chest while playing 18 holes of miniature golf....My daughter loved it(Mini-ME).  Yes, too bad it can't hold a baby over 25lbs, But THANK GOD it doesn't or else I would have major back pains;-)  It's a must for newborns.

product_title: The First Years Night Cravings Bottle Warmer & Cooler
review_body: We totally love this product.  We have two - one upstairs and one in the kitchen.  It's true that it takes some trial and error to see how much to adjust the amount of water that you put into this.  But once you figure it out, it's a lifesaver!  I can't imagine having to wait for plain hot water to heat up a bottle.  We have used it both with the Medela bottles and with Dr. Brown's bottles.

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie Twist-Away Pail System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Not good in the long run
review_body: I received the Diaper Genie as a shower gift.  In the beginning, I loved it.  There was no diaper smell in the nursery and it was easy to use.  However, after each refill the plastic ring would bend a little and make it increasingly difficult to change.  I have now had the Diaper Genie for almost fifteen months.  The hinge on the back has broken and I can no longer use it with one hand.  I am currently searching for a diaper pail that will last through at least one kid in diapers.

product_title: Sunshine Kids Mighty Tite (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: wish i had this with my first car seat
review_body: there's nothing worse than being a new parent & trying to get the car seat installed correctly. a friend of mine showed me the gadget & i decided to buy one along with a new car seat when my son grew out of his old one. this definitely made the entire installation experience a breeze! this worked well for me, especially since i have a 97 vw golf & a convertible car seat.

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Take-Along Swing 79616
review_body: I thought the idea was wonderful- it takes up very little space, easy to pack, easy to assemble. once the motor started though it was a noisy grinding sound, so I returned it. also it only goes up to 17 lbs. most other swings go up to 25.

product_title: Dekor Diaper Plus Diaper Disposal System
review_body: I'm wondering if you can use these for cloth diapers as well??  I am registering for items, as I am not due for three more months.  I am looking to use disposables for the first few months and then switch to a cloth diaper service... Anyone know???  Also, does this come with "starter" plastic bags, or do you have to purchase a package of them right off?  Thanks!

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 9oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I used this system for my son.  He easily switched back and forth between breast and bottle, even at an early age, and never had problems.  The wide mouth is great for mixing forumla.  It will leak if you don't screw it on just right, but that's the parent's fault, not the bottle's! He never had a problem with gas or spit up, and transitioned into the sippy cup easily with the Magic Cups and the bottles being interchangeable. I am pregnant again and would never consider using anything else!  I am looking forward to the new disposable cups.

product_title: Amy Coe™ limited edition Sorbet Splash Pink Collection
review_body: This is a beautiful collection and it is very bright and springy. Can do a lot with it and can grow with baby, but the duvet is shaped very weird to me. It doesn't seem like it fits right in the crib. I am just comparing it to the first bedding I bought for my first daughter.

product_title: Britax Marathon in Ashley Floral
review_body:
While pregnant with my first child, I began looking at all the car seats and the online reviews. I was determined to get the best seat and also the best price. Looking online at the Britax car seats, my first thought was \\"who would spend that much on a car seat\\". After going to the stores and comparing the quality of the car seats, the Britax was by far the best.

My husband and I decided to give it a try and we haven't been sorry yet. The easy installation was great and took hardly any time at all(couldn't move the seat, you can get it that secure!). The fabric is so soft and my daughter just loves the seat. The velcro to hold the straps is wonderful. The straps are so easy to adjust also.

Another hint, I found mine at a local baby specialty store for less money which is always nice, and no shipping cost. Our daughter is 5 months now and we will plan to purchase another seat in the future for our second child.

Thanks for reading.
Hope you love your car seat as much as we do!!

product_title: Safety 1st Secure Lock Bed Rail
review_body:
This is the best bed rail ever! I put this rail together...by MYSELF! I haven't been able to put any of my sons things together alone!

It does press on the mattress but it has to in order to stay in place. I let mine hang down to the floor when I make his bed & during the day.

There are clear windows on each side of the rail that you have to look at to make sure that it is on correctly. If you see any red, it means it's not on correctly! If you see all green, its on right. Just keep pressing down until you see all green. It's really not that hard.

product_title: Graco Passage Classic Pooh™ Travel System - 7255
review_body: I noticed that there were no reviews for this stroller so I would like to be the first.  I liked this stroller because of the design, it matches my theme.  When there weren't any reviews for it, it made it kind of difficult to decide, but I took my chances and we bought it.  This being our first child I payed very close attention to how it was set up and how easy it is to use.  My husband put it together and it took him all of 10 minutes, the collapsable turn handle is great, you can just do it with one hand.  The basket underneath is enormous, and I really like the canopies.  The only drawback was the weight it's a little heavy, but I'm still pregnant so I'm hoping that that won't be a factor for too long.  Another great feature is that it's not bulky and since we don't have a big car it's great that it doesn't take up to much space.  I hope this helps you in your search, it's a great stroller, easy to use.

product_title: Summer Infant Ultimate Crib Sheet
review_body: I haven't actually used this particular brand, but for those of you have not yet had a baby and tried to change the crib sheets this type of product is a must!!!  It is easily removed and changed without having to remove the bumper pads (and practically the mattress) to get the little sheet off.  You will probably never have to accomplish this Herculean task if you have a couple of these in the drawer.  This has become my favorite shower gift for first time mothers.

product_title: Evenflo Exersaucer Smartsteps Jump & Go
review_headline: The 1 star is for the cute toy! Otherwise its horrible!
review_body: I purchased two of these Jump N Go's for my twin sons, when they were about 6 months old... and I HATE them!    First of all we bought them since its easier to move the jumpers from room to room than the exersaucer's. I also knew my sons LOVED jumping, and the Jump and Go seemed to be fitted with the most toys. There is actually only one toy, but it plays music, and seemed to be the most entertaining of all of the jumpers.    I have to admit, the assembly was horrible! Well, one of them went together no problem, but the other one just wouldnt click! It was completely ridiculous, so we wound up exchanging it for another, which was easily assembled while we were in BRU... This is obviously not a huge problem, but it may happen to someone! Attaching them to the doorframe was also easy, and they seemed very sturdy. I put my sons in them for about 3 minutes, (in a doorway measuring about 12 ft across!) before I decided they were unsafe!     (1)  It seemed like when the boys would jump maybe 4 times in a row, that the clip that holds it over the molding would start slipping out of place! I began to hold the jumpers still when this happened, and watch the clip \\"slip\\" back into place, this is certainly not safe!  (2)  The boys were banging against the doorframe really hard! I know that they were both in a jumper in one doorway, but it was basically the same room they would have if it was one child in one average sized doorframe. They would also look up at the cross above their heads, causing the jumper to sway over to the doorway and crush their fingers, and bang their heads!   (3)  The jumper didnt \\"jump\\" right. I believe its for the reason described in a previous review, its built \\"backwards\\". When we later purchased the bumper jumper, the twins were fine, and used a lot less energy to jump in them!  (4)  They happened to be wearing white onsies, and they were wet with baby drool... The onsies turned BLUE, which came right off of the dye on the seat! I wasn't sure how dangerous this was, or what would happen to the twins if they ingested the stuff, but obviously it wouldn't be washable either!  (5)  The seat was also oddly designed. Instead of \\"propping them up\\" in a standing position, it sort of set them up with their legs sticking outward... This seemed very awkward, and the boys were leaning forward the entire time, I guess to achieve the correct placement to jump? I know that babies lean foward in most jumpers, but I KNOW that they are supposed to be supported into a standing position, not held in a \\"sitting\\" position, anyway this was never a problem with the Graco!  (6)  The spring was VERY noisy! At first I didnt purchase these to keep the noise level down, but since the saucers have music (not too loud, but music none the less) I now know its better to have something like this WITHOUT music and sounds... I actually wouldn't have cared, but the music is about 10 x noisier than that of my saucers! No WAY you could watch television with your baby jumping in this apparatus. It was also the kind of noise that worries me, like it sounds as if its malfunctioning, which is very odd since the Jump and Go isn't mechanical at all!    I was quick to return the jumpers, came home with two new Gracos, and am very satisfied... MUCH better quality, and we just add on our own toys (especially since they provide you with the \\"links\\" to attach toys to).. I would stay away from this jumper, its not good at all!

product_title: Pack 'n Play - Colby
review_body: I love this pack 'n play!  It packs away nicely and includes everything you need for when traveling with baby.  My daughter loves the soothing nature sounds and the vibrating bassinet was a lifesaver in those early weeks!  The only con I have found with this item is the light--it isn't bright enough.  I prefer to give her glo-worm a squeeze so I can actually see her.  I love the color as well, since I use it downstairs in my den.  It tends to blend in a little better rather than some of the brighter, bolder patterns they make.  Another great item by GRACO!

product_title: Fisher Price Nesting Action Vehicles
review_headline: This is a really cool toy
review_body: I just got this for my 7.5 month old son. He loves to push them and really enjoys the fire engine's ladder. The small one is good for chewing on.=) This is a fun durable toy!

product_title: Evenflo Top of Stair Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Do your research and Buy Sturdy
review_body:
I've read some of the parents comments regarding this gate, and it sounds like the gate is CHEAP. Just as an FYI because our sitter did not have a gate on her stair case, my 13 month old son fell, cut his head and had to get 5 stitches lastnight. He will have a scar the rest of his life and I'm sick to my stomach about it.
Word of advise, invest in a well constructed sturdy gate, it might save your child from getting badly injured.

product_title: Baby Einstein Discover and Play Entertainer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Someone on my pregnancy message board reccomended this product to me and I could not be more graetful. Our son is very long (27.5 inches at four months) and what interested me initally was that this particular exersaucer accomodates babies up to 32 inches and most others on the market only accomodated babies up to 30 inches.     As a parent I liked this product for a couple of reasons. Comparable products seemed to overwhelm me because I thought there were OVER stimulting, with more bells and whistles than I could count. And if I found them over stimulating as an adult I was concerned about my son's reaction. I also like that there is only one feature that requires batteries, and all the other toys force the baby to use their hands (and mind) for exploration. I have no problem with electronic toys, but I don't think that every toy we own needs to play music, light up, and vibrate. And this product was a nice balance for us.    This saucer was easy to put together (I assembled it in 30 minutes) and our son loves it. We let him play with it in the store and he fell in love with the colors, the music and all of the activities for him. He can happily play in it for 30-40 minutes and it let's me get a jump on things I need to do around the house. This product was definately worth the money.

product_title: Summer Infant Sure And Secure Expansion Gate
review_body: I attached a 2\\" x 4\\" with long wood screws on my hinge side  because my wall was of disparate material and size.  No problem.  Don't try and use drywall (wallboard) to drill into as that might be the cause of several frustrations mentioned above-you're dealing with a hinge that may get frequent use. Even if I had used the third section, I believe it would have been fine because I built a solid hinge side. Out of the box, the templates were off, which I made sure I proved to my wife and baby (after drilling from the template), who were viewing from the nearby steps. I cut from the dotted lines but I noticed the bottoms didn't match up evenly from the cutout. That may have been a printing error. I just re-drilled and used wood putty for visible holes.  One thing they didn't mention is that if you're using only 2 of the panels (a & b-guess I had a C in mine), you should realign your template B about a 1/2\\" because it will be offset from your panel B (won't go straight across). Don't know if that would have impacted the operation or not. Other than that, it worked out nice and secure-solid as a rock. Achieved wife approval on this one. Just take some time and pre-read the directions for possible adjustments for your situation.

product_title: Playtex Hip Hammock Standard Black/Black
review_body: I love the hip hammock and so does my baby (who just loves to be carried around). The only unfortunate piece is that the material doesn't breathe very well and my baby has gotten overheated in the summer. I believe the deluxe edition of this product is made from a nice material ... I would have checked this out more carefully had I known then what I know now. BTW, the hammock folds unto itself in a neat, easy package and is comfortably portable (I can bundle it and tie with the attached button and easily put in my diaper bag).

product_title: Stroller Rain Cover
review_headline: OTHER USES IF YOU DO NOT GET MUCH RAIN
review_body: THIS PRODUCT IS ALSO USEFULL TO KEEP THE STROLLER CLEAN, WHILE IT IS BEING STORED IN THE GARAGE,OR WHEREVER. WE DO NOT GET MUCH RAIN IN PHOENIX BUT WHEN WE DO IT COMES DOWN FAST AND FURIOUS,SO THIS WOULD BE VERY USEFULL, WHILE ON AN EXTENDED WALK AND THE RAIN CLOUDS COME POURING DOWN SUDDENLY A FEW BLOCKS FROM HOME.

product_title: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Did not use for second child
review_body: These bottles did allow me to nurse and work at the same time, which is why I went as high as 3, but as soon as he was done with the bottle I threw them all away.  They leaked like crazy.  I guess my husband and I did not have the \\"touch\\".  We tested different tightnesses, but still it leaked as my son ate, when we would store the bottles in insulated bags, and when we tried to shake to mix the contents.  We put up with them for a year.  With my second son we used playtex.  He still went back and forth nursing and using the bottle.  I did not have leaks, and I was happy. Before you purchase, decide if you want to take the gamble to see if you will be able to tighten accurately.  I personally want to tighten and go.

product_title: UltraSoft Quilted Crib Mattress Pad
review_body: I love it.  It is very soft.  It fits snug on the mattress and won't slip off.  A nurse in my hospital said mattress pads are safe as long as they stay on.  I have no complaints.

product_title: Baby's Quiet Sounds Video Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The concept is great - however after 6 months, the video image no longer works... what is the point - any baby monitor will do what this does now...

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_headline: Many Benefits - Including One That's Quite Unexpected
review_body:
I fully agree with all the other raves that have been posted here for this product...but would like to add that - in addition to hours of enjoyment and some pretty obvious boosts in our son's visual tracking ability that have come from this toy - we've also experienced another unexpected, and completely wonderful, benefit: it helps keep his digestion regular. Now I don't mean to be crude here (and please don't be offended), but our son is a rather gassy baby, who tends to go long stretches between dirty diapers. When he's playing with this mobile, however, he gets so revved up and excited, he vigorously pumps his arms and legs for up to 15 minutes at a time, and - as a result of the great exercise - almost always produces a dirty diaper by the time he's done. In fact, this is so reliable that we've nicknamed the mobile "The Poop Machine," and now try to make sure he gets a session with it at least once every day or two.
The one negative review I see here comments on the fact that the mobile does go through batteries, but a nice set of rechargeables takes care of this easily (we've only had to recharge them twice in six months, as far as I can remember). As for the contention that the motor's too loud and you can't hear the music, that user must not have found the volume control switch, which lets you choose between softer and louder settings -- both of which have been quite loud and clear enough for us.

product_title: Medela Breastmilk Storage and Feeding Set
review_body: These bottles are useful for storing milk....they are sturdy and fit in bottle warmers nicely.  My baby hates them for feeding, however.  I now just use these for storage and then pour the warmed milk into Playtex Nurser bottles.  I bought the Medela system when I was pregnant b/c I wanted what was best for my baby...and I was led to believe that Medela nipples would be most like the breast.  Um, no.  Take one look at them and it's pretty clear.  My baby wouldn't even take it in her mouth.  She instantly responded to the Playtex nipples, however.  Much, much better!

product_title: Fisher-Price Cow Over the Moon Nursery Center
review_body: The bassinet part falls in and does not secure tightly and safely. I purchased this product to travel with however, it is so large when packed up it is not travel friendly. Yes, the price is lower than most, but you pay for what you get!!!

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body: You simply can't go without this playgym.  It's got all the stimulus toys and our little girl enjoys it more and more as she get older.  Highly recommended!

product_title: Sassy Busy Bugs Bar (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Great if it would stay upright
review_body: I have tried this stroller bar on several different strollers and have had limited success.  On the umbrella stroller it was so close to my son's face it kept hitting him in the nose.  On my travel system, the straps barely fit around the child tray, and the bar kept falling forward so my son couldn't get to the toys.  He loves it anyway, I just wish there was a way to attach it so it would stay put!

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Over the past several years, I have babysat for many different families.  In every home where there was a child in diapers, there was a Diaper Genie.  Recently, I had my first child, and I decided to try the Diaper Champ instead.  I am so glad that I did. I find it much simpler to use than the genie, and I have had no problems with odors.(I don't think this should be an issue if the bag is replaced every few days.)  It is also nice being able to use any garbage bag instead of having to purchase special bags.  I have no complaints about this product- it works great for me!

product_title: Diaper Genie 3pack Refill
review_body: We love our diaper genie.  Very easy to use and keeps the "smells" in the pail.

product_title: SafeFit Car Seat Leveler (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A great purchase, well worth the price
review_body: I purchased this product after having my third child.  I had always used rolled up towels before, but they always seemed to move under the car seat.  This product held the infant seat in my Accord very firmly.  It did not move around or become compressed easily like rolled up towels or blankets.  It kept the seat at the appropriate angle!! My best friend also uses this item and she loves it too!

product_title: Avent ISIS Breast Pump with Disposable Nurser
review_body: I purchased this pump on recommendation from a friend. I WAH (work at home) so didn't believe I would need one of the large, bulky electric model pumps that most working moms need. Unfortunately, my son had some health issues and had to be re-admitted to the hospital two days after his release. Imagine my dismay when I found I would have to pump for every meal! The hospital loaned me a double pump (Medela model). I was able to get one ounce from BOTH sides during a pump with the electric model. At the same time, I was experiencing excruciating pain as well as cracking/bleeding. The electric pump was too strong and yet wasn't pulling the milk correctly. I sent my husband home to get me my Isis. It was the best decision I made the entire time we were at the hospital. I was pumping 2-4 ounces per breast every two hours for the remainder of my time at the hospital, and the nipple shield on the Isis did not further inflame the scabs I had from the electric pump. In fact, I believe I healed very normally in spite of having to continue to pump. This pump, if you need a pump, is the best investment you can make.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_headline: Excellent Tub- Big but worth it
review_body: This tub is wonderful.  The only drawback is that it is large.  I thought I'd be able to put this tub in our bathtub and then sit in front of it, but that didn't work.  I wound up sitting next to the tub and bending over, which isn't the best position.  But it was a dream to give our 4 day old daughter a bath.  The toddler side is deeper than the infant side, so I could put warm water in the bottom of the tub without baby sitting in it- important until the cord falls off.  From there it was so easy to dip the washcloth in the water and sponge bathe the baby.  It will only get better as she gets older.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini
review_body:
Both my girls love this gym. My 2-month old is already fascinated at looking at herself or the arches over her. She loves to coo and smile every time she is in it. My now 21-month old still enjoys trying to get in it and listening to the music. When she was younger, she learned to turn over for the first time in this gym. She gets bored rather easily, but this toy seemed to keep her attention the longest.
They both have different personalities, but really enjoyed learning and gained a lot of brain stimulation from the black/white/red contrasts. I hang additional toys for easy reach and more fun.
It is easy to unsnap the mat for easy cleaning in the washer. BUT, I would have liked to wash the arches. Using an antibacterial wipe seems to do the trick just as well. I wash the mat rather frequently and it has not faded much.
Have fun with this one. I really recommend it. It's great to bring when visiting friends and family.

product_title: Philips AVENT Express Baby Food and Bottle Warmer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I've been using this warmer since my 4mo old was born and I think it's pretty good. I have it down to a science (using Dr Brown's bottles)... 6 minutes for short 8 oz bottles and 7 min for tall 9oz bottles (using refrigerated formula or breastmilk). Shake the bottle before feeding to avoid hot spots. The one thing I really do find annoying is the lack of on/off switch. What I have done is left it plugged in with the knob down to the lowest setting. Not an ideal solution but it beats trying to find the outlet at 3am! Also the cord is way too short. Overall it does the job

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_body: this is a bright mobile with cool shapes, but our baby was afraid of it. I think it was the angle of it, he probably thought they were coming after him. we are looking at getting another mobile, but there are so much out there, we may have to keep buying them and seeing if he likes them.

product_title: Boppy® Bare Naked Nursing Pillow for Breast Feeding
review_headline: You either love it or hate it...
review_body: I bought this pillow and the luxe pink slipcover and I borrowed the word search one and bought a denim slipcover.  I tried over and over to use them thinking eventually they would work for me.  They never did.  I don't know if it is my body shape or what.  My daughter is now 7 months and I still nurse her using just my arms.  Occasionally I have used a regular pillow which worked much better.  I did love this pillow for propping her up before she could sit and keeping her study when she was just learning to sit.  I would purchase it again for that purpose.  Everyone I have talked to about it either LOVED it and couldn't live without it or it just didn't work for them.

product_title: Safety 1st Crystal Clear Baby Monitor, White
review_body: The only good thing that I have to say about this monitor is that it was cheap, now I know why!  It does pick up every little sound your baby makes, it's just hard to hear it through all the static.  Maybe I have too much interference from all the other electrical gadgets in my house, (i.e. T.V., receiver, cordless phones, computer, etc.) but I would have to get the receiver in just the right position night after night to get it to work, only to be woken up half way through to try to reposition it because the static is back.  Finally, the last straw was that after a couple of months it started to have an annoying whine that accompanied the static.  I am taking it back and spending the extra $10 or $20 to get a monitor that works!

product_title: Lamaze Grip & Grab Rattle (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I got this because I can't stop compulsively buying everything for my new son, and while many of the things I bought just sit on shelves this one is a huge hit. It is suggested for 3 months+ but my son at 10 weeks is entralled with it. He follows it in a complete arc and it is the first thing he has ever really grabbed. There is something about the sound, which reminds me of a rain stick, that just holds him rapt, and when he is too tired to grab I can put his hand through it and every jerk brings out a grin in him. I would have paid 3 times more for this, and for $10 it simply can't be beat.
Nathaniel's Mom

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body: We bought some extra animals to hang on this.  I don't like to listen to the music, but the mirror is great and my son loves the toys.  Easy to take with you...

product_title: Tiny Love Trio - Monkey
review_headline: I've been handing them down for years
review_body: When these first came out, I bought them for one of my kids. They've been passed down several times since then (I even had to buy another set for my triplets). We love them, the babies play with them, teethe on them, make them click and clack and any other thing possible with them. They're great toys!

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body: This tub is perfect for the baby. My 4 month old fits in the tub so I can have my hands free to bath him. At first I thought it would be too big, but I am very happy to have it. I highly recommend it.

product_title: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter is primarily breastfeed. However, now that I have returned to work, she has to be fed my milk from a bottle 3 or 4 times a day. This is the ONLY nurser that didn't frusterate or confuse her, as long as we use the NaturaLatch nipples. She refuses everything else and has NO problems switching between the bottle and breast.I LOVE NaturaLatch!!! It is so convenient to just put my pumped milk right into the bottle and is so much more sanitary too.

product_title: Snugli Front and Backpack - Carrier (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
This product seems to be getting mixed reviews, but I like it. My husband adjusted the straps to fit me the first night I got it. It's easy to put on, although I find it easier to load the baby from the top than to lay her on my lap and slide the sides into place like the directions say.
I had a cheaper Snugli with my first daughter that didn't even compare with this one. I haven't used a Bjorn so I can't compare them, but this one is more than adequate for my needs and much cheaper.

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis Manual Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Pain Free and Easy, Even While Healing From Electric Pump!
review_body: I have a 3 month old and want to continue breastfeeding.  My husband earned incentive trips from work and we haven't redeemed any of them because I don't want to feed my baby formula!  My mother baught an Electric Double Pump not Avent brand, and the minute it started, I was in so much pain I was crying.  It was my first, (last time) I tried it.  I had to feed my baby right after and that was an even worse experience.  I was bleeding and sore.  I purchased this Isis Pump two days later, attempting to stay positive! I was affraid at first but the soft petals around the breast opening was so comfortable, it made it easy.  Assembly is a breeze.   Small compact yet powerful enough for a manual.  Although a manual, it is so easy to pump and not too bad for hands!  Needless to say, it has been two days after purchase, I am STILL healing but I still am using the Isis Pump!

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Well worth the money!!!! No bag refills to buy-- just use a regular handled trash bag! Easy to empty, still using it after 2 years!!! Very cost efficient, and no stinky diapers in the trash! Definately recommend!

product_title: Kiddopotamus SwaddleMe 100% Cotton Flannel Small
review_body: The Swaddle blanket worked wonderful for my 6 week old. She slept much more restful. However, like other reviewers, it did shrink and at 10 weeks it no longer fits her at 11 lbs. I purchased the large size and it is huge. A friend told me she added extra velcro to hers to allow it to fit more snug. There needs to be a medium size! All in all, I felt like I could not live without this blanket and have stocked up on extras to give as gifts to friends.

product_title: Fisher-Price Step & Play Piano
review_body: My kids love this toy-- all three of them. The baby, 3 months, sits in the sit and the boys 2 and 1 love to help her play with the toys and make music. This is worth the money as it grows with the baby.

product_title: Baby Einstein Discover and Play Entertainer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter who is 8 months old gets somewhat bored with this exer saucer.  Which for the price, name, and reputation was  disappointing.  She also gets her little fingers scratched badly when she uses it.  I am still trying to figure out which toy on the exer saucer is doing the scratching.  I wish I would of tried out some other brands in the store.

product_title: French Blue Cuddle Bug Burpie Burp Cloth - Attractive yet absorbent burp cloths for infants and babies. Each approximately 14 inches by 19 inches.
review_body: Excellent quality, beautifully made - lots of choices to mix'n'match products or colors/patterns for boys or girls...to make a great baby gift basket.

product_title: Eddie Bauer® Leather High Back Booster
review_headline: Unfortunate that some can'f afford it...
review_body:
I just installed two of these seats in our Tahoe last week prior to a two day driving trip with my wife and 3 and 4 year old daughters. Those other non-purchase opinion writers whining about the leather...simply put, my guess is they simply can't afford these seats. Easier for them to try and find a reason why they can't buy it...\\"Oh, it gets too hot...how cruel.\\" Ridiculous!! Like many things in life, nicer things cost more...and these seats are nice, and my daughters love them. Six hours each day of driving, and not one complaint about the seats, no squirming...you know the drill. Plenty of \\"Are we there yet?\\", however...
Denver, Colorado (with 300 days of Sun a year!)

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor Blister Package
review_body: This monitor is the best and a must have!  The monitor has a few settings that allow you to adjust "what" you want to monitor.  For example if you want to monitor movement and sound or sound only.  For the first 2 weeks, the "ticking" feature was so reassuring to us that baby was breathing/moving.  I highly recommend it - One caveat, you need to remember to turn off the "angel" and and monitor prior to removing the baby from bassinet or crib or the alarm will sound and loud static will come through on the "angel".

product_title: Natural Rectangle Table with Drawer
review_body: I just purchased this particular piece of furniture along with some chairs and a shelf.  I got it together with a minimum of difficulty, but the drawer does not stay in place.  For some reason, the legs are wider spread then they are supposed to be and the drawer is not held in place.  I tried to call the 800 number that came with the directions, but I get "Sorry, your call can not be completed as dialed".  The shelf I purchased also has a problem, the two middle boards are not drilled through as they are supposed to be and so I have to go back to the store and exchange it.

product_title: Nano Bag Yellow
review_headline: nice idea  - I only wished it worked
review_body: I ordered this nanobag because it looked like a good solution for traveling during the winter months for my youngest child. Its a high quality product but I returned it because I found it impractical to use. Ultimately a traditional bunting and blanket is the better way to go because an additional blanket can be added or removed as needed to control his temperature . The nanobag caused my little guy to sweat even when used in 30 degree weather ,with light clothes on underneath , and its zippered closures on the back uncomfortably pressed into my baby's back. I also tried leaving the carseat in the car and just taking him in the nanobag but that also didn't work well because you must then open the bag in the cold to put the carseat restraints on and off. All the rave reveiws seem rather suspect after experiencing this product firsthand.

product_title: Capri Stroller - Red Tech
review_body: This is a GREAT stroller.  It's great for running errands, or going for a nice walk.  It Unfolds and stores very easily. I wish I purchased it sooner!

product_title: Lamaze Octotunes (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Difficult for baby to operate. More fun for parents.
review_body: My husband and I thought this would be the greatest toy, but my 10-month old son couldn't care less about it. Clever concept, but the legs take considerable pressure to \\"play,\\" and need to be squeezed in just the right spot. I also think it's also too big and heavy for him--he can't get any of the parts in his mouth, which is all he really wants to do. Maybe he'll take interest when he's older. I'm giving it 2 starts instead of 1 because my husband and I actually have fun playing songs it...  UPDATE: Now at 19-months, my son is sort of curious by the way it makes sound (when I show him), but he still is not able to squeeze the legs \\"just so\\" to get the sounds right. He does not play with it much.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_headline: Is it worth the shipping cost?
review_body: I researched all types of bathtubs & found this one to be the best.  However, when I went to order it, the shipping & handling cost $21.00...almost the cost of the bathtub!!!  I don't see paying $51.00 for a bathtub!!  I found the exact same tub on-line at babydepot.com & the shipping was only $7.00 so I ended up ordering it from there.

product_title: FISHER PRICE SINGING STAR GYM by Mattel
review_body: This is an absolute must have for baby.  The piano was a Christmas present for our 6 month old granddaughter.  Papaw picked it out.  She is now 10  months old and still loves to play with it.

product_title: Recalled Item: Metro Lite LE Stroller - Plaid
review_body: i got this stroller because i liked the black and white plaid design, and i was excited about the fact that Graco infant car seats snap right in to make it double as a carriage.  however, after weeks of searching, i finally broke down and called Graco to ask how i could find the matching car seat.  turns out, they don't make them in this pattern, [...] otherwise, it's great - lots of room, cup holders, attractive design, and very easy to assemble.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: I've used the Kick n Play with my 4 month old son since he was born, and I just love it!!!!  It's so nice for him to not have to be flat on his back (or be held) all the time.  The recline is just perfect for him, and the vibrations put him right to sleep.  He's so comfortable in it that many days, he spends nap time in his Kick n Play.  When he was just a few weeks old, he caught a cold and was so stuffed up that he couldn't sleep on his back because it made the congestion worse.  He spent nights sleeping in his bouncer, and was so much more comfortable.  Now that he's older, we've tried out the toy bar, and he loves to look at himself in the mirror toy in the center.  Even at 4 months (and 16 pounds!), he has plenty of room in the bouncer for him to be comfortable.  The only drawback is that the vibrator eats batteries, but aside from that, I still just love this bouncer!

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: WORKS VERY WELL!!  DOES WHAT IT SAYS!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Baby Papasan (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I couldn't wait to put my daughter in her papasan chair. Unfortunately, she didn't fit into it well until she was about two months old (about 9 lbs.) I wish it had different reclining positions, it just sat too upright for a small baby. But now, she loves it. She can sit and watch her videos or take a nap. It also has the perfect setting of vibration and the music it plays is just beautiful, not like cheesy, cartoony lullaby music.

product_title: Fisher Price Soothing Massage Bouncer
review_body: I love this bouncer to death its very sturdy unlike its other fisher price relatives. and with a deep bucket seat feeling you know your baby is safe. Now if they could only talk.they would probably wish they made bouncer chairs for adults.

product_title: Boppy Luxe - Clouds
review_headline: You'd be silly to try to Breastfeed without it!
review_body: How did mothers breastfeed their babies before this was invented? Boppy pillows are the best. Make sure you get your's before the baby is born and take it to the hospital with you! It's also great to use as a support when baby is first learning to sit up. It's become my staple gift to give at showers. By the way, don't waste your money on the Luxe, I'd recommend getting the standard or naked boppy. When baby or mommy \\"leaks\\" on the pillow - the milk can get the fabric of luxe somewhat matted. The plain cloth is much easier to spot clean.

product_title: Peg Perego Venezia SNG Carriage / Stroller - Chesapeake
review_body:
I bought this stroller because it seemed to be better thn the rest. The softness, 5 point harness and the fact that the arms swing back anf forth were very nice ... so I thought. However, this stroller turned out to be a nightmare! The arm bar is too low (I am only 5'5) and it was uncomfortable to push. The wheels did not turn properly ... ever ... and made for a terrible ride. It is VERY heavy and not good for the sidewalk. I purchased the so-called universal bar that would allow me to attach my Graco infant car seat but it didn't work!
... Don't be fooled by looks and go for comfort and ease of use ...

product_title: Fisher-Price Baby Papasan (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Her second bouncer and well worth it!
review_body:
When I saw the Baby Papasan line, I just had to have this for our daughter. She has a perfectly good Ocean Wonders bouncer that she loves but something told me to get this one and I'm glad I did.

She has a few minor breathing problems and sleeps better on her Boppy or in the bouncer or swing. Well, in her fishy bouncer her head would fall over but not in this one. This is more of a comfy sit back and relax bouncer. It is so soft and comfy and she loves to sleep in it. She naps in it most days.

We still have the fishy bouncer and we use it for play, but when she wants to nap she wants her papasan. I will admit that when she wants to play, she wants out of this so it does have some flaws.

product_title: J. Mason Safe Surround Play Yard
review_body: I received this play yard as a gift for my daughter this Christmas and although we haven't used it very much yet, it does have other good qualities.    First off it is very, very easy to assemble. I dreaded putting it together for days, but when I finally got around to it, it took me longer to open the box then to put the play yard together.   Plus it comes with storage slots for the 'legs' and is FULLY collapsable.   And I remember my sister's kid's old playpens with the metal hinges, but this model is very sturdy and safe with no metal or sharp edges.   I would recommend this play yard to anyone who looking for safety and maybe for using it to travel.

product_title: Safety 1st On-the-Go Fold-Up Booster Seat
review_body:
We received this seat as a gift, and we really love it! It's wonderful for traveling, and we use it at home in place of a highchair as well. My son is 8 months old and we have been using this for just over a month and a half. We have absolutley no room for a high chair, and were using his bouncer seat to feed him in before we got the booster seat. He loves his big boy chair and enjoys sitting at the table with us. Right now he has plenty of room in it even though he is very tall (over 31 inches.)
This seat is very easy to set up, everything locks in place very well, and it truly does fit every chair! It's great in restaurants and at friend's homes. We tend to be on the go a lot, and this seat has been a God-send! I love that it folds up so compactly and easily, and is so light as well. If the tray should become too tight at some point, we'll just let him use the table - which is what we do most of the time when we are out anyway. I would highly recommend this product to anyone with a baby. It's a great value for the price too.

product_title: Tots In Mind Cozy Crib Tent II 1, White
review_body:
We thought this would be so great to keep kitties out of the crib and were thrilled when we received it off our registry. And, yes! My husband and I have a new name for it. It's the piece of CRIB tent! After fighting with the stupid thing to even get it on the crib we were not happy to find out that it is NOT compatible with babies! You cannot lower the side of the crib and the mattress is supposed to be set at the lowest setting. So how do you put a baby in there? Throw it? Drop it? Lower it with a crane? I know I'll use my Gadget arms!

Plus, this piece of junk didn't even fit the crib right! We have a pretty standard crib that we got from TRU and it was NOT easy to get on there. I did not feel like it was safe AT ALL! I can't see how it would stay safely on if you had an older child who could stand up and push on it! It would tilt over and there would be the pointy ends sticking in the crib! Ugh! We thought *tent* meant it would be like a tent! WRONG!

I won't even get into all the bedding issues there are with this thing. I can't believe we were fooled into thinking this was a decent product. I feel silly for thinking it would be so great! And how do I tell the person who bought it for us knowing how much we wanted it (and it is on the pricey side) that it went FLYING back to the store?!?!

I am so disappointed with this thing! I wish they would let me rate this less than 1 star!

product_title: Deluxe Music In Motion Developmental Mobile W Remote (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Good mobile; Removeable toys are the best part
review_body:
I bought this mobile for my daughter when she was 3 months old. I specifically wanted one with a remote control so I didn't have to continually wind it. The remote is a good thing, but unfortunately I rarely get to use it. That's because before the first selection is over (about 10 minutes), my daughter is crying for me to come get her. She enjoys looking at the mobile, but for no more than 10 minutes at a time. Perhaps I should have bought this when my daughter was first born. Maybe if she had been used to it from day one she would enjoy it more now.
Despite the fact that I haven't got a lot of use out of this as a mobile, the best part about this thing is that the toys are detachable. I can easily change out the toys on the mobile and mix it up so she's got something different to look at each time.
My daughter is teething right now, so I always keep a few of the extra toys on her changing table for her to chew on as I change her. She loves that! Sometimes she wants to bite on a soft toy and sometimes one of the hard plastic toys. I'm glad I bought the deluxe model that has both type of toys.
So.....as far as this being just a mobile - no, I haven't gotten a ton of use out of it. Maybe it's just my baby, but she would NEVER fall asleep with the mobile going. But that's just as well b/c I didn't want the mobile to become a sleep prop. Instead, she uses it to amuse herself. HOWEVER.....as far as having 8 great toys for my daughter to play with and use as "teething toys" PLUS a nice music box with pleasant background noise as I change her diaper - YES, this mobile was worth it. I'm glad I bought this one. It's proven useful - just in a different way than I imagined.

product_title: Deluxe Shopping Cart Cover - Toile
review_body: The Buggy Bagg gets my vote as best baby/toddler product.  I've owned one for over 3 1/2 years.  You used to have to buy them directly on the Buggy Bagg website for closer to $75.00.  It is such a well-designed product.  The cushy padding, the included bolster pillow, and the seat belt allow you to use it with an infant who can't quite sit up on their own yet.  This product was an absolute lifesaver when both of my children outgrew their infant car seats but couldn't sit up on their own in a shopping cart.  With the Buggy Bagg, they can sit up.  Same goes for those wooden high chairs at all the restaurants.  It fits in the highchair and supports babies who are still a little floppy when sitting.  My children started using it during their 5th months.  They used it until they were close to 3 years old.  It has been washed at least 30 times and it looks like new except for a little fading.  Don't think twice about getting this product.  It is worth every penny.  When you run into an acquaintance and exchange comments on this product, everyone ALWAYS gushes about how wonderful it is.  I can't imagine that anyone would give it a less than 5 star review.  Anyone who complains about the price hasn't used it long enough.  Its usefulness makes you think that it would have been worth several times the price.

product_title: ExerSaucer Mega Active Learning Center
review_headline: Wish they have this in store in this part of the world
review_body: AS this product is currently not available in this part of Asia I am in, I cannot describe how grateful I am to my brother who carried this saucer with him (well, he didn't really carried it physically but put it on the airplane cargo space) from the US.
