Not only has it kept my baby occupied for the longest period of time (nothing has done that prior to this), 30+ minutes, but it is also a great and safe alternative to a walker (which my in-laws kept insisting on buying despite my objections until they see how happy Elliot is in this one!)  Thank you Evenflo!  And please, make it available in Taiwan and other Asian countries, you will have lots of moms's gratitude.

product_title: Delta Wood Highchair
review_body: I am ordering this highchair because it is is easy to clean, easy to use, and our child can sit at the table WITH us not APART from us.  With my first child I had a \\"fancy\\" $150 chair with all the pretty cushions, it was the biggest pain to clean.  So if you want to have your child exposed to crusty food and germs that will catch on the pretty fabric and in the folds and crevices of the other chairs go ahead and spend the extra $70.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer --the only anti-microbial warmers
review_body:
Does not warm the upper part of the wipes and the lower part is almost \\"Hot\\". Can not hold the entire pack of wipe I bought.

Stupid pop up never works.

My $5 wipe warmer works far better than this one.

product_title: Playtex Drop-Ins Original BPA Free Nurser Newborn Starter Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: The only ones my daughter likes
review_body: When I was creating my registry, I made sure to register for SEVERAL types of bottles.  This was my husband's idea because when his ex-wife had his first child they ended up having to buy many different types of bottles just to find one that made her comfortable.  These were the only ones I received off my registry.  My daughter was fine with them, but after a few other people tried to feed her and said they didn't think she liked her bottles, I gave in and tried several other brands.  THESE WERE THE ONLY ONES SHE LIKED!!!  The pre-formed collapsible liners are wonderful.  She gets very little gas with them.  I would highly recommend these to anyone.

product_title: Personalized Toddler Birthday Hat
review_body: The description of this personalized hat says for ...1 month and up..when you receive this hat...the tag says for 3yrs and up!!!....its tooooo large for a 1 yr old....and since I had it personalized I'm stuck with it..personalization says "Nicholas is 1 yr old today"...the only thing I typed in was the childs name...("is 1 yr old today)" was inscribed from the company..this hat is big enough to fit a 12 yr old...BUYER BEWARE!!!

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 4oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The Avent bottles leak terribly.  I would not recommend buying them to anyone.  It is hard enough waking up in the middle of the night to feed, but add in getting all wet (me and baby).  It isn't just me who has had this problem, which I initially thought.  I have asked several people if this has happened to them and it has.  We've even tried purchasing new nipples, thinking it was that, and it didn't matter.  The bottles seem to have a defect, according to a friend who used to use them years ago and NEVER had the problem then (but NOW does).

product_title: Graco Ez Latch Anchorage System
review_body: I write this as I just finished installing two carseats in my van with the new EZ latch attachment.  I have a 2001 Chrysler T&C, and it has been difficult (at best) to install carseats with the type of seatbelt that comes standard.  The seatbelt wasn't secure enough on its own, even though the manual says that the \\"lock\\" on the seatbelt clip was enough to hold carseats.  We have had to use a clip-- and I wouldn't consider that the safest option.  We also had trouble with our 3 year old sneaking in and just undoing the seatbelt latch without our knowing.  Now the locks are out of her reach and the seat is in so tight that is hardly moves at all!  Our carseats are both Century Next Step DX's.  They installed with ease.  I would HIGHLY recommend this new attachment.  It is very easy to use and works very well.

product_title: The First Years Everywhere Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This gate is perfect for stairways! We got this gate as a gift and we love it. We installed it at the top of the staircase leading to the basement. It is very easy to open, even with one hand. So if you have the baby in your arms or even laundry it works perfect. My hubby has a home office and we needed something easily accsessable since he is up and down the stairs all day and this gate has just worked out for all reasons. I would definately recommend this gate! It is very affordable, and it isn't \\"jailish\\" looking:)

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: This bouncer sits up to straight for my baby who is now 3 months old. We are using a hand me down from my sister in law that leans back a lot further for now until he sits up better. When he falls asleep in this one, his head just flops over. I do like the activity bar and the interactive part and the baby seems to enjoy it.

product_title: Playtex VentAire Standard Bottles, 3 Pack
review_body: The first time our daughter used this bottle we thought she was sick because she would suck for a little while and then cry.  After about a half an hour of her gumming the nipple but not really drinking anything I tryed out the bottle myself to see if maybe it tasted funny.  That's when I realized nothing was coming out.  When you use new nipples for the Ventaire bottles you have to squeeze the tip a little bit to break it open.  A friend of mine had a similar experience.  Other than that we love them.  I'm a new mom and it's the only bottle I've ever used.  However, my daughter is almost 5 months old and she doesn't seem to be terribly gassy and she only seems to spit up when she eats too much or too fast which is usually my fault.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_headline: I can't understand the bad reviews!!
review_body: After researching a good buy yet safe and versatile product, I had to try this one.  I can't understand why it would recieve any bad reviews. The non-skid padding does work great.  The suction cups do stick firmly and it does allow for your baby to lie back and relax.  The drain on the bottom was a definite plus for a thourough rinse.  All-in-All it saves my back because it does fit into my kitchen sink.  I would recomend this product to anyone. The versatility of another use for my baby while he grew was an added bonus.  This is an excellant product.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Infant Car Seat tan  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: My daughter cried out in pain every time we put her in this!
review_body:
I hate this carseat. We registered for it (big mistake) & received it as a gift before our daughter was born. My husband & I installed it -- it took about 30 minutes -- when I was 6 1/2 mos. pregnant. We really liked it until we had to take our daughter home from the hospital. It took 4 people about 15 minutes to figure out how to properly adjust it -- and we did read the directions. The straps are way too short & extremely difficult to adjust. Our poor daughter cried every time we buckled her in. The straps just don't provide enough slack to comfortably put her arms through, and the puzzle buckle is a pain. Our daughter is less than 9 lbs. at 4 wks old & we finally gave up & got the convertible Britax Roundabout. The Roundabout is much safer, and although it's $199, it's worth every penny & lasts alot longer. Thank God we aren't causing our poor little girl pain anymore.

Do not get this car seat!

product_title: Fisher-Price Stride to Ride Walker
review_body: I would not recommend this toy to anyone.....My daughter got it for her first birthday.  She liked the noise it made.  She stood up to push it and it took off really fast.  She bumped into another toy and it tipped over forwards.  She flipped right over with it onto her head.......I am packing it up and taking it back to the store right now.  The toy ruined her first birthday party by her getting hurt.......I recommend you do not buy this item...

product_title: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review_body: Spend the extra $10 and get the Clear & Near Monitor. 2.4 GHZ really makes a difference.  I haven't had any major problems with the Peace of Mind, but the static and interference will truly make you crazy.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: This bouncy seat will be one of your best investments.  Because of it I am able to get the laundry and dishes done, make dinner, etc.  The vibrations mimic that of riding in a car, which almost all babies seem to love.  And when your baby won't sleep in the crib at night, at least he/she will sleep in this!  It is also nice that the toy bar is removable and has a high/low volume switch for the music.  This bouncer works great for newborns too because it is reclined enough that their heads have good support.  Definitely invest in a bouncer with the soothing vibrations, whether it be this model or another one.  It will definitely be worth it.

product_title: The First Years: Clear and Near 2.4 GHz Monitor
review_body: I bought this item despite the reviews saying it beeped in the middle of the night.  There were so many good reviews I thought the beeping was a fluke. The monitor worked GREAT for the first three months.  Since then, it randomly beeps - often in the middle of the night.  Its loud, its scary, and it disrupts sleep!  Do not buy this monitor!!

product_title: Eddie Bauer Car Seat Travel Bag
review_body: I bought this travel bag with the expectation that I would be able to use it for many trips to come and was very disappointed that it didn't last even one trip. I flew one way and when I retrieved my bag it was torn on the bottom and top. The bag cannot be used again.

product_title: Summer Infant Pacifier Thermometer and Medi-Dispenser (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My baby never would take either of these pacifiers.  Plus, every time we called the doctor, they wanted a rectal temperature anyways.  Save your money, and buy a quick read digital thermometer that can be used rectally.

product_title: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing - Nature's Touch N1973 (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A great swing...only the Aquarium Swing is better IMO
review_body:
I actually have both the Aquarium Swing and the Papasan swing. We recieved the AS as a gift along w/ the Baby Papasan (non-swing). Having a colicky and reflux baby, we relied on these two items for the first weeks of his life. We recently received the Papasan swing as a gift and so we can keep one on the second floor and one in his nursery.

My main gripe (aside from the comments already addressed such as lack of padding and slight noise) is that the pillow is adjustable but not removable. I wanted to use a Boppy Noggin Nest (see the Pottery Barn Kids version) but couldn't unless I cut the attached pillow off. I was fine w/ that since my husband had already wired an A/C adapter into the Papasan swing anyway.

So parents, if you're relying on this swing to get you through colicky periods and want to avoid plagio issues, cut off the pillow and replace w/ an approved \\"noggin nest.\\" Otherwise, the pillow should be just fine.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Natural Flow Bottle Starter Kit (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: After 3 weeks of using these I went out and bought new bottles.  They leak way to much and you might as well deal with spit up.  Cause after you are done feeding the baby they are soaked and you have to change them.  Then they are awake fussy cause they have been moved around to the point that they spit up any way.  DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY TILL THEY FIX THE LEAKING PROBLEM

product_title: Evenflo Cool Mist Humidifier
review_body: I had one like this when I was a child and I was thrilled to find it. I got it for my baby and once I heard the ole familiar hum, I decided to buy another one for myself :)

product_title: Deluxe Snuggle Nest - Blue Patchwork
review_headline: Great for co-sleeping... during and after!
review_body:
When we brought our daughter home from the hospital, she refused to sleep anywhere but with us. We ended up co-sleeping, even though we'd bought an Arms Reach Co-Sleeper for her. She just wouldn't tolerate it.

After a couple of months we started trying to get her out of our bed, but it didn't work, so we bought this. She slept in it in our bed for the first two nights. Now she sleeps in it in the co-sleeper, with no problems.

I think the construction makes her feel secure... when her arms flail out, she touches something. So she doesn't wake up looking for me.

Anyway... this product worked, she slept in it immediately, and now I don't feel like she'll be in our bed forever :). We can move it to the crib, and hopefully she'll sleep in it there, too!

product_title: BABYBJÖRN Navy Carrier
review_body: I got it before my baby was born. I couldn`t wait to try it. When I did I couldn`t stop using it, because it`s very comfortable for me and for my baby. Worth even more!

product_title: The First Years - Crib CD Player (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love my cd player. My baby uses it every time she goes to sleep...at night and for naps. I like it cause it shuts off itself. I gave it 4 stars cause I wish it would play louder,...but it truly is worth buying!

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie Twist-Away Pail System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This diaper genie product is horrible. My daughter's room always stunk when you walked in it. I even bought the stage 2 refills because my daughter is going on 2 and I always smelled the \\"poops\\" when I would walk into her room. DO NOT BUY A COMPLETE WASTE OF MONEY. I was able to return it to BRU and get my money back!

product_title: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer --the only anti-microbial warmers
review_headline: Yikes! Tiny Heiny Seeks Warmth and Comfort
review_body:
My sister warned me BUT I was a clueless first-time mom and didn't listen. She told me *get a wipe warmer*! She said nothing makes a sleepy newborn more indignant than being awakened in the middle of the night by an ice-cold wipe on their delicate heiny. (Okay the iciness of it is only relative to a nice pee-warmed diaper, but babies don't seem to care).

Buh. I just didn't get it until I my darling little sweetheart shrieked in alarm at 2am and then refused to be cuddled back to sleep.

So, yes, add this to your shower list or your to-buy list. Or if you are a friend, buy this for the first-timer and they will thank you.

Pam T~

product_title: Fisher-Price Deluxe Take-Along Swing 79616
review_headline: Best  thing I put on my registry!
review_body: This swing is wonderful! I originally put this swing on my regisrty so that I would have it when we went on outings, but in the beginning my son did not take o the standard size swing, so I decided to try this one, well he just loved it from the beginning! The lights and music keep his attention for a good bit of time, he even coo's at the animals hanging on the sides! I love traveling with this swing because it is so light and compact! I do however have one problem when my son starts to fall asleep his head goes to the side and one of the animals is constantly in his face, so if I had to change one thing it would be to maybe have the top bar that they hang from a little higher! All in all I would definitely recommend this swing to all new parents!

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body:
My son just turned 7 weeks old and already I couldnt live without this. When he was born he licked his swing, for a bout a week, then we tried the kick & Play, LOVED IT! I am a stay at home mom and had a hard time trying to figure out how to shower and watch him at the same time. He now sits in this plays and I take a lighting fast shower. He normally falls asleep while I am in the shower and I always peek my head out to say hello! This is great for his morning nap. He will sleep for about an hour in it. I manage to get tons done. Highly recomended!!
The only things I would change is that you cant change out the toys. It would be a great feature to be able to put different toys on there so he wouldnt get bored. The other would be when I switch the music to play continuosly it plays for only 15 minutes then shuts off.

product_title: Knit Double Headrest - Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I agree with the other reviewers who commented that directions would be helpful and should be included, but it doesn't take a degree in rocket science to figure out how to \\"install\\" the headrest. Once hooked in, it stays in place and I have never had to re-adjust it. You must put both headrests in to secure it for a newborn's head.
The headrest is great ... it keeps my newborn son's head stationary & from rolling around in his infant seat. Our infant seat goes in the car and in a jogging stroller and I've had success with both.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body:
I have a very active 2 month old son who loves to jump and kick.
When he was 2 weeks old the tub was okay as long as I had a foam bath cushion purchased separately in there with him and when he was big enough I took it out. Now he slides around and kicks the t-bar and has cuts and scrapes from it on his feet. Also the suction cups work a little too well as I have to pry them up every time to totally empty the tub because the drain does not completely drain the tub. The tub is very slippery and not easy to lift him forward to wash his back. He also slides over the hump and it hurts his back.

product_title: Triumph V Car Seat - Black Diamond Assortment
review_body:
I had shopped and fretted for a month before I decided on this carseat. I purchased an Evenflow triumph first, good seat but it didn't work in my car (Olds Aurora) in the rear-facing position. My precious angel's head was slung fowrard due to the ultra erect position he was forced to sit in. It works fine in my husband's Suburban (seats are flatter).
This seat on the other hand works great!! It has a special full recline position for use in the rear-facing position, so now my baby boy sits in a perfectly comfortable position. I love the way the adjustments work all from the front, I love the incredible amount of supporting form throughout the seat, the straps are never twisted and the clips are easy to operate. My baby is always totally secure because of the five point harness and the "on the fly" adjustments offered by the yellow knobs. I adjust the straps in a matter of seconds with baby in the seat. I love how easy it is to get my son in and out of this seat.
I truly love the round design of the seat, from the rear it looks like an egg shape, truly a step up from the typical bars and straps you see with every other seat on the market (yes even the Britax everyone raves about, is very unattractive from the back). It may sound silly, but you look at the back of the seat for a year...might as well be pleasing to the eye :) The egg-like shape also allows this seat to give baby maximum comfort while not taking up too much of the seat (my 8 yo and 10 yo boys sit comfortably next to it).
I can't say enough about this seat...every baby should have one!

product_title: Dreamscapes Soother
review_body: I absolutely love this product, but the Leapfrog Company is not at all family-friendly.  My daughter is reliant on the Soother to fall asleep.  I had difficulty with the turning mechanism and the batteries running down too quickly.  I called Leapfrog and they told me that in order to get a replacement (I've used this for only 2 months), I would have to mail in the product, at my expense, and they'd send a new one in 10 days.  This is not at all helpful to me, since my daughter needs it to sleep.  They let me know this is standard policy for their company and there is no way around it.  This product is no only available online, so I had to pay to replace it myself.  I would recommend this product to anyone, but I will never again buy an item from Leapfrog company.

product_title: Contoured Changing Pad
review_body: I WOULD LOVE TO ORDER THIS, BUT I WILL NOT SINCE THEY DO NOT GIVE THE MEASUREMENTS!!!!!  THIS DISAPOINTS ME VERY MUCH.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I love this diaper pail. I change it 2 times a week and have no problem with smell. Ok - when you open it - it may be a little stinky but it has dirty diapers in it!!!! With the lid closed, however, no smell issue at all.

We love that it takes regular bags - we buy the least expensive kitchen bags we can find and they work great!

product_title: Sealy Stain Protection Crib Mattress Pad
review_body: I have been using this product for three months. It has gotten alot of use with my baby boy. We were always dealing with leaks. It looks like new with no signs of stains. Washing and drying the pad has not caused it to shrink.

product_title: Philips Avent Electric Steam Sterilizer
review_body: I found this very difficult to clean and because of this it smelled when it was used.  Although I thought it was useful I always wondered if it was really doing its job.

product_title: Velour Boppy Nursing Pillow - green
review_body: I received my Boppy as a gift.  I don't breastfeed, so I really don't use it as much as other people probably do.  It is nice to use to prop up my arm when bottle feeding.  It is also nice to prop my daughter in.  I could live without it though which is why I didn't give it 5 stars.

product_title: Boppy Luxe - Clouds
review_body: Seriously- I can't! Even at 6 months I still nurse her on her boppy- we are both more comfy and cozy! It travels well and can be used for so many other things too! It can used for belly time- my daughter wasn't a fan of belly time so I put her so her arms were over the side and her legs were in the open portion. She loved it- we took great pictures and she was still building those core muscles. Now she sits in the circle and I know if she falls over she's cushioned and safe.  And even though she is young you can still see a sense of satisfaction in her face like hey look mommy no hands! My 2 recomendations? Get 2- 1 for home and 1 for travel- then you always have it for whenever or whatever you need to use it without trying to remember it each time- there's enough to remember each time you leave the house. And #2 get an extra cover than one can be on while one is washing! Enjoy! Hope this helps!

product_title: Delta Children's Products Jenny Lind Changing Table in White
review_headline: A Nice Table if you could assemble it
review_body: The finish and design are nice, but it was impossible to assemble the shelves.  The grooves to insert the wood into were machined too narrow.  After returning the item to Toys-R-Us, the manager informed me that he had seen 3 of these come back for the same reason.  He said he had even tried to help someone else assemble it with a hammer and sand paper with no luck!  Maybe they got a bad batch?  I'd stay away anyhow.

product_title: Safety 1st All in One Child Care Kit
review_body: It's a great item to have, but all the stuff inside isn't properly secured. :-)))

product_title: Gerber Knit Crib Sheet ~ Snug Fitting Soft Jersey Knit
review_body: Great elastic all around and generous size really makes changing the sheets so much easier.  I bought this together with the Ultrasoft Mattress Pad and the combination is heavenly, I'm sure my baby has sweet dreams every night.  The texture is so soft, like an old tshirt that you want to wear all the time.  Very inexpensive compared to other sheets.  This is the best sheets I've ever purchased for my baby.

product_title: Baby Bjorn Baby Carrier - Navy
review_headline: Good for small babies and going on walks
review_body: The Bjorn carrier was useful when I needed to walk the dog and it also helped my baby fall asleep. It was pretty easy to put on and get my baby in and out, although I noticed that the side latches became difficult to slide in the groove once my baby became bigger (but still under 20lbs) and would come undone if I didn't make sure they were latched properly. I found it difficult to do household chores w/ the carrier because I couldn't see properly over my baby's head and if I lowered the sliding buckle then my baby's arms would be uncomfortable since they have to go through the armholes. Although the carrier says you can carry a baby up to 33lbs, even before my baby was 20lbs using the carrier became very uncomfortable. It would put a strain on my neck and shoulder muscles and give me a headache. When I turned my baby around to face front wards, my baby was able to flip the infant head support up and it would cover his face. My baby was almost 10lbs when he was born so the carrier was only good for a few weeks. If your baby is small and if you don't plan on doing anything except go for walks when using the carrier then purchase it, otherwise I wouldn't recommend it. I think its popularity is simply due to all the hype it receives.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Bottle
review_body: Desperate and in tears at a Babies-R-Us store, I purchased these bottles after watching my son in agony for two months.  I bottle fed from the start and used Avent, dealing with my son's extreme gas, vomiting, spit up, crying, you name it.  I switched formula 8, yes, 8 times thinking that was it.  My younger sister suggested Dr. Browns because it worked for her daughter.  We switched and saw a difference with the first feeding.  My son eats MORE less frequently, is less fussy, less gassy, less agitated, he sleeps more, and I have less laundry! DON'T BUY ANYTHING ELSE!  This is a great product.  It was invented and patented by a pediatrician for his kids...obviously he knows better than us!  This is worth it!

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_body: This seems like it will be a great mobile but we had a very difficult time getting it attached to our crib. When it finally was attached we tried to adjust it and the small o ring between the two attached sections broke. It broke with very little effort. When we researched reviews on other sites we noticed the same complaint. Once that ring is broken the two pieces do not sit right together and many people complained that the mobile seperated and fell on their babies! Yikes. We're taking back the original product and hope the second won't break so easily. Serious design flaw.

product_title: Avent ISIS Breast Pump with Disposable Nurser
review_body: When I had my first child, I knew that I wanted to breastfeed exclusively even though I had to return to work after six weeks. The Avent Isis breast pump made it possible for me to pump and store enough milk for my son while I was at work. I tried a Medela electric pump, since that was the one the nurses all suggested, but felt that it was slow and noisy. The Avent pump is manual so it makes no noise, but it is also much faster than any other pump I tried. When you first start to pump, it feels like there is not enough pressure, but as the suction builds there is more than enough, and you can control it by how far you squeeze the handle. Then just hold it down for several seconds while the milk keeps coming. You can do it with one hand. I'll be using mine again with the baby I'm expecting now.

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis On The Go Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I am a first time mother. When I decided I wanted to breast feed my son I knew I would need a good breast pump. I liked the stylish look and the easy assembly and use of the Avent Isis pump.  Even though I am not going back to work I bought the back to work set for the extra bottles and carry case.  I bought it when my son was fist born but didn't use it for about 2 months.  When I opened the box I found that 2 of the pieces were cracked.  I called the store and they said they could not replace breast pumps for sanitary issues, so I called Avent.  They were so helpful and sent replacement parts which arrived in 3 days.  This is a great pump, light and easy to use.  I recomend it to all of my breast feeding friends.

product_title: Fisher Price AutoMirror
review_body:
Installed easily.
Curved mirror does the trick from almost any angle.
Our boy likes it.
A great buy.

I originally didn't think we needed a mirror. Now that we have one I would recommend it to all parents. Fun to look back and peace of mind.

product_title: Ginny Fraser 11 Piece Jungle Nursery In A Box
review_body:
When this set became unavailable at the Babies R Us store I went searching for another set that was neutral, cute and of reasonable price. I couldn't find anything even close. So I found this set at Babylove.com for the same price and purchased it. It is so cute and a great deal!

NM

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: This is a great tub (it was the third one i tried). It is easily placed over sink whether you have one large sink or a double sink. It has a separate area for clean water to rinse with and it is really easy to keep clean. And most important of all it is very safe- there is a raised area at bottom of tub so baby can't slide down.  My son in 8 months and pretty tall and he still fits comfortably.

product_title: Graco Passage Travel System in Bancroft 2007
review_headline: You couldn't pick a better travel system
review_body:
My Husband and I are expecting our first child, a little girl, in July. We received this as an early shower gift from my grandmother and absolutely could not have asked for a better gift. It rides smoothly - everything is very easy to snap together and it's not complicated to figure out. There was minimal assembly which my husband did for me and he had a blast testing it out around our dining room! <br />
It's a great system - we think everyone will love it.

product_title: EuroRider
review_body: Wny pay twice as much. Got the Eurorider from Target, my infant loves it. Whenever she cries to much, I stick it on and walk around with her in it she loves it. I have even worked on teh computer with her sleeping in it. This product is worth the money, I do not understand what Bjourn is twice the amount. If your looking at these type of carriers I highly recomend this one.

product_title: Safety 1st Crystal Clear Baby Monitor, White
review_body: This monitor is your basic monitor. It does all the things that any normal monitor would do. No frills. I use it as a stationary monitor in the bedroom. It's crystal clear and is a great buy, if youre looking for an inexpensive monitor.

product_title: Chicco London Stroller - Red
review_body:
I had written a review of this stroller that was based on the one we'd bought in November. We loved it then. Unfortunately, it was destroyed in a fire and we needed to get another.
This one purchased in April is even better than the one we bought in November. It's a newer model and improvements have been made. The steering is even better, the hood is easier to fold up, they've added a foot pedal to assist in closing it. The saleswoman at Babies R Us mentioned they'd only just gotten this newer model in, so it may be tough to locate the ones with the newer features.
I highly recommend this stroller.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_headline: OK for under 4 months...bad for 6 months plus!
review_body: This tub worked OK (not great) for our baby when she was small--tough at first to get used to it, but it was usable.  Now at six months old, it is impossible to use and too uncomfortable for our baby.  It doesn't convert well to a "toddler tub"--the incline is too much for a 6 month old baby and it has a large bump that hits them in the small of the back--hurts me to even look at it!  Used it once after we converted it and have since passed it on to friends to use with a small infant.  Supposedly, there are some cheap, inflatable ones that are much better for older babies.

product_title: Red, White&Denim Quilt
review_body: I bought this last fall to replace a white quilt for the winter and loved it soo much I am leaving it on. Love the colors and so does my husband, he says &quot;its not too girly&quot;. Great quality, look and feel. Thanx Target!

product_title: Fisher-Price: Link-a-doos Open-Top Take-Along Swing
review_body: Not reliable, music stops working, and Fisher Price has a crappy replacement policy and even crappier customer service reps.  Buy the Graco if you need a travel swing.

product_title: Delta Children's Products Vintage Chic Jenny Lind Crib in Classic White
review_body:
I purchased this crib when my granddaughter was born. I wanted a safe crib for her when she visited from Mass. She is now almost 18 months old, and has slept in the crib many times. At first it was in my daughters room while I was renovating my home, but now it has been moved into the room I created for my granddaughter. The casters made the move easy, although the crib had to be disassembled to get through the doorways. It was a snap to take apart and put back together. I too found that the matress fits so snuggly that it is hard to change the sheets
and if THAT is the only problem, I will manage. I am looking forward to converting this crib to a day bed. Although it does not say anything about needing extra parts so if anyone knows the answer to this I would appreciate hearing from you. All in all I did not find the look of the crib to appear cheap in any way as the previous reviewer indicated. My children's crib 35 years ago looked exactly like this one and was much more expensive. A crib is a temporary item and if it is safe, and lasts 3 years, for the price you cannot beat it.

product_title: Tiny Love 1-2-3 Discovery Lane
review_headline: Looks good, but isnt the best.
review_body: I thought this toy looked fantastic as I was searching for developmental toys to help in various areas while they grew. The versitility of this one looks great. Well, I liked it more than either one of my children did, as they almost never played with it except for the simple joy of taking it apart and strewing it all over the playroom! The black and white face was good when they are first starting to be attracted to faces but other than that, it just got taken apart and lost its interest, no matter which way i arranged the peices. Infants would do much better with a flat playmat with a mobile suspended above their heads.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini
review_body: Well I have to say our son really did not like this toy. He thought it was very boring. Recently I hung all the other toys like a rattle etc. from it and then he liked it. But still is not interested at all in the toys it originally came with.The toy actually has one plus, it folds up nice in is very easy to take along.

product_title: DO NOT USE-Universal Infant Carseat Carrier
review_body: I received a carseat as a gift and did not want to invest another 200.00$ in a complete travel system. I read the negative reviews and tested it without the baby in it. That satisfied me and we have had no problems. Our Graco seat fits great in it. The strap is what holds it down and it is a tight and secure fit. Plenty of room in the bottom too!

product_title: Dollhouse Floor Storage
review_body: This is a great bookcase/storage area for all of my 2 1/2 yr old daughters books/ stuffed animals...It holds a surprising amount of stuff and is also really solid.  I was a little skeptical because I bought in online, but I was pleasantly surprised at its size and durability, especially for the $$.  I'm very happy with this buy.

product_title: Safety 1st Cradle and Comfort Bath Tub
review_headline: Takes the fear out of bathing tiny ones!
review_body: I received this bath tub for a shower gift and I am so glad I did!  Easy to fill, clean, etc!!  The soft cushion insert makes it comfortable for the baby and eases you when nervous like I was about bathing a newborn!  I highly recommend this to all new moms!

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: My daughter loves the kick and play.  She giggles when she makes the lights and music go.  This is a must have in my book!

product_title: Tiny Love Take Along Arch -Tropical
review_body: We are currently using a bassinet for our son, but I was disapointed that we could not hang a mobile up to entertain our son. Then we hit on the idea of using the arch instead. Our son loves looking up at the arch and trying to bat at the toys. We also use the velcro strap on the airplane to tie it around his wrist so he can play with the plane as a wrist rattle.

product_title: The First Years Natural Comfort Breast Pump
review_body: I got this right after my son was born and I totally love it. I also have the Avent Isis and they both produce the same amount of milk for me! It does hurt IF you don't gradually increase the suction at first to get your nipple used to it (I have found its the same with all pumps though, your nipple has to get used to being sucked like that). But if you just got done nursing and are pumping the remaining milk it doesn't hurt. Like anything else you have to 'learn' how to use it (which isn't hard) and its wonderful. I am so glad I got this and I recommend it to everyone. This is well worth the $!

product_title: Peg Perego Prima Pappa Rocker High Chair
review_body:
I have 5 month old identical twin sons, and yes, I didnt start off wiht this huge chair at first.

I tried the Eddie Bauer Wooden chair, and it was a pain to clean, hard to keep babies in, tough to manuver, and it was just horrible, so I bought two of these, the exact opposites.

These Prima Papa chairs are HUGE, I mean bigger than anyother chair out there, but they EASILY fold up to but away in our laundry room (right next to the kitchenm) and they take up less space that way. The chair is very safe, it has a nice 5 pt. harness which enables my sons to be able to sit up. The wheels lock very well, but I can also use them to push the babies around the first floor. The rocker is a nice touch and my sons really love it. The seat can go all the way down to the floor for toddlers who love it that much, that they want it as a little chair. The tray is big, big enough to hold a plate and it is very nice because I dont have to worry about food flying off the sides because its so huge. The snap in tray actually COVERS the ENTIRE bottom tray, making it much easier to clean. The seat pad is not cloth, so you can just wipe it up and be done with it... The chair itself is comfortable and my sons are never fussy. The chair is super durable and stable, its not budging when the wheels are locked. It reqlines for my infants and its the perfect way to give em' a bottle. There will be enough room for them when they are toddlers, so thats also a big plus. Its also adjustable to table hieghts and the tray is a one handed removal, great when you have two squirmy infants!

The only bad, the tray is very far away. I have SCRAWNY sons and they will need a little pillow we bought (can fold so it pushes them closer and up higher) and they will probably be using that for a year, year and 1/2... but thats really not a problem for us. We made a slip on vinyl cover and its fine, but hey, its better than having the tray too close right?

This chairis super convinient and we plan on using it for years to come, its so much easier than the other chairs out there, thats why its so highly priced. THANKS PRIMA PAPA!

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body: I wish I read the reviews of the other mothers regarding this tub.  I would not have bought this tub.  I agree that this tub sounds like a versatile product, but it is not user friendly.  Since the 1st day we used it when my daughter was 2 weeks old, she slips down the tub everytime we give her a bath, her feet get hurt under the blue bar, and the suction cups do not work!!  No matter how you try to attach them to the tub or the tile around the sink.  To sum it up,  is a dangerous product!!

product_title: my first fish bowl by lamaze / learning curve
review_body: I just wanted to recommend the Lamaze First Fish Bowl as it is my seven month old's favorite toy. She never tires of playing with it. It is so cute and it is small enough to take anywhere. It was a lifesaver on our 5 hour communte to the beach last week.

product_title: Pack 'n Play - Colby
review_body: The only thing about this item I don't like is that you can't turn off the timer. It is hard to collapse, but that means it will also be hard for it to come apart on baby.

product_title: Philips AVENT Express Microwave Sterilizer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I love most of the AVENT Products, but this is definately
the most used. Makes life much easier. No need to check to
see if water is boiling yet, or try to chase small pieces
out of a large pot of boiling water. Pop it in the microwave
for a few minutes, walk away, let it stand for 2 minutes. Your done. Also works great with Medela system.
Only complaint is could have handles for removing from microwave.
So many other good points though, that one is almost mute.

product_title: Trailblazer Backpack Child Carrier
review_body: My husband and I love the backback.  The only setup required was to attach the sunshield.  My 6 month old daughter is so comfortable in this product that she fell asleep and we did not even notice.  One of the great selling points is that we can use this until she weighs 45 lbs (she is already 20lbs) and it is easily used if only one person is around.  I tried on all the backpacks that my local store carried and pick this out as the most comfortable for me to carry.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Bottle
review_body:
I have tried Avent, Ventaire, Platex Nursers, Evenflo, and Gerber and let me tell you Dr. Brown's bottles are THE BEST by far.
My baby was bottle fed from the start and he could not get good suction on the wide nipples that are so popular right now. Therefore, he was swallowing a TON of air and spitting up constantly and always struggling every time I would feed him.
I tried these bottles as a last resort because they are more expensive and have more pieces to clean than other bottles, but it was WORTH every dime and the small amount of extra time to clean. (there are two extra pieces to throw into the dishwasher basket)
My child is relaxed and enjoys his feedings now. He has signifigantly reduced spit up and gas. Isn't it worth the extra time and money to have a happy baby? I recommend that you try these bottles FIRST and save yourself the time of having to switch later. You get what you pay for with these bottles! Another plus is that there are 3 different types of nipples (flex, regular and wide) and 2 types of bottles, wide mouth and regular so you are not limited to one particular type of bottle!

product_title: Aquarium High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
The high chair is a little tacky looking if you ask me, but my mom bought it for her house when we go over. I ended up putting it together myself and it wasn't as easy to put together as the high chair I bought for our own house was. It seems pretty flimsy as well. Buckling my daughter in is more of a challenge than i bargained for. Using the 5-point harness is a little difficult because you have to put their arms through it, especially if you have a squirmy kid like I do. Another thing I noticed is that the wheels don't roll as smoothly as they should, I find that I am always getting caught up on something, it's like when you go grocery shopping and you get a bad cart with wheels that are hard to push. The height adjustment is a little strange because it only tells you what level it is at on one side of the chair. So for the first couple of times I used it I didn't even realize I had the left side on height level 4 and the right side on level 5. I think the chair should have a little snack tray under the big tray, cause our high chair has that and for now that's pretty much all we use. THe highchair does have some great toys, but I think eating should be done without toys.
Overall this highchair, when compairing to the high chair we have is not nearly as good. However, it serves it's purpose and my daughter loves to play with the toy on the ground. The one hand recline is great and the one hand tray release is really good.

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_headline: 15 months and still love this tub
review_body: my son loves his tub.  We're still using it and he's 15 months and 23 lbs, 33 inches tall.  I think he'll outgrow it soon, but it is safe and fun.

product_title: Medela CSF Bags - Economy 50 Pack
review_body: While these bags do accomplish their goals of collecting, storing, and freezing breast milk, I found them difficult to attach securely to the pump, the twist tie system prevents them from freezing flat (therefore taking up lots of freezer space), and they are next to impossible to open without scissors.  ...

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Bouncer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My 3 month old son just loves this bouncer seat! He never seems to get sick of the aquarium scene. He loves the twirling starfish & the bubbles. A great feature is that you can switch from music to ocean waves to rain, etc. He stays entertained & will sit in it for long periods of time without fussing. He falls asleep in it alot, too. This is great for when you need time to do things around the house & cant hold your baby. It's easy to pick up & move (with him in it!). You can even remove the aquarium panel & just have it as a seat which is nice, too. I recommend this bouncer seat!

product_title: Fisher-Price Sounds'n Lights Monitor
review_body: I love this monitor. It picks up all the noises my little girl makes with no static. I can even hear her breathing. The only time it makes any noise is when I pick up our cordless phone, you can hear a little click. The only downside, I wish I would have gotten one that I could talk back to her on. Overall, it's great!

product_title: Philips AVENT Express Microwave Sterilizer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
If you want to sterilize bottles and pacifiers this is the product to have. It is very quick - 5 minutes in our microwave and you are done. Yes, you can put these items in the dishwasher but I hate to run the DW for just a load of bottles. You also need to have a special basket to keep the various bottle parts from falling to the bottom of the dishwasher.
Yes, there is condensation, but we keep a bottle rack next to the sink and let them air dry for a few hours. If you hand washed you would also have to let them air dry so I really don't see the point of this complaint.
Avent is very durable - we have had ours over 3 years now and have been doing bottles daily and it has not cracked or broken. Child #3 is on the way so we will be using it for at least another two years.

product_title: Baby Einstein Seek & Discover Activity Gym (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I received this gym as a shower gift and I am so thankful that we have it.  We began putting my daughter under it when she was only a few weeks old and she enjoyed looking at all the dangling objects and the lights.  Now she's 4 1/2 months old and this is by far her favorite toy.  The only thing that I would change about it is to have a way to turn off the sound (but still have the lights work)--it's pretty loud and gets a little annoying.  Most of the time I don't turn it on and she enjoys it anyways.  Regardless, I still give this an easy 5 stars.  It's a little pricey but worth every penny.

product_title: Lamaze Octotunes (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Even though my son (7 months) cannot squeeze the tentacles himself yet, he loves to listen to us make music for him. He has enjoyed this since he was a few months old.  He also likes to chew on it.  :)

product_title: Disney Baby - Gingham and Floral Shoulder Diaper bag -Large
review_headline: wonderful though its different from what is pictured here !
review_body: i love this bag.its very spacious & comfy.I have the mini diaper bag of the same one aswell. told my friend to buy & send me to UK.i expected to receive the same bag as in the picture listed in the site. but it was different. floral patterns, winnie pic in the front look totally different, side pockets dont have fastner as in website pictured bag. amazon should have informed this. a bit disappointed despite of all tht i love in this bag.

product_title: Playtex VentAire Advanced Standard Bottle Gift Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
My son actually loves this bottle otherwise i might have switched to something else. It isnt that the bottle doesnt do what is advertised-i found that it DOES reduce the amount of air swallowed during feedings... it is just that you have to have all of the many parts in exact alignment otherwise you either have a leaky bottom or a collapsing nipple. (this means that after each cleaning you are spending a little bit of time putting each bottle back together) That having been said, once we figured out the seal on the bottom sometimes needs to be readjusted prior to feeding (you need to hold it upside down
to get in there if there is formula inside), we are 90% happy with these bottles. I do agree that the stage one nipples are sooooo slow that unless you take a pin or knife to the hole you'll spend hours feeding your newborn. (it gets better once your baby is old enough to handle the stage two)
I can't say one way or another if we'd do anything differently..the time and rare inconvenience of a spill or inverted nipple is a small price in exchange for a less gassy baby. (and no, they dont leak or collapse everytime...or even everyday...but it does happen).

product_title: Contoured Changing Pad
review_body:
We have a dresser with a top that can be used as a platform for a changing table and then later used as a regular dresser top. The changing pad fits perfect on top of it, it secures to the back of the dresser and stays in place. It also has securable straps for added safety. It's incredibly durable and quite handy, even with older toddlers.

Don't forget to buy the covers that fit over the pad, I'd suggest at least two but there have been days when the three we have were all in the laundry and we've used a receiving blanket or a towel in a pinch as well.

product_title: Summer Infant Newborn-To-Toddler Bath Center & Shower (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I requested this tub because the shower sounded like a great idea, well it was a big disapointment.  The first tume we used it the shower didn't work.  We finally got one that works but it was awful; the button didn't work well, the water came out some times. the shower would run without holding the button, and now we can't be bothered using the shower spray.  Do yourself a favor, buy another tub.

product_title: Crown Crafts The Original NoJo BabySling by Dr. Sears - Black Chambray (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This sling has several major drawbacks:    It is way to bulky--there's no way it can fit in your diaper bag, and it's too hot.  They went way overboard with the padding.    The rings are very hard to adjust.  I felt like I was constantly pulling on the rings to keep it comfortable.    It is not for little people.  I am 5' 6\\" and 125 lbs and it was still a little too big.    (...)    While I agree that a sling is a must have, this was NOT the best choice for me.

product_title: Munchkin Mozart Magic Cube
review_headline: If you live in a musical household, pass on this toy...
review_body:
Although the concept is an intriguing and potentially enlightening one for an infant/toddler, the implementation leaves a lot to be desired. As a musician and engineer, I acquire and test out many toys claiming to enrich a child's musical tastes/abilities, etc.
As a musician, the sound this cube produces is so terrible, I shudder every time I hear it. When I first heard it, I immediately thought the batteries were dead and changed them, only to discover that brand new batteries made no difference whatsoever. My 11 month old son pressed the buttons eagerly to see what would happen, frowned, and then quickly pressed them again to make it stop and pointed at the CD player from which there is almost always some sort of music playing! He by far prefers a CD or even an MP3, so this toy has now been abandoned. The distinction between the different instruments is very slight. My violin sounds nothing like this supposed violin sound. The rest of the instruments do not resemble their real counterparts very much either, and even the intonation is not exact.
As an engineer, I know that even the simplest synthesizers and even the most terrible audio compression algorithms produce better audio quality. Why couldn't the engineers of this toy make this sound better? If anything, I would think the audio auality of this toy would put a musically oriented child off of music entirely. For this price you can buy a better electronic keyboard and play with truly different sounds with your little one.
As for selection, aside from a few obvious ones that are acceptable, there are numerous more interesting and more familiar pieces composed by Mozart. I'd love to know who chose these pieces and why.
So far, this toy has mostly been thrown around. As such, it has not yet broken, though I too have experienced the need to turn it off and on again in order to get it to function \\"properly\\" again.
So, I would wait for a new version of this toy to come out with considerably better electronics before buying. Or, at the very least, listen to it at the store before you buy it to see if you can stomach the sound yourself.

product_title: The First Years Nature Sensations Lullaby Player (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I loved this item BUT the batteries were ALWAYS dying. This thing just sucks the life out of batteries like you wouldn't imagine.  It is a great idea and my son loved it, but do NOT plan to use it the whole night or many nights or you will find it dead in the morning.

product_title: Simplicity 3-In-1 Bedside Bassinet
review_body: I am extremely satisfied with this bassinet.  It's ability to change from a traditional bassinet, bedside sleeper, and changing table was more than worth the money. I contacted the manufacturer to purchase additional sheets and they accomodated my request and were very friendly and helpful.  I recommend this product to anyone looking to purchase a bassinet for themselves or as a gift.

product_title: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review_headline: Excellent value- ask for the smooth shields
review_body:
I looked at several pumps and considered renting a pump before deciding on purchasing this one. The cost to purchase this pump was equal to renting a quality pump for the first month.

I am a new Mom, and I have only tried the Medela basic manual pump and this electric one, so I don't have a lot to compare it to. I've been using this electric pump for several weeks and find it pretty effective. I like that the suction intensity is adjustable.

The customer service at First Years has also been accommodating- I requested a non-textured shield and it was sent to me within a week. When the bag is closed most of the noise is muffled, though it still wouldn't be considered quiet. It comes with 2 storage containers, which I found handy.

UPDATE October 2004: I've been using the pump for 8 months and still think it is a great value! To the Mom who said the textured shields hurt- I agree, which is why I called the company and asked for the smooth shield. It was sent to me right away at NO charge!

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 9oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love these bottles and so does my son. I like that you can change the flow of the nipple. Some bottles mainly the cheap ones you can't do that with. I have never had a leak problem. I also don't wash mine in the dishwasher. I soak them and wash them with the Avent bottle and nipple cleaner. Works great. My son never had a problem with the nipple either. He is mainly breastfed so the nipple was important to me in deciding with bottles. This has never been a problem for him. He always goes right back to the breast. I will by these bottles for all of my children.

product_title: Crib Shield System White
review_body: I just received the new crib shield system today and have already installed it. It was very easy to install and it fits very nice & snug without any gapping. I really didn't know what to expect after reading all of the mixed reviews. My 8 month old daughter is taking a nap right now and so far, so good!!

product_title: Crown Crafts The Original NoJo BabySling by Dr. Sears - Denim (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Pretty good alternative to holding baby all the time
review_body:
I got this sling when my first son was 1.5 months old and I was trying to shop in Target. He was screaming in his car seat so I put it on right in the store!!! I liked it because I could nurse him in it while wearing a nursing top - much easier than in the Bjorn, and nobody can see what you are doing. The padded lip on the sling is actually really great, it helps prop the baby's head up, and also keeps them from slipping out, which almost happened with a sling my cousin lent me.
I am now using it with my second son, and sometimes I can slip the sling off me when he is sleeping and tuck it around him and he stays asleep, although you have to make sure you place it in such a way that the ring doesn't get in the way or the baby doesn't get tangled in the \\"tail.\\" I don't do this all the time, but it is a nice way to get him to sleep when he's really having a hard time, and because the sling smells like mommy, he feels comfy.
I've taken the sling everywhere, and my older son still likes to be in it, even though he's a tad over the weight limit.
I didn't give it 5 stars because as really tiny infants my sons did not like this. Now though, we use it a lot around the house when we don't want to fiddle with the Bjorn - a great way to deal with separation anxiety. If you are really clever, there is a way to wear it so you can have an older child on your back. My older son likes that a lot!

product_title: Safety 1st Secure Lock Bed Rail
review_body:
I was hesitant to purchase the bedrail, after reading the reviews. But it was the only one the store carried, so I didn't have much of a choice. The directions for assembly were easy to follow and it was put together in 5 minutes. Now I wasn't sure what to expect when I put it on the bed, after reading about all the trouble other people had, but it was fine. You just need to read the directions-it is not meant for toddler beds or bunk beds-yes, you do need to make sure the posts are locked into position but it is no big deal to figure it out.
I do like this very much, it is sturdy and can hold the weight of a sleeping child-no more BUMPS in the night!

product_title: UltraSoft Quilted Crib Mattress Pad
review_body: These are awesome. We bought two so we always have a clean one in the closet. We think it's great-- well made, a tight fit around the mattress, and it dries fairly quickly in the drier. A previous reviewer wrote that it's not as soft and luxurious as it sounds, but I think it's just right. It's not supposed to be too padded or you increase your baby's SIDS risk.

product_title: UltraSoft Quilted Crib Mattress Pad
review_body: Liked this pad except for the waterproof backing, my child sweats so much as it is the vinyl backing just makes it worse. The pad itself is nice. I'm still searching for a nice all cotton pad with no vinyl backing!!!!!

product_title: Evenflo Portable Ultrasaucer
review_body: My son loves playing in the Exersauser Ultra, and treats the whole thing as one giant teether. When I first looked at the Exersauser, I was wary of the concerns posted by some parents but it seems Evenflo has addressed these, and made changes to their product. Having a friend who has an older model, I noticed the following changes: The sounds are slightly higher. The jester rattle no longer has 3 pointed edges on its hat but rather only two but with balls on the end, completely removing the sharp edges. The castle has also had all sharp edges and corners removed by adding an extra molding to the top. The only area that I feel needs to be addressed is one extra height needs to be added for taller children as my son's feets are nearly flat on the base and he's only 6 months old.

product_title: Bugs On Board (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Bugs on Board are a hit!
review_body: My daughter loves having the bugs on her carseat.  I first attached them when she was 2 months old and it has been fun watching her develop in her play with them.  First she watched them, then she would bat at them, and now (at 5 months) she enjoys pulling and chewing on them.  She smiles when I put her in her car seat and put the bar up so she can see her \\"bugs.\\"  They are her favorite car seat toy.

product_title: Trailblazer Backpack Child Carrier
review_body: I bought this carrier because I had read reviews saying that it worked well for short and tall people but I don't find this to be true. I am 5'4" and the carrier seems to sit too low on my back. It fits my husband fine (he is 5'9")but I can't get it to adjust properly to fit me. I've used it several times and each time it makes my back and shoulders sore. My son is around 22 pounds at 1 year old so he's not that big. I bought this hoping that I would be able to use it for a while because I walk a lot and wanted to carry him in the backpack instead of a stroller.

product_title: Roundabout Convertible LATCH Car Seat - Denim
review_body: I ORIGINLLY BOUGHT THE EDDIE BAUER EDIION CAR SEAT, BUT IT JUST DID NOT FIT MY FOUR MONTH OLD DAUGHTER CORRECTLY IT WAS COMMPLICATED AND A REAL PAIN TO INSTALL IN MY VEHICLE. I'M RETURNING IT AND SINCE I HAVE WENT AND BOUGHT THIS SAME CAR SEAT...AND ITS AWESOME...VER EASY TO INSTALL AND FITS MY DAUGHTER PERFECT, IT RECLINES ENOUGH FOR HER SINCE SHE IS JUST COMING OUT OF THE CARRIER. I WOULD RECOMMEND THIS CAR SEAT FOR ANYONE. THE PRICE IS HIGH BUT ITS WORTH EVERY PENNY...I BUYING ANOTHER TO KEEP IN THE OTHER VEHICLE I LIKE IT SO MUCH

product_title: DO NOT USE-Universal Infant Carseat Carrier
review_body: If you are looking for an easy, transportable carrier, this is it. This is not meant to be your be-all-end-all stroller. This is for a quick trip to the mall, etc. If you want a big, sturdy stroller, then get one in addition to this, b/c this Kolcraft serves its purpose, and it serves it well! And as for tilting the carrier up the stairs as the reviewer prior to this, you should never tilt any stroller UP a flight of stairs. That's just dangerous no matter what.

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 9oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Don't overthink everything - this is a fine feeding option.
review_body:
I'll admit it - I have to laugh when I read some of these reviews, both the good and bad. There is no need to overthink what bottle you use to feed your baby. If you try this one and she accepts the nipple, go with it. If she rejects it, try another bottle. These bottles are no better or worse than any other.
All babies experience some degree of gas and spitting up. Do you really think a "special" bottle is going change what has been happening since the dawn of time?
Regarding the leakage problem discussed by others, just make sure the top is tight and you will be fine. I experienced leakage one time and ever since, I have made sure to tighten the top before giving it to my daughter. No more problems.
Relax, parents. Your baby needs you to spend less time overthinking everything and more time holding, cuddling, playing, etc. with her.

product_title: Fashion Shoulder Backpack- Black
review_body:
This bag is so great that we just ordered a second one in a different color! It can be carried as a sling bag, a back pack, or a shoulder bag. It has two zipper pouches on the outside of keys, wallet, pacifiers, etc. Then on the inside it has 3 insulated bottle pouches and a mulitude of zippered nad velcro pouches and compartments. So there is a place for everything and everything has it's place. Plus, is is extra roomy without being too big. We can fit all we need for the day and still have room left for all the little extras that we always seem to need to fit in it throughout the day. It also cleans up in a snap! We've had spit up, leaking bottles, soda, and ice cream in/on it and they have all just wiped right off without any staining. Another big plus is that is very affordable!

This bag is wonderful and I will never part with it! It is so great that my cousin and two friends got them after they saw it!

product_title: DEX Products Wipe Warmer Deluxe WWTH-01
review_body: I have bought two of these warmers and have had to return both of them because the lid breaks within weeks of using it. I chose not to try again. It works as far as warming the wipes but after a few weeks of use the lids hinges break and then it winds up on the floor,then the wipes dry up. Eight years ago with my first child I had something like a heating pad that wraped around the wipes box and it lasted for years, through two children. Now with # 3 I'd just rather have the old style wipe warmer.Good luck finding it, I can't.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Deluxe - Noah's Ark
review_body:
Does it work?
The designers of this toy seem to hit the right combo of colors and design to really attract a baby's attention. One of several things that make it so great is its versatility. Thanks to the rings that suspend the toys over the baby, you can change the height so that they are within reach of hands and feet. Also it folds in half and tucks away neatly in an included bag.
What are its CON's? The material thread count is LOW, and gives it a cheap rough feeling.

product_title: JJ Cole Premaxx Sling Carrier - New Edition Red Orange (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a great product if you are 5ft 6in or taller or if your baby likes to be  kind of crunched it a very snugg fit 4 the baby!

product_title: Summer Infant Sure & Secure Walk-Thru Gate
review_body: This is an impossible gate!  My husband, who is an engineer and very mechanical, spent over an hour trying to get it installed correctly.  Once in place, we tried it out and realized we had purchased a worthless gate...the latch is very difficult to open and the pressure mounting is effective ONLY when the gate is closed--once opened, the top slides forward.  In fact, we've decided having the gate is more dangerous than not having one on our stairs at all.  We are exchanging it today for either the hands free gate or one that mounts into the wall.

product_title: Aquarium High Chair (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have the aquarium bouncer and I loved it and when I was looking for highchairs, I saw this advertised and fell in love with it. The removable tray to put in dishwasher is great; I know some come with 3 but one is enough for us. I LOVE the aquarium toy that comes with it (and has a spot in the back for when not in use); it is like the other aquarium crib toy and my baby LOVES it! The pattern is new and even cuter than the old aqarium bouncer pattern. It has a 3 point reclining chair and the tray is one hand super easy to put on and off. I am telling all my friends about this!

product_title: Fisher Price Sparkling Symphony Piano
review_body: I was going to purchase this toy but decided against it because of it's playing options.  It has two supposed settings.  One setting:  Baby hits a key, and a song plays.   Other setting:  Baby hits a key and random, continuous notes play.  To me, these are not different settings.  One setting SHOULD instead be like a regular piano, where baby touches one key and only one key plays.   Little Tikes makes one like that but it doesn't have keys that light up.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: When I did research on diaper pails before my baby arrived I liked that you didn't have to buy refills and the smell didn't seem to be a big issue with the Diaper Champ.  I didn't keep my receipt to return it but I'm going to spend another $30 to buy the Diaper Genie.  The Diaper Champ is extrememly smelly and I feel that I can tolerate a lot.  The most frustrating disappointment was that it was constantly jamming.  I was constantly having to open the top and manually stuff the diaper down into the base.  My friend bought the Diaper Champ as well and has also returned hers for the exact same reasons.  The less expensive route with the Diaper Champ will now cost me double when I purchase the Diaper Genie.

product_title: Basic Comfort Rest EZ II Pregnancy Wedge
review_body: I am 6 and a half months pregnant. I got this pillow a month and a half ago after reading the favorable reviews. I quit using it pretty quickly. Maybe I toss and turn too much for this sort of wedge, but I would consistently wake up with the wedge under me in such a way that I was being stabbed by sharp edges on the velcro (which is underneath)! I am much more comfortable sleeping on my left side with 4 pillows... some skinny and some fluffy ...and a teddy bear (my hubby gets to teeter on the edge of the bed) ;-)

product_title: Soft Stroller Bar
review_body: Our little girl has loved this toy from the moment we purchased it when she was 4 months old and able to sit in her stroller by herself. She is now almost 8 months and is still discovering new things to do with it. It has held up well and she hears the laughing & ribbits just fine - she thinks they are hilarious.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body:
Having a number of kids is a lot of fun so when the ability to save a little money is presented it is very appealing. This 2 in 1 product is an option I went with and am more than satisfied with. The product has lasted through two children, not to mention the fact that I used it on my oldest (3rd) child for as long as possible before he grew out of it. The seat is still in great condition and ready for more. The non skid pads have not worn a bit and toys aren't even the slightest bit faded.
Very Happy to continue using this product!

product_title: Munchkin Deluxe Bottle  And Food Warmer With Pacifier Cleaning Basket
review_body: This item has been a life saver!  For 6 months now it has never failed me.  Any bottle will fit into it, and the temperature is always perfect.  I've used it so much you can't read the measuring cup anymore, and the lid to it came off.  But it still works like a champ!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: I agree with most if not all of the other reviews that rate this product favorably, but one person said that the seat was too far back. I have to respond to that and say that I, too, thought the seat was too far back when I first started using it (shortly after my son's birth) and didn't understand why they designed it that way. When my son turned three months, I suddenly figured it out: the baby is supposed to touch and kick the dangling toys, not grab them (he discovered what his feet were for right about then). A small baby has to recline until he/she is able to sit unassisted anyway.

product_title: Graco Star Gazing Glider LXI Travel System - 7446STA
review_body: We ordered this travel system on a Wednesday and recieved it today, Tuesday.  Very quick on the shipment, so woohoo to target for that.  As for the stroller, it was very easy to put together and feels very sturdy.  I put it together myself, I'm about eight months along, except for a part on the back wheels that I couldn't push in, but other than that, it was very simple.  The stroller is very manuverable, not big and bulky like my parents had with my brother.  The basket is still accessible even when the seat is reclined all the way.  It folds very easily, although my only gripe is that if you pull it by the handle folded, it scrapes the other side where the kid's feet goes.  But you can just pull it from the other side with no problems.  We had no problems with the car seat, so far.  It came assemble and fits into our Mini Cooper without a problem.  Although the stroller itself doesn't fit in the boot, which I expected, but then again we did get a Mini, right?  So far so good with the whole thing.  I'll post an update once our baby girl arrives and takes it for a ride!  Another plus is that it's really cute!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: My baby loves this bouncer.  She loves the vibration and loves the lights when I attach the light/music/toy part.  At 1 month she was following the lights around with her eyes.  Very nice.  She isn't strong enough to kick it to make it light up yet, so I don't know how that will work out.

product_title: Summer Infant Sure And Secure Expansion Gate
review_body: I have read alot of the reviews here and the problem with the gate is neither the installation nor the gate itself.  The problem with the gate is the hardware.  the extra wide, and therefore, extra heavy gate attaches to the wall on each side with metal screws.  these screws are held in place by plastic.  for the most part this is fine until an accident occurs, which is when you want to gate to work the best.  unfortunately, the plastic holding the gate onto the wall broke, not the screws, and not the metal gate itself, but the plastic mounting hardware.  the fix to this is simple, get rid of the plastic and use brass or stainless steel.  at the very least, make the replacement parts available on-line through the company's web site.  If I am paying 60, 70 or more dollars for a gate, I would pay an extra five for better hardware.  fortunately, when the gate came down, with my wife, she suffered a bruised ego and some black and blue marks, but it could have been much more serious.

product_title: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing - Nature's Touch N1973 (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son would not take naps in his crib but would nap for hours in this swing.  The soothing music and sounds are very pleasant and my son likes to look at himself in the mirrored part.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body: I registered for this tub & it was okay for the infant stages of baths...it fit in our kitchen sink perfectly.  Though my daughter would constantly scrape her toes on the green bar.  Once we converted it to a seat for our 6 month old that is when the danger began.  The seat would collapse on my daughters legs, thank god she was not harmed too badly.  The best place for this tub is on the curb with the rest of the trash!!

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie - First Refill Included
review_body: I think the wide opening Diaper Genie is great.. I have both the other genie worked fine but as the diapers got bigger it was harder to put in the opening....but the new genie works GREAT..    I think the only thing missing is a freshener so when you open it..you don't get an order... I use a stick on kind now and it work.....Thank you,               a Proud Grandma

product_title: Summer Infant Deluxe Day and Night Handheld Color Video Monitor with 2.5" Screen, Blue (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I previously had the Baby's Quiet Sounds (Summer infant care) monitor but returned it b/c the reception started out ok and then got progressively worse. As soon as I plugged in this monitor the picture quality was crystal clear AND the sound monitor is very sensitive. If you are going to be far away from the signal then you'll have to plug it into the wall to boost the signal, but it still works very well.

I'm very pleased and would recommend buying one the sooner the better!!

product_title: First Years Premium Double Pump
review_body: This pump works very well as many reviews have said, but unfortunately not for very long,mine keeps getting condensation in the air hose and shortly after it breaks, this is my third one, the only reason I still have it despite its unpredictability is Babies R Us took it back with the receipt.

product_title: Graco Ultra CarGo Booster Car Seat
review_body: We use this seat for our 4 and 6 year olds and absolutely love it! Unlike many of the other reviewers, I love the way this one tightens/loosens the belts. To tighten, you pull on the lower strap - it tightens using a ratchet type system - each pull on the lower belt tightens it a little bit more. To loosen, you just push the button and pull on the straps...it couldn't be easier. My son uses the seat with the car seat belt. With other seats we have had problems with the belt positioners wearing out of the fabric cover, so it ends up not really helping position the belt correctly - we have used this seat for a year and a half and have not had this problem at all! I can't say enough for this product - I've even recommended it to friends and family.

product_title: Winnie The Pooh - Peek a Pooh Wall Border
review_body: My wife and I purchased this border to go with the rest of the nursery....We love the design, however, as with the other reviewer, the border did not stick to the walls at all...We followed the directions to a \\"T\\" and an hour later, it fell off the wall in a crinkled mess....We were able to put it back up with wallpaper adhesive, but it was quite a hassle.  You would think that at fifteen dollars a strip, the self adhesive would be a little more reliable.....

product_title: Munchkin Mozart Magic Cube
review_body: My son used this toy form birth to 3 years old.  He became interested again when his newborn sister was playing with it.  It stimulates younger babies but can advance to teach about musical instruments for older children.  I find most electronic toys annoying, but this was actually lovely to listen to.

product_title: Medela TheraShells Breast Shells
review_body: I get very sore and can't go anywhere without them.  u cant see them at all through my clothing (thought it might make me look a little larger on top.)  i wish i knew about these earlier.  its also great for leaking - the foam absorbs so well and then you have the cup to hold leaking milk.  you can barely leak through with this.  i would even use this just to prevent leakage!

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis Manual Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Although I'm a big fan of the Avent products, I didn't really care for this one much.  First off, while pumping (since you're the one controling it) you can actually feel the pressure.  I'd much rather prefer an electric pump where you're not the one controling your own pain).  Second of all, the milk kept interfering with the suction.  It would go under the rubber that keeps the pressure on your breast therefore losing the suction.  So much of a hassle.  GET THE ELECTRIC PUMPS.

product_title: Safety 1st Sound 'n Lights Discovery Walker
review_body: Our 6 month old loves this walker!  He will just sit in it and play and stretch his legs for quite a while!  We put him in it to make & eat dinner, take a shower, do chores, etc.  His 3 year old cousin loves to stand next to him and play with the toys also.
