She had to show him a couple times how the motion sensored toy works, and then he learned how and they were both entertained!  Its so cute to watch a little one play with this toy.  I believe it will help him learn how to walk.  This is a great purchase!

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body: I really hate this tub. After reading the other reviews, it's good to know that I wasn't crazy or inept because everyone seems to have had the same problems I did. My son's feet get stuck in the thing all the time. He slips and slides. Don't waste your money.

product_title: BABYBJORN Original Carrier - City Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This carrier has come in very handy since the birth of my second child.  This allows me to still have two hands for my toddler.  I would suggest this carrier to any parent, especially to parents expecting their second child.

product_title: Jeep Liberty Renegade - Traditional Walker
review_body:
On the positive side, my daughter loves the wheel and horn feature on this walker. The steering wheel turns, beeps, makes an ignition sound, and plays music, all very fun. This walker is also very durable and would last through multiple children.

However, I wanted a walker that my daughter could actually walk in. We have had the walker since she was about 4 months. She began walking at 9.5 months. She is now 11.5 months and is walking very well and still cannot walk in this walker. The same durability that I thought would make this walker a good choice, is very cumbersome for her. The way the child's legs hang out, I don't think I would be able to walk in it if it were made for my size. We do not have carpet in our house and even on smooth surfaces the walker requires a lot of initial force to get it going. Carpet is impossible, even with an adult helping.

All in all, I would recommend a much less expensive steering wheel toy to compensate for the great features of this walker. I don't think I would recommend a walker at all. My daughter preferred installed towel racks her height around the rooms, and a helping hand from mom or dad to start walking than to be put into something.

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 9oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I wouldn't recommend these bottles.  There ae many others out there with the same benifits, minus the hassle.  I can't even COUNT how many times I have been soaked in a mother's breat milk because of the leakage.  I have tried screwing them extra tight, I have tried screwing them on the looser side, ... I have even tried putting them on crooked!  LOL  They don't leak all the time, but when they do, watch out!  It comes pouring out like a river!  Personally, I used the Playtex disposible bottles.  You can get the same great \\"mother like\\" nipples, same easy clean-up, same gas reduction, and a LOT less leakage!  None..  Imagine that?!  If you're gonna use the Avent bottles, make sure you have some extra milk/formula, for those occassions you lose half the bottle on you lap!

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: The newborn cradle is a must for any new parent.  My one month old baby girl is perfectly snuggled as if she was on a hammock.  It is machine washable and very easy to clean.  I was able to put her on the newborn side where she was at just the right angle for her bath.  It's very sturdy and easy to clean and the compartment for holding soap, etc is very convenient.  The temperature plug really isn't necessary because I don't know many parents that wouldn't test the water first with their elbow or wrist.  Overall, it's a good tub that has proven good support thus far.

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_headline: It's ok for a little one
review_body: It's ok for a little one but once my baby reached about 4 months, she played and splashed so much, she grew out of it.  She has long legs and they reach the toddler side now.  She slips around way too much because the bump on the bottom is too small and doesn't come up enough.  She's almost gone under a couple times if I hadn't been there.  The water doesn't cover her enough.  It's ok for little ones but I don't recommend it as they get older.  Plus, mine doesn't fit in my sink.

product_title: Wrap-n-ride Warm and Cozy Carrier Liner
review_headline: LOVE IT, LOVE IT, LOVE IT
review_body:
Much better than the ones that fit OVER the car seat. Keeps baby mobile, warm and comfortable!
We live in upstate New York and when we get snow, WE GET SNOW! Even in 4 degree weather, it is so much easier to bundle her in the seat without the big, bulky snowsuits, sweaters and jackets! All we need is a good hat and we're good!
The seat belt fits better over her day clothes and I feel she's much safer that way. We just zip it up and put the top flap over her head to transport the seat in and out of the car.
The only downfall is that it's a universal fit, so in some seats you may have extra material. We work around it but it would be nice if they made them to fit each model!

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis Manual Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I decided to go with this pump since all of my feeding products where Avent as well.  I found it to be easier for me to pump than to nurse, because my little one got tired of suckling.  She drank more with more ease from the bottle.  After a long battle with this noisy little pump, I've slowly but surely begun to produce less and less milk.  I've contacted the company on several occasions regarding the pump and they've been more than helpful.  They even sent me a new pump, which was great except it squeaked just as loud as the old one did!!!  So I've decided to give up on breastfeeding because of the sour experience with this little pump.  I wish I had never spent the money on this!!!  I give the company and their customer service 5 stars, but 1 for this product!

product_title: Peg Perego Prima Pappa Multi-Position Dual Fabric High Chair - Chesapeake
review_body: We love this chair its one of the best items we have bought! Easy to fold up i can do it with one hand and it takes about two sec.!  It folds up so easy and flat that we never bought a portable high chair. Theres no need to because, the chairs height is adjustable so that you can take the tray off and it will fit at any table.

product_title: Summer Infant Newborn-To-Toddler Bath Center & Shower (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The tub itself is very nice--a good size with nice features like grippers and contoured parts.  The shower, however, stopped working after only 4 baths and was only a small stream of water when it did work.  We still use the reservoir portion to have some clean rinsing water handy, but the sprayer is useless.  If you purchase this product for the tub itself, you will be pleased.

product_title: Stroller Rain Cover
review_headline: Great cover for middle temp areas
review_body: We have had this product for about nine months now and we have gotten great use out of it. Not only does it fit our regular stroller, I have also been able to use it on our jogging stroller. My son likes it because he can still see what is going on around him, but it protects him from the wind and rain. I do think that when my one year old is older, this product may not be long enough to cover his feet, but for now it works just fine. I have also used this product in the summer months to keep my baby protected from mosquitos and it worked much better at keeping bugs out than the netted cover I had purchased. It folds easily and is easy to clean. The side vents are great. I don't know that it would hold up well in extreme temps, but it has worked fine for us in mild snow and 100 degree summers. All in all, it has been a flexible product for our family.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body: My child slip and slide all over the place and he is now 8 months old.  It's uncomfortable for him and uncomfortable for me to give him a bath in.  I thought this would be a good bath system for him to use for a while, unfortunately, it's not to be.

product_title: Britax: Preview Lightweight Umbrella Travel System Stroller: Unity Blue
review_body:
My daughter is approaching 2 years of age and it was time to purchase a more light weight stroller. My daugher is a bit on the small side so it was hard to find a stroller where her legs were not sticking straight out and the harness fits her properly. This Britax stroller was the only stroller that fit her perectly. She likes it for the most part (considering she dislikes confinement of any kind). The stroller is easy to assemble, fold up, and store. The added diaper bag is handy. It is quite large and holds all the items you use for a day at the mall ;-)

K. Casey
Westwood, NJ

product_title: Chicco Tuscany Stroller
review_body: We just bought 2 of the Tuscany strollers for our twin boys who are 18 months old.  We previously used a heavy double stroller, and although it is still nice and will be used on occasion, these new Chicco's are the best!  They are so lightweight and maneuver easily through lots of spaces.  Our 7 year old daughter can push one with ease if I am out without my hubby.  The fabric is very nice, padded and very durable.  I have had no trouble at all with them and agree with the other reviewers that we could have spent a ton more on the pricier strollers, but this one is a steal at $79.  I would recommend this stroller to anyone needing a lightweight, great looking stroller!

product_title: Graco Angelcare Movement Sensor with Nursery Monitor
review_body: The Angelcare movement sensor is the BEST product I have ever seen on the market. It works so well that new parents can get a &quot;sound&quot; sleep and not worry that your baby has stopped breathing or is tangled in his/her blankets. The alarm sounds ONLY if there is no movement detected in 20 seconds and it is also a sound monitor so it is 2 monitors in 1. It really works and it is a product I would recommend to anyone worried about SIDS.

product_title: Capri Stroller - Red Tech
review_body: This is a great, light weight and compact stroller. One reviewer mentioned that the stroller wheels can't be locked when it's folded, but this isn't true. At least with the model I bought, each wheel has it's own lock, and they can be used anytime. As for the cup holder, you can buy these great attatchments (I got them in a Baby's R Us store, but a similar version is sold on line. They're called Clip N Go Stroller Accessories). It comes with a big cup holder, a snack holder, and clips that hold drinks/bottles/etc. With this added attachement (which is only $17), the stroller becomes just as nice as the big ones, without all the unneccessary bulk.

product_title: Baby Trend Triplet Stroller in Navy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I am a mother of 9 month old triplets.  This stroller is beginning not to work for my babies.  First of all, there is no room in the basket to place even a diaper bag.  It is a very small area.  Secondly, the middle seat has little room to grow.  Thirdly, the seats are so close that the one in the back allows enough room for the baby to put his feet on the back of the seat in front.  The stroller is also very cumbersome to collapse and heavy to pick up.  It has worked okay up to now, but I think it is now time to invest in the Peg-Perego.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: I put this on our registry after reading some of the reviews.  We put our baby in it and she loved it.  The vibrating can get a little intense for her but she learned to kick her feet to make noises very easily.

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie - First Refill Included
review_headline: Twist and Twist This is Crap
review_body: I for one hate this thing. Your suppose to twist the diaper once you put it in there , it almost always comes on done. So instead of having sausages I have a big bag of diapers, its just point less. You better off with a old fashion trash can.

product_title: Kushies 5 Pack Reusable Ultra Diapers
review_body: no diapers seem to work for my baby toby! I have tried everything imaginible to the point where I was just about to give up on diapers for him, ya know? just let him go naked. Well I brought these home and they gave my baby toby these terrible rash's all over his face even though I didn't even put them on his face and I had rubbed plants all over his face to feed him...but ya know what I give UP!!!

product_title: Dreamscapes Soother
review_headline: I had to buy another Ocean Wonders Aquarium
review_body: My first child had the Ocean Wonders Aquarium and loved it. At 2 he still sleeps with it attached to his bed. When my daughter was born I decided to try the Dreamscapes Soothes. I have been very satisfied with Leap Frop products in the past. This toy ate up batteries every 1-2 weeks with minimal usuage. Knowing that my son still uses his Ocean Wonders soother now, I realized I would go broke on batteries over the next few years. At 4 months old I bought my daughter the Ocean Wonders Aquarium to use instead of the Dreascapes Soother. I don't think she really care which toy she has and I'd rather save some money on batteries.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Backpack - Navy
review_headline: If only the flap would stay closed
review_body: I registered for this because I thought it was much cooler looking than the others, and thought my husband would be more willing to carry it.  It looks great and holds a lot of stuff, but doesn't stay closed the way it should.  When the pack is full, the flap doesn't stay velcro'd down, and I have many times found myself walking around with the pack hanging wide open behind my back.  As soon as my daughter was big enough to sit up, she was going through the pack, pulling stuff out; I don't think that would have been as much of a problem with a zipped bag.  Also it would be helpful if the inside were divided into more pockets because stuff tends to get very disorganized.  There is a nice net pocket on the outside for drinks but only the skinniest bottles and cups fit into it; it needs to be enlarged.

product_title: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review_body: I bought this pump after careful review of all the electric pumps and despite some bad reviews decided to take a chance. And I really didn't want to spend $300 on the Pump In Style.  I originally had a $15 manual pump and was able to express 4-5oz within 10 minutes (not bad) but quickly got tired of having to do it myself. Anyway, I think this pump is great!  I don't understand some of the other reviews.  I don't think this pump hurts at all.  It doesn't suck nearly as hard as my little one yet I was able to get over 5oz in about 3 minutes!  Much easier than doing it manually.  And although the bottle isn't perfectly clear, I don't know how you can't see how much is in there!  I do wish the bottles were bigger to hold more than 5oz but that's not a big deal. My only issue is that the milk flows back thru the suction tube when I'm done which they say can cause damage.  To correct that problem, I disconnect the handle before releasing it from my breast.  That seems to do the trick.  All in all, I have to say that this is worth the money and does the job well!

product_title: Infantino Cozy Rider
review_body: I never figured out how to get my baby in and out of this carrier and I felt uncomfortable when he was in it.  The design is overly complex but I am sure there is some good use for thing...perhaps a modernistic hanging fern planter:)

product_title: Evenflo Titan 5 Convertible Car Seat - York
review_body: I just called Evenflo consumer line b/c my daughter is 1 and only weighs 17 lbs, so we will be rear-racing for the next few months. I could not get the straps to loosen enough in the rear-facing slots to even get one arm through. I called this morning and they said you can move the splitter plate to the toddler area, but keep the straps in the rear-facing slots. They have been doing testing on this and everything has come out safe.Just an FYI, as I know a lot of reviews mentioned this.

product_title: The First Years - Air-Flow Sleep Positioner
review_body: I received this as a shower gift.  Works wonders.  My son was 10 lbs 4 oz at birth.  At 3 months and 16 lbs, he still fits in it.  Was easy to wean from swaddling due to snugness of positioner.  Highly recommend.

product_title: Munchkin Mozart Magic Cube
review_headline: Fun?  Depends on who you ask. . . .
review_body: Buyer beware!  My 16-month-old received this toy as a gift from my mother-in-law and of course loved it - the one time my husband and I let him play with it.  What parent needs to lose his or her sanity over a toy? ...Whereas some musical toys have volume control or only play for few seconds, the Mozart Magic Cube blares at one solitary volume level and plays the ENTIRE sonata before it shuts off.  It's like the Energizer Bunny:  it keeps going and going and going and . . .  .... . . .  Heed my warning...buy a board book about musical instruments and a Baby Mozart tape instead.

product_title: Graco Mobile Entertainer Activity Center
review_body: my daughter loves this toy!  we bought it for her when she was 4-1/2 months old and she has loved it from the very beginning!  she was able to figure out how to move in it right away and loves being able to be upright!  we have a landing in our front door that is one-step below the floor in our family room and if she does go by there, rather than crashing down, the front wheels drop off and the toy just stops moving.  i will be watching as she gets older to make sure that continues but the toy also enables you to make it stationary if you aren't able to watch you child completely.

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_body: This mobile is wonderful, my son just loves it.  The colors are great and the music is stimulating.  There are a few draw backs though.  The music only has two volume settings, they are botrh loud, we have a blanket tied around the speaker so the music is softer.  Also you can't just have the mobile on without the music.  All and all I would buy this mobile again, it is wonderful, my son just giggles and smiles at it.

product_title: Especially for Baby Wipe Warmer with bonus Diaper Organizer
review_body: I think this is a fantastic product!  My daughter goes to work with me and I had to purchase one for there as well because she loves warm wipes!  Yes, the bottom few get a bit yellow, but you can still use them.  (to avoid yellow wipes you can rotate the wipes once in a while)

product_title: BABYBJÖRN Navy Carrier
review_headline: if you're serious about a baby carrier just go for the bjorn
review_body: Don't waste your time, effort, or money like I did trying to find the best carrier, this is it.  I wanted to use a sling but my son didn't like being swaddled to begin with so he didn't like a sling.  I started looking at regular carriers.  I couldn't see why there wouldn't be a less expensive carrier that would be just a good as the Baby Bjorn was suppsed to be.  So I tried an inexpensive Snugli which was uncomfortable.  Then I tried a more mid-priced Snugli which was ok, relatively comfortable and easy to use but it wasn't very trim and it wasn't easy to get my arms comfortably in front of the baby to do things like wash dishes.  So I bought a Your Loving Arms Carrier which was ok but still not great, I didn't like the way the support pillow pushed his arms out.  Then I tried a Theodore Bean which was terribly uncomfortable for me and I didn't like the way the adjustment clips were right by my baby's head, how could it be comfortable if he bumped his head in looking around or if he fell asleep?  So I finally broke down and spent the money on a Bjorn.  The moment I put it on and stood up with my baby I could feel the difference.  The weight is so well distributed it is by far the most comfortable carrier.  And it is so easy to use.  The instructions are even printed on the inside of the carrier in case you loose the paperwork.  I just wish I had figured this all out a lot sooner.  My baby is 4 months now and seems to love it but will soon outgrow this carrier.  It's so well made however that I'll keep this for the next one.  An added benefit, it's completely soft so that it can be compacted pretty well to fit in a diaper bag when traveling.  Don't be skeptical, yes it's pricey, but it is definitely the best carrier out there.

product_title: Fisher-Price Peek a Blocks Circus Fun
review_headline: Circus filled fun peek a blocks review
review_body: My daughter is 11 months old.  I was thrilled when she got all of the peek a blocks for the holidays but no one got her this circus themed one so I went to get it myself. I love it!  She loves it!  All of the blocks are interesting and fun filled but the circus blocks are the best, so colorful, and each has its own tiny surprise inside. The big top case is the best because the other blocks are in a plastic container having no where to put them and this holds them as a convenienent carrier, great purchase. She will surely enjoy these for years to come. She is teething now so they go in her mouth and I am so happy that there is nothing she can break or damage or swallow. They were made with our kids in mind, get them!

product_title: Medela Double Mini Electric Breastpump
review_body: I bought this pump after using an electric Medela pump in the hospital with my first baby. I thought since it was a \\"Medela\\" it would be a good investment and I didn't want to spend [a lot]on the Pump 'n Style breast pump. What a mistake!  This pump was horrible, it hurt and I could only pump 3 or 4 ounces  at a time not to mention it was so LOUD.  I really coudln't relax while using this pump because of the noise and discomfort. I ended up buying the Pump 'n Style and it was the best [money] I ever spent.  I am now expecting my second baby and look forward to using the Pump 'n Style.

product_title: Dr. Brown's 8 oz. Natural Flow Wide Neck Bottle
review_headline: No more gas and no more leaking!
review_body: We started with the Avent bottles... they leaked everywhere and the baby was screaming in pain, arching his back, etc from gas.  Within 2 days he was a different baby!  There are alot of pieces to wash, but it's well worth it.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love my diaper champ!  It takes regular trash bags rather than expensive refills.  It is also extremely simple to operate.  My only complaint is that after 15 months of use, mine does not hold the odor as well.  However, after contacting the company, they are sending me a new gasket & instructions on how to install it.  I highly recommend this item.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: This bouncer is just great; colorful, safe, big, and full of surprises. Lots of options for baby to start up lights and sounds; plays kid's songs too. Baby kicking sets some of them off, or you can turn on the switch. The light bar easily swings out so you can get baby in and out quickly. Safe, three point restraint, and on top of all of this, there is a vibration feature too. Three play items dangle from the light bar as well. You won't be sorry if you buy this item.

product_title: amy coe Blue Belle Woven Crib Sheet - Sonny
review_body: Go with the knit sheets instead. While this one is fully elastisized, it shrank after one washing (and low temp dryer). I have had no problems with the knit version.

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie Twist-Away Pail System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I used the diaper genie for my newborn and by the time she approached her first birthday the thin plastic hinges on the diaper genie lid were broken and cracked off and the sharp thin plastic pieces under the lid (used to cut the genie plastic when the pail is full) also cracked off.  The diaper genie does not completely take the stink away once your little one starts to eat solid foods (This includes the \\"toddler\\" diaper genie refills too).   Also,  I found the diaper genie refills to be expensive over the long run and most grocery stores carry a low inventory or are often out.  Myth: There exists a diaper system where the stink will be completely hidden.  Moms, Dads, don't let the expensive \\"diaper systems\\" fool you.  Save yourself some money.  Buy a regular diaper pail (I got one for $16) that uses cheap scented trash bags and change the diaper pail every night before your little one goes to sleep.  You'll both be happy you did so and you can use the money you saved to do something fun.

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 9oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: First of all I do not know why everyone is getting leakage from this bottle.  My baby was born 1/23/2004.  I bought 9-10 Avent bottles and 1 (4ounce) bottle from Babies R Us and some from Target.  And not once, and I repeat once did I experience ANY leaking.  The ONLY leaking I got is from my baby's mouth when he's full or when he spits out formula.  Yes, I also put it in my diaper bag and it doesnt leak.  Also, after I get it out from the Munchkin bottle warmer and shake it up even after tightening the ring I get NO leak!!!.. I guess some people do not know how to follow directions.. Also, my baby sleeps real good after feeding.. Don't have to burp him as much either... I can tell these bottles really do reduce colic in infants..  I had my 1st kid 6 years ago and used cheap bottles and bought them for the design and I had to change her formula 3 times because she was soooo gassyy with them.. and she didnt burp as much.. Maybe my 1st kid wasnt lactore intolerant kid maybe its the cheap bottles I bought, playtex, gerber etc.. I should have used these bottles with her and would not have the colicky, crying, fussy issue.. Sure they are pricey!! But what does price have to do with the care and comfort of you lil ones tummy?? Not bad for %5-6 bucks each per bottle.. Cheap bottles will cost you $2 less but you have to deal with the headache.. Also, Aven makes variable nipples for when they are ready to have cereal on their bottle.. It comes with slow, medium and fast flow.. Hey what else can you ask for?? Avent really made a difference with my baby.. Also, if you have the money to spend do buy the electric Avent sterilizer, I did.. And it was a life saver.. I give it a 5 star as well.. It's wash, plug and go.. So, hopefully my review helped you mothers out there that are reading other people bad feedback about these bottles... I guarantee you .. You will be satisfied you bought them...

product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_headline: Perfect for new Mothers and Premie babies
review_body: This is a "must have" item for newborns and new mothers!. While pregnant with my first baby I was very scare of the "first baby bath" experience, however, with the Safer Bather, my fears were gone!. My baby loves it, it keeps him comfortable and warm during the bath, so comfortable that he sleeps sometimes while I am bathing him!!. I use it in combination with the First Years Newborn to Toddler bathtub, the Safer Bather fits in it, by the way, I don't use the "hammok" that comes with the First Years bathtub because it is difficult to keep the baby warm. My "tip"- when I use it, I continously pour warm water over the top of the Safer Bather (part that is not "under water", where baby's head rest), to also keep the back of his head warm. I also used the Safer Bather for the first few days after the baby was born, when only sponge baths are recommended, it was perfect to use over my bed!.

product_title: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review_body: I was using "Peace of Mind" by The First Years!  After 6 months, I thought I might lose my mind!  I decided to just go out and buy new monitors.  I LOVE THIS MONITOR!  We love having dual receivers so we aren't constantly plugging and replugging.  I leave them on all day and night so I never have to worry about turning them on.  I can use the phone, microwave, dishwasher, and any other electronic, and they are not affected at all!  What a difference these monitors have made!  I was also pleasantly surprised to see that they are $20 less than the useless ones I bought to begin with!  Buy this monitor!  You will not be disappointed!

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body:
I know this tub is inexpensive, but it really isn't worth the money. I registered for this and started using it as soon as my daughter was old enough for a real bath. She kept sliding down in it, but I figured that was just because she was a newborn. However, with every new 'stage' there are problems. Here are some of the negatives:
1. As a newborn up until she was about 3 months old she slid down too far into the water. To keep her up I had to hold her bottom with one hand while washing her with the other.
2. Now at four months she's scratching her toes on the safety bar
3. The suctions cups are VERY difficult to remove, making it hard to fill and clean the tub
4. When we converted the seat into a sitting up position it was very difficult to get my daughter in and out of the seat without scratching her legs on the bar
It does put her in a nice reclining position as a four month old who can hold her head up and has better upper body control, but overall I would say don't waste your money.

product_title: Fisher-Price Baby Papasan (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We just brought our newborn son home yesterday and today is the first time he's using the Baby Papasan (actually right now).  He has jaundice so we have him in the Papasan in front of the window and he loves it.  The only thing I dont like is that he slips down because of the incline.

product_title: BABYBJÖRN Navy Carrier
review_body:
I absolutely love this product. I carry my 4-week old all over the house when I do laundry, wash dishes, etc. It's also wonderful for taking the baby outside for a walk. I get some fresh air and mild exercise and the baby gets a change of scenery too. It's ideal for going grocery shopping because the baby is close to me and strangers are less likely to touch him or get close to his face since he's right against my body. Also, I then have two hands free to push a shopping cart and deal with my wallet, etc. Awesome! I've also been able to breastfeed with my son in the Bjorn! I just unbuckled one side so he could lean to the side and he was able to eat and I could hold him with one arm while putting ornaments on our Christmas tree! What a valuable investment. I highly recommend this for anyone who wants to have their baby close, but also has things they need to get done during the day.

EDITED TO SAY that while I definitely loved my Bjorn, it turned out to be one of the factors in causing recurrent breast infections for me. I ended up having 7 infections with my first son. I changed to a Hotsling carrier instead when I had my 2nd baby, and have had ZERO infections! Our Bjorn still got a little use by my husband, but I can no longer use it.

product_title: ExerSaucer Mega Active Learning Center
review_body: I put my daughter in this when she was 21/2 months. She was getting bored with her other toys. I think that what it said on the box about strengthening the back is true, now she's 6 months and sits on her own. She's been sitting on her own since she was 5 months. She still loves the toy. She loves the car that plays music. When she gets a little fussy, she'll just push on the car and rock back and forth (dances) to the music. It took me about 30 min to put it together. The only problem I have is folding it down, but that's a good thing, because this way it won't fold on her while she's in it.

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: I love this tub! The hammock was great for both of my preemie twins. They are both almost 6 months old now and we just took out the hammock so they can splash a little bit more. Of course we have to be that much more attentive since it was easy to rely on the hammock keeping them up out of the water (although we never left their side). Now they slide down a lot easier and we have to keep pushing their bums onto the little seat but they love the freedom. The plug is nice too since it is heat sensitive so we don't make the water too hot. We give them a bath every night as part of their bedtime routine and I am so glad that this is the tub that we have!!!

product_title: Eddie Bauer Booster Car Seat, Tan  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I've had this car seat for a few months and we love it. I like how I can put it back and baby can sleep.

product_title: Fisher-Price: Aquarium Take-Along Swing
review_body: I got this swing at a baby shower before my daughter, Sophie, was born.  I registered for this because I thought it would take the place of a bouncy seat and a swing.  This swing does not vibrate, which I assumed it did.  I was thinking of returning it once I realized that, but decided to try it out first instead.  My daughter has loved this all along.  She is able to look around and kick her legs and is reclined enough so her head didn't flop about.  She is 3 months old now, and hasn't really begun playing with the hanging fish yet or really noticed the lights, although she really enjoys looking at the orange one.  She loves the music, it is the same as on the Ocean Wonders Aquarium crib toy.  I assembled this all by myself when I was 38 weeks pregant and it is very simple to fold up and pack when needed.  All in all I ABSOLUTELY recommend this to amazon.com viewers and to all my friends.  I have read other people's reviews on this item about how they dislike it because it was so low to the ground, I have had no problem at all with this. As for the dog being close to her, yeah he is but if I was worried that the dog might cause harm I would have gotten rid of the dog before my daughter was born.  I do keep my eyes on her and the dog to make sure he doesn't lick her and get in her face, but i do not at all regret getting this swing.  I LOVE IT

product_title: Sure N Secure Dbl Bedrail
review_body: I like the convenience and security of this double bed rail, which was the only one I could find. However, I have had 2 of these already in 3 months of my son using it and the material at the bottom of the rail where it meets the bed has ripped twice. The material around the mesh area is very thin and flimsy. I have a 32 lb toddler and I'm sure kids heavier than this are using this product.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Natural Flow Bottle Starter Kit (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I started reading reviews of Dr. Brown's online and found the information very interesting.  I saw nothing but wonderful things written so I opted to use this system when we introduced a bottle after the first few weeks of breastfeeding.  My family was skeptical, saying they had never heard of it and thought I was crazy for wanting to use it.  But I stuck to my guns and registered for these bottles.  I absolutely love using them.  I have yet to have a problem with gas or spitup when I use them.  I can tell my son is more \\"burpy\\" and spitty when I occasionally have to use a different off-brand bottle when all other bottles are dirty.  I spoke with a Lactation Consultant about introducing the bottle and when I told her that I was using Dr. Brown's, she was thrilled!  She said she would never recommend any other system, especially for those mothers who were going to breastfeed and use a bottle.  That, along with continued success with my son liking the bottles, is enough to know that I'm glad I stuck to my guns!  Great buy!

product_title: Odorless Diaper Pail by Safety 1st
review_body: My husband and I bought this because, as new parents, we wanted to save money on baby equipment.  As many of the other reviews have stated, the low price and the fact that you can use regular trash bags in this is a big draw.  Please, do not get sucked into getting this pail.  In fact, if you really want to save money, don't get a diaper pail at all.  Manufacturers of baby products make you think you need diaper pails, just as they make you think you need changing tables and diaper wipe warmers!  Use a plain plastic grocery bag, hang it on the door knob to your baby's room, and put diapers in it.  When it gets full(or too stinky!), simply take it to the big garbage can outside.  This diaper pail made my son's room smell horrible.  As soon as I went to go upstairs, I could smell the stink coming from his room.  I sprayed the pail with Lysol almost every day and washed it in hot, soapy water weekly, and it still didn't help.  Save your money!!

product_title: NoJo Baby Cover-Up- Blue Plaid
review_headline: Why didn't I think of this?????
review_body: My daughter was born in July, and as the weather here in Virginia started to get cooler, getting a jacket on her without screaming was impossible!  I saw this in the store yesterday and tried it on the carseat.  She LOVED it!!  She smiled at me through the opening and giggled when I zipped it shut!  That was enough to convince me!  No more tears - hallelujah!  The opening is perfect for her face, but even if she were younger, it is easily adjustable - just pull up or down.  We don't even have to take it off the carseat when we attach it to the stroller.  I sure wish I had thought of this.  (SMILE)

product_title: Safety 1st Space Saver Fold-Up Bath Tub
review_headline: Good for Newborns - forget it after 12 lbs!
review_body: I bought this tub, because I liked the fact that it folds and stores easily.  It was great when my baby was a newborn, but now that he is almost 14 lbs - forget it!  He bangs his head on the hinges and I always have to put a towel there so he won't hurt himself.  The water leaks at the hinges, so you end up putting way too little water in it to avoid leaking.  My baby loves to splash about and this is really not possible in this tub.  I am now looking for something else!

product_title: Stork Craft Aspen Changing Table with Drawer
review_body: Before having my baby my mom had convinced me to purchase a changing table for downstairs.  It came very quickly and was easy to put together.  My daughter is now 7 months old and I have used this more times than I can count.  It has been wonderful.  Have a place to "hide" certain items is also great keeping my living room looking tidy.  My only complaint is I have only been able to find 1 cover to fit.

product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_body:
I absolutly love the Safer Bather! Everytime I give my, now 2 month baby a bath using it, I remember that I want to rate it on Amazon so that others know what a great product it is! So here I am...With my first baby I had one of those big plastic baths, it was hard, bulky and certanly did not look like my baby was comfortable in it. I dreaded bath time and ended up just taking him in the shower with us.
The Safer Bather is soft, comfortable, ans so easy to use. Drop it in a warm bath, and it soakes up the warm water. Your baby is surrounded by warm water, and comfy as can be. Alexis loves taking baths with her 5 year old brother. Her head is lifted up just enough with pillow cushion to keep her mouth out of the water. It is so easy to store and put away. Just pick it up and all of the water comes pouring out of it, hang it on it's hook in the bathtub and within a couple hours it is totally dry. No worries about mildew etc.. LOVE IT!!

product_title: The First Years Hands Free Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This gate has been absolutely wonderful in keeping our son safe.  It's easy to install and use, and we've had no complaints about it at all.

product_title: Evenflo Car Seat Base
review_headline: Dont' buy it!  Evenflo has the worst infant seats.
review_body:
I had an evenflo infant seat with my first child and decided to purchase another when my daughter was born four months ago. That turned out to be the one of the worst purchasing decisions that I have ever made. Everytime we put the seat into the base, it takes five minutes of fighting with it to get the seat back out. The base does not release the seat in the proper manner and we have to keep pushing the seat back down and trying to release it again. We had to remove my daughter from the seat to avoid rattling her brain while we fought to get the seat out.

Not only is the base awful, but so it the car seat. The final straw was the other evening when the handle released and my daughter fell out of the car seat. I realize that she should have been strapped in, but I guess my mother in law did not realize that. Regardless, I trusted the seat to be safe and it is not. When I called the manufacturers, I was not pleased with their policy in handling the matter.

If you want to feel confident that you are putting your child in a safe seat that is easy to use, buy a different brand. I would definatly not recommend Evenflo seats to anyone.

product_title: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review_body: This device provided hours upon hours of entertainment for our daughter! It is very well made & something we couldn't have lived without! We highly recommend it!

product_title: Sassy 836 - Fascination Station (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Well, despite the fact that this toy has one a few national awards, it was a total flop in our house.  The suction cup is completly non-functional (it sticks for maybe 10 seconds before popping off whatever surface you stick it to, even after wetting the bottom) and the rattle is too heavy for most babies.  By the time they are big enough to hold the rattle, they are too old for it.  It is a pretty cool looking toy, and has a great design, I just wish it worked like it is supposed to.  My daughter did have some fun batting at it as I held the black and white "handle" (the part that sticks in the base). A much better toy is made by Early Years (or maybe The First Years - I can't remember) - it has a suction cup that actually works and a spinning disk with a clicking knob, clear plastic ball with mirror inside that spins, and a squeaker.  We have attached this to our infant swing tray, highchair, and table, and it stays put until we (or our 17 month old) pry it off.  I found it at Babies R Us (looked but didn't see it at amazon).

product_title: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing - Nature's Touch N1973 (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: One of the best things I registered for!
review_body:
I researched a ton of different baby swings and I am so glad I choose this one! My daughter loves it! The comfort it provides and the swinging motion rocks her to sleep with ease. Because my daughter is only 2 weeks old, I love that the motion swings from side to side. I use the head pillow (comes with the swing) to prop her head up and she enjoys the motion of swinging from side to side. When she gets more head and neck control, I love that I can adjust the swing to swing from back to front. The different sounds and music, as well as the entertainment of the bird mobile with the mirror are great as well.
One thing to note: This swing can swing quite fast for a newborn ... the more your child weighs, the better adjusted the swing becomes. I have found if I drap a blanket over my daughter's lap and allow the blanket to touch the floor, the swings slows down to a more appropriate pace for newborns. But I do not consider this a flaw, thus FIVE stars for this swing. My daughter and I both love it!

product_title: Philips AVENT Newborn Starter Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
I love these bottles. I used them for 15 months with my daughter and never had any problems. Not even one leak. A friend who used them showed me how to put the cap on before my daughter was born. She said to twist the cap just until you feel it catch. Perfect. In the beginning we'd turn the bottle over to make sure there were no leaks, which there never were. I passed this advice on to 3 other friends of mine who were planning to use the Avent bottles. They never had leaks either.

These bottles are great for controling gas. Plus, they're really easy to hold and wash due to their size. Also, the nipples hold up wonderfully.

We're expecting baby #2 any day now and we'll be using these bottles again.

LOVE THEM

product_title: Evenflo Portable Ultrasaucer
review_body: I recently purchased this item for my four month old daughter.  Although she is still a little young (can't sit up by herself) for the item she really enjoys the bright colors and all the different sounds it makes...from beads inside a turning ball to a rattle to songs and much more.  The flag and frog have become great items for her to chew on.  I brought her to the store with me and let her try out all the options and she seemed to like this one the best.  I feel the ultra saucers's toys are a lot closer, so she can play easily, compared to the others where they were either to low or just too far away.  There is a variety of toys, with shapes, texture and color...not only is it fun but educational also.  the only thing I would add, that I noticed on all others, would be beads on a line that she could move from side to side.  Overall,I would definetly recommend it to anyone.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: But this is not a fault of the product!  Babies make alot of dirty diapers.  I like it very much--the fact that you use your own trash bags is helpful.  I do not smell any odor in the nursery.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: The diaper champ is wonderful!  It uses kitchen trash bags which are cheaper than refills for the diaper genie and it keeps odor contained extremely well!  We plan to buy another diaper champ for our second child!

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: We also bought this before our son was born who is now 5months old. I liked that it had the sling for when he was littler, we used it till about 2-1/2 months. It worked great supporting him. Its very slip resistant and I like that it has a built in water temperature gauge (even though what it says is a safe temp, seems quite chilly when I test it) and a spot for the shampoo and whatever else we need during bath time so it's all just right there. Our son loves to splash in the water. He's loved the bath since his first try at 5-days old. I highly recommend it!

product_title: Recalled Item: Wizard Convertible Car Seat with LATCH in Midnight
review_body: I personally feel this product is the just the right one for babies.I like the color of the car seat and my baby likes it!!!!

product_title: Tiny Love Take Along Arch -Tropical
review_headline: Not for the Peg Perego Venezia
review_body: I bought this stroller arch because it seemed like it would be excellent entertainment for my baby.  However, the arch did not fit appropriately on the sides of my Peg Perego Venezia stroller or my Peg Perego Primo Viaggio car seat.  There is a great deal of cushioning on my stroller and car seat, and the sides where the arch should attach seem to be much wider than other strollers. Unfortunately, the stroller arch clips could not fit around the cushioning or sides.  Kind of disappointed that I have to make another trip to BRU to return it.

product_title: Baby Bjorn Toilet Trainer - White and Blue
review_body: I highly recommend this toilet seat. After a few weeks of using a plastic potty chair with a slide-out tray, I got tired of cleaning the thing. It seemed too small for my son (2 yrs. 4 months), and it frequently leaked. This product is very adjustable, so it fits on top of our oblong toilet snugly and securely. The one-piece design makes it easy to clean, and the front is well-designed to keep everything in the bowl where it belongs. It's nicely contoured, which makes it comfy for little bottoms. I think the plastic potty chairs are useful for a short time, but once your child is comfortable with the idea of using a potty or toilet in general, they should graduate to this product. Well worth the price.

product_title: Odorless Diaper Pail by Safety 1st
review_body: I had this bought for me as a present with a set mind of not wanting any sort of diaper pail. I had heard nothing but bad things about the diaper genie and I knew if I got one of those I'd return it, but I figured I'd give this one a try. So far I have been very happy with it. I love the fact you can just use regular garbage bags for it. It's very easy to put the bags in and take out. I have yet to smell any odors from it. The only reason I gave it 4 stars was because it seems to fill up a little bit faster then I had hoped, but it's not bad.

product_title: Dr. Brown's 8 oz. Natural Flow Wide Neck Bottle
review_body: My son is now 5 months old.  We started off with the Avent bottles at birth, but at 2 weeks old we discovered he had a severe case of acid reflux and colic.  So, in a effort to find anything that would help the problem we switched to Dr. Brown's bottles.  These bottles have been a life saver for us.  I have also used the standard Dr. Brown's bottle and never had a problem.  We had to put cereal and various medicines in my son's bottle at an early age so the wide neck made it much easier to add the much needed items.  I currently own about 15-20 of these bottles and I have never had a problem with leaking or with the nipples collapsing.  They have been wonderful!  Well worth the money and the added effort to clean!

product_title: Snugli Front and Backpack - Carrier (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: After the Baby Bjorn... this is IT!!!
review_body: This is an awesome Backpack for my 9 month-old son. He loves it as much as I do. We always used the Baby Bjorn, but once he hit about 18 lbs, he was too much for me to carry on the front. I wanted something on the back, but I did not like the bulk of the hiking backpacks. I saw this and was skeptical at first because of how inexpensive it was, but thought I would give it a try. We tried it around the house for the first time, and we both loved it! When the stress of him getting into everything is getting to much, I just but him in the backpack and it's perfect! I can cook dinner, fold laundry, you name it! It's also awesome for shopping, grocery or retail. In some stores you feel too cramped with a stroller, but this backpack does not add any extra bulk other than your baby on your back. I would definitely recommend this carrier to anyone looking for something after the Baby Bjorn.

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: I got this bathtub as a gift and I love how I can give my little baby girl a bath in the kitchen. This tub fits perfectly in my double sink. She is right at perfect height. My only complaint is the green back really doesn't prevent baby from sliding, I have to place a small hand towel behind her back for every bath, or else she is sliding all over.

product_title: Safety 1st Secure Lock Bed Rail
review_body: I read many bad reviews of this product, but the local stores had no other options, so I bought it.  This bedrail has worked great - I put it together fast and it feels very secure on my son's bed.  It feels great to have no worries about him falling out of bed!  I also like the design of this bedrail and I find it very functional.

product_title: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Chesapeake
review_headline: I WOULD GIVE IT 10 STARS IF I COULD!!!
review_body: I love this seat. I bought it to match the Aria stroller (also a wonderful Peg product!). My daughter has not had any problems with it being too small and she is almost four months old and far from out growing it . Also, it is not any heavier than her Graco car seat. As for the sun shade I am not sure what the problem is. Ours blocks the sun as well as any car seat! Granted this car seat is almost twice the price of the others but you get what you pay for. Have you felt the padding in some of the others? This car seat is the best in the market... trust me I did my research.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Ultimate Wipes Warmer --the only anti-microbial warmers
review_body: I received this wipes warmer as a shower gift for my second child and I really wish I would of had it for my first! I use the Huggies Newborn wipes and I have never had even one of them dry out. I don't bother with the pop up feature, it's just as easy and fast to open the lid every time you use it and no pop up wipe compares to the Huggies Newborn. I pour hot tap water on the pad once a week and I've never had a brown or dry wipe (I've used it for 6 months straight) even when I've forgotten to wet the pad, only the pad got dry, not the wipes (not even the very last one). Although this is definately not a nursery necessity, it is very much appreciated by my little one who just smiles at every diaper change instead of screaming like my first child!

product_title: Sunshine Kids Mighty Tite (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: There are some things you might want to take into consideration when deciding whether or not to purchase this product.  You may want to try one in your vehicle since there is some truth to the fact that it doesn't fit well in all vehicles.  Also, it can be slightly troublesome to remove until you are used to removing it.  Those are the only negatives that can be applied to this product.  Just like anything in life, you must use good judgment and common sense when using it.  Familiarize yourself with it before using it.  Don't over-tighten it.  Make sure you are comfortable installing and removing it before you make any drastic decisions.  This is a well built item with a minimal amount of working components that could fail.  I would bet my life on this product if I had to and feel confident that if I were in a crash my children would be safe.  This is especially true for vehicles that are not the usual ones you put your car seat into.  Every vehicle is different, especially older makes and models.  This product has proven itself to my family and in my book, should be considered a mandatory item when purchasing any car seat.

product_title: Brainy Baby Storybook Shapes
review_body: I like the whole left brain/right brain approach to this line of toys, so I bought this one for the left, and the Music Maker for the right.  This one can teach colors, shapes, and numbers all in one toy.  Plus, it's a book, so it encourages reading.  The only flaws I see so far are that the light-up sun gets covered more with each page turn, and that the \\"narration\\" doesn't go in page order.  However, this might actually be a good thing, since it would test the child on focusing on the shapes themselves, rather than just memorizing the sequence.  Also, if you are going to read the actual printed text to your baby, turn the sound off -- otherwise it will \\"talk\\" over your reading.

product_title: Contoured Changing Pad
review_body: I purchased a changing table for our first child that came with it's own pad. After our second child was born, I decided to buy this one. It is filled with comfort. The contoured sides are a nice extra. The original pad that the table came with, was super thin and had no cover. This pad allows for covers to be bought for it. That is something that comes in handy when our little one is fresh out of the bath, and getting dressed. It keeps his bare skin off the cold plastic pad. A welcome addition to any nursery.

product_title: Rite Temp Baby Bath Shower
review_body: I'm on my third hand-held baby shower.  I returned the first two because they quit working after the second or third use.  When it does work it is nice because the spray comes out just hard enough to rinse of my baby, but not too hard.  The other thing I'm not crazy about is it is very hard to hold on to and push the button, and the button occasionally sticks.  If this one breaks, I'm done.  I'll use a cup to rinse my baby from now on.

product_title: Fisher-Price Stride to Ride Walker
review_body: I bought this for my 10 month old son who was starting to stand and walk while holding onto the furniture.  Within the 2 weeks since I bought this item, he has started to walk around the house and even drops the balls into the basket while standing behind it.  This was a great investment for him and for us.

product_title: Philips AVENT Isis Manual Breast Pump (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I used this pump with both of my daughters.  When my first daughter was 5 weeks old, I went back to work.  I worked three 10-hour days, so I had to pump quite a bit!  There was no room with outlets for me to pump in, so I had to have a manual one.  This one was wonderful!  It was comfortable, easy to use, easy to clean, and small and discreet.  I gave it away thinking we were done having kids, but surprise, I'm back to buy one for baby #3!  This is such a bargain, and I woulnd't think of buying anything else!

product_title: Lamaze Octotunes (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Buzz by Lamaze is #1... Octotune is #2 - this has been very entertaining for my son. His eyes light up when I grab it and start playing a song on the tentacles. It does take some time to learn the songs yourself to play to your baby but it's so worth the smiles and giggles! I've had this since he was 3 months old and it's been a hit with him and his little buddies (all range in age from 4 to 16 months). Just recently he (9 months old now) made one of the tentacles "squeak" when he got so excited and hugged it hard. This is a great buy!

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini Super Deluxe Lights & Music Play Mat
review_body: My son almost choked on the pink plastic from the bottom of the elephant's stomache. If my father didn't see it in his mouth, he would have choked. So make sure to either get rid of that piece, or supervise when child is playing with the elephant.

product_title: Fisher-Price Step & Play Piano
review_headline: Better for a child over 7-8 months old
review_body: My 7 month old daughter is just now growing into this. Before now she was not able to reach and touch any of the activity items on it because her arms were not long enough.  Keep in mind that this does not allow your child to bounce. I would have preferred an Exersaucer if I could do it over again. I am sure she will enjoy this one more as she grows and can move the seat forward and back and turn on her own and realizes that the movement of her feet makes the piano sounds. Right now she's oblivious.

product_title: Eddie Bauer - Infant Car Seat with LATCH - Gridlock Charcoal
review_body: ... I just bought this carseat last night ,using my own judgement I loved the size of it. The smaller narrower carseats are bound to be lighter but not knowing how big my new baby will be bigger is always better. I lifted 4 other ones in [local store] and they all felt about the same weight to me and couldnt compare in style. As for a baby sweating in the chair it is summer and very hot any car seat will be hot for the baby if he/she is sitting in long enough without air conditioning. Use a soft cotton blanket underneith your baby and you will get the same result. ...  And I find that a 1yr old is enough weight alone why carry  in any of these chairs seems a lil dangerous to me. ......

product_title: Eddie Bauer Booster Car Seat, Tan  (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Don't buy this with the idea for rear facing use unless your car is LATCH equipped because it won't work! This was bought for a gift for us and it does not work in our car and we can not return it to Target because we &quot;don't have the box&quot;. We can not afford a new car seat and are stuck with our 6 month old son unsafely riding in this until we can afford one or he turns a year. If you buy something from Target make sure you hang on to the box because with the receipt or not, they won't take it without the box.

product_title: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review_body: When I went to the store and saw this monitor, I had remembered buying it for a friend as part of her baby shower gift a few months back. I even recall asking her, after she had her son, if it worked good and she said that yes, it worked just fine. So, I thought, &quot;It's not expensive, it lights up, and it works great. Cool.&quot; So I bought it for myself. When I brought it home and set it up while my 7 month old daughter was sleeping last night, I was surprised that I could hardly hear her breathing over the constant &quot;ZZZZZZZZZZ&quot; sound coming over the monitor. I've tried both channels and have even tried setting it up in different places, but the interference is here to stay. On the box it says that this product has &quot;Crystal Clear Reception&quot;, but I have found that to be very untrue. So now I have to go back to the store and return it. Thank God I kept the receipt.

product_title: Sassy Busy Bugs Bar (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son hated sitting in the stroller until I got this toy bar. It's really helped. He can't reach it yet because he is still too small, but he kicks it and plays with the butterfly, which is attached by a string.

product_title: DO NOT USE-Universal Infant Carseat Carrier
review_body: This felt much smoother and more solid than the other one out there (the Snap-n-Go, I believe).  Also much easier to fold and the parent tray is great.  Great, easy, lightweight.

product_title: Vintage Teaberry 4 Piece Crib Set
review_body: I bought this in a Houston BRU.  The colors are sweet, rather than babyish.  The fabrics are decorator quality.  The skirt and blanket are crushed velvet sage green (leaning towards olive)and so soft.  The gorgeous vintage bumper is in a decorator weight woven cotton.  The pink eyelet trim on the bumper is so sweet, it is not a washed out pale pink but a richer pink with some possible apricot watermelon undertones.  The sheets are sweet and simple in a creme color with pink stripes.  I can't wait to see/ buy the mobile, it is to be released soon (March 1st maybe)!

product_title: Fisher-Price: Aquarium Take-Along Swing
review_headline: I think this is an awesome swing
review_body: My daughter is 5 1/2 months old, being a preemie she can fit into this swing she is only about 12 lbs now. We just got this swing for her and gave are old one to a friend. Our old swing was a full size swing by Graco. My daughter likes this swing much better. The lights, music and toys plus the more gentle rocking motion are more stimulating to her then just the clicking and rocking from the old swing. This swing is very silent , well the actual rocking is quiet of course there is a setting which plays music but there is a volume control. The swing takes up a lot less space, it is east to travel with and as was said in the reviews prior the only complaint about that I would have is there does need to be a Velcro strap or something so that the seat stays up while in the travel position, but regardless it is not hard to Cary, that would just make it easier. I had a lot of second thoughts about this swing from reading the conflicting reviews about baby's heads getting stuck and such but as I look at the swing right now while my baby is in it, unless you put a baby in it who is very active and may try to climb out there isn't any way on her own she could get her head stuck. Also I think I noted a 20 lb weight restriction on the swing so if you put a bigger baby in the swing it could eat up batteries faster then most. The batteries this swing uses are smaller then most full size swings so it will use more, also you should take into consideration that the swing has lights and music where most don't so this alone with the rocking will use more energy from the batteries. My over all rating for this product will be 4 stars only because one of the lights and music switch positions, the one furthest to the right doesn't work right, I'm not to sure what exactly it is supposed to do but it is basically just like turning the lights and music off. That switch option has a picture a smiling baby face. I don't have the manual now so that one I am not to sure of. On one more note there was a review where the music and lights would not work unless the swing was turned on, mine work with or without the use of each other. The swing can either be on or off and both the lights and music will still play so I think that was a problem with that particular swing. I hope this review was helpful since there are so many conflicting reviews on this product.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body: We have been using this tub since our son's first bath- he is now 6 months old.  We love everything about it- and so does he. He loves bathtime and has plenty of room to splash around and get mommy wet!  We recently traveled to see my parents and borrowed a "regular" infant tub from a friend while we were there.  We didn't even finish one complete bath with it because it was so awkward and my son (4.5 months old at the time)seemed uncomfortable.  After being spoiled with this great tub, I don't know how anyone uses those other things! We are looking forward to changing to the sitting up position soon - I'm sure my son will love that too- as there will still be lots of room for spashing and playing.  Get this tub- it's the best!

product_title: Evenflo Portable Ultrasaucer
review_body: This ultrasaucer is the best baby item we own. My husband and I don't know what we would do without it. Our baby boy absolutely loves it. We first started putting him in when he could hold his head up. He was a little small for the seat so we would put blankets in front and behind him so he wouldn't flop around. It was amazing to watch him study each toy then learn how to use it. He has mastered everything on it. It helps build his strength in his legs and back. He loves to spin around in the seat and bounce up and down. Everyone loves watching him play in it. We take it everywhere we go. It is so cute with all of the medieval times themed toys, we call it \\"The Royal Playground\\". We recommend this to all new parents.

product_title: The First Years - Crib CD Player (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: When I became pregnant with my second child I was so excited to see a crib cd player!  I wouldn't have to find a place to put it on a shelf or find one that 'matched' (impossible!).  BUT....this thing goes through BATTERIES soooooo fast!  It is definitely not worth the price unless it has a plug attachment as well as the battery option for travel.  It is so frustrating!  Oh, and this was my second one...the first broke within a day.

product_title: BABYBJORN Baby Carrier Active - Blue/Silver (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love this carrier.  It has the lumbar support and is very easy to adjust from one user to the next.  The clips are easy to open and close and our baby is very comfortable in it.  Long walks are a bit tiring on the shoulders for me, but that is to be expected with any carrier.  However, my husband does not have the same sore shoulders that I get.  I would recommend this carrier to all parents.

product_title: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review_body: Despite good reviews, we had nothing but trouble with this monitor. Lots of static and feedback. We bought a Graco monitor instead and we have zero feedback, we just hear the baby.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Diaper Depot Clear
review_body: I think this prodict is wonderful because it saves time with everything right there at hand and gives you an easy reach for all essentials needed for changing a baby's diaper.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body: Do not waste your money on this tub.When she was a newborn this tub had that annoying hump in the way. Now she is able to sit in it and that humb pokes her in the back. The toy is useless and you have to be really careful because the baby can get hurt on that green part when your taking her out.

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_headline: Wish my first child had this!
review_body: When I had my first child, I bought the mobile that match her crib set like most people.  It was a wind-up mobile and ended up being a waste of money because she never paid any attention to it.  So four years later, I have a three month old and decided to try this mobile.  It is the GREATEST!  The colors and animals really capture my daughter's attention and the music is wonderful.  The music lasts long after she falls asleep and in the morning I find her in her crib "talking" to the cute animals.  We have other crib toys but this mobile is the only thing she enjoys.

product_title: Tiny Love Trio - Monkey
review_body: My 4 month old loves these toys!  She loves to pull the monkey legs and put the feet in her mouth.  She loves to chew on the elephant trunk.  However, I think the trunk is way too long, she chokes on it!!

product_title: Safety 1st On-the-Go Fold-Up Booster Seat
review_body: This chair is a LOSER. The storage compartment door falls open and has room for nothing more than a small bib. The straps come loose and are very diffucult to adjust and clean. Food gets stuck in the crevices and the chair does not come apart so you can clean it(reminds me of the Prima Papa Highchair which also has too many crevices for food to get stuck in). The tray was tight against my son's stomach at 1 year old and he is a little fella. The hooks to detach the tray from the seat are made of soft plastic so they bend and break...the tray also gets stained easily from spaghetti sauce and fruit...very porous, cheap plastic. It is heavy and cumbersome, has no shoulder strap and I would never take it out of the house. The only good thing about this seat is that the tray is useful if you turn it upside down on the floor and put snacks on it.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: we are very pleased with this bouncy seat!  I love the fact that the activity bar is optional and our daughter loves being able to look out and see the room.  It was definitely a great investment!

product_title: Safety 1st Crystal Clear Baby Monitor, White
review_body: This monitor really is crystal clear. We went through 3 other monitors before finding this one. No noise except baby. We have been using this monitor for 4 years and it still works great.

product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_headline: If you have long hair--rethink this item
review_body:
The bath pillow is great, I have no complaints about the product--BUT for mothers who are going to breastfeed, think about what is going to happend to your hair for the next few months. For mothers who have longer hair, think about what happends to all your hair when you take a shower. I have medium/long, thick brown hair and breastfeeding; everytime I take a shower, I lose alot of hair. It is everywhere!
With this tub, everyday I have to clean my tub out before I give him a bath. I have decide to get a single tub for my son---free from my hair.

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We got this and the Diaper Decor Plus as gifts and I have to say that the Champ is not my favorite. I like that you can use your own garbage bags with the Champ, but that's the only positive in my opinion. I find it pretty hard to open it without breaking a nail and it does get fill up much more quickly than the Decor. When you're changing the bags on the champ, it can be messy, depending on how long you waited to change the bag, but with the Decor, you just open the front door and knot the bag even if it's full to the brim--so much easier. I also like the Decor because you can dispose of the diaper with your foot, instead of a hand like with the Champ, because now that my son is super squirmy on the changing table, I need of my hands on him!

product_title: Playtex VentAire Advanced Standard Bottle Gift Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Answers for the bad reviews..LOVE these bottles
review_body: These bottles do have extra parts but it only takes a few seconds to put together, and because the bottoms come off they are easy to clean. I know these bottles take a few extra seconds to put together so I don't wait until my child is ready to eat, I have them ready to go before she is screaming for food. They don't leak if you make sure the vent seal is in the bottom of the bottle good, and put together when the bottle/vent is dry. I have had to make sure the nipple is in tight a couple of times or nothing came out. BUT the main fix for not getting milk fast enough is (like many reviews I was about to give up on these bottles) not letting your baby take the nipple to the base of the bottle. If their lips stay around the nipple where it starts to get bigger the milk flows fine...or at least that has fixed the problem for my baby and a friend of mine..and she had never had problems with leaks..we both own about 10 to 15 bottles each. My baby has never got to much air and she is a gulper!! You can see the air bubbles pop because of the vent when ever she takes a break and air/milk goes back in the bottle. I breast feed as well, I switch back and forth since week 4 with no problem. It did take a few times for her to get it. With  Advent she liked the nipple but the flow was way way way to fast even at stage one. So I have stuck with these.    As far as not being able to use bottle warmers, microwaves, or steamers. That is the only thing I did not like. Not suppose to use a microwave to begin with because of hot spots. I use my steamer with the bottles and put the nipples and vents in the microwave to boil them faster than in a pan. To warm the milk I put water in a cup, microwave the water for about a min  place the bottle without the nipple in the water for 2 to 3 min and you have a warm bottle just as quick as a warmer and it's not that much more work.     Worth a few extra seconds of putting together and warming to keep air out of my baby's belly! Hopes this helps

product_title: Eddie Bauer® High-Back Booster
review_body: My mother in law wanted a seat in her car for my son and she saw this one on sale at a department store.  I was leery since I didn't get to research it first, but it's an ok car seat.  I figured that all seats are safety tested and I'm sure Eddie Bauer wouldn't put their name on a POS.  Problem #1: VERY hard to get straps to tighten down as far as they should - my car seat has a ratcheting system that works 100% better.  Problem #2: hard to get the vehicle's seat belt tightened down as well..had to literally sit in the booster seat, and still had a problem!  Really need 2 people to install.  Problem #3: Cup holder only fits on one side of seat, so if you can't use it on the child's left side, it's a pointless piece of plastic.  I know my son won't be in this seat very often which is good - I wouldn't buy one of these for every day use.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body:
Our son loved this from the minute we placed him into it as an infant. When rocking wouldn't help sooth him, he would relax immediately with the vibration of the seat. As he got older he LOVED the toys that he could bat with his hand or kick. The music and lights made him smile & laugh. He's now 6 months and sitting up so we can no longer use it. The seat also travels very well. We drove 10 hours to visit Nana and placed the bouncie in our trunk and took it with us.

The only cons are the music can become wearisome after a while and the seat could use a litle more padding for comfort.

product_title: Fisher-Price Healthy Care Deluxe Booster Seat, Blue/Green/Gray
review_headline: I would never have bought a High Chair if I knew how Great this was.
review_body:
Had I known that this booster seat was this easy I would never have registered for a high chair. Not only is it great for a family on the go, I use it at home as my primary so that our 7 month old can sit at the table with us for meal times, I can only imagine that it will help him have better table manners when he is older.

I am going to buy another one so that grammy can have one at her house for all of the grandchildren when they visit.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body: The EurBbath is the only bathtub that I would recommend for a baby! We tried 3 other tubs, and our son just didn't fit in them right, and he always seemed cold because he wasn't sitting in much water. With the EuroBath he is held in place so our hands are free, and he also has enough water to cover the majority of his body. He seems more comfortable, and so are we!

product_title: Evenflo SecureRight LATCH Kit (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: There's nothing to this product - it's just a belt made of the same kind of webing as your seat belts. It clips into the LATCH anchors of your LATCH-compatible vehicle, you pull to tighten and voila, you child's seat is as secure as ever with less effort than using the seat belts. Give a good tug on the belt and the seat will hardly budge when you try to move it. Evenflo doesn't support this item for other manufacturers seats, but it works with any seat that accepts a lap belt. Removing the seat isn't as easy as I had hoped, but it's still easier than the regular seat belt. I leave the strap threaded through the child seat so that I can re-install it quickly. Simple and nice.

product_title: Tike Tech Double T Stroller - Blue
review_body: We're not really into jogging, but needed a stroller that could handle gravel or dirt paths, since most of the parks and recreational places in our area don't have paved paths. I really like the large storage area under the seats and it even has pockets behind each seat. The handle bar is comfortable to grip and the stroller rides very smoothly. The stroller also fits very nicely, once it's folded up, into the back of our Ford Escape. Also, it's very easy to fold up and easy to load. We are very happy with this stroller.

product_title: Especially for Baby Bottle Warmer
review_body:
Bottle warmers are items you can do without. Using a cup of warm water works just as well. For all the new parents out there just save your money for the diapers you will REALLY need!
This was adequate nothing to rave about.

product_title: Playtex VentAire Advanced Standard Bottle Gift Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: These bottles are great.  My son is 2 1/2 month old and hasn't had any gas bubble that much.  He drinks very good with these bottle.  Just have to remember to put the plastic part down and around on the bottom part of it will leak!

product_title: Evenflo Big Kid Honeycomb Convertible Carseat
review_headline: Boys love it mom love it more
review_body: I ordered this yesterday and received it in the mail today.  WOW fast shipping for standard free shipping.  My 4 1/2 yr old loves the seat and not my 7 year old want it too.  The light are cool, padding is just right, cupholders and everything is just what a kid needs to be safe and cool.  I am here to get another one.

product_title: Infantino 3-in-1 Sling Rider- Black Toile
review_body: I bought this sling recently and I found that it was very difficult to get my 2 month old daughter into.  You have to lay the sling on a flat surface to get the baby in which is difficult enough because of the elastic.
