The harness did not fit on the baby right and getting the thing on me once the baby is in there was a chore in itself.  Plus it was very hot, and nursing with it was not any more discreet than just pulling up my shirt.  The reason I bought this was so I could nurse discreetly in the mall or wherever I was at, but it's not very good for that, so if you're a nursing mom like me, I recommend a good old fashioned blanket over the shoulder.  Also the strap would not adjust to have my baby high enough to nurse, so I ended up having to use both hands supporting the sling. In my opinion, not worth the money or hassle.            Crystal, mother of 2 girls, 5 years and 2 1/2 months

product_title: Summer Infant Ultimate Crib Sheet
review_body: I have two of these and they're really great money saver(if you want to save money and don't want to  buy more than one set of bedding) and time saver(unsnap the soiled one and snap on a clean one while the other is being washed).  They're also extremely convenient(no need to flip, pull and tug at the mattress to change the sheets)I always have one sheet on top of the crib sheet, so from the side of the crib, you can still see the pattern of the sheet, but from top down, you see a white sheet.  It's very soft, and the slight padding seems very comfortable.  Only gripe I have is that it shrinks a little after  coming out from the dryer(I have a Maytag Neptune) even though I was careful to put in on the lowest setting. A great gift for all new parents!

product_title: The First Years Night Cravings Bottle Warmer & Cooler
review_body: I used this when I was first starting out bottlefeeding. The bottles (resusible) weren't getting enough heat, BUT when I decied to try the disposibles, it worked nice. SInce not alot of warmers alow disposibles, it worked great. All though I don;t use them anymore ( she likes diff bottles better) I plan to use it to heat up her baby food.

product_title: Tiny Love Gymini
review_body: This toy would make a great shower gift because it keeps babies occupied and entertained for quite awhile. The black and white patterns are very stimulating for newborns while the hanging toys offer something of interest  to older infants. We highly recommend this toy. And it's washable too!

product_title: JJ Cole Original Infant Bundleme, Snow (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I think it's a great product, quality-wise but I was disappointed that it doesn't cover around the baby's head and neck. Even if you use a hat, the neck area is exposed. If you try to cover the area, the baby's face gets covered which is problematic because it's dangerous and you can't see the baby's face. There are cheaper versions out there that cover everything except the baby's face. I returned this product for one of those.

product_title: Graco Deluxe Prenatal Heart Listener
review_body:
I had absolutly no problems with this product. Everytime my husband and I have used the monitor we have heard the babys heartbeat, without dificulty. Yes we pick up external noise as well at times but that is inherent in the nature of the device.
Personally I believe my money was not wasted. The product performed as the manufacturer stated it would.

product_title: Fisher-Price Flutterbye Mobile (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I bought this mobile for my second son, I absolutely love it it's very entertaining even my 17 month old son likes it too.  I had no problem putting it together and it works perfectly.  I am really happy with it

product_title: NoJo Baby Cover-Up- Blue Plaid
review_headline: YOU MUST GET THIS IF YOU HAVE A WINTER BABY!!!!
review_body: The biggest thing I liked about this cover-up was that I didn't have to jeopardize my newborn's safety in his infant seat by putting bulky clothes on him.  I strapped him in, wrapped a blanket around him, and zipped up the cover-up.  And when we went indoors, or it was warmer out, all I had to do was unzip it!  I also had to unzip it halfway when he was first born because if I zipped it all the way, it completely covered his head.  I never had to worry about him being cold.  You must get this!!!!!!

product_title: Fisher-Price Infant-To-Toddler Rocker in Blue/Red (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My son is 3 1/2 months old and he really loves this rocker/bouncy seat.  I registered for this particular one because my nephew who just turned 2 has the same one, and he still uses it.  I like it because the seat is deep.  I think it is the best value because he's been using it since he was about 4 weeks old and continues to use it.  My only problem is that the toys on all the bouncers seem so close to the baby's face.  My son hates it so I just removed the toy bar.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_headline: A good product to use on the counter
review_body: We picked this tub out because we thought it would grow with our son.  It worked great as long as it was sitting on the counter. Our son got to almost 4 months and he was too long for it and it would pinch his toes, if they slid under the bar.  I tried it as a seat in the bath tub and I couldn't get the suction cups to stick.  It is also a problem because my son can't sit up by himself yet.  I have to wash him with one hand so, I can hold him with the other one.  It is also difficult to pull him out of the seat.  I am looking for another product to buy to replace this one.

product_title: Child Craft Natural Crib with Drawer
review_body: We got this crib for our first child- due this January.  It was slightly complicated to put together, but really not bad at all, especially if you have two people.  It's beautiful, gender neutral, and the drawer underneath is shallow but very wide so it is great for holding LOTS of blankets, small toys, etc.  It feels very sturdy, my husband and I shook it and pressed on it from all sorts of angles and it didn't budge.  The box arrived in really bad shape but the crib was packaged very well and there was not a scratch on it.

product_title: The First Years Night Cravings Bottle Warmer & Cooler
review_headline: Instructions indicates not used for glass bottles!
review_body: I received this bottle warmer a couple of months before I had my daughter, I thought it would be the best thing. I opened it, threw out the box and set it up. All ready. As I read the instructions it states not for glass bottles, we use glass bottles so, what is it good for. The warmer should have a temperature gauge where it gradually get to the point where the bottle was ready. I was not impressed.

product_title: Evenflo Evaporative Cool Mist Humidifier
review_body: ***NOTE FOR FILTER REPLACEMENT****  Yes- Babys R Us stopped carrying this unit (along with the filters) Call the Customer Service number located on the back of the unit. They will ask the model number which is also locate don the back. It really can't get easier than that. We ordered a few to ensure we had one when we needed it.  I bought this humidifier after returning the Vicks Cool Mist because the Vicks left white dust everywhere and leaked water.  The EVENFLO has done it's job well and has not left any dust or water anywhere. I highly recommend this product so far.  It'a louder than some, but the pros outweigh that which to me is the only con. Pros to is are:  The tank is easy to fill and it is also easy to clean.  There is a dial letting you know what stage the filter is in for replacement.  It doesn't leak.  I am very happy with this product. I also suggest buying the thermometer thing that tells you your humidity level- those with mold clearly are not using the product right.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Natural Flow Level 3 Wide Neck Nipple, 3 Pack
review_body: I'm a grandma and taking care of my 5 month old grand daughter.  Her Mom bought the Dr. Brown bottles.  We just love them, but we can't find the inserts that go in  the bottles.  HELP!  Any suggestions?

product_title: Basic Comfort Head-n-Back Sleep Positioner
review_headline: Helps maintain back/side postures for infants
review_body: I got this as a baby shower gift.  It's very useful in keeping infants in the back/side lying positions, and helpig prevent that "flat head" look, with the soft head rest that it provides.  Washing is no problem, and neither is drying it, tho, I dry mine on the low dryer setting.  The only problem that i have is that the velcro wears out after sometime.  But then again, what velcro product doesn't eventually?

product_title: Evenflo Position and Lock Tall Wood Mount Gate (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Evenflo Wire Mesh Gate worked fine for me!
review_body: I am back to order two more of these gates, because for the money, they were the tallest, the best, & the sturdiest I could find. I use them to keep my dogs out of the bedrooms, & also to separate new feline family members from each other until they get used to the others. I do have 2 that will climb up them, & have only knocked them down maybe twice out of dozens of times. Plus, the cats won't fit through the wire mesh, where they do with the flimsier plastic grate models. It's not 100% purfect, but perhaps 95%! And very affordable compared to pet store ones!

product_title: Summer Infant Pacifier Thermometer and Medi-Dispenser (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Don't waste your money on any Pacifier Thermometers. My baby use to gag on it because it is much larger than a newborn pacifier and now that he is dosen't leave it in his mouth long enough (4 minutes) for it to calculate his temperature. Who has time for this aggravation with a sick baby.

product_title: Safari Bedding Collection
review_body: My husband and I chose this nursery set because it's so cute and comes in seperate pieces that were affordable for my shower guests. There are so many pieces that we were able to get, such as the knobs, lamp shade, switch plate, numerous blankets, and more. I just love how the whole room looks in the safari theme. The colors are nice and bright and everything is well made. We are so pleased with this set and would recomend it to anyone.

product_title: Graco Swingomatic Dreamer 6-Speed Infant Swing - 1330DRM
review_body: This swing is great!  The reclining is so handy and the swings six speeds are great.  My little boy loves sitting in the swing.  It is very quiet and the music can be three different levels.  I am very pleased for the price.

product_title: Inclined to Sleep
review_headline: Worked fine for a couple of weeks
review_body: This was a perfect design for our baby when he was a couple of weeks old, but then, as he began to fidget and wiggle, he slid right off of the wedge.

product_title: Monterey Sleigh Crib - White
review_body:
OMG this is \\"THE CRIB TO HAVE\\", pretty, inexpensive, and amazingly easy to put together in 10 minutes FLAT (even if u have an 8 month belly and just desperate to see ur baby crib in the room, lol).
The only down side to this crib, it can be tricky pulling the sides down, and i do have to unhook one latch at the time to bring it down, but i doubt i'll be needing to pull the sides up and down very often other than to change the sheets.
Good luck to all mommys out there and happy shopping :O)

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: We got this chair for a shower gift and our son has loved it from day one.  When he was much younger we would just run the lights, which he loved.  Now at 4 months old he kicks to play the music, and grabs at and kicks the toys.  Best gift we got!  He stays entertained for so long in it!  We have not had the same problems that others had with them, and our son never lost any of his birthweight, just kept gaining, and he still is able to use it perfectly!

product_title: BABYBJORN Original Carrier - City Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I purchased a Bjorn 2 years ago.   The old model was difficult to use.  My son hated being placed in it, therefore I rarely used it.  I received another Bjorn as a gift for my second child.  I was impressed with the redesign.  It is easy to place my baby in it.  He loves it. I use it instead of a stroller.  It is great for grocery shopping,  my 2 year old sits in the cart and I place the baby in the Bjorn.

product_title: Summer Infant Digital Ear Thermometer Set
review_body: I purchased this thermometor for our first child, and have used it several times (tested first on myself).  I find it is almost always within a degree of the oral temperature (and ear thermometors will ALWAYS read about a degree lower than oral).  I am a registered nurse, and have used them a lot in my career; this helped me with technique.  It's important to gently tug the ear lobe down and turn the probe for a snug fit into the canal opening.  If you are unsure of your technique, be sure to bring it to your pediatrician so they can teach you.  I find this product to have very accurate readings when used properly.  I am completely satisified with it's performance!

product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_body: The picture is very deceiving! It looks like it holds a baby that is at least a couple of months old, with his head safely elevated, in a fair amount of water. I've also read reviews that indicate people use this with 5 and 6 month old babies. My 15 pound 10 week old barely fits on it! It was so small, not what I expected at all. It is more of a pillow than a tub. It is also very flat and does not keep the baby very elevated in the tub. It does seem like it may be nice for sponge bathing a new born though.

product_title: 900mhz Attachable Monitor
review_headline: Nice concept, but I've tried 3 and all have been broken.
review_body: I really like the concept of being able to move the child unit since my baby sleeps in different areas of the house and we have had no problems with reception.  However, I have replaced it 3 times now because the charging light on the base of the child unit has always had something wrong.  If I knew the charger was working, I could live with replacing batteries on the parent unit.  But, I figure 3 tries is enough and will be returning this last one for a different brand that hopefully works.

product_title: Medela SoftShells for Inverted Nipples
review_body: These really do work.  I recommend using them before you have the baby though.  I waited, and it was quite an ordeal.  You will save yourself considerable misery if you wear them in advance (but not too far in advance, or you can induce premature labor--talk to your obgyn).

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Works great, no need for expensive refill bags
review_body: I received this as a baby gift and it works great. I have not noticed any smells, and my baby has had some pretty smelly diapers.  It holds more diapers than some of the other diaper pails and has the greatest advantage-- no expensive refill bags.  It uses regular trash bags.  I suggest buying scented trash bags to even greatly decrease the chance of smells.  It is a little tricky to open, but once you figure out how it's not bad.  Just push down on the lever rather than trying to pull up.

product_title: Ambi Toys Ted and Tess Carousel
review_body: My infant was intrigued with the spinning bears on this toy (which will spin for a long time if you keep pumping after initiating a spin).  Now that she is 9 months old she can finally set the bears spinning herself.  It's fun to watch her try to figure out why/how the bears started/are spinning and how to stop them (flipping the toy on its side).

product_title: Safety 1st Deluxe 4-in-1 Bath Station
review_body: Well, like many other people here I too have been cheated by safety 1st.Though the idea seems like a good one,it doesn't work.It worked fine for 2 months.Then it started leaking.I did assemble it properly but there is a fundamental flaw in the design.There is a layer of sponge/foam between the two layers of the tub.This layer of foam is not all that good.Since I used to collapse the tub everyday for storage purpose,it wore out and hence started leaking.new moms-don't buy this tub.It's a loser.

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie Twist-Away Pail System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Please don't give anyone this for a shower gift
review_body: 0 Stars --  The last thing anyone needs is a contraption that rolls poopy diapers into sausage links.  My advice: Put diapers in a garbage can with a liner and lid.  Empty it regularly.  How hard is that????  Someone made a deal with the devil when they invented this thing...why are people drawn to it?  It smells bad and even if you're great at one-handed baby changing, you still have to spin the bag which takes your focus off the baby.  No upside to this thing.

product_title: Baby's Quiet Sounds Video Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I wish I had gotten one of these sooner!  My daughter is 13 months and we just got this a few months ago.  My husband thought it was a ridiculous purchase at first but now he loves it.  You can even see your baby perfectly at night.  We haven't had any problems with the sound, the picture, or with overheating.  Everyone that comes over thinks its the coolest thing and want to get one for their baby.  Highly recommended!

product_title: Philips Avent 3 Pack 9oz Bottles (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I originally used Playtex Ventaire bottles, but had problems with those. My friend recommended these and I couldn't be happier. I will never use another brand. My daughter is an Avent bottle baby for the rest of her bottle days.

product_title: Kids Line Sage Luxe Baby Blanket
review_body: My twin sons just turned 9 months old. They have had these blankets since about 3 or 4 days old and they never leave their sides. We own every color except pink (blue, green, ivory, and yellow) and my boys have these as their \\"blankies\\". They are really security blankets. These blankets are soft and durable. They have an adoring satin trim around them and the material is always soft to the touch. They wash well and my sons really drag them everywhere. They cover them as an actual blanket, and are great for cuddling too. All of our blankets like this one are constantly in use, and I definatly plan on having them around for future children, my sons would be just devistated if they lost \\"blankie\\"

product_title: Baby Trend Playard W/Bassinet & Canopy (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Beautiful playard, don't listen to the negative reviews!!!
review_body:
The negative reviews are all very strange.

First of all, this is a very safe sturdy playard. It has one of the most sturdy bassinet features on the market. We have NOT had a problem with this wobbling, swaying, sagging or collapsing. I have not had a problem with the bottom support leg that is in the middle popping up either. The changing table that swings over the side is also very sturdy. I have rolled this all around my home with not a single problem.

I think the negative reviewers are not setting this up right somehow. Read the instructions after purchasing to put the parts together and for first time set up and take down. It is very important.

This playard has a very nice palm tree theme with the jungle animals, and the colors are a very nice neutral with burgundy and gray and brown. The mobile animals are too cute.

We bought this a month ago, and my 2 month old son loves it! He loves to look at the colorful animals (giraffe, lion and zebra), which are absolutely adorable (unlike the mobiles on the other playards which have the same animal, either lambs or teddy bear heads and are not interesting to look at). He sleeps very well in the bassinet, and when I am changing him on the changing table, he looks at the animals and he smiles at them.

We take this outside with us when we are on the patio, and it is very easy to take down and put back up. It has a nice carry bag that holds ALL the pieces to this playard unlike the Gracos, which do not hold everything in its bag.

This is a very wonderful product, and we are very pleased with our purchase of this item. It is a great playard and has great features (bassinet, flip away changer, organizer, canopy with cute animals, ruffle along the bottom) It is very attractive to look at and for all the features it has compared to other playards with some of the same features, is less expensive.

This is a great safe place for my baby. We love this playard so much, I feel sad for the day he outgrows it. I feel the quality is outstanding.

Hopefully you will not let the negative reviews persuade you to not buy this product. When the reviewers all went out and bought a Graco, they aren't buying anything different in quality, just the more expensive name.utgrows it. I feel the quality is outstanding. Hopefully you will not let the negative reviews persuade you to not buy this product. When the reviewers all went out and bought a Graco, they aren't buying anything different in quality, just the more expensive name.

product_title: Evenflo Portable Ultrasaucer
review_body: We purchased this on-line for our daughter when she was four months old. She liked being upright, but quickly grew tired of the toys. When looking at the saucer before buying it, it looked like there would be a lot of stimulating toys and it would be fun, but actually there isn't a whole lot to do. Most of the "toys" are for chewing on and the spring covers don't do anything. If we had seen it in person we would not have purchased it. I keep it in the kitchen while I prepare meals, but now at nine months she doesn't like to spend very much time in it. We had a lower end Graco version for my son four years ago and it seemed much better. Toys were simpler, but more to do. He was also able to really get it moving - rocking and bouncing. My daughter is only able to bounce in this one. We thought the fact that it folds for travel would be a big bonus, but it is still quite large even when folded, so it stays home. I think this product is okay, but overrated and too expensive for what you get.

product_title: New Kushies Newborn Baby Assorted 6 pc. Diaper Set
review_body: I use disposable diapers but I got some of these as a shower gift.  They make great birp cloths.  They are very absorbent and they keep spit up from running down your shoulder.  The prints are very cute also.

product_title: The First Year's Infant To Toddler Tub with Sling
review_body: I registered for this tub while I was still pregnant, because it was much more reasonably priced than many of the other tubs, and got great reviews.  I have to say, I couldn't be more pleased.  Before our baby's cord stump fell off, the little hammock was great.  It kept her secure, and I could wash her back through the mesh without having to turn her over (if you've never washed a newborn, you'll just have to take my word for it that this is an outstanding feature).  Now that she's bigger, and has to sit inside the tub, she loves it.  It holds her completely comfortably (so she ENJOYS sitting in the bath, rather than screaming through it, as I've been told a friend's baby always does), and the padding keeps her from slipping around.  And it fits perfectly in our sink, which saves my back.  I couldn't possibly imagine a more expensive tub being any better.  I HIGHLY recommend this.

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor w. Sound Monitor w. Two Parents' Units
review_body: I watched my daughter sleep in the hospital and the first few days. This monitor gave me peace of mind and allowed me to rest. She is now 1 year old and the monitor has only alarmed a few times when she's rolled all the way to one end of the bed. I didn't mind the false alarms at all, it just reassured me that the monitor was doing it's job. I'm now getting one for our next baby that is on the way so that they both have monitors on their beds.

product_title: Prince Lionheart Diaper Depot Clear
review_body: Hook it on to the changing table, hook it on to the side of the crib (until you little one starts to stand).  This product is a great tool for any parent.  It is great to just be able to have  a diaper and the wipes in one location.  After the bath it is wonderful having some necessities like q-tips, lotions, powders, etc in the side holders.  This is a must have item for all parents.

product_title: Playtex Diaper Genie - First Refill Included
review_body: I only used this thing for about a week as it always seemed too much of a struggle to actually get it to work.  I then switched to a regular pail which was fine until baby started solids but then we started to have odor problems.  I bought the Neat Diaper Disposal System from safety 1st and love it.  We've never had an odor problem and it's easier to use.

product_title: Baby Einstein Baby Neptune Carrier Toy Bar (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I absolutely loved this item when I saw it in the store but once I got it home and on his carrier i was a little dissapointed.  It is extremely loud and doesn't have volume control and it has to be taken off of the seat everytime you put the baby in or take them out.   Also, the little creatures inside get stuck together which is a little aggrivating.  I love Baby Einstein products but this one didn't impress me.

product_title: Summer Infant Sure & Secure Walk-Thru Gate
review_body: Getting the gate up was a challenge, but the worst part was yet to come.  I have no problems with getting my gate opened, it's getting it closed that is another story.  Everytime I try to close the gate, it seems to slide off out of the position in my doorway unless I use two hands, one to hold the frame still and the other to work the door.  My baby hasn't even come along yet and I can only imagine the problems that will cause.

product_title: Snorepin - Anti Snoring Aid Sleep Device- The Smarter Solution Against Snoring and Sleeping Conditions - Naturally And Effectively Stop Snoring
review_body:
I had bought these before my son was born because I thought that the concept of the bottles was great. I bought almost 12 bottles and opened and sterilized all of them. (I would now recommend that you first see how your baby does with a bottle before opening all of them.) Now I can't return them.
Anyway, I had trouble with the nipple collapsing and the bottoms leaking. It also took my 3 week old almost an hour to take 2-3 oz. of formula. I called customer service and they gave me several recommendations that I think should be in the instructions. I tried everthing they suggested and am still having the same problems. My son is also extremely gassy which these bottles are supposed to prevent.
Whenever I put water in the bottles for traveling they eventually end up slowing leaking out everywhere. I am so frustrated with these bottles and would not recommend them to anyone. I am going to try the Dr. Brown bottles and hopefully they will be better. I have seen only a couple of negative comments on them compared to all of the negative ones I see on these. Hope this helps!

product_title: Philips Avent BPA Free Breast Milk Storage Starter Set, Clear, 6 Ounce, 10 Count (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I love these.  I hated the bags because they always seemed to leak and I could never get them to stand up in the freezer so  I wouldn't have frozen milk all over the place. When the bags did leak the bag would stick to the freezer and I wouldn't be able to use the milk anyway.  I bought these when I had my second child and have used them mainly to store milk but have also used them during feedings.  I have not had any trouble with them leaking. As for the problem with writing and marking off on the container I went to office depot and bought labels which I can peel off after it has been used.

product_title: Safety 1st Perfect Fit Gate
review_body: We have 3 big dogs and this gate works perfectly to keep them in or out. I love that it is secured into the door frame and that it is so simple to open and close!!!

product_title: The First Years: Clear and Near 2.4 GHz Monitor
review_body: We went thru several monitors as well. We got this one and thought we have finally found the one for us. It worked ok for about 6 months. We got frequent static that was so loud you would almost jump out of the bed it was so startling, then it the clarity became terrible. My daughter is 3 so when she calls us from her room all that comes thru the monitor is so distorted it sounds like the teacher from Charlie Brown. I am about to have our 2nd child and I am hoping to find a better monitor this time around.

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor w. Sound Monitor w. Two Parents' Units
review_headline: Wonderful for new parents like me!
review_body: I LOVE this product! My mother and I went to Babies R Us 45 minutes away from my house to pick this up because I was NOT sleeping at night. They tell you to put baby on their side or their backs...but what if baby likes to sleep on their tummy? In my case, my daughter is a tummy sleeper. She stirs too much when on her back and doesnt get a good sleep/eat pattern going. I didnt feel safe putting her on her stomach until I got this moniter because of SIDS. I am scared to death that something will happen to her in her sleep and it would be my fault. So we paid the 100 dollars to get this moniter and have used it two nights in a row already. Both nights she has been able to sleep for three or four hours and wake to eat...then sleep again...just like it should be. The first three nights she would not sleep so I was up for four days straight with her...not a good thing because it caught up to me and now I feel like all I want to do is sleep. I definantly recommend this product to anyone to might be slightly paranoid about the SIDS as I am. It WILL ease your mind tremendously.

product_title: Organizer Nursery Cart
review_body: This is a pretty good organizer.  It wont take heavy bulky stuff, but its good as extra storage.  I use it to store extra diapers, bath stuff and outfits.

product_title: Playtex VentAire Advanced Standard Bottle Gift Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter was an extremely fussy and gassy baby when she first came home.  We tried 4 different bottles and a dozen different nipples and nothing made a difference.  Her doctor recommended we try these.  They have been great.  She eats so much better and doesn't cry after only an oz or 2 as she had been doing.  I agree that it would be nice of there was a stage 2 nipple.  Once she reached about 2 months the stage 1 was to slow but the stage 2 flow was WAY to fast.  To fix this all I did was stretch the stage 1 hole with the tine of a fork before feeding.  I only had to do this a few times with each nipple and haven't had to since (she's 5 months now).  I've never had a problem with leaking and I've been using the same disks for for 4 1/2 months!

product_title: Leachco Safer Bather infant Bath Pad
review_body:
The only reason I give the bath pillow less than 5 stars is because I would have liked a little more padding in the headrest. I still have trouble keeping the water out of his ears. Otherwise, it has been fantastic. My 4 mth old son is SO comfortable during bathtime and just last week he fell asleep during his bath!!!!
I simply lay the pillow in our big tub and just fill with a few inches of water and my son can spread out and not be cramped for space.
The hanging hook is a great idea as well. I just hang it on the shower nozzle to dry in between baths. I've been very pleased with this product and would readily recommend it to other moms.

product_title: MOBI MobiCam System (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I was so excited to find this monitor and after reading the reviews thought it was going to be great!!  However, once I recieved the monitor and tried it at home, I relized that I was not so lucky after all.  The picture and sound was incredible.  The night vision was unreal.. however there was this white line that went thru the picture continuously and caused a static sound.  I tried it at several locations in the house and all had the same result.  So now I am on the search again.

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body: This is the #1 product I recommend to all mothers-to-be!  I love this tub.  My daughter use this until she was 23 months old.  The design is great! I used the one end for infants where they are reclined about 45 degrees until she could sit on her own, and the other end for the next year and a half!  It was so convenient to be able to just put it on top of the kitchen sink and bathe her while standing.  Great for bad backs!  When I was done I would just pull the drain and walk away.  The large size didn't bother me because when not in use, I just hung it in the doorway of the basement.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS TUB!  IT IS WORTH THE FEW EXTRA BUCKS!

product_title: Arms Reach Concepts Original Co Sleeper Blue Str
review_headline: Best thing I received for new baby!
review_body: I originally registered for a traditional playyard/pack and play.  My sister talked me into getting this telling me it was convenient and an absolute necessity.   She was right!  The best thing about it was that the baby was in 'arms reach' any time of day or night while I slept, was safe and at the same time was sleeping right next to me, as I wanted to co-sleep with my new baby.  Being a new mom and breastfeeding was made more than easy with this product.  Using it as a portable is great too, folds up just like others.  I highly recommend this product!

product_title: Classic Pooh Ivory Fitted Sheet
review_body: I received this as a gift (I also received the other colors) and I love that it is well fitted for the crib which is important when thinking about baby safety (SIDS).  The colors and pictures are great and soft to the eyes and my son loves to look at it when he is in prone position.

product_title: Fisher-Price Ocean Wonders Aquarium Cradle Swing (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A cradle swing is a must!
review_body: A fisher price cradle swing is a must. I had one with all 4 of my children. I bought this one new with baby #4 as the first swing was past it's prime after being used A LOT by my older 3 and niece and nephew. The first swing did not have all the bells and whistles this one has but was just as good. I think the mobile and music are just something to waste batteries and break. Like many other reviewers mentioned the mobile and music stopped working. Didn't need anyway. Swing was good enough w/o them. I got many extra hours of sleep with this. I think a cradle swing is a must have, aquarium model or not.

product_title: Dr. Brown's 8 oz. Natural Flow Wide Neck Bottle
review_headline: YOU are probablly making mistakes, the bottles are wonderful!
review_body: At first, I HATED these bottles, although they are GREAT for gassy twins, they were just annoying me so much!    First of all, its more-likely that YOU are doing something incorectly, not the bottle. When you travel with them, you NEED to use the white disk that comes with a purchase of the bottles to keep the liquid from going into the vent and leaking. OR you can purchase the new travel caps, but carrying around the vent and vent insert seperatly was too annoying, so we stick with the white disks. Okay, so that solves the annoying leaks while traveling, but what about making formula? We either (a) use pre-made formula, and just pour it in, or (b) we make a pitcher of formula from powder, and then pour it into the bottles. This saves time, and money (pre-made formula is more expensive). Or if you are expressing breastmilk, you can either (a) shake it in another off-brand bottle, or (b) stir it inside the bottle. You CANNOT shake these bottles, unless you have the white disk in (do not forget to remove it before feeding your baby!). Okay, so that was my mistake as well, but what about CLEANING?! First of all, you do not need those thin brushes they provide, atleast we found a way to work around them. We put the dirty bottle into hot soapy water, whether its 3 minutes after a feeding, or if it has been sitting in my diaper bag for an hour or more. We let them sit for about 10-15 minutes, enough time for me to get the laundry done! Then I use a SPONGEY bottle brush to wipe out the gunk in the bottle, and use a nipple brush for the nipples. The vent and vent insert are just rinsed off, and then we throw em in the dishwasher. They come out beautifully clean, and it really isnt too much work. Also, the wide-neck bottles are easier to clean with a bottle brush, and my boys like the nipple better, so I suggest buying 1 or 2 of each (the wide necks and the regulars) so you can see which your baby prefers. by the way, the reason the nipples on the regualar 8 oz Dr.Browns aredifferent than those on the wide-necks are because they are different styles. Most bottles have a few nipple shapes you can purchase, along with different flow speeds. Thats like what this is, only the two nipples arent interchangable. Oh, dont bother with any bottle lower than8 oz, as they are expensive bottles and the 4 oz ones dont last more than a month or two. These bottles (like many reviewers say) reduce gas, or help with reflux (along with the mycolin drops) and are a true blessing! Maybe they can come out with a lower maitenence bottle, but for now, Dr.Browns rank supreme in gas elimintaion (if your baby isnt really too gassy, try the ventaires, they are pretty good too, but the Dr.Browns are better).

product_title: Baby Trend Diaper Champ (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I've used all types of diaper disposal systems and I've found this one to be the easiest.  I love that you can use any bags with it, and it doesn't take 2 hands to throw away a diaper.  My 6 year old likes it so much, she insists on trashing the diapers for me!  After four months of use, I haven't had any problems with it.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Bottle
review_body: I think the engineering of this bottle system is great, but the nipples are just too small and narrow. My baby would put the whole thing in her mouth and her lips would touch the plastic rim. I never purchased any more after my initial set. I much preferred the Avent bottles and found they were much closer to breast feeding anatomy.

product_title: Basic Comfort Head-n-Back Sleep Positioner
review_body: I bought this product for my daughter.  When it arrived it had a very noxious chemical smell.  Having read in numerous places that this type of smell generally means a plastic product is exuding harmful chemicals, I repeatedly washed it to try to get rid of the smell.  After 10+ washings, the smell was as strong as ever, so I finally returned it.  I do not think it's healthy for a sleeping infant to be exposed to noxious chemical fumes.

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_body:
I got this mobile when my son was born and put it on his crib immediately. From day one that he was in his crib, the music played as he fell asleep. As he got older, I think he associated the music from the mobile with sleeping and it put him right out. If he woke in the middle of the night or too early in the morning to get up, I would just hit the music to start it again, and he would instantly go back to sleep.
We have since removed the mobile portion since he is older now (17 months) however the music part stays on his crib and plays every night as he goes to bed. Its cute to watch and listen as he has learned to turn it on and off. I also bring it with me wherever I go, to ensure my son a good night sleep.
Great purchase, and highly recommended!

product_title: Boppy Luxe - Clouds
review_body: I don't have children yet, but my profession is a photographer, and with infants so little it's sometimes hard to get them in a perfect pose, the boppy is a great tool to get a natural look, you can cover it with a blanket to match whatever you want, so next time you go to get those special memories captured, bring along your boppy and introduce your favorite photographer to the boppy, ( i also prop it up a little if they are on a table, and the camera is fixed ie jcpenney or sears)  Congrats to all and many smiles!!!

product_title: Odorless Diaper Pail by Safety 1st
review_body: I use cloth diapers and have been happy with this pail, especially considering how inexpensive it was. I haven't had any problems with it breaking. Instead of using deodorizers from Safety 1st, I just use deodisks that I buy from places that sell cloth diapers; they're very inexpensive and work well.

product_title: The First Years 2-in-1 Drying Rack (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Super Way to Keep Bottles Clean and Organized!
review_body: We use this with the wide-mouthed Avent bottles and it works great for us.  We can dry 6 bottles at a time, plus the nipples and lids.  It is angled to drain water, which I love, and it holds it's own bottle brush.  I also have the Avent bottle brush and it holds it as well.  I have never had any problem with the holders collapsing.  I recommend it!

product_title: Peg Perego Primo Viaggio Car Seat / Infant Carrier with LATCH Base - Black Sable
review_headline: Nice, but not worth the price.
review_body: It really is not worth the price. It is a nice carseat, I have the black sable, but it has too many drawbacks. The first one being that the fabric makes my son sweat. Even if he is in just a t-shirt, he comes out of the seat drenched. He hates being it, and screams every time we put him in. The second drawback is that it is very small. My son outgrew it in 3 months at 14lbs and 23in long. The third thing I don't like is that you cannot install the carseat without the base...inconvenient if you're going on an airplane and are trying to travel light. The carseat looks good, but you are better of with a Graco Snugride...which is a fraction of the cost of this one, I went out and bought one, and I love it.

product_title: SafeFit Car Seat Grabber in Gray (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This seat cover is a great idea if it were only big enough!  I doesn't cover enough of the seat to protect it.  It in my opinion needs to go higher up on the seat.  I would also caution parents about thinking that there car seat is in tight enough because of the grippers.  make sure even when using this that your car seat moves no more that 1" AT THE MOST in ANY direction!  I would also recomend the Sunshine Kids Mighty Tite to all.  It is a wonderful and easy to use product that will keep your car seat from budging even and inch!

product_title: Metalica Pliko P3 MT Stroller
review_headline: Wow! This is a GREAT stroller!
review_body:
I know what you're thinking...this is an expensive stroller. It is, but it is so well worth it! I haven't seen another lightweight umbrella stroller out there that has all the features this stroller has! My husband and I are pretty picky about baby items. We do tons of research and then when we find the one we think is the right one for us, we do more research...We wanted a stroller that didn't take up too much space in my trunk, was lightweight and wasn't so bulky when strolling through store aisles, etc. We had an Eddie Bauer travel system and that was just way too bulky. It was great for the first few months of our baby's life, we felt he was safe and secure and comfortable, but now that our son is a year old, we wanted something that would fit him just right.
I looked at every store and online and found umbrella strollers that were cheaper, but nothing really compares to the Pliko that we have. This stroller had the tray and cupholder we wanted, it had a large enough basket on the bottom, it has a parent drink holder (which could hold only small drinks or a water bottle), it is lightweight, has an adjustable canopy (which is what won my husband and I over), that can completely cover our son when it either gets too sunny or cold, has the adjustable handle bars, to adjust for taller or shorter people, whichever makes a person comfortable, has a fully reclining seat that is the most simple thing to operate! It clicks into position behind the seat using just one hand, so when baby is sleeping, you won't wake him up! There is padding on the sides for baby's head, so when he does fall asleep or when he just wants to lean to one side, he won't get hurt. It is easy to fold; just click on the sides of the handles and pull on the lever and it locks in place. The maneuverablity is awesome! So lightweight and easy to push! I personally love this stroller, it is something that was well worth the money, since both my husband and I wanted something that would last untilmy son is three. It's pretty stylish, but beyond that, it is a great stroller, with everything that a parent would think of to make life just a little bit easier.

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_headline: Loved it while it lasted... don't throw away receipt
review_body: We live in Okinawa, Japan, and received this from our relatives in the states. Our son loved it from 2 weeks of age, but less than 4 weeks later, it stopped working.  The music plays, but the mobile will not spin.  Tried everything to get it working again, but no success.  We cannot return it from here, since we don't have a receipt and did not keep the packing slip.  I would have given this 5 stars if it worked, but $40 is a lot to pay for a mobile, and not have it work.  I guess we'll continue to use the "music box"  part of it, since we are unable to return it.

product_title: Gerber Premium Feeding System Infant Starter Gift Set
review_body:
I love these bottles!!! Gerber has outdone itself!
I especially love that you can use the same bottles with the pump and then, later down the road, just screw on a transition top (which converts the bottle to a sippy cup) so I won't be buying a whole new \\"wardrobe\\" of cups when it is time to move to sippy cups. I just wonder if Gerber will be selling the transition (sippy) cup tops alone in the near future since the point of being able to use the same bottles for the pump, for feeding, and for transition is moot if every product comes with a bottle...
I feel that a lot of parents might be missing out on learning about these since this bottle set doesn't come up when you search under \\"bottles\\" on the website, though!
Also, I don't understand why there are reviews under this product that are talking about the old, cheap Gerber bottles..

product_title: White Dressing Table
review_headline: DONT WASTE YOUR TIME OR RISK YOUR CHILDS SAFETY
review_body: Gosh how confusing the reviews are for this changing table! I read them all and ordered the table because with twins most our money goes to diapers so I bought this table for the low price.       I'm convinced that you have 50/50 chance of receiving a good table vs. a pile of sticks that do not fit, that have white paint chipping off, and is overall very unstable.       I build airplanes for a living and know that the fit and finish of the table we received is VERY POOR after assembling the table EXACTLY how the directions specify.       We took the rickety changing table to a Target Store here where we live and showed the manager who was in disbelief. He even tried to strengthen the unit by tightening the cams and in the process broken one apart! He apologized that Target sells such an unsafe product and apologized he couldn't accept the return in the store but directed us to send it back by printing out a prepaid return mailer via. Target.com, which we did. Sure glad that saga is over!      I don't know what to tell you folks. Some reviews are good but most are bad or very bad. There are other tables that are much better for a little more $$. As far as this one goes and like my parents used to say...When in Doubt, Throw it Out. Don't risk the time wasting headache my wife and I and others went through by taking a chance on this falsly advertised, unstable, poorly manufactured table. Overall, don't risk YOUR CHILDS SAFETY, it simply IS NOT WORTH IT.

product_title: Safari Bedding Collection
review_headline: Very difficult to locate all items
review_body: I absolutely LOVE this set; however, it is terribly difficult to locate all of it! Only one store in my area even has it in stock, and they don't have everything. I bought the dust ruffle and it doesn't fit on our standard crib- it is an inch too short (not length of the ruffle to the floor, but end to end), I was very disappointed. I adore the &quot;wall hanging&quot; animals, but, not only are they unlisted online, but they are quite hard to find. Once Target sees the popularity of a pattern-they should make a better attempt to make it available; might I suggest a way to locate what local stores have it available to save a multitude of phone calls etc...

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: When my daughter was born she only wanted to sleep on mommy or daddy.  So, we bought this thinking maybe the vibration mode would help her sleep.  And it did!  She would only sleep for about 20 minutes once we put her down in her crib.  But, if we put her in the bouncer on vibrate she would sleep for an hour!  She is 6 months old now and still plays with the toys.  I put her in it so she can watch Baby Bach also!  It is also great to put in the bathroom so you can take a shower and I don't have to worry about her falling out.  I think this is a wonderful purchase and will keep it around for the next child.

product_title: Organizer Nursery Cart
review_body: I registered for this item thinking it would be wonderful for the extra storage as I am having twins.  I have had it for a week now, and thats about as long as I have been working on trying to get it together.  The holes do not fit the screws and the legs do not line up so it looks out of place.  I did read the reviews about this item, and saw some good ones, and thought maybe there are people out there that are too picky!  Not so!!  I can pretty much deal with anything, and if was able to get it together would have overlooked the legs, and cheaply made snaps.  The last thing I will need is this falling apart while I am at home caring for 2 infants.  I am re-boxing it, and taking it back, hoping they will have some compassion.  It was also purchased online and the box came in damaged, luckily, there was nothing cracked, or course until I started screwing things into the wood.  Please take it from me and do not buy this.  I have put everyother item together in an hour, it should not take you weeks and weeks to do this!!  Ill find something else, and Im surprised target would sell it.

product_title: Recalled Item: Metro Lite LE Stroller - Plaid
review_body:
This was my first child and not knowing what or where to begin.
So this was my third stroller before she reached the age of two.
She's a big girl and it's comfortable and roomy for her.
I love that it's easy to fold, great color, lightweight, cupholders for mommy and baby, front bar opens for easy entry for toddlers. I'ts a great purchase and well worth every penny.
LOOK NO FURTHER!!! YOU FOUND IT!!!!

product_title: Baby's Quiet Sounds Video Monitor (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This monitor is horrible.  I just put my daughter in her crib tonight for the first time.  She is three months old.  All I see is fuzz and all I hear is static.  It makes me dizzy just looking at the thing.  With all the technology out there can't they come out with something better.  This will not help me get a good nights sleep because i'll be checking up on her all night long. I only give it one star because I can hear her making noise if she gets up.

product_title: Snugli Front and Backpack - Carrier (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I did so much research before I put anything on my registry. I had my son on March 6 and have been using this since he was about a week old.  My husband is a huge \\"outdoor\\" kind of guy who takes about a year to decide on anything because he needs to read every review known to man. He's the first one to be critical of the smallest things but this carrier is so impressive to him (and his favorite thing of everything from the shower)! All the straps make it very safe (and extremely comfortable for both daddy and baby). It allows you to carry the baby in several positions which is great. This carrier is definitely recommended... our baby either falls right asleep in it or just looks at the world around him while \\"snuggling\\" against his daddy's chest. =) A must have!

product_title: Philips AVENT Infant Feeding Set
review_body: We returned the Avent bottles and bought more Playtex VentAire bottles instead.  Isaiah is 3 mo's old and he has used Stage 2 nipples from birth.  He enjoys drinking from the Playtex VentAire much more than Avent or other brands.  We believe it is because Playtex's venting allows him to suck without encountering increasing resistance and needing to break his seal for the bottle to backfill with air.  The Avent do seem like they would look newer longer but looks aren't everything.

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_body: When my daughter was in the NICU for two days post-birth, a baby in the crib near her had this toy.  It worked perfectly, and my husband and I could see just how stimulating and varied the toy was.  It jiggles, it wiggles, it plays 15 minutes each of different classical composers -- marvelous!  We quickly went out and bought one for our own daughter.  Alas, the one we brought home had a horrible, grinding squeak.  We tried to WD40 it, but to no avail.  Friends who also bought the same mobile had the same problem.  We used it anyway -- the grinding squeak wasn't that loud, and our daughter loved to watch it go round and round.  Now that she's older, we've snipped the stuffed animal portions off and she plays with them in her crib.  Also, it is designed to become "just" a music box when children are too old for mobiles, and that is what it has become -- minus the squeak!  I do highly recommend this toy so long as you don't mind having to possibly return one or two defective ones.  As someone else noted -- the company's quality control could be a lot better.

product_title: Dex Products Travel Wipes Warmer
review_body: This isn't a nessecity but it sure was nice to have bc my daughter screamed at the top of her lungs whenever we wiped  her behind with a regular baby wipe. After we put it in the warmer she didn't scream, so I think it was actually soothing to her to have her butt wiped when the wipe was warm. The only problem is, is that the case is pretty heavy to carry in a diaper bag. It does it's job well though, keeps em' warm. It works in the car too which is good bc we take a lot of road trips out of state. I like this product bc i clean my face with baby wipes so it is sort of getting a facial after the wipe is warm lol!!!

product_title: Evenflo Cool Mist Humidifier
review_headline: 30 yr old technology in a new box
review_body: Our toddler needed a humdifier, we borrowed one from grandma, it was loud and a had seen better days. We bought this Evenflow product and it used the same basic technology and was LOUD... it also drenched the carpet... even though it was raised up on furniture. What a horrible product. We actually unplugged it about 1:AM because we couldn't take it anymore. We have since found another product that uses a conventional fan, is quiet and sends the water into the air without the mess. If you could rate a negative star we would have.

product_title: The First Years Reclining 3 Stage Feeding Seat (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: Put this one on your registry!
review_body: I recommend this seat b/c it is handy when you don't have your highchair around.  We've taken it on vacation with us and it is just so perfect and portable. I recommend putting this item on your registry; you really can't go wrong. It is a little cheesy by being light & plastic, but truthfully, you really don't need a highchair if you have this seat.

product_title: Medela Nursing Stool Natural #61082
review_body: I nursed my baby in a glider without a stool for a few weeks. I didn't think I needed to spend money on a stool. However, after enduring the lower back pain that ensued as a result, I caved in & bought this stool. It's been well worth the buy! No more back pain. I now nurse my baby comfortably. The stool was easy to assemble & is the perfect height for me (I'm 5'2\\"). I am very happy with this stool.

product_title: Summer Infant Newborn-To-Toddler Bath Center & Shower (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: While this is a bit picky I still love it.  The shower works great as long as you don't overfill it.  We had a little trouble with it spraying the second time but my husband just created suction by sucking on the shower head and it worked fine after that (a little strange but it worked!).  I love that the tub can be used until she can fit in the big tub as well.    This is my old review.  Now I wish I could change the number of stars.  The shower has long since found its way into the garbage.  The bathtub is OK.  The sling tends to let the baby slide down it, I'd really prefer one that cradles them more.  But it still works after 3 children so the tub really is fine (really, you don't use the sling THAT long anyway) but the shower was a piece of junk.

product_title: The First Years: 4-Stage Bath System
review_body: My newborn used to scream when we put her in this.  There was no way to keep a good grip on her and make her comfortable.  I thought at first that maybe she just didn't like baths.  Then, I bought a bath tub w/ a sling in it.  She LOVES that one and it is MUCH safer.  For a newborn, but a tube w/ a sling.

product_title: Fisher-Price Step & Play Piano
review_body: We purchased this for our son who's 7 months old now.  He and his 2 year old brother have a great time with it.  We like that it gives the benefits of a walker, by sliding back and forth, without the dangers of the free mobility that a walker offers.  We also have had problems with his thighs getting scratched by the sharp plastic corners under the seat.  However, as stated in some of the other reviews, if you take your time removing your child from the toy, there isn't really a problem.  I couldn't figure out why so many people were giving this 5 stars even though they too had the problem with their child getting scratched.  Now that I'm writing the review, I see that Amazon only offers ratings on Fun, Educational Value and Durability.  Well, it's fun, I guess he's learning something so it's educational and we left it out overnight on the deck in the rain once and it still works great, so it gets 5 stars for durability from me!  I think Amazon should incorporate a safety type rating as well.  The manufacturer doesn't always put out the safest toys!

product_title: Navy Eddie Bauer Weekender Diaper Bag
review_headline: Plenty of room and comfortable on shoulder
review_body:
This bag has plenty of room and compartments for a trip out with baby. It's also a comfortable fit to carry over the shoulder (I tried them all in the store and this one felt the best to me and hubby, and after using it I still feel that way). We had also considered the back pack model, but felt this one had more room. I am pleased with having chosen this one over the backpack, because when out and about with baby in the stroller, I can put the diaper bag under the stroller in the storage basket or I can hang the strap over the stroller handles and leave room for other things in the basket. The back pack doesn't have long enough straps that I could have done this.

The only change I would recommend to the makers is to nix the attached diaper changing pad and opt for a detachable one. Depending on where I am changing my son, the attached pad is not so convenient. It's not such a problem that I would want another bag though.

product_title: Fisher-Price Baby Papasan (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My daughter loved this seat from her first day home! It's cozy and would fit her perfectly (just make sure to use the straps) Her Aquarium bouncer seat is just too big for newborns and offers little neck support.  She would sleep for hours in this cozy little seat!  Now that she is 2 months old, she doesn't like it as much as her swing. I still use this papasan seat to keep her near while I am in the shower and most of the time she will stay happy in it. Now that she is getting bigger, I think we will start using the Aquarium bouncer soon (it offers more stimulation).

product_title: PRIMO EuroBath, Pearl White
review_body:
This is a really great tub at a great price! The first tub we purchased was by Safety 1st--it came with a padded fabric liner that is slanted, which at the time, I thought would be great for support and security. WRONG! My son kept slipping into the water, leaving me one free hand while I supported his head with the other. Not to mention, the liner had to be washed and dryed after each use to prevent mildew. The Primo tub keeps baby stable so you can use both hands to bathe with. My son who is now 4 months, enjoys kicking and splashing, as the Primo tub allows you to fill the water level high enough, whereas the other tubs feel more like a sponge bath.
The only drawbacks I can think of are: the drain is hard to release; we usually end up tipping the tub into the sink to empty. Also the tub itself is rather large and harder to store when not in use. And finally, it can provide a false sense of security, since baby doesn't slip into the water, one might have the urge to turn away to get a towel or soap, etc. NEVER leave baby unattended in water! OK, I'm off my soapbox--otherwise, it's a great tub--HIGHLY recommend!!!

product_title: Baby Night Sight Value Pack Remote Control Light and Mirror Set
review_headline: Mirror is too small.  NOT Recommend for Leather Seat.
review_body: When we first bought it home and tried it.  The remote for the light doesn't work very well.  But we tried it again the next day, it seems to work alright. Mirror is way too small and it is hard to attach to the seat especially Leather seat.  Considering keeping the remote light kit & buying another bigger mirror or return the whole thing and just go with the regular mirror instead.

product_title: ExerSaucer Mega Active Learning Center
review_body: I bought this for my daughter when she was 4 months old.  She loves to try and stand & can move around in a circle.  She is also a big teether and chews on all the toys.  Its easy to clean and when I go to visit friends or relatives I just fold it up and toss it in the trunk.

product_title: Peace of Mind Two 900 Mhz Baby Receivers, Monitor
review_body: Although the monitors let me hear the tiniest sound my baby makes, there is CONSTANT background noise.  No matter where I place the receiver, we hear a light click about every 5 seconds.  Then there are frequent light bursts of static for a few seconds.  And LOUD bursts of static that act like an alarm clock.  I would not recommend these monitors - it is very hard to sleep with all the noise.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_body: Our son loves this seat and has since he was a couple days old. He loves to see the lights and hear the sounds as he kicks. As he gets older (he's 4.5 months now), he gets more and more use out of this chair. I like the convenient way you swing the play bar out of the way (leave the circle side in and remove the square and it swings off to the left). Great way for baby to spend time when I have to get dinner on the table.

product_title: Symphony-In-Motion Mobile
review_body: I love this mobile.  It is something my daughter, who is two months old, is fixated on whenever I turn it on.  While it is not a mobile that would put her to sleep, it is one that will help her development and keep her entertained.  She smiled and cooed the first time my husband and I turned it on for her!!  It is great to sit there and watch her, watch it.  It is more expensive than some mobiles, but it is well worth the money!!  I highly recommend it for anyone looking to enhance their baby's development.

product_title: Baby Martex - In Flight Wall Border
review_body: I absolutly love the Baby Martex In Flight nursery set.  However, this is the poorest quality border I've ever used in all my life!  Not only does it not want to stick (no matter what you do), but it is expensive to boot.  My husband and I had to spring for additional glue just to get it to stay on the wall.

product_title: Safety 1st Deluxe RollerShade 2-Pack
review_body: It works fine, and I like that it has 2 ways to install:  either attach via an adhesive (which I don't like to do to my car's windows), or clip at the top of the windows.  Another nice thing is:  when you don't need the shades covering the windows (like at night), you can roll them up out of the way without having to detach altogether.  They work.  On the downside:  they don't cover the windows fully.  and when attached by the clips, the windows are open by a few millimeters and may create a slight wind noise when driving at higher speeds.  Hardly noticeable, but worth mentioning per my husband.  Despite those details, we feel they were worth it and don't regret buying them.

product_title: Playtex Premium Nurser Newborn Gift Set (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: This is a great bottle set for my newborn.  He is now 2 months and we are still very pleased with them.  I don't have anything bad to say about them.

product_title: Jumpster Doorway Jumper - Jackpot
review_headline: The best thing to register for!
review_body: Once our little boy was 3 1/2 mos, we tried putting him in this; he wasn't sure what to do then but now he is now 4 mos and LOVES it. He jumps all around by himself and is smiling the whole time. I haven't had any troubles with finger pinching or anything else that folks mentioned. I highly recommend this toy. This is much better and cheaper than the exersaucer and he likes it a lot more!

product_title: Fisher-Price Baby Papasan (Discontinued by Manufacturer) (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: We received this as a shower gift along with the swing that goes with this.  I thought my daughter would love it, but she seems very bored in it.  I am going to have to get another bouncy seat.  It doesn't really do much.

product_title: Philips AVENT Express Baby Food and Bottle Warmer (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I got this product, it worked ok but within 30 days it broke.  I dont recommend this product!!!

product_title: Sunshine Kids Mighty Tite (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body:
Ok, I have read most of the reviews on this item. But first let start from the beginning.

I came across the mighty tite while buying a second carseat. I thought I would try it out just to see since carseats can be a pain. I found it easy to use and very secure. Also worth the price. I was so happy with it I went to buy another one but they were sold out.

Just out of bordem I thought I would search online, maybe get a cheaper price, and here I am. I read the reviews and found out very quickly that I needed to give my carseat more effort. I went outside and did my carseat with all my effort I had at 2:00 am and found the car seat was perfectly tight without the mighty tite.

I still don't know where I stand. Everyone has made great points but in the end I feel like this. If an extra device has to be used to safen a safety product, something is being overlooked. In my case it was just time and effort I was putting in...my carseat is great!!! go evenflo triumph 5!!...{{shameless plug!}}.

Before you buy the mighty tite make sure YOU have done EVERYTHING you can to make it the seat tight. We dont pay hundreds of dollars on them for nothing. And also make the decision for you and your child. If it gives you peace of mind good for you, but I can't ignore my gut feeling.

product_title: Gossamer Wings Embroidered Fleece Blanket by Kidsline
review_body: This beautiful blanket completes our Gossamer Wings collection.  You'll be very satisfied with this purchase.

product_title: Roundabout Convertible LATCH Car Seat - Denim
review_body: If you're interested in saving some $$$ check out babycatalog.com. I'm buying the same car seat from them for only $179.

product_title: Dekor Diaper Plus Diaper Disposal System
review_body: I used a friend's Diaper Genie before my son was born and was amazed (read <disgusted>) at the amount of twisting needed to get the dirty diaper in there!  This Diaper Dekor system is easy to use and I don't have to wrangle the diaper to fit.  The foot pedal makes it easy while I keep a hand on the baby, and it is simple to change the bag.  The top keeps odors inside, all around a great system.

product_title: Roundabout Convertible Car Seat - Grey Wicker
review_headline: I would pay 10x more for the saftey if need be!
review_body:
I have four children, three of which are still in carseats (2 1/2 year old, 11 month old twins) I love the roundabouts, they are safe and comfortable, for toddler, baby or even a newly born baby!

At BRU we were possitive that we would purchase two more Triumphs, they werent too expensive, and were safe. But once we heard about the roundabouts, we KNEW we had to get them. They looked great (contimplated purchasing three actually, until we realized our daughters triumph was fine) and they were rated HIGHLY in crash test ratings... So we have 2 different brands of carseats in our car, but for saftey you cant beat it!

We have used these seats since DAY ONE with the twins, with our daughter we used the Triumph since she outgrew her carrier. Its easy to install with the LATCH system (assosiate at BRU installed it) or easy to install without (I have to do that when switching carseats from my car which has LATCH to my husbands which doesnt). Either way the carseat is adjusted to fit very tightly and securely. It has NEVER ruined the leather seats in my mini van, or the fabric seats in my husbands explorer. They are easy to adjust the settings of the straps and they can even be held out of the way by two pieces of velcro on the sides of the carseats (dont irritate the boys though) The roundabout grows with baby up to 45 lbs... thats your average four year old, but if your willing to spend more, the Marathon (also by Britax) holds up to 65 lbs. The seats fabric is plush, comfortable, easy to wipe up, and easy to take off and put in the washing machine. I love the ease of moving it to different cars, and I ADORE how safe they buckle in!

Its not a question over price, but rather one over saftey... The roundabout ensures that your baby will be safe in the car, so choke hard on the price tag and purchase one for your precious cargo.

product_title: TOT-Co Toilet Trainer
review_body: We bought this because my neighbors daugher loved it. My son thought it was neat but had a very hard time peeing in it without it spilling all over the place. the splash guard does not stay in very well at all. It's not big enough to stop pee. I gave it to a friend of mine who had a girl. I do not recomend this toilet for boys.

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Bottle
review_body: My baby was 6 weeks premature and had difficulty breastfeeding.  The problem was compounded with the bottles the NICU used to feed her - the nipples were fast flowing so my baby got lazy and didn't want to suck very hard to get her meal.  When I got her home I continued to practice breastfeeding with her and then used the Dr. Brown's bottle to feed her.  After only three days she developed the sucking skills and strength to breastfeed.  The Dr. Brown's bottles are wonderful because the Level 1 nipples simulate the flow of breastfeeding and the bottle reduces bubbles by pushing air to the back of the bottle.  The only drawback is the extra parts you'll need to clean - small price to pay if you're having breastfeeding problems!

product_title: BébéSounds Angelcare Movement Sensor Blister Package
review_body: I just got this monitor last night, but what a difference it made .  My daughter is almost 5 months old and has just started refusing to sleep on her back or her side.  With the only way she sleep is on her tummy  I was very worried about her breathing.  I would be up numerous times checking to see if she was still breating, even though she was still in our room. After a month of sleepless nights worring, i bought this monitor. I was amazed at the difference and how sensitive it is.  I woke up a few times still, but this time all I had to do was look and see the flashing green light telling me that she was still moving.  I sure slept much better knowing that if she did stop breating the alarm would go off.  It's great to have that peace of mind.

product_title: Open Top Swing - Rockwell Plaid
review_body: This is a great product!  My son loves sitting in his swing.  We put 4 "C" size batteries in when he was born and haven't had to change them yet! (he's now 4 months old and uses it ALOT!) I would reccommend this swing to everyone. It reclines far enough back to sleep and sits up straight.  We bought a suction cupped toy to attach to the tray and he loves batting at it while he swings.  We also attached the Peaceful Planet Aquarium to the side of it and he listens to the fish as he falls asleep.  Definately worth it!!

product_title: Big Top Mobile
review_body: We had absolutely no problem assembling this mobile...I believe it took all of two minutes.  It attaches to the crib easily with no scratching (we bought a cherry wood crib which easily shows scratches).  This is definitely a must have if Big Top is your theme.

product_title: First Years Premium Single Electric Pump
review_body: I bought this pump before I asked a lactation consultant to recomend one.  It somewhat worked but it was extremely painful. I could express just as much just as fast with the Avent hand pump.  I was actually brused from the 'easy comfort' pump!!  My lactation consultant said she would not recomend this pump because everyone she knew that used it had a similar experience.  I sent it back!

product_title: Fisher-Price Royal Potty (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: I have 2 of these for my twin boys. The music runs the batteries out pretty quick so we don't even keep them in. The good things are: the guard for boys, the easy to remove bowl, the high back, and the side arm rests. The bowl is easy to remove so after each potty I empty the bowl into the big potty to flush it away which has encouraged them to use the big potty to \\"put it away\\" themselves. It has never leaked; sometimes they miss the guard so pee completely misses the potty but that's not the potty's fault. The top potty part is extremely easy to use when put on the real toilet. On and off in seconds. I just think the hole should be bigger, we've had some trouble with poopy but if you make sure your kids sit all the way forward it should be okay.

product_title: Fisher-Price Papasan Cradle Swing - Nature's Touch N1973 (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: My Dad bought this for us as a Shower gift.Our little girl absolutely loves it (so does hubby) . I love the option that she can swing back and forth and side to side. My daughter loves the little bird musical also and the sounds are great. The seat is the best , it is perfectly shaped. The head rest pillow is not the greatest,but it does adjust. I would recommend this highly to everyone, in fact I have -everytime I see someone at store looking at swings I tell them how great the Baby Papasan is. The price is about average as the other swings I looked into. My daughter is 4 mos old now and has been in this swing from day 1 when we bought her home. This product has been a life saver. The motion and the position baby is rocked puts her to sleep- which is the best. Fisherprice really outdid themselves when they marketed the Baby Papasan- I also love the name and the color is great too.

product_title: Peg Perego Venezia SNG Carriage / Stroller - Chesapeake
review_body: we checked out all models at BRU before choosing this one. it just seemed to be a smoother ride and well-built. the other strollers felt flimsy. some features i really like are the reversible/adjustable handle, the large basket, and real rubber wheels, not scratchy plastic ones. i also like the large hood and the boot came in handy as my son was a winter baby. the 5 point harness is a plus as is the extended foot rest. the fabric is easy to clean and the hood is fairly water-resistant (we got stuck in a downpour and made that discovery). when folded it stores pretty compactly standing on its own. the ride is very smooth, especially over bumpy sidewalks. i will say that the harness has gotten stuck a few times as we unfolded the stroller, but if you're careful it can be avoided. the one thing that made me give it 4 stars instead of 5 was that it does not seem to sit fully upright-there's always a slight recline. this has been a problem, especially now that it's cold out and my son has to wear a heavy coat. he seems to slide down into the seat. but all in all, i really do like the product and would definitely recommend it to parents who do a lot of walking. i know it's expensive but in the 15 months we've been using it, the stroller is in excellent shape. you'll get your money's worth.

product_title: Sound N Lights Monitor with Dual Receivers
review_body: Did I say Static? I am on the second monitor, thinking something was wrong with the first one. Nope, still the same static roar as the first. it works as long as you are holding it. Put it down and you cannot hear anything. I am taking it back again and this time I will have a total different monitor. Like the clear and near. This was an absolute waste of time.

product_title: Baby Einstein - Melody and Motion Activity Toy
review_body: My 5 month old son loves this toy. When wound up it plays music and slowly rolls around. My son loves to follow it. He's not quite crawling, he more 'inchworms' around, so this toy is perfect...it rolls at just about his pace.

product_title: Fisher-Price Kick & Play Bouncer - 79636
review_headline: GREAT PLACE FOR INFANT TO SLEEP
review_body: I REALLY DONT HAVE ANY COMPLAINTS AS OF YET, THE REASON I DID NOT GIVE THE BOUNCER 5 STARS IS BECAUSE AT 1 MONTH MY SON REALLY DOES NOTHING BUT SLEEP IN IT. THE VIBRATING HOWEVER DOES COME IN HANDY BUT THE ATTACHMENT WITH TOYS IS TO CLOSE TO HIM FOR HIM TO FOCUS AND IN ORDER TO USE THE KICKING FUNCTION YOU MUST HAVE THE FRONT ATTACHMENT ON. I AM SURE WHEN HE GETS A FEW MONTHS OLDER HE WILL BE ABLE TO ENJOY THE FULL BENEFITS OF THE BOUNCER. BUT IT IS A GREAT PLACE FOR HIM TO SLEEP FOR NOW.

product_title: Eddie Bauer Wooden High Chair
review_body: We love this high chair! It's great! There are only 2 little problems... it's kind of hard to move on carpet and the seat cushion doesn't have enough \\"cushiness\\" for my son's head. Other then that it's exceptionally made and wonderful! It took all of 5 mins to put it together and it's been so great both grandparents have one in their homes! Recomended to anyone looking for an heirloom wooden highchair!

product_title: The First Years Night Cravings Bottle Warmer & Cooler, Blue/White
review_body: This item did not work for me at all. It would either warm up the bottles too much or not at all. I would use the proper amount as sugggested to warm up my 4 oz bottles, but they would end up extremly hot so I would have to spend some more time cooling them. Then I tried warming up the 6oz bottles and it wouldn't warm them up at all. I'm not sure if I used either too much water or what.. i just never figured it out. Also, the bottles weren't really kept cool. I did fill up the plastic container with water and froze it.. its just that around 5am the water in the container was a room tempature at that point the bottle didn't need to be warm up at all.. may be I over reacted.. but I'm a first time mom and i just felt uneasy about the bottles being at room tempature. Anyways, finally I gave up and bought the Munchkin Healthflow Deluxe Bottle and Food Warmer and it works great!!

product_title: Dr. Brown's Original Bottle, 8 Ounce, 3-Pack
review_body: I bought these bottle and Evenflo bottles when my son was born.  What a big difference.  With the Dr. Brown's my son had no problems with gas, burping, or anything.  They have more parts to clean, but it is a small price.  With the Evenflo bottles he kept gulping it to fast and would choke, he had the hiccups a lot and you could here the bottle making a \\"vacuum\\" noise.  After just two days, I threw away the Evenflo's and bought more Dr. Brown's and have had no problems.  My son had not problems going from breast to bottle.  Best buy ever.

product_title: Recalled Item: MetroLite Travel System - Carmel
review_body: All Snugride Infant Car seats from 1999 to February 28, 2002 were recalled.  I believe that this Travel System all comes with that same infant carseat.  Please be aware.

product_title: BABYBJORN Original Carrier - City Black (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_headline: A must have for every new parent!
review_body:
Ok, ok....I know what you're thinking....this carrier is EXPENSIVE!!! I once felt the same way, but after purchasing this carrier for our little Princess Amanda,let me tell you, it is well worth the money.
As most new parents do, we bought a stroller for our baby. As a matter of fact we bought a whole travel system, which includes the convience of a carseat that you can pop into the stroller, so as not to wake a sleeping baby after a long car ride. From day one, our little girl has not liked her travel system at all! I was about at wits end, since I frequently go on outings to the mall, grocery shopping, AYSO soccer games etc. What was a mother to do?
I looked at the reviews for the Baby Bjorn. In most every case, it got a RAVE! I figured that all of these parents couldn't be wrong! So, I took the plunge and purchased one, basicly thinking that if it didn't work out, I could always return it for a full refund.
When you 1st take the carrier out of the box, it can look very confusing. After reading and then re-reading the directions, and trying the carrier out without the baby in it, I got the hang of putting the carrier on.
Then the real test came, would Amanda like the carrier? Would it be easy to put her in? Well, let me tell ya... she LOVES this carrier! Amanda likes being held, and this carrier provides a way that we can hold her and manage to get other things done. We have gone on quite a few outings with it, and Amanda either falls asleep or she looks around in amazement at all the different sights. Amanda is now 11 pounds, and the carrier feels great on my back. I purchased the extra large version, me being a Big Gal and my hubby being a large man, and it works beautifully!
Please, give the Baby bjorn a try. It may seem pricey, but if you break it down, say you use it 10 times and have great results, you've paid only dollars per use. In the end, it is so worth every single penny!
